description: Shrub, 2-3 m tall. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with yellowish, stellate scales 0.1-0.4 mm in diam. Petioles 2-4 mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm in diam. Lamina elliptic-ovate to narrowly ovate, (5-)7-10(-12) cm long, (2-)3-5 cm wide, leaf index 2-2.5(-2.9), coriaceous, dark shiny green above, green below, rather densely covered with whitish, stellate hairs 0.5-0.7 mm in diam. above, glabrous with age (primary vein permanently covered with stellate hairs), rather densely (to sparsely with age) covered with yellowish to whitish, stellate scales 0.1-0.7 mm in diam. below, base rounded to obtuse (or acute), apex acute to acuminate (acumen 5-10 mm long), primary vein impressed above, secondary veins curved, (8-)10-14(-16) on either side of primary vein, slightly raised above, angles with primary vein (60-)65-80(-90)°, loop-forming at right angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 2.5-5 mm, tertiary veins slightly raised on both sides. Inflorescences among leaves, leaf-opposed, a single rhipidium, 1-2-flowered, to 5 flowers in succession. Indument: pedicels and outer side of bracts, sepals, and petals totally to rather densely covered with stellate scales 0.3-0.7 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and petals totally covered with stellate hairs 0.50.8 mm in diam., inner base of petals glabrous. Peduncle 5-8 mm long, 3 mm in diam. Sympodial rachis to 4 mm long. Pedicels 5-15 mm long, 1-3 mm in diam., fruiting pedicels to 17 mm long, to 4 mm in diam. Upper bract halfway the pedicel, shallowly triangular, 2-3 mm long. Flower buds very broadly ovoid. Flowers yellowish green in vivo, inner base of inner petals deep crimson. Sepals connate for 15-25%, (broadly) triangular to (broadly) ovate, 11-15 mm long, 8-11 mm wide, acute to mucronate. Petals subequal, rhombic-elliptic to elliptic, 14-22 mm long, 9-12 mm wide, acute to mucronate, inner base of inner petals callóse, strongly grooved. Stamens 1-1.5 mm long, color unknown, apex of connective shallowly to very shallowly pyramidal, distinctly umbonate, 0.2-0.4 x 0.7-0.8 mm, densely covered with simple hairs. Carpels (as counted in flower) 120-150, 2-3 mm long, ovary rather densely covered with stellate hairs, stigma sparsely so. Fruit greyish-green in vivo, globose, ca. 3 cm in diam., basal collar composed of 10-14 connate, sterile carpels, 4-6 mm in diam., not protruding below the fruit, fertile carpels ca. 80, obovoid to obtrulloid, 11-13 mm long, 69 mm in diam., fused for 25-35%, apical free parts spacing 1-2.5 mm apart, areoles depressed trulloid, 56 mm high, irregularly grooved, with a 0.5-1 mm long, woody, curved apicule, densely covered with stellate scales and stellate hairs 0.1-0.3 mm in diam. Seeds ellipsoid, 9-11 mm long, 5-6 mm in diam., obtuse to rounded, brown to reddish brown.

description: Tree, (3-)5-20 m tall, to 15 cm in diam. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with stellate hairs 0.1-0.5 mm in diam. Petioles 5-10 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam. Lamina elliptic to obovate to narrowly so, 14-26 cm long, 5-9 cm wide, leaf index 2.5-4.2, chartaceous, greyish green above, brown below, sparsely covered with stellate hairs to 0.3 mm in diam. when young above, becoming glabrous, sparsely (to more densely so along primary vein) covered with stellate hairs to 0.3 mm in diam. below, base attenuate, apex long-acuminate (acumen to 25 mm long) to subacute, primary vein impressed above, secondary veins straight, 8-12 on either side of primary vein, raised above, angles with primary vein 60-75°, loop-forming at obtuse angles, loops distinct, smallest distances between loops and margin 3-7 mm, tertiary veins raised above. Inflorescences among leaves, leaf-opposed (to supra-axillary), a single rhipidium, 1-2-flowered, to about 10 flowers in succession. Indument: peduncles, pedicels, outer side of bracts, and both sides of sepals and petals totally to densely covered with stellate hairs 0.1-0.3 mm in diam., most parts with brownish hairs, but petals with greyish hairs. Peduncle 3 mm long, 2 mm in diam., fruiting peduncle to 5 mm long, to 3 mm in diam., strongly and somewhat irregularly grooved. Sympodial rachis to 10 mm long. Pedicels 7 mm long, 1.5-2 mm in diam., young fruiting pedicels to 11 mm long, to 3 mm in diam. Upper bract halfway the pedicel, ovate-triangular, 2-A mm long, caducous. Flower buds ovoid. Flowers pale cream in vivo. Sepals free, ovate, 8-10 mm long, 6-8 mm wide, obtuse. Petals subequal, ovate-triangular, 12-15 mm long, 6-8 mm wide, acute, inner base of inner petals callose, distinctly grooved. Stamens ca. 1 mm long, color unknown, apex of connective discoid, 0.2 x 0.4 mm, glabrous. Carpels 2-2.5 mm long, ovary totally covered with stellate hairs, stigma glabrous. Fruit (only young ones seen) yellowish green to brown in vivo, globose, 2.5-2.8 cm in diam., basal collar composed of 9-15 connate, sterile carpels, not protruding below the fruit, 8-10 mm in diam., fertile carpels 30-50, obovoid to obtrulloid, 9-12 mm long, 5-8 mm in diam., free, areoles depressed ovoid, 2-6 mm high, acute to obtuse, apiculate (apicule to 0.5 mm long), polygonal to rounded, surface wrinkled, totally covered with a velutinous, brownish indument of stellate hairs up to 0.1 mm in diam. Seeds ellipsoid, 6 mm long, 4 mm in diam., obtuse, brown, shiny.

description: Tree, (2-)5-25 m tall, 8-20 cm in diam. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with pale brown, subentire (the many, large ones) to stellate (the few, small ones) scales 0.1-0.5 mm in diam. Petioles 3-7 mm long, 23 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly elliptic to obovate, 15-27(-32) cm long, 6-9(-10) cm wide, leaf index 2.53.2, chartaceous, greyish green, often slightly shiny above, dull grey to dull pale brownish grey below, glabrous above, totally to sparsely covered with pale brownish-grey stellate (the few, small ones) to subentire (the many, larger ones) scales 0.1-0.5 mm in diam. below, base acute, apex acuminate (acumen 5-20 mm long), primary vein impressed above, secondary veins curved, 10-15 on either side of primary vein, raised above, angles with primary vein 60-75°, loop-forming at right to obtuse angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 5-9(-12) mm, tertiary veins slightly raised above. Inflorescences among leaves or often on older branchlets, leaf-opposed or supra-axillary, occasionally at the base of a lateral shoot, a single rhipidium or rarely composed of 2-3 rhipidia and/or slightly ramified. Rhipidia 1-4-flowered, to about 12 flowers in succession. Indument: peduncles, pedicels, and outer side of bracts, sepals, and petals totally covered with pale brown (greyish white on petals) subentire (the large ones) to stellate (the few, small ones) scales 0.1-0.5 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and petals densely covered with curly, stellate hairs 0.1-0.3 mm in diam., inner 1/3 of sepals and basal 1/2 of petals glabrous. Peduncle 3-5 mm long, 2 mm in diam., fruiting peduncle to 5 mm in diam. Sympodial rachis to 10 mm long. Pedicels 5-10 mm long, 2 mm in diam., fruiting pedicels to 5 mm in diam. Upper bract at 1/2 to 2/3 of base of pedicel, depressed ovate, 3-4 mm long, caducous. Flower buds depressed globose. Flowers creamy yellow in vivo, inner base of inner petals dark red. Sepals connate for 10-15%, ovate-triangular, 12-15 mm long, 9-11 mm wide, obtuse. Petals subequal, oblong-ovate to narrowly elliptic, 14-20 mm long, 5-10 mm wide, obtuse, inner base of inner petals strongly concave, not callose. Stamens 1-1.5 mm long, red, apex of connective discoid, 0.1 x 0.8-1 mm, papillate to glabrous. Carpels to 2.5 mm long, subglabrous, except for some stellate scales along the sides. Fruit green to yellow, maturing red in vivo, subglobose, 3.5-5.5 cm in diam., basal collar composed of 10-15 connate, sterile carpels, 10-20 mm in diam., slightly protruding below the fruit, fertile carpels 75-100, obtrulloid to oblong-obovoid, 18-22 mm long, 8-12 mm in diam., free, areoles shallowly pyramidal to pyramidal, 5-10 mm high, obtuse, apiculate (apicule 1-2 mm long), distinctly 5-6-ridged, sparsely to rather densely covered with stellate scales 0.1-0.2 mm in diam. Seeds obovoid, 12-15 mm long, 8-9 mm in diam., obtuse, dark brown, shiny.

description: Tree, 5-17 m tall, 15-25 cm in diam. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with entire scales 0.1-0.3 mm in diam. Petioles 3-5 mm long, 1 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly elliptic, 8-15 cm long, 2-4 cm wide, leaf index 3.6-4.6, chartaceous, greyish black to black above, dark grey to greyish brown below, glabrous above, except for some hairs along primary vein, sparsely covered with stellate (the smaller ones) to entire (the larger ones) scales 0.2-0.4 mm in diam. below, base acute, apex acuminate (acumen 10-20 mm long), primary vein slightly impressed to flat above, secondary veins curved, 12-14 on either side of primary vein, raised above, angles with primary vein 70-80°, loop-forming at obtuse angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 2-4 mm, tertiary veins raised above. Inflorescences among leaves, leaf-opposed or supra-axillary, sometimes terminal, 1-2-flowered. Indument: peduncles, pedicels, and outer side of bracts, sepals, and petals totally covered with pale brown, stellate to entire scales 0.1-0.3 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and petals totally to densely covered with stellate hairs 0.1-0.3 mm in diam., inner 1/2 of petals glabrous. Peduncle 1-3 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam. Pedicels 3-5 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam., fruiting pedicels 6-7 mm long, 2 mm in diam. Upper bract at 1/3 of base of pedicel, caducous, only remnant of base seen. Flower buds ovoid. Flowers yellow in vivo. Sepals connate for 10-20%, broadly ovate, 6-10 mm long, 6-7 mm wide, obtuse, shortly apiculate. Petals subequal, obovate, 8-13 mm long, 6-8 mm wide, obtuse, inner base of inner petals callose, slightly grooved. Stamens ca. 1 mm long, color unknown, apex of connective discoid, 0.3 x 0.8 mm, papillate. Carpels ca. 2 mm long, glabrous. Fruit green, maturing red in vivo, globose, 2-3 cm in diam., basal collar composed of 56 connate, sterile carpels, 5-6 mm in diam., not protruding below the fruit, fertile carpels 15-20, obtrulloid, 11-12 mm long, 8-10 mm in diam., free, areoles depressed ovoid, 4-6 mm high, obtuse, apiculate (apicule ca. 1 mm long), indistinctly ribbed, crested, glabrous except for a few hairs towards the apex. Seeds obovoid, 9-10 mm long, 6-7 mm in diam., obtuse, dark brown, shiny.

description: Tree or shrub, 3-10 m tall, 10 cm in diam. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with erect, stellate hairs to 0.8 mm in diam. Petioles 2-10 mm long, 1-3 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly elliptic to narrowly oblong-elliptic, 12-25 cm long, 4-8 cm wide, leaf index 2.6-3.6, chartaceous, greyish green to blackish green, slightly shiny above, pale green to greyish green below, glabrous above, densely to sparsely covered with erect, stellate hairs 0.4-1 mm in diam. below, base acute to obtuse, apex acute to obtuse, to shortly acuminate (acumen 5-10 mm long), primary vein impressed above, secondary veins curved, 8-15 on either side of primary vein, raised above, angles with primary vein ca. 55°, loop-forming at right to obtuse angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 2-5 mm, tertiary veins slightly raised above. Inflorescences among leaves, leaf-opposed or sometimes supra-axillary (or rarely terminal?), 1-3-flowered, to about 10 flowers in succession. Indument: pedicels, outer side of bracts, and both sides of sepals and petals totally covered with brown to greyish, stellate hairs 0.2-1 mm in diam., inner base of inner petals glabrous. Peduncle 2-5(-10) mm long, 2 mm in diam., fruiting peduncle to 3 mm in diam. Sympodial rachis to 13(-40?) mm long. Pedicels 5-20 mm long, 1-3 mm in diam. Bracts frequently foliaceous; upper bract about halfway the pedicel, ovate-triangular, 5-25 mm long, with thickened primary vein, acute to shortly apiculate, caducous. Flower buds globose to depressed globose, 3-ridged by recurved edges of the sepals. Flowers cream to yellow, inner base of petal reddish in vivo. Sepals connate for ca. 15%, ovate-triangular, 12-20 mm long, 8-15 mm wide, acute. Petals subequal, narrowly obovate, 20-25 mm long, 10-12 mm wide, obtuse to acute, base of inner petals callose, distinctly grooved. Stamens 1-1.2 mm long, red, apex of connective discoid, 0.2-0.3 x 0.5-0.6 mm, slightly papillate. Carpels 2-3 mm long, ovary totally covered with whitish, stellate hairs 0.1-0.4 mm in diam., stigma glabrous. Fruit green in vivo, subglobose, 3 cm long, 3.5 cm in diam., basal collar composed of ca. 10 connate, sterile carpels, 6-7 mm in diam., not protruding below the fruit, fertile carpels ca. 50, obtrulloid, 13-15 mm long, 7-10 mm in diam., free, areoles pyramidal to shallowly so, 4-7 mm high, obtuse, apiculate (apicule 2-3 mm long), surface distinctly and irregularly ridged, totally covered with a velutinous indument of golden brown, erect, stellate hairs 0.2-0.4 mm in diam. Seeds obovoid, 8 mm long, 6 mm in diam., obtuse, dark brown, slightly shiny.

description: Tree, 10-28 m tall, 15-30 cm in diam. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with brownish, entire to stellate scales 0.1-0.8 mm in diam. Petioles 5-8 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly elliptic to elliptic, 5-12 cm long, 2.5-4 cm wide (up to 18 x 6 cm in vegetative collections), leaf index 2-3, chartaceous, greyish (to greyish brown), black when young above, golden brown below, glabrous above, totally covered with brownish entire to stellate scales 0.1-0.8 mm in diam. below, base acute, apex acute to shortly acuminate (acumen to 5 mm long, somewhat longer in vegetative material), primary vein impressed above, secondary veins straight (to curved), 10-13 on either side of primary vein, flat to slightly raised above, angles with primary vein 65-70°, loop-forming at right to obtuse angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 45 mm, tertiary veins flat to slightly raised above. Inflorescences among leaves, leaf-opposed, 1-4-flowered, to 7 flowers in succession. Indument: pedicels and outer side of bracts, sepals, and petals totally covered with brownish, entire scales 0.1-0.6 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and petals totally covered with stellate hairs 0.1-0.4 mm in diam., inner 1/5 of petals glabrous. Peduncle 0-3 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam. Sympodial rachis to 4 mm long. Pedicels 10-15 mm long, 1 mm in diam., fruiting pedicels to 5 mm in diam. Upper bract at 1/3 to 1/2 of base of pedicel, broadly ovate, ca. 1 mm long. Flower buds ovoid. Flowers green to cream in vivo, inner base of petals dark red. Sepals connate for 25-30%, triangular to deltate, soon reflexed, 6-8 mm long, 4-7 mm wide, acute to obtuse. Petals subequal, elliptic to obovate, older ones distinctly narrowed to the base, 10-23 mm long, 5-10 mm wide, obtuse (angle ca. 90°), inner base of inner petals callose, grooved. Stamens 0.8-1 mm long, pink to red, apex of connective discoid, 0.2 x 0.5 mm, papillate. Carpels 1.5-2 mm long, ovary totally covered with stellate hairs, stigma glabrous. Fruit brownish in sicco, globose, 3.5-5 cm in diam., basal collar composed of 7-10 connate, sterile carpels, 10-18 mm in diam., protruding below the fruit, fertile carpels 40-50, obtrulloid, 9-12 mm long, 6-15 mm in diam., free, areoles broadly to shallowly ovoid-pyramidal, 4-9 mm high, 4-5-ribbed, obtuse, apiculate (apicule to 2 mm long), rough, totally covered with brown, stellate scales 0.1-0.5 mm in diam. Seeds narrowly obovoid to obovoid, 16-17 mm long, 6-8 mm in diam., acute to rounded, dark brown, shiny.

description: Tree, 4-20 m tall, 10-30 cm in diam. (to 80 cm in Cid et al 780). Young twigs and petioles totally covered with greyish, entire scales 0.2-0.4 mm in diam. Petioles 3-10 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly oblong-elliptic to oblong-ovate, 11-25 cm long, 3-7 cm wide, leaf index 3.1-4.3, chartaceous, pale greyish green above, pale brown to brown below, glabrous above, sparsely covered with stellate (the smaller ones) to entire scales (the larger ones) 0.3-0.6 mm in diam. below, base abruptly broadly cuneate, apex acuminate (acumen 5-20 mm long) or sometimes acute, primary vein impressed above, secondary veins curved, 10-14 on either side of primary vein, like the marginal vein strongly impressed above, angles with primary vein 60-85°, forming a marginal vein, smallest distance between marginal vein and margin 1.5-4.5 mm, tertiary veins raised above. Plant cauliflorous; inflorescences composed of a varying number of rhipidia with a total of up to ca. 100 flowers, one rhipidium producing several flowers in succession. Indument: pedicels, and outer side of bracts, sepals, and petals totally covered with stellate to entire scales 0.2-0.6 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and apical part of petals densely covered with whitish, crisped, stellate hairs to 0.4 mm long, middle and basal, inner part of petals glabrous. Sympodial rachis to 15 mm long, varying from condensed to rather lax, with internodes to 4 mm long, often with longer basal internodes to 10 mm. Pedicels to 25 mm long, to 2 mm in diam., fruiting pedicels to 30 mm long, to 5 mm in diam. Upper bract halfway the pedicel, broadly ovate, 5-7 mm long, caducous. Flower buds subglobose. Flowers creamy white to yellow in vivo, greyish-white in sicco. Sepals free, ovate-oblong, 12-20 mm long, 9-15 mm wide, obtuse. Petals subequal, ovate to obo-vate, 20-25 mm long, 8-15 mm wide, obtuse, inner base of inner petals callose, grooved, weakly so in outer petals. Stamens 1.2-2 mm long, pink, apex of connective discoid, umbonate, 0.3-0.6 x 0.6-0.9 mm, papillate. Carpels 2-2.5 mm long, ovary densely covered with greyish, stellate hairs, stigma subglabrous. Fruit green, maturing brown in vivo, globose, 5-7 cm in diam., basal collar composed of 12-15 connate, sterile carpels, 10-20 mm in diam., protruding below the fruit, fertile carpels 100-150, obovoid to obtrulloid, polygonal, 25-30 mm long, 7-12 mm in diam., fused for up to 10%, strongly 5-6-ribbed and in between the ribs strongly grooved, areoles trulloid, 10-12 mm high, acute, sharp-pointed, totally covered with a velutinous, brownish indument of stellate hairs to 0.1 mm in diam. Seeds narrowly ellipsoid, 14 mm long, 5 mm in diam., obtuse to rounded, brown, shiny.

description: Tree or shrub, 1-10(-30) m tall, 2-18(-40 in one specimen) cm in diam. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with stellate scales 0.1-0.4 mm in diam. Petioles 3-10(-15) mm long, 2-3 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly elliptic, (7-) 15-25(-3 3) cm long, (2-)4-7(-11) cm wide, leaf index 2.8-4.6, chartaceous, dull, greyish green to greyish brown above, pale brown below, glabrous above, sparsely covered with stellate scales 0.10.5 mm in diam. below, base obtuse, sometimes acute, apex acuminate (acumen 5-20 mm long), sometimes acute, primary vein impressed above, secondary veins curved to straight, 10-15 on either side of primary vein, raised above, angles with primary vein 60-80°, loopforming at right to obtuse angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 4-8(-10) mm, tertiary veins slightly raised above. Inflorescences among leaves, supra-axillary or rarely leaf-opposed, infrequently terminal (with abortive axillary shoot below or not), terminai on a (short) axillary shoot, or at the base of an axillary shoot, 1-4-flowered, to about 10 flowers in succession (but see also under the comments further on). Indument: peduncles, pedicels, and outer side of bracts, sepals, and petals totally to densely covered with stellate scales 0.1-0.3 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and petals densely covered with stellate hairs 0.1-0.3 mm in diam, inner basal 1/2 to 1/3 of sepals and inner basal 1/2 to 1/5 of petals glabrous. Peduncle 1-3 mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm in diam., fruiting peduncle to 10 mm long, to 4 mm in diam. Sympodial rachis to 15(-20) mm long. Pedicels 5-15 mm long, 2-3 mm in diam., fruiting pedicels to 5 mm in diam. Upper bract halfway the pedicel, depressed ovate, 1-2 mm long. Flower buds depressed globose, distinctly to slightly 3-ridged by recurved edges of the sepals. Flowers creamy white to creamy yellow in vivo, sepals with a brownish indument on the outer side. Sepals free, broadly ovate-triangular, 10-17 mm long, 9-16 mm wide, obtuse. Petals subequal, obtrullate to obovate, 15-30 mm long, 10-20 mm wide, obtuse, inner base of inner petals callose, grooved and sometimes papillate. Stamens 2-4 mm long, cream, apex of connective discoid, 0.5-0.7 x 0.7-1.2 mm, densely to totally covered with simple to stellate hairs 0.1-0.2 mm in diam. Carpels 3-6 mm long, ovary totally covered with stellate hairs, stigma subglabrous. Fruit brownish to yellow in vivo, ellipsoid to subglobose, 3-8 cm long, 2-4.5 cm in diam., basal collar indistinct, composed of 10-15 connate, sterile carpels, 8-10 mm in diam., not or hardly protruding below the fruit, fertile carpels 50-100(-125), obtrulloid to oblong, 11-20 mm long, 5-10 mm in diam., free, areoles pyramidal, 2-8 mm high, obtuse, apiculate (apicule 1-7 mm long), slightly polygonal, totally covered with greyish or brownish, stellate hairs 0.1-0.2 mm in diam. Seeds obovoid to oblong-obovoid, 7-14 mm long, 4-10 mm in diam., obtuse, pale brown to creamy white, shiny.

description: Shrub or tree, 1-7 m tall, 2-4 cm in diam. Young twigs and petioles densely covered with brown to orange, stellate scales 0.1-0.5 mm in diam. Petioles 2-8 mm long, 1-3(-5) mm in diam. Lamina narrowly elliptic to obovate, 11-26 cm long, 3-8 cm wide, leaf index 3.3-3.6, chartaceous, pale green to dark green above, brown to pale green below, glabrous above, sparsely covered with stellate scales 0.1-0.5 mm in diam. below, base cuneate to acute, apex acuminate (acumen to 20 mm long) to acute, primary vein impressed above, secondary veins abruptly curved, 10-20 on either side of primary vein, raised above, angles with primary vein 55°-80°, loop-forming at obtuse to right angles, loops distinct, submarginal vein present, smallest distance between loops and margin 2-5 mm, tertiary veins raised above. Inflorescence flagelliform, originating from the trunk at ground level or at some distance above the ground, creeping, a single rhipidium or furcately branching 1-several times, greatly elongate and producing many flowers in succession. Indument: pedicels and outer side of bracts, sepals, and petals rather densely to densely covered with orange to almost white, stellate scales 0.1-0.6 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and petals totally to rather densely (less densely hairy to glabrous toward the base) covered with stellate hairs 0.1-0.2 mm in diam. Sympodial rachis 12-400 cm long, with internodes 0.2-7 cm long. Pedicels 10-30(-40) mm long, 1-2 mm in diam., fruiting pedicels to 3 mm in diam. Upper bract in lower 1/4 of pedicel, ovate to depressed ovate, 2-8 mm long. Flower buds ovoid to broadly ovoid. Flowers with petals red to purple in vivo, inner base white, or petals white with red base (Maas et al. 8065), sepals brown to green. Sepals 10-15% connate at the base, ovate to broadly ovate, 10-23{-29} mm long, (4-)7-12{-15} mm wide, acute. Petals unequal, ovate, acute, the outer ones 12-28{-33} mm long, (4-)6-12{-14} mm wide, the inner ones ovate, 19-22(-28) mm long, 10-12 mm wide, with pronounced, white, fleshy callóse swellings at the base. Stamens 0.8-3 mm long, red to pink, apex of connective deltoid, 0.4-0.8 x 0.4-0.8 mm or absent, acute, glabrous. Carpels 2-4 mm long, ovary densely covered with yellow to brown, stellate hairs 0.1-0.2 mm in diam., stigma glabrous. Fruit dark to pale brown in vivo, subglobose, 2.5-4 (-6 according to de Granville et al. 6481) cm in diam., basal collar absent, fertile carpels 15-25(-30), broadly obtrulloid, 12-17 mm long, 12-16 mm in diam., free, areoles shallowly pyramidal, 5-6 mm high, obtuse, mostly apiculate (apicule deflexed, 1-3 mm long), irregularly crested (crests 0.5-1.5 mm high), densely covered with brownish, stellate hairs 0.1-0.2 mm in diam. Seeds broadly obovoid, 13-15 mm long, 15 mm in diam., obtuse to rounded, pale brown, somewhat shiny.

description: Tree, 4 m tall. Old twigs and petioles sparsely covered with stellate scales 0.2-0.3 mm in diam. Petioles 5-7 mm long, 3 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly elliptic, 20-29 cm long, 7-10 cm wide, leaf index 2.8-2.9, chartaceous, blackish brown above, brown below, glabrous above, sparsely covered with stellate scales 0.20.5 mm in diam. below, base acute to obtuse, slightly oblique, apex acute, primary vein impressed above, secondary veins curved, 12-15 on either side of primary vein, slightly raised above, angles with primary vein 65-70°, loop-forming at right to obtuse angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 4-5 mm, tertiary veins slightly raised above. Inflorescences (only a single one seen) among leaves, leaf-opposed, 3-flowered. Indument: peduncles, pedicels, and outer side of bracts and sepals totally covered with stellate scales 0.2-0.7 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and both sides of petals totally to densely covered with stellate hairs 0.1-0.3 mm in diam. Peduncle 5 mm long, 3 mm in diam. Pedicels 5-18 mm long, 2-4 mm in diam. Upper bract at 1/3 of base of pedicel, broadly ovate-triangular, ca. 10 mm long, amplectent. Flower buds ovoid. Flowers greenish in vivo. Sepals connate for 15%, broadly ovate-triangular, 35 mm long, 30 mm wide, acute, distinctly ribbed. Petals subequal, probably ovate, ca. 60 mm long, 30 mm wide, apical part broken off, base of inner petals not seen. Stamens not seen. Carpels not seen. Fruit not seen.

description: Tree or shrub, 1.5-5(-8) m tall, 2-5 cm in diam. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with stellate hairs 0.1-0.3 mm in diam., glabrous with age. Petioles 1-3 mm long, 1-1.5 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly ovate to narrowly elliptic (to narrowly obovate), 9-16 cm long, 2-4.5(-5.5*) cm wide, leaf index 3-5.5, chartaceous, greyish green above, (brownish) green below, glabrous above, sparsely covered with stellate hairs and scales 0.2-0.4 mm in diam. below, base acute, apex long-acuminate (acumen 10-30 mm long), primary vein impressed above, secondary veins curved, 9-12 on either side of primary vein, slightly raised above, angles with primary vein 65-80°, loop-forming at right to obtuse angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 1.5-4 mm, tertiary veins slightly raised above. Inflorescence among leaves, generally supra-axillary, l-(2)-flowered. Indument: peduncles, pedicels, and outer side of bracts, sepals, and petals densely covered with yellowish brown, stellate hairs and scales 0.10.2 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and petals sparsely to rather densely covered with whitish, stellate hairs 0.1-0.4 mm in diam. Peduncle 1-2 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam. Pedicels 2-4 mm long, 1.5-2 mm in diam., fiuiting pedicels to 5 mm long, to 2.5 mm in diam. Upper bract halfway the pedicel, broadly triangular, 1 mm long. Flower buds broadly ovoid. Flowers yellow in vivo, inner base of inner petals red. Sepals free, ovate-triangular to broadly so, 6-13(-18*) mm long, 6-8(-11*) mm wide, acute to obtuse. Petals unequal, 10-18(-30*) mm long, 5-8(-14*) mm wide, the outer ones obovate, obtuse, the inner ones elliptic to narrowly obovate, acute, basal part strongly concave, inner base of inner petals callose, grooved. Stamens 1.3-1.4 mm long, red, apex of connective discoid, 0.8 x 0.2-0.4 mm, papillate. Carpels 2-3 mm long, densely covered with whitish, stellate hairs throughout. Fruit green when young, maturing orange in vivo, subglobose, 1-2.5 cm in diam., basal collar composed of 5-8 connate, sterile carpels, 7-10 mm in diam., not protruding below the fruit, fertile carpels 10-20, broadly ovoid, 7-13 mm long, 6-9 mm in diam., free, areoles ovoid, 5-8 mm high, acute to obtuse, apiculate (apicule sharp-pointed, 1-2 mm long), totally covered with pale brownish green to pale brown, stellate hairs 0.1-0.3 mm long. Seeds ellipsoid to obovoid, 7-10 mm long, 5-7 mm in diam., obtuse, reddish brown, shiny.

description: Tree or shrub of unknown height. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with brown, stellate hairs 0.4-0.6 mm in diam. Petioles 0.5-2 mm long, 1-1.5 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly ovate, 10-19 cm long, 3-6.5 cm wide, leaf index 2.7-3.5, chartaceous, brown on both sides, glabrous above, sparsely covered with brown, stellate hairs 0.3-0.6 mm in diam. below, base cordate to amplexicaul, apex acute to acuminate (acumen 5-10 mm long), primary vein impressed above, secondary veins recurved, 10-15 on either side of primary vein, slightly impressed above, angles with primary vein 80-85°, loop-forming at right angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 1.5-5 mm, tertiary veins flat above. Inflorescences among leaves, supra-axillary, a single rhipidium; one terminal cluster of several (?) rhipidia observed. Rhipidia 1-3(-more?)-flowered. Indument: pedicels, and outer side of bracts, sepals, and petals densely covered with brown, stellate hairs 0.1-0.5 mm in diam., inner side of petals sparsely covered with yellow, stellate hairs 0.1-0.5 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and inner base of petals glabrous. Pedicels 36 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam. Upper bract halfway the pedicel, broadly triangular, 1-2 mm long and wide. Flower buds broadly ovoid. Flower color unknown. Sepals free, broadly ovate-triangular to subcordate, 3-4 mm long and wide, acute. Petals unequal, narrowly ovate, acute, the outer ones 11-16 mm long, 45 mm wide, the inner ones 18-21 mm long, 5-6 mm wide, inner base part of inner petals not callose. Stamens 1-1.5 mm long, color unknown, apex of connective discoid, 0.1-0.2 x 0.5-0.8 mm, papillate. Carpels ca. 15, ca. 2.5 mm long, ovary and basal part of stigma densely covered with brown, stellate hairs 0.1-0.2 mm in diam., apical part of stigma glabrous. Fruit not seen.

description: Tree, 4-7 m tall. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with dark brown, erect, stellate (and simple) hairs 0.8-1.5 mm in diam. Petioles 3-8 mm long, 24 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly elliptic, 15-26 cm long, 5-8 cm wide, leaf index 3-3.6, chartaceous, pale greyish green above, pale glaucous brown below, glabrous above or sparsely covered with simple (and furcate) hairs along the primary vein, glabrous below, but primary vein (particularly at the base) of young leaves sparsely covered with 3-4-rayed, stellate hairs 1.5-2 mm in diam., base acute, slightly oblique, apex acuminate (acumen 5-20 mm long), primary vein impressed above, secondary veins curved, 12-18 on either side of primary vein, impressed above, angles with primary vein 70-80°, loop-forming at right angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 2-6 mm, tertiary veins flat above. Inflorescences among leaves, supra-axillary or leaf-opposed, 1-2-flowered, to about 10 flowers in succession. Indument: peduncles, pedicels, and outer side of bracts, sepals, and petals totally covered with dark brown, stellate hairs 0.8-1.5 mm in diam., inner side of sepals and petals subglabrous. Peduncle extremely short or wanting. Sympodial rachis to 8 {15} mm long. Pedicels to 8 mm long, and to 3 mm in diam. Upper bract from about halfway the pedicel to just below sepals, very broadly ovate, 4-8 mm long. Flower buds very broadly ovoid. Flowers cream or creamy white in vivo, inner base of inner petals dull pink. Sepals free, triangular-ovate, 12-15 mm long, 9-12 mm wide, obtuse. Petals subequal, broadly ovate or obovate, 18-21 mm long, 12-14 mm wide, shortly unguiculate over a length of 2-4 mm, obtuse to rounded, inner basal 1/5 of inner petals distinctly grooved. Stamens 0.6-1 mm long, pink, apex of connective discoid, 0.2-0.3 x 0.5-0.8 mm, densely covered with simple hairs. Carpels ca. 1 mm long, densely covered with hairs to 1 mm long, stigma glabrous. Fruit incompletely known, dark brown in vivo, shape unknown, ca. 2 cm in diam., sepals persistent, basal collar composed of ca. 7 sterile carpels, 10-12 mm in diam., fertile carpels 5-10, broadly trulloid to broadly ovoid, 10-19 mm long, 12-17 mm in diam., free, ar-eoles shallowly pyramidal, 9-15 mm high, obtuse, totally covered with brown, erect, stellate hairs 0.8-1.5 mm in diam. Seeds subglobose to obovoid, 6-12 mm long, 10-14 mm in diam., rounded to obtuse, dark brown to blackish, slightly verrucose, shiny.

description: Herb, to 1.5 m tall; stem partly rhizomatous, supraterranean part to 1.3 m long, ascending, 4-10 mm thick, (retrorsely) puberulous to hirtellous, partly with uncinate hairs; internodes to 1.5(-2.5) cm long. Leaves in spirals, spaced; lamina ovate to subcordiform to subpanduriform, in the lower part often constricted, 10-40 × 3.5-20 cm, chartaceous; apex acuminate to acute; base cordate with a wide to very narrow sinus, the lobes often overlapping; margin ± irregularly crenate-dentate to repand, sometimes ± deeply lobed; upper surface sparsely strigose to almost glabrous; lower surface (mainly on the veins) minutely puberulous or partly hirtellous with uncinate hairs and/or partly hispidulous, or to hirsute on the midrib; lateral veins 8-10 pairs, faintly or hardly loop-connected; tertiary venation reticulate to subscalariform; petiole 10-35 cm long, minutely puberulous with retrorse hairs or partly hirtellous or sometimes hirsute; stipules ovate to broadly triangular, 0.7-1.3 cm long, coriaceous, plurinervate, with the venation faintly flabellate, base subcordate, apex acuminate, puberulous or partly hispidulous. Inflorescences with the flowering face purplish to red-brown; peduncle 5-12 cm long, minutely puberulous with ± retrorse hairs or partly hirtellous or sometimes hirsute; receptacle centrally attached, discoid, (sub)orbicular (to elliptic) in outline, 1-1.8 cm diam., sometimes slightly lobed, the outside minutely puberulous, ± distinctly ribbed by veins leading to the marginal bracts, the margin dentate to appendiculate, the fringe 1-1.5 mm broad, minutely puberulous; bracts in one row on the margin or often on the apices of short or occasionally to 2.5 cm long filiform appendages, departing from the margin or occasionally below the margin, appressed, ovate to triangular, to 2.5 mm long, distinctly different in length, shorter and longer ones ± clearly alternating, minutely puberulous; staminate flowers among the pistillate ones; tepals 2; stamens 2; filaments longer than the perianth; stigmas (almost) equal in length, 0.3-0.5 mm long. Endocarp body ca. 1.5 × 1.5 mm, tuberculate.

description: Herb, with the stem (mainly) subterranean, 3-5 mm thick, hirsute to hirtellous, mainly with straight hairs; internodes short. Leaves in spirals, subrosulate; lamina elliptic to oblong (to subovate), 9-13 × 4.5-6.5 cm, subcoriaceous; apex obtuse; base cordate; margin subentire to repand; upper surface glabrous; lower surface puberulous to hirtellous, on the lower part of the midrib hirsute; venation pinnate; lateral veins 6-7 pairs, ± distinctly loop-connected; tertiary venation subscalariform to reticulate; petiole 3-18 cm long, hirsute with straight hairs; stipules ovate, 0.5-1 cm long, uninervate, acute, hirtellous (to hirsute), mainly with straight hairs. Inflorescences with at least the margin of the receptacle purplish; peduncle 2.5-3 cm long, hirsute; receptacle centrally attached, discoid, orbicular in outline, ca. 2 cm diam., the outside hirtellous, the margin entire, the fringe to 3 mm broad; bracts in 1-2 rows on and below the margin, appressed or some of the submarginal ones ± radiating, triangular to ovate, to 2 mm long, puberulous to hirtellous; staminate flowers among the pistillate ones; tepals 2; stamens 2; filaments longer than the perianth; stigmas not seen. Endocarp body not seen.

description: Epiphytic or terrestrial shrubs, scandent or erect, to 3 m tall. Young branchlets usually with a mucilaginous exudate distally, ridged, ± smooth, puberulous or glabrate, the hairs eglandular, white, the indumentum of the mature branches similar. Leaves 0–4 per cm, spirally arranged, diffuse; petiole 2–3.5 mm long, glabrate or puberulous, the hairs eglandular; lamina elliptic, or less often obovate or ovate, 1.2–2.4(–3.5) × 0.6–1.2 (–1.9) cm, basally obtuse or cuneate, marginally entire, slightly revolute toward base, apically ciliolate with eglandular hairs (especially in young leaves), apically obtuse and usually prominently apiculate, adaxially glabrous or glabrate in young leaves with eglandular or glandular hairs, abaxially glabrate with glandular hairs, the venation hyphodromous on both sides, the midvein adaxially impressed and abaxially raised. Axillary solitary flowers and rarely in 2(–3)-flowered fascicles; bracts 4–6, chartaceous, ovate, 0.8–2.4 × 0.9–2.8 mm, marginally eciliate, apically obtuse, abaxially glabrous; pedicel 0.9–1.5 mm long, reduced and hidden by overlapping bracts, glabrous or glabrate with glandular hairs; differentiated apical bracteoles green, 2, distinct, chartaceous, enveloping the base of the calyx tube or the entire calyx tube, covering 40–60% of calyx, ovate or elliptic, 2–3.5 × 2.3–3.9 mm, occasionally marginally ciliolate with minute eglandular hairs (apically), apically obtuse, the surface smooth and keeled, abaxially and adaxially glabrous. Flowers 5-merous, rarely corollas 4- or 6-lobed, or calyces appearing 4-lobed because the fifth lobe is reduced or because two adjacent lobes are much smaller and closer. Calyx aestivation valvate, campanulate, (3.8–)4.5–5.3(–5.7) mm long; tube terete, (1.8–)2–2.5(–2.7) mm long, abaxially glabrate with glandular hairs; limb (2–)2.5–3.2 mm long, abaxially glabrous or glabrate with eglandular hairs, adaxially glabrous; lobes triangular, 1.5–2(–2.5) × 1.4–1.7 mm, sometimes ciliolate with eglandular hairs, apically acute; sinuses acute (V-shaped). Corolla pink or white, thick-fleshy, bistratose, urceolate, (5.6–) 6.5–7.5(–9) mm long, 3.7–6 mm diam., 2.3–4 mm wide at throat, abaxially glabrate with glandular hairs, adaxially glabrate, rarely even on the lobes; lobes (1.1–) 1.5–2 × 1.2–1.5 mm, apically acute, adaxially rugose. Stamens 10, (4.8–)5.5–6.7 mm long, included; filaments distinct, straight, ± linear with parallel sides, (2.5–)2.7–3.5 mm long, abaxially and adaxially puberulous distally; anthers distinct, papillae only on thecae, at times with a couple of long hairs at base; thecae 1.3–1.8 mm long, basal appendages present or not; tubules 2, distinct, 1.6–2.1(–2.6) mm long, dehiscing introrsely by longitudinal slits, 0.8–1.1 mm long. Ovary 5-locular; style 6.8–7.8 mm long, exserted. Berry violet to almost black,± spherical, 6–7 mm diam., the persistent calyx lobes erect or spreading, becoming succulent (at least at base), same color as mature berry; embryo green.

description: Liana, the young branches ferrugineous tomentose, soon becoming glabrous. Leaves elliptic, coriaceous, 8.0-17.5 cm long, 4.5-8.0 cm broad, acute to acuminate at apex, subcordate to rounded at base, bullate above, with a few stiff appressed hairs only beneath; midrib slightly impressed and pubescent above; primary veins 7-9 pairs, slightly impressed above; secondary venation impressed or plane above; petioles 2.0-5.0 mm long, villous-tomentose. Stipules subpersistent, villous, fimbriate, ca 5.0 mm long. Flowers hermaphrodite; pedicels ca 5.0 mm long. Inflorescences large terminal corymbose panicles ca 12.0 cm long, the rachis and branches villous-tomentose. Bracts and bracteoles linear, 1.0-4.0 mm long, persistent, tomentose. Calyx ca 3.0 mm long, villous-tomentose on exterior, the lobes almost equal. Corolla of 5 equal lobes, deeply bifid and slightly cucullate, free to base, glabrous. Fertile stamens 5, alternating with and exceeding the corolla lobes. Disc of 5 ellipsoid glands, united at base into a small circular disc. Ovary bilocular or trilocular with 2 ovules in each loculus, or occasionally of 2 separate unilocular carpels, lanate on exterior. Style lanate at base, glabrescent above, the apex bifid or trifid. Fruit bilocular or trilocular; epicarp with a short compact pubescence; mesocarp very hard when dry, ca 1.5 mm thick; endocarp thin, hard, lanate within.

description: Liana, the young branches tomentellous, becoming glabrous with age. Leaves oblong, coriaceous, 8.0-16.0 cm long, 3.0-5.0 cm broad, acuminate at apex, the acumen 3.0-13.0 mm long, rounded and unequal at base, plane not bullate above, glabrous beneath except for a few appressed hairs on venation; midrib more or less plane above, pubescent; primary veins 7-9 pairs, weakly impressed above; venation plane above; petioles 10.0-18.0 mm long, tomentellous when young, canaliculate. Stipules linear, ca 2.0 mm long, tomentellous, caducous. Flowers polygamo-dioecious; pedicels ca 0.3 mm long. Inflorescences spreading petiolar panicles, 4.0-5.5 cm long, the rachis and branches shortly tomentellous; peduncles 5.0-20.0 mm long. Bracts and bracteoles lanceolate, 0.3-1.5 mm long, persistent, tomentose. Calyx ca 2.0 mm long, tomentose on exterior, the lobes equal. Corolla of 5 equal slightly bifid lobes, free to base, glabrous. Fertile stamens 5, alternating and equalling corolla lobes. Disc of 2-3 glands, lobed at apex. Ovary bilocular, with 2 ovules in each loculus, lanate on exterior. Styles 2, short, connate at base. Fruit not seen.

description: Tree, shrub, scandent shrub or vine, the young branches tomentellous becoming glabrous with age. Leaves ovate to elliptic, coriaceous, 8.0-30.0 cm long, 4.0-16.5 cm broad, abruptly acuminate at apex, the acumen 5.0-10.0 mm long, usually curved, rounded to cuneate and unequal at base; plane not bullate above, sparsely hirsute or with a few stiff appressed hairs only beneath; midrib more or less plane above, pubescent when young; primary veins 8-10 pairs, plane to slightly impressed above; venation plane to slightly impressed above; petioles 7.0-15.0 mm long, sparsely short-tomentellous or puberulous when young. Stipules to 8.0 mm long, lanceolate, tomentellous, caducous, the margins entire. Flowers hermaphrodite; pedicels ca 0.5 mm long. Inflorescences axillary and petiolar spreading panicles, 4.0-6.5 cm long, the rachis and branches shortly puberulous; peduncles 8.0-30.0 mm long. Bracts and bracteoles triangular, 0.5-2.0 mm long, persistent, tomentose. Calyx ca 2.0 mm long, gray-tomentose on exterior, the lobes equal. Corolla of 5 equal lobes, the apex deeply bifid, slightly cucullate, free to base, glabrous. Fertile stamens 5, alternating and equalling the corolla lobes. Disc of 5 glands, the apices lobed. Ovary bilocular or trilocular, with 2 ovules in each loculus, lanate on exterior. Style with bifid or trifid apex, glabrous except for lanate base. Fruit ellipsoid; epicarp with short dense appressed pubescence; mesocarp thin; endocarp thin, hard, glabrous within.

description: Vine, the young branches hispid-tomentose, soon becoming glabrous. Leaves oblong to oblong-lanceolate, coriaceous, 6.0-16.0 cm long, 1.7-4.0 cm broad, tapered into a long usually curved acumen at apex, rounded to. subcordate and unequal at base, plane not bullate above, with a few stiff appressed hairs only beneath; midrib almost plane and pubescent above; primary veins 8-11 pairs, weakly prominent above; venation more or less plane; petioles 1.0-4.0 mm long, hispid to tomentose. Stipules ca 2.0 mm long, ovate, persistent, tomentose, the margins entire. Flowers hermaphrodite; pedicels 1.5-3.0 mm long. Inflorescences short terminal panicles, the rachis and branches hispid-tomentose. Bracts and bracteoles to 3.0 mm long, lanceolate, tomentose. Calyx ca 2.5 mm long, the lobes equal, tomentose on exterior. Corolla of 5 equal deeply bifid lobes, glabrous, free to base. Fertile stamens 5, alternating with and equalling corolla lobes in length. Disc entire, flattened. Ovary bilocular, with 2 ovules in each loculus, lanate on exterior. Style deeply divided into three, lanate at base, glabrescent above. Fruit ellipsoid, unilocular to bilocular; epicarp densely tomentose, mesocarp thin; endocarp thin, bony, glabrous within.

description: Liana, the young branches puberulous to glabrous. Leaves elliptic to oblong, chartaceous to coriaceous, 8.0-16.0 cm long, 3.5-9.0 cm broad, acuminate at apex, with acumen 5.0-15.0 mm long, rounded to cuneate, and equal or slightly unequal at base, plane not bullate above, glabrous or with a few stiff appressed hairs on primary venation beneath; midrib more or less plane, sparsely puberulous to glabrous above; primary veins 7-9 pairs, slightly prominent above; venation plane to prominent above; petioles 4.0-8.0 mm long, puberulous to glabrous. Stipules linear-lanceolate, to 5.0 mm long, caducous, the margins entire. Flowers hermaphrodite; pedicels 1.0-3.0 mm long. Inflorescences spreading axillary or petiolar panicles, the rachis and branches tomentellous to glabrous. Bracts and bracteoles 0.5-1.0 mm long, lanceolate, persistent, puberulous. Calyx 1.5-2.0 mm long, gray-puberulous on exterior, the lobes equal. Corolla of 5 equal lobes, deeply bifid, glabrous, free to base. Fertile stamens 5, alternating and equalling corolla lobes. Disc of 5 short united glands, the apices bifid. Ovary bilocular with 2 ovules in each loculus, lanate on exterior. Style lanate on lower portion, the apex trifid. Fruit not seen.

description: Shrub, the young branches hispid. Leaves lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, membraneous to chartaceous, 6.0-12.5 cm long, 1.1-2.8 cm broad, the apex tapered to a finely pointed acumen 10.0-16.0 cm long, subcordate and slightly unequal at base, plane not bullate above, with a sparse appressed hirsute pubescence beneath; midrib slightly prominent and hirsute above; primary veins 10-11 pairs, almost plane above; venation plane above; petioles 2.0-4.0 mm long, hispid. Stipules lanceolate, to 5.0 mm long, persistent, hispid, the margins entire. Flowers hermaphrodite; pedicels 2.0-3.0 mm long. Inflorescences small terminal panicles (one only seen), the rachis and branches hispid. Bracts and bracteoles lanceolate, 1.5-3.5 mm long, persistent, hispid. Calyx ca 2.5 mm long in bud, gray-tomentose on exterior, the lobes equal. Corolla of 5 equal deeply bifid lobes, glabrous, free to base. Fertile stamens 5, alternating with corolla lobes disc of 5 elongate glands. Ovary (one examined) bilocular, lanate on exterior. Style short, lanate at base, glabrous above, the apex bifid. Fruit unilocular to trilocular, ellipsoid; epicarp hispid-tomentose; mesocarp thin; endocarp very thin, bony, glabrous within.

description: Tree, the young branches sparsely hirsute-tomentose, soon becoming glabrous. Leaves oblong, coriaceous, 8.0-13.0 cm long, 4.5-5.5 cm broad, acuminate at apex, with acumen 5.0-15.0 mm long, rounded and equal at base, slightly bullate above, glabrescent or with a few stiff appressed hairs only beneath; midrib plane, hirsutulous above; primary veins 7-9 pairs, plane above; venation plane or slightly impressed above; petioles 3.5-5.0 mm long, sparsely hirsutulous. Stipules subpersistent, hispid-hirsute, fimbriate. Flowers hermaphrodite; pedicels 2.0-3.0 mm long. Inflorescences (part only seen) with gray-tomentellous rachis and branches. Bracts and bracteoles lanceolate 1.5-4.0 mm long, persistent, tomentellous. Calyx 2.0 cm long in bud, tomentellous on exterior. Corolla of 5 equal bifid lobes, glabrous, free to base. Fertile stamens 5, alternating with corolla lobes. Disc of 5 separate ellipsoid glands. Ovary (one only examined) bilocular with two ovules in each loculus, lanate on exterior. Style short and with a trifid apex, lanate at base. Fruit ellipsoid, unilocular; epicarp velutinous-tomentellous; mesocarp thin; endocarp thin, hard, bony, glabrous within.

description: Liana, the young branches shortly and densely tomentellous, becoming glabrous with age. Leaves elliptic to ovate-elliptic, coriaceous, 8.0-36.0 cm long, 4.0-21.0 cm broad, mucronate to shortly acuminate at apex, rounded to subcuneate at base, plane not bullate above, with a gray lanate tomentum beneath; midrib plane and pubescent above; primary veins 6-8 pairs, plane to weakly impressed above; the secondary and tertiary venation usually weakly impressed above; petioles 7.0-18.0 mm long, short-tomentellous. Stipules caducous (not seen). Flowers androdioecious; pedicels 1.5-3.0 mm long. Inflorescences spreading terminal or petiolar panicles; the rachis and branches tomentellous. Bracts and bracteoles lanceolate, 0.7-4.0 mm long, persistent, tomentose. Calyx ca 2.0 mm long, gray-tomentellous on exterior, the lobes slightly unequal. Corolla of 5 equal deeply bifid and slightly cucullate lobes, free to base, glabrous to sparsely pubescent on exterior. Fertile stamens 5, alternating and slightly exceeding corolla lobes. Disc of 5 free glands with a weekly bifid apex. Ovary bilocular or trilocular with 2 ovules in each loculus, lanate on exterior. Style lanate at base, glabrous above, the apex trifid. Fruit (immature) ellipsoid; epicarp tomentose.

description: Shrub, tree or vine, the young branches tomentose or tomentellous, becoming glabrous with age. Leaves oblong-lanceolate to ovate-elliptic, coriaceous, 6.0-28.0 cm long, 2.5-12.5 cm broad, acuminate at apex, with acumen 2.0-12.0 mm long, cuneate to subcordate at base, plane not bullate above, often hirsute when young above; hirsute, glabrous, or with a few appressed hairs beneath; midrib plane to weakly prominent above, pubescent; primary veins 7~ 12 pairs, plane to weakly prominent above; petioles 5.0-18.0 mm long, tomentose when young. Stipules linear, 1.0-25.0 mm long, tomentose. Flowers hermaphrodite; pedicels 0.5~2.5 mm long. Inflorescences terminal and petiolar panicles, the peduncles and branches tomentose; peduncles 5.0-35.0 mm long. Bracts and bracteoles lanceolate, 0.5-2.0 mm long, tomentose. Calyx 2.0-2.5 mm long, tomentose on exterior, the lobes almost equal. Corolla of 5 equal bifid and often slightly cucullate lobes, glabrous, free to base. Fertile stamens 5, alternating and equalling the corolla lobes. Disc of 5 free, ellipsoid glands, lobed at apex. Ovary bilocular or trilocular, with 2 ovules in each loculus, lanate on exterior. Styles 3, united or free, lanate at base, glabrous at apex. Fruit unilocular to trilocular, ellipsoid; epicarp shortly tomentose; mesocarp thin; endocarp thin, hard, bony, glabrous within.

description: Vine or shrubby vine, the young branches hispid, becoming glabrous with age. Leaves ovate-elliptic to elliptic, coriaceous, 15.0-32.0 cm long, 6.0-19.0 cm broad, acuminate at apex, the acumen 10.0-20.0 mm long, rounded to subcordate at base, bullate above, hirsute beneath; midrib slightly impressed and pubescent above; primary veins 9-12 pairs, slightly impressed above, the secondary and tertiary venation impressed above; petioles 5.0-8.0 mm long, hispid. Stipules subpersistent, hispid, the margins fimbriate. Flowers hermaphrodite; pedicels 5.0-6.0 mm long. Inflorescences short terminal or subterminal panicles, much branched at base, 2.0-3.0 cm long, hispid. Bracts and bracteoles linear, persistent, hispid. Calyx ca 3.0 mm long, gray-puberulous and hispid on exterior, the lobes almost equal. Corolla of 5 equal deeply bifid and slightly cucullate lobes, free to base, glabrous. Fertile stamens 5, alternating with and exceeding corolla lobes. Disc of 5 free ellipsoid glands, apex of glands rounded. Ovary bilocular with 2 ovules in each loculus, lanate on exterior except for glabrous base. Style lanate at base, sparsely puberulous above, the apex shortly trifid. Fruit not seen.

description: Shrub or small tree, the young branches sparsely tomentellous, becoming glabrous with age. Leaves oblong to oblong-elliptic, subcoriaceous, 6.0-16.0 cm long, 2.2-6.5 cm broad, the apex tapered to a long slender acumen 5.0-25.0 mm long, usually subcuneate at base, plane not bullate above, glabrous or with a few stiff appressed hairs beneath; midrib impressed to slightly prominent above; primary veins 7-9 pairs, plane above, venation more or less plane above; petioles 4.0-8.0 mm long, tomentellous to tomentose. Stipules to 2.0 mm long, deltoid, tomentose, caducous. Flowers hermaphrodite; pedicels 0.2-1.0 mm long. Inflorescences short terminal, axillary or petiolar panicles, the rachis and branches gray-brown tomentose. Bracts and bracteoles lanceolate, 0.5-2.0 mm long, tomentose, persistent. Calyx ca 2.5 mm long, the lobes almost equal, tomentose on exterior. Corolla of 5 equal, deeply bifid and slightly cucullate lobes, glabrous, free to base. Fertile stamens 5, alternating with and equalling corolla lobes. Disc of 5 tack-like, free glands. Ovary bilocular or trilocular with 2 ovules in each loculus, lanate on exterior. Style lanate at base, glabrescent above, the apex trifid. Fruit irregularly elongate-ellipsoid, to 3.8 cm long; epicarp shortly gray-brown tomentellous; mesocarp thin, endocarp thin, bony, glabrous within.

description: Shrub or small tree to 6 m tall, young shoots and branchlets lepidote, sometimes sparsely so or glabrous. Leaf blade oblancolate or narrowly elliptic, 7.5-18 (-27) x 2.5-5.5(-8.5) cm, subcoriaceous, 0.25-0.35 mm thick, glabrous, base attenuate, apex acute or short-acuminate, often mucronulate; extraxylary sclerenchyma mostly separated from epidermis by a layer of mesenchymatous cells, arranged in bundles 5-17 cells thick and ± isodiametric in cross section; hypo-derm lacking; petiole 6-25 mm long, 1.2-2.6 mm thick. Flowers l-3(-9), seemingly umbellate or racemose with rachis to 0.7 cm long, pedicels 13-25 mm long, seemingly glabrous; bracts 2-3.5 mm long-inserted at base of pedicel. Calyx lobes very broadly ovate, 6-7 x 7-8 mm, seemingly glabrous, margins erose. Corolla tube 7-8 mm long, smooth within, lobes (10-) 13-14 x (8-)13-17 mm, margins fimbriate. Staminodes ovate or obovate, 1.5-2 x 1.2-1.7 mm, margins entire. Filaments 4.5-5 mm long, anthers 3-3.5 mm long. Pistil 6-8 mm long; ovules 40-60 in 4-6 rows. Fruit 10-14 x 6-7 cm, pericarp 2-3 mm thick, surface smooth to faintly rugose; seeds 35-45, 8-15 mm long.

description: Tree 20-25 m high; trunk 40-70 cm diam.; bark striate, reddish-brown. Branchlets slender, obtusely trigonous. Leaves markedly resembling those of Goupia glabra Aublet (Celastraceae), ovate to oblong-ovate, apex rather gradually acuminate, tip subacute, base rounded-obtuse, chartaceous, nigrescent in dry state, glaucescent beneath, entire, glabrous, 3(or sub-5)-nerved from above base (these basal nerves prominent beneath), other lateral upper nerves 6-8 pairs much less conspicuous, hardly raised beneath, 6-10 x 2.5-3.5 cm; petiole canaliculate, a little or not swollen at base or apex, smooth, 1-1.5 cm long. Umbels axillary, 10-12-flowered, on slender peduncle 1.5-2 cm long which bears on top a number of thick subglobular gland-like emergences from which the slender pedicels (1-2 cm long) arise. Calyx cup-shaped, hardly 1 mm long and in diam., obtusely 4(-5)-dentate for ½ its length, minutely pubescent. Petals 4, linear-oblong, subacute, pale yellow or greenish, papillose outside and with a line of forward directed hairs at edge inside, ca. 4 x 1 mm. Stamens 8 (sometimes 12), exserted for ca. 1 cm at full anthesis; filaments filiform, glabrous; anthers obconical or obovate-clavate, ca. 1 mm long. Ovary subcylindric, shortly attenuate distally, 4-7-costulate lengthwise, 2 mm long; stigma small. Drupe pyriform, blackish when ripe, 7.5-8 x 45 cm; pericarp thin; endocarp woody for ca. 5 mm outside, spongious for ca. 2 mm inside.

description: Description based on wet and dried specimens. Fleshy yellowish-brown to deep purple root parasites. Tuber subspherical to ellipsoid, (2.3-)4-6 cm long and (2.1-)4-8(-10) cm wide, often irregularly lobed and bearing short, cylindrical processes. One or more inflorescence-bearing stems appear from each tuber, breaking through the outer tissues of the tuber, thus forming an inconspicuous volva or ring-like mark at the base of the fully developed stem. Stem leafless, short or elongated, cylindrical, (0.2-)3-7(-10.5) cm long and (0.3-)0.7-1.6(-2.9) cm wide, often slightly longitudinally furrowed in upper part. Inflorescences apparently not branched, subspherical to ellipsoid or obovoid, when young covered by the flattened or conical, marginally cohering hexagonal peltas of peltate, petiolate bracts; (1.0-)3-7(-ll) cm long and (1.2-) 2-4.5(-8.5) cm wide without bracts. Bracts with pelta 4-8 mm diam. and 1.5-3 mm thick, flattened or with a low conical knob in the centre, petiole 3 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide below and 1.7-2 mm wide in upper part, early deciduous. Each bract subtends an extremely depressed, hardly discernible branch delimitated by imaginary lines between the petioles of four neighboring bracts. Branch unisexual or bisexual and then strongly proterogynous. Flowers embedded in a dense layer of filiform, narrowly clavate hairs, which are 1.8-2 mm long. Male flowers with perianth tubular below and funnelshaped, irregularly crenate to obviously 3-lobed above, 3.5-5 mm long and up to 1 mm wide, lobes ligulate 1.8 x 0.8 mm. Stamens 3, filaments united into a tubular column, which again is united with the lower third of the perianth tube; column 2.5-6 mm long and up to 0.3 mm wide. Anthers connate into a 6-locular synandrium with the locules longitudinally arranged, 0.8 x 1 mm. A short, conical structure 0.8 mm long protruding from the receptacle into the base of the staminal tube might constitute a rudimentary ovary. Female flowers with perianth adnate to ovary, 2 short and broad, lip-like segments protruding above ovary, compressed with edge generally facing petioles of bracts, 1-1.2 mm long from base to tip of perianth segments and 0.5-0.6 mm wide, Styles 2, filiform, 1-1.2 mm long, appearing above layer of hairs, caducous; stigma capitellate. Fruit a small, 1-seeded achene.

description: Bejuco, lenticelas presentes, alargadas, ramas jóvenes densamente ferrugíneo-tomentosas. Hojas imparipinadas; foliolos 5-7, pulvínulo cilindrico, craso, rugoso, ferrugíneo-tomentoso a glabro, 1-1.4 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, liso, ferrugíneo-tomentoso cuando joven, más tarde glabro, 5-6 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, ferrugíneo-tomentoso cuando joven, a glabro, 5-9 cm de largo. Foliolos 12-24 cm de largo, 4.5-6.5 cm de ancho, elípticos a oblongo-lanceolados, car-táceos, haz glabra, envés glabro o esparcidamente pubérulo, base cuneada o redondeada, raramente irregular, ápice acuminado (acumen 1-1.8 cm de largo), margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, Asurado, hasta de 1 cm de largo; venación transversal al menos en las 2/3 partes proximales del foliolo, nervadura central prominente en el envés y en la haz; nervaduras laterales 6-8 pares, formando ángulos de 70° con la nervadura central, irregularmente anastomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas en el envés, levemente promínulas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias levemente promínulas en ambas caras. Inflorescencia paniculada, pseu-doterminal; raquila hasta de 20 cm de largo, densamente ferrugíneo-tomentosa. Flores sésiles; sépalos 3 mm de largo, ca. 2 mm de ancho, más o menos connados formando dos grupos de dos sépalos cada uno y dejando un sépalo libre, con puntuaciones pequeñas, inconspicuas, tomentosos exteriormente, glabros interiormente, ápice agudo u obtuso; pétalos 4 mm de largo, 1.5 mm de ancho, oblongo-obovados (espatulados), con numerosas puntuaciones conspicuas, glabros; filamentos connados en flores jóvenes, más tarde libres, 5 más largos 4 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 2.5 mm de longitud, glabros; anteras globosas, 0.3 mm de diámetro; ovario densamente tomentoso, estilo muy corto (0.3 mm), tomentoso. Fruto desconocido.

description: Hojas trifolioladas. Folíolos oblongos, raramente oblongo-lanceolados, cartá-ceos, base redondeada, nervaduras laterales (8-) 10-13 pares, delicadas, paralelas entre sí, anastomosadas claramente cerca al margen del folíolo, ápice corto y suavemente acuminado. Inflorescencia tomentosa, ferrugínea. Fruto joven ferrugíneo-tomentoso, más tarde glabrescente o pubérulo.

description: Bejuco, lenticelas presentes, pequeñas, verrucosas, ramas jóvenes ferrugíneo-tomentosas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos (3-)5-7, pulvínulo cilindrico, grueso, rugoso, ferrugíneo-tomentoso cuando joven, más tarde glabro, 0.7-1.2 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, adulto glabro, 4-14.5 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, adulto glabro, 1-9 cm de largo. Folíolos 9-22 cm de largo, 3.6-10 cm de ancho, elípticos u oblongo-obovados, cartáceos, haz opaca, glabra, envés con tomento ferrugíneo esparcido, base redondeada o atenuada, ápice brevemente acuminado, margen entero; peciólulo rugoso, hasta de 1 cm de largo; venación reticulada (oscuramente transversal en la mitad proximal del foliolo), nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 7-9 pares, formando ángulos de 45° con la nervadura central, irregularmente anastomosadas cerca al margen, prominentes en el envés, impresas o planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias levemente promínulas en el envés, planas o muy levemente promínulas en la haz. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar o pseudoterminal; raquila densamente ferrugíneo-tomentosa. Pedicelo muy corto (0.1 mm); sépalos 3-3.5 mm de largo, l.8 mm de ancho, lanceolados, con puntuaciones inconspicuas, tomentosos ex-teriormente, glabros interiormente, ápice agudo; pétalos 4.5 mm de largo, ca. 1 mm de ancho, subrectangulares, con puntuación inconspicua, glabros exterior e interiormente; filamentos unidos cortamente en la base, 5 más largos, ca. 3.2 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 2.2 mm de longitud, glabros; anteras globosas, 0.4 mm de diámetro. Fruto estipitado, estípite 0.5-0.7 cm de largo, el fruto 2.5 cm de largo, 1.4 cm de ancho, tomentoso exteriormente, cáliz en el fruto presente, densamente ferrugíneo-tomentoso.

description: Liana, lenticelas presentes, verrucosas. Hojas trifolioladas (raramente unifolio-ladas), pulvínulo cilindrico, poco diferenciado del pecíolo, liso en algunas hojas y profundamente Asurado en hojas adultas, 0.7(-1.5) cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, liso o levemente estriado, lenticelado, glabro, (3-) 10-15(-20) cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, liso o levemente estriado, lenticelado, glabro, 1.5-4(-5) cm de largo. Foliolos (14-)20-33(-36) cm de largo, (7-)9.5-13(-19.5) cm de ancho, elípticos, oblongo-elípticos u obovados, cartáceos, haz brillante, glabra, envés opaco, glabro o esparcidamente pubérulo sobre las nervaduras, base angostada o cuneada, ápice abruptamente acuminado (acumen 0.5 cm de largo, raramente hasta 1.5 cm), margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, profundamente Asurado transversalmente, glabro, 0.5-1 cm de largo; venación transversal (al menos en 2/3 de la longitud del folíolo), nervadura central muy prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales (6-)7-11 pares, formando ángulos de 45° con la nervadura central en la base del folíolo, y de 70° hacia la mitad y el ápice, claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen, prominentes en el envés, impresas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias promínulas en el envés, planas o muy levemente promínulas en la haz. Inflorescencia en panícula racemosa, axilar; raquila 4(-9) cm de largo, diminutamente pubérula, más tarde glabra, sépalos (en botón) con puntuaciones más o menos conspicuas, pubérulos exteriormente, pubescentes interiormente, ápice obtuso; pétalos (en botón) con puntuaciones conspicuas, numerosas; filamentos unidos, con pelos glandulosos en el extremo distal; anteras cordadas, con pelos glandulosos en el ápice; ovario tomentoso. Fruto sésil, no estipitado, 2-3.5 cm de largo, 1.2-2 cm de ancho, diminutamente pubérulo exteriormente, velutino interiormente, cáliz presente en el fruto, pubérulo. Semilla 2 cm de largo, ca. 1 cm de ancho, ariloide 1 cm de largo.

description: Bejuco, lenticelas presentes, romboides, ramas jóvenes densamente marrón-vellosas. Hojas trifolioladas (raramente unifolioladas), pulvínulo cilindrico, rugoso, densamente velloso cuando joven, más tarde glabro, 0.3-1 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, levemente estriado, más o menos velloso a glabro, 2-11 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, más o menos velloso o glabro, 0.5-1.5 cm de largo. Folíolos 7-19 cm de largo, 2.3-7.5 cm de ancho, oblongos u oblanceolado-oblongos, subcoriáceos, haz oscura, algo brillante, glabra, envés opaco, concoloro, glabro o escasamente pubescente en la base de la lámina y del nervio central; base angostada, irregular en los dos foliólos laterales, ápice abruptamente acuminado, margen entero, débilmente revoluto; peciólulo cilindrico, velloso, hasta 0.5 cm de largo; venación reticulada u oscuramente transversal principalmente hacia la base de la lámina, nervadura central prominente en el envés, plana en la haz; nervaduras laterales 7-9 pares, formando ángulos de 45° con la nervadura central, irregularmente anastomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias levemente promínulas en ambas caras. Inflorescencia en panícula racemosa, axilar o pseudoterminal; raquila 13 cm de largo (en fruto puede llegar a 17 cm), densamente marrón o ferrugíneo-tomentosa; brac-teolas 1.5 mm de largo. Pedicelo densamente velloso, 0.1 cm de largo; sépalos 2.8 mm de largo, 1.5-1.8 mm de ancho, ovados, con puntuaciones pequeñas, conspicuas interiormente, densamente vellosos exterior e interiormente, ápice agudo; pétalos 4.2 mm de largo, 1.5-1.8 mm de ancho, elípticos, con puntuaciones inconspicuas, elongadas (prácticamente lineares) localizadas principalmente hacia el ápice, glabros; ñlamentos unidos por 0.1-0.2 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 2.2-2.3 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 1.2 mm de longitud, glabros; anteras redondeadas, 0.5-0.6 mm de diámetro; ovario densamente velloso, estilo velloso, estigma aplanado. Fruto estipitado, estípite hasta 0.7 cm de largo, el fruto 3-4 cm de largo, 1.8-2.3 cm de ancho, densamente ferrugíneo-velloso cuando joven, velloso en la base cuando maduro, velloso interiormente, cáliz presente en el fruto, densamente velloso. Semilla 2 cm de largo, 1.3 cm de ancho.

description: Liana, lenticelas presentes, inconspicuas, ramas jóvenes glabras. Hojas trifolioladas; pulvínulo cilindrico, rugoso, glabro, 0.7-1 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, liso, algo brillante, glabro, 3-13.5 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, liso, glabro, 14 cm de largo. Foliolos 9-15(-20) cm de largo, 3.8-7(-10) cm de ancho, ovados a ovado-elípticos, coriáceos a rígido-coriáceos, haz brillante, oscura, glabra, envés opaco, claro, glabro, base redondeada o levemente cordada, ápice acuminado (acumen hasta de 1.5 cm de largo), margen marcadamente revoluto; peciólulo cilindrico, rugoso, 0.5-1 cm de largo; venación transversal, patente en la haz, nervadura central prominente en el envés, plana o levemente impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 7-9 pares, formando ángulos de 45-60° con la nervadura central, no claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias planas en el envés, promínulas en la haz. Inflorescencia paniculada, laxa, axilar o pseudoterminal, raquila hasta 15 cm de larga (raramente 21 cm), pubérula. Pedicelo pubérulo, 0.5-0.8 cm de largo; sépalos 3-3.5 mm de largo, 1.3 mm de ancho, con puntuaciones inconspicuas, pubérulos exterior e interiormente, ápice barbado, margen ciliado; pétalos 4.5-5.5 mm de largo, 1.8-2.5 mm de ancho, connados en la parte media, oblongo-elípticos, con numerosos puntos inconspicuos, pubérulos y con pelos glandulosos exteriormente, glabros interiormente; filamentos unidos por 0.4 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 2-3 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 1-2 mm de longitud, con pelos glandulosos; anteras globosas con pelos glandulosos en el ápice; ovario pubérulo, estilo pubérulo, estigma bilobulado. Fruto estipitado, estípite 0.5-0.8 cm de largo, el fruto hasta 2.3 cm de largo, 1.7 cm de ancho, glabro exteriormente, pubérulo interiormente, cáliz en el fruto no persistente.

description: Bejuco. Lenticelas presentes, circulares, ramas jóvenes velutinas. Hojas trifolioladas; pulvínulo cilindrico, Asurado, glabro, 0.2-0.5 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, estriado, rugoso, glabro, 1.5-4(-5) cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, estriado, rugoso, glabro, 1-2(-2.5) cm de largo. Foliolos 4-8.5(-9.5) cm de largo, 1.8-3.3 (-5.5) cm de ancho, elípticos, coriáceos, haz brillante, glabra, envés opaco, glabro, base redondeada a subcordada, ápice acuminado, margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, muy rugoso, 0.3-0.5 cm de largo; venación reticulada, retículo aerolado, nervadura central prominente en el envés, plana en la haz; nervaduras laterales 7 pares, formando ángulos de 45-50° con la nervadura central, en general claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias formando un retículo promínulo en el envés. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar o principalmente pseudoterminal y reunida en grupos al extremo de las ramillas; raquila 4-8 cm de largo, ferrugíneo-tomentosa. Pedicelo ferrugíneo-tomentoso, ca. 0.4 cm de largo; sépalos 2 mm de largo, 1.2 mm de ancho, ovados, con puntuaciones inconspicuas, tomentosos exteriormente, glabros interiormente, ápice agudo; pétalos 4 mm de largo, 1.7-2 mm de ancho, oblongo-elípticos, con puntuaciones inconspicuas, glabros; filamentos unidos por 0.3 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 2.2 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 1.5 mm de longitud, glabros; anteras cordadas con pelos glandulosos en el ápice, 0.3 mm de diámetro; ovario densamente tomentoso, estilo tomentoso, estigma lobulado. Fruto brevemente estipitado, 2.1 cm de largo, 1.6 cm de ancho, glabro exterior-mente, densamente ferrugíneo-tomentoso interiormente, cáliz en el fruto presente. Semilla 1.5 cm de largo, 0.8 cm de ancho.

description: Arbusto o bejuco alto, lenticelas presentes, conspicuas, verrucosas, ramas jóvenes ferrugíneo-pubérulas, las demás blanquecinas y glabras. Hojas imparipi-nadas; foliólos (3-)5-7(-9), pulvínulo cilindrico, grueso, rugoso, en general más oscuro que el pecíolo, glabro, hasta 1 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, estriado, pubérulo cuando joven, más tarde glabro, (2-)5-12(-14) cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, estriado, pubérulo cuando joven, más tarde glabro, 5-6(-12) cm de largo. Foliolos (3-)8-20(-25) cm de largo, (1.5-)3-5(-9) cm de ancho, angosto-elípticos u oblongo-lanceolados, cartáceos, haz brillante, oscura, glabra, envés opaco, claro, inconspicuamente verrucoso, a veces con puntos oscuros, glabro, base redondeada a levemente subcordada, ápice abrupto y largamente acuminado (acumen 0.5-1 cm de largo), margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, rugoso, glabro, 0.5—1 cm de largo; venación transversal, nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 10-13 pares, formando ángulos de 60° con la nervadura central, claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias promínulas en ambas caras. Inflorescencia paniculada, densiflora, axilar o pseudoterminal y por lo general varias colocadas en el extremo de las ramas; raquila 15 cm de largo, pubérula. Pedicelo pubérulo, 0.6-1 cm de largo; sépalos 2.5-3.5 mm de largo, 0.8-2 mm de ancho, elípticos, con puntuaciones conspicuas, pubérulos exteriormente, glabros interiormente, margen ciliado; pétalos 4.5-7 mm de largo, 1.2-2.6 mm de ancho, oblongo-elípticos, con puntuaciones característicamente conspicuas y numerosas, glabros o glabrescentes exteriormente, pubérulos y con pelos glandulosos interiormente, ápice con pelos glandulosos; filamentos unidos por 0.5-1 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 1.5-5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 0.5-3.5 mm de longitud, con pelos glandulosos conspicuos; anteras elongadas, ca. 0.2-0.4 mm de diámetro; ovario tomentoso. Fruto estipitado, estípite hasta 0.7 cm de largo, el fruto 2.5 cm de largo, 1.2 cm de ancho, glabro exteriormente, pubérulo interiormente, cáliz en el fruto presente.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Bejuco, lenticelas presentes, verrucosas, conspicuas, ramas blanquecinas, ramas jóvenes glabras. Hojas trifolioladas, pulvínulo grueso, Asurado, glabro, 0.5-0.8 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, muy levemente estriado, lenticelado, glabro, 1.65 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, muy levemente estriado, lenticelado, glabro, 0.4-1.8 cm de largo. Foliolos 7-20 cm de largo, 3.5-9 cm de ancho, oblongo-obovados, rígido-coriáceos, haz brillante, glabra, envés opaco, glabro, base angostada o redondeada, ápice cortamente acuminado (acumen 0.2-0.3 cm de largo), margen revoluto; peciólulo grueso, fisurado, 0.6-0.8 cm de largo; venación reticulada, nervadura central muy prominente en el envés, levemente promínula o plana en la haz; nervaduras laterales 9-11 pares, formando ángulos de 70° con la nervadura central, claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen, levemente promínulas en el envés, planas o muy levemente promínulas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias muy levemente promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz. Inflorescencia paniculada, con varias inflorescencias formándose sobre una corta ramilla engrosada; raquila hasta 10 cm de largo, pubérula; brácteas inconspicuas. Pedicelo pubérulo, 3 mm de largo; sépalos 3 mm de largo, 1.6 mm de ancho, ovados, con puntuaciones inconspicuas exteriormente, conspicuas interiormente, pubérulos exteriormente, glabros interiormente, ápice obtuso, margen ciliado; pétalos 4.2 mm de largo, 1.6-1.7 mm de ancho, elípticos, con puntos conspicuos, pequeños, pelos glan-dulosos presentes exteriormente y en el margen, glabros interiormente; filamentos unidos por 0.5-0.7 mm de su longitud y con puntuaciones características en la porción libre, 5 más largos 2.5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 2 mm de longitud, con pelos glandulosos en la mitad distal; anteras globosas, 0.4 mm de diámetro; ovario velutino, estilo pubescente y con pelos glandulosos en la mitad distal, estigma lobulado. Fruto estipitado, estípite 0.2-0.3 cm de largo, el fruto 2.2 cm de largo, 1.4 cm de ancho, estriado, glabro exteriormente, pubérulo interiormente, cáliz en el fruto persistente, cubriendo el estípite. Semilla 1.3 cm de largo, 0.4 cm de ancho, ariloide lasciniado, 0.4 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Bejuco de gran tamaño, lenticelas presentes, ramas jóvenes grisósas, muy densamente vellosas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos (1-)3, pulvínulo cilindrico, más o menos indiferenciado, Asurado, velloso o glabrescente, 0.4-0.7 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, levemente estriado, velloso cuando joven y con la pubescencia irregularmente distribuida a lo largo del pecíolo cuando maduro, 4-14 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, velloso, completamente reducido ó 1.5 cm de largo. Folíolos 10-20(-22) cm de largo, 3.5-8(-10.2) cm de ancho, elípticos u obovado-oblongos, cartáceos, haz brillante, algo bulada, glabra, envés opaco, densamente marrón-velloso cuando joven, glabros o irregularmente vellosos principalmente sobre las nervaduras cuando maduros, base angostada, ápice obtuso o usualmente cortamente acuminado, margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, rugoso, velloso, 0.40.5 cm de largo; venación reticulada, oscuramente transversal hacia la base de la lámina, nervadura central prominente en el envés, promínula en la haz; nervaduras laterales 5-7 pares, las inferiores fuertemente ascendentes, anastomosándose claramente cerca al margen en la mitad superior del folíolo, prominentes en el envés, planas o promínulas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias prominentes en el envés, levemente promínulas en la haz. Flores desconocidas. Infrutescencia axilar o pseudoterminal; raquilla 5-14 cm de largo, vellosa. Frutos sésiles, estipitados, estípite hasta de 0.5 cm, engrosado, el fruto hasta 3 cm de largo, hasta 2 cm de ancho, densamente velloso cuando joven (el estípite permanece velloso cuando maduro) exteriormente, glabro cuando maduro, velloso interiormente, cáliz y corola persistentes en el fruto, cáliz velloso. Semilla 2.1 cm de largo, 1.3 cm de ancho, ariloide hasta 1.3 cm de largo.

description: Bejuco, lenticelas presentes, conspicuas, ramas blanquecinas, las jóvenes velutinas. Hojas imparipinadas; foliólos (5-)7, pulvínulo cilindrico, levemente rugoso, glabro, (0.5-)0.7-1 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, muy levemente estriado, glabro, (3-)9.5-15 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, glabro, (2-)6-8 cm de largo. Foliolos (7-)9-20 cm de largo, (2.5-)2.7-4.4 cm de ancho, angosto-oblanceolados, cartáceos, haz brillante, oscura, glabra, envés opaco, algo más claro que la haz, glabro, base redondeada, ápice acuminado (acumen hasta de 0.7 cm de largo), margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, rugoso, 0.2-0.4 cm de largo; venación oscuramente transversal en la mitad proximal de los foliolos, nervadura central muy prominente en el envés, levemente impresa o plana en la haz; nervaduras laterales 10-15 pares, formando ángulos de 45-60° con la nervadura central, irregularmente anastomosadas cerca al margen, levemente promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias muy levemente promínulas en el envés, obsoletas en la haz. Flores desconocidas. Infrutescencia paniculada, axilar (1-2 por axila) o pseudoterminal; raquila hasta de 26 cm de larga, velutina. Frutos sésiles, estipi-tados, estípite 0.3-0.5 cm de largo, el fruto 2 cm de largo, 1.5 cm de ancho, diminutamente pubérulo o glabrescente exteriormente, pubérulo interiormente, cáliz en el fruto presente.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Pecíolo (2-)5-12(-16) cm de largo, raquis (2-)9-13 cm de largo. Foliolos (2-)4-17(-23) cm de largo, (l-)2.7-5.5(-6) cm de ancho, angosto-elípticos, rígido-cartáceos, ápice largamente acuminado, acumen hasta 1.5 cm de longitud, margen levemente revoluto, venación reticulada. Pedicelo 0.2 cm de largo; sépalos 2.8-3.5 mm de largo, unidos en grupos; pétalos 2.8-3.5 mm de largo, 0.7-0.9 mm de ancho, glabros o esparcidamente pubérulos exteriormente; filamentos unidos por 1 mm de su longitud, glabros o con pelos glandulosos; anteras globosas con pelos glandulosos en el ápice del conectivo o sin ellos. Fruto estipitado, estípite hasta 0.4 cm de largo, el fruto 2 cm de largo, 1.7 cm de ancho.
