description: Arbusto escandente o bejuco leñoso, ramas jóvenes glabras, conspicuamente lenticeladas. Hojas imparipinadas; foliólos (3-)5-7; pecíolo 1.5-7 cm de largo, glabro; raquis 0.5-1.5 cm de largo, glabro. Foliolos 5.5-12 cm de largo, 2.5-3.5 cm de ancho, angosta o anchamente elípticos, coriáceos, haz oscura, brillante, glabra, envés claro, opaco o brillante, glabro, base redondeada o atenuada, ápice acuminado a abruptamente acuminado, margen revoluto; peciólulo 0.2-0.5 cm de largo, venación finamente reticulada, difusa, plana o levemente promínula en la haz, promínula en el envés; nervaduras laterales 5-6 pares, formando ángulos de 50-60° con la nervadura central, no anastomosadas cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, pseudoterminal, terminal o axilar; raquila 4-7 cm de largo, glabra; brácteas 0.2 cm de largo, carinadas. Fruto 1.2-1.5 cm de largo, 0.5 cm de ancho, glabro; pedúnculo de obsoleto a 0.5 cm de largo; cáliz en fruto 0.4-0.5 cm de largo, glabro o glabrescente, ápice barbado. Semilla 0.8-1.1 cm de largo, 0.3-0.5 cm de ancho; ariloide 0.2-0.3 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbusto o bejuco leñoso, ramas jóvenes glabras, glabrescentes, pubérulas o tomentosas, conspicuamente lenticeladas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos 5-7; pecíolo 2-3.5 cm de largo, glabro o densamente tomentoso; raquis 2-4 cm de largo, glabro o velloso. Folíolos (1-) 1.5-10 cm de largo, (0.5-) 1-4.5 cm de ancho, oblongos, elípticos u oblongo-elípticos, cartáceos, haz oscura, glabra, envés claro, opaco, glabro o velloso y sedoso, con papilas, nervadura central glabra en la haz, densamente vellosa o glabra en el envés; base cordada o subcordada, raramente obtusa o truncada, ápice agudo o corto-acuminado, margen revoluto; peciólulo ca. 0.10.2 cm de largo; venación reticulada, difusa o levemente promínula en la haz, promínula en el envés; nervaduras laterales 3-6(-7) pares, formando ángulos de 40-50°(-70°) con la nervadura central, más o menos claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, terminal, pseudoterminal o axilar, raquila (3-)4-11 cm de largo, esparcidamente tomentosa o glabra; brácteas 0.20.4 cm de largo, pilosas. Pedicelo articulado, 0.3-0.7 cm de largo; sépalos 3 mm de largo, 1.5 mm de ancho, ovados, glabros o glabrescentes, margen ciliado, ápice barbado; pétalos 5-7 mm de largo, 1.5-3 mm de ancho, oblongos, glabros, libres; filamentos unidos por 0.5-0.6 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 3-5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 2-3.5 mm de longitud; anteras globosas; ovario piloso, estilo glabro; estigma capitado, bilobulado. Fruto 1.2 cm de largo, 0.6 cm de ancho, esparcidamente velloso; cáliz en fruto 0.6 cm de largo, glabro, margen ciliado, ápice barbado. Semilla 0.9 cm de largo; ariloide 0.2 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbusto escancíente o bejuco leñoso, ramas jóvenes glabras o pubescentes, len-ticeladas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos (1-)3-7(-15); pecíolo 0.5-7 cm de largo, glabro o pubérulo; raquis 2-15 cm de largo (raramente obsoleto), glabro a pubérulo. Folíolos 2.5-9(-11) cm de largo, 1-4.5 cm de ancho, oblongos, elípticos u oblongo-elípticos, rígido-cartáceos a subcoriáceos, haz oscura, brillante, glabra, envés claro, opaco, glabro, base redondeada, atenuada o cuneada, ápice acuminado; peciólulo 0.1-0.5 cm de largo; venación reticulada, promínula en ambas caras; nervaduras laterales 5-8(-9) pares, formando ángulos de 50-70° con la nervadura central, anastomosadas más o menos claramente cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar, pseudoterminal o terminal, raquila 3-9(-18) cm de largo, glabra o pubérula; brácteas generalmente pequeñas 0.1 (-0.3) cm de largo, ovadas o triangulares. Pedicelo articulado, (0.2-)0.25-0.6 cm de largo; sépalos 2-3 mm de largo, 1-2 mm de ancho, ovados, glabros, raramente pubérulos exteriormente, velutinos interiormente; margen ciliado, ápice barbado; pétalos 3-6 mm de largo, 1-3 mm de ancho, oblongos u obovados, ¿abros, libres; filamentos unidos por ca. 0.5 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos ca. 1.5-4 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos ca. 0.5-3.5 mm de longitud; anteras globosas o subcordadas; ovario velloso o piloso, estilo glabro, o pubescente en la base; estigma capitado, bilobulado. Fruto 1.2-1,6(-2) cm de largo, 0.5-1 cm de ancho, glabro, inmaduro raramente esparcidamente pubérulo; cáliz en fruto 0.5 cm de largo. Semilla 1-1.5 cm de largo, 0.5-0.7 cm de ancho; ariloide ca. 0.4 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbusto, arbusto escándeme o bejuco leñoso, ramas jóvenes esparcidamente vellosas, pubérulas o glabrescentes, conspicuamente lenticeladas. Hojas imparipinadas; foliólos 5-7(-9); pecíolo 2-4 cm de largo, velloso o glabro; raquis 2-7 (-9) cm de largo, densamente velloso o glabro. Foliolos 1.5-12 cm de largo, 1-5 cm de ancho, oblongos, elípticos, oblongo-elípticos u oblongo-obovados, subcar-táceos o cartáceos, haz glabra, envés glabro o densamente velloso y sedoso, papilas ausentes o poco desarrolladas, nervadura central densamente vellosa o glabra, base cordada o subcordada, raramente obtusa, ápice redondeado, agudo o cortamente acuminado, margen entero o levemente revoluto cerca a la base; peciólulo desde muy corto hasta 0.2 cm de largo; venación reticulada, plana o difusa en la haz, promínula en el envés; nervaduras laterales 4-7 pares, formando ángulos de 30-80° con la nervadura central, más o menos claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, pseudoterminal o axilar; raquila 5-10 cm de largo, esparcidamente tomentosa, glabrescente o glabra; brácteas desde muy pequeñas hasta 0.4 cm de largo, lanceoladas, tomentosas. Pedicelo articulado, 0.2-0.4 cm de largo; sépalos 3 mm de largo, 2.5 mm de ancho, ovados u orbiculares, glabros, margen ciliado, ápice barbado; pétalos 5-6 mm de largo, 1.5-2 mm de ancho, oblongos, glabros, libres; filamentos unidos por 0.5 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos ca. 3 mm, 5 más cortos ca. 1.4 mm; anteras globosas; ovario piloso. Fruto 1 cm de largo, 0.3-0.4 cm de ancho, glabro o glabrescente; cáliz en fruto 0.4-0.5 cm de largo, glabro. Semilla 0.6-0.8 cm de largo, 0.25-0.3 cm de ancho; ariloide 0.2 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbusto escandente o bejuco leñoso, ramas jóvenes tomentosas, densamente tomentosas o densamente pubérulas, inconspicuamente lenticeladas. Hojas im-paripinadas; foliólos 5-7(-11); pecíolo 0.5-0.6 cm de largo, pubérulo a densamente pubérulo; raquis 1-7 cm de largo, pubérulo a densamente pubérulo. Foliolos (0.8-) 1.5-12 cm de largo, (0.5-)1-5 cm de ancho, elípticos u oblongo-elípticos, cartáceos a rígido-cartáceos, haz oscura, brillante, glabra, envés claro, opaco, diminuta a densamente pubérulo o glabrescente, nervadura central glabra en la haz, pubérula o densamente pubérula en el envés, base obtusa o cuneada, ápice abruptamente acuminado, acumen emarginado o entero; peciólulo 0.1-0.3 cm de largo, densamente pubérulo; venación reticulada, plana a promínula (raramente impresa) en la haz, promínula en el envés; nervadura central impresa en la haz, prominente en el envés; nervaduras laterales 5-7(-10) pares, formando ángulos de 50-80° con la nervadura central, claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar a pseudoterminal; raquila 1-6 cm de largo, pubérula o tomentosa; brácteas 0.1-0.2 cm de largo, triangulares. Flores desconocidas. Fruto 1-1.2 cm de largo, 0.5 cm de ancho, esparcidamente pubescente o glabro; pedúnculo articulado, 0.1-0.5 cm de largo; cáliz en fruto 0.4-0.6 cm de largo, pubérulo o densamente pubérulo. Semilla ca. 1 cm de largo, 0.4 cm de ancho; ariloide 0.3-0.4 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arboles pequeños, arbustos o arbustos trepadores; lenticelas presentes. Hojas imparipinadas, 7-13 folioladas; foliolos membranáceos a cartáceos, glabros o pubescentes en la haz, envés esparcidamente pubescente hasta densamente villoso, papilas ausentes, pecioluladas. Inflorescencias axilares, paniculadas. Brácteas conspicuas. Flores actinomorfas, bisexuales, pentámeras; sépalos imbricados, pu-bérulos externamente, glabros internamente, puntos glandulosos ausentes; pétalos glabros, puntos y pelos glandulosos ausentes; estambres 10, libres, glabros; pistilos 5, estilo glabro, pelos glandulosos ausentes, óvulos 2. Fruto folículo, varios carpelos maduros por flor, obovado, ligeramente mucronado, sésil, pubérulo o gla-brescente exteriormente, glabro interiormente, cáliz en fruto presente, reclinado; semilla 1 por fruto, endospermo ausente.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Lianas; ramas jóvenes tomentosas o rufo-tomentosas. Hojas imparipinadas, 59 folioladas; foliolos cartáceos o subcoriáceos, pubérulos o rufo-tomentosos en el envés, glabros en la haz, papilas ausentes, peciolulados. Inflorescencias paniculadas, axilares o pseudoterminales. Brácteas conspicuas o inconspicuas. Flores actinomorfas, bisexuales, pentámeras; sépalos pubescentes exteriormente, más o menos pubescentes o glabrescentes interiormente, puntos glandulosos ausentes; pelos glandulosos ausentes; pétalos glabros; estambres 10, cortamente connados o libres en la base; anteras globosas o cordadas, dehiscencia longitudinal; pistilo con 5 carpelos libres, óvulos 2. Fruto 1-2 folículos, raramente 4, sésil, pubescente exteriormente, glabro interiormente, pelos glandulosos ausentes, cáliz en fruto presente; semilla 1, endospermo presente, escaso; ariloide presente.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbustos, arvoretas ou árvores, raro lianas (coletada em Caiena) 1-35 m, DAP 5-100 cm. Ramos pubescentes ou pulverulentos, glabros na maturação. Folhas palmatinérveas, pecíolos 0.2-7.5 cm, avermelhados, canaliculados, pubescentes ou pulverulentos, glabrescentes; limbos de tamanhos e formas muito variados, 1-17(19) x 1-9(-10) cm, ovais, elípticos, lanceolados, obovais, orbiculares, elíptico-ovais, elíptico-obovais, elíptico-lanceolados, elíptico-oblongos, a oboval-lanceolados, discolores, cartáceos a subcoriáceos, ápices obtusos, agudos, mais raro acuminados, raríssimos retusos, bases arredondadas a cuneadas, glândulas 2-4 ou mais, de formas variadas (basicamente arredondadas à elípticas), margens delicadamente a acentuadamente crenado-glandulosas, raro apenas onduladas; estipulas 0.5-1 mm, sagitadas, pilosas, caducas; faces adaxiais com nervuras impressas, planas ou levemente proeminentes, indumento de tricomas estrelados mais concentrado nas nervuras; faces abaxiais com nervuras discretamente proeminentes, pulverulentas a glabrescentes, indumento de tricomas estrelados mais concentrado nas nervuras, às vezes com glândulas esparsas em toda a lâmina, do-mácias crateriformes ou pouco escavadas, com tricomas estrelado-dentríticos ou apenas estrelados na junção da nervura principal com as secundárias, algumas vezes com as demais nervuras. Plantas dioicas, raríssimo monoicas (Oliveira 718, Paraná). Plantas masculinas com inflorescências em racemos isolados ou em fascículos, algumas vezes em panículas, 2-17 cm, axilares, raro terminais ou caulifloras, na base brácteas várias, 0.5-1.5 mm, sagitadas, pilosas, flores dispostas em glomérulos multiflorais, as raque pubescentes ou tomentosas. Flores estaminadas curto-pediceladas, pedicelos 0.5-1 mm, bractéolas ca. 0.5 mm, escamiformes, pubescentes; lobos do cálice 2(-3), 1-1.5 mm, glabros; estames (5-6-)8, 1-1.5 mm, concrescidos pelas bases, com um tufo de tricomas estrelados no centro do androceu, às vezes ausente. Plantas femininas com inflorescências em racemos axilares ou terminais, às vezes agrupadas em 2 (ou 3), 2-14 cm compr., flores isoladas, raro aos pares, a raque cilíndrica, pubescente. Flores pistiladas com pedicelos 0.5-1 mm, bractéolas 0.5-0.7 mm, sagitadas, pilosas; cálice gamossépalo, lobos (3-)4,0.5-1.5 mm, sagitados, pilosos, ovário 1-1.5(-2) X 1.2-1.5(-2) mm, subgloboso a piriforme, tomentoso, pubescente ou glabro (visto em coleções amazônicas), 2(-3)-locular, estiletes 2(-3), 4-15 mm, livres ou concrescidos por 0.5-1 mm na base, filiformes, ápices inteiros, pubescentes ou esparso-pubescentes, quase glabros na face externa, glabros, (raríssimo pilosos— Jesus 2011, Rio de Janeiro; Santos 568, Bahia) e levemente rugosos ou lisos na interna. Fruto 0.5-13 cm diâm., elíptico, rosados em fase jovem, negros em material seco, mericarpos 2(-3) ou apenas 1 (por aborto de 1 semente), pubescentes ou glabros; sementes 2(-3), 0.5-0.6 X 0.5-0.6 cm, ovais, globosas a elípticas, sarcotesta carnosa, vermelha ou alaranjada, levemente muricada.
bibliographicCitation: Secco, Ricardo de S. 2004. Alchorneae (Euphorbiaceae) (Alchornea, Aparisthmium e Conceveiba). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 93: 1-194.

description: Arvores 6-25 m altura. Ramos bastante lenticela-dos, glabros. Folhas palmatinérveas, alternas, raro opostas, pecíolos 2-7.5 cm, estriados, canaliculados, glabros; limbos 5-18.5 X 2.5-9 cm, ovais, oval-elípticos, ou simplesmente elípticos, cartáceos, subcoriáceos, ou coriáceos, ápices acuminados a caudados, bases obtusas a levemente cuneadas, planas (não revolutas), glândulas 2-4, arredondadas, margens acentuadamente crenado-glandulosas; faces adaxiais escuras e brilhantes no material seco, verdes-brilhantes no material fresco, com nervuras planas a levemente proeminentes, glabras; faces abaxiais com nervuras proeminentes, esparso-pubescentes, quase glabras, tricomas estrelados restritos às domácias na base foliar e na junção da nervura principal com as secundárias. Plantas masculinas não vistas. Plantas femininas com inflorescências em panículas espiciformes, 9-18 cm, axilares e terminais, na base brácteas várias, 1-1.5 mm, triangulares, pubescentes, flores isoladas, raro pareadas, raques pubescentes ou tomentosas. Flores pistiladas sésseis, bractéolas 0.5-1 mm, sagitadas, pubescentes; cálice gamossépalo, lobos 4, 1 mm, sagitados, pubescentes, especialmente nas margens; ovário 1-1.5 X 1-1.5 mm, ovoide a elíptico, glabro, 2-locular, estiletes 37 mm, filiformes, às vezes levemente achatados, concrescidos por ca. 1 mm na base, ápices inteiros, esparso-pubescentes na face externa, glabros e lisos na interna. Fruto 0.6-0.8 cm diâm., elíptico, mericarpos 2, glabros; sementes 2, ca. 0.5 cm, ovais à elípticas, um tanto deformadas no material examinado, levemente muricadas.

description: Arvoretas ou árvores 4-30 m. Ramos pubescentes a glabros. Folhas palmatinérveas, tipicamente trinervadas nas bases, pecíolos 2-16.5 cm, estriados, canaliculados, denso-pilosos, glabrescentes; limbos 13-43 X 5.5-21 cm, largamente ovais a oval-orbiculares, raríssimo elíptico-lanceolados a elíptico-oblongos, coriáceos, ápices acuminados, bases cuneadas a levemente arredondadas, com 2(4) glândulas, margens crenado ou serrilhado-glandulosas; faces adaxiais com nervuras impressas a levemente proeminentes, glabras; faces abaxiais com nervuras proeminentes, pubescente-estreladas ou quase glabras, domácias pubescentes na junção da nervura central com as secundárias. Plantas masculinas com inflorescências em panículas, 4-12 cm, axilares e caulifloras, fasci-culadas, flores dispostas em glomérulos, raques delicadas com indumento tomentoso de tricomas estrelados. Flores estaminadas vistas em fase jovem, subsésseis, pedicelo 0.5 mm, bractéolas 1 mm, escam-iformes, pubescentes nas margens; lobos do cálice 2, 1-1.5 mm, ovais a orbiculares, glabros; estames 1-1.5 mm, concrescidos pelas bases, com tricomas estrelados no centro do androceu. Plantas femininas com inflorescências em racemos espiciformes a espigas, caulifloras, 8-27 cm compr., as flores dispostas isoladamente, raro pareadas, as raques pubescentes, tricomas estrelados. Flores pistiladas subsésseis a sés-seis, bractéolas 0.8-1 mm,sagitadas, pubescentes, especialmente nas margens; cálice gamossépalo, lobos 4, 1-1.5 mm lanceolados ou sagitados, pilosos; ovário 2 X 2-2.5 mm, subgloboso, oval a elíptico, pubescente-estrelado, 2-locular, estiletes 2, 10-20 mm, filiformes, livres, face externa glabra, face interna lisa a levemente estriada. Fruto analisado apenas em fase jovem, 0.5-0.6 cm diâm., vermelho escuro ou vinoso quando maduro, mericarpos 2, freqüente-mente reduzidos a 1 por aborto (?) de uma semente, pubescente-estrelados; sementes 2 (muito comum vingar apenas 1), ca. 0.5 cm, ovais, levemente muricadas.

description: Arvores 10-30 m. Ramos pubescentes a pulverulentos, glabrescentes. Folhas palmatinérveas, pecíolos 1-9.5 cm, cilíndricos, levemente canaliculados, pulverulentos a pubescentes, glabrescentes; limbos 5-19 X 5-18 cm, suborbiculares, orbiculares, ou oval-orbiculares, cartáceos a subcoriáceos, ápices obtusos a agudos, bases obtusas a levemente cuneadas, trinervadas, margens crenado-glandulosas, estípulas 58 mm, estreito-lanceoladas a filiformes, pubescentes; faces adaxiais pubescentes na folha jovem, na folha adulta tricomas concentrados nas nervuras e ñas bases; faces abaxiais pubescentes à tomentosas, domácias de tricomas estrelados na junção da nervura principal com as secundárias. Plantas masculinas com inflorescências em panículas, 6-17 cm, terminais e axilares, flores isoladas, aos pares ou em tríades, pedúnculos 2.5-4.5 mm, tomentosos a lanosos, raques pulverulentas. Flores estaminadas pediceladas, pedicelos 1 mm, glabros, bractéola 1 por flor, 1-2 mm, lanceolada, margens glandulosas, pubescente externamente, glabra internamente; cálice gamossépalo, valvar, lobos 3, 3-5 mm, ovais, côncavos, ápice pubescente e levemente papiloso (no botão); estames 50-60, 3-4.5 mm, livres, filetes filiformes, glabros, anteras ovais, deiscência lateral. Plantas femininas com inflorescências em racemos, 6-18 cm, terminais, flores isoladas, raro aos pares, raques pulverulentas. Flores pistiladas pediceladas, pedicelos 3-5(-8) mm, tomentosos a lanosos, bractéola 1 por flor, 2.5-4 mm, lanceolada, margens glandulosas, pubescentes externamente, glabras internamente; cálice dialissépalo, às vezes com 4-5 glândulas na base, sépalas (6-)7, 2.5-5 X 0.5-1 mm, valvares ou 2-3 imbricadas e 4-5 valvares, lanceoladas, pubescentes externamente, glabras internamente, ovário 2.5-3 mm diám., oval, trígono, tomentoso, 3-locular, às vezes com 3 rudimentos de estames, 1.5 mm, estiletes 3, 3-5 mm, grossos, bífidos, estigmatosos, concrescidos na base por 1-1.5 mm, face externa pubescente, face interna denso-papilosa, glabra. Fruto 0.8-1.2 cm diâm., cápsula septícida, elíptico quando jovem, subgloboso na maturação, levemente trígono, mericarpos 3, lisos, esparso-pubescentes; sementes não analisadas (fruto colado na exsicata).

description: Arbustos ou árvores, 3-30 m, DAP 10-30 cm. Ramos pubescentes a pulverulentos. Folhas palmatinérveas, bases trinervadas, pecíolos 3.5-25 cm, cilíndricos, pubescentes a pulverulentos, estípulas 1.5-5 cm, lancelado-saciformes, côncavas, estriadas, pubescentes externa e internamente; limbos 10-32 X 7.5- 24 cm, orbiculares, elípticos, ou elíptico-orbiculares, subcoriáceos a coriáceos, ápices obtusos a agudos, bases profundamente cordadas, trinervadas, margens crenado-glandulosas; faces adaxiais pubescentes ñas nervuras; faces abaxiais pulverulentas a pubescentes, indumento de tricomas estrelados, cerosas, glándulas raras na lámina, domácias de tricomas estrelados na junção da nervura principal com as secundárias. Plantas dioicas, raríssimo monoicas. Plantas masculinas com inflorescências em corimbos, 15-32 cm, terminais, flores dispostas em glomérulos paucifloras, raques pubescentes a pulverulentas, estriadas, robustas. Flores estaminadas subsésseis à pediceladas, pedicelos 0.5-1.5 mm, bractéolas 3 por flor, sagitadas, 1 externa e 2 internas, diminutas, imensuráveis, pilosas externamente, glabras internamente; cálice gamossépalo, valvar, lobos 3-4, 2-3.5 mm, ovais, côncavos, pubescentes externamente, glabros internamente, estames 12, 0.5-1.5(-2) mm, sendo 3-4 menores, 8-9 maiores, dispostos externamente aos estaminódios, concrescidos pelas bases, formando uma estrutura plana, filetes grossos, subulados, anteras elípticas, deiscência lateral, estaminódios 15-35, 2.5-4 mm, dispostos centralmente aos estames, livres, em geral dobrados, plicados, filetes filiformes, glabros, as vezes com rudimento de anteras; raramente ocorrem apenas estames (32) férteis, 2.5-3 mm, 12 menores, externos, 20 maiores, internos, os externos levemente dobrados, plicados. Plantas femininas com inflorescências em racemos, 10-30 cm, terminais, flores isoladas, raques pubescentes à pulverulentas. Flores pistiladas pediceladas, pedicelos 7-9 mm, tomentosos, bractéola 1 por flor, 1.5-2 mm, sagitada, pilosa externamente, glabra internamente, glândulas 2, laterais, na base da bractéola; cálice dialissépalo, sépalas 7-9, 2.5-3.5 X 2.5-3 mm, biglandulosas na base, imbricadas, 4-5 externas, 3-4 internas, sagitadas, livres, tomentosas externamente, glabras internamente, raramente ocorre cálice gamossépalo, lobos 4-5.2 mm; ovário 3-4 mm diám., subgloboso a globoso, levemente trígono, tomentoso, 3-locular, estiletes 3, 7-9 mm, eretos, bífidos, concrescidos na base, face externa pubescente, face interna denso-papilosa, glabra. Fruto 1.3-1.8 cm diâm., cápsula septícida, subgloboso, levemente trígono, mericarpos 3, lisos, pulverulentos; sementes 3,0.8-1 cm diâm., ovais, levemente quilhadas ventralmente, levemente pintalgadas.

description: Arvores 5-25 m. Ramos estriados, pulverulentos, glabrescentes. Folhas peninérveas, pecíolos 2-5 cm, subcilíndricos, levemente canaliculados, pubescentes; limbos 11-20 X 5.5-12 cm, elípticos, elíptico-ovais, ou raro elíptico-lanceolados, cartáceos, ápices curtamente acuminados, bases obtusas à levemente arredondadas, margens crenado-glandulosas, estipulas 59 mm, lanceoladas, pubescentes; faces adaxiais esparso-pubescentes, os tricomas mais concentrados nas nervuras e na base foliar; faces abaxiais pubescentes em toda a lâmina, cerosas, domácias de tricomas estrelados na junção da nervura principal com os secundárias. Plantas masculinas com inflorescências em panículas, 18-23 cm, pouco ramificadas, terminais, flores dispostas em glomérulos paucifloras (4-6 flores), raques tomentosas, às vezes pulverulentas. Flores estaminadas vistas apenas em botões em préantese, subsésseis, pedicelo 0.5-0.7 mm, bractéolas 3 por flor, diminutas, imensuráveis, sagitadas, 1 externa, 2 internas, pilosas externamente, glabras internamente; cálice gamossépalo, valvar, lobos 3-4, 1.5-2 mm, ovais, côncavos, pubescentes externamente, glabros internamente, estames 20-30.1-1.5 mm, livres, filetes filiformes, glabros, anteras ovais, deiscência lateral. Plantas femininas com inflorescências em racemos, 14-16 cm, terminais, flores isoladas, raro aos pares, raques tomentosas. Flores pistiladas pediceladas, pedicelos 3.5-4 mm, tomentosos, bractéolas 3 por flor, 3-3.5 mm, 1 externa e 2 internas, ovais, tomentosas externamente, glabras internamente, glândulas 2, laterais, na base das bractéolas; cálice gamossépalo, eglandular, lobos (5-)6, 3-3.5 X 1 mm, lanceolados, tomentosos externamente, glabros internamente, ovário 3-4 mm diâm., subelíptico a elíptico, trígono, tomentoso, 3-locular, estiletes 3.3-4 mm, eretos ou dobrados, grossos, profundamente bífidos, estigmatosos, concrescidos na base por 1 mm, face externa pubescente à tomentosa, face interna denso-papilosa, glabra. Fruto não visto.

description: Arbustos, arvoretas ou árvores, 3-20 m, DAP 1525 cm. Ramos pubescentes a pulverulentos, glabrescentes. Folhas peninérveas, pecíolos 2-15 cm, levemente canaliculados ou inteiros, cilíndricos, pulverulentos a pubescentes, glândulas 2 no ápice; limbos 6-27 X 3.5-15 cm, elípticos, ovais, elíptico-ovais, elíptico-obovais, ou elíptico-lanceolados, subcoriáceos a coriáceos, ápices acuminados, raro caudados, bases levemente arredondadas, margens crenado-glandulosas; faces adaxiais pubescentes na nervura principal, no restante glabras; faces abaxiais pubescentes, com delicado indumento de diminutos tricomas estrelados concentrados nas nervuras, glândulas esparsas na lâmina, domácias de tricomas estrelados (às vezes apenas pubescentes) na junção da nervura principal com as secundárias. Plantas masculinas não vistas. Plantas femininas com inflorescências em racemos, 10-16 cm, terminais, flores isoladas, raques pulverulentas. Flores pistiladas pediceladas, pedicelos 3.5-5 mm, pulverulentos, bractéolas 3 por flor, 1-1.5 mm, 1 externa, 2 internas, ovais, sagitadas, raro lanceoladas, pilosas externamente, glabras internamente, glândulas 2, laterais, na base das bractéolas; cálice dialissépalo, glândulas 410 na base, sépalas 4-5, 1-1.5(-2) mm, ovais, raro lanceoladas, quase ocultas pelas glándulas do cálice, pubescentes externamente, glabras internamente; ovário 3-4 mm, ovoide a elíptico, às vezes anguloso nas laterais, pubescente a pulverulento, raríssimo tomentoso, 2-locular, estiletes 2.4-5 mm, patentes, grossos, bífidos, concrescidos na base formando coluna de 2-3 mm compr., face externa lisa e pubescente, face interna denso-papilosa e glabra. Fruto 1,5-2 cm diâm., cápsula septícida, globoso a elíptico, raro subtrigono ou anguloso nas laterais, mericarpos 2, lisos, pubescentes; sementes (1-)2, 1-1.2 diâm., naviculares, levemente pintalgadas.

description: Woody liana to 25 m (also tree 8 m but possibly an error for liana in tree); combretaceous hairs (often very sparse) and peltate scales present. Leaves opposite, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, 6.5-21 × 2.5-13 cm, elliptic or sometimes broadly or narrowly so, acute or obtuse to shortly acuminate at apex, cuneate to cordate at base, often hairless but sometimes sparsely pubescent on both surfaces, moderately to densely reddish- to golden-lepidote abaxially, more or less scaleless to sparsely lepidote adaxially. Venation as in C. fruticosum but secondary veins 6-12 pairs and tertiary veins usually regularly percurrent. Petiole 0.6-1.5 cm, glabrous to moderately pubescent, contiguously to densely reddish- to golden-lepidote. Inflorescences unbranched, very stout, in opposite pairs in leaf-axils, 5.5-30 cm, usually aggregated into terminal racemes to 49 cm, at the lower nodes in axils of normal leaves (usually fallen by fruiting), at the upper nodes usually without or with much reduced subtending leaves, glabrous to rather densely pubescent, densely to contiguously reddish-lepidote. Flowers borne densely around rhachis but in nature all swept up to vertical position from more or less horizontal rhachis, with long exserted stamens forming bottlebrush syndrome, tetramerous, variable in size but not shape, (12-) 15-24.5 mm, glabrous on outside and inside except on disk; lower hypanthium 4-8.5 mm, 4-angled, with pedicel-like proximal region 1.2-4 mm, contiguously reddish-lepidote; upper hypanthium 8-16 × 5-10 mm, infundibuliform to bucciniform with proximal region (below disk) scarcely distinguishable from distal region externally, moderately to densely reddish-lepidote; calyx lobes (1.7-)2.2-6 mm, erect, acute to obtuse, moderately to densely reddish-lepidote; petals 4, 1.7-3.3 × 0.6-3.2 mm, usually falling well short of calyx lobes but sometimes reaching ca. to their apex, narrowly elliptic to suborbicular, acute to shortly acuminate, without a basal claw, glabrous; stamens 8, far exserted, with filaments (16.5-)23-33.5 mm; disk densely pubescent at margin with straight hairs, with distinct free margin 0.2-0.5 mm; style (18-)31-47 mm, exserted ca. as far as stamens, glabrous; ovules 4-7. Fruit 2.7-4 × 2.3-3.7 cm, oblong-elliptic or broadly elliptic to orbicular in side view, rounded to truncate or retuse at base, with very distinct pseudostipe 0.4-1 cm, truncate or rounded to retuse and usually distinctly apiculate at apex, moderately to densely reddish-lepidote especially on body; wings 4, 1-1.6 cm wide. Scales ca. 70-175(-210) µm diam., either as in C. rohrii with an isodiametric-celled central region or less often as in C. fruticosum without one; marginal cells ca. 20-70, almost all to none reaching from margin to center. Reproductive biology. Flower color and pollination syndrome are probably as in C. fruticosum, although no references to pollinators have been found; the red hypanthium is a conspicuous feature in addition to the stamens. The attribution to C. assimile by Sazima et al. (2001) of the data reported by Janson et al. (1981) for C. fruticosum is a mystery; probably a clerical error is to blame (S. Vogel, pers. comm., 2002). Flowering May to January; fruiting August to March.

description: Erect, multi-stemmed shrubs, to 2 m tall; bark exfoliating in irregular plates; young twigs densely glandular hirsute with multiseriate-stalked, swollenheaded glandular hairs interspersed with shorter, uniseriate, hyaline hairs. Leaves congested at stem tips, coriaceous, narrowly ovate, narrowly elliptic, elliptic, or narrowly obovate, 4.3-11.5 × 1.4-4.2 cm, base tapering and cuneate or narrowly cuneate; apex acute to obtuse, often mucronate; margins plane to slightly revolute, entire, often with a few scattered teeth near the apex; upper surface bright to dark green, sparingly pubescent with scattered uni- and biseriate hyaline hairs and uniseriate-stalked, swollen-headed, glandular hairs, the hairs persisting on older leaves along midribs, margins, and toward the base; lower surface pale white to gray, densely lanate with uniseriate hairs and scattered uni- and biseriate-stalked, swollen headed, glandular hairs, the glands red; petioles short, 0.5-1.1 mm long, densely glandular-hirsute as with young stems. Inflorescences paniculate, loosely and much-branched, 10-20 cm long; rachis, pedicels, bracts, bracteoles, and calyx densely glandular hirsute with muliseriate-stalked, swollen-headed, glandular hairs, the glands red, imparting a reddish color to the entire inflorescence; floral bracts narrowly ovate, 8-23 × 1.5-4 mm, ciliate; pedicels 8-16 mm long; bracteoles 4.5-8 mm long, ciliate. Flowers with calyx lobes triangular, 1.7-2.1 × 1-2.2 mm, acuminate, ciliate; corollas urceolate, 5.2-7.1 mm long, 3.5-6 mm in diam., red, outer surface sparingly pubescent with scattered, short, uniseriate, hyaline hairs, inner surface more densely pubescent distally with similar hairs, the lobes reflexed, 0.7-1.6 × 1-1.5 mm; stamens 2-4 mm long, filaments dilated at the base, 1.8-3.5 mm long, glabrous or nearly so; anthers 1-2.2 × 0.5-1.1 mm, spurs 0.4-1 mm long; style 3.5-4.1 mm long, glabrous; ovary glabrous or pubescent with unicellular, hyaline hairs. Fruit drupaceous, 3.5-4.5 mm in diam, (immature); seeds not seen.

description: Erect, evergreen shrubs 1-3 m tall; bark peeling or exfoliating in irregular plates, outer bark brown to orange, newly exposed areas brown to greenish-brown or yellowish-green; young twigs canescent, the trichomes eglandular (glandular trichomes also present). Leaves coriaceous to slightly so, elliptic to oblong, plane, not revolute, 3.7-12 × 0.7-3.3 cm, base cuneate to rarely nearly round, apex acute to obtuse, usually mucronate, margins serrulate to entire, upper surface glabrous or with scattered eglandular or glandular hyaline trichomes, often nearly glabrate with age, lower surface usually much lighter in color than upper surface, puberulent to densely gray-tomentose; petioles 3-16 mm long, with indumentum as on young twigs. Inflorescences paniculate, usually much-branched, 3.8-8.9 cm long, canescent (also with glandular trichomes), usually appearing whitish-gray; floral bracts nearly plane to navicular or carinate, narrowly ovate to ovate, 1.4-4.5 mm long, often ciliate; pedicels 2-9 mm long; bracteoles rarely more than two, basal to subdistal, narrowly ovate to ovate, 0.8-2.2 mm long, often ciliate. Flowers with calyx lobes triangular to ovate-triangular, 1.4-2 × 0.9-1.4 mm, acute to acuminate, subglabrous to canescent, ciliate, sometimes reddish; corollas 4.8-8.2 × 3.7-5.4 mm, glabrous or slightly pubescent, light to deep pink, sometimes darker distally, lobes 1.2-2.2 × 1.5-1.9 mm; stamens 2.5-2.9 mm long; filaments 2.1-2.7 mm long, densely villous; anthers 1-1.5 × 0.6-0.8 mm; spurs nearly absent to 0.5 mm long; ovary glabrous or subglabous; style 4.8-5.8 mm long, glabrous. Fruit red when immature, dark purple to black at maturity, 4-6 mm in diam.; seeds 2-2.5 × 1-1.2 mm, surface reticulate.

description: Erect evergreen shrubs; young twigs densely hirsute with stalked, swollen-headed glandular hairs. Leaves congested at stem tips, coriaceous, narrowly ovate-elliptic to elliptic, 3.5-6.6 × 0.9-2.2 cm, base cuneate, apex acute, sometimes mucronate, margins entire, revolute, upper surface pubescent with stalked, swollen-headed glandular and eglandular trichomes, becoming less so with age but never glabrous, lower surface lanate with dense gray to tan eglandular trichomes, scattered glandular trichomes also present, especially along the midrib; petioles 2.0-4.5 mm long, densely glandular hirsute as with young twigs. Inflorescences paniculate, often much branched, 5.0-10.9 cm long, rachis, pedicels, bracts, bracteoles, and calyx densely hirsute with stalked, swollen-headed glandular hairs; floral bracts narrowly ovate to elliptic, 5-9 mm long, ciliate; pedicels 5-9 mm long; bracteoles basal to medial or slightly higher, to 2.8 × 1.3 mm, ciliate. Flowers with caylx lobes long triangular, 1.7-3.1 × 1.73.1 mm, acute to acuminate, ciliate; corollas white-yellowish (Gonzalez V., 1990b), 5.4-6.2 × 3.54.7 mm, subglabrous to pubescent with short hyaline hairs, lobes 0.9-1 × 1-1.4 mm; stamens 2.7-3.1 mm long; filaments 2.4-2.8 mm long, sparsely villous; anthers 1.1-1.3 mm long, spurs 0.4-0.6 mm long; ovary villous; style 3.1-3.3 mm long, glabrous. Fruit drupaceous, dark purple to black at maturity, 4-7 mm in diam.; seeds 1.6-1.8 × 1-1.1 mm, surface reticulate.

description: Erect to trailing or upright shrubs to 1 m tall, some individuals flowering when only approx. 10 cm tall; bark gray to brownish-red, peeling and flaking in small pieces; young twigs glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, linear to narrowly elliptic to ovate-elliptic, plane to very slightly revolute, 1.4-7(-9.8) × 0.2-2(-2.7) cm, usually at the smaller end of the range of leaf size variation, base cuneate to tapering, apex acute to acuminate, margins entire, with a few scattered teeth or marginal callose thickenings or distinctly serrulate, abaxially and adaxially glabrous; petioles to 3(-5) mm long, glabrous. Inflorescences racemose or paniculate, to 3.3 cm long, glabrous; floral bracts, bracteoles, and calyces glabrous, marginally ciliate by eglandular trichomes; floral bracts carinate to navicular, acute, 1.3-2.5 mm long; pedicels 4.1-6.6 mm long, glabrous; bracteoles basal to medial, narrowly ovate, 1.1-1.7 mm long. Flowers with calyx lobes triangular or ovate-triangular, 11.7 × 1.1-1.4 mm, acute; corollas pink with white lobes, 4.5-5 × 3.7-4.5 mm, outer surface glabrous, inner surface with slight pubescence of hyaline hairs, lobes 1-1.1 × 1.4-1.8 mm; stamens 2.6-2.8 mm long; filaments 2.4-2.7 mm long, dilated at base, villous; anthers ovoid, 1.1-1.3 × 0.7-0.8 mm, spurs 0.6-0.8 mm long; style 2.8-3.3 mm long; ovary glabrous. Fruit 5-8 mm in diam., black at maturity; seeds to 2.3 × 1.4 mm.

description: Shrubs or trees to 20 m; young twigs and petioles glandular hirsute to ferruginously tomentose, trichomes stalked, swollen-headed, and glandular or eglandular and hyaline. Leaves usually with dense ferruginous tomentum below; midrib pubescent, trichomes often glandular. Inflorescences with rachis, pedicels, bracts, bracteoles and calyces tomentose to glandular hirsute, often with stalked, swollen-headed glandular trichomes. Flowers with calyx lobes pubescent, trichomes glandular or not; corollas glabrous to tomentose; ovary pubescent or more rarely glabrous.

description: Liana, ramas jóvenes densamente rufo-tomentosas. Hojas imparipinadas; foliólos 7-9, pulvínulo poco diferenciado del pecíolo, densamente rufo-tomentoso, 0.5-0.7 mm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, densamente rufo-tomentoso, hasta 10 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, rufo-tomentoso, hasta 16 cm de largo. Folíolos 3-10(-16) cm de largo, 1.5-4.8(-7.5) cm de ancho, elípticos, oblongos o levemente obovado-oblongos, cartáceos, haz opaca, oscura, glabra, envés opaco, claro, densamente rufo-tomentoso, tomento principalmente conspicuo en las nervaduras, base redondeada, ocasionalmente subcordada y en el folíolo terminal a veces angostada, ápice abruptamente acuminado, acumen 0.5-1 cm de largo, margen entero o levemente revoluto; peciólulo cilindrico, densamente rufo-tomentoso; venación transversal, nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 7-10 pares, más o menos rectas, formando ángulos de 45° con la nervadura central, más o menos claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen, prominentes en el envés, impresas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias delicadas, levemente promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz. Inflorescencia paniculada, densiflora, axilar o pseudoterminal; raquila hasta de 20 cm de largo; brácteas conspicuas, densamente tomentosas. Flores sésiles o con pedicelo hasta de 1 mm de largo; sépalos 2 mm de largo, 1-1.5 mm de ancho, ovados, densamente tomentosos exteriormente, tomentosos en la mitad o los % distales interiormente; pétalos 4 mm de largo, 1 mm de ancho, oblongos; filamentos libres, 5 más largos 2.5-3 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 2 mm de longitud; anteras globosas, 0.4-0.5 mm de diámetro; ovario con 5 carpelos libres, vellosos, (siendo los pelos largos, rectos y ascendentes) sésiles, estilos 0.8-2.2 mm de longitud, glabros, estigma bilobulado. Fruto sésil, 1 (raramente 2) carpelos maduran para formar frutos, 1.3-1.5 cm de largo, 0.7-0.8 cm de ancho, característicamente encorvado y exteriormente densamente ferrugíneo-tomentoso, interiormente glabro, cáliz en el fruto presente, cubriendo la base de este. Semilla 0.8 cm de largo, 0.4 cm de ancho; ariloide 0.4 cm de largo.

description: Shrub or small tree to 3 m, rarely taller, young shoots puberulous, rarely subglabrous. Leaf blade narrowly obovate to oblanceolate, sometimes elliptic. 13-47 x 6-17 cm, coriaceous or subherbaceous, 0.12-0.23 mm thick, glabrous or glandular-pilose beneath, base attenuate, apex acute or short-acuminate, sometimes obtuse, margins entire or serrulate, lateral veins conspicuous beneath, rather inconspicuous above, surfaces between veinlets striate beneath, striate, furrowed or smooth above; extraxylary sclerenchyma adjacent to epidermis on both sides, abaxially arranged in bundles 3-12 cells thick, adaxially in somewhat flattened bundles 3-10(-13) cells thick or in a more or less continuous layer 1 or partly 2 cells thick, hypoderm lacking; petiole 2.5-12 cm long, 0.9-3.5 mm thick, mostly puberulous at base. Racemes in male and bisexual plants to 31 cm long with 15-60 flowers, in female plants 1-3.5 cm long with 7-15 flowers, rachis in male and bisexual plants 0.5-1 mm thick, in female plants 0.7-1.6 mm thick, glabrous or puberulous; pedicels (0.5-)l-2(-3) mm long; bracts 0.5-1 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 4- or 5-merous, calyx lobes very broadly ovate, (1-) 1.7-3 x (1.5-)2-3 (-3.2) mm; corolla orange or orange-red, tube 1.5 2 (-2.5) mm long, lobes (1.5-) 1.7-3 x (1.5-)2-3(-3.2) mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, in male and bisexual flowers fused into a tube 0.5-1.2 mm long, in female flowers free, 0.5-0.7 mm long. Pistil in male flowers lacking or linear, in bisexual flowers sublinear with 1-3 ovules, in female flowers ovoid with 8-16 ovules in 2 or 3 rows; stigma in bisexual flowers often 2-lobed. Fruit orange or orange-yellow, 1.5-3(-4) cm diam., pericarp 0.3-0.4 mm thick, surface smooth; seeds 2-8(-13), (6-)7-9.5(-l 1) mm long.

description: Shrub or small tree to 4(-8) m tall, young shoots puberulous. Leaf blade oblanceolate, 31-71 x 7.5-17 cm, coriaceous, 0.14-0.25 mm thick, glabrous, base attenuate, apex acute or sometimes obtuse, margins entire or faintly serrulate, lateral veins rather conspicuous, surfaces between veinlets striate or sometimes smooth; extraxylary sclerenchyma usually present, arranged in bundles 2-8(-12) cells thick, abaxially adjacent to epidermis and often slightly flattened, adaxially usually adjacent to a continuous or variously interrupted, 1-layered hypoderm; petiole 1-4.5(-6) cm long, 1.5-5 mm thick, puberulous at base. Flowers 5-merous; calyx lobes very broadly ovate, 1.5-1.7 x 1.5-2 mm. glabrous; corolla orange or orange-red, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes 2.5-3.5 x 2.7-4 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, fused into a tube 1-1.2 mm long. Pistil in staminate flowers sub-linear, in bisexual flowers narrowly ovoid with 1-6 ovules. Fruits orange, 1-2 cm diam., pericap 0.2-0.5 mm thick, surface smooth or slightly scabrous; seeds 1-4(-9), 7.5-10 mm long.

description: Tree to 10 m tall, unbranched or sparsely branched, young shoots glabrous. Leaf blade oblanceolate, 35-60 x 7-12 cm, coriaceous, glabrous, light green beneath, dark green above, 0.3-0.4 mm thick, base narrowly attenuate, apex acute or short-acuminate, margins entire with a rather conspicuous, pallid border, lateral veins rather inconspicuous, surfaces between veinlets striate on both sides; extraxylary sclerenchyma arranged in bundles 2-8 cells thick, abaxial bundles adjacent to epidermis, adaxial bundles somewhat immersed into mesophyll, hypoderm lacking; petiole 3-7 cm long, 3-6 mm thick, glabrous. Racemes in male plants to 35 cm long with 30-55 flowers, plants with female or bisexual flowers not seen; rachis ca. 1.5 mm thick, glabrous; pedicels 2-3 mm long; bracts ca. 1 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 4(5)-merous; calyx lobes very broadly ovate, 3-3.5 x 4-4.2 mm, glabrous; corolla orange-red, tube ca. 3 mm long, lobes suborbicular, 6-7 x 6-7 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, fused into a tube 2 mm long. Pistil very narrowly ovoid, stigma entire. Fruits 2-3 cm diam., borne on infructescences 10-15 cm long, pericarp thin, surface papillose; seeds not seen.

description: Leaf blade oblanceolate, 55-70 x 15-20 cm, coriaceous, 0.24-0.26 mm thick, glabrous; base narrowly attenuate, apex acuminate, margins densely serrate, teeth 75-85 per side, 1-3 mm long, pungent; lateral veubs rather conspicuous, at least beneath, surfaces etween veinlets striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma in undies 4-8 cells thick, abaxially adjacent to epidermis, axially adjacent to a 1- or partly 2-layered hypoderm; petiole 5-7 cm long, 3.5-4 mm thick, glabrous. Pistil narrowly ovoid with 15-20 ovules in 2 or 3 rows, stigma 2-lobed. Fruits not seen.

description: Shrub or small tree to 6 m tall, young shoots densely puberulous. Leaf blade oblanceolate, 39-67 x 9.5-13 cm, coriaceous or subcartilaginous, 0.23-0.35 mm thick, glabrous, base attenuate, mostly shortly so, apex acute or obtuse, margins serrate, teeth 30-70 per side, 1-4 mm long, pungent, lateral veins rather inconspicuous, surfaces between veinlets striate below, striate or furrowed above; extraxylary sclerenchyma present, adjacent to epidermis on both sides of leaf, abaxially arranged in bundles 7-15 cells thick, adaxially in rather poorly demarcated, flattened bundles interrupted by hypodermal cells above major veins; petiole 0.5-1.5 cm long, 2.8-5 mm thick, puberulous at base. Racemes in bisexual plants to 24 cm long with 25-35 flowers, plants with unisexual flowers not seen; rachis 1.5-2 mm thick, glabrous; pedicels 2-4 mm long; bracts 0.5-1 mm long, inserted at nodes or sometimes decurrent on lower half of pedicel. description: Shrub to 1.5 m tall, young shoots glabrous or sparsely puberulous. Racemes in male plants to 20 cm long with 15-35 flowers, in female plants to ca. 3 cm long with 5-10 flowers, plants with bisexual flowers not seen; rachis ca. 0.7 mm thick, sparsely puberulous to subglabrous; pedicels 1-2 mm long; bracts 0.5-1 mm long, inserted at nodes. description: Shrub to 4 m tall, young shoots puberulous or glabrous. Leaf blade oblanceolate to narrowly obovate, 15-50 x 5-17 cm, coriaceous or subcoriaceous, 0.21-0.36 mm thick, glabrous or glandular-pilose beneath, base attenuate, apex obtuse or subacute, margins vaguely repand, serrulate or entire, lateral veins inconspicuous, surfaces between veinlets smooth or very sparsely striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma lacking or very sparse, if present arranged in bundles 1-6 cells thick adjacent to epidermis on both sides, hypoderm lacking; petiole 2.5-5 cm long, 1.5-3.8 mm thick, glabrous or sparsely glandular-pilose. description: Shrub or small tree to 6 m, or taller, stem to at least 3 cm diam., young shoots puberulous. description: Treelet to 7 m tall, young shoots glabrous, greyish. description: Shrub to 1 m tall, young shoots puberulous. Leaf blade oblanceolate to elliptic, 30-33 x 10-13 cm, subcoriaceous, 0.30-0.35 mm thick, glabrous, green above, pale green beneath, base attenuate, apex obtuse, margins entire, lateral veins rather inconspicuous, surfaces between veinlets striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma adjacent to epidermis on both sides, arranged in bundles; petiole 4-5 cm long, ca, 2 mm thick, glabrous or puberulous at base. description: Shrub or small tree to 6 m tall, young shoots glabrous. Leaf blade oblanceolate, 35-120 x 9-22 cm, coriaceous, 0.2-0.26 mm thick, glabrous, base attenuate, apex acute or obtuse, margins serrate to serrulate, rarely subentire, lateral veins rather inconspicuous, surfaces between veinlets smooth or very sparsely striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma lacking or very sparse, if present then arranged in bundles of 2-6 cells adjacent to epidermis on both sides, hypoderm lacking; petiole 2.5-9.5 cm long, 1.7-6.5 mm thick, glabrous. Racemes in bisexual and male plants 4-18 cm long with 15-50 flowers, in female plants 1.5-4 cm long with 10-30 flowers; rachis 0.8-1.4 mm thick, glabrous or subglabrous; pedicels 1.5-3 mm long; bracts 0.7-1 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 5-merous; calyx lobes very broadly ovate, 1.5-2.5 x 2-2.5 mm, glabrous; corolla orange, orange-brown in bud, tube 1.5-2.2 mm long, lobes 3.5-5 x 4-5 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, in male and bisexual flowers fused into a tube 1-1.5 mm long, in female flowers united at base only, free parts ca. 0.7 mm long. Pistil in male and bisexual flowers narrowly ovoid, in bisexual flowers with 2-7 ovules in 1 or 2 rows, in female flowers ovoid with ca. 16 ovules in 2 or 3 rows; stigma subcapitate. Fruits orange or orange-yellow, 1.5-3.5(-5) cm diam.. pericarp 0.3-0.4(-1) mm thick, surface papillose; seeds 3-10, 7-11 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Ståhl, Bertil. 2010. Theophrastaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 105: 1-160.

description: Tree to 8 m tall, young shoots puberulous. Leaf blade oblanceolate or narrowly oblanceolate, 60-100 x 10-17 cm, coriaceous or almost cartilaginous, 0.42-0.5 mm thick, glabrous, concolorous, base short-attenuate and generally somewhat unequal, apex obtuse or rarely truncate, margins entire, lateral veins rather conspicuous on both sides; subepidermal extraxylary sclerenchyma lacking; a 1- or partly 2-layered hypo-derm present adaxially; petiole 2-5 cm long, 3.5-5.5 mm thick, puberulous. Racemes in bisexual plants to 65 cm long with 80-130 flowers, plants with unisexual flowers not seen; rachis 1.5-2.8 mm thick, sparsely puberulous; pedicels 3-4 mm long; bracts 1-1.8 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 5-merous; calyx lobes broadly to very broadly ovate, 2.5-3 x 3-3.2 mm; corolla orange, tube ca. 2 mm long, lobes broadly oblong or suborbicular, 5.2-6 x 4-6 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, free to base, 1-1.7 mm long. Pistil ovoid with 40-50 ovules densely set in 4 or 5 rows; stigma truncate. Fruits 2-3.5 cm diam., pericarp 0.3-0.4 mm thick, surface smooth. Seeds 5 or 6, 7-13 mm long.

description: Shrub or small tree to 4 m tall, sometimes taller, young shoots glabrous. Leaf blade oblanceolate, rarely narrowly oblanceolate, 26-120 x 8-23 cm, coriaceous or subherbaceous, 0.14-0.20 mm thick, glabrous, base attenuate, apex acute or obtuse, rarely short-acuminate, margins entire or faintly serrulate, lateral veins conspicuous, surfaces between veinlets striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma adjacent to epidermis on both sides, in bundles 4-12 cells thick; hypoderm lacking; petiole 1-4(-7) cm long, 1.7-5 mm thick, glabrous. Racemes in male or bisexual plants to 27 cm long with 20-75 flowers, in female plants to 3 cm long with 5-15 flowers; rachis 0.8-2.7 mm thick, glabrous or subglabrous; pedicels 1-3 mm long; bracts 1-1.5 mm long, inserted at nodes or sometimes decurrent on lower half of pedicel. Flowers 4-merous; calyx lobes broadly or very broadly ovate, (2.5-)3-3.5 x 2.5-3 mm, glabrous; corolla orange, tube 2-3(-3.5) mm long, lobes in male or bisexual flowers 4-5 x 4.5-6(-7) mm, in female flowers 2-4 x 3.5-5.5 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, in male and bisexual flowers fused into a tube 0.5-1 mm long; in female flowers free, ca. 1 mm long. Pistil in male flowers lacking, rudimentary or sublinear, in bisexual flowers narrowly ovoid with 2-4 ovules, in female flowers broadly ovoid with 12-25 ovules in 2 or 3 rows. Fruits yellow to orange, 2-4.5 cm diam., pericarp 0.2-0.5 mm thick with surface smooth or 0.7-3 mm thick, surface papillose; seeds (2-)4-22, 6-11 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Ståhl, Bertil. 2010. Theophrastaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 105: 1-160.

description: Shrub to 2.5 m tall, young shoots glabrous. Leaf blade narrowly obovate, 55-65 x 20-30 cm, subcoriaceous, 0.22-0.28 mm thick, glabrous, light green beneath, somewhat darker above, base attenuate, apex obtuse or acute, margins sparsely serrate or serrulate, lateral veins rather conspicuous on both sides, surfaces between veinlets striate beneath, vaguely furrowed above; extraxylary sclerenchyma adjacent to epidermis on both sides, abaxially arranged in bundles 3-8 cells thick, adaxially as an interrupted layer 1 or 2 cells thick; hypoderm lacking; petiole 14-21 cm long, 4-5 mm thick, glabrous. Racemes in bisexual and male plants to 12 cm long with 30-35 flowers, plants with female flowers not seen; rachis 1-1.5 mm thick, glabrous; pedicels 3-5 mm long; bracts ca. 1 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 5-merous; calyx lobes very broadly ovate, 2.5-2.7 x 2.7-3 mm; corolla yellow, tube ca. 1.5 mm long, lobes suborbicular, 4-5 x 4.5-5 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, united into a tube 1.5 mm long. Pistil narrowly ovoid with 4-8 ovules in 1 or 2 rows; stigma truncate. Fruits not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Ståhl, Bertil. 2010. Theophrastaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 105: 1-160.

description: Shrub to 1.5 m tall, young shoots glabrous. Leaf blade narrowly obovate to oblanceolate or elliptic, 38-66 x 13-25 cm, coriaceous. 0.22-0.27 mm thick, glabrous, lower side light green, upper side dark green, base attenuate, apex acute, margins entire, lateral veins rather prominent on both sides, surfaces between vein-lets striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma sparse, in bundles 8-35 cells thick, on both sides separated from epidermis by a layer of mesophyllous cells; hypoderm lacking; petiole 13-22 cm long, 3.5-5.5 mm thick, glabrous. Racemes of morphologically bisexual plants to 21 cm long with 20-40 flowers, plants with unisexual flowers not seen; rachis 1.2-1.5 mm thick, glabrous; pedicels 5-8 mm long; bracts ca. 1.2 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 5-merous. Calyx lobes broadly or very broadly ovate, 3-5 x 3.2-5 mm; corolla orange, tube 3-4 mm long, lobes 4-6 x 4-6 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, free to base, 1.5-2 mm long. Pistil narrowly ovoid to ovoid with 4-12 ovules in 1-3 rows; stigma truncate or shallowly 3-lobed. Fruits orange, 2.2-4 cm diam., pericarp 0.5-0.7 mm thick, surface ± papillose. Seeds 3-8, 9-13 mm long.

description: Small tree to 3 m, possibly taller, young shoots glabrous. Leaf blade oblanceolate, (45-)60-81 x 14-18 cm, subcoriaceous, 0.25-0.28 mm thick, glandular-pilose beneath, glabrous above, base attenuate, apex short-acuminate, margins faintly serrulate to entire, lateral veins conspicuous beneath, rather inconspicuous above, surfaces between veinlets striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma on both sides adjacent to epidermis, arranged in bundles 3-10(-15) cells thick, abaxial bundles usually fewer but thicker than adaxial bundles, the adaxial bundles often somewhat compressed laterally; hypoderm lacking; petiole 5-8 cm long, 4-4.3 mm thick, sparsely glandular-pilose. Racemes in male plants to 18 cm long with 10-25 flowers, in bisexual plants to 7 cm long with 18-20 flowers, in female plants to 1 cm long with 4-10 flowers; rachis 1 mm thick in male and bisexual plants, 2-3 mm thick in female plants, glandular-pilose; pedicels 1.5-2 mm long; bracts 0.75-1 mm long, inserted at nodes, distinctly darkened. Flowers 4-merous; calyx lobes very broadly ovate, 2.5-3 x 2.7-4 mm, sparsely to densely glandular-pilose; corolla orange-red, tube 2-3 mm long, lobes 4-5 x 4-6 mm. Stamen fdaments glabrous, in male and bisexual plants fused into a tube 0.75-1.5 mm long. Pistil in male flowers narrowly ovoid, in bisexual flowers ovoid with 12-14 ovules densely set in 2 rows, in female flowers broadly ovoid with 25-35 ovules in 3 or 4 rows. Fruits subglobose, somewhat depressed, 3.5-4 cm diam., sometimes glandular puberulous, pericarp 0.6-0.8 mm thick, surface granulate; seeds 11, 8-11 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Ståhl, Bertil. 2010. Theophrastaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 105: 1-160.

description: Shrub 3 m, sometimes taller, young shoots densely puberulous. Leaf blade oblanceolate or narrowly obo-vate, 25-65 x 5.5-15 cm, subcoriaceous, ca. 0.2 mm thick, glandular-pilose beneath, base attenuate, apex acute, rarely obtuse, lateral veins rather conspicuous, surfaces between veinlets densely striate on both sides or furrowed above; extraxylary sclerenchyma adjacent to epidermis on both sides, arranged in bundles 4-10 (-16) cells thick, adaxial bundles often distinctly flattened, forming a discontinuous layer, hypoderm lacking; petiole 1.5-4 cm long, 1.5-3 mm thick, puberulous at base. Racemes in male and bisexual plants to 20 cm long with 30-40 flowers, female flowers not seen; rachis 0.5-1.5 mm thick, puberulous to subglabrous; pedicels 1-3 mm long; bracts 2.5-3 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 5-merous; calyx lobes very broadly ovate 1.5-2 x 2-2.2 mm; corolla orange or orange-red, tube 2-2.5 mm long, lobes 4-5 x 4-4.5 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, in male and bisexual flowers fused into a tube 1-1.2 mm long. Pistil narrowly ovoid, in bisexual flowers with 3 or 4 ovules in a single row; stigma entire or 2-lobed. Fruits 1.5-2.5 cm diam., pericarp 0.3-0.6 mm thick, surface smooth or faintly papillose. Seeds 2-12, 7.5-11 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Ståhl, Bertil. 2010. Theophrastaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 105: 1-160.

description: Shrub or small tree to 4 m, sometimes taller, young shoots glabrous. Leaf blade narrowly obovate to ob-lanceolate, sometimes elliptic to broadly elliptic, 7.5-23 x 3.5-9 cm, coriaceous or subherbaceous, 0.20-0.26 mm thick, glabrous or rarely sparsely glandular-pilose beneath; base narrowly attenuate, apex acuminate with acumen 0.5-1.5 cm long, sometimes acute, margins entire or faintly serrulate, often somewhat repand, lateral veins rather inconspicuous, surfaces between veinlets striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma in bundles adjacent to epidermis on both sides, arranged in bundles 2-14 cells thick, those of adaxial side somewhat coarser; petiole 1.5-	12 cm long, 1-2 mm thick. Racemes in male and bisexual plants to 9 cm long with 9-17 flowers, female plants not seen; rachis 0.5-1.2 mm thick, glabrous or sparsely puberulous; pedicels 1.5-3(-5) mm long; bracts 0.5-0.8 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 4-merous; calyx lobes broadly or very broadly ovate, 2-2.5 x 1.7-2.5 mm, glabrous or sparsely puberulous; corolla orange, tube 2-3 mm long, lobes 2.5-4.2 x 3.5-5 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, in male and bisexual flowers fused into a tube 0.7-1.2 mm long. Pistil in male flowers sublinear, in bisexual flowers narrowly ovoid with 7-9 ovules in 2 rows. Fruits orange, 1.5-4 cm diam., pericarp ca. 0.3 mm thick, surface smooth; seeds 2-6(-11), 6-10 mm long.

description: Tree, to 40 m tall; bark conspicuously lenticellate, that of the base of the trunk and of the (larger) roots reddish. Leafy twigs 0.5-3.5 mm thick, minutely puberulous to subglabrous. Lamina elliptic to lanceolate, 4-14 × 2-6.5 cm, often broadest below the middle, sometimes slightly inequilateral, coriaceous to subcoriaceous; apex acuminate to subacute; base acute to obtuse to truncate (to emarginate); margin entire; upper surface glabrous; lower surface sparsely puberulous; venation ± prominent to plane above, but the midrib mostly ± impressed, the venation ± prominent beneath; lateral veins 9-18 pairs; tertiary venation reticulate; petiole 0.5-1.5 cm long, 1-2 mm thick, sparsely and minutely puberulous; stipules broadly ovate to subcordiform, 0.1-0.3 cm long, minutely puberulous, caducous. Staminate inflorescences on (usually) leafless branchlets, sometimes on short-shoots (spurs), often on the older wood; peduncle 0.1-0.8 cm long, minutely puberulous; spike 1-10(-l 8) cm long; tepals 3-7, free or sometimes connate, variously shaped, 0.5-0.8 mm long, minutely puberulous; stamens 1-2(-3), filaments 0.3-1 mm long, anthers ca. 0.3-0.4 × 0.3-0.4 mm; bracts variously shaped, partly suborbicular and subpeltate, ca. 0.5-0.6 × 0.5-0.8 cm, often ± fimbriate, minutely puberulous, and with minute, embedded yellow dye-containing "glands." Pistillate inflorescences on (usually) leafless branchlets, sometimes on short-shoots (spurs), usually on the older wood; peduncle 0.4 cm long, to 1.5 cm long in fruit, minutely puberulous; flowers 1, or sometimes 2; perianth 3-4 mm long, subentire to 4-lobed, puberulous in the uppermost part, and with minute, embedded yellow dye-containing "glands"; ovary adnate to the perianth; style 1-3 mm long; stigmas filiform, 4-7 mm long; bracts 3-7, suborbicular to broadly ovate, often subpeltate, 0.8-1.2 mm long, minutely puberulous, and with minute, embedded yellow dye-containing "glands" Fruiting perianth subglobose to ellipsoid, 1.5-3(-4) × 1-1.7(-2.4) cm, glabrous, orange to red; endocarp woody.

description: Tree, to 35 m tall; bark conspicuously lenticellate, that of the base of the trunk and the (larger) roots reddish. Leafy twigs 2-4.5 mm thick, sparsely to densely puberulous, sometimes with (retrorse) uncinate hairs. Lamina elliptic to oblong (to lanceolate), 4.5-25 × 1.5-11 cm, broadest at or above the middle, often ± inequilateral, subcoriaceous to coriaceous; apex acuminate; base acute to rounded; margin entire; upper surface glabrous; lower surface sparsely puberulous with straight and/or uncinate hairs; midrib slightly impressed, the other veins slightly prominent to plane above, ± prominent beneath; lateral veins 8-15 pairs; tertiary venation reticulate or partly scalariform; petiole 0.5-2 cm long, 1-2.5 mm thick, sparsely puberulous, the epidermis often flaking off; stipules lanceolate, 0.3-0.8 cm long, puberulous, caducous. Staminate inflorescences in the leaf axils or on leafless branchlets just below the leaves; peduncle 0.1-0.8 cm long, puberulous to almost glabrous; spike 2-12 cm long; perianth ca. 1 mm long; tepals 3-5, variously shaped, often spathulate, sparsely and minutely puberulous; stamens 1-2(-3); filaments ca. 1-1.5 mm long; anthers ca. 0.30.5 × 0.3-0.4 mm, the upper part of the connective with a yellow glandular apex; bracts basally attached, reniform to broadly spathulate, ca. 0.5-0.8 mm long, sparsely and minutely puberulous, with small, embedded yellow dye-containing "glands." Pistillate inflorescences in the leaf axils or on leafless branchlets just below the leaves, uniflorous; peduncle 0.2-0.8 cm long, puberulous with straight and/or uncinate hairs; perianth 3-4 mm long, 2-4-lobed to subentire, glabrous except for the uppermost and basal parts, with small, embedded yellow dye-containing "glands"; ovary adnate to the perianth; stigmas filiform to band-shaped and 512 mm long or tongue-shaped, 2-4 mm long, smooth or sometimes conspicuously papillate; bracts 3-7, reniform to elliptic, puberulous, with small, embedded yellow dye-containing "glands" Fruiting perianth globose to ellipsoid (or oblongoid), 1.8-2 × 1.8-2 cm or 3.5-4 × ca. 1.5 cm, yellowish(-green) or red at maturity, glabrous; endocarp coriaceous.

description: Herbs rhizomatous, 50-100(-180) cm tall, rhizomes short, inside bright red or yellow, roots sometimes swollen, narrowly fusiform. Leaves radical, (5-)15-60(-85) cm long, (0.3-)0.7-2.5 cm wide, glabrous. Inflorescence a thyrse, 8-30 cm long and 6-25 cm wide, the cincinni 3-17-flowered, once or twice branched. Indument of inflorescence: cataphylls, rachis, bracts, pedicels, and base of outer tepals densely to sparsely villose, hairs 0.2-0.5 mm long; ovary and smaller stamens completely hidden by hairs to 5 mm long; margins of valves of fruit slightly to densely hairy; inner tepals glabrous. Number of cataphylls 1-6, 2-8 cm long, 0.5-1.4 cm wide. Primary bracts narrowly triangular, 1-6 cm long. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, 0.2-0.6 cm long. Pedicels 2-4 mm long. Flowers white with yellow, orange or sometimes purple nectar guide on three adaxial tepals. Outer tepals narrowly elliptic, 10-13 mm long, 3-5 mm wide, inner ones narrowly obovate, 12-14 mm long, 4-8 mm wide, the three adaxial ones connate for half of their length. Abaxial stamen 8-10 mm long, thecae equal 2-3 mm long, the two adaxial stamens 3-4 mm long, thecae unequal, the smallest ca. 1.5 mm long, the largest ca. 2.5 mm long. Ovary ellipsoid. Style 5-6 mm long. Capsule globose to trigonous, 7-9 mm long, 8-10 mm in diam. Seeds ca. 10, subglobose, 2.5-3.5 mm in diam., densely covered with unicellular finger-shaped hairs (1-1.5 mm long).
bibliographicCitation: Maas, P. J. M. & Maas-van de Kamer, H. 1993. Haemodoraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 61: 1-44.

description: Herbs 15-200 cm tall, rhizomes horizontally creeping, inside white to brownish red, 4-20 cm long, to 10 mm in diam., roots fibrous; stolons 5-55 cm long, rooting at the nodes, each node with a membranous, brownish, ovate bract, basally sheathing, apex acuminate, 8-10(-22) mm long. Leaves scattered to mainly radical, somewhat succulent, 20-65 cm long, (1-)1.5-6(-6.5) cm wide, mostly exceeding the inflorescence, glabrous. Inflorescence a thyrse, 2-44 cm long and 2-15 cm wide, the cincinni 5-25-flowered, simple, sometimes once branched; sometimes young plants sprouting from the axil of the cataphylls and/or primary bracts. Indument of inflorescence: cataphylls, rachis, bracts, pedicels, and ovary sparsely to densely villose, hairs white, 0.3-2.0 mm long, tepals and fruit almost glabrous. Number of cataphylls 2-6, 0.5-14 cm long, 0.2-1.2 cm wide. Primary bracts narrowly triangular, 0.1-3.0 cm long. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, 0. l-0.2(-0.6) cm long. Pedicels 2-10 mm long. Buds pale yellow to orange. Flowers white to yellowish white, bluish inside, sometimes with a yellow nectar guide on the three adaxial tepals. Tepals narrowly ovate-elliptic to ovate-elliptic, the three adaxial ones basally connate, outer ones 4-11(-13) mm long, 1-4 mm wide, inner ones 5-13 mm long, 2-6 mm wide. Stamens with white to pale green filaments and bright yellow to orange anthers, abaxial stamen 4-11 mm long, the two adaxial ones 3-6 mm long, dehiscence starting apically. Ovary green, subglobose. Style white to pale green, 3-5(-9) mm long. Capsule green when young, maturing shiny orange, red, and finally black, (subglobose, 5-10 mm in diam. Seeds 8 black, subglobose, tuberculate, 0.5-1 mm in diam. Chromosome number 2n=38.

description: Leaves many in a dense rosette, 8-10 dm long; sheaths large, very broadly obovate, very densely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, acute, linear from the base to the middle and then enlarged between the middle and apex, 5-7 cm wide, subdensely serrate with spines to 4 mm long, green, red at apex. Scape short, stout; scape-bracts imbricate, ovate, attenuate, the lowest spinose-serrate, the upper entire, massed below the inflorescence and equaling it, red. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, many-flowered, broadly subhemispheric; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts but narrower; branches with naked sterile bases 3-4 cm long and flowers fascicled at the apex. Floral bracts lance-ovate, attenuate, exceeding the sepals, membranaceous but much thickened toward apex, pungent, entire. Sepals strongly asymmetric, ovate, attenuate, pungent, 23 mm long, connate for 5 mm; petals shorter than the sepals, acute, connate for 5-6 mm, blue toward apex, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base; stamens included, pollen ellipsoid, reticulate, biporate; ovary subcylindric, 15-20 mm long; epigynous tube large; placentae small, central; ovules obtuse.

description: Leaves about 16 in a spreading rosette, 6 dm long; sheaths distinct, suborbicular, entire, broadly membranaceous-margined, lepidote on both sides especially toward base; blades ligulate, acute, filiform-apiculate, contracted at base, 3-6 cm wide, regularly and subdensely serrulate with antrorse curved spines nearly 1 mm long, channeled, undulate along margin, lepidote on both sides, green above, often purple-brown beneath. Scape almost none. Inflorescence sunk in the center of the rosette, subcorymbose-compound, depressed-pyramidal, many-flowered; primary bracts foliaceous, dark red, exceeding the inflorescence; branches 8-flowered. Floral bracts obovate, mucronulate, 30 mm long, slightly exceeding the centers of the sepals, carinate, membranaceous, white, entire, subglabrous; flowers sessile, 56 mm long. Sepals subsymmetrical, oblong-elliptic, rounded and apiculate, 20 mm long, connate for 7 mm, convolute, greenish white toward base, reddish toward apex; petals erect, obtuse, cucullate, free at base, connate a little above and then free again, bearing 2 fimbriate scales 10 mm above the base, white with greenish apex; stamens included, filaments of the second series adnate to the petals for most of their length; anthers 6 mm long; pollen biporate; ovary angled, 12 mm long, 6 mm in diameter, white, glabrous; placentae slightly above center of cell; ovules obtuse.

description: Leaves rosulate, to 4 dm long, obscurely pale-lepidote; sheaths distinct, ovate, 10 cm long; blades ligulate, narrowed toward base, caudate-acuminate at apex, 23 mm wide, laxly serrulate with spines 0.5 mm long. Scape elongate, raising the compact involucrate inflorescence well above the leaf-sheaths; primary bracts 14 cm long, obscurely pale-lepidote, the sheaths ovate, ample, concealing all but the apices of the few flowers in each axil, the blades linear, acuminate, 15 mm wide, reddish, laxly and minutely serrulate. Floral bracts broadly ovate, subacute, the outer equaling the petals, the inner shorter, entire, membranaceous, white. Sepals 28 mm long, connate for 7 mm, the free lobes lanceolate, acute but not pungent, subsymmetric, green; petals 5 cm long, highly connate, the free lobes 15 mm long, elliptic, obtuse, cucullate, yellow with bright orange apices, the tube green and white, bearing calli above the base; stamens included; ovary globose, 6 mm long, epigynous tube lacking; placentae central.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Leaves many, rosulate, to 35 cm long, coriaceous; sheaths oblong-elliptic, 12 cm long, entire, purplish, densely vestite on both sides with fine subappressed dark brown scales; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and cuspidate, slightly contracted at base, 4 cm wide, glabrous above, obscurely appressed-lepidote beneath, subdensely serrate with coarse spreading dark brown spines 3 mm long. Scape short, densely bracteate. Inflorescence sunk in the center of the rosette, simple, few-flowered, involucrate with broadly elliptic outer bracts. Floral bracts small, narrow, exceeded by the ovaries; flowers slenderly short-pedicellate. Sepals lance-ovate, obtuse, 35 mm long, connate for 10 mm; petals 65 mm long, high-connate, the appendages highly adnate to the claw, the blades narrowly elliptic, blue at apex; stamens included; ovary ellipsoid, 8 mm long; placenta central, globose.

description: Plant flowering 2 dm high. Leaves rosulate, 4 dm long, green with a pale median band, obscurely pale-lepidote; sheaths elliptic, 8 cm long, entire except near apex; blades linear, acuminate, contracted toward base, 13 mm wide, laxly serrulate. Scape erect, slender, much exceeding the leaf-sheaths, covered and much exceeded by the foliaceous bracts. Inflorescence compact, few-flowered, less than 3 cm in diameter; primary bracts subfoliaceous, elongate, forming a stellate involucre about the inflorescence. Floral bracts oblong, obtuse, about equaling the center of the sepals, densely serrulate, membranaceous, lepidote. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 12 mm long, connate for 3 mm, thin, glabrous, nerved; petals 15 mm long, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base, the free lobes elliptic, obtuse, cucullate, blue; stamens included; ovary obconic, 6 mm long, epigynous tube 1.5 mm long; placentae central; ovules apiculate.

description: Lianas; tricomas ferrugíneos malpiguiáceos, em toda a planta ou somente nas folhas e partes reprodutivas ou mesmo somente nos pedicelos, misturados ou não com tricomas não ramificados, não glandulares, e alvescentes, tricomas não ramificados restritos aos tufos de tricomas ñas axilas das nervuras ou às vezes em toda a planta; ramos jovens subcilín-dricos, às vezes ramentáceos, ou alados, esparso pubescentes, tomentosos, glabros, ou raro pubérulos, principalmente nos nós, fissurados, com lenticelas esparsas, ramos reprodutivos cilíndricos, vegetativos cilíndricos, 4-angulados, ou às vezes alados. Folhas trifolioladas; pecíolos (l,7-)3,4-6,4(-9,7) cm compr., canaliculados ou levemente alados, seríceos na base principalmente nas folhas jovens ou raro vilosos, tomentosos, ou pubérulos, glabrescentes; estípulas (1,5—)2,5—3(—5) mm compr. x (1—)2(—3) mm larg., triangulares, deltoides, ou raro falcadas, glabras, ciliadas, carnosas, persistentes ou caducas, base gibosa, às vezes com centro escurecido; peciólulos centrais (2-) 6-8(-25) mm compr., laterais (0-)3-5,5(-9) mm compr. comumente desiguais na mesma folha, canaliculados ou levemente alados, tomentosos, raro pubescentes, ou pubérulos, principalmente no ápice, glabrescentes; láminas dos folíolos centrais (3,2-)7,7-10(—16,4) x (1,3—)2,1 —6,7 (—13,4) cm, laterais (0,5-)3,2-7,9(—12) x (0,4—)1,4—2,8(—7,9) cm, elípticas, obova-das, largo-elípticas, suborbiculares, subelípticas, suboblongas, subovais, ou subobtruladas, ápice agudo, acuminado, ou obtuso, margem denticulada, crenu-lada, ou às vezes denteada, raro lobada, base atenuada, cuneada, assimétrica, ou truncada, nos ramos reprodutivos lâminas dos folíolos laterais comumente reduzidas e desiguais na mesma folha, lâminas jovens subseríceas em ambas as faces, maduras pubescentes, esparso pubescentes, pubérulas, ou raro pubérulas nas nervuras na face adaxial, esparso seríceas, vilosas, pubescentes, tomentosas, ou raro pubescentes nas nervuras na face abaxial, às vezes glabrescentes em ambas as faces, axilas das nervuras secundárias na face abaxial do folíolo central às vezes com tufos de tricomas alvos ou raramente com domácias achatadas, nervuras fre-qüentemente com pontuações esbranquiçadas ao longo das nervuras na face adaxial, secas ditonais marrons, papiráceas. Inflorescências (2,3-)3,8-4,6 (-6,6) cm compr. x (2,2-)3,6-4,7(-7,4) cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos (0,8-) l,5-2,2(-2,7) cm compr., vermelhos ou raro laranja, esparso seríceos principalmente no ápice e nos ramos, seríceos, glabrescentes, tomentosos, pubérulos, ou vilosos; brácteas l(-2) mm compr., triangulares, glabras ou esparso seríceas, ciliadas, base gibosa, às vezes com centro escurecido; pedicelos(2-) 3-4(-5) mm compr., vermelhos ou laranja, esparso seríceos, raro seríceos, ou pubérulos, glabrescentes, raro papilosos; botões elipsoides ou raro conoidais; cálice (0,5-) 1 (-2) mm alt. x (1,5—)2 mm diâm., vermelho, laranja ou raro verde-amarelado, glabro, pubérulo ou raro tomentoso na base, raro papiloso, carnoso, truncado, base arredondada; corola em botão (1-) 1,5-2(-2,5) mm alt. x 1-2 mm diâm.; pétalas vermelhas, laranja ou raro verde-amareladas, glabras, raro esparso seríceas ou tomentosas e logo glabrescentes, papilosas; anteras latrorsas ou extrorsas, conectivo deltoide, granuloso, seco amarelo-claro ou marrom-escuro; disco amarelo, ápice côncavo; estilete cilíndrico, estigma pontual. Baga 10-13 mm compr. x 7-9 mm diâm., púrpura, piriforme, lisa ou com lenticelas esparsas; semente 1, ca. 9 mm compr. x ca. 5 mm larg., subturbinada, lateralmente mais ou menos achatada, laterais levemente rugosas ou lisas, hilo agudo, rafe marcada com estrias transversais.

description: Lianas; tricomas raros, curtos, não ramificados e não glandulares; ramos subcilíndricos, secos sulcados, com lenticelas pontuais esparsas, às vezes verrucosos, lustrosos, glabros ou raro pubérulos. Gavinhas não ramificadas, glabras, discos adesivos não observados; escamas 0,5-1 mm compr., triangulares, glabras. description: Lianas, adquirindo cor vermelho-telha escura quando secas; tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, ferrugíneos, misturados a tricomas glandulares; ramos leve escabrosos, reprodutivos cilíndricos, vegetativos 4-angulados ou alados. Gavinhas ramificadas dicotomicamente várias vezes, pubérulas, discos adesivos presentes ñas extremidades; escamas ca. 2 mm compr., triangulares, pubérulas. Folhas trifolioladas, nos ramos reprodutivos folíolos laterais presentes e muito reduzidos, às vezes unidos com o folíolo central, ou até suprimidos; pecíolos (0,4-)4,2-14,1 cm compr., canaliculados, pubérulos; estipulas (4-)5-6 mm compr. x (2-)5-9 mm larg., deltoides ou subfalcadas, pubérulas nas duas faces, ciliadas, papiráceas, persistentes, reflexas, levemente gibosas; peciólulos centrais 0—3,5(—17) mm compr., laterais 0-9(—12) mm compr., canaliculados, pubérulos; lâminas dos folíolos centrais (2,9—)7,1—11,8 x (0,7—)3,1—6,7 cm, laterais (0,7-)3,6-8,7(-10,3) x (0,4-)l,8-5,2 cm, elípticas, lanceoladas, subovais, ou ovais, ápice agudo ou acuminado, margem denticulada, base atenuada ou arredondada, lâminas escabras ao longo das nervuras na face adaxial, glabras, ou levemente escabras na face abaxial, cartáceas. Inflorescências 2,4-3,2(-6,3) cm compr. x 2,4-4,2(-5,7) cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos 1—1,5(—2,7) cm compr., cor desconhecida, pubérulos ou escabrosos; brácteas ca. 2 mm compr., triangulares, pubérulas, ciliadas; pedicelos 2,5-3 mm compr., vermelhos, pubérulos; botões conoidais; cálice 1-1,5 mm alt. x 2 mm diâm., glabro ou pubérulo na base, carnoso, truncado ou de lobos irregulares de margens ciliadas, base truncada e irregularmente lobada; corola em botão 1-2 mm alt. x 2 mm diâm.; pétalas alaranjadas ou vermelhas, glabras, papilosas; anteras extrorsas, conectivo deltóide, granuloso, seco marrom-escuro; disco vermelho, ápice côncavo; estilete cilíndrico, estigma pontual. Baga ca. 1,7 cm compr. x 1,2 cm larg., púrpura, botuliforme, com lenticelas esparsas; semente 1, ca. 13 mm compr. x 8 mm larg., subprismática, lateralmente achatada, laterais rugosas, hilo obtuso, rafe marcada com poucas estrias transversais.

description: Lianas; tricomas não ramificados, curtos; ramos cilíndricos, estriados, com lenticelas circulares esparsas, glabros. Gavinhas não vistas. Folhas digitadas, às vezes com um sexto folíolo reduzido; pecíolos (l,2-)2,2-3,8(-4,5) cm compr., cilíndricos, glabros, pubérulos ou tomentosos na base e na face adaxial; estípulas (1,5—)2—3 mm compr. x 3-3,5 mm larg., deltoides, glabras, ciliadas, membranáceas, persistentes, inseridas na base do pecíolo; peciólulos centrais 0-3,5 mm compr, intermediários 0-4,5 mm compr., laterais 0-4 mm compr., canaliculados, glabros; lâminas dos folíolos centrais 4,8-7,8 x 1,6-3,5 cm, intermediários 3,7-7,8 x 1,7-3,1 cm, laterais 1,8-7 x 0,8-3 cm, sexto folíolo reduzido 3-10 x 1,5-6 mm, obovadas ou elípticas, ápice agudo, margem denticulada, revoluta, base atenuada, lâminas no início esparso pubescentes na face abaxial e logo glabrescentes em ambas as faces, carnosas. Inflorescências 6,2-8,5 cm compr. x 4,1-7,8 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado, ramos às vezes volúveis; pedúnculos 3,1-4,1 cm compr., verdes, glabros; brácteas 1 mm compr., triangulares, glabras, ciliadas; pedicelos (3-)3,5-4 mm compr., esverdeados, glabros; botões fusiformes; cálice 1-2 mm alt. x (2-)2,5-3 mm diâm., verde-amarelado, glabro, carnoso, lobos deltoides, base afunilada; corola em botão 3 mm alt. x 2-2,5 mm diâm.; pétalas verde-amareladas, glabras, margens elevadas na junção; filetes achatados, delgados, anteras latrorsas, conectivo inconspícuo; disco turbinado; estilete cónico, estigma levemente capitado. description: Lianas; tricomas malpiguiáceos com ramos curtos, misturados a tricomas não ramificados curtos, principalmente nas nervuras; ramos 4-angulados, glabros ou pubérulos principalmente nos nós, ramos reprodutivos com lenticelas esparsas, vegetativos lustrosos. Gavinhas birramificadas mas somente com o ramo axilar desenvolvido, ramo axial atrofiado, glabras, discos adesivos não observados; escamas ca. 1 mm compr., triangulares, glabras. description: Lianas; tricomas malpiguiáceos, alvos ou raro ferrugíneos; ramos cilíndricos, velutinosos. Gavinhas não vistas. Folhas simples; pecíolos (1,2-)2,2-5(-6,5) cm compr., canaliculados, velutinosos; estipulas 4 mm compr. x 3 mm larg., deltoides, pubescentes no ápice, ciliadas, membranáceas, persistentes; lâminas 5,9 9,7 x (1,6—)2,5—5,4 cm, nos ramos vegetativos triangulares, nos reprodutivos elípticas, ápice acuminado, margem denticulada, base truncada, subcordada, ou cuneada, láminas glabras na face adaxial, velutino-sas na face abaxial, argénteas na face abaxial, papiráceas. description: Lianas; tricomas malpiguiáceos adpressos, ferrugíneos; ramos cilindricos, seríceos, com lenticelas circulares. description: Lianas; tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, unicelulares, misturados a esparsos tricomas malpiguiáceos adpressos, estes principalmente nos pedicelos; ramos cilindricos ou angulados, esparso seríceos ou pulverulentos, glaucos ou avermelhados nos nós, dilatados nos nós. Inflorescências (l,5-)4-4,2 cm compr. x (2-)3,1-3,9 cm larg., glomeruliformes, de ápice convexo; pedúnculos (4—) 13-20 mm compr., verdes, esparso seríceos, pulverulentos; brácteas ca. 1 mm compr., deltoides, glabras, glaucas, caducas na maior parte; pedicelos (1—)2—3 mm compr., verdes, glaucos, esparso seríceos e glabrescentes, curvos no fruto; botões subovóides; cálice 0,5-1 mm alt. x 1 mm diâm., glauco-esverdeado, glabro, carnoso, truncado, base arredondada; corola em botão 1-2 mm alt. x l mm diâm.; pétalas glauco-amareladas, glabras, ápices com marcas serosas alvas; anteras latrorsas, conectivo cuneiforme, granuloso, seco amarelo claro; disco esverdeado, borda externa elevada; estilete cilíndrico, esverdeado, estigma pontual.
