description: Lianas; tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, ferrugíneos, misturados a tricomas glandulares longos nos ramos e mais curtos nas flores; ramos reprodutivos alados, vegetativos 4-angulados, pubérulos. Gavinhas ramificadas dicotomicamente várias vezes, pubérulas, discos adesivos presentes nas extremidades; escamas ca. 2 mm compr., triangulares, pubérulas, ciliadas. Folhas trifolioladas, às vezes simples ou ausentes na extremidade dos ramos reprodutivos; pecíolos (l,4-)6,3-10,4(-14,4) cm compr., triangulares, alados, pubérulos; estipulas 5-9 mm compr. x 5—7(—11) mm larg., falcadas, pubérulas nas duas faces, ciliadas, papiráceas, persistentes, reflexas; peciólulos centrais (3-)l 1—13(—27) mm compr., laterais 0-2(-8) mm compr., canaliculados, pubérulos; lâminas dos folíolos centrais (4,4—) 11,7-17,8(-20,6) x (2,5-)7-9,3	(-14,8) cm, laterais (3,2-)7,8-10,7(-17,7) x (2,4-) 3.5-	6,1 (-11,1) cm, elípticas, ovais, ou rómbicas, ápice acuminado, margem denticulada, base atenuada ou arredondada, lâminas pubérulas em ambas as faces principalmente nas nervuras ou canescentes na face abaxial, cartáceas, conduplicadas quando jovens, vénulas salientes na face abaxial, secas amarelas quando novas ou ocres quando maduras. Inflorescências (5,5-)7-7,6 cm compr. x (4,5-)5,2-5,6 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos 3.6-4,3 cm compr., verdes, pubérulos; brácteas 3 mm compr., triangulares, pubérulas, ciliadas, translúcidas; pedicelos 3-4 mm compr., esverdeados, pubérulos, papilosos; botões conoidais; cálice ca. 1 mm alt. x 2,5 mm diâm., verde-amarelado, pubérulo, papiloso, carnoso, urceolado, truncado, base arredondada; corola em botão ca. 1 mm alt. x 2 mm diâm.; pétalas verde-amareladas, pubérulas, papilosas; anteras extrorsas, conectivo deltóide, granuloso, seco marrom-escuro; disco esverdeado, borda externa elevada, ápice com 4 elevações radiais partindo do estilete; estilete truncado, estigma pontual. Anfisarco (2,8-)3,3-3,6 cm compr. x (1,8—)2,6-3,1 cm larg., púrpura, botuliforme, com lenticelas esparsas, endocarpo vermelho; semente 1, 1,7-2,2 cm compr. x 1 cm larg., subprismática, lateralmente achatada, laterais lisas, hilo agudo, rafe marcada com estrias transversais.

description: Arbustos ou lianas, ás vezes prostradas, tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, às vezes avermelhados; xilopódios presentes, superficiais, pouco ramificados; ramos avermelhados, angulados ou sulcados, vilosos. Gavinhas ausentes ou birramifica-das, esparso vilosas, discos adesivos presentes ñas extremidades; escamas ca. 1,5 mm compr., triangulares, esparso pubescentes, ciliadas. Folhas trifolio-ladas, às vezes algumas simples e irregularmente trilobadas; pecíolos (0,4-)2,3-4,4(-7,8) cm compr., canaliculados, raro subnulos, vilosos, às vezes avermelhados; estípulas (3-)4,5-5(-7) mm compr. x 2-2,5(-4) mm larg., triangulares ou falcadas, base auriculada, esparso vilosas, ciliadas, papiráceas, persistentes; peciólulos centrais 1,5(-5,5) mm compr., laterais (0-)3 mm compr., canaliculados, vilosos, às vezes avermelhados; lâminas dos folíolos centrais (5—) 12,7—15,3(—19,8) x (l,6-)4,5-6,8(-10,l) cm, laterais (l,7-)3,6-9,9(-l 1,8) x (l-)l,4-4(-5,8) cm, rómbicas, obtruladas, elípticas, subrómbicas, ou subobovais, ápice agudo, margem ciliada, denticulada e sinuosa, crenada, ou lacerada, às vezes ondulada, raro lobada, base atenuada, láminas estrigosas, sub-vilosas, tomentosas e glabrescentes, raro glabras, cartáceas, dicolores, secas mais ou menos argénteas na face abaxial, às vezes mais ou menos buladas, às vezes avermelhadas na nervura central e margens. Inflorescencias (4,2-)5,5-6,4(-7,4) cm compr. x 2,1 3,3	cm larg., umbeliformés, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos (2,1—)3,5—5,3 cm compr., avermelhados, vilosos; brácteas 2-3 mm compr., triangulares, esparso pubescentes, ciliadas; pedicelos (1—)2,5—3 mm compr., esverdeados ou avermelhados, velutinosos ou subvelutinosos, curvos no fruto; botões conoidais; cálice 1 mm alt. x 1-1,5 mm diám., verde-amarelado ou rosado, pubérulo ou às vezes com poucos tricomas esparsos, carnoso, truncado, base arredondada; corola em botão 1(-1,5) mm alt. x 1-1,5 mm diâm.; pétalas verde-amareladas ou rosadas, pubérulas ou às vezes com poucos tricomas esparsos; anteras extrorsas, conectivo deltóide, granuloso, seco marrom-escuro; disco esverdeado, ápice levemente côncavo; estilete cilíndrico, estigma obscuro. Baga ca. 8 mm compr. x 5 mm larg., esférica ou subesférica, lisa, verde-amare-lada; sementes 1(2), soldadas quando duas, ca. 6 mm compr. x 4 mm larg., subturbinadas, lateralmente arredondadas, laterais lisas, hilo agudo, rafe inconspícua com poucas estrias transversais.

description: Lianas, tricomas malpiguiáceos adpressos ou raro com braços longos, misturados a tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares curtos; ramos cilíndricos ou 4- angulados, com lenticelas pontuais esparsas, pubérulos. Gavinhas não ramificadas, glabras, discos adesivos não observados; escamas ca. 1 mm compr., deltoides, glabras, ciliadas. Folhas simples; pecíolos (0,7—) 1,1—14(—19,4) cm compr., canaliculados, pubérulos e glabrescentes; estipulas 2-3(-4) mm compr. x 1-4 mm larg., triangulares, subovais, ou rómbicas, glabras ou esparso seríceas, ciliadas, carnosas, caducas; lâminas 5,1-17,5 * 2,3-16,5 cm, cordiformes, elípticas, ovais, triangulares, ou oblongas, ápice agudo ou acuminado, margem denticulada, base cordada, subcordada, arredondada, cuneada, ou truncada, às vezes geniculada, lâminas seríceas ou pubérulas na nervura central na face abaxial, ou seríceas e glabrescentes em ambas as faces, quase sempre denso minuto-papilosas na face abaxial, cartáceas, secas ocres ou amarelas na face abaxial. Inflorescências 2,2-5,8(-6,2) cm compr. x 2,5-4,9 (-6,9) cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos (3-)5-24(-32) mm compr., verdes ou vermelhos, pubérulos ou seríceos; brácteas 1 mm compr., deltóides, glabras, ciliadas; pedicelos (l-)2-4 mm compr., esverdeados ou vermelhos, seríceos e glabrescentes, curvos no fruto maduro; botões subfusiformes; cálice 0,5-1 (-1,5) mm alt. x 1—2(—3) mm diâm., verde-amarelado ou vermelho, seríceo e glabrescente, carnoso, truncado ou às vezes com lobos triangulares inconspícuos, base arredondada; corola em botão 1—2(—3) mm alt. x 1—2(—2,5) mm diâm.; pétalas verde-amareladas internamente, vermelhas externamente, glabras ou seríceas; anteras latrorsas, conectivo triangular, granuloso, seco marrom-escuro; disco amarelo, não cobrindo o ápice do ovário, borda externa mais ou menos elevada, lateral côncava; estilete esverdeado, 4-angulado, estigma pontual. Baga 13-20 mm compr. x 6-9 mm larg., púrpura, botuliforme, com lenticelas esparsas; semente 1, 12,5 mm comp. x 5-7 mm larg., subfusiforme, lateralmente mais ou menos arredondada, acentuadamente curva na face das fóveas, laterais irregular e profundamente rugosas, hilo agudo, rafe não marcada, base aguda.
bibliographicCitation: Lombardi, Julio A. 2000. Vitaceae: Géneros Ampelocissus, Ampelopsis e Cissus.. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 80: 1-250.

description: Lianas, tricomas malpiguiáceos, alvos; ramos cilíndricos ou sulcados, vegetativos esfoliantes, glabros, suculentos, com lenticelas esparsas, ramos reprodutivos surgindo em caules velhos, vináceos, tomentosos ou glabrescentes. Gavinhas birramificadas, subseríceas ou glabrescentes, discos adesivos não observados; escamas ca. 1 mm compr., triangulares, glabras. Folhas 15,2-20,3(-36) x 23-28(-39,2) cm, bipinadas ou tripinadas, decíduas sazonalmente, na floração ausentes em toda a planta (espécimens raramente com folhas jovens e flores); pecíolos 3-7,6 cm compr., cilíndricos, esparso pubescentes, pulvinados; estipulas 4-5 mm compr. x 1,5 mm larg., levemente falcadas, seríceas, tomentosas, ou glabrescentes, nos ramos reprodutivos canescente-ferrugíneas ou glabrescentes, carnosas, caducas; ráquis 10,6—16(—30,9) cm compr., cilíndricas, esparso pubescentes; peciólulos de segunda ordem (0,2-)l,8-2,8(-4,5) cm compr., cilíndricos, tomentosos; folíolos 3,7-11 * 2-8 cm, 911 pares por folha, simples, temados, ou pinados (cada com 5-7 folíolos de segunda ordem); raquíolas 3,8— 6,5(—19,7) cm compr., cilíndricas, esparso pubescentes; pecíolos de terceira ordem (0—)1—2(—15) mm compr., cilíndricos, tomentosos; folíolos de segunda ordem simples ou trifoliolados; folíolos de segunda e terceira ordens 3,4-4(-6,2) x 1,8-3,8 cm; lâminas dos folíolos de primeira, segunda e terceira ordens elípticas, ovadas, ou orbiculares, ápices agudos ou acuminados, margens denticuladas, bases cuneadas, lâminas esparso vilosas na face adaxial, esparso seríceas em ambas as faces, ou tomentosas em ambas as faces, papiráceas. Inflorescencias 4,5-5,2 cm compr. x 4,1-5,2 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos (1,3-) 1,8-2,2 cm compr., vermelhos, esparso tomentosos nas ramificações ou glabrescentes; brácteas ca. 1 mm compr., deltoides, glabras; pedicelos 4-5(-7,5) mm compr., vermelhos, glabros; botões conoidais; cálice 2(-3) mm alt. x 2-3(-4) mm diâm., vermelho, glabro, seco rugoso, carnoso, truncado, base afunilada; corola em botão 3 mm alt. x 2-3 mm diâm., aplanada no ápice; pétalas vermelhas ou alaranjadas, glabras, margens elevadas na junção; filetes alaranjados, alargados, anteras latrorsas, conectivo oblongo, granuloso, apicu-lado, amarelado; disco vináceo, com 4 lobos elevados em copo e formando câmara interna em volta do estilete, lobos do disco acrescentes no fruto; estilete amarelado, cilíndrico, estigma capitado. Baga ca. 10 mm compr. x 8 mm larg., púrpura, piriforme, lisa, imatura com estilete róseo persistente; semente 1, ca. 8 mm compr. x 6 mm larg., subturbinada, lateralmente arredondada, laterais lisas, hilo obtuso, rafe levemente marcada com estrias transversais.
bibliographicCitation: Lombardi, Julio A. 2000. Vitaceae: Géneros Ampelocissus, Ampelopsis e Cissus.. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 80: 1-250.

description: Lianas, tricomas malpiguiáceos de braços curtos e adpressos, alvos, raramente também com tricomas não ramificados curtos nas axilas das nervuras secundárias ou nas nervuras em ambas as faces da folha, muito raros em outras partes; ramos sub-4-angulados, carnosos, rosados, esparso seríceos nos nós ou glabros. Gavinhas ramificadas dicotomicamente várias vezes, raro somente com um dos ramos das ramificações desenvolvido, esparso seríceas ou glabras, discos adesivos não observados; escamas ca. 2 mm compr., triangulares ou deltoides, glabras. Folhas simples, trifolioladas ou digitadas, todas as formas conmínente presentes na mesma planta, ausentes nas extremidades dos ramos reprodutivos; pecíolos (1,6—)6,9—9,6(— 19) cm compr., canaliculados, glabros ou seríceos no ápice ou esparso seríceos no ápice e na base; estipulas 2-3(-3,5) mm compr. x (2—)3—5 mm larg., deltoides, glabras, carnosas, persistentes, inseridas na base do pecíolo; lâminas das folhas simples (4,4-)6,6-9,2 (-13,8) x (2,3-)7,2-8,6(-16) cm, subelípticas, subdel-tóides, subtruladas, ou rómbicas, às vezes assimétricas, ápice arredondado, base subcordada, truncada, ou cuneada; peciólulos das folhas trifolioladas e digitadas 0-4(-10) mm compr., canaliculados, glabros; lâminas dos folíolos centrais das folhas trifolioladas 5,4-7,4 (-17) x (1,9—)4,6-8(—10,3) cm, laterais (3,2-)5,5-7,3(—15,7) x (l,l-)2-3,5(-9,3) cm, assimétricas, elípticas, suborbiculares, subtriangulares, ou subovais, às vezes lobadas, ápice arredondado ou agudo, base atenuada ou oblíqua; lâminas dos folíolos centrais das folhas digitadas (5,8-)7,2-9,4(-13,3) x (2,5-)3,4-5,7(-8,3) cm, intermediários (4,5-)7,7-9(-12,7) x (2,l-)3-4,7(-5,6) cm, laterais (2,7-)5,3-7,l(-8,3) x (1,5—)2,9—3,9 cm, assimétricas, elípticas, subelípticas, ou subrômbicas, ápice arredondado ou agudo, base atenuada, alguns folíolos das folhas compostas ocasional e irregularmente conatos, todas as formas com margem denticulada, levemente revoluta, lâminas esparso seríceas principalmente ao longo das nervuras e na base da lâmina na face adaxial, esparso seríceas na face abaxial ao longo das nervuras, e glabrescentes, carnosas, verrucosas. Inflorescéncias (3,2-)6,7-7,9 cm compr. x (3,6-)4,8-7,8 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos (1,3—)1,8—2,5 cm compr., vermelhos, seríceos e glabrescentes; brácteas ca. 0,5 mm compr., triangulares, glabras, carnosas; pedicelos (2-)3-4 mm compr., vermelhos, seríceos ou esparso seríceos; botões fusiformes; cálice 1,5-2 mm alt. x 2,5-3(-4) mm diâm., vermelho, esparso seríceo e glabrescente, carnoso, lobos deltoides, às vezes escariosos, base afunilada; corola em botão (2-)3(-4) mm alt. x 2-3 mm diâm., acuminada; pétalas vermelhas, esparso seríceas e glabrescentes, às vezes margens elevadas na junção; anteras latrorsas, conectivo triangular, granuloso, seco amarelo-claro; disco amarelo, borda externa elevada em tubo em volta do estilete, 4-lobada; estilete cilíndrico, persistente no fruto, estigma obscuro. Baga 6-10 mm compr. x 810 mm larg., púrpura, subesférica, lisa ou com lenticelas esparsas; sementes 1-4, 5,5-6 mm compr. x 4 mm larg., sub turbinadas, mais ou menos assimétricas, lateralmente mais ou menos arredondadas, fóveas longas estendendo-se por quase toda a extensão da face adaxial, laterais sulcadas, hilo agudo, rafe inconspícua.

description: Lianas, tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, misturados a tricomas glandulares; ramos cilíndricos, pubérulos. Gavinhas não vistas. Folhas trifolioladas, folíolos laterais ausentes ou muito reduzidos nos ramos reprodutivos e então folhas simples, folhas às vezes ausentes nas extremidades dos ramos reprodutivos; pecíolos (0,l-)0,4-5(-l 1,9) cm compr., canaliculados, na extremidade dos ramos reprodutivos muito reduzidos, esparso pubescentes e glabrescentes; estipulas 2-8 mm compr. * 2-4,5 mm larg., falcadas, reflexas, pubérulas principalmente na base, ciliadas, carnosas, caducas; peciólulos centrais 1—10(—18) mm compr., laterais 0-6 mm compr., canaliculados, esparso pubescentes ou glabrescentes; lâminas dos folíolos centrais (ou da folha simples nos ramos reprodutivos) 2,3-3,1 (-14,6) x 0,6-0,7(-9,6) cm, laterais (0,1-) 1,1 (-9,2) x (0,05-) 1 (-7,6) cm, elípticas ou subovais, ápice agudo, acuminado, ou caudado, margem denticulada e ciliada, base atenuada ou arredondada, lâminas pubérulas nas nervuras na face adaxial, pubérulo-glandulares nas nervuras na face abaxial, e glabrescentes em ambas as faces, papiráceas. Inflorescéncias 3,4-5,7(-7) cm compr. x 2,3-5,2(-6,3) cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos l,4-2,6(-3,8) cm compr., cor desconhecida, pubérulos; brácteas 1-2 mm compr., triangulares, esparso pubescentes na base, ciliadas; pedicelos 3—3,5(—6) mm compr., cor desconhecida, pubérulos; botões subobovóides, lateralmente comprimidos; cálice 1 mm alt. x 3 mm larg., vermelho (?), pubérulo, granuloso, carnoso, base afunilada, expandida lateralmente com laterais replicadas e parcialmente adnatas ao ápice, truncado ou de lobos irregulares; corola em botão 1 mm alt. x 2 mm diám.; pétalas vermelhas (?), glabras, papilosas; estames alaranjados, filetes firmemente inclusos no disco, anteras latrorsas, conectivo deltóide, granuloso, seco marrom-escuro; disco vermelho, ápice cóncavo; estilete cilindrico, estigma levemente capitado. Anfisarco (?) ca. 1,5 cm compr. x 1 cm diâm., púrpura, botuliforme, com lenticelas esparsas; semente não vista.

description: Lianas, tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, eretos, curvos ou torcidos, curtos ou longos, misturados a tricomas glandulares; ramos circulares, sulcados, híspidos ou pubérulos. Gavinhas ramificadas dicotomicamente várias vezes, híspidas, discos adesivos não observados; escamas ca. 1,5 mm compr., triangulares, pubérulas, ciliadas. Folhas trifolioladas, nos ramos reprodutivos muito reduzidas ou ausentes; pecíolos (1,4—)7,1 —8,5 cm compr., cilíndricos, híspidos ou vilosos; estipulas 4 mm compr. x 3 mm larg., subfalcadas ou triangulares, glabras, carnosas, caducas, base gibosa; peciólulos centrais (3,5-)9-27 mm compr., laterais (0—)8—18 mm compr., canaliculados, híspidos ou vilosos; lâminas dos folíolos centrais (4,3-) 17,5-18,8 x (l,3_) 7,4-9,7 cm, laterais (3,6-) 14,3 x (1,1—)7,3 cm, elípticas, obovadas, subo vais, ou subelípticas, ápice acuminado ou agudo, margem denticulada, base subcordada, arredondada, cuneada, ou oblíqua, lâminas esparso pubérulas nas nervuras na face adaxial, esparso híspidas, ou híspidas principalmente ao longo das nervuras, glabrescentes na face abaxial, vénulas mais ou menos proeminentes na face abaxial, papiráceas. Inflorescências (2,l-)5,2-7,4(-9,6) cm compr. x (1,7-) 2,4-6 cm larg., alongadas ou mais ou menos umbeliformes; pedúnculos (0,8-)2,3-3,5 cm compr., verdes, pubérulos; brácteas 1-2 mm compr., triangulares, pubérulas, ciliadas, base gibosa; pedicelos 2,5-3 mm compr., esverdeados, pubérulos; botões conoidais; cálice 1-1,5 mm alt. x 2-3 mm diâm., verde-amarelado, glabro, carnoso, urceolado, truncado ou de lobos irregulares, base truncada; corola em botão 1,5-2(-2,5) mm alt. x (1,5—)2,5—3 mm diâm.; pétalas verde-amareladas, papilosas, margens elevadas na junção; anteras extrorsas, conectivo deltoide, granuloso, seco marrom-claro; disco esverdeado, ápice côncavo com depressão central em volta do estilete; estilete cônico, estigma levemente capitado. Baga ca. 1,5 cm compr. x 1 cm larg., subesférica, com lenticelas esparsas, púrpura; semente 1, ca. 10 mm compr. x 9 mm larg., subdolabriforme, lateralmente achatada, levemente curvada na face das fóveas, laterais rugosas, hilo agudo, rafe marcada, frisada, e erosa.

description: ESPÉCIE INSUFICIENTEMENTE CONHECIDA Lianas; tricomas malpiguiáceos misturados a tricomas curtos não ramificados; ramos cilíndricos, vegetativos minutamente hirsutos e glabrescentes, glaucos, reprodutivos tomentosos e glabrescentes, vermelhos. Gavinhas dicotomicamente ramificadas, estriadas, pubérulas, glaucas, discos adesivos presentes nas extremidades; escamas ca. 0,1 cm compr., deltoides, glabras. Folhas não vistas, ramos reprodutivos áfilos; estípulas nos ramos reprodutivos ca. 0,2 cm compr. x 0,1 cm larg., deltoides, pubérulas, carnosas, nos ramos vegetativos persistentes e espessando-se em estruturas intumescidas mais ou menos carnosas, obtusas ou agudas de bordos afilados. Inflorescências 2,1-3,2 cm compr. x 1,4-2,1 cm compr., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos (0,9-) 1,1-1,5 cm compr., vermelhos, glabros ou tomentosos; brácteas 1,5-2 mm compr., triangulares, esparso pubescentes, ciliadas; pedicelos 2-3 mm compr., vermelhos, esparso seríceos ou glabros; botões elipsoides; cálice 1-1,5 mm compr. x 2-3 mm diâm., vermelho, esparso seríceo ou glabro, carnoso, truncado, base truncada; corola em botão 1,5-2 mm compr. x 1,5-2,5 mm diâm.; pétalas vermelhas, glabras; anteras latrorsas, conectivo vermelho, triangular, granuloso, seco marrom-escuro; disco amarelo, não cobrindo o ápice do ovário, borda externa elevada formando pequeno tubo; estilete cilindrico, estigma inconspícuamente bilobado. Fruto e semente não vistos.

description: Lianas, comumente adquirindo cor vermelha quando secas, tricomas malpiguiáceos, ferrugíneos, nos tufos de tricomas foliares não ramificados e não glandulares; ramos cilindricos ou 4-angulados, carnosos, novos vilosos, às vezes vermelhos, velhos glabres-centes, com lenticelas esparsas. Inflorescências (2,1—)3,2—3,9 cm compr. x (1,6—)2,7-3,1 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos 1,2-2 cm compr., verdes, esparso seríceos principalmente no ápice; brácteas ca. 2 mm compr., triangulares, glabras, ciliadas, gibosas na base; pedicelos 3-4 mm compr., verdes, vilosos; botões elipsoides; cálice 0,5-1 mm alt. x 1-2 mm diám., verde-amarelado, glabro, carnoso, lobos arredondados de margem escariosa, base arredondada; corola em botão 1,5-2 mm alt. x 1-2 mm diám.; pétalas verde-amareladas, glabras, margens elevadas na junção; anteras latrorsas, conectivo inconspícuo; disco não cobrindo o ápice do ovário, borda externa crispada; estilete cilindrico, estigma pontual. description: Lianas, secas verde-oliva escuro; tricomas mal-piguiáceos, com ramos curtos e adpressos, misturados a tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, curtos; ramos cilíndricos, seríceos, principalmente nos nós, alargados nos nós, velhos lustrosos. Inflorescências 2,7-3,4 cm compr. x 2,7-3,8 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos 11-14 mm compr., verdes, seríceos; brácteas ca. 1 mm compr., deltoides, glabras; pedicelos 2-5 mm compr., verde-amarelados, seríceos; botões elipsoides; cálice 0,5-1 mm compr. x 1,5-2 mm diâm., verde-amarelado, seríceo principalmente na base, papiráceo, truncado, base arredondada; corola em botão 2 mm compr. x 1,5-2 mm diâm.; pétalas verde-amareladas, glabras; anteras latrorsas, conectivo triangular, granuloso, seco amarelo-claro; disco amarelo, borda externa elevada; estilete cilindrico, alargado na base, estigma pontual. description: Lianas, secas vermelho-telha, tricomas malpigui-áceos retorcidos de pedúnculo alongado, ferrugíneos ou alvescentes; ramos circulares, com lenticelas circulares esparsas, esparso vilosos principalmente nos nós. description: Lianas, tricomas malpiguiáceos, às vezes esparsos tricomas estrelados na face abaxial das folhas, ferrugí-neos ou amarelo-dourados; ramos 4-angulados, lenticelados, glabros, ou esparso seríceos, pubescentes, e glabrescentes. Gavinhas birramificadas, pubescentes na base, lenticeladas, discos adesivos não observados; escamas ca. 1 mm compr., triangulares, glabras. description: Lianas ou ocasionalmente hemiepífitas, tricomas malpiguiáceos ferrugíneos ou alvescentes; ramos circulares ou sulcados (às vezes alargando-se em túberas caulinares de seção elíptica compreendendo um a dois nós), suculentos, lenticelas circulares esparsas, ramos vegetativos vilosos ou glabrescentes, ramos reprodutivos às vezes surgindo em ramos vegetativos já sem folhas, esparso seríceos, vilosos nos nós. Gavinhas birramificadas, às vezes com ramo reduzido, ou dicotomicamente ramificadas várias vezes, glabrescentes, esparso seríceas na ramificação, discos adesivos não observados nas gavinhas birramificadas, presentes nas extremidades das gavinhas dicotomicamente ramificadas; escamas 1 mm compr., triangulares, glabras, ciliadas. Baga 8-9 mm compr. x 5_7 mm larg., púrpura, subesférica, lisa; semente 1,6,5 mm compr. x 4-5 mm larg., subesférica, lateralmente arredondada, laterais rugosas, hilo agudo, rafe levemente marcada com estrias transversais.

description: Lianas; tricomas ferrugíneos, não ramificados e não glandulares, longos e curtos, misturados a tricomas glandulares; ramos avermelhados, cilíndricos, híspidos. Gavinhas ramificadas dicotomicamente várias vezes, híspidas, discos adesivos presentes nas extremidades; escamas ca. 1 mm compr., triangulares, híspidas, ciliadas. Folhas trifolioladas; pecíolos (2,2-) 3,1—3,5(—4) cm compr., canaliculados, híspidos; estípulas 3--4(-6) mm compr. x 2(-3) mm larg., falcadas, híspidas, ciliadas, membranáceas, persistentes; peciólulos centrais 0(-3) mm compr., laterais 0(-l) mm compr., canaliculados, híspidos; láminas dos folíolos centrais (4-)7-8,7 x (1,5—)2—3,9 cm, laterais (2,1—)3,3—4,8(—5,3) x l-2,6(-3,4) cm, rómbicas, subelípticas, ou fusiformes, ápice agudo, acuminado, ou caudado, margem denticulada, base atenuada ou cuneada, láminas híspidas ou esparso híspidas em ambas as faces, às vezes levemente dicolores e avermelhadas, papiráceas. Inflorescéncias 2,6-3 cm compr. x 3-3,7 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos 14-18 mm compr., verdes, híspidos; brácteas ca. 1 mm compr., triangulares, híspidas, ciliadas; pedicelos 2,5-3 mm compr., esverdeados, minutamente híspidos; botões conoidais; cálice 0,5-1 mm alt. x (1—)1,5 mm diám., verde-amarelado, minutamente híspido, carnoso, truncado, base lateralmente apendiculadacom 1-3 lobos lineares de ca. 2 mm compr., lobos com margens ciliadas; corola em botão 1 (-1,5) mm alt. x 1 mm diám.; pétalas verde-amareladas, minutamente híspidas no ápice; anteras extrorsas, conectivo deltóide, granuloso, seco marrom-escuro; disco esverdeado, ápice cóncavo com depressão central irregular em volta do estilete; estilete cilindrico, estigma levemente capitado. Baga ca. 10 mm compr. x 6,5 mm larg., púrpura, turbinada, lisa ou tuberculada, com tubérculos pubescente-glandu-lares principalmente na base, seca sulcada; semente 1, ca. 8 mm compr. x 5 mm larg., subturbinada, lateralmente achatada, laterais levemente rugosas, ápice emarginado, hilo agudo, rafe marcada e com estrias transversais irregulares.

description: Lianas; tricomas malpiguiáceos, ferrugíneos; ramos subcilíndricos ou 4-angulados, lenticelados, tomentosos, esparso seríceos ou glabros. Gavinhas não ramificadas, achatadas, glabras, discos adesivos não observados; escamas ca. 1 mm compr., deltoides, proeminentes, glabras. Folhas simples; pecíolos (1,6-) 2.8- 8,4(-19,l) cm compr., canaliculados, esparso seríceos ou tomentosos; estípulas 1,5-3 mm compr. x 2 mm larg., triangulares, esparso pubescentes no ápice e margem e glabrescentes, carnosas, caducas, parte basal caindo antes do ápice, parte mediana permanecendo unida ao caule; lâminas 7,8-11,5(-25,2) x 4,8—11,3(—23,2) cm, nos ramos vegetativos cordiformes ou triangulares, nos ramos reprodutivos rómbicas, panduriformes, elípticas, ou oblongas, ápice agudo ou acuminado, margem denticulada, base cordada, subcordada, truncada, ou raro sagitada, lâminas jovens hirsutas ou pubescentes na face abaxial ou esparso seríceas em ambas as faces, maduras muito esparso seríceas em ambas as faces e glabrescentes, papiráceas, secas verde-oliva escuro. Inflorescências 8,3-11,7 cm compr. x 8-9,1 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos 3-4,8 cm compr., verdes, esparso seríceos na base e tomentosos nos ramos; brácteas ca. 1 mm compr., triangulares, glabras ou pubescentes no ápice e na base, ciliadas, secas enegrecidas; pedicelos 3(-5) mm compr., verdes, seríceos; botões conoidais; cálice (0,5-) 1 mm alt. x (1,5—)2 mm diâm., verde-amarelado, esparso seríceo, ciliado, lobos deltoides, base arredondada; corola em botão 2(-3) mm alt. x 2 mm diám.; pétalas verde-amareladas, esparso seríceas; anteras latrorsas, conectivo triangular, granuloso, seco amarelo-claro; disco de borda externa elevada e 4-lobada; estilete cilindrico, alargado na parte média, estigma pontual. Baga ca. 8 mm compr. x 7 mm larg., púrpura, subpiriforme, lisa; semente 1, ca. 8 mm compr. x 6 mm larg., subturbinada, lateralmente achatada, laterais sulcadas, hilo agudo, rafe levemente marcada.

description: Plant known only from fragments over 7 dm long but probably flowering very much higher. Leaves ca 1 m long, densely and finely brown-lepidote beneath; sheaths ovate, 15 cm long; blades very narrowly triangular, long-attenuate, flat, 35 mm wide. Scape straight, 8 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, closely enfolding the scape, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper ovate, apiculate, slightly exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence simple, ca 25 cm long, glabrous in age; rhachis slender, flexuous, angled. Floral bracts more or less secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, acute, 4 cm long, all but the lowest twice as long as the internodes, exceeded by the sepals, ecarinate, chartaceous, nerved. Sepals oblong-elliptic, obtuse, 33 mm long, 8 mm wide, chartaceous, nerved.

description: Lianas, tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, misturados a tricomas glandulares, alvescentes ou avermelhados; ramos às vezes avermelhados, cilíndricos ou angulados, raro irregularmente alados, híspidos, cobertos com ramentos densos ou esparsos. Gavinhas avermelhadas, birramificadas, híspidas, glabras no ápice, discos adesivos presentes nas extremidades; escamas ca. 1 mm compr., deltóides, híspidas, ciliadas. Folhas trifolioladas, raro simples e irregularmente fendidas; pecíolos (2,3-)4,2-8,45(-9) cm compr., canaliculados, híspidos, com ramentos diminutos; estípulas 4-5(-7) mm compr. x 2(-3) mm larg., falcadas, híspidas ou pubérulas na face abaxial, glabras na face adaxial, ciliadas, carnosas, caducas, secretoras na base, reflexas; peciólulos centrais (0-) 5 mm compr, laterais (0-) 1,5-2,5(-4) mm compr., canaliculados, híspidos; lâmina dos folíolos centrais (5,4-) 12,3-14 x (2-)6,5-8,5(-9) cm, laterais (2,l-)7,3-9,4(-10,3) x (1—)4,3—6,6 cm, elípticas, ovais, ou obovais, ápice agudo, margem ciliada e denticulada ou irregularmente lacerada, nos ramos reprodutivos às vezes lobada, base atenuada, arredondada, ou oblíqua, lâminas pubérulas na face adaxial, pubérulas ou tomentosas ao longo das nervuras principais na face abaxial, membranáceas, dicolores, violáceas ou avermelhadas na face abaxial e argênteas ao longo das nervuras na face adaxial. Inflorescências (l,3-)3,4-3,6(-5,9) cm compr. x (l,3-)2,3-2,8(-4) cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos (9—) 12— 18,5(—32) mm compr., verdes, híspidos ou às vezes com ramentos esparsos; brácteas 1 mm compr., triangulares, minutamente híspidas, ciliadas; pedicelos 35 mm compr., esverdeados, híspidos, curvos no fruto jovem; botões conoidais; cálice 1 mm alt. x 2 mm diâm., verde-amarelado, esparso híspido principalmente na base ou híspido, papiloso, carnoso, truncado, às vezes levemente expandido lateralmente, base truncada; corola em botão (1,5—)2 mm alt. x 2 mm diâm.; pétalas verde-amareladas ou arroxeadas, esparso híspidas principalmente no ápice ou com poucos tricomas esparsos; anteras latrorsas, conectivo deltóide, granuloso, seco marrom-escuro; disco de ápice côncavo, com depressão no centro em volta do estilete; estilete cilíndrico e delgado, estigma levemente capitado. Baga (6—)9— 12 mm compr. x 68 mm larg., púrpura, piriforme, lisa; semente 1, ca. 12 mm compr. x 5 mm larg., subturbinada, lateralmente achatada, laterais levemente rugosas, ápice levemente emarginado, hilo agudo, rafe levemente marcada com estrias transversais.

description: Lianas, tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, alvescentes, misturados a tricomas glandulares; ramos às vezes avermelhados, sulcados, angulados, raro alados, ou ramentáceos, tomentosos. Gavinhas ramificadas dicotomicamente várias vezes, avermelhadas, tomentosas ou híspidas, discos adesivos presentes nas extremidades; escamas ca. 2 mm compr., triangulares, híspidas ou pubescentes, ciliadas. Folhas trifolioladas, nos ramos reprodutivos com folíolos laterais muito reduzidos ou ausentes nas extremidades dos ramos reprodutivos; pecíolos 1,1—9,2(—12) cm compr., canaliculados ou raro alados, esparso tomentosos; estípulas 4-7,5 mm compr. x 1-2,5 mm larg., espatuladas ou falcadas, tomentosas, esparso pubé-rulas ou esparso pubescentes nas duas faces principalmente no ápice, ciliadas, papiráceas, persistentes, reflexas, base gibosa; peciólulos centrais (0—) 10 mm compr., laterais 0-5 mm compr., canaliculados, tomentosos; lâmina dos folíolos centrais (2,3—)12— 14,5(—17,7) x (0,8—)8,3—10(—11,1) cm, laterais (0,4-) 8,1—9,5(—14,8) x (0,3-)4,7-6,5(-l 0,5) cm, elípticas, subelípticas, rómbicas, ou subovais, freqüentemente desiguais, ápice agudo ou obtuso, margem denticulada, crenulada, ou raro denteada, raro lobada, base atenuada ou oblíqua, lâminas escabras na face adaxial, pubérulas, subcanescentes, ou esparso tomentosas ao longo das nervuras, papiráceas. Inflorescências (2,3-) 3,2-4,5(-5,3) cm compr. x (1,7—)3—4 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos 6-21 mm compr., verdes, tomentosos na base, pubérulos no ápice; brácteas 2-5 mm compr., espatuladas ou falcadas, híspidas ou pubérulas, ciliadas; pedicelos 24 mm compr., esverdeados ou avermelhados, pubérulos ou híspidos; botões conoidais; cálice 1-1,5 mm alt. x 2 mm diâm., esverdeado ou avermelhado, pubérulo, papiloso, carnoso, truncado, base arredondada ou truncada; corola em botão 1,5-2,5 ram alt. x 1,5-2 mm diâm.; pétalas verde-amareladas ou avermelhadas, glabras, papilosas ou às vezes esparso pubérulas, tardiamente caducas; anteras latrorsas, conectivo rómbico, granuloso, seco amarelo-claro; disco alaranjado, ápice levemente côncavo; estilete cilíndrico, estigma pontual ou levemente capitado. description: Leaves rosulate, to 5 dm long; sheaths elliptic, castaneous toward base, densely punctate-lepidote; blades ligulate, 3 cm broad, flat, rounded at apex and apiculate, concolorous, densely and minutely lepidote beneath, glabrous above. Scape erect, glabrous, its bracts foliaceous, densely imbricate. Inflorescence simple, curved, subdensely few-flowered, ca 15 cm long. Floral bracts imbricate, slightly secund, very broadly ovate, triangular-acute, to 45 mm long and 33 mm wide, exceeding the sepals, glabrous, strongly rugose when dry, not at all carinate, dark castaneous toward base; flowers strongly secund; pedicels 1 cm long, very thick. Sepals broadly ovate, acute, 35-40 mm long, rather thin, impressed-punctulate, rugulose when dry; petals imperfectly known, at base bearing 2 scales 1 cm long, stamens apparently included.

description: Lianas, glabras, enegrecidas quando secas; ramos cilíndricos. Gavinhas não vistas. Folhas simples; pecíolos (0,9-) 1,7-4,1 cm compr., canaliculados; estípulas ca. 1 mm compr. x 1,5 mm larg., deltóides, ciliadas, carnosas, caducas; lâminas 5-7 x l ,7-5,3 cm, nos ramos vegetativos triangulares, nos reprodutivos elípticas ou obovais, ápice acuminado, margem denticulada, base cordada, subcordada, ou cuneada, membranáceas. Inflorescências 2-4 cm compr. x 2,5-3,1 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos 5-21 mm compr., verdes; brácteas ca. 1 mm compr., triangulares, ciliadas; pedicelos 1-2 mm compr., esverdeados; botões elipsoides; cálice 1 mm alt. x 1-2 mm diâm., verde-amarelado, carnoso, truncado ou de lobos obscuro-triangulares, base arredondada; corola em botão 1-2 mm alt. x l-l ,5 mm diâm.; pétalas verde-amareladas ou rosadas, fortemente coerentes; anteras latrorsas, conectivo cuneiforme, granuloso, seco amarelo claro; disco esverdeado, ápice côncavo; estilete cilíndrico, estigma pontual. Anfisarco ca. 15 mm compr. x 8 mm diâm., púrpura, botuliforme, liso; semente 1, ca. 12 mm compr. x 5 mm larg., subfusiforme, lateralmente achatada, laterais irregularmente rugosas, hilo agudo, rafe não marcada.

description: Plant stemless (?), flowering 8 dm long with the inflorescence extended. Leaves suberect, 4 dm long, sparsely and minutely appressed-lepidote; sheaths elliptic, 10 cm long, dark castaneous except near apex; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, 2 cm wide at base, longitudinally marked with fine purple stripes. Scape slender, decurved (?), glabrous; scape-bracts erect, subfoliaceous, much exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence bipinnate, lax, 14 cm long; primary bracts broadly ovate with a narrowly triangular spreading or recurved blade, the lower ones exceeding the flowers; branches 2-flowered, the axis almost completely aborted. Floral bracts suborbicular, 8 mm long; pedicels stout, 3 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 18 mm long, 11 mm wide, ecarinate, coriaceous; petals 45 mm long, appendaged at base.

description: Plant flowering ca 2 m high. Leaves rosulate, 5 dm long, obscurely punctulate-lepidote throughout; sheaths large, ovate-oblong; blades linear-triangular, attenuate, 8 cm wide at base. Scape erect, 3 cm in diameter; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, obscurely dark-punctulate, the lower ones foliaceous, the upper very broadly ovate, acute, subinflated. Inflorescence many-flowered, amply bipinnate, 1 m long; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts; branches strictly erect, densely secund-flowered, to 4 dm long, laxly prophyllate at the base. Floral bracts erect, more or less secund with the flowers, broadly ovate to suborbicular, inflated, obtusely carinate toward apex, 3 cm long, about equaling the sepals and more than twice as long as the internodes, thick and rigidly coriaceous when dry, even, glabrous outside, densely and minutely punctulate-lepidote inside; flowers strongly secund and even nutant after maturity; pedicels stout, 10 mm long. Sepals elliptic, 22 mm long, 12 mm wide, obtuse, thick-coriaceous, not at all carinate. Capsule stout, acute, beaked, 35 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1977. Tillandsioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (2): 663-1492.

description: Leaves rosulate, 30-36 cm long, exceeding the inflorescence, punctulate-lepidote throughout; sheaths elliptic, ca 10 cm long; blades ligulate, slightly narrowed toward base, broadly acute and apiculate, 23 mm wide, wholly green. Scape very short; scape-bracts imbricate, elliptic, acute. Inflorescence simple, subdense, oblong-lanceolate, compressed, 17-22 cm long, 4 cm wide. Floral bracts erect and imbricate, subelliptic, broadly acute, 45 mm long, 30 mm wide, sharply carinate, incurved toward apex, dark red except the narrow green margin, subpapyraceous, covered with appressed cinereous scales; flowers ill-scented; pedicels obconic, 5 mm long. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, to 34 mm long, sparsely lepidote, nerved, ecarinate; petals obtuse, nearly 5 cm long, greenish yellow, bearing 2 large rounded scales; stamens exserted. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, about equaling the sepals.

description: Plant flowering 1.6 m high. Leaves in a dense crateriform rosette, 60 cm long, rigid, coriaceous; sheaths subovate, 20 cm long, 16 cm wide, dark castaneous, densely pardaline-lepidote above, inconspicuously lepidote beneath; blades sublinear, long-attenuate and then short-acuminate, 10 cm wide, green below, the upper half vinaceous. Scape erect, 15 mm thick, purplish; internodes 5 cm long; scape-bracts spreading toward apex, vinaceous beneath, green and lepidote above, the lower imbricate, subtriangular, long-acuminate, 8 cm long, 6 cm wide, the upper much smaller, short-acuminate, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate; primary bracts very broadly ovate, rounded and apiculate, 30 mm long, 45 mm wide, shorter than the sterile bases of the branches, vinaceous; branches 4, spreading, 25-35 cm long with 12-15 distichous flowers, the sterile base 10 cm long with 2 bracts; rhachis geniculate, purplish; internodes 15 mm long. Floral bracts suborbicular, cymbiform-inflated, emarginate and minutely apiculate, 3 cm wide extended, obtusely carinate or ecarinate, dark purple; flowers a litde secund upwardly, nocturnal, not imbricate; pedicels 10 mm thick. Sepals broadly ovate, acute, 30 mm long, much exceeding the floral bracts, pale vinaceous; petal linear-lanceolate, acute, 8 cm long, 10 mm wide, soon flaccid, bearing 2 entire, 7 mm long scales at base; stamens free, 10 cm long; ovules long-caudate.

description: Plant flowering 5 dm high. Leaves rosulate, 3 dm long; sheaths broadly ovate, 10 cm long, covered with fine brown appressed scales; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 5 cm wide, apparently concolorous, subdensely and minutely brown-lepidote on both sides. Scape somewhat curved toward apex but not deflexed, exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts erect, the lowest subfoliaceous and densely imbricate, the highest suborbicular, apiculate, red, equaling or slightly exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence few-branched, compact, 11-17 cm long; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, equaling to shorter than the short sterile bracteate bases of the spikes; spikes suberect, elliptic, to 8 cm long, 4 cm wide, strongly complanate; rhachis nearly straight, 4-angled. Floral bracts imbricate but not wholly covering the rhachis, incurved toward apex, ecarinate, 3 cm long, about 4 times as long as the internodes, slightly exceeded by the sepals, thick, probably somewhat fleshy, nearly even when dry, obscurely punctulate-lepidote at apex; flowers not at all secund; pedicels slenderly obconic, 5 mm long. Sepals narrowly obovate, obtuse and cucullate, 28 mm long, even, brown-lepidote inside; petal-blades elliptic, 10 mm long; stamens exserted.

description: Plant flowering 85 cm high. Leaves to 53 cm long, obscurely punctulate-lepidote; sheaths broadly elliptic, 7 cm long; blades ligulate, acuminate, 25 mm wide, purple toward base. Scape straight, very slender; scape-bracts strict, closely enfolding the scape, imbricate, lanceolate, chartaceous, glabrous, purple when dry. Inflorescence simple, lax, at least 4-flowered, glabrous. Floral bracts secund with the flowers, broadly elliptic, apiculate, to 30 mm long, less than twice the internodes, thin, nerved, ecarinate; pedicels slender, 5 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 25 mm long, exserted, thin, nerved, castaneous; petals slightly exceeding the sepals, pale yellow when dry; stamens included. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, slightly exceeding the sepals, long-beaked.

description: Plant stemless, 4 dm high. Leaves few, subfasciculate, 25 cm long; sheaths elliptic, small and inconspicuous; blades ligulate, acute with a linear soft cusp 1 cm long, flat, 2 cm wide, green. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts imbricate and tightly enfolding the scape, elliptic, acute, thin, even, obscurely punctulate-lepidote. Inflorescence lax, 3-flowered with a sterile rudiment at apex; axis slender, flexuous, enlarged and verrucose below each node. Floral bracts not imbricate, ovate, 3 cm long, much exceeding the sepals, ecarinate, very obscurely lepidote, nerveless and rugulose when dry, probably somewhat fleshy in life; flowers more or less secund; pedicels obconic, 5 mm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, about 2 cm long, ecarinate, nerveless and rugulose. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, acute, 3 cm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 4 dm high. Leaves about 20 in a broadly funnelform rosette, to 27 cm long, pale beneath and densely and finely lepidote; sheaths ovate, distinct, 10 cm long; blades ligulate, acuminate, 25-30 mm wide, green above. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts imbricate, closely enfolding the scape, the upper elliptic, apiculate. Inflorescence simple, 15 cm long, densely 10-flowered; rhachis flexuous, slender, slightly sulcate. Floral bracts erect, nearly 3 times as long as the internodes, scarcely if at all secund with the flowers, ovate, subacute and slightly cucullate, 4 cm long, ecarinate, thin-coriaceous, sparsely verrucose, otherwise even, glabrous, pale castaneous when dry; pedicels 10 mm long. Sepals ovate, acute, 25 mm long, ecarinate, thin-coriaceous, glabrous.

description: Plant flowering over 7 dm high. Leaves over 7 dm long, dark green; sheaths elliptic, covered with white appressed dark-centered scales; blades ligulate, acute, cuspidate-thickened, 5 cm wide, soon glabrous. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts imbricate, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper ovate, attenuate. Inflorescence narrowly cylindric, 15 cm long, laxly bipinnate; axes slender, obscurely lepidote; primary bracts broadly ovate, acuminate with a thickened apex, about equaling or shorter than the axillary branches, obscurely lepidote; branches suberect, lax, to 5-flowered with the terminal one usually much reduced, slender, geniculate, the sterile base short, naked. Floral bracts suborbicular, 10 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous, even, glabrous; pedicels obconical, 5 mm long. Sepals suborbicular, 12 mm long, coriaceous, even, glabrous; petals 30 mm long, pale greenish white; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering 7-8.5 dm high. Leaves 4 dm long; sheaths large, broadly elliptic; blades ligulate, broadly rounded, apiculate, 55 mm wide, glabrous at maturity, marked with transverse lines. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts erect, broadly elliptic, acute, subinflated, the upper slightly shorter than the internodes, red. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, many-flowered, 25 cm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, about 1/3 as long as the branches; branches spreading, 5-6-flowered from the base, without sterile bracts, broadly lanceolate, 9 cm long, strongly compressed; rhachis geniculate, slender. Floral bracts distichous, divergent or spreading at anthesis, broadly ovate, narrowly obtuse, 28 mm long, about equaling and nearly surrounding the sepals, 2-3 times as long as the internodes, obtusely carinate, coriaceous, red; flowers never secund; pedicels stout, very short. Sepals lanceolate, obtuse, 24 mm long, obtusely carinate; petals ligulate, about equaling the stamens, each bearing a single large triangular-ovate entire scale (! Mez-not verified and dubious).

description: Leaves to 25 cm long; sheaths relatively narrow, very densely pale-lepidote, lead-colored when dry; blades acute, ca 5 cm wide, coriaceous when dry, subglabrous, marked with wavy dark purplish-brown lines especially near base. Scape erect, slender, undoubtedly much exceeding the leaves, at least 4 dm long; scape-bracts shorter than the internodes and not at all foliaceous. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 25 cm long, 9 cm in diameter; primary bracts ovate, acute, many times shorter than the sterile naked bases of the branches; branches erect or ascending, to 13 cm long, slender, slightly compressed at the base, bearing 3 secund lax flowers near the apex. Floral bracts ovate, acute, 10 mm long, exceeded by the sepals, ecarinate; pedicels very stout, to 4 mm long. Sepals equal, broadly elliptic, obtuse, subsymmetrical, 9 mm long, 6 mm wide, rigidly coriaceous, even.

description: Plant stemless, ca 4 dm high. Leaves densely utriculate-rosulate, 25 cm long, suberect; sheaths broadly ovate, 8 cm long, appressed-lepidote, violet within, brown toward base outside; blades triangular, attenuate, 22 mm wide, lepidote, green, sparsely purple-spotted. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts imbricate and wholly covering the scape, triangular-ovate. Inflorescence simple, 21-20-flowered, oblong, sublax at anthesis. Floral bracts distichous, suborbicular, 25 mm long, about equaling the sepals, ecarinate, submembranaceous, bright purple, sparsely lepidote; flowers suberect, flavous. Sepals asymmetric, obtuse, 22 mm long, 10 mm wide, ecarinate; petals 33 mm long, bearing 2 acute scales, the blades elliptic, obtuse; stamens exserted.

description: Plant flowering ca 8 dm high. Leaf-blades ligulate, acuminate, over 8 dm long, 4 cm wide, green, concolorous, very obscurely punctulate-lepidote. Scape stout; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, broadly elliptic, apiculate. Inflorescence simple, 15-flowered, 3 dm long. Floral bracts remaining erect, barely imbricate, very broadly ovate with a short triangular obtuse cucullate apex, 45 mm long, about equaling the sepals, ecarinate, thick, coriaceous, rugulose when dry, obscurely punctulate; flowers secund, divergent; pedicels stout. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 40 mm long, 28 mm wide, coriaceous; petals elliptic-oblong, each bearing 2 large scales at the base.

description: Plant flowering ca 3 dm high. Leaves rosulate, many, 35 cm long, cinereous-lepidote throughout; sheaths broadly ovate, ca 5 cm long, dark castaneous; blades very narrowly triangular, attenuate, 3 cm wide at base, arched-recurving, subinvolute. Scape erect, short, mostly concealed by the leaves; scape-bracts densely imbricate, ovate with long recurving foliaceous blades, green. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, slenderly fusiform, 13 cm long, 2 cm in diameter; primary bracts elliptic, ample, laminate or apiculate, 5 cm long, imbricate and covering the spikes except for the corollas, subchartaceous, rose, covered with fine appressed cinereous scales; spikes sessile, elliptic, complanate, 35 mm long, 15 mm wide, densely 5-7-flowered; rhachis alate. Floral bracts lanceolate, acute, to 23 mm long, exceeding the sepals, sharply carinate, densely cinereous-lepidote, thin, nerved toward apex; flowers subsessile. Sepals oblong-elliptic, acute, 15 mm long, ecarinate, glabrous; petals tubular-erect, green, bearing 2 acute scales near base; stamens exserted.

description: Plant flowering 1.5 m high. Leaves many, densely rosulate, 70-80 cm long; sheaths elliptic, not constricted but merging with the blade, 10-12 cm wide, castaneous, densely lepidote-foveolate throughout; blades ligulate, acute and apiculate, 7 cm wide, sparsely and inconspicuously lepidote. Scape erect, 40-45 cm high, 1-2 cm thick, glabrous; scape-bracts imbricate, foliaceous, 7-10 cm long. Inflorescence simple, distichous-flowered, lance-oblong, 40 cm long, 10 cm wide. Floral bracts densely imbricate before anthesis, then spreading and lax, ovate, obtuse, 6 cm long, much exceeding the sepals, ecarinate, brown at base to stramineous at apex, purple-margined. Flowers nocturnal, not at all secund; pedicels stout, 10 mm long. Sepals lance-ovate, acute, 40 mm long, ecarinate; petals elliptic, subobtuse and emarginate, 45 mm long, 20 mm wide, flavous, purple-punctate, bearing 2 oblong, acute scales at base; stamens and pistil included.

description: Plant flowering nearly 1 m high. Leaves ca 35 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, large; blades ligulate, broadly rounded, apiculate, 6 cm wide, glabrous at maturity. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts densely imbricate and clasping the scape, elliptic, rounded, apiculate. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, slenderly cylindric, to 35 cm long, 5 cm in diameter, glabrous; primary bracts very broadly ovate, apiculate, half as long as the branches; branches erect, laxly 5-flowered, 5 cm long with a short naked sterile base; rhachis slender, flexuous. Floral bracts distichous, suborbicular, to 13 mm long, much shorter than the sepals, slightly carinate; flowers spreading, never secund; pedicels short, stout. Sepals narrowly elliptic, to 17 mm long, subcoriaceous; petals broadly ligulate, 25 mm long, yellow, bearing 2 long acute scales; stamens included, filaments thickened toward apex.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 6-8 dm high. Leaves 28-65 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic but scarcely wider than the blades, 6 cm long, densely vestite with brown-centered scales; blades narrowly subtriangular, attenuate, 3 cm wide, obscurely brown-punctulate on both sides. Scape slightly curved, 8 mm in diameter; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate, the lowest subfoliaceous, the highest elliptic, apiculate. Inflorescence simple, 16-flowered, oblong, 20 cm long, 5 cm wide, strongly complanate; rhachis geniculate, excavated, sparsely dark-punctulate. Floral bracts suberect, about three times as long as the internodes but not concealing the rhachis, ovate, acute, to 5 cm long, distinctly exceeding the sepals, ecarinate, subchartaceous and sulcate when dry, sparsely and obscurely dark-punctulate; flowers not secund at anthesis; pedicels stoutly obconic, 5 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, obtuse, 30 mm long, 10 mm wide, ecarinate, subchartaceous, densely brown-lepidote; petals ca 4 cm long, white, bearing 2 acute scales at base.

description: Plant flowering at least 75 cm high. Leaves many, rosulate, 50 cm long, obscurely punctulate-lepidote; sheaths ovate, to 10 cm long; blades ligulate, acute, contracted toward base, to 20 mm wide. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts imbricate, ovate, the lower laminate, the upper apiculate. Inflorescence simple, lax, oblong, 27 cm long, strongly complanate, very laxly and obscurely lepidote; axis slightly flexuous, slender, narrowly alate, purple. Floral bracts divergent, narrowly ovate, to 55 mm long, much exceeding the sepals, sharply carinate, incurved at apex, thin, nerved when dry, red; pedicels slender, ca 10 mm long; flowers distichous, erect. Sepals oblong, rounded and apiculate, 3 cm long, thin, nerved, the posterior carinate; petals and stamens unknown. Capsules about equaling the sepals.

description: Plant flowering 5 dm high or less, very slender. Leaves 20-35 cm long, chartaceous, densely appressed-lepidote, brownish green, sometimes tinged with red or violet; blades linear, attenuate, 13-18 mm wide. Scape slender, erect, usually exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts imbricate, ovate or elliptic, acuminate or the upper ones acute, brown, submembranaceous, not foliaceous. Inflorescence simple, densely 4-9-flowered, 4-9 cm long; rhachis slender, flexuous, slightly angled. Floral bracts becoming secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, about 26 mm long, equaling the sepals at anthesis, convex and not carinate, strongly incurved toward the apex, even, chartaceous, light brown, slightly lustrous; flowers suberect, 28 mm long; pedicels very stout, 4 mm long. Sepals elliptic, rounded and apiculate, 22 mm long, 10 mm wide, thin, even, glabrous outside, dark-punctulate-lepidote inside; petals yellow, each bearing 2 lanceolate acute or bicuspidate scales near the base; stamens and pistil included; ovules with a short stout protuberance, not truly caudate.

description: Plant flowering (immature) to 7 dm high. Leaves few, erect, 35 cm long; sheaths nearly as long as the blades but narrow and indistinct, minutely lepidote, brown toward base; blades ligulate, rounded, apiculate, 55-60 mm wide, nearly glabrous, green, bluish toward apex. Scape erect, 12 mm in diameter, glabrous, red; scape-bracts erect and clasping the scape, the upper broadly ovate, acute, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence compound, 23 cm long, narrow, glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches simple, erect, densely 6-8-flowered with long sterile bases bearing 1-2 bracts, 8 cm long. Floral bracts imbricate, broadly ovate, subacute, 2 cm long, exceeding the sepals at least before anthesis, sharply carinate, greenish yellow, nearly smooth; flowers distichous; pedicels obconic, stout. description: Plant stemless, flowering over 1 m high. Leaves many in a spreading rosette, 65 cm long, covered with pale appressed dark-centered scales; sheaths oblong-elliptic, ca 20 cm long, brownish; blades ligulate, broadly subacute with a triangular apiculus, 9 cm wide, green, concolorous, tinged with red beneath, becoming glabrous above. Scape erect, very short, wholly concealed by the leaves; scape-bracts imbricate, broadly ovate, red with a small green triangular blade. Inflorescence subdigitate typically 7-branched, its short axis hidden by the leaves; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but merely apiculate and wholly red, 5-6 cm long; spikes linear, terete, 45-60 cm long including the densely bracteate sterile base, 1 cm wide; rhachis slightly flexuous, angled. Floral bracts narrowly ovate, acuminate, nearly 6 cm long, ecarinate, deep red, chartaceous, covered with inconspicuous white appressed scales; pedicels stout, 5 mm long; flowers blooming one at a time, downwardly secund as to petals alone. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acute, 37 mm long; petals linear, obtuse, 65 mm long, deep pink; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering 5-27 dm high. Leaves 1 m long; sheaths broadly elliptic, 35 cm long, densely and minutely ferruginous-lepidote; blade ligulate, acute, cuspidate, 6-7 cm wide, obsucrely punctulate-lepidote beneath. Inflorescence erect, simple, laxly 6-26-flowered, 10-36 cm long, glabrous; rhachis flexuous. Floral bracts becoming secund with the flowers, ovate, acute, ecarinate, to 25 mm long, barely exceeding the internodes, membranaceous; flowers subspreading; pedicels stout, 7 mm long. Sepals suboblong, to 4 cm long, much exceeding the floral bracts, 9 mm wide, ecarinate, thin; petals slightly exceeding the sepals; stamens included. Capsule stout, ellipsoid, to 24 mm long.

description: Plant flowering over 1.5 m high. Leaves many (?), to 34 cm long; sheaths very large, broadly elliptic, castaneous toward base; blades ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, 25-40 mm wide, subrigid, wholly green, glabrous above, covered beneath with minute appressed scales. Inflorescence typically of two racemes; primary bract equaling the sterile base of the raceme; terminal raceme 25 cm long with 2 sterile bracts at base, lateral raceme 16 cm long with a naked sterile base, densely 6-flowered; rhachis slightly flexuous, stout, angled, glabrous. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 40 mm long, 18 mm wide; petals ligulate, 55 mm long; stamens and pistil exserted.

description: Plant flowering scarcely 50 cm high. Leaves many in a crateriform rosette, ca. 50 cm long, thin; sheaths narrowly ovate, 8 cm long, 4 cm wide, purple, inconspicuously lepidote; blades linear, long-acuminate, 2 cm wide, purple beneath, green above. description: Plant stemless, flowering 8 dm high. Leaves 4 dm long, finely and densely brown-lepidote throughout; sheaths elliptic, 16 cm long, very dark castaneous except near apex; blades ligulate, acute, 45 mm wide. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts ovate, acute, slightly exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence bipinnate, 3 dm long, glabrous at least with age; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, about equaling the sterile bases of the branches; branches erect or suberect, very slender, the lateral ones 9 cm long including the abortive apical flower, laxly 3-4-flowered, the terminal 7-flowered, the sterile base short and bearing one or two prophyllae. Floral bracts becoming downwardly secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, acute, carinate, thin, about half as long as the sepals; pedicels obconic, 8 mm long. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 20 mm long; petals unknown. Capsule cylindric, acute, 3 cm long; coma pale brown.

description: Plant flowering 8-10 dm or higher. Leaves many in a broadly funnelform rosette, 4-6 dm long; sheaths distinct, broadly elliptic, covered with minute appressed brown scales; blades ligulate, subacute or rounded and apiculate, 30-45 mm wide, very obscurely lepidote beneath, glabrous above, wholly green. Scape erect, 5 mm or more in diameter; scape-bracts imbricate, elliptic, apiculate, clasping the scape but spreading near apex. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 3-4 dm long; primary bracts broadly ovate, acute, many times shorter than the racemes, red; racemes subspreading, densely 8-14-flowered, naked at base or with a single sterile bract, oblong, acute, strongly compressed, 10-18 cm long, 2-3 cm wide; rhachis nearly straight, slender, glabrous. Floral bracts distichous, imbricate but not always covering the rhachis, broadly elliptic, broadly acute, strongly carinate and incurved, 27-32 mm long, exceeding the sepals, 20-24 mm wide, thin-coriaceous, nerved, slightly lepidote toward apex; flowers never secund; pedicels obconic, stout, 5 mm long. Sepals elliptic, broadly subacute or obtuse, 25 mm long; petals ligulate, obtuse, 3-4 cm long, yellow, bearing 2 oblong obtuse scales at base; stamens and pistil exserted.

description: Plant stemless, 12-50 cm high. Leaves 8-15 in a fasciculate rosette, 22-45 cm long, sometimes exceeding the inflorescence, green, concolorous, sheaths broadly ovate, covered with coarse subappressed ferruginous scales; blades linear, attenuate, ferruginous-lepidote, soon becoming glabrous. Scape erect, very slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect and enfolding the scape, barely or not imbricate and exposing sections of the scape but their caudate apices always exceeding the internodes, very obscurely lepidote. Inflorescence linear, complanate, 4-6(-14) cm long, 10-15 mm wide; rhachis slender, subterete. Floral bracts laxly imbricate and partially exposing the rhachis, broadly elliptic, subacute, 15-20 mm long, much exceeding the sepals, ecarinate, subcoriaceous, nerved when dry, glabrous outside or sparsely lepidote near apex, pale yellow; pedicels very short, broadly obconic. Sepals free, oblong, obliquely subtruncate, 8.5 mm long, ecarinate, thin, nerved, sparsely lepidote; petals oblong, obtuse, 13 mm long, bearing 2 large obtuse entire scales at base; stamens included. Capsules shorter than the floral bracts.

description: Plant flowering about 4 dm high. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts imbricate, acuminate from an ovate base, inflated, pale brown, lepidote toward apex but elsewhere glabrous, nearly even. description: Plant flowering to 1 m high. Leaves many in a funnelform rosette, 4-5 dm long, straight; sheaths large, very broadly elliptic, covered with minute appressed scales, dark castaneous beneath; blades ligulate, acute or rounded, apiculate, 5-8 cm wide, glabrous above, obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath, wholly pale green. Scape erect, short, stout, completely covered by the foliaceous densely imbricate bracts. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, narrow, many-flowered; primary bracts erect, imbricate, more or less red, the lower subfoliaceous and more or less equaling the branches, the upper suborbicular, apiculate, and much shorter than the branches; branches suberect, 6-12-flowered, lax at least toward base, 15-25 cm long, the lower with sterile bracts at base; rhachis geniculate, angled, glabrous. Floral bracts distichous, never secund, very broadly elliptic, strongly carinate and incurved, 25-30 mm long, exceeded by the sepals at anthesis, coriaceous, smooth, red, very obscurely punctulate-lepidote; flowers divergent, never secund; pedicels stout, 3-5 mm long. description: Plant flowering to 5 dm high with the inflorescence extended. Leaves about 15 in a dense subglobose rosette, to 26 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, much wider than the blades, covered with minute appressed brown scales; blades subligulate, acute or rounded and apiculate, distinctly narrowed toward base, flat, 10-25 mm wide, green or tinged with purple-brown, nearly glabrous when dry, the margins with large spreading scales in life. Scape decurved, very slender; scape-bracts erect and clasping the scape, from slightly shorter to slightly longer than the internodes, elliptic, acute. Inflorescence simple, laxly racemose, 3-11-flowered, 3.5-28.5 cm long; rhachis very slender, flexuous. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, about equaling the midpoint of the sepals, not more than 35 mm long or half as wide, the margins meeting only slightly; flowers spreading; pedicels slender, 1-2 cm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 3 cm long, ecarinate; petals ligulate, slightly longer than the sepals; stamens and pistil exserted.

description: Plant flowering 125 cm high (!Schwacke). Leaves 15 or more in a funnelform rosette, 4 dm long, subdensely vestite throughout with minute dark appressed scales; sheaths elliptic, nearly as long as the blades, their lower half dark castaneous; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 45 mm wide, finely purple-spotted. Scape erect, 7 mm in diameter near the middle, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lower subfoliaceous and densely imbricate, the upper broadly ovate, apiculate, about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence bipinnate, 27 cm long, typically of 4 branches; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, shorter than the prophyllate bases of the lateral spikes; spikes subdensely 6-8-flowered, 13-18 cm long, the lateral suberect, the terminal on the end of a scape-like peduncle with several imbricate bracts; rhachis flexuous, 2-3 mm wide, angled. Floral bracts more or less downwardly secund with the flowers especially on the lateral branches, broadly ovate, minutely cucullate, 23 mm long, nearly or quite twice the internodes, equaling about the middle of the sepals, obtusely if at all carinate, coriaceous, even, whitish (! Schwacke), punctulate-lepidote at apex; pedicels obconic, 6 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 27 mm long; petals white (! Schwacke).

description: Plant flowering 7 dm high. Leaves numerous, rosulate, suberect, over 25 cm long, obscurely lepidote; sheaths elliptic, ca 10 cm long, dark castaneous toward base; blades sublingulate, acute, ca 25 mm wide, marked with Fine wavy transverse lines. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts erect, closely involute, exceeding the internodes, ovate, acute. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 13 cm long; axis slender, nearly straight; primary bracts spreading, broadly ovate, acute and apiculate, to 5 cm long; branches aborted; flowers 2 at each node. Floral bracts elliptic, obtuse, ca 1 cm long. Sepals slightly asymmetric, elliptic, obtuse, 20 mm long, fleshy, dark and minutely rugulose when dry; petals elliptic, obtuse, 45 mm long; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering 75 cm high. Leaves rosulate, 80 cm long, covered with appressed cinereous brown-centered scales; sheaths indistinct; blades very narrowly triangular, 4 cm wide. Scape straight, 1 cm in diameter; scape-bracts densely imbricate, broadly elliptic, covered with pale appressed scales, linear-laminate. Inflorescence bipinnate, densely cylindric, 30 cm long, 3 cm in diameter; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but merely apiculate, to 7 cm long, covering all but the highest spikes; spikes lanceolate, complanate, densely 7-flowered, 5 cm long without the naked sterile base, 17 mm wide. Floral bracts ovate, 25 mm long, covering the sepals, ecarinate, chartaceous, nerved, densely pale-lepidote. Sepals ovate, 20 mm long, ecarinate, thin-coriaceous, glabrous except at apex; petals tubular-erect, 5-6 cm long; stamens exserted.

description: Plant flowering 15-18 dm high, propagating by rhizomes to 12 dm long. Leaves 6-9 dm long, sublaxly rosulate; sheaths elliptic, large, covered with minute brown scales; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 4 cm wide, flat, glabrous above, obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, rather slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lower foliaceous, the upper ovate, apiculate, slightly exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence laxly paniculate, glabrous; primary bracts distinctly shorter than the bracteate sterile bases of the branches; branches suberect, nearly 3 dm long, to 17-flowered; rhachis geniculate, angled. Floral bracts becoming secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, acute, to 16 mm long, 1.5 times as long as the internodes, carinate, coriaceous, smooth; pedicels obconic, to 7 mm long. Sepals elliptic, acute, to 26 mm long, green with narrow purple margins; petals elliptic, acute, slightly exceeding the sepals, pale purple, bearing 2 triangular scales at base; stamens included, filaments thickened toward apex.

description: Plant flowering nearly 1 m high, very stout. Leaves 15 to 20 in a cyathiform rosette; blades ligulate, to 4 dm long, 45 mm wide, rounded-apiculate, concolorous, subglabrous, coriaceous and rigid when dry. Scape erect, stout, exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts involute, exceeding the internodes, elliptic, abruptly acute, not at all foliaceous, thick, rigid, rugulose especially toward apex, glabrous, somewhat shiny. Inflorescence simple, rather laxly 11-flowered, subfusiform 18 cm long, 5 cm wide, compressed. Floral bracts erect or suberect, barely imbricate, ovate-elliptic, obtuse, about 42 mm long, much exceeding the sepals, thick and rigid, not at all carinate nor incurved, rugose, slightly shiny; flowers distichous, 48 mm long; pedicels very stout, 7 mm long. Sepals ovate-elliptic, obtuse, 37 mm long, 25 mm wide, stout, coriaceous, striate and very densely punctulate-lepidote; petals very broad, each bearing 2 scales near base.

description: Plant stoloniferous, flowering 40 cm high; stolons 7-15 cm long, densely bracteate. Leaves about 20, densely rosulate, 15 cm long, sheaths ovate, minutely brown-lepidote throughout, within dark purple turning castaneous when dry; blades sublinear, rounded and slightly emarginate with a slender apiculus, 3-4 cm wide, minutely white-lepidote. Scape erect, then abruptly curved just below the inflorescence, much exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts densely imbricate, suborbicular, apiculate, glabrous, red. Inflorescence simple, distichous-flowered, lance-oblong, acute at both ends, about 20-flowered. Floral bracts imbricate and wholly covering the rhachis, suborbicular, inflated, 30 mm long, equaling or slightly shorter than the sepals, red with the yellow apex carinate and incurved; flowers erect before anthesis, later becoming slightly secund; pedicels obscure, 5 mm long. Sepals ovate-oblong, acute, 25-30 mm long, flavous; petals linear, obtuse, 35 mm long, flavous, bearing 2 linear, acute, highly adnate scales; stamens and pistil exserted.

description: Plant flowering 3-6 dm high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, 16-35 cm long, wholly green or tinged or spotted with dark purple; sheaths broadly elliptic, much wider than the blades and up to the same length, covered with minute appressed brown scales; blades arching-recurved, ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 2-4 cm wide, very obscurely punctulate-lepidote. Scape erect or suberect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect and clasping the scape but with spreading or recurved apices, broadly elliptic, apiculate, purple, the upper equaling or shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, subpyramidal, 12-36 cm long; primary bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, 2-4 times shorter than the racemes, red; racemes spreading, laxly 3-7-flowered with a short naked sterile base; rhachis geniculate, very slender. Floral bracts distichous, suborbicular, 10-17 mm long, much exceeded by the sepals, sharply carinate, yellow; flowers spreading, never secund, yellow; pedicels 3 mm long. Sepals narrowly elliptic, broadly rounded, 16-20 mm long, obscurely carinate; petals linear, 3 cm long, bearing 2 lanceolate acuminate scales at base; stamens and pistil exserted. Capsule terete, slender, acuminate, 30-35 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 3 dm high. Leaves to 37 cm long; sheaths elliptic, 1 dm long, covered with minute appressed brown scales, pale brown toward base; blades ligulate, acute, slightly narrowed toward base, flat, to 24 mm wide, very obscurely lepidote, wholly green. Scape straight, short; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, broadly ovate, acute. Inflorescence erect, simple, narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, thick and little compressed, about 20-flowered, 17 cm long, 5 cm wide, nearly glabrous. Floral bracts densely imbricate, suborbicular, apiculate, not incurved, to 42 mm long, inflated, ecarinate or obtusely carinate near apex, rather fleshy and becoming rugose when dry, rose with a yellow-green apex, subpapyraceous when dry; flowers distichous; pedicels slender, 5 mm long. Sepals narrowly elliptic, 24 mm long, nerved; petals narrow, 35-40 mm long, yellow, bearing 2 obtuse scales at base; stamens exserted. Capsule slender, acute, ca 2 cm long.

description: Plant flowering to 14 dm high. Leaves 8 dm long; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, to 68 mm wide. Scape erect, typically stout; scape-bracts imbricate and tightly clasping the scape, broadly elliptic, acute. Inflorescence simple, laxly racemose, many-flowered, to 7 dm long; rhachis geniculate, robust. Floral bracts distichous, spreading at anthesis, broadly ovate with decurved auricles, to 4 cm long, much exceeded by the sepals, not covering the bases of the sepals, convex, ecarinate, fleshy, rigid; flowers not at all secund; pedicels obconic, stout, 10-17 mm long. Sepals broadly subelliptic, obtuse, 25-44 mm long, ecarinate; petals elliptic, obtuse, 56 mm long, bearing 2 narrowly triangular scales at base; stamens included, filaments stout but not enlarged toward summit. Capsule stout, beaked, to 6 cm long.

description: Plant flowering 5-8 dm high. Leaves few in a sublax funnelform rosette, 50-65 cm long, wholly green; sheaths broadly ovate, 8-12 cm long; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 2-3 cm wide, subglabrous. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts clasping and covering the scape, subelliptic, subtruncate and apiculate. Inflorescence simple, laxly 12-18-flowered, to 25 cm long; rhachis straight, the internodes 10-15 mm long. Floral bracts distichous, spreading at anthesis and exposing the rhachis, suboblong, widest near apex, subtruncate and apiculate, to 55 mm long, slightly exceeding and enfolding the sepals, recurved toward apex, ecarinate, subpapyraceous, the margins strongly undulate; flowers not secund; pedicels obconic, to 10 mm long. Sepals elliptic, acute, 44 mm long, obtusely carinate; petals ligulate, to 53 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 6 dm high. Leaves erect, 38 cm long, covered with minute gray closely appressed scales; sheaths triangular-ovate, 6-8 cm long, dark castaneous; blades linear-triangular, 2 cm wide, green. Scape curved, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect and closely enfolding the scape, imbricate, elliptic, apiculate, red, lepidote, thin. Inflorescence few-branched, digitate, 38 cm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, 4 cm long, much shorter than the densely bracteate sterile bases of the branches; branches suberect, flexuous, slender, shallowly excavated next the flowers. Floral bracts erect, slightly longer than the internodes and exposing much of the rhachis, exceeding the sepals, 27 mm long, ecarinate, the apex nerved and densely pale-lepidote, elsewhere even and glabrous, subcoriaceous. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 18 mm long, ecarinate; petals much exceeding the sepals, dark violet, bearing 2 large oblong scales at base; stamens exserted (?).

description: Plant flowering less than 3 dm high. Leaves numerous in a dense rosette, 10-11 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, sometimes as long as the blade and always much wider, brown-punctulate, lepidote, deep castaneous near base, brown-spotted near apex; blades ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, 15-20 mm wide, flat and coiled-recurving, glabrous above, beneath obscurely punctulate-lepidote and coarsely and densely maroon-spotted. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, closely enfolding the scape, elliptic, acute. Inflorescence simple, lax, 5-flowered in the type, glabrous; rhachis nearly straight, ca 6 cm long. Floral bracts partly erect, partly secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, acute, to 18 mm long, equalling or slightly exceeding the internodes, convex, ecarinate, even; flowers secund, spreading; pedicels slenderly obconic, 1 cm long. Sepals narrowly elliptic, 18 mm long, much exceeding the floral bracts, convex, ecarinate; petals, stamens and pistil not known.

description: Plant flowering 7-8 dm high. Leaves in a funnelform rosette, nearly 6 dm long; sheaths elliptic, over 10 cm long, green except for the dark castaneous base, diffusely and finely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, acute, apiculate, 3-4 cm wide, flat, green, concolorous, glabrous above, minutely and obscurely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, 1 cm in diameter; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, foliaceous or subfoliaceous. Inflorescence simple, very dense, oblong-elliptic, complanate, 8-14 cm long; rhachis straight, sulcate; internodes 6 mm long or less. Floral bracts (juvenile) very broadly ovate, subacute and apiculate, 35 mm long, slightly carinate toward apex, thin, strongly rugose, pale green, diffusely brown-lepidote; flowers not at all secund; pedicels 3-4 mm long, strongly angled. Sepals broadly oblong-elliptic, slightly asymmetric, truncate or slightly retuse, 18 mm long, carinate toward base, subcoriaceous, castaneous, glabrous. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, 35 mm long; coma of the seeds bright red-brown.

description: Plant flowering 9-12 dm high. Leaves numerous in a dense crateriforme rosette, 1-5 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 10-15 cm long, dark brownish purple toward base, densely brown-punctulate-lepidote on both sides; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, ca 25 mm wide at base, more or less blotched with red, glabrous above, obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lowest subfoliaceous and imbricate, the others elliptic, apiculate, much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence erect, simple, laxly 8-11-flowered, 1-2 dm long, glabrous; axis slender, slightly geniculate, angled. Floral bracts remaining erect, broadly ovate, acute ca 25 mm long, barely exceeding the internodes, much exceeded by the sepals, convex, obtusely carinate, subcoriaceous, faintly nerved, dark purple; flowers strongly secund, spreading; pedicels thick-cylindric, 1 cm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 25-28 mm long, ecarinate, even, yellow except for the brownish base; petals oblong, obtuse, over 4 cm long, bearing 2 lobed scales at base; stamens included, filaments thickened toward apex, conglutinated. Capsule cylindric, acute, 5 cm long, seeds with a reddish brown coma.

description: Plant flowering 5-14 dm high. Leaves many, arched-spreading, 4-6(-9) dm long, minutely lepidote on both sides; sheaths broadly elliptic, relatively short, usually almost wholly dark-castaneous; blades ligulate, broadly acute or rounded, apiculate, 35-65 mm wide, with irregular cross-lines by transmitted light. Scape erect, 7-10 dm long, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper broadly elliptic, apiculate, green or red. Inflorescence simple, usually many-flowered, lax, linear, 15-40 cm long, glabrous; rhachis straight or flexuous, usually rather stout, sulcate. Floral bracts broadly ovate with decurrent auricles, 25-35 (-45) mm long, usually about equaling the middle of the sepals, ecarinate, inflated, coriaceous, faintly nerved or even, red or dark green, rarely with dark margins; flowers reflexed at anthesis; pedicels stout, 7-15 mm long. Sepals narrowly elliptic, 25-30 mm long, ecarinate, yellowish; petals 30-45 mm long, broadly oblong, obtuse, greenish, bearing 2 obovate scales at base; stamens included; filaments much enlarged toward apex. Capsule stout, acute, 3-5 cm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 5-10 dm high. Leaves 4-6 dm long; sheaths elliptic, densely brown-punctulate-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate to acuminate, 3-4 cm wide, flat, soon glabrous above, very obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath. Scape erect or ascending, stout; scape-bracts erect, exceeding the internodes, the lower foliaceous, the upper elliptic, acute or apiculate, rigidly coraceous, subinflated. Inflorescence simple secundly 12-20-flowered, dense, 15-20 cm long; rhachis stout, angled, geniculate. Floral bracts secund with the flowers, very broadly ovate, obtuse and minutely cucullate, usually appearing acute by the inrolling of the margins, 30-35 mm long, exceeding the sepals, 2-3 times as long as the internodes, coriaceous, even, bronze-green when fresh, drying to deep castaneous with a narrow pale margin, glabrous, lustrous; flowers subspreading; pedicels stout, 7-10 mm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 17-27 mm long, coriaceous, dark brown, glabrous; petals broadly ligulate, 25-40 mm long, pale green; stamens and pistil included. Capsule stout, short-beaked, 3 cm long, seeds with a usually reddish coma.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 35 cm high. Leaves densely utriculate-rosulate; sheaths ovate, ample, densely brown-lepidote, chartaceous, pale brown beneath, pale green above; blades curved-spreading, ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 26 cm long, 30 mm wide, channeled, sparsely and obscurely lepidote, green with some purple spots beneath, bearing Fine irregular transverse lines. Scape slightly curved, 4 mm in diameter, red punctulate; scape-bracts imbricate and enfolding the scape, elliptic with a soft triangular apex, the lower green, the upper red with green apex, lepidote, 4 cm long. Inflorescence simple to 4-branched; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, much shorter than the branches; branches 6-8-flowered with 1-5 imbricate sterile bracts at base, oblong, strongly complanate; rhachis geniculate, glabrous, red. Floral bracts distichous, imbricate and almost completely covering the rhachis, broadly ovate, 35 mm long, slightly exceeding the sepals, sharply carinate, incurved toward apex, nerved, bright red with flavous apex and margins; flowers sessile, 60 mm long. Sepals ovate-elliptic, obtuse, 27 mm long, 10 mm wide, carinate; petals obtuse, emarginate, yellow with green apex, bearing 2 serrulate scales; stamens exserted. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, acute, ca 25 mm long.
