description: Plant lacking rhizomes, flowering 1-3 m high. Leaves very many in a dense spreading rosette, 5-8 dm long; sheaths elliptic, distinctly wider than the blades, dark purple toward apex, diffusely and minutely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly rounded, apiculate, 5-8 cm wide, usually green except for the dark purple apex, obscurely lepidote. Scape erect, stout, much shorter than the leaves; scape-bracts densely imbricate, divergent, foliaceous, the upper bright red. Inflorescence very laxly paniculate, much branched, nearly glabrous; primary bracts much shorter than the branches, the lower subfoliaceous, ample, the upper ovate, apiculate; branches suberect, lax, to 5 dm long, the lower divided and bearing sterile bracts at base; rhachis slender, flexuous. Floral bracts downwardly secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, acute, about equaling the middle of the sepals, straight, ecarinate, membranaceous, red; pedicels 5-10 mm long. Sepals lanceolate or elliptic, broadly acute, to 25 mm long, ecarinate, yellow; petals linear, acute, 35-45 mm long, greenish toward apex, bearing 2 acute scales at base; stamens exserted. Capsule slender, slightly exceeding the sepals.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high (base unknown). Leaves presumably rosulate, to 63 cm long, obsucrely punctulate-lepidote throughout; sheaths elliptic, 15 cm long, somewhat darkened apically; blades ligulate, attenuate, to 55 mm wide. Scape erect, ca 1 cm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts densely imbricate, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper ovate, attenuate. Inflorescence bipinnate with ca 16 branches; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, erect and imbricate; racemes spreading from a suberect bracteate sterile base, the fertile part to 13 cm long, densely 15-flowered; rhachis geniculate, quadrangular, 2 mm wide. Floral bracts imbricate, more or less downwardly secund with the flowers, ovate, acute, 23 mm long, subcoriaceous, even, glabrous, red (! E. Pereira), drying to castaneous; pedicels 3 mm long, rather slender. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acute, 28 mm long, the posterior ones with basal keels decurrent on the pedicel; petals ca 35 mm long, about equaling the stamens.

description: Plant flowering to 8 dm high. Leaves 4-5 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 10-14 cm long, covered with minute appressed brown scales; blades ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, about 45 mm wide, very indistinctly lepidote. Scape erect, 1 cm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper broadly ovate with a subtriangular apex, punctulate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 3 dm long; primary bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, about equaling the sterile erect naked bases of the branches; branches arched-spreading, to 13 cm long, 8-flowered; rhachis geniculate, angled, slender. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, 25 mm long, erect, slightly if at all secund, 3 times as long as the internodes but not wholly covering the rhachis, carinate, incurved toward apex, subcoriaceous, smooth or slightly nerved, yellow-brown when dry; flowers downwardly secund; pedicels stout, angled, 5-6 mm long. Sepals oblong, broadly acute or rounded, 20 mm long, 5 mm wide, carinate.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves ca 5 dm long; blades ligulate, acuminate, over 3 cm broad, concolorous, sparsely brown-punctulate-lepidote on both sides. Scape erect, 8 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts all shorter than the internodes, broadly ovate, acute, closely enfolding the scape, brown-punctulate, even. Inflorescence simple, densely many-flowered, 6 dm long; rhachis flexuous, faintly angled, glabrous. Floral bracts becoming secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, acute, minutely cucullate, to 32 mm long, more than twice as long as the internodes, obtusely carinate, coriaceous, faintly nerved when dry, green, brown-punctulate; flowers secund-spreading; pedicels stout, ca 1 cm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, acute, 23 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous; petals narrowly elliptic, obtuse or emarginate, 28 mm long, bearing 2 large acute scales at base, greenish yellow when dry; stamens included, filaments slightly thickened toward apex.

description: Plant stemless. Leaves 15 in an obconical rosette, ca 20 cm long, thin; sheaths ovate, 5 cm long, 4 cm wide, green; blade linear, attenuate to a narrow apex, ca 14 cm long, 2 cm wide, reflexed. Scape erect, green, 23 cm long, exceeding the leaves, 3 mm thick; scape-bracts imbricate, lanceolate, 3 cm long, green, minutely lepidote beneath, the lowest spreading, short-acuminate, the others acute, appressed. Inflorescence simple, lax, 10 cm long, 3.5 cm wide, 7-flowered with the terminal one sterile; rhachis slightly geniculate, reddish. Floral bracts ovate, acute, slightly incurved, 4 cm long, carinate toward apex, minutely pale-lepidote inside, glabrous outside; flowers erect, not at all secund, 4 cm long, at least twice the internodes; pedicels 3-5 mm long, stout. Sepals free, linear, obtuse, 32 mm long, exserted, 8 mm wide, yellow, minutely pale-lepidote inside, glabrous outside; petals connate for 5 mm at base, linear, obtusely emarginate, 30 mm long, 8 mm wide, pale yellow, reflexed at anthesis, biligulate at base; anthers linear, 4 mm long; ovary pyramidal, 5 mm long.

description: Plant flowering slightly over 3 dm high. Leaves 4 dm long; sheaths inconspicuous; blades subligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, 25 mm wide, concolorous. Scape erect; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, the upper ovate, acute. Inflorescence simple, typically 6-flowered, very lax, 17 cm long, 2 cm wide. Floral bracts distichous, 25 mm distant, erect with the flowers appressed to the slightly flexuous rhachis, very broadly ovate, neither carinate nor incurved, to 45 mm long, equaling the sepals and completely enfolding them, strongly nerved; flowers about 55 mm long; pedicels very short. Sepals oblong, rounded, asymmetric, 35 mm long, carinate, coriaceous, strongly nerved.

description: Plant flowering 1 m or higher. Leaves 1 m long; sheaths inconspicuous, dark toward base; blades ligulate, broadly rounded with a narrowly triangular apiculus, 11 cm wide, marked with dark flexuous transverse lines, minutely lepidote. Scape stout; scape-bracts unknown. Inflorescence amply bipinnate, many-flowered, over 5 dm long; primary bracts suborbicular with short narrowly triangular recurved blades, about half as long as the sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading, densely 12-20-flowered, to 33 cm long, the long sterile base bearing a single bract at the middle; rhachis stout, nearly straight. Floral bracts distichous, spreading, not secund with the flowers, very broadly ovate or suborbicular, minutely apiculate, 27 mm long, 29 mm wide, exceeded by the sepals, inflated, green, pale brown when dry; flowers spreading, secund, yellow; pedicels 10 mm long, stout. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, to 28 mm long, ecarinate; petals broadly ligulate, 35 mm long, bearing 2 ovate-triangular acuminate scales; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering 6-8 dm high, very slender. Leaves many, 3-4 dm long, pale purple beneath; sheaths short and much wider than the blades, obscurely lepidote; blades linear, abruptly acute and apiculate, to 13 mm wide, green and glabrous above, obscurely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, barely 4 mm in diameter, glabrous, green except the dark nodes; scape-bracts erect, the lower foliaceous and densely imbricate, the upper lanceolate, apiculate, about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence simple, lax, to 11 cm long; rhachis very slender, geniculate. Floral bracts ovate, obtuse, 10-15 mm long, barely equaling the middle of the sepals, about equaling the internodes, ecarinate, thin, green, obscurely lepidote; flowers distichous, not secund, divergent, subsessile. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 16 mm long, green; petals elliptic, obtuse, 20 mm long, short-connate, bearing 2 large acute scales, opening for only a few hours at night; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering slightly over 4 dm high with the inflorescence extended. Leaves 35-40 cm long, spotted with dark purple; sheaths large, broadly elliptic; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 5 cm wide, pale-lepidote beneath. Scape decurved; scape-bracts densely imbricate, broadly elliptic, acute. Inflorescence simple, densely many-flowered, 10-35 cm long, to 75 mm wide, thick. Floral bracts densely imbricate, suborbicular, strongly inflated, 35 mm long, to 50 mm wide, equaling the sepals, neither carinate nor incurved, white-farinaceous toward base; flowers distichous, not secund, suberect to spreading, yellow; pedicels short, very stout. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 29 mm long, farinaceous toward base; petals ligulate, 5 cm long, bearing 2 scales; stamens exserted.

description: Plant caulescent, 80 cm high without the inflorescence. Leaves densely rosulate, 80 cm long; sheaths indistinct, densely and minutely brown-lepidote, castaneous beneath; blades sublinear, attenuate and acuminate at apex, 6 cm wide, densely nerved, green, densely and minutely pale-lepidote beneath, subglabrous above. Scape 70 cm long, 12-20 mm thick, the internodes 3-4 cm long; scape-bracts 3 or more times as long as the internodes, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, appressed, densely white-lepidote throughout. Inflorescence laxly pyramidal, bipinnate, 90 cm long, 15-17-branched; axis 12 mm thick; primary bracts erect, lanceolate, green, densely white-lepidote beneath, shorter than the sterile bases of the branches, the lower acuminate, 9 cm long, the upper acute, 2.5 cm long; branches spreading, 30-40 cm long, 2-3 mm thick, distichously ca 13-flowered; sterile basal bracts bicarinate. Floral bracts obovate, obtuse, 30 mm long, equaling or shorter than the sepals, carinate, green, glabrous outside, minutely lepidote inside; pedicels stout, 5-6 mm long; flowers spreading, 40 mm long. Sepals narrowly spatulate, subobtuse, 30 mm long, green, minutely lepidote within; petals linear, slightly dilated toward apex, 35 mm long, biligulate above base, the scales linear, 6 mm long, denticulate at base; stamens included; ovary 5 mm long; ovules long-caudate.

description: Plant flowering 25 cm or slightly higher. Leaves many in a funnelform rosette, ca 2 dm long, wholly green; sheaths broadly ovate; blades ligulate, broadly acute or rounded, apiculate, sparsely lepidote beneath. Scape short, stout, much exceeded by the leaves; scape-bracts imbricate, ovate or elliptic, acute, green or slightly reddish. Inflorescence simple, densely 12-flowered, to 11 cm long, 35-60 mm wide, oblong or subelliptic, strongly compressed, equaling or slightly exceeding the leaves; rhachis stout, the internodes very short. Floral bracts distichous, very densely imbricate with the upper ones wholly covering the rhachis, ovate, acute, carinate and slightly incurved toward apex, 4 cm long, equaling or slightly exceeding the sepals, glabrous, red except for the green apex; flowers not at all secund, short-pedicellate. Sepals lance-ovate, acute, carinate, to 3 cm long, yellow; petals ligulate, obtuse, ca 5 cm long, yellow, bearing 2 lanceolate acuminate scales at base; stamens and pistil exserted. Capsule terete, stout, acuminate, slightly exceeding the sepals.

description: Leaves unknown. Scape nearly 2 dm long, slender; scape-bracts much shorter than the internodes, broadly elliptic, apiculate, subinflated, tubular-erect. Inflorescence paniculate, subcorymbose, very dense, 45 mm long and wide, few-flowered; primary bracts forming an involucre below the inflorescence; branches very short. Floral bracts distichous, nearly orbicular, obtuse, 14 mm in diameter, much shorter than the sepals and clasping their bases, coriaceous; flowers erect; pedicels thick, 6 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 22 mm long, 9 mm wide, coriaceous; petals ligulate, ca 3 cm long, exceeding the stamens, each bearing a single (! Mez) large suborbicular entire scale.

description: Plant stemless, non-stoloniferous, flowering 40 cm high. Leaves many, densely rosulate, 30-35 cm long; sheaths ovate, not constricted but merging with the blade, greenish, minutely punctate-lepidote throughout; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 20 cm long, 4 cm wide, pale green and obscurely punctate on both sides. Scape erect or slightly curved, equaling or slightly shorter than the leaves; scape-bracts ovate-apiculate, slightly exceeding the internodes, 20 mm long, 15 mm wide, glabrous, green. Inflorescence simple, distichous-flowered, oblong, rounded at apex, 13 cm long, 5 cm wide, about 15-flowered. Floral bracts divergent and lax at base, imbricate above, lance-ovate, incurved and sharply carinate toward apex, 35 mm long, 20 mm wide, equaling or slightly exceeding the sepals, glabrous, reddish-flavous with green apex; flowers short-pedicellate, erect before anthesis, then slightly secund. Sepals lanceolate, 30 mm long, 10 mm wide, sharply carinate, glabrous, hyaline, pale flavous; petals linear, obtuse, 45 mm long, 7 mm wide, hyaline, pale flavous, bearing 2 linear, acute, highly adnate scales; stamens and pistil exserted.

description: Plant subacaulescent, flowering 4-6 dm high. Leaves many, very densely rosulate; sheaths broadly elliptic, large; blades ligulate, subacute and apiculate, 40-58 cm long, 4 cm wide, subcoriaceous, glabrous. Scape central, erect, 6-7 dm high, 10 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper narrowly ovate, acute. Inflorescence simple, densely and distichously 13-17-flowered; floral bracts very broadly ovate, acute or obtuse, ecarinate, inflated, to 30 mm long, 35 mm wide, twice as long as the sepals, subcoriaceous, faintly nerved when dry; flowers reflexed at anthesis. description: Plant short-caulescent, reproducing vegetatively by basal offsets, flowering 55 cm high. Leaves many in a funnelform rosette, 3 dm long, minutely brown-lepidote throughout; sheaths subelliptic, 7 cm long, dark castaneous with pale margins and apex; blades narrowly triangular, 2-3 cm wide, flat. Scape erect, 4 mm in diameter at apex, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper broadly elliptic, long-attenuate. Inflorescence known only from a single old specimen, cylindric, laxly bipinnate, 15 cm long, glabrous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, erect to spreading, exceeding the flowers; branches completely aborted with 2 flowers fasciculate in the axil of each primary bract. Floral bracts incompletely known but evidently broad and about equaling the 7 mm long spreading pedicels. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 17 mm long, coriaceous, even.

description: Plant stemless, flowering to 6 dm long with the inflorescence extended. Leaves numerous, 5-6 dm long, completely covered with fine appressed cinereous scales; sheaths suborbicular, scarcely distinct from the blades, 45 mm wide, ferruginous; blades very narrowly triangular, 35 mm wide at base. Scape decurved, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts densely imbricate and completely covering the scape, subfoliaceous with long linear blades. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, 37 cm long; primary bracts broadly ovate, barely exceeding the sterile bracteate bases of the branches, subdensely and obscurely lepidote; spikes erect or suberect, the lateral to 14 cm long, the terminal to 18 cm including the sterile base, linear-lanceolate, acute, strongly complanate, 10-12-flowered, dense, glabrous; rhachis alate. Floral bracts lanceolate, acute, carinate, 25 mm long, about equaling the sepals, subcoriaceous, nerved and reddish toward apex, yellowish green below; pedicels obscure. Sepals free, lanceolate, broadly acute and apiculate, 23 mm long, ecarinate, subcoriaceous; petals linear, 35 mm long, bearing 2 large linear-lanceolate acute scales at base, the blades deep blue-violet with a narrow white margin; stamens exserted.

description: Plant flowering 25 cm high with the inflorescence extended. Inflorescence simple, dense, broadly elliptic, strongly compressed, about 12-flowered, 13 cm long, 5.5 cm wide. Floral bracts suberect, very densely imbricate, suboblong, acute, 50-55 mm long, incurved and sharply carinate toward apex, exceeding the sepals, red with a green or yellow apex; pedicels short, stout. description: Plant stemless, 8 dm long with the inflorescence extended. Leaves about 15, subfasciculate, to 65 cm long, green, concolorous, obscurely pale-lepidote; sheaths elliptic, 12 cm long; blades ligulate, acuminate, 25 mm wide. Scape decurved, very slender; scape-bracts imbricate and tightly enfolding the scape, thin, stramineous when dry, verrucose. Inflorescence simple, linear, complanate, 18 cm long, densely 12-flowered. Floral bracts ovate, over 3 cm long, much exceeding the sepals, ecarinate, stramineous when dry, densely verrucose; flowers erect, not secund; pedicels stout, 5 mm long. Sepals ovate, over 18 mm long, ecarinate, nearly even except the rugose-verrucose margins. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, beaked, 4 cm long; coma white.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 4-5 dm high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, suberect, 2-4 dm long; sheaths very broadly elliptic-ovate, about 8 cm long, very dark castaneous, densely but not completely covered with fine white immersed scales; blades ligulate, acute, 20-35 mm wide, subfenestrate with fine brownish-purple lines especially toward the base, vinaceous toward the apex, chartaceous when dry, subglabrous. Scape erect, stout, equaling or exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate, foliaceous. Inflorescence few-flowered, densely capitate or short-cylindric, 5-9 cm long; primary bracts spreading, reflexed toward the apex, broadly lance-ovate, acuminate, much exceeding the axillary flowers, very obscurely punctulate-lepidote; branches almost wholly aborted. Floral bracts broadly elliptic or suborbicular, to 25 mm long, exceeding and enfolding the flowers, carinate, subchartaceous; flowers 2 in each axil, subsessile. Sepals very broadly elliptic, obtuse, to 14 mm long and 10 mm wide, coriaceous, thick, obscurely punctulate; petals 22 mm long, 7 mm wide, bearing 2 triangular acuminate scales at the base.

description: Plant stemless, to 4 dm high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, erect, cross-barred with broad brownish-purple stripes, 3 dm long; sheaths very broadly ovate, castaneous, densely covered with brown immersed punctiform scales; blades subligulate, obtuse and apiculate, 33 mm wide, revolute toward the apex, rigid when dry, obscurely punctulate-lepidote. Scape erect, stout, slightly exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts short, exceeding the internodes, broadly ovate, triangular-acute, subinflated, deflexed from about the middle. Inflorescence short-cylindric, 9 cm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, erect with reflexed blades, imbricate, polystichous, exceeding the axillary flowers, obscurely brown-punctulate-lepidote; branches almost wholly aborted. Floral bracts very broadly reniform, truncate, 6 mm long and more than twice as wide, much shorter than the sepals, ecarinate, enfolding the base of the flower, coriaceous; flowers 2 or 3 in each axil, collateral. Sepals very broadly elliptic, obtuse, 12 mm long, coriaceous, thick, even, glabrous.

description: Plant flowering 1-2 m high. Leaves many in a funnelform rosette, 4-10 dm long, straight, rigid; sheaths elliptic or suboblong, slightly wider than the blades and not very distinct, covered with minute appressed dark brown scales; blades narrowly subtriangular, acute or attenuate, 5-8 cm wide, flat, green, densely pale-lepidote beneath, less so above. Scape erect, 7-13 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, long-acuminate from a broadly elliptic base, the upper reddish. Inflorescence large, laxly paniculate, 2-3-pinnate, glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, usually a little shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches divergent, straight, 25-45 cm long, bearing 1-3 sterile bracts at base; racemes 6-15-flowered; rhachis slender, slightly flexuous, angled. Floral bracts laxly distichous, erect and imbricate before anthesis then divergent and enfolding the sepals, elliptic, broadly acute, to 35 mm long, slightly exceeded by the sepals, coriaceous, slightly carinate toward apex, green or reddish, smooth or slightly nerved on the margins; flowers not secund; pedicels to 7 mm long. Sepals narrowly elliptic, acute, ecarinate, to 29 mm long; petals ligulate, 5-10 mm longer than the sepals, bearing 2 acute scales; stamens and style exserted. Capsule fusiform, 3 cm long; coma red-brown.

description: Plant flowering to 7 dm high. Leaves ca 3 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 14 cm long, pale; blades ligulate, subrounded, glabrous, concolorous, green, reddish purple toward base. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts densely imbricate, elliptic-triangular. Inflorescence paniculate, rather many-flowered; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, shorter than the sterile bracteate bases of the branches; branches erect or suberect, ca 13 cm long, laxly flowered. Floral bracts distichous, not at all secund, remote and not imbricate at anthesis, ovate-elliptic, broadly acute, to 35 mm long, about equaling the sepals, slightly carinate toward the straight apex, red; flowers suberect, ca 45 mm long; pedicels distinct but short and stout. Sepals narrowly elliptic, acute, scarcely carinate; petals ligulate, bearing 2 scales. Capsule fusiform, 3 cm long.

description: Plant flowering 8 dm high. Leaves many in a funnelform rosette, 5 dm long, pale green marked with irregular transverse dark green lines; sheaths ample, dark castaneous toward base; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, to 95 mm wide, soon glabrous. Scape short, nearly hidden by the leaves, stout; scape-bracts equaling or slightly exceeding the internodes, the upper ones broadly ovate, subacute. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, about 8-branched, many-flowered, 4-6 dm long, 3 dm in diameter; primary bracts broadly ovate, acute, shorter than the sterile bases of the branches, pale yellow; racemes suberect, subequal, to 26 cm long, subdensely 10-20-flowered, the sterile base with 2 bracts. Floral bracts more or less secund with the flowers and enfolding their bases, broadly subelliptic, 2-3 cm long, obtuse, much exceeded by the sepals, convex, ecarinate, coriaceous, rose or brown; flowers divergent, secund; pedicels stout, to 10 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 3 cm long, coriaceous, pale yellow; petals ligulate, 45 mm long, greenish yellow, bearing 2 ovate scales; stamens included; filaments attenuate. Capsule fusiform, 4 cm long.

description: Plant flowering to 13 dm high. Leaves many, suberect, 6 dm long, obscurely lepidote, the outer soon disintegrating; sheaths 2 dm long, dark castaneous toward base; blades subligulate, 4 cm wide, narrowly rounded, apiculate. Scape erect, 8 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts foliaceous or subfoliaceous, large, densely imbricate. Inflorescence compound, lax, 3 dm long, glabrous; primary bracts much shorter than the racemes, broadly ovate or suborbicular; racemes spreading, densely 10-flowered, 10 cm long including the naked sterile base; rhachis slender, geniculate, angled. Floral bracts erect, 4 times as long as the internodes but not covering the rhachis, elliptic, broadly acute, 26 mm long, slightly exceeding the sepals, carinate, slightly incurved toward apex, coriaceous, nearly smooth, yellow-brown when dry; flowers distichous; pedicels short, stout. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 22 mm long, carinate.

description: Plant flowering 2-3 dm high. Leaves 2-3 dm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, much broader than the blades, minutely brown-lepidote, purple toward apex; blades ligulate, acute and apiculate, 15-25 mm wide, wholly green, very obscurely lepidote. Scape erect slender; scape-bracts densely imbricate, broadly elliptic, apiculate, subinflated, membranaceous, rose. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered, lanceolate or oblong, strongly compressed, 6-12 cm long, 3-4 cm wide; rhachis geniculate, slender, the internodes 8-13 mm long. Floral bracts distichous broadly elliptic, acute, 3-4 cm long, 24 mm or wider, exceeded by the sepals especially the lower ones, enfolding the sepals and exposing the rhachis, carinate, incurved, membranaceous, yellow and rose, glabrous; flowers imbricate, suberect; pedicels to 6 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, to 34 mm long; petal-blades 10 mm long; stamens exserted.

description: Plant stemless, flowering to 57 cm high. Leaves fasciculate-rosulate, 6 dm long, subdensely vestite on both sides with minute brown scales; sheaths ovate, 7 cm long, dark castaneous on the extreme base, green elsewhere; blades very narrowly triangular, filiform-attenuate, 12 mm wide at base. Scape erect, very slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect and enfolding the scape, elliptic, chartaceous, nerved, dark purple, the highest imbricate, the others shorter than the internodes but their filiform blades much exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence simple, erect, subdense. Floral bracts more or less secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, acute, chartaceous, nerved, dark purple, broadly convex, not at all carinate, glabrous outside, inside pale-lepidote; pedicels stout, 4 mm long (juvenile). Sepals lanceolate, rounded and apiculate, slightly asymmetric, 27 mm long, chartaceous, the apex outside and all the inside lepidote; petals (juvenile) incompletely known, green.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 3 dm high with the inflorescence erected. Leaves about 20 in a spreading rosette, 14 cm long, regularly longitudinally red-striped especially toward base, covered on both sides with pale appressed scales; sheath elliptic, distinct, 6 cm long; blade ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, 25 mm wide, flat. Scape very slender, sigmoid, spreading and then ascending at anthesis, becoming erect in fruit; scape-bracts very tightly enfolding the scape, barely imbricate or the upper shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, rather dense, 6-9-flowered. Floral bracts secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, acute, much exceeded by the sepals, even, ecarinate; flowers short-pedicellate, suberect-secund. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 19 mm long, thin-coriaceous, ecarinate, smooth; petals ligulate, obtuse, 30-35 mm long, bearing two coarsely dentate scales at base; stamens included, the filaments evenly linear throughout.

description: Plant flowering to 8 dm high but usually less. Leaves to 3 dm long, dark red below or the sheaths green with red spots, green or green with red spots above; blades 4-5 cm wide, ligulate, acute. Scape erect, about equaling the leaves; scape-bracts imbricate, the lower ones produced into a short spreading blade, the upper ones abruptly acute. Inflorescence simple, cylindric, to 17 cm long, densely 10-24-flowered. Floral bracts very broadly ovate, obtuse, 25 mm long, 28 mm wide, shorter than the sepals, not at all carinate, red-brown or pale green with a dark-green border; flowers erect, imbricate, 7-8 cm long; pedicels very short and stout. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 27-32 mm long, nearly even, drying rugose, dark-punctate, green; petals linear, greenish-white, each bearing 2 spatulate incised scales at the base, exceeding the stamens; pistil exceeding the stamens; ovules very minutely caudiculate. Coma white.

description: Plant flowering 1.4 m high. Leaves to 66 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, scarcely distinct, brown, covered on both sides with pale brown-centered scales; blades ligulate, acute, 9 cm wide, minutely punctate-lepidote on both sides. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts erect, subfoliaceous, very densely imbricate and wholly covering the scape. Inflorescence cylindric, densely bipinnate, 4 dm long, 8 cm in diameter, glabrous outside; primary bracts suberect, broadly ovate, apiculate, slightly shorter than the spikes, red; spikes sessile, broadly ovate, 8 cm long, 5-flowered, strongly complanate. Floral bracts densely imbricate, ovate, 5 cm long, exceeding the sepals, carinate, coriaceous, yellow except the red apex; pedicels stout, 5 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 33 mm long, subcoriaceous, strongly carinate, glabrous outside, inside subdensely dark-lepidote; petals 55 mm long, bearing 2 acute scales; stamens barely included.

description: Plant stemless, flowering over 1 m high. Leaves 4-6 dm long, finely and regularly red-striped, obscurely punctate-lepidote; sheaths elliptic, ca 15 cm long, brownish; blades ligulate, broadly subacute and apiculate, 5 cm wide. Scape erect, 1 cm in diameter, red; scape-bracts erect, the upper about equaling the internodes, broadly ovate, apiculate, red. Inflorescence slenderly thyrsoid, 35 cm long, 6 cm wide, dense toward apex, interrupted below, nearly glabrous; axis straight, slender, primary bracts very broadly ovate, apiculate, about half as long as the branches and equaling the lower spikes, punctate toward apex; branches divergent, mostly of 3 subfasciculate spikes with the 2 basal much smaller than the terminal; spikes broadly ovate, strongly complanate, 2-3 cm long, subdensely few-flowered; rhachis geniculate, angled, almost wholly exposed. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, to 20 mm long, exceeding the sepals, sharply carinate, coriaceous, nerved, green; flowers subsessile. Sepals free, elliptic, acute, 13 mm long, coriaceous, nerved, the posterior carinate; petals 4 mm longer than the sepals, pale yellow, bearing 2 scales at base; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering 85 cm high. Leaves to 3 dm long, densely punctulate-lepidote on both sides; sheaths elliptic, slightly wider than the blades, brown; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 48 mm wide, densely marked with small brown-purple spots. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts tubular-erect, elliptic, apiculate, recurved at apex, the upper shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, few-flowered, 2 dm long, 3 cm in diameter, wholly castaneous when dry, glabrous; primary bracts broadly ovate, 3 times shorter than the branches; branches erect, to 5-flowered almost to base, lax, without sterile bracts. Floral bracts distichous, very broadly ovate, 15 mm long, much exceeded by the sepals, carinate, subinflated, slightly if at all incurved; flowers not at all secund, suberect, very short-pedicellate. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 21 mm long, 10 mm wide; petals pale yellow, bearing 2 scales.

description: Plant flowering to 7 dm high, very stout. Leaves 45 cm long, 35 mm wide, abruptly acute, green with irregular violet spots, rigid, subglabrous at maturity. Scape erect, stout, glabrous, slightly exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts imbricate, elliptic, abrupdy acute, rigid, shiny. Inflorescence simple, laxly about 10-flowered, 18 cm long. Floral bracts becoming secund with the flowers, very broadly ovate, obtuse, 42 mm long, inflated-convex, not at all carinate, very thick and rigid, punctulate-lepidote with immersed scales; pedicels very stout. Sepals very broadly elliptic, obtuse, 26 mm long, 20 mm wide, very thick, even except for the finely striate apex.

description: Plant flowering probably more than 5 dm high. Leaves 6 dm long, 4 cm wide, concolorous, green, acute, densely covered especially toward the base and dorsally with minute pale appressed scales. Scape very stout, apparently much shorter than the leaves; scape-bracts densely imbricate and concealing the scape, broadly elliptic, very thick, coriaceous, castaneous when dry, shining, the lower produced into short mucroniform blades, the upper abruptly acute. Inflorescence simple, 12-flowered, lanceolate in outline, acute at both ends, 20 cm long, 45 mm wide, strongly compressed. Floral bracts densely imbricate, broadly ovate, obtuse, 48 mm long, slightly exceeding the sepals, very thick and rigid, under a lens appearing punctulate and transversely rugose, convex, not carinate; flowers strictly erect; pedicels very short and stout. Sepals ovate-elliptic, narrowly rounded, 35 mm long, 18 mm wide, striate especially toward the apex.

description: Plant flowering 6-12 dm high. Leaves 35-67 cm long; sheaths elliptic, not much wider than the blades, densely dark-punctulate-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, flat, 35-40 mm wide, pale or dark green and glabrous above, dark green or maroon, glaucous and obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, rather stout, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, the lower ones foliaceous, the upper elliptic, acute. Inflorescence simple or rarely with 1-3 lateral racemes, the principal or only raceme 17-28 cm long, densely many-flowered; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, about equaling the sterile bracteate bases of the racemes; rhachis geniculate, angled, stout, glabrous. Floral bracts subspreading at anthesis and more or less secund, two and one half to three and one half times as long as the internodes, broadly ovate, broadly acute, to 35 mm long, obtusely carinate, slightly incurved at apex, faintly nerved, obscurely punctulate-lepidote, pale greenish brown at anthesis becoming darker with age; flowers secund-spreading; pedicels obconic, stout, 5-8 mm long. Sepals elliptic, subacute, 20-27 mm long, about equaling or somewhat exceeding the bracts, fleshy-coriaceous; petals narrowly obovate or elliptic, ca 3 cm long, yellow, bearing 2 acute scales 8 mm long at the base; stamens included, equaling the pistil, filaments much dilated toward apex.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1977. Tillandsioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (2): 663-1492.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 25-30 cm high with the inflorescence extended. Leaves 20-30 in an ovoid pseudobulb, erect, the inner ones to 20 cm long, the outer greatly reduced, appressed-cinereous-lepidote, concolorous; sheaths ovate, about as long as the blades; blades narrowly triangular; abruptly acute or obtuse, involute. Scape curved, 2 mm in diameter; scape-bracts erect, ovate, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence bipinnate from 3 or 4 spikes, lax, 9-11 cm long, glabrous (?); primary bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than the sterile naked or 1-bracteate bases of the branches; spikes subspreading, 4-8.5 cm long, laxly 2-9-flowered; rhachis slender, geniculate. Floral bracts broadly ovate, about half as long as the sepals, strongly nerved; flowers spreading, subsessile. Sepals elliptic, 14 mm long, nerved, ecarinate. Capsule cylindric, beaked, 25 mm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 36-60 cm high. Leaves many in a broadly funnelform rosette, 30-33 cm long, covered throughout with white appressed dark-centered scales; sheaths elliptic, 12 cm long; blades narrowly triangular, 25 mm wide at base, flat. Scape slightly curved; scape-bracts densely imbricate, subfoliaceous, red. Inflorescence laxly cylindric, bipinnate, 14-28 cm long; axis slender, nearly straight, almost black when dry, glabrous; primary bracts spreading, attenuate from a broadly ovate base, to 8 cm long, red, white-lepidote toward apex; branches densely 2-flowered, the naked sterile base to 8 mm long. Floral bracts suborbicular, to 14 mm long, about equaling the sepals, subcoriaceous, yellow when dry, glabrous; flowers subsessile. Sepals broadly obovate, subtruncate, to 14 mm long.

description: Plant stemless. Leaves as many as 40 in a handsome cyathiform rosette, to 35 cm long; sheaths scarcely broader than the blades, densely appressed-lepidote, lead-colored when dry; blades ligulate, rounded-apiculate, 8 cm wide, subglabrous, without markings, suffused with red, flat when living, rigidly coriaceous when dry. Scape short, erect, relatively slender, terete, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, short but exceeding the internodes, elliptic, abruptly acute, stiff. Inflorescence erect, slenderly thyrsoid, rather lax, about 2 dm long; axis stout, slightly angled when dry; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but reflexed, 3 cm long, apparently exceeding the axillary branches; branches short, slender, 2-flowered or 3-flowered. Floral bracts shorter than the pedicels; pedicels slender, 5-6 mm long. Sepals (undeveloped) 10 mm long, obtuse, strongly asymmetric, slightly emarginate, chartaceous, glabrous, free.

description: Leaves 37-44 cm long; blades lanceolate, 5 cm wide at base, acute and apiculate, very sparsely and minutely lepidote on both sides. Scape erect, rather stout; scape-bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 3-6 cm long, exceeding the internodes, their bases clasping the scape. Inflorescence paniculate, many-flowered, 27-60 cm long, glabrous or subglabrous; primary bracts broadly ovate with a triangular blade, shorter than the branches, thin; branches 8-12 cm long, bearing 2 sterile bracts 7-8 mm long, 3-4 cm above the base and then a fascicle of 3-4 pendulous racemes; rhachis flexuous, 3-5 cm long, 4-7-flowered, glabrous. Floral bracts broadly ovate to nearly semiorbicular, obtuse, 7 mm long, 4 mm wide; flowers secund or not, subspreading; pedicels rather stout, 3-4 mm long. Sepals lance-oblong, obtuse, 13 mm long, nerved, glabrous; petals lanceolate, acute, 22 mm long, 5 mm wide, bright yellow, bearing 2 long scales; stamens and style exserted.

description: Plant flowering to 23 cm high, very slender. Leaves 21 cm long; sheaths elliptic, 6 cm long; blades linear, abruptly acute or rounded, apiculate, 25 mm wide, bright or pale green, concolorous, minutely punctulate-lepidote on both sides. Scape erect, shorter than the leaves or about equaling them; scape-bracts tubular-erect, distinctly longer than the internodes, broadly elliptic, rounded at apex. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered, lax, barely 1 dm long. Floral bracts suberect and 4 times as long as the internodes but not imbricate, elliptic, subacute, distinctly shorter than the sepals and enfolding them to above the middle, straight toward apex, slightly carinate; pedicels stout, 3 mm long; flowers distichous, not secund, suberect, to 48 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 28 mm long, ecarinate; petals ligulate, bearing 2 scales; stamens exserted (?).

description: Plant flowering to 3 dm in length. Leaves 13-20 cm long; sheaths large, elliptic, tinged with purple or red, minutely appressed-lepidote; blades ligulate, subrounded, apiculate, 17 mm wide, green or somewhat dark reddish, soon glabrous. Scape decurved, very slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect and clasping the scape, broadly ovate, apiculate, small and much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence few-branched, to 15 cm long, lax, glabrous; lower primary bracts like the scape-bracts, much shorter than the branches, the upper like the floral bracts; branches laxly 2-6-flowered, very slender, flexuous. Floral bracts suborbicular, apiculate, 15 mm long, much shorter than the sepals, carinate toward apex, membranaceous, nerved; flowers spreading, not secund; pedicels slender, 5-7 mm long. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 17-20 mm long; petals 7 mm longer than the sepals.

description: Plant flowering 1.2 m high. Leaves over 6 dm long; sheaths ample, dark brown; blades ligulate, acute, apiculate, 10 cm wide, marked with dark irregular cross-bands green above, paler beneath. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, the lower to 7 cm long, acuminate to a 1 cm long mucro. Infloresence amply paniculate from 8-9 branches; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, much shorter than the sterile many-bracteate bases of the branches; branches spreading, slightly sigmoid, to 25 cm long, the upper half densely flowering. Floral bracts distichous, imbricate, not becoming secund, 3 cm long, subinflated, ecarinate, emucronate, subcoriaceous, green becoming fuscescent toward apex; flowers downwardly secund. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 20 mm long, about equaling the bracts before anthesis; petals 37-38 mm long, bearing 2 scales at base; stamens included, anthers 6-7 mm long.

description: Plant flowering barely over 4 dm high, slender. Leaves subutriculate, to 4 dm long, barely 20 mm wide, the sheaths and the lower part of the blades dorsally marked with transverse brown bands, acuminate, the apex produced into a mucro 10 mm long but not pungent. Scape erect, less than half as long as the leaves; scape-bracts with a mucronate blade like the leaves, exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence lanceolate in outline, acute at both ends, 70 mm long, 18 mm wide, distichous, compressed, 3-flowered. Floral bracts barely imbricate, ovate, acuminate, 45 mm long, much exceeding the sepals, mucronate, slightly incurved, strongly carinate, glabrous; flowers erect, imperfectly known. Sepals elliptic, broadly acute, 30 mm long, 11 mm wide, coriaceous, free.

description: Plant flowering 1 m or higher. Leaves many in a dense funnelform rosette, 4-7 dm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, barely wider than the blades, dark castaneous toward base beneath, minutely appressed-lepidote; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 6-10 cm wide, green tinged with red or with red lines or small spots, minutely lepidote beneath, nearly glabrous above. Scape erect, very stout; scape-bracts erect and clasping the scape, imbricate, suborbicular, apiculate, brown. Inflorescence bipinnate with 3-11 branches, lax, glabrous, 4-5 dm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, about equaling the sterile bases of the branches; racemes suberect to spreading, densely 7-15-flowered, the lower sometimes with a single sterile bract. Floral bracts distichous, slightly if at all secund, suborbicular, strong inflated, obtusely carinate, 2-3 cm long, usually exceeded by the sepals, coriaceous, rose drying to dark castaneous with narrow yellow margins; flowers spreading, secund; pedicels stout, 6 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, to 28 mm long, coriaceous, brown, faintly nerved, ecarinate; petals ligulate, obtuse, to 35 mm long, bearing 2 ovate acute scales at base, yellow or greenish; stamens included. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, acute, 35-40 mm long.

description: Plant flowering to 45 cm high; leaves few in a broadly funnelform rosette, 3 dm long, very obscurely lepidote; sheaths broadly elliptic, distinct, pale; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 32 mm wide, wholly green. Scape erect or ascending, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect and enfolding the scape, elliptic, apiculate, about equaling the internodes, green or red. Inflorescence simple, very dense, sublinear with a triangular-incised apex, 8-14 cm long, sigmoid-curved. Floral bracts more or less secund with the flowers, suberect, densely imbricate and concealing the rhachis, triangular-ovate, acute, incurved toward apex, sharply carinate, to 34 mm long, 18 mm wide, about equaling the sepals, papyraceous, subglabrous, bright red except for the green apex and margins; flowers short-pedicellate. Sepals sublanceolate, 25-30 mm long, carinate; petals linear, obtuse, about 15 mm longer than the sepals; stamens exserted.

description: Plant flowering 3-7 dm high. Leaves 15-20 in a spreading rosette, 25-56 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, much wider than the blades, pale brown toward base, green or sometimes purple toward apex, covered with minute appressed brown scales; blades ligulate, broadly acute or subrounded and apiculate, 20-45 mm wide, sometimes slightly narrowed toward base, wholly green, sometimes with small irregular transverse nerves, glabrous above, very obscurely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, 5-6 mm in diameter, much shorter than the leaves; scape-bracts strongly imbricate and enfolding the scape, broadly elliptic, apiculate, the upper red and gradually larger and more like the floral bracts. Inflorescence simple, densely many-flowered, oblong or linear, acute, strongly compressed, 15-40 cm long, 4-5 cm wide, glabrous or nearly so. Floral bracts strongly imbricate, always covering the rhachis and sepals, erect, 45-60 mm long, subrhombic, folded on the keel with the side nearly flat, incurved toward apex, papyraceous and red with broad yellow membranaceous margins; flowers erect with the petals all issuing from one side of the inflorescence but not truly secund; pedicels obconic, stout, 3-5 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 15-27 mm long, ecarinate; petals ligulate, obtuse, nearly 5 cm long, bearing 2 obtuse scales at base; stamens and pistil exserted. Capsule cylindric, attenuate, 35-40 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 3-5 m high; stem erect, stout. Leaves many in a funnelform rosette, to 15 dm long; sheaths very broadly elliptic, 25 cm wide, densely and minutely dark-lepidote; blades ligulate, acute or acuminate, 12 cm wide, wholly green or obscurely maculate toward base, glabrous above, minutely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, exceeding the leaves, ca 45 mm in diameter; scape-bracts suberect, densely imbricate, recurved toward apex. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, slenderly pyramidal; primary bracts broadly ovate with a small narrow blade, about equaling the sterile bases of the branches; branches densely 10-50-flowered, suberect at the sterile base with 3-4 bracts, then spreading and decurved; rhachis more or less geniculate, the internodes 2-4 cm long. Floral bracts secund with the flowers, ovate, acute, about half as long as the sepals, carinate, incurved; flowers spreading, upwardly secund; pedicels obconic, stout, 1 cm long. Sepals elliptic, ca 4 cm long, 15 mm wide, ecarinate; petals over 10 cm long, linear, obtuse, white, bearing 2 large linear scales at base, flaccid and pendent at anthesis. Capsule slenderly ovoid, long-beaked, 55 mm long; seeds with coma at both ends.

description: Plant flowering 1-2 m high. Leaves to 1 m long; sheaths dark brown; blades ligulate, subrounded and broadly apiculate, to 1 dm wide, concolorous, pale green. description: Plant usually flowering 2 m or more high. Leaves numerous in a spreading rosette, 3.5-5 dm long; sheaths large, broadly elliptic, dark castaneous, very densely and minutely appressed-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly acute or obtuse and apiculate, flat, 6-8 cm broad, pale green, concolorous, very finely reticulate with irregular cross-veins, obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath, glabrous above. Scape erect, elongate, 14 mm in diameter at base, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lower foliaceous and densely imbricate, the upper broadly lanceolate and about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence simple and bent obliquely from the summit of the scape or more often laxly few-branched; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, mostly shorter than the sterile bases of the racemes; racemes up to 28 cm long, 8-16-flowered, the lateral ones divergent, slenderly stipitate, eprophyllate or with a single sterile bract in the same inflorescence, the terminal raceme long-stipitate with many sterile bracts like the upper scape-bracts. Floral bracts becoming secund with the flowers at anthesis, to 32 mm long, about twice as long as the internodes, suborbicular, very broadly acute or apiculate, obtusely carinate toward the apex and slightly incurved, flavous, nearly or quite even, obscurely and very minutely brown-lepidote; flowers downwardly secund at anthesis, spreading; pedicels rather slender, to 10 mm long. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, to 34 mm long, exceeding the floral bracts, minutely brown-lepidote especially inside; petals oblanceolate, obtuse, to 5 cm long, lemon-yellow, bearing 2 large acute scales at base; stamens included, filaments much thickened toward apex.

description: Plant stemless, to 1.4 m high. Leaves rosulate, 8 dm long, minutely and obscurely lepidote; sheaths elliptic, 2 dm long, nearly the same color as the blades; blades ligulate, acute, to 65 mm wide. Scape erect, about 8 mm in diameter; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, broadly ovate, acute. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 8 dm long; axis slender, slightly flexuous, glabrous; primary bracts elliptic, acute, much shorter than the spikes; spikes spreading or slightly ascending, to 25 cm long, 15-flowered, bearing 1 or 2 sterile bracts at the base; rhachis slender, slightly flexuous, excavated, glabrous. Floral bracts imbricate, not at all secund, obovate, broadly subtruncate, to 32 mm long, exceeding the sepals, ecarinate, coriaceous, glabrous, and even at base and center, the apex and margins thin, obscurely lepidote, nerved, punctulate-lepidote within; pedicels short and obscure. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 24 mm long, thin, nerved, punctulate-lepidote, posteriorly connate for 3 mm; petals about 30 mm long, white, bearing 2 scales above the base; stamens included.

description: Plant known only from old fragments, flowering over 14 dm high. Leaves unknown, but undoubtedly like the lower scape-bracts only larger. Scape erect, very slightly flexuous, glabrous at least in age; scape-bracts erect and closely enfolding the scape, sparsely and obscurely lepidote, the lower ones imbricate with ovate sheaths ca 7 cm long and very narrow, triangular blades to 75 cm long, the upper merely acute and shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, laxly and distichously many-flowered, over 30 cm long, ca 3 cm wide, glabrous at least with age; rhachis 5-7 mm thick at base, slightly flexuous. Floral bracts erect or suberect, ovate, broadly rounded and apiculate, to 4 cm long, from shorter than the internodes to nearly twice as long, distinctly exceeded by the sepals, convex, ecarinate, thin-coriaceous and nerved when dry; pedicels distinct, ca 7 mm long; flowers erect, not at all secund. Sepals elliptic, obtuse (?), 25 mm long, ecarinate; petals and stamens unknown.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 35 cm high. Leaves many in a broad rosette, 20 cm long, covered with white appressed dark-centered scales; sheaths elliptic, 7-8 cm long; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, 15 mm wide at base. Scape slender, curved; scape-bracts erect, red, their elliptic sheaths shorter than the upper internodes but their foliaceous blades much exceeding them. Inflorescence few-flowered, very lax, 7 cm long; axis slender, geniculate; primary bracts long-attenuate from an ovate base, the lowest nearly equaling the flowers; branches spreading, densely 2-flowered, the sterile base naked, slender, 8 mm long. Floral bracts suborbicular, 16 mm long, exceeded by the sepals, coriaceous, soon glabrous, yellow, carinate; pedicels stout, 3 mm long. Sepals elliptic, broadly rounded, 20 mm long; petals 28 mm long, bearing 2 acute scales at base; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering at least 85 cm high. Leaves to 47 cm long, minutely appressed-lepidote on both sides; sheaths broadly elliptic, slightly wider than the blades, very dark purple, nearly black; blades ligulate, broadly rounded with the apiculate apex recurved, 65 mm wide, green with narrow very obscure transverse lines. Scape erect, stout, bright red; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, broadly elliptic, apiculate, bright red. Inflorescence compound, dense, narrow, 32 cm long, ca 10 cm in diameter, glabrous; primary bracts broadly ovate, much shorter than the branches, red; branches simple, suberect, 10-12 cm long, 9-12-flowered, geniculate. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, broadly acute or obtuse, to 27 mm long, 4 times longer than the internodes, slightly shorter than the sepals, slightly if at all carinate, coriaceous, smooth; flowers spreading, not secund; pedicels stout, 3-5 mm long. Sepals oblong-elliptic, broadly acute to 24 mm long. Capsule slender, slightly exceeding the sepals.

description: Plant flowering 4-7.5 dm high with the inflorescence extended. Leaves less than 20 in a funnelform rosette, 15-40 cm long, densely and minutely appressed-lepidote on both sides; sheaths elliptic, slightly wider than the blades, more or less castaneous; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, flat, 25-40 mm wide. Scape decurved, slender; scape-bracts slightly exceeding die internodes, broadly elliptic, apiculate. Inflorescence simple, many-flowered, oblong, acute, strongly complanate, 10-35 cm long, 4-6 cm wide; rhachis flexuous, angled. Floral bracts spreading at anthesis or at least the basal ones, broadly elliptic, acute, 3-4 cm long, 3-4 times as long as the internodes, 26 mm wide, obtusely carinate toward apex, never incurved, subcoriaceous, rose, farinose, smooth; flowers never secund; pedicels obconic, stout; sepals narrowly elliptic, acute, to 3 cm long, usually equaling or exceeding the bracts, farinaceous; petals ligulate, very narrow, obtuse, 35-45 mm long, yellow, bearing 2 entire scales; stamens exserted.

description: Plant flowering barely 4 dm high, very slender. Leaves to 4 dm long; sheaths violet-tinged; blades 5 mm wide, linear and grass-like, attenuate, appressed-pale-lepidote, chartaceous when dry, green, concolorous. Scape erect, very slender, terete, glabrous; scape-bracts lax, very narrow, reddish with foliaceous blades. Inflorescence simple, 3-flowered in the type, exceeded by the leaves, lax, 7 cm long; axis slightly angled and undulate. Floral bracts secund with the flowers and enfolding their bases on one side, membranaceous, striate, the lowest produced into a long attenuate blade, the others acute, 17 mm long and about equaling the sepals; flowers suberect; pedicels stout, 5 mm long. Sepals elliptic, narrowly obtuse, 15 mm long, 7 mm wide, castaneous with a pale membranaceous border when dry, even and shiny. Capsule acuminate, gray-black, opaque.

description: Plant stemless, flowering to 2 m high. Leaves 7 dm long, densely purple-banded throughout; sheaths inconspicuous; blades ligulate, acute, 6-8 cm wide, flat, arching-recurved, obscurely lepidote, appearing glabrous. Scape erect, glabrous; scape-bracts densely imbricate, broadly elliptic, apiculate, spotted. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, about 6-branched; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, about equaling the sterile bracteate bases of the branches; spikes linear, strongly complanate, 25-50 cm long, 3-4 cm wide. Floral bracts imbricate but exposing the rhachis, elliptic, acute, 55-60 mm long, ecarinate, rose, subchartaceous and nerved when dry. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 26 mm long, nerved; petals bright red. Capsule subcylindric, 25 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 2 m high. Leaves many in a large broadly funnelform rosette, 6-10 dm long, minutely appressed-lepidote on both sides; sheaths large, very broadly elliptic, densely castaneous-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, 6-9 cm wide, flat, wholly green; scape erect, stout; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, acuminate, suberect, densely imbricate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 1 m or longer, ca 4 dm in diameter, nearly glabrous; primary bracts ovate, acuminate, shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches divergent, all subequal, laxly many-flowered, to 45 cm long with a long sterile base bearing 1-2 bracts; rhachis flexuous. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, subacute, to 3 cm long, equaling the middle of the sepals, convex, ecarinate, not incurved, coriaceous; flowers distichous, rarely somewhat secund, suberect. Sepals elliptic, subacute, to 37 mm long, ecarinate; petals ligulate, obtuse, 4-5 cm long, greenish yellow, bearing 2 long acute scales at base, exceeding the stamens; filaments enlarged toward apex. Capsule cylindric, acute, 4 cm long.

description: Plant flowering 1.2 m high. Leaves to 9 dm long; sheaths ample, dark castaneous, punctulate-lepidote; blades ligulate, acuminate, 7-10 cm wide, flat, green, concolorous, obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath, glabrous above. Scape erect, over 2 cm in diameter; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, broadly ovate with narrowly triangular blades. Inflorescence very laxly bipinnate; primary bracts broadly ovate, the lower ones with a narrowly triangular blade exceeding the mostly 2-prophyllate bases of the branches; branches divergent to spreading, subdensely 7-10-flowered; rhachis flexuous, slender, angled. Floral bracts more or less secund with the flowers, broadly obovate, truncate, 25-30 mm long, about twice as long as the internodes, much exceeded by the sepals, coriaceous, pale green when dry, obscurely punctulate-lepidote, carinate toward apex, strongly gibbous about one-third below apex; pedicels to 10 mm long; flowers deflexed-secund. Sepals ovate, obtuse, to 32 mm long, coriaceous and castaneous with a broad thin pale margin, ecarinate, glabrous; petals 6 cm long, equaling the stamens, bearing 2 large acute scales at base, the long narrow blades soon drooping. Capsule ellipsoid, acute, 5 cm long.

description: Plant flowering over 7 dm high. Leaves about 15 in a funnelform rosette, to 33 cm long; sheaths large, broadly elliptic, completely covered with minute appressed dark brown scales; blades ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, 5 cm wide, dark green with a white powdery surface, nearly glabrous above, densely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, 15-20 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper broadly ovate with acuminate spirally recurved blades. Inflorescence very laxly compound from a few simple branches, 4 dm long; axis short, stout; primary bracts broadly ovate, 2-4 cm long; branches 2-3 dm long with the laxly bracteate sterile base much longer than the raceme; racemes dense at least before anthesis, to 7 cm long. Floral bracts suborbicular, obtuse, 2 cm long, exceeding the sepals, ecarinate, thick, fleshy, glabrous, black, much wrinkled on drying; flowers distichous. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, green; petals broadly elliptic, yellow, bearing 2 acute scales at base, exceeding the stamens at least before anthesis.

description: Plant flowering to 1 m high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, 5 dm long; sheaths elliptic; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 4 cm wide, sparsely lepidote. Scape erect; scape-bracts very densely imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper lanceolate, acute. Floral bracts ovate, obtuse, shorter than the sepals, more than twice as long as the internodes but mostly spreading at anthesis and completely exposing the rhachis, straight, ecarinate or slightly carinate, rose or yellowish, subcoriaceous; pedicels stout. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, to 33 mm long; petals linear, bearing 2 scales; stamens exserted.

description: Plant flowering 1-2 m high. Leaves many in a spreading rosette, 7 dm long; sheaths oblong-elliptic, large, dark castaneous almost to apex, densely and minutely appressed-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly acute or rounded and apiculate, to 7 cm wide, green and glabrous above, beneath obscurely lepidote and marked with wavy purple transverse lines. Scape erect, to 12 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect and enfolding the scape, nearly all shorter than the internodes, lanceolate or ovate, rounded and apiculate, densely and finely purple-spotted. Inflorescence simple, many-flowered, lax at anthesis, linear, over 4 dm long, glabrous, finely spotted; rhachis straight, stout, sulcate. Floral bracts very broadly ovate with decurrent auricles, broadly acute, 3-4 cm long, exceeded by the sepals, inflated, obtusely if at all carinate, coriaceous, smooth or faintly nerved, yellowish; flowers distichous, reflexed at anthesis; pedicels stout, to 13 mm long. Sepals elliptic, 27 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous, smooth, green; petals elliptic, exceeding the stamens, purple toward apex, elsewhere green, bearing 2 acute scales at base. Capsule stout, slightly exceeding the sepals.

description: Plant caulescent; stem (?) 60 cm high. Leaves in a dense crateriform rosette, 50 cm long, thin; sheaths ovate-elliptic, 15-20 cm long, 10-12 cm wide, dark purple beneath drying to brown; blades sublinear, attenuate at apex into a slender spotted (?) subulus, 30 cm long, 7 mm wide, inconspicuously lepidote. Scape erect (?), 80 cm long, 10 mm thick, green; scape-bracts twice as long as the internodes, spreading, green. Inflorescence laxly pyramidal-paniculate, flaccid, to 1 m long, to 17-branched; axis 7 mm thick, green, its internodes about equaling the primary bracts; primary bracts exceeding the bicarinate sterile basal bracts of the branches, the lower ones yellow with red spots, the upper pale yellow; branches spreading, flexuous, 2-3 mm thick, the internodes nearly straight. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, ecarinate, 30-35 mm long, exceeded by the internodes and sepals, punctate-lepidote inside; flowers 45 mm long, exceeding the internodes; pedicels stout, 8 mm long. Sepals oblong, ca 30 mm long, yellow, punctate-lepidote inside; petals linear, obtuse, 40 mm long, bearing 2 acuminate 12-14 mm long ligules above the base, the blade with 1-2 lobes at base (normal?); stamens exserted; anthers linear, 5 mm long; ovary 5 mm long; ovules short-caudate.

description: Plant flowering 4-5 dm high, propagating by very slender rhizomes. Leaves many, densely rosulate, to 28 cm long; sheaths elliptic, ample, dark castaneous, densely and finely brown-lepidote; blades very narrowly triangular, 1 cm wide, flat, densely pale-lepidote beneath, obscurely lepidote above, sometimes Finely violet-spotted. Scape erect, very slender; scape-bracts imbricate, elliptic, bearing suberect linear blades. Inflorescence simple, densely many-flowered in about 4 ranks, slenderly ovoid, 5-11 cm long. Floral bracts imbricate except the lowest spreading ones, very broadly elliptic, obtuse, inflated, ecarinate, to 28 mm long, slightly longer or shorter than the sepals, straight or slightly cucullate, membranaceous, nerved, bright red or the highest yellow, sparsely and minutely pale-lepidote; pedicels short, stout. Sepals narrowly obovate, broadly obtuse, to 2 cm long, ecarinate, subcoriaceous; petals white, the blades about 1 cm long; stamens and pistil exserted.

description: Plant flowering 5-6 dm high. Leaves many, rosulate, 3-4 dm long, strongly nerved and with age fraying into long dark persistent fibers, brown-appressed-lepidote throughout, broadly scarious-margined; sheaths ovate, scarcely distinct; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, ca 15 mm wide. Scape erect, 5 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, elliptic, the lowest very narrowly laminate, the highest shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly 6-7-flowered, glabrous; rhachis slender, flexuous. Floral bracts becoming secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, obtuse and apiculate, about half as long as the sepals, ecarinate, thin, nerved; pedicels 7 mm long; flowers erect before anthesis then secund-spreading. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 25 mm long, ecarinate, chartaceous when dry, nerved; petals exceeding the stamens, bearing 2 acute scales at base, the blades elliptic, obtuse, 10 mm long, reddish outside, greenish white inside.

description: Plant flowering 5-10 dm high. Leaves about 60 in a broad rosette, arching-recurved, 35-50 cm long; sheaths large, 10-12 cm wide, marked with small red-brown spots; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 65-80 mm wide; pale green marked with narrow dark green lines, the longitudinal lines regular and the transverse irregular, glabrous above, minutely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, exceeding the leaves, slightly robust, glabrous, green; scape-bracts erect, about equaling the internodes or slightly shorter, elliptic, acute or apiculate, green with small red-brown spots. Inflorescence simple, lax, many-flowered, to 52 cm long; rhachis straight. Floral bracts broadly ovate, obtuse, 3 cm long, much shorter than the sepals and enfolding their bases, ecarinate, recurved toward apex, bearing decurrent auricles at base, green, spotted, smooth; flowers distichous, spreading at anthesis; pedicels to 1 cm long. description: Plant flowering 2-3 m high. Leaves many in a funnelform rosette, ca 1 m long; sheaths large but inconspicuous, covered with minute appressed brown scales; blades ligulate, acute, 5-10 cm wide, pale bluish green, smooth and glabrous above, obscurely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts divergent, the lower subfoliaceous and imbricate, the upper acuminate from a broadly ovate base, not covering the scape. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate from a few branches; primary bracts much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches, broadly ovate, acute; branches spreading, many-flowered, lax, to 65 cm long, lightly sigmoid, geniculate. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, obtuse, 4 cm long, exceeded by the sepals, inflated, ecarinate, humped and incurved below the apex, strongly rugose on drying; flowers distichous, spreading; pedicels stout, to 1 cm long. Sepals elliptic, 35-50 mm long; petals linear, acute, to 8 cm long, shorter than the stamens; seeds bearing a coma on both ends.

description: Plant flowering 4-5 dm high. Leaves about 15-20 in a broadly funnelform rosette, 30-35 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, distinct, purple-tinged, minutely and obscurely lepidote; blades ligulate, slightly narrowed at base, broadly acute or somewhat rounded and apiculate, to 35 mm wide, flat, wholly green, subglabrous. Inflorescence simple, dense, linear or narrowly lanceolate, acute, strongly compressed, 16-26 cm long, 50-65 mm wide, exceeding the leaves. Floral bracts suberect, 4-6 times longer than the internodes but so narrow as to expose the slender rhachis, suboblong with slightly curved margins, acute, incurved, sharply carinate, 45-50 mm long, 25-30 mm wide, papyraceous, minutely and obscurely lepidote, bright red except for the green apex and margins; flowers short-pedicellate, never secund. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse or emarginate, 20-35 mm long, carinate, yellow; petals linear, obtuse, nearly 5 cm long, yellow except the green apex, bearing 2 scales; stamens and style exserted.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves rosulate, to 63 cm long; sheaths elliptic, 15 cm long, covered throughout with appressed brown-centered scales; blade narrowly subtriangular, long-attenuate, 4 cm wide at base, densely and finely appressed-lepidote beneath, glabrous above. Scape erect, 2 cm in diameter, glabrous, red; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper long-attenuate from an ovate base. Inflorescence bipinnate, subcylindric, ca 8 cm in diameter; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, suberect, their blades exceeding the lower branches; racemes divergent or arching from a long erect naked sterile base, to 8 cm long in all, few-flowered; rhachis slender, geniculate, quadrangular, glabrous. Floral bracts more or less downwardly secund with the flowers, ovate, acute, 2 cm long, about 4 times as long as the internodes, much exceeded by the sepals, carinate, subchartaceous and nerved when dry, glabrous; flowers in part downwardly secund, yellow; pedicels rather slender, 7 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 25 mm long, ecarinate, nerved; petals evidently more than twice as long as the sepals and soon flaccid and drooping; pistil to 6 cm long.

description: Plant stemless (?), flowering 35 cm high with the inflorescence extended. Leaves 30 cm long, covered with fine appressed scales; sheaths broadly ovate, small and merging with the blades, castaneous; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, flat, 3 cm wide, gray-green. Scape shorter than the leaves, curved; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, the upper broadly ovate with a long caudate apex, subchartaceous when dry, brown-lepidote. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, ellipsoid, 12 cm long exclusive of the petals; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts but elliptic and merely apiculate, slightly more than half as long as the spikes, pale red; spikes lanceolate, acute, complanate, 10 cm long, densely 4-5-flowered. Floral bracts linear-lanceolate, 6 cm long, sharply carinate, thin, faintly nerved, white-lepidote; pedicels very short, brown-flocculose. Sepals linear-lanceolate, 48 mm long, very short-connate, thin, nerved, sparsely lepidote; petals linear, 12 cm long, greenish yellow, bearing 2 large acute scales at base; stamens about equaling the petals.

description: Plant flowering 18-21 cm high. Leaves more than 20 in an obconical rosette, 13-15 cm long, strongly purple-tinged and strikingly white-lepidote beneath especially toward base; sheaths elliptic, 5 cm long; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 15 mm wide. Scape erect, slightly curved, about equaling the leaves; scape-bracts densely imbricate, ovate with a short stout apiculus, coriaceous, even, lepidote. Inflorescence simple, to 3-flowered with the terminal flower vestigial; rhachis flexuous, obtusely angled. Floral bracts somewhat less than twice as long as the internodes, becoming secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, 20 mm long, exceeded by the sepals, coriaceous, ecarinate, glabrous in age; pedicels stout, obconic, 5 mm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 18 mm long, ecarinate; petals and stamens unknown. Capsule ellipsoid, 28 mm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering to 5 dm high. Leaves as many as 13 in a dense rosette, erect or suberect, about 25 cm long; sheaths indistinct, ovate-elliptic, pale lepidote, usually marked with pale violet longitudinal lines; blades ligulate, acuminate, about 2 cm wide, subchartaceous when dry. Scape strict, very slender, nearly twice as long as the leaves, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, appressed, distinctly shorter than the internodes, elliptic, acute, not at all foliaceous. Inflorescence laxly few-flowered, 13 cm long, 3 cm in diameter, glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than the sterile base of the spike; branches about 7, erect, compressed, the lower ones to 4 cm long, bearing a flower and a rudiment at the apex and a second flower 10 mm below the apex. Floral bracts elliptic, obtuse, 4 mm long, much shorter than the sepals, membranaceous; pedicels very short and stout. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 8 mm long, 6 mm wide, coriaceous, free.

description: Plant flowering not more than 5 dm high. Leaves (inner) to 18 cm long; sheaths indistinct; blades short, ligulate, 5 cm wide, broadly rounded and apiculate, green, densely punctulate-lepidote especially beneath. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts few, equaling or slightly shorter than the internodes, very broadly ovate, apiculate. Inflorescence densely bipinnate from a few branches, to 14 cm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, much shorter than the racemes; racemes 4-6-flowered; rhachis slender. Floral bracts secund with the flowers, suborbicular, obtuse, 25 mm long, 23 mm wide, exceeded by the sepals, ecarinate, inflated; flowers divergent; pedicels long and slender. Sepals sublanceolate, narrowly obtuse, 24 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous.

description: Plant flowering 35 cm high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, to 15 cm long, minutely lepidote on both sides; sheaths elliptic, large, reddish; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, red-spotted, twisted at apex. Scape erect, very slender, glabrous, slightly exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence erect, lax, few-branched, glabrous; primary bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, about half as long as the sterile bases of the branches; branches suberect, laxly 2-4-flowered; rhachis flexuous, very slender. Floral bracts secund with the flowers, broadly elliptic, acute, to 27 mm long, about equaling the sepals, carinate, strongly incurved toward apex, membranaceous, red; flowers spreading; pedicels slender, 3 mm long. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 23 mm long, membranaceous.

description: Plant flowering 4-8 dm high. Leaves numerous in a funnelform rosette, 4-6 dm long, densely and Finely appressed-lepidote; sheaths elliptic, 1 dm long, brown; blades very narrowly triangular, 4 cm wide. Scape erect, short and stout; scape-bracts densely imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper broadly elliptic with a linear blade. Inflorescence slenderly cylindric, densely bipinnate; lower primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, the upper merely apiculate, nearly equaling the spikes, obscurely lepidote; spikes strict, elliptic, 6-8 cm long, 2-3 cm wide, strongly complanate, dense, 8-12-flowered, bearing a few carinate lepidote sterile bracts at base; rhachis excavated. Floral bracts imbricate, ovate, acute, 24 mm long, about equaling the sepals, coriaceous, even, all but the lowest scarcely or not at all carinate and soon glabrous; pedicels 2 mm long, stout. Sepals free, lance-ovate, obtuse or apiculate but the thin margins inrolled and making them appear acuminate, 22 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous; petals about 3 cm long, green with dark purple margins, bearing 2 scales; stamens and pistil exserted.

description: Plant flowering 5-20 dm high. Leaves 5-6 dm long; sheaths large, broadly elliptic, dark castaneous; blades ligulate, acute, 8-10 cm wide, green, densely and minutely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts few, the highest 2-3 times shorter than the internodes, very broadly ovate, truncate and apiculate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, few-branched, 2-5 dm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than the sterile mostly naked bases of the racemes; racemes densely 3-12-flowered; rhachis stout. Floral bracts secund with the flowers, subreniform, 15-25 mm long, 30 mm wide, about half as long as the sepals, subinflated, thick, coriaceous; flowers divergent to spreading; pedicels stout. Sepals ovate or oblong, obtuse, 28 mm long, ecarinate; petals broadly ligulate, obtuse, ca 45 mm long, exceeding the stamens, yellow, bearing 2 small scales.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 1-1.5 m high. Leaves many in a crateriform rosette, rigid; sheaths elliptic, ca 15 cm long; blades subspreading, ligulate, 5-8 dm long, acute, apiculate, 6-10 cm wide, green, concolorous, obscurely punctulate-lepidote. Scape erect, exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, the lower with short linear apiculate blades, the upper acute or obtuse. Inflorescence bipinnate from 3-5 branches, 5-7 dm long; primary bracts spreading or subspreading, clasping the sterile bases of the branches, broadly ovate, obtuse, apiculate, 5-6 cm long; lateral spikes 15-30 cm long with a sterile base 5-10 cm long usually bearing 2 bracts, 10-25-flowered, the terminal spike 40 cm long with a sterile base 25 cm long bearing 5-6 barely imbricate sterile bracts; rhachis flexuous, angled, 3 mm in diameter, the internodes obconic. Floral bracts secund, suborbicular, broadly ovate, or broadly elliptic, obtuse, 35-45 mm long, 3 times as long as the internodes, carinate toward apex, rigid, cinereous at anthesis, subglabrous outside, brown-punctulate inside; pedicels 5-7.5 mm long; flowers downwardly secund. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 15-20 mm long, much shorter than the bracts, coriaceous, dark brown, even; petals oblong, broadly acute or rounded, 30-35 mm long, sordid green, bearing 2 acuminate denticulate scales; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering 9-10 dm high. Leaves rosulate, to 8 dm long, minutely and obscurely lepidote throughout; sheaths broadly elliptic, ca 15 cm long, nearly black beneath; blades ligulate, broadly acute with a stout involute terminal cusp, 7-8 cm wide, flat. Scape erect, rather slender; scape-bracts strict, imbricate, the lowest subfoliaceous, the others broadly ovate with a cuspidate apex. Inflorescence typically of 2 branches with long sterile laxly bracteate bases; spikes oblong, densely many-flowered, 15-17 cm long (fertile part); rhachis nearly straight, subalate, 4 mm wide. Floral bracts 3 times the internodes but spreading at anthesis and exposing the rhachis, not secund, broadly ovate, rounded and apiculate, 25 mm long, very broadly convex and ecarinate, coriaceous, even, glabrous, green (! Foster); flowers slightly secund at anthesis; pedicels slenderly obconic, to 10 mm long in fruit. Sepals broadly elliptic, 17 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous, even; petals oblong, exceeding the stamens, white, musky and opening at night (! Foster). Capsule cylindric, acute, beaked, 3 cm long.

description: Plant stemless. Leaves 3-5 dm long; sheaths elliptic, densely ferruginous-lepidote; blades linear to lanceolate, minutely punctulate-lepidote. Scape slender, erect; scape-bracts imbricate, broadly ovate, the lower acuminate, the upper obtuse. Inflorescence of 1-4 spikes; primary bracts short and inconspicuous; spikes linear, 1-6 dm long, complanate, many-flowered. Floral bracts densely imbricate, broadly ovate, triangular-acute, 25-35 mm long, exceeding the flowers, ecarinate, yellow, coriaceous; flowers subsessile, 25 mm long. Sepals lance-ovate, 15 mm long; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering 7-8 dm high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, 6-7 dm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, 20 cm long, 8 cm wide; blades ligulate, long-acuminate, over 25 mm wide, densely brown-punctulate on both sides. Scape erect, 5 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts all slightly longer than the internodes, broadly ovate, acute, tightly clasping, brown-punctulate. Inflorescence simple, densely many-flowered, 6 dm long; rhachis erect, slightly angled, glabrous. Floral bracts secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, acute, 25-32 mm long, more than twice as long as the internodes, carinate, coriaceous, pale brown when dry; pedicels stout, 8 mm long. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse or emarginate, 30 mm long; stamens included, Filaments slightly thickened toward apex.

description: Plant evidently stemless, flowering over 6 dm high. Leaves to 31 cm long, concolorous, covered on both sides with appressed cretaceous brown-centered scales; sheaths elliptic, ca 8 cm long; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 4 cm wide, flat. Scape erect, 7 mm in diameter at base; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, the lowest foliaceous, the highest elliptic, broadly acute and apiculate. Inflorescence laxly compound from 5 spikes, 20 cm long, obscurely punctulate-lepidote; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, covering the prophyllate bases of the lateral spikes, suberect; lateral spikes subspreading, subdesnely 6-7-flowered, the fertile part 4 cm long, terminal spike erect on the end of a scape-like peduncle with several imbricate bracts, 11-flowered; rhachis stout, geniculate, angled. Floral bracts spreading and becoming downwardly secund with the flowers, broadly ovate, obtuse, to 10 mm long, slightly more than twice the internodes, about half as long as the sepals, ecarinate, thin-coriaceous, pale brown when dry; flowers spreading, short-pedicellate. Sepals elliptic, rounded, 17 mm long, coriaceous, even or faintly nerved; petals ca 22 mm long, bearing 2 large lanceolate acuminate scales at base; stamens included, filaments somewhat thickened apically.
