description: Plant caulescent, rather stout, flowering to 18 cm high. Leaves densely polystichous along the stem, to 14 cm long, covered with appressed gray scales; sheaths short, merging with the blades; blades suberect, very narrowly triangular, 5 mm wide, channeled. Scape erect but soon laterally decurved; scape-bracts erect, imbricate and covering the scape, rose, densely lepidote. Inflorescence simple, of 7-12 polystichous flowers, dense at first, elongating at anthesis, to 7 cm long, laxly cylindric, equaling the leaves. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute or the upper subacute, deep rose with a greenish apex, lepidote; flowers suberect. Sepals rose, pellucid, submembranaceous, broadly acute, unequal, the anterior 16 mm long and free, the posterior 18 mm long and connate for 6 mm; petals suberect, 30 mm long, dull pale lilac, rose when dry, the blade subelliptic, asymmetrically emarginate; stamens included; filaments faintly plicate; anthers 2 mm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 4 dm high. Leaves suberect, 3 dm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, large, dark; blades narrowly triangular, 3 cm wide, subglabrous. Scape erect, stout, about equaling the leaves; scape-bracts densely imbricate, lanceolate, acuminate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, subpyramidal; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, at least their sheaths shorter than the spikes; spikes spreading, short-stipitate, linear, acute, 50 mm long, 12 mm wide, 12-flowered, complanate. Floral bracts imbricate, ovate, broadly acute, 12 mm long, slightly exceeding the sepals, somewhat carinate toward apex, coriaceous, glabrous, faintly nerved; sepals subfree, elliptic, obtuse, slightly asymmetric, 9 mm long, coriaceous, glabrous, the posterior carinate; petals violet; stamens included.

description: Plant 1-2 dm long; roots present; stem much branched with the branching largely in a single plane, 4-6 cm long. Leaves densely distichous, 5-7 cm long, densely pruinose- or tomentose-lepidote, cinereous to fuscous; sheaths broadly ovate, 1 cm long, glabrous except for the upper half outside; blades suberect to spreading, linear-subulate, involute, long-attenuate, 1-2 mm in diameter. Scape terminal, erect or decurved, to 9 cm long, ca 0.5 mm in diameter, sulcate, lepidote at least below; scape-bracts 1-2, remote, much shorter than the internodes, elliptic, the upper acute or apiculate and usually glabrous, the lower usually filiform-laminate and appressed-lepidote. Inflorescence always simple and distichous-flowered, linear-lanceolate, 2-3 cm long, 3-5 mm wide, 2-4-flowered; rhachis slightly flexuous, very slender, excavated next the flowers, glabrous. Floral bracts not at all imbricate, equaling or slightly longer than the internodes, ovate-elliptic, acute, more or less nerved, 9-12 mm long, the lower ones equaling or somewhat shorter than the sepals and sometimes sparsely lepidote, the upper ones much shorter than the sepals and glabrous; flowers erect, appressed to the rhachis; pedicels very short, obconic. Sepals subelliptic, acute, 8-10 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide, thin, nerved, glabrous, equally subfree; petals 15-16 mm long, claw narrow, blade broadly elliptic or obovate, 5 mm long, 6 mm wide, blue or violet; stamens deeply included, exceeding the pistil, anthers linear; ovary subprismatic, passing gradually into the short style. Capsule cylindric, ca 2 cm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering to over 1 m high. Leaves many in a dense spreading rosette, to 5 dm long, obscurely punctulate-lepidote, green with fine purple spots; sheath elliptic, 18 cm long; blade narrowly triangular, attenuate, 5 cm wide. Scape erect, stout, exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts imbricate, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper broadly ovate, acuminate. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, narrow, 4-7 dm long; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, shorter to longer than the sterile bracteate bases of the branches; spikes erect to slightly divergent, linear-lanceolate, acute, strongly complanate, 7-22 cm long, dense. Floral bracts imbricate and wholly concealing the rhachis at anthesis, oblong, obtuse or apiculate, 35-50 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous, even or nearly so, pale, glaucous; pedicels stout, 5 mm long. Sepals free, oblong, slightly exserted at anthesis, the posterior carinate; petals linear, 8 cm long, white, quickly pendent at anthesis; stamens exceeding the petals.

description: Plant stemless or becoming short-caulescent by the loss of the lowest leaves, flowering to 11 dm high. Leaves rosulate, erect, 3 dm long, minutely punctulate-lepidote, thin, flexible; sheaths narrowly ovate-elliptic, dark brown; blades narrowly triangular, tapering into a whip-like point, light gray-green, pale-lepidote. Scape erect, slender, soon glabrous; scape-bracts lance-elliptic, acuminate, submembranaceous, densely punctulate-lepidote, the upper ones somewhat shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence erect or pendulous, tripinnate, 40 cm long, 14 cm in diameter, lax; axes slightly flexuous, slender; lower branches with a long stipe which equals or exceeds the primary bracts, composed of 2-3 spikes; bracts below the spikes small, not extending beyond the second lowest flower; spikes laxly 8-20-flowered, oblong, 4-5 cm long, spreading or ascending; rhachis slightly if at all flexuous, terete, densely ferruginous-lepidote. Floral bracts ovate, acute, shorter than the sepals, nerved, ferruginous-lepidote; flowers suberect to spreading, sessile. Sepals asymmetric, elliptic, broadly rounded, 4-5 mm long, keeled, ferruginous-lepidote; petals conglutinated, 1 mm longer than the sepals, yellow with opaque spots when dry, limb narrow, acute, spreading; stamens included; anthers deltoid-cordate; ovary nearly spherical; style short. Capsule cylindric, acute with a short beak, 18 mm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 2-4 dm high, growing in dense masses. Leaves several in a bulbous rosette, equaling or exceeding the inflorescence, densely appressed-cinereous-lepidote throughout; sheaths ovate, relatively small, forming an ovoid pseudobulb 2-5 cm long, passing gradually into the blades, often conspicuously ciliate-lepidote; blades contorted, linear, involute-subulate, attenuate, 5 mm in diameter at base. Scape erect or ascending, 2 mm in diameter, cinereous-lepidote; scape-bracts like the leaves but smaller and with narrow sheaths which are often shorter than the upper internodes. Inflorescence simple or of 2-4 spikes; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, much shorter than the axillary spike; spikes linear, 4-10 cm long, 12 mm wide, subdensely 6-17-flowered, complanate, appressed-cinereous-lepidote. Floral bracts suberect, loosely imbricate, ovate, acute, 2 cm long, exceeding the sepals, about three times as long as the internodes, ecarinate, subchartaceous, prominently nerved, roseate; flowers subsessile. Sepals lanceolate, acute, to 16 mm long, chartaceous, prominently nerved, cinereous-lepidote, short-connate posteriorly; petals ligulate, 3 cm long, purple; stamens and pistil exserted. Capsule slenderly cylindric, 4 cm long.

description: Plant stemless, 3 dm high. Leaves forming a slightly irregular subutriculate rosette; sheaths scarcely distinct, glabrous toward base; blades narrowly triangular, 75 mm long, 15 mm wide, uncinate-recurved, coarsely pruinose-lepidote. Scape erect, elongate, slender, lepidote; scape-bracts narrow, acute or the lowest laminate, mostly shorter than the internodes, submembranaceous, densely lepidote. Inflorescence simple, lax, 6-flowered, 9 cm long; axis undulate, densely lepidote. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, 14 mm long, shorter than the sepals, ecarinate, slightly incurved toward apex, submembranaceous, red-brown when dry, lepidote; flowers divergent; pedicels stout, 2.5 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, about 15 mm long, glabrous; petals yellow, the blades spreading, 1 cm long, broadly elliptic; stamens deeply included, exceeding the pistil. Capsule cylindric, acuminate, 35 mm long.

description: Plant stemless (?), flowering 75-95 cm high. Leaves 35-50 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, 12-15 cm long, very dark but covered with a glaucous coat of thin appressed whitish scales; blades ligulate, flat, broadly retuse and apiculate, 60-65 mm wide, green and soon glabrous above, densely purple-spotted and subdensely pale-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts strict, elliptic, all but the lowest imbricate, thin. Inflorescence amply and laxly bipinnate, glabrous, red with yellow flowers; primary bracts lance-ovate, acute, to 5 cm long, much shorter than the branches; branches subspreading, to 13 cm long including the very short naked sterile base, lax, the rhachis slender, flexuous. Floral bracts ovate, acute, 15 mm long, always exceeded by the sepals, thin, prominently nerved, ecarinate; flowers spreading; pedicels slenderly obconic, 4 mm long. Sepals narrowly obovate, obtuse, 15 mm long, equally short-connate, ecarinate; petals 20 mm long; stamens included.

description: Plant caulescent; stem to 6 dm long, stout; roots wholly lacking. Leaves densely polystichous, 2 dm long, ferruginous-cinereous, densely and coarsely pruinose- or tomentose-lepidote; sheaths elongate, broadly elliptic, amplexicaul, ochreiform, glabrous inside and below the middle outside; blades very narrowly triangular, 7-9 mm wide, channeled, involute-subulate above the middle, filiform-attenuate, erect or diverging, recurving toward apex. Scape erect, slender, exceeding the leaves, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, tubular-involute, equaling or exceeding the internodes, sublanceolate, acute or apiculate, densely lepidote. Inflorescence depauperate-compound in the type with two much reduced lateral spikes but more often simple and distichous; axes glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, lepidote, much shorter than the axillary spikes; single or principal spike linear or lanceolate, to 75 mm long, 10 mm wide, densely 6-12-flowered; rhachis slightly flexuous, angled. Floral bracts erect, often closely involute about the sepals, not noticeably imbricate, narrowly elliptic, apiculate, 15 mm long, from distinctly shorter than to slightly exceeding the sepals, chartaceous, glabrous or the lowest sparsely lepidote, nerved; pedicels very short and stout. Sepals elliptic, acute or obtuse, 12 mm long, 5 mm wide, even, glabrous, coriaceous, subequally connate to 3 mm; petals 23 mm long, violet, the blades suborbicular; stamens deeply included, exceeding the pistil; anthers linear, acute; ovary elongate, prismatic. Capsule cylindric, abruptly acute.

description: Plants often pulvinate, flowering to 13 cm high; stem short but usually distinct, simple or few-branched; roots present. Leaves densely polystichous, often secund-curved, to 13 cm long but the lower ones much reduced; sheaths triangular, merging imperceptibly into the blades, thin, at least the lower half glabrous and lustrous; blades erect or suberect, very narrowly triangular or linear, abruptly acute, pungent, rigid, channeled above, obtusely carinate beneath, angular-subulate, 3-6 mm wide, covered with closely appressed cinereous scales. Scape from practically none to 6 cm long, exceeded by the leaves, erect or ascending, glabrous; scape-bracts imbricate and concealing the scape, lanceolate, acuminate, stramineous, chartaceous, strongly nerved, glabrous. Inflorescence always simple, broadly lanceolate or oblanceolate, strongly complanate, to 45 mm long and 15 mm wide, 4-7-flowered, glabrous throughout; rhachis nearly straight, strongly 4-angled. Floral bracts imbricate but narrow and exposing the rhachis, lanceolate, acuminate, to 25 mm long, much exceeding the sepals, subcoriaceous, even or somewhat nerved, ecarinate, red, sublustrous; flowers subsessile. Sepals narrowly lance-triangular, acuminate, 12-18 mm long, free, subequal, the posterior carinate; petals narrow with scarcely distinct suberect to spreading blades, ca 30 mm long, obtuse, entire, bright rose-red; stamens ca 20 mm long, shorter than the pistil, filaments thickened and transversely plicate, anthers linear, 5 mm long; ovary subprismatic. Capsule cylindric, beaked, 20 mm long.

description: Plant 25 cm high; stem rhizomatous, curved, very short but often branched. Leaves many in a dense rosette, spreading, 6-9 cm long, densely white- or ferruginous-lepidote with appressed to slightly spreading basally produced scales; sheaths subtriangular, small, scarcely distinct from the blade; blades linear-subulate, filiform-attenuate, rigid, 2 mm wide at base. Scape erect or ascending, exceeding the leaves, 1 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, partially clasping the scape, exceeding the internodes or the uppermost sometimes slightly shorter, ovate, abruptly acute or caudate, 8 mm long without the caudate apex, chartaceous, prominently nerved, at least the lowest densely appressed-lepidote. Inflorescence simple, 7 cm long, lax, 6-8-flowered; rhachis geniculate, slender, angled, glabrous. Floral bracts subspreading, equaling or shorter than the internodes, broadly elliptic, acute or apiculate, 11 mm long, much shorter than the sepals, ecarinate, membranaceous, densely appressed-lepidote; flowers subspreading; pedicels distinct, stout, 2-5 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 14 mm long, 5 mm wide, submembranaceous, prominently nerved, appressed-lepidote, becoming glabrous with age, free; petals ligulate, obtuse, 3 cm long, bright red; stamens exserted, shorter than the pistil. Capsule 4-5 cm long, slender, acute.

description: Dioecious, much-branched shrub 0.3-1 m tall, with grayish rimóse bark, with persisting naked twigs, young branches terete, tomentose. Leaves subsessile, stipular lines inconspicuous, axils with fascicles of smaller leaves, blades linear to oblong, 1.5-3.5 x 0.3 0.5 cm, subcoriaceous, densely short tomentose on both surfaces, underlain by glandular trichomes, venation pattern obvious below; apex rounded, base attenuate, margin involute, crenate to undulate. Inflorescence 4-12 cm long, consisting of 3-7 pairs of heads forming verticels, subtended by progressively shorter pairs of leaves, each verticel 0.8-1.3 cm diam. with 15-30 flowers. Calyx campanulate, tomentose and glandular outside, tube 2.5-3.5 mm long, lobes acute, 1-2 mm long. Corolla light yellow, salverform, outside tomentose and glandular on upper two-thirds, inside with scattered warty hairs primarily below stamens, small glandular trichomes in rows above stamens, tube 4-5 mm long, lobes orbicular, 1-1.2 x 1.5-1.7 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted 1.5-1.7 mm below sinus, anthers 0.6-1 mm long. Ovary 1-1.5 mm long, stigma 0.5-1 mm long, clavate, obscurely two-lipped. Capsule ovoid, 2-2.5 x 1.3-1.5 mm, tomentulose near apex, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally, valves becoming recurved. Seeds type 5, ellipsoid, 0.4-0.5 x 0.2-0.3 mm, wingless, seed body filling seed coat.

description: Dioecious shrub 0.5-3(-5) m tall, with gray fissured bark, young branches terete, covered with tomentum. Lower leaves with petioles 0.5-2 cm long, stipular lines conspicuous, blades oblong to ovate, 8-15 x 2.5 5.5 cm, subcoriaceous, above glabrescent more rarely tomentose or tomentulose with numerous glandular trichomes, below tomentose to lanose; apex acute to attenuate, base cunéate to subtruncate, often decurrent, margin entire to coarsely serrate; upper leaves with petioles 0.5-1 cm long, blades lanceolate to elliptic, 3-11 x 1-4 cm, margin entire; flowers borne in hemispheric heads in axils of progressively smaller leaves, 5-20 pairs of heads per branch, heads with peduncle 0-0.5 cm long, upper peduncles shorter, each head 0.9-1.5 cm diam. with 5-20 flowers. Calyx tubular, tomentose outside, tube 2.2-3 mm long, lobes 0.6-1 mm long, often irregular. Corolla yellowish orange, subsalverform to subfunnelform, tomentose outside, inside with warty hairs in upper part of tube, tube 3.5-5 mm long, lobes suborbicular, 1.5-2 x 1.5-2.5 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted 1 mm below sinus, anthers 1-1.5 mm long. Ovary 1-2.5 mm long, tomentose on upper half, style 1.5-3 mm long, stigma clavate, 1-0.5 mm long. Capsule cylindrical, 3.5-5 x 1.5-2 mm, puberulent on upper half, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally only at apex, valves acute, recurved. Seeds type 5, fusiform, 0.6-1 x 0.25-3 mm, wingless, seed body 0.6-0.9 mm long. 2n = 38.

description: Shrub 0.5-2 m tall, with grayish fissured bark near base, young branches quadrangular, covered with grayish tomentum. Leaves mostly subsessile, sometimes with petiole to 1 cm long, more rarely subamplexicaul, stipules forming a conspicuous line, blades lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, 8-18 x 2-6 cm, membranaceous, above tomentulose, below tomentose; apex acuminate, base ovate or narrowly connate, margin crenate. Inflorescence 5-20 cm long with 6-12 pairs of axillary cymes, sometimes appearing spicate due to short internodes, each pair of cymules in the axils of progressively smaller leaves. Each cyme with 6-13 sessile flowers, subtended by several small bracts, basal cyme short pedunculate, others sessile. Calyx tubular, tomentose, tube 5-7 mm long, lobes acuminate, 2.5-3.5 x 1.5-2 mm. Corolla orange outside, deep yellow within, tubular, tomentose on outside surface, inside glabrous except for ring of warty hairs 3 mm above base of tube, tube 13-16 mm long, lobes erect, elliptic 1.5-2.5 x 2 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted approximately 2 mm below sinus, anthers 1.5 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 2.5-3 mm long, tomentulose and glandular, style 13-25 mm long, stigma subglobose, 0.7 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, 5-7 x 2.5-3 mm tomentulose, pericarp thin opening septicidally, loculicidally only at apex, valves acute. Seeds type 6 oblong, 0.7-0.8 x 0.3-0.4 mm, spongy at funicular end, seed body 0.6 mm long. 2n = 38.

description: Plant caulescent; roots sometimes present; stem prostrate, branching, over 12 cm long. Leaves densely polystichous, 6-7 cm long, covered with cinereous subappressed black-centered scales; sheaths ovate, small and almost indistinguishable; blades spreading, very narrowly triangular, filiform-attenuate, 6 mm wide, involute on drying. Scape almost none. Inflorescence simple, lanceolate, acute, complanate, 25-40 mm long, 10-13 mm wide, densely few-flowered. Floral bracts imbricate and wholly covering the rhachis, ovate, acute, 14 mm long, about equaling the sepals, carinate, coriaceous, almost wholly even, red, glabrous or with a few scales at apex, lustrous; flowers subsessile. Sepals lanceolate, cucullate, 12 mm long, the posterior more than half connate; petals exceeding the stamens.

description: Dioecious shrub l-2.5(-4) m tall, with gray fissured bark, with persisting naked branches, young branches yellow, terete, tomentulose and glandular. Leaves sessile, stipular line inconspicuous, blades elliptic to oblong, 0.5-3 x 0.2-0.5(-l) cm, subcoriaceous, above tomentulose and glandular to glabres-cent, below tomentose; apex acute or rounded, base obtuse or cuneate, margin entire. Inflorescence with 1 terminal and 2-7 pairs of verticillate or short pedunculate heads in axils of upper leaves, each head 0.8-1.2 cm diam. with 6-20 flowers. Calyx tubular, tomentose outside, tube 1.5-2 mm, lobes 1-1.5 mm long, acuminate. Corolla yellowish-orange, tubular salverform, tomentose on outer surface of tube, inside with scattered warty hairs in tube below insertion of stamens, tube 5-5.5 mm long, lobes orbicular 1.5-2 x 2-2.5 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted 1-2 mm below sinus, anthers 1-1.2 mm long. Ovary 1.5-2 mm long, tomentose, style 2-3 mm long, stigma clavate, 1-1.5 mm long. Capsule ovoid, 4-5 x 2.5-3 mm, tomentose, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 5, ellipsoid, 0.7-0.9 x 0.3-0.35 mm, seed body filling testa.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 6-8 dm long. Leaves numerous in a funnelform rosette, 25-50 cm long, covered with appressed, cinereous brown-centered scales; sheaths elliptic, 25 cm long, 10 cm wide, deep maroon; blades attenuate, flat, 2-5 cm wide, green. Scape arching-decurved, 15 mm thick; scape-bracts densely imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper elliptic, deep maroon, bearing a short attenuate recurved green blade. Inflorescence compact at apex, primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, many times shorter than the spikes; spikes few, pendulous, lance-oblong, acute, strongly complanate, 9-17 cm long, 2.5-5 cm wide, densely 13-17-flowered. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, acute, 4 cm long, exceeding the sepals, carinate, coriaceous, glabrous, lustrous, yellow-green with maroon-red margins; pedicels stout, 4 mm long. Sepals elliptic, to 32 mm long, free, carinate, thin-coriaceous, sparsely lepidote; petals 6 cm long, blade deep purple; stamens included.

description: Shrub 1-2(-3) m, with light brown fissured bark, nodes very close together, young branches thick, sub-quandrangular with pale yellow thick tomentum. Leaves with petioles 1-3.5 cm long, stipular line well-marked, blades elliptic to lanceolate, 10-18 x 2-4 cm, subcoriaceous, above glabrescent, below with thick tomentum; apex acuminate, base attenuate, margin subentire to serrulate. Inflorescence 10-20 cm long, with 1-2 orders of branches, flowers borne in paired 3-flowered cymes, peduncles 1-3 cm long, subtended by progressivly smaller leaves, pedicels 0.5-1 cm long. Calyx tubular, thickly tomentose outside, tube 8-12 mm long, lobes 4-5 mm long, triangular. Corolla reddish orange, tubular, tomentose on outside surface except on lobes, sometimes with glandular trichomes in this area, glabrous within, tube 25-30 x 4 mm, lobes 3-3.5 x 4-5 mm, orbicular, subcrenulate. Stamens sessile, inserted near sinus, anthers 2.5-3 mm long. Ovary 6-8 mm long, tomentose, style 17-22 mm long, tomentose on the lower third of its length, stigma globose, 0.5 mm long. Capsule narrowly ovoid, thickly tomentose throughout, 12-13 x 4-5 mm, dehiscing septicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 2, oblong, truncate at both ends, 1-1.2 x 0.35-0.4 mm, testa loosely fitting around seed body, embryo 0.6-0.7 mm long. 2n = 38.

description: Dioecious tree or shrub 5-6 m tall, young branches yellowish brown, quadrangular, youngest portions tomentose. Leaves with petiole 0.5-1 cm long, stipular lines conspicuous, blades lanceolate to elliptic, 7-14 x 2-4 cm, membranceous, above glabrous except for youngest leaves, below tomentose to tomentulose; apex and base acuminate, margin entire. Inflorescence paniculate, 12-15 x 10-15 cm with 2-3 orders of branches, the 2 basal pairs of branches subtended by leaves, upper and secondary branches subtended by bracts or bracteoles; flowers sessile or subsessile, disposed in cymes of 6-9 flowers on peduncles 0.5-1 cm long, central flower often pedicellate. Calyx tubular or campanulate, tomentose, tube 2-2.6 mm, lobes acute to acuminate, 0.8-1.6 mm long. Corolla orange, funnelform, tomentose on outside surface, inside with few scattered warty hairs near insertion of stamens until sinus, tube 3.5-4 mm long, lobes oblong to suborbicular, 1.5-2 x 1.4-1.7 mm. Stamens inserted 0.6-0.8 mm below sinus, filaments up to 0.3 mm long, anthers 0.8-1 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 1.4-2.2 mm, tomentose, style 0.9-1.7 mm long, stigma clavate, 0.8-1.2 mm long. Fruits not available.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 25-30 cm high. Leaves suberect, 15-22 cm long, covered with appressed cinereous brown-centered scales; sheaths broadly ovate, 6-9 cm long, castaneous; blades narrowly triangular, 15 mm wide. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts imbricate, foliaceous. Inflorescence bipinnate, ovoid, dense at apex, usually lax below, bright red; primary bracts broadly ovate, lepidote, the lower exceeding the spikes at least by their caudate blades; spikes subsessile, lanceolate, 25-35 mm long, complanate, 5-6-flowered. Floral bracts laxly imbricate and exposing the rhachis, oblong-ovate, 12-15 mm long, exceeding the sepals, carinate, incurved, thin, strongly nerved, soon glabrous; flowers subsessile. Sepals oblong, obtuse, to 12 mm long, sparsely lepidote or glabrous, nerved, much connate posteriorly; petals oblong, obtuse, white; stamens included.

description: Shrub, young branches subquadrangular with appressed tomentum. Leaves with petiole 0.5-1.5 cm long, stipular lines apparent, blades oblong-elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, 2-4 x 0.5-1.2 cm, membranaceous, above tomentulose, below appressed tomentose; apex acuminate, base attenuate, margin somewhat revolute, entire or irregularly serrulate; many small crowded leaves in axils of larger ones. Inflorescence 5-10 x 1.5-3 cm, with 8-10 pairs of sessile or pendunculate heads, basal nodes often with lateral branches, 5-9 flowers per heads, each head 0.6-0.7 cm diam., subtended by small bracts. Calyx campanulate, outside tomentulose, tube 1-1.5 mm long, lobes broadly triangular 0.5-1 mm long. Corolla funnelform, tomentulose outside, with scattered warty hairs in upper half of tube, tube 2-3 mm long, lobes ovate obtuse at apex, 1.5-1.7 x 1.6-1.7 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted near sinus, anthers 0.7 mm long. Ovary 1.5 mm long, tomentulose, style 1-1.2 mm long, stigma clavate, 0.7 mm long. Capsule ovoid, 2.5-3 x 1.2-1.4 mm tomentulose, opening septicidally, loculicidally only at apex. Seeds (immature), up to 1 x 0.3 mm, probably winged.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Trioecious shrub or small tree 1.5-5 m tall, trunk to 7 cm diam., with yellowish brown fissured bark, young branches subquadrangular, yellowish, youngest portions tomentose. Basal leaves with petiole 1-4 cm long, stipular lines evident, blades ovate 9-23 x 5-14 cm, membranaceous, above glabrescent, below tomentulose; apex acute or acuminate, base attenuate to obtuse, decurrent, margin serrate, doubly serrate, crenate or dentate; upper leaves subsessile or with petiole to 1 cm long, blades lanceolate or narrowly elliptic, 5-15 x 1.5-3 cm, tomentulose to glabrescent above, tomentose to tomentulose beneath; apex acute, base attenuate, decurrent, margin entire or irregularly serrulate. Inflorescence 6-25 cm long, sometimes branched at base, flowers in sessile or short pedunculate heads or pseudoverticels, each head 1-3 cm diam. with 10-35 flowers, subtended by progressively shorter leaves or bracts. Calyx campanulate, tomentose outside, tube 1.7-3 mm long, lobes 1-1.8 mm long, acute. Corolla yellow, funnelform, tomentose outside with abundant warty hairs in upper half of tube and base of lobes, tube 3.2-4.2 mm long, lobes ovate, obtuse, 1-1.5 x 1.2-1.7 mm. Stamens with filaments 0.3-0.5 mm long, inserted 1 mm below sinus, anthers 0.8-1.2 mm long. Ovary 1-1.5 mm long, upper half tomentose, style 1-1.5 mm long, stigma clavate, 1.2-1.4 mm long. Capsule cylindrical, thin-textured, 4-4.5 x 1.7-2 mm, tomentulose at apex, opening septicidally, loculicidally only at apex, valves rounded. Seeds type 2, 0.8-1.2 x 0.3-0.35 mm, fusiform, winged, seed body 0.4-0.6 mm long. 2n = 76.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious shrub, 0.3-1.2 m tall, densely branched and aromatic, with brownish or grayish shredding bark, young branches subquadrangular, tomentose and glandular, old naked branches sometimes persisting. Leaves sessile, stipular lines faint, blades oblong to linear, 1-3 x 0.3-0.8 cm, membranaceous to subcoriaceous, rugose above, tomentose and glandular on both surfaces; apex obtuse, base cuneate or attenuate, margin coarsely crenate. Inflorescence 2-10 cm long, of 3-15 pairs of sessile clusters, forming pseudoverticels, near tip of branches subtended by leaves, each pseudoverticel 0.4-0.7 cm diam. with 15-20 flowers having odor of sage. Calyx campanu-late, thickly tomentose outside, tube 1.5-1.8 mm long, lobes 0.2-0.5 mm long, obtuse. Corolla lemon yellow, funnelform, lobes erect, outside tomentose-glandular on upper half, inside glabrous, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes 1-1.5 x 0.5-0.9 mm, oblong, acutish. Stamens subsessile inserted at sinus, anthers 0.4-0.8 mm long. Ovary 0.5-1 mm long, style 1-1.5 mm, stigma clavate, slightly 2-lipped, 0.3-0.5 mm long. Capsule subglobose, 1.5-2.5 x 1.5 mm, densely glandular tomentulose at apex, indehiscent in widening calyx. Seeds type 7, 0.7-0.8 x 0.5-06 mm, ovoid, wingless, seed body filling seed coat. 2n = 38.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Trioecious shrub or small tree 1-3 m tall, with blackish fissured bark, young branches subquadrangular, tomentulose. Leaves with petioles 0.5-2 cm long, stipular lines evident, blades lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 9-15 x 3.5-7 cm, membranaceous, above glabrescent with glandular trichomes, below tomentulose and glandular; apex acuminate, base long attenuate, decurrent, margin serrulate except at base. Inflorescence 10-25 x 10-15(-20) cm, paniculate, with 2 orders of branches, basal ones subtended by leaves, the upper by linear bracts; flowers borne in subsessile cymules, 0.7-1 cm diam. with (1—)3—5(—10) flowers. Calyx campanulate, outside tomentose, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes triangular, 0.7-1 x 1-1.4 mm. Corolla pale yellow, funnelform, lobes erect, tomentose outside, with warty hairs in upper part of tube and base of lobes, tube 2-3 mm long, lobes rounded at apex, 1.5-1.8 x 1.5-2 mm. Stamens inserted 1 mm below sinus, filaments 0.3-0.5 mm long, anthers 0.7-1 mm long. Ovary 1.5-2 mm long, tomentose and glandular, style 0.7-0.8 mm long, stigma rod-shaped, 0.8-1 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, 3.5-5 x 1.7-2 mm, with glandular trichomes, sparsely tomentulose. Seeds type 3, 0.9-1 x 0.2-0.3 mm, fusiform, winged, seed body 0.6-0.7 x 0.2 mm. 2n = 114, 152.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Plant caulescent, flowering 15-30 cm long; stem simple or few-branched; roots with enlarged apices which fix them to rocks. Leaves densely polystichous along the stem, all secund-curved, 3-7 cm long; sheaths short, broadly triangular, white, glabrous at base; blades rigid, subterete, attenuate to a pungent apex, carinate, covered with fine appressed pale brown-centered scales. Scape ascending, slender, exceeding the leaves, glabrous; scape-bracts imbricate, elliptic or obovate, membranaceous, rose, bearing thick linear lepidote blades. Inflorescence simple with 5-12 polystichous flowers, 3-5 cm long, sublax. Floral bracts ovate, acute, exceeding the sepals, membranaceous, rose, glabrous; flowers erect to divergent. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 12-15 mm long, posteriorly high-connate; petals 20-30 mm long, white, the blades narrow, rounded; stamens included; filaments lightly plicate near apex. Capsule cylindric, to 25 mm long.

description: Dioecious shrub, 2 m tall with shredding brownish bark, the young branches tomentose, somewhat quadrangular. Leaves subsessile, the stipules reduced to a line, the blade oblanceolate, 1.5-3 cm x 0.7-1.2 cm, subcoriaceous, above with tomentum interspersed with glandular trichomes, belo v thickly tomentose; apex obtuse, base attenuate, margin sinuate-crenate. Inflorescence 3-8 cm long, with 1-2 orders of branches; flowers borne in pairs of lax cymose clusters, subtended by reduced leaves, sometimes cymes reduced to 1-2 flowers, pedicels 1-2 mm long. Calyx tubular, leathery, tomentose outside and on inner apex of lobes, tube 2.5-3.5 mm long, lobes acute 0.5 mm long. Corolla white, tubular, tomentose outside, with prominent glandular trichomes on outside of lobes, with very few scattered warty hairs on inner surface below stamens, tube 3-3.5 mm long. Stamens sessile, inserted 1.5 mm below sinus, anthers 0.5-0.7 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 2-3 mm long, tomentose, style 2-3 mm long, stigma globose, 0.5 mm long. Capsule narrowly ellipsoid, tomentose. No pollen or mature seeds seen.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious, lax, often hanging shrub 0.3-1.5 m tall, with grayish-brown rimóse bark, with persisting old branches, young branches terete, tomentose and glandular. Leaves with petiole 0.5-2 cm long, stipular lines inconspicuous, blade ovate-oblong to lanceolate 3-8(-10) x 1.5-3(-4) cm, membranaceous to subcoriaceous, above glabrous or glabrescent, below appressed tomentose or with only a few stellate hairs, always with conspicuous glandular trichomes; apex acute, base hastate, cuneate, or truncate, margin irregularly dentate, crenate, or subentire. Inflorescence 830 cm long, sometimes once branched at base, of (4-) 8-12(-28) pairs of pedunculate or sessile heads subtended by short linear bracts, heads 0.5-0.7 cm diam., usually with 6-12 flowers. Calyx campanulate, tomentose and glandular outside, tube 1-1.7 mm long, lobes acute, 0.5-0.8 mm long. Corolla pale yellow, campanulate-rotate, outside tomentose in upper half of tube, with numerous glandular trichomes at base of lobes, inside with warty hairs in upper two-thirds of tube, tube 1.5-2.5 mm long, lobes orbicular, 0.7-1 x 1.5-1.5 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted in upper third of tube, anthers 0.4-0.8 mm long. Ovary 0.71.2 mm, glandular and tomentose, style 0.5-1 mm long, stigma 0.5-0.7 mm long, clavate, 2-lipped. Capsule ovoid, 2-2.5 x 1.7-2 mm, glandular and tomentulose, opening septicidally and loculicidally, the valves remaining appressed. Seeds type 5, ellipsoid, 0.5-0.6 x 0.2-0.25 mm, without wings, seed body filling seed coat.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious shrub or tree 3-6 m tall, with blackish fissured bark, older trees with gnarled appearance, young branches terete with thick tomentum. Leaves sessile or subsessile, petiole to 0.5 cm long, with stip-ular lines or auriculate stipules, 1-1.5 x 1.8-2 cm in young shoots, blades lanceolate, 3—10(—15) x 0.7-3 (-5.5) cm, coriaceous or subcoriaceous, above glabres-cent, below with thick tomentum, usually only midvein visible; apex acuminate, base acute to acuminate, margin entire to crenulate. Inflorescence 3-12 cm long, with 1-2 orders of branches, usually with 3-6 pairs of pedunculate heads, sometimes basal branches divided, basal branches subtended by leaves, upper ones by bracts; heads recurved, subtended by bracteoles with one central pedicellate flower surrounded by 12-18 flowers, 1.2-2 cm diam. Calyx campanulate, densely wooly outside, tube 3.5-^4 mm long, lobes 1.5—2(—3) mm, sometimes unequal. Corolla golden yellow, turning orange, subsalverform, outside thickly tomentose on upper part of tube, glabrous inside, tube 3-5 mm long, lobes orbicular, 2-3 x 2.5-3 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted 1-1.5 mm below sinus, anthers 1.2-2 mm long. Ovary 1.5-2.5 mm long, tomentose, style 1-2 mm long, stigma clavate, 0.7-1 mm long. Capsule cylindrical, 7-9 x 2-2.5 mm, tomentose, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally at apex, valves acute. Seeds type 3, oblong, 2-2.5 x 0.4-0.5 mm, with wings, seed body 0.9-1.3 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious shrub 0.8-2 m tall, much-branched, with grayish-black shredding bark, young branches subquadrangular, tomentose and glandular. Leaves sessile, stipular lines evident, blades lanceolate to elliptic, 3-8 x 1-2.5 cm, subcoriaceous, rugose above, with thick felt-like tomentum on both surfaces, underlain by glandular trichomes, venation prominent on lower surface; apex acute, base connate-perfoliate to attenuate, margin finely crenulate. Inflorescence (5-)8~15(-25) cm long, consisting of 5-26 pairs of pedunculate to subsessile heads borne in axils of leaves, heads subtended by a pair of small bracts, each head 0.8-1.2 cm diam., with 30-40 flowers. Calyx campanulate, densely wooly outside, tube 1.5-2.5 mm long, lobes 0.1-0.5 mm, obtuse, tomentum exceeding tip of lobes by 1-1.5 mm. Corolla yellow with odor of sage, tubular-funnelform, lobes erect, outside tomentose on upper half, inside glabrous, tube 2.5-3.5 mm long, lobes oblong, acute, 1-1.5 x 0.8-1 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted 0.3-0.5 mm below sinus, anthers 0.5-0.9 mm long. Ovary 1-1.5 mm long, tomentose on upper portion, style 1.5-2.5 mm long, stigma clavellate, slightly 2-lipped, 0.5-0.8 mm long. Capsule narrowly ellipsoid, 2.6-3 x 1.4-2 mm, tomentulose at apex, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally, valves acute, recurved. Seeds type 5, 0.6-0.8 x 0.3-0.4 mm, ellipsoid, wingless. 2n = 38.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious shrub, bark dark brown, longitudinally fissured, young branches, quadrangular. Leaves sessile, stipules reduced to a line, the blades elliptic-oblong, 6—12(—15) x 0.8-2(-3) cm broad, membranaceous, above glabrous or subglabrous, sometimes glauces-cent, below glabrescent, with scattered stellate hairs, especially on the veins, sometimes intermixed with glandular trichomes; apex acuminate, base attenuate, upper margin crenulate to serrulate. Inflorescence 4-10 cm long, of 4-8 pairs of sessile or subsessile heads in axils of reduced leaves, each head 0.7-1.5 cm diam. with 5-9 flowers. Calyx tubular with scattered stellate hairs, intermixed with glandular trichomes, tube 3-4 mm long, lobes 1.5-2 mm long, acuminate. Corolla white, subsalverform, tomentulose on outside surface, with scattered warty hairs on inner surface in upper 2/3 of tube, the tube 4.5-5.5 mm long, lobes orbicular 1.5-2 x 1.7-2 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted near throat, 0.5-1 mm long. Ovary 2-2.5 mm long, tomentulose and glandular, style 3.5-4 mm long, stigma globose, 0.5 mm long. Capsule ovoid, 4-5 x 2.5-3 mm, with many glandular trichomes and few stellate hairs, dehiscing primarily septicidally, loculicidally at apex, valves acute. Seeds type 4, quadrangular, spongy, 1 x 0.5-0.6 mm broad without wings, seed body 0.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious shrub or tree 4-10(-15) m tall, up to 60 cm diam. at base with dense rounded crown, brown to black exfoliating bark, young branches subquadrangular, tomentose. Leaves with petiole (0.5-)1-2(-3) cm long, stipular lines evident, blades oblong-lanceolate, 3-10 x 1-3.5 cm (or in dwarfed form 1 x 0.5 cm), subcoriaceous, above glabrescent, below with strongly appressed tomentum; apex acute to long acuminate, base obtuse, margin entire, rarely serrulate. Inflorescence 3-8(-14) x 3-7(-10) cm, paniculate, with 3-4 orders of branches, basal branches subtended by leaves, others by small bracts, flowers grouped into 3-5 flowered cymules, 5-7 mm diam., pedicels 0-2 mm long. Calyx tubular-campanulate, tomentose outside, tube 1-1.7 mm long, lobes broadly triangular, obtuse, 0.5-0.7 mm long. Corolla yellow maturing to orange, campanulate-funnelform, tomentose outside, inside with warty hairs in throat and on lower part of lobes, tube 2.5-3 mm long, lobes ovate-oblong, 1.2-2 x 1.5-1.8 mm, rounded at tip. Stamens subsessile, inserted just below sinus, anthers 0.6-1 mm long. Ovary 1-1.5 mm long, tomentulose on upper portion, style 1-1.5 mm long, stigma clavate, obscurely 2-lipped, 0.5-0.8 mm long. Capsule oblong or ellipsoid, 4-5 x 2-2.5 mm, tomentose, opening septicidally for most of its length, loculicidally at apex, valves acute. Seeds type 2, 1.2-1.7 x 0.3-0.35 mm, fusiform, winged, seed body 0.6-0.75 mm long. 2n = 76.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious scrambling shrub 1-4 m tall, branches quadrangular, tomentose. Leaves sessile or subsessile with stipular lines or with auriculate stipules 0.8-1 x 0.5-0.7 cm, blades elliptic to lanceolate, 10-20 x 3.5-7.5 cm, membranaceous, above glabrescent, below glabrescent, tomentulose, or sublanate; apex acute to acuminate, base attenuate, margin crenate to serrate. Inflorescence 10-20 x 7-12 cm, paniculate with 2-3 orders of branches, branches subtended by leaves below, linear bracts above and on secondary and tertiary branches; flowers mostly subsessile, central flower sometimes pedicellate, borne in cymules 1-1.5 cm diam. at tip of branches. Calyx campanulate, tomentose outside, tube 1.5-3 mm long, lobes 1-1.5 mm, acute. Corolla yellowish-orange to red, darkening at maturity, funnelform, tomentulose outside, with warty hairs in upper half of tube and base of lobes, tube 3—4.5 mm long, lobes broadly ovate 1-2 x 1.5-2.5 mm. Stamens inserted 1-1.5 mm below sinus, filaments 0.2-1 mm long. Capsule fusiform, 5.5-6 x 2 mm, tomentulose, opening septicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 2, oblong, 2-2.5 x 0.3-0.4 mm, with wings.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious shrub or small tree 2-5(-8) m tall, with gray, rimóse bark, young branches subquadrangular, tomentose. Leaves with petiole 0.4-0.7 cm long, with well marked stipular lines, blades oblong to elliptic, 3-8 x 0.5-1.5 cm, coriaceous, above tomentulose to glabrescent, usually dull (in dry condition) with very fine reticulation above, below thickly tomentose, midvein conspicuous; apex acuminate or acute, base obtuse, margin entire. Inflorescence paniculate, with 1-2 orders of branches, 3-7 x 2-6 cm, flowers in small cymules, pedicels 0.5-1.5 mm. Calyx campanulate, tomentose outside, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes 1.5-2 mm long, acute to acuminate. Corolla deep yellow turning orange, campanulate, tomentose outside, inside with a few warty hairs near sinus, tube 2.7-3.5 mm, lobes orbicular, 2-2.5 x 2-3 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted 1.2-1.5 mm below sinus, anthers 1-1.5 mm long. Ovary 1.2-2 mm long, tomentose, style 0.7-1.2 mm long, stigma clavate to subglobose, 0.4-0.6 mm long. Capsule oblong-ovoid, 5.5-6.5 x 2.5-3 mm, tomentose, dehiscing primarily septicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 2, oblong, 1.5-2.5 x 0.4-0.5 mm, with wings, seed body 1.1-1.6 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious shrub 1-2 m tall, with tannish fissured bark, young branches subquadrangular with thick tomentum. Leaves sessile, blades lanceolate to elliptic, 5.5-10 x 1.5-4 cm, above lanose, below thickly lanose; apex acute, base connate-perfoliate, often au-riculate, margin crenulate to subentire. Inflorescence 15-30 cm long, with 1 order of branches; flowers sessile, borne on 5-15 pairs of pedunculate or subsessile heads in axils of progressively smaller leaves, each head 1-1.5 cm diam. with 20 or more flowers, peduncles to 2.5 cm long. Calyx tubular, densely lanate outside, tube 3-3.8 mm long, lobes 2-2.5 mm long, long acuminate. Corolla yellow, tubular, to subfun-nelform with thick tomentum outside, with warty hairs on inner surface in upper half of tube, tube 4.5-5 mm long, lobes oblong, 2-2.5 x 1.2-1.5 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted near sinus, anthers 0.7-1 mm. Ovary 1.5-2.5 mm long, thickly tomentose except at the base, style 3.5-4.5 mm long, stigma capitate, 0.5-0.7 mm long. Capsule narrowly ellipsoid, 6-7.5 x 2.5-3 mm, tomentulose on upper half, dehiscing septicidally, the valves acute. Seeds type 6, oblong, 0.7-0.9 x 0.2-0.3 mm, wingless, funicular end spongy, seed body 0.7 mm long.

description: Dioecious shrub 0.2-2 m tall, the bark grayish, young branches subterete, tomentose. Leaves quite variable, petioles to 1 cm long, stipular lines marked, blades linear to oblong-lanceolate, or ovate, 0.5-5(-8) x 0.2-2 cm, subcoriaceous to membranaceous, above glabrescent to tomentose, glandular trichomes often conspicuous, below tomentose to lanose; apex acute to acuminate, base decurrent, obtuse or hastate, margin entire, sinuate, or serrate. Inflorescence of 2-5 pairs of small heads in the axils of upper or subterminal leaves. Heads sessile or short pedunculate with 1-5 sessile or subsessile flowers. Calyx tubular, tomentose outside, tube 2-3 mm long, lobes acute, 0.8-1.5 mm long. Corolla yellowish to orange, subsalverform, tomentose outside, inside with warty hairs in upper part of tube, the tube 3.5-4.5 mm long, lobes suborbicular, 1.2-2 x 1.2-2 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted 1 mm below sinus, anthers 1-1.2 mm long. Ovary 1.5-2 mm, tomentose, style 1.5-3 mm long, stigma clavate, 0.7-1.2 mm long. Capsule cylindrical, 3.5-5 x 2-3 mm, tomentulose and glandular, dehiscing septicidally, loculicidally at apex, valves acute. Seeds type 5, fusiform, 0.7-0.9 x 0.3-0.41 mm long, wingless, embryonic mass 0.6-0.9 mm long. 2n = 38.

description: Leaves 6 dm long, densely and minutely appressed-lepidote; sheaths large, castaneous; blades very narrowly triangular. Inflorescence bipinnate, axis 8 mm in diameter, the internodes 15-20 mm long; primary bracts ovate with a caudate apex, much shorter than the sterile base of the spike, cinereous-lepidote; spikes strict, long-stipitate with many imbricate sterile bracts. Floral bracts more than twice as long as the internodes but divergent and not at all imbricate, elliptic, carinate, incurved, 28 mm long, distinctly exceeded by the sepals, subcoriaceous, sulcate, glabrous; pedicels 2 mm long. Sepals free, lanceolate, 28 mm long, the posterior ones carinate with the keel decurrent on the pedicel; petals 4 cm long; stamens included.

description: Dioecious tree 5-12(-15) m tall, trunk to 65 cm diam. at base with brownish fissured bark, young branches stout, quadrangular, thickly tomentose. Leaves with petiole 1-2 cm long, stipular lines conspicuous, blades lanceolate or elliptic-oblong, 7-20 x 2-6 cm, subcoriaceous, glabrescent above, below with dense tomentum; apex acute to acuminate, base obtuse or acute, margin entire. Inflorescence 6-20 x 8-10 with heads in racemes, sometimes with 2 orders of branches, the terminal head often poorly developed, lower branches subtended by leaves, the upper by linear bracts, bracts also sometimes halfway up peduncle, heads 1.2-2 cm diam. with 40-50 flowers. Calyx tubular, densely tomentose outside, tube 1.5-2.5 mm long, lobes narrowly triangular, acuminate, 1.5-2 mm long. Corolla deep orange inside, paler outside, tubular funnel form, outside tomentulose on lobes, with few scattered warty hairs in upper part of tube, tube 4-5 mm long, lobes orbicular, 2-2.5 x 2.5-3 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted ca. 1 mm below sinus, anthers 0.7-1 mm long. Ovary 1.5-2 mm long, tomentulose, style 1.5-3 mm long, stigma clavate, 1 mm long. Capsule narrowly ellipsoid, 4.5-6 x 2-2.5 mm, tomentulose or glabrescent, dehiscing primarily septicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 2, 1.5-2 x 0.35-0.45 mm, fusiform, prominently winged, seed body 0.6-0.9 mm long. 2n = 76.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious much-branched shrub 0.5-2 m tall, with grayish to blackish rimose bark, with persisting old naked twigs, young branches terete, tomentose. Leaves short-petiolate, stipular lines inconspicuous, blades ovate to rhomboid, l-3(-6) x 0.6-1.5(-2.5) cm, membranaceous, or subcoriaceous, densely tomentose on both surfaces, underlain by glandular trichomes, venation pattern obvious below; apex obtuse or rounded, base cuneate, acute, or attenuate, margin crenate. Inflorescence with 1 globose terminal head, head 0.8-1.2 cm diam. with ca. 35 flowers subtended by a pair of bracts. Calyx campanulate, tomentulose and glandular outside, tube 2-3.5 mm long, lobes obtuse, 1-1.5 mm long. Corolla deep yellow, turning orange, salverform, outside tomentulose on upper third of tube, with glandular trichomes and tomentum at base of lobes, inside with scattered warty hairs primarily below the insertion of the stamens, small glandular trichomes in rows above stamens, tube 3-4.5 mm long, lobes orbicular, 1-1.5 x 1.5-2 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted in upper third of tube, anthers 0.6-1 mm long. Ovary 1-1.5 mm long, tomentose and glandular on upper half, style 1-2 mm long, stigma 0.6-1 mm long, clavate, two-lipped. Capsule oblong-ovoid, 3-4 x 1.52 mm tomentulose and glandular at apex, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally, valves remaining incurved. Seeds type 5, narrowly ellipsoid, 1-1.3 x 0.20.3 mm with wing 0.1-0.15 mm at chalazal end, seed body 0.9-1.1 mm long. 2n = 38.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Plant pulvinate; stem less than 25 mm long; roots present. Leaves distichous or polystichous, to 15 mm long, densely and coarsely cinereous-lepidote; sheaths suborbicular, thin, many-nerved, glabrous only at the extreme base; blades spreading to recurved, triangular, stout, angled, mucronate. Scape very short and hidden by the leaves but bearing a single ovate acute prominently nerved densely lepidote bract. Inflorescence 1-flowered; floral bract like the scape-bract, slightly shorter than the sepals, at least 5-nerved. Sepals subfree, lepidote. Capsule slenderly subcylindric, abruptly short-beaked, 2 cm long.

description: Dioecious shrub or tree 1 —7(—10) m tall, with gray furrowed bark, young branches quadrangular, tomentulose. Leaves with petioles to 1 cm long, stipules auriculate, 3.4-4.3 x 5-8.5 mm, soon deciduous, blades oblong-lanceolate to oblong-elliptic, 10-20 x 3-6.5 cm, membranaceous, above glabrescent with scattered glandular trichomes, below tomentose to tomentulose and glandular; apex long acuminate, base attenuate, decurrent, margin subentire or serrulate. Inflorescence 15-25 x 15-22 cm, paniculate with 3 orders of branches, basal ones subtended by leaves, the upper by linear bracts; flowers borne in sessile cymules, 0.4-0.7 cm diam. with 1-6 flowers. Calyx tubular, outside tomentose to tomentulose, glandular, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes triangular, 0.5-1 x 0.9-1.2 mm. Corolla white to cream or very pale yellow, tubular to funnelform, tomentose outside, with warty hairs in upper part of tube and base of lobes, tube 2-3 mm long, lobes rounded at apex, 1-1.2 x 1.2-1.5 mm. Stamens inserted 1-1.2 mm below sinus, subsessile, anthers 0.7-1 mm long. Ovary 1-2 mm long, tomentose and glandular, style 1-1.5 mm long, stigma clavate, 0.7-1 mm long. No mature fruits available.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Shrub 0.5-1 m tall, young branches thick, densely tomentose. Leaves with petioles 1-2.5 cm long, stipular line well-marked, blades lanceolate, 10-17 x 1.22.7 cm, coriaceous, above glabrescent, below with thick tomentum; apex acuminate, base attenuate, margin subentire to serrulate. Inflorescence to 15 cm long, the flowers borne in paired 3-5-flowered cymes, peduncles 0.5-1 cm long, subtended by progressively smaller leaves; pedicels 0.5-1 cm long. Calyx tubular, thickly tomentose outside, tube 10-14.5 mm long, lobes 5-6 mm long, acuminate. Corolla yellowish orange, tubular, tomentose on outside surface, inside glabrous except for glandular trichomes near throat, tube 35-42 x 4-5 mm, lobes 3-3.5 x 3.5-4.5 mm, orbicular. Stamens sessile, inserted near sinus, anthers 2-2.5 mm long. Ovary 6-8 mm tomentose, ovoid, pointed at tip, style 30-35 mm long, tomentose on lower third of its length, stigma globose 0.5 mm long. Fruits not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious shrub or subshrub 0.5-1 m tall, with grayish bark near base, younger branches terete, lanate. Leaves with petiole 0.5-2 cm long, stipular lines evident, blades ovate, 7-10 x 4-7.5 cm, membranaceous, lanate on both surfaces, tomentum especially thick below; apex acute to acuminate, base truncate or subcordate, margin serrate. Inflorescence 10-25 cm long, of 5-10 pairs of pedunculate heads in axils of reduced leaves, peduncles 0.5-3 cm long; heads 1.2-1.5 cm diam. with 20-25 flowers, subtended by bracteoles. Calyx tubular, densely wooly outside, 2.5-3.5 mm long, lobes acuminate, 1-1.5 mm long. Corolla yellow, tubular or funnelform, tomentose outside on upper half, within with a ring of warty hairs at base of lobes, tube 3.5-4.5 mm long, lobes oblong, 1-2 x 1.2-1.7 mm. Stamens inserted 0.7-1.2 mm below sinus, filaments 0.3-0.5 mm long, anthers 0.5-1 mm long. Ovary 1.5-2 mm long, tomentose on upper half, style 0.5-1 mm long, stigma clavate, 0.5-0.7 mm long. Capsule narrowly ellipsoid, 4-5 x 2-2.5 mm, tomentulose in upper half, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 5, oblong, 1-1.2 x 0.3-0.4 mm, with very short wings, seed body 0.7-0.9 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious shrub 1-2.5 m tall, with dark brown fissured bark, young branches subquadrangular, tomentose. Leaves subsessile to distinctly petiolate, petiole 1.5-2 cm long, the blade 5-10 x 1.5-3.5 cm, narrowly elliptic, above glabrescent, below tomentose; apex and base acute, margin serrulate. Inflorescence 6-9 x 2-4 cm, the flowers borne in pairs of congested cymes,peduncles 1-2 cm long, 10-15 flowers per cyme, 1.2-1.7 cm diam., subtended by bracts, flowers sessile or subsessile. Calyx tubular, tomentose, tube 3.5-4 mm long, lobes 2-2.5 mm long, hairy within. Corolla white, tubular, outer surface of tube tomentulose, with warty hairs on inner surface in upper portion of tube with a few glandular trichomes near sinus, 6-6.5 mm long, lobes orbicular, 2 x 2.5 mm. Stamens sessile inserted 1 mm below sinus, anthers 1-1.5 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 1.5-3 mm long, tomentose, style 3-3.5 mm long, stigma clavate, 0.7-1 mm long. Capsule ovoid 6-7 x 3-3.5 mm, tomentulose, underlain by scattered glandular trichomes, dehiscing primarily septicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 1, oblong, 1.7-2.4 x 0.4-0.5 mm, with short wings.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Trioecious shrub or subshrub 0.5-1.5 m tall, base with grayish fissured bark, stems subquadrangular, lanose, crowded with leaves on short axillary branches. Leaves sessile, those of young shoots with auriculate stipules, 0.8-1 x 1.2-1.5 cm, blades lanceolate, 3-4 x 1-2 cm, membranaceous, lanose on both surfaces, underlain by glandular trichomes below; apex acuminate, base truncate, margin subentire, slightly revolute; leaves on older plants with auriculate stipules, 0.2-0.3 x 0.4-0.5 cm, or reduced to a line, blades oblong, 1-3 x 0.5-1 cm, texture and indument as above; apex obtuse or acute, base truncate or attenuate, margin entire, slightly revolute. Inflorescence usually of 1 terminal head, sometimes with an additional pair of sessile heads, surrounded by many small leaves, each head 0.8-1.6 cm diam. with 15-30 flowers. Calyx tubular, woolly outside, tube 3-4 mm long, lobes 0.7-1.2 mm long, acuminate. Corolla yellowish-white, tubular-funnelform, outside tomentose on upper half, with tufts of long warty hairs at base of lobes and in throat, sparsely hairy in upper third of tube, tube 3.5-4.5 mm long, lobes oblong, 1-2 x 1-1.2 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted 1-1.5 mm below sinus, anthers 0.7-1 mm long. Ovary 2-2.5 mm, lanose on upper half, style 0.7-1 mm long, stigma 2-lipped, subglobose, 0.4-0.5 mm long. Capsule, cylindrical, 4-6.5 x 2-2.5 mm, tomentulose on upper half, dehiscing septidically and loculicidally, the valves recurved, acute. Seeds type 2, oblong, 1.2-1.5 x 0.4-0.5 mm, with short wings, seed body mass 0.9-1 mm long.

description: Dioecious shrub 1-2 m tall, with grayish bark, young branches covered with white tomentum. Leaves with petiole 1-1.5 cm long, stipules reduced to a line, blades lanceolate, 5-12 x 2-3 cm, subcoriaceous, above tomentulose, below white tomentose; apex long acuminate, base acute or obtuse, margin entire. Inflorescence 10-20 cm long, with 1-2 orders of branches, primary branches more or less perpendicular and often as long as main axis, basal branches subtended by leaves, others by progressively smaller bracts; flowers borne in pairs of capitate cymules, each cymule sessile, 0.5-0.8 cm diam. with 3-9 flowers. Calyx campanulate, tomentulose outside, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes 0.5 mm long, acute. Corolla whitish yellow, campanulate, with sparse tomentum and glandular trichomes outside on upper part of tube and lower part of lobes, with warty hairs in upper part of tube, tube 1.7-2 mm long, lobes orbicular 1-1.2 x 1-1.2 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted 0.5 mm below sinus, anthers 0.5-mm long. Ovary ovoid, 0.6-1.2 mm long, style 0.5-1 mm long, stigma clavate, 0.5 mm long. Capsule subglobular, 2-3 x 1.7-2.5 mm, with glandular trichomes in upper half, dehiscing primarily septicidally, the valves obtuse, remaining appressed, placental trichomes 0.60.8 x 0.2-0.25 mm. Seeds type 5,0.6-0.75 x 0.25-0.30 mm, with very short wings, seed body 0.45 mm long.

description: Plant varying from the typically stemless phase to long-caulescent. Leaves scarcely more than 5 cm long, covered throughout with appressed cinereous or brownish scales; sheaths distinct, triangular-ovate, ca 5 mm long; blades erect to recurved, linear, filiform-attenuate, 1-2 mm wide, strongly keeled below. Scape none. Inflorescence terminal, consisting of a single flower or rarely two. Floral bract lance-oblong, acute, membranaceous, 1-nerved, glabrous, not more than half as long as the sepals. Sepals elliptic-ovate, obtuse, 15 mm long, chartaceous, even, glabrous, free; petals erect but more or less recurving at apex, slightly asymmetric as in Pitcairnia, to 44 mm long, red; stamens and pistil exserted.

description: Dioecious tree or shrub 4-12(-15) m tall, with brownish furrowed bark, up to 50 cm at base, with rounded crown, branches subquadrangular, covered with tomentum. Leaves with petiole 1-2 cm long, with stipular lines, blades oblong, lanceolate-oblong, or elliptic-oblong, 7-15(-21) x 1-3(-5) cm, subcoriaceous to coriaceous, above glabrescent, often rugose or bullate above, below white or yellowish tomentose; apex acuminate, base acute to acuminate, margin subentire, crenulate or serrulate. Inflorescence 8-12 (-20) x 8-12(-20) cm, paniculate with 2-3 orders of branches, basal branches subtended by leaves, others by linear bracts, bracts often conspicuous below each head; heads 1-1.5 cm diam. with 15-40 flowers. Calyx campanulate, tomentose outside, tube 1.5-2.5 mm long, lobes 1-1.7 mm, acuminate. Corolla yellow turning orange, tubular to campanulate, tomentulose outside, inside with few warty hairs in upper half of tube, tube 3-4 mm long, lobes ovoid to suborbicular, 1.5-2 x 1.5-2 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted 0.5-1 mm below sinus, anthers 0.5-1 mm long. Ovary 1.5-3 mm long, tomentose, style 1.5-2 mm, stigma globose, bilobed, 0.5-1 mm long. Capsule cylindrical, 5-6 x 2.5-3.5 mm, tomentose, dehiscing primarily septicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 3, oblong, 1.5-2 x 0.4-0.45 mm, with wings, seed body mass 0.9-1.2 mm long. 2n = 76.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Shrub, young branches subquadrangular, tomentose. Leaves with petiole 2-3 cm long, stipular lines indistinct, blade elliptic, 8-15 x 3.7-9 cm, membranaceous, above glabrescent, below tomentose; apex acute, base obtuse, margin serrate to serrulate. Inflorescence 10-20 x 7-18 cm with 2-3 orders of branches, lowest branches subtended by leaves, otherwise by bracts, flowers short pedicellate borne in cymules of 5-15, 1-2 cm diam. Calyx campanulate, outside tomentose, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes acute, 1.5-2 x 2 mm. Corolla white or yellowish, funnel-form, tomentose outside, with warty hairs on upper half of tube and base of lobes, tube 3.5-4 mm long, lobes ovate, rounded at apex, 2-2.5 x 2.5 mm. Stamens inserted 1 mm below sinus, filaments 1 mm, anthers 1-1.2 mm long. Ovary ovoid 2-2.5 mm long, tomentose, style 1.2-1.5 mm long, stigma clavate, 0.7-1 mm long. No fruits available.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Plant flowering to 3 dm long; stem over 2 dm long, branching especially near apex; roots present. Leaves rather laxly distichous or polystichous, to 4 or sometimes 6 cm long, covered with subappressed basally produced cinereous scales; sheaths about 5 mm apart on the stem, making it appear 3-4 mm thick, suborbicular, much broader than the blades, several-nerved with broad nerveless margins, ciliate with long scales, usually lepidote except the extreme base, occasionally with a narrow glabrous strip next to the margin or wholly glabrous in age; blades recurving and more or less contorted, 2 mm in diameter, acuminate, pungent, terete, nerved when dry. Scape terminal or pseudo-axillary, from almost none to 6 cm long, densely lepidote, naked or with a single lanceolate involute acuminate lepidote bract. Inflorescence 1- or rarely 2-flowered, densely lepidote; rhachis produced behind the terminal flower. Floral bract lance-ovate, acuminate, to 14 mm long, exceeding the sepals, twice as long as the internode and not concealing the rhachis in the 2-flowered specimen, nerved, ecarinate, closely enfolding the calyx; flowers subsessile. Sepals lance-oblong, 11 mm long, nerved, joined posteriorly for 1/2; petals narrow; stamens deeply included, exceeding the pistil.

description: Dioecious shrub 1-1.5 m tall, with grayish rimóse bark, with persisting old naked branches, youngest branches tomentulose. Leaves subsessile, without any stipular line, blades oblong, 0.5-3 x 0.4-1 cm, membranaceous or subcoriaceous, above tomentulose or glabrescent, below tomentose; apex acute, obtuse, or rounded, base attenuate, margin entire. Inflorescence with one terminal head and often with a pair of small sessile heads in the axil below, terminal head with 6-9 flowers, 0.5-0.7 cm diam., lower heads with 3-6 flowers, heads subtended by leaves. Calyx campanulate, tomentose outside, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes 0.8-1.2 mm long, acute. Corolla yellowish-white, campanulate or tubular, outside tomentulose on upper part of tube, with warty hairs scattered in upper half of tube, tube 2.5-3 mm long, lobes suborbicular, 1-1.5 x 1-1.5 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted 1-1.5 mm below sinus, anthers 0.7-1 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 0.8-1.2 mm long, style 0.7-1 mm long, stigma clavate, 0.8-1 mm long. Capsule 3-3.5 x 2.6-2.8 mm, slightly tomentulose and glandular near apex, pericarp thin, dehiscing primarily septicidally, valves remaining appressed, with finger-like trichomes on placenta, 0.3 x 0.1 mm. Seeds type 5, fusiform, wingless, 0.7-1 x 0.3-0.35 mm, seed body 0.7 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Plant stemless. Leaves numerous, 15-40 cm long, equaling or exceeding the inflorescence, very densely and minutely pale-lepidote, green; sheaths triangular-ovate, longitudinally red-striate; blades recurving, narrowly triangular, 7-12 mm wide. Scape erect, stout, very short and almost completely hidden by the leaves; scape-bracts densely imbricate, ovate, acute or the lowest with an erect linear blade, much smaller than the floral bracts, coriaceous, even, glabrous. Inflorescence simple, elliptic, strongly complanate, 10-15 cm long, 55 mm wide, densely 10-20-flowered, glabrous. Floral bracts suberect, triangular, acute, to 4 cm long, sharply carinate, coriaceous, even, somewhat lustrous, green or pale rose with greenish margins; flowers short-pedicellate. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, acute, 3 cm long, coriaceous, even, equally subfree, carinate; petals more than twice as long as the sepals, the claw linear, white, the blade spreading, lance-elliptic, acute, blue or rarely white; stamens deeply included, exceeding the style. Capsule slenderly cylindric, shorter than the sepals.

description: Subshrub 1 m tall, with brownish bark, young branches quadrangular with whitish tomentum. Leaves sessile, blades lanceolate, 10-16 x 2.5-4.5 cm, membranaceous, above glabrescent, below lanose; apex acuminate, base long attenuate, connate-perfoliate, margin above base irregularly dentate. Infloresence 10-20 cm long with 1 order of branches, flowers sessile, in paired cymes of 3-12 flowers, borne in the axils of reduced leaves or bracts, peduncles 5-30 mm long. Calyx tubular tomentose, tube 4-5 mm long, lobes 2-2.5 mm long, acute. Corolla cream or white, tubular, tomentose on outside surface, tube glabrous within, lobes minutely papillose inside, tube 15-20 mm long, lobes obtuse, 1-1.2 x 1.5-1.7 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted 2.5-3 mm below sinus, anthers 1.2-1.4 mm long. Ovary 3.5-4 mm long, tomentose, style 9-15 mm long, stigma globose, 0.5 mm long. Capsule subglobose, tomentulose, and glandular, 5-6 x 4-4.5 mm, opening septicidally, valves rounded. Seeds type 6, oblong, 0.6-0.7 x 0.3 mm, funicular end spongy, seed body 0.5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Shrub 1-2 m tall, with brownish bark, young branches subquadrangular covered with white tomentum. Leaves subsessile or with petiole to 1 cm, stipular line inconspicous, blades narrowly lanceolate, 5—10(—15) x l-2.5(-4.5) cm, membranaceous, above tomentose, tomentulose, or glabrescent, below lanose; apex acute to acuminate, base attenuate, rarely connate auriculate, margin crenulate or serrulate. Inflorescence 5-15 cm long with 1-2 orders of branches, lower nodes on main axis and side branches subtended by leaves, upper ones by bracts; flowers sessile borne in paired cymes, each cyme with 1-6 flowers, the lower ones with peduncle 0.5-1.5 cm long, the upper ones sessile. Calyx tubular, lanose, tube 3.5-5 mm long, lobes 2-3.6 mm long, narrowly triangular. Corolla yellow, tubular, tomentose on outside surface with pitted hairs in upper 2/3 of tube, hairs sparser near sinus, tube 10-12 mm long, lobes oblong, erect, 2-3 x 1.5 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted near sinus, anthers 1-1.5 mm long. Ovary 3-4 mm long, tomentose, style 8-10 mm long, stigma globose, 0.5 mm long. Capsule ovoid, tomentulose, 5-6 x 2.5-3 mm dehiscing primarily septicidally, the valves acute. Seeds type 6, oblong, often slightly beaked, 0.9-1 x 0.25-0.3 mm, funicular end spongy, seed body 0.6-0.7 mm long, restricted to upper portion of seed.

description: Dioecious tree 8-15 m tall, young branches quadrangular, tomentose only at apex. Leaves with petiole 3-7 cm long, stipules auriculate, 2-3.5 x 3-5 mm, blades ovate to ovate-elliptic, 15-27 x 8-16 cm, membranaceous, upper surface glabrous or nearly so, below densely tomentose, at first underlain by glandular trichomes, becoming tomentulose; apex short acuminate or acute, base rounded or obtuse, margin entire or slightly undulate. Inflorescence 20-30 x 20-30 cm, paniculate with 3-4 orders of branches, basal branches subtended by leaves, upper ones by filiform bracts; cymules short pedunculate, with usually 3 flowers, 0.4-0.6 cm diam. Calyx campanulate, outside tomentose, tube 1.7-2.5 mm long, lobes 0.7-1 mm long, broadly triangular. Corolla yellow, campanulate, outside tomentose on upper half, inside with warty hairs at base of lobes and in upper part of tube, tube 2-2.5 mm long, lobes ovate-oblong rounded at tip 1.6-2.2 x 1.5-1.8 mm. Stamens with filaments 0.2-0.5 mm long, inserted 0.5-1 mm below sinus, anthers 0.4-0.8 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 1-1.5 mm long, tomentose, style 1-1.3 mm, stigma clavate 0.5-0.6 mm long. Capsules not available.

description: Trioecious(?) shrub or small tree 2-6 m tall, young branches subquadrangular, lanate. Leaves with petioles 1-2 cm long, stipular lines inconspicuous, blades ovate-lanceolate to lanceolate, 13-24(-30) x 3-8(-11) cm, membranaceous, above tomentose, gradually glabrescent, below lanate; apex acuminate, base subcordate to attenuate, sometimes decurrent, margin subentire to serrulate. Inflorescence 10-27 cm long, with heads borne in a raceme, but usually with 1 or (more rarely) 2 orders of branches at base, lowest heads or branches subtended by leaves, others by bracts, each head 1.5-2.5 cm diam., with 20-50 flowers. Calyx campanulate, outside lanate, tube 2.5-3 mm long, lobes 2-2.5 mm long, acuminate. Corolla yellow, funnelform lobes erect, outside tomentose in upper half, inside with warty hairs in a crescent-shaped line on lobes near base and scattered in upper part of tube, tube 3-3.5 mm long, lobes oblong, obtuse, 3-3.5 mm long. Stamens inserted at sinus or immediately below, filaments 0.5-1 mm long, anthers 0.7-1 mm long. Ovary 1.5-2 mm long, tomentose, style 0.8-1 mm long, stigma clavate, 1-1.2 mm long. Capsule cylindrical, 4.5-6 x 2.4-2.7 mm, tomentose, opening septicidally, cleft at apex. Seeds type 3, 1-1.4 x 0.3-0.33 mm, fusiform, winged, seed body 0.5-0.6 mm long. 2n = 38.

description: Dioecious, scrambling viny shrub 1-3.5 m tall, with yellowish bark, branches quadrangular, youngest portions covered with white or buff yellow tomentum. Leaves with petiole 0.5-1.5 cm long, upper leaves often sessile, stipules auriculate, 0.5-0.8 x 0.8-1 cm, sometimes reduced to a line, blades ovate or elliptic, 3-14 x 2-8 cm, membranaceous, above glabrescent, below tomentose; apex acuminate, base subcordate, rounded, or attenuate, margin usually entire, sometimes slightly serrulate. Inflorescence 15-30 cm long, with 1-2 orders of branches, primary branches more or less perpendicular and shorter than main axis, basal branches subtended by leaves, upper and secondary ones by smaller leaves or bracts; flowers borne in pairs of capitate cymules, each cymule 0.6-1 cm diam. with 9-15 flowers, lower cymules on all axes pedunculate, upper ones progressively more sessile. Calyx tubular, tomentose outside, tube 2-3 mm long, lobes acuminate, 0.5-0.8 mm long. Corolla white at anthesis, soon turning yellow, campanulate or tubular, tomentulose on outside surface, inside with scattered warty hairs in upper part of tube and at base of lobes, tube 3-3.5 mm long, lobes suborbicular, 1.5-1.7 x 1.2-1.6 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted 0.5-1 mm below sinus, anthers 0.5-1 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 0.7-1.5 mm long, style 0.5-1 mm long, stigma clavate, 1-1.2 mm long. Capsule ovoid 3-3.8 x 1.7-2.2 mm, covered with glandular trichomes, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 5, 0.8-1 x 0.2-0.3 mm, with wings, seed body 0.5-0.6 mm long.

description: Dioecious shrub or small tree 1-5 m tall, with grayish brown shredding bark, young branches quadrangular, sometimes winged, tomentose near the tip. Leaves sessile or with petioles to 1.5(-2) cm long, stipular lines faint, blades lanceolate, narrowly elliptic or ovate, 4.5—15(—20) x 1—8(—12) cm, subcoriaceous, sometimes rugose above, more rarely membranaceous, above tomentose, tomentulose or glabrescent, below tomentose, or tomentulose, underlain by glandular trichomes; apex acute or acuminate, base subcordate, truncate, cuneate, or amplexicaul, then abruptly contracted at the base, margin serrate, doubly serrate, serrulate, crenulate, or subentire. Inflorescence 6-18 x 5-12 cm with usually 2 orders of branches at the base and one above, branches subtended by small leaves or inconspicuous bracts; flowers borne in sessile pairs of heads forming pseudo-verticels, the first pair of heads on the lateral branches borne very close to main axis, except sometimes on the lowermost branch, pseudoverticels 0.5-1.2 cm diam. with 10-25 flowers. Calyx campanulate, lanose outside, tube 1-1.5 mm long, lobes 0.5-1 mm long, acuminate. Corolla greenish-yellow, funnelform, lobes erect, tomentose outside, with warty hairs in a crescent-shaped line on inner surface of the lobes, tube constricted at base, 1.5-2 mm long, lobes oblong, acute, 1.5-2 x 1-1.2 mm. Stamens inserted at sinus or just below, filaments 0.5-1 mm long, anthers 0.5-1 mm long. Ovary 1-1.5 mm long, tomentose or tomentulose, style 0.7-1 mm long, stigma ca. 0.5 mm long, clavellate. Capsule short-cylindrical, 3-3.5 x 1.7-2 mm, tomentulose, opening septicidally for half its length, loculicidally only at apex. Seeds type 3, 0.8-1 x 0.25-0.3 mm, fusiform, winged, seed body 0.45-0.6 mm long. 2n = 76.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Trioecious shrub or tree with dense crown, 1-5(-8) m high, with brownish or blackish fissured bark, branches thick, subquadrangular, tomentose. Leaves with petiole 3-4 mm long, with well marked stipular lines, blades elliptic to obovate, 1-4 x 0.5-1.5 cm, coriaceous, above glabrous, shiny, often with a conspicuous waxy surface (in dry condition), below with appressed tomentum; apex acute, or subacuminate, base cuneate or acute, margin entire, often recurved (in dry condition). Inflorescence with 3-8 pairs of head-like cymes, in axils of bracts, peduncles usually 0.5-3 cm long, progressively shorter towards tip of inflorescences, sometimes inflorescences more highly branched, paniculate, the primary branches 6-9 cm long; cymes with 8-12 sessile flowers, 0.9-1.2 cm diam.; flowers subtended by linear bracteoles, about the length of the calyx. Calyx tubular, tomentulose outside, tube 2.5-3.5 mm long, lobes 1-1.5 mm long, acute, often of unequal size. Corolla deep yellow turning orange, tubular-salverform, tomentulose outside, inside glabrous, tube 4.5-6 mm, lobes orbicular, 1.5-2 x 1.5-2.5 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted 1-2 mm below sinus, anthers 0.8-1.5 mm long. Ovary 1.5-2 mm long, tomentose, style 1-1.5 mm long, stigma clávate, 0.5-0.8 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, 4-5.5 x 2-3.5 mm tomentose, dehiscing primarily septicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 2, oblong, 1.2-1.5 x 0.4-0.5 m, with wings, seed body 0.8-1 mm long. 2n = 76.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious, densely branched shrub, 1-2 m tall, with gray fissured bark, young branches terete, tomentose. Leaves with petiole 3-4 mm long, stipular lines conspicuous, blades lanceolate, 2-6(-8) x 0.5-1.2(-2) cm, coriaceous, thickly tomentose on both surfaces; apex acuminate, base acute, rarely obtuse, margin entire. Inflorescence with one terminal head and up to 9 pairs of subsessile or short-pedunculate heads in the axils of very reduced leaves, penduncles 0-1 cm, progressively shorter towards apex, each head with 12-25 flowers, 0.6-1 cm diam. Calyx tubular, thickly tomentose outside, tube 2-3 mm long, lobes 0.5-1 mm long, acute, margin obscured by tomentum. Corolla deep yellow, fading to beige, salverform, tomentose outside, with warty hairs inside in upper portion of tube, tube 3-4 mm long, lobes orbicular 1-1.5 x 1.5-2.2 mm. Stamens sessile, inserted 0.7-1 mm below sinus, anthers 0.7-1 mm long. Ovary 1.5-2 mm long, tomentose, style 1.5-2 mm long, stigma clavate 0.7-0.9 mm long. Capsule ovoid, 2.7-3.5 x 2.5-3 mm, tomentulose on upper half, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally at apex, valves obtuse. Seeds type 5, oblong, 0.9-1 x 0.3-0.4 mm, wingless, seed body 0.75-0.9 mm long.

description: Dioecious shrub or tree 2-12(-20) m tall, with rounded crown, trunk 10-45 cm diam. at base, with brownish or blackish furrowed bark, young branches quadrangular, tomentose. Leaves with petiole 1-4 cm long, stipular lines evident or with foliaceous stipules, 0.1-1 x 0.15-2 cm, blades lanceolate to ovate, (4-)8-20(-27) x 3-8(-18) cm, membranaceous, occasionally subcoriaceous, glabrescent above, sometimes sparingly tomentulose below with appressed tomen-tum or with thick floccose tomentum often underlain by glandular and appressed trichomes; apex acute or acuminate, base subcordate, obtuse, sometimes decurrent, margin entire, serrate or serrulate. Inflorescence 6-30 x 10-20 cm, paniculate, with 2-4 orders of branches, lowermost pairs of branches subtended by leaves, upper ones by small bracts, flowers in groups of 5-10 per cymule, 0.5-1 cm diam. Calyx campanulate, outside tomentose or subglabrous, tube 1-1.8 mm long, lobes 0.5-1.5 x 1.2-1.5 mm, broadly triangular. Corolla white, cream, yellow or turning orange at maturity, often with a flush of orange at throat, tubular-campanulate, lobes spreading, outside tomentose or tomentulose, inside with warty hairs in upper half of tube and lower half of lobes, tube 1.5-2.5 mm long, lobes ovate-oblong, rounded at tip, 1.2-2 x 1.5-1.8 mm. Stamens subsessile or with filaments 0.2-0.5 mm long, inserted 0.5 mm below sinus, anthers 0.5-1 mm long. Ovary 1-1.8 mm long, tomentose on upper portion, style 0.5-14 mm long, stigma clavate, obscurely 2-lipped. Capsule short cylindrical, 3.5-5 x 1.5-2.5 (-3.2) mm, tomentulose and glandular, opening septicidally for at least half of its length, loculicidally at apex, valves acute. Seeds type 2, oblong, 1.2-2 x 0.25-0.4 mm, winged, seed body 0.6-0.8 mm long. 2n = 76.

description: Dioecious shrub 1-2 m tall, with dark brown fissured bark, young branches subquadrangular, covered with white tomentum. Leaves with petiole 0.5-1 cm long, stipular lines inconspicuous, blades ovate, 4-8(-10) x 1.3-3.5(-6) cm, membranaceous, above glabrescent, below white tomentose; apex acute, base cuneate or truncate, margin irregularly serrate, lob-ulate, or subentire. Inflorescence 10-20 cm long, sometimes once branched at base with 6-14 pairs of sessile or short pedunculate pairs of heads, subtended by small leaves near base, bracts above, each cymule 0.6-0.9 cm diam. with 6-20 flowers. Calyx tubular, tomentose outside, tube 1.7-2.5 mm long, lobes acute 0.6-0.9 mm long. Corolla yellowish white, campanulate-rotate or tubular, tomentulose on outside surface, sometimes glandular at base of lobes, inside with scattered warty hairs in upper two-thirds of tube, tube 2.7-3.2 mm long, lobes suborbicular, 0.9-1.2 x 1.21.8 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted 0.5-1 mm below sinus, anthers 0.7-1 mm long. Ovary 0.8-1.5 mm long tomentulose, style 0.5-0.8 mm long, stigma clavate, 2lipped, 0.6-0.8 mm long. Capsule ovoid, 3-3.5 x 1.7-2 mm, tomentulose at tip, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally, valves acute. Seeds type 5, 0.7-1 x 0.20.3 mm, with short wings, seed body 0.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Norman, E. M. 2000. Buddlejaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 81: 1-225.

description: Dioecious shrub 0.25-1.5 m tall, with light grayish brown rimose bark, young branches terete, woolly, floccose. Leaves sessile, blades rhomboid, 3-7.5 x 1.5-3.5 cm, membranaceous, woolly, floccose on both surfaces, underlain by conspicuous glandular trichomes, glabrescent above; apex acute or obtuse, base attenuate, connate-perfoliate, margin serrate to crenate; leaves associated with inflorescence oblong or ovate, 2 x 0.5-1 cm, entire. Inflorescence 3-10 cm long, consisting of 3-6 pairs pedunculate or sessile heads, peduncles and subtending leaves progressively smaller, each head 0.8-1.1 cm diam. with 15-20 flowers. Calyx campanulate, densely woolly and conspiciously glandular outside, tube 2-2.5 mm long, lobes acuminate, 1-1.5 mm long. Corolla yellow, salverform, outside tomentose for upper two-thirds, with scattered warty hairs inside in upper two-thirds of tube, tube 2.8-3.5 mm long, lobes orbicular, 1.3-1.5 x 1.3-1.6 mm. Stamens subsessile, inserted 0.8-1 mm below sinus, anthers 0.5-0.8 mm long. Ovary 1-1.5 mm long, tomentose on upper third, style 1.5-2 mm long, stigma clávate 0.3-0.5 mm long, two-lipped. Capsule ovoid, 2.8-3.2 x 1.7-2 mm, tomentulose at apex, dehiscing septicidally and loculicidally, valves becoming recurved. Seeds type 5, ellipsoid, 0.4-0.5 x 0.2-0.3 mm, wingless, seed body filling seed coat.
