description: Plant short-caulescent, flowering ca 1.8 m high. Leaves 9 dm long; sheaths sub-orbicular, 9 cm long, pale-lepidote and serrulate toward apex; blades 4 cm wide, minutely brown-lepidote between the nerves beneath, glabrous above, laxly serrate with broad nearly black often retrorse spines 8 mm long. Scape elongate, exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts small and inconspicuous, long-acuminate from a broadly ovate base. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, covered with a pale tomentum except for the petals; primary bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, much shorter than the naked sterile bases of the branches; branches sublaxly many-flowered, the lateral subspreading, to 23 cm long, the terminal longer and with stouter rhachis. Floral bracts broadly ovate, much exceeded by the sepals, soon glabrous, acute or the lowest of the terminal branch acuminate; flowers suberect; pedicels very short and stout, obconical. Sepals broadly ovate, acute, ca 25 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous; petals 4 cm long; stamens included.

description: Flowering 1-2 m high. Leaves over 7 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, caudate-acuminate, 35 mm wide, glabrous above, covered beneath with coarse subappressed whitish scales, laxly serrate with flat uncinate antrorse spines 10 mm long. Scape 2 cm in diameter, densely and finely pale-flocculose; scape-bracts densely imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper acuminate from a broadly ovate base, serrulate, red. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, at first finely white-flocculose; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, much shorter than the long sterile bases of the branches; branches divergent, 15-30 cm long, subdensely secund-flowered with the slender rhachis covered toward apex. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, 20-25 mm long, about equaling the middle of the sepals, rather thin, red, obscurely serrulate, soon glabrous; pedicels slender, 5-10 mm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, very narrowly obtuse and apiculate, 28 mm long, ecarinate, soon glabrous; petals dark violet.

description: Aggregated, flowering plant at least 7 dm high. Leaves many, densely rosulate, 3 dm long; blades 3 cm wide, flat, laxly serrate with pale curved spines 4 mm long, glabrous at least with age. Scape erect, 15 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts numerous, very densely imbricate, only the lowest at all foliaceous, the others thin and deciduous with age, probably reflexed, but undoubtedly completely covering the scape. Inflorescence racemose, densely cylindric, 30-45 cm long, 7 cm in diameter and glabrous in fruit; axis stout; floral bracts reflexed in age, lanceolate, 5 cm long, entire; pedicels arcuate-spreading, 15 mm long, rather slender and slightly thickened toward apex; sepals lanceolate, about 25 mm long, ecarinate, nerved; petals contorted in drying. Seeds alate.

description: Plant known only from fragments but probably over 1 m high. Leaves over 8 dm long; blades 25 mm wide, covered on both sides with white appressed scales, laxly serrate with slender brown uncinate spines 7 mm long. Scape unknown. Inflorescence simple, subdensely many-flowered, densely and finely pale-lanate, becoming subglabrous, the base unknown. Floral bracts ovate, contracted to a caudate apex, shorter than the sepals (so far as known); flowers divergent; pedicels obconic, 5 mm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, 23 mm long, 3.5 mm wide, ecarinate; petals with lateral folds, contorted after anthesis.

description: Plant caulescent, flowering 5-12 dm high; stem short, stout. Leaves rosulate, recurving, over 1 m long; sheaths broadly ovate, merging with the blade, dark, lustrous, more or less lepidote beneath; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate to a pungent apex, 30 mm wide, glabrous above, covered beneath with pale appressed scales, laxly serrate with antrorse uncinate spines 8 mm long. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts dense, foliaceous with long blades, coarsely serrate. Inflorescence laxly and amply bipinnate, 5 dm long, sordidly pruinose-lepidote; primary bracts broadly ovate, to 3 cm long, serrate with spines to 4 mm long, subcoriaceous, the lowest with narrow decurved blades; branches scorpioid-decurved, flowering to the apex, to 15 cm long, the lowest 15-25-flowered, subdense to lax at an thesis. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, serrulate, 10 mm long, equaling or shorter than the sepals, strongly convex; pedicels very short and stout. Sepals lanceolate, attenuate, mucronulate, 16-18 mm long; petals 28 mm long, deep blue or purple, naked; stamens included; anthers linear, 5 mm long. Capsule subglobose, 10 mm long; seeds alate.

description: Flowering about 1.5 m high. Leaves over 5 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 6 cm wide, glabrous, dark castaneous, lustrous, serrulate at apex; blades about 2 cm wide, glabrous above, covered beneath with a layer of cinereous scales, laxly serrate with slender pale uncinate mostly antrorse spines 4-5 mm long. Scape 2 cm in diameter near base, soon glabrous except the nodes; scape-bracts deciduous, unknown. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, narrowly pyramidal, 7 dm long, drying black, densely white-lanate; primary bracts ovate, acute, ample, much exceeding the short flat sterile bases of the branches, thin coriaceous, becoming glabrous, the margins crisped when dry; lateral branches few, basal, 10-15 cm long, lax, their floral bracts shorter than the sepals; terminal branch elongate with floral bracts the size of the primary bracts and much exceeding the sepals; pedicels rather stout, to 20 mm long; flowers more or less secund. Sepals lance-elliptic, apiculate, 42 mm long, dull and rather rugose on drying; petals over 6 cm long.

description: Plant flowering about 1 m high; stem prostrate, branching, thick. Leaves rigid, 8 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, 37 mm wide, appressed-cinereous-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with dark brown uncinate spines 5 mm long. Scape stout, erect; scape-bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 4-5 cm long. Inflorescence racemose, 6 dm long, 9 cm in diameter, subcylindric, dense above and lax below, densely cinereous-lanate. Floral bracts broadly ovate or lanceolate, acute or acuminate, at first about equaling the sepals but at maturity not reaching beyond their mid-point, entire, thick, coriaceous; flowers spreading or reflexed at anthesis; pedicels stout, 1 cm long. Sepals narrowly ovate, obtuse or apiculate, 25-35 mm long, 16 mm broad, petals tubular-erect, 6 cm long, blue-green, the blade broadly lanceolate, acute; stamens and style exserted.

description: Flowering 3 5-80 cm high. Leaves ca 4 dm long; sheaths ovate, 15 mm wide, spinose-serrate toward apex; blades 10 mm wide, glabrous above, subdensely tomentose beneath with white linear trichomes, laxly serrulate with slender pale antrorse spines 4 mm long. Scape erect, ca. 3 mm in diameter, finely white-stellate; scape-bracts erect, ovate with a caudate apex, red, the upper ones about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, sparsely white-stellate, becoming glabrous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts but not caudate, nearly the same size and form as the floral bracts, exceeding the axis of the very short few-flowered lateral branches; branches divergent to spreading with a very short naked sterile base, subdense but with the axis largely exposed. Floral bracts suberect, broadly ovate, acute and apiculate, 15 mm long, ecarinate, broadly convex, red with a narrow scarious margin, subchartaceous; pedicels about 1 mm long but slender and distinct. Sepals linear-lanceolate, narrowly obtuse and apiculate, 27 mm long; petals ca. 4 cm long, naked.

description: Plant caulescent, branching, flowering shoot 1-1.5 m high. Leaves more or less rosulate at the ends of the branches, numerous; blades spreading to recurving, about 6 dm long, 2 cm wide, covered with white appressed scales but soon glabrous and lustrous above, laxly serrate with spreading brown spines 7 mm long. Scape erect, 1 cm in diameter near apex, soon glabrous; scape-bracts not at all foliaceous, fragile, drying to blackish brown, quickly deciduous. Inflorescence densely cylindric, simple except for several very short few-flowered branches at base, 14 cm long, 4 cm in diameter; primary bracts suborbicular, apiculate, 30 mm long, exceeding the branches but not the sepals, coriaceous, opaque, drying blackish brown, soon glabrous. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, 30 mm long; pedicels slender, 20 mm long, densely cinereous-lanate. Sepals oblong, rounded and apiculate, 22 mm long, densely cinereous-lanate; petals 35 mm long, blue-green; stamens slightly exserted at anthesis.

description: Young branches glabrous, slender with small roundish, brown lenticels; scales surrounding buds prominent, dark brown, acute. Leaves clustered at ends of branchlets, usually paripinnate rarely imparipinnate, sometimes with an abortive terminal leaflet, (12-)14-22(-30) cm long; rhachis glabrous, pulvinus swollen. Leaflets opposite or subopposite, sessile or subsessile, (2-)3-6(-7) pairs, usually ovate to elliptic-ovate sometimes ovate-lanceolate, apex caudate or long acuminate, extended into a slender filiform thread, base rounded or acute, slightly asymmetric, chartaceous, waxy, sometimes slightly glaucous beneath, (4.5-)7-9(-14) cm long, (1.75-)2.5-4.5 cm broad, upper and lower surfaces glabrous; venation reticulate; secondary venation raised and prominent on both surfaces. Flowers unisexual, but 6 and 9 flowers very similar; inflorescence usually axillary sometimes subterminal, (4-)8-12(-18) cm long, erect or spreading, much shorter than leaves, terminal thyrses often densely clustered, glabrous. Flowers sessile, subsessile, or with pedicels to 2 mm long, glabrous. Calyx 5-lobed, lobes obtuse, deltate to suborbicular, 0.5-1 mm long, glabrous, margin ciliolate. Petals 5, free, slightly contorted in bud, (5.5-)6.5-7.5 mm long, 2.5-3 mm broad, lingulate to obovate, glabrous, margin ciliolate. Staminal tube cylindrical or urceolate, slightly constricted at throat, (3-)3.5-4.5(-5.5) mm long, terminated by 10 short acuminate or narrowly deltate appendages, glabrous inside and out; anthers or antherodes 10, sessile ± contained within mouth of tube. Nectary annular or patelliform, margin crenulate or ribbed, glabrous. Ovary in 2 flowers globose (4-)5-locular, with (10-) 12-14(-16) ovules, glabrous; style very short, 1-1.5 mm long; style-head discoid, glandular with 4-5 stigmatic lobes. Pistillode in 6 flowers more slender, narrowly cylindrical with well-developed loculi but rudimentary ovules; style 2-3 mm long; style-head thin. Capsule erect, ovoid sometimes elongate-ovoid with a short umbo, pale greyish-brown, smooth or indistinctly pitted, 8-16(-20) cm long, 10-12 cm diam., (4-)5-valved, outer valves very woody, 5-7 mm thick, inner valves much thinner, mottled pale brown and white. Seeds pale straw-brown, 6-8(-9) cm long including wing. Embryo with cotyledons thin. Field characters. A small to medium-sized deciduous tree 15-20 m tall (specimens are rarely seen larger than this). Bole short, often crooked, unbuttressed, from 30-50 cm diameter, with dark-grey or brownish-black, longitudinally fissured bark; in older specimens rough and flaking. Old leaflets tend to lose their filiform apices due to wind and other damage and may then resemble those of S. macrophylla in shape. Flowering occurs in April and May and the fruit takes almost a year to mature. The white flowers are faintly but sweetly scented and are visited by bees. The large fruits standing erect above the foliage make the tree easily recognizable from a distance. This and the other two species exude a colourless gum from the trunk and branches. The bark and seeds possess a stringent alkaloid, reputed to be very poisonous.

description: Young branchlets glabrous, slender, rich chestnut-brown or reddish-brown; finely lenticellate; scales surrounding buds prominent, brown, ovate or acute. Leaves clustered at ends of branchlets, usually paripinnate sometimes imparipinnate with an abortive terminal leaflet, (14-)16-30(-40) cm long; rhachis glabrous, pulvinus swollen. Leaflets opposite or subopposite, with slender petiolules 0.5-1.2 cm long, (2-)3-6(-8) pairs, usually oblong to oblong-lanceolate or ovate-lanceolate, sometimes elliptic-ovate, slightly falcate, apex acute or very short acuminate, base uneven, truncate, rounded or subcordate, chartaceous, (8-)9-13(-18.0) cm long, 3-4(-5.5) cm broad, upper and lower surfaces glabrous, dark glossy green above; secondary venation prominent above, tertiary veins impressed and obscure. Flowers unisexual, sexes very similar; inflorescence axillary or subterminal, 10-18(-20) cm long with short lateral, spreading branches, generally shorter than leaves, glabrous. Flowers with pedicels very slender, 1.5-2.5 mm long, glabrous. Calyx 5-lobed, lobes broadly rounded, 1-1.5 mm long, glabrous, margin ciliolate. Petals 5, free, slightly contorted in bud, (4.5-)5-6 mm long, 2-2.5 mm broad, oblong to ovate-oblong, glabrous, margin ciliolate. Staminal tube cylindrical, slightly constricted at throat, 3-4.5 mm long, terminated by 10 acuminate appendages, glabrous inside and out; anthers or antherodes 10, sessile, ± contained within mouth of tube. Nectary annular or patelliform, margin crenulate. Ovary in 2 flowers globose (4-)5-locular, loculi with (10-)12-14 ovules, glabrous; style short ca. 1.5 mm long; style-head discoid, with 4-5 glandular stigmatic lobes. Pistillode in [male] flowers very slender, with well-developed loculi but rudimentary ovules; style ca. 2 mm long with thinner style-head. Capsule erect, elongate to elongate-ovoid sometimes pear-shaped, with a short umbo, greyish-brown, smooth or minutely verrucose, 10-15(-22) cm long, 6-8(-10) cm diam., (4-)5-valved, outer valves woody 6-8 mm thick, inner valves much thinner, mottled brown and white. Seed dark lustrous brown, 7.5-10(-12) cm long including wing. Embryo with cotyledons thin.

description: Flowering 3-4 m high (! Wurdack). Leaves ca 8 dm long; blades pungent, 4 cm wide, covered beneath with subappressed cinereous scales, glabrous above, laxly serrate with antrorse flat pale 6 mm long spines. Scape erect, 4 cm in diameter, soon glabrous; lower scape-bracts subfoliaceous, densely imbricate, the upper deciduous, unknown but probably similar to the primary bracts. Inflorescence very laxly bipinnate, densely whitish-lanate except the petals and the old bracts; primary bracts ovate, acuminate, ca 5 cm long, much shorter than the usually naked sterile bases of the branches, dark brown, becoming nearly glabrous; branches spreading, to 3 dm long, lax except at apex, 10 mm in diameter. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, 20-30 mm long, about equaling the stout obconic pedicel. Sepals broadly elliptic-oblong, broadly rounded at apex, 40 mm long; petals naked, 70 mm long, green.

description: Plant solitary, columnar, 9.5 m high, dying after the formation of fruit; caudex simple, erect, 4 m high, 6 dm in diameter, surmounted by the dense leaf-rosette. Leaves very many, 1-1.25 m long, subglabrous; sheaths 15 cm broad; blades stiff, spreading, 9 cm wide, covered with appressed white scales at first, laxly serrate with uncinate stout dark brown spines to 1 cm long. Scape very short and stout, hidden by the leaves. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, slenderly cylindric, attenuate, 4.3 m long, 6 dm in diameter, white-lanate throughout; primary bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, much shorter than the branches, entire, membranaceous, white; branches spreading or reflexed. Floral bracts densely imbricate, ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, exceeding the sepals, membranaceous, subglabrescent; pedicels cylindric, stout, 15 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 4 cm long; petals 6-8 cm long, greenish white, often purplish, the blade broad. Capsule globose-ovoid, 25-30 mm long; seed, including its irregular circumferential wing, 3-5 mm broad.

description: Monoecious shrub or treelet, 5-9(-15) m tall and reaching a dbh of 20 cm; bark gray and smooth, young branchlets terete but flattened at the nodes, with minute stellate or stellate-lepidote hairs. Leaves opposite, very rarely temate; petioles 0.5-1.5 cm long; lamina drying irregularly grayish- to yellowish brown, rather stiff and parchment-like, oblong to elliptic or lanceolate, 10-22(-33) X 4-10(-16) cm, the base obtuse, the apex acuminate, the tip 0.5-1 cm long, older leaves with a few simple hairs above near the lamina base and on the midrib or glabrous, the lower surface stellate or on the veins lepidote-stellate puberulent, with 9-11 pairs of secondary veins, slightly raised above, more conspicuously so below, the margin entire. Cymes in subsessile clusters, 1-1.5 cm long (to 3 cm long in fruit) and densely covered with stellate to sublepidote hairs, with 5-15 flowers. Fresh flowers greenish yellow; male flowers cupshaped, 2-3 mm in diam., 1.5-2.5 mm high, the indumentum as on the cymes, the 4-6 tepals minute, broadly triangular, about 0.2 mm long, the floral roof barely developed; stamens 10-18, membranaceous, distally narrow; female flowers ovoid to subglobose, 1.8-2.5 mm in diam., 2.5-3 mm high, the tepals as in the male flowers, the floral roof conical; carpels 3-12(-17); exposed styles 5-7, free (Fig. 9H) or forming a column (Fig. 8C). Fruiting receptacle globose, 1-1.5 cm in diam., more or less densely covered with stellate hairs, the fresh and mature receptacles smelling strongly and often unpleasantly of lemon, greenish red and splitting open to expose a yellow-orange interior on which the drupelets are displayed; drupelets 4-10, lacking a stylar aril, the exo- and mesocarp fleshy and whitish gray or orange, soon becoming slimy, the endocarp stony.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 3 dm high. Leaves many, rosulate, to 17 cm long; sheaths small, suborbicular, serrulate, sparsely lepidote; blades 15 mm wide at base, glabrous and lustrous above, densely appressed-white-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with slender curved brown spines 2.5 mm long. Scape slender but appearing almost as stout as the inflorescence on account of the bracts; scape-bracts very densely imbricate, elliptic, linear-laminate or acuminate, papyraceous when dry, strongly nerved, soon glabrous. Inflorescence subsimple, very densely strobilate, ellipsoid, 5 cm long, 2.5 cm in diameter, white-lanate; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but smaller and more vestite, much exceeding the sepals, subentire, red; branches abortive with the flowers fascicled or solitary. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, carinate, membranaceous, exceeding the sepals; pedicels short but slender. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 18 mm long, thin; petals 3 cm long, greenish blue.

description: Flowering plant 15-20 cm high. Leaves about 2 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 3 cm long, serrulate, glabrous; blades rigid, 11 mm wide, covered with cinereous appressed scales but becoming partly glabrous above, laxly armed with spreading red spines 3.5 mm long. Scape 1-2 cm long, largely concealed by the leaves; scape-bracts foliaceous but only 5-6 cm long. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, ellipsoid, 9 cm long, 3 cm in diameter. Floral bracts erect, imbricate, triangular-ovate, acuminate, 3 cm long, much exceeding the sepals, pectinate-serrate, subcoriaceous, finely nerved, opaque, dark brown with a paler apex, bearing minute inconspicuous white stellate scales; pedicels stout, obconic, 5 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 17 mm long, ecarinate, dark brown when dry, lepidote; petals naked, elliptic-oblong, obtuse, 25 mm long, blue-green.

description: Leaves over 5 dm long; blades very narrowly triangular, caudate-attenuate, 25 mm wide, densely pale-appressed-lepidote on both sides but becoming more or less glabrous above, laxly serrate with brown uncinate antrorse spines 3 mm long. Scape 8 mm in diameter at apex, glabrous; scape-bracts small and exposing most of the upper scape, the ovate serrulate base 2 cm long, the slender linear blade over 5 cm long. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 7 dm long, glabrous, somewhat glaucous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts but with much shorter blades or merely apiculate, about equaling the sterile base of the branch; branches suberect, nearly straight, to 25 cm long, 4 mm wide at the flattened base, lax. Floral bracts ovate, apiculate, to 15 mm long, entire, thin; pedicels slender, enlarged upward, to 30 mm long; flowers more or less secund, often subverticil-late. Sepals lanceolate, rounded and apiculate, 21 mm long, carinate at base, sulcate when dry; petals 4 cm long, naked; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering somewhat over 1 m high. Leaves 6 dm or longer; blades very narrowly triangular, rigid, 25 mm wide, bicolorous, covered beneath with whitish appressed scales, glabrous above, laxly serrate with curved castaneous spines 5 mm long. Scape straight, 6 cm in diameter at base, soon glabrous; scape-bracts early deciduous but evidently densely imbricate judging by the very short internodes, the lowest subfoliaceous, the others unknown. Inflorescence densely cylindric, 40 cm long, 10 cm in diameter, bipinnate but appearing simple, at first whitish-tomentose except the petals; primary bracts ovate, acute, about twice as long as the axillary spikes and with their apical half reflexed and soon glabrous, entire; spikes subglobose, densely few-flowered. Floral bracts ovate, acute, about equaling the sepals, thin; pedicels stoutly obconic, 10 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 25 mm long, thin-coriaceous, drying stramineous, their tomentum persistent; petals ca 4 cm long, exceeding the stamens.

description: Stems decumbent, branching, 8-9 cm thick. Leaves 7-8 dm long; blades 36 mm wide, densely cinereous-lepidote on both sides, serrate with spines 1 cm long. Scape unknown. Inflorescence simple, densely cylindric, 3 dm long, 55 mm in diameter, glabrous at anthesis; axis stout. Floral bracts lanceolate, 45 mm long, 12 mm wide, slightly exceeded by the sepals, thick, coriaceous, entire, reflexed or revolute; flowers erect or nearly so; pedicels 15 mm long, stout. Sepals narrowly triangular, acuminate, 35 mm long, coriaceous or fleshy; petals oblong, obtuse, 70 mm long, reddish brown, naked.

description: Caulescent, the flowering shoot tall. Leaves (only the upper known) 4 dm long; sheaths broadly triangular, densely laciniate-spinose near apex, glabrous; blades 27 mm wide, densely white-lepidote beneath, glabrous and bright green above, laxly serrate with brown antrorse uncinate spines 6 mm long. Scape very stout, terete, glabrous; lower scape-bracts foliaceous, the upper lax, apparently broadly triangular but friable and soon lost, glabrate. Inflorescence obviously bipinnate, thyrsoid, 60 cm long, 15 cm in diameter, merging into an elongate lax terminal raceme; primary bracts ovate-elliptic, very much shorter than the branches, recurved, serrate, appressed-cinereous-tomentose throughout; racemes suberect to spreading, ascending at apex, distinctly stipitate, pale-lanuginose soon becoming glabrous, the lateral ones 30-40-flowered, subdense, the terminal 50-60-flowered, laxer. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, abruptly acuminulate, much shorter than the sepals, reflexed, entire, subcoriaceous, soon glabrous; flowers suberect to spreading; pedicels stout but distinct, 10 mm long, angled. Sepals elliptic, asymmetrically rounded, 21 mm long, 10 mm wide, lanuginose becoming glabrous, lineate, thick coriaceous; petals ca 4 cm long, claw linear, naked, blade elliptic, rounded, contorted after anthesis, yellow or green when dry; stamens included.

description: Rhizome subbulbous; flowering shoot 35 cm high. Leaves densely rosulate; sheaths suborbicular, 3 cm wide, pale, almost wholly glabrous; blades recurving, narrowly triangular, pungent, 13 cm long, 16 mm wide, green and glabrous above, covered with appressed cinereous scales beneath, sublaxly serrate with dark antrorse uncinate spines 3 mm long. Scape erect, slender, cinereous-lepidote; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, curved-divergent, distinctly longer than the internodes but covering little of the scape. Inflorescence bipinnate, interrupted at base, otherwise very densely ellipsoid, 9 cm long, 4 cm in diameter; primary bracts elliptic, acute, to 2 cm long, equaling the subaborted lowest branches, otherwise shorter, cinereous-lepidote; racemes strict, subdensely few-flowered. Floral bracts elliptic, exceeding the pedicels, secund with the flowers; flowers spreading; pedicels slender, 3-4 mm long. Sepals oblong-lanceolate, broadly acute, 11 mm long, glabrous; petals ca 14 mm long; stamens included.

description: Flowering plant 6 dm or slightly higher. Leaves unknown; blades (on the basis of the lower scape-bracts) narrowly triangular, glabrous above, sparsely and minutely lepidote beneath, spinulose-serrate. Scape erect, rather slender, soon glabrous; scape-bracts ovate, serrulate, submembranaceous, red, the lower with a long blade. Inflorescence 25 cm long, depauperately paniculate, very finely white-tomentose; primary bracts ovate, acute, muchshorter than the branches, serrulate, submembranaceous, red, nerved; branches laxly few-flowered, briefly sterile at apex, complanate at base, the lateral ones not over 9 cm long. Floral bracts like the primary bracts but entire, slightly exceeding the pedicels; flowers pendulous, ca 5 cm long; pedicels to 13 mm long. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 35 mm long; petals oblong, 45 mm long, naked, greenish violet when dry; stamens and style included but slightly exserted after anthesis.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 22 cm high. Leaves many, suberect and then decurved, 15 cm long; blades 7 mm wide, velutinous-lepidote especially beneath, densely serrate with slenderly aciculate spines 3 mm long. Scape slightly exceeding the leaves, densely velutinous; scape-bracts erect, exceeding the internodes, sublanceolate, bladeless, subglabrous, minutely spinulose. Inflorescence subsimple, rather densely cylindric, slightly or not at all interrupted at base, 10 cm long, 15 mm in diameter; branches basal with one normal and one abortive flower, shorter than the bracts. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, 20 mm long, denticulate, glabrous, lineate; flowers erect; pedicels to 6 mm long. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 11 mm long, minutely araneose; petals 15 mm long, blue or violet, naked; ovary nearly superior.

description: Plant caulescent, flowering 1-2 m high; stem prostrate, 5 dm long, 5-6 cm in diameter including the old leaf-bases. Leaves ca 45 cm long; blades 20-26 cm long, 15 mm wide, densely appressed-pale-lepidote above, soon glabrous beneath except near apex. Scape 8-15 mm in diameter at apex, soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the upper small, triangular. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate but subdense toward apex, 1 m long; axes densely white-flocculose; primary bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, distinctly shorter than the branches, serrate, thin-coriaceous, sublustrous, soon glabrous beneath except near apex; racemes spreading, substrobilate, lax toward base, 6-7 cm long, 3 cm in diameter, about 15-flowered, the naked sterile base 1 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, short-acuminate, 22 mm long, about equaling the sepals, erose-denticulate, sublustrous; flowers suberect; pedicels short, stout. Sepals lanceolate, 16 mm long, carinate, densely white-flocculose; petals 25 mm long, green.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves 7-12 dm long; blades recurving, scarcely over 20 mm wide, green on both sides, furfuraceous especially beneath with long flexuous hairlike scales, the marginal spines 5 mm long with the upper ones antrorse. Scape very stout, sparsely furfuraceous; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, spinose-serrate, bearing very long filiform-subulate blades. Inflorescence amply bipinnate, interrupted at base and dense elsewhere, subpyramidal, acute, 50 cm long, 18 cm in diameter; axis very stout, angled when dry; primary bracts conspicuous, the lower ones with elongate recurved subulate blades, entire, glabrate; branches elongate but substrobiliform, to 13 cm long and 10-15-flowered, subspreading, fertile toward apex, flattened at base. Floral bracts erect, subimbricate, ovate with an acute acicular apex, 33 mm long, exceeding the sepals, rather rigid, veined, glabrate; flowers subsessile. Sepals very narrowly triangular, attenuate to an acicular apex, 32 mm long, lanate; petals acute and barbellate (?), 40 mm long, blue-green, naked; anthers 8 mm long.

description: Plants densely aggregated. Leaves reflexed, 6 dm long; blades 2 cm wide, glabrous on one side, minutely pale-lepidote between the nerves on the other, laxly serrate with hooked spines 7 mm long. Scape 1.5 m. high. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, ca 1 m long, apparently glabrous; primary bracts subtriangular, much shorter than the long sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading, the lateral to 3 dm long. Floral bracts elliptic, obtuse, not over 8 mm long; flowers spreading; pedicels obconic, 18 mm long; sepals oblong, obtuse or broadly acute, 3 cm long. Capsule subglobose, abruptly acute, 25 mm long; seeds broadly alate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 55-70 cm high. Leaves very many, very densely rosulate; sheaths suborbicular, 35 mm in diameter, dark castaneous outside, appressed-lepidote at apex, glabrous elsewhere; blades 15-22 cm long, 12-15 mm wide at base, glabrous and lustrous above, covered beneath with a membrane of cinereous scales. Scape slightly decurved toward apex, 15 mm in diameter, sparsely ferruginous-lanate, soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, the lowest subfoliaceous, the others very broadly elliptic, serrulate, thin when dry, dark, bearing gradually shorter linear blades. Inflorescence nutant, simple, densely strobilate, subglobose, ca 5 cm in diameter at anthesis. Floral bracts like the scape-bracts but merely apiculate and obscurely denticulate, exceeding the sepals; pedicels ca 5 mm long, stout. Sepals narrowly obovate, broadly obtuse, 18 mm long, very densely ferruginous-stellate; petals 4 cm long, pale green.

description: Plant flowering 2-3 m high. Leaves 3-6 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, dark brown, serrulate; blades 23 mm wide, minutely lepidote between the nerves beneath, smooth and glabrous above, the lower ¾ laxly serrate with dark uncinate spines 6 mm long, the upper ¼ entire. Scape erect, 3 cm in diameter, brown-lanate, becoming glabrous; scape-bracts numerous, much longer than the internodes, reflexed, the lower ones foliaceous but with narrower sheaths and smaller blades, the upper elliptic with caudate apices, dark brown, membranaceous throughout, entire. Inflorescence simple, slenderly cylindric, densely many-flowered, 5-6 cm in diameter, densely and persistently brown-lanate. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts much exceeding the flowers but soon reflexed; flowers erect; pedicels 5-10 mm long. Sepals lance-elliptic, apiculate, 18-20 mm long, striate, subcoriaceous; petals ca 4 cm long, obtuse, pale.

description: Plant flowering 1.5 m or higher. Leaves many, densely rosulate, ca 1 m long; sheaths reniform, 13 cm wide, castaneous, lustrous, glabrous; blades 3 cm wide, glabrous above, covered beneath with cinereous appressed scales, laxly serrate with recurved castaneous 7 mm long spines. Scape erect or ascending, 12 mm in diameter at apex, glabrous except the white-tomentose nodes; scape-bracts soon deciduous, unknown. Inflorescence simple, cylindric, 4 dm long, 8 cm in diameter, many-flowered, sublax at anthesis, thinly white-tomentose, soon glabrous. Floral bracts divergent at anthesis and more or less exposing the rhachis, lanceolate, acute, ca 5 cm long, exceeding the sepals, not recurved, entire, probably rather fleshy, blackened along the margin at anthesis and soon wholly black, brittle; pedicels slender, 10 mm long. Sepals narrowly oblong, obtuse, 40 mm long, 7 mm wide, ecarinate, coriaceous; only very immature petals and stamens known.

description: Leaves rosulate, many; sheaths oblong, inconspicuous; blades linear-triangular, over 6 dm long, 25 mm wide, glabrous above, densely cinereous-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with dark antrorse spines 5 mm long. Scape short. Inflorescence sub sessile, compound from many fascicles, semiglobose, dense, 15 cm in diameter; outer bracts ovate or ovate-oblong with a narrowly deltoid apex, 45-50 mm long, 15-20 mm wide, entire, subcoriaceous, lustrous, striate, roseate drying to yellow-brown with a very dark base, subfurfuraceous, becoming glabrous. Floral bracts like the outer bracts but narrower and more furfuraceous, about equaling the sepals; pedicels broadly obconic, 15 mm long, merging with the base of the ovary, compressed; sepals narrowly lanceolate, attenuate to a pungent apex, 35-40 mm long, 10 mm wide in the middle, carinate, tomentellous toward base and apex; petals lingulate-lanceolate, subacute, slightly exceeding the sepals, contorted after anthesis, naked, blue-green; stamens barely exserted, anthers linear, 7 mm long, pollen ovoid, 40-30 µ; ovary conic-cylindric, ¼ inferior; ovules ovate, winged.

description: Flowering plant to 7 dm high, slender. Leaves scarcely over 15 cm long, entire throughout; sheaths forming a large ellipsoid bulb; blades about 5 mm wide at the middle, subulate-convolute and green throughout. Scape erect, slender, much exceeding the leaves; lower scape-bracts rather dense, with long entire blades, the middle and upper ones ovate, acute, with serrulate blades, glabrous. Inflorescence simple, laxly racemose, ca 20 cm long, to 15-flowered, glabrous; axis slightly angled. Floral bracts broadly ovate-elliptic, acute, pungent, exceeded by the sepals but exceeding the pedicels, entire or the lowest serrulate near base; flowers nutant at anthesis, erect in fruit; pedicels 15 mm long, thickened upward. Sepals elliptic, slightly asymmetric, obtuse, not mucronate, 16 mm long, fleshy, glabrous except the barbellate apex; petals tubular-erect, lingulate, obtuse, 32 mm long, yellow-green; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering only 10 cm high. Leaves forming a subbulbous rosette, to 12 cm long; sheaths broadly ovate, 15 mm long, serrulate and appressed-lepidote toward apex, elsewhere entire and glabrous, the outer ones dark brown; blades to 6 mm wide, covered on both sides with suborbicular slightly spreading cinereous scales, becoming glabrous above, laxly serrate with slender yellow-brown retrorse spines 1.5 mm long. Scape slender, pale-stellate-lepidote, mostly hidden by the leaves; scape-bracts imbricate, the upper ovate, acute, thin. Inflorescence simple, 4 cm long, subdense, few-flowered, sparsely pale-stellate-lepidote except the petals. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, to 13 mm long, entire, much exceeding the pedicels, bright red; pedicels slender, to 8 mm long. Sepals oblong, broadly acute and apiculate, 11 mm long; petals ca 15 mm long, naked.

description: Plants forming dense masses, flowering to 2.4 m high. Leaves many in dense spreading rosettes, to 85 cm long; sheaths reniform, 6 cm long, 9 cm wide, dark castaneous, glabrous except near apex; blades 35 mm wide, glabrous above, covered beneath with appressed cinereous scales, laxly serrate with stout uncinate spines 10 mm long. Scape unknown. Inflorescence simple and pyramidal-cylindric or few-branched, many-flowered, covered with fine white spreading scales but all becoming glabrous except the pedicels. Floral bracts lanceolate, attenuate to a pungent apex, the lowest 9 cm long, ample, exceeding the sepals, subspinulose, submembranaceous, strongly nerved; pedicels rather slender, to 15 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, narrowly rounded and apiculate, 30-40 mm long; petals lingulate-elliptic, subacute, 50-52 mm long, 10 mm wide, naked, green with violet margins; stamens included, the anthers linear, 10 mm long, the pollen elliptic, 20-30 µ; ovary conic, 3-angled; ovules ovate, winged.

description: Plant flowering about 1 m high. Leaves 35 cm long; blades rigid, 2 cm wide, glabrous above, densely and minutely appressed-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with flat brown mostly retrorse spines 4 mm long. Scape about 1 cm in diameter at apex, lanate; scape-bracts densely imbricate, the upper with a broad dark brown membranaceous base and linear subfoliaceous blade. Inflorescence densely cylindric, bipinnate, densely pale brown-lanate except the petals; primary bracts orbicular, apiculate, at least 4 cm long, entire, pale brown, membranaceous, translucent, becoming more or less glabrous; lateral branches reduced to few-flowered pulvini. Floral bracts elliptic, abruptly acuminate, slightly exceeding the sepals, membranaceous; pedicels cylindric, 6 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 20 mm long, ecarinate; petals 35 mm long, yellowish green, naked.

description: Caulescent, the stem 3 cm in diameter; flowering shoot 20-37 cm high; leaves many, rosulate at the end of the stem, to 20 cm long; sheaths suborbicular, 25 mm long, their apical third serrulate and densely lepidote; blades narrowly triangular, acuminate, 12 mm wide, glabrous above, covered beneath with white appressed scales, laxly serrate with slender spreading spines 3 mm long; scape erect, slender, densely white-flocculose; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, the upper ones with thin roseate sheaths; inflorescence slenderly cylindric with the apical third simple, 10-20 cm long, 2-3 cm in diameter; primary bracts triangular-ovate, acuminate, 3-4 cm long, exceeding the few-flowered axillary branches, pectinate-serrate, subchartaceous, finely nerved, opaque, deep rose, covered with white appressed scales; floral bracts of the branches like the primary bracts, shorter than the sepals; pedicels distinct, to 3 mm long; sepals lance-oblong with an acicular apex, 18-20 mm long, carinate, densely white-flocculose; petals 34-40 mm long, blue-green.

description: Flowering plant 7-20 dm high (! Wurdack). Leaves 1 m long; blades 5 cm wide, covered beneath with fine appressed cinereous scales, laxly serrate with flat pale antrorse 5 mm long spines. Scape erect, 25 mm in diameter near middle, densely and finely white-lanate; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate and completely covering the scape, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper lance-ovate, acute, finely white-lanate, denticulate. Inflorescence simple, densely cylindric, 4 dm long, 15 cm in diameter including the petals, many-flowered, except the petals densely and finely white-lanate. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts but only obscurely denticulate and recurving toward apex, to 9 cm long, much exceeding the sepals if extended, subcoriaceous, greenish; pedicels slenderly cylindric, ca 2 cm long. Sepals lance-oblong, obtuse, 37 mm long; petals naked, 7 cm long, cream (! Wurdack).

description: Plant flowering 5-6(-10) dm high. Leaves rosulate, over 4 dm long, thick and rigid but brittle and easily broken; sheaths suborbicular, 4 cm in diameter, pale, lepidote outside toward apex, glabrous elsewhere; blades 4 cm wide at base, glabrous and lustrous above, pale green but conspicuously dark-maculate beneath each spine, minutely white-lepidote between the nerves beneath. Scape 12 mm in diameter, brown-flocculose; scape-bracts densely imbricate, the lowest foliaceous, the highest ovate, acuminate, subentire, subpapyraceous when dry, brown-lanate. Inflorescence strobiliform-clavate, 15 cm long, 5 cm in diameter, brown-lanate; primary bracts erect, nearly covering the flowers, like the upper scape-bracts; branches abortive, each bearing a fascicle of 3 flowers. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, exceeding the sepals, thin; pedicels obconic, 6 mm long. Sepals oblong-lanceolate, subacute, 21 mm long, ecarinate, subcoriaceous; petals 4 cm long, dark blue.

description: Stems decumbent, branched, "as thick as a man’s arm;" flowering shoot 1-1.5 m high. Leaves numerous, rosulate, recurved, ca 4 dm long; sheaths short; blades attenuate to a very stout pungent apex, to 35 mm wide, covered throughout with a membrane of pale appressed scales, serrate with spreading curved fusco-castaneous or darker spines 9 mm long. Scape erect, very stout, exceeding the leaves, densely white-lanate; scape-bracts erect or suberect, much exceeding the internodes, large, ovate with the lower laminate and the upper acute, glabrous, minutely crenulate. Inflorescence very densely subspicate, cylindric-sceptriform, tapering gradually from base to apex, 35 cm long, 5 cm in diameter, many-flowered; axis stout, densely white-lanate. Floral bracts erect or suberect, broadly ovate, acuminate, 4 cm long at the center of the inflorescence, exceeding the sepals but not the petals, entire, brown, pergamaceous when dry; flowers subsessile, densely lanuginose except the petals. Sepals triangular, attenuate, 26 mm long, rigid; petals tubular-erect, Lingulate, 47 mm long, dark violet, naked; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering ca 2 m high. Leaves unknown but presumably spinose-serrate judging by the scape-bracts. Scape straight, slightly compressed, to 3 cm wide, finely white-stellate, glabrous with age; scape-bracts erect, much exceeding the internodes but not completely covering the scape, the lowest unknown, the others elliptic, acute, pungent, subchartaceous, finely white-stellate, densely spinose-serrate near apex. Inflorescence simple, cylindric, nearly 1 m long, subdensely many-flowered, very finely white-stellate, soon glabrous; axis stout. Floral bracts soon reflexed, lance-oblong, acute, entire, to 6 cm or longer, exceeding the pedicels, subchartaceous; pedicels slender, ca. 2 cm long at anthesis, becoming stouter, flattened, and 4 cm long in fruit. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acuminate, ecarinate, 28 mm long at anthesis, 40 mm in fruit, subcoriaceous, nerved when dry; petals 5 cm long, yellow-green (! Hutchison), twisted together after anthesis. Capsule very broadly ellipsoid, 25 mm long.

description: Flowering plant 1 m high. Leaves 7-8 dm long; blades 25 mm wide, glabrous above, minutely appressed-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with stout dark brown uncinate spines 6 mm long. Scape erect, terete, glabrous; scape-bracts deciduous, unknown. Inflorescence simple, laxly racemose, elongate, minutely cinereous-tomentose throughout. Floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, shorter than the pedicels, entire, thick, opaque, reflexed; flowers erect or suberect; pedicels rather stout, 2 cm long, thickened upward. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, 35 mm long, 7 mm wide, ecarinate; petals 6 cm long, spirally contorted after anthesis, naked, green.

description: Plant known only from fragments but probably flowering over 1 m high. Leaves rosulate, ca. 8 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 10 cm long, the basal part yellow and glabrous, the apical dark castaneous and covered with coarse white appressed scales; blades narrowly triangular, 5 cm wide, covered on both sides with appressed white scales, laxly serrate with flat brown uncinate spines 8 mm long. Scape 8 mm in diameter at apex, soon glabrous; upper scape-bracts ovate with a long narrowly triangular apex, exceeding the internodes but exposing most of the scape, entire, rugose when dry as if formerly fleshy. Inflorescence simple, subdensely cylindric, interrupted at base, over 5 dm long, densely and finely white-stellate. Floral bracts broadly ovate, contracted to a narrowly triangular apex, the lowest exceeding the sepals, the upper much shorter; flowers suberect; pedicels obconic, 6 mm long. Sepals oblong, acute, 26 mm long, ecarinate; petals 40 mm long, yellowish; stamens included.

description: Flowering plant about 2 m high. Leaves 1 m long; blades pale-appressed-lepidote throughout, becoming glabrous above, laxly serrate with spreading spines 7-8 mm long. Scape 15 cm in diameter at base; scape-bracts unknown. Inflorescence compound; primary bracts shorter than the branches; branches fertile throughout, strobilate, ovoid or ellipsoid. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, acuminulate, reaching the middle of the sepals, convex, ecarinate, densely ferruginous-lanate; pedicels stout, 15 mm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, 30 mm long, densely ferruginous-lanate; petals 65 mm long, naked, the blade elliptic; stamens and style included; ovary pyramidal.

description: Plant flowering ca 1 m high; stem erect, short, 15-40 mm in diameter. Leaves rosulate, numerous, to 1 m long; sheaths suborbicular, 7 cm long, the basal half pale on both sides and entire, the apical dark castaneous and spinulose-serrate, densely brown-lepidote beneath; blades spreading, 2-4 cm wide, covered beneath with cinereous appressed scales, glabrous above, laxly serrate with mostly antrorse spines to 3 mm long or sometimes subentire. Scape 15 mm in diameter, soon glabrous; scape-bracts suberect, the lowest subfoliaceous, the upper attenuate from a broadly ovate base, exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence erect, laxly bipinnate, ca 4 dm long, sparsely and fugaciously vestite with fine white stellate scales; axes rather slender, dark purple; primary bracts broadly ovate, pungent-apiculate, to 5 cm long, much shorter than the branches, thin but persistent, nerved, serrulate; branches subspreading, to 24 cm long including the very short naked sterile base, laxly 10-20-flowered. Moral bracts mostly suberect, ovate, acute, 12-16 mm long, exceeding the pedicels, thin, nerved, minutely serrulate; pedicels ascending, slender, to 6 mm long. Sepals elliptic, broadly acute or rounded and mucronulate, 11-14 mm long, thin, sulcate, thickened at base but otherwise ecarinate; petals 18-20 mm long, naked, blades elliptic, green, twisted together in age; stamens included; ovary pyramidal, 5 mm long. Capsule 8 mm long, 5 mm in diameter; seeds numerous, rugose-reticulate, the wing narrow, incurved.

description: Plant distinctly caulescent; stem 1.8-2.4 m long, branching; flowering shoot 1.8-2.4 m high. Leaves rosulate at the ends of the stem, very numerous, 45-75 cm long; sheaths white, succulent; blades pale green, serrate with pale brown spines. Inflorescence amply paniculate, the axes covered with appressed ferruginous tomentum, becoming glabrous; primary bracts narrowly triangular, pungent, mostly shorter than the naked sterile bases of the branches, serrulate; racemes dense but not strobilate, 17 cm long, stipitate for 3-4 cm. Floral bracts ovate, triangular-acute, much exceeded by the sepals, convex, entire, tomentulose; flowers erect or suberect, not at all secund; pedicels stout, 5 mm long. Sepals asymmetric, subelliptic, rounded-emarginate and mucronulate, 21 mm long, nearly 10 mm wide, ferruginous-tomentulose, becoming glabrous with age; petals 5 cm long, olivaceous-blue, spreading to reflexed at anthesis, naked; stamens included; filaments dilated toward base; anthers 8 mm long.

description: Flowering shoot 8 dm high. Leaves at least 27 cm long; sheaths suborbicular, 3 cm long, glabrous toward base, densely serrulate toward apex; blades narrowly triangular, caudate-acuminate with a long entire apex, laxly serrate below with slender antrorse brown spines 5 mm long, densely tomentose with coarse white scales especially beneath. Scape 4 mm in diameter, mostly exposed, soon glabrous; scape-bracts ovate, thin, the lower ones with small foliaceous blades, the upper merely acuminate, entire, much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, soon glabrous except for the white-puberulent pedicels; primary bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, entire, to 25 mm long, thin, mostly about half as long as the sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading, straight, very slender, lax, the lateral ones to 23 cm. long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, to 13 mm long, slightly exceeding the pedicels, entire, membranaceous; flowers dark violet, not noticeably secund; pedicels slenderly cylindric. Sepals lance-oblong, apiculate, 17 mm long, thin, sulcate, slightly carinate at base; petals 30 mm long, naked.

description: Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, tomentose-lepidote; primary bracts ovate, exceeding the long slender sterile bases of the branches, minutely serrulate, submembranaceous, red when dry; racemes secund, dense, ellipsoid, to 10 cm long and 5 cm in diameter. Floral bracts like the primary bracts but smaller and entire, about equaling the sepals; flowers erect; pedicels slenderly obconic, 7 mm long. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, uncinate at apex, 45 mm long, ecarinate; petals narrowly elliptic, acute, 6 cm long, dark violet when dry; stamens and style elongate, about equaling the petals or slightly exserted after anthesis; ovules obtuse.

description: Plant flowering to 1 m high. Leaves to 4 dm long; blades very rigid, 30 mm wide, pungent, subglabrous above, appressed-cinereous-lepidote beneath, densely serrate with strict erect spines 8 mm long. Scape relatively slender, terete, glabrous; scape-bracts very broadly ovate, glabrous, lustrous, serrate with long spreading spines, all more or less laminate. Inflorescence densely paniculate, cylindric, 40 cm long, 85 mm in diameter, rounded at apex; axis terete, stout; primary bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, to 45 mm long, 25 mm wide, exceeding the branches, coarsely spinose-serrate, nerved, laccate-lustrous, glabrous; branches with a short sterile base, rather laxly 4-flowered. Floral bracts very broadly elliptic, acuminulate, 25 mm long, much exceeded by the sepals; pedicels 3-4 mm long. Sepals broadly elliptic-oblong, broadly acute, 21 mm long, rigid, closely striate, glabrous except for the barbellate apex; petals 37 mm long, the blades broadly elliptic, apiculate, minutely barbellate at apex; stamens included.

description: Flowering plant 1 m or higher. Leaves unknown. Scape stout, densely white-tomentose when young, becoming glabrous; scape-bracts (upper) reflexed, lance-triangular, ca 15 cm long, sparsely laciniate-spinulose. Inflorescence simple, densely cylindric, subacute, 30 cm long, ca 7 cm in diameter, densely tomentulose when young, becoming glabrous. Floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, equaling or exceeding the sepals, entire, submembranaceous, the lowest reflexed, the others erect or suberect; flowers erect or suberect; pedicels slender, to 12 mm long. Sepals subelliptic, triangular-acute, 25 mm long, 8 mm wide, petals obtuse, 46 mm long, brownish, naked; stamens exserted. Capsule stout-ovoid, 14 mm long, brown, opaque, equally loculicidal and septicidal; seeds falcate-alate, 2.5 mm long including the wing.

description: Plant flowering to 2 m high. Leaves 2-5 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 4 cm long, serrulate; blades 2-4 cm wide, densely and closely cinereous-lepidote above, becoming wholly glabrous with age, laxly serrate with straight slender spines 4 mm long. Scape central, erect, 15-20 mm in diameter, pale-flocculose; scape-bracts erect, exceeding the internodes but exposing much of the scape at anthesis, the lowest subfoliaceous, the others broadly ovate with a linear attenuate apex, subdensely spinulose-serrate, soon glabrous, dark castaneous, lustrous, somewhat rugose when dry. Inflorescence simple, lax at anthesis, 4-8 dm long, the rhachis and pedicels persistently pale-flocculose. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts but with merely apiculate summits, about equaling the sepals at anthesis, coriaceous, serrulate to subentire; flowers spreading; pedicels 15-50 mm long, compressed, 3-4 mm wide. Sepals elliptic-oblong, acute, 24-30 mm long, 10 mm wide; petals 45 mm long, blue, blade obovate, abruptly acute, 15 mm wide; stamens included; anthers 6 mm long; ovules alate. Capsule oblong-ovoid, acute, 25 mm long.

description: Plant known only from fragments but probably less than 1 m high. Leaves 3-4 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, castaneous and lustrous beneath becoming cinereous-lepidote at apex; blades 12 mm wide, covered on both sides with appressed cinereous scales, laxly serrate with pale brown slender curved 5 mm long spines. Scape slender, densely and finely stellate-lepidote; scape-bracts much exceeding the internodes, the upper ones thin and drying stramineous but persistent, broadly triangular-ovate with a narrow serrulate blade, cinereous-tomentose. Inflorescence sublaxly bipinnate, slenderly cylindric, 3 dm long, densely and finely cinereous-tomentose; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, much shorter than the spikes but their blades sometimes slightly exceeding them; spikes divergent, sessile, densely few-flowered, the lateral to 4 cm long, the terminal 8 cm. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, much exceeded by the sepals; flowers sessile. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, acute, 14 mm long. Capsules subglobose, 12 mm long.

description: Plant known only at the beginning of anthesis, ca 1.5 m high. Leaves over 6 dm long; blades 4 cm wide, paler above, covered with pale appressed persistent scales on both sides, laxly serrate with spreading pale brown 5 mm long spines. Scape straight, 12 mm in diameter, densely and finely white-stellate, soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lowest unknown, the others linear-lanceolate, the median serrate, the upper entire. Inflorescence simple, cylindric, 4-5 dm long, rather lax at least toward base, except for the petals covered with a fine pale gray stellate tomentum. Floral bracts suberect, narrowly triangular, attenuate, about equaling the sepals of the lowest flowers, elsewhere distinctly shorter, coriaceous; pedicels slenderly obconic, 12 mm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, broadly acute and apiculate, 30 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous; petals 5 cm long, about equaling the stamens, naked, metallic blue (! Hutchison).

description: Plants cespitose with a rhizome up to 15 cm in diameter, the flowering shoot 15-25 cm high. Leaves 20-25 cm long; sheaths ovate, 15 mm long, blades 7 mm wide, cinereous-lepidote especially beneath, laxly serrate with spreading spines 3 mm long. Scape very short, white-tomentellous, becoming glabrous; scape-bracts densely imbricate, broadly ovate-elliptic with foliaceous blades; inflorescence simple, strobilate, fusiform, 6-8 cm long, 25 mm in diameter, few-flowered; axis densely white-tomentose. Floral bracts strict, broadly ovate, acuminate, 20-28 mm long, 15 mm wide, exceeding the petals, entire, pungent, appressed-lepidote, becoming glabrous, rose, nerved, rigid; pedicels 2-3 mm long. Sepals subtriangular, acutish, 12-13 mm long, carinate, sparsely lepidote, becoming glabrous especially toward apex; petals obtuse, 15-20 mm long, about equaling the stamens, naked, green becoming blue or violet when dry. Capsule ovoid, acute, 11 mm long, brown, loculicidally dehiscent to base; seeds with a thick truncate suberose wing 2 mm long.

description: Flowering 1 m or higher (?). Leaves over 8 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, pungent, 55 mm wide, smooth and glabrous above, bearing minute pale brown scales between the nerves beneath, laxly serrate with spreading or ascending slender pale brown spines 4 mm long. Scape stout, soon glabrous; scape-bracts deciduous, unknown. Inflorescence simple, subdensely cylindric, elongate; axis 2 cm in diameter, finely lanate. Floral bracts reflexed, lanceolate, acute, to 8 cm long, thin, nerved, soon glabrous, dark brown when dry; pedicels arching-decurved, slender, 2 cm long, finely white-lanate. Sepals narrowly spatulate, obtuse, 40 mm long, finely white-lanate; petals narrowly elliptic, 75 mm long, naked; stamens included.

description: Flowering probably 1-2 m high. Leaves 6-7 dm long; sheaths reniform, 12 cm wide, dark castaneous, glabrous except at apex; blades narrowly triangular, acuminate, pungent, to 70 mm wide, pale-appressed-lepidote on both sides, becoming more or less glabrous, laxly serrate with slender brown uncinate spines 7 mm long. Scape unknown. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, finely pale-tomentose-lepidote, primary bracts elliptic, caudate-apiculate, 11 cm long, much exceeding the sterile naked base of the branches, serrulate; branches divergent, straight, to 34 cm long, rather laxly flowered with the rhachis wholly visible at anthesis. Floral bracts uniform, lanceolate, apiculate, to 35 mm long, reaching about the centers of the sepals, thin; pedicels slender, to 30 mm long, persistently lepidote and contrasting with the glabrescent sepals. Sepals lanceolate, rounded and apiculate, 27 mm long, ecarinate, sulcate when dry; petals over 7 cm long, naked, red-purple when dry; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves 5 dm long; blades 5 cm wide, densely cinereous-lepidote especially beneath, the spines antrorse, 5 mm long. Scape unknown. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 3-7 dm long, glabrous; primary bracts broadly ovate, acute, about equaling the sterile bases of the branches, inflated, entire, stramineous; branches spreading to suberect, to 20 cm long, lax. Floral bracts ovate-elliptic, about equaling the slender, 15-18 mm long pedicels, entire; flowers suberect to deflexed. Sepals lanceolate, rounded and apiculate, 26 mm long, carinate at base, petals 40 mm long, naked or appendaged.

description: Plant flowering 1.2-2 m high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, 4-5 dm long; blades 2 cm wide, densely cinereous-lepidote beneath, glabrous above, laxly serrate with uncinate brown spines 4 mm long. Scape straight or slightly curved, elongate, stout, much exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts reflexed, soon deciduous. Inflorescence densely cylindric or ellipsoid, compound, 2-3 dm long, covered with a yellowish white wool; primary bracts large, very broadly ovate or obovate with a deltoid apiculus, fuscous when dry, lanate on both sides, becoming glabrous at anthesis, suberose, slightly exceeding the few-flowered spikes, recurved toward apex. Floral bracts like the primary bracts but smaller, equaling or slightly exceeding the sepals; pedicels ca. 10 mm long. Sepals ovate-oblong, subacute, 30 mm long, 15 mm wide, covered on both sides with a dense easily detached wool; petals 5 cm long, naked, the blade oblong, to 13 mm wide, flavous; stamens included, the anthers 10 mm long, the pollen grains ellipsoid, 44 X 22 µ.

description: Plant flowering 1.5 m high. Leaves ca 1 m long; blades pale-lepidote beneath, glabrous above. Scape 3-4 dm long (?), nearly 2 cm in diameter; scape-bracts unknown. Inflorescence compound, very densely cylindric, 3-4 dm long, covered with sordid white wool except the petals; primary bracts imbricate and covering the branches, broadly ovate, acute or acuminate, entire; branches 5-7 cm long, few-flowered, dense. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminuiate, 40-45 mm long, 25 mm wide; pedicels short and thick. Sepals oblong, obtuse or subacute, 25 mm long, 11 mm wide, subcoriaceous; petals 50-55 mm long, the blade oblong-oblanceolate, obtuse; ovary slenderly conic, 11 mm high.

description: Flowering plant 2.5-4 m high, solitary. Leaves 7-15 dm long; sheaths ample, serrulate toward apex; blades 2-3 cm wide, flat, glabrous above, beneath minutely pale-lepidote between the nerves, laxly serrate with hooked teeth 11-15 mm long. Scape erect, very stout. Inflorescence cylindric, very densely bipinnate, densely white-lanate; primary bracts acuminate from an ovate base, exceeding the axillary branches at anthesis, entire; racemes subglabrous, subsessile. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, entire, about equaling the sepals, chartaceous when dry; pedicels stout, about 1 cm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, to 23 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous; petals obtuse, 4 cm long, dark blue, naked.

description: Plant flowering 1 m high. Leaves 3 dm long; sheaths inconspicuous, sparsely appressed-lepidote; blades narrowly triangular, acuminate, glabrous above, minutely and obscurely lepidote between the nerves beneath, laxly serrate with slender straight suberect spines 3.5 mm long. Scape ca 1 cm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts densely imbricate, the lowest foliaceous, the others membranaceous and rapidly deciduous. Inflorescence simple, over 3 dm long, sublax with the rhachis visible throughout, many-flowered, pale-stellate-lepidote except the petals. Floral bracts suborbicular, apiculate, distinctly exceeding the pedicels, entire, thin, drying almost black; flowers spreading to reflexed; pedicels slender, curved, to 13 mm long. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 20 mm long, carinate at base; petals 35 mm long, grayish green, bearing slight irregular folds at base.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 5 dm high. Leaves numerous, 3 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 3 cm long, white and glabrous except the extreme apex; blades 2 cm wide, covered beneath with subappressed cinereous scales, glabrous above, laxly serrate with pale slender ascending spines 2 mm long. Scape erect, 1 cm in diameter, finely white-flocculose, becoming glabrous; lowest scape-bracts foliaceous and densely imbricate, the highest barely equaling the internodes and exposing most of the scape, ovate, acute, subchartaceous, dark red. Inflorescence simple, 12 cm long, lax at base, finely white-flocculose. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, 35 mm long, entire, slightly exceeded by the sepals, thick, coriaceous, rugose when dry; flowers divergent to spreading; pedicels cylindric, 10 mm long. Sepals lance-oblong, broadly acute, 34 mm long, ecarinate, thick, coriaceous. Capsule broadly ellipsoid, 2 cm long.

description: Plant caulescent, flowering barely 1 m high; stem 20 cm in diameter, branching. Leaves ca 5 dm long; blades 45 mm wide, above pale green, glabrous and lustrous, covered with a membrane of white scales beneath, serrate with suberect spines that are 7 mm long and nearly straight except for the highest uncinate ones. Scape relatively slender, white-tomentose soon becoming glabrous; scape-bracts very broadly ovate, white-lepidote, laciniate-spinose, laminate, the upper lax; inflorescence very densely bipinnate. cylindric, over 25 cm long, 8 cm in diameter; axes stout, slightly angled when dry, white-araneous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, spinose-serrate; branches fertile throughout, substrobilate, erect or suberect, to 10 cm long, exceeding the primary bracts; floral bracts ovate-elliptic, attenuate, 35 mm long, exceeding the sepals, spinose-serrate, araneous; flowers suberect, very short-pedicellate, to 40 mm long. Sepals triangular, attenuate to an acicular apex, 35 mm long, rigid; petals tubular-erect, narrowly lingulate, naked, glaucous-green.

description: Flowering plant 8-10 dm high. Leaves 6-7 dm long; blades 18 mm wide, ferruginous-lepidote, the marginal spines slender, uncinate, 7 mm long. Scape erect, 5 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts remote, ovate, spinulose-serrate, the lowest long-caudate. Inflorescence simple, lax, 35 cm long, finely stellate-lepidote. Floral bracts ovate, apiculate, usually exceeded by the sepals, obscurely serrulate, membranaceous; flowers erect or suberect, slender; pedicels 5-7 mm long, slender. Sepals narrowly ovate, acuminate, 30 mm long; petals tubular-erect, 45 mm long, about equaling the stamens, naked; style exserted.

description: Plant flowering to 5 m high. Leaves over 1 m long; sheaths suborbicular, pale, densely serrulate; blades 50-75 mm wide, minutely pale-lepidote between the nerves beneath, glabrous above, very laxly serrate with flat dark more or less uncinate spines 4-11 mm long. Scape erect, very stout; scape-bracts densely imbricate, the lower subfoliaceous but with thinner bases, the upper suborbicular with a narrowly triangular apex, dark brown, submembranaceous, soon disintegrating. Inflorescence bipinnate, substrobilate, cylindrical; primary bracts very broadly ovate, triangular-acute, longer or shorter than the axillary branches, covered with a pale brown evanescent indument, dark brown, membranaceous, disintegrating soon after anthesis; racemes erect or suberect, lax, the axes 2-8 cm long, rather slender. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, acute, exceeding the pedicels, dark brown, membranaceous; flowers divergent to spreading; pedicels slender, 15-35 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, 20-29 mm long, prominently nerved, pubescent with minute pale trichomes, soon glabrous; petals 5-6 cm long, the blade suborbicular, green or greenish blue; stamens shorter than the petals, the anthers 8-9 mm long. Capsule subglobose.

description: Plant caulescent, flowering shoot 1.5-2 m high. Leaves 6 dm long; sheaths short, the lower ones suborbicular, toward apex membranaceous-margined and laciniate-spinulose, covered with a membrane of whitish scales especially on the back, becoming glabrous; blades 20 mm wide, lustrous, and pale green, very densely white- or whitish-lepidote beneath, above glabrous, serrate with antrorse to retrorse spines 5-7 mm long. Scape erect, stout, terete, glabrous; lower scape-bracts with short triangular blades, middle and upper bladeless, lax, glabrous. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, sceptriform, 35 cm long, 7 cm in diameter, densely brown-lanate; primary bracts triangular from a broadly ovate base, serrulate, recurved or revolute-reflexed and glabrate toward apex; spikes sessile or subsessile, globose to broadly ellipsoid, 6-8 cm long, 35 mm in diameter, barely exceeding the primary bracts, densely 10-flowered. Floral bracts densely imbricate, very broadly obovate, rounded at apex, 25-35 mm long, 22 mm wide, slightly to much shorter than the sepals, entire, inflated, ecarinate, coriaceous, glabrous within; pedicels stout, to 7 mm long; flowers very stout; sepals broadly obovate, obtuse, slightly asymmetric, 25 mm long, 15 mm wide, thick-coriaceous; petals over 5 cm long, obtuse, naked, green.

description: Flowering plant 2 m high. Leaves to 6 dm long, very rigid; sheaths short, very broadly ovate, subglabrous; blades 20 mm wide, appressed-pale-lepidote between the nerves beneath, glabrous above, laxly serrate with pale antrorse spines 6 mm long. Scape erect, very stout, glabrous; scape-bracts lax, foliaceous but reduced. Inflorescence very large, bipinnate, many-flowered; axes angled when dry, sparsely araneous-pubescent; primary bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, much shorter than the sterile naked bases of the branches; branches suberect, to 30 cm long, densely polystichous-flowered. Floral bracts very broadly ovate, 9 mm long, distinctly shorter than the pedicels, entire, araneous-tomentellous; flowers suberect; pedicels stout, to 13 mm long, araneous-tomentellous. Sepals subelliptic, rounded and mucronulate, 20 mm long, thick, tomentellous; petals over 4 cm long, glaucous green, naked, the claw broadly linear, the blade elliptic; stamens included.

description: Flowering 1 m high. Leaf-blades very narrowly triangular, acuminate, pungent, nearly 5 dm long, 5 cm wide at base, rigid, thick coriaceous, one side (upper?) glabrous, the other densely appressed-white-lepidote; laxly serrate with slender antrorse curved brown spines. Scape unknown. Inflorescence subdensely bipinnate, minutely white-flocculose; primary bracts oblong-ovate, acuminate, to 7 cm long, a half or a third as long as the axillary branches, subchartaceous when dry, minutely serrulate; racemes subsessile, sub-erect or divergent, the rhachis 14-15 cm long, sulcate. Floral bracts lanceolate, attenuate, slightly exceeding the pedicels, minutely erose but hardly serrulate, membranaceous; flowers divergent; pedicels slender, to 17 mm long. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 26 mm long, slightly carinate at base, subcoriaceous; petals 4 cm long.

description: Plant known only from fragments, probably flowering over 2 m high. Leaves over 12 dm long; blades very narrowly triangular, over 4 cm wide, obscurely lepidote between the nerves beneath, glabrous above, laxly serrate with broad castaneous antrorse 12 mm long spines. Scape unknown. Inflorescence branching (! Hutchison); primary bracts unknown; branches cylindric, rather dense but some of the rhachis visible at anthesis, except for the petals subdensely vestite with minute pale sessile glands. Floral bracts suberect at anthesis, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, thin-coriaceous when dry, entire; pedicels slender, to 12 mm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, obtuse, 37 mm long, ecarinate, thin; petals ca. 7 cm long, exceeding the stamens, green (! Hutchison), naked, twisted together after anthesis.

description: Flowering plant 6-8 dm high. Leaves 4-7 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 5-9 cm wide; blades 2-3 cm wide, at first covered on both sides with gray appressed scales, laxly serrate with slender uncinate spines 10 mm long. Scape erect, shorter than the leaves, stout. Inflorescence bipinnate, densely cylindric, densely and finely white-lanate with the bracts and sepals soon becoming glabrous; primary bracts persistent, elliptic, ample, acute, to 13 cm long, equaling the branches, opaque, serrate. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, about equaling the sepals, serrulate; pedicels slender, to 16 mm long. Sepals lance-ovate, acuminate, much thickened centrally but not winged, 35 mm long, coriaceous; petals 55 mm long, naked, green or purple.

description: Plants densely massed, flowering 6-10 m high. Leaves 1-1.3 m long; blades 4 cm wide, covered with pale appressed scales beneath, glabrous above, rigid, laxly serrate with antrorse spines 11 mm long. Scape erect, 5 cm or more in diameter; scape-bracts densely imbricate, deciduous. Inflorescence bipinnate, dense but not strobilate, fusiform, covered with dark ferruginous stellate trichomes; primary bracts disintegrating soon after anthesis, elliptic; branches 13-15 cm long including the 3-4 cm naked sterile base, dense. Floral bracts about equaling the sepals, dark brown, membranaceous; flowers erect or suberect; pedicels slender, 15-20 mm long. Sepals elliptic, 26 mm long, membranaceous.

description: Flowering 6-11 dm high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, to 5 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 25-30 mm long, pale toward base, dark castaneous toward apex, entire, glabrous; blades very narrowly triangular, attenuate, pungent, 10-15 mm wide at base, glabrous beneath, covered above with whitish subappressed scales, laxly serrate with subspreading straight slender brown 10 mm long spines. Scape erect, to 15 mm in diameter, white-flocculose, becoming glabrous; scape-bracts erect, exceeding the internodes, the lower subfoliaceous, densely imbricate, the upper broadly ovate and dark lustrous brown with a narrowly triangular green blade, pectinate-serrate, exposing much of the scape. Inflorescence cylindric, 3-5 dm long, simple or pseudo-simple with short inconspicuous branches at base, lax except at apex, white-flocculose soon becoming glabrous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, covering the few-flowered axillary branches. Floral bracts of the main axis like the primary bracts but merely acuminate and wholly brown, about equaling the sepals, floral bracts of the lateral branches broadly acute, entire, distinctly exceeded by the sepals; pedicels slender, 10 mm long; flowers spreading. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 15 mm long, white-lanate at apex, petals naked, 25 mm long, pale green.

description: Flowering plant 1 m high. Leaves numerous, rosulate, 4-5 dm long; sheaths sub-orbicular, 9 cm in diameter, bearing a band of appressed cinereous scales beneath at apex, elsewhere glabrous; blades 5 cm broad at base, glabrous above, minutely pale-lepidote between the nerves beneath, laxly serrate with dark flat straight or hooked spines 9 mm long. Scape very short, concealed by the leaves; inflorescence very densely bipinnate, thick-cylindric, rounded at apex, densely brown-lanate; primary bracts membranaceous, pale green, the suborbicular base equaling the sepals, the long narrowly triangular apex reflexed, coarsely serrate; branches much abbreviated, few-flowered. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, long-caudate, exceeding the sepals, subentire, membranaceous, light green drying stramineous; pedicels 1 cm long, rather slender. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acute, 45 mm long, ecarinate, minutely and sparsely serrulate, submembranaceous; petals broadly elliptic, ultramarine, dark purple at base.

description: Leaves unknown. Scape centrally 12 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts ovate, large, glabrous, serrate toward apex, their blades narrow, armed with stout uncinate castaneous spines 4 mm long, very densely villous-lepidote beneath, subulate-pungent at apex; inflorescence bipinnate, many-flowered, glabrous; primary bracts with the lowest like the scape-bracts, the others elliptic, entire, subpungent, barely exceeding the short sterile base; branches to 2 3 cm long, dense toward apex, lax at base, floral bracts very broadly elliptic, to 25 mm long, nearly or quite equaling the sepals, inflated, entire, probably bright red; flowers suberect; pedicels to 15 mm long, stout, thickened upward; sepals ovate-elliptic, rounded and apiculate, ca. 17 mm long, subrigid; petals tubular-erect, 25 mm long, naked; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering 1.5-2 m high. Leaves ca. 1 m long; blades to 4 cm wide at base, rigid, covered with whitish strongly appressed scales on both sides but soon becoming glabrous above, laxly serrate with uncinate dark castaneous 8 mm long spines. Scape erect, stout, nearly 2 cm in diameter at base, covered at first with minute white strongly appressed stellate scales; scape-bracts strict, exceeding the internodes and almost completely covering the scape, narrowly ovate, the lowest foliaceous-laminate and coarsely serrate, the highest acuminate and entire. Inflorescence simple, subdensely many-flowered, 60-75 cm long, very densely and finely lanate with minute white stellate scales. Floral bracts spreading or subreflexed at anthesis, narrowly triangular-ovate, attenuate, to 7 cm long, exceeding the sepals, entire, subcoriaceous; flowers sub-spreading at anthesis and more or less exposing the axis; pedicels arching, 15 mm long, 4 mm in diameter. Sepals narrowly oblong, acute, 35 mm long, 6 mm wide, coriaceous, ecarinate; petals yellow-green; stamens included. Capsule ellipsoid, 25 mm long.

description: Leaves over 1 m long; blades pungent, 35-40 mm wide, serrate with spines to 13 mm long, glabrous and lustrous above, beneath with pale appressed scales between the nerves. Scape unknown. Inflorescence amply bipinnate; axis stout, subterete, completely glabrous; primary bracts conspicuous but much shorter than the branches, thick, coriaceous, entire, glabrous and sublustrous dorsally; branches suberect to spreading, to 15 cm long, strobilate, the sterile base long, flat, and glabrate, the rhachis subangulate, densely furfuraceous. Floral bracts erect and more or less imbricate, broadly ovate-elliptic, acute and apiculate, 37 mm long, exceeded by the sepals, entire, rigid, dorsally glabrate, lustrous, rugulose; flowers stout; pedicels short, very stout. Sepals subelliptic, rounded and minutely mucronate, 30 mm long, rigid, lanate becoming glabrous; petals very broad, broadly acute, 50 mm long, blue-green, naked; stamens free, shorter than the pistil, the anthers subobtuse, 11-12 mm long.

description: Plant very stout, flowering to 2.5 m high. Leaves numerous in a dense rosette, the inner ones over 4 dm long; sheath blades attenuate to a pungent apex, very stiff, densely serrate with suberect nearly straight spines 6 mm long, glabrous above, densely and very closely and finely lepidote beneath. Scape-bracts squamiform. Inflorescence very densely but distinctly paniculate, thick-cylindric, thyrsiform, 1 m long, 1 dm in diameter, rounded at apex; axis long-villous, stout; primary bracts suberect to erect, ovate, sub-acuminate, nearly equaling the branches, laciniate-serrulate, lanate at base, soon glabrous elsewhere; branches short but distinct, few-flowered with a tuft of sterile bracts at apex, the lowest to 8 cm long. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, acute, ca. 30 mm long, exceeding the sepals, subcoriaceous, soon glabrous; pedicels to 7 mm long, stout, laxly tomentose. Sepals elliptic, subobtuse, 20 mm long, very thick, long-pilose; petals broadly ligulate, obtuse, 37 mm long, yellow-green, naked; stamens exserted, the anthers bacilliform, 8 mm long.

description: Stem very short and stout; flowering shoot to 2 dm high. Leaves relatively few, rosulate, barely 70 cm long; blades 11 mm wide, strongly carinate, glabrous except for white-barbate apex and ciliate-floccose margins when young, the lower half serrate with subspreading acicular spines 3 mm long, elsewhere entire. Scape twice as long as the leaves, stout, ferruginous-lanuginose; scape-bracts imbricate, elliptic-ovate, acuminate, to 25 mm long, the lower sparsely spinulose, the upper entire. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, 40 mm long, 23 mm in diameter, ferruginous-lanuginose. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, to 10 mm long, equaling the sepals, coriaceous, light blood red; flowers subsessile. Sepals distinctly asymmetric, subelliptic, emarginate, strongly veined inside; petals rounded, 20 mm long, naked, dark blue (?); stamens included, the anthers 5 mm long.

description: Plants fasciculate from a very short stem, flowering slightly over 3 dm high. Leaves 12-20 in the rosette, all more or less decurved, to 2 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 2 cm long, dark castaneous; blades linear, acuminate and pungent, 6 mm wide in the middle, glabrous, laxly serrate with ascending straight or slightly curved spines 3 mm long. Scape erect, slender, glabrous, minutely purple-spotted toward base. Lower scape-bracts foliaceous, densely imbricate, the upper ones long-acuminate from a broadly ovate base, pectinate, exceeding the internodes but exposing much of the scape. Inflorescence densely and depauperately bipinnate but often interrupted at base, cylindric, ca 10 cm long, 45 mm in diameter, glabrous except for the furfuraceous axis, blackish in drying; primary bracts acuminate from a suborbicular base, covering most of the flowers, coarsely spinose; branches aborted with the few flowers fasciculate. Floral bracts ovate, cuspidate, slightly exceeded by the sepals, spinose-serrate, carinate; flowers subsessile. Sepals subtriangular, subacute, to 12 mm long; petals 18 mm long, slightly exceeding the stamens, dark blue, naked.

description: Stem decumbent, branching. Leaves rosulate at the ends of the stem, over 6 dm long; blades 4-5 cm wide, pungent, rigid, coriaceous, very sparsely lepidote or glabrous above, below very minutely puberulous or subglabrous, armed with brown or blackish spines. Scape 9 dm high. Inflorescence simple, slenderly strobilate, nearly 7 dm long. Floral bracts densely imbricate and forming a coma at the apex of the inflorescence, lance-ovate, acuminate, to 5 cm long, 15-20 mm wide, entire or sparsely fimbriolate-denticulate, villosulous toward base, soon glabrous above; pedicels nearly 1 cm long. Sepals broadly lanceolate, acute, 30-33 mm long, 10-11 mm wide at base, loosely brownish-villous becoming glabrous; petals lingulate-lanceolate, nearly 6 cm long; ovary slenderly pyramidal, glabrous.

description: Plant flowering ca. 5 dm high. Leaves 4 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, 3 cm wide, glabrous above, minutely appressed-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with dark curved spines 6 mm long. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts dense, foliaceous, coarsely spinose-serrate. Inflorescence composed of a terminal raceme and 2 much reduced lateral ones, dark purple, densely and minutely appressed-lepidote; primary bracts suborbicular, apiculate, nearly concealing the lateral racemes. Floral bracts ovate or elliptic, apiculate, entire, exceeding the sepals; flowers erect; pedicels stout, obconic, to 10 mm long. Sepals oblanceolate, acute, 25 mm long; petals 37 mm long, bright green, drying to purple, naked, the blade scarcely distinct; stamens and style included; ovary pyramidal.
