description: Plant stemless, flowering 9 dm high. Leaves many in a dense pseudobulb; sheaths suborbicular, dark brown, sublustrous, glabrous; blades dimorphic, some reduced to dark brown flat retrorsely serrate spines, others green, deciduous along a straight transverse line, serrate below the line, unknown above but presumably like the larger scape-bracts. Scape erect, ca 1 cm in diameter at base, densely brown-floccose; scape-bracts imbricate, ovate, becoming glabrous, the lowest few with small spinose serrate blades, the central ones with large linear attenuate entire green blades 12 mm wide, the highest with long almost filiform blades. Inflorescence simple, subdense, 3 dm long; rhachis slender, flexuous, densely ferruginous-lanate. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, to 6 cm long, soon glabrous; pedicels arching, ca 15 mm long, lanate; flowers secund, reflexed. Sepals ovate, acuminate, 35 mm long, densely ferruginous-lanate, the posterior subcarinate; petals at least 10 cm long, naked; ovary more than 4/5 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 16 cm high. Leaves bulbous-rosulate, evidently all alike; sheaths ovate, ca 3 cm long, dark castaneous at least toward apex, entire; blades deciduous, unknown above the abscission line, the base 7 mm wide, pale-lepidote beneath, spinose-serrate. Scape very short, hidden by the leaf-bases; scape-bracts densely imbricate, lanceolate, acuminate. Inflorescence simple, sublax, glabrous; axis slender. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, to 28 mm long, much exceeding all the pedicels, entire, thin; flowers secund, subspreading at anthesis; pedicels slender, subterete, to 6 mm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 24 mm long, alate-carinate; petals 35 mm long, naked, red; ovary more than ½ superior.

description: Plant stemless, flowering about 1 m high. Leaves all alike, persistent, few, densely fasciculate, contracted above the sheath but not petiolate, entire; sheaths elongate, brownish at extreme base, tomentose-lepidote beneath; blades linear-lanceolate, long-attenuate to a firm apex, 8 dm long, 30 mm wide, glabrous or sparsely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, stout, pale-arachnoid becoming glabrous; scape-bracts narrowly triangular, entire, appressed, arachnoid or glabrate, the highest shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence densely racemose, ellipsoid or subcylindric, 15 cm long, 75 mm in diameter, many-flowered; rhachis stout. Floral bracts suberect, about equaling the pedicels, soft, arachnoid or lepidote; flowers suberect at anthesis, yellow or red; pedicels slender, 7 mm long. Sepals triangular or oblong, acuminate or subacute, 16 mm long, slightly or not at all carinate, hyaline-margined, sparsely lepidote or glabrous; petals ligulate, 44 mm long, arching-decurved after anthesis, bearing a small broadly truncate scale; stamens slightly exserted, anthers 7 mm long; ovary 2/3 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant stemless or with stems to 20 cm long, flowering to 15 dm high. Leaves dimorphic with those of the sterile offshoots reduced to dark serrate spines 4-10 cm long, the larger ones to 15 dm long; sheaths ovate to subtriangular, densely lepidote beneath except for the extreme base, serrate; blades linear, attenuate, slightly contracted toward base, 28-37 mm wide, showing a median channel especially when dry, entire, glabrous except along the margins and beneath at base and apex. Scape stout, straight, arachnoid-lepidote; scape-bracts from subfoliaceous and densely imbricate to ovate and about equaling the internodes, entire. Inflorescence simple, densely racemose, 18-27 cm long, arachnoid-lepidote when young. Floral bracts lanceolate to lance-ovate, 7-14 mm wide, the lowest equaling or exceeding the midpoint of the sepals; flowers reflexed after anthesis; pedicels slender, 5-10 mm long. Sepals oblong, rounded and apiculate, 19-29 mm long, ecarinate; petals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 45-55 mm long, exceeding the stamens, 13 mm wide, bearing a single rounded entire scale at base, yellow or white; ovary two-thirds superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering 3 dm high; rhizome stout, tuberous. Leaves persistent, few, entire, the lower ones reduced to broadly ovate sheaths with slender subpungent apices; upper sheaths tubular-involute, elongate, sparsely and obscurely brown-lepidote; blades of the upper leaves not petiolate, elliptic, 15 cm long, 4 cm wide, glabrous. Scape well developed, white-tomentose; scape-bracts foliaceous. Inflorescence few-flowered, densely racemose above, interrupted toward the base; axis tomentose. Floral bracts erect, ovate, acute, exceeding the sepals, the upper ones 37 mm long; flowers erect; pedicels short and stout. Sepals subelliptic, obtuse, 20 mm long, distinctly asymmetric, ecarinate; petals appendaged. Capsule ovoid, obtuse, trisulcate, 15 mm long, five-sixths superior; seeds caudate at both ends.

description: Plant flowering 27-55 cm high, stemless. Leaves all alike, to 17 cm long, entire; sheaths ovate, small, nearly black, densely imbricate and forming a narrowly ovoid or subcylindric pseudobulb 4-6 cm long; blades sessile, deciduous, linear, attenuate, 2 mm wide, white-floccose at base, soon glabrous. Scape erect, 1.5 mm in diameter, white-flocculose especially at the nodes; scape-bracts much shorter than the internodes, ovate, acuminate. Inflorescence simple, sublax, 7-13 cm long, white-flocculose. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, to 13 mm long, the lower ones exceeding the sepals; flowers divergent; pedicels slender, 2 mm long. Sepals oblong, rounded and apiculate, 7-9 mm long, ecarinate; petals 12-17 mm long, yellow, naked; ovary 4/5 superior; ovules not seen.

description: Plant flowering 35 cm high. Inflorescence densely subcylindric, obtuse, 13 cm long, the axis brown-flocculose. Floral bracts imbricate but spreading to reflexed near apex, elliptic, acute, 45 mm long, much exceeding the sepals, entire, membranaceous; pedicels short but slender. description: Plant stemless, flowering ca 3 dm high. Leaves rosulate; blades dimorphic, some reduced to slender dark spines, others foliaceous, deciduous, linear, attenuate, ca 5 dm long and 20 mm wide (! photo), green on both sides, entire at least above the line of abscission. Scape straight, slender, sparsely white-flocculose; scape-bracts strict, imbricate but slightly exposing the scape, ovate, attenuate, pectinate-serrate with dark spines. Sepals triangular-ovate, attenuate, 36 mm long, the posterior ones alate-carinate; petals 8 cm long, linear, acute, naked, red, about equaling the erect stamens but recoiling and exposing them; ovary 4/5 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering 1.8 m high. Leaves few, 1.8 m long, long-petiolate; sheaths small, broadly reniform, dark ferruginous-lanate; petioles serrate with dark spines 2 mm long; blades linear-lanceolate, attenuate, cuneate, entire, 9 cm wide, brown-lanate but soon glabrous. Inflorescence densely cylindric, over 7 dm long, 4 cm in diameter, brown-lanate. Floral bracts erect, imbricate, broadly ovate, acute, 4 cm long, slightly exceeded by the sepals, even, dark brown, thin-coriaceous; flowers 3-ranked; pedicels short and stout. Sepals lanceolate, acute, strongly asymmetric, 37 mm long, brown, the posterior carinate but not alate; petals recurving after anthesis, strapshaped, broadly rounded, 55 mm long, yellow, densely and minutely brown-lepidote outside, bearing a cupuliform scale at base; ovary 3/5 superior; ovules unknown.

description: Plant flowering 1.5 m high. Leaves to 6 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 3 cm long, subglabrous, castaneous, lustrous; blades linear, attenuate, pungent, 17 mm wide, covered with appressed cinereous scales on both sides, laxly serrate with dark antrorse curved spines 1 mm long. Floral bracts ovate, acute, to 25 mm long, about equaling or exceeding the ovary, entire, nerved, red with a narrow pale margin; flowers subsessile, divergent. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acute, 4 cm long, ecarinate; petals acute, 6 cm long, naked, pale green; stamens included; ovary ca 2/3 inferior. Seeds alate.

description: Plant flowering 1-2 m high. Leaves distinctly petiolate; sheaths short, triangular-ovate, deep-castaneous, covered with a thick coat of pale-brown coalesced scales; petioles 3 dm long, entire, channeled, complicate; blades narrowly lanceolate, attenuate, 14 dm long, 4 cm wide, densely and minutely spinose-serrate toward the apex, submembranaceous, glabrous and bright-green above, covered beneath with a membrane of white coalesced scales. Scape conspicuous, very stout, white-araneous, soon glabrous; scape-bracts appressed, lax, the upper ones just equaling the internodes, ovate, acuminate, white-lepidote, becoming glabrous. Inflorescence simple, lax at the base where flowers are mature, densely spiciform toward the apex, 3 dm long, 35 mm in diameter; axis stout, white-araneous. Floral bracts erect, broadly ovate, triangular-acute, 5 cm long, much exceeding the sepals, chartaceous, even, densely and very closely pale-lepidote, becoming glabrous with age; flowers erect; pedicels much slenderer than the base of the ovary, 5 mm long, subalate-angled along with the lower part of the ovary and white-araneous with it and the sepals. Sepals subtriangular, acute, carinate near the base, 34 mm long; petals narrowly ligulate, 11 cm long, exceeding the stamens, equaling the pistil, bearing a small scale at base; anthers 16 mm long; ovary half superior; ovules distinctly caudate.

description: Plant caulescent; stem stout, 1 m high; flowering shoot 1 m high. Scape straight, stout, sulcate, sparsely white-furfuraceous; scape-bracts strict, imbricate, triangular-ovate, acute, the upper ones 4-5 cm long. description: Stem erect, scandent, bearing widely separated fascicles of leaves, elsewhere covered with large triangular-oblong mucronate dark-castaneous buff-lepidote sheaths. Leaves 5-6 dm long, petiolate; sheaths small, broadly ovate; petioles short, rather densely serrate with dark spines 2 mm long, buff-lepidote; blades narrowly oblanceolate, acuminate, cuneate, 4-5 cm wide, entire, glabrous, reticulate beneath. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acuminate, uncinate, 6 cm long, much exceeding the bracts, glabrous; petals linear, acute, 12 cm long, about equaling the stamens, arcuate-recurved, white, bearing a serrate ligule at base; anthers 2 cm long; ovary 4/5 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 4-5 dm high, slender. Leaves heteromorphic, the outer reduced to sheaths terminating in setiform entire or sparsely serrate spines, others intermediate, the inner functional, fasciculate, deciduous along a transverse line, spinose-serrate below the line; blades linear, attenuate, entire, 4 dm long, 13 mm wide, pale arachnoid beneath, soon becoming glabrous, submembranaceous when dry. description: Plant ca 1 m high. description: Plant stemless, flowering nearly 1 m high. description: Plant flowering over 1.3 m high. Leaves 1.4 m long, glabrous above, beneath densely appressed-brown-lepidote, subdensely serrulate; sheaths ovate, 5 cm wide; blades linear, long-attenuate, slightly contracted at base, 3 cm wide. Scape robust, white-flocculose, soon glabrous; scape-bracts with a broadly elliptic red base produced into an elongate foliaceous blade, the highest ones remote. Inflorescence few-branched, 4 dm long, red; primary bracts suborbicular, apiculate, much shorter than the branches, thin, subentire, white-lepidote; spikes erect, short-pedunculate, narrowly ovoid, densely many-flowered, 5-6 cm long, the highest congested, the others remote. Floral bracts orbicular, much shorter than the sepals, thin, white-lepidote; pedicels slender, 3 mm long; flowers strict. description: Plant caulescent, 3-3.6 m long, the flowering shoot 75-90 cm high. Leaves dimorphic, some with triangular-ovate dark castaneous brown-lepidote sheaths and subulate coarsely spinose-serrate brown blades, others with more or less distinct spinose-serrate petioles and broadly lanceolate, entire glabrous blades 3-7 dm long and 4-8 cm wide. Scape erect, brown-floccose; scape-bracts erect, the lower foliaceous and densely imbricate, the upper lance-ovate, acute, shorter than the internodes, red, spinose-serrate. Inflorescence simple or few-branched, glabrous; primary bracts small; branches ascending, 10-14 cm long, densely many-flowered. description: Plant flowering 85 cm high; stem horizontal. description: Plant stemless, flowering over 2 m high. description: Plant nearly stemless, flowering 7 dm high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, all alike, persistent, 5-10 dm long; sheaths ovate, castaneous; blades linear, filiform-attenuate, 18 mm wide, entire or with a few small teeth at base, soon wholly glabrous. description: Plant nearly stemless, flowering about 3 dm high. Scape erect, 5 mm in diameter, white-flocculose; scape-bracts all exceeding the internodes, the lower foliaceous with deciduous blades, the upper much smaller and ovate. Inflorescence simple, dense, 5-6 cm long. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, 2 cm long, longer to shorter than the slender 13-20 mm long pedicels. Sepals oblong-elliptic, acute, 15 mm long, all broadly alate-carinate; petals appendaged; ovary about 2/3 superior; ovules apiculate. Fruit dehiscent, about equaling the sepals.

description: Plant flowering to 1 m high. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, pyramidal, sparsely furfuraceous to glabrous; primary bracts inconspicuous. Floral bracts lanceolate, acute, longer to shorter than the slender 5-15 mm long pedicels; flowers divergent to spreading, 35-47 mm long. description: Leaves many, all alike (?), densely fasciculate, to 5 dm long; sheaths narrowly triangular, abruptly dilated and brown at base; blades persistent, linear-lanceolate, sub-filiform-attenuate, contracted toward base but not actually petiolate, 20 mm wide, antrorse-spinulose throughout, sparsely ferruginous-lepidote beneath. Inflorescence simple, 16 cm long, much exceeded by the leaves, to 20-flowered, puberulous. Floral bracts lance-triangular, suberect at anthesis, 25 mm long, exceeding the pedicels, entire; pedicels to 10 mm long, increased in fruit; flowers suberect at anthesis, ca 5 cm long. Sepals symmetric, subtriangular, obtuse, 16 mm long, ecarinate, red-orange, puberulous; petals subacute, 4 cm long, red-orange, bearing an irregularly crenate scale at base; stamens slightly shorter than the petals; ovary obconic, 3/4 inferior. description: Plants densely aggregated, nearly stemless; flowering 5-6 dm high. Leaves distichous, persistent, 8 dm long, entire, very sparsely white-flocculose, soon glabrous; sheaths narrowly ovate, 3-4 cm long, brown; petioles about 1 cm wide, strongly channeled; blades linear-lanceolate, filiform-attenuate, 25 mm wide. Scape 5 mm in diameter; scape-bracts erect, foliaceous, densely imbricate. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, slenderly ellipsoid, 10 cm long, 3 cm in diameter. Floral bracts in about 4 or 5 ranks, closely imbricate, broadly elliptic, acute, 5 cm long, scarlet, subcoriaceous, nerved when dry, finely flocculose toward base; pedicels obconic, 2 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 19 mm long, brown-flocculose, the anterior ecarinate, the posterior alate-carinate; petals 4 cm long, red with a narrow white margin, bearing a triangular scale at base; ovary almost wholly superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 8 dm high, propagating by basal stolons. Leaves many in a dense pseudobulb; sheaths broadly ovate, dark-brown, lustrous, pale-floccose-lepidote at first; blades dimorphic, some persistent, reduced to dark-brown retrorsely spinose-serrate spines, others green, deciduous along a straight transverse line, linear, attenuate, 4 dm long, 13 mm wide, glabrous above, pale-floccose-lepidote below, entire above the line of cleavage. Scape erect, about 6 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lowest foliaceous and serrate, the others ovate, acute or acuminate, mostly shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, laxly racemose, 2 dm long; axis stout, glabrous. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, equaling or slightly shorter than the pedicels, submembranaceous, prominently nerved; flowers erect or divergent; pedicels slender, glabrous, 15-20 mm long. Sepals lance-oblong, asymmetric, acute, 35 mm long, 7 mm wide, ecarinate, glabrous; petals ligulate, naked, 9 cm long, 1 cm wide, white, obtuse, tomentose-lepidote at the apex; stamens included; anthers linear, 15 mm long; ovary more than half superior.

description: Plant stemless (?), flowering 75 cm high. description: Plant stemless (?), flowering 75 cm high. description: Plant flowering over 2 m high; stem stout, elongate, branched, rather laxly foliate. Leaf-sheaths broadly ovate, enfolding the stem, covered with a brown membrane of coalesced scales, densely serrate with straight dark castaneous spines 5 mm long; blades persistent, dimorphic, some reduced to linear-triangular spinose-serrate spines, others green, 1.2 m long; petioles distinct, spinose-serrate, soon glabrous; blades narrowly lanceolate, attenuate, 8 cm wide, entire, glabrous. description: Plant short-caulescent, flowering 4 dm high. Scape erect, slender, white-flocculose; scape-bracts erect, all exceeding the internodes, the lower foliaceous and equaling the leaves, the upper ovate, acuminate, scarcely larger than the floral bracts. Inflorescence simple, laxly few-flowered, white-flocculose, the slender axis 7 cm long. description: Plant caulescent; stem 1 cm in diameter, covered with the remains of old leaf-sheaths. description: Plant stemless, flowering 5 dm high. description: Leaves dimorphic, some reduced to ovate acuminate pungent entire sheaths, others large with broad, flat, serrulate, persistent blade-bases; blades deciduous along a straight transverse line, linear, attenuate, pungent, 4 dm long, 8-12 mm wide, entire, furfuraceous on both sides. description: Plant scandent, long-caulescent, flowering 1.8-2.1 m long. Leaves persistent, up to 1.5 m long, strongly petiolate; sheaths small, broadly ovate, dark castaneous, covered with a brown membrane of coalesced scales; petioles elongate, densely armed with dark stout often forked spines 5 mm long, wholly brown-lepidote; blades oblanceolate, acute, long-cuneate, 1 m long, 15 cm wide, glabrous, reticulate. description: Plant stemless, flowering to 75 cm high, slender. description: Plant caulescent; stem elongate, 15 mm in diameter, covered with old leaf-bases. description: Plant flowering over 8 dm high. Leaves dimorphic or trimorphic, the median ones over 1 m long with linear blades 2-3 cm wide; sheaths bulbous-imbricate, ovate, 20 mm long, 15 mm wide, covered outside with a membrane of gray-fuscous scales; petiole distinct, 20-25 cm long, channeled when dry, spinose-serrate, more or less furfuraceous; blade 80-90 cm long, attenuate at both ends, entire or nearly so, somewhat furfuraceous beneath, broadly white-striate along the median nerve when dry; innermost leaves reduced to very broadly ovate sheaths with a spinose apex, enfolding the base of the scape. Scape erect, stout, glabrous, purple; scape-bracts erect, the highest narrowly lanceolate, filiform-acuminate, shorter than the internodes, entire. Inflorescence amply paniculate, to 30 cm long, bipinnate, many-flowered; primary bracts narrowly triangular, much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches divaricate, to 13 cm long, 4-9-flowered, slightly glaucous-pruinose. Floral bracts ovate-elliptic, acuminate, about half as long as the pedicels; pedicels erect to spreading, 10 mm long, slender. Sepals lanceolate, acuminate and recurved at apex, 20 mm long, nearly or quite ecarinate, glabrous; petals linear, subobtuse, to 50 mm long, 5 mm wide, red, naked; stamens included; ovary about half inferior; ovules caudate.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plant very large; stem short. Leaves apparently all alike, entire, over 1 m long, the sheaths narrowly triangular and passing gradually into the petioles; petioles over 2 dm long, covered with appressed brown scales; blades oblong-lanceolate, long-attenuate at base and apex, to 8 cm wide, flat, very minutely and obscurely brown-lepidote on both sides. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, large but the upper ones shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence diffuse, amply 4-pinnate, 2 m long, glabrous; primary bracts very short; branches very slender, spreading, over 5 dm long, greenish purple. Floral bracts triangular, acuminate, shorter than the pedicels; flowers spreading or reflexed; pedicels slender, to 7 mm long. Sepals subtriangular, attenuate, 25 mm long, ecarinate, nerved, green; petals linear, 5 cm long, red or blue (! Garcia-Barriga), ligulate at base; ovary 7/8 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant stemless, 4-8 dm high. Leaves 8-10, basal, arched-recurving, entire throughout, dimorphic, some reduced and squamiform, triangular-ovate or elliptic, abruptly acute, brown or pale, others petiolate, 6-14 dm long, much exceeding the inflorescence; sheaths short, broadly triangular, covered outside with a membrane of white scales; petioles broad and indistinct, to 15 cm long; blades narrowly lanceolate, attenuate, 3-6 cm wide, narrowly channeled down the middle, glabrous above at maturity. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts suberect, densely imbricate, subfoliaceous with triangular attenuate apices, thin, brown-lepidote. Inflorescence simple, densely spiciform, cylindric or subcorymbose, broadly obtuse, 8-20 cm long, 35 mm in diameter. Floral bracts erect, densely imbricate, 8-12-ranked, broadly ovate, acute, often apiculate, up to 5 cm long, exceeding the sepals, membranaceous, nerved, glabrous, reddish-yellow; flowers erect, subsessile. Sepals subtriangular, rounded-mucronate, 24 mm long; petals linear, acute, unequal, 58-67 mm long, slightly exceeding the stamens, yellow, bearing a large coarsely dentate scale well above the base; ovary more than three-fourths superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering 2 m high. Leaves to 17 dm long, entire; blade linear-lanceolate, attenuate, 4 cm wide, glabrous, narrowed to a narrowly triangular floccose base but not petiolate, flat, slightly if at all channeled. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate; primary bracts triangular, shorter than the long sterile bases of the branches; branches 8-20 cm long. Floral bracts ovate, 4 mm long; flowers nutant; pedicels slender, 5-7 mm long at anthesis. Sepals lance-oblong, obtuse, 15 mm long; petals 4 cm long, red or yellowish, appendaged; ovary 4/5 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering over 6 dm high. Leaves subbulbous-rosulate; blades dimorphic, some reduced to slender pectinate-serrate dark spines, others foliaceous, deciduous, linear, attenuate, 32 cm long, 18 mm wide, entire above the line of abscission, pale-lepidote beneath, soon glabrous. Scape erect, 5 mm in diameter, soon glabrous; scape-bracts linear-lanceolate, attenuate, much shorter than the upper internodes. Inflorescence simple, lax, white-flocculose, becoming glabrous. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, to 30 mm long, exceeding all the pedicels; flowers secund, spreading to decurved at anthesis; pedicels slender, to 14 mm long, somewhat biangulate. Sepals narrowly triangular, attenuate, 30-35 mm long, glabrous at anthesis, the posterior ones subalate-carinate toward base; petals over 8 cm long, naked, yellow; ovary 7/8 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering to 4 dm high, white-flocculose at first. Leaves many in a bulbiform rosette, entire; sheaths ovate, dark castaneous; blades dimorphic, the outer filiform, very short, soft, persistent, the others deciduous along a straight transverse line, linear, filiform-attenuate, 6 mm wide at base. Scape erect, 3 mm in diameter, dark when dry; scape-bracts erect, few but much exceeding the internodes, the lower foliaceous, the others ovate with a long filiform blade. Inflorescence simple, 2 dm long, sublax. Floral bracts about equaling the pedicels, ovate or lanceolate, attenuate; flowers suberect; pedicels slender, to 3 cm long. Sepals narrowly triangular, acuminate, ecarinate, to 22 mm long; petals about 4 cm long, naked, red; ovary 4/5 superior; ovules long-caudate.

description: Plant stemless, to 4 dm high. Leaves numerous, bulbous-rosulate; sheaths broadly ovate, 4 cm long, dark-castaneous, glabrous, lustrous; blades deciduous along a straight transverse line, linear, attenuate, 3-5 dm long, 14 mm wide, glabrous above, pale-floccose-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, 4 mm in diameter, floccose-lepidote; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate and almost wholly concealing the scape, floccose-lepidote, the lowest subfoliaceous, the highest broadly ovate and acuminate. Inflorescence simple, densely and slenderly cylindric, 10-15 cm long, 15-20 mm in diameter, floccose-lepidote. Floral bracts erect, densely imbricate, broadly ovate and acuminate, up to 3 cm long, equaling or exceeding the sepals, broadly convex, subcoriaceous, pale-rose, subeven, nearly or quite glabrous at anthesis; flowers subsessile; slender. Sepals lanceolate, acuminate, 22-25 mm long; petals linear, 6 cm long, red, naked; ovary almost wholly superior; ovules long-caudate.

description: Plant flowering to 8 dm high. Leaves persistent; petioles distinct, 5 dm long, entire, grooved; blades narrowly oblanceolate, 60 cm long, 8 cm wide, subglabrous, the apex acuminate, minutely spinulose. Scape erect; scape-bracts acuminate, exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence simple, laxly racemose, 25 cm long, sparsely furfuraceous. Floral bracts oblanceolate, acuminate, exceeding the pedicels but much shorter than the sepals, purple; pedicels 15-18 mm long. Sepals ovate, acuminate, 25 mm long, 7 mm broad, slightly carinate, lepidote; petals narrowly lingulate, acute, over 6 cm long, violet, bearing a scale at base; stamens slightly shorter than the petals; pistil 5 cm long; ovary 5 mm long, about Vi superior (?).

description: Plant flowering about 9 dm high. Leaves dimorphic, the outer reduced to dark brown scale-like pungent-mucronate sheaths, the inner green, narrowed above the sheath but not petiolate; blades persistent, entire except near the base, linear-lanceolate, 5-6 dm long, 25 mm wide, glabrous above, minutely white-puberulent beneath. Scape erect, slender, scantly furfuraceous; scape-bracts narrowly triangular, acuminate, the highest shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence a depauperate panicle; axis scantly pale-furfuraceous; primary bracts about half as long as the axillary branches and much exceeding their short sterile bases. Floral bracts elliptic-lanceolate, acute or acuminate, about equaling the pedicels; flowers suberect to spreading; pedicels slender, 10 mm long. Sepals narrowly triangular, attenuate, 17 mm long, scantly punctulate-lepidote; petals 4 cm long, scarlet-red, naked; stamens exserted; ovary 3/4 superior.

description: Leaf with petiole 55 cm long, stout, strongly channeled, serrulate; blade linear-lanceolate, acuminate, attenuate at base, over 1.4 m long, 8 cm wide, brown-lepidote beneath but soon entirely glabrous, serrulate toward apex. Scape stout, red; scape-bracts broadly lanceolate, acuminate. Inflorescence simple, dense, many-flowered, over 5 dm long, red, all except the petals covered with fine pale stellate scales. Floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, to 5 cm long, always exceeded by the sepals; flowers suberect, pedicels to 2 cm long. Sepals oblong, broadly acute, 34 mm long, scarcely carinate, coriaceous; petals 8 cm long, narrowly pale-margined, bearing a large rounded scale at base; ovary 2/3 inferior; ovules bearing a dorsal wing.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 4-5 dm high. Leaves subbulbous-rosulate, 35-45 cm long; sheaths orbicular, ca 3 cm in diameter; blades arching, very narrowly triangular, long-attenuate, 12 mm wide, glabrous above, covered with appressed silvery scales beneath, laxly serrate with slender straight spreading spines 4 mm long. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, linear, entire, much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly racemose, 11-16 cm long, glabrous. Floral bracts triangular, much shorter than the pedicels; flowers divergent; pedicels slender, 25 mm long. Sepals narrowly triangular, acute, 20 mm long; petals linear, broadly acute, 5 cm long, naked, red; stamens included; ovary 2/3 superior. Fruit dehiscent; seeds alate.

description: Plant flowering 1 m high. Leaves and scape unknown. Inflorescence simple, laxly many-flowered, glabrous with age; axis 1 cm in diameter, lightly sulcate. Floral bracts reflexed, broadly lanceolate, acute, 35 mm long, exceeding the pedicels; flowers spreading or reflexed; pedicels ca. 25 mm long, 2 mm in diameter, angled. Sepals narrowly triangular-lanceolate, 42 mm long, carinate, nerved; petals ligulate at base; ovary 2/3 superior. Seeds caudate.

description: Plants stemless, densely aggregated. Leaves all alike, subdistichous, to 1.5 m long, much exceeding the inflorescence, entire, soon glabrous, the sheaths narrow, pale, auricled at base, the blades linear, long-attenuate, conduplicate, 2 cm wide, narrowed at base but not really petiolate. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; lowest scape-bracts foliaceous, the upper broadly ovate, acuminate, about equaling the internodes or slightly shorter. Inflorescence simple, 15-25 cm long, subglabrous. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, about equaling the pedicels, obscurely lepidote toward apex; flowers divergent; pedicels, slender, 2 cm long tricostate with the lower part of the ovary. Sepals narrowly oblong, acute, 45 mm long, ecarinate, green, transversely ridged at the junction with the ovary; petals 6 cm long, greenish white, ligulate at base; ovary 12 mm in diameter, about half superior. Fruit dehiscent; seeds narrowly winged.

description: Plant stemless. Leaves dimorphic, the outer ovate, acute, the inner entire except for the petiole, blade narrowly lanceolate, acute or attenuate, strongly plicate, to 1 m long, 1 dm wide, glabrous above, densely and finely white-lepidote beneath. Scape pendulous, stout; scape-bracts usually imbricate, ovate, acuminate, green. Inflorescence simple, densely many-flowered, trailing on ground; axis stout. Floral bracts lanceolate, much exceeding the pedicels; flowers secund; pedicels 1 cm long. Sepals straight, subtriangular, 26 mm long; petals appendaged, 7 cm long, red with a narrow white margin; ovary about half superior; ovules and seeds winged.

description: Plant caulescent, flowering shoot to 2 m high. Leaves apparently homomorphic, 6-15 dm long, sheaths broadly ovate, 7 cm long, dark castaneous, covered with a membrane of. white scales, becoming glabrous, blades subpetiolate, linear-lanceolate, attenuate, 3-4 cm wide, at first minutely white-lepidote beneath, sparsely serrulate near base, entire above, the long narrow base densely serrate with straight spreading spines 4-8 mm long. Inflorescence very laxly bipinnate, minutely white-flocculose becoming glabrous; primary bracts narrowly triangular, shorter than the long sterile bases of the branches; racemes ascending, subdensely many-flowered, 25-30 cm long. Floral bracts triangular-ovate, 4 mm long; flowers becoming secund-nutant after anthesis; pedicels slender, 15 mm long. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 14 mm long, ecarinate; petals red, appendaged; ovary 2/3 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 45 cm high. Leaves fasciculate in a bulbous rosette; outer sheaths broadly ovate, castaneous, the inner longer and narrower and paler; blades dimorphic, some persistent and reduced to slender flat serrate spines, others foliaceous (inferred from the median scape-bracts), linear, attenuate, deciduous along a straight transverse line, spinose-serrate below the line. Scape erect, slender, at first appressed-tomentose with white finely divided scales; scape-bracts erect, equaling or exceeding the internodes, entire, the lowest vaginiform, lanceolate, acuminate, the median foliaceous, to 3 dm long, 10 mm wide, the upper narrowly triangular, filiform-caudate. Inflorescence simple, laxly few-flowered, tomentose-lepidote when young. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, slightly longer or shorter than the pedicels; pedicels divergent, slender, to 10 mm long. Sepals linear, 20 mm long, acuminate, the posterior broadly alate especially toward apex; petals naked, red; ovary 3/4 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant short-caulescent, flowering 95 cm high. Leaves all alike, 18 dm long; sheath narrowly triangular, about 15 cm long, entire, merging with the petiole, covered beneath with dark ferruginous appressed scales; petiole 5-10 mm wide, channeled, entire; blade linear-lanceolate, long-attenuate at both ends, flat, 6 cm wide, laxly and finely serrulate, green and glabrous above, covered beneath with a thin membrane of scales. Scape erect, ca 8 mm in diameter at the middle, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper broadly ovate, acuminate. Inflorescence simple, clavate-spicate, broadly ellipsoid, 12 cm long, glabrous. Floral bracts broadly ovate, triangular-acute, 5 cm long, red, curved-spreading toward apex, entire, chartaceous; flowers subsessile. Sepals oblong, broadly acute and apiculate, 30 mm long, 5 mm wide, ecarinate; petals 7 cm long, red drying to purple, bearing a large oblong scale at base, slightly zygomorphic at apex and forming a hood over the nearly equal stamens; ovary ½ inferior; ovules obtuse.

description: Leaves persistent, more than 1 m long, entire, petiolate; blades linear-lanceolate, long-attenuate, 55 mm wide, glabrous. Scape unknown. Inflorescence 1 m high, very laxly bipinnate, the axes slender, glabrous, bright red, racemes ascending, very lax, 45 cm long, the sterile base 11 cm long. Floral bracts ovate, acute; pedicels slender, biangulate, 2 cm long, about twice the bracts, sparsely stellate-lepidote; flowers spreading, more or less secund, pale green. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, acute, 38 mm long, ecarinate, even, glabrous; petals naked.

description: Plant flowering 7-9 dm high. Leaves persistent, dimorphic, the outer ones with small orbicular deep castaneous sheaths and blades reduced to spinose-serrate spines, the inner 75 cm long, entire, slightly constricted between sheath and blade, sparsely flocculose, soon glabrous; sheath narrowly triangular, pale; blade linear with a median channel, 23 mm wide. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts narrowly triangular, filiform-attenuate, exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence simple or depauperately and laxly compound, white-flocculose; primary bracts linear, much shorter than the ascending branches; only the apical half of the lateral branches fertile. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, exceeding the slender 5 mm long pedicels; flowers ascending. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 15 mm long, ecarinate; petals 5 cm long, red, bearing a bidentate scale at base; stamens included; ovary 2/3 superior; ovules apiculate.

description: Plant flowering to 1 m high, slender; rhizome short. Leaves persistent, 1.3 m long; sheaths ovate, dark; petioles 50 cm long, channeled, lepidote, spinulose-serrate; blades linear, attenuate at both ends, 35 mm wide, entire, membranaceous, glabrous above, beneath furfuraceous and with a prominent median channel. Scape to 60 cm long; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, the lower foliaceous, the upper triangular, attenuate, thin. Inflorescence about 30 cm long, paniculate at base with 2 or 3 lateral branches; primary bracts narrowly triangular; branches flowering nearly to base, lax, much exceeding the primary bracts. Floral bracts thin, shorter than the pedicels, those of the lateral branches ovate, minute, those of the terminal narrowly triangular; pedicels 10 mm long. Sepals lance-ovate, obtuse, 12-18 mm long; petals 32 mm long, rose, naked; ovary 7 mm long with 2 mm inferior. Capsule trigonous, to 10 mm long, many-seeded; seeds caudate.

description: Plant flowering to 6 dm high; rhizome elongate, branched, covered with densely imbricate gray coriaceous scales 25 mm in diameter. Leaves entire, dimorphic, the outer reduced to narrowly triangular sheaths 15 cm long and 15 mm wide, subulate-attenuate, brown, the inner green; sheaths short; petioles to 20 cm long, channeled, furfuraceous; blades elliptic-oblanceolate, acuminate at both ends, to 41 cm long, 6-7 cm wide, channeled toward base, stellate-furfuraceous beneath. Scape erect, slender, furfuraceous; scape-bracts lanceolate, acuminate, the upper shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence secundly racemose, to 20 cm long, exceeded by the leaves, lax. Floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, more than half as long as the pedicels; flowers downwardly secund; pedicels slender, 10-15 mm long; hypanthium 3-keeled. Sepals oblong-linear, broadly acute or rounded and apiculate, 20 mm long, asymmetric, green, glabrous, carinate or subalate; petals linear, subacute, 45-50 mm long, yellow, bearing a scale at base; stamens included; ovary more than ½ superior; seeds short-caudate.

description: Leaves homomorphic, persistent, entire; blades linear, not narrowed at base, H.5 m long, 35 mm wide, white-lepidote beneath when young, becoming glabrous. Scape unknown. Inflorescence amply and laxly paniculate, 3-pinnate (?), many-flowered, covered with spreading whitish gray scales; ultimate racemes subspreading, to 15 cm long, laxly 4-12-flowered. Floral bracts elliptic, apiculate, 15 mm long, about equaling the slender pedicels; flowers 55 mm long, red. Sepals triangular, acute, 22 mm long, carinate; petals acute, naked or appendaged; stamens included, anthers 5 mm long; ovary more than half superior.

description: Plant flowering over 7 dm high. Leaves distinctly petiolate, entire; sheaths broadly triangular, covered with a buff membrane of scales toward the apex; petioles 2 dm long, channeled; blades lanceolate, attenuate at both ends, 6 dm long, 35 mm wide, glabrous. Scape erect, rather stout, shorter than the leaves, densely white-tomentulose; scape-bracts elongate, densely imbricate, elliptic-lanceolate, acuminate, glabrous except for the slightly tomentulose base. Inflorescence very densely subspicate, 3 cm in diameter. Floral bracts narrowly elliptic-ovate, acuminate, 75 mm long, much exceeding the sepals, membranaceous, glabrous dorsally, furfuraceous within; flowers to 12 cm long; pedicels very thick, 8 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acuminate, about 4 cm long, floccose; petals obtuse, naked, white, strongly decurved after anthesis; anthers 19 mm long; ovary half superior; ovules long-caudate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 5-6 dm high, the base subbulbous. Leaves all alike, persistent, few, laxly fasciculate, not narrowed above the sheath, entire, glabrous; sheaths long and narrow; blades linear, long-attenuate, 25 cm long, 19 mm wide. Scape erect, stout, glabrous; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, erect, much longer than the internodes, red and more or less swollen at base. Inflorescence subsecundly racemose, dense, ca. 2 dm long; axis reddish, slightly ferruginous-furfuraceous or glabrous. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, rose, glabrous outside, furfuraceous within, the lowest equaling or slightly exceeding the pedicels; flowers suberect; pedicels slender, to 25 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, strongly alate-carinate, 25 mm long, 4.5 mm wide; petals acute, 5 cm long, naked; stamens included; ovary slightly more than Vi superior; seeds caudate.

description: Plant reproducing vegetatively by slender scaly rhizomes, flowering 30-60 cm high. Leaves forming bulbous rosettes that soon appear lateral by the elongation of the rhizome, entire, vestite with linear white subspreading scales; sheaths broadly ovate, 2 cm long, strongly nerved, castaneous toward base; blades dimorphic, some persistent, reduced, broadly triangular, thin, stramineous, others deciduous along a straight transverse line, linear, attenuate, 10 cm long (probably not fully developed), 2 mm wide, fasciculate. Scape very slender, white-flocculose especially toward base; scape-bracts erect, the lower imbricate, subfoliaceous and with deciduous blades, the upper narrowly triangular, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence secundly racemose, many-flowered, red, sparsely white-flocculose. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, exceeding the slender terete 6-8 mm long pedicels; flowers suberect. Sepals oblong, acute, 18 mm long, carinate at base; petals linear-spatulate, rounded-apiculate, 45 mm long, red, naked; stamens included; ovary 4/5 superior. Seeds caudate-appendaged.

description: Plants aggregated, subacaulescent, flowering 3-4 dm high. Floral bracts elliptic, acuminate, membranaceous, nerved, bright red, the lowest exceeding the sepals, the upper shorter; pedicels short but slender. description: Plant flowering, nearly 2 m high. description: Plant stemless or short-caulescent, flowering 33-60 cm high. Leaves numerous, bulbous-rosulate; sheaths broadly ovate, 4 cm long, dark-castaneous, glabrous; blades deciduous along a straight transverse line, linear, attenuate, 3-7 dm long, 17 mm wide, glabrous above, sparsely pale-floccose beneath, entire. Scape erect, 3.5 mm in diameter, floccose; scape-bracts large, ovate with long subfiliform blades, exceeding the internodes, floccose, green. Floral bracts ovate, acute or acuminate, chartaceous, prominently nerved, the lower equaling or exceeding the sepals, the rest much shorter; flowers suberect, subsessile. Sepals lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 25-28 mm long, the posterior ones carinate; petals linear, 6 cm long, naked, red; stamens included; style exserted; ovary 2/3 to almost wholly superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant nearly stemless, flowering 8 dm high. Leaves dimorphic, some reduced to broadly elliptic or suborbicular dark brown sheaths, others large, green, glabrous; petioles 8-9 dm long, slender, entire; blades oblanceolate, cuneate at base, abruptly contracted to an acuminate apex, 35-40 cm long, 15 cm wide, minutely reticulate. Scape erect, slender, red, sparsely floccose; scape-bracts ovate, acuminate, except for the highest much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, dense, 15 cm long, sparsely white-lepidote. description: Plant stemless 2.5 m high. Leaves numerous, 5 dm long, sheaths suborbicular, 3 cm in diameter, dark castaneous, forming a compact pseudobulb 8 cm in diameter, blades very narrowly triangular, acuminate, pungent, not at all narrowed at the base, 25 mm wide, covered with a membrane of coalesced cinereous scales, becoming glabrous above, very laxly serrate with uncinate antrorse spines 2 mm long. Scape ca 1 cm in diameter, soon glabrous; scape-bracts foliaceous, all serrate, the upper shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate or simple, to 1 m long, red, sparsely pale-lepidote becoming glabrous; primary bracts narrowly triangular, acuminate, 10 cm long, exceeding the short peduncle; branches spreading-ascending, laxly many-flowered, 35 cm long. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, acute, 10 mm long, equaling or slightly shorter than the stout costate pedicels; flowers spreading. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acute 35 mm long, ecarinate, sulcate with age; petals about 45 mm long, greenish white, naked; ovary slightly more than half inferior. description: Plant flowering to 3 m high; stem branched. Leaves all alike, up to 1.2 m long; blades linear-lanceolate, narrowed at base and bearing dark spines 5 mm long but scarcely petiolate, entire elsewhere, acuminate, 40-85 mm wide, soon glabrous. Inflorescence very dense, cylindric, many-flowered, 30 cm long, 7 cm in diameter. Floral bracts erect, imbricate but with the apices spreading, lanceolate, 10 cm long, serrate, subcoriaceous and rugulose when dry, brownish, the bases brown-flocculose; pedicels short but slender. Sepals narrowly triangular, acuminate, 4 cm long, glabrous, green except for the dark brown apex; petals recurved, lingulate, broadly rounded, 9-12 cm long, 2 cm wide, naked, white or green; stamens included, the anthers 20 mm long; ovary 4/5 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant caulescent, flowering shoot 1.2-1.8 m high, brown-lepidote becoming glabrous. description: Plant stemless or nearly so, flowering 4-8 dm high. Leaves of the fertile rosettes all alike or those of the sterile shoots sometimes with spiniform blades, 1-16 dm long; sheaths ovate or triangular, small, dark-castaneous, glabrous; blades linear to linear-lanceolate, attenuate, 8-32 mm wide, channeled, closely spinose-serrate toward the base, sparsely elsewhere, glabrous above, glabrous or covered with a fine white more or less persistent membrane of coalesced scales beneath. Scape erect, more or less floccose; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, the lower foliaceous, the upper linear-lanceolate, attenuate, entire. Inflorescence simple or few-branched; axes white-flocculose; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, many times shorter than the axillary branches; racemes laxly flowered, 2-4 dm long. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, filiform-attenuate, white-flocculose, the lower ones equaling or exceeding the pedicels, the upper much shorter; flowers spreading; pedicels slender, (7-)9-34(-36) mm long. Sepals narrowly triangular, attenuate, 15-25 mm long, ecarinate; petals ligulate, acute, 37-52 mm long, red, bearing at the base a truncate scale 7 mm long; stamens included; ovary half superior; ovules bicaudate.

description: Plant wholly glabrous at anthesis, flowering 1 m high. Leaves many in a bulbous rosette, homomorphic, over 5 dm long; sheaths reniform, 4 cm wide, dark castaneous, lustrous; blades very narrowly subtriangular, slightly narrowed at base, attenuate, 20 mm wide, flat, very laxly serrate with slender antrorse spines 2 mm long. Scape erect, 6 mm in diameter; scape-bracts strict, subfoliaceous, serrulate, all but the highest exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence very laxly subtripinnate, subpyramidal, over 4 dm long, 3 dm wide, red; primary bracts narrowly triangular, shorter than the sterile mostly naked bases of the branches, the lowest serrulate; branches spreading, mostly simple, slender, slightly flexuous. Floral bracts downwardly secund with the flowers, elliptic, apiculate, 8 mm long, exceeding the very short but slender pedicels, membranaceous; flowers spreading. Sepals linear, acute, 22 mm long, ecarinate; petals naked, undeveloped in the type; ovary 2/3 superior; ovules alate.

description: Plant caulescent, stem prostrate; simple or branched. Scape strict, more than 1 m high, stout, scape-bracts triangular, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, densely cylindric, 40 cm long, 3 cm in diameter, many-flowered; axis stout, angled, minutely furfuraceous. description: Plant with a short erect stem covered with old leaf-sheaths, flowering 66-86 cm high. Leaves all alike, fasciculate at the apex of the stem, to 5 dm long, entire; sheaths suborbicular, 15-20 mm long, dark castaneous, glabrous at least with age; blades linear, slightly contracted at base, filiform-attenuate, 10-15 mm wide, covered with fine ap-pressed cinereous scales beneath, glabrous above. Scape erect, slender, white-flocculose; scape-bracts erect, the lowest subfoliaceous and imbricate, the highest narrowly triangular, filiform-laminate, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence few-branched, lax, laxly white-flocculose; primary bracts narrowly triangular, much shorter than the naked sterile bases of the short few-flowered lateral branches. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, shorter than the slender spreading 13 mm long pedicels. Sepals oblong, rounded and apiculate, 16 mm long, the anterior ecarinate, the posterior alate-carinate; petals 4 cm long, pale yellow, bearing an oblong truncate scale at base; stamens included; ovary 3/5 superior. description: Plant stemless. description: Plant stemless, 0.4 to 1 m high. description: Plant caulescent, flowering 4 dm high; stem branched, 7 cm long, very densely covered with the remains of old leaves. Leaves soon glabrous; sheaths short, ample, almost completely covered; blades dimorphic, some persistent, much reduced, flat, straight, rigid, spinose-serrate, dark brown, others deciduous above the sheath, linear, acuminate, to a spinose-pungent apex, slightly contracted toward base, to 5 dm long, 35 mm wide, flat, entire or bearing a few weak setiform spines near base, green. description: Plant caulescent, flowering 6 dm high; stem repent, at least 12 cm long, appearing 3 cm in diameter because of the covering of old leaf-bases. description: Leaves about 2 m long, entire, petiolate, glabrous above, covered beneath with a fine white membrane of fused scales; blades linear with a narrow median channel, caudate-attenuate, flat, 5 cm wide. description: Plant flowering 1 m high. Leaves fasciculate, dimorphic, some persistent, reduced to suborbicular dark castaneous brown-flocculose sheaths and short linear spinose-serrate blades, others 1.1 m long, slightly narrowed and deciduous above the large elliptic-oblong sheaths but not petiolate, glabrous, the blades linear, long-attenuate, 25 mm wide. Scape erect, slender, white-flocculose; scape-bracts very narrowly triangular, long-attenuate, the upper ones slightly shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence a depauperate panicle, lax, sparsely flocculose; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, much shorter than the subdense racemes; lateral racemes 7 cm long, the terminal 17 cm long. Floral bracts elliptic, apiculate, about half as long as the pedicels, scarious; pedicels slender, 6 mm long; flowers divergent. description: Plant very short-caulescent. Leaves polystichous, very obscurely punctulate-lepidote, dimorphic, the outer reduced to broadly ovate entire sheaths, the inner to 1.5 m long, contracted above the sheath into an elongate spinose-serrate deeply channeled petiole; blade lanceolate, entire, 6-8 cm wide, flat except for a strong median channel. Scape erect; scape-bracts imbricate, elliptic. Inflorescence densely cylindric, 8-35 cm long. Floral bracts strict, imbricate, broadly elliptic, obtuse, 20-35 mm long, even or finely striate, subcoriaceous, bright red; flowers slenderly pedicellate. Sepals linear, obtuse, to 4 cm long, always exceeding the bracts, ecarinate, white, soon turning black toward the apex; petals naked, apparently included at anthesis; ovary 3/4 superior. Seeds long-caudate.

description: Plants caulescent; stems many, erect, 3 dm high, 5-6 mm in diameter, covered below with old leaf-bases. Leaves many, all alike, rosulate at the apex of the stem, spreading to recurved, 15-29 cm long, not petiolate; sheaths narrowly ovate, small, glabrous; blades linear, long-attenuate, scarcely if at all narrowed toward base, flat, 5-10 mm wide, glabrous, laxly serrate toward apex with spines 0.5 mm long. Scape very short or none, hidden by the leaves. Inflorescence a short dense spike, to 1 dm long, red except for the bracts, furfuraceous or becoming glabrous. Floral bracts broadly ovate, the lower acuminate and exceeding the sepals, the upper acute; flowers suberect, the upper sessile, the lower slenderly pedicellate for not more than 2 mm. Sepals narrowly elliptic, more or less asymmetric, 15-18 mm long, 5 mm wide, ecarinate; petals 45-80 mm long, naked or appendaged, stamens exserted; ovary 1/2-2/3 superior. Capsule indehiscent (?); seeds naked.

description: Plant flowering 1 m or higher. Leaves 15-20, fasciculate, 7-11 dm long, slightly contracted above the narrow sheaths; blades narrowly lanceolate, filiform-attenuate, 2-3 cm wide, membranaceous, minutely serrulate at base or above the middle, glabrous above, rather densely pale-lepidote and subfarinaceous beneath. Scape erect; scape-bracts lance-triangular, attenuate, not enfolding the scape, serrulate, densely lepidote, the lower 10-35 mm long, the upper nearly 3 cm long. Inflorescence equaling or slightly exceeding the leaves, simple, lax, ca. 20 cm long, 12-20-flowered, densely lepidote. Floral bracts triangular, acute, to 25 mm long; flowers spreading, sessile or obscurely pedicellate, distinctly zygomorphic and curved. Sepals lance-triangular, acute, 20 mm long; petals narrowly obovate, abruptly acute, 55-60 mm long, pale green, bearing a large crenate scale at base; stamens equaling the petals or slightly shorter, anthers narrowly sagittate, 8-9 mm long; ovary nearly 15 mm long, completely inferior, angular-sulcate, lepidote. Seeds alate.

description: Plant flowering about 2 dm high. Leaves all alike, persistent, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, narrowed at base but not really petiolate, to 35 cm long, 3 cm wide, entire, covered beneath with coarse white appressed scales, green and sparsely lepidote above. Scape short but evident, often curved-ascending, green, sparsely lepidote; scape-bracts foliaceous, many times exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence laxly racemose, few-flowered, usually much exceeded by the leaves, slightly furfuraceous. Floral bracts narrowly ovate, equaling or exceeding the lower pedicels; pedicels ascending, slender, 10 mm long; flowers erect. Sepals sublanceolate, acute, 23 mm long, ecarinate, green; petals zygomorphic, naked, acute, 65 mm long, equaling the stamens, yellow toward apex, bright orange elsewhere; anthers 7 mm long; ovary 5/6 superior; ovules obtuse.

description: Plant flowering 85 cm high. Leaves all alike, persistent, 1 m long or more, scarcely petiolate; sheaths suborbicular, small, brown, prominently nerved, covered with a membrane of brown scales; blades linear, filiform-attenuate, 2 cm wide, entire, glabrous, above, covered beneath with a membrane of whitish scales. Scape erect, 5 mm in diameter, sparsely white-flocculose; scape-bracts erect, lanceolate, filiform-attenuate, the upper ones equaling or slightly shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, laxly polystichous-flowered, 32 cm long, sparsely flocculose. Floral bracts subtriangular, attenuate, equaling or slightly exceeding the pedicels; membranaceous; flowers spreading; pedicels slender, up to 2 cm long. Sepals oblong, acute, flat, 2 cm long; petals imperfectly known, at least 4 cm long, yellow when dry, bearing a large bidentate scale at the base; ovary half superior; ovules bearing a single oblique dorso-apical wing.

description: Plant over 8 dm high. Leaves over 8 dm long, entire, petiole distinct, over 2 dm long, deeply channeled, blade linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 2-3 cm wide, sparsely floccose-lepidote beneath, soon glabrous, prominently nerved and channeled. Scape erect, 6 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lower foliaceous, the upper triangular-ovate with long caudate tips. Inflorescence laxly racemose, 18 cm long, few-flowered, glabrous. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, 5-10 mm long; pedicels spreading, slender, 25-35 mm long, flowers erect at anthesis and making an angle with the pedicels. Sepals narrowly triangular, broadly obtuse, 20-24 mm long, ecarinate; petals broadly rounded, 52 mm long, red at base, white toward apex, bearing a broadly retuse scale; stamens nearly equaling the petals, anthers 9 mm long; ovary ellipsoid, becoming globose, 3/4 inferior. Fruit indehiscent; seeds very narrowly winged.

description: Plant flowering to 1 m high but usually much less, stemless, spreading by basal offsets. Leaves 10-20, fasciculate, all alike, persistent, 3-5 dm long, narrowed above the sheath but not petiolate, entire; sheaths ovate, dark castaneous toward base, appressed-lepidote or glabrous; blades sublinear, filiform-acuminate, to 13 mm wide, glabrous or beneath slightly lepidote. Scape slender; scape-bracts erect, the lower foliaceous and imbricate, the upper narrowly triangular, acuminate and remote. Inflorescence laxly racemose, usually many-flowered, glabrous. Floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, about half as long as the pedicels; flowers spreading; pedicels very slender, 15-25 mm long. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 15-18 mm long, slightly carinate, pale yellow; petals symmetrically recurving at anthesis, acute, ca 5 cm long, naked, white to yellow; stamens about equaling the petals, filaments white; ovary 2/3 superior. Capsule ovoid, 12 mm long; seeds caudate.

description: Plant caulescent; stem 5 mm in diameter, covered with the sheaths of old leaves. Leaves numerous; sheaths ovate, dark castaneous, more or less white-flocculose; blades dimorphic, some persistent and reduced to brown serrate spines, others deciduous along a straight transverse line, serrate below the line, above the line linear, attenuate, not petiolate, entire, 4-5 dm long, much exceeding the inflorescence, 13 mm wide, pale-flocculose. Scape erect, slender, flocculose; scape-bracts erect and imbricate, long-acuminate from an ovate base. Inflorescence simple, sublaxly few-flowered. Floral bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than the sepals but much exceeding the pedicels; flowers suberect, more or less secund; pedicels slender, to 14 mm long, biangulate. Sepals linear, to 4 cm long, obtuse or truncate, more or less erose, broadly alate-carinate, auriculate at base, glabrous; petals to 55 mm long, white, naked; ovary over 3/4 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant known only from fragments but undoubtedly large. Leaves 94 cm long, ensiform, obscurely lepidote; sheath relatively small, barely distinct, dark castaneous, serrulate; blade attenuate, slightly narrowed toward base, 9 cm wide, thick, subdensely serrate throughout with dark nearly straight spines 3 mm long. Scape unknown. Inflorescence probably simple; axis terete, smooth, 5 mm in diameter; floral bracts probably exceeding the pedicels; pedicels stout, 6 mm long; flowers strongly recurved. Sepals subtriangular when dry, ca. 25 mm long, thin, nerved; ovary about ½ inferior. Capsule exceeded by the sepals; seeds winged.

description: Plant stemless, flowering over 1 m high. Leaves dimorphic, the outer reduced to a suborbicular castaneous sheath and acicular pectinate blade, the inner functional and about equaling the inflorescence, not petiolate; blades linear, filiform-attenuate, 14 mm wide, glabrous above, sparsely white-flocculose beneath, entire, deciduous, the persistent base spinose-serrate. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, lanceolate, acuminate, the upper slightly shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence very laxly racemose, 4 dm long, glabrous. Floral bracts lance-ovate, acuminate, submembranaceous, the lowest exceeding the pedicels; flowers divergent; pedicels 2 cm long, slender. Sepals narrowly triangular, long-attenuate, 30 mm long, scarcely carinate, yellow; petals unequal, linear, acute, 7 cm long, bearing a bidentate scale, pale yellow; stamens exserted, anthers linear, 15 mm long; ovary to 3/4 superior. Seeds caudate.

description: Plant scandent, 2.4-6 m long, including the 1.2 m long flowering part; stem branched. Leaves possibly dimorphic but only large ones seen, 45-60 cm long; sheaths suborbicular, 15 mm wide, dark castaneous, densely appressed-white-lepidote; petioles 10 cm long, slender, densely serrate with dark spines 2 mm long; blades oblanceolate, acute, 6 cm wide, soon glabrous, reticulate beneath. Scape straight, stout, flocculose; lower scape-bracts subfoliaceous, densely imbricate, entire, the others broadly lanceolate, acute, the uppermost about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence straight, simple, 75 cm long, laxly many-flowered, flocculose. Floral bracts spreading to reflexed, broadly elliptic, apiculate, 15-20 mm long, membranaceous, brown; pedicels 4 mm long, slender. Sepals very narrowly triangular, 34 mm long, green; petals 85 mm long, yellow, bearing two auricles which are probably the remains of a deeply incised ligule; ovary 3/4 superior.

description: Plant subbulbous or short-caulescent, flowering 15 cm high. Leaves soon glabrous; sheaths suborbicular, ca 1 cm long, entire, dark castaneous, sublustrous; blades dimorphic, some persistent, greatly reduced, very slenderly spiniform, spinose-serrate, brown, others deciduous above the sheath, linear, attenuate toward apex and base but not at all petiolate, to 25 cm long, exceeding the inflorescence, 7-8 mm wide, flat, entire, green. Scape erect, short, very slender, white-flocculose; scape-bracts erect, exceeding the internodes and almost completely covering the scape, linear, acuminate, green. Inflorescence simple, laxly racemose, few-flowered, sparsely white-flocculose. Floral bracts like the scape-bracts, about twice as long as the lowest pedicels; flowers suberect, not secund; pedicels 5 mm long, terete, very slender. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 22 mm long, scarcely or not at all carinate; petals linear, broadly acute, 4 cm long, naked, red; stamens included; ovary 4/5 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant short-caulescent, flowering 6-7 dm high. Leaves subrosulate at the apex of the stem; sheaths concealed by each other; blades dimorphic, some reduced to dark pectinate-serrate flat spines, others foliaceous, deciduous, linear, acuminate, slightly narrowed toward base, 6 dm long, 18 mm wide, sparsely white-flocculose at base, entire above the line of abscission. Scape erect, over 1 cm in diameter at base, soon glabrous; scape-bracts all exceeding the internodes, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper triangular, caudate-attenuate, green, entire, sparsely white-flocculose. Inflorescence simple, 15-22 cm long, subdense, bearing a tuft of sterile bracts at apex; rhachis sulcate, minutely and obscurely tuberculate, otherwise glabrous. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, caudate-attenuate, much exceeding the pedicels and the lowest about equaling the sepals; flowers stiffly spreading; pedicels 6 mm long, strongly sulcate when dry. Sepals narrowly triangular, acuminate, 26-29 mm long, ecarinate, minutely tuberculate, sulcate when dry; petals linear, 6 cm long, probably white, bearing a truncate scale at base; stamens included; ovary about 2/3 superior, the lower part strongly trialate; ovules caudate.

description: Apophysis nearly flat, or slightly raised only on one side of the cone and toward the base, transversely keeled, rhombic or pentagonal in outline, upper margin angular, irregularly undulate, or rounded, colour in various hues of brown. Umbo dorsal, prominent, 4-6 mm long, 3-4 mm wide at base, without a prickle, usually darker than the apophysis.

description: Tree, usually tall, height (Mexico) to ca. 40 m, dbh to 80-120 cm. Trunk monopodial, straight, erect, usually slender. Bark thick, rough and scaly, dividing into large, slightly elongate plates separated by broad, shallow fissures, clear orange-pinkish or reddish brown with dark fissures on the lower part of the bole, on young trees and branches thin, scaly, brown or dark reddish brown. Branches of first order relatively short, spreading or curved down, numerous and persistent; branches of higher orders ascending or spreading, the lower branches subpendulous, assurgent at tips. Shoots stout, rough, with persistent, decurrent pulvini which leave prominent marks after the fascicles have fallen, reddish brown, often glaucous. Cataphylls 10-15 mm long, subulate, scarious, recurved, with hyaline-erose to ciliate margins, reddish brown, weathering blackish, mostly abscising with the leaf fascicles. Vegetative buds ovoid-acute to broad-ovoid, the terminal bud 15-25 X 10-15 mm, the laterals smaller, not resinous; the scales spreading or recurved at base of bud, subulate-caudate, lustrous red-brown with darker apex and white or brown ciliate margins. Fascicle sheaths initially ca. 20 mm long, consisting of ca. 10 imbricate, appressed, orange- to red-brown scales with hyaline margins, in mature fascicles persistent but reduced to 10-15 mm, with a thickened base, weathering blackish grey. Leaves in fascicles of 2-3 (in some trees predominantly 2 or 3), in dense, spreading tufts toward the ends of upturned branches, persisting 2-2.5 years, straight or curved, rigid, (10-)15-25(-27) cm X 1.3-1.6 mm, with serrulate margins, acute-pungent to acuminate, light or dark green. Stomata on all faces of the leaves, in 8-10 lines on the convex abaxial face, in 3-4 lines on each adaxial face. Leaf anatomy: Cross section transverse-triangular (3leaved fascicles), or semi-circular (2-leaved fascicles), with a convex abaxial side; hypodermis uniform, with 2-3 layers of cells; resin ducts 2-6, medial; stele oval in cross section; outer cell walls of endodermis thickened; vascular bundles 2, distinctly separated. Pollen cones densely clustered near the proximal end of a new shoot, subtended by subulate bracts with white ciliate margins, ovoid-oblong to cylindrical, 15-30 X 5-7 mm, yellowish, turning yellowish brown. Seed cones subterminal, solitary or in whorls of 2-3 on short, stout, recurved peduncles, persistent some time after seed dispersal, leaving a few basal scales on the peduncle when falling. Immature cones broadly ovoid to subglobose, with sharp, spreading or curved spines, (15-)20-25 X 12-18 mm, purplish brown, glaucous, maturing in two years. Mature cones ovoid to subglobose when opened, symmetrical or slightly oblique toward the base, 5-10 X 4.5-7 cm when open. Seed scales ca. 90-120, parting when mature, thin, flexible, oblong, with thin margins, straight or recurved, dark purplish brown with a light brown edge below the apophysis abaxially, light brown with faint marks of seed wings adaxially. Apophysis slightly to prominently raised, transversely keeled, rhombic or irregularly pentagonal in outline, ochraceous to reddish brown. Umbo dorsal, flat to prominently raised and transversely keeled, 5-7 mm wide with a persistent, curved, to 3 mm long spine. Seeds obliquely ovoid, slightly flattened, 5-7 X 4-5 mm, light grey-brown, sometimes with dark spots. Seed wings articulate, effective, held to the seed by two narrow, flimsy claws, obliquely oblong, 15-20 X 6-10 mm, translucent, light yellowish brown. Cotyledons 6-9(-11).

description: Tree, as in the species. Seed cones distinctly pedunculate, peduncles up to 20 mm long, curved, falling with the cones after a few years. Cones opening readily, narrowly ovoid to ovoid-attenuate when closed, (narrowly) ovoid when open, then 5-8 X 3.5-4.5(-5) cm. Seed scales ca. 100-120, (thin) woody, somewhat flexible, parting readily to release the seeds.

description: Tree, medium size, height to 15-20(-25) m, dbh to 40-50 cm. Trunk monopodial, straight or sometimes curved. Bark rather thin, rough, scaly, breaking in small, rectangular plates, exfoliating slowly, greyish brown to grey; on young trees and branches smooth exfoliating in thin, papery scraps, greyish brown. Branches of first order long, spreading to assurging, along much of the length of the stem in free-standing trees, in dense stands only in the upper part; of higher orders slender, spreading, forming an irregular or rounded, open crown. Shoots often multinodal, rough, with short decurrent, persistent pulvini. Cataphylls subulate, scarious, tapering into a caudate apex, margins erose-ciliate, dark brown; deciduous before leaf fascicles. Vegetative buds ovoid-acute, the terminal buds 15-30 X 10-15 mm, the laterals smaller, resinous, brown; the scales appressed, subulate, scarious, with erose, hyaline margins. Fascicle sheaths initially 10-18 mm long, papery, orange-brown at base, whitish hyaline distally, persistent but reduced to 3-6 mm, turning grey-black. Leaves in fascicles of 3, rarely 2, spreading obliquely from the shoot, persisting 2-3 years, rigid, straight, (8-) 10-12(-14) cm X 1-1.5 mm, margins serrulate, apex acute, light green or slightly glaucous-green. Stomata on all faces of leaves, in 8-12 lines on the convex abaxial face and in 3-5 lines on each adaxial face. Leaf anatomy: Cross section transverse-triangular; hypodermis uniform, with 1-2 rows of cells; resin ducts 2-3, medial; stele wide, elliptic in cross section; outer cell walls of endodermis not thickened; vascular bundles 2, distinctly separate. Pollen cones crowded near the proximal end of a new shoot, subtended by scarious, subulate bracts, ovoid-oblong to cylindrical, 15-20 X 5-7 mm, yellowish to yellowish brown. Seed cones subterminal, solitary or more often in pairs or whorls of 3-5, on short, stout, recurved peduncles, very persistent on main stem and branches. Immature cones ovoid-acute, 10-15 X 5-8 mm, purplish, maturing time two seasons. Mature cones seemingly sessile, reflexed, extremely serotinous, ovoid-oblong to ovoid-attenuate, slightly curved, asymmetrical, 8-15 X 3.5-6 cm when closed (up to 8 cm wide when open). Seed scales ca. 150-180, parting after fire (extreme heat) but remaining connate at base, thick, rigid, oblong, straight or slightly curved when parted, purplish brown to reddish brown on the abaxial side, reddish brown with light brown marks of seed wings on the adaxial side. Apophysis rhombic to pentagonal in outline, transversely keeled, from slightly raised on the lower side of the cone to conical and curved on the upper side, especially toward the base of the cone (there >10 mm long), ochraceous or yellowish brown, slightly lustrous, weathering grey. Umbo dorsal, rhombic, from almost flat to pyramidal or unciform in conjunction with development of the apophysis, curved toward the cone apex, up to 5 X 5 mm, darker than apophysis; prickle absent. Seeds obliquely ovoid, flattened, apex slightly acute, 5-7 X 3.5-4.5 mm, blackish grey. Seed wings articulate but effective, held to the seed by two oblique claws, oblong, with one side curved, 12-18 X 5-7 mm, yellowish to grey-brown. Cotyledons (5-)7-8(-9).

description: Shrub or small tree, height to 3-12 m, dbh to 10-80 cm. Trunk monopodial, very short (shrubs), branching immediately above the ground, or short, contorted or more or less straight, branching low. Branches of first order long, spreading or trailing on the ground, or ascending. Crown an open or dense shrub or broad, open, irregular. Vegetative buds oval-cylindrical, the terminal buds 8-10 X 3-5 mm. Leaves in fascicles of 3, rarely 2, 4 or 5, persisting 4-5(-7) years, curved or less often straight, more or less rigid (especially short leaves), 2.5-5(-6) cm X 0.8-1.2 mm; bicolorous, dull green to grey-green on the abaxial face, usually glaucous-white on the adaxial faces, divided by a green midrib. Stomata: Leaves epistomatic, in 2-3 lines on each adaxial face. Seed cones 2.5-4.5 X 3-5 cm when open. Apophysis slightly raised, radially keeled or ribbed. Umbo flat or slightly recessed, prickle absent. Seeds 10-12 X 6-9 mm, integument thick, 0.5-1 mm; macrogametophyte (endosperm of authors) white when fresh.

description: Tree of medium size, height to 15-20 m. Leaves in fascicles of 3-4(-5), thick, coarse, rigid, usually curved and twisted, 14-25 cm X 1.4-1.8 mm. Stomata on all faces of leaves, in 8-12 lines on the convex abaxial face and in (3-)4 lines on each adaxial face (the abaxial number of lines correlated with width of leaf). Resin ducts in the leaf 3-5(-8). Seed cones ovoid to ovoid-oblong, often curved, (4.5-)5-10(-14) X 3.5-6(-8) cm when open. Seeds obliquely ovoid, slightly flattened, 5-6 X 3.5-4 mm. Seed wings obliquely ovate, 12-16 X 6-8 mm.

description: Tree. Young branches glabrous; bark mid brown; lenticels 0.5mm diam., to 4x 1 mm, more frequently fusiform than circular, elevated, granular, pale orange-brown. Axillary buds closely juxtaposed in stacks of up to four, with compacted ferruginous-villous hairs. Leaves subcoriaceous to coriaceous, decussate to spirally arranged, rarely verticillate on older shoots, glabrous. Petioles 5-20 × 3-8 mm, flat to subterete, glabrous. Lamina 16-27 × 5.5-9.3 cm, narrow oblong, narrowly obovate, or oblanceolate; base symmetrical, obtuse, rounded or cordate (very rarely acute), often rapidly decurrent; apex acute to obtuse; margin sometimes with narrow revolute rim; venation conspicuous, raised, brochidodromous, at times the lowermost vein(s) eucamptodromous; midrib slightly elevated above, narrowly grooved down center (rarely elevated); lateral veins 9-11 pairs, leaving midrib at 40-70° at base, to 50-80° at mid lamina, and 40-60° at apex, either running parallel before ascending steeply or ascending immediately on leaving the midrib. Primary axis of inflorescence branched, 25-30 cm × 5-8 mm (early infructescence stage); 3-8 lateral inflorescences at 2-5 nodes, 7.5-22 cm × 2-4 mm, spirally arranged, and well spaced. Flowers (post-anthesis, ovaries beginning to enlarge) 6-7 mm long, supported on pedicels 2-5 × 0.6 mm, the indumentum brown, appressed-pilose; hypogynous nectary ca. 1 mm long; ovary hairs extending to 1.5-2 mm from base, pale orange-villous fading to gray, becoming sparse; style clavate. Fruit pedicel 5-7 × 2.5-3.5 mm. Fruit 5-6 cm diam., globose, abruptly mucronate at apex to 10 mm, smooth, dark brown; pericarp 3-4 mm thick; outer mesocarp 2 mm thick, mid mesocarp 1-2 mm thick, resin present; inner mesocarp thin (1 mm thick in immature fruit). Seed ca. 3.5 cm diam., seed coat chartaceous, fused to pericarp. Field characters. Tree, 20-40 m tall, 40-50 cm dbh, bark brown, furrowed; outer bark 15-20 mm thick, red-brown, inner bark to 5 mm thick, whitish. Immature fruit green, maturing to brown, 5-6 cm diam., subglobose, strongly apiculate, pericarp coriaceous.

description: Tree, to 5 m. Young branches densely tomentose-crispate, ferruginous; bark dark gray to dark brown or black; lenticels numerous, minute (<0.25 mm), orbicular, plane to slightly raised, powdery, orange-brown. Axillary buds single or stacked, densely tomentose-crispate, ferruginous. Leaves coriaceous, spirally arranged to subopposite-decussate, petiolate; essentially glabrous above or with yellowish- to ferruginous-villous indumentum at the base, especially on venation, densely tomentose-crispate beneath, becoming gray with age; young leaves densely ferruginous tomentose-crispate on both surfaces. Petioles 7-10 × 1.75-2.5 mm at midlength, 2-3.5 mm at base, flat and thick to subterete, the indumentum villous and frequently yellowish in younger leaves, tomentose-crispate in older leaves, becoming gray with age, very gradually glabrescent. Lamina 4.5-8 × 2.4-3.3 cm, oblong to oval, sometimes elliptic; base symmetrical to weakly asymmetrical, obtuse to rounded, sometimes acute, shortly narrowing; apex obtuse to rounded; margin entire, frequently weakly convolute; venation obscure above in old leaves, slightly raised above in newer growth, obscure due to dense indumentum to moderately prominent beneath, reticulodromous to faintly brochidodromous; midrib plane to slightly sunken above, densely buff-villous at base becoming glabrous towards apex, prominent beneath; lateral veins 4-7 pairs. Primary axis of inflorescence branched, ca. 5.3 (broken) cm × l.5 mm; 3-4 lateral inflorescences, at ca. 3 nodes, 5-6.6 cm × 1.25-1.5 mm, spiral, accessory branching absent; indumentum dense, ferruginous tomentose-crispate. Common bracts ca. 0.9-1 mm. Pedicels 2.5-3 × ca. 0.5-0.7 mm, indumentum as for inflorescence. Flowers 3.5-4.75 mm long, the perianth indumentum as for inflorescence; free part of filaments 2.75-3 mm long, adnate to perianth for 0.5-0.6mm; anthers 1 × 0.5 mm, oblong, apiculate; hypogynous nectary to 0.75 mm long, the lobes mucronate; ovary ferruginous-villous (often lighter in color than pedicels), the hairs reaching 3 mm to base of style; ovary only 1.5 mm long; style ca. 3 mm long, not or weakly clavate. Immature fruit 2.5 × 2 cm, subglobose, ferruginous-tomentose, becoming glabrescent, the apiculum latero-apical, very prominent, ca. 0.5 cm long. Field characters. Tree to 5 m. Branches dark brown. Leaves shiny greenish yellow above, ferruginous-tomentose beneath. Buds ferruginous-tomentose. Flowers yellow. Young fruits olive green, becoming dark brown with maturity. Seeds white.

description: Small to large tree. Young branches mostly glabrous, the young twigs with indumentum of very sparse, appressed, pale yellow to ferruginous hairs; bark gray to buff or brown, conspicuously lenticellate; lenticels numerous, large, circular to 1 mm diam, or fusiform to 3 × 1 mm, raised, granular, buff to orange. Axillary buds usually present, singly or in stacks of up to three, with tightly compacted ferruginous pubescence. Leaves subcoriaceous, spirally arranged, decussate or rarely verticillate, often clustering toward the end of the seasonal growth, glabrous. Petioles (l-)3-12 × l(-2) mm, flat to semi-terete, slightly wrinkled, the base of the lamina usually descending the petiole a short distance. Lamina 5-17 × 1.5-5(-9) cm, oblanceolate or occasionally narrow-elliptic or narrow- to wide-obovate; base (acute to) cuneate, rarely obtuse; apex acute to obtuse, rarely rounded; margin ± revolute with very narrow rim of leaf inrolled; venation conspicuous to obscure, raised, the basal vein eucamptodromous, inconspicuously brochidodromous farther up; midrib raised above with thin groove running up center; lateral veins (5-)6-8 pairs, leaving midrib at 40-80°. Primary axis of inflorescence branched, 6-24 cm × 2-3 mm; (3-)5-8 lateral inflorescences at (2-)4-8 nodes, 5-18 cm × l(-1.5)mm, spirally arranged, clustering near base of primary axis; indumentum yellow-brown, appressed-tomentose to appressed-pilose. Common bracts 0.7-1 mm long, sparsely orange-villous. Pedicels 3-5.7 mm long, 0.25-0.3 mm wide, the indumentum dense, short-sericeous, appressed-villous becoming pilose, yellow- to orange-brown. Flowers 4.1-1.5 mm long, the perianth indumentum yellow-brown, closely appressed, sparse-pilose, calvescent; free part of filaments 2.5-4.3 mm long, adnate to perianth parts 0.3-2 mm from base, anthers 0.8-1.4 × 0.4-0.7mm; hypogynous nectary 0.4-0.8 mm long; ovary yellow-orange to orange villous, extending to 1.5-2.5 mm from base, hairs bushing outwards considerably; style 0.2-0.4 mm wide at midpoint, narrowly clavate. Fruit pedicel (l-)4-7(-10) × 3-7 mm. Fruit 5-5.5 cm long × 4-5 cm wide, subglobose, usually gradually mam mi li form at apex for 5-10 mm, mid to dark brown, surface roughened with buff to pale orange-brown scaling; pericarp 3.5-6 mm thick; outer mesocarp 1-1.5 mm thick, mid mesocarp 2-3.5 mm thick, resin present, inner mesocarp thin. Seed coat chartaceous where separated from pericarp. Field characters. Small to large tree 6-20(-25) m tall × (7.5-)30-80 cm dbh, rarely single stems 2-3 m tall. Trunk slightly to very rough, bark brown to dark brown, cambium noted to be cream colored with rusty brown flecks on one specimen, crimson emitting small amounts of colorless sap on another. Wood very hard. Leaves coriaceous, lustrous above (dull beneath). Terminal panicles, racemes pendulous, flowers yellowish to grayish-white or white (greater detail on one label specifies pedicel and style light green, ovary bronze, stamens white; another specifies a green pistil), sweetly fragrant. Fruit to 8 cm diam., very hard, green (to coffee colored), and without a strong smell; eaten by pacas.
