Inflorescence nidular, capitate, submultiflowered; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, to 15 cm long, green with reddish apices. Floral bracts oblong, cymbiform, mucronate, ca. 30 mm long, 10 mm wide, exceeding the ovary, entire, thin, hyaline, glabrous. Sepals lance-ovate, acute and mucronulate, subsymmetrical, ca. 23 mm long, connate 6-8 mm, whitish-green; petals ca. 55 mm long, free for 10-12 mm, the tube and margins white, deep blue toward apex, bearing 2 small scales; stamens included; pollen ellipsoid, biporate; ovary 12-15 mm long, glabrous, white.

description: Leaves 12-20 in a dense tubular rosette, 30-50 cm long; sheaths large, elliptic, entire, pale, brown-lepidote beneath; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, scarcely if at all narrowed toward base, 3-6 cm wide, green, paler beneath, subentire or serrate with remote spines 0.2 mm long. description: Leaves 10-20 in a dense funnelform rosette, to 45 cm long; sheaths large, elliptic, entire, brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly acute or subrounded with a slender usually recurved apex, 3-4 cm wide, tinged with purple beneath, subdensely serrulate with spines 0.5 mm long. description: Leaves 12-40 in a dense rosette; sheaths large, oblong-elliptic, entire, usually tinged with purple, covered with minute appressed brown-centered scales; blades ligulate, acute or acuminate, slightly if at all narrowed toward base, wholly green, glabrous or subglabrous, subdensely serrate with spines 1 mm long. description: Plant propagating by slender rhizomes 7-14 cm long. description: Plant propagating by rhizomes. description: Plant stemless, propagating by rhizomes. Leaves 15-20 in a broad spreading rosette, 30-40 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic to suborbicular, much wider than the blades, entire, pale, densely lepidote with brown appressed scales; blades ligulate, slightly narrowed toward base, broadly acute and then acuminate to a short pungent spine, 3-6 cm wide, laxly serrate with spines 4 mm long, glabrous above, obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath, pale green. description: Tree, small to medium, height to 10-15(-20) m, dbh to 100-150 cm. Trunk monopodial or with 2 to several stems, straight or contorted, branching very low. Bark thin, rough and scaly, breaking into small, scaly plates, brown, weathering grey, on young trees and branches smooth and greyish white. Branches of first order thick, contorted, or long and slender, ascending or spreading, of higher orders slender, flexible, assurgent. Shoots initially puberulent, soon glabrous, with short, non-decurrent pulvini, grey-green to grey. Cataphylls 5-10 mm long, subulate, scarious, brown, with erose-hyaline margins, soon deciduous. Vegetative buds ovoid or subglobose, the terminal buds 8-15 mm long, the laterals smaller, resinous; with imbricate, appressed, subulate, brown scales. Fascicle sheaths ca. 15 mm long, with 6-7 loosely imbricate, orange-brown scales, deciduous and absent in second year’s fascicles. Leaves in fascicles of 5, in dense, short tufts toward the ends of branchlets, persisting (3-)5-6 years, straight or slightly curved, sometimes twisted, lax, spreading at 30-50° from the shoot, (5-)6-9 cm X 0.8-1.2 mm, with remotely serrulate to nearly entire margins, acute to acuminate, dark green on the abaxial face, glaucous to white stomatal lines on both adaxial faces. Stomata: Leaves epistomatic or weakly amphi-stomatic, with 0-1 (-2 intermittent) lines of stomata in grooves on the abaxial face and 2-4 (intermittent) lines on each adaxial face. Leaf anatomy: Cross section triangular; hypodermis unilayered or sometimes with a few extra cells on the abaxial side and near the margins; resin ducts 1-3, external on the abaxial side; stele terete; cell walls of endodermis thin; vascular bundle single. Pollen cones crowded at the proximal end of a new shoot, spreading, subtended by light brown bracts, ovoid-oblong, 610 mm long, yellow, maturing to yellowish brown. Microsporophylls peltate, the distal part cordate to rounded, smooth, ca. 1 mm wide. Seed cones subterminal, solitary, in pairs or in whorls of 3(-4), on stout, to 15 mm long peduncles which fall with the cone. Immature cones erect, ovoid-oblong to cylindrical, greenish or purplish, maturing in two seasons. Mature cones subpendulous, cylindrical, straight or slightly curved when closed, ovoid-cylindrical or broad-cylindrical when opened, then 10-15 X 4-6 cm. Seed scales ca. 80-110, parting but spreading only ca. 50° from the axis, the proximal, infertile scales slightly recurved, the other scales obtrullate, slightly concavo-convex, with seed cavities near the base on the adaxial side, the apex recurved at mid-cone, dark (reddish) brown. Apophysis relatively thick woody, triangular to rhombic, with an obtuse apex, recurved but not reflexed at mid-cone, ochraceous to light brown, very resinous. Umbo terminal, transverse-triangular, obtuse, 5-10 mm wide, grey-brown, very resinous. Seeds broadly obovoid, flattened, 10-15 X 8-10 mm, dark brown, sometimes with blackish spots. Seed wings adnate, vestigial to very small, reduced to a narrow strip around the distal part of the seed up to 5 mm wide, or absent when the seed is free from the scale. Cotyledons 10-13, 30-40 mm long; according to Steinhoff & Andresen (1971) Pinus flexilis s.str. has 10 or fewer cotyledons.

description: Plant propagating by pendulous, 5 cm long stolons, stolon scales appressed, triangular-acute, paleaceous, densely nerved, brown-punctulate. Leaves ca. 8-10 in a long rosette, 5 cm long; sheaths barely distinct or forming a tank, white-lepidote; blades reflexed, linear, subrounded and mucronate, 15 mm wide, white-lepidote but soon glabrous, purple-banded beneath, purple-spotted above, channeled, minutely denticulate. Scape 8 mm long; scape-bracts triangular, mucronate, 10 mm long, 5 mm wide, purplish. Inflorescence simple, 6-8-flowered. Floral bracts linear, acuminate, 14 mm long, exceeding the ovary, entire; pedicels 2 mm long. Sepals slightly asymmetric, lanceolate, acuminate, 13 mm long, connate 3 mm, purplish, glabrous; petals 28 mm long, connate 20 mm, narrowly rhombic, acuminate, violet; ovary 3 mm long; epigynous tube 1 mm high; ovules obtuse.

description: Plant stemless, propagating vegetatively by short stout stolons. Leaves 6-10; sheaths 9 cm long, about equaling the blades, ample, strongly inflated and forming a subglobose narrow-mouthed rosette, dark red-purple, densely appressed-lepidote on both sides; blades abruptly spreading, ligulate, acute, 25-30 mm wide, thick-coriaceous but pliable, subdensely punctulate on both sides, laxly serrate with antrorse to retrorse spines 1 mm long. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered, 1 cm in diameter. Flowers obscurely pedicelate. Sepals ovate, acute, 20 mm long, connate for 3 mm; petals sky blue; ovary subcylindric.

description: Leaves all alike, to 22 cm long, covered on both sides with coarse cinereous ap-pressed scales; sheaths broadly elliptic, 6-8 cm long, their scales with brownish centers; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, becoming broadly retuse by the reflexing of the apex, 28 mm wide, subdensely serrulate with teeth less than 1 mm long, green, darker beneath. Inflorescence simple, about 20-flowered; outer bracts broadly ovate, 3 cm long, thin, lepidote. Floral bracts exceeded by the sepals, membranaceous, lepidote; pedicels slender, to 13 mm long. Sepals strongly asymmetric with the acuminate apex extending 3 mm above the wings, subfree, 14 mm long, the median part red-purple and lepidote toward the apex, the wings white; petals 18 mm long, white, their blades broadly ovate, acute; ovary ellipsoid, 7 mm long.

description: Plant propagating by long rhizomes 7 mm in diameter. Leaves suberect, 25 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, 11 cm long, pale green, densely and finely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly rounded or even somewhat retuse and apiculate, 5 cm wide, subentire, green, concolorous, glabrous above, inconspicuously pale-lepidote beneath. Scape 3 cm long, 4 mm in diameter; scape-bracts suborbicular, 15 mm long, thin, densely lepidote. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered, less than 3 cm in diameter; outer bracts broadly ovate, acute, nearly equaling the sepals, thin, lepidote toward the apex. Floral bracts lance-linear, flat, rounded and apiculate, slightly exceeded by the sepals, thin, sparsely lepidote; pedicels 5 mm long. Sepals lance-linear, acute, slightly asymmetric, 30 mm long, connate for 8 mm, glabrous; petals linear, acuminate, ca. 3 cm long; ovary subcylindric, 2 cm long, epigynous tube funnelform, 4.5 mm long, ovules apiculate.

description: Plant stoloniferous. Leaves about 30 in a dense spreading rosette, 20-30 cm long, chartaceous, laxly and inconspicuously lepidote; sheaths broadly elliptic, 12 cm long, 9 cm wide, pale green; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 5-6 cm wide, laxly and minutely denticulate, pale green with reddish spots. Scape 35 mm long; lower scape-bracts subrounded, acuminate, greenish, the upper forming an involucre about the inflorescence, triangular, acute, membranaceous, green. Inflorescence simple, corymbiform, ca. 30-flowered, 4 cm in diameter. Floral bracts lanceolate, acute, about equaling or slightly exceeding the ovary, entire, glabrous; pedicels 10 mm long. Sepals nearly free, slightly asymmetric, attenuate to a subulate apex, 20 mm long, green, glabrous; petals 35 mm long, connate for 5 mm, long-acuminate, white except for a violet apex; ovary trigonous, 10 mm long, whitish.

description: Plant stemless, propagating by long slender arching-pendent stolons. Leaves about 10 in each rosette, even the inner ones only 15 cm long, bearing minute dark ap-pressed scales; sheaths ample, 6 cm long, forming a subcylindric or ellipsoid tank, densely lepidote; blades linear, flat, broadly rounded and apiculate, 25 mm wide, green, very sparsely lepidote, very sparsely serrulate with teeth less than 0.5 mm long. Inflorescence few-flowered, hidden in the center of the rosette. Floral bracts oblong, obtuse, about equaling the sepals, thin, greenish-white, subglabrous; pedicels slender, 5 mm long. Sepals short-connate, 12 mm long, broadly obtuse, strongly asymmetric, green centrally; petals 22 mm long, white, the blades elliptic, obtuse or apiculate; ovary ellipsoid, 7 mm long.

description: Plant propagating by stout scaly stolons. Leaves about 10 in an ellipsoid rosette, reddish, concolorous, densely cinereous-lepidote on all exposed surfaces, the outer ones reduced to short ovate acute sheaths, the inner to 25 cm long; sheaths elliptic, 14 cm long, distinctly exceeding the blades; blades varying from (outer) triangular with a thick involute terminal cusp to ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, 27 mm wide, laxly serrulate with spreading spines 0.5 mm long. Scape 7 cm long; scape-bracts imbricate, the upper ones short-involucrate about the inflorescence, elliptic, entire, membranaceous, subdensely brown-lepidote. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered. Floral bracts ovate, acute, about equaling the pedicels; pedicels slender, distinct, to 23 mm long. Sepals slightly asymmetric, oblong, acute, 26 mm long, very short-connate, membranaceous, sparsely lepidote; petals acute, ca. 4 cm long, white with blue apices (! Hatschbach).

description: Plant stemless. Leaves rather numerous, rosulate, to 3 dm long, wholly red except for a few green spots, appressed-pale-lepidote, obscurely banded beneath; sheaths ca. 9 cm long; blades ligulate, slightly narrowed toward base, rounded and apiculate, 4 cm wide, laxly serrate with spines 1 mm long. Scape short. Inflorescence compound, rather many-flowered, ca. 4 cm in diameter, red; bracts about equaling the sepals, serrulate, chartaceous when dry, appressed-pale-lepidote, the outer broadly ovate, the floral narrowly lanceolate; pedicels slender, to 5 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, asymmetric, acuminate, 15 mm long, connate for 2 mm, glabrous outside, flocculose inside; petals naked, acuminate, 19 mm long, red; stamens included; ovary ellipsoid, 9 mm long, the epigynous tube broadly funnelform; placentae subapical; ovules apiculate.

description: Plant stoloniferous. Leaves all alike, to 36 cm long, completely covered with coarse pale appressed scales; sheaths broadly elliptic, 11 cm long, their scales brownish; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 27 mm wide, laxly serrulate with teeth 0.5 mm long, green. Scape 6 cm long. Inflorescence simple, about 12-flowered; outer bracts ovate, 3 cm long, membranaceous, densely lepidote. Floral bracts oblong, obtuse and apiculate, membranaceous, lepidote; pedicels slender, 14 mm long. Sepals 15 mm long, connate for 3 mm, the lobes slightly asymmetric, broadly elliptic and apiculate. Fruit globose, 6 mm in diameter.

description: Leaves obscurely and laxly dark punctulate beneath; blades concolorous.

description: Plant propagating by long, pendulous stolons. Leaves 5-7 in number, 13-20 cm long; sheaths elliptic-oblong, 5-6 cm long, 2 cm wide, forming an ellipsoid, apically constricted tank, densely brown-lepidote within, the upper half dark purple, the lower half pale; blades linear, rounded and slenderly apiculate, 10-15 mm wide, concolorous, sparsely and minutely lepidote, sparsely and minutely spinose-serrate. Scape 5 cm long; scape-bracts imbricate, suborbicular, apiculate, 10 mm long, serrulate, brown-punctate-lepidote. Inflorescence simple, 6-10-flowered. Floral bracts narrowly spathulate, apiculate, 25 mm long, entire, white-hyaline; pedicels 5 mm long. Sepals subsymmetrical, lanceolate, acuminate, 15 mm long, connate 5 mm, pale green, glabrous; petals 30 mm long, the blade lanceolate, acuminate, violet; stamens high-connate, anthers exserted above corolla-tube; ovary cylindric, 3 mm long; placenta subapical; ovules many, obtuse.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Leaves about 10 in a funnelform rosette that is not constricted at apex, to 18 cm long; sheaths elliptic, longer than the blades, pale but completely covered by appressed dark castaneous scales; blades broadly ligulate, rounded-retuse with a minute usually deciduous apiculus, ca. 3 cm wide, obscurely serrulate near apex and entire elsewhere, covered with coarse appressed white scales beneath, soon glabrous above, tinged with dark purple. Inflorescence about equaling the leaf-sheaths, 2 cm in diameter, few-flowered; outer bracts broadly ovate, much exceeded by the sepals, membranaceous, sparsely pale brown-lepidote. Floral bracts like the outer bracts but narrower; pedicels slender, 5 mm long. Sepals only slightly asymmetric, oblong, obtuse, 13.5 mm long; petals white; ovary ellipsoid.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Plant propagating by 5 mm thick stolons covered with castaneous scales. Leaves forming a tubular rosette 25 cm high; sheaths of the outer ovate, 6 cm long, 4 cm wide, of the inner narrowly ovate, 10 cm long, 5 cm wide, green and castaneous-lepidote outside; blades of the outer gradually narrowed at apex into a subpungent spine, 12 cm long, 15-20 mm wide, of the inner linear, subrounded, mucronate, 10 cm long, 25-30 mm wide, minutely white-lepidote, serrate with castaneous, 1 mm long spines 3 mm apart. Scape 3 cm long, 8 mm thick, white; basal scape-bracts ovate, acuminate, 15 mm long, 10 mm wide, entire, white-lepidote; upper scape-bracts ("primary bracts") oblong, acuminate, 4 cm long, 15 mm wide, exceeding the ovary, entire, white, lepidote at apex. Floral bracts unknown; pedicels 1 cm long, white. Sepals lanceolate, acuminate, 35 mm long, connate for 10 mm, glabrous, red; petals 7 cm long, high-connate, the limb linear, acute, 55 mm long, 5 mm wide, spreading at anthesis, the apical half violet; stamens 3 cm long; ovary subtrigonous, 10 mm long, 5 mm thick; placentae subapical; ovules many, obtuse.

description: Plant stoloniferous. Leaves more than 30 in a broadly obconic rosette, to 23 cm long, sparsely and obscurely lepidote beneath; sheaths broadly elliptic, 9 cm long; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, to 28 mm wide, sparsely and obscurely serrulate. Scape 3 cm long; upper scape-bracts involucrate about the inflorescence, slightly exceeding the ovaries, broadly elliptic, membranaceous, pale. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered, ca 2 cm in diameter. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts but narrower, entire; pedicels distinct, to 10 mm long. Sepals slightly asymmetric, obtuse, 12 mm long, connate for 4 mm, apically red-purple (! A. Seidel) petals 23 mm long, connate for 2 mm, the upper 2/3 blue (! A. Seidel); ovary ellipsoid, 6 mm long.

description: Plant propagating by basal rhizomes. Leaves 4-6 in a slenderly funnelform or subcylindric but never constricted rosette, 20 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, entire, about half as long as the blades, sparsely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 24 mm wide, thin, laxly serrulate with spines less than 0.5 mm long, wholly green when dry, obscurely white-banded beneath in life, sparsely and very obscurely pale-lepidote. Scape slender, 4 cm long; scape-bracts membranaceous. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered, deeply sunk in the center of the rosette; outer bracts elliptic, apiculate, slightly exceeding the ovaries, minutely serrulate toward apex, membranaceous, pale. Floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, slightly exceeding the ovary, membranaceous, obscurely serrulate toward apex; pedicels 5-7 mm long; flowers to 24 mm long. Sepals sublanceolate, asymmetric, acuminate, 13 mm long, connate for 1-2 mm, green; petals slightly exceeding the sepals, white, much exceeding the stamens; ovary ellipsoid, epigynous tube evident; placentae subapical.

description: Plant propagating by brown, scaly, pendulous stolons 30-50 cm long. Leaves few in a funnelform rosette 15 cm high and 10 cm across, the outer shorter than the inner; sheaths broadly elliptic, ca. 6 cm long, to 5 cm wide, entire, brown or violet above, densely lepidote throughout; blades recurved, ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 5-6 cm long, 4-5 cm wide, thick, vinaceous after anthesis, serrate with brown spines 2 mm long and 3 mm apart. Scape ca. 6 cm long, white; scape-bracts imbricate, serrate, the lower ca. 1 cm long, the upper ampler, surrounding the inflorescence, with short, recurved, lepidote blades. Inflorescence simple, dense, ca. 20-flowered, 3 cm wide. Floral bracts subspatulate, acuminate, coarsely spinose-serrate, ca. 20 mm long, equaling or exceeded by the sepals, sparsely lepidote, the lower to 7 mm wide, the upper 4 mm wide; pedicels stout, to 4 mm long, sparsely lepidote. Sepals 15 mm long, 5 mm wide, connate for 2-3 mm, subspatulate, acuminate, coarsely spinose-serrate, spreading at apex, laxly stellate-lepidote; petals free, narrowly ligulate, 20-23 mm long, white; ovary subglobose, obtusely trigonous, 3 mm long, green, sparsely brown-stellate; seeds ca. 4, fuscous, 2 mm long.

description: Plant propagating by long slender stolons. Leaves about 10 in a slenderly subcylindric rosette, the outer over 3 dm long, the inner evidently larger but with most of the blade lost by decay, covered with pale appressed brown-centered scales; sheaths elliptic, to 12 cm long; blades very narrowly triangular, long-attenuate, 15 mm wide at base, concolorous, sparsely and minutely serrate; scape very short. Inflorescence deeply sunk in the tube of the rosette, 10-flowered. Floral bracts elliptic, about equaling the pedicels, white, membranaceous; pedicels very slender, to 20 mm long. Sepals nearly free, asymmetric, broadly lanceolate, acute, 14 mm long, pale green with broad white margins, glabrous; petals unappendaged, the blades ovate, acute, 7 mm long, white with lavender tips; stamens deeply included; ovary slenderly obovoid, 6 mm long, the epigynous tube broadly funnelform; placentae apical; ovules apiculate.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Leaves 5-8 in a fasciculate rosette, 4-6 dm long and probably much longer in nature, exceeding the inflorescence; sheaths narrow and obscure, elongate; blades linear, long-acuminate and with a long entire apex, 25 mm wide, laxly serrate with curved spines 4 mm long, covered on both sides with appressed whitish scales. Scape erect, slender, white-flocculose; scape-bracts erect, exceeding the internodes, subfoliaceous. Inflorescence lax, 3 dm long; lower floral bracts linear, acute, exceeding the flowers, the upper triangular and shorter than the pedicels; pedicels slender, 5-7 mm long; flowers spreading, glabrous. Sepals broadly ovate, broadly rounded, red; petals ligulate, broadly rounded, 2 cm long, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base, bright purple; ovary broadly ellipsoid, 6 mm long; epigynous tube short; placentae central.

description: Plants aggregated, caulescent; stem robust, over 1 dm long. Leaves densely polystichous along the stem, persistent, spreading; sheaths short, wholly hidden; blades linear, attenuate, to 19 cm long, 16 mm wide, densely and minutely serrulate, glabrous and green above, gray beneath, sparsely and minutely punctulate-lepidote. Inflorescence densely capituliform, nidular in the center of the leaves, few-flowered. Floral bracts elliptic, apiculate, exceeding the sepals, coriaceous, brown, lepidote at apex; flowers sessile. Sepals free, the posterior ones spatulate, 11 mm long, strongly alate and lepidote toward apex; petals white.

description: Plant short-caulescent; stem ascending. Leaves many; sheaths small, scarcely wider than the blades, brown; blades spreading, curved, linear, attenuate, 3-6 dm long, 20-25 mm wide, green with a broad pale median stripe, glabrous above, sparsely and minutely white-lepidote beneath, sublaxly serrate with flat straight spines 2 mm long. Scape naked short, wholly concealed by the leaf-sheaths. Inflorescence hemispherical, digitate-glomerate, 4-6 cm in diameter; outer bracts subfoliaceous, broad, forming an involucre about the inflorescence and about equaling the flowers, red at base. Floral bracts lanceolate, about equaling the sepals, thickened at apex, entire or obscurely serrulate, red; pedicels short and stout. Sepals free, lanceolate, straight, 22-30 mm long, entire, red, obscurely lepidote; petals 5 cm long, obtuse, bright yellow with a green spot at apex; stamens and style long-exserted; ovary superior. Seeds naked, corrugated, black.

description: Plant probably low. Leaves 5 dm long; sheaths broadly ovate, short, brown, glabrous; blades linear, caudate-attenuate, 10 mm wide, laxly serrate with pale spreading spines 1 mm long, glabrous above, sparsely and minutely white-pilose beneath, bearing a broad pale median stripe. Inflorescence sessile, subglobose, 25 mm in diameter, digitately bipinnate from very short spikes, glabrous; outer bracts foliaceous but greatly reduced. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate to a thick apex, exceeding the sepals but the apex reflexed, serrulate, nerved, green; pedicels short, broad. Sepals free, cochlear-imbricate, lanceolate, acute, 8 mm long, strongly nerved, green, the posterior ones broadly alate-carinate; petals white; ovary superior.

description: Plant probably caulescent. Leaves many; sheaths broadly ovate, ca. 25 mm long, pale brown, broadly hyaline-margined; blades linear, attenuate, not contracted at base, to 16 cm long, 5 mm wide, glabrous above, covered beneath with appressed cinereous scales, narrowly cartilagineous-margined, laxly and minutely serrulate toward base. Sepals free, 12 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, the anterior one obtuse, the posterior ones carinate, strongly cucullate, thin, glabrous; ovary superior. Capsule ellipsoid, 6 mm long; seeds naked or with minute deciduous wings.

description: Plant caulescent. Leaves 8-13 cm long, white-pilosulous; sheaths short, broadly ovate, brown; blades linear, attenuate, 6 mm wide, laxly serrate with pale spines 0.7 mm long, the axils of the spines white-barbellate. Scape 1 cm long, wholly concealed by the leaves. Inflorescence very densely hemispherical, 3-4 cm in diameter, bipinnate, white-pilose; outer bracts like the leaves but much reduced. Floral bracts ovate, acute, exceeding the sepals, serrulate, red; flowers short-pedicellate. Sepals free, lanceolate, straight, acuminate, 15 mm long, nerved, red, the posterior ones narrowly alate-carinate; petals white; stamens included; ovary superior.

description: Plant caulescent. Leaves subpetiolate, to 26 cm long, entire except for the obscurely serrulate apex, white toward base, very sparsely and obscurely lepidote when young, soon glabrous; sheaths triangular, 3-4 cm long, reddish when dry; blades linear-lanceolate, attenuate, 14 mm wide, the margins slightly thickened. Inflorescence sessile in the center of the leaf-rosette, ellipsoid, 30 mm long, 15 mm in diameter, apparently simple. Floral bracts elliptic, obtuse, ca. 2 cm long, exceeding the sepals, entire, even, red. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 16 mm long, thin, connate for 4-5 mm above the base; stamens included; ovary superior.

description: Plant caulescent; stem over 2 dm long. Leaves densely polystichous along the stem, spreading; sheaths short, wholly hidden; blades linear, attenuate, ca 20 cm long, 8 mm wide, laxly and minutely serrulate, glabrous above, sparsely pilose-lepidote and soon glabrous beneath, green. description: Plant low. Leaves 2 dm long, glaucous (! Cowan), sparsely vestite with microscopic white hairs; sheaths short, broadly ovate, brown; blades linear-oblong, acute or acuminate, pungent, 3 cm wide, subdensely serrate with slender spreading pale spines 4 mm long, the axils of the spines white-barbellate. Scape short, naked. Inflorescence very dense, hemispherical, 3-4 cm in diameter; outer bracts ovate, acuminate, subfoliaceous, equaling or exceeding the flowers. description: Plant caulescent; stem 2 dm long, 15 mm in diameter, covered with the remains of old leaf-bases. description: Plants densely aggregated; stem 8 mm in diameter. description: Plant short-caulescent but branching. description: Plant flowering over 3 m high. Leaves 9 dm long; sheath subquadrate, 5 cm long, barely wider than the blade, white except for the lustrous brown apex, entire, nearly glabrous; blade linear with a long entire attenuate pungent apex, 5 cm wide, flat, closely sulcate, laxly serrate with dark ascending spines 1.5 mm long, covered above with a very fine white membrane of coalesced scales, glabrous beneath. Scape erect, over 14 mm in diameter; scape-bracts erect, foliaceous but much reduced, much exceeding the internodes, but so narrow as to leave most of the scape exposed. Inflorescence ample, at least tripinnate, glabrous (at least in age); primary bracts broadly triangular, several times shorter than the naked flattened sterile bases of the branches, entire; branches spreading with the ultimate divisions pendent; racemes to 20 cm long including the short naked sterile base, densely many-flowered, the rhachis strongly angled. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, 7 mm long, entire, subcoriaceous; flowers obscurely pedicellate, reflexed. Sepals free, heteromorphic, elliptic, the anterior one shorter than the others, ecarinate, the posterior ones 6 mm long, alate-carinate; ovary 1/3 inferior. Seeds wingless.

description: Plant probably flowering 1-2 m high. Inflorescence large, very laxly tripinnate, probably glabrous; primary and secondary bracts imperfectly known but probably small and much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading and decurved, to 45 cm long, sterile bases to 8 cm long, strongly flattened; spikes spreading, sublax, 10 cm long. Floral bracts very broadly ovate, spiculate, 3 mm long; flowers subsessile, strongly reflexed. description: Plant low with the habit of Navia cretacea. Inflorescence sessile, hemispherical, 4 cm in diameter; outer bracts foliaceous but reduced. Floral bracts pandurate, broadly rounded and apiculate, about equaling the sepals, strongly nerved, serrulate and lepidote at apex; pedicels short, broad. Sepals free, obovate, 10 mm long, strongly nerved, sparsely lepidote at apex, the posterior ones broadly alate-carinate, incurved; petals white, their blades large; stamens included; ovary superior.

description: Plants growing in colonies, caulescent; stem erect, simple or few-branched, to 35 cm long, 1 cm thick, covered with the remains of old leaves. Leaves rosulate at the stem-apices; sheaths suborbicular, 1 cm long, glabrous; blades spreading to reflexed, linear, acute, 4 cm long, 4 mm wide, thick, finely and densely serrulate throughout, covered beneath with a thick layer of white appressed scales, glabrous elsewhere except for the barbellate teeth-axils. Inflorescence subsessile, ovoid, densely few-flowered, 8 mm wide; outer bracts like the leaves but reduced. Floral bracts lanceolate, about equaling the sepals, cucullate, entire, obtusely carinate, densely white-lanate toward apex with finely divided stellate scales; flowers subsessile. Sepals free, narrowly lance-triangular, acute, cucullate, conduplicate, 14 mm long, 1.4 mm wide on the side, narrowly alate-carinate, densely white-lanate toward apex; ovary superior.

description: Plant probably caulescent. Leaf-blades very narrowly triangular, 18 cm long, 15 mm wide, entire, densely white-lanate along the margins, glabrous above, white-flocculose beneath. Inflorescence nidular, hemispherical, many-flowered, 3 cm in diameter, white-flocculose; outer bracts subfoliaceous, much exceeding the flowers. description: Plant low. Leaves numerous, 17 cm long; sheaths broadly ovate, short, brown; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, 18 mm wide, densely serrulate, concolorous, densely and minutely white-flocculose above, soon glabrous beneath. Scape slender, 20-25 mm long, naked. Inflorescence hemispherical, 2-3 cm in diameter; outer bracts acuminate from a broadly ovate base, serrulate, thick-coriaceous, flavous when dry, forming an involucre about the inflorescence that exceeds and nearly conceals it. Floral bracts lanceolate, acute, about equaling the sepals, entire, thickened toward apex, minutely lepidote; pedicels short. Sepals free, lanceolate, acute, 14 mm long, lepidote toward apex, the posterior ones carinate, narrowly alate toward base, obscurely dentate toward apex; petals yellow, about equaling the stamens; ovary superior.

description: Plant growing in colonies, caulescent; stem erect, simple, to 24 cm long, 1 cm thick, covered with the remains of old leaves. Inflorescence subsessile, very few-flowered, dense, glabrous; outer bracts like the leaves but reduced and yellowish toward base. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute and thickened at apex, exceeding the distinctly immature sepals; flowers sessile. Sepals free, oblong, cucullate, conduplicate, at least 7 mm long (immature), 1.3 mm wide on the side, narrowly alate-carinate; ovary superior.

description: Plants low, in colonies. Leaves rosulate at the ends of the short stems; blades spreading, lance-oblong, contracted to a thick obtuse apex, 4-5 cm long, 12 mm wide, stiff-coriaceous, finely and densely serrate with the teeth becoming obscure toward apex, covered beneath with appressed cinereous scales, glabrous elsewhere except for the barbellate axils of the lower teeth. Inflorescence sessile, globose, few-flowered, 1 cm wide, glabrous; outer bracts foliaceous but reduced and creamy yellow for most of their length. Floral bracts lance-elliptic, obtuse and thickened at apex, slightly shorter than the sepals, broadly subcarinate, brown with scarious margins; flowers subsessile. Sepals free, oblong, conduplicate, strongly cucullate, 7 mm long, 1 mm wide on the side, narrowly alate-carinate; ovary superior; ovules naked.

description: Plant probably low. Leaves very many, nearly 2 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 15 mm long, subhyaline, glabrous; blades linear, attenuate, 3 mm wide at base, very minutely and subdensely uncinate-serrulate, thick, coriaceous, glabrous above, appressed-white-lepidote beneath. Floral bracts linear, acute, thin, serrulate, thickened toward apex; pedicels short. description: Plant flowering to 4 m high; caudex erect, 1 m high, 3 cm in diameter. Leaves over 6 dm long, very obscurely and sparsely lepidote; sheaths smoother than the blades and with pale spines but scarcely distinct; blades linear, attenuate, pungent, 3 cm wide, nerved, laxly serrate with antrorsely curved dark spines 2 mm long. Scape erect, ca. 3 cm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate, densely serrate, the lowest narrowly triangular, the highest lanceolate. Inflorescence amply and laxly tripinnate, glabrous; axis straight; primary bracts like the highest scape-bracts, much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches divergent, over 5 dm long, laxly branching, the sterile base elongate, 4-7-bracted; secondary bracts ovate, acuminate, slightly exceeding the peduncles of the spikes; spikes arched-spreading, very densely cylindric, 4-6 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, exceeding the sepals, carinate at base, obscurely serrulate; pedicels obconic, short. Sepals free, broadly elliptic, acute, 6 mm long, coriaceous, the posterior ones alate-carinate; petals 11 mm long; stamens included; ovary superior. Capsule globose, half as long as the sepals; seeds few, naked or very narrowly alate.

description: Plant short-caulescent; most of the stem covered with decayed leaf-bases. Leaves many in a spreading rosette at the apex of the stem; sheaths completely covered; blades linear, acute, pungent, 25 cm long, 20 mm wide, flat, densely serrulate. Scape short. Inflorescence very dense, compound, globose, 25 mm in diameter; primary bracts lance-triangular, pungent, serrate, shorter than the globose short-stipitate spikes. Floral bracts ovate, acute, slightly but consistently shorter than the sepals, ferruginous-flocculose at base; pedicels short and inconspicuous. Sepals lance-oblong, acute, 6 mm long, the posterior ones sharply carinate and connate for 2 mm; petals white, blades spreading, narrowly elliptic; ovary superior.

description: Plant flowering 3 m high. Scape unknown. Inflorescence very laxly tripinnate, glabrous; primary bracts broadly ovate, cuspidate-acute, much shorter than the long naked sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading; spikes spreading, laxly flowered; rhachis strongly angled. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, shorter than the sepals; flowers spreading; pedicels very short and stout. Sepals cochlear-imbricate, broadly ovate, 10 mm long, the posterior ones alate-carinate; petals unknown; ovary superior, stout, ovoid. Seeds very narrowly winged, the wings deciduous.

Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, much shorter than the sepals; flowers subsessile. description: Plant flowering 2 m high. Leaves to 75 cm long; sheaths smoother than the blades and brownish but scarcely wider, small, subentire, sparsely and obscurely lepidote; blades linear, attenuate, pungent, 2 cm wide, covered above with pale appressed scales, laxly serrate. Scape erect, 15 mm in diameter at base, glabrous, densely and minutely red-spotted; scape-bracts erect, serrulate, the lowest subfoliaceous, much exceeding the internodes, the highest broadly triangular, small, much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence amply tripinnate, lax, glabrous; axis straight; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches subspreading, to 28 cm long, divided toward apex, the basal 2/3 sterile; secondary bracts like the floral bracts; spikes slender, slightly arching, cylindric, short-stipitate, 4-9 cm long, 1 cm in diameter, dense except near base, many-flowered. Floral bracts erect, very broadly ovate, apiculate, 5 mm long, about equaling the sepals, pale, red-punctate, thick, probably fleshy, hyaline-margined; flowers subsessile. Sepals free, broadly elliptic, subobtuse, 5 mm long, the posterior broadly alate-carinate; petals broadly rounded, 7 mm long, white, drying flavous; stamens included; ovary wholly superior.

description: Fruticulus usque 80 cm altus; rami homotini pilis glan-dularibus obsitis. description: Arbusto o subarbusto erguido o decumbente, 4080 cm de alto, muy ramificado; base leñosa, hasta 4 cm diám.; ramas viejas con corteza pardonegruzca con estrías y grietas longitudinales, cicatrices foliares salientes; ramas nuevas con pelos glandulares 0.4-0.5 mm long, con base amarillenta, pelos simples tenues y pelos estrellados sin base globosa, más cortos que los glandulares (Fig. 5A); entrenudos comúnmente muy cortos, 1-3 mm long. Yemas axilares 2, la basal florífera; ramas seriales desarrolladas. Hojas frecuentemente agrupadas en la porción distal de las ramas, muy pequeñas, cartáceas, discoloras, abolladas, viscosas. Estípulas nulas. Pecíolo 1.5-3 mm long., cilindrico, indumento como el del tallo, pero con más pelos estrellados. Lámina suborbicular, elíptica, ovada u obovada, 7-12(-19) x 6-11 mm, relación largo:ancho = 1.1-1.5:1; base redondeada, brevemente atenuada o cuneada; ápice obtuso, a veces subagudo; borde crenado, revoluto; haz tomentosa, con pelos porrecto-estrellados, radio central 0.3-1 mm long., radios cortos 0.1-0.3 mm long., y pelos glandulares dorados con base mamiforme rígida (se rompe el cuerpo del pelo y persiste la base) especialmente abundantes hacia los bordes; envés tomentoso con pelos estrellados; venas laterales 3-6, alternas u opuestas, dirigidas hacia las escotaduras, divididas antes del borde, muy hundidas en la haz, prominentes en el envés, con muchos pelos glandulares, ángulo de divergencia 35-40°; venas terciarias visibles en el envés; venación menor inconspicua. Inflorescencias axilares, cimosas, 1-3 floras. Pedúnculos breves, 0.5-4 mm long., indumento como el del pecíolo. Ramas sucesivas 1-3 mm long. Profilos subulados, 0.5-2 mm long., raramente 5 x 1 mm. Pedicelos breves, 1-2.5 mm long. Flores heterostilas. Cáliz 7-12 mm long.; tubo calicino 1.5-3 mm long., glabro por dentro, por fuera hirsuto con pelos porrecto-estrellados ferrugíneos, radio central 1 mm long.; lóbulos del cáliz angustiovados o triangulares, cerca del ápice con pelos más cortos, 0.5 mm long., los lóbulos internos con bandas de pelos sedosos, blanquecinos antes del borde membranáceo, ápice emucronado. Pétalos amarillos; uña glabra; lámina 9-11 x 4-8 mm. Corona blanquecina en seco, lóbulos unidos a los pétalos 0.6-0.7 mm long., borde superior fimbriado. Filamentos estaminales subulados, glabros, 3.5-4.5 mm long, en flores longistilas, 5 mm long, en flores brevistilas, soldados 0.5 mm en la base al tubo calicino; anteras sagitadas, 1.6-2.2 x 0.8-1.0 mm, filamento inserto a 0.7 mm de la base, ápice obtuso y recurvado a la dehiscencia. Ovario ovoide, 1.5-2.5 mm long., hirsuto-velloso, pelos blanquecinos, placentas 4-6 ovuladas; estilos cilindricos, 3.5-5 mm long, en flores longistilas, bifurcados, con pelos blandos en la parte basal, 1.5 mm long, en flores brevistilas; estigmas 1 mm long., penicilados. Frutos subesféricos, 4.5-6 mm diám.; valvas ovadas, cara externa apenas verrucosa, con pelos estrellados y pelos glandulares con base mamiforme amarillenta, cara interna lisa, lustrosa, amarillenta. Semillas angustiobovoides, rectas, 2.5 x 1.1 mm, negruzcas a la madurez; exóstoma cónico muy breve, 0.2 mm long.; rafe linear; cálaza redondeada no prominente; episperma pilosiúsculo, reticulado, aréolas transrectangulares o cuadranglares; arilo lateral, lacerado, blanquecino en seco, más corto o tan largo como la semilla.

description: Fruticulus usque metralis; rami homotini pilis stellaribus, quorum radius intermedius ferrugineus valde elongatus est. Folia ovata vel elliptica, dentata vel serrato-crenata. Inflorescentia cymosa 1-3-flora. Prophylla 1-2 mm longa. Flores heterostyli. Fructus tuberculatus, hirsutus. Semina reticulata, arillo flavido, papilloso.

description: Arbusto o subarbusto erecto o decumbente 0,4-1 m de alto; ramas viejas con corteza rojizo-negruzca; ramas jóvenes hirsutas, a veces viscosas, con pelos porrecto-estrellados robustos, con base globosa, radio largo ferrugíneo o castaño, 2-3 mm long., radios cortos dorados de 0,2-0,3 mm diám., pelos estrellados 0,3 mm diám. y glandulares 0,4-0,5 mm long. Yemas axilares 2, la basal florífera; ramas seriales desarrolladas. Hojas ásperas, discoloras en vivo, a veces viscosas. Estípulas nulas, reemplazadas por un mechón de pelos. Pecíolo 1-4 mm long., cilindrico, indumento más denso que el del tallo. Lámina ovada, elíptica, suborbicular, 19-35(-47) x 13-28(-32) mm, relación largo:ancho = 1.1-1.6:1; base redondeada o brevemente atenuada; ápice obtuso, a veces subagudo; borde plano o ligeramente revoluto, dentado, a veces aserrado-crenado, cada diente terminado en una prominencia glandular; haz verde oscura en vivo, con pelos estrellados, pelos porrecto-estrellados y glandulares; envés grisáceo, tomentoso con pelos estrellados; 5 pares de venas laterales, alternas o subopuestas, hundidas en la haz, prominentes en el envés, con pelos porrecto-estrellados y glandulares, curvado-ascendentes, divididas antes del borde, ángulo de divergencia 35-45°; venas terciarias con orientación variable; venación menor prominente en el envés. Inflorescencias cimosas, axilares, 1-3-floras. Pedúnculo 3-12(-25) mm long. Ramas sucesivas 2.5-5(-8) mm long., pelos porrecto-estrellados cortos, pelos estrellados y glandulares. Profilos altemos, subulados, 1-2 mm long. Pedicelos 3-5(-7) mm long, con pelos porrecto-estrellados largos, marrones. Flores heterostilas. Cáliz 9-12.5 mm long.; tubo cali-cino 2.5-3 mm long., por fuera con pelos porrecto-estrellados con radio central marrón, 2-2.5 mm long., por dentro brevemente piloso; lóbulos triangulares, ovados o angustiovados, bordes membranáceos, los extemos con una banda glabra antes del borde brevemente piloso, indumento como el del tubo, los pelos acortándose hasta 0.3-1 mm long, en el breve mucrón apical de 0.3 mm long.; los lóbulos internos con pelos blanquecinos ordenadamente dispuestos casi hasta el borde. Pétalos rosados o color salmón; uña pilosa; lámina 9-13 x 6-10 mm, a veces con base y venas purpúreas. Corona purpúrea, lóbulos unidos a los pétalos 0.5-0.8 mm long., lóbulos unidos a los sépalos 0.3-0.4 mm long., borde superior fimbriado. Filamentos estaminales 3-4 mm long, en flores longistilas, 5-8 mm long, en flores brevistilas, soldados 1 mm en la base al tubo calicino; anteras 1.3-3 x 0.8-1.5 mm, filamento inserto a 0.5-1 mm de la base, ápice brevemente apiculado y recurvado a la dehiscencia; polen anaranjado o rojizo. Ovario ovoide, hirsuto, 2 mm long., placentas 6-8-ovuladas; estilos cilindricos, no bifurcados, rojizos, pilosos, 3-5 mm long, en flores longistilas, 1.5 mm long, en flores brevistilas; estigma purpúreo, multirramoso, 1 mm long. Frutos ovoides, 4-7 mm long.; valvas ovadas, tuberculadas, hirsutas por fuera, con pelos estrellados y pelos porrecto-estrellados con el radio central muy largo, por dentro glabras, lustrosas, superficie ondulada, vena placentaria prominente. Semillas ob-ovoides, curvadas, 2.8-3.6 x 1.2-1.5 mm; exóstoma cónico, 0.2 mm long.; rafe linear; cálaza redondeada, no prominente; episperma pilosiúsculo, reticulado, aréolas hexagonales o cuadranglares; arilo unilateral, amarillento o rojizo en seco, ancho, rasgado, papiloso, tan largo como la semilla o más corto.

description: Fruticulus ca. metralis; rami homotini hirsuti pilis aureis stellaribus quorum radius intermedius valde elongatus est. Folia discolora, ovata vel elliptica, supra nitida, rufescentia, subtus lívida. Flores solitarii heterostyli. Fructus tuberculatus, hirsutus. Semina crassa, reticulata, glabra; arillo ampio, circundante.
bibliographicCitation: Arbo, María M. 1995. Turneraceae --- Parte I. Piriqueta. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 67: 1-156.

description: Subarbusto erecto ca. 90 cm de alto, tallos 5 mm diám., hirsutos, pelos porrecto-estrellados dorados, radio central 2-3.5 mm long., radios cortos 1-2 mm long. Yemas axilares 1-2; ramas seriales no observadas. Hojas discoloras. Estípulas 3-4 pares, reducidas a prominencias glandulares 0.3-0.5 mm long., ocultas en el indumento. Pecíolo 2-6 mm, indumento como el del tallo. Lámina foliar ovada o elíptica, 2570 x 20-48 mm, relación largo:ancho = 1.2-1.5:1, hojas básales de cada rama suborbiculares; base redondeada, ligeramente cordiforme o brevemente atenuada; ápice obtuso; borde crenado-aserrado, ligeramente revoluto, con pelos porrecto-estrellados; haz pardorojiza, lustrosa, pelos porrecto-estrellados 2-2.5 mm long.; envés gris-amarillento, pelos estrellados; venas laterales 7-10, hundidas en la haz, prominentes en el envés, curvado-ascendentes, divididas hacia los bordes, ángulo de divergencia 35-50°, con pelos porrecto-estrellados como los del tallo; venas terciarias a veces visibles; venación menor inconspicua. Flores axilares, solitarias. Pedúnculo 3-5 mm long., pelos porrecto-estrellados y glandulares. Profilos reducidos a prominencias glandulares 0.3-0.4 mm long. Pedicelo 4 mm long., articulación no discernible. Cáliz 9-12 mm long., hirsuto, con pelos porrecto-estrellados y glandulares; tubo calicino ca. 2 mm long., glabro por dentro; lóbulos externos angustiovados, internos más o menos triangulares, glabrescentes a ambos lados de la vena media, borde membranáceo y glabro, mucrones ausentes. Corola 12 mm long.; pétalos 10 x 3 mm en seco. Corona laciniada, lóbulos unidos a los pétalos obova-dos, 1 mm long., lóbulos unidos a los sépalos más cortos. Filamentos estaminales glabros, subulados, 4-4.5 mm long.; anteras 2.0-2.2 x 1.0-1.3 mm, base emarginada, ápice obtuso recurvado en la dehiscencia, filamento inserto a 0.7 mm de la base. Ovario ovoide, 1.5-2.2 mm long., hirsuto, placentas 13-15 ovuladas; estilos glabros, cilindricos, 3.6 mm long.; estigma 0.5-0.7 mm long., multilobulado. Frutos 6-8 mm long.; valvas latiovadas, por fuera tuberculadas, hirsutas, pelos glandulares y simples, por dentro lisas, castañas, glabras, lustrosas, vena placentaria poco prominente. Semillas obovoides, gruesas, 3-3.3 x 1.5 mm; exóstoma cónico, reticulado; rafe linear poco visible; cálaza redondeada no prominente; episperma glabro, reticulado, aréolas transrectangulares; arilo amplio, envolvente, 2.5 mm long., borde lacerado, células lisas, sin papilas.

description: Plant probably caulescent. Leaves many, densely aggregated at the summit of the stem, to 9 cm long, glabrous except for the barbellate axils of the lowest spines, the white bases of the inner leaves and bracts forming a large colored area about the inflorescence; sheaths reniform, 15 mm wide, dark brown; blades linear, attenuate, rigid and pungent, 5-6 mm wide, slightly contracted at base, strongly nerved beneath, minutely and subdensely serrulate. Scape short, naked. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered, 8 mm in diameter, glabrous; outer bracts subfoliaceous but greatly reduced. Floral bracts elliptic, obtuse, entire, thickened at apex, shorter than the sepals. Sepals free, sublinear, cucullate, 9 mm long, the posterior ones narrowly alate-carinate toward base; petals white; ovary superior.

description: Arbusto virgado 0.4-1.25 m de alto, corteza rojiza con estrías y grietas longitudinales que dejan ver el súber blanquecino; ramas jóvenes con pelos glandulares de diferente longitud, hasta 0.7 mm long, y pelos simples tenues, en los nudos algunos pelos porrecto-estrellados 1,5 mm long. Yemas axilares 2, la basal florífera; ramas seriales desarrolladas. Hojas recurvadas, viscosas, planas o plegadas en ángulo longitudinalmente. Estípulas reducidas a prominencias glandulares subuladas 0.4 mm long. Pecíolo cilindrico, a veces violáceo, 5-20 mm long., indumento como el del tallo, con pelos porrecto-estrellados. Lámina ovada, latiovada u obcordada, 19-56 x 14-31 mm, relación largo:ancho = 1.3-1.8:1, base redondeada o cordada; ápice agudo u obtuso; borde crenado, revoluto, con pelos glandulares; haz lustrosa, laxamente cubierta de pelos estrellados y porrecto-estrellados a veces de base globosa, 7-18 radios, 0.4-0.9 mm long, y pelos glandulares; envés tomentoso, verde más pálido, con pelos estrellados y a veces glandulares; venas laterales 5-6 pares, alternas u opuestas, ángulo de divergencia 25-50°, mayor en las venas básales, los 2-3 pares básales naciendo muy próximos, hundidas en la haz, prominentes en el envés, con pelos porrecto-estrellados y glandulares, curvado-ascendentes, divididas antes del borde especialmente las 3 básales; venas terciarias hundidas en la haz, prominentes en el envés, más o menos perpendiculares o recurvadas con respecto a la vena media; venación menor conspicua en el envés. Flores axilares, solitarias, he-terostilas. Pedúnculo 3-8 mm long., a veces violáceo, indumento como el del pecíolo. Profilos reducidos a prominencias glandulares, 0.4 mm long., opuestas en la articulación. Pedicelo 3-4 mm long., ligeramente más grueso y con más pelos estrellados que el pedúnculo. Cáliz 12-15(-20) mm long.; tubo calicino 2-2.5 mm long., brevemente piloso por dentro, cara externa con pelos estrellados y pelos glandulares muy densos; lóbulos angustiovados o triangulares, glabros por dentro, por fuera indumento más laxo que el del tubo, los internos con pelos adpresos, blanquecinos, ordenadamente dispuestos antes de los bordes membranáceos; mucrón 0.5-1 mm long. Corola 7-15 mm más larga que el cáliz; pétalos con uña pilosa; lámina cárnea, con venas coloreadas, 17-27(-33) x 8-17(-20) mm. Corona con borde superior fímbriado, lóbulos unidos a los pétalos 1-1.3 mm long., lóbulos unidos a los sépalos 0.5 mm long. Filamentos estaminales soldados 0.5 mm en la base al tubo calicino, 4 mm long, en flores longistilas, 6-7 mm long, en flores brevistilas; anteras obscuras, 1.5 x 0.6-0.7 mm, filamento inserto a 0.4 de la base emarginada, ápice revoluto a la dehiscencia. Ovario elipsoide, verde, 2-2.3 mm long., placentas 25-ovuladas; estilos glabros o con algunos pelos en la base, 5-5.5 mm long, en flores longistilas, 1.8-2 mm long, y excurvos en flores brevistilas; estigma muy breve, verdoso, capitado, multilobado. Frutos 5-10 mm long., tuberculados, hirsutos, por fuera con pelos glandulares, simples y algunos porrecto-estrellados, por dentro amarillentos, lisos, lustrosos, vena placentaria prominente en la base. Semillas obovoides, 2.4-2.7 x 0.9-1.1 mm, lado rafeal cóncavo; exóstoma muy breve; rafe linear apenas visible; cálaza obtusa no o ligeramente prominente; episperma pilosiúsculo, reticulado, aréolas transrectangulares; arilo papiloso, pequeño, angosto, unilateral, 1.5-2 mm long.

description: Herba 40 cm alta, rami homotini pilis glandularibus dense vestitis, ceterum pilis simplicibus ac stellatis inter-mixtis. Folia anguste elliptica vel anguste ovata, patentia vel recurvata, frequenter longitudinaliter plicata. Inflorescentia axillaris 1-2-flora. Flores lutei heterostyli. Fructus immaturi dense tuberculata

description: Hierba 40 cm de alto, simple o con varios tallos desde la base engrosada; ramas jóvenes viscosas, con abundantes pelos glandulares setiformes 0.3-0.8 mm long., pelos estrellados 0.3 mm long, y pelos simples, entrenudos bien desarrollados 10-30 mm long. Yemas axilares seriales 2, la basal florífera. Hojas patentes o recurvadas, plegadas en ángulo a lo largo de la vena media o planas. Estípulas reducidas a prominencias glandulares subuladas, 0.5 mm long., ocultas entre el indumento. Pecíolo 3-5 mm long., indumento como el del tallo. Lámina angustielíptica o angustiobovada, 34-53 x 5-12 mm, relación largo rancho = 4-7:1; base atenuada; ápice obtuso o agudo; borde plano o ligeramente recurvo, subentero u ondulado-serrulado; haz tomentosa, con pelos estrellados multirradiados breves y pelos glandulares sobre los bordes; envés con pelos estrellados y glandulares entremezclados; 6-9 pares de venas laterales ligeramente impresas en la haz, prominentes en el envés, ángulo de divergencia 35-40°, curvadas, perdiéndose hacia los bordes; venas terciarias y venación menor conspicuas en el envés. Inflorescencias cimosas, axilares, 1-2-floras. Pedúnculo 8-14 mm long., indumento como el del tallo. Profilos ovados, 1 mm long., tomentosos, altemos en la porción apical de cada eje, frecuentemente reducidos a prominencias glandulares subuladas, 0.4 mm long., acompañadas de un mechón de pelos estrellados. Pedicelos 2.5-6.0 mm long., ligeramente más gruesos que el pedúnculo. Flores heterostilas. Cáliz 8-11 mm long.; tubo calicino 2-3,5 mm long., cara externa densamente cubierta de pelos estrellados cortos y glandulares 0.5-0.6 mm long., cara intema glabra o con pelos simples, cortos, esparcidos; lóbulos angustiova-dos, 3-5 nervados, por fuera indumento como en el tubo, por dentro glabros, los internos con bandas de pelos adpresos y ordenadamente dispuestos antes de los bordes membranáceos; ápice a veces subcuculado, mucrón brevísimo, 0.3 mm long. Corola amarilla 0-3.5 mm más larga que el cáliz; uña glabra o pilosa; lámina obovada, 6-10 x 3-4 mm. Corona lacerada, ca. 1 mm long., lóbulos unidos a los pétalos más desarrollados. Filamentos estaminales amarillos, soldados en la base 0.6-0.7 mm al tubo calicino, 4-4.5 mm long, en flores longistilas, 6-8.5 mm long, en flores brevistilas; anteras angustiovadas, 1.5-2 mm long., base emarginada, filamento inserto a 0.5 mm de la base, ápice obtuso recurvado después de la dehiscencia. Ovario ovoide, hirsuto, 1.5-2 mm long.; estilos cilindricos, con algunos pelos en la base, bifurcados cerca del ápice, 5.5 mm long, en flores longistilas, 1.6-2 mm long, en flores brevistilas; estigma penicilado, 1-1.5 mm long., 12-16 ramas. Frutos inmaduros granuloso-tuberculados, con pelos estrellados y glandulares abundantes.

description: Plant low; stem to 10 cm long, covered with the remains of old leaves. Leaves (living) numerous in a dense rosette at the apex of the stem, 24 cm long; sheaths broadly ovate, short, brown; blades linear, acuminate, 12 mm wide, subdensely serrulate, strongly crisped along the margin, marked with a pale median stripe, sparsely and obscurely white-pilose beneath. Inflorescence sessile, subglobose, digitately bipinnate from many short spikes; outer bracts few, foliaceous but greatly reduced. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, about equaling the sepals, subentire, thin, white, minutely pilosulous; pedicels short. Sepals free, lanceolate, acute, 8 mm long, strongly nerved, brown, pilosulous, the posterior ones narrowly alate-carinate; petals white; capsule shorter than the sepals. Seeds naked, dark, reticulate.

description: Plant low. Leaves many, ca 13 cm long; sheaths short, broadly ovate, brown; blades linear, attenuate, 9-13 cm wide, subdensely serrulate, nearly or completely concolorous, glabrous above, covered beneath with a snowy cretaceous powder. Inflorescence sessile, hemispherical, 25 mm in diameter; outer bracts foliaceous but reduced. Floral bracts broadly oblong, acute, about equaling the sepals, entire, even, glabrous; pedicels short, broad. Sepals free, obovate, 12 mm long, even, glabrous, the posterior ones carinate, incurved; petals white, the blades large; stamens included; ovary superior.

description: Herba erecta; rami homotini pilis stellaribus hirsutis, interdum pilis glandularibus intermixtis. Folia obovata, elliptica vel oblonga, longitudinaliter plicata. Flores solitarii heterostyli; pétala flavocamea. Fructus tuberculatus. Semina reticulata, glabra; arillo angusto.

description: Hierba erecta, 7-38 cm de alto, base leñosa, tallos simples o ramificados, hirsutos, con pelos porrecto-estrellados dorados o rojizos, base esférica, a veces brevemente estipitados, radio central 1.5-2 mm long., radios cortos de longitud variable, algunos poco menores que el central, y excepcionalmente algunos pelos glandulares entremezclados; entrenudos cortos. Yemas axilares generalmente una; ramas seriales no observadas. Hojas plegadas longitudinalmente en seco. Estípulas ausentes. Pecíolo 1-4 mm long., indumento como el del tallo. Lámina foliar obovada, elíptica u oblonga, disminuyendo de tamaño hacia el ápice, 15-60 x 6-17 mm, relación largoiancho = (1.6-)2.5-4.8:1; base cuneada; ápice obtuso o subagudo; borde aserrado-crenado, ligeramente revoluto; haz y envés con pelos porrecto-estrellados paucirra-diados, radio central 0.6-1.2 mm long., a veces algunos pelos glandulares; venas laterales (5-)6-8 pares, alternas o subopuestas, ángulo de divergencia 30-35°, hundidas o ligeramente salientes en la haz, prominentes en el envés, con pelos más largos, perdiéndose cerca del margen, a veces dan venas que se dirigen hacia los dientes; venas terciarias y venación menor generalmente inconspicuas. Flores axilares, solitarias, heterostilas. Pedúnculo cilindrico, 5-12 mm long., con pelos estrellados más cortos que los del tallo y pelos glandulares; profilos nulos, reducidos a un mechón de pelos en la articulación o cerca del ápice del pedúnculo; pedicelo cilindrico 2-7 mm long., indumento más denso que el del pedúnculo, con más pelos glandulares. Cáliz 6-9.5 mm long.; tubo calicino 1.5-2.2 mm long., hirsuto, con pelos porrecto-estrellados y glandulares; lóbulos externos ovados, internos triangulares, glabrescentes a ambos lados de la vena media, margen membranáceo, cara interna glabra, emucronados. Corola rosado-amarillenta, 8-12 mm long.; pétalos 7-10 x 4-6 mm, obovados, glabros, con venas coloreadas. Corona con borde superior fimbriado, lóbulos unidos a los pétalos 1 mm long., lóbulos unidos a los sépalos más cortos. Filamentos estaminales glabros, subulados, 3-4 mm long, en flores longistilas, 5 mm long, en flores brevistilas; anteras ovadas, 1.5-2.2 x 0.8-1.1 mm, base emarginada, ápice obtuso recurvado después de la dehiscencia, filamento inserto en una cavidad basidorsal 0.5-0.7 mm long. Ovario hirsuto, ovoide, 1.5-2.2 mm long., placentas 8-9 ovuladas; estilos cilindricos, glabros, 3-4.3 mm long, en flores longistilas, 1 mm long, en flores brevistilas; estigma multirramoso, 1-1.3 mm long. Frutos 6 mm long.; valvas ovadas, tuberculadas por fuera, con pelos estrellados y glandulares setiformes, cara intema lisa, glabra, lustrosa, vena placentaria prominente. Semillas obovoides, 1.7-2 x 0.9-1 mm, rectas o apenas curvadas, lado rafeal recto (Fig. 13 A); exós-toma cónico, breve, a veces reticulado; rafe linear apenas visible (Fig. 15B); cálaza redondeada no prominente; episperma glabro, reticulado, liso, aréolas transrectangulares, muros longitudinales más salientes que los transversales; arilo angosto, unilateral, lobulado, tan largo como la semilla.

description: Plant long-caulescent and laxly branched; stem to 3 dm long and over, slender, covered with old leaf-bases. Leaves (living) subrosulate at the ends of the stem, to 3 dm long, entire; sheaths narrowly triangular-ovate, conspicuous, glabrous except for the laxly lepidote margins, strongly nerved, reddish when dry; blades linear, attenuate toward base and apex, to 10 mm wide, often lustrous white toward base and with the bracts forming a handsome involucre about the inflorescence. Scape very short. Inflorescence simple, densely ellipsoid, 25 mm long, rather many-flowered; outer bracts subfoliaceous but much reduced. Floral bracts oblong-elliptic, obtuse, about equaling the sepals, entire, membranaceous, red-brown when dry, glabrous; flowers sessile. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acute, 13 mm long, equally connate for 6 mm, membranaceous, glabrous, the posterior ones narrowly carinate; petals yellow, slightly exceeding the stamens, their blades spreading, elliptic, 6 mm long; ovary wholly superior.

description: Fruticulus ramosus; rami homotini pube tenuissima simplici vestiti, pilis glandularibus hirsutis, pilis nonnullis stel-laribus adjectis. Folia elliptica, anguste ovata vel ovata, tomentosa, crenate serrata. Flores solitarii heterostyli (tantum forma brevistyla observata). Fructus tuberculatus. Semina reticulata, minute pilosiuscula; arillo angusto, breve.

description: Subarbusto 35 cm de alto, muy ramificado, corteza rojiza o negruzca con estrías y grietas longitudinales; ramas jóvenes con pelos simples tenues articulados, abundantes pelos glandulares 0.3-0.5 mm long., estrellados con pocos radios y algunos porrecto-estrellados, radio central 0.6-1 mm long., a veces los radios cortos articulados. Yemas axilares 2, la basal florífera; ramas seriales desarrolladas. Hojas tomentosas, grisáceas (silvery green). Estípulas reducidas a prominencias glandulares anaranjadas o rojizas, 2-3 pares a cada lado, 0.3-0.5 mm long., acompañadas de pelos porrecto-estrellados. Pecíolo cilindrico, 2-5 mm long., indumento más denso que el del tallo, y proporcionalmente con más pelos estrellados y porrecto-estrellados. Lámina foliar elíptica, angus-tiovada u ovada, 13-30 x 6-12 mm, relación largo:ancho = 2.1-3.4:1, base cuneada; ápice agudo, a veces obtuso; borde crenado-aserrado, dientes más o menos obtusos terminados en pelos glandulares; haz con pelos estrellados y porrecto-estrellados, radio central 0.5-0.8 mm long., 12-15 radios cortos 0.2-0.3 mm long.; envés con pelos estrellados; 4-6 pares de venas laterales rectas o ligeramente excurvas, hundidas en la haz y prominentes en el envés, con pelos porrecto-estrellados 0.5-0.7 mm long., ángulo de divergencia 20-25°, ramificadas cerca del borde; venas terciarias prominentes en el envés; venación menor poco conspicua en el envés. Flores axilares, solitarias, heterostilas (sólo observé plantas brevistilas). Pedúnculo cilindrico, 6-10 mm long., indumento como el del tallo. Profilos altemos en la porción apical del pedúnculo, subulados, 0.5 mm long., distantes hasta 3 mm del ápice. Pedicelo 2-5 mm long., cilindrico, ligeramente más oscuro y con indumento más denso que el del pedúnculo. Cáliz 8-10 mm long.; tubo calicino 2 mm long., por dentro piloso, por fuera tomentoso, con pelos estrellados y algunos glandulares, pelos porrecto-estrellados especialmente sobre las venas; lóbulos angustiovados o triangulares, 7-nervados, los internos con bandas de pelos más o menos adpresos y ordenadamente dispuestos a cada lado de la vena media y con pelos cortos casi hasta los bordes membranáceos, ésto bien visible en los alabastros, mucrón 0.5 mm long., grueso. Corola 7-8 mm más larga que el cáliz; pétalos con uña pilosa; lámina 14-15 mm long. Corona color crema en seco, lóbulos unidos a los pétalos 1.5 mm long., laciniados, lóbulos unidos a los sépalos poco más cortos. Filamentos estaminales subulados, glabros, soldados 0.5 mm en la base al tubo calicino, 6.5-7 mm long, en flores brevistilas; anteras angustiovadas, 1.3-1.5 x 0.5 mm, base emarginada, ápice obtuso recurvado a la dehiscencia. Ovario hirsuto, ovoide, 1.5-2 mm long., placentas ca. 10-ovuladas; estilos cilindricos, 1.6-2.2 mm long, en flores brevistilas, pilosos en la base, con pelos cortos simples situados sobre el lado externo, a veces brevemente bifurcados en el ápice; estigma 0.5-0.7 mm long., amarillo, ca. 12 ramas. Frutos 5-6 mm diám., amarillo-verdosos, tuberculados, con pelos simples de diferente longitud y escasos pelos glandulares, cara interna ligeramente reticulada, glabra, vena placentaria prominente en la parte basal. Semillas obovoides, 2-2.2 x 0.8-0.9 mm, recta o ligeramente curvada, lado rafeal ligeramente convexo o cóncavo; exóstoma hemisférico breve; rafe linear; cálaza redondeada no prominente; episperma pilosiúsculo, reticulado, aréolas transrectangulares o hexagonales; arilo angosto, unilateral, más corto que la semilla.

description: Plant caulescent, branching. Leaves in terminal rosettes, 15-25 cm long, sparsely vestite beneath and at base above with minute white hairs, the white or red bases of the inner leaves and bracts forming a large colored area about the inflorescence; sheaths small, broadly ovate, brown; blades linear, long-attenuate, 8-11 mm wide, subdensely serrate with slender pale spines 0.5-1.5 mm long. Scape short, naked. Inflorescence subhemispherical, 15-25 mm in diameter, bipinnate, many-flowered; outer bracts subfoliaceous, forming an involucre about the inflorescence and much exceeding it. Floral bracts ovate, acute, 7-8 mm long, entire, lepidote at apex; pedicels short, broad. Sepals free, lanceolate, acute, 9 mm long, inflexed and lepidote at apex, the posterior ones narrowly alate-carinate; petals yellow; ovary superior.

description: Plant short-caulescent; stem simple. Leaves rosulate at the end of the stem, ca. 8 cm long; blades ligulate, short-acuminate, 10-14 mm wide, subconcolorous, sparsely pale-lepidote on both sides, densely serrate with minute curved spines, those of the lower half recurved. Inflorescence sessile, capitate, 5 mm in diameter, rather few-flowered, apparently simple or depauperately compound. Floral bracts oblong, broadly acute, shorter than the sepals, carinate with decurrent base, membranaceous, obscurely lepidote at apex; flowers sessile. Sepals cochlear-imbricate, free, linear, broadly acute and subcucullate, 11 mm long, 2 mm wide, membranaceous, obscurely lepidote at apex, the posterior narrowly carinate; petals and stamens imperfectly known; ovary superior.

description: Plants forming a dense sheet, flowering 3-5 cm high. Leaves 15-20, rosulate at the apex of a very short caudex, 3 cm long; sheaths much broader than the blades; blades linear, acuminate, 3 mm wide, pungent, entire, subcoriaceous, glaucescent above, minutely lepidote, the margins often revolute. Scapes 1-2, very short, vestite like the inflorescence with multicellular furfuraceous-papilliform unequal spreading flexuous flavous-brown trichomes; scape-bracts lanceolate, 3.5 mm long. Inflorescence simple, racemose, the rhachis not over 1 cm long. Floral bracts ovate or lance-ovate, acute, 3 mm long, 2 mm wide, dilated at base and subamplexicaul, white-margined; pedicels ascending, 4-7 mm long. Sepals free, lanceolate, green and notably thickened toward the cucullate-acuminate apex, 3.5 mm long, 1.2 mm wide, plicate-navicular and white-margined toward base, its trichomes tuberculate-thickened at base; petals included, narrowly lance-elliptic, scarcely 3 mm long and 1 mm wide, acuminate, flexuous-recurved at apex, white; stamens included, short-adnate to the tepals, the filaments 1.5 mm long, the anthers 0.8 mm long; pistil 3.2 mm long; ovary superior, slenderly lance-conic, tapering into the style and stigma; ovules elliptic-oblong, naked. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, 5-6 mm long.

description: Plant caulescent; stem erect, simple, 10-19 cm high, 1 cm in diameter including the covering of old leaf-remnants. Leaves (living) terminal, strict, to 22 cm long, glabrous; sheaths ovate, 2 cm long, nerved, brown; blades linear, attenuate, 3 mm wide, obscurely serrulate at base, involute, white toward base but not contracted. Inflorescences terminal and pseudolateral, sessile, simple, slenderly ellipsoid, 23 mm long, glabrous. Floral bracts elliptic, about equaling the sepals, entire, subulate-thickened at apex, thin elsewhere. Sepals linear, acute, 12 mm long, the posterior ones connate, narrowly alate-carinate; petals white; ovary superior.

description: Plant caulescent, branching. Leaves very many, to 9 cm long, barbellate in the axils of the lower spines, otherwise glabrous, the inner leaves not distinctively colored; sheaths broadly ovate, 10 mm wide, entire, red-brown; blades linear, attenuate, 2.5 mm wide, not narrowed toward base, stiff, subpungent, even above, obscurely nerved beneath, finely spinulose-serrate throughout. Inflorescence terminal, sessile, simple, narrowly ellipsoid, 20 mm long, 6 mm in diameter, nearly glabrous. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, exceeding the sepals, carinate, thin, red-brown, the lowest serrulate near apex. Sepals free, sublinear, cucullate, 10 mm long, the posterior ones narrowly alate-carinate; ovary superior.

description: Plant caulescent for 1 m, flowering shoot 5 m high. Leaves over 1.5 m long, sheaths scarcely distinct, broadly ovate, 11 cm wide, entire, pale brown, appressed-lepidote beneath; blades linear, attenuate, glabrous, slightly contracted above the base, the extreme base subdensely serrate with dark uncinate spines 3 mm long, elsewhere entire. Scape 3 cm or more in diameter; scape-bracts erect, foliaceous, densely imbricate. Inflorescence very laxly 4-pinnate; primary bracts narrowly triangular, shorter than the naked sterile bases of the branches; branches to 53 cm long; spikes subdense, many-flowered, to 26 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, the lowest about equaling the sepals; flowers spreading, subsessile. Sepals free, cochlear-imbricate, broadly ovate, obtuse, 3.5 mm long, the posterior ones carinate; petals 6 mm long; stamens included; ovary superior, stout, ovoid, style elongate.

description: Plant nearly stemless. Leaves many; blades linear, slightly contracted toward base, acuminate, 3 dm long, 2 cm wide, bearing a pale median band and base, elsewhere green, densely and minutely serrulate, barbellate between the lower teeth, elsewhere glabrous. Inflorescence terminal, sessile, 3 cm in diameter, digitately compound from a few densely ellipsoid spikes; outer bracts foliaceous but greatly reduced. Floral bracts suborbicular, apiculate, distinctly shorter than the sepals, sparsely appressed-lepidote toward apex. Sepals free, narrowly triangular-ovate, 7 mm long, 2 mm wide, minutely cucullate and bearing a few linear scales at apex, the posterior ones narrowly alate-carinate; ovary superior. Seeds suborbicular, naked, reticulate.

description: Plant caulescent, stems 3-6 dm long. Leaves densely many-ranked, rigid; sheaths small, pale brown, sparsely fine-lepidote, subscarious; blades narrowly triangular, 5 cm long, 4.5 mm wide, green with a dark brown margin, densely and minutely denticulate, glabrous above, minutely appressed-lepidote beneath, soon glabrous. Inflorescence densely capituliform, immersed in the center of the terminal leaf-rosette, 1 cm in diameter. Floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, acute, 12 mm long, membranaceous, pale brown, minutely brown-lepidote at apex; flowers with short stout pedicels. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, acute, almost exactly like the floral bracts, 10-11 mm long, sparsely and finely brown-lepidote at apex, the two lateral ones strongly conduplicate and enclosing the nearly flat abaxial sepal; petals yellow, to 18 mm long, connate into a tube below, blade obovate; style and stamens included.

description: Plant with very short stems, solitary or in clusters of 6 or 7. Leaves 9-14 cm long; sheaths scarcely broader than the blades, concealed; blades linear-oblong, acute or acuminate, 15 mm wide, glabrous and green above, densely white-lanate beneath, nerved when dry, very densely serrulate except near apex. Scape 3 cm long, glabrous. Inflorescence 35 mm in diameter, glabrous except for the slightly flocculose outer bracts. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, about equaling the sepals, entire, pungent; flowers subsessile. Sepals oblong, acute, 5.5 mm long, connate for 1.5 mm; petals white when dry, blades lanceolate, 9 mm long, strongly inflexed at apex.

description: Plant low, stem simple, erect or ascending, over 25 cm long, covered with the remains of old leaf-bases. Leaves (living) several in a terminal rosette, spreading, 20 cm long, brittle; sheaths broadly ovate, short, entire; blades ligulate, attenuate, pungent, slightly contracted at base, to 18 mm wide, densely red-serrulate, white-barbellate in the axils of the spines, elsewhere glabrous, above toward the base marked with a white median line. Scape slender, 1 cm long. Inflorescence simple, subglobose, few-flowered. Floral bracts (outer) subfoliaceous, much exceeding the flowers, the inner acute, entire, glabrous, about equaling the sepals. Sepals free, lanceolate, obtuse and cucullate, 20 mm long, orange, the posterior narrowly alate-carinate; petals pale yellow.

description: Short-caulescent; stem not over 10 cm long, 8 mm in diameter. Leaves multiseriate, persistent, wholly covering the stem; sheaths broadly obovate, 12 mm long, thin, nerved, subdensely serrulate at apex; blades linear, acuminate, pungent, 8 cm long, 2-3 mm wide, laxly and minutely serrulate, coriaceous, green, at first very laxly white-flocculose at base, glabrous and lustrous with age. Inflorescence densely capituliform, sessile. Floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, about equaling the sepals, minutely serrulate at apex; flowers sessile. Sepals free, linear-lanceolate, long-acuminate, ca 12 mm long, thin, glabrous, the lateral ones carinate; petals yellow, ca 25 mm long.

description: Plant stemless or with short simple erect stem. Leaves about 20, rosulate; sheaths small, inconspicuous; blades spreading, linear, caudate-attenuate, slightly contracted toward the base, to 38 cm long, 17-30 mm wide, flat, green, covered on both sides with white appressed scales but soon glabrous above, laxly serrate with spreading nearly straight 2 mm long spines. Inflorescence central, sessile, simple, few-many-flowered, densely capitate; outer bracts few, subfoliaceous, reddish. Floral bracts very narrowly triangular, long-attenuate, ca 25 mm long, much exceeded by the sepals, entire, membranaceous, reddish, white-lepidote; pedicels stout, 5 mm long. Sepals very narrowly triangular, 35-40 mm long, ecarinate, thin; petals yellow with rose apex; ovary partly or wholly inferior; capsule thick-ovoid, 8 mm long.

description: Plant caulescent, often decumbent or forming cushions; stem simple or few-branched, 3-15 dm long, ca 7 mm in diameter, the apical 3 dm densely covered with leaves, elsewhere denuded. Leaves (young) sparsely arachnoid with septate hairs; sheaths erect, broadly ovate, 1 cm long, white when dry; blades recurved, narrowly triangular, attenuate, 6 cm long, 9 mm wide, rigid, pungent, green throughout, subdensely serrate with dark slender antrorse spines 1.5 mm long. Inflorescences sessile, soon becoming pseudo-axillary by the growth of sympodial branches, densely globose, few-flowered. Floral bracts subfoliaceous, exceeding the flowers, flowers subsessile. Sepals cochlear-imbricate, acute, 9 mm long, the posterior ones narrowly alate-carinate; petals yellow; ovary more than 1/3 inferior. Seeds naked.

description: Plant caulescent; stem erect, simple, to 12 cm high, 7 mm in diameter, covered with old leaf-sheaths. Leaves (young) terminal, subpetiolate, to 3 dm long, entire except for the obscurely serrulate apex; sheaths triangular, 3-4 cm long, reddish when dry, villous-lepidote along the margin; blades linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 10 mm wide, the margins slightly thickened. Inflorescence sessile in the center of the leaves, ellipsoid, 20 mm long, 6 mm in diameter, apparently simple. Floral bracts elliptic, ca 15 mm long, exceeding the sepals, rather thin, slightly thickened and reddish at apex, sparsely lepidote, entire, even. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 12 mm long, thin, ½ connate; petals white, reflexed and exposing the stamens; ovary superior.

description: Plant stemless or short-caulescent; stem to 10 cm long, few-branched, 5 mm in diameter, soon naked. Leaves many, very densely aggregated at the apex of the stem, to 6 cm long, the inner not forming a colored area about the inflorescence; sheaths entire, the lower subtriangular, small, the higher suboblong, ca 1 cm long; blades linear, attenuate, 3.5 mm wide, not contracted at base, strongly nerved and cretaceous beneath, soon glabrous on both sides, subdensely serrulate with minute spines. Inflorescence subsessile, simple, few-flowered, 5 mm in diameter; outer bracts subfoliaceous but greatly reduced. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, acute and mucronulate, 8 mm long, entire, wholly membranaceous, pale brown, sparsely vestite with minute pale linear scales. Sepals oblong, obtuse and cucullate, 7 mm long, the posterior narrowly alate-carinate; petals white; stamens included; ovary superior.

description: Subshrubs 1 m tall, the stems evenly covered with minute recurved hairs, sometimes also with scattered setae 1.5-3 mm long. Leaf blades lance-ovate, mostly 4-8 x 1.5-3 cm, basally rounded or subcordate, coarsely serrate, acute or acuminate, sparsely and obscurely pubescent; petioles 1-5 cm long; stipules subulate or filiform, 3-5 mm long. Flowers solitary or paired in the leaf axils, sometimes in a terminal panicle, the pedicels 2-4.5 cm long, slender, articulated 4-10 mm below the flower, minutely pubescent, sometimes setose distally; involucellar bracts 6-8, linear-lanceolate, 7-9 x 1 mm or less, ciliate; calyx 4—5(-7) mm long, ciliate; corolla 4-7 mm long, white. Fruits 5-6 mm diam., oblate, glabrous, smooth, the mericarps 3 mm high; seeds 2 mm long, not striate, minutely pubescent, the hairs slightly curled.

description: Shrubs or trees 2-4 m tall, the stems sparsely and obscurely lepidote to glabrate. Leaf blades broadly elliptic, mostly 6-14 x 4-9 cm, basally truncate, crenate to subentire, acute to obtuse, penninerved (or 3-nerved from the base), minutely stellate-pubescent (on youngest leaves) to glabrate, sometimes vernicose; petioles 1-2.5 cm long, pubescent on adaxial side; stipules ligulate or spatulate, 8-13 x 1-2 mm. Flowers solitary in the leaf axils, the pedicels 6-12 cm long; involucellar bracts 4-5, ovate, 10-19 x 5-10 mm, more or less undulate-revolute at base, acute, nearly glabrous or sparsely ciliate on margins, sometimes vernicose; calyx 10-12 mm long, externally nearly glabrous and sometimes vernicose, internally densely yellowish-puberulent; corolla tubular, 16-20 mm long, subequal to involucel or exceeding it, rose or yellowish with red center and red venation; genitalia subequal to corolla. Fruits ca. 8 mm diam., 7 mm long, glabrous.

description: Subshrubs or shrubs 0.5-1.5 m tall, the stems green (sometimes reddish), slender, pubescent with stellate and simple hispid hairs (1-2 mm long), minute stellate hairs, and longitudinal lines of recurved hairs. Leaf blades mostly 2-6 cm long, about twice as long as wide, ovate, truncate, irregularly serrate, acute or acuminate, sparsely and variably pubescent, the upper surface with the largest hairs simple (or bifurcate) and 1-1.5 mm long, the lower surface with 3-5-armed stellate hairs; petioles mostly ¼ the length of the blade or less; stipules 4-6 mm long, filiform. Flowers solitary in the leaf axils, the pedicels up to 6 cm long; involucellar bracts 10-15, filiform, 10-15 mm long, prominently hispid-ciliate, more or less arcuate; calyx 4-6 mm long, minutely stellate-pubescent; corolla 1.5-2.5 cm long, yellowish-white, glabrous except ciliate on claw; staminal column 5-6 mm long, glabrous, pallid, the filaments 1.5-2 mm long; styles exceeding the staminal column, connate for most of their length, pallid, glabrous, the stigmas prominently villous. Fruits ca. 6 mm diam., the mericarps reticulate-veined, 3-spined, the spines 1-2 mm long, retrorsely barbed, the mericarp body 3.5 mm long; seeds 2-2.5 mm long. Chromosome number, 2n = 42 (Bates, 1976).
