description: Tree to 20 m high; trunk to 30-40 cm in diameter; crown usually very leafy and round, the terminal branchlets when very young more or less densely ochraceous-villous-pubescent with ascending hairs, these at times very dense with the aspect of a lanate tomentum, often only sparsely pilose and soon glabrous, the internodes quandrangular, slightly compressed and sulcate, 2-5 cm long, lenticellate-tuberculate. Terminal leafy buds densely pubescent-villous outside, ochraceous, with acute ascending trichomes. Stipules geminate, lanceolate, rather thick, acute, 2 mm long, puberulous or glabrous. Leaves opposite, 2-5 (-6)-jugate; axis 5-16(-26) cm long, the petiole subterete, robust, slightly striolate, glabrous, puberulous or densely pubescent with ascending subappressed hairs, 3.5-9.5 cm long, the interjuga angulate, striolate, usually sulcate above, more or less villous or completely glabrous, 1-3 cm long, the stipels geminate, subulate, 1.0-1.5 mm long. Leaflets rigid, coriaceous, rather thick; petiolules sulcate above, thickened near the base, glabrous or pubescent, 4-12 mm long, the terminal 1.0-1.6 cm long; blades usually 6-11 cm long, 2.5-4.0(-l6 × 5.4) cm wide, oblong-elliptic, slightly attenuate, asymmetrically obtuse or rounded at the base, obtuse, obtusely attenuate or rounded at the apex, often abruptly and shortly acuminate, the margin thickened and slightly revolute, conspicuously simply crenate, the crenatures prominent, minutely and inconspicuously mucronate at the apical end; rather dark green, shining, slightly rugulose, glabrous or rarely with very sparse subappressed hairs on the nerves above when very young, the costa impressed, the secondary nerves thin and more or less slightly conspicuous; pale green or pale ochraceous when dry beneath, the main nervation usually villous-pubescent with subappressed or ascending, acute, straight hairs, the surface sparsely pilose, the hairs minute, subappressed or appressed, copious or rare, the costa very prominent, pale, the secondary nerves prominent, parallel, 4-7 mm apart, usually 10-14 on each side, ascending with an angle of divergence 45°-55°, curved near the margin, each ending with a mucro, the tertiary and minor veins anastomosing into a visible, minute, but flat reticulum, the areoles minutely papillose. Cymose-paniculate inflorescences axillary, 5 × 8-10 × 14 cm, copiously branched and multiflorous, the peduncle short, robust, compressed, pubescent or sparsely pilose with subappressed hairs, 2-10 cm long, three-branched, the further divisions dichotomous, spreading and rather intricate although not too crowded, the branchlets angular, compressed to ancipitate, more or less densely villous-pubescent with subappressed or ascendent hairs. Bracteoles subulate, 1-2 mm long, soon deciduous. Pedicels straight, rigid, terete, pubescent, 1.5-4.0 mm long, articulate to short peduncles. Buds 5-angulate, globose, 3.0-3.5 mm in diam. Flowers 5-merous, female or hermaphrodite; calyx about 3.5 mm high, when expanded 7-8 mm in diam, the lobes ovate, acute, rather thick, puberulous or almost subglabrous outside, sparsely sericeous inside, 2.8-3.0 mm long, 1.7-2.2 mm wide; fertile stamens in bisexual flowers with filaments 3.5 mm long, subulate, slender above, thickening below, the lower half with hyaline, spreading, long hairs; fertile anthers ellipsoid, 1.0-1.2 mm long, obtuse; sterile staminodia in female flowers small, the filaments 0.8-1.0 mm long, glabrous, the sterile anthers oblong, about 0.4 mm long; ovaries about 0.8 mm long, ovoid, sericeous, biovulate; style 1 mm long, glabrous; disc sharply lobate, shortly tomentose. All five or most of the follicles usually evolved, globose-ovoid with patulous, thickened apiculum (0.6-1.0 mm), more or less laterally compressed, sericeous, 3.0-3.5 × 3.5-4.0 mm; endocarp about 3.0 × 2.8, 3.0 × 3.0 mm, subglobose-ellipsoid, with acute, apiculate angle at the insertion point, U-shaped when dry and open. See solitary, reddish-brown, shining, ellipsoid with an apiculate end, the other end obtuse, 2.0 × 2.5 mm.

description: Arbor usque ad 10 m alta. Rami terminales striato-sulcati, leviter compressi, dense fulvo-tomentosis, valde novelli et gemmae crasse fulvo-tomentosi, subvelutini, pilis longis (ad 1 mm) gracilibus, acutis, patulis; internodiis 3-9 cm longis. Stipulae lineari-subulatae, crassiusculae, dense tomentosae, 6-7 mm longae, medialibus brevioribus, circa 3	mm longis. Folia opposita, imparipinnata, 1-2-juga terminalia trifoliata in specimine unico, axi robusto, 19 cm longo (in trifoliolata 6.5 cm longo), striato, supra paulo sulcate, dense crasseque fulvo-tomentoso, interjugis circa 5 cm longis, petiolo 6.5-13.0 cm longo plus minusve basim versus incrassato; stipellae arcuatae, tomentosae circa 2 mm longae. Foliola 11-18 cm longa, 5-7 cm lata coriacea sessilia vel subsessilia, sed terminale 0.8-10.0 mm longe petiolulata; lamina ovata vel oblongo-ovata basi obtuse cuneata asymmetricaque sed terminalis symmetrica, apice attenuata acutaque, margine plana remote leviterque serrulata, mucronibus callosis ad 1 mm longis minutis acutis ascendentibus 8-13 mm inter se distantibus; supra juvenilis tomentosa adulta viridis nervo medio impresso tomentoso excepto glabra, nervis secundariis filiformibus impressis, reliquis inconspicuis; subtus dense fulvovel ochraceo-tomentosa, indumento pilis longis gracilibus flexibilibus (ad 1 mm) patulis ad nervos principales denso ad ceteros moderate copioso, costa crassa elevataque, nervis secundariis 13-16 utroque latere prominentibus parallelis semiascendentibus angulo 60°-65° divergentibus, 7-10 mm inter se distantibus prope marginem paulo arcuatis et in dentem mucronatum terminantibus, nervis tertiis transver-sis parallelis prominentibus rubescentibus, nervulis minoribus in reticulum prominulum gracilem rubescentem valde conspicuum anastomosantibus. Paniculae axillares 10-12 cm longae lataeque, pedunculo robusto striato dense fulvo-tomentoso 4-5 cm longo, trifur-cato, ramis crassiusculis striolatis bifurcato-ramulosis dense hirsuto-tomentosis, ramusculis ultimis brevibus flores breviter pedicellatos vel sessiles subglomeratos ferentibus. Bracteae quam flores longiores usque ad 5 mm longae bracteolae 1.0-2.5 mm longae. Pedicelli 0-3 mm longi, tomentelli. Flores stricte pentameri, alabastro globoso 2 mm diametro; calyx 2.0-2.2 mm longus expansus 6.3-6.5 mm diametro, lobis ovato-triangularibus 1.5-2.0 mm longis, 1.3-2.0 mm latis, extus villosis pilis longis ascendentibus vel parcis patu-lisque, intus dense sericeis margine minute tomentulosis; staminodia filamento 0.7 mm longo glabro vel basim parcis pilis, antheris oblongis 0.5-0.6 mm longis sterilibus; carpella 5, ovario ovoideo-oblongo 1.0-1.2 mm longo dense hispidulo-hirsuto, stylo crassiusculo 2/3 inferiore hirsutulo \ superiori glabro articulato deciduo; discus hispidulo-tomentosus. Folliculi immaturi 4 × 3 mm ellipsoidei apiculati, exocarpio crassiusculo hirsuto-hispidissimo setis rigidis 1 mm longis, endocarpio elliptico-oblongo, 3 mm longo, cartilagineo tenui (immaturo) monospermo. Semina ellipsoidea compressa circa 2.5 × 1.6 mm (immatura).

description: Tree to 40 m high. Branchlets ochraceous-tomentose or more or less glabrate, in a few varieties glabrous from the first. Stipules geminate or bigeminate, deciduous. Leaves opposite 3-9-jugate; axis 10-35 (-65) cm long, usually bicostate and narrowly canaliculate above, the petiole 4-14 cm long. Leaflets moderately coriaceous or chartaceous, sessile or shortly petiolulate; blades 6.5-17.0 cm long, 1.3-7.0 cm broad, ovate-lanceolate, lanceolate-elliptic, or oblong-elliptic, acute or subacute at the apex, obtuse or attenuate at the base, doubly serrate or crenulate, or occasionally simply indented, the teeth mucronulate; glabrous or more or less pubescent above; more or less densely hirtellous-tomentose beneath, the costa and secondary nerves (10-17 on each side) prominent, the venular reticulum more or less prominent, more or less dense or loose. Inflorescence 3-20 cm long, usually densiflorous, the peduncle 2-8 cm long, tomentose or glabrescent. Branchlets divaricately dichotomous, angulate or striate, tomentose or densely hirtellous. Pedicels 1-3 mm long, shortly pedunculate. Flowers usually unisexual, tetramerous or pentamerous, rarely hexamerous. Expanded calyx 4-7 mm in diam, pubescent-tomentulose outside, minutely tomentulose on the margins, rather densely sericeous inside. Fertile stamens 2.5-4.5 mm long, hyaline-pilose in their lower half. Staminodia 1-2 mm long. Carpels as many as the sepals, usually all developing in female flowers. Follicles subglobose or ovoid-ellipsoid, 2-4 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, densely tomentulose and hispid, monospermous. Endocarp cartilagineous, ellipsoid, 2-3 mm long, 1.8-2.0 mm broad, when dry and open, in U-shape. Seed ellipsoid, 2.0-2.5 × 1.2-1.8 mm. Disc densely hirsutous-tomentose.

description: Tree about 10 m tall with dark green, rather crowded crown. Branchlets stout, sub-tetragonal but deeply 6-furrowed, lenticellate-tuberculate, brownish tomentose with dense, mediocre, flexible hairs, the internodes 2-5 cm long, the terminal ones more or less compressed. Stipules geminate or bigeminate, the proxal linear-subulate, 2-3 mm long, the distal less than 1 mm long. Young shoots and buds densely subappressed tomentose with ascending, ochraceous hairs. Leaves opposite, 2-5-jugate; axis robust, striolate, rather flat and narrowly sulcate above, densely tomentose with subpatulous, flexible or subflexuose mediocre hairs, the inter juga 1.5-4.5 cm long, the petiole robust, 2.5-7.5 cm long; stipels triangular-subulate, tomentose, 2.5-3.5 mm long. Leaflets rigid coriaceous; petiolules thick, 3-8 mm long, sulcate above, tomentose; blades 7.5-19.0 cm long, 4.0-9.5 cm wide, ovate or oblong ovate, inaequilateral and rounded or obtusely attenuate at the base, attenuate and subacute or subobtuse and also obtuse at the apex, coarsely biserrate-dentate with ascending, obtuse teeth 5-12 mm apart, or also subentire; when young pubescent or puberulous above, with rather long, flexible, ascending fine hairs, soon becoming glabrous, dark yellowish green, lustrous and slightly rugose or undulate above, the midrib and secondary nerves deeply impressed and marked, the tertiary veins more or less impressed and visible; tomentose-ochraceous and strongly nerved beneath, the costa very prominent, striolate and carinate, the secondary nerves strongly prominent, 10-15 on each side, 6-12 mm apart, parallel, subascendent with divergence angle of 50°-60°, curving near the margin, the tertiary nerves also prominent, irregularly transversal, the minor veins forming a rather loose, prominulous reticulum, the indumentum of mediocre, flexible, subpatulous, more or less intricate, sublanuginose hairs above the reticulum, and of dense, ascending, longer hairs on the medial and secondary nerves, the bottom of the areoles densely cinereous-papillose. Inflorescences axillary and subterminal, the panicles long-pedunculate, erect, 8-24 cm long and broad, the peduncle 4-11 cm long, robust, striate, compressed above, ochraceous tomentose, with rather long (up to 1 mm long) flexible, patulous somewhat intricate hairs, the first division trichotomous, the rest usually dichotomous, the branchlets ascending, striate compressed, hirtellous-tomentose, the short terminal ones bearing sessile or subsessile glomerate flowers. Pedicels 0-1.5 mm long, shortly pedunculate. Bracts and bracteoles linear-subulate, hairy, 1-2 mm long. Flowers pentamerous, occasionally hexamerous with only two or three carpels, the buds pentagonal-globose, about 3 mm in diam, lanate-tomentose; calyx about 3 mm long, expanded 8.0-8.5 mm in diam, the lobes ovate-triangular, acute, 2.0-2.5 mm long, 1.8-2.2 mm wide, tomentulose-hirtulous with rather long, flexible, more or less intricate subpatulous hairs outside, sparsely sericeous inside, minutely tomentulose at the margin; stamens in male flowers with filaments 4.0-4.5 mm long, puberulous below, the anthers elliptic-ovoid, subcordate, apiculate, 1.2-1.4 mm long; staminodia in female flowers with glabrous filaments 0.8-1.0 mm long, the anthers oblong-lanceolate, acute, 0.7-0.8 mm long; carpels rudimentary in male flowers, the ovary 0.7 mm long, long-hirsute, the style about 1 mm long, glabrous. In female flowers two to three carpels, usually only one or two developing into a fruit, the biovulate, hirsute ovary about 1 mm long, the style about 2 mm long, strigose towards the base. Follicles monospermous, ovoid, acute at the apex, acuminate, 10-12 mm long, 6-7 mm broad, minutely velvety-tomentose and hispid-hirsute with semipatulous-ascendent straight pungent bristles; the endocarp thick-corneous, hard, elliptic ovoid, acutate at both ends, 9-10 mm long, about 6 mm broad, when dry and open, coracle shaped. Seeds elliptic-oblong, rounded at one end, attenuate at the other, reddish brown, shining, 3.5-3.8 mm long, 2mm broad. Disc tomentose hirsute.

description: Tree 10 m tall; young terminal branches ochraceous crisped-lanate, 6-furrowed. Stipules geminate, densely lanate, 3 mm long, soon caducous. Leaves opposite, 15-35 cm long, 2-4-jugate; axis 14-17 cm long, shortly ochraceous-lanuginous; petiole 4-6.5 cm long, rather thin and rigid, terete, striolate; interjuga 3-5 cm long; stipels geminate, subulate, densely appressed-crisped-lanate, 3-5 mm long. Leaflets opposite, petiolulate, the lateral petiolules (3-)5-10 mm long, the terminal 15-20 mm long; blades moderately thick-coriaceous, rather flexible, elliptic-oblong or lanceolate-elliptic, attenuate and subacute at apex, obtuse or sometimes subacute at asymmetrical base, (7-) 10-15 × 3-6 cm, slightly and minutely simple-denticulate; sparsely and shortly lanuginous when young and soon green above, costa impressed and minutely puberulous, surface glabrous, rugulose, secondary nerves and the minute venular reticulum yellowish, very conspicuous; underside densely and minutely ochraceous-lanuginous, the covering indument not masking the strong nervation, costa very prominent, subterete, striolate, secondary nerves prominent, 22-27 each side (down to 17 in smaller lower leaflets), rather patent, parallel, 3-7 mm distant, ending with a minute callous tooth at the margin, transverse tertiary nerves subparallel, conspicuously prominent, minor veins joining into a very distinctive and prominent minute reticulum of about three levels, the alveoles narrow and deep, not concealed by the short crisped indument. Inflorescences 13-22 cm long; first branching trichotomous, the other apparently dichotomous, the peduncles 8-10 cm long, rather slender, striate, terete or distally more or less compressed, the same for the branches, all ochraceous lanuginous. Flowers pentamerous, glomerate at the top of the distal branchlets, sessile, bracteoles linear, tomentose lanate, 2-5 mm long; flower buds globose, lanuginous, 3 × 3 mm. Male flowers pentamerous; calyx 4 mm long, when expanded 9 mm diam., the five lobes 3 × 2 mm, rather thick, oblong-ovate, acute, tomentose-lanate abaxially, villous-sericeous adaxially, margins minutely papillose-tomentose; stamens ten, filaments 3-3.5 mm long, dilated and abundantly long-villous towards the base, anthers elliptic, cordate at base, 1.2-1.3 mm long; carpels five, ovary minutely hirsute-hispidulous, style 1.5 mm, disk hirsute-hispid. Female flowers (in fruit) 5-merous; expanded calyx 9 mm diam., lobes triangular, acute, 3 × 2.5-3 mm; staminodia ten, filaments 0.8-1 mm, sterile anthers 0.7 mm long; disk hispid-hirsute. Follicles usually two developed, ovate-oblong, thickly apiculate at apex, 7-8 × 5-6 mm, exocarp densely and minutely tomentose and in addition densely hispid; endocarp corneous monospermous, 6-7 × 4 mm, ovate, attenuate-apiculate at apex, hard, when open rather pot-shaped and somewhat compressed laterally, minutely apiculate at the margin. Seeds 4.5 × 2.5 mm, oblong-ellipsoid, rounded at one end, subacute at the other, brown, shining.

description: Tree to about 15 m. Branchlets obtusely quadrangular, more or less compressed, usually copiously lenticellate-tuberculate, strongly nodose, the internodes 2-4 cm long, the terminal ones compressed, densely fulvo-hirsuto-tomentose; young shoots and buds fulvous or ferruginous densely hirsute-tomentose and rather velutinous. Stipules geminate, oblong-triangular, tomentose, about 2 mm long. Leaves opposite, 3-5-jugate; axis 7-12 cm long, rather thick, densely fulvo-tomentose or velvety, more or less glabrate, striolate, sulcate above, often lenticellate-tuberculate, the interjuga 1.2 to 2.2 cm long, the petiole robust, thickened at the base, 2.5-4.0 cm long; stipels unguiculate, very acute, 1.0-1.5 mm long. Leaflets rigid-coriaceous, yellowish-green above, ochraceous beneath; petiolules 2-5 mm long, robust, sulcate above; blades 4-9 cm long, 2.2-4.0 cm wide, oblong-ovate or elliptic ovate, oblong, asymmetrically rounded or subcordate at the base, attenuate, acute or shortly acuminate at the apex, dentate-serrate and revolute, the indentation simple or double; strongly rugose-bullate, glabrous and lustrous above, the nervation deeply impressed; ochraceous-tomentose beneath, with a moderately dense indumentum of long, patulous or subpatulous, fine hairs, the costa very prominent, angular, striolate, the 12-15 pairs of prominent, secondary nerves ascendent, the angle of divergence 55°-65°,’ curving and anastomosing near the margin, the tertiary nerves transverse and with the small reticulum of minor veins strongly prominent and conspicuous throughout the indumentum. Panicles axillary, long-pedunculate, 12-22 cm long, 8-18 cm broad, the peduncle 6-11 cm long, striate, compressed, tomentose, often glabrate, the first division trichotomous, the rest dichotomous, the ascending branchlets angular, striolate, more or less compressed, densely hirsute-tomentose, the subtending bracts linear, hirsutulous, 2-4 mm long, the ultimate branchlets bearing sessile or subsessile flowers, not crowded. Pedicels 0-0.5 mm long. Bracteoles subulate, 1.0-2.5 mm long. Female flowers pentamerous, rarely tetramerous, the buds subangular-globose, 3.0-3.2 mm in diam; calyx about 3 mm long, when expanded 8-10 mm in diam, the lobes ovate triangular, acute, 2.8-3.0 mm long, 1.6-2.2 mm wide, appressed-puberulous with fine hairs outside, sericeous towards the apex inside and minutely tomentose at the margin; staminodia small, the filaments 0.7-1.0 mm long, thickened and pilose at the base, the sterile anthers oblong, cordate or rounded at the base, acute at the apex, 0.7 mm long; fertile carpels five (rarely four), the ovary about 1 mm long, ovoid, densely hirsutulous-hispid, the style 2.0-2.5 mm long, rather thick, glabrous except at the pilose base. All follicles in a flower developed or only two to four developed, subrotundate, thickly marginate-carinate at the suture, divergent, apiculate, about 5.0 × 4.5-5.0 mm, the apiculum 1.5-2.0 mm long, curvate; exocarp medium sized, densely and minutely tomentose and long-hispidulous, the bristles 0.7-1.0 mm long; endocarp rigidly cartilaginous, ellipsoid, with subacute angle of insertion, obtuse at the opposite stylar point, very slightly or not at all compressed, 4-5 mm long, 3.2-4.5 .mm broad, when dry and open urceolate, pot-shaped with short medial incision. Seeds single, ellipsoid-orbicular, compressed, reddish-lustrous, 2.8-3.0 × 2.0-2.4 mm.

description: Tree to about 6 m tall; terminal branches subterete, densely brown-tomentose with short, intricate, flexuous hairs, the ultimate branchlets more or less compressed, obtusely angulate, the internodes 2-6 cm long. Terminal shoots and buds densely subsericeous, brown-tomentose. Stipules geminate, subulate, acute, about 2.5 mm long. Leaves opposite, 5-9-jugate; axis 10-30 cm long, densely covered with a short, flexous-intricate brown tomentum, the interjuga 2-3 cm long, slightly striate, angulate above, the petiole subterete, striolate, 3.5-6.0 cm long. Stipels geminate, corniculate, callous, 1.0-1.2 mm long. Leaflets coriaceous, rigidulous; petiolules 0.2 mm long; blades 7-16 cm long, 2.0-4.4 cm wide, oblong-lanceolate, asymmetric and subcordate-rounded at the base, attenuate, acute and acuminate at the apex, crenate-serrate, the mucros callous, acute, accumbent, 0.4 mm long, 5-10 mm apart; light yellowish-brownish above, the depressed costa tomentellous, for the rest subglabrous, with very scattered hairs, the secondary nerves and the slightly prominulous, reticular venation conspicuous; ochraceous softly tomentellous beneath, with an indument of fine, patulous, slightly flexuous hairs mainly on the venation, the costa very prominent, angular, striolate, often densely tomentose, the secondary nerves 16-24 on each side, 4-7 mm apart, prominent, subpatulous with angle of divergence 55°-70°, ascendent near the margin and curving, the tertiary nerves prominulous, transverse, anastomosing with the minor veins into a rather lax, slightly prominulous reticulum, the intrareticular surface densely cinereous-papillose. Inflorescences axillary, 6-15 cm long and broad; peduncle 2-6 cm long, more or less compressed, as well as the branchlets, densely subcrisp-tomentose and brown, the branches dichotomous, divaricate, angular, the shorter terminal ones curved, supporting several subglomerate, subsessile flowers. Bracts lanceolate or subulate, 0.5-1.0 mm long, pubescent. Pedicels to 0.4 mm long, thick and tomentose. Male flowers pentamerous; buds subpentagonal-globose, 2.2-2.5 mm in diam; calyx about 3 mm long, when expanded 7 mm in diam, the lobes ovate-triangular, acute, 2.0-2.2 mm long, 1.3-1.7 mm wide, brown-tomentose with short flexuous intricate hairs outside, minutely tomentose at the margin, sericeous inside; stamens ten, fertile, the filaments 3.0-3.5 mm long, flexuous-pilose in the lower half; anthers ovoid-ellipsoid, obtuse, about 1 mm long, exserted; carpels rudimentary, the ovaries sterile, about 0.4 mm long, long-hirsute, the styles about 1 mm long, pilose at the base, hamate at the apex; disc densely long-hirsute.

description: Tree with terminal branchlets obtusely angulate, more or less densely crisp-tomentulose, when older terete, glabrate, brownish, more or less lenticellate, the internodes 1.5-4.0 cm long. Stipules usually geminate, sometimes bigeminate, triangular or subulate 1.0-1.5 mm long, deciduous. Terminal shoots and opening leaves densely ferrugineous lanate. Leaves simple, opposite, rigid coriaceous. Petiole 1.0-1.5 cm long, crisp-tomentose, sulcate above, rounded and rugose beneath, broadened at the base, when older glabrate. Blade 5-10 cm long, 2-4 cm wide, oblong-elliptic, obtuse, rounded or attenuate and subobtuse at the apex, shortly narrowed and obtusely cuneate at the base, slightly serrate-crenate, the indentation simple or double, the callous mucronate teeth very short, often obsolete or lacking and margin entire; when very young sparsely and minutely pilose above, with crisp-tomentose costa, soon glabrous, yellowish green, slightly rugose and lustrous, only the costa very conspicuous, the depressed lateral nerves barely visible; below ochraceous or ferrugineous, densely crisp-tomentose, the costa and the 11-12 pairs of secondary nerves prominent, ascending, the divergence angle 40°-55°, curvate-anastomosate near the margin, the tertiary and smaller nerves strongly reticulate. Cymose panicles axillary, 5-7 cm long, only known in the fruiting stage; peduncle 2-3 cm long, first branches 1.0-1.5 cm long, the rest shorter, all shortly lanuginose-tomentose, the flowers short-pedicellate, glomerate at the end of short branchlets; pedicels thick and tomentose, 0.5-2.0 mm long; bracts subulate, rather thick, tomentose-hirsute, 2-3 mm long. Flowers mainly pentamerous, rarely hexamerous or tetramerous, the calyx thick, expanded 10-12 mm in diam, 4.5-5.0 mm long, the five lobes ovate, acute 3.5-4.2 mm long, 2.0-3.2 mm wide, crisp-tomentose outside and along margins, densely hirsute-velutinous inside; staminodia ten, the filaments 1.8-2.0 mm, rather thick, tapering towards the apex, hirsute near the base, the anthers oblong, about 0.5 mm, sterile; carpels usually five, all developing into fruit, the style about 4 mm long, hirsute toward the base. Follicles subovoid or subrotundate, abruptly apiculate, 5-6 mm long, about 5 mm wide, densely short-tomentose (short, acute hairs) and long-hispid (with 0.8-1.5 mm long bristles), the endocarp rather thick, corny, subglobose compressed, ventrally carinate, hispidous near the opening inside, 4-6 mm long and broad, 3 mm thick, monosperm, when dry and open suburceolar with a slight medial incision, the seeds 2.8-3.0 mm long, 2.0-2.5 mm broad, elliptic, obtuse, reddish black, very shining. Disc densely hispid.

description: Tree with stout terminal branches. Branchlets subtetragonal or triangular costate, striate, lenticellate, in the adult stage glabrous, the internodes 2-6 cm long. Very young shoots pubescent or puberulous with rather rigid, acute, ascendent, appressed or subappressed hairs. Stipules subulate, rather thick, about 2-4 mm long, caducous, often bigeminate with a longer and a shorter one each side. Leaves opposite or ternate, 5-8-jugate; axis robust, striolate, lenticellate, narrowly sulcate and hirsutulous with rigid, ascending hairs at the joints above, the rest glabrous, 20-40 cm long, the inter juga 2-6 cm long, the petiole 7-19 cm long; stipels probably bigeminate, thick, subulate, 2-3 mm long; petiolules 2-5 mm long, the terminal one 10-15 mm; blades rigid, coriaceous 8-19 cm long, 2.4-6.0 cm broad, ovate-oblong, asymmetric and rounded at the base,-attenuate and acute at the apex, distally serrate, the dentations acumbent, callose, acute, 7-14 mm apart; dark green, shining and glabrous above, the midrib and secondary nerves well marked, the yellowish reticulum conspicuous; yellowish brownish beneath, glabrous or with sparse, appressed hairs on the main nervations and with sparse, minute, acute, ascending hairs, the costa very prominent, secondary nerves prominent, 18-23 on each side, 4-11 mm apart, subpatulous, the divergence angle 60-70, ascending near the margin curving, tapering and anastomosing; tertiary and minor veins prominously and minutely reticulate, the slightly depressed areoles minutely griseo-papillose. Male inflorescences axillary 20-26 cm long, the peduncle 9-11 cm long, striate, compressed to ancipitate, glabrous, the branches mostly trifurcate, loose, compressed, striate, glabrous or with very sparse, minute, appressed hairs, the ultimate ones reduced and supporting many glomerate, sessile flowers. Bracts 1.5-2.0 mm long, subulate. Male flowers pentamerous or hexamerous; calyx about 5 mm long, expanded 11-12 mm in diam, the lobes ovate-oblong, acute, carnose, 4.0-4.5 mm long, 3 mm wide, copiously subappressed sericeous inside, subglabrous with sparse minute hairs outside; stamens 10-12, the filaments about 5.5 mm long, thickened towards the base, pubescent at the base; anthers broadly elliptic, apiculate, 2.0-2.5 mm long; carpels five or six rudimentary, the ovaries sterile, 0.5 mm long, hirsute, the styles 1 mm long, glabrous, erect. Disc hirsute. Fruiting inflorescences robust and dense, 13-24 cm long, 10-14 cm broad, the peduncle stout, 4-10 cm long, 5-8 mm broad, striate, compressed to ancipital, glabrcus, the branches trichotomous or dichotomous, angulate, striolate, puberulent, with sparse, short, straight, appressed or subappressed hairs, the ultimate branching very short with many sessile or subsessile, crowded flowers, the thick pedicels up to 2 mm long. Female flowers pentamerous or hexamerous; calyx in fruiting stage about 5 mm high and 12 mm in diam expanded, the lobes 4-5 mm long, 2.0-2.5 mm wide, oblong ovate, acute, sericeous inside, with minutely tomentose margin, subglabrous outside; filaments about 1.5 mm long, thickened near the base, rather glabrous; anthers oblong, acute, 1 mm long, sterile. One to five follicles developed in each flower, oblong-lanciform, attenuate, apiculate, subcorniform, 20-24 mm long, 6-7 mm broad, minutely and shortly tomentose and hispidulous outside, with patulous hairs to 1 mm long, bispermous, the valves of pericarp prominously and very conspicuously discolor-reticulate. Endocarp hard, rigid, smooth, subfusiform, subobtuse at the base, acuminate, very acute at the top, 13-15 mm long, 3.5-4.0 mm broad, when dry and open with a characteristic spathiform shape. Seeds 3.5-4.0 × 2.0 mm, ellipsoid oblong, brownish red, very lustrous. Disc tomentulose-hirsute.

description: Tree about 20 m tall with spreading branches, the terminal subterete, cinereous green, lenticellate, and rather densely pubescent, with ascending, appressed trichomes, substrigose. Stipules two to three on each side of the petiole, subulate, strigose, 6-3 mm long, caducous. Leaves opposite, 2-4-5-jugate, axis 9-24 cm long, the interjuga 4-6 cm long, subterete, very slightly striate and narrowly sulcate above, pubescent with copious, weak, mostly subappressed hairs, the stipels usually bigeminate, aciculate or subcorniculate, 1.5-3.0 mm long; petiole 6-12 cm long, subterete, pubescent, slightly thickened at the base. Leaflets chartaceous, pale greenish; lateral petiolules 5-10 mm long, pubescent, sulcate above, the terminal ones 10-20 mm long; blades 7-15 cm long, 2.5-5.0 cm wide, elliptic-oblong, sublanceolate, asymmetric at the base with one half rounded the other half somewhat decurrent, attenuate and slightly acuminate at the apex, moderately crenate the crenations about 5-8 mm long with minute, acute, apical teeth; light yellowish-green, shining and glabrous above (except for a few hairs on the midrib) the midrib impressed, the secondary nerves noticeable, pale and thin, the minor veins obsolete; greenish-cinereous or pale ochroleucous beneath, pubescent with short, acute, rather rigid, subascendent or subappressed hairs very copious above the nervation, the costa very prominent, subcarinate, the secondary nerves 18-22 pairs, 3-6 mm apart, prominent, parallel, ascending, with an angle of divergence 45°-55°, curving at the margin, ending in a callous minute tooth, the tertiary and quaternary veins prominulously reticulate, the inter-reticular surface strongly papillose, rather cinereous-whitish, contrasting with the more yellowish, pubescent, and sparsely glandulose-punctate venation. Inflorescences axillary, elongate, somewhat shorter than the leaves, with rather long, spreading, loose branching to 30 cm long, the peduncle 8-12 cm long, angulate, compressed, pubescent or puberulous, with ascendent hairs, the branches thin, flexuous, dichotomous, compressed, ancipital, pubescent, and final divisions trichotomous, slender, spreading-pilose. Pedicels pedunculate; bracts linear, pubescent, 0.4-1.0 mm long; peduncles 0.5-2.0 mm long; pedicels 1-2 mm long, pubescent. Buds tetragonous-globose, about 1.8 mm broad, 1.5 mm tall, white, or roseate when dry. Male flowers tetramerous; expanded calyx about 4 mm in diam, the lobes ovate, subacute, about 1.5 mm long, 1.3-1.4 mm wide, with a gland at the sinus, sparsely appressed-pilose outside, densely sericeous inside, minutely tomentulose at the margin; stamens eight, the filaments 1 mm long (in the bud), with a few hairs at the base; anthers thick, ellipsoid, obtuse, 0.8-0.9 mm long; carpels four, rudimentary, about 0.9 mm long, the ovary hyaline-pilose, 0.3 mm long with two rudimentary ovules, the style subulate, almost glabrous, smooth, 0.4-0.5 mm long; disc hirsutulous. Female flowers in fruit also tetramerous; calyx when expanded 5 mm in diameter, the lobes rounded-ovate, 1.8 × 1.8 mm, with a punctiform gland at the sinus; staminodes eight, the filament 1 mm long, glabrous, the anther sterile, oblong, about 0.7 mm long; carpels four, often all developed into fruit; ovary biovulate, ovoid, slightly compressed, sericeous-hirsute, about 1 mm long; style about 2 mm long, the end contorted, the base thickened and minutely sericeous. Follicles 2.5 × 2.5 mm, subglobose, apiculate and slightly compressed, minutely sericeous-tomentose and hispid (the bristles 1 mm long), the style about 2.5 mm long, the base forming appressed-pilose apiculum. Endocarp monospermous, ca 2.3 × 2.3 mm, papyraceous, subglobose with angular insertion point, for the rest smooth, when dry open U-shaped. Seeds subglobose compressed, about 1.7 × 1.3 mm.

description: Lianas, ou árvores, 2.5 - 7 m, glabras; ramos novos mais ou menos achatados, esparso verrucosos ou não lenticelados, secos cinzentos a marrom-escuros, às vezes sulcados longitudinalmente, velhos subcilíndricos a cilíndricos, lenticelados, marrom-avermelhados, esparso fissurados; córtex marrom, marrom-avermelhado, avermelhado ou rosado, aromático. Folhas opostas ou subopostas; estípulas triangulares, inteiras, deixando cicatrizes oblíquas; pecíolos (7-)13-18(-34) mm, secos marrom-escuros, marrons ou acinzentados, minutamente frisados; lâminas (10.1-)7.6-25.6(-46,5) × (3.8-)4.8 -7,5(-14,7) cm, elípticas, base arredondada a cuneada, margem inteira, ápice agudo, raro acuminado, emarginado ou obtuso, coriáceas, ás vezes levemente buladas, levemente conduplicadas, pelo menos na base, secas lustrosas e marrons na face adaxial, marrom-claras na face abaxial, nervuras secas marrons na face adaxial, de cor inconspícua na face abaxial, secundárias promínulas em ambas as faces, ás vezes proeminentes na abaxial, ou impressas em ambas as faces, terciárias obscuras na face adaxial, impressas a obscuras na abaxial. Inflorescências fasciculadas, 1-4 flores, axilares ou ramifloras, freqüentemente com protuberâncias indicando sucessivas florações; brácteas erosas ou denticuladas; pedicelos (7.4-)14-18 (-19.3) mm, rosa alaranjados a esverdeados. Botões florais hemisféricos. Flores (7.1-)10.5-14.5(-18.4) mm diâm na antese, rotáceas; sépalas (1-)2.1-2.7(-3.5) × (1.6-)2.7-3.7(-4,7) mm, transverso elípticas, denticuladas, erosas, carnosas, alaranjadas a verde-amarronzadas; pétalas (5.9-)7.7(-10.1) × 4.9-6.3(-9.1) mm, largo elípticas a subcirculares, deflexas, erosas, escariosas, margem revoluta, papiráceas, amarelas, amareladas de base marrom, brancas, verde-amareladas, verde-amarronzadas, verdes de base laranja ou verdes; disco pulviniforme, 1.35-1.6 × 0.8-1.15 mm, margem externa delgada, ca 0.45 mm, erosa; estames 2.1 -2.4(-3.4) mm, laranja, filetes 1.4 -2.1 mm, anteras (0.4 -)0.6 -0.8(-1.1) × (0.75-)0.9 mm, reniformes a triangulares, 2-loculares, lóculos confluentes por fenda em ângulo de ca 120°, conectivo triangular; ovário ca 1.9 mm diâm, piramidal, estilete obsoleto, estigma pontual, laranja, óvulos por lóculo (5)6. description: Lianas ou árvores, 4-5 m, pubérulas; ramos novos achatados a subcilíndricos, glabros, esparso miúdo lenticelados, secos enegrecidos, velhos cilíndricos ou tetrangulares, lenticelados, enegrecidos a cinzentos; gavinhas presentes. description: Árvores (2-)3-7(-14) m, ou arbustos, 2-8 m, de ramos flexuosos, raro lianas, glabros; ramos novos achatados, lisos, logo miúdo lenticelados, secos marrom-claros ou amarelados, superfície rígida, fissurada em craquelê ou às vezes apenas fissurada, velhos cilíndricos, miúdo lenticelados, fissurados, marrons; córtex vermelho a marrom, interno marrom-claro avermelhado, raspagem reportada como de odor de raiz-forte. Folhas opostas ou subopostas, aromáticas; estípulas triangulares, inteiras; pecíolos (7-)10-12(-21) mm, secos esverdeados, minutamente frisados; lâminas (9-)12.3-27(-33.7) × (2.7-)4.4-9.8(-13.2) cm, elípticas, base cuneada, raro arredondada, margem inteira, ápice agudo, menos comumente acuminado, raro obtuso, cartáceas, secas rugosas em ambas as faces, verde-acinzentadas na face adaxial, marrom-claras ou verdes na face abaxial, nervuras secas de cor inconspícua na face adaxial, marrom-claras na abaxial, secundárias promínulas, terciárias obscuras a promínulas em ambas as faces. Inflorescências fasciculadas, 1-2 flores, axilares ou ramifloras; brácteas fimbriadas; estipetes florais (6-)9-18(-27) mm, articulados no ápice. Botões florais cônicos. Flores (18.3-)21.2-24.3 mm diâm na antese, rotáceas; sépalas (1-)1.8-2.9 × 2.4-4.5 mm, unidas na base em receptáculo de 2.9-4.3 mm diâm, transverso elípticas, ciliadas, mais ou menos carnosas, amareladas, vermelhas, verde-amareladas ou verdes; pétalas (7.8-)8.6-9.7 × (6-)8-9.3 mm, elípticas, deflexas, erosas, carnosas, amarelas, amarelo esverdeadas, laranja-amareladas, verde-amareladas ou verdes, secas mosqueadas por traços marrons; disco pateliforme, 0.5 × (1.6-)1.9-2.4 mm, alaranjado, margem externa delgada, fimbriada, seca amarela; estames 2.1-3.2 mm, filetes 1.5-2.5 mm, anteras 0.5-0.7 × 0.7-0.75 mm, triangulares, amarelas, 2-loculares, lóculos confluentes por fenda em ângulo de ca 120°, conectivo triangular; ovário 1.9-2.2 mm diâm, 3-lobado, cada lobo marcado por elevação, estilete ca 0,85 mm, estigma pontual, óvulos por lóculo 6. description: Known from fragments only. Leaves to 3 dm long; sheaths broadly ovate, about 5 cm long, only slightly broader than the blades, densely serrulate, stramineous, glabrous, even, lustrous; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, 2 cm wide, densely appressed-white-lepidote, soon glabrous above, the teeth uncinate, 5-6 mm long, flavous to dark-castaneous, distant. Scape slender, soon glabrous; scape-bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, the upper ones small, remote. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate or tripinnate, pale-subfloccose-lepidote; primary bracts like the scape-bracts; branches suberect, up to 17 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, about equaling the sepals, nerved, membranaceous, pale-stramineous, broadly hyaline-margined; staminate flowers subsessile. Sepals ovate, acute, 5-6 mm long, membranaceous; petals elliptic, obtuse, 8 mm long, white, sparsely lepidote outside; stamens included. Capsule ovoid, acute, 1 cm long; carpels even.

description: Known from parts of the pistillate plant only. Leaf-blades narrowly triangular, at least 36 cm long, 15 mm wide, pungent, glabrous above, finely pale-lepidote between the nerves beneath, so strongly repand as to appear geniculate, the teeth themselves slender and not over 3 mm long, yellow or brown. Inflorescence cylindric, 36 cm long, 6-7 cm in diameter, quite glabrous in fruit; primary bracts narrowly triangular, attenuate, 25 mm long, subchartaceous; branches simple, erect, not over 1 dm long, densely flowered nearly to the base, 25 mm in diameter in fruit; rhachis stout, subterete, subalate with fine ridges decurrent from the flowers. Floral bracts very broadly ovate, obtuse, 4 mm long, exceeding the pedicels, erose, even, thickened at the base, pale-brown; flowers erect or suberect; pedicels stout, triquetrous, sulcate, articulate with the rhachis, 2 mm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 3.5 mm long, even, pale-brown with a hyaline margin, erose; petals broadly triangular, acute, 4.5 mm long, white; stigmas subsessile. Capsule ovoid, acute, 11 mm long; carpels even; seeds linear, long-caudate at apex.

description: Plant 2 m high. Leaves numerous in a spreading rosette, to 6 dm long, coarsely and densely pale-appressed-lepidote beneath, soon glabrous and shiny above; sheaths large, suborbicular; blades linear-triangular, spine-tipped, 35 mm wide, laxly serrate with dark uncinate spines to 7 mm long. Scape erect, 1 cm or more in diameter, soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect or spreading, lanceolate, linear-laminate or acuminate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate or tripinnate, slenderly pyramidal or subthyrsoid, 10-15 dm long, sparsely pale-floccose at first, soon glabrous; primary bracts narrowly triangular, 2-4 cm long, thin; branches elongate, many-flowered, interrupted; rhachis slender, subterete, even or faintly angled. Floral bracts subdeltoid, acute, entire or serrulate, exceeding the pedicel at anthesis but usually much shorter than the sepals, thin; flowers subverticillate, the staminate spreading, the pistillate strict; pedicels very short, the pistillate elongating beyond the floral bracts in fruit and becoming articulated at base. Staminate sepals elliptic, broadly obtuse, sometimes apiculate, 1.5-2.5 mm long, the pistillate deltoid, acute; petals free, 3-4 mm long, the staminate elliptic, obtuse, the pistillate narrowly deltoid, acuminate; stamens exserted; ovary slightly inferior, glabrous, the stigmas sessile. Capsule ovoid, acute, 5-6 mm long, the carpels even; seed linear, completely encircled by a narrow wing.

description: Plant probably 2 m tall or more. Leaves 35 cm long; sheaths broadly ovate, 4 cm long, denticulate toward apex, pale-brown, lustrous; blades narrowly triangular, 2 cm wide, laxly serrate with uncinate spines 5 mm long, glabrous above, densely pale-appressed-lepidote beneath. Scape slender, glabrous; upper scape-bracts ovate, acuminate, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly pyramidal, 55 cm long, minutely pale-lepidote; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, 25 mm long; branches much divided, up to 16 cm long, compressed near the base; racemes densely spiciform or lax near the base. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, slightly shorter than the sepals, deep-rose with a broad scarious margin; flowers spreading; pedicels very short, obconic. Sepals elliptic, acute, 6 mm long, 1-5-nerved, deep-rose with a broad scarious margin; petals elliptic, obtuse, 9 mm long, connate for 3 mm; stamens included, very unequal; ovary more than half superior.

description: Plant known only from very scant pistillate material but evidently large. Leaves over 3 dm long; blades linear-triangular, 3 cm wide, armed with uncinate teeth 4 mm long and 10-15 mm apart. Inflorescence bipinnate, large; racemes short-stipitate, cylindric, laxly many-flowered, to 15 cm long. Floral bracts broadly deltoid, acuminate, equaling or shorter than the pedicels; flowers spreading; pedicels terete, slender, 4 mm long, articulated with the rhachis, deeply sulcate. Sepals deltoid, filiform-acuminate, thickened at the base, 4 mm long but the point wearing away with age; petals narrowly deltoid, acuminate, 5 mm long; ovary minutely inferior, the style short but distinct. Capsule ovoid, acute, 1 cm long, dark-brown, the carpels coarsely and irregularly reticulate; seeds 5 mm long, linear with a narrow lateral wing which is expanded into a short broad appendage at the apex.

description: Plant slender, 5-6 dm high. Leaves densely rosulate, up to 7 dm long; sheaths large, suborbicular or reniform; blades linear-triangular, 35 mm wide, densely pale-appressed-lepidote below, soon glabrous above, armed with uncinate teeth up to 2 mm long and 1-2 cm apart. Scape short, ascending, 4-6 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts lance-ovate, linear-laminate or acuminate, much exceeding the internodes, chartaceous. Inflorescence densely cylindric, 4-5 dm long, 5-15 cm in diameter, bipinnate except for the barely divided lowest branches, glabrous; primary bracts lance-ovate, acuminate, the lower ones half as long as the axillary branches; racemes laxly few-flowered. Floral bracts lance-oblong, minute, much shorter than the pedicels; flowers spreading; pedicels slender, the staminate up to 3 mm long, the pistillate up to 8 mm long. Sepals broadly triangular, 1.5 mm long; staminate petals oblong, obtuse, 3 mm long, cucullate; pistillate petals broadly triangular, acute, 2 mm long; stamens included; ovary wholly superior, glabrous; style 1 mm long. Capsule ovoid, acute, 1 cm long; seeds linear or oblong, with a narrow wing on 3 sides.

description: Pistillate plant flowering 2.2 m high. Leaves many, rosulate, 1.1 m long; sheaths suborbicular, ca 8 cm long, white-furfuraceous; blades linear-triangular, long-attenuate, pungent, 5 cm wide, green, glabrous above, appressed-pale-lepidote between the nerves beneath, laxly serrate with uncinate red spines 5-6 mm long. Scape central, 2 cm in diameter, sparsely white-flocculose, soon glabrous; lower scape-bracts subfoliaceous with bright red blades, the upper narrowly ovate, entire, slightly exceeding the internodes but covering little of the scape. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, to 7 dm long, soon glabrous; primary bracts narrowly ovate, acuminate, much shorter than the axillary branches; lateral branches divergent, to 9 cm long, subdense; rhachis stout. Floral bracts ovate, acute, 5 mm long, slightly exceeding the pedicels, denticulate, hyaline at apex; pedicels stout; flowers divergent. Sepals ovate, obtuse, 4 mm long; petals narrowly triangular, 7 mm long; filaments lacking; style almost none. Capsule slenderly ovoid, acute, 14 mm long, acutely three-angled, dark, glabrous.

description: Plant known only from pistillate material, flowering over 5 dm high. Leaves numerous, rosulate, 20 cm long; sheaths reniform, 5 cm wide, glabrous and stramineous except for the extreme apex; blades narrowly triangular, abruptly acute and mucronate, 4 cm wide, evidently very thick and fleshy in life, densely cinereous-lepidote becoming partially glabrous above, laxly serrate with uncinate spines 2 mm long. Scape erect, only about 4 mm in diameter; scape-bracts densely imbricate, lanceolate, 6 cm long, entire, subchartaceous when dry, densely lepidote. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate; primary bracts linear, about equaling the branches; racemes sessile, subdense, their slender axes to 35 mm long. Floral bracts linear, attenuate, 7 mm long, membranous; pedicels subspreading, almost filiform, 10 mm long, not articulated. Sepals narrowly triangular, 3 mm long; petals 8 mm long; ovary almost wholly superior. Capsule slenderly ovoid, 15 mm long, thin-walled.

description: Plant relatively small and slender. Leaves few; sheaths suborbicular, ca. 2 cm in diameter, castaneous, densely lepidote at apex, elsewhere glabrous and lustrous; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, thick and fleshy, to 13 cm long, 2 cm wide, densely and closely pale-lepidote on both sides, sinuate-serrate with upwardly curved spines 4 mm long. Scape glabrous, flattened, 4 mm wide at apex; upper scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, broadly ovate with a long linear blade. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, glabrous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, mostly much shorter than the branches; branches divergent, short-stipitate, sublax, the staminate to 55 mm long, the pistillate to 40 mm; staminate rhachis terete, less than 1 mm in diameter, the pistillate flattened at base, 2 mm wide. Floral bracts broadly ovate, convex, about equaling the sepals, erose, white when dry; staminate pedicels 1 mm long, pistillate 2 mm. Sepals like the floral bracts, 2 mm long; staminate petals obovate, rounded, about 4 mm long, equaling the stamens; pistillate petals narrowly triangular, bearing a large callus at base; ovary ovoid, trigonous, glabrous.

description: Plant flowering 2 m high. Leaves 5 dm long; blades very narrowly triangular, 45 mm wide, covered with pale appressed scales but becoming glabrous above, repand-serrate with spreading 3 mm long spines. Scape erect, green; scape-bracts to 16 cm long, reflexed, lepidote beneath, nearly glabrous above. Inflorescence 8 dm long, 6 dm wide, bipinnate from 8 reflexed weak branches; primary bracts very small and inconspicuous; spikes 55 cm long, laxly flowered. Floral bracts narrowly ovate, acuminate, 9 mm long, 2 mm wide, thin, glabrous, much reduced toward the apex of the spike; flowers subsessile. Sepals ovate, mucronate, 3 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, glabrous, reddish when dry; petals 5 mm long, 1 mm wide, whitish. Capsule ellipsoid, subterete, to 1 cm long.

description: Plant flowering about 1 m high, red except the leaves. Leaves to 7 dm long, very narrowly triangular, 8 cm wide, appressed-lepidote throughout, coarsely repand-serrate. Scape elongate; scape-bracts vaginiform, the upper ones about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, ca 7 dm long, 3 dm in diameter, glabrous; primary bracts lanceolate or ovate, acuminate, much exceeding the short sterile bases of the branches, thin; branches spreading, slender, sublaxly flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, much exceeding the 2 mm long pedicel; only the staminate flowers known, spreading. Sepals broadly subelliptic, acute, 4 mm long; petals spatulate, subunguiculate, 7 mm long; stamens barely exceeding the petals; anthers elliptic, 2.5 mm long; remnant of the ovary largely inferior, making the pedicel appear nearly 4 mm long.

description: Plant probably considerably more than 1 m high. Leaves more than 1 m long, densely appressed-lepidote beneath, becoming glabrous above; sheaths elliptic-oblong, 1 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, caudate-attenuate, 3 cm wide at base, densely serrate with teeth not more than 0.5 mm long. Scape unknown. Inflorescence amply and laxly tripinnate, 8 dm long, glabrous at least in age; primary bracts poorly known, probably shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; ultimate branches filiform, elongate, straight. Floral bracts lance-ovate, acute, slightly shorter than the pedicels to slightly exceeding them, thin; staminate flowers spreading, the pistillate reflexed in fruit; staminate pedicels slender, 1 mm long, the pistillate stout, less than 1 mm long. Staminate sepals ovate, obtuse or apiculate, 1.5 mm long, the pistillate deltoid, acute, 1.2 mm long, both much shorter than the petals; stamens included; ovary 3/4 superior. Capsule 5-7 mm long, its upper half both loculicidal and septicidal; seeds few, subcylindric, 2 mm long, not including the long caudate appendages at each end.

description: Known only from parts of the pistillate plant, probably less than 1 m high. Leaves 3 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 3 cm long, much thickened, glabrous; blades narrowly triangular, 2 cm wide, caudate-attenuate, densely serrulate with teeth 0.5 mm long, sparsely lepidote above, densely pale-appressed-lepidote beneath. Scape unknown. Inflorescence very laxly tripinnate, glabrous; primary bracts triangular, acuminate, up to 13 mm long; branches very slender, up to 2 dm long, their sterile bases 3-5 cm long; racemes 3-10 cm long, very laxly flowered. Floral bracts linear-lanceolate, 2 mm long, much shorter than the pedicels, hyaline; flowers spreading, 3 mm long; pedicels very slender, 3-4 mm long. Sepals ovate, obtuse, 1.4 mm long, 1-nerved, subhyaline; petals very broadly elliptic, obtuse, 2.3 mm long, whitish when dry; ovary ovoid, 1.5 mm long, superior, glabrous; style almost none.

description: Plant flowering over 1.7 m high, very slender and graceful. Leaves over 4 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, 4 cm wide, glabrous above, beneath finely nerved and covered with pale appressed scales, laxly armed with pale slender spines 4 mm long. Scape flattened at base, lateral (?), ca 1 cm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts all small and remote, triangular, acuminate, thin, stramineous. Inflorescence very laxly bipinnate, glabrous; primary bracts narrowly triangular, much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading or ascending, very slender, 20 cm long, slightly if at all flexuous, very laxly flowered. Floral bracts ovate, acute, mostly about half as long as the pedicels, thin, greenish rose; pedicels slenderly cylindric, 2-4 mm long; flowers spreading, only the pistillate known. Sepals very broadly ovate, acute, 3 mm long, dark rose with a greenish tinge; petals ovate, acute, 5 mm long, green with roseate tips; ovary glabrous.

description: Plant flowering 45-60 cm high. Leaves over 1 m long, lanate at first; sheaths reniform, 6 cm high, densely lepidote at apex beneath, elsewhere glabrous, dark castaneous, lustrous; blades narrowly triangular, 7 cm wide, covered beneath with appressed cinereous scales, with age glabrous and lustrous above, densely serrate at base, laxly so elsewhere with antrorse curved spines 5 mm long. Scape central, 5-6 mm in diameter, lanate at first; scape-bracts small, about equaling the internodes, ovate with a linear lanate blade. Inflorescence slenderly cylindric; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, about equaling the branches; branches 2 cm long, densely flowered. Floral bracts equaling or exceeding the pedicels but narrow and nearly flat, serrulate; pedicels narrowly obconic, the staminate 2 mm long, the pistillate 2.5 mm. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 1.5 mm long, serrulate; staminate petals obtuse, 4 mm long; stamens included. Capsule ovoid, acute, 9 mm long, castaneous, even, lustrous.

description: Known from very young staminate and very old fruiting plants, flowering 2 m high. Leaves densely rosulate, over 6 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, rigid, 3 cm wide, covered with pale appressed scales on both sides, becoming glabrous above, laxly repand-serrate with curved antrorse spines 3 mm long. Scape (staminate) straight, ca 10 mm in diameter, sparsely pale-lepidote, very soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, exceeding the internodes but so narrow as to expose most of the scape, entire or subentire, the lower linear from a small triangular base, the upper narrowly triangular. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate in both sexes, sparsely pale-lepidote when young; primary bracts (staminate) like the upper scape-bracts, to 17 mm long; branches spreading or subspreading, densely flowered with a short flattened sterile base, the pistillate to 15 cm long. Floral bracts broadly triangular, much shorter than the pistillate pedicels; staminate flowers much too young (ca 1 mm long) to show characters but the anthers already exserted; pistillate flowers with pedicels slenderly cylindric, 3.5 mm long, smooth, basally articulate. Sepals broadly ovate, apiculate, 1.5 mm long; petals triangular, 3.5 mm long, white; ovary wholly superior. Capsule ovoid, 8 mm long, deeply sulcate between the carpels, casta-neous, even, covered at first with appressed white scales.

description: Known only from fragments of the pistillate plant. Leaves (one known) to 8 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 5-6 cm long, stramineous, glabrous toward base, serrate toward apex; blades narrowly triangular, 3 cm wide, glabrous above, covered with fine appressed cinereous scales beneath, subdensely repand-serrate at base with slender curved antrorse spines 3 mm long, more laxly so above. Scape 1 m high (! McVaugh). Inflorescence bipinnate so far as known, lax, sparsely pale-lepidote becoming glabrous; primary bracts lanceolate, caudate-acuminate, to 4 cm long, slightly longer to slightly shorter than the bracteate sterile bases of the branches, densely serrate; branches divergent, 14-24 cm long, straight or slightly curved, ca 3 mm thick, sulcate, laxly subverticillate-flowered, flattened at base. Floral bracts lance-ovate, acuminate, to 9 mm long, about equaling the sepals, strongly convex, minutely denticulate, green toward base and brown toward apex, the margin not contrasting; pedicels spreading, stout, subcylindric, to 4 mm long, subalate, contracted and articulate at base. Pistillate sepals ovate, broadly acute or obtuse, 4 mm long, nearly even, brown with prominent scarious margin; petals ovate, acute, barely exceeding the sepals; ovary wholly superior. Capsule narrowly ovoid, acute, 11 mm long, sharply angled, deeply divided between the carpels; seeds caudate.

description: Plant flowering probably at least 2 m high. Leaves rosulate, 7-8 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, slightly wider than the blade; blades linear-triangular, 3-6 cm wide at the base, glabrous above, covered below with a dense even layer of white scales, the caudate apex entire, elsewhere armed with fine uncinate teeth 3-4 mm long and 5-12 mm apart. Scape slender, glabrous; scape-bracts unknown. Inflorescence amply and densely tripinnate, 1 m long, glabrous; primary bracts lance-triangular, not over 3 cm long, entire or rarely the lowest ones serrulate toward apex; branches up to 3 dm long; secondary bracts narrowly triangular, 5 mm long, membranaceous; racemes 10-15 cm long, laxly flowered. Floral bracts lanceolate or triangular, acuminate, about equaling the pedicels, scarious; pedicels in the staminate plants slender, spreading, 2 mm long, in the pistillate plants stout, reflexed, 1 mm long. Sepals elliptic in the staminate flowers, obtuse, 1.75 mm long; petals elliptic in the staminate flowers, obtuse, 5 mm long, white; stamens shorter than the petals; ovary or its rudiment almost wholly inferior, glabrous. Capsule ellipsoid, 5-8 mm long, glabrous, prominently and irregularly veined, tardily loculicidal; seeds oblong, black-brown, minutely pitted, the wing reduced to two apical tubercles and a single narrow connecting band.

description: Plant stemless, flowering to 18 dm high. Leaves about 40 in a dense spreading rosette, 25-40 cm long; sheaths suborbicular, 6 cm wide; blades linear-triangular, attenuate, pungent, 1-3 cm wide, glabrous above, green, often reddish toward apex, covered beneath with a close layer of fine white or pale brown scales, laxly serrate with coarse uncinate spines to 6 mm long, repand toward base. Scape lateral, erect or ascending, slender, tomentose-lepidote when young, soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, ovate or elliptic, acute, the upper ones longer or shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly compound, 2-5 dm long, densely tomentose-lepidote; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than or equaling the axillary branches, dark brown, thin, soon disintegrating; branches densely capitate to short-cylindric or the staminate plant sometimes bearing secondary branches to 7 cm long in the axils of the original ones. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute or acuminate, 4-6 mm long, exceeded by the sepals, yellow-brown, membranaceous, erose; flowers subsessile. Sepals ovate or elliptic, obtuse or apiculate, 4-4.5 mm long, brown, erose; petals elliptic, obtuse, 5 mm long, white, the staminate connate in tube with filaments, the pistillate free; stamens included; ovary superior, densely tomentose-lepidote, its remnant in the staminate flower largely inferior; stigmas sessile. Capsule ovoid, acute, 5-8 mm long; seeds broadly obovate with a wing across the large end and down one side.

description: Plant large, probably 2 m or more high. Leaves 5-7 dm long; blades linear-triangular, pungent, 3 cm wide, laxly spinose-serrate, repand, glabrous and shiny above, densely pale-appressed-lepidote below when young. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, subpyramidal, at least 7 dm long and 2-3 dm in diameter, glabrous; primary bracts narrowly ovate, acuminate, many times shorter than the axillary branches, chartaceous, soon deciduous; racemes ascending or spreading, short-stipitate, cylindric, densely many-flowered; rhachis strongly flattened throughout. Floral bracts lance-oblong, acute, equaling or shorter than the pedicels, brown, membranaceous; flowers spreading; staminate pedicels obconic, 2 mm long; pistillate pedicels 2 mm long, 1.5 mm in diameter, articulate at base, sharply triquetrous, often with intermediate ridges as well. Staminate sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 1.5 mm long, convex, ecarinate, cucullate; pistillate sepals broadly triangular, acute, 2.5 mm long, carinate; staminate petals broadly elliptic, obtuse or emarginate, 3 mm long, cucullate, pale-yellow; pistillate petals triangular, acuminate, 3 mm long; stamens included; ovary very slightly inferior, more so in the remnant in the staminate flower; stigmas subsessile. Capsule oblong-ellipsoid, triquetrous, 7 mm long; carpels even except for a median ridge; seeds slenderly ellipsoid with a single large triangular wing at the apex.

description: Plant large, probably over 2 m high. Leaves to 4 dm long; blades linear-triangular, spine-tipped, 25 mm wide, densely and finely pale-appressed-lepidote between the nerves below, soon glabrous and shiny above, armed with brown uncinate teeth to 4 mm long and 3 cm apart, entire toward the apex. Inflorescence laxly tripinnate, elongate, subcylindric, 5 dm in diameter, sparsely floccose-lepidote; primary bracts narrowly subtriangular, 4 cm long; spikes cylindric, interrupted, up to 3 dm long; rhachis stout, deeply sulcate. Floral bracts broadly ovate-deltoid, acute, 1-2 mm long, from longer than to shorter than the sepals, serrulate, thin; flowers strict, subsessile. Staminate sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 1.5 mm long; pistillate sepals acute; staminate petals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 2.5 mm long, dark-punctate; pistillate petals deltoid, acute; ovary glabrous, the stigmas sessile. Capsule ovoid, acute, 3“4 mm long, seed oblong, 2 mm long, black, bearing small flattened appendages at both ends.

description: Plant flowering 15 dm high. Leaves over 1 m long; sheaths reniform, 10 cm wide, glabrous except at apex, very dark castaneous and lustrous on both sides; blades narrowly triangular, 7 cm wide, glabrous above, covered with appressed cinereous scales beneath, densely serrate at base, laxly so above with curved antrorse spines 6 mm long. Scape curved and flattened at base and presumably lateral, 11 mm wide at apex; scape-bracts broadly triangular, exposing almost the whole scape but their linear mostly entire blades equaling or exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence (pistillate only) bipinnate except at base, 9 dm long; primary bracts triangular, small and inconspicuous; branches simple except the basal which are 3-parted at base, to 14 cm long, rather evenly and sublaxly flowered, sulcate, flattened at base. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, 4 mm long, much exceeding the stout obconic pedicel. Sepals ovate-oblong, obtuse, 3 mm long, hyaline with a thickened brown base; petals 4 mm long, white. Capsule ovoid, acute, 8 mm long, sharply trigonous, brown, even, sublustrous.

description: Plant known only from fragments, probably 1 m high or more. Leaves 35-40 cm long; blades linear-triangular, subfiliform-attenuate, 2-3 cm wide at base, densely white-scurfy on both sides, becoming glabrous with age, densely serrulate toward the apex, the teeth stout, uncinate, pale, up to 3 mm long and 12 mm apart, coarsely lepidote in the axils. Scape unknown. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate or possibly tripinnate (! Harms), subcylindric, glabrous; axes slender; bracts subtending the racemes broadly ovate, apiculate, 7-15 mm long, thin; racemes suberect or ascending, short-stipitate, dense or lax, 3-7 cm long. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, acute, 3-4 mm long, membranaceous, white; flowers spreading or ascending; pedicels slender, terete, slightly enlarged toward apex, the staminate 6-7 mm long, the pistillate about 3 mm long. Sepals subovate, obtuse, 2.5-3.5 mm long, pale-brown, membranaceous; petals broadly elliptic, obtuse, cucullate, 5 mm long, rose; stamens equaling the petals; filaments free; ovary (or its minute rudiment) almost wholly inferior, trigonous, 5-10 mm long; ovules numerous, fusiform, biacuminate.

description: Only the staminate plant known, to 5 dm high. Leaves 27 cm long; sheaths broadly ovate, 25 mm long, flavous or castaneous, serrulate, glabrous; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, 1-2 cm wide, splashed with bright-rose, densely appressed-white-lepidote but soon becoming glabrous above, the teeth distant, 4 mm long, straight or uncinate, dark-castaneous. Scape slender, strongly compressed, soon glabrous; scape-bracts small, ovate, acute, thin, the upper remote. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 2 dm long, pale-lepidote; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, much shorter than the axillary spikes; spikes suberect, dense or subdense, 2-5 cm long, 1 cm in diameter. Floral bracts suborbicular, apiculate, nearly equaling the sepals, very thin, rose with a broad hyaline margin, erose; flowers suberect, subsessile. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 5 mm long, 3-nerved, broadly hyaline-margined; petals elliptic, obtuse, 8 mm long, pale-lepidote outside, connate for 3 mm; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering about 1 m high. Leaves densely rosulate, 2-4 dm long; sheaths ample; blades linear-triangular, 4 cm wide at the base, glabrous above, covered below with a dense even layer of white appressed scales, armed with fine pale teeth 1-3 mm long and 5-10 mm apart. Scape elongate, terete, glabrous; scape-bracts 7-9 cm long, densely white-lepidote below, red, serrulate, with broadly ovate base and linear elongate contorted blade. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 3-6 dm long, glabrous except for the primary bracts, red; primary bracts ovate, acuminate, many times shorter than the axillary branches; racemes strobilate, many-flowered, 3-8 cm long, sessile or the lower ones with a short much flattened naked base. Floral bracts linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 6-8 mm long, membranaceous; flowers subsessile, but the staminate appearing pedicellate because of the largely inferior ovary remnant. Sepals lance-ovate, acute, 4-5 mm long, red, petals lance-ovate or lance-oblong, acute, 5-6 mm long, white; stamens slightly shorter than the petals; ovary almost wholly inferior. Fruit indehiscent, much enlarged, ellipsoid; seeds bicaudate-appendaged.

description: Known from parts of the staminate plant only, probably about 1 m high. Leaves up to 37 cm long, even and sparsely pale-lepidote above, soon becoming glabrous, beneath closely and prominently nerved and persistently lepidote; sheaths ovate, 4 cm long, brown; blades linear-triangular, pungent, 13 mm wide, laxly armed with uncinate spines up to 2 mm long. Scape terete, 5 mm in diameter, at least 2 dm long, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, linear from a triangular-ovate base, red with prominent hyaline margins, densely pale-lepidote, the upper ones small and remote. Inflorescence lax, glabrous; primary bracts ovate, short-caudate or apiculate, not more than 13 mm long; branches simple, spreading, 7-11 cm long, subdensely flowered nearly to the base; rhachis flattened for its entire length, strongly sulcate. Floral bracts elliptic, broadly acute or obtuse, 2-2.5 mm long, exceeding the pedicels, brownish, membranaceous, erose; flowers spreading; pedicels subcylindric, 1.5 mm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 2 mm long, pale-brown, blackish-punctate, uniformly membranaceous, entire or faintly erose; petals elliptic, obtuse, 4 mm long, white; stamens exserted.

description: Plant flowering about 8 dm high. Leaf-blades sublinear, attenuate, pungent, 25 cm long, 6-7 mm wide, stout, glabrous above, densely white-appressed-lepidote beneath. Scape 7 mm in diameter, terete, white-flocculose, soon glabrous; scape-bracts linear-caudate from a broadly ovate base, much exceeding the internodes but hardly obscuring the scape. Inflorescence slenderly cylindric, sublax, about 5 cm long, white-flocculose, soon glabrous; primary bracts very broadly ovate or suborbicular with an acuminate apex, 3 cm long, usually exceeding the axillary branches and largely concealing them, thin, nerved, serrulate; branches simple, dense, subcapitate. Floral bracts broadly ovate, obtuse or broadly acute, slightly shorter than the sepals, strongly convex, brown, even; pedicels short but distinct, stout, triquetrous. Sepals ovate, obtuse, the staminate 3 mm, the pistillate 4 mm long; petals broadly ovate, obtuse, barely exceeding the sepals, whitish; stamens included. Capsules broadly ovoid, 8 mm long, glabrous, even, dark-castaneous; seeds narrowly alate.

description: Plant flowering 12 dm high. Leaves over 5 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, to 9 cm wide, except at apex entire, brown and lustrous; blades narrowly triangular, 55 mm wide, red, succulent, covered with coarse appressed cinereous scales on both sides, partially glabrous above with age, laxly serrate with antrorse curved spines 2 mm long. Scape (staminate only) flattened at base and presumably lateral, 5 mm in diameter at apex, glabrous; scape-bracts densely imbricate, ovate with long linear subentire lepidote blades. Inflorescence bipinnate, cylindric, glabrous; lower primary bracts like the scape-bracts, the upper much reduced and bladeless; branches to 10 cm long, slender, slightly compressed at base, rather dense with the flowers subverticillate. Floral bracts ovate, apiculate, flat, 4 mm long, shorter than to exceeding the pedicels; pedicels slenderly obconic; staminate flowers (immature) 4 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 2 mm long; pistillate sepals (very old) broadly ovate. Capsule ovoid, acute, 11 mm long, yellow-brown.

description: Leaves barely over 3 dm long; blades glabrous above, densely white-appressed-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with spines up to 3 mm long. Scape soon glabrous. Inflorescence laxly tripinnate, about 4 dm long, many-flowered, sparsely tomentulose; branches scarcely over 1 dm long, bearing about 6 small heads. Floral bracts suborbicular, apiculate, shorter than the sepals, subglabrous; pistillate flowers subsessile, 6 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, acute, 4 mm long, ferrugineous-tomentose; petals elliptic, acute, strongly convex, white, free; ovary densely tomentose-lepidote; stigmas sessile.

description: Plant stemless, to 14 dm high. Leaves up to 100 in a dense spreading rosette, 3-6 dm long, blades linear, pungent, 18 mm wide, densely cinereous-lepidote on both sides; laxly serrate with stout uncinate pale-brown spines up to 7 mm long, subrepand. Scape ascending, 13 mm in diameter at the base, soon glabrous; scape-bracts strict, broadly ovate, acuminate, the upper ones remote. Inflorescence very laxly paniculate with simple or subsimple branches, 20-45 cm long, sparsely white-tomentulose; primary bracts triangular-ovate, acuminate, about half as long as the axillary branches, dark-brown; spikes densely capitate, subglobose or short-cylindric, 2-5 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, nearly equaling the flowers, brown, scarious; flowers of only the pistillate plant known, subsessile. Sepals subelliptic, acute, 4-5 mm long, white-tomentulose; petals elliptic, broadly acute or obtuse, 7 mm long, free, white; staminodes present; ovary ovoid, wholly superior, tomentose; stigmas sessile.

description: Herbs, 4-25 cm high. Rhizome-scales narrowly ovate-triangular, 1.3-6 mm long, 0.4-0.8 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Stems white to purple, branched or not. Leaves broadly ovate, 1.2-2.3 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, apex obtuse. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, each cincinnus at an angle of 90° or more with the other, 0.6-4 cm long and 3-18-flowered. Bracts ovate to broadly ovate, 1.62 mm long, 1.3-1.6 mm wide, the basal ones to 3.6 mm long and 2 mm wide, apex obtuse, sometimes acute, often dark (in herbarium material). Pedicels 0.8-2.5 mm long. Internodes of infructescence (0.8-)l-4(-6) mm long. Flowers white, soon recurved, 7.5-8.4 mm long. Floral tube 4.4-5.4 mm long, slightly ribbed. Outer tepals 3-lobed, 2.1-3.4 mm long, 1-1.4 mm wide; central lobe depressed ovate-triangular, 0.3-0.5 mm long, 1-1.4 mm wide; lateral lobes depressed ovate, 0.3-0.4 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide. Inner tepals ovate, swollen, 0.4-0.6 mm long, 0.3-0.4 mm wide. Connective without appendages. Style, including branches and stigmas, 3.5-3.7 mm long, branches with stigmas 0.5-1 mm long, stigmas horseshoe-shaped, sinus 0.2 mm deep, without appendages. Ovary transversely ellipsoid, 1-1.2 mm x 1.5-2 mm. Capsule ellipsoid to transversely ellipsoid, to 2.7 x 2.4 mm, with six slightly prominent longitudinal ribs, the persistent part of the floral tube including the capsule 3.3-4.8 mm long, the style exceeding the floral tube by 0.3-0.9 mm. Capsule longitudinally dehiscent, the three valves separating from base to apex, each valve split into two narrowly obovate parts cohering at the top; the three remaining ribs of the capsule and the three placentabearing ribs forming a lantern-like structure. Seeds 0.5-0.9 x 0.3-0.6 mm.

description: Herbs, 5-15(-25) cm high. Rhizome-scales subulate to narrowly triangular, 0.53 mm long, 0.2-0.3 mm wide, apex acute. Stems white to pale purple, branched or not. Leaves broadly ovate, 0.6-1.6 mm long, 0.8-1.1 mm wide, apex acute or obtuse. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus (resembling a rhipidium in herbarium material), each cincinnus 0.3-7 cm long and l-4(-7)-flowered. Bracts ovate to narrowly ovate, 0.7-2 mm long, 0.4-0.9 mm wide, apex acute. Pedicels 0.5-2.5 (-3.8) mm long. Flowers white, erect, 5-8 mm long. Floral tube often constricted just below the tepals, 3.3-5 mm long. Outer tepals 3-lobed, to 3 mm long; central lobe broadly ovate-triangular, 0.4-1.2 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide; lateral lobes narrowly to broadly ovate-triangular, 0.2-1.3 mm long, 0.2-0.6 mm wide. Inner tepals narrowly to broadly ovate-triangular, 0.3-0.5 mm long, 0.2-0.3 mm wide, often swollen. Connective without appendages. Style, including branches and stigmas, 2-3.3 mm long, branches to 0.2 mm long, stigmas yellow, horseshoeshaped, 0.4-0.6 mm in diam., appendages to 4 mm long. Ovary obconical to ellipsoid, 1.5-3 x 1-2 mm. Capsule broadly obovoid to globose or very broadly obovoid, to 3.2 x 3.3 mm, the persistent part of the floral tube including the capsule 3.6—6.1 mm long, style exceeding the floral tube by ca. 0.5 mm. Capsule dehiscing longitudinally, the three valves separating from apex to base, each bearing one parietal placenta. Seeds 0.2-0.3 x 0.2 mm.

description: Herbs, 3-7.5 cm high. Rhizome-scales ovate, (only one scale measured) 0.6 mm long, 0.3 mm wide, apex acute. Stems purple to white, branched or not. Leaves narrowly ovate, at an angle of ca. 30° with the stem, (0.7-) 1.1-2 mm long, 0.50.8 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, each cincinnus 0.2-2.5 cm long and 1-4-flowered, or the plant with a solitary terminal flower only. Bracts narrowly ovate, (1.6-)2.3-4 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Pedicels mostly absent, sometimes to 1 mm long. Flowers white, erect, 5.2-8 mm long. Floral tube 4.3-6 mm long. Outer tepals 3-lobed, yellow in bud, white at anthesis, 1.6-2.2 mm long, 3-3.5 mm wide; central lobe broadly ovate-triangular, 0.8-1.4 mm long, 1.1-1.5 mm wide; lateral lobes ovate-triangular to broadly ovate-triangular, 0.8-1.5 mm long, 0.8-1 mm wide. Inner tepals ovate, ca. 0.2 mm long and 0.1 mm wide. Connective with two very small, apical, obovoid swellings at the abaxial side. Style, including branches and stigmas, 2.1-	2.6 mm long, branches 0.1 mm long, stigmas yellow, horseshoe-shaped, 0.4 mm diam., sinus 0.2 mm deep, without appendages. Ovary obconical to broadly obovoid, 1-2 x 0.5-1.4 mm. Capsule broadly obovoid to obovoid, to 3.2 x 3.2 mm, the persistent part of the floral tube including the capsule 3.9-5.3 mm long, style exceeding the floral tube by 0.5 mm at the most. Capsule longitudinally dehiscent, the three valves separating from apex to base, each bearing one parietal placenta. Seeds 0.2-0.3 x 0.1-0.2 mm.

description: Herbs, 10-30 cm high. Rhizome-scales narrowly ovate, 1.8-3.5 mm long, 0.40.6 mm wide, apex acuminate. Stems white to brown, unbranched, sometimes branched just above the ground. Leaves ovate to broadly ovate, 0.9-2.1 mm long, 0.8-1.6 mm wide, margins often involute, apex acute or obtuse. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, each cincinnus at an angle of 90° or less with the other, 1-8 cm long and 3-10-flowered. Bracts creamy, broadly ovate, 0.5-1.2(-l.6) mm long and wide, the basal ones to 2 mm long, apex obtuse or acute. Internodes of infructescence (3-)4-6 mm long. Pedicels 3-5.4(-6.4) mm long. Flowers white to creamy, erect, 5.5-8.8 mm long. Floral tube 4-7.2 mm long, somewhat constricted just below the tepals, with six slightly prominent ribs. Outer tepals 3-lobed, ca. 2 mm long; central lobe broadly ovate-triangular, ca. 0.9 mm long, 0.7-1 mm wide; lateral lobes broadly ovate-triangular, 0.7-0.8 mm long and wide. Inner tepals obovate to broadly obovate, 0.3-0.8 mm long, 0.4-0.6 mm wide. Connective without appendages. Stipes 0.1 mm long. Style, including branches and stigmas, 3.4-4.8 mm long, branches 0.2-0.3 mm long, stigmas yellow, horseshoeshaped, 0.4-0.5 mm diam., sinus 0.3-0.4 mm deep, base of the horseshoe shortly (0.1 mm) bidentate, apical filiform appendages to 1.6 mm long. Ovary transversely ellipsoid, 0.6-1.3 x 1-2 mm. Capsule broadly ovoid, to 2.8 x 2.1 mm, with six slightly prominent longitudinal ribs; the persistent part of the floral tube obliquely abscising or longitudinally split, not constricted above the capsule, persistent part of the floral tube including the capsule 3.4-5.2 mm long, style exceeding the floral tube by 1.3-1.5 mm, often swollen at the top. Seeds 0.2-0.5 mm diam.

description: Plant flowering 1.6-2 m high. Leaves to 8 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 25 cm long, 12 cm wide, densely and minutely appressed-lepidote, castaneous beneath with a narrow pale margin; blades ligulate, broadly subacute and apiculate, 7 cm wide, flat, green, concolorous, glabrous above, obscurely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, 14 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper elliptic, acute. Inflorescence bipinnate, cylindric, 4-5 dm long, sublax except the extreme apex, glabrous, green (! Wurdack), becoming castaneous when dry; axis flexuous; primary bracts orbicular, apiculate, the lowest 5 cm long and covering reduced spikes, the highest about half as long as the spikes; spikes sessile, globose (except the lowest), 5 cm long, many-flowered. Floral bracts straight, ovate, acute, 25 mm or longer, exceeding the sepals, ecarinate, even or slightly rugose in drying; flowers subsessile. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 22 mm long, equally connate for 4 mm, carinate, coriaceous, castaneous when dry; petals yellow, naked, the claws conglutinate into a tube, the blades spreading, lanceolate, acute, 15 mm long; stamens exserted from the throat of the corolla but much shorter than the petals.

description: Plant flowering ca 1 m high. Leaves rosulate, 8-11 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 9 cm long, 6 cm wide, dark brown; blades ligulate, acuminate, 35-50 mm wide, very inconspicuously lepidote. Scape curved, ca 4 mm in diameter; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, erect, densely imbricate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 40-50 cm long, 15-20 cm wide; primary bracts ovate, acuminate, 4-8 cm long, much exceeding the short bracteate bases of the branches; spikes ascending, subdensely ellipsoid, 10-14 cm long, 40-45 mm in diameter, 9-15-flowered. Floral bracts imbricate toward apex of spike, obovate, 35-40 mm long, 15 mm wide, thin, nerved, punctulate dorsally, yellow. Sepals obovate, acute, 20-22 mm long, 5 mm wide, equally connate for 5-7 mm, coriaceous, carinate, glabrous; petals ca 5 cm long, lobes green.

description: Plant stout, flowering 1 m high. Leaves 9 dm long; sheaths narrowly elliptic, densely ferruginous-lepidote; blades ligulate, acuminate, 6 cm wide, coriaceous when dry, subglabrous above, sparsely and minutely furfuraceous beneath. Scape erect, stout, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, elliptic, acuminate, exceeding the internodes but not wholly covering the scape. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, subcylindric, 3 dm long, 45 mm in diameter; axis angled when dry, glabrous; primary bracts suberect, very broadly ovate, abruptly acuminate, exceeding the spikes, scarlet, coriaceous, glabrous, strongly nerved; spikes short-stipitate, thick-ellipsoid, obtuse, 25 mm long, 18 mm in diameter, densely 5-8-flowered. Floral bracts erect or nearly so, broadly elliptic, rounded-emarginate, 10 mm long, much shorter than the sepals, rugulose when dry, coriaceous, glabrous; pedicels short and stout. Sepals 19 mm long, equally connate for 11 mm, the lobes elliptic, asymmetric, obtuse.

description: Plant stemless.
