Scape erect, short; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate, foliaceous, the upper ones roseate. Inflorescence bipinnate, 15 cm long; primary bracts broadly ovate with a subtriangular blade, erect, much exceeding the few-flowered fascicles, roseate with a castaneous base. Floral bracts lanceolate, inflexed at the apex, exceeding the sepals, their apical third pale brown and subchartaceous, elsewhere castaneous and coriaceous; flowers subsessile. Sepals like the floral bracts, 20 mm long, free.

description: Plant stemless, flowering to 9 dm high. Leaves numerous, 5-6 dm long, sparsely and Finely lepidote; sheaths elliptic, large, castaneous toward base; blades ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, flat, ca 25 mm wide, concolorous. Scape erect, slender, red-violet, sparsely pale-lepidote, soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lower subfoliaceous and imbricate, the upper ovate, acuminate, mostly shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence bipinnate, lax, 8-17 cm long, sparsely pale-lepidote; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, all much shorter than the axillary branches but exceeding their naked sterile bases; spikes spreading, ovoid or ellipsoid, 25-40 mm long, dense except at base. Floral bracts broadly ovate, obtuse, much shorter than the sepals, nearly or quite even; flowers subsessile. Sepals free or nearly so, elliptic, obtuse, to 10 mm long, the posterior carinate; petals greenish-yellow, the blades spreading, elliptic, 6 mm long, barely exceeding the stamens.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 5-8 dm or higher. Leaves many in a spreading rosette, 7 dm long, covered with appressed pale brown-centered scales; sheaths distinct, elliptic, brown; blades ligulate, acute, 4-5 cm wide, green, concolorous. Floral bracts elliptic, obtuse, slightly cucullate, 30 mm long, equaling or exceeding the sepals, rather thin, nerved, lepidote; pedicels short, stout. description: Plant spreading by stolons, flowering 3-8 dm high. description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves 12 dm long, very minutely and obscurely lepidote; sheaths inconspicuous; blades linear, acuminate, 25 mm wide, strongly plicate. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, truncate, 18 mm long, slightly but constantly shorter than the sepals, ecarinate, nerved, green, membranaceous; flowers suberect, short-pedicellate. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 17 mm long, carinate, membranaceous, yellow toward apex, the posterior connate for 2 mm, the anterior subfree; petals 25 mm long, pale yellow, blades elliptic, obtuse. description: Plant stemless (?), flowering over 7 dm high. description: Plant flowering 1.4 m high. description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves 50-75 cm long, minutely and obscurely lepidote; sheaths narrowly ovate, indistinct; blades ligulate, acute to rounded and apiculate, 45-50 mm wide. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts ovate, acute, usually remote. Inflorescence lax, bipinnate, 20-56 cm long, glabrous; primary bracts broadly ovate, acute, 2 cm long, much shorter than the sterile 1-3-bracteate bases of the branches; branches ascending, 12-21 cm long, laxly many-flowered. Floral bracts ovate, acute, 6-8 mm long, subcoriaceous, yellow, even to nerved; flowers divergent; pedicels broadly obconic, 3 mm long. description: Plant stemless. Leaves suberect, 5 dm long, exceeding the inflorescence, minutely and obscurely punctulate-lepidote; sheaths large but barely distinct; blades ligulate, 6 cm wide, broadly rounded and retuse-apiculate at apex, pale purple beneath, purple-spotted above, narrowly purple-margined. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, elliptic, apiculate, punctulate-lepidote. Inflorescence simple, densely ellipsoid, 4.5 cm long, 2 cm in diameter, fertile throughout. Floral bracts orbicular, broadly convex, 2 cm in diameter, exceeding the sepals, coriaceous, brown, lustrous, punctulate-lepidote, nerved or nearly even; flowers subsessile. Sepals elliptic, 13 mm long, evenly connate for 5 mm, carinate, coriaceous, sparsely lepidote at apex; petals 23 mm long, flavous, the blades broadly elliptic; stamens and style included.

description: Plant stemless. Leaves about 10 in a funnelform rosette, 4 dm long, exceeding the inflorescence; sheaths broad, distinct; blades ligulate, acute and apiculate, 3 cm wide, obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, curved, slender, largely hidden by the leaves; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, broadly elliptic, caudate to apiculate, membranaceous. Inflorescence simple, densely fusiform, 12 cm long, 3 cm in diameter, many-flowered, sterile toward apex. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, 35 mm long, much exceeding the sepals, obscurely lepidote; pedicels short, obconic. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, cucullate, 17 mm long, connate for 5 mm, membranaceous.

description: Plants aggregated, 1 m high. Leaves densely rosulate, 6 dm long, minutely and very obsucrely lepidote; sheaths elliptic, 10 cm long; blades ligulate, acuminate, 25 mm wide, green above, reddish beneath, green-spotted on both sides. Scape erect or suberect, slender, red, pale-flocculose; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, very densely imbricate. Inflorescence bipinnate, very lax, 32 cm long, pale-flocculose; primary bracts long-acuminate from an ovate base, the lowest about equaling the branches; spikes spreading, distinctly stipitate with one sterile bract, laxly 3-6-flowered. Floral bracts broadly obovate, truncate, 15 mm long, ecarinate, flavous with red stripes, nerved, the broad margin membranaceous, crisped; flowers not secund; pedicels 4 mm long. Sepals narrowly oblong, obtuse, 31 mm long, nerved, equally connate for 2 mm, the margins membranaceous, crisped. Capsule subcylindric, much shorter than the sepals.

description: Plant flowering over 1.5 m tall. Leaves 9-12 dm long; sheaths large, elliptic; blades 9 cm wide, ligulate, acuminate to a strongly thickened pungent apex, minutely appressed-lepidote throughout. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts strict, imbricate, foliaceous. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate; primary bracts narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, pungent, the lowest about equaling the spikes, the upper much shorter; spikes suberect, stipitate for 3 cm, cylindric, subdense, 8 cm long. Floral bracts thin, apparently equaling the sepals or shorter; flowers suberect, subsessile. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, acute, 25 mm long, connate to 6 mm, ecarinate, thin, nerved. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, 28 mm long.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves about 1 m long; blades ligulate, acuminate, to 45 mm wide, green, subglabrous, rigidly coriaceous. Scape stout, exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts foliaceous, strict, densely imbricate. Inflorescence many-flowered, cylindric, laxly bipinnate with branches 35 mm apart but dense at apex, 3-4 dm long, 75 mm in diameter; primary bracts broadly ovate, the lower ones suberect, exceeding the spikes and with a long triangular-acuminate apex, the upper spreading, equaling or shorter than the spikes and apiculate; spikes suberect, densely strobilate, globose to subcylindric, 20-25-flowered, 4-6 cm long, the lower ones very short-stipitate, the upper sessile. Floral bracts very broadly elliptic, broadly rounded and emarginate, exceeding the sepals, strongly convex, rigidly coriaceous, soon glabrous, prominently nerved; flowers short-stipitate. Sepals obtuse, 16-18 mm long, connate for 2-5 mm, coriaceous. Capsule 20 mm long.

description: Plant short-caulescent, 9-11.5 dm high. Leaves about 15, erect, 8-13 dm long, very minutely and obscurely lepidote; sheaths purple, often striped with green above and minutely punctulate-lepidote; blades linear, 2 cm wide, narrowly acuminate, strongly plicate. Scape 8 mm in diameter, erect, soon glabrous; scape-bracts foliaceous, erect, densely imbricate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, composed of 15 spikes, subcylindric, 3 dm long; primary bracts lance-ovate, ample, membranaceous, soon disintegrating, the lower ones much longer than the spikes; spikes stoutly short-stipitate, broadly ovoid, 4-5 cm long, densely 12-15-flowered. Floral bracts imbricate broadly elliptic or ovate, acute, 25	mm long, exceeding the sepals, membranaceous, prominently nerved, subglabrous; flowers subsessile. Sepals free, narrowly lanceolate, acute, 16 mm long, glabrous, sulcate. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, about equaling the sepals.

description: Plant flowering to 2 m high. Leaves 55-90 cm long, densely pale-appressed-lepidote beneath; sheaths broadly ovate, brownish; blades ligulate, acute, 25-70 mm wide, glabrous above. Inflorescence lax, elongate, 3-4-pinnate, dark red except the petals, becoming glabrous; primary bracts ovate, acute, the upper barely exceeding the sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading, 7-12 cm long; floral bracts elliptic, obtuse, 5 mm long, equaling or shorter than the slender pedicels after anthesis, submembranaceous, nerved. Sepals narrowly elliptic, 8 mm long, connate for 3 mm, nerved; petals 15 mm long, white, blades elliptic, obtuse.

description: Plant stemless, 5-6 dm high. Leaves numerous, 25-41 cm long; sheaths elliptic, finely brown-lepidote, red-striped; blades acute, 20-35 mm wide, subglabrous. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts strict, ovate, acute, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple or laxly bipinnate from 2-6 spikes; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, many times shorter than the spikes; spikes subcylindric, 2 cm in diameter, the terminal one 6 cm long and on a long scapelike stipe, the lateral smaller and short-stipitate. Floral bracts erect, ovate, obtuse, 15 mm long, ecarinate, coriaceous with a narrow thin margin, even or nearly so; flowers densely imbricate, at least toward apex, glabrous; pedicels very short. Sepals slightly asymmetric, obtuse, short-connate, exceeding the floral bracts after anthesis; petals white or greenish yellow, 20 mm long.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high (?). Leaves 85 cm long; sheaths long and narrow, densely umbrine-lepidote especially beneath toward the base; blades linear, acuminate, 20 mm wide, rigid when dry, glabrous above, minutely punctulate-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, stout, glabrous; scape-bracts lance-ovate, caudate-acuminate, exceeding the internodes but not wholly covering the scape, glabrous. Floral bracts suberect but not imbricate, very broadly ovate, rounded at apex, convex and enfolding the flower, ecarinate, ca 15 mm long, exceeding the sepals, coriaceous, nerved; flowers sessile, 21 mm long, glabrous, yellow. description: Plant probably stemless, to 6 dm high. Leaves 4 dm long; sheaths ovate, sparsely punctulate-lepidote; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 35 mm wide, glabrous above. description: Stem to 1 m long but only a few millimeters in diameter. Leaves evenly and densely distributed along the stem, about 16 cm long; sheaths subelliptic, imbricate, dark-castaneous, minutely brown-punctulate-lepidote; blades suberect to spreading, very narrowly triangular, acuminate, 4 mm wide, chartaceous, glabrous above, minutely appressed-lepidote below. Inflorescence sessile, shorter or longer than the upper leaves, simple, to 5-flowered, corymbose. Floral bracts erect, ample, broadly ovate, apiculate, 25 mm long, shorter than the sepals, membranaceous, bright red; pedicels slender, 8 mm long. Sepals membranaceous, connate into a slender tube for 15 mm, glabrous, reddish-yellow, the free lobes broadly elliptic, obtuse; petals bright yellow, highly connate, the free lobes elliptic, obtuse; stamens slightly shorter than the petals; filaments adnate to the petals for most of their length; pistil barely exserted. Capsule slenderly clavate, 25 mm long; coma flavescent.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 85 cm high. Leaves 65 cm long, inconspicuously lepidote; sheaths narrowly ovate, inconspicuous; blades linear, acuminate 35 mm wide. description: Plant stemless, flowering to 1 m high. Leaves 20-30 in a spreading rosette, to 11 dm long, arching-decurved, coriaceous; sheaths scarcely distinct, brown toward base, covered with minute castaneous scales; blades linear, acute, pungent, 7 cm wide, evenly marked with fine wavy brown-purple cross-lines, wholly brown-purple beneath when young, becoming green and glabrous. description: Plant stemless, flowering 3-4.35 m high. Leaves 20-30 in a dense rosette, erect to decurved, to 7 dm long, dark green toward apex, reddish brown toward base, crossbanded with bundles of fine irregular dark lines; sheaths elliptic-ovate, densely punctulate-lepidote; blades linear, acute, 7-8 cm wide. description: Plant flowering 1-1.5 m high. description: Plant flowering 1 m high. Leaves over 1 m long; sheaths large, covered with brown appressed scales; blades ligulate, acuminate, 6 cm wide, glabrous above, subdensely lepidote beneath with appressed lacerate brown-centered scales. Scape erect, 1 cm in diameter, glabrous at maturity; scape-bracts broadly ovate with long narrowly triangular blades, erect, exceeding the internodes but not wholly covering the scape. Inflorescence ample, laxly bipinnate, densely brown-lepidote; primary bracts spreading, much shorter than the branches, the lower long-laminate like the scape-bracts; spikes to 13 cm long including the large stipe, laxly few-flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, obtuse, 12 mm long, ecarinate, chartaceous, nearly even; pedicels short, stout; flowers subspreading. description: Plant flowering 65-75 cm high, stemless with close off-shoots. Leaves 4-7 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 15 cm long, covered with tightly appressed brown-centered scales, tinged with purple toward base; blades ligulate, acute with a subulate apex, 2-3 cm wide, dark green, soon glabrous above, very obscurely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper elliptic, acuminate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate from 4-5 spikes; primary bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, shorter than the spikes; spikes densely ellipsoid, short-stipitate, the lateral 5-7 cm long, the terminal 7-10 cm long. Floral bracts densely imbricate broadly elliptic, obtuse, 3 cm long, slightly shorter to slightly longer than the sepals, broadly convex and not at all carinate, nearly even, becoming slightly rugulose when dry; pedicels obconic, very short. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 32 mm long, equally connate for 8 mm, rather thin, nerved; petals 65 mm long, white, the tube much exceeding the sepals, the blades elliptic, obtuse, slightly spreading; stamens shorter than the petals.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 3-8 dm high. Leaves 16-80 cm long, obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath; sheaths large, elliptic; blades ligulate, acute, to 25 mm wide. Scape slender, erect; scape-bracts strict, the lower foliaceous and dense, the upper subtriangular and about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence of a few spikes, densely digitate, or pinnate, 5-9 cm long, glabrous; primary bracts broadly ovate, acute, about equaling the lower spikes; spikes globose or stout-ellipsoid, 3-4 cm long. Floral bracts ovate, acute, longer to shorter than the sepals; pedicels very short and stout. Sepals elliptic, acute, 12-15 mm long, nerved, connate for 3 mm; petals 20 mm long, blades elliptic, obtuse.

description: Plant flowering nearly 1 m high, propagating by stout scaly rhizomes. Leaves to 20 in a dense rosette, erect, coriaceous, 8 dm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, deep castaneous; blades ligulate, acute, 3-4 cm wide, subglabrous, wholly green, 30 mm wide. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts with castaneous base and short acute erect blades, imbricate; inflorescence erect, capitate from about 10 spikes, 65 mm thick; primary bracts broadly ovate, shorter than the spikes, brown; spikes densely strobiliform, very short-stipitate, suberect, stout, 45 mm long. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, equaling or slightly exceeding the sepals, submembranaceous, nerved at least at apex; flowers glabrous; pedicels 3 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 16-22 mm long, short-connate.

description: Plant flowering 4 dm long. Leaves numerous, 8 dm long; sheaths ovate, 3 cm long, dark castaneous with a narrow green margin, sparsely and obscurely lepidote; blades linear, 6 mm wide, green, glabrous or obscurely lepidote. Scape decurved, slender; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, ovate with long foliaceous blades, red, obscurely lepidote. Inflorescence simple, globose, densely many-flowered, 8 cm in diameter, Filled with a jelly-like substance in life. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, obtuse, 30 mm long, exceeded by the sepals, membranaceous, transparent, yellow with a red base; pedicels obconic, 5 mm long. Sepals 37 mm long, exceeding the petals and stamens, membranaceous, transparent, obsucrely lepidote, green, fused into a cylindrical tube 23 mm long, the lobes suborbicular; petals white.

description: Plant reproducing by short erect stolons covered by dark castaneous scales, the rosettes densely aggregated; flowering shoots ca 4 dm high. Leaves 2-3 dm long, subdensely brown-punctulate beneath; sheaths ovate, 5-8 cm long, their basal half dark castaneous; blades linear, attenuate, 10-15 mm wide, green concolorous. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts imbricate, closely enfolding the scape, the lowest subfoliaceous, the others lanceolate, acuminate, chartaceous, nerved, dull, stramineous when dry. Inflorescence simple, ellipsoid or subglobose, 3 cm long, rather few-flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, to 15 mm long, exceeding the sepals, ecarinate, subcoriaceous, even, glabrous, sublustrous, stramineous or pale green when dry; pedicels obconic, stout, 2 mm long. Sepals elliptic, broadly rounded at apex, 11 mm long, connate for 5 mm, coriaceous, glabrous, the posterior ones alate-decurrent on the pedicel; petals highly conglutinated, naked, white, the blades spreading, elliptic, 7 mm long; stamens included.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 35 cm high. Leaves 15-20 in a funnelform rosette, covered on both sides with pale appressed scales; sheaths broadly elliptic, 10 cm long, purple-striped; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 3 cm wide. Scape erect, curved, hidden by the leaves; scape-bracts imbricate, broadly elliptic, apiculate, stramineous when dry, appressed-lepidote especially toward apex. Inflorescence (fruit only) simple, dense, 10 cm long, probably 15-20 mm in diameter at anthesis, polystichous with flowers about 3-ranked. Floral bracts suberect, like the upper scape-bracts, about equaling the sepals, coriaceous, even; pedicels obconic, 3 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, 15 mm long, connate for 5 mm, coriaceous, even, glabrous. Capsule slenderly cylindric, beaked, 35 mm long; coma red-brown.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m (3 ft) high. Leaves to 6 dm long; blades ligulate, acuminate, 5 cm wide, coriaceous, dark green when dry, glabrous above, obscurely appressed-lepidote below. Scape terete, over 1 cm in diameter; scape-bracts foliaceous, suberect, densely imbricate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, subthyrsoid, about 4 dm long and 2 dm in diameter; primary bracts reflexed, very ample, the lower exceeding the axillary branches, the upper equaling them; branches nodding, laxly many-flowered, to 1 dm long. Floral bracts lanceolate, acute, 25-35 mm long, exceeded by the sepals; flowers spreading; pedicels stout, 5 mm long. Sepals narrowly triangular, acuminate, 32 mm long, free, strongly nerved. Capsule subcylindric, shorter than the sepals; coma dark-ferruginous.

description: Plant stemless, 4 dm high. Leaves 12-20 in a dense rosette, 4 dm long, green, often purplish below, very obscurely punctulate-lepidote throughout; sheaths small and inconspicuous, narrower than the blade; blades linear-lanceolate, acute, 4 cm wide, chartaceous when dry. Scape erect, short and largely concealed by the leaves, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, the lower and middle foliaceous or red toward the base, the upper broadly elliptic, apiculate, bright-red with pale margins and greenish apex. Inflorescence simple, ellipsoid, strobilate, fertile throughout, 10-15 cm long, 30-45 mm in diameter, glabrous or subglabrous; axis 8 mm in diameter. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts but broadly acute or obtuse, 4 cm long, 2 cm wide, much exceeding the sepals, subchartaceous, even when fresh, finely striate when dry; flowers subsessile. Sepals elliptic, broadly obtuse, 2 cm long, coriaceous, dark-castaneous especially toward the base, connate for 4 mm; petals barely exserted from the bracts, connate for most of their length, white, the free lobes elliptic, obtuse; stamens 5 mm shorter than the petals, the filaments highly adnate to the petals; ovary slender.

description: Plant flowering ca 1 m high. Leaves ca 1 m long; sheaths large, ample, densely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, acute, pungent, 6-7 cm wide. Scape erect, 16 mm in diameter; scape-bracts imbricate, attenuate, 8-15 cm long. Inflorescence laxly tripinnate, ca 35 cm wide; primary bracts ovate, acuminate, 6-9 cm long; branches 20 cm long, including the 15 mm stipe, 12 cm wide; secondary branches 1-3, 8-10 cm long, spreading to nodding. Floral bracts erect to spreading, ovate-elliptic, obtuse, 24-26 mm long, 11 mm wide, chartaceous, nerved, glabrous outside, lepidote inside; pedicels 6 mm long. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 35-40 mm long, 4 mm wide, mostly ecarinate, thin-coriaceous, nerved, connate to 9 mm; petals 5 cm long, yellow, the blades 7 mm wide; stamens and stigma included.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 15 dm high or higher. Leaves to 6 dm long; sheaths distinct, finely and densely brown-lepidote, purple toward apex, especially above; blades ligulate, acuminate, pungent, 75 mm wide, glabrous above, very minutely punctulate below. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts foliaceous, large, erect, densely imbricate, reddish-purple toward the apex. Inflorescence many-flowered, densely bipinnate, cylindric, 3 dm long and 15 cm in diameter; primary bracts very broadly ovate, triangular-acute, flat, wholly concealing the axis, up to 1 dm long, exceeding the axillary flowers, punctulate-lepidote below, coriaceous; branches almost wholly aborted and the flowers therefore in fascicles. Floral bracts 32 mm long, elliptic, much exceeded by the sepals, membranaceous, striate; flowers erect; pedicels slender, 12-15 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 22-28 mm long, brown with a pale margin when dry, even, glabrous, nearly free; petals linear, obtuse, cucullate, 32 mm long, dark-yellow when dry, connate for nearly half their length. Capsule ellipsoid, beaked, about equaling the sepals; coma flavous.

description: Plant evidently stemless, flowering to 2 m high. Leaves spreading, 8 dm long, obscurely lepidote throughout; sheaths elliptic, 2 dm long; blades ligulate, acute and apiculate, flat, 65 mm wide, dark green above, red-purple beneath. Scape erect, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lower subfoliaceous and imbricate, the upper ovate, acuminate, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence very laxly bipinnate, glabrous; axes red; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, shorter than the long sterile bases of the branches; racemes spreading, laxly few-flowered. Floral bracts obovate, about equaling the pedicels, yellow; pedicels slender, to 13 mm long. Sepals 35 mm long, more than 2/3 connate in a slender tube, the blades broadly obovate, 9 mm long; petals always (?) included.

description: Plant flowering ca 2 m high. Leaves rosulate, 6-8 dm long, minutely appressed-lepidote; sheaths inconspicuous, pale brown; blades ligulate, acuminate, 4-8 cm wide. Scape erect; scape-bracts foliaceous, densely imbricate. Infloresence lax, tripinnate, 4-10 dm long; primary bracts ovate, acuminate, many times shorter than the branches, lepidote, red or yellow; branches divergent to spreading, 8-21 cm long, short-stipitate, few-mostly 3-branched, lax, yellow, glabrous. Floral bracts ovate, obtuse, 7-10 mm long, thin, nerved; flowers suberect to downwardly secund; pedicels stout, 3-4 mm long. Sepals obovate, broadly obtuse, 12 mm long, much exserted, connate for 3 mm, thin, nerved; petals 20 mm long, white or yellow, blades elliptic, obtuse.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 5 dm high. Leaves ca 20 in a funnelform lax rosette, 6 dm long; sheaths distinct, ovate, often elongate, brown, densely punctulate-lepidote on both sides; blades linear, attenuate, to 15 mm wide, chartaceous, green marked with fine regular purple-brown stripes beneath, glabrous above, sparsely pale-lepidote beneath. Scape straight, much shorter than the leaves, rather stout; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate and covering the scape, the lower foliaceous, the upper ovate, acuminate, bright red. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, ellipsoid or subglobose, 6 cm long, 4.5-5 cm in diameter, exceeded by the leaves. Floral bracts very broadly ovate, apiculate, 3-4 cm long, equaling the petals, thick, coriaceous, bright red; flowers subsessile. Sepals ovate, subacute, 15 mm long, connate for 3 mm, microscopically brown-punctulate; petals high-conglutinate in a tube, 32 mm long, the lobes elliptic, rounded, white; stamens included, highly adnate to the petals, anthers sagittate, 6 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 1 m high. Leaves to 65 cm long, minutely appressed-lepidote, becoming glabrous above; sheaths elliptic, nearly concolorous with the blades; blades ligulate, acute, 4-5 cm wide. Scape stout, erect, glabrous; scape-bracts strict, imbricate, ovate, acute, sometimes violet-striped. Inflorescence very densely bipinnate from about 15 spikes, 10 cm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, exceeding the lowest spikes; spikes suberect, sessile, globose, 4 cm long. Floral bracts densely imbricate, ovate, acute, exceeding the sepals, coriaceous, nerved; flowers short-pedicellate. Sepals elliptic, acute, 16 mm long, nearly half connate; petals white, the blades elliptic, obtuse, 10 mm long. Capsule stout, 22 mm long, coma ferruginous.

description: Plant flowering 45 cm high. Leaves subfasiculate, 8 dm long, obscurely punctulate-lepidote; sheaths narrowly ovate, 12 cm long, finely striate except for the dark castaneous base; blades graminiform, 15 mm wide, flat, attenuate, green with broad pale margins beneath. Scape erect, very slender, hidden by the leaves; scape-bracts linear, caudate-acuminate, exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence bipinnate, very lax, 15 cm long, glabrous except for the obscurely lepidote apices of the bracts; lower primary bracts like the scape-bracts, exceeding the branches, the upper ovate, apiculate, about equaling the sterile bases of the branches; branches subspreading, laxly few-flowered, slender, flexuous. Floral bracts ovate, broadly acute, 8-12 mm long, ecarinate, thin, nerved; flowers spreading; pedicels distinct, 6-8 mm long. Sepals spatulate, obtuse, 16 mm long, thin, nerved, unequally short-connate; petals naked; stamens included.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 1.5 m high, robust. Floral bracts elliptic, ample, about equaling the sepals, membranaceous, densely and finely lepidote; pedicels slender, 5 mm long. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 33 mm long, connate for 20 mm; petals 7 cm long.

description: Plant flowering over 8 dm high. Leaves rosulate, large, obscurely and diffusely appressed-lepidote; sheaths broadly elliptic, 25 cm long; blades ligulate, acute or acuminate. Scape straight, very stout; scape-bracts erect and densely imbricate, the upper lanceolate, acuminate with involute apices, green. description: Plant 2 m high (! Dudley), described from only the upper scape and fruiting inflorescence. Leaves rosulate, ca 1 m long (! Sepals lanceolate, obtuse, 17 mm long, short-connate, thin, nerved.

description: Plant flowering over 2 m high. Leaves rosulate, 65-90 cm long; sheath elliptic, 3 dm long, densely brown-lepidote; blade acuminate, 6 cm wide, glabrous. Scape stout; scape-bracts foliaceous, spinose-pungent, much exceeding the internodes, erect. Inflorescence bipinnate, laxly thyrsoid, 5 dm long, 12 cm in diameter; axis minutely furfuraceous; primary bracts acuminate from an ovate base, pungent, much shorter than the branches; branches ascending, 13-23 cm long, lax, many-flowered, the sterile base very short. Floral bracts ovate-elliptic, obtuse, much shorter than the sepals, scarcely or not at all carinate, coriaceous, nerved; pedicels stout, 5-10 mm long. description: Plant stemless, to nearly 6 dm high. Leaves over 10 in a funnelform rosette, straight, 5 am long, castaneous at extreme base, otherwise green and concolorous; sheaths broad, 8-10 cm long; blades ligulate, acuminate, 3 cm wide. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts tightly imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper lanceolate, acuminate. Floral bracts suborbicular, shorter than the sepals, coriaceous, even, dark castaneous, obscurely punctulate; flowers subsessile. description: Plant caulescent, branching, flowering shoot 50-55 cm high. Leaves strict, 2-3 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 10 cm long, densely lepidote on both sides; blades narrowly triangular, 2-4 cm wide, soon glabrous beneath, densely cinereous-lepidote above. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, very densely imbricate, purplish. Floral bracts suborbicular, much shorter than the sepals, membranaceous, sparsely lepidote. description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves densely rosulate, 6 dm long; sheaths elliptic, conspicuous, deep-castaneous at the extreme base; blades ligulate, acuminate, 2 cm wide, glabrous above, very finely brown-punctulate-lepidote beneath, green, concolorous. Scape stout, erect, glabrous; scape-bracts densely imbricate, elongate, foliaceous. Inflorescence many-flowered, tripinnate, thyrsoid, 4-7 cm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, the upper ones much reduced; branches erect to spreading, the lower shorter than the primary bracts, the upper up to 11 cm long, divided into 3 or 4 spikes; spikes laxly about 10-flowered. Floral bracts suberect, not concealing the rhachis, very broadly ovate-elliptic, abruptly acute or obtuse, 12 mm long, 9 mm wide, slightly shorter than the sepals, subcoriaceous, nerved, glabrous. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 8-10 cm long, coriaceous, striate toward the apex, free, the posterior ones carinate; corolla white when dry, 15 mm long. Capsule stout, short-beaked, about 15 mm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering nearly 5 dm high. Leaves 4 dm long, glabrous or minutely punctulate-lepidote below at maturity, longitudinally red-striped toward the base; blades ligulate, acute, 25 mm wide. Scape conspicuous, erect, stout; scape-bracts strict, very densely imbricate, linear, acute or acuminate, subpungent, longitudinally red-striate below, chartaceous when dry. Inflorescence compound, very densely digitate, ovoid, subobtuse, 40-75 mm long, bright red when dry; primary bracts erect, broadly ovate, acuminate, much exceeding the lower axillary spikes; spikes erect, sessile, densely globose, strobiliform, 3-10-flowered. Floral bracts imbricate, broadly elliptic, obtuse, about 11 mm long, distinctly shorter than the sepals, strongly convex, ecarinate, coriaceous, prominently nerved; flowers glabrous, 16-18 mm long; pedicels short but distinct. Sepals sub-symmetrical, broadly obtuse, shiny, granular-punctulate especially toward the apex, unequally short-connate, coriaceous; petals conglutinate into a long slender tube, the lobes elliptic, obtuse; stamens included, the filaments highly connate with the petals, the anthers 3 mm long; ovary slenderly ellipsoid; ovules obtuse.

description: Plant flowering 1 m high. Leaves 3-8 dm long, densely punctulate-lepidote beneath; sheaths narrowly elliptic, brown toward the base; blades linear, acuminate, 2-4 cm broad. Scape stout, erect, its bracts densely imbricate, lanceolate, acuminate, ferruginous-lepidote. Inflorescence simple, densely strobilate, fertile throughout, 6-18 cm long. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, acute, covering the sepals, membranaceous, densely lepidote; flowers subsessile. Sepals narrowly elliptic, acute, 22 mm long, connate for 6 mm, thin, lepidote becoming glabrous; petals narrowly elliptic, obtuse. Capsule slenderly cylindric, 35 mm long.

description: Plant flowering nearly 1 m high. Leaves many in a dense funnelform rosette, straight, ca 3 dm long; sheaths conspicuous, elliptic, covered on both sides with minute brown scales; blades ligulate, acuminate, to 20 mm wide, rigid, microscopically punctulate above with dark scales, covered beneath with a thick white membrane of scales. Scape erect, slender, about twice as long as the leaves, terete, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, lanceolate, the lower laminate and imbricate, the upper bladeless and shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate from 6-8 spikes, ca 16 cm long; axis glabrous, obscurely angled; primary bracts spreading, triangular-ovate, acute, shorter than the spikes, subspreading, subsessile, strobilate, ellipsoid, 35 mm long, 18 mm in diameter. Floral bracts elliptic, rounded, 13 mm long, slightly exceeding the sepals, glabrous, nerved; flowers nearly sessile. Sepals subelliptic with a slightly asymmetric rounded apex, 12 mm long, connate for 1 mm; petals tubular-erect, blades obtuse; stamens included, anthers linear, 3 mm long.

description: Plant flowering to 1.5 m high. Leaves densely rosulate, to 75 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, dark brown; blades ligulate, acuminate, 20-25 mm wide, green, glabrous, subpapyraceous. Scape erect, to 1 m long, its bracts more or less foliaceous, imbricate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate from 3-6 branches or rarely simple; primary bracts ovate, apiculate, much shorter than the branches but exceeding the short sterile base; branches spreading, sublaxly 20-40-flowered, to 25 cm long. Floral bracts ovate, acute, straight at apex, exceeded by the sepals, thin; flowers suberect to spreading, short-pedicellate. Sepals lanceolate, acute, mucronulate, 15-22 mm long, connate to 8 mm, coriaceous; petals acute, about 3 cm long, pale yellow. Capsules slenderly cylindric, to 35 mm long; coma of the seeds red-brown.

description: Plant stemless (?), flowering over 1 m high (?). Leaves 12 dm long, densely appressed-lepidote on both sides; sheaths elliptic, ample ca 25 cm long, dark castaneous toward base; blades ligulate, subacute with a thick terminal subulus, 65 mm wide, flat, becoming glabrous with age. Scape erect, at least 12 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper lanceolate, acuminate, dark castaneous at base. Inflorescence simple or of two digitately arranged spikes; primary bract inconspicuous; spikes subsessile, strobilate, cylindric, 4 cm in diameter, the lateral 18 cm long, the terminal 27 cm. Floral bracts erect, about 8-ranked, suborbicular, apiculate, 4 cm long, coriaceous, somewhat striate and rugulose when dry, obscurely lepidote, red with a pale yellow apex; flowers subsessile. Sepals oblong-obovate, obtuse, 22 mm long, equally connate for 2 mm, dark castaneous, even, lustrous, the posterior ones obtusely carinate; petals unknown. Capsules cylindric, shorter than the floral bracts; coma brown.

description: Plant caulescent; stem at least 35 cm long; flowering shoot 20 cm long. Leaves erect, very densely imbricate, 20-25 cm long; sheaths ovate, 4 cm long, dark castaneous and covered with fine closely appressed scales beneath; blades linear, attenuate, flat, 7 mm wide, pale and appressed-lepidote above, dark and glabrous beneath. Scape erect, very slender; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, foliaceous but reduced. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 9 cm long, sparsely white-lepidote; primary bracts spreading, broadly ovate, red, shorter than the spikes but the lowest with foliaceous blades exceeding them; spikes more or less secund, subdensely 3-4-flowered, to 27 mm long including the naked sterile base, yellow. Floral bracts elliptic, 9 mm long, thin, nerved, the lower carinate and incurved; flowers subsessile, erect, more than 2-ranked. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 11 mm long, much exserted, equally connate for 4 mm, carinate toward base; petals 20 mm long.

description: Plant stemless or short-caulescent, flowering 8-10 dm high. Leaves 6-8 dm long; sheaths narrowly ovate, 10-15 cm long, covered with appressed brownish scales, dark castaneous toward base, red-striate above; blades linear, attenuate, flat, 15 mm wide, green, concolorous, obscurely lepidote. Scape erect, slender, lepidote becoming glabrous; scape-bracts erect, lepidote, the lower foliaceous and densely imbricate, the upper lanceolate, caudate-acuminate, equaling or slightly exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate from 5-12 spikes, 12-23 cm long; axis straight or flexuous; primary bracts ovate, the lower ones acuminate and about half as long as the spikes, the upper apiculate and much shorter; spikes divergent to subspreading, very short-stipitate, strobilate, fusiform, acuminate, 5 cm long, 1 cm in diameter. Floral bracts elliptic, obtuse, 18 mm long, exceeding the sepals, convex, ecarinate, subcoriaceous except for the brownish membranaceous margin, appressed-lepidote, pale green with a brown base; flowers subsessile. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts slightly exceeding the internodes, ovate, apiculate. Inflorescence simple, densely strobilate, fusiform, 8 cm long, many-flowered, glabrous, sterile toward apex. Floral bracts suborbicular, 2 cm long, much exceeding the sepals, membranaceous, striate; pedicels short. Sepals elliptic, broadly acute, 12 mm long, equally connate for 3 mm, membranaceous, striate; petals unknown. Capsule 3 cm long; coma red-brown.

description: Plant flowering to 1 m high. Leaves rosulate, 4-5 dm long, subdensely lepidote with small pale appressed scales; sheaths elliptic, dark castaneous; blades ligulate, acuminate, 25 mm wide. Scape erect, 7 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper broadly ovate, acuminate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 35 cm long; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, about half as long as the spikes, spikes erect but with flowers subsecund, short-stipitate, slenderly ellipsoid, dense, 10 cm long, 2-3 cm in diameter. Floral bracts each enfolding a single flower after anthesis, oblong-elliptic, 48 mm long, much exceeding the sepals, ecarinate, obscurely pale-appressed-lepidote, bright red except for the orange apex, the center subcoriaceous, the margins membranaceous; flowers subsessile, erect but subsecund at anthesis. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 30 mm long, sparsely white-lepidote, the posterior ones carinate, connate for 8 mm with each other and for 4 mm with the ecarinate anterior one.

description: Plant stemless, flowering over 45 cm high. Leaves about 20 in an infundibuliform rosette, 45 cm long, obscurely punctulate-lepidote throughout; sheaths elliptic, 10 cm long, slightly paler than the blades; blades ligulate, subacute, 4 cm wide, green suffused with purple. Scape erect, 6 mm in diameter; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, closely enfolding the scape, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper with broadly ovate purple-striped base and triangular solid purple apex. Inflorescence densely bipinnate, subglobose but lax at base, 7 cm long, very obscurely punctulate-lepidote, appearing glabrous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, shorter than the axillary branches; spikes ellipsoid, stout, 4 cm long, strobilate. Floral bracts suborbicular, to 17 mm long, exceeding the sepals, subcoriaceous and smooth, lustrous; flowers subsessile. description: Plant stemless, 50-75 cm high. Leaves 5-6 dm long, appressed-lepidote beneath; sheaths elliptic, 8-10 cm long, pale brown; blades linear, acuminate, 2 cm wide, green, glabrous above. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, densely imbricate, the upper ones involucrate. inflorescence densely digitate, 4 cm long; primary bracts ovate with a long foliaceous blade equaling or exceeding the spike; spikes many-flowered, 3 cm long. description: Stem short, stout, erect. Inflorescence many-flowered, compressed and presumably lateral; outer bracts broadly ovate, abruptly acute, pungent, 5 cm long, spinose-serrate, dark castaneous, pale-lepidote. description: Plant caulescent, 1-1.2 m high. Leaves many, arching-recurved, over 1 m long, covered beneath with coarse pale appressed scales, soon glabrous above; sheaths elliptic, 15 cm long, very dark castaneous; blades linear, acuminate, somewhat narrowed toward base, 3-4 cm wide, green, laxly and subregularly serrate with dark teeth 1-2 mm long. Inflorescence lateral with scapes up to 6 cm long, about 10-flowered, depauperately compound; outer (scape- and primary) bracts ovate with long stiff involute-subulate blades, 6-8 cm long, nerved along the margins, sparsely pale-lepidote, entire or sparsely serrate. Floral bracts lanceolate, mucronate, 3 cm long, centrally castaneous becoming gradually paler toward margins, pale-lepidote. description: Plants large, terrestrial, arising from elongate rootstocks, the stems stout, 1-1.5 m high, densely leafy. Leaves up to 13 dm long; sheaths 3-4 cm wide, slightly inflated, entire, densely brown-appressed-lepidote; blades linear, acuminate, 12-18 mm wide, obscurely brown-lepidote, finely striate, thin, bright green when fresh, serrate to 15-18 cm above the base with numerous antrorse, dark-brown, spinose teeth 1.5-3 mm long and 8-22 mm apart, along the middle unarmed or with very minute and remote teeth, the apex finely and densely spinose-serrate for 20-25 cm. Inflorescence terminal, nearly hidden among the leaves, capitate, many-flowered, about 5 cm in diameter, borne on a stout bracted scape 4 cm long; bracts linear-lanceolate or the outermost ovate, long-acuminate, the outer equaling the sepals, thin, sparsely brown-lepidote, entire below, toward the apex densely serrate with coarse brown incurved teeth; flowers sessile; ovary 3-angled, 10-15 mm long, 5 mm in diameter. Sepals free, lanceolate, acuminate, mucronate, 2 cm long, entire, green, sparsely brown-lepidote. Immature fruit about 1.5 cm long and 1 cm thick, many-seeded.

description: Stem stout, 15-24 dm long. description: Leaves rosulate (! Cuatrecasas), to 9 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 10 cm long, castaneous except the pale base, densely brown-lepidote, spinose-serrate at apex; blades linear, attenuate, slightly contracted toward base, to 33 mm wide in the middle, pale-lepidote on both sides, laxly serrate, the spines slender, spreading or antrorse, dark castaneous, the basal ones to 5 mm long. description: Stem evident, 3 dm long. description: Plant caulescent, 1.2-1.35 m high; leaves 1.5-2.5 m long, green throughout, glabrous above; sheaths elliptic, entire, covered beneath with dark ferruginous scales; blades linear, attenuate, to 35 mm wide, narrowed at the base, densely white-pruinose beneath, very laxly serrate with spines 1 mm long. Inflorescences lateral, numerous, compressed, many-flowered, 4-6 cm long; primary bracts broadly ovate or elliptic with a narrowly triangular apex, 6 cm long, exceeding the sepals at anthesis, toward the apex green, densely serrulate, and white-lepidote, subcoriaceous. description: Plant known only from fragments. description: Plant growing in dense masses. Leaves 3-4 dm long, laxly and very obsucrely serrulate, the sheaths elliptic, 6-7 cm long, brown except for the green apex, covered with coarse pale strongly appressed scales, the blades linear, acuminate to a subulate thickened apex, 2 cm wide, slightly narrowed at the base, strongly revolute when dry, densely cinereous-pruinose above, glabrous beneath. description: Plant stemless. Leaves rosulate, 10-20, barely 5 dm long; sheaths inconspicuous, oblong, scarcely wider than the blades, pale, subglabrous or lepidote beneath with large pale brown scales; blades linear, attenuate to a weakly pungent apex, scarcely more than 17 mm wide, bright green, wholly glabrous at maturity or bearing large pale brown or white scales beneath, the apical 1/4 bearing antrorse curved spines, elsewhere entire. Sepals linear, rounded and mucronulate, 15 mm long, 3 mm wide, wholly hyaline, carinate, sparsely lepidote; petals erect or suberect at anthesis, 28 mm long, connate for 3/4 in a slenderly funnelform tube; emarginate; stamens slightly shorter than the petals, filaments highly adnate to the petals, anthers broadly lanceolate, acute, 8 mm long; ovary slenderly cylindric, 3-angled, the epigynous tube very short.

description: Plant evidently short-caulescent. Leaves spreading to erect, 6 dm long; sheaths ovate, ca. 10 cm long, green marked irregularly with dark castaneous, very sparsely dark-lepidote; blades linear, attenuate, slightly contracted at base, to 3 cm wide, very sparsely vestite beneath with appressed, dark-centered scales, serrulate toward apex, entire elsewhere or with a few dark, 2 mm long teeth at base. description: Plant distinctly caulescent, to 9 dm high. Leaves drooping, 9 dm long, covered with coarse appressed whitish scales beneath, soon glabrous above; sheaths ovate, 5-6 cm long, dark castaneous, serrulate toward apex; blades linear, long-attenuate, narrowed toward base, 22 mm wide, green, laxly and regularly serrate with upwardly curved teeth 1 mm long. description: Plant growing in dense masses, 45-60 cm high. Leaves 30-45 cm long, the sheaths broadly elliptic, 5 cm long, dark castaneous, the blades linear, acuminate, 23 mm wide, narrowed at the base and bearing close-ranked slender spines 5 mm long, elsewhere sparsely and obscurely serrulate, tomentose-lepidote above, soon glabrous throughout. description: Plant caulescent; stem erect, 3-15 dm long. Leaves 8 dm long, brown-lepidote throughout, concolorous, the sheaths elliptic, the blades linear, attenuate, narrowed at the base. Inflorescences lateral, numerous, compressed, many-flowered, 6-7 cm long; primary bracts broadly elliptic with narrowly triangular apices, exceeding the sepals at anthesis, dark castaneous except for narrow green margins and apices, nearly even, coriaceous, bearing a few obscure teeth toward the apex, sparsely pale-appressed-lepidote. Floral bracts lanceolate, subulate-acuminate, 3 cm long, sparsely lepidote, the base and margins pale and membranaceous, elsewhere castaneous and coriaceous; flowers sessile. Sepals lance-triangular, subulate-acute, 21 mm long, pale except for the castaneous apex, sparsely lepidote; petals 35 mm long, the blades pale lilac, sparsely lepidote within.

description: Plant flowering to 7 dm high; leaves 3-7 dm long, appressed-white-lepidote beneath; sheaths large, dark brown, densely serrate with spines 3-4 mm long; blades linear, attenuate, slightly constricted toward base, 22 mm wide, laxly and minutely spinose-serrate. Inflorescence about 8-flowered, dense; outer bracts triangular-ovate, acuminate, pungent, dark castaneous except the stramineous base, densely uncinate-serrate, appressed-lepidote. Floral bracts linear-lanceolate, 35 mm long, exceeding the sepals, entire, pungent, punctate-lepidote, the lower part stramineous and membranaceous, the upper dark castaneous and subcoriaceous; flowers 4 cm long. Sepals like the floral bracts, 2 cm long; corolla 27 mm long, reddish, lobes about as long as the tube, erect; stamens and style included.

description: Leaves stiffly erect, 45-60 cm long, lepidote beneath with coarse pale appressed scales, soon glabrous above; sheaths elliptic, 8 cm long, castaneous beneath toward base, entire or with a few small teeth at apex; blades linear, acuminate, not narrowed toward base, 19 mm wide, serrulate toward apex and sometimes with a few small teeth at base, green. Inflorescences lateral, short-scapose, few-flowered, depauperately compound; outer (scape- and primary) bracts ovate with a short but distinct triangular involute-subulate apex, to 35 mm long, strongly nerved, sparsely pale-lepidote, the lower ones mostly castaneous with broad pale entire margins, the upper ones pale except near apex, laxly serrate along the upper half; floral bracts linear, mucronate, 22 mm long, centrally castaneous with broad thin pale margins, lepidote. Sepals lanceolate, mucronate, 16 mm long, castaneous, pale-lepidote; ovary evidently much enlarged in fruit, dark castaneous, lepidote.

description: Rhizome 1.5 m long, upright stem short. Leaves over 7 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 10 cm long, pale, subdensely serrate with straight slender dark castaneous spines 7 mm long; blades 5 cm wide, slightly narrowed at the base, appressed pale-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with antrorse spines 7 mm long, the upper spines 2 mm long. Inflorescences strongly complanate and presumably lateral, flabellate, about 15-flowered; outer bracts suborbicular, abruptly acute, scarcely over 25 mm long, entire or sparsely serrate with spines 3 mm long, dark castaneous and lustrous or pale at the extreme apex, sparsely pale-lepidote. Floral bracts linear, acute, 3 cm long, wholly castaneous; flowers short-pedicellate. Sepals free, narrowly triangular, pungent, 23 mm long, almost wholly exserted above the bracts; petals about 5 mm longer than the sepals.

description: Leaves over 8 dm long, sheaths narrowly triangular-ovate, 5 cm long, entire, dark castaneous, subdensely brown-lepidote beneath, blades to 23 mm wide, long-attenuate, narrowed at base, soon glabrous, 2 mm long. Inflorescences lateral, complanate, few-flowered; outer bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, 3 cm long, entire, dark castaneous, sparsely lepidote. Floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, scarcely over 2 cm long, castaneous; flowers short-pedicellate. Sepals free, narrowly triangular, acuminate, pungent, 16 mm long, castaneous; ovary 10 mm long.

description: Leaves over 4 dm long; blades very narrowly lanceolate, to 3 cm wide, glabrous, for the whole length bearing stout dark castaneous spines 4-5 mm long. Inflorescence rather few-flowered; outer bracts with bases broadly ovate, dark castaneous, sparsely lepidote, entire, broadly hyaline-margined, blades narrowly triangular, pale. Floral bracts linear-lanceolate, acuminate, pungent, 4 cm long, exceeded by the sepals, entire with a dorsal mucro, the lower part stramineous and membranaceous, the upper dark castaneous, coriaceous, sparsely lepidote; flowers 5-6 cm long. Sepals like the floral bracts, 20 mm long; corolla 30-35 mm long.

description: Plant growing in masses, short-caulescent. Leaves many, subrosulate, 9-12 dm long, densely cinereous-lepidote beneath; sheaths oblong, entire, dark castaneous at base; blades linear, attenuate, 28 mm wide, narrowed at base and armed with dark teeth 5 mm long, entire near middle, densely serrulate toward apex. Inflorescences lateral, few-flowered, compressed, 5 cm long; primary bracts broadly triangular-ovate, thick-subulate toward the apex, 4 cm long, much exceeding the sepals, dark castaneous, sparsely white-lepidote, entire. Floral bracts broadly lanceolate, subulate-acuminate, 24 mm long, about equaling the sepals, dark castaneous except for the pale base and margins, nerved, sparsely appressed-white-lepidote; flowers sessile. Sepals elliptic, 15 mm long, pale castaneous, sparsely lepidote; ovary sparsely ferruginous-lepidote.

description: Stem over 1 m long and 3 cm thick, woody, prostrate and rooting below, then curved-ascending and erect. Leaves rosulate at the apex of the stem, 75-90 cm long, thin; sheaths to 25 mm wide; blades linear, attenuate, to 18 mm wide, narrowed toward base to 10-12 mm wide, subpungent, serrate with 0.5 mm spines along the apical 1/4, elsewhere entire, pale whitish green and glabrous above, silvery-lepidote beneath. Scape to 15 mm long; scape-bracts triangular 20-25 mm long, sharply carinate, entire or subentire. Inflorescence lateral (?), compound, stout ovoid to subglobose, few-flowered, 45 mm in diameter in fruit; outer bracts about 30, broadly triangular-ovate, 25-40 mm long, chartaceous, firm, pectinate-spinulose toward apex. Floral bracts like the outer bracts but narrower and thinner, 20-40 mm long, 5-15 mm wide, entire or with a subdorsal mucro to 2 mm long, thin toward base. Sepals persistent, free, linear, acute, 17-20 mm long, 3 mm wide at base, obtusely carinate, cucullate and subdorsally mucronate; petals connate for 8 mm. Fruit obovoid to obconical, 17 mm long, 7-8 mm in diameter; seeds very numerous, biseriate, covered with a gelatinous coat.

description: Plant caulescent. Leaves spreading, to 1 m long; sheaths ovate, 8 cm long, entire, dark castaneous with narrow pale margins, very sparsely appressed-lepidote beneath; blades linear, acuminate, slightly narrowed toward base, to 16 mm wide, obscurely serrulate toward base and apex, glabrous. Scapes lateral, 4 cm long. Inflorescences subglobose, 35 mm long, few-flowered, depauperately compound with 1-2-flowered branches; outer (scape- and primary) bracts broadly ovate, acute, to 30 mm long, bearing a few curved teeth near apex, dark castaneous with narrow pale margins, glabrous. Floral bracts lanceolate, mucronate, ca 2 cm long. Sepals lance-oblong, mucronate, 17 mm long, dark castaneous. Fruit ellipsoid, 2 cm long.

description: Caudex erect, ca 15 cm long. Leaves numerous, ca 65 cm long; sheaths elliptic, 10 cm long, entire, dark castaneous, covered with whitish transparent appressed scales; blades linear, acuminate, 15 mm wide, densely but inconspicuously appressed-lepidote above, sparsely so beneath, at base subdensely serrate with dark straight or curved spines 5 mm long, involute when dry. Inflorescence single (?), few-flowered; the outer bracts broadly ovate, acute or the lowest laminate, exceeding the sepals, entire, covered with conspicuous white appressed scales. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, acute, mucronate, shorter than the sepals, densely pale-lepidote. Sepals free, slightly asymmetrical, subtriangular, acuminate, mucronate, 25 mm long, alate-carinate, green except the castaneous base, glabrous or nearly so; petals 35 mm long, naked; pollen grains spherical, smooth.

description: Plant flowering 1-2 m high. Leaves many in a dense spreading rosette, to 7 dm long; sheaths elliptic, indistinct, subdensely vestite on both sides with appressed dark castaneous scales; blades ligulate, acute but soon rounded by withering, 8 cm broad, glabrous above, obscurely lepidote beneath. Scape much exceeding the leaves, stout; scape-bracts imbricate, elliptic, red, tightly enfolding the scape. Inflorescence bipinnate with erect or ascending spikes, interrupted-thyrsoid, red, glabrous; primary bracts elliptic, rounded-apiculate, shorter than the spikes, coriaceous; spikes subovoid, 5 cm long, 3-4 cm in diameter, the lower short-stipitate, all with a prominent bicarinate sterile bract on the upper side of the base. Floral bracts elliptic-oblong, rounded, mucronate, 35 mm long, 14 mm wide, exceeded by the sepals, ecarinate, finely nerved, coriaceous; flowers sessile, erect. Sepals sublanceolate, 21-28 mm long, carinate; petals to 25 mm long, included, bearing two 9 mm long crenulate scales at base; filaments of the second series adnate to the petals for 9-10 mm, style exserted, exceeding the stamens; ovary inferior for 10-12 mm. Capsule slenderly fusiform, 35 mm long.

description: Herbs, 5-25 cm high. Stems solitary or branched from the base, salmon to white, internodes 0.6-4 cm long. Leaves connate at the base, salmon to white, triangular to narrowly triangular, 2.5-10 mm long, often carinate. Flowers solitary, 5-merous. Bracts and bracteoles absent. Pedicels (5-)30-40 mm long. Calyx salmon to white, tubular, 6-16 mm long, tube carinate, 3-7 mm long, lobes triangular to narrowly triangular, remote, 1.5-8 mm long, acute, as long as or shorter than the tube, sinuses obtuse, calyx scales present. Corolla salverform, 15-70 mm long, tube salmon, pink, or white, cylindric, 12-45 mm long, ca. 3 mm in diam., inflated near the insertion of the stamens, minutely hairy to papillate in the upper part, lobes creamy to white, narrowly triangular to linear, patent, soon strongly recurved, 3-30 mm long, 0.8-2 mm wide. Stamens inserted 3-6 mm below the throat, anthers basifixed, sessile, 0.2-0.5 mm long, rounded at base and apex, connective prominent. Ovary narrowly ovoid, 5-8 x 2 mm, sessile, provided with two glandular marks at the base. Style 8-30 mm long, glabrous to papillate, stigma peltate-clavate. Discoid scales absent. Capsule fusiform, 6-10 x 2-2.5 mm, (?) indehiscent. Seeds saccate, 0.1-0.3 x 0.05-0.10 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M. & Ruyters, P. 1986. Voyria and Voyriella (saprophytic Gentianaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 41: 1-93.

description: Herbs, to 10 cm high. Stems simple, white, internodes to 2 cm long. Roots horizontal, cylindric, 0.5-1 mm thick, densely covered with erect, 1 mm brown hairs. Leaves triangular to narrowly triangular, 2-6 mm long, 1-3 mm wide, acute to acuminate at the apex. Flowers solitary, 5-merous. Calyx yellow-orange, tubular, 3-10 mm long, tube about as long as the calyx lobes or somewhat shorter, 1-5 mm long, lobes narrowly triangular, 1-5 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide, slightly keeled, sinuses acute, calyx scales present. Corolla salverform, orange at the base, pale yellow in the upper part, 20-40 mm long, tube cylindric, inflated above the middle, 15-30 mm long, papillate within, lobes white, trullate, 5-10 mm long, to 6 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Stamens inserted in the inflated part of the corolla tube, filaments ca. 0.5 mm long, anthers ca. 0.5 mm long, basifixed. Ovary ovoid, ca. 7 mm long, sessile, provided with two sessile glands at the base. Style ca. 10 mm long, stigma capitate, margins lobed. Capsule narrowly ovoid, to 10 x 3 mm, probably indehiscent. Seeds ca. 0.2 x 0.1 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M. & Ruyters, P. 1986. Voyria and Voyriella (saprophytic Gentianaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 41: 1-93.

description: Herbs, 2-25 cm high. Stems simple, sometimes branched at the base, orange to red, rarely white, glabrous, internodes 0.5-1.5 cm long. Leaves orange to white, connate at the base, narrowly triangular or narrowly ovate to subulate, 1-9 mm long, 0.3-1 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Flowers solitary, 4- or 5-merous. Bracts and bracteoles absent. Pedicels 6-30 mm long. Calyx tubular, pink to orange-red, rarely white, 4-10 mm long, tube 1-6 mm long, carinate to narrowly winged, lobes narrowly triangular to subulate, 2-5 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide, sinuses acute, calyx scales present. Corolla salverform, yellow, rarely whitish to flesh-colored but then with yellow throat, 7-30 mm long, tube cylindric, 5-17 mm long, lobes patent to reflexed, narrowly triangular-trullate, 4-13 mm long, 1-3 mm wide, apex acute, acuminate or mucronate. Stamens inserted 2-3 mm below the throat, filaments to 1 mm long, anthers 1.5-4 mm long, dorsifixed, thecae with a basal, tail-like, densely hairy appendage equalling or somewhat exceeding the fertile part, apex rounded. Ovary fusiform, ca. 6 mm long, sessile, glandular marks present. Style about as long as the ovary, 4-8 mm long, sometimes slightly exceeding the corolla-tube, stigma peltate to capitate, papillate to glabrous. Capsule fusiform, 6-8 x 2 mm, (?) indehiscent. Seeds irregularly ovoid, 0.1-0.3 x 0.05-0.10 mm.

description: Herbs, to 20 cm high. Stems simple, sometimes branched below the inflorescence, pink to orange, upper part minutely hairy, internodes 0.5-2.5 cm long. Roots white, cylindric, to 40 mm long and 5-12 mm thick, irregularly horizontally branched (Maas et al. 4245). Leaves pink to orange, connate in their lower half, ovate to narrowly triangular, 5-8 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, apex acute to obtuse, the margins ciliate. Inflorescence a loose to dense (2-)3-6(-10)-flowered cyme, or flowers solitary. Bracts similar to the upper leaves but somewhat smaller. Bracteoles usually present, closely appressed to the calyx, triangular, 2-3 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide. Pedicels 3-7 mm long. Flowers 5-(or 6-)merous, fragrant (recorded for some collections from French Guiana). Calyx pinkish to red, tubular-campanulate, 6-12 mm long, tube 4-10 mm long, lobes oblong-elliptic, remote, 1.5-2 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide, apex obtuse to slightly emarginate, margins ciliate, sinuses obtuse, calyx scales present. Corolla salverform, pink to red, 45-100 mm long, tube generally slightly inflated below the throat, expanded towards the base by the maturing capsule, 30-70 mm long, lobes narrowly ovate to narrowly obovate, 10-20 mm long, 3-9 mm wide, apex obtuse. Stamens inserted 5-10 mm below the throat, anthers subsessile, 1.5-3 mm long, dorsifixed, thecae tapering towards the base, apex rounded to truncate. Ovary fusiform to cylindric, 8-10 x 2.5 mm, sessile, provided with two glandular marks near the base. Style 20-70 mm long, stigma peltate. Discoid scales absent. Capsule ovoid to fusiform, 8-12 x 2-4 mm, possibly dehiscing along one side (?). Seeds saccate, 0.3 x 0.10.2 mm.

description: Herbs, 3-15 cm high. Stems simple, solitary or a few together, orange to white, internodes 0.2-1.5 cm long. Roots cylindric, tapering to the apex, 1-13 mm long, 0.3-0.6 mm diam., glabrous. Leaves orange to white, connate in their lower half, triangular to narrowly triangular or ovate, 2-7 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, the basal part of the stem sometimes densely covered with densely imbricate leaves to 3 mm long and 1 mm wide. Flowers solitary, 5-merous, rarely subtended by two narrowly triangular bracts to 3 mm long and 1 mm wide. Pedicels 5-30 mm long. Calyx orange, red, or white, campanulate, 3-6 mm long, tube 2-3 mm long, lobes ovate to triangular, usually remote, 1-2(-3) mm long, 0.5-2 mm wide, apex obtuse to acute, sinuses usually obtuse, calyx scales present. Corolla salverform, yellow (yellowish white to white), 11-20 mm long, tube cylindric, often swollen at the base, 8-14 mm long, lobes narrowly ovate to ovate, (2-)3-6 mm long, 0.5-2 mm wide, apex obtuse to acute. Stamens inserted 0.5-2 mm below the throat, anthers 1.5-3 mm long, subsessile, dorsifixed, coherent, thecae tapering to the base, apex rounded. Ovary ellipsoid, 3-6 x 1-2.5 mm, sessile, provided with two sessile, elliptic glands near the base. Style as long as the ovary, rarely shorter, stigma rotate, sometimes 2-lobed, homed. Capsule narrowly ovoid, to 10 x 3 mm, probably dehiscing by two longitudinal slits. Seeds irregularly ellipsoid, 0.1-0.2 x 0.05-0.08 mm.

description: Herbs, to 20 cm high. Stems simple, rarely branched at the base, usually white; internodes 0.5-1 cm long. Leaves usually white, connate at the base, triangular to narrowly triangular, 2-8 mm long, 2-3 mm wide. Inflorescence a dense, 2-6 (-10)-flowered cyme, flowers sometimes solitary. Bracts similar to the upper leaves. Bracteoles triangular to narrowly triangular, 7-10 mm long, 3-6 mm wide, concealing at least half the calyx. Bracts and bracteoles often purplish-tinged. Pedicels very short, rarely to 5 mm long. Flowers (4-)5(-7)-merous, very fragrant (various collections from French Guiana). Calyx tubular, lilac throughout or yellowish towards the base, 10-25 mm long, tube 8-20 mm long, often split for most of its length along one or two sides, lobes deltate to narrowly triangular, 1-5 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, sinuses acute, calyx scales absent. Corolla salverform, blue to purplish, often fading to white, 40-80 mm long, glabrous to minutely hairy, tube 30-60 mm long, to 8 mm diam., expanded by the maturing capsule, gradually widened above the insertion of the stamens, lobes ovate to narrowly ovate, (4-) 12-20 mm long, (3-)5-8 mm wide, apex acute to obtuse. Stamens inserted 5-10 mm below the throat, filaments at the most as long as the anthers, anthers 2-3 mm long, free, basifixed, thecae rounded. Ovary fusiform, ca. 10 mm long, sessile, eglandular. Style 10-50 mm long, glabrous to (glandular) hairy, stigma funnelshaped, sometimes somewhat lobed at the margin. Capsule fusiform, 15-30 x 3-5 mm, sessile, usually exposed at maturity. Seeds urceolate to ovoid, 0.3-0.4 x 0.2-0.3 mm.

description: Leaves about 30, 10 to 33 cm long; blades 10 mm wide, glabrous above, sparsely lepidote and pale green beneath, minutely spinose except for the entire apical 3-5 cm, the margin recurved when dry, otherwise complicate-carinate. Inflorescence to 25-flowered, densely capitate, surrounded by a few red inner leaves; outer bracts shorter than the flowers, the claw linear, the blade rounded, red-brown, minutely crenulate, snowy-farinose at apex; pedicels very short and inconspicuous; flowers 30 mm long. Sepals oblong, rounded and cucullate, 13 mm long, 5 mm wide, glabrous at base, snowy-farinose at apex; petals 2-3 mm longer than the sepals, blue soon changing to brown, ligulate, spreading at the extreme apex, the scales basal, small, denticulate; filaments 6 mm long; anthers barely exserted at anthesis, bacilliform, 6 mm long; ovary glabrous, to 20 mm long; style 15 mm long.

description: Shrub 0. l-0.3(-l) m tall; mature stems subterete, striate, minutely verrucose, glabrate; bark cracking longitudinally; twigs subterete, striate, densely short-pilose with ferruginous to cinereous hairs. Leaves thick-coriaceous, strongly convex above and concave beneath, often falcate, oblong-elliptic, 0.6-2.6 × 0.3-0.7 cm, base rounded, obtuse to broadly cuneate, decurrent, apex obtuse or rounded (with a subapical, blunt protrusion to 1 mm long appearing as the actual apex), margin strongly revolute over entire length, actual margins not visible, bearing 1-2 pairs of pustular glands at base of lamina or on petiole, weakly to moderately short-white-pilose above when young then glabrate, densely whitish- or more often ferruginous-tomentose beneath on surfaces, obscure; pinnately nerved with midrib impressed above and raised beneath, lateral nerves (apparently 3-4 per side) obscure; petiole subterete, narrowly canaliculate above, rugose, 2-4 mm long, densely short-pilose. Inflorescence l-4(-5)-flowered; rachis subterete, striate, 2-8 mm long, glabrous (glaucous to densely short-white-pilose); floral bract concave, ovate, up to 1 mm long, acute, glabrous to short-pilose; pedicel subterete to somewhat angled, striate to ribbed, 3-10 mm long, glabrous (glaucous to moderately short-white-pilose); bracteoles broadly ovate, 1-2 mm long, glabrous to weakly short-pilose. Flowers nodding, with calyx 7-11 mm long, essentially glabrous or lobes sometimes puberulent at tips, lobes striate or rugose, ovate, ca. 6-9 mm long, long-acuminate; corolla 9-14.5 mm long, glabrous, pink to scarlet when fresh, lobes ovate-deltoid, 1-1.5 mm long, acute to obtuse, reflexed; stamens 8 mm long (measurements from corollas 14-14.5 mm long); filaments curved, ca. 6 mm long; anthers ca. 3.3 mm long, base mucronate; thecae ca. 2.3 mm long; tubules 0.8-1 mm long, dehiscing by obliquely terminal pores; ovary glabrous; style ca. 7-8 mm long, glabrous. Berry ± spherical, to 1.6 cm diam., red when mature.

description: Shrublet 0.1-0.3(-1) m tall; mature stem terete, striate to ribbed, moderately short-grayish-white-pilose to glabrate; twigs subterete to terete, striate to ribbed, densely to moderately short-white- to ferruginous-pilose (glabrate). Leaves coriaceous, basically flat to long-revolute, except apex, ovate-elliptic, 1.5-2.5(-3.8) × (0.3-)0.6-1(-1.3) cm, base broadly cuneate and short-decurrent, or obtuse, apex acute with actual apex conspicuously, bluntly, and stoutly mucronate, or rarely obtuse to rounded, margin bearing 1 pair of pustular glands at the base of the lamina, weakly short-white-pilose above when young then glabrate, densely short-tomentose over entire lower surface (except midrib and sometimes lateral nerves) with white, grayish-white, to tan or ferruginous hairs; pinnately nerved, midrib shallowly impressed above, raised beneath, lateral nerves (ca. 4 per side) obscure above, slightly raised beneath but usually obscure; petiole subterete, flat but not conspicuously canaliculate above, rugose (ribbed), 3-5 mm long, moderately and shortly white- or ferruginous-pilose. Inflorescence l-4(-8)-flowered; rachis subterete, bluntly angled, striate, rugose, 5-10(-20) mm long, moderately and shortly white- or ferruginous-pilose, or glabrate; floral bract concave, ovate, 1.5-1.8 mm long, acute to obtuse, moderately and shortly white- or ferruginous-pilose to glabrous; pedicel subterete, striate, 5-11 mm long, moderately and shortly white- or ferruginous-pilose, glabrate distally; bracteoles broadly ovate, keeled, 2-2.5 mm long, acute, pubescent as floral bract. Flowers nodding, with calyx (6-)8-10 mm long, essentially glabrous or lobes white- or ferruginous-puberulent in apical one-third, or only at tips both without and within, lobes themselves rugose, ovate, 6-8 mm long, acuminate; corolla 12-13 mm long, ca. 8 mm diam., pink to red when fresh, glabrous or weakly short-pilose along angles distally, lobes broadly triangular, 2-3 mm long, acute, reflexed; stamens ca. 8 mm long (from corolla 13 mm long); filaments ca. 5.2 mm long; anthers (2-)3-3.8 mm long; thecae ca. (l-)2.2 mm long, base conspicuously mucronate (ca. 0.3 mm long); tubules 1-1.3 mm long; style 5-7 mm long, glabrous (very rarely weakly pilose at apex); ovary glabrous or rarely very weakly pilose. Berry ± spherical, to ca. 1 cm diam., red.

description: Shrub 0.5-1.5 m tall; mature stems terete to subterete, striate, minutely vernicose, short-pilose with whitish to grayish-white or ferruginous, curled hairs, glabrate; twigs subterete, bluntly angled, densely short-pilose as stems. Leaves thick-coriaceous, basically flat, elliptic-ovate, (1.5-)3-5.5 × (0.8-)1.3-2.5 cm, base obtuse or rounded, short-decurrent, apex acute and shortly and bluntly mucronate or obtuse to rounded, margin entire, narrowly revolute, bearing 1-2 pairs of pustular glands at base of lamina or onto petiole, glabrous above, densely tomentose, rarely glabrate, beneath with whitish-gray to ferruginous hairs obscuring most of the surface except the veins; pinnately nerved with midrib impressed above and raised beneath, lateral nerves (3-5 per side) and veinlets impressed above and raised beneath, ± conspicuous on both surfaces; petiole stout, subterete, narrowly canaliculate above, rugose, 3-7 mm long, pubescent as stems. Inflorescence (once-branched at base) 3-5-flowered; rachis, pedicels, floral bracts, and bracteoles densely short-tomentose with whitish to ferruginous hairs, glabrate; rachis stout, terete, 1-2(-5) cm long; floral bract concave, ovate, 1.5-2(-3) mm long (leaf-like, oblong, to ca. 5 mm long), obtuse; pedicel subterete (angled), 3-9 mm long; bracteoles broadly ovate, 2-3 mm long, acute or obtuse. Flowers with calyx 7-8 mm long, lobes ovate, 5.5-6 mm long, acuminate, densely short-pilose with ferruginous hairs over whole length or distal half to glabrate without, short-pilose distally within; corolla 10-11 mm long, densely short-pilose along the wings but glabrous in between, rose to scarlet when fresh, lobes broadly deltoid, 3-4 mm long, acute; stamens 6-8 mm long; filaments 4-6 mm long; anthers 2.5-3 mm long, base short-mucronate; thecae 1.5-2 mm long; tubules ca. 1 mm long; ovary densely long-pilose with ferruginous hairs obscuring the surface; style ca. 5.5 mm long, glabrous or distally sparsely long-pilose. Berry known only as immature, spherical, at least 8 mm diam., sparsely long-pilose.

description: Lianas, árvores, 5-7(-13) m, glabros exceto pelas flores; ramos novos tetrangulares achatados ou subcilíndricos, lisos, secos marrons ou acinzentados, velhos cilíndricos, minutamente lenticelados, enegrecidos ou cinzentos, comumente pruinosos. Folhas opostas; estípulas triangulares, inteiras, deixando cicatrizes interpeciolares; pecíolos (4-)8-10(-16) mm, secos marrons; lâminas (3.9 -)9.2-15.3(-27) × (1.7-)2.4-5.8(-13) cm, elípticas, raro ovais, base cuneada, raro arredondada, margem inteira ou ondulada, ápice agudo, raro acuminado ou longo-acuminado, cartáceas, secas esverdeadas em ambas as faces, ou verde-acinzentadas ou marrons na face adaxial, marrom-esverdeadas na abaxial, mais ou menos conspicuamente minuto pontuadas de negro na face abaxial, nervuras secas de cor inconspícua na face adaxial, inconspícuas, amareladas ou marrom-acinzentadas na abaxial, em ambas as faces secundárias promínulas, terciárias levemente promínulas, ou secundárias proeminentes na abaxial. Inflorescências (1.4-)2.4-3(-6. 1) × (1.6 -)2-3.5(-6.6) cm, ca 80 flores, axilares; pedúnculos 0(-3) mm, ramos achatados, sulcados, opostos, papilosos, secos pruinosos; brácteas papilosas, afastadas das ramificações ou raramente não; pedicelos 1 -2(-4) mm; bractéolas ausentes. Flores ca 3.3 mm diâm na antese, campanuliformes; sépalas 0.5 -0.7 × 0.7 -0.9 mm, triangulares, carnosas, pubérulas no ápice; pétalas 1.4- 1.9 × 0.9-1.35 mm, elípticas ou espatuladas, mais ou menos oblíquas, carnosas, pubérulas na metade distal ou somente no ápice, às vezes no ápice e no centro em ambas as faces, amarelas, amarelo esverdeadas; disco 0.3 -0.6 mm alt.; estames 0.9-1.2 mm, alternos aos lobos do estigma, filetes 0.35 -0.75 mm, anteras 0.25 -0.3 × 0.35 -0.6 mm, reniformes, deiscência transversa; ovário e disco ca 1,25 mm diâm, ovário 3-lobado, estilete 0.3 -0.55 mm, seção triangular, estigma 3-lobado, 0.3-0.4 mm diâm, lobos bífidos, patentes, óvulos por lóculo 2. Bagas 5.4 -5.7( -9.2) × 2.6-3.3(-4.5) cm diâm, elipsóides ou subpiriformes, secas enegrecidas, lenticeladas, imaturas pruinosas, azul acinzentadas, maduras laranja ou marrons, epicarpo maduro lenhoso, 4-5 mm. Sementes 3.9 × 1.5 cm.

description: Shrub to 4 m tall; twigs glabrous to sparsely pubescent, with clearly chambered pith; buds to ca. 0.8 mm long, leaves revolute. Leaves coriaceous, slightly and narrowly ovate to narrowly oblong, (1-) 1.6-5.6 × 0.3-1 (-1.7) cm, base cuneate to truncate, apex acute- to rounded-mucronate, margin entire, plane to very slightly revolute, especially near base, adaxial surface sparsely to very sparsely pubescent on basal portion of midvein, abaxial surface glabrous (with few very inconspicuous glandular dots along mid vein); petiole 2-6 mm long. Inflorescences (fascicle-like) axillary racemes to 0.5-1.5(-2.5) cm long; rachis sparsely to densely pubescent; pedicels 4-10 mm long, very sparsely to moderately pubescent; bracteoles 2, alternate to subopposite, from nearly basal to near midpoint of pedicel, narrowly triangular to linear, to ca. 1.6 mm long; floral bracts to 1.2 mm long. Flowers with triangular calyx lobes, with acuminate (to acute) apices, 1.4-2.6 × 0.8-1.4 mm, abaxial surface glabrous to sparsely pubescent; corolla cylindrical, white, 6.5-11 × 2.5-4.5 mm, glabrous; filaments 5-5.5 mm long; anthers ca. 1.2 mm long; ovary glabrous to very slightly pubescent near apex. Capsules short-ovoid to subglobose, 3-5 × 4.5-7.5 mm, placentae ± central; seeds 1-1.5 mm long.

description: Shrub; twigs sparsely to very sparsely pubescent, with ± nonchambered pith; buds to ca. 1.8 mm long, leaves re volute. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to elliptic, 1-3.1 × 0.6-1.3 cm, base rounded to slightly cordate, apex acute- to rounded-mucronate, margin entire (slightly sinuous), plane to slightly re volute, both surfaces glabrous to sparsely pubescent on midvein, abaxially often with few to several inconspicuous glandular dots along midvein; petiole 1-2.5 mm long. Inflorescences axillary racemes to 5-10 cm long; rachis sparsely to moderately pubescent; pedicels 3.5-7 mm long, sparsely to moderately pubescent; bracteoles 2, at or near base to within lower 1/3 of pedicel, narrowly triangular, to ca. 1.1 mm long; floral bracts to 1.5 mm long. Flowers with triangular calyx lobes, with acuminate apices, 1-1.5 × 0.9-1.5 mm, abaxial surface glabrous to very sparsely pubescent, especially near base; corolla cylindrical to urceolate-cylindrical, white, 6-7.5 × 3-3.5 mm, glabrous; filaments ca. 3.5 mm long; anthers ca. 1.3 mm long; ovary glabrous to very sparsely pubescent near apex. Capsules subglobose to short-ovoid, 4-5 × 5.5-6.5 mm, placentae subapical; seeds not seen.

description: Briefly deciduous tree 5-20 m. Leaves 4.5-14 × 2-7.5 cm thickly chartaceous to coriaceous, oblong- or elliptic-obovate or narrowly so, subacute to shortly acuminate at apex, cuneate to attenuate at base, glabrous except sometimes appressed-pubescent on veins, domatia absent. Venation brochidodromous or eucamptodromous-brochidodromous; midvein moderate, prominent; secondary veins 5-9 pairs, moderately spaced, originating at moderately acute angles, slightly curved distally, scarcely prominent; intersecondary veins rarely present; tertiary veins usually randomly reticulate, sometimes weakly percurrent; higher order veins usually well-developed; areolation close, usually well developed, not to slightly prominent. Petiole 0.7-2 cm, glabrous to pubescent, eglandular. Inflorescences 7.5-12 cm, simple, with all flowers bisexual; peduncle 1.5-2 cm, pubescent; rhachis 6-10 cm, densely pubescent. Flowers pentamerous, 3-4 × 2.5-3.5 mm; lower hypanthium 1-2 mm, rufous-to white-tomentose; upper hypanthium 1.5-2 mm, cupuliform to campanulate, pubescent to tomentose; calyx lobes 0.6-1 mm, usually revolute, pubescent; disk villous; stamens 2.5-4 mm; style 2.8-4 mm, villous except glabrous near tip. Fruits usually few, disposed along whole length or mostly near apex of rhachis, 1.7-3 × 2.5-3.8 cm, strongly flattened, rhombic or suborbicular to transversely broadly elliptic in side view, rounded or truncate to emarginate at apex, pseudostipitate at base, densely pubescent at first, becoming subglabrous at maturity; wings 2, stiff, equal, 0.9-1.4 cm wide, markedly thickened with spongy material adjacent to body, rounded to somewhat angled laterally, sometimes 1-2 extra narrower wings on more convex side of body; body 0.6-0.9 cm wide but appearing wider due to thickened base of wings, often slightly ridged on 1 face and slightly grooved on other. Reproductive biology. Flowers white, greenish white, green with yellow stamens, cream-colored, or yellow, sweetly scented, much visited by indigenous bees (Bahia); no evidence of dichogamy. Specimens from Tocantins often have beautiful white-tomentose flowers, but in other material the pubescence varies from fulvous to rufous. Flowering and fruiting August to March. The corky fruits are presumably suited to water dispersal.
