description: Plant known only from fragments, probably flowering over 5 dm high. Leaves unknown. Scape ca 4 mm in diameter; scape-bracts remote, broadly ovate, acuminate, entire. Inflorescence simple, lax, finely and fugaceously whitish-furfuraceous. Floral bracts spreading or reflexed, like the scape-bracts, the lower nearly equaling the sepals; pedicels stout, 2-3 mm long, articulate; flowers spreading or reflexed at anthesis, to 15 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, acute, 6-8 mm long, straight or nearly so; petals exceeding the stamens, the blades suberect, broadly obovate, obtuse, undulate, carinate (?); filaments high-connate above the common tube with the petals, the anthers triangular, acute, recurved toward apex; style short; ovules broadly alate.

description: Plant known only from fragments. Leaves to 12 dm long; blades attenuate to a slenderly subulate apex, 25 mm wide, densely serrate near base with acicular spines 1.5 mm long, more laxly so above, coriaceous, subglabrous on both sides. Inflorescence simple (?), slenderly virgate, over 3 dm long, very laxly many-flowered; rhachis slender, terete, with the bracts and sepals umbrinous-tomentellous becoming glabrous. Floral bracts reflexed, ovate, broadly acute, 4 mm long, much exceeded by the sepals, strongly convex, entire; flowers subsessile, some suberect, others subspreading, slender, orange when dry. Sepals broadly elliptic, rounded and emarginate, ca 5 mm long; petals erect, 13 mm long, the blades broadly subacute, ecarinate; stamens exserted, high-connate above the common tube with the petals; style short.

description: Plant known only from fragments. Inflorescence compound, over 6 dm long, 7-branched; primary bracts ovate, acuminate, fulvous-tomentose; branches erect or suberect, to 3 dm long, sublaxly flowered, fulvous-tomentose. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, to 11 mm long, equaling the sepals, fulvous-tomentose; flowers erect to spreading, subsessile, to 20 mm long. Sepals oblong-ovate, rounded at apex, 11 mm long, tomentose; petals 18 mm long, pale yellow, the blades ovate, subacute, erect, more or less carinate; stamens equaling the petals, connate for 3.5 mm above the common tube; anthers linear, acute, sagittate at base, strongly recurved; ovary pyramidal, 13 mm high; style none.

description: Plant flowering to 5 dm high. Leaves densely rosulate, to 12 cm long; blades 4 mm wide, glabrous, the outer irregularly curved-spreading, near the base bearing a few minute teeth evident to touch, more or less subulate-complicate, the inner blades erect, entire, linear, acicular at apex. Scape much exceeding the leaves, stout, glabrous; scape-bracts all much shorter than the internodes, very broadly ovate, acuminate, all short-laminate. Inflorescence simple (?), very lax at least at base, glabrous; rhachis stout, terete. Floral bracts like the scape-bracts but with shorter blades, suberect to erect, to 12 mm long, exceeding the axillary flowers, violet-tinged when dry; flowers erect, short-pedicellate, to 11 mm long, Sepals very broadly elliptic, rounded and with a few teeth at apex, 6 mm long, submembranaceous; petals erect, broadly rounded and slightly emarginate, ecarinate, lemon yellow, very briefly connate at base; stamens much shorter than the petals, free above the common tube, the filaments very broad and almost foliaceous; style half as long as the ovary, very stout.

description: Plant flowering to 1 m high, densely colonial. Leaves over 5 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 5 cm long, pale; blades spreading, narrowly triangular, 4 cm wide, covered with pale appressed scales beneath, the teeth antrorse, uncinate, 4 mm long. Scape erect, 6 mm in diameter at apex, lepidote; scape-bracts erect, broadly ovate, the lowest with narrowly triangular serrulate blades, the uppermost apiculate, much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence paniculate, lax; primary bracts shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches short, very densely flowered, cinereous-lepidote-pubescent. Floral bracts reflexed, acuminate from a broadly ovate base, to 5 mm long, puberulous; pedicels very short; flowers spreading, to 14 mm long, sulphur-yellow. Sepals ovate, rounded and mucronulate, to 8 mm long, ferruginous-puberulous at base, elsewhere glabrous and lustrous; petals erect, the blade subreniform, broadly rounded and minutely emarginate, not undulate, ecarinate; stamens exserted, free above the common tube with the petals; anthers sublinear, acute; styles 5-6 times shorter than the ovary; ovules with a thin rounded circumferential wing slightly enlarged on the back.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves to 6 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, laxly serrulate, glabrous toward base; blades very narrowly triangular, 30-35 mm wide, very laxly serrate with slender curved spines 3 mm long, near the base covered with a pale membrane of fused scales, elsewhere glabrous. Scape stout, brown-lanate; scape-bracts erect, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper narrowly triangular, longer or shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple or few-branched, sublaxly flowered, very densely dark brown-lanate throughout. Floral bracts broadly ovate, short-acuminate, 8-20 mm long, entire, the lower about equaling the sepals; flowers subsessile, spreading. Sepals elliptic, acute, to 15 mm long, the margins wholly obscured by the indument; petals slightly exceeding the sepals, narrowly elliptic and without a distinct claw, orange, lanate dorsally; stamens included, the filaments free above the short common tube with the petals; style simple, very short.

description: Plant flowering about 1 m high. Leaves nearly 5 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, 35 mm wide at base, densely pale-lepidote beneath, densely serrate with spines 2 mm long. Scape stout, lepidote; scape-bracts much shorter than the internodes, broadly ovate, acuminate, pungent, entire. Inflorescence simple, subdense, but interrupted at base, densely ferruginous-lepidote. Floral bracts spreading or reflexed, ovate, acuminate to acute, to 10 mm long, equaling or shorter than the sepals; flowers divergent, subsessile, to 13 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 7 mm long; petals exceeding the stamens, the blades suberect, rhombic, subobtuse, carinate; filaments high-connate above the common tube with the petals, the anthers linear, subacute, recurved; style very short.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plant flowering 1 m or higher. Leaves 5 dm or longer; sheaths ample, dark brown; blades narrowly triangular, ca 15 mm wide, densely pale-lepidote beneath, subdensely serrate with slender spines 2 mm long. Scape slender, subglabrous; scape-bracts much shorter than the internodes, very broadly ovate, abruptly acute, entire. Inflorescence simple, rather lax, subsecund, tomentellous-lepidote. Floral bracts subspreading, broadly ovate, abruptly acute or subrounded, to 6 mm long, shorter than the sepals; flowers ascending or the uppermost erect, subsessile, 19 mm long. Sepals elliptic-ovate, incised-emarginate, to 8 mm long, lepidote-tomentellous; petals erect, the blades broadly obovate, rounded, ecarinate, more or less undulate; stamens free above the common tube with the petals; anthers exserted, triangular, acute, slightly recurved; style half as long as the ovary; ovules with a very large asymmetric wing obtuse above and acute at the side.

description: Plant flowering to 13 dm high. Leaves 5 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, over 2 cm wide, laxly serrate with spines 1.5 mm long, densely lepidote especially beneath. Scape stout, 1 m high, soon glabrous; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, broadly ovate with narrowly triangular acuminate serrulate blades. Inflorescence few-branched at the base or pseudo-simple with buds in the axils of the lower bracts, 3 dm long, sparsely ferruginous-tomentose; primary bracts many times shorter than the branches. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, the lower serrulate and equaling or exceeding the flowers; flowers suberect to spreading, 12-13 mm long; pedicels short and stout. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 7-12 mm long, nearly or quite glabrous; petals erect, the blades suborbicular, ecarinate; stamens included, the filaments free above the common tube with the petals, the anthers linear, slightly recurved; style single, very short; ovules nearly surrounded by the asymmetrical wing.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plant flowering over 8 dm high. Leaves unknown. Scape erect, 6 dm long, very slender; scape-bracts acuminate from a very broadly ovate base very much shorter than the internodes, entire, prominently striate. Inflorescence simple, rather few-flowered, polystichous-flowered, 2 dm long, sublax, covered with appressed cinereous scales; rhachis straight, terete. Floral bracts subspreading, very broadly ovate, apiculate, 7 mm long, not much shorter than the sepals, entire; flowers suberect to erect, subsessile, golden yellow. Sepals very broadly elliptic, rounded and emarginate at apex, 6 rum long; petals erect, to 10 mm long, the claws very short, the blades very broadly trapeziform-orbicular, very broadly rounded and slightly emarginate, ecarinate, minutely undulate along the margin; seamens 2 mm longer than the petals; filaments broad, free above the common tube with the petals; style very short.

description: Leaves rosulate, 4-5 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, 3 cm wide, thick, sub-carnose-coriaceous, canous-furfuraceous on both sides, repand-serrate with antrorse curved wholly lepidote spines 6-8 mm long. Scape 5-8 dm long, glabrous; scape-bracts much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence 4-5 branched, glabrous; primary bracts ovate, mucronulate, 10 mm long; branches 15 cm long, laxly flowered. Floral bracts subreflexed, triangular-ovate, apiculate, to 5 mm long, about equaling or shorter than the pedicels; pedicels 4-5 mm long. description: Plant flowering 4-5 dm high. description: Plant flowering 5 dm high. description: Plant flowering to 3 dm high. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, the lowest equaling the sepals or shorter, microscopically serrulate; pedicels ca 1 mm long, stout but distinct. description: Plant flowering 85 cm high. description: Plant acaulescent, flowering 66 cm high. description: Plant stemless (?), flowering 4.5 dm high. description: Plant flowering to 8 dm high. description: Plant flowering 75 cm high. Scape 5 mm in diameter, glabrous; lower scape-bracts subfoliaceous, the upper narrowly triangular, thin, serrulate, irregularly shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, laxly many-flowered, 21 cm long, glabrous. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, serrulate, the lowest exceeding the sepals; pedicels spreading to reflexed, broadly obconic, 3 mm long, constricted at base. Sepals broadly ovate, rounded, entire or apiculate, 7 mm long, rugose when dry as if formerly fleshy, little if at all carinate; petals 9 mm long, red-orange (! Pabst), the blades obovate, carinate; stamens included; filaments short-connate above the short common tube; stigmas sessile.

description: Plant flowering 7 dm high. Leaves many in a subbulbous rosette, 5 dm long; sheaths ample, ca. 4 cm long; blades recurved-spreading, very narrowly triangular, rigid, 25-30 mm wide, covered beneath with closely appressed cinereous scales, soon glabrous above, very laxly serrate with black subspreading 1.5 mm long spines. Scape erect, very slender, soon glabrous; scape-bracts remote, very small, acuminate from a broadly ovate base, entire. Inflorescence simple, very lax, over 2 dm long, glabrous. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, but apiculate, to 5 mm long; pedicels spreading, rather stout, 3 mm long. Sepals elliptic-oblong, broadly rounded, 6 mm long, ecarinate, rather thin; petals 10 mm long, about equaling the stamens, the blades very broadly rounded, carinate; stamens with filaments short-connate above the junction with the petals; stigmas subsessile.

description: Plant known only from fragments. Scape glabrous; scape-bracts much shorter than the internodes, ovate, acuminate, entire. Inflorescence few-branched, sparsely short-tomentulose; branches ascending, subdensely flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, shorter than the pedicels, fimbriate at apex; pedicels 3 mm long, flowers spreading at anthesis. Sepals broadly ovate-elliptic, apiculate, 7 mm long, fimbriate, appressed-tomentulose; petals ca 11 mm long, the blades suborbicular, obtuse, carinate, erect; stamens equaling or slightly exceeding the petals; filaments free above the common tube with the petals; anthers sublinear, acuminate, strongly recurved; style almost none; ovules with small thick nearly equilateral wings.

description: Plant stemless (?), flowering 33 cm high. Leaves 8-9 cm long; sheaths very broadly ovate, 15 mm long, glabrous, stramineous, obscurely serrulate at apex; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, 13 mm wide, laxly serrate with curved spines 1.5 mm long, sulcate when dry, pale-appressed-lepidote but becoming glabrous above with age. Scape erect, slender, densely white-lepidote but soon glabrous; scape-bracts lanceolate, acuminate, small and remote, serrulate, white-lepidote. Inflorescence simple, laxly few-flowered, 5 cm long, except for the petals densely white-lepidote; rhachis slender, geniculate. Floral bracts short-acuminate from a broadly ovate base, to 7 mm long, exceeding the pedicels, the lowest obscurely serrulate; pedicels obconic, 5 mm long; flowers spreading or reflexed. Sepals elliptic, apparently obtuse but the fragile apex soon broken, 8 mm long, ecarinate; petals broadly obovate, 12 mm long, orange-yellow, scarcely carinate; stamens included, filaments free above the short common tube with the petals; style distinct.

description: Plant flowering 10 cm high. Leaves (separated) 15 cm long; sheaths triangular-ovate, inconspicuous, stramineous, smooth, sublustrous, sparsely lepidote toward apex; blades narrowly triangular, 5 mm wide, covered with white appressed scales on both sides,becoming glabrous above, laxly serrate with pale slender spreading spines 2 mm long. Scape lacking. Inflorescence simple but in 3 parts, a cluster of flowers at the base, the basal part of the raceme (4 cm) with obviously abortive flowers, and the terminal part with apparently well developed flowers, the whole subdensely white-flocculose. Floral bracts broadly ovate, the basal ones with long narrowly triangular serrate blades that exceed the flowers, the highest merely apiculate; pedicels spreading, slender, 3 mm long; flowers 2-merous, "with a very sweet and strong fragrance" (! David Hutt). Sepals suborbicular, very broadly acute and minutely apiculate, 5-6 mm long; petals 10 mm long, orange, short-connate, the blade spreading, broadly rounded; stamens much shorter than the petals, the filaments almost completely connate, the anthers sagittate, curved, 1.5 mm long; ovary slenderly conical, the styles short but obvious and separate.

description: Plant flowering 1-1.2 m high. Leaves 25-50 cm long; blades narrowly triangular, 10-35 mm wide, sparsely pale-appressed-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with slender curved spines 4 mm long. Scape slender, glabrous; scape-bracts shorter than the internodes, broadly ovate with long-attenuate entire apices. Inflorescence few-branched, glabrous; primary bracts only a little larger than the floral bracts; branches erect, elongate, very laxly flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate or suborbicular, apiculate, 5-8 mm long, lustrous, those of the branches much exceeded by the sepals, those of the central axis longer than the sepals; flowers suberect; pedicels very stout, angled, 2-4 mm long. Sepals suborbicular, obtuse, 5-7 mm long, carinate; petals 13-15 mm long, the blades spreading, elliptic, obtuse or emarginate, undulate; stamens exserted, the filaments high-connate above the common tube with the petals, the anthers sublinear, acute, recurved; style about as long as the ovary; ovules with rounded dorsal wings.

description: Leaves many, densely rosulate, 23-27 cm long; sheaths suborbicular, 3 cm in diameter, brown, lustrous and lepidote toward apex above, elsewhere dull and glabrous; blades linear, acute and mucronulate, 10-13 mm wide at base, rigid, channeled, more or less curved, covered with appressed cinereous scales but soon glabrous above, laxly serrate with slender antrorsely curved brown spines 2.5 mm long. Scape 4 dm high, subterete, 5 mm in diameter, very dark when dry, flocculose becoming glabrous; scape-bracts broadly ovate, foliaceous-laminate or the highest acuminate, about equaling the upper internodes, cinereous-lepidote, serrulate. Inflorescence lax, many-flowered, 28 cm long, bearing 6 laxly few-flowered long-stipitate racemes at base, densely ferruginous-flocculose except the petals; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, to 17 mm long, much exceeded by the sterile bases of the racemes. Floral bracts acuminate from a broadly ovate base, spreading, slightly exceeded by the sepals, serrulate; flowers spreading, to 15 mm long, orange, pedicellate for 5 mm. Sepals ovate-elliptic, acute, incurved to 10 mm long, rugose when dry, serrulate; petals distinctly unguiculate, curved-spreading toward apex, the blade obovate; stamens included, the filaments connate for 3 mm above the common tube with the petals, the anthers narrowly triangular, 3.5 mm long, recurved toward apex; ovary slenderly ovoid, the stigma subsessile, 3-parted.

description: Plant flowering 3 dm high. Leaves rosulate; blades attenuate, pungent, 18 cm long, 1 cm wide, laxly serrate with curved spines 3 mm long and 4-6 mm apart. Scape slender, 27 cm long, glabrous; scape-bracts shorter than the internodes, amplexicaul at base. Inflorescence simple, 5-10 cm long; rhachis furfuraceous. Floral bracts suborbicular, apiculate, shorter than the sepals, nerved, lepidote; flowers sessile. Sepals suborbicular, broadly rounded, 6 mm long, 8-10 mm wide; petals 14 mm long, the tube with the stamens 3 mm high, the blade rhombic, rounded at apex, erect; stamens slightly exserted, high-connate above the common tube; anthers slightly recurved, 3-3.5 mm long; ovary pyramidal, 5 mm high; style 6 mm long; ovules with a semiorbicular wing.

description: Plant flowering 25-75 cm high. Leaves 20-35 cm long; sheaths suborbicular, large; blades triangular, pungent and abruptly acute with thickened apices, channeled, rigid, thick, densely pale-lepidote especially beneath, laxly serrate with curved spines 2 mm long. Scape rather stout, tomentulose, then glabrous; scape-bracts equaling or exceeding the internodes, broadly ovate with long acuminate serrulate apices. Inflorescence simple, usually lax at anthesis and many-flowered, 7-35 cm long, white-furfuraceous. Floral bracts spreading or reflexed, like the scape-bracts, the lowest equaling or exceeding the flowers, usually serrulate; pedicels distinct, to 4 mm long; flowers spreading or reflexed. Sepals broadly elliptic, acute, 7-9 mm long; petals 11-14 mm long, exceeding the stamens, the blades suborbicular, carinate, suberect; filaments connate for 2 mm above the common tube with the petals, the anthers narrowly triangular, acuminate, recurved; styles 3, very short; ovules with broad vexilliform wings.

description: Leaves to 15 dm long, relatively long and narrow. Inflorescence mostly compound. Sepals 3-4 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 0.4-2 m high. Leaves 2-15 dm long, sheaths inconspicuous, scarcely wider than the blades; blades narrowly triangular, 15-30 mm wide, pale-lepidote especially beneath but often becoming glabrous, typically subdensely serrate with spines 6 mm long but varying gradually to entire. Scape erect, slender, glabrous at maturity; scape-bracts ovate with long acuminate pungent blades, at least the highest shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence few-branched or rarely simple, to 8 dm long, many-flowered, soon glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, small, usually shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading, densely flowered, 6-26 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate or suborbicular, apiculate, 2 mm long, much exceeded by the sepals; flowers subsessile, 6-13 mm long. Sepals suborbicular, 3-6 mm long; petals obovate, suberect, ecarinate, orange; stamens exserted or about equaling the petals, the filaments free above the short common tube with the petals; style nearly the same length as the ovary.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high (?). Leaves over 3 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate to an abruptly acute pungent apex, 15 mm wide, pale-lepidote between the nerves on both sides, very laxly serrate with slender spreading mostly recurved spines 4 mm long. Scape 3 mm in diameter at apex, minutely pale-lepidote at the nodes; scape-bracts ovate, acuminate, the upper remote. Inflorescence subsimple with a short 2-flowered branch at base, lax, covered with ferruginous stellate appressed scales but the flexuous axis soon largely glabrous. Floral bracts reflexed, the lower ovate, acuminate, 11 mm long, nearly equaling the sepals, the upper suborbicular, apiculate, about half as long as the sepals; pedicels stout, 3 mm long; flowers spreading. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 8 mm long, erose; petals to 13 mm long, the blades broadly obovate, emarginate, ecarinate; stamens included, filaments free above the common tube with the petals; anthers narrowly triangular, nearly straight, 3 mm long; style simple, 2 mm long.

description: Flowering over 2 m high. Leaves many in a spreading rosette, ca. 6 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, dark castaneous, glabrous; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, pungent, to 4 cm wide, thick, rigid, glabrous above, minutely pale-lepidote between the nerves beneath with internerves very deep and narrow, very laxly serrate with broad curved spines 3-5 mm long. Scape straight, to, 2 cm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper narrowly triangular, much reduced. Inflorescence amply tripinnate with branches to 25 cm long, densely tomentose-lepidote; primary bracts inconspicuous; spikes many-flowered, subdense. Floral bracts spreading to reflexed, scarcely 3 mm long, subulate-acuminate from a broad base; flowers perfect and unisexual, suberect to spreading, very short-pedicellate. Sepals broadly ovate, acute, 5 mm long, densely brown-furfuraceous; petals obtuse, 7 mm long; stamens exserted, the filaments free above the very short common tube with the petals; style longer than the ovary. Seed oblong with a narrow lateral wing widened at the ends.

description: Plant flowering 1 m or higher. Leaves in a dense rosette, to 20 cm long; sheaths short, suborbicular; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, pungent, densely lepidote beneath, laxly repand-serrate with curved spines 2 mm long. Scape subangular, densely ferruginous-flocculose toward apex; scape-bracts erect, the lower foliaceous and imbricate, the upper shorter than the internodes, lance-ovate with long narrowly triangular serrulate blades. Inflorescence racemose or paniculate, ferruginous-flocculose; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, much shorter than the long compressed bases of the branches. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, finely serrate, slightly exceeding the stout 5 mm long pedicels; flowers suberect or sometimes spreading and secund. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 6 mm long; petals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 9 mm long, exceeding the stamens, yellow; filaments connate for 2 mm above the common tube with the petals; ovary 4.5 mm long, style 1.5 mm long.

description: Plant flowering about 4 dm high. Leaves 25 cm long; sheaths suborbicular, 3 cm long, stramineous; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, to a fine rigid point, 15 mm wide, laxly serrate with retrorsely uncinate spines 1.5 mm long, covered beneath with appressed whitish (appearing ferruginous from soil) scales, smooth and glabrous above. Scape very short, finely ferruginous-lepidote; scape-bracts long-acuminate from an ovate base, subentire, the uppermost much shorter than the internode. Inflorescence simple, laxly many-flowered, 25 cm long, finely ferruginous-lepidote except the petals. Floral bracts like the scape-bracts, entire, the lowest exceeding the sepals; pedicels spreading, slenderly cylindric, to 10 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, rounded or apiculate, 7 mm long, strongly convex, the posterior more or less carinate; petals 14 mm long, orange (! E. Pereira), the blades broadly rhombic, carinate; stamens included; filaments almost wholly connate; styles 3, very short.

description: Plant flowering 8 dm high. Leaves rosulate, 25 cm long; sheaths suborbicular, 3 cm in diameter, glabrous; blades linear-triangular, 15 mm wide, covered on both sides with white appressed scales, laxly serrulate with acicular teeth 1 mm long. Scape 4 mm in diameter, sparsely pale-lepidote; scape-bracts broadly ovate, thin, abruptly contracted into a linear-triangular apex, all but the lowest several times shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, lax, sparsely pale-lepidote; rhachis slender, flexuous. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, to 6 mm long; flowers spreading or divergent; pedicels cylindric, stout, 2-4 mm long. Sepals ovate, obtuse, 7 mm long, ecarinate, rather fleshy; petals 10 mm long, the blades erect, elliptic, ecarinate, dark blackish orange externally; stamens included; filaments free above the short common tube with the petals; stigmas subsessile.

description: Plant flowering 3 dm high, caulescent; stem stout, probably short. Leaves rosulate at the summit of the stem, spreading; sheaths ample, over 3 cm in diameter; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, 6-8 cm long, 14 mm wide, covered beneath with appressed cinereous scales, soon glabrous above, laxly serrate with dark nearly straight spines 1.5 mm long. Scape lateral, very slender, glabrous; scape-bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, shorter than the internodes, serrulate, the highest 7 mm long. Inflorescence simple, 4555 mm long, laxly 10-flowered, glabrous. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, about equaling the pedicels; pedicels slender, 5 mm long; flowers spreading or reflexed. Sepals oblong-elliptic, broadly obtuse, strongly convex, 5 mm long; petals 7 mm long, reddish drying to golden yellow, forming a tube 0.5 mm long with the filaments; stamens included, free above the common tube; stigmas subsessile.

description: Plant flowering to 8 dm high, very slender. Leaves (inner) to 10 cm long; blades linear, covered on both faces with pale appressed scales, laxly serrulate. Scape very slender, glabrous; scape-bracts small, remote, broadly ovate, acuminate, membranaceous, reddish. Inflorescence simple, lax, to 9 cm long, subglabrous; rhachis straight, slender. Floral bracts like the scape-bracts but apiculate, shorter than to barely exceeding the pedicels; flowers suberect to spreading; pedicels slender, 4-5 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 8-9 mm long; petals to 12 mm long, orange-yellow when dry, the blades broad; stamens slightly exserted, the filaments high-connate above the common tube with the petals; style slender, 2 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 4 dm or higher. Leaves 40-55 cm long; sheaths suborbicular, 5 cm long, dark castaneous; blades sublinear, 1 cm wide, covered beneath with brown or whitish strongly appressed scales, laxly serrate toward base with slender curved spines 1.5 mm long. Scape very slender, glabrous; scape-bracts remote, ovate, acuminate, entire. Inflorescence simple, subdense, many-flowered, completely glabrous. Floral bracts spreading to reflexed, triangular-ovate, exceeding the pedicels but much shorter than the sepals; pedicels rather slender, to 7 mm long; flowers spreading at anthesis, then erect. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, to 8 mm long; petals ca. 15 mm long, exceeding the stamens, the blades suberect, narrowly elliptic, obtuse, carinate; filaments free above the common tube with the petals, the anthers linear, mucronulate, nearly straight; style about 1/3 as long as the ovary.

description: Plant flowering 7-8 dm high. Leaf (only one known) 24 cm long; sheath suborbicular, 35 mm wide, stramineous at base, dark brown and densely serrulate at apex; blade narrowly triangular, curved, 15 mm wide, pungent, laxly serrate with antrorse and retrorse uncinate slender brown spines 2 mm long, covered on both sides with pale appressed scales. Scape nearly straight, 3 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts (except the lowest) triangular, small, remote, finely serrulate. Inflorescence depauperately compound with 1 or 2 small suberect lateral branches, to 25 cm long, lax, covered with pale appressed scales except for the petals; rhachis slender, flexuous, compressed. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, 6 mm long, the lowest serrulate and slightly exceeding the pedicels; flowers secund; pedicels rather stout but distinct, to 5 mm long in fruit. Sepals ovate, broadly acute and apiculate, 7 mm long, sulcate; petals 12 mm long, orange, the blade elliptic-rhombic, obtuse, carinate; stamens included, filaments free above the 4 mm common tube; style ca 1 mm long. Capsule subglobose, 15 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 5-15 dm high, very variable but with a gradual transition between the extremes. Leaves 4-10 dm long; sheaths persistent and forming a thick bulb, broadly ovate to suborbicular, 4 cm wide; blades arching, narrowly triangular, long-attenuate, 1-3 cm wide, densely white-lepidote on both faces or soon glabrous above, laxly repand-serrate with slender curved spines 3-4.5 mm long. Scape very slender, minutely lepidote or glabrous; scape-bracts small, many times shorter than the internodes, very broadly ovate, apiculate, entire. Inflorescence simple or few-branched, 12-16 cm long; axis sparsely lepidote or glabrous; primary bracts inconspicuous. Floral bracts spreading, very broadly ovate, abruptly contracted to an acuminate point, 3-8(-12) mm long, much exceeded by the sepals; flowers suberect to spreading, 13-23 mm long, on very short stout pedicels. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 6-12 mm long, more or less carinate, even, soon glabrous; petals erect, red-orange, the blade broad, obtuse or emarginate, minutely crenulate; stamens usually exserted, filaments free above the common tube with the petals, the anthers acute, mucronate, recurved; style distinct and sometimes long or partially divided.

description: Plant flowering often 1 m high. Leaves to 4 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, 12-16 mm wide, sublepidote beneath and green-canescent or sometimes fuscescent, laxly serrate with slender spines 1-2 mm long. Scape ca. 5 mm in diameter, lepidote or finally glabrous; scape-bracts broadly ovate with long narrowly triangular blades, equaling or exceeding the internodes, serrulate. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered, minutely and fugaciously lepidote. Floral bracts suberect to spreading, suborbicular with long narrowly triangular blades, exceeding the lowest flowers and all the sepals, fimbriate-serrulate; pedicels 1-2 mm long, stout; flowers erect or suberect, to 12 mm long, orange. Sepals ovate, broadly subacute or rounded, mucronulate or obtuse, 6-9 mm long, slightly fimbriate; petals erect, slightly exceeding the sepals, the blades broadly obovate, obtuse, slightly undulate, subcarinate; stamens included, filaments connate for 7 mm above the common tube with the petals, the anthers narrowly triangular, recurved; style very short; ovules broadly winged.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plant flowering to 2.25 m high. Leaves 6-7 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 4 cm long, castaneous with pale margins; blades linear-triangular, pungent, 20-25 mm wide, laxly serrate with brown spines 2 mm long, covered with appressed whitish scales on both sides, becoming partially glabrous above. Scape lateral, 10 mm wide, pale-lepidote, becoming glabrous; lower scape-bracts subfoliaceous, the upper narrowly triangular from a broadly ovate base, much shorter than the internodes, serrulate. Inflorescence laxly few-branched, 1 m long, finely cinereous-lepidote, becoming glabrous with age; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, much shorter than the sterile bracteate bases of the branches; branches suberect, slightly flexuous, slender, elongate. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, mostly shorter than the pedicels; flowers lax, secund, curved-ascending; pedicels slender, to 5 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 6-8 mm long; petals 9 mm long (at least), the blade suberect, broadly obovate; stamens included; filaments connate above the common tube; stigmas subsessile. Capsules ovoid, acute, 15 mm long; seeds with a broad rounded subfalcate wing.

description: Plant flowering to 1 m high. Leaves very numerous in a spreading rosette; blades very narrowly triangular, to 56 cm long, 18 mm wide, subrigid, covered beneath with closely appressed pale cinereous scales, soon glabrous above, laxly serrate with black antrorse curved 2 mm long spines. Scape erect, 5 mm in diameter, densely ferruginous-lanate; scape-bracts densely imbricate, narrowly triangular from a broadly ovate base, serrulate, ferruginous-lanate. Inflorescence simple, densely many-flowered, ca. 3 dm long, densely ferruginous-lanate. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, serrulate, mostly exceeding the flowers; pedicels stout, compressed, 5 mm long. Sepals ovate, acuminate, 10 mm long, the posterior ones alate-carinate; petals 15 mm long, the blade subrhombic; stamens included, filaments free above the junction with the petals; stigmas subsessile.

description: Plant flowering 3-4 dm high, the base bulbous from dead leaf-sheaths, 6-8 long. Leaves 20-35 cm long; sheaths broad, glabrous, brown and lustrous beneath; blades linear-triangular, filiform-attenuate, 15 mm wide, covered on both sides with whitish appressed scales, laxly serrate with spreading or ascending acicular spines 3 mm long. Scape 30-60 cm long, slender, striate, glabrous; scape-bracts long-acuminate from a triangular-ovate base, serrate like the leaves, the lower 6-7 cm long, exceeding the internodes, the upper 2 cm long, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, lax, 3-7-flowered, more or less lepidote including the petals; lower floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, the upper triangular-ovate, filiform-attenuate, shorter, entire; pedicels 7-11 mm long; flowers erect to spreading. Sepals oblong-ovate, obtuse, 10-12 mm long, finely fimbriate-serrulate; petals erect, 22-28 mm long, elliptic-oblong, subacute or obtuse, red to flavous, the common tube with the stamens less than 1 mm high; stamens 10 mm longer than the petals, free above the common tube; anthers linear, subsagittate at base, strongly recurved; ovary conic, 10 mm high; style single, 25 mm long, divided near apex. Capsule stout ovoid, long-beaked, 20 mm long, 14 mm in diameter; seeds 4 mm long, bearing a dorsal falciform hyaline wing.

description: Plant flowering 1 m high. Leaves 3_4 dm long; blades rigid, narrowly triangular, 22 mm wide, sinuate-serrate with spines 4 mm long, glabrous above, cinereous-lepidote beneath. Scape glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lowest foliaceous, the median 25 mm long, the upper 15 mm long, about a third as long as the internodes, serrate. Inflorescence paniculate, few-6-branched, subglabrous or sparsely lanate toward apex; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches ascending, laxly flowered. Floral bracts triangular, recurved, shorter than the sepals, pungent, serrate; pedicels to 5 mm long but usually about 3 mm; flowers suberect to reflexed. Sepals broadly elliptic, rounded, entire, 7-9 mm long, 4 mm wide, coriaceous, glabrous; petals 14 mm long, 8 mm wide, ecarinate with undulate margins; stamens included; filaments free above the short tube with the petals; style distinct, 2 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 3.5-15 (! Burchell) dm high; rhizome short, erect, very stout, starchy, covered with old leaf-bases. Leaves many, usually erect, 13-32 cm long; sheaths oblong, scarcely wider than the blades; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, pungent, 10-15 (-30) mm wide, finely puberulent-lepidote beneath when young but soon glabrous, laxly serrate with slender spreading nearly straight spines 2 mm long. Scape slender, glabrous; scape-bracts many times shorter than the internodes, ovate, acumiante or apiculate, entire or serrulate. Inflorescence simple, lax, few- to many-flowered, glabrous. Floral bracts spreading, ovate, acuminate or apiculate, entire, the lowest about equaling the sepals to exceeding flowers, serrulate; pedicels short; flowers spreading at anthesis, then erect. Sepals triangular-ovate, broadly acute, obtuse or apiculate, carinate, 6-8 mm long; petals narrowly elliptic without a distinct blade, 7-10 mm long, yellow; stamens included, the filaments completely connate, the anthers short, linear, subobtuse, straight; styles very short; ovules with large lateral vexilliform falcate wings.

description: Plant flowering scarcely 5 dm high, slender. Leaves to 14 cm long; sheaths ample, 3 cm long; blades narrowly triangular, ca 1 cm wide, covered with pale appressed scales beneath, very laxly serrate with slender spines 2 mm long. Scape slender, glabrous; scape-bracts many times shorter than the internodes, ovate with narrowly triangular apices, entire, the central ones only 7 mm long. Inflorescence simple, very lax, sparsely lepidote. Floral bracts spreading or reflexed, ovate, acuminate, much shorter than the sepals; pedicels to 3 mm long; flowers spreading at anthesis, 12 mm long. Sepals ovate, apiculate, 6 mm long; petals much exceeding the stamens, the blades erect, broadly obovate, obtuse, slightly carinate; filaments free above the common tube with the petals, the anthers linear, apiculate, slightly recurved; style about 1/3 as long as the ovary.

description: Plant subacaulescent, flowering 4-5 dm high. Leaves 10-12 cm long, usually entire but very rarely with a few teeth; sheaths large, suborbicular, almost black; blades narrowly triangular, 2 cm wide, thick, rigid, pungent, glabrous above, covered beneath with cinereous appressed scales. Scape stout, to 6 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, the upper ones much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly racemose, many-flowered, glabrous. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, the lower ones exceeding the pedicels; pedicels slenderly clavate, spreading, frequently curved upward, to 14 mm long; flowers green. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, erose, 9 mm long; petals broadly elliptic without a distinct claw, obtuse, 11 mm long, barely exceeding the stamens; filaments free above the very short common tube with the petals; style simple, short but distinct; capsule ovoid, short-beaked, about equaling the sepals.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves numerous in a dense spreading rosette, ca 15 cm long; blades narrowly triangular, over 15 mm wide at base, covered with appressed cinereous scales on both sides, subdensely serrate with spreading slender spines. Scape erect, slender, about 3 times as long as the leaves; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes but divergent, very narrowly triangular and wholly exposing the scape, serrulate, red. Inflorescence laxly subtripinnate with branches to 30 cm long, densely cinereous-lepidote; primary bracts inconspicuous; spikes many-flowered, subdense to lax. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, 5 mm long, much exceeded by the sepals; flowers short-pedicellate, suberect to spreading and sometimes slightly secund. Sepals ovate, broadly subacute, 4.5 mm long; petals spatulate, obtuse, 7 mm long, yellow; stamens included, free above the 1 mm tube with the petals; style slender, elongate, Capsule 8 mm long; seed with a narrow apically pointed wing.

description: Plant known only from fragments, flowering 1.5 m high (!Hatschbach). Leaves to 85 cm long; sheaths inconspicuous; blades linear-triangular, pungent, 45 mm wide, laxly serrate with antrorse uncinate dark spines 7 mm long, covered beneath with white appressed scales, initially or soon glabrous above. Scape (upper) slender, ferruginous-tomentose; scape-bracts imbricate, linear-triangular from an ovate base, serrulate. Inflorescence simple, sublax, 4 dm long, many-flowered, ferruginous-tomentulose except the petals. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, the lowest slightly exceeding the pedicels, serrulate; pedicels spreading, straight, slender, to 10 mm long. Sepals ovate, acute, 8 mm long, carinate; petals 14 mm long, the blades subrhombic, curved-spreading; stamens included; filaments free above the common tube; styles 3, to 2 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 5 dm high. Leaves to 3 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, 20-25 mm wide, covered beneath with closely appressed pale cinereous scales, serrate with spines 4 mm long. Scape very slender, glabrous; scape-bracts remote, very broadly ovate with a short acuminate apex, entire. Inflorescence simple, lax, few-flowered, minutely furfuraceous. Floral bracts reflexed, suborbicular-ovate, apiculate, ca. 4 mm long, much shorter than the sepals; flowers suberect, subsessile, slender. Sepals very broadly elliptic, emarginate, 7-9 mm long, nearly glabrous; petals 14-18 mm long, equaling or slightly shorter than the stamens, the blades erect, obovate, rounded, scarcely if at all carinate; stamens connate above the common tube with the petals; anthers linear, acute, strongly recurved; style 2-3 times shorter than the ovary.

description: Plant flowering to 2.5 m high. Leaves lacking (but judging from the lower scape-bracts) narrowly triangular, pungent, very laxly spinose-serrate, covered on both sides with appressed whitish scales at least at first. Scape stout, soon glabrous; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, the lower presumably foliaceous, the upper ovate with a long narrowly triangular apex, serrulate. Inflorescence laxly compound, 1 m long, finely cinereous-lepidote at first; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, to 7 cm long; main axis stout; lateral branches suberect, slender, slightly flexuous, to 5 dm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, serrulate, the lower long-acuminate and exceeding the flowers, the upper apiculate and shorter than the sepals; pedicels suberect, stout but distinct, to 4 mm long (fruit). Sepals broadly deltoid-ovate, to 6 mm long, equally wide, ecarinate, persistently lepidote; petals 10-12 mm long, orange, the blade spreading, elliptic, rounded, carinate, about equaling the stamens; filaments short-connate above the common tube; style distinct, 1 mm long.

description: Plant flowering about 1 m high. Leaves about 1 m long; sheaths reniform, 9 cm wide, dark castaneous; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, 35 mm wide, very closely appressed-lepidote beneath, pale or glaucescent, the outer serrate with spines 2-5 mm long. Scape lateral, ascending, stout, lepidote when young; scape-bracts sparse, exceeding the internodes or the upper shorter, acute from a broadly ovate base, minutely serrulate. Inflorescence amply paniculate, many-flowered, subferruginous-tomentellous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, usually shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading, to 3 dm long, subdense toward apex. Floral bracts broadly ovate, abruptly acute, shorter than the flowers, the lower serrulate; pedicels distinct, to 3 mm long; flowers 11-18 mm long. Sepals ovate, acute, 5-8 mm long, carinate, fimbriate; petals yellow or pale yellow, the blade subovate, rounded, undulate, strongly carinate, spreading-recurved; stamens much shorter than the petals, free above the common tube with the petals; anthers broadly truncate at base, attenuate, strongly recurved; styles conglutinated, 4-5 times shorter than the ovary; ovule with a very large semiorbicular acute wing.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Leaf-blades 8-10 mm wide, repand-serrate with recurved spines 2-3 mm long. Scape slender. Inflorescence dense to lax. Sepals 6 mm long.

description: Plants aggregated, flowering 1-4.5 dm high. Leaves many in a dense flat rosette, arching-recurved, 9-17 cm long; sheaths suborbicular; blades narrowly triangular, 8-12 mm wide, serrate with recurved or antrorse spines 2-4 mm long, covered on both sides with a cinereous membrane of fused scales. Scape sparsely flocculose; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes or the upper slightly shorter, lanceolate, acuminate, serrulate, densely lepidote. Inflorescence simple, 3.5-13 cm long, densely lepidote. Floral bracts like the scape-bracts, the lowest about equaling the flowers, serrulate; flowers suberect or spreading; pedicels distinct, nearly 2 mm long. Sepals ovate, acute, 6-9 mm long, carinate, ferruginous-lepidote; petals 8-10 mm long, orange, the blades spreading, rhombic; stamens included, the filaments short-connate above the common tube with the petals; style very short.

description: Plant flowering 6-10 dm high. Leaves 2-10 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 3-6 cm long, pale, glabrous; blades attenuate to a pungent apex, 25 mm wide, covered with white or cinereous scales especially beneath, laxly serrate with curved spines 4-6 mm long. Scape elongate, 5-8 mm in diameter at apex, glabrescent; scape-bracts shorter than the internodes, broadly triangular-ovate, acuminate, thin. Inflorescence paniculate, lax, many-flowered, lepidote at least at anthesis; primary bracts ovate, apiculate, small and inconspicuous; branches subspreading, slightly flexuous, laxly to densely flowered. Floral bracts ovate-triangular, acute or apiculate, much exceeded by the sepals; pedicels very short at anthesis, to 4 mm long in fruit; flowers divergent to spreading, orange. Sepals broad, rounded, obtuse or apiculate, 7 mm long, strongly convex; petals obovate-elliptic, broadly rounded and emarginate, 10-14 mm long, forming a very short ring with the stamens, undulate, carinate; stamens slightly exserted, free above the common tube; anthers sublinear, acute, more or less recurved; styles free, very short; ovules with a short lateral falciform-incurved wing.

description: Plant flowering 1 m or higher. Leaves often 8 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 5 cm long, castaneous, glabrous, blades narrowly triangular, 25 mm wide, densely and coarsely repand-serrate with teeth 10 mm long, covered with subappressed whitish scales, becoming glabrous above. Scape stout, ferruginous-tomentulose or in age glabrous; lower scape-bracts foliaceous, imbricate, the upper linear-lanceolate, entire. Inflorescence simple, dense or more or less interrupted, many-flowered, densely ferruginous-tomentulose; rhachis stout. Floral bracts divergent to spreading, narrowly triangular, to 7 mm long, shorter than the sepals; flowers on very short pedicels, suberect to spreading. Sepals ovate, broadly rounded, 7-8.5 mm long; petals 10-14 mm long, yellowish green, thE blades broadly elliptic, obtuse, ecarinate, suberect, ferruginous-tomentulose outside; stamens about equaling the petals, the filaments free above the very short common tube with the petals, the anthers linear, obtuse, scarcely recurved; ovary sparsely lepidote, style about the same length.

description: Flowering 6 dm high. Leaves 2-5 dm or longer, sheaths suborbicular, ca. 3 cm long; blades narrowly triangular, 8-20 mm wide, covered beneath with pale closely appressed scales, laxly serrate with acicular antrorse or retrorse spines 4-6 mm long. Scape slender, cinereous-tomentose, soon glabrous; scape-bracts shorter than the internodes, very broadly ovate, abruptly acute, entire. Inflorescence simple or few-branched, lax, cinereous-tomentose to glabrous; primary bracts scarcely larger than the floral bracts; lateral branches short. Floral bracts spreading or reflexed, suborbicular-ovate, obtuse or apiculate, much shorter than the sepals, subglabrous; flowers subsessile. Sepals very broadly elliptic, very broadly rounded at apex, 5-7 mm long, subglabrous; petals to 12 mm long, the blades suberect, subrhombic, rounded, scarcely undulate, little if at all carinate; stamens shorter than the petals; filaments free above the common tube with the petals; anthers triangular, subacute, strongly recurved at apex; styles 3, very short.

description: Plant stout, probably flowering over 1 m high. Leaves over 7 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, 45 mm wide, punctulate and sublustrous above, beneath striate and very finely appressed-white-lepidote, armed with slightly curved spines to 9 mm long and 2-3 cm apart. Scape stout, glabrous; upper scape-bracts much shorter than the internodes, broadly ovate, acute, 15-20 mm long. Inflorescence lax, few-branched, glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, distinctly shorter than the sterile prophyllate bases of the branches; branches densely flowered above, the lateral ones subspreading, to 16 cm long, the terminal one nearly 6 dm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, except for the lowest exceeded by the sepals; flowers subsessile, flavous. Sepals suborbicular, 6 mm long, pale margined when dry; petals elliptic, obtuse, not unguiculate, 11-13 mm long, pale-margined when dry; stamens long-exserted, slightly exceeding the style, the filaments free above the 1 mm long tube, the anthers straight 3.5 mm long; style slender, longer than the ovary; seeds narrowly winged.

description: Plant flowering 1 m or higher. Leaves about 3 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, over 2 cm wide, laxly serrate with spines 1 mm long, sparsely appressed-lepidote beneath. Scape stout, soon glabrous; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, broad with narrowly triangular pungent serrulate blades. Inflorescence simple, lax, densely furfuraceous. Floral bracts reflexed, broadly ovate, the lower acuminate, 20 mm long, exceeding the flowers; flowers spreading or subreflexed, ca 14 mm long, the pedicels conspicuous but less than 5 mm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, ca 9 mm long; petals much exceeding the stamens, the blades suberect, trapeziform, carinate, slightly undulate; filaments free above the common tube with the petals or short-connate, the anthers 3 mm long, strongly spirally reflexed; style very short; ovules with asymmetrical wings.

description: Plant flowering nearly 1 m high. Leaves to 4 dm long; sheaths broadly ovate; blades narrowly triangular, ca 15 mm wide, covered with pale appressed scales beneath, serrate with stout straight or curved spines 6 mm long. Scape slender, soon glabrous; scape-bracts much shorter than the internodes, the upper ovate-triangular, ca 1 cm long. Inflorescence simple, very lax, few-flowered, soon glabrous. Floral bracts spreading or subreflexed, ovate-triangular, shorter than the sepals; flowers suberect, subsessile, 11 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 7-8 mm long; petals exceeding the stamens, the blades suberect, broadly obovate, obscurely carinate; filaments free above the common tube with the petals, the anthers triangular, acute, straight or slightly recurved; styles 3, very short.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plant probably flowering over 1 m high. Leaves to 4 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, large; blades narrowly triangular, 17 mm wide, subglabrous and green beneath, laxly serrate with spines 4 mm long. Scape stout, 5 dm high, soon glabrous; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, equaling or exceeding the internodes, sparsely serrulate. Inflorescence laxly paniculate, narrow, many-flowered, tomentulose but soon glabrous; primary bracts much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches elongate, laxly flowered. Floral bracts reflexed, broadly ovate, acute, finely serrate, shorter than the flowers but the lowest about equaling the sepals; flowers short-pedicellate, spreading or reflexed, 12 mm long. Sepals elliptic, broadly rounded, 7 mm long, glabrous; petals erect, much exceeding the stamens, orange, the blade large, suborbicular, neither carinate nor undulate when dry; filaments free above the common tube with the petals, the anthers short, subtriangular, apiculate, scarcely recurved; style 1/3 as long as the ovary or even shorter; ovules with large hatchet-shaped wings.

description: Plant flowering about 1 m high. Leaves barely 5 dm long; blades sublinear, long-attenuate to an acicular apex, 15 mm wide, subdensely ferruginous-lepidote beneath, serrate with spines 2.5-3 mm long. Scape to 7 mm in diameter, glabrous at maturity; scape-bracts ovate, the lower linear-laminate, the upper long-acuminate and shorter than the internodes, fimbriate-serrulate. Inflorescence paniculate from a few branches, rather many-flowered; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, inconspicuous; branches mostly elongate, laxly flowered, cinereous-furfuraceous. Floral bracts spreading or reflexed, triangular-ovate, acute to acuminate, equaling the middle of the sepals; flowers spreading or suberect at anthesis, to 18 mm long, orange; pedicels obconic, 3 mm long. Sepals ovate-elliptic, abruptly acute, 7 mm long, carinate, furfuraceous toward base; petals 14 mm long, the blade elliptic-rhombic, obtuse and inflexed, undulate, carinate, suberect; stamens distinctly shorter than the petals, filaments free above the common tube with the petals; anthers sagittate, sublinear, recurved at apex; style very short; ovules with a large falciform acute dorsal wing.

description: Arbol(?), ramas jóvenes pubérulas, lenticeladas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos 5; raquis 5-7 cm de largo, pubérulo o glabrescente. Folíolos 4.5-11 cm de largo, 1.5-4 cm de ancho, elípticos o levemente obovado-elípticos, coriáceos, haz oscura, glabra, envés claro, subopaco, glabro, nervadura central glabra en la haz, pubérula en el envés, base cuneado-atenuada, ápice agudo o subagudo; venación reticulada, promínula en el envés; nervaduras laterales 8-10 pares, prominentes en el envés, ascendentes, anastomosadas cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar o pseudoterminal; raquila 13-25 cm de longitud, pubérula; brácteas en la base de la inflorescencia hasta de 0.6 cm de largo, vellosas, ápice circinado, con aspecto de hojas reducidas. Pedicelos cortos; sépalos 3.5 mm de largo, 2.5 mm de ancho, ovados, agudos, densamente pubérulos; pétalos 6 mm de largo, 2.5 mm de ancho. Fruto desconocido.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Bejuco, ramas jóvenes pubérulas o glabrescentes, lenticeladas. Hojas impari-pinadas; foliolos 5-9; pecíolo 2-6 cm de largo, diminutamente pubérulo; raquis 3.5-11 cm de largo, diminutamente pubérulo. Foliolos (2.5-)3-12 cm de largo, (1.2-) 1.5-6 cm de ancho, elípticos u oblongo-elípticos, coriáceos, haz opaca, glabra, envés claro, opaco, subglauco, con papilas bien desarrolladas, pubérulo, pelos adpresos, paralelos, brillantes, base redondeada, ápice acuminado, margen marcadamente revoluto; peciólulo 0.2-0.5 cm de largo; venación fuertemente reticulada, plana o promínula en la haz, prominente en el envés; nervaduras laterales 5-8 pares, formando ángulos de 60-80° con la nervadura central, anastomosadas más o menos claramente cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar a pseudoterminal; raquila 8-14 cm de largo, densamente ferrugíneo-tomentosa; brácteas 0.1 cm de largo. Flores sésiles o pedicelo de 0.1 cm de largo, articulado; sépalos 2.5-3 mm de largo, anchamente ovados, agudos, densamente tomentosos; pétalos 6 mm de largo, 2.5-3 mm de ancho, oblongo-obovados, glabros, libres; filamentos unidos por 0.5 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 1 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos ca. 0.5 mm de longitud; anteras globosas; ovario piloso-lanado; estilo glabro. Fruto 1.2 cm de largo, 0.6 cm de ancho, recto, inmaduro pubérulo, maduro glabro; fruto sésil o pedúnculo 0.1 cm de largo; cáliz en fruto 0.5 cm de largo, pubérulo. Semilla 0.8 cm de largo, 0.3 cm de ancho; ariloide 0.3 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbusto o bejuco leñoso, ramas jóvenes estriadas, densamente pubérulas a densamente tomentosas, inconspicuamente lenticeladas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos (3-)5-9; pecíolo 1-7 cm de largo, tomentoso; raquis 2-8 cm de largo, tomentoso. Folíolos 3-12 cm de largo, 1.9-7 cm de ancho, constantemente obo-vados, raramente elípticos u obovado-elípticos, cartáceos a rígido-cartáceos, haz oscura, algo brillante u opaca, glabra, nervadura central y nervaduras laterales pubérulas, envés claro, opaco, tomentoso, los pelos adpresos, paralelos, base redondeada o atenuada, ápice acuminado; peciólulo 0.1-0.3 cm de largo, densamente tomentoso; venación reticulada, promínula en ambas caras, nervadura central impresa en la haz, prominente en el envés; nervaduras laterales 4-6 pares, ascendentes, formando ángulos de 40-60° con la nervadura central, difusamente anastomosadas cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar; raquila 7-10 cm de largo, tomentosa; brácteas 0.1-0.2 cm de largo. Pedicelos no articulados u oscuramente articulados, 0.3-0.5 cm de largo; sépalos 2-2.5 mm de largo, 1-1.5 mm de ancho, ovados, densamente gris-tomentosos exteriormente, densamente tomentosos interiormente, agudos; pétalos 4 mm de largo, 1 mm de ancho, glabros, libres; filamentos cortamente unidos, 5 más largos ca. 3 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos ca. 2 mm de longitud; anteras globosas; ovario piloso; estilo glabro. Fruto 1.3 cm de largo, glabrescente; cáliz en fruto 0.3 cm de largo, pubérulo. Semilla 1 cm de largo, 0.6 cm de ancho; ariloide 0.3 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbusto, ramas jóvenes vellosas. Hojas imparipinadas; foliolos 3-7; raquis 5.5-6.5 cm de largo, velloso. Foliolos 3-8 cm de largo, 1.7-3 cm de ancho, elípticos, membranosos o subcartáceos, haz oscura, esparcidamente pilosa, envés claro, opaco, velloso sobre la nervadura central y las nervaduras laterales, base atenuada, cuneada u obtusa, oblicua en los foliolos laterales, ápice agudo; peciólulo 0.1-0.2 cm de largo; venación reticulada, impresa o difusa en la haz, prominente en el envés; nervaduras laterales 5-6 pares, ascendentes, casi rectas, anastomosadas claramente cerca al margen. Inflorescencia una panícula reducida, terminal; raquila en floración 2.5-3 cm de largo, en fructificación 7-12 cm de largo, vellosa; brácteas 0.1-0.4 cm de largo, triangulares. Pedicelo articulado, 0.5-0.7 cm de largo, delgado, velloso, con pelos glandulosos; sépalos 5 mm de largo, 3 mm de ancho, elípticos, pubérulos, con pelos glandulosos esparcidos; pétalos 6-7 mm de largo, 2 mm de ancho, oblongos, glabros, connados por encima de la base; filamentos unidos por 0.8 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos ca. 4.5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos ca. 3-3.5 mm de longitud; anteras globosas; ovario piloso. Fruto (ex descr.) 1.3 cm de largo, 0.7 cm de ancho; cáliz en fruto 0.5 cm de largo, pubérulo, sépalos oblongo-lanceolados. Semilla 1.2 cm de largo, 0.6 cm de ancho; ariloide 0.2 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbol pequeño o bejuco leñoso, ramas jóvenes glabras, lenticeladas. Hojas imparipinadas, folíolos (l-)3(-5); pecíolo 1-7 cm de largo, glabro; raquis 2-5 cm de largo (raramente obsoleto), glabro. Foliolos 3.5-15 cm de largo, 2-7 cm de ancho, elípticos, rígido-coriáceos, brillantes y glabros en ambas caras, base obtusa, ápice acuminado, margen revoluto; peciólulo 0.4-0.6 cm de largo; venación re-ticulada, promínula o plana en la haz, promínula en el envés; nervaduras laterales 6-9 pares, formando ángulos de 50-70° con la nervadura central, claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar o pseudoter-minal; raquila 6-10 cm de largo, glabrescente; brácteas 0.2-0.4 cm de largo, carinadas, pilosas. Pedicelo articulado, 0.2-0.6 cm de largo; sépalos 2 mm de largo, 1.5 cm de ancho, ovado-lanceolados, glabros exteriormente, tomentosos interiormente, ápice barbado, margen ciliado; pétalos 3-5 mm de largo, 1.5 mm de ancho, glabros, libres; filamentos cortamente unidos, 5 más largos 2.5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 1.5 mm de longitud; anteras globosas; ovario piloso; estilo piloso en la base; estigma bilobulado. Fruto 1-1.2 cm de largo, glabro; pedúnculo 0.2-0.6 cm de largo; cáliz en el fruto 0.5 cm de largo, glabro. Semilla 0.8 cm de largo, 0.5 cm de ancho, ariloide 0.4 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Bejuco leñoso, ramas jóvenes cilindricas, diminutamente pubérulas a glabres-centes. Hojas imparipinadas; foliolos 5-9; pecíolo 1.5-4.5 cm de largo, diminutamente pubérulo o glabrescente; raquis 1.5-12 cm de largo, diminutamente pubérulo o glabro. Foliolos (2.5-)4-10 cm de largo, (1.5-)2-4 cm de ancho, elípticos o anchamente elípticos, cartáceos, haz oscura, opaca, glabra, envés claro, opaco, marrón, pubérulo, los pelos adpresos, paralelos, nervadura central pubérula, base atenuada, ápice cuspidado a caudado (0.5-2 cm de largo); peciólulo 0.3-0.6 cm de largo; venación reticulada, promínula en la haz y en el envés, nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 6-9 pares, formando ángulos de 60-80° con la nervadura central, anastomosadas claramente cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar; raquila 3-7 cm de larga, densamente pubérula, brácteas 0.1-0.2 cm de largo, pubérulas. Pedicelo articulado, (0.5-)0.6-0.8 cm de largo, densamente pubérulo; sépalos 4 mm de largo, 2-3 mm de ancho, anchamente ovados o suborbiculados, densamente pubérulos; pétalos 6-7 mm de largo, 2 mm de ancho, oblongo-obovados, glabros, libres; filamentos unidos por 0.5-1 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 4-4.5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 2-2.5 mm de longitud; anteras globosas, 0.5-0.7 mm de diámetro; ovario densamente piloso-lanado, estilo pubescente. Fruto desconocido.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbolito(?) de 3 m, ramas jóvenes cilindricas, esparcidamente pubérulas, inconspicuamente lenticeladas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos 11-23; pecíolo 0.51 cm de largo, pubérulo; raquis 2-9 cm de largo, pubérulo. Folíolos cartáceos, 0.5-2 cm de largo, 0.4-0.8 cm de ancho, rectangulares, el terminal obovado, haz glabra, oscura, brillante, envés opaco, claro, glabro, papilas ausentes, base obtusa o cordada, ápice obtuso o redondeado, margen revoluto; peciólulo 0.1 cm de largo; venación reticulada, difusa en ambas caras. Inflorescencia en panícula re-ducida(?). Flores desconocidas. Fruto uno por inflorescencia, 1 cm de largo, 0.30.4 cm de ancho, diminutamente pubérulo; cáliz en fruto 0.7 cm de largo, imbricado, diminutamente pubérulo, pelos glandulosos ausentes. Semilla 0.8 cm de largo; ariloide 0.2 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Hierbas de 4-11.5 cm de alto; tallos 2-4 cm de largo. Hojas en roseta, vinosas, patentes cuando viejas, 10-12 cm de largo; laminas obovado-oblongas, 4-7 × 1 mm, apices obtusos, superficie abaxial vi-losa, tricomas filamentosos; pecíolos 6-7 × 1 mm, superficie adaxial glabra, la abaxial vilosa, tricomas filamentosos; estipulas rectangulares, ca. 7 mm de largo, membranaceas, lacinias ca. 6 mm de largo. Inflorescencias 1-2, vinosas, 4-7 cm de largo, flores 24; pedunculos 3.5-6 cm de largo, viloso, tricomas filamentosos; pedicelos vinosos. Flores con sepalos 4 × 1.5 mm, superficie abaxial vilosa, tricomas filamentosos, lobulos oblongos; petalos blancos o róseos; estigmas 6, clavados. Semillas oblongas, testa reticulada.
bibliographicCitation: Correa A., Mireya D. & Santos Silva, T. R. 2005. Drosera (Droseraceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 96: 1-65.

description: Lianas, glabras; ramos novos subcilíndricos, lenticelados, secos marrons, velhos cilíndricos, sulcados, fissurados, cinzentos. Folhas opostas; estípulas não vistas; pecíolos 7-11 mm, secos marrons; lâminas (7.4-)12.8-18 × (2-)3.7-4 cm, elípticas, base cuneada, margem inteira, ápice acuminado e apiculado, papiráceas, secas cinza-esverdeadas na face adaxial, marrons na abaxial, nervuras secas de cor inconspícua em ambas as faces, promínulas em ambas as faces. Inflorescências 3.1 × 1.8 cm, tirsóide-paniculadas, ca 15 flores, axilares; pedúnculos nulos, ramos surgindo de um tufo de escamas triangulares, cilíndricos, opostos a alternos, brácteas inteiras; pedicelos ca 2.9 mm; bractéolas 2. Flores ca 4.6 mm diâm na antese, rotáceas; sépalas 0.8-0.9 × 1.2-1.3 mm, triangulares ou elípticas, erosas, mais ou menos carnosas, verdes; pétalas 1.9-2.1 × 2 mm, suborbiculares, deflexas, inteiras a erosas, mais ou menos carnosas, verdes; disco ca 0.3 mm alt., inteiro; estames ca 0.7 mm, filetes ca 0.5 mm, anteras ca 0.2 × 0.5 mm, oblongas, deiscência por fendas oblíquas em ângulo de ca 120°, conectivo inconspícuo, não proeminente acima das tecas; ovário ca 0.7 mm diâm, hemisférico, mais ou menos 3-lobado, estilete ca 0.3 mm, estigma pontual, óvulos por lóculo 2. Bagas maduras não vistas, imaturas 3.4-4.6 × 2.8-4 cm, subpiriformes, secas marrom-escuras e pruinosas, lisas, maduras negras. Sementes imaturas ca 2.4 × 1 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Lombardi, Julio A. 2014. Celastraceae (Hippocrateoideae e Salacioideae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 114: 1--227.

description: Árvores, 4-5(10) m, glabras; ramos novos subcilíndricos, esparso lenticelados, secos marrom-claros, velhos cilíndricos, fissurados, lenticelados, marrons. Folhas opostas; estípulas triangulares, erosas; pecíolos 3-8 mm, secos marrons; lâminas 5.5-11.6 × 1.5-3.2 cm, elípticas, base cuneada, margem inteira, amarelada quando seca, ápice agudo a acuminado, cartáceas, secas marrons em ambas as faces, nervuras secas de cor inconspícua em ambas as faces, ou principal amarelada na adaxial, marrom-escura na abaxial, na face adaxial secundárias e terciárias obscuras, na abaxial secundárias promínulas, terciárias obscuras. Inflorescências 0.9-2.6 × 1.2-1.5 cm, tirsóide-paniculadas, 28-49 flores, axilares; pedúnculos 2-5 mm, ramos subcilíndricos, opostos, brácteas erosas, escariosas; estipetes florais 1.2-1.7 mm, articulados; bractéolas 2. Flores 3.7-4 mm diâm na antese, rotáceas; sépalas 1.2-1.3 × 1 -1.1 mm, elípticas, erosas, mais ou menos carnosas; pétalas 1.5-1.8 × 1.6 -1.7 mm, suborbiculares, deflexas, erosas, mais ou menos carnosas, verdes; disco ca 0.4 mm alt., inteiro; estames ca 0.8 mm, filetes ca 0.6 mm, anteras ca 0.2 × 0.4 mm, oblongas, deiscência por fendas oblíquas em ângulo de ca 120°, conectivo inconspícuo, não proeminente acima das tecas; ovário ca 0,65 mm diâm, hemisférico, levemente 3-lobado, estilete ca 0.2 mm, estigma pontual, óvulos por lóculo 2. Bagas 4.3-6 × 2.6-2.7 cm, elipsóides, secas marrom-claras e pruinosas, lisas, minutamente pontuadas de amarelo. Sementes não vistas.
bibliographicCitation: Lombardi, Julio A. 2014. Celastraceae (Hippocrateoideae e Salacioideae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 114: 1--227.

description: Liana; ramos novos cilíndricos, lisos, velhos cilíndricos, lenticelados. Folhas opostas ou subopostas; estípulas triangulares, denticuladas na base, erosas; pecíolos 2-3(-7) mm; lâminas (0.9-)2.4-8.7 × (0.3-) 0.6-4.8 cm, elípticas a ovais, raro largo-obovais, base arredondada ou cuneada, raro reniforme, margem inteira ou denteada na metade ou quarto distal, ápice agudo ou obtuso, coriáceas, secas esverdeadas, nervuras secas às vezes principais amareladas na face abaxial, proeminentes em ambas as faces. Inflorescências (1.6-)3.5-5.5 × (0.5-)2.5-3(-6.8) cm, dicásios compostos, às vezes agregadas em inflorescências compostas tirsóides pela supressão de folhas nos nós, com 31-62 flores, axilares; pedúnculos (1-)13(-28) mm, ramos opostos ou subopostos, achatados; brácteas erosas, denticuladas na base; pedicelos 1.3-3 mm; bractéolas 2. Flores 2.1-2.3(-3.5) mm diâm na antese, rotáceas, inodoras (J. S. Sobrinho 323), inodoras; sépalas 0.9-1.1 × 0.9-1.3 mm, triangulares, denticuladas, hialinas, membranáceas; pétalas 1.5-1.8 × 1.4-1.6 mm, elípticas, ovais ou subrômbicas, patentes, erosas, carnosas na base, verde-amareladas; disco 0.15-0.2 mm alt., anelar, 5-angulado, carnoso; estames (2-)3, 0.6-1 mm, filetes 0.4-0.7 mm, alargados na base, anteras 0.2-0.3 × 0.3-0.4 mm, oblongas; ovário ca 0.25 mm diâm, estilete ca 0.3 mm, estigma pontual ou inconspicuamente 3-lobado, óvulos por lóculo 6. Mericarpos 3.4 × 1.8 cm, elipsóides ou obovados, sulcados, verrucosos. Sementes 2.4 × 1.3 cm, núcleo seminífero elipsóide, ala elíptica, papirácea, mais longa que o núcleo seminífero.

description: Leaves 2-5 mm long, 0.7-1 mm wide. Pedicels 1.6-3.3 mm long. Flowers 3.7- 5.4 mm long. Floral tube constricted just above the ovary, once to half again as long as the ovary, 1.8-3 mm long, 0.7-1.5 mm diam. Ovary broadly obovoid, 1.8-2 mm long. Capsule to 3 x 3.6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M., et al. 1986. Burmanniaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 42: 1-189.

description: Plants flowering 15-20 cm high. Leaves rosulate, 10-20 cm long; blades pungent, 18 mm wide, covered with a whitish or silvery coat of scales. Scape short but distinct; scape-bracts foliaceous to narrowly triangular, exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence lax, of about 4 branches; primary bracts foliaceous to triangular, exceeding the branches; spikes sessile, ellipsoid, obtuse, strobilate, 3 cm long, 18 mm in diameter. Floral bracts ovate, acute, 7 mm long, about equaling the sepals; flowers sessile or subsessile, very variable in size, glabrous. Sepals broadly elliptic, somewhat asymmetric, ca 8 mm long, mucronulate.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plants aggregated, dying in the center and forming circles, flowering 6 dm high. Leaves 24 cm long; blades narrowly triangular, 16 mm wide, covered with white appressed scales on both sides, serrate with spines 2 mm long and 10-15 mm apart. Scape ligneous; scape-bracts foliaceous. Inflorescence paniculate, laxly bipinnate, glabrous or nearly so; primary bracts narrowly triangular, much shorter than the branches; branches emerging from fascicles of bracts, flavous, lustrous, laxly to densely flowered. Floral bracts ovate, 4-9 mm long, acute with a 2 mm apiculus. Sepals slightly asymmetric, ovate, 6 (-10) mm long, even; petals narrowly spatulate, 13 (-24) mm long, bearing a lacerate scale at base; stamens equaling or shorter than the petals, anthers linear, 3 mm long; ovary pyramidal, 3 mm long. Capsule trigonous, 7 mm long, 5 mm in diameter; seeds cuneiform, 1.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plants aggregated, stout, leafy. Leaves 30 cm or longer; sheaths suborbicular or reniform, 5.5-6 cm wide, castaneous toward apex; blades narrowly triangular, recurving, 30 mm wide, fleshy, furfuraceous, serrate with spines 3-5 mm long and 1 cm apart. Scape about 6 dm high, subligneous, glabrous; scape-bracts small, deciduous. Inflorescence amply paniculate, lax; primary bracts subtriangular, short, deciduous; branches substrobilate, to 26 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, attenuate, nerved, 8-10 mm long; pedicels 1 mm long. Sepals ovate, mucronate, 12-15 mm long, papillose; petals narrowly spatulate, 25-32 mm long, flavous when dry, bearing a 3 mm long lacerate scale at base; stamens slightly shorter than the petals, filaments capillary, anthers linear, 4 mm long; ovary pyramidal, 3 mm long; capsule trigonous, 12 mm long. Seeds linear, 3 mm long, bearing a narrow dorsal wing.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plants forming rings, the flowering shoot 15-25 cm high. Leaves rosulate, 10-20 cm long; sheaths short but ample; blades 18 mm wide, covered with a whitish or silvery coat of scales, laxly serrate with spines 2 mm long. Scape erect, slender, nearly equaling the leaves; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, the upper narrowly lanceolate, entire. Inflorescence digitate, subdigitate from a few spikes, or rarely simple, glabrous; primary bracts much shorter than the spikes, entire; spikes slenderly cylindric, dense, to 5 cm long. Floral bracts ovate, acute, slightly shorter than the sepals; flowers sessile or subsessile. Sepals elliptic, ca 8 mm long; petals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, bearing a single scale at base, about equaling the stamens; style slightly exserted.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plants growing in dense masses, flowering 5-10 dm high. Leaves to 13 cm long; sheaths inconspicuous; blades narrowly triangular, 20-35 mm wide, pungent, densely serrate with spines 6 mm long, densely cinereous-lepidote on both sides. Scape erect, 4-9 mm in diameter at apex, finely cinereous-pruinose; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, the upper equaling or shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence bipinnate, many-flowered, glabrous; primary bracts inconspicuous; branches densely strobilate, 2.5-10 cm long; the short sterile base covered with many imbricate bracts. Floral bracts broadly ovate, attenuate, 22 mm long, thickened at base and joined with the rhachis to form a pouch about the flower; flowers 22 mm long, subsessile, yellow, the lowest on each spike spreading. Sepals elliptic-oblong, rounded, minutely mucronate, 8 mm long, the posterior carinate; stamens included, anthers 3.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Tree, to 15 m tall. Leafy twigs 2-3 mm thick, (sparsely) puberulous; periderm flaking off. Lamina oblong, (5-)8-15(-21) × (1.7-)3-5.5(-7.5) cm, coriaceous; apex acuminate to subcaudate; base obtuse to rounded; margin often ± revolute; upper surface glabrous (or sparsely puberulous at the base of the midrib); lower surface glabrous or sparsely puberulous on (the base of) the midrib; lateral veins 10-16 pairs; tertiary venation reticulate; petiole 0.2-0.8 cm long, the epidermis flaking off; stipules 0.3-1 cm long, puberulous, caducous. Staminate inflorescences in the leaf axils and below the leaves, ca. 1-1.5 cm diam.; peduncle 0.2-0.3 mm long, not bracteate; involucral bracts in 4-5 series, broadly ovate to semicircular to suborbicular, the outer ones minutely puberulous, the inner ones only ciliolate; perianth ca. 2 mm long; tepals 2-7, often ± cucullate, minutely puberulous on the upper part; stamens 3-5; filaments 0.6-0.8 mm long; anthers oblong to elliptic, 0.7-1 × 0.3-0.4 mm. Pistillate inflorescences 1.5-3 cm diam., subsessile or peduncle to 0.6 cm long; involucral bracts in 6-8 series, broadly to narrowly ovate, minutely puberulous to submuriculate, the inner ones to 1.5 cm long; flowers numerous; free parts of the tepals spine-like to pyramid-ate, minutely puberulous to submuriculate; style 2-5 mm long; stigmas filiform, 4-7 mm long. Infructescences (3-)4-8(-10) cm diam., free parts of the tepals to 1 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Berg, Cornelius C. 2001. Moreae, Artocarpeae, and Dorstenia (Moraceae): With introductions to the family and Ficus and with additions and corrections to Flora Neotropica Monograph 7. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 83: 1-346.

description: Tree. Leafy twigs 2-4 mm thick, greyish to brownish, yellowish appressed-puberulous, periderm irregularly wrinkled, peeling off in very small flakes. Leaves oblong to lanceolate, 11-16 cm long, 4.5-5.2 cm broad, subcoriaceous, acuminate, acute at the base, glabrous; the costa and the secondary veins prominent, otherwise the venation nearly plane above, veins prominent beneath, 16-18 pairs of secondary veins, several parallel tertiary veins; petioles 5-8 mm long; stipules 21-23 mm long, puberulous at the base. Pistillate inflorescences ca 2 cm in diameter, subsessile; involucre with ca 30-40 deltoid to narrowly lanceolate, up to 30 mm long, acute, puberulous bracts in ca 7 series; flowers ca 50; tepals free, subulate, 2.5-5 mm long, puberulous; style up to 0.5 mm long, stigmas filiform, ca 10 mm long; pseudobracts similar to the tepals. Flowering in September.

description: Revised description, including the staminate inflorescences: Tree, to 25 m tall. Leafy twigs 2-4 mm thick, grayish, yellowish or brownish appressed-puberulous; periderm flaking off. Lamina oblong to lanceolate, 11-23 × 4.5-8.5 cm, (sub)coriaceous; apex acuminate; base (sub)acute; both surfaces glabrous; lateral veins 16-18 pairs; tertiary venation partly scalariform; petiole 0.51 cm long; stipules 1.5-2.5 cm long, puberulous at the base, caducous. Staminate inflorescences 0.5-0.8 cm diam.; peduncle 0.4-0.6 cm long, bracteate towards the apex; involucral bracts in 4-5 series, broadly to narrowly ovate to oblong, ciliolate; center of the receptacle conical; perianth 1.2-1.4 mm long; tepals 6-8, free, often somewhat cucullate, minutely puberulous; stamens 46; filaments 0.4-0.7 mm long; anthers elliptic, 0.4-0.6 × 0.4-0.5 mm. description: Trees up to 15 m tall. Leafy twigs 2-6 mm thick, greyish to brownish, sparsely whitish puberulous, periderm more or less irregularly wrinkled, peeling off in very small flakes. Leaves lanceolate, 21-40 cm long, 5-11 cm broad, subcoriaceous to coriaceous, subacuminate to acute, acute to obtuse at the base, glabrous; the costa and the proximal parts of the secondary veins prominent, otherwise the venation plane above, veins prominent beneath, 22-32 pairs of secondary veins; petioles 7-22 mm long; stipules 12-19 mm long, appressed-puberulous, glabrous, curved. Pistillate inflorescences sessile; involucre with 24-32 deltoid to ovate to lanceolate, acute to obtuse, puberulous bracts in 3-5 series; flowers ca 50-60; tepals free, subulate to clavate, acute, puberulous; style ca 4 mm long, stigmas vittiform, 4-5 mm long; pseudobracts similar to the tepals. Infructescences 3-5 cm in diameter; tepals and pseudobracts more or less spine-like, up to 22 mm long, narrowed at the base. Mature infructescences collected from August to March.
