description: Plant flowering 3-5 dm high. Leaves about 20 in a dense rosette, to 5 dm long; sheaths large, broadly elliptic, more or less reddish, densely ferruginous-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, slightly if at all narrowed toward base 4-5 cm wide, subdensely serrate with straight spines 1-2 mm long, green on both sides, sometimes spotted with dark green or red-brown. Scape erect, 6-7 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts imbricate and covering the scape, broadly subovate, acute, inflated, pale green except the brown apex, obscurely ferruginous-punctulate. Inflorescence very densely 30-100-flowered, cylindric to subglobose, obscurely punctulate and appearing completely glabrous; involucral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, erect and slightly exceeding the flowers, entire, the inner ones bright red. Floral bracts lanceolate, acute, equaling the middle of the sepal, entire, carinate, red or orange toward apex; flowers sessile, 4-5 cm long. Sepals free, strongly asymmetric with a large wing, acute, 15-17 mm long, yellow; petals free, ligulate, obtuse, yellow, soon black in drying, bearing 2 scales at base; stamens included; pollen multiporate; ovary trigonous, compressed, epigynous tube short; placentae subapical; ovules acute.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Saprophytic herbs, 7-33 cm high. Rhizome cylindric, 1.5-3 x 0.5 cm, rhizome-scales stiff, narrowly triangular to triangular-ovate, roots 0.5-1 mm diam. Stems pale blue, mostly unbranched. Leaves narrowly ovate, rarely linear-ovate, (1.8-)3.5-19 mm long, 1.4-4.8 mm wide, apex acuminate to obtuse, midrib mostly thickened. Inflorescence a bifurcated cincinnus, cincinni 2-8-flowered and 17-67 mm long, or the plant having a solitary terminal flower only. Bracts narrowly ovate, 5-16.3 mm long, (0.8-)1.5-4.5(-8) mm wide, apex acuminate, midrib often thickened. Flowers pale purplish blue to white, with darker tepals, 16-28 (-36) mm long, fragrant. Outer tepals narrowly elliptic to narrowly triangular, (3.2-)5.3-11.2 mm long, 1.1-3.4 mm wide, inner side papillate, margins often involute. Inner tepals narrowly ovate to narrowly elliptic, (3.2-)5-10.3 mm long, 0.8-2.3 mm wide, inner side papillate. Floral tube 6-9.5(-l 1) mm long, 1-2.5 (-3.5) mm diam., in older flowers often slightly curved, 6-ribbed. Ribs linear, 0.2-0.7 mm wide. Filaments 0.3-0.5(-0.8) mm long, 0.2-0.3 mm wide. Style (3.9-)5.2-8.9 mm long, branches 0.9-2 mm long. Ovary narrowly ellipsoid to narrowly cylindrical, 7-14.5 x (0.9-)1.3-4.5 mm. Capsule white to bluish white, trigonous, narrowly ellipsoid to narrowly obovoid, 6.5-14.5 x 1.9-4.5 mm. Seeds 0.3-0.8 x 0.3-0.6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M., et al. 1986. Burmanniaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 42: 1-189.

description: Saprophytic herbs, 8-23 cm high. Stems white, branched or not. Leaves white, ovate to narrowly triangular-ovate, l-3.6(-6) mm long, (0.4-)0.6-1.3 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, cincinni 2-5(-8)-flowered, and 5-17(-30) mm long, flowers 2.5-8 mm apart, or the plant having a solitary terminal flower only. Bracts narrowly ovate(-triangular), 1.2-3.3 mm long, 0.4-0.9 mm wide, apex acute to mostly acuminate. Pedicels (0-)0.8-1.5 mm long, central (basal) flower mostly sessile. Flowers tubular, white to pale blue with yellowish tepals, 4.5-7 mm long. Outer tepals deltate to broadly angular-ovate, 1-1.4(-1.6) mm long, 0.8-1.2 mm wide, inner side papillate. Inner tepals very broadly ovate-triangular, 0.1-0.3 mm long, 0.1-0.4 mm wide, fleshy. Floral tube 1.7-2.8 mm long, 0.5-1.2 mm diam. Wings running from the top of the floral tube down to the base of the ovary, (broadly) semicordate to semiobovate, 2-3.5 mm long, 0.6-2.3 mm wide. Connective bearing apically two and basally one appendage. Style 1.8-2.6 mm long, branches 0.4-0.7 mm long. Ovary broadly obovoid to globose, (1.3-)1.6-3.1 x 1.2-2.5 mm. Capsule white to yellow, broadly obovoid to globose, sometimes narrower, 2-3.8 x 1.5-2.7 mm, longitudinally dehiscent, the valves separating from apex to base, the remaining ribs of the capsule forming a lantern-like structure around the central column. Seeds narrowly fusiform, 0.5-0.8(-1) x 0.1 mm, the small, ellipsoid embryo surrounded by a thin, transparent testa.

description: Herbs, relatively firm, (12-)20-48 cm high. Stems green, the upper part purple, mostly unbranched. Leaves green, the upper ones purple, narrowly triangular-ovate to subulate, (4.5-)8.6-37 mm long, 1.7-7.5 mm wide, apex acute to mostly acuminate, basal ones rosulate. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, cincinni 2-7-flowered and 7-35 mm long, flowers to 5 mm apart, or the plant having a solitary, terminal flower only. Bracts narrowly ovate-elliptic, 4.8-15.4 mm long, 1.6-4(-7) mm wide, apex acute to mostly acuminate. Pedicels 0-(-1.6) mm long. Flowers tubular, purple to blue with yellow tepals, (8-) 12.5-25 mm long. Outer tepals angular-ovate to broadly angular-ovate, 2.2-3.1 mm long, 1.6-2.4 mm wide, margins involute. Inner tepals elliptic, rarely ovate, 1.5-2 mm long, 0.9-1.4 mm wide, margins sometimes involute. Floral tube 4.1-7.6 mm long, 1.4-3.5 mm diam. Wings running from the top of the floral tube down to the base of the ovary, continuing over the outer tepals as a crest, semiobcordate to semielliptic, 8-20 mm long, 1.9-6 mm wide. Stamens yellow to white, inserted in a cavity formed by two folds between outer and inner tepals, connective bearing apically two, and basally one appendage. Style (4.8-)5.7-6.8 mm long, branches 1.4-1.9 mm long, upper lip of stigma divided into two parts. Ovary narrowly obconical to narrowly obovoid, (4.5-)5.8-12 x (1.3-)1.8-3.7 mm. Capsule purple, cylindrical to narrowly obovoid, 6.6-10.2 x 2.4-3.1 mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.4-0.8(-4).9) x 0.1-0.3 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M., et al. 1986. Burmanniaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 42: 1-189.

description: Herbs, 11-42 cm high. Stems branched or not. Leaves narrowly triangular-ovate, 2.3-12(-15) mm long, 0.7-2.4(-4) mm wide, apex acuminate to sometimes acute. Inflorescence capitate, consisting of two contracted cincinni, cincinni 2-many-flowered and 2.5-17.5 mm long, flowers up to 1 mm apart. Bracts narrowly ovate-triangular to ovate-elliptic, 1-4 mm long, (0.3-)0.6-1.5 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Flowers mostly sessile, tubular, purple with white, yellow, or green tepals, 4-6.5 mm long. Outer tepals broadly ovate, 0.6-1 mm long and wide, margins involute. Inner tepals narrowly oblong-elliptic, 0.4-0.7 mm long, 0.1-0.3 mm wide. Floral tube 1.5-3.1 mm long, 0.5-0.9(-1.2) mm diam. Wings exceeding the top of the outer tepals and running down to the ovary, narrowly semiobcordate to semielliptic, 2.8-5.1 mm long, 0.3-0.9 mm wide. Connective bearing apically two, and basally one appendage, rarely absent. Style 1.6-3.2 mm long, branches 0.2-0.6 mm long. Ovary obconical to obovoid, rarely globose, 1-2.4 x 0.5-1.5 mm. Capsule purple, obovoid to globose, 1.3-2.5 x 0.9-2 mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.2-0.4 x 0.1-0.2 mm.

description: Erect or pendent herbs, mostly epiphytic, 25-75 cm high. Stems unbranched. Leaves yellow-green, narrowly ovate to linear, 2-50 cm long, 0.5-0.8 cm wide, apex acute. Inflorescence terminal, lax, sometimes umbelliform, consisting of 2-12 cincinni, each cincinnus 4.5-25 cm long, and many-flowered. Bracts narrowly ovate to ovate, imbricate, 10-25 mm long, 3-6 mm wide, apex acute to beaked. Pedicels 5-10 mm long. Flowers tubular, white to greenish-white, more or less tinged with blue, 9-12 mm long. Outer tepals ovate, 2-3 mm long, 1.5-2.2 mm wide, margins involute. Inner tepals narrowly oblong to narrowly ovate, 1-1.5 mm long, 0.3-0.5 mm wide, basally decurrent into a crescent-shaped pouch at the inner side of the floral tube. Floral tube 2.5-3.5 mm long. Wings when present reduced to ribs running from the top of the floral tube down to the base of the ovary, linear, 9-12 mm long, 0.2-0.4 mm wide. Connective bearing apically and sometimes basally two appendages. Style 1.5-2.5 mm long, branches 0.5-0.6 mm long, upper lip of stigma funnel-shaped, 0.4-1 mm in diam. Ovary obovoid to angular-ovoid, 4.5-6 mm long. Capsule pale green, ovoid to angular-ovoid, up to 6.5 x 3 mm, dehiscing by transverse slits. Seeds 0.3-0.4 x 0.1 mm.

description: Herbs, 6-20 cm high. Stems mostly unbranched. Leaves often purplish, triangular-ovate, sometimes ovate, 1.3-3.9(-5) mm long, 0.6-1.6 mm wide, apex acute (to acuminate). Inflorescence consisting of 1-4(-5) terminal flowers, flowers 2.5-5 mm apart. Bracts narrowly elliptic-ovate to ovate, (1.6-)2-3.5(-4.5) mm long, 0.6-2.2 mm wide, apex acuminate, rarely acute. Flowers sessile or shortly pedicellate, salverform, purple to blue, 12-18 mm long. Outer tepals radiate; narrowly ovate to ovate, sometimes elliptic or even obovate, 4-6.4(-7.3) mm long, 1.7-2.5(-3.1) mm wide, inner side papillate. Inner tepals narrowly triangular-ovate, 0.8-1.5 mm long, 0.2-0.5 mm wide, inner side often papillate. Floral tube 4-5.5(-7.1) mm long, 0.9-2.2(-2.6) mm diam. Wings running from the top of the floral tube down to the top or the middle of the ovary, semiobovate to semielliptic, 4.2-9.6 mm long, (0.4-)0.9-2.1 mm wide. Connective bearing apically two, and basally one appendage. Style 4.7-5.5 mm long, branches 0.9-1.2 mm long. Ovary narrowly obovoid to narrowly obconical, 3.5-7.1 x (1-) 1.4-2.1 (-3.6) mm. Capsule narrowly obovoid to narrowly ellipsoid, 5-6.2 x 1.8-2.1 mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.2-0.3 x 0.1-0.2 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M., et al. 1986. Burmanniaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 42: 1-189.

description: Herbs 10-50 cm high. Rhizomes to 50 mm long and 1-2 mm diam. Stems mostly unbranched. Leaves green, narrowly ovate, 0.9-12 cm long, 0.2-1.2 cm wide, apex circinate (sometimes long-apiculate). Inflorescence terminal, capitate, 0.5-2.5 cm long, 0.5-3 cm wide, consisting of two contracted, many-flowered cincinni. Bracts narrowly ovate to narrowly angular-ovate, (0.9-)4-10 mm long, 0.8-3 mm wide, apex acute to circinate. Pedicels 0-11 mm long. Flowers tubular, purple to blue, 4.5-7.7 mm long. Outer tepals broadly ovate, 1.3-1.8 mm long, 1.2-1.5 mm wide, hairy, particularly near the margins, margins involute. Inner tepals ovate to broadly ovate, 0.7-1.3 mm long, 0.5-0.6 mm wide, inner side hairy, basally decurrent into a crescent-shaped pouch at the inner side of the floral tube. Floral tube 0.8-2 mm long, wingless. Connective bearing apically two appendages. Style 1.5-1.7 mm long, branches 0.2-0.3 mm long, funnel-shaped, upper lip of stigma 0.2-0.5 mm diam. Ovary obovoid to angular-ovoid, 2.2-5 mm long. Capsule and seeds unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M., et al. 1986. Burmanniaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 42: 1-189.

description: Herbs, 3-30(-50) cm high. Stems pale green to green, mostly unbranched. Leaves narrowly ovate-triangular, 1.8-12.5(-24) mm long, 0.4-2.5(-3.2) mm wide, apex acuminate to rarely acute, basal ones rosulate. Inflorescence of 1-3(-4), mostly two, terminal flowers, flowers 2.2-3.5(-10) mm apart. Bracts broadly ovate-elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 2-5 mm long, 0.5-2(-2.8) mm wide, apex mostly acute. Pedicels 0-1 (-1.8) mm long. Flowers tubular, yellow to yellowish green, 4-13 mm long. Outer tepals broadly angular-ovate, rarely angular-ovate or ovate, 1.3-2.3 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, margins involute. Inner tepals obovate to elliptic, 1-1.6(-2.3) mm long, 0.4-1 mm wide. Floral tube 2.5-5(-6) mm long, 0.7-2.7 mm in diam. Wings running from the top of the floral tube down to the middle or the base of the ovary, narrowly semielliptic (to semiobcordate), rarely broader (semicircular), 3.4-8.5(-10) mm long, 0.6-2.7(-3.4) mm wide. Connective bearing apically two, and basally one appendage which is sometimes minute or even absent. Style 3.5-5.5 mm long, branches 0.7-1.4 mm long, upper lip of stigma divided into two parts. Ovary obovoid to ellipsoid, 1.8-6 x 1-3.5(-4.5) mm. Capsule yellow to green, obovoid to ellipsoid, 2.5-6 x 1.8-4.5 mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.2-0.4 x 0.1 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M., et al. 1986. Burmanniaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 42: 1-189.

description: Herbs, 23-48 cm high. Stems mostly unbranched, very firm. Leaves subulate to narrowly triangular-ovate, 3-70 mm long, 1.4-6.1 mm wide, apex acuminate, basal ones rosulate. Inflorescence capitate, consisting of two contracted cincinni, cincinni 5-many-flowered and 6-20 mm long or longer. Bracts narrowly ovate-elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 2.5-5.8(-8.1) mm long, 0.9-3.6 mm wide, apex acuminate to acute. Pedicels 0.5-1.8(-2.1) mm long. Flowers tubular, purple, sometimes yellow or white, often with yellow tepals. 7-11 mm long. Outer tepals broadly to very broadly angular-ovate, 1-1.4 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, margins involute. Inner tepals obovate to elliptic, more or less spathulate, 0.4-0.7 mm long, 0.30.5 mm wide. Floral tube 3.4-5.6 mm long, 0.8-1.8 mm diam. Wings running from the middle or sometimes from the top of the outer tepals down to the base of the ovary, narrowly semiobtriangular to semielliptic, 4.2-8.5 mm long, 0.4-1 mm wide. Connective bearing apically two, and basally one appendage. Style 4.4-5.2(-6) mm long, branches 0.7-1 mm long. Ovary obovoid to obconical, 1.6-3.2 x 1-2.2 mm. Capsule green, obovoid to ellipsoid, rarely broader, 1.7-4 x 1.2-2.2 mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.3-0.5 x 0.1 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M., et al. 1986. Burmanniaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 42: 1-189.

description: Herbs, 4-12 cm high. Rhizomes to 80 mm long and 1-1.5 mm diam. Stems mostly unbranched. Leaves green, narrowly ovate to narrowly elliptic, 16-40 mm long, 2.5-6 mm wide, acute to sometimes apiculate. Inflorescence terminal, capitate, globose to transversely ellipsoid, 15-20-flowered, 7-8 mm long, 4-13 mm wide, not exceeding the leaves. Bracts narrowly ovate, 2-7 mm long, 0.3-1 mm wide, sometimes imbricate, acute. Pedicels 0-0.5 mm long. Flowers tubular, yellowish white, 3-5 mm long. Outer tepals triangular, ca. 1.5 mm long, ca. 0.8 mm wide, margins involute, apex cucullate. Inner tepals elliptic, ca. 1 mm long. Floral tube ca. 1.3 mm long, ca. 1.8 mm diam., wingless. Wings narrowly semielliptic, crenulate, 0.2-0.3 mm wide, exceeding the top of the outer tepals and running down to their base. Connective bearing apically two appendages. Style ca. 1.3 mm long, branches ca. 0.6 mm long. Ovary obovoid, ca. 1 x 1 mm. Capsule globose, 1.5-2.5 mm diam., dehiscing irregularly. Seeds 0.2-0.3 x 0.1 mm. Flowering in April.

description: Herbs, 3.5-14 cm high. Stems green, sometimes the upper part purple, mostly unbranched. Leaves green, the upper ones often purple, narrowly triangular-ovate, 1.3-3.8 mm long, 0.3-1.2(-1.8) mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, cincinni 2-6(-9)-flowered and 3-20(-30) mm long, flowers 1.5-4(-8) mm apart, or the plant having a solitary, terminal flower only. Bracts ovate-elliptic, 1.3-3.6 mm long, 0.5-1.8 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Pedicels 0-1.5 mm long. Flowers tubular, purple to white, often with yellowish-white tepals, 3-6.5 mm long. Outer tepals broadly ovate-triangular, 0.5-1.1 mm long, 0.4-1 (-1.4) mm wide, margins mostly involute. Inner tepals ovate to triangular, (0.3-)0.4-0.7 mm long, 0.2-0.4 mm wide, margins involute. Floral tube 0.7-1.8 mm long, 0.4-1.3 mm diam., always shorter than the ovary. Wings running from the top of the floral tube down to the middle or base of the ovary, very broadly semiobcordate to semiobovate, rarely narrower, 2-5 mm long, 1.1-3 mm wide. Connective bearing apically two, and basally one appendage. Style 1.2-2 mm long, branches 0.3-0.7 mm long, upper lip of stigma divided into two parts. Ovary obovoid to ellipsoid, 1.4-3.7 x 0.7-2 mm. Capsule purple, obovoid to ellipsoid, 1.7-3.7 x 1-2(-2.7) mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.2-0.4 x 0.1 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M., et al. 1986. Burmanniaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 42: 1-189.

description: Herbs, 4-42 cm high. Stems green, sometimes the upper part purple, mostly unbranched. Leaves green, narrowly triangular-ovate to subulate, 2-19 mm long, 0.4-2.8(-4) mm wide, apex acuminate, basal ones rosulate. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, 2-6(-8)-flowered, each cincinnus 5-26 mm long, or the plant having a solitary, terminal flower only. Bracts narrowly ovate-elliptic, 1.5-5.5 (-6.2) mm long, 0.4-1.6 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Pedicels 0.5-2.5 (-3.5) mm long. Flowers tubular, purplish blue to white with yellow tepals, (4-)7-16(-19) mm long. Outer tepals broadly ovate-triangular, 1.1-1,7(-3) mm long, 0.9-1,7(-2.1) mm wide, margins sometimes involute. Inner tepals narrowly triangular to narrowly elliptic, sometimes ovate to elliptic, 0.5-1.4(-l.7) mm long, 0.1-0.5 mm wide, margins sometimes involute. Floral tube 2.6-6.8 mm long, 0.9-2.7 mm diam. Wings running from the top of the floral tube down to below the ovary, semielliptic, 6.1-11.5(-13.5) mm long, (0.2-)1.6-4.3(-5.5) mm wide. Stamens yellow, connective bearing apically two, and basally one appendage. Style 3-6.8 mm long, branches 0.8-1.3 mm long, upper lip of stigma divided into two parts. Ovary broadly obovoid to obconical, rarely narrower, 1.6-5.6 x 1-3.2 mm. Capsule purple, obovoid to obconical, sometimes narrower, 2.4-5.6 x 1.5-3 mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.2-0.7 x 0.1-0.2 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M., et al. 1986. Burmanniaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 42: 1-189.

description: Herbs, (5-)13-36 cm high. Roots ending in fusiform tubers. Stems mostly unbranched. Leaves often purple, narrowly ovate, sometimes ovate or elliptic, (1.6-)2.6-4.8 mm long, 0.6-1.8(-2.2) mm wide, apex acute (to acuminate). Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, cincinni 2-6(-8)-flowered and 5-22(-32) mm long, flowers 1.5-3.5(-5.5) mm apart, or the plant having a solitary terminal flower only. Bracts narrowly ovate-elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 2.3-4.5 mm long, 0.9-1.8 (-2.2) mm wide, apex acute to sometimes acuminate. Flowers sessile, salverform, purple to white, 6-12 mm long. Outer tepals radiate, ovate, rarely elliptic, 1.4-3.3(-3.9) mm long, 1-2.3(-2.9) mm wide, 3-veined, rarely margins involute. Inner tepals narrowly elliptic to narrowly obovate or spathulate, 0.6-1 mm long, 0.20.5 mm wide, apex curved over the stamens. Floral tube (0.5-)l-2.8 mm long, 0.6-1.5 mm diam., wingless. Connective bearing apically two and basally one appendage. Style (1.4-)1.7-3.5 mm long, branches 0.7-0.9 mm long, upper lip divided into two parts. Ovary narrowly ellipsoid to narrowly obovoid, 3-6(-7) x 0.8-1.8(-2.5) mm. Capsule narrowly ellipsoid to narrowly obovoid, 2.9-6(-7) x 1.5-2.5 mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.3-0.4 x 0.1 mm.

description: Leaves rosulate, to 1 m long, not narrowed between sheath and blade; sheaths large, subelliptic or triangular, forming a bulb above ground, covered with linear brown-ferruginous scales; blades linear, attenuate, 2-3 cm wide, white-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with curved spines 3-5 mm long, the inner leaves red. Inflorescences very densely corymbose, nearly sessile in the center of the rosette, few-many-flowered, very densely pale brown-lanate except the petals; primary bracts like the inner leaves. Floral bracts very narrowly spatulate, obtuse, about equaling the sepals, entire or slightly serrulate toward apex, membranaceous, pale brown; flowers slenderly pedicellate, 45-50 mm long. Sepals oblong, 17 mm long, obtuse, free, ecarinate; petals slightly exceeding the sepals, connate for 12 mm, white or purple; ovary cylindric, very slender, much enlarged in fruit.

description: Leaves to 1.5 m long; sheaths subovate, 7 cm long, covered at base with linear pale brown scales, densely recurved-serrate; blades linear, attenuate, slightly narrowed toward base but not petiolate, to 3 cm wide, sparsely and obscurely pale-lepidote, laxly serrate with antrorse and retrorse spines 4 mm long. Inflorescence corymbose, nidular in the center of the rosette, rather few-flowered, 6 cm in diameter, densely brown-lepidote including the petals; primary bracts subfoliaceous. Floral bracts oblong, 4 cm long, exceeding the ovary, serrate at apex. Sepals to 2 cm long, highly and irregularly connate into a cylindric tube, convex, irregularly lobed and serrate at apex; petals linear, obtuse, 4 cm long, much exceeding the stamens, white; filament-tube 20 mm long; ovary subcylindric, to 25 mm long.

description: Leaves over 2 m long; sheaths elliptic or oblong, little wider than the blades, dark castaneous, densely brown-lepidote with fine elongate scales; blades linear, attenuate, 3 cm wide, glabrous above, minutely pale-lepidote between the nerves beneath, laxly serrate with antrorse spines 3 mm long. Scape short but distinct. Inflorescence densely corymbose, densely tomentose-lepidote with fine brown scales except for the petals. Floral bracts linear-lanceolate, equaling the sepals, laciniate-serrulate toward the apex, thin, carinate; flowers including the indistinct pedicel 7-9 cm long. Sepals free, erect, very narrowly triangular, irregularly incurved near the apex, 33 mm long, carinate, pale toward apex; petals erect, to 36 mm long, connate for 13 mm, glabrous, the blade narrowly elliptic, obtuse; ovary slender, triangular-prismatic.

description: Leaves 1-2 m long; sheaths dark brown, lepidote on both sides; blades narrowly triangular, not contracted at base, 3-4 cm wide, serrate with retrorse basal spines 5 mm long. Inflorescence capitiform, sunk in the center of the rosette, brown-tomentose-lepidote; primary bracts scarlet. Floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, shorter than the sepals, serrate toward apex; pedicels 1 cm long; flowers 4-5 cm long. Sepals free, narrowly triangular, 20-25 mm long, carinate, spinulose-serrate toward apex; petals 3 cm long, united at base, white or violet at apex, glabrous.

description: Plant flowering 3-4 dm high. Leaves rosulate, spreading, to 3 m long, not narrowed between sheath and blade; sheaths broadly subtriangular (exterior) to obovate (interior), densely white-lepidote beneath; blades linear, long-attenuate, 25 mm wide, glabrous above, minutely pale-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with curved spines 3-5 mm long, the outer green, the inner bright red. Scape well developed, stout, densely white-flocculose; scape-bracts like the inner leaves but smaller, densely imbricate. Inflorescence sublaxly paniculate, pyramidal, ca 15 cm long, 11-12 cm wide, white-flocculose; lower primary bracts like the scape-bracts and exceeding the branches, the upper bladeless and shorter than the branches; branches spreading or subspreading. Floral bracts variable in size, sometimes exceeding the ovary, at others shorter, oblong, obtuse, entire, white, papyraceous; flowers 3-4 cm long, short-pedicellate. Sepals free, erect, oblong, obtuse or emarginate, 10-16 mm long, carinate, white, papyraceous; petals erect, 15-21 mm long, connate for 5 mm, sparsely lepidote, purple, thickened toward apex; stamens slightly shorter than the petals; ovary subellipsoid.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Leaves 2 m long or longer, not at all constricted between the blade and the sheath; blades linear, attenuate, 5-6 cm wide, pungent, pale green when dry, glabrous and shining above, densely and very minutely appressed-lepidote below, armed with brownish teeth 4-8 mm long. Inflorescence corymbose-capitiform, many-flowered, sunk in the center of the leaf-rosette; axes densely lepidote with coarse dark brown scales; primary bracts unknown. Floral bracts great dilated toward the apex, about 7 cm long, attaining the middle of the sepals, glabrous within, coarsely spreading-lepidote outside toward the apex, membranaceous, laciniate-serrate toward the apex, ecarinate; flowers to 8 cm long. Sepals erect, broadly elliptic, obtuse, entire, 32 mm long, straight, lanate but soon glabrous, prominently striate, free; petals only about 5 mm longer than the sepals, narrowly elliptic, obtuse, joined nearly to the middle, erect at anthesis, glabrous; ovary cylindric, very densely lepidote with coarse dark brown scales.

description: Plant flowering to 4 dm high propagating by elongate scaly stolons. Leaves many in a dense rosette, 1.5 m long; sheaths ample, forming a bulb, densely tomentose; blades linear, attenuate, not constricted at base, 4 cm wide, laxly serrate with antrorse uncinate spines 5 mm long, lepidote, green above, cinereous beneath. Scape short, stout, densely lepidote; scape-bracts foliaceous, densely imbricate, bright red. Inflorescence densely globose, 6 cm in diameter; primary bracts broadly ovate, 4 cm long, bearing long foliaceous blades covering most of the fasciculate flowers; branches short, 5-9-flowered. Floral bracts ligulate, obtuse, cucullate, 30 mm long, exceeding the ovary, 11 mm wide, carinate, spinose-serrulate, densely pale-lepidote; pedicels 5-10 mm long in fruit; flowers subsessile, 4-5 cm long. Sepals free, oblong, cucullate, 15 mm long, 5 mm wide, carinate, entire or sparsely serrulate, white, lepidote; petals elliptic, obtuse, connate for 5 mm, blue-purple with white base and margins; stamens included, forming a tube 3 mm high; ovary subcylindric, angled, 2 cm long. Fruit ovoid, 40 mm long, 25 mm in diameter.

description: Plant flowering 2-3 m high. Leaves not petiolate, 12 dm or longer; blades linear, attenuate, stout, very laxly serrate with hooked spines 5 mm long. Scape over 12 cm long; scape-bracts very dense, foliaceous, very large. Inflorescence compact, subglobose or ellipsoid; primary bracts suborbicular, exceeded by the flowers, serrulate; branches very densely flowered; rhachis to 25 mm long. Floral bracts elliptic-dilated at apex, 27 mm long, exceeding the ovary, serrulate, thin, subglabrous; flowers ca 4 cm long, short-pedicellate. Sepals narrowly oblong, obtuse, cucullate, 22 mm long, free, carinate, serrulate toward apex, pale-lepidote; petals 24 mm long, connate for 6 mm, bright violet, glabrous (?); ovary slender, densely pale-brown-lepidote.

description: Leaves (inner) not narrowed between the sheath and the blade; sheaths elongate, narrowly lanceolate, densely serrate, densely white-tomentose; blades linear, attenuate, subdensely serrate with slender curved spines 1-1.5 mm long. Scape evident, stout, white-tomentose; scape-bracts like the inner leaves, densely imbricate. Inflorescence densely paniculate, subglobose, many-flowered, ca 14 cm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but bladeless, slightly tomentose toward apex; branches to 6-flowered, laxly racemose. Floral bracts lance-ovate, acute and obliquely emarginate, about equaling the ovary, 15-20 mm long, pale, subglabrous, strongly carinate; flowers 25-30 mm long, very short-pedicellate. Sepals suberect, free, subovate-lanceolate, narrowed from near the base to the apex, subacute, ca 11 mm long, carinate, curved, slightly tomentose; petals narrowly lanceolate, acute, 15 mm long, connate for 3 mm, thick, glabrous; stamens included; ovary slenderly cylindric, densely white-tomentose.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Leaves very many in a dense rosette, not narrowed between the sheath and blade, to 2 m long; outer sheaths short, subtriangular, covered with linear brown scales, the inner elongate, elliptic; blades linear, attenuate, 25 mm wide, laxly serrate with stout antrorse and retrorse curved spines 7 mm long, glabrous above, minutely white-lepidote beneath. Scape to 3 dm long, stout; scape-bracts very densely imbricate, like the inner leaves with red blades. Inflorescence very densely ellipsoid to subglobose, to 75 cm long, 12 cm in diameter; axes ferruginous-tomentulose; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but the upper ones bladeless; branches to 17-flowered. Floral bracts oblong, subacute, 15-25 mm long, shorter than the ovary, entire, carinate, subglabrous; flowers short-pedicellate. Sepals free, erect, elliptic, subacute or obtuse, to 15 mm long, slightly convex; petals 25-34 mm long, connate with the filaments for 6 mm, thick, glabrous; stamens included; ovary subcylindric, 25 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid, 4 cm long, 2 cm in diameter, yellow.

description: Leaves not narrowed between sheath and blade; sheaths suborbicular, very large, transversely undulate, lacinate-serrate with soft teeth; blades (outer) attenuate, densely serrate with very stout antrorse 3 mm long spines but entire within 3 cm of apex, terminating in a stout pungent spine, completely glabrous on both sides, very lustrous above, paler and opaque beneath, inner blades carinate. Inflorescence densely capitiform, sunk in the center of the rosette; primary bracts like the inner leaves, tomentellous inside toward apex; branches with as many as 7 subdistichous flowers, short; axes all brown-tomentellous. Floral bracts subovate-lanceolate, acute, about equaling the flowers, sparsely dentate, obtusely carinate, subglabrous; pedicels short but evident; flowers ca 6 cm long. Sepals free, suberect, narrowly lanceolate, acute, 30 mm long, 5 mm wide, tomentellous at base, becoming glabrous elsewhere; petals glabrous (?); ovary attenuate toward base, slightly constricted at apex, covered with fine appressed scales.

description: Leaves many, rosulate, often over 2 m long, not at all constricted between the sheath and the blade; sheaths very broad, densely and coarsely tomentose-lepidote; blades linear, attenuate, 4 cm wide, deep green above, pale green and very minutely pale-appressed-lepidote below, armed with stout teeth up to 10 mm long. Scape stout, white-farinose; scape-bracts foliaceous but with the sheaths roseate and subinflated. Inflorescence many-flowered, narrowly pyramidal, white-farinose; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but the upper ones entire; branches up to 12-flowered. Floral bracts linear-subulate from a short broad base, 3 cm long, much shorter than to about equaling the ovary; flowers up to 6 cm long, distinctly pedicellate. Sepals erect, very narrowly triangular-subulate, 15-30 mm long, flat or nearly so, pale; petals 3 cm long, 5.5-6 mm wide, linear-elliptic, rose with white base and margins, densely white-tomentose at the apex; ovary slenderly ellipsoid, 2 cm long. Fruit ovoid, about 35 mm long, yellow or ochraceous, strongly verrucose, acidulous, aromatic.

description: Leaves 1 m long or more, not at all constricted between blade and sheath; blades linear, attenuate, pungent, armed with stout teeth 3 mm long, glabrous and shiny above. Scape slender, elongate, geniculate toward the summit; scape-bracts linear-lanceolate, small, serrate, coarsely villous-lepidote toward apex. Inflorescence many-flowered, broadly and laxly subthyrsoid, 3-4 dm long, 11 cm in diameter; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but less serrate, reflexed; branches well developed, elongate, laxly 4-flowered. Floral bracts ovate, shorter than the ovary, entire or faintly crenulate; flowers suberect, slender, to 55 mm long. Sepals erect, elliptic-oblong, broadly acute and mucronate, free, brown-furfuraceous; petals 3 cm long, acute and mucronate, short-connate, flavous, slightly lepidote toward apex; ovary slenderly cylindric, slightly sulcate.

description: Plant stemless. Leaves about 15 in a flat spreading rosette with its base partially sunk in the ground; sheaths suborbicular, 4 cm long, their upper third laxly serrulate and covered on the outside with coarse brown scales; blades curved or contorted, linear, attenuate, 18 mm wide, pale-appressed-lepidote on both sides, then more or less glabrous, laxly serrate with curved spines 2 mm long, brilliant red toward base, elsewhere green. Inflorescence subglobose, ca 4 cm in diameter, sessile in the center of the rosette; primary bracts obovate, 4 cm long, serrulate and white-lepidote toward apex, thin. Floral bracts linear, otherwise like the primary bracts, 3 cm long, about equaling the sepals. Sepals free, elliptic, obtuse and cucullate, 15 mm long, sharply carinate, serrate near apex, white-lepidote becoming glabrous; petals narrow, erect, 20 mm long,  glabrous; filament-tube 8 mm long; ovary slenderly cylindric, 20 mm long, persistently and finely white-lepidote.

description: Leaves 30-40 in a dense rosette, 1-3 m long, not narrowed between sheath and blade; sheaths evident, broadly triangular, very thick, serrate, dark brown and covered with coarse linear brown scales; blades linear, attenuate, pungent, 30-45 mm wide, laxly serrate with stout curved spines 7 mm long, green and glabrous above, whitish beneath. Inflorescence very densely corymbose, nearly sessile in the center of the rosette, surrounded by purple or red inner leaves, few-many-flowered, except the petals covered with linear brown scales; branches very short. Floral bracts oblanceolate, obtuse, exceeding the sepals, serrulate, membranaceous, brown; flowers 4-5 cm long, very short-pedicellate. Sepals free, erect, narrowly lanceolate, subacute, 25-27 mm long, slightly carinate, coriaceous; petals 32 mm long, connate to the middle, rose; ovary stout-ellipsoid, 2 cm long, 8-10 mm in diameter.

description: Plant flowering ca 1 m high (! Irwin). Leaves at least 37 cm long, not narrowed between sheath and blade; sheaths broadly ovate-triangular, 4 cm wide, covered beneath with coarse oblong brown scales; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, 2 cm wide, covered with coarse appressed white scales, becoming glabrous above, laxly serrate with antrorse and retrorse spines 3-4 mm long. Scape erect, 7 mm thick, covered with small finely divided crisped brown scales; scape-bracts erect and imbricate but narrow and exposing the scape, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper lance-ovate with a thick linear blade, rose-pink, subchartaceous when dry, covered beneath with appressed white scales. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, cylindric, 20-27 cm long, white-tomentulose with small finely divided scales; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts but ovate, the lowest exceeding the flowers; branches short but distinct. Floral bracts broadly ovate-triangular, several times shorter than the ovary; pedicels short and obscure. Sepals free, ovate-triangular, obtuse, 6 mm long, ecarinate; petals imperfectly known; blades erect, ca 10 mm long; stamens with filament-tube 10 mm long; ovary cylindric, 20 mm long, 2 mm thick.

description: Plant propagating by rhizomes, flowering 2-6 dm high; leaves 2-15 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 2-8 cm wide, glabrous above and the lower half beneath, the upper half beneath covered with coarse brown subspreading scales; blades linear, attenuate, not at all constricted at base, 2 cm wide, glabrous above, covered with white ap-pressed scales beneath, laxly serrate with uncinate teeth 4-7 mm long, the basal teeth recurved, the others ascending. Scape erect, elongate; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, densely imbricate. Inflorescence ellipsoid or short-cylindric, much longer than wide, 4 cm in diameter; primary bracts broadly elliptic, covering all but the apices of the flowers, the lowest with small foliaceous blades; branches short, few-flowered. Floral bracts exceeding the ovary, oblong, obtuse, cucullate, carinate, serrulate, white-lepidote; flowers subfasciculate, subsessile, 32-39 mm long. Sepals free, oblong, obtuse and cucullate, 12-15(-20) mm long, carinate, conduplicate, densely white-lepidote; petals erect, lilac; filaments connate for 5 mm; ovary slenderly ellipsoid, densely white-lepidote.

description: Plants relatively small, less than 1 m in diameter, propagating by leafy stolons. Leaves densely rosulate, the outer recurving, the inner suberect and usually tinged with red or purple; sheaths triangular-ovate, tomentose-lepidote or glabrous; blades not at all constricted toward base, attenuate, pungent, 15-30 mm wide, appressed-white-lepidote becoming glabrous above and on the nerves beneath, laxly serrate with spines 3-4 mm long. Inflorescence sessile in the center of the rosette, corymbose, few-flowered, densely white-lanate except the petals. Floral bracts lanceolate to linear, equaling the sepals; flowers 5-7 cm long. Sepals free, oblong, obtuse, carinate toward apex, cucullate, 20-25 mm long, entire; petals linear, obtuse, 40 mm long, connate for 1/3 their length, purple at apex, white below, glabrous; stamens included; ovary cylindric.

description: Leaves many in a dense rosette, not constricted between the sheath and blade, 1.5 2 m long; sheaths conspicuous, broadly triangular; blades linear, attenuate, 4-5 cm wide, serrate with uncinate brown spines 5-8 mm long, pale green on both sides, minutely and closely appressed-lepidote beneath. Scape stout, to 25 cm long, but largely concealed by the leaf-sheaths. Inflorescence subconic-oblong to hemispheric, to 18 cm long, 9 cm in diameter, many-flowered; outer primary bracts ovate, very large, long-laminate, within greenish white and nearly glabrous, beneath very densely pale-lepidote, with linear allutaceous scales, laciniate-serrate; branches short with the flowers fasciculate. Floral bracts linear-oblong, acute or bilobed, 5-6 cm long, 7-8 mm wide, thin-papyraceous, densely paleaceous-lepidote beneath; flowers 6-7 cm long, distinctly pedicellate. Sepals linear, 25 mm long, pale, densely white-farinose; petals linear-lanceolate, obtuse, recurved at apex, 3 cm long, 5-6 mm wide, connate for 8 mm, white or pale rose except the base and margins; stamens much shorter than the petals, anthers linear-subulate, slightly incised at base, 15 mm long; ovary terete or slightly trigonous, style equaling the anthers; ovules few in each cell. Fruit ovoid, 40 mm long, 22 mm in diameter, yellow or ochraceous-yellow, strongly verruculose, the rind aromatic, acidulous.

description: Leaves over 1.5 m long, not constricted between sheath and blade; sheaths covered above with a dense coat of linear ferruginous scales; blades linear, 40 mm wide, serrate with curved spines 5 mm long, glabrous above, conspicuously incanous-lepidote beneath. Inflorescence sunk in the center of the rosette (?). Floral bracts oblong-obovate, narrowly rounded at apex, 80 mm long, 20 mm wide, equaling the sepals, laciniate toward apex but the teeth hidden by the indument, the upper half covered by a long dense coat of brown linear scales; pedicels very stout and merging with the ovary, to 15 mm long. Sepals free, linear-oblong, slightly narrowed toward apex, to 26 mm long, carinate, entire, stout-coriaceous; petals erect, 38 mm long, over half connate, glabrous, thick, the lobes narrowly elliptic, strongly convex.

description: Leaves of rosette unknown to Mez but evidently not contracted between sheath and blade (judging from scape-bracts); scape very short; scape-bracts foliaceous with long blades, their sheaths broadly elliptic, inflated, pale rose, subglabrous within, linear-lepidote especially on the margins outside, coarsely serrate toward apex, their blades attenuate to a pungent apex, very rigid, glabrous above, densely and minutely lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with mixed antrorse and retrorse, 3 mm long spines. Inflorescence capitate-subcorymbose with short, few-flowered branches; axes covered with pale, linear scales. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, nearly equaling the sepals, tomentellous, ecarinate, minutely serrate especially toward apex; flowers to 45 mm long, exceeding the floral bracts, obscurely short-pedicellate. Sepals broadly elliptic, rounded and somewhat crisped at apex, to 30 mm long, weakly carinate, glabrous at least toward apex; petals linear-ligulate, obtuse, 36 mm long, fleshy, glabrous; stamens included; anthers linear, 7-8 mm long; ovary subprismatic, little if at all contracted at apex, covered with a brown-alutaceous tomentum.

description: Plant flowering over 4 dm high. Leaves over 2 m long, sheaths oblong, 10 cm long, badious-tomentose; blades dilated at base, elsewhere linear-triangular, acuminate, pungent, to 5 cm wide, glabrous, very laxly serrate with antrorse curved spines 10 mm long. Scape stout; scape-bracts erect, very densely imbricate, foliaceous. Inflorescence densely cylindric, 30 cm long, 10 cm in diameter, badious-lepidote including the petals; primary bracts erect, the lowest long-laminate, completely covering the short flowering branches. Floral bracts oblong, not at all dilated at apex, broadly acute, 4 cm long, distinctly exceeding the ovary, flat, laxly serrulate; pedicels slender, to 10 mm long. Sepals free, sublinear, carinate, cucullate, 27 mm long, sparsely serrulate; petals slightly exceeding the sepals; filament-tube 9 mm long; ovary cylindric, 13 mm long.

description: Plant propagating by rhizomes, flowering 2-3 dm high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, not constricted between sheath and blade, 3-5 dm long; outer sheaths short, broadly triangular, covered with coarse linear brown scales, serrate toward apex, inner sheaths large, elliptic; blades recurved, narrowly triangular, attenuate, complicate, 1216 mm wide, laxly serrate with retrorsely curved brown spines 3 mm long, wholly glabrous or covered beneath with a pale membrane of fused scales, inner blades red. Scape 10-15 cm high; scape-bracts like the inner leaves, densely imbricate; inflorescence very densely subcorymbose, 5 cm in diameter; axes densely white-tomentose; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but with short blades. Floral bracts broadly elliptic-oblong, obtuse, carinate, ca 3 cm long, equaling or slightly exceeding the sepals, serrulate, pale, minutely tomentose; pedicels very short. Sepals like the floral bracts but only 20 m long, free, erect; petals erect, slightly exceeding the sepals, obtuse, thick, connate with the filaments for 5-6 mm, bluish rose; stamens included; ovary very short, subcylindric, white-tomentose.

description: Leaves over 12 dm long; sheaths large, suborbicular, their apices covered with dark brown linear scales; blades linear, not constricted, to 4 cm wide, laxly serrate with hooked spines to 5 mm long, covered with appressed white scales. Scape none. Inflorescence densely corymbose, few-flowered, covered with dark brown linear scales; primary bracts broadly elliptic, 7 cm long, coarsely serrate, dark brown, chartaceous. Floral bracts elliptic-oblong, about equaling the ovary, laxly serrulate, very thin. Sepals lance-oblong, free, carinate, cucullate, 22 mm long, 6-8 mm wide, entire, thin; petals 33 mm long, joined with the filaments into a tube 18 mm high; ovary cylindric, 5 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Plant short-caulescent, propagating by numerous erect basal offsets. Leaves many, spreading, 9-12 dm long; sheaths oblong, 4 cm wide, brown, bearing coarse brown linear scales; blades sublinear, long-attenuate, contracted at base and then abruptly dilated into a suborbicular section, 5 cm wide, broadly channeled in the middle, brown-lepidote, soon glabrous above, laxly serrate with spines 1.5 mm long. Inflorescence few-flowered, densely corymbose, 5 cm in diameter, sunk in the center of the rosette, densely brown-lepidote including the petals; primary bracts subfoliaceous, the blades small, the sheaths equaling the sepals. Floral bracts oblong, much exceeding the ovaries, serrulate, thin and fragile when dry; flowers obscurely pedicellate. Sepals oblong, obtuse, cucullate, 21 mm long, connate to the middle, convex, serrulate; petals linear, obtuse, 37 mm long, much exceeding the stamens; filament-tube 17 mm long; ovary subcylindric, to 3 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Leaves rosulate, not constricted between sheath and blade, 2 dm long; sheaths large, suborbicular, thick, densely imbricate and forming a pseudobulb on the ground, covered near apex with coarse linear dark brown scales; blades recurved, linear, pungent, rigid, 10 mm wide, glabrous, laxly serrate with broad curved spines 4 mm long. Inflorescence densely subglobose, sessile in the center of the rosette, few-flowered; primary bracts linear and then expanded and white-tomentose toward apex, coarsely serrate. Floral bracts with linear claws and broad serrulate blades, equaling the sepals, ecarinate, greenish-rose; flowers short-pedicellate. Sepals free, elliptic, obtuse, cucullate, to 12 mm long, strongly carinate, densely white-tomentose; petals glabrous; ovary slenderly cylindric, densely white-tomentose.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Leaves unknown. Scape over 45 cm long, 8 mm in diameter, decurved at least in age, finely brown-lanate; scape-bracts erect, undoubtedly foliaceous, linear, acuminate, many times longer than the internodes, over 35 mm wide, roseate, laxly serrate with curved spines 5 mm long, the suborbicular base brown-lanate, the blade laxly and obscurely brown-lepidote. Inflorescence sublax, ellipsoid, 13 cm long, densely brown-lepidote with the possible exception of the petals; primary bracts elliptic, the lower large, foliaceous-laminate, exceeding the flowers, the upper much smaller, apiculate; branches 4 cm long, laxly and secundly few-flowered, slender. Floral bracts linear, 3 cm long, about equaling the slenderly cylindric ovary, entire, membranaceous. Sepals linear, obtuse, 25 mm long, obtusely carinate, entire, connate for 8 mm; petals imperfectly known but obviously connate by their centers to the 6 mm filament-tube; epigynous tube subcylindric, 7 mm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 8 dm high. Leaves many in a bulbous rosette, to 24 m long; sheaths ample, 4 cm long, dark castaneous, densely and coarsely lepidote toward apex especially beneath, also serrulate; blades linear, attenuate, pungent, 40 mm wide, white-lepidote beneath especially between the nerves, soon glabrous above, laxly serrate with slender uncinate brown 7 mm long spines. Scape erect, slender, covered with a persistent white tomentum; scape-bracts densely imbricate, the lowest foliaceous, the upper elliptic, reddish, bearing a short foliaceous blade. Inflorescence subdensely bipinnate, subcylindric; axes white-tomentose; primary bracts elliptic, entire, the lowest short-laminate, the upper bladeless, about half as long as the few-flowered fascicles, subchartaceous, soon glabrous. Floral bracts oblong, obtuse, 2 cm long, about equaling the ovaries, thin, ecarinate, white, soon glabrous; flowers subsessile. Sepals like the floral bracts, 15 mm long; petals erect, 23 mm long, glabrous, white at base, dark dull purple above; stamens included; filament-tube 8 mm long; ovary slenderly ellipsoid, 2 cm long, white-flocculose. Fruit broadly ellipsoid, to 4 cm long, nearly even.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Plant 7-15 dm high. Leaves numerous in a very dense rosette, to 15 dm long; sheaths distinct, triangular-ovate, covered above with a felt of long fine pale brown scales; blades linear, attenuate, 3-4 cm wide, glabrous and lustrous above, finely pale-lepidote between the nerves beneath. Scape stout, pale brown-flocculose; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, red with thin bases. Inflorescence slenderly cylindric, dense or lax, buff-tomentose except for the petals; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but less serrate and gradually smaller. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, serrulate, 10-15 mm long, about equaling the ovary. Sepals free, broadly ovate, rounded and mucronate, 917 mm long, carinate; petals yellow, fleshy, glabrous, blades spreading at anthesis, elliptic, obtuse, 9-10 mm wide; ovary obconic, merging gradually into the pedicel. Fruit turbinate, yellow, very sweet, not verrucose.

description: Leaves not narrowed between sheath and blade, to over 12 dm long; sheaths short, subtriangular, covered with fine linear dark brown scales; blades linear, attenuate, pungent, 25-40 mm wide, laxly serrate with curved spines to 8 mm long, minutely white-lepidote between the nerves beneath, the inner leaves red. Scape well developed, 15-20 mm in diameter; scape-bracts and primary bracts like the inner leaves, densely imbricate. Inflorescence laxly paniculate, pyramidal, densely and minutely white-tomentose except for the petals; branches spreading or reflexed, very laxly 4-15-flowered, often strongly geniculate, very slender. Floral bracts asymmetric, subovate, apiculate, 7 mm long; flowers spreading or subreflexed, slender, 40-45 mm long; pedicels usually curved, to 15 mm long. Sepals free, oblong, obtuse, flat or nearly so, 10 mm long, 2.5-3 mm long, subcoriaceous; petals very narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 27 mm long, much exceeding the stamens, connate for 6 mm., violet-purple; ovary subcylindric. Fruit ellipsoid, to 45 mm long, 15-25 mm in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Plant propagating by stolons, flowering over 1 m high. Leaves very many in a dense spreading rosette, not constricted between sheath and blade, over 1 m long; sheaths elliptic, large; blades linear, attenuate, 25 mm wide, glabrous above, closely pale-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with antrorse spines. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts like the inner leaves, erect, imbricate. Inflorescence paniculate, densely cylindric, 18-22 cm long, 7-9 cm in diameter; axes densely vestite with fine white to allutaceous tomentum; primary bracts large, covering most of the flowers; branches to 10-flowered, very dense with little or no sterile base. Floral bracts linear-subelliptic, rounded-truncate, ca 30 mm long, 8 mm wide, equaling the centers of the sepals, entire or slightly serrulate toward apex, subglabrous; flowers subsessile, ca 45 mm long. Sepals suberect, free, elliptic, obtuse, 14-20 mm long, 6-7 mm wide, carinate, cucullate, entire, coriaceous, allutaceous, soon glabrous except the minutely tomentellous base; petals erect and only slightly parted at anthesis, linear, obtuse, 25 mm long, 8 mm wide, connate for 7-8 mm, deep violet with broad white margins, glabrous; stamens included, filaments more than 1/2 connate, anthers narrowly elliptic, acute, 10 mm long; ovary clavate, trigonous, not constricted at apex, attenuate toward base, 15 mm long, 5 mm in diameter. Fruit ovoid, 47 mm long, 20 mm in diameter, fleshy, edible; seeds many, flat, triangular-orbicular, 5 mm wide, gray-black, minutely punctulate.

description: Plant flowering only about 12 cm high. Leaves to 7 dm long; sheaths broadly ovate, 3 cm long, castaneous, covered beneath toward apex with oblong brown retrorse-spreading scales, elsewhere glabrous, spinulose-serrate toward apex; blades linear, attenuate to a small rounded-apiculate apex, 8 mm wide, antrorsely serrate at base with spines 3 mm long, retrorsely above, sparsely pale-lepidote on both sides except at base where densely vestite like sheath. Scape to 4 cm long; scape-bracts narrowly obovate with large apical auricles, densely serrulate, thin, covered beneath with pale appressed scales, shorter than the flowers but their foliaceous blades much exceeding them. Inflorescence densely corymbiform, 4-5 cm in diameter, pale-lepidote; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but with shorter blades. Floral bracts subclavate with an elliptic-dilated thickened serrulate apex, exceeded by the sepals; flowers obscurely short-pedicellate. Sepals free, linear, 20 mm long, cucullate and serrulate at apex, conduplicate, somewhat glabrescent and contrasting with the ovary; petals narrowly ligulate without a distinct blade, pale-lepidote near apex; filament-tube 18 mm long; ovary slenderly cylindric, covered with fine pale spreading scales.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Plant flowering to 4 dm high. Leaves many, not narrowed between sheath and blade, to 5 dm long; sheaths short, ovate, covered with dark linear scales; blades linear, acute, pungent, 15 mm wide, green and glabrous above, densely pale-lepidote beneath, serrate with broad curved dark brown spines 5-10 mm long. Scape white-flocculose; scape-bracts foliaceous, very large. Inflorescence paniculate, laxly cylindric, white-flocculose except for the petals; lower primary bracts subfoliaceous, much exceeding the branches, rose; branches few-flowered, lax. Floral bracts subovate, 8-10 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, equaling or shorter than the ovary; flowers 22-25 mm long, very short-pedicellate. Sepals free, erect, lanceolate, broadly acute, 12-13 mm long, 6-7 mm wide, slightly unequal, carinate; petals ligulate, obtuse, 16 mm long, connate for 5 mm, purple, glabrous, thick; stamens included; ovary obconic.

description: Plant flowering to 3 m high, propagating by stout rhizomes to 1 m long; leaves to 100 or more in a dense rosette, not narrowed between sheath and blade, to 3 m long; outer sheaths short, broadly subtriangular, covered toward apex with linear brown scales, inner sheaths large, elliptic, pale, pale-flocculose; outer blades linear, attenuate, pungent, 20-35 mm wide, laxly serrate with stout antrorse and retrorse curved spines to 8 mm long, glabrous above, minutely pale-lepidote between the nerves beneath, green, the inner blades red and smaller. Scape usually short but always evident, stout, densely white-flocculose; scape-bracts like the inner leaves, very densely imbricate. Inflorescence subcylindric, dense or sublax, 2-10 dm long, 6-30 cm in diameter, minutely white-flocculose except for the petals; primary bracts like the scape-bracts the uppermost bladeless, the lowest much exceeding the branches; branches erect or suberect, from a few fasciculate flowers to 12 racemose ones. Floral bracts broadly subelliptic, obtuse or acute, 6-10 mm long, shorter than the ovary, entire, whitish, submembranaceous; pedicels rather slender, those of the lower flowers to 1 cm long; flowers 35-40 mm long. Sepals free, erect, elliptic or oblong, obtuse or broadly subacute, slightly if at all carinate, nearly flat, 6-13 mm long, submembranaceous, entire; petals erect, oblong, obtuse, 25-30 mm long, short-connate with the filaments, purple, glabrous; stamens included; ovary cylindric. Fruit ovoid or ellipsoid, to 50 mm long, 25 mm in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Plant flowering 2 m or higher. Leaves many, suberect, 3-4 m long; sheaths subtriangular, dark castaneous, covered with linear brown scales; blades linear, attenuate, pungent, slightly contracted at base, 7 cm wide, broadly channeled, glabrous above, pale-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with broad flat curved spines 6 mm long. Scape stout, densely brown-lepidote; scape-bracts fragile, soon losing the blades, the sheaths subelliptic, over 12 cm long, serrulate, brown-lepidote. Inflorescence densely cylindric, obtuse, 25 cm long, 7 cm in diameter, brown-lepidote including the petals; primary bracts erect, short-laminate, their sheaths suborbicular, covering most of the short dense branches. Floral bracts oblong, acute, 3-4 cm long, exceeding the ovary, conduplicate, serrulate; flowers obscurely pedicellate. Sepals subtriangular, 20-24 mm long, free, entire, convex or obtusely carinate, thin, fragile; petals 27 mm long, the blades purple-spotted; filament-tube 5 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid, 2 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Plant flowering nearly 1 m high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, about 1 m long, not at all constricted between the sheath and the blade; sheaths large, ovatae, laciniate-serrate near the summit, very densely white-tomentose-lepidote; blades linear, attenuate, pungent, armed with stout teeth 5 mm long, glabrous and lustrous deep-green above, densely pale-appressed-lepidote below. Scape stout, densely white-floccose; scape-bracts with inflated roseate sheath and spreading foliaceous coral-red blade. Inflorescence subdensely subthyrsoid, often interrupted toward the base, densely white-floccose throughout; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but with smaller blades, the upper ones ovate, acute, entire; branches erect or suberect. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, flat, not at all subulate, shorter to longer than the ovary, entire, thin; flowers up to 5 cm long; pedicels very short and stout. Sepals erect, lance-triangular, acute or obtuse, free, flat or nearly so, 15-18 mm long; petals barely spreading at anthesis, lanceolate, obtuse, 25 mm long, fleshy, blue or rose with white margin, glabrous or very scantily lepidote at the apex, connate for only 3 mm; ovary cylindric. Fruit subglobose, strongly verrucose (! Mez), 2 cm in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Plant flowering 2 dm high, 8 dm in diameter. Leaves 30-40 in a dense rosette, often 5 dm long; sheaths short, triangular, covered with fine brown appressed (not tomentose) scales, sparsely and finely serrate; blades narrowed toward base but not petiolate, attenuate, pungent, 35 mm wide, dark green but the inner bright scarlet, covered beneath with white closely appressed scales, serrate with very stout green or allutaceous spines 5 mm long, the upper spines antrorse. Scape 8 cm long, stout, appressed-brown-tomentellous. Inflorescence slightly above the center of the rosette, densely paniculate, globose, to 10 cm in diameter, much branched, many-flowered; primary bracts very broadly ovate, inflated, shorter than the flowers, laciniate-denate, appressed-brown-tomentellous especially beneath, bearing a very short spinose-serrate blade; branches to 15 mm long, 3-5-flowered; rhachis closely appressed-tomentellous with dark brown scales. Floral bracts linear-triangular, much shorter than the ovary, membranaceous, glabrous; pedicels very short; flowers to 45 mm long. Sepals free, suberect, linear-lanceolate, subacute, to 17 mm long, conduplicate, reddish allutaceous in life, subglabrous; petals erect, subacute, ca 30 mm long, connate for 8 mm, white at base, pale red toward apex, glabrous; stamens 5 mm shorter than the petals; filaments slender, 5 mm long; anthers 11 mm long; ovary prismatic or fusiform, very finely umber-tomentellous.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1979. Bromelioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (3): 1493-2142.

description: Plant flowering 1 m high. Leaves rosulate, 20-25 cm long; sheaths short, scarcely wider than the blades, dark castaneous; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, pungent, flat, to 35 mm wide, entire, glabrous and lustrous above, subdensely punctulate-lepidote beneath, green. Scape erect, 6 mm in diameter, densely brown-puberulent; scape-bracts narrowly triangular, attenuate, glabrous, thickened toward apex, the highest much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence subdensely tripinnate, 25-45 cm long, 15 cm in diameter, densely puberulent except for the primary bracts; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, to 18 mm long; branches slender, rather laxly flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, about half as long as the ovary, thin; flowers sessile, divergent or spreading. Sepals oblong-elliptic, obtusely carinate and cucullate, 4 mm long; petals oblong-elliptic, obtuse, about equaling the sepals, white; stamens free, included; ovary 5-6 mm long, terete, slightly superior; styles free.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plant flowering 2-3 m high; stems (in the shade) to 2 m high. Leaves numerous, densely rosulate, 5-10 dm long, entire; sheaths broadly elliptic, 3-4 dm long, ample, merging with the blades, castaneous, evenly and subdensely appressed-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly subacute to rounded, apiculate, flat, 9-12 cm wide, regularly and closely nerved, sparsely and obscurely lepidote above, finely and regularly brown-spotted beneath with each spot consisting of several scales. Scape erect, 25 mm in diameter, soon glabrous; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, ascending, loosely imbricate. Inflorescence diffusely paniculate, 3-pinnate, densely and minutely ferruginous-stellate, the axes straight; primary bracts broadly ovate or ligulate, apiculate, to 12 cm long; branches elongate, spreading or the lowest ascending. Floral bracts ovate, attenuate, 3-5 mm long, about equaling the ovary, thin; pedicels short but distinct. Sepals and petals subequal, elliptic, 3.5	mm long; sepals sparsely lepidote; petals not at all unguiculate, white; stamens free, slightly shorter than the petals; ovary terete, wholly inferior; styles connate at base. Capsule slenderly clavate, 10-12 mm long; seeds with an elongate wing at each end, the basal wing sometimes splitting.

description: Plant flowering 6-20 dm high. Leaves to 7 dm long, strict, subdensely punctulate-lepidote; sheaths broadly ovate, ca 8 cm long, castaneous at base; blades narrowly subtriangular, pungent, ca 35 mm wide, involute when dry, reticulate. Scape erect, 1 cm in diameter; scape-bracts foliaceous, the lowest densely imbricate. Inflorescence amply 3_4-pinnate, minutely and densely brown-flocculose; primary bracts subfoliaceous, small, the highest much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches divergent, slender, the ultimate ones usually subfasciculate. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, much shorter than the ovaries; flowers sessile, divergent. Sepals subtriangular, 4 mm long, hardly carinate; petals elliptic, obtuse, not cucullate, about equaling the sepals, yellow; stamens included, the filaments broad, their bases connate with the sepals and petals; ovary oblong-ellipsoid, trigonous, 8 mm long, wholly inferior; styles joined.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Stem prostrate, twisted, 20 cm in diameter. Leaves rosulate, to 1.8 m long, blades linear, caudate-acuminate, to 2 cm wide, glabrous, laxly serrate toward the base with dark curved spines 3 mm long, minutely serrulate elsewhere. Scape stout, floccose; scape-bracts subfoliaceous. Inflorescence amply paniculate; primary bracts much shorter than the branches, narrowly triangular, serrulate; branches slender, flocculose; ultimate racemes over 20 cm long, subdense. Floral bracts broadly ovate, long-caudate, barely exceeding the base of the sepals; flowers spreading to reflexed, subsessile. Sepals free, ovate, cucullate, 4 mm long, densely lepidote; petals subunguiculate, obtuse, 5-6 mm long; stamens free, included; ovary stout, 2/3 superior, style about equaling the petals. Seeds few, caudate-appendaged at either end.

description: Plant caulescent, flowering 1.5 m or higher; stem repent, over 3 dm long, 7 mm in diameter, foliate. Leaves to 23 cm long, entire, glabrous above, densely punctulate-lepidote beneath; sheaths elliptic, ca. 5 cm long, scarcely broader than the blades; blades narrowly subtriangular, attenuate but the extreme apex acute and apiculate, 35 mm wide, flat, green except for a narrow white margin, areolate; scape unknown. Inflorescence very laxly tripinnate, nearly 1 m long, sparsely and minutely white-furfuraceous; primary bracts ovate, acuminate, small, much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches, punctulate-lepidote; branches divergent, very slender, the ultimate ones often secund-flowered. Floral bracts ovate, acute, 2-3.5 mm long, exceeding the slender pedicels, membranaceous; flowers secund, spreading. Sepals lanceolate, obtuse, 6 mm long, thickened at base, ecarinate; petals broadly ovate, cucullate, short-unguiculate, about equaling the sepals, white; stamens included; ovary very slenderly cylindric, to 18 mm long, slightly superior; styles free.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 5-6 dm high. Leaves erect, few in a cylindric rosette, 25-50 cm long; sheaths large, merging with the blades, densely lepidote with impressed scales; blades linear, rounded and apiculate, 3-6 cm wide, pale green, obscurely punctulate-lepidote on both sides. Scape terete, scarcely more than 3 mm in diameter, glabrous, whitish below, green above; scape-bracts not over 30 mm long, the lower subdense, whitish, the upper distant, elliptic, green. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate or near base tripinnate, sparsely pale-lepidote; racemes to 10 cm long, slenderly subvirgate. Floral bracts ovate, abruptly acuminate, 3 mm long; flowers erect, or suberect, 5 mm long, short-pedicellate. Sepals elliptic-ovate, subacute and mucronulate, 4 mm long, nearly equaling the petals, glabrous; petals suborbicular, obscurely unguiculate; stamens short-connate with the perianth, the anthers ovate, mucronulate; ovary slender, tomentellous; style rather stout, not attaining the anthers, divided into 3 long stipitiform stigmas. Capsule subcylindric, slender, 10 mm long.

description: Plant flowering almost a meter high. Leaves rosulate, 40 cm long, scarcely any distinction between blade and sheath; blade narrowly triangular, involute, 2-3 cm wide, minutely and obscurely appressed-lepidote, the lower surface definitely lacunose. Scape erect, slender, terete, glabrous; scape-bracts foliaceous, exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate; primary bracts small, lance-acuminate, scarcely attaining the lowest flower of the raceme; racemes slender, about 20 cm long, laxly many-flowered. Floral bracts minute, about equaling the pedicels; flowers erect, gradually tapering into the pedicels. Sepals 4.5 mm long; stamens free, shorter than the petals. Capsule elliptic in outline, almost wholly inferior, 1 cm long, strongly 3-angled; seeds flat with a narrow wing at either end.

description: Plant to 8 m high. Leaves 6-12 dm long; sheaths ample, dark castaneous, pale-appressed-lepidote; blades broadly acute, pungent, 11 cm wide. Scape stout. Inflorescence amply paniculate, lax, to 3 m long covered with coarse pale appressed scales; primary bracts ovate, acute, pungent, shorter than the sterile bases of the branches. Floral bracts ovate, apiculate, shorter than the pedicels; flowers spreading, 12-15 mm long; pedicels 4 mm long. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 2.5 mm long; petals about equaling the sepals, claw narrow, blade reniform; stamens connate with the sepals and petals; ovary 5/6 inferior.

description: Plant stemless, flowering over 8 dm high. Leaves to 6 dm long, entire, obscurely punctulate-lepidote; sheaths elliptic, 7-8 cm long, membranous-margined, dark castaneous and lustrous at base; blades strict, narrowly triangular, ca 2 cm wide, the apical part ca 5 cm long, involute, thickened, smooth, dark castaneous beneath, the remainder of the blade revolute, green, rugose when dry. Scape straight, 5 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts long-attenuate from a broadly ovate base, their blades with apices like the leaves, much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly tripinnate, ca 5 dm long, glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches strict, slender. Floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acute, equaling the ovary or slightly shorter; flowers slightly divergent; pedicels short but slender. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 4.5 mm long; petals narrowly pandurate, cucullate, about equaling the sepals, white; stamens included, filaments of the second series slightly connate with the petals; ovary obovoid, trigonous, 4 mm long, wholly inferior; styles united.

description: Flowering plant 1 m or slightly higher; stem erect, robust, 8-15 cm high, covered with the dark bases of old leaves. Leaves rosulate at the apex of the stem, 2-3 dm long, sparsely and obscurely lepidote; sheaths elliptic, 6-9 cm long, scarcely broader than the blades, green except for the extreme base; blades ligulate, acute with a stout subulus, 3-6 cm wide, thick-coriaceous and pale green when dry. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, remote, from ovate tapering into a subulate-attenuate apex. Inflorescence narrow, laxly tripinnate, 3~4 dm long, nearly glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than the naked sterile bases of the branches; branches divergent, slender; spikes laxly few-flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, 3 mm long; flowers divergent; pedicels very short. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 5 mm long; petals 6 mm long, unguiculate, the blades elliptic, obtuse, white; stamens included, the filaments short-connate with the sepals and petals; ovary slightly superior; styles wholly connate.

description: Plant apparently stemless, flowering ca 3 dm high. Leaves suberect, 2 dm long, entire, white-cretaceous beneath; sheaths indistinct, more or less white-cretaceous above; blades ligulate, flat, broadly acute and stout-cuspidate, 4 cm wide, glabrous above. Scape short, hidden by the leaves; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate, lanceolate, small but subfoliaceous. Inflorescence densely tripinnate, ellipsoid, 13 cm long, 8 cm in diameter; axes covered with linear white scales; primary bracts acuminate from a broadly ovate base, pungent, thick, about half as long as the axillary branches, white-cretaceous beneath; branches simple or 2-3-forked, dense. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, about equaling the ovary, membranaceous, white, glabrous; flowers divergent, subsessile. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 5 mm long, white, thin, sparsely villous-lepidote at base; petals elliptic, obtuse, slightly exceeding the sepals, white, glabrous; stamens included, slightly unequal; ovary clavate, 5 mm long, slightly superior, densely villous-lepidote; styles distinct, slender.

description: Plant flowering 1-2 m high. Leaves numerous in a broad rosette, recurved-spreading, 4-8 dm long, sheaths ample, dark castaneous, densely punctulate-lepidote, blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 7-10 cm wide. Scape slender; lowest scape-bracts foliaceous, the others ovate, acute, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly paniculate, tripinnate; primary bracts small, like the upper scape-bracts; branches spreading. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate or apiculate, the lower ones about equaling the ovary; pedicels short. Sepals elliptic, acute, 3.5 mm long, thin; petals the same form and size as the sepals, white; ovary wholly inferior.

description: Plant flowering 20-35 cm high; stem erect, at least 3 cm high, 8 mm in diameter, covered with the dark remains of old leaf-bases. Leaves rosulate at the apex of the stem, to 16 cm long, sparsely appressed-lepidote; sheaths very broadly ovate, 1 cm long, dark castaneous, sublustrous; blades linear, attenuate, 4 mm wide, flat, densely nerved, pale green, entire. Scape erect, very slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, remote, small, narrowly triangular, sparsely lepidote. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 5-13 cm long, glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches divergent, 3-5 cm long, very slender, laxly few-flowered. Floral bracts ovate, acute, 2.5 mm long, membranaceous; flowers divergent, short-pedicellate. Sepals oblong, obtuse, 2.5 mm long, membranaceous, stramineous; petals oblong, obtuse, 3.5 mm long, not at all unguiculate, white; stamens included, filaments short-adnate to the sepals and petals; ovary clavate, 5 mm long, very slightly superior, styles distinct, slender.

description: Plant flowering 1 m or higher. Leaves rosulate, 5-6 dm long, sparsely and minutely lepidote, glaucous; sheaths elliptic, ample, dark castaneous; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and cuspidate-apiculate, 8 cm wide, reticulate. Scape erect, short, wholly covered by the leaves. Inflorescence elongate, very narrow, tripinnate, pale-flocculose, the axis flexuous; primary bracts strict and enfolding the axis, suborbicular, apiculate, the lowest 5 cm long and exceeding the basal flowers of the branches; branches strict, slightly divided or the highest simple, subdense, to 10 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, 3 mm long, scarious, nerved; pedicels slender, equaling or exceeding the bracts; flowers divergent. Sepals oblong, acute, 5 mm long, nerved; petals elliptic, barely exceeding the sepals, white; stamens included, strongly unequal, filaments forming a short tube with the sepals and petals; ovary slenderly fusiform, terete, wholly inferior; styles half connate. Seeds long-caudate.

description: Flowering plant 4 dm high. Leaves many, probably rosulate, 15 cm long, sparsely and obscurely lepidote beneath; sheaths elliptic, scarcely broader than the blades; blades ligulate, acute, thick-subulate at apex, 23 mm wide, even and sublustrous above. Scape ascending, slender; scape-bracts erect, much exceeding the internodes but hiding little of the scape, subulate-acuminate from a broadly ovate base. Inflorescence subdensely bipinnate, narrow, 22 cm long, subdensely vestite with minute brown hairlike scales; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, slightly exceeding the short sterile bases of the branches; branches divergent, subdensely flowered, 6 cm long, the rhachis slender, nearly straight. Floral bracts narrowly triangular from a very short broadly ovate base, equaling about the middle of the ovary, white; pedicels very short; flowers spreading. Sepals oblong, acute, 6 mm long, equaling the petals and stamens, white; petals elliptic, acute, white; stamens free, ovary slightly superior; styles free. Seeds long-caudate.

description: Plant probably caulescent, the flowering shoot small. Leaves over 4 dm long, entire, obscurely and sparsely lepidote beneath; sheaths narrowly triangular, inconspicuous, dark castaneous toward base; blades subpetiolate, linear-lanceolate, attenuate, 3 cm wide, flat, green, concolorous or sometimes slightly darkened toward apex. Scape unknown. Inflorescence small, laxly tripinnate, glabrous (?); axis very slender, flexuous; primary bracts triangular, shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches divergent, 6 cm long; racemes subdense. Floral bracts triangular-ovate, about equaling the pedicels; flowers subspreading; pedicels distinct, 1 mm long. Sepals subelliptic, 1.5 mm long; ovary almost wholly inferior. Capsule ellipsoid, beaked, 5 mm long.

description: Flowering plant 2 m high. Leaves in a bulbous rosette 25 cm in diameter, 8 dm long, sheaths elliptic, 20 cm wide, dark castaneous, subdensely appressed-white-lepidote, blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, 2-4 cm wide, glabrous. Scape straight, 2 cm in diameter, its bracts foliaceous, the upper ones with sheaths shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence amply paniculate, lax, 1 m long, glabrous or nearly so; primary bracts subfoliaceous. Floral bracts broadly triangular; flowers subsessile, divergent, 9-12 mm long. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, cucullate, 4.5 mm long; petals narrowly obovate; ovary terete, almost wholly inferior.

description: Leaves 12-15, tubular-rosulate, 6-10 dm long, minutely appressed-white-lepidote, green; sheaths large, narrowly ovate, barely wider than the blades, entire; blades ligulate, acuminate, 4-9 cm wide, spinose-serrate with teeth 1-4 mm long, marked with broad white cross-bands on the back. Scape suberect to arching, about equaling the leaves, 3-5 mm in diameter, white-floccose, becoming glabrous with age; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, elliptic-oblong, acute and apiculate, to 14 cm long, minutely serrulate, membranaceous, red, white-floccose. Inflorescence simple, laxly racemose, 2-5 dm long; axis slender, glabrous. Floral bracts linear-triangular, acuminate, the lowest to 2 cm long, membranaceous, white-floccose; pedicels spreading, to 5 cm long, 1 mm in diameter, glabrous; flowers glabrous. Sepals asymmetric, lance-triangular, acuminate, 21 mm long, green; petals linear-lanceolate, acute, 4-5 cm long, green, slightly recurved at anthesis, bearing 2 subentire scales at the base; ovary ellipsoid, 10-12 mm long, green, glabrous, the epigynous tube infundibuliform, 2-4 mm long; ovules caudate, borne at the apex of the cell.

description: Leaves few in a cylindric rosette, 5-11 dm long, densely and coarsely brown-lepidote especially beneath; sheaths narrowly elliptic; blades linear, abruptly acute with a pungent mucro, 3-6 cm wide, densely pale-lepidote beneath and white-banded or concolorous, laxly serrate with antrorse curved spines 1-1.5 mm long. Scape decurved, slender, densely white-farinose; scape-bracts lanceolate, acuminate, ample, typically violet but also red or green, the highest suberect. Inflorescence simple, subdensely to laxly cylindric, 10-26 cm long, 9 cm in diameter, many-flowered, white-farinose; rhachis straight. Floral bracts spreading, ovate, abruptly acute, shorter than the ovary; pedicels very short and obscure; flowers subspreading, 7 cm long. Sepals narrowly triangular, acute, unequal, one 14-18 mm, the others shorter, minutely soft-mucronate, glabrate; petals spirally recurved, lorate, acuminate, green, bearing 2 crenate scales at base; stamens erect at anthesis, the second series filaments very short-adnate to the petals; anthers linear, 8 mm long; ovary ovoid, 8 mm long, many-sulcate, otherwise even, constricted below the urceolate epigynous tube.

description: Leaves nearly 1 m long, densely pale-lepidote beneath, spotted toward base; sheaths narrowly elliptic, large; blades ligulate, attenuate to an acute apex, 6-10 cm wide, densely serrate with brown subspreading spines 3 mm long. Scape decurved, slender, densely white-farinose; scape-bracts elliptic, ample, to 20 cm long, thin, rose, white-lepidote. Inflorescence pendulous, simple, cylindric, 2 dm long, sublax, densely white-farinose; rhachis straight. Floral bracts ovate, acute, the lowest exceeding the sepals, the others shorter than the ovary; flowers erect to suberect, sessile, to 8 cm long. Sepals equal, elliptic, abruptly acute, to 10 mm long, verrucose at base; petals unguiculate, spirally recurved at anthesis, exceeding the stamens and pistil before, flavous-green except the violaceous apex; anthers filamentous, 20 mm long; ovary urceolate, sulcate, densely verrucose, the epigynous tube short and broad.

description: Plant flowering 6 dm high. Leaves rosulate, rigid, compressed; blades ligulate, abruptly acute, 6 dm long, 2-5 cm wide, spinulose, gray-green, white-banded. Scape 4 dm long, 8 mm in diameter, densely flocculose; scape-bracts lanceolate, 16-19 cm long, rose. Inflorescence simple, curved, many-flowered; rhachis straight, white-flocculose. Floral bracts ovate, acute, 8 mm long, membranaceous, rose; flowers sessile, 6-8 cm long. Sepals lance-ovate, acute, 12 mm long, green toward base, violet toward apex, flocculose; petals linear-lanceolate, acute, 5 cm long, 6 mm wide, blue, bearing 2 white scales at base; stamens 5 cm long, filaments pale blue, anthers filiform, 2 cm long, undulate; style 5 cm long, dark blue; ovary ovoid-conical, 12 mm long, trigonous, sulcate, white-flocculose; epigynous tube short, narrowed above ovary.
