description: Plants densely aggregated, to 2 m high. Leaves few in a slenderly tubular rosette, 6-20 dm long, green, concolorous when dry but with a few spots beneath in life; sheaths very large but narrow and indistinct, covered on both sides with minute appressed scales, sometimes reddish; blades ligulate, rounded and long-apiculate but the apex often decayed, 4-12 cm wide, densely white-lepidote especially beneath, serrate with stout spines 1-2 mm long. Scape stout, white-flocculose, green; scape-bracts erect, tightly clasping the scape, narrowly elliptic, acute, to 25 cm long, papyraceous, rose, white-lepidote. Inflorescence erect, very laxly paniculate, few-flowered, sparsely white-flocculose even to the petals sometimes; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, large; branches spreading, elongate, lax. Floral bracts 3-4 mm long, very broadly ovate or suborbicular, apiculate, green; flowers sessile, 50-75 mm long. Sepals more or less asymmetric, 12-24 mm long, green; petals linear, broadly rounded, to 5 cm long, pale blue above the sepals and pale green below, bearing at base 2 laciniate obliquely attached scales; stamens shorter than the petals and short-adnate to them; ovary slenderly cylindric, the epigynous tube almost lacking; fruit ellipsoid, sulcate.

description: Leaves to 1 m long; blades ligulate, acuminate, 40-65 mm wide, finely spinulose-serrate. Scape elongate, white-farinose; scape-bracts lance-oblong, acute, 15 cm long, membranaceous, carmine, massed below the inflorescence. Inflorescence simple, cylindric, 2 dm long, many-flowered, white-farinose. Floral bracts mostly deltoid, almost aborted, 2-3 mm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, 35-40 mm long; petals linear; style slender, to 12 cm long; ovary turbinate; epigynous.

description: Leaves to 9 dm or longer; blades ligulate, acuminate, laxly spinose-serrate. Scape rather stout, over 3 dm long, white-farinose; scape-bracts imbricate, broadly lanceolate, lance-oblong or lance-ovate, gradually acuminate (?), 15-18 cm long, 3-4 cm wide, entire. Inflorescence densely cylindric, 4 dm long, white-farinose except the petals. Floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, the lower 30-35 mm long, the upper 10-15 mm long; flowers sessile, ca 9 cm long. Sepals subequal, triangular-lanceolate, attenuate, 17-20 mm long; 6-7 mm wide; petals linear, attenuate, 80-85 mm long, pale green (?); ovary turbinate with the epigynous tube still wider and almost as long, lightly sulcate.

description: Plant flowering 7 dm long. Leaves 6 (! A. Seidel), over 5 dm long; blades ligulate, 3 cm wide, densely lepidote on both sides, prominently white-banded beneath, laxly serrulate with brownish spines 1 mm long. Scape curved, to 2 mm in diameter, soon glabrous; scape-bracts elliptic, acute, rolled about the scape in a slender cylinder, to 11 cm long, the upper imbricate, membranaceous, rose, covered with white appressed scales. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, few-flowered; axis slender, geniculate, finely and sparsely white-lepidote; primary bracts spreading, like the upper scape-bracts, to 8 cm long, much exceeding the branch-axes and about equaling the petals; branches short, 2-flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, about half as long as the ovary; flowers sessile. Sepals slightly asymmetric, lance-oblong, broadly subacute and minutely apiculate, 25 mm long, 6 mm wide; petals 5 cm long, blue-purple toward apex; ovary obovoid, 5 mm long, strongly sulcate, densely white-lepidote except the ridge-crests, the epigynous tube short.

description: Leaves 15-22 in a slenderly funnelform rosette, 3-4 dm long, green and unspotted; sheaths large, elliptic; blades ligulate, very broadly rounded, apiculate, to 6 cm wide, serrate with coarse black antrorsely curved spines to 7 mm long. Scape 5-8 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, clasping the scape, broadly elliptic, rounded, serrulate or entire, pale-appressed-lepidote, membranaceous, rose. Inflorescence usually pendulous, compound; primary bracts large, like the scape-bracts, sometimes serrulate; branches short, usually 2-flowered. Floral bracts obovate, obtuse, half as long as the ovary or more, membranaceous; flowers sessile, 6-7 cm long. Sepals slightly asymmetric, suboblong, acute or obtuse, 20-25 mm long, pale blue and lepidote at apex, elsewhere green and glabrous; petals never spiraled, linear, obtuse, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base, pale blue toward apex and the rest yellow-green, exceeding the stamens; ovary slenderly cylindric, sulcate, glabrous, green, the epigynous tube evident, funnelform.

description: Plant over 1.3 m long with the inflorescence extended. Leaves over 1.5 m long, minutely appressed-lepidote, sheaths large but scarcely wider than the blades, blades 11 cm wide, laxly serrate with straight dark spines 3-4 mm long. Scape slender, elongate. description: Leaves few, the outer arching-recurved, the inner tubular-rosulate, to 8 dm long, pale-banded beneath; blades ligulate, narrowly rounded and apiculate, 75 mm wide, laxly serrate with spines 2 mm long. Scape decurved, slender, glabrous except the nodes; scape-bracts imbricate, large, narrowly lanceolate, acute, papyraceous, rose. Inflorescence pendulous, simple, lax, to 18 cm long, sparsely white-farinose; rhachis straight, slender, red-brown. description: Leaves 1 m long; sheaths narrowly ovate; brown; blades ligulate, 5 cm wide, subdensely spinose-serrate, conspicuously white-spotted. Scape decurved, slender, densely white-farinose; scape-bracts lance-ovate. Inflorescence simple, 2-4 dm long, many-flowered, white-farinose except the petals. Floral bracts semiorbicular, obtuse, 4 mm long; flowers erect, sessile, 85 mm long. Sepals narrowly triangular, 12, 10, and 10 mm long respectively, verrucose; petals spirally recurved at anthesis, acute, 65 mm long, yellowish green, bearing crenate scales; ovary stout-ovoid, densely verrucose; fruit yellow, globose, 10 mm in diameter.

description: Leaves 6-9 in a tubular rosette, 3-8 dm long, marked with broad pale bands beneath; sheaths large, ovate; blades ligulate, 25-33 mm wide, broadly rounded, apiculate, laxly serrulate with spines 0.5 mm long. Scape decurved, very slender; scape-bracts few, elliptic, apiculate, membranaceous, red. Inflorescence pendulous, compound but few-flowered, very lax, sparsely lepidote becoming glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, remaining large above the middle of the inflorescence; branches 1-4-flowered, elongate. Sepals subsymmetric, oblong, rounded, minutely apiculate, 13-25 mm long, yellow or green except for the dark blue apex; petals linear, yellow or green below, dark blue above the sepals, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base, exceeding the stamens; ovary slenderly cylindric, epigynous tube funnelform, short.

description: Plant propagating by very short basal rhizomes. Sepals broadly ovate, broadly acute and apiculate, equal, 5-7 mm long; petals spirally recurved at anthesis, linear, wholly green or yellow-green, bearing 2 large fimbriate scales at base; stamens and style purple; ovary ellipsoid, 10-15 mm long, not verrucose, bearing dark glabrous longitudinal lines, the epigynous tube half as long as the ovary and nearly as wide, the placentae central.

description: Leaves few in a tubular rosette, ca 35 cm long; sheaths narrowly elliptic; blades ligulate, acute, apiculate, 2 cm wide, subglabrous, laxly and minutely serrulate to subentire. description: Leaves tubular-rosulate, 6 dm long; sheaths large, narrowly ovate; blades ligulate, acute, 45 mm wide, spinose-serrate with upwardly curved teeth 3 mm long. description: Leaves few in a tubular rosette, to 8 dm long; sheaths narrowly elliptic, obscurely appressed-lepidote; blades linear, acuminate, 22 mm wide, very laxly serrate with minute spines, subglabrous, apparently concolorous. description: Leaves 6-12 in a tubular rosette, wholly green and without spots, the outer much reduced, the inner to 75 cm long; sheaths large, ovate or elliptic, nearly concolorous with the blades, entire, appressed-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly acute, apiculate, to 55 mm wide, subglabrous, subdensely serrate with spines 0.5-1.5 mm long. description: Plant flowering slightly over 4 dm high with the inflorescence extended. Leaves to 53 cm long, covered with appressed white scales beneath; sheaths barely distinct, white-lepidote above; blades linear, long-acuminate, 1-2 cm wide, soon glabrous above, very laxly serrate with spines less than 1 mm long. description: Known only from fragments but apparently the habit typical of Billbergia subgenus Helicodea. description: Leaves few in a long tubular rosette, 40-75 cm long, pale-lepidote and white-banded beneath; sheaths very large, narrowly elliptic, entire or serrate toward apex; blades ligulate, acute, pungent, 35 mm wide, sublaxly serrate with antrorse curved spines 1-2 mm long. description: Leaves to 6 dm long; sheaths large, narrowly ovate-oblong; blades ligulate, acuminate, 3-4 cm wide, densely serrate with upwardly curved teeth 2.5 mm long, densely and minutely appressed-white-lepidote, concolorous. description: Leaves few in a tubular rosette, 3-7 dm long, minutely lepidote, pale-banded beneath; sheaths large but barely distinct from the blades; blades ligulate, broadly acute or rounded and mucronate, 3-8 cm wide, serrate with curved spines. description: Leaves 5-10 in a short tubular rosette, the inner 35-55 cm long, whitish beneath with pale appressed scales but not banded; sheaths elliptic; blades ligulate, acute and mucronate, 2-3 cm wide, laxly serrate with antrorse curved spines to 2 mm long. description: Plant stoloniferous, flowering 45-60 cm high. description: Plant propagating by short stout ascending rhizomes. Sepals asymmetric, narrowly elliptic, rounded and minutely apiculate, 12-18 mm long; petals never spiral, linear, obtuse, purple or dark blue toward apex, elsewhere pale green, exceeding the stamens, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base; ovary subcylindric, the epigynous tube evident.

description: Leaves few in a tubular rosette, about 3 dm long, concolorous; sheaths large, narrowly elliptic, indistinct, appressed-lepidote on both sides; blades ligulate, rounded and then narrowed to an elongate point, to 38 mm wide, laxly serrate with dark spines 1.5 mm long. Scape decurved, slender, tomentulose; scape-bracts suberect, broadly elliptic, apiculate, the upper imbricate. Inflorescence pendulous, lax, compound at base, simple above the middle, slightly tomentose; axis straight or geniculate toward apex; primary bracts large, like the scape-bracts; branches to 3 cm long, 1-3-flowered. Floral bracts obovate, obtuse, the upper ones half as long as the ovary; flowers sessile, ca 7 cm long. Sepals symmetric, narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 25-30 mm long, distinctly lepidote, green with a blue apex; petals never spiraled, linear, obtuse, pale yellow-green except the blue apex, slightly exceeding the stamens, bearing 2 serrate scales at base; ovary cylindric, 15 mm long, slightly lepidote at first.

description: Leaves few in a tubular or narrowly funnelform rosette, to 7 dm long, white-banded beneath and sometimes yellow-spotted as well; sheaths large but indistinct; blades ligulate, broadly acute or subrounded and apiculate, to 6 cm wide, sublaxly serrate with stout antrorse curved spines. Scape decurved, more or less white-farinose; scape-bracts lanceolate or elliptic, acute, large, entire, bright rose, the upper ones massed beneath the inflorescence. Inflorescence pendulous, simple, sublax, 10-15 cm long, densely white-farinose except the petals. Floral bracts minute or lacking; flowers sessile or subsessile, 9-10 cm long. Sepals suboblong or broadly ovate, broadly acute and apiculate, to 12 mm long; petals spirally recurved at anthesis, linear, acute, wholly green; stamens green or greenish yellow; ovary ellipsoid, scarcely or not at all sulcate, without spots or dark glabrous lines, the epigynous tube short.

description: Plant propagating by stolons, flowering 3-4 dm high. Leaves typically 5, forming a tubular tank; sheaths about equaling the blades, white and purple spotted outside, purple-marbled inside; blades ligulate, acuminate to a subpungent apex, 8-20 cm long, 3-6 cm wide, white-maculate beneath, laxly and minutely serrulate. Scape erect, 4 mm thick, red, densely white-floccose; lower internodes 5 cm long, upper 3 cm; lower scape-bracts lance-oblong, 9-10 cm long, 25 mm wide, greenish rose, the upper ca 6 clustered beneath the inflorescence, acuminate, slightly smaller, deep red, white-lepidote beneath. Inflorescence simple, to 7-flowered, 10 cm long; axis red, densely white-floccose. Floral bracts not described; pedicels to 10 mm or longer, slightly geniculate, red, white-floccose. Sepals free, linear, rounded and emarginate, 17 mm long, 5 mm wide, white-floccose, the lower half red, the upper green; petals linear-spatulate, 35 mm long, bearing 2 denticulate scales at base, the blade dark violet, the claw green; anthers linear, 4 mm long; pollen ellipsoid, bisulcate; ovary subcylindric, 12 mm long, red, white-floccose; epigynous tube none; placentae slightly above median; ovules many, obtuse.

description: Leaves (inner only) ca 1 m long; sheaths very large; narrowly elliptic, subglabrous (! Mez), entire; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 95 mm wide, subglabrous, without evident banding, subdensely serrate with brown curved spines over 2 mm long. Scape decurved, slender, white-farinose; scape-bracts very large, imbricate, lanceolate, acute. Inflorescence pendulous, simple, lax, cylindric, many-flowered, 4 dm long, 5 cm in diameter, densely white-farinose except the petals. Floral bracts minute, hidden in the indument; flowers sessile, ca 7 cm long. Sepals broadly ovate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 7 mm long; petals spirally recurved, 6 cm long, violet, bearing 2 scales adnate to 3 mm above the base; ovary slenderly obconic, the epigynous tube equally long.

description: Plant flowering to 35 cm high with the inflorescence extended. Leaves 3 dm long, appressed-pale-lepidote on both sides, pale green with purple spots; sheaths elliptic, distinctly broader than the blades; blades ligulate, over 3 cm wide, slightly narrowed toward the base, rounded and short-apiculate, laxly serrate with suberect spines 2 mm long. Scape decurved, slender, soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, broadly elliptic, apiculate, whitish (! Foster), densely pale-lepidote. Inflorescence compound, 17 cm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, large, covering the flowers until anthesis; branches short, 1-2-flowered. Floral bracts suborbicular, apiculate, 2 mm long; flowers sessile. Sepals oblong, obtuse, slightly asymmetric, 16 mm long; petals linear, obtuse, 4 cm long, greenish white, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base, exceeding the stamens; stamens free; pollen ellipsoid, sculptured, sulcate when dry; ovary cylindric, 15 mm long, epigynous tube lacking but three deep pockets between the carpels; placentae linear; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves 8-10 dm long; sheaths large; blades linear-triangular, long-attenuate, 4-6 cm wide, densely and minutely white-lepidote, laxly serrate with nearly straight spines 1-1.2 mm long. Scape decurved or pendulous, 5-6 mm in diameter, densely white-farinose becoming glabrous; scape-bracts suberect, lanceolate, acuminate, 14-17 cm long, subcoriaceous, white-floccose. Inflorescence pendulous, simple, cylindric, 25-30 cm long, laxly many-flowered, densely white-farinose. Floral bracts erect, deciduous, oblong-ovate or broadly lanceolate, acuminate, about equaling the ovary, membranaceous, 12-14-nerved; flowers subspreading, sessile. Sepals symmetric, subtriangular, obtuse and apiculate, subequal, 12-14 mm long, 5-7 mm wide, nerved; petals sublinear, acute, 30-35 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, membranaceous, strongly nerved, dilated at base; ovary oblong-ovoid, 20-22 mm long, deeply sulcate, the epigynous tube 4 mm long; placentae median to apical.

description: Leaf-blades ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, 4 dm long, 35 mm wide, covered on both sides with coarse cinereous appressed scales, laxly serrate with dark curved teeth 2 mm long. Scape slender, densely and very finely white-flocculose; scape-bracts lanceolate, acute, 13 cm long, rose. Inflorescence simple, densely many-flowered; axis white-flocculose. Floral bracts ovate, acute, shorter than the ovaries, membranaceous, glabrous except at base. Sepals equal, ovate, broadly acute, 10 mm long, thin, nerved, orange, nearly glabrous; petals linear, acute, spirally recurved, 5 cm long, yellow, bearing two broadly obovate, denticulate scales at base; ovary ellipsoid, strongly trigonous, 10 mm long, sulcate, white-flocculose, epigynous tube small and narrow.

description: Leaves to 10 in a slenderly funnelform rosette, pale green, obscurely spotted, to 4 dm long; sheaths large, elliptic, dark reddish above; blades ligulate, broadly rounded, minutely apiculate, to 6 cm wide, finely serrulate. Scape suberect, slender, glabrous, shorter than the leaves; scape-bracts large, elliptic, acute, bright rose. Inflorescence suberect, few-flowered, usually with a single one-flowered branch at base and elsewhere simple, to 12 cm long, 8 cm in diameter, glabrous. Floral bracts minute, triangular; flowers sessile, to 70 mm long. Sepals oblong, emarginate and without a mucro, 25 mm long, green except the dark blue apex; petals to 50 mm long, never spiral, the part above the sepals dark blue, bearing 2 coarsely serrate scales at base; stamens slightly shorter than the petals; ovary cylindric, 20 mm long, sulcate, pale green.

description: Plant propagating by short ascending rhizomes. Leaves 8-10 in a subtubular rosette, to 8 dm long, broadly white-banded beneath; sheaths large, broadly elliptic, nearly or quite concolorous with the blades; blades recurved, ligulate, broadly acute to subrounded, apiculate, 6-7 cm wide, rigid, laxly serrate with brown antrorsely curved spines 1.5-3 mm long, lepidote especially beneath. Scape decurved, white-farinose; scape-bracts suberect and massed beneath the inflorescence, large, lanceolate, acute, red. Inflorescence usually pendulous, simple, subdense, cylindric, elongate, densely white-farinose except the petals; rhachis straight. Floral bracts minute, nearly covered by the indument; flowers sessile, suberect, 65 mm long. Sepals barely asymmetric, suboblong, rounded and minutely apiculate, 10 mm long; petals contorted or some spirally recurved for a short distance, linear, acute, dark blue-purple except the white base, bearing 2 fimbriate scales; stamens shorter than the petals; ovary subterete, without dark lines, the epigynous tube short but distinct.

description: Leaves in a subinfundibuliform rosette, to 6 dm long, glabrous above, densely appressed-brown-lepidote beneath; sheaths ovate, small; blades linear-lanceolate, 4 cm wide, slightly contracted at base, laxly serrate with spines 1.5 mm long. Scape short, decurved, slender, densely brown-flocculose; scape-bracts large, much exceeding the internodes but spreading and not concealing the scape, lanceolate, membranaceous, rose. Inflorescence pendulous, simple, subdense, few-flowered, 14 cm long including the petals, densely brown-flocculose; rhachis slender, straight. Floral bracts much shorter than the ovaries, broadly ovate, acute; flowers sessile, divergent or spreading, rose. Sepals auricled, 13 mm long; petals linear, acute, 7 cm long, spirally revolute at anthesis, bearing 2 denticulate scales at base; stamens erect at anthesis, anthers linear, 18 mm long; ovary broadly turbinate, 8 mm long, sulcate, the epigynous tube broad, 2 mm long; placentae apical.

description: Leaves 6-10 in a slenderly ellipsoid rosette; sheaths broadly ovate, 20 cm long, 14.5 cm wide, densely lepidote on both sides, violet above, entire; blades ligulate, rounded with the apex usually decayed, 9 dm long, 10 cm wide, not constricted at base, dark green, white-banded beneath, very rigid, the lower half channeled, the upper half gently recurved, laxly serrate with stout antrorse spines 4-6 mm long. Scape 1 m long, terete, 14 mm in diameter, densely white-farinose; scape-bracts lance-ovate, acuminate, ca 25 cm long, 5 cm wide, exceeding the internodes, all but the lowest entire, rose-red, white-lanate. Inflorescence pendulous, simple, cylindric, 5 dm long, lax, about 50-flowered; rhachis straight, densely white-farinose. Floral bracts minute, 3-4 mm long without the 1 mm aculeolus, 6 mm wide, the upper 2 mm long, nearly hidden by the indument; flowers subverticillate, 10-12 cm long, on very short but distinct pedicels. Sepals free, broadly oblong, deeply emarginate with a sharp violet apiculus in the sinus, 11 mm long, 6 mm wide, yellow-green, tomentose; petals 10 cm long, 8 mm wide, spirally recurved at anthesis, yellow-green except the violet barbellate apex, bearing 2 fimbriate scales but no calli; stamens 20 mm shorter than the petals; anthers 30 mm long, violet; pollen ellipsoid, sulcate; placentae median to apical; ovules obtuse.

description: Plant very slender, nearly 1 m high, producing stolons at the base. Leaves linear, 70 cm long, acute, fasciculate; sheaths narrowly ovate, large; blades remotely spinose-serrate, constricted at the base, the inner ones channeled, 50 cm long and 2 cm wide, the outer ones much reduced and shorter than the sheaths. Scape slender, elongate; scape-bracts narrow, membranaceous, the lower longer than the internodes. Inflorescence glabrous, few-branched, brilliant-red, 15-22 cm long; primary bracts small, ovate, acuminate, membranaceous, spreading; spikes elongate, many-flowered, 1 cm broad, erect; rhachis flexuous, sulcate. Floral bracts ovate, acute or mucronulate, strongly pectinate, 7 mm long, concealing the flowers, auricled, reflexed; flowers sessile. Berry broadly ovoid, 5 mm long; seeds few, ovoid, curved.

description: Stemless, propagating by horizontal rhizomes. Leaves few in a long slenderly cylindric rosette, suberect, 7-18 dm long, equaling or exceeding the inflorescence, often subpetiolate, subglabrous, the outer ones much reduced; sheaths narrowly ovate, to 18 cm long; blades linear, acuminate, flat, 10-17 mm wide, green, laxly serrate with recurved spines 3 mm long. Scape erect, very slender; scape-bracts erect and enfolding the scape, imbricate, narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, glabrous, membranaceous, red. Inflorescence laxly paniculate, many-flowered, subpyramidal, 7-30 cm long; axes strongly curved-flexuous, slender, glabrous, red; lower primary bracts like the scape-bracts, much shorter than the branches, the upper much reduced and resembling the floral bracts; spikes very laxly 3-10-flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, 24 mm long; flowers sessile, ca. 5 mm long. Sepals symmetric, suborbicular, mucronulate, 0.5-0.75 mm long; petals obovate, 3-3.5 mm long, yellow; stamens included, filaments free; ovary subglobose, ca. 2 mm in diameter; placentae apical; ovules very few, very long-caudate. Fruit purple with about 6 slender seeds.

description: Plant stemless, 70 cm high; leaves few in an ellipsoid rosette, the outer ones reduced to acute sheaths, the inner about equaling the inflorescence; sheaths elliptic, about 25 cm long; blades ligulate, acute, narrowed toward base, flat, 4 cm wide, laxly serrulate. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts imbricate, lanceolate. Inflorescence laxly tripinnate, 14-28 cm long; lower primary bracts like the scape-bracts but smaller, much shorter than the axillary branches; branches divergent, 10 cm long, few-branched, slightly flexuous, slender, very laxly flowered. Floral bracts suborbicular, 3 mm long, apiculate, minutely serrulate, membranaceous; flowers sessile, spreading. Sepals free, oblong, asymmetric, 2 mm long, truncate and apiculate; petals 5 mm long, the blade elliptic, obtuse. Fruit globose, 3 mm long.

description: Stemless; flowering shoot 2-6 dm high. Leaves few, 7-40 dm long; sheaths forming a slenderly ovoid pseudobulb, entire or subentire, densely brown-lepidote, the inner ones 8-18 cm long; blades decurved, linear, filiform-attenuate, ca. 1 cm wide at base, coarsely and laxly serrate toward base, serrulate or entire toward apex, pale-lepidote. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts few, lanceolate, 2-12 cm long, thin, entire, pale-lepidote. Inflorescence bipinnate or rarely simple, subpyramidal, 1-3 dm long; primary bracts, lanceolate, 2-3 cm long, membranaceous, pale red; racemes to 8 cm long. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, 1-3 mm long; pedicels spreading, slender, 6-8 mm long; flowers lilac-green (! Huebner). Sepals asymmetric with the large wing exceeding the submucronate apex, oblong-ovate, 3 mm long; petals 6-9 mm long; ovary ellipsoid.

description: Shrub or tree to 18 m tall and 25 cm dbh.; twigs subterete, glabrate, usually moss-covered. Leaves simple, alternate, oblanceolate to narrowly obovate, acute, attenuate with the petiole undifferentiated and essentially lacking, 13-29 cm long, 4.0-8.5 cm wide, chartaceous, secondary veins 11-16 on a side, the midvein raised above, lepidote above and beneath, a few plate-shaped glands at base beneath, drying dark brown. Inflorescence a terminal fascicle, the pedicels glabrous to inconspicuously lepidote, 2.2-7.9 cm long, commonly reduced to a single flower. Flower with the calyx thick, fleshy, irregularly split into subequal anterior and posterior halves or merely ruptured apically by the expanding corolla, one of the lobes sometimes itself split, 2.5-2.8 cm long, 1.9-2.1 cm wide, glabrous; corolla greenish-white, tubular, usually with an inconspicuous transverse fold in the throat, fleshy, 4.1-5.2 cm long, 1.2-1.6 cm wide at the mouth, the tube 2.5-3.3 cm long, the lobes fused, 0.5-1.2 cm long, glabrous; stamens subexserted, inserted 13-18 mm from base of the tube, the anther thecae thick, somewhat divergent, 5 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, the anterior filaments 2.3-2.4 cm long, the posterior filaments 2.5-2.7 cm long; pistil 3.8-3.9 cm long, the ovary rounded-conical, 8-9 mm long, 4-5 mm wide, incompletely 2-locular with 2 protruding parietal placentae at the top, these fused above middle, the ovules then irregularly 4-seriate in each locule; disc pulvinate, ca. 3 mm long, 9-10 mm wide. Fruit ellipsoidal with the apex elongated, 12-15 cm long, 6.6-7.2 cm in diam., evenly rough-surfaced under a lens, inconspicuously scattered-lepidote; seeds thick, 1.5-2 cm long, 1.5-2.4 cm wide, without wings.

description: Leaves rosulate, stiff, erect, 1 m or longer; blades 35 mm wide, entire or nearly so except for the pungent, involute apex. Scape erect, elongate, slender, to 15 mm thick in life; scape-bracts foliaceous, erect. Syncarp subcylindric, ca 12 cm long, 5 cm thick in life, bearing numerous, short, foliaceous branches at base and apex, the flesh scant and unpalatable, the coma large. Floral bracts small, entire. Sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, ca 7 mm long; petals 17 mm long. Seeds few or none.

description: Leaf-blades coarsely and laxly spinose-serrate, the basal spines retrorse. Scape stout. Syncarp over 15 cm long at maturity, succulent. Floral bracts conspicuous, imbricate and covering the ovaries, coarsely serrate, pale green at maturity. Petals bearing vertical folds.

description: Plant stemless, spreading by stolons up to 7 dm long, flowering shoot 8 dm high. Leaves forming a slender infundibuliform rosette, green and very faintly striped above and inconspicuously though densely lepidote, beneath covered with two types of scales forming broad alternating cross-bands of green and white; sheaths small and inconspicuous; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 5 cm wide, laxly spinose-serrate. Scape elongate, 8 mm in diameter; scape-bracts elliptic, acute, serrate, thin and soon lost. Inflorescence bipinnate, subdense, 28 cm long; lower primary bracts like the scape-bracts, exceeding the stipes; spikes spreading, densely 17-flowered, 18 cm long including the 5 cm long naked strongly flattened stipe; rhachis narrow, strongly excavated. Floral bracts broadly ovate, navicular, entire, carinate near the apex, bicarinate and grooved below, 28 mm long, exceeding the sepals, coriaceous, even, obscurely punctulate-lepidote. Sepals free, lance-oblong, slightly asymmetric, muticous, 16 mm long; ovary globose.

description: Plant coarse, 1 m high or more. Leaves about 1 m long; blades ligulate, acuminate, thickened at apex, 7 cm wide, covered with white appressed scales, laxly serrulate. Scape stout, densely farinose-lepidote; scape-bracts elliptic, 15 cm long, the upper densely imbricate, serrulate, subchartaceous, rose, subulate-indurate at the apex. Inflorescence bipinnate, cylindric, 26 cm long, farinose-lepidote; lowest primary bracts like the scape-bracts, exceeding the branches, the others abruptly reduced and little if at all larger than the floral bracts; branches spreading, 6 cm long, geniculate, laxly few-flowered. Floral bracts vestigial, narrowly reniform with an acicular apex; flowers distichous, divergent. Sepals asymmetric with a large wing, mucronate, 11 mm long; ovary slenderly obovoid or ellipsoid, becoming 15 mm long in fruit, epigynous tube broadly funnelform, 2 mm high, placentae apical.

description: Plant flowering 30-35 cm high. Leaves 10, rosulate, 30-36 cm long, green; sheaths subelliptic, wholly lepidote, serrulate toward apex; blades suberect, ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 4 cm wide, laxly serrulate with antrorse spines 0.5 mm long. Scape erect, sparsely white-lanate, 2.5 mm thick; scape-bracts remote, elliptic, acute, entire, reddish green with a stramineous apex. Inflorescence to 7 cm long, lax, bipinnate on the basal half, the upper a polystichous-flowered spike; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, much shorter than the axillary branches; branches spreading, few-flowered. Floral bracts narrowly lance-ovate, spine-tipped, 7 mm long; flowers blooming from the middle of the inflorescence toward either end, sessile, 16 mm long. Sepals strongly asymmetric, bilobed, 3 mm long without the 1.2 mm spine, half-connate, red toward base, elsewhere greenish flavous, all turning green, sparsely lepidote; petals yellow, each bearing 2 fimbriate scales; stamens included; pollen biporate; ovary subcylindric, 5 mm long, red; placentae slightly supramedial; ovules numerous, obtuse.

description: Leaves over 4 dm long; blades broadly ligulate, subacute with a stout cusp, sparsely lepidote, serrate with rather dark stout curved spines. Scape unknown. Inflorescence amply paniculate; primary bracts lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, apiculate, 5-10 cm long, entire, rose (?); branches often elongate and angled, the ultimate ones bearing lax, few-many-flowered spikes and short broad acuminate secondary bracts; spikes 2-7-flowered; rhachis flexuous, slender. Floral bracts spreading, 5-8 mm long, shorter than the ovary, long-acuminate from a broad base. Sepals asymmetric with a very broad lateral wing, short-mucronate, 15 mm long, 9 mm wide, rigid; petals 25 mm or longer, bearing 2 short scales at base; ovary stout, nearly 1 cm long, glabrous.

description: Plant flowering 4-5 dm high. Leaves 12-20 in a dense ellipsoid rosette, 3-6 dm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, large, covered with minute appressed brown scales, laxly serrulate toward apex; blades recurving, ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, 25-35 mm wide, slightly narrowed toward base, glabrous above, obscurely lepidote beneath, entire except at base, centrally channeled. Scape erect; scape-bracts imbricate and covering the scape, lance-ovate, acuminate, entire, membranaceous, at least the upper bright red. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate to apex, to 15 cm long, glabrous with bright red axes and bracts; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, exceeding the lower spikes; spikes subspreading or spreading, to 4 cm long including the flowers, wholly fertile, 2-6-flowered, sublax. Floral bracts polystichous, suborbicular, minutely mucronulate, broadly convex, entire, about equaling the ovary; flowers sessile, spreading, more or less upwardly secund, to 25 mm long. Sepals strongly asymmetric, minutely mucronulate, to 8 mm long, 1/3 connate, pale blue-purple; petals broadly rounded, 2 cm long, pale purple with white margins, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base; stamens included; ovary ellipsoid, stout, epigynous tube short; placentae apical; ovules long-caudate.

description: Plant flowering 6-7 dm high. Leaves in a funnelform rosette, 5-8 dm long, green, appressed-cinereous-lepidote; sheaths oblong-elliptic, 15-20 cm long, 8-9 cm wide; blades ligulate, acuminate to a pungent apex, 4-7 cm wide, laxly serrate with brown, 2 mm long spines. Scape erect, 8 mm thick, white-floccose; scape-bracts imbricate, lanceolate, attenuate, 6-8 cm long, 2 cm wide, green, cinereous-lepidote, spinose-serrate. Inflorescence simple, laxly cylindric, 10-15 cm long, polystichous-flowered. Floral bracts long-attenuate from an ovate base, the lowest to 35 mm long, about equaling the sepals, soon glabrous; flowers subspreading. Sepals free, strongly asymmetric, suboblong, 2 cm long without the spreading, brown, 1 cm long mucro, rose; petals free, 4 cm long, 6 mm wide, blue, with 2 scales; stamens included, free; ovary 8 mm long, rose.

description: Plant stoloniferous, flowering 7-9 dm high with the inflorescence raised. Leaves forming a funnelform rosette, 35-65 cm long; sheaths obovate, 6-8 cm wide, densely brown-lepidote within; blades ligulate, contracted toward base, rounded, apiculate, 4-5 cm wide, broadly channeled, sparsely and obscurely lepidote, sparsely and minutely serrulate. Scape strongly decurved, 5 mm thick, verruculose, dark purple; scape-bracts 12-15 cm long, exceeding the internodes, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, entire, paleaceous, red becoming white outside and violet inside. Inflorescence 20-25 cm long, bipinnate at base, simple toward apex with straight, verrucose rhachis and 20-35 polystichous flowers; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, exceeding the spikes; spikes geniculate, distichously (?) 2-5-flowered. Floral bracts minute, triangular, apiculate, paleaceous; flowers spreading, sessile, 25-30 mm long. Sepals free, asymmetric, sub-apiculate, 8-10 mm long, unarmed, dark violet with white margins; petals linear-oblong, acute, 17 mm long, bearing 2 denticulate scales at base, the blades reflexed at anthesis, violet with white margins, turning deep red; stamens included, second series filaments half-adnate to petals; anthers dorsifixed; pollen globose, 4-porate; ovary globose; placentae apical; ovules few, long-caudate.

description: Plant flowering 35-45 cm high. Leaves many in a dense funnelform rosette, 30-45 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic or obovate, ca 1 dm long, covered with minute appressed brown scales; blades ligulate, acute or subrounded and apiculate, narrowed toward base, to 4 cm wide, wholly green, sparsely and obscurely lepidote or glabrous above, narrowly channeled, subdensely serrate with spines less than 1 mm long. Scape erect, slender, green or red, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the upper longer than the internodes, lanceolate or elliptic, acute, inflated, membranaceous, pale green or red, the lower serrulate toward apex, brown-lepidote. Inflorescence subdensely many-flowered, slenderly pyramidal, 1 dm long, 5-6 cm in diameter, glabrous, paniculate at base, simple toward apex or wholly; primary bracts small or minute; spikes spreading lax, the lateral 4-6-flowered; rhachis geniculate. Floral bracts minute, subreniform, apiculate; flowers sessile, spreading, to 15 mm long. Sepals strongly asymmetric, suboblong, unarmed, 4.5-6 mm long, connate for 1.5-2.5 mm, red and verrucose like the ovary; petals oblong or elliptic, obtuse, 9-11 mm long, blue, bearing 2 oblong dentate or entire scales at base; stamens included; ovary globose, epigynous tube short; placentae apical; ovules caudate.

description: Plant stoloniferous, about 1 m high. Leaves 12-17 in a loosely cyathiform rosette, nearly straight, 3-10 dm long; sheaths short and indistinct; blades ligulate, abruptly acute, apiculate, pungent, 4-6 cm wide, glabrous and pale green above with spots of dark green, covered beneath with fine appressed cinereous scales, subdensely serrulate, broadly channeled. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, foliaceous, acute or acuminate, spinulose-serrate. Inflorescence simple with flowers many-ranked, densely spicate, cylindric or slenderly conic, 1-4 dm long, 30-55 mm in diameter. Floral bracts equaling or longer than the flowers but with the upper half sharply reflexed, lance-ovate, acuminate, pungent, 12-15 mm long, densely spinose-serrate, bright red, glabrous above, sparsely white-furfuraceous beneath; flowers suberect, 2 cm long. Sepals asymmetric, acute, pungent, 13 mm long, white with the apex rose, free; petals fugacious, ligulate, obtuse, barely exserted, bearing 2 oblique denticulate scales near the base; stamens included, the second series short-connate with the petals; ovary stoutly obconic, glabrous, white; placentae apical; ovules caudate.

description: Leaves more than 7 in a funnelform rosette, to 4 dm long, much exceeding the inflorescence; sheaths elliptic, large, brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly acute and then attenuate to a long involute-subulate apex, flat, 2 cm wide, entire throughout, sparsely lepidote beneath. Scape erect, slender, glabrous (?); scape-bracts densely imbricate and covering the scape, elliptic, acute, entire, sparsely lepidote. Inflorescence simple, subdensely ellipsoid, obtuse, 5.5 cm long, 3 cm in diameter, rather many-flowered. Floral bracts lance-ovate, acuminate, subequal, about equaling the sepals, entire; flowers many-ranked, about 15 mm long without the petals. Sepals free, strongly asymmetric with a large lateral wing, acute, 8 mm long, subglabrous; ovary puberulous.

description: Plant flowering to 55 cm high. Leaves many in a dense funnelform rosette, equaling the inflorescence; sheaths elliptic, to 18 cm long, much broader than the blades, covered with minute appressed scales; blades ligulate, broadly acute and then attenuate to a long involute-subulate apex, to 33 mm wide, laxly serrate with dark slender spines 1.5 mm long, nearly glabrous above, covered beneath with minute appressed scales. Scape erect, slender, white-lanate; scape-bracts densely imbricate and completely covering the scape, lanceolate, apiculate, papyraceous. Inflorescence simple, slenderly subcylindric, subdensely many-flowered, the specific name from its resemblance to an ear of wheat, 8 cm long, 2 cm in diameter, without a noticeable apical coma. Floral bracts subreniform, enfolding the flowers, subtruncate with a long terminal spine, not thickened, tomentose toward base, exceeded by the sepals; flowers 18 mm long. Sepals free, strongly asymmetric, 6 mm long without the terminal spine, subglabrous; petals 12 mm long, green, bearing 2 coarsely dentate scales near the middle; stamens included; ovary stout-ellipsoid, densely lanate, epigynous tube short; placentae apical; ovules short-caudate.

description: Plant flowering to 37 cm high. Leaves to 5 dm long, covered with a membrane of pale appressed scales; sheaths elliptic, 18 cm long, 9 cm wide, near the apex densely serrate with dark spreading spines 5 mm long, green with small red spots, elsewhere entire and dark brown; blades narrowly triangular, caudate-acuminate, 4 cm wide at base, laxly serrate with spreading or antrorse teeth. Scape erect, 3 mm in diameter, white-flocculose; scape-bracts broadly elliptic, thin, rose-like, inconspicuously lepidote with white appressed scales, the lower ones much shorter than the internodes, caudate, serrate near the apex, the upper ones much longer than the internodes, divergent, serrate throughout. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, cylindric, 6 cm long, 2 cm in diameter exclusive of the petals, densely lepidote with white subappressed scales. Floral bracts orbicular, apiculate, 8 mm long, exceeding the ovary, coriaceous, bicarinate. Sepals 6 mm long, connate for 2 mm, the free lobes asymmetric, subquadrate, retuse, unarmed; petals 12 mm long, lavender to purple turning black the second day, bearing 2 fimbriate scales high on the claw, blade broadly elliptic, obtuse; epigynous tube almost none; placentae apical; ovules caudate.

description: Leaves ca 2 m long; sheaths elliptic, dark castaneous toward base; blades ligulate, acuminate, pungent, 45-70 mm wide, serrate with small curved antrorse spines, pale green, glabrous above, covered beneath with minute appressed white scales. Scape stout, dark purple, white-tomentulose becoming glabrous; scape-bracts large, broadly elliptic, entire. Inflorescence tripinnate, subdensely pyramidal, obtuse, 22 cm long, 16 cm in diameter, white-tomentulose; axis red; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, exceeding the branches, to 1 dm long, ample, red, bearing pale appressed scales; branches wholly fertile, short. Floral bracts setaceous, 3 mm to almost lacking, entire; flowers sessile. Sepals free, strongly asymmetric, mucronate, 23 mm long, thick-coriaceous; ovary obconic, not constricted at apex, 12 mm long, epigynous tube large; placentae borne between the middle and apex of the cells; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering 1 m high or higher. Leaves 5-7 dm long; blade linear, acute, 6-10 cm wide, serrate with spines 3-5 mm long, appressed-white-lepidote. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts lanceolate, acuminate, bright red. Inflorescence amply bipinnate; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, 6-15 cm long, diminishing evenly toward apex of inflorescence, the lowest about equaling the spikes; spikes long-stipitate, spreading, oblong, 815 cm long, densely and distichously 12-20-flowered, glabrous. Floral bracts ovate, obtuse, lustrous, 15-25 mm long, nearly equaling the sepals, green tipped with orange. Sepals obovate-oblong, obtuse, 13 mm long, nearly free; petals acute, 20 mm long, orange.

description: Plant flowering 4 dm high. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate, narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, entire, green, pale-lepidote beneath. Inflorescence simple, dense, subcylindric, 6 cm long, nearly 4 cm in diameter, much enlarged in fruit, bearing a small coma at the apex. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, pungent, 12 mm long; flowers sessile. description: Leaves rosulate, over 2 m long, covered beneath with appressed ferruginous scales, very laxly serrate toward base with retrorse curved teeth 4 mm long, densely antrorse-serrulate toward apex; sheaths elliptic, ca 15 cm long; blades linear, acumitiate, 55 mm wide, flat. Scape erect, not much over 10 cm high, stout; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, ovate, acute, densely serrulate. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, short-cylindric, 15 cm long, 12 cm in diameter, densely ferruginous-lepidote. Floral bracts lance-triangular, long-acuminate, over 7 cm long, densely serrulate, dull red, the apical part reflexed; flowers sessile, strongly compressed. Sepals lance-triangular, subulate-acuminate, pungent, 36 mm long, subequally short-connate, the posterior ones sharply carinate with the wings continuous on the ovary; ovary suborbicular, the epigynous tube broadly funnelform, 5 mm deep; seeds flat, broadly elliptic, 8 mm long.

description: Plant over 6 dm high. Leaves to 52 cm long, covered with closely appressed scales; sheaths broadly elliptic, castaneous, the outer 17 cm long; blades of the outer leaves ligulate, broadly acute and recurved near the apex, 8 cm wide, cinereous-lepidote, laxly serrate with dark ascending flat teeth 6 mm long, blades of the inner leaves vestigial. Scape erect, 5 mm in diameter, white-lanate; scape-bracts lanceolate, acute, about equaling the internodes, membranaceous, rose-purple, densely pale-lepidote, laxly and obscurely serrulate. Inflorescence bipinnate, densely ellipsoid, 12 cm long; lowest primary bracts like the scape-bracts the others greatly reduced; spikes divergent, densely few-flowered; rhachis angled but not alate, densely pale-lepidote. Floral bracts distichous, much more than twice as long as the internodes but spreading and not imbricate, broadly ovate, acuminate, mucronate, 7 mm long, nerved. Sepals asymmetric, narrowly oblong, subtruncate, mucronate, 10 mm long, connate for 1 mm; ovary globose, placentae apical.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves over 1 m long, subdensely brown-punctate-lepidote, coriaceous; sheaths ample, ca 2 dm long, dark castaneous; blades ligulate, subacute, cuspidate, 4-6 cm wide, subdensely serrate with spreading, flat, dark castaneous, 4 mm long spines. Scape straight, slender; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, lanceolate, acute, entire, over 2 dm long, chartaceous, rose, brown-lepidote. Inflorescence laxly subpyramidal, tripinnate, 1-4 dm long, covered with fine brown stellate trichomes; primary bracts linear-lanceolate, the upper ones shorter than their axillary branches; spikes laxly 7-8 flowered; rhachis geniculate, slender. Floral bracts acicular from a broadly triangular base, 2 mm long; flowers more than 2-ranked, sessile, suberect. Sepals 12 mm long, connate for 1 mm, subelliptic, strongly asymmetric, the terminal mucro 1 mm long; petals about 2 cm long, each bearing 2 oblong obtuse entire scales near the base; ovary subcylindric, becoming ellipsoid, epigynous tube infundibuliform; placentae extending almost the whole length of the cell; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering at least 8 dm high. Leaves about 1 m long; sheaths subovate, covered on both sides with closely appressed scales; blades ligulate, attenuate to a large brown spine, 53 mm wide, rigid, subdensely serrate with antrorse spines 3.5 mm long, sparsely pale-lepidote beneath. Scape 8 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect and enfolding the scape, imbricate, lance-ovate, acuminate to a pungent spine, entire, rose. Inflorescence simple, cylindric, densely many-flowered, ca 2 dm long, 43 mm in diameter, obtuse, bearing a coma of bristles at apex. Floral bracts suborbicular, 6 mm long without the slender 6 mm terminal spine, convex, entire, carinate, submembranaceous, glabrous or subglabrous; flowers sessile, reflexed. Sepals free, strongly asymmetric, 14 mm long with a spreading brown terminal spine 3 mm long, obscurely carinate, glabrous; petals bearing 2 fimbriate scales adnate well above the base, green (?); filaments of the second series highly adnate to the petals; ovary 5 mm long, glabrous, epigynous tube very short; placentae apical; ovules long-caudate.

description: Leaves many in a spreading rosette, 5-8 dm long; sheaths elliptic, large, densely and minutely brown-lepidote on both sides; blades ligulate, subobtuse, apiculate, pungent, 5 cm wide, green or with red margin, spines to 3 mm long. Scape rather slender, erect or decurved, bright rose, white-furfuraceous; scape-bracts erect, exceeding the internodes, ovate-oblong, obtuse and apiculate, entire, furfuraceous, the lower ones scarious, the upper rose. Inflorescence compound with simple branches, ellipsoid to subcylindric, dense, 12-25 cm long, white-furfuraceous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, entire, at least the lower ones equaling or exceeding the axillary branches; spikes divergent to spreading, sessile to short-stipitate, lance-ovate, acute, strongly complanate, 4-6 cm long, 3 cm broad, distichous on the main axis, densely distichous-flowered; rhachis strongly winged. Floral bracts ovate-oblong, acuminate, artistate, to 2 cm long, usually equaling or exceeding the sepals at anthesis, green with a broad scarious lavender margin; flowers suberect. Sepals asymmetric, lance-ovate, aristate, 12	mm long, coriaceous, green; petals oblanceolate, mucronate, 23 mm long, deep violet, bearing 2 scales at the base, the scales much prolonged next the petal as folds; epipetalous stamens short-connate with the petals; ovary 5 mm long, enlarged in fruit, lepidote; epigynous tube short; placentae apical; ovules caudate.

description: Plant 1-3 m high with the inflorescence extended. Leaves 1 m long; sheaths suborbicular, 9-30 cm long, entire, very dark brown, covered below with a castaneous membrane of coalesced scales; blades ligulate, scarcely or not at all constricted at base, acute or broadly rounded With a broad triangular apiculus, 35-70 mm wide, densely white-lepidote beneath, densely spinose-serrate toward base, sometimes subentire toward the apex, teeth stout, black, straight or uncinate, to 15 mm long. Scape arching-decurved, 13 mm in diameter; scape-bracts suberect, many times exceeding the internodes, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, coarsely spinose-serrate, 2 dm long, subchartaceous, bright red, pale-lepidote. Inflorescence pendulous, densely bipinnate or subtripinnate, cylindric, to 9 cm in diameter, soon glabrous, sterile at base and apex and at the apices of the remaining spikes; primary bracts slenderly spiniform from a small triangular base, 3 cm long, dark brown; spikes laxly and distichously 2-4-flowered; rhachis 25-35 mm long, terete. Floral bracts subreniform, asymmetric, 1 cm long, forming a tube about the ovary, green, nerved, bearing a slender brown terminal spine to 25 mm long, those toward the apex of the spike sterile and gradually reduced to just the spine. Sepals very asymmetric, subelliptic, obtuse, 16 mm long, unarmed, free; petals ligulate, obtuse, 3 cm long, pale greenish yellow, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base; epigynous tube large, urceolate; placentae subapical; ovules caudate. Berry ellipsoid, 1 cm long.

description: Leaves rosulate, 8-12 dm long, subdensely pale-lepidote; sheaths large, broadly elliptic to suborbicular; blades ligulate, rounded and cuspidate, 2.5-9 cm wide, becoming glabrous above, laxly or sublaxly serrate with dark straight spreading or ascending spines 2-6 mm long. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts broadly lanceolate, acute, chartaceous, rose, pale-lepidote, the lower remote, the upper imbricate. inflorescence laxly paniculate, 2-5 dm long, 20 cm in diameter, nearly glabrous at anthesis, lower primary bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than the axillary branches, upper primary bracts abruptly and greatly reduced; lower branches 3-parted with long sterile bases, upper branches simple; rhachis flexuous, terete. Floral bracts ovate, nearly equaling the ovary at anthesis, thin, nerved. Sepals asymmetric, free, obscurely mucronulate, 7-8 mm long; petals 12-14 mm long, orange-yellow, bearing 2 fimbriate scales near the base; placentae apical; ovules caudate.

description: Leaves to 8 dm long; sheaths ovate, 9 cm or more wide, densely appressed-castaneous-lepidote, castaneous on the inside; blades ligulate, acuminate, mucronate, 33 mm wide, armed with coarse pale teeth 5 mm long, densely appressed-white-lepidote especially below. Scape erect, 8 mm in diameter; scape-bracts tubular-involute, erect, imbricate, ovate, acuminate, serrate, densely brown-appressed-lepidote. Inflorescence very densely bipinnate, ovoid, many-flowered, exceeded by the leaves, 15 cm long, 10 cm in diameter; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, equaling or exceeding the axillary spikes, serrate; spikes densely 10-20-flowered; rhachis compressed, 4-winged with the wings decurrent on the backs of the floral bracts. Floral bracts very broadly ovate, entire or minutely serrulate, mucronulate, equaling the sepals, strongly convex, combining with the rhachis-wings to form a pouch about the flower, prominently nerved, the lower ones with a median wing; flowers sessile, 26 mm long. Sepals strongly asymmetric, 13 mm long including the slender, 4 mm long, terminal mucro, connate for 2 mm; petals mucronate, 18 mm long, bearing 2 fimbriate scales 3 mm above the base; stamens slightly shorter than the petals, anthers 6 mm long, acute; ovary ellipsoid, 8 mm long, constricted toward the apex, the epigynous tube deep, infundibuliform; berry scarcely enlarged from the ovary; seeds 2.5 mm long, ovoid, acute, brown.

description: Plants stemless, stoloniferous, densely aggregated, flowering over 1 m high. Leaves rather few in a funnelform rosette, 6-12 dm long, covered especially beneath with appressed scales; sheaths elliptic, 2 dm long, dark castaneous; blades ligulate, acute and terminating in a slender dark spine, laxly serrate with dark curved spines 2 mm long. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts strict, very densely imbricate, the lowest foliaceous, the highest broadly ovate, abruptly acuminate, serrate, forming an involucre about the inflorescence. Inflorescence simple, densely strobilate, 8 cm in diameter, covered throughout with white appressed scales, not notably comate at apex. Floral bracts spreading, elliptic, acute or acuminate, about equaling the sepals, serrulate, excavated above and enfolding the base of the flower; flowers strongly compressed. Sepals free, subelliptic, asymmetric, pungent, 19 mm long, entire, the lateral ones alate-carinate; petals 26 mm long, high-conglutinate, pale green, bearing vertical calli; stamens included, the filaments highly conglutinate with the petals; ovary broadly bialate; epigynous tube infundibuliform, 7 mm long; placentae subapical; ovules caudate.

description: Leaves 2 m long, covered on both sides with appressed ferruginous scales; blades ligulate, more or less narrowed toward the base, acuminate, 55-65 mm wide, laxly armed with stout uncinate spines 5 mm long. Scape short, stout. Inflorescence simple, depressed-globose, many-flowered, 12 cm in diameter, densely ferruginous-lepidote; axis very thick. Floral bracts spreading, lance-triangular, 5 cm long, exceeding the flowers, densely serrulate; flowers sessile. Sepals narrowly triangular, slightly asymmetric, acuminate, pungent, 25 mm long, free, the posterior ones alate-carinate toward base; ovary 10 mm long, broadly elliptic, much compressed, subglabrous.

description: Leaves many in a broadly funnelform rosette, to 55 cm long, exceeding the inflorescence, diffusely punctulate-lepidote; sheaths broadly elliptic, 15 cm long, pale green, blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 5-6 cm wide, uniformly green except for a paler median channel toward the base, laxly serrulate with flat spreading or ascending spines 2 mm long. Scape curved, 5 mm in diameter; scape-bracts thin, quickly deciduous. Inflorescence sublaxly bipinnate from about 8 spikes, glabrous at least in age; primary bracts broadly lanceolate, acuminate, 7 cm long, decreasing evenly in size, membranaceous, red, laxly serrate; branches simple, divergent to spreading peduncles 4 cm long, strongly flattened; spikes lance-oblong, 10 cm long, 25 mm wide, strongly complanate; rhachis slender. Floral bracts densely imbricate, very broadly ovate, acute, 22 mm long, equaling or exceeding the sepals, carinate, chartaceous, prominently nerved, stramineous. Sepals free, lance-oblong, slightly asymmetric, over 15 mm long (tip decayed), thin, nerved; ovary ellipsoid, stout, 6 mm long, epigynous tube short but distinct, placentae apical; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering ca 6 dm high. Leaves 4 dm long, densely punctulate-lepidote; sheaths ovate, but slightly wider than the blades but mostly entire, nearly black above, brown with purple streaks beneath; blades ligulate, broadly subacute, 6 cm wide, wholly green, laxly serrate with dark spreading spines 3 mm long. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts much longer than the internodes but reflexed, lanceolate, rose, serrulate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate with 11 branches; primary bracts nearly all like the scape-bracts and reflexed, much exceeding the sterile naked base of the branch; branches spreading and then curved-ascending, 15 cm long, 2 cm wide, strongly complanate, dense, very sparsely white-flocculose; rhachis geniculate, winged, dark green drying to black, the internodes to 8 mm long. Floral bracts distichous, suberect, exposing nearly all of the rhachis, elliptic, retuse, 17 mm long, much exceeding the ovary, pale green drying to stramineous, prominently nerved, soon glabrous. Sepals free, asymmetric, suboblong, truncate with a minute mucro, 13 mm long, ecarinate, nerved; petals 16 mm long, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base; ovary obovoid, 8 mm long at anthesis; epigynous tube distinct, 2 mm high; placentae apical; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering 45-60 cm high with the inflorescence extended, propagating by erect shoots. Leaves rosulate, ca 3 dm long, subpetiolate; sheaths ovate, covered with minute brown scales; blades ligulate, gradually dilated toward apex, 35 mm wide, rounded and apiculate, minutely serrulate, bearing a broad pale median channel. Scape very slender, orange; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, divergent, narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, red. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered, sublax, glabrous, 8 cm long. Floral bracts minute, squamiform; flowers spreading, with short but distinct pedicels. Sepals ovate, asymmetric, broadly obtuse, unarmed, 9 mm long, red toward base, yellow toward apex; petals elliptic, 15 mm long, yellow toward apex, elsewhere purple, bearing 2 dentate scales at base; stamens included, filaments of the second series short-adnate to the petals; ovary globose, 8-9 mm in diameter, red, densely verrucose, epigynous tube 2.5 mm long; placentae apical; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering 4-12 dm high. Leaves few in a dense rosette, to 1 m long, green except for a broad pale median channel, the outer leaves bladeless; sheaths broadly elliptic, 15 cm long, densely brown-punctulate, blades narrowed above the base but not truly petiolate, ligulate, acute, apiculate, 25-50 mm wide, white-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate toward the base with straight or retrorse green teeth 5 mm long. Scape erect, slender, white-lanate, soon glabrous; scape-bracts densely imbricate, lance-ovate, entire, membranaceous, bright red, pale-lepidote. Inflorescence paniculate, bipinnate or the lower branches divided, oblong or pyramidal, 10-35 cm long, fertile throughout, lax at least toward the base, at first densely white-floccose but often becoming nearly glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but narrower, the lower ones equaling or exceeding the axillary branches, the upper ones no larger than the floral bracts; spikes linear, densely and distichously 8-16-flowered; rhachis straight or flexuous, flattened but not winged. Floral bracts spreading and exposing the rhachis, broadly ovate, acuminate, pungent, 10-13 mm long, equaling or exceeding the sepals, entire with margins free, navicular, carinate toward the apex, subcoriaceous. Sepals strongly asymmetric, subtriangular, 6 mm long, mucronulate, strongly carinate; petals ligulate, obtuse, 10 mm long, bearing 2 fimbriate scales high above the base; ovary subellipsoid, 3-angled, slightly enlarged in fruit; placentae apical.

description: Plant stoloniferous, flowering 5 dm high. Leaves densely crateriform-rosulate, 4 dm long; sheaths narrowly ovate, 14 cm long, 10 cm wide, purple and densely lepidote inside, pale green and densely brown-lepidote outside; blades sublinear, slightly narrowed toward apex then subrounded and weakly mucronate, densely white-lepidote at first, serrate with subspreading slender brown spines 5 mm long and 5 mm apart. Scape erect, 37 cm long, 5 mm thick, glabrous, purplish; internodes 7-10 cm long; scape-bracts 4, shorter than the internodes, thin, whitish. Inflorescence 7 cm long, typically of 2 spikes; primary bracts strongly appressed, about equaling the spikes, thin, red; flowers sessile, appressed, 25 mm long, cleistogamous. Floral bracts ovate, concave, mucronulate, 25 mm long, exceeding the sepals, glabrous, red. Sepals free, oblong, minutely apiculate, subsymmetrical, 13 mm long, white, sparsely lepidote inside; petals free, linear-oblong, cymbiform at apex, 20 mm long, bearing 2 scales at base; episepalous stamens free, epipetalous ones highly adnate; filaments complanate, linear, 15 mm long, 3 mm wide; anthers dorsifixed, linear, apiculate, 4 mm long; pollen biporate; ovary slightly complanate, 4 mm long; placentae in upper half of ovary; ovules many, obtuse.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves ca 1 m long; sheaths suboblong, 30 cm long, dark castaneous, densely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, acuminate into a stout dark terminal cusp, laxly serrate with stout dark antrorse 5 mm long spines, glabrous. Scape erect, 1 cm in diameter, densely white-lanate; scape-bracts lanceolate, attenuate to a dark stout cusp, 30 cm long, entire, subcoriaceous, rose, densely white-tomentulose. Inflorescence bipinnate, densely cylindric, 30 mm long, 7 cm in diameter, densely white-tomentulose on axes and bracts; primary bracts narrowly lanceolate, attenuate, to 25 mm long including the slender terminal spine; branches very short with the basal flower developed and the 1 or 2 others much reduced. Floral bracts forming a tube that enclosed all but the tips of the sepals, thin-coriaceous, bearing a dark slender terminal 15 mm long spine. Sepals strongly asymmetric, subelliptic, obtuse, unarmed, 18 mm long, glabrous; petals and fruit green (! Prance).

description: Plant stemless, flowering to 1 m high. Leaves many, forming an ellipsoid tank, 9 dm long; sheaths oblong-ovate, 26 cm long, 15 cm wide, dark purple, the upper third spinose-serrate; blades linear-lanceolate, attenuate to a stiff woody spine, 4 cm wide, rigidly coriaceous, green, obscurely lepidote, serrate with dark purple 7 mm long spines, the outer ones reflexed at apex. Scape erect, 65 cm long, 15 mm thick, woody, blood red, white-floccose; internodes 3-5 cm long; scape-bracts lax, oblong, 12-15 cm long, 5 cm wide, castaneous when dry, punctate-lepidote. Inflorescence tripinnate, subrounded, 25 cm long, 23 cm wide; axis terete, straight, blood red, sparsely white-flocculose; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but smaller, exceeding the sterile bases of the branches; branches divergent; secondary bracts triangular, equaling or slightly exceeding the sterile bases of the spikes, paleaceous; spikes few-flowered, lax; rhachis complanate, purple, white-flocculose. Floral bracts ovate, 22 mm long, 14 mm wide, exceeding the ovary, rounded with a 2 mm mucro, nerved, lepidote, purple, darker toward apex; flowers sessile, erect to divergent, 35 mm long, exposing the rhachis. Sepals very short-connate, strongly asymmetric, mucronate, 15 mm long, green with indigo apex, white floccose; petals linear, slightly dilated above, emarginate, 18-20 mm long, bearing 2 irregular fimbriate scales at base; stamens included; filaments half adnate to petals; anthers dorsifixed, 3.5 mm long; pollen 4-porate; ovary trigonous, 15 mm long, white-lepidote; epigynous tube 2 mm long; placentae apical; ovules few, long-caudate.

description: Plant flowering over 7 dm high. Leaves 7-10 dm long, pale-appressed-lepidote throughout; sheaths elliptic, ample, 25-30 cm long; blades ligulate, broadly acute or rounded and cuspidate-apiculate, 8-9 cm wide, flat, all green or red-bronze beneath, laxly serrate with broad flat spines 7 mm long. Scape erect, 7 mm in diameter, white-flocculose, soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, elliptic, acute, much shorter than the internodes, entire, chartaceous when dry, red, white-lepidote. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 3 dm long, except for the primary bracts soon glabrous; lowest primary bracts like the scape-bracts but larger, to 11 cm long, deflexed, the others abruptly much reduced, like the floral bracts; spikes divergent or spreading, to 8 cm long including the very short naked base, laxly 8-12-flowered; rhachis slender, geniculate. Floral bracts suborbicular, apiculate, flat, minute; flowers sessile, divergent. Sepals asymmetric, ovate, obtuse, minutely mucronate, 7 mm long; petals 15 mm long, bearing 2 dentate scales at base; stamens included; ovary ellipsoid, 5 mm long, the epigynous tube short but distinct; placentae central; ovules caudate; berry much enlarged from the ovary.

description: Plant climbing; flowering shoot 45 cm long. Leaves to 42 cm long; sheaths elliptic to suborbicular, 12 cm long, subdensely and minutely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, subacute and apiculate, slightly narrowed toward the base, 3 cm wide, subdensely serrulate with antrorse teeth 1 mm long, sparsely and obscurely pale-lepidote, lustrous. Scape curved, 3 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, elliptic, acute, red, membranaceous, obscurely lepidote, the lower ones serrulate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, pyramidal, 12 cm long, 7 cm in diameter, glabrous; primary bracts triangular, the largest only 5 mm long; branches spreading and lax with a few distchous flowers; rhachis slender, geniculate. Floral bracts minute, suborbicular; flowers suberect, on pedicels 1 mm long. Sepals 4 mm long, connate for 1.5 mm, verrucose, the free lobes strongly asymmetric, retuse; petal blades 4 mm long; ovary globose, red, verrucose, epigynous tube very short; placentae apical; ovules caudate.

description: Leaves to over 1 m long; sheaths unknown; blades ligulate, acuminate, pungent, 75 mm wide, lepidote especially below, laxly spinose-serrate with stout, nearly straight, brown-tipped teeth to 1 cm long. Scape erect, stout, white-tomentulose; scape-bracts erect, tubular-involute, densely imbricate, lance-elliptic, pungent, entire or rarely with a few teeth, bright-red. Inflorescence paniculate, laxly tripinnate, pyramidal, 33 cm long, 20 cm in diameter; axes tomentulose at first, soon glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, the lower about half as long as the axillary branches, the upper much reduced; branches all fertile throughout, subspreading, long-stipitate with the spikes clustered at the end; secondary bracts barely larger than the floral bracts; spikes laxly about 10-flowered, linear in outline, up to 1 dm long; rhachis strongly geniculate, complanate, excavated next the flowers. Floral bracts erect, suborbicular, broadly rounded with a mucro 2 mm long at the apex, 10 mm long including the mucro, 9 mm wide, only one to one and half times as long as the internodes, exceeding the sepals, entire, prominently nerved, minutely white-arachnoid, soon glabrous, entire, the margin free from the rhachis; flowers appressed to the rhachis. Sepals barely asymmetric, 4 mm long, minutely mucronate, white-tomentulose especially toward the base, free; petals 10 mm long, not mucronate, pink-purple, bearing 2 fimbriate scales high above the base; stamens much shorter than the petals, the filaments of the second series much adnate to the petals, the anthers narrow, 1.5 mm long, mucronulate; pistil about equaling the petals, the epigynous tube very short; ovary 3-angled.

description: Leaves about 10, densely rosulate, to 4 dm long; sheaths triangular, 25 mm wide, glabrous above at maturity, obscurely lepidote beneath with appressed brown scales; blades involute-subulate, about 4 mm wide, long-acuminate, pungent, glabrous, the inner nearly entire, the outer laxly serrate with brown curved retrorse spines 2 mm long. Sepals subsymmetric, narrowly lance-triangular, acuminate, mucronulate, 17 mm long, connate for 2 mm, strongly carinate, slightly lepidote becoming glabrous; ovary ellipsoid, much compressed, 8 mm long, ferruginous-tomentulose; epigynous tube crateriform; placentae apical; ovules few, long-caudate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 25-30 cm high. Leaves about 20 in a dense funnelform rosette, 25-30 cm long; sheaths large, ovate, 10 cm long, 5.5 cm wide, entire, impressed near apex, bearing a large violet spot above; blades recurving, linear, acute, 25 mm wide, laxly serrulate with brown curved antrorse spines 1 mm long, concolorous, pale green, densely lepidote on both sides. Scape erect, ca 15 cm long, 8 mm in diameter, subglabrous; scape-bracts triangular, acuminate, serrulate toward apex, white-lepidote. Inflorescence simple, ellipsoid, 5 cm long, flowering from the middle, bearing a coma of sterile bracts at apex; rhachis densely lanate. Floral bracts triangular, acuminate, exceeding the lower sepals, entire or sparsely serrulate; flowers sessile, 25 mm long. Sepals asymmetric, rounded, 9 mm long without the 3 mm long terminal spine, flavous becoming pale rose at apex, densely white-lanate; petals oblong-obovate, rounded and cucullate, 16 mm long, free, bearing 2 laciniate scales 2 mm above the base; stamens included, the second series adnate to the petals; pollen ellipsoid, biporate; ovary ellipsoid, subtrigonous, 8 mm long, epigynous tube distinct; placentae subcentral; ovules obtuse.

description: Plant flowering to 75 cm high. Leaves many in a dense funnelform rosette, 4-11 dm long, usually much exceeding the inflorescence, covered on both sides with a pale membrane of fused scales; sheaths large but not much wider than the blades and obscure, entire, brownish; blades ligulate, broadly acute and then attenuate to a stout dark rigid spine, 4-12 cm wide, subdensely serrate with stout dark antrorse spines 2-7 mm long, whitish beneath with green transverse spots. Scape erect, stout, white-flocculose; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper elliptic, acute, pungent, entire. Inflorescence very densely bipinnate, many-flowered, subcylindric, obtuse, 12-29 cm long, to 65 mm in diameter, white-flocculose at least when young; primary bracts shorter than the spikes, ovate, pungent; spikes densely few-flowered, the lower ones bearing sterile gemmae at base. Floral bracts asymmetric, subovate, mucronate, enfolding the ovary, strongly nerved, entire, their margins free from the rhachis; flowers sessile, to 24 mm long. Sepals strongly asymmetric, 6 mm long without the 4 mm terminal spine, short-connate; petals ligulate, minutely mucronulate, to 16 mm long, blue, bearing 2 fimbriate scales adnate to 2 mm above the base; stamens included; ovary ovoid or subcylindric, epigynous tube large, crateriform; placentae subcentral; ovules obtuse.

description: Leaves many in a dense rosette, 6-12 dm long, covered on both sides with a membrane of fused scales; sheaths large, elliptic, entire, brown; blades ligulate, acute with a stout terminal spine, to 7 cm wide, subdensely serrate at base with dark curved spines 5 mm long, more laxly and finely serrate toward apex, wholly green. Scape erect, short, stout; scape-bracts very large, erect, very densely imbricate, elliptic, terminating in a stout spine, entire, smooth, thick-coriaceous, covered beneath with a pale membrane of fused scales. Inflorescence simple, densely strobilate, cylindric, ca 500-flowered, 16 cm long, 6 cm in diameter, bearing a dense white wool between the flowers, bearing a small broadly conical coma at apex. Floral bracts very broadly elliptic, acute and mucronulate, 2 cm long, carinate, equaling the centers of the sepals, enfolding the flowers, coriaceous, castaneous toward base, yellow toward apex; flowers sessile, spreading. Sepals free, asymmetric, suboblong, mucronulate, 1 cm long, coriaceous, covered with white appressed scales; petals ovate, shorter than the sepals (?), much thickened toward base, bearing entire folds which clasp the filaments; stamens included, filaments very short, anthers large; ovary subcylindric or clavate, epigynous tube cupuliform, 3 mm long; placentae subapical; ovules caudate.

description: Leaves 5-7 dm long, thin; sheaths conspicuous, ovate, brown-lepidote especially beneath; blades ligulate, not constricted at base, abruptly acute, apiculate, 2-4 cm wide, pale-lepidote beneath, soon glabrous, subentire or armed toward the base with fine teeth 1 mm long. Scape erect to decurved, 3-5 mm in diameter, soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lower remote, the upper massed beneath the inflorescence, lanceolate or elliptic, acute or acuminate, entire or nearly so, membranaceous, bright red. Inflorescence paniculate, bipinnate or the lower branches divided, subdensely ellipsoid, 7-15 cm long, fertile throughout, soon glabrous; lower primary bracts like the scape-bracts, equaling or exceeding the branches, the upper much reduced; spikes suberect to spreading, 35 mm long, distichously 6-10-flowered, internodes 4-5 mm long. Floral bracts suborbicular, 2-5 mm long, equaling the ovary at anthesis, thin, nerved; flowers erect. Sepals asymmetric, subovate, obtuse, entire or obscurely mucronulate, 4-6 mm long, free or subfree; petals 13 mm long, bearing 2 fimbriate scales above the base; ovary ellipsoid or subglobose, much enlarged in fruit, epigynous tube short; placentae apical.

description: Plant flowering 4-7 dm high. Leaves about 10-15 in a dense funnelform rosette, 3-9 dm long, covered on both sides with a pale membrane of coalesced scales; sheaths large, broadly elliptic but sometimes not much wider than the blades, brown toward base; blades ligulate, broadly acute or subrounded, then attenuate to a long pungent involute-subulate apex, flat, 6-9 cm wide, wholly green but turning red at anthesis, serrate with dark curved spines 2.5 mm long. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts densely imbricate and covering the scape, foliaceous, densely serrate with stout spines. Inflorescence simple, stout-cylindric or subellipsoid, densely many-flowered, 6-10 cm long, 5-6 cm in diameter. Floral bracts ovate or lanceolate, acuminate to a brown pungent spine, slightly exceeded by the sepals, densely serrate with coarse dark spreading spines, covered on both sides with a pale membrane of fused scales; flowers sessile. Sepals asymmetric, subovate, acuminate to a slender spine, carinate, 17 mm long, connate for 2 mm, densely pale-lepidote like the ovary; petals ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 16-18 mm long, greenish, bearing 2 obtuse scales at base; stamens with filaments of the second series highly adnate to the petals; ovary subcylindric; placentae extending nearly the whole height of the cell; ovules caudate.

description: Leaves 20-30 in a dense rosette, whitish beneath, the short outer ones over 25 cm long; sheaths ample; blades ligulate, acuminate, 37-50 mm wide, densely serrate with fulvous corneous ascending spines 4-6 mm long. Scape lateral, stout, naked (?). Inflorescence paniculate, laxly and amply 4-pinnate, glabrous; lower primary bracts lanceolate, large; lowest branches densely cylindric, 40 cm long, 7 cm in diameter; ultimate branchlets flexuous, 5 cm long, 2-4-flowered, slender, terete, the lowest bearing sterile gemmae of setiform bracts; spikes distinctly stipitate. Floral bracts suborbicular, 15 mm wide, symmetric, ending in a flavescent 8 mm spine, entire, the margins free from the rhachis; flowers sessile, nearly 4 cm long, greenish yellow. Sepals very asymmetric with a broad lateral wing, mucronulate, free, 8-9 mm long, contorted, glabrous; petals not mucronate, 27 mm long, bearing 2 large coarsely dentate scales at base; stamens included, the second series partly adnate to the petals; anthers narrowly lanceolate, 5 mm long; ovary glabrous; epigynous tube distinct, cyathiform; seeds long-stipitate, dark brown, ovoid, 4 mm long.

description: Plant stemless, reproducing by short suberect stolons. Leaves about 20 in a rosette, the outer greatly reduced, the others to 52 cm long, erect, about equaling the inflorescence, coriaceous, sparsely and minutely lepidote beneath; sheaths broadly elliptic, ca 15 cm long, purple; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, to 7 cm long, sublaxly serrate with spreading spines 1.5 mm long, not at all channeled. Scape erect, glabrous, 4 mm in diameter at apex; scape-bracts erect or the highest suberect, about twice as long as the internodes, ovate, acuminate, entire, subcoriaceous, nerved, white, punctulate-lepidote. Inflorescence simple, strobiliform, 8 cm long, 5 cm in diameter, many-flowered. Floral bracts spreading but their bases densely imbricate, ovate, broadly acute, resembling the scape-bracts, much exceeding the flowers, entire; flowers sessile. Sepals free, oblong, obtuse and unarmed, slightly asymmetric, 11 mm long, the posterior alate with the ovary; petals white; ovary subglobose; ovules long-caudate.

description: Plant propagating by rhizomes. Leaves over 1 m long; sheaths elliptic, brown, covered with appressed scales; blades ligulate, acute, 20-35 mm wide, laxly serrate with curved spines 2 mm long, glabrous above, covered with minute closely appressed scales. Scape erect, stout, nearly glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate and covering the scape, subfoliaceous but entire, attenuate to a stout brown spine. Inflorescence simple, very densely cylindric, to 2 dm long. Floral bracts enfolding the ovary, bearing a central and two lateral keels, coriaceous, 17 mm without the terminal spine which equals or exceeds the sepals, minutely white-lepidote; flowers to 30 mm long. Sepals subsymmetric, 13 mm long including the 2 mm spine, connate for 3 mm; petals erect, ca 20 mm long, cucullate, bearing 2 highly adnate scales; ovary obconic, 4-angled, epigynous tube evident; placentae apical; ovules long-caudate.

description: Plant flowering 4 dm high, propagating by short ascending shoots. Leaves about 20 in a dense funnelform rosette, to 3 dm long, marked beneath with broad purple-brown spots or bands; sheaths large, very broadly elliptic, entire, dark purple beneath, covered on both sides with minute appressed brown scales; blades ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, to 45 mm wide, obscurely punctulate-lepidote, serrate with straight spines 4 mm long. Scape erect, slender, red, glabrous; scape-bracts erect and enfolding the scape, broadly elliptic, apiculate, serrulate toward apex, membranaceous, red, minutely white-flocculose, the lower shorter than the internodes, the upper imbricate. Inflorescence very densely bipinnate, ovoid, 7 cm long, 5 cm in diameter; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, also serrulate, exceeding the spikes; spikes subsessile, dense, distichously 4-flowered, ca 3 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, entire, exceeding the sepals, red, the margins free from the rhachis; flowers sessile, erect. Sepals free, strongly asymmetric, suboblong, short-mucronulate, 11 mm long, nerved, glabrous; petals 2 cm long, blades erect, elliptic, broadly rounded, pale yellow except the white margins, bearing fimbriate scales at base; stamens included; pollen biporate; ovary slenderly ellipsoid, 6 mm long, epigynous tube short; placentae central; ovules obtuse.

description: Plant flowering 4-6 dm high. Leaves about 10 in a slenderly funnelform rosette, 25-95 cm long, covered with minute appressed whitish scales especially beneath; sheaths narrowly ovate, green or slightly brownish; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, to 58 mm wide but often much narrower, laxly and minutely serrate or nearly entire. Scape erect, slender, white-flocculose or glabrous; scape-bracts erect, lanceolate, acuminate, entire, membranaceous and soon deciduous, pale red. Inflorescence pyramidal, many-flowered, bipinnate nearly to middle and then simple, glabrous or subglabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, longer or shorter than the lower branches; spikes spreading, laxly 3-8-flowered; rhachis slender, strongly geniculate, red. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, about equaling the ovary or shorter, nerved, red, membranaceous, the margins free from the rhachis; flowers sessile, subspreading, 1520 mm long. Sepals strongly asymmetric, 4-5 mm long without the 2-4 mm terminal spine, half-connate; petals ligulate, obtuse, 10-12 mm long, blue, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base; stamens included; ovary subcylindric, obtusely trigonous, slightly enlarged in fruit, the epigynous tube evident, crateriform; placentae extending nearly the whole height of the cell; ovules obtuse.
