description: Shrubs, to 1.5 m tall. Stems: reddish brown turning gray, erect or ascending, succulent, glabrous; latex clear in young stems but cloudy and sticky in older branches. Leaves: persistent, stipules branched, stipitate glands, 4-10 mm long; petioles reddish, with glandular cilia on upper surface, 5.5-9 long, 1-2 mm in diam.; blades cordate in outline, deeply lobed to nearly dissected to 5- 7 segments, 7-16 x 5.5-10 cm, segments lanceolate-elliptic (narrower in plants from Peru than in plants from Bolivia), membranous, bases cordate, margins covered with dense, brown, glandular cilia, apex acute-acuminate, venation palmate with 5-7 primary veins, pubescent and verrucate on both surfaces. Inflorescences: terminal and lateral, paniculate cymes, bracts 0.8-10 mm, margins glandular, pubescent on both surfaces; peduncles of main florescences 2.5-6 cm long, those of coflorescences 1-2.5 cm, densely pubescent; pedicels 1-2 mm long. Staminate flowers: sepals ovate-lanceolate, 4.5-5 x 1.5-2 mm, distinct, margins glandular-ciliate, apex acuminate, glabrous on adaxial surface but pubescent on abaxial; corollas campanulate, solid pinkish red or with white margins, petals obovate, 4.5-6.5 x 2.5-4 mm, distinct, apex round, reflexed, glabrous on both surfaces; stamens (8 or 9-) 10, diadelphous-biseriate (5 + 5), filaments connate to ½ of length, outer series 1.5-2.5 mm and inner series 1.8-3 mm long; basal glands spherical. Pistillate flowers: like staminate but sepals 5.5-7 x 3-4 mm and petals 5-7.5 x 3-4 mm; carpels 3, styles ca. 1 mm long, distinct; stigmas horseshoe-shaped, fleshy; basal glands fusiform. Capsules: spherical, 3-lobed, 0.8-1 cm in diam., pubescent. Seeds: yellow with reddish brown spots, oval, 6.5-7 x 3-3.5 mm, caruncle prominent.

description: Shrubs, 0.5-3.0 m tall, monoecious. Stems: pale grey, much-branched, mostly erect, young branches thin, tomentose, somewhat angled, leaf scars halfcircular, older branches grayish white, smooth, glabrescent, bark not peeling; latex clear and watery. Leaves: deciduous; on nodes but short shoots sometimes present and terminate with a few leaves, stipules caducous; petioles 1.3-3 cm long and 0.2-0.5 mm diam.; blades cordate to broadly ovate in outline, shallowly 3- to 5-lobed, 2.3-3.8 x 2-3.5 cm, membranous, base cordate to truncate, margins entire, apex acuminate, venation palmate, with 3-5 primary veins, glabrous on both surfaces, lighter beneath. Inflorescences: lateral or sometimes terminal on short shoots, few-flowered cymes, often with a single paracladium of 1 female and 2 male flowers, peduncles densely white-puberulent, 0.4-1.9 cm; bracts linear-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 1.5-5 x 1-1.5 mm; pedicels ca. 0.5 mm in staminate, sessile in pistillate. Staminate flowers: sepals ovate, sometimes reddish, 2.5-3.2 x 1.3-1.5 mm, imbricate, margins ciliate, apex acute; corollas tubular-campanulate; pinkish white, petals 3-3.7 x 1.3-1.6 mm, glabrous on abaxial side but densely pilose on adaxial; stamens 8, monadelphous-biseriate (5 + 3), filaments of outer series ca. 3 mm long and distinct, those of inner series ca. 4.5 mm and connate to ½ of length. Pistillate flowers: like staminate but sepals ± foliaceous, 3.2-4.6 x 1.4-1.7 mm, glabrous; petals 3.5-4.5 x 1.5-2 mm; carpels 3, styles ca. 1 mm, connate ¾ of length, massive. Capsules: spherical, 1 cm long and wide, bright red on upper portion, surface verrucate, explosively dehiscent. Seeds: golden-brown mottled reddish brown; oblong, ca. 8 x 5.5 mm, caruncle prominent, lacerate.

description: Trees, to 7 m tall, monoecious. Stems: brown in younger shoots and gray in older, erect, much-branched, wood soft, trunk diameter ca. 20 cm, stem pith hallow in older parts of twigs, branchlets densely covered with short, tawny pubescence; latex cloudy, turning dull reddish brown when dry. Leaves: semideciduous (remaining green at the shoot tips during winter months), stipules filiform, caducous, to 1 cm., tawny tomentose; petioles densely pubescent, 6-10 cm long and 2-3 mm in diam., blades orbicular to cordate in outline, shallowly 3- to 7-lobed, 12-20 x 15-22 cm, chartaceous, base cordate, margins dentate-serrate, apex acute, venation palmate with 5-7 prominent veins often extending beyond apex as glandular knobs, densely white-tomentose on both surfaces when young but adaxial surface glabrous at maturity except conspicuously densely white-pubescent on the veins. Inflorescences: lateral, predominantly only staminate or pistillate but sometimes with both sexes, staminate inflorescences loosely corymbose-cymose, pistillate inflorescences compact, subcapitate; staminate bracts scalelike, 3-5 x 1 mm, tawny pubescent, pistillate bracts foliaceous, 1-2 x 0.8-1 cm, margins entire; peduncles tawny pubescent, 3-15 cm x 2-4 mm diam; pedicels 3-5 mm. Staminate flowers: sepals ovate to oblong, 2.5-3.5 x 1.5-2.5 mm, connate ca. 1/3 of length, margins with 4-6 irregularly spaced, short-stipitate to sessile glands near the apex, apex acute, pubescent on both surfaces; corollas subglobose-tubular, greenish white, petals 4-5 x 2-3 mm, connate at base otherwise imbricate, apex acute, revolute, densely long-villous adaxially, glabrous abaxially; stamens 10, monadelphous-biseriate (5 + 5), filaments of outer series 4-6 mm long and those of inner series 4.2-4.7 mm, connate to near top at anthesis but becoming free above the middle. Pistillate flowers: sepals ovate to oblong, 6-12 x 2-12 mm, unequal, often foliaceous, imbricate, apex obtuse-acuminate, densely tomentose abaxially, glabrous or nearly so adaxially, margins sometimes with a few irregularly spaced, stipitate glands; corollas campanulate, greenish white, petals oblong-elliptic, 6-12 x 3-5 mm, imbricate, densely tawny-villous adaxially, glabrous or nearly so abaxially, apex reflexed; carpels 3, styles 3, connate to near top, stigmas capitate, 4-5 mm. Capsules: oval, 1.2-1.6 x 1-1.5 cm, shortly apiculate, pubescent. Seeds: solid brown, spherical, 7-10 mm diam., caruncle vestigial.

description: Shrubs, 2-4 m tall. Stems: light gray to brown, sparsely branched, succulent, usually smooth and glabrous, with prominent, round leaf scars, latex clear. Leaves: deciduous, stipules glandular, nearly sessile, 0.6-1 mm long; petioles robust, 6.5-16 cm long and 1.5-3.5 mm in diam.; blades orbicular-peltiform in outline, shallowly 3- to 5-lobed, 7-13.5 cm long and nearly as wide, lobes triangular, membranous, base ± truncate, margins beset with stipitate glands, apex cuspidate, primary veins (5-)7, glabrous on both surfaces, lighter green on abaxial side. Inflorescences: terminal, compact, capitate cymes with well-organized, uniformly spaced paracladia; bracts ovate, 2-8 mm long, margins denticulate, apex acuminate; peduncles 7.5-16.5 cm long; pedicels 2-3.5 mm long. Staminate flowers: sepals ovate-oblong, 2-3 x 1.2-1.5 mm, margins irregularly denticulate, apex erose, glabrous on both surfaces; corollas rotate, brilliant scarlet-red; petals obovate, 8.5-11 x 4-5 mm, distinct, apex round, glabrous on both surfaces; stamens 8(-9), monodelphous-uniseriate, filaments 2-5 mm long, connate to 1/3 of length at anthesis otherwise distinct, anthers red with yellow margins. Pistillate flowers: like staminate but sepals ovate-triangular, 2.5-4 x 1.5-2 mm, glabrous, margins denticulate, apex acuminate; petals obovate, 9-12 x 4-5.5 mm; apex rounded; carpels 3, glabrous; styles red, 1.5-2 mm long, distinct. Capsules: spherical, 1-1.2 mm long and wide, glabrous. Seeds: dark brown, oblong, 9-11 x 4.5-6 mm, smooth; caruncle large and distinctly lobed or grooved.

description: Shrubs or subshrubs, to 1 m tall. Stems: much-branched, soft and pliable, covered with short pubescence, leaf scars flattened-oval, trunk to 7 cm in diam., latex nearly clear in younger branches, cloudy in older ones. Leaves: persistent, stipules linear, ca. 0.2 mm long, petioles sessile or subsessile, often covered with short, glandular cilia near leaf axils; blades heteromorphic, 5.5-9.5 x 0.5-4 cm, unlobed, younger (recent) linear, older (early) elliptic-ovate; membranous to crustaceous, base cuneate, margins entire, apex acute to abruptly acuminate, venation pinnate with few to no visible, secondary veins, scurfy on abaxial side but glabrous on adaxial. Inflorescences: terminal becoming lateral with continued growth, cymose, peduncles 5-10 cm long; bracts caducous, 1-7 mm long; pedicels 0.5-3 mm long, when present. Staminate flowers: sepals ovate, distinct, 2-3 x 1-1.5 mm, connate at base, margins entire, apex rounded, glabrous on both surfaces; corollas pink to rose-pink, rotate, petals elliptic-ovate to obovate, distinct, 7-13 x 3.5-7.5 mm, apex rounded, glabrous on both surfaces, but tufts of hair often present at adaxial base of petals; stamens 10, diadelphous-biseriate (5 + 5), filaments of outer series 1.5-3 mm long and those of inner series 3-6 mm, both connate to ca. ½ of length, basal glands small, spherical, ca. 1.5 mm long. Pistillate flowers: like staminate but sepals 2-4 x 1.5-2 mm; corollas 7-16.5 x 4.5-8.5 mm; styles distinct, 1-2 mm long, filiform, ovary 3-lobed, glabrous. Capsules: brownish upon maturity, nearly spherical, 7-13 x 7-10 mm, explosively dehiscent. Seeds: brown-black and often mottled with gray, oval, 7.5-8 x 4.5-5 mm, smooth, caruncle prominent.

description: Trees or large shrubs, to 5.5 m tall, dioecious. Stems: light gray-brown, multibranched, ± succulent, shoots densely cinereous villous-pubescent, older stems deeply ridged, to 7 cm diam.; leaf scars round and protruding, latex clear in younger branches changing to cloudy and brownish pink in older shoots. Leaves: deciduous; stipules ovate, 5-9 x 0.5-0.8 mm; petioles 3-7.7 cm long or occasionally longer and 2.5-3.5 mm in diam.; blades cordate to orbicular in outline, shallowly (3-)5-lobed, 75-12 x 10-16 cm (wider in moister habitats and in cultivation), coriaceous, base cordate, margins mostly entire but often with a few ciliate hairs and infrequently with a few stipitate glands and/or dentations, apex abruptly acuminate, venation palmate with 5 prominent, primary veins and 2 less conspicuous, lower veins, noticeably elevated and thick on abaxial side, densely villous when young but sparsely puberulent on adaxial surface and on veins of abaxial surface near the leaf base. Inflorescences: staminate terminal and lateral, many-flowered cymes; peduncles 5-15.5 cm (short at flower anthesis); bracts foliaceous, 1.5-4.5 x 0.7-3 mm, bracteoles 1-2 mm long, margins entire, densely cinereous-villous; pistillate solitary or sometimes 2-3; pedicels short to nearly sessile, ca. 0.5 mm. Staminate flowers: sepals narrowly elliptic-ovate, 3-6 x 2-3 mm, densely cinereous-villous onboth surfaces, margins entire; corollas campanulate, pale green, petals narrowly elliptic-ovate, 8.5-10 x 2-3 mm, imbricate, apex rounded, densely cinerous-villous on both surfaces; stamens 10, monadelphous-biserate (5 + 5), filaments of outer series 2 mm longand those of inner series ca. 5 mm, free or only slightly connate at base. Pistillate flowers: like staminate but larger sepals foliaceous, 8-11 x 3-7 mm; petals 3-7 5 X 1.5-2 mm, united; carpels 3, distinctly 3-lobed, styles dark green, flattened, 2-6 mm long, connate ¼-½ of length. Capsules: smooth and shiny, spherical with sides flattened and ridged, 1.4-1.8 x 1.5-1.9 cm, tardily dehiscent. Seeds: black, ellipsoid, 9-11 x 8-10 mm caruncle vestigial but ± fleshy.

description: Plants forming dense mats or cushions, brownish or blackish below, with light green or yellowish green tips. Stems to 5 cm or more, tomentose below, equally foliate. Leaves concave, conspicuously curved inwards (cf. the synonym "harpophyllus"), appressed at stems tips, about 5 mm long, narrowly lanceolate. Costa filling half of the leaf width, excurrent in a short hyaline point, in transverse section with thick walled ventral hyalocysts and dorsal groups of stereids, smooth at back. Alar cells differentiated, hyaline. Basal laminal cells thin walled, short rectangular beside the costa, 6-13 × 48-64 µm, becoming longer and narrower at margins. Upper laminal cells oval to elongate oval, 3-6 × 10-26 µm, ca. 4-8:1. Sporophyte not known.

description: Plants to 4 cm high, blackish below, yellowish green above. Stems tomentose. Leaves 5-7 mm long, narrow lanceolate; not appressed as in other species of Pilopogon but erect spreading when dry. Costa half as broad as the leaf base, excurrent in a denticulate point, smooth at back. Alar cells well differentiated, inflated, reddish brown. Basal laminal cells elongated, thick-walled and pitted, 7-10 × 40-60 µm, narrower and shorter at margins. Upper laminal cells elongated oval, incrassate, 3-6 × 16-24 µm. Perichaetial leaves short, reaching half the length of the seta. Capsule 2 mm long, cylindric, (3-)4 times long or longer as broad. Operculum longly rostrate, as long as or longer as the urn. Peristome teeth 16, filiform, split to the base, densely papillose. Calyptra cucullate, longly fringed at base. Spores ca. 13 µm in diam., yellowish, smooth.

description: Plants dioicous, in dense tufts, whitish to dark green. Stems to 8 cm high, erect, often branched, radiculose. Leaves 4-8 mm long, erect or homomallous, lanceolate, ending in a long, canaliculate apex. Leaf tips serrate or smooth. Perichaetial leaves broader at base, suddenly contracted to a narrow subula. Costa filling 1/3-4/5 of the leaf width, ridged at back or smooth, in transverse section with ventral and dorsal hyalocysts and median or median and dorsal chlorocysts. Alar cells differentiated, inflated, lax. Basal laminal cells elongate, hyaline, thin-walled, slightly pitted. Upper laminal cells elongate. Seta erect, 10-13 mm long, brownish, twisted dextrorsely in the upper part. Capsule erect, cylindrical, symmetric. Operculum longly rostrate. Annulus lacking. Peristome teeth divided into two prongs. Exothecial cells incrassate, rectangular. Stomata in two rows near the base of the capsule. Spores 13-34 µm. Calyptra yellowish, cucullate, entire at base.

description: Shrub to small tree 3-10 m tall, the branchlets glabrous, slender; stipules caducous to deciduous, ca 1 mm long, linear, glabrous; leaves glabrous, the petioles (9-) 14-22 mm long, terete, slender, the rachis (7-) 15-28 mm long, terete, exalate, estipellate, slender; leaflets unijugate, the petiolules (2-)3-4.5 mm long, canaliculate, the blades (3.8-)5-7(-10) cm long, (1.7-)2-4.5 cm wide (the terminal leaflet usually longer), oval or elliptic or ovate, the base of the lateral leaflets rounded-obtuse to acute, that of the terminal one subobtuse to cuneate, the apex of all the leaflets caudate-acuminate, the tip 10-20 mm long, linear and finally slightly retuse or truncate-obtuse, the upper surface usually drying green and the lower tan-brown, the venation obscure, the costa impressed above, salient beneath, the primary veins plane; inflorescences axillary, 2- or 3-flowered or occasionally the flowers solitary, 5-6.5 cm long, the axis glabrous or sparsely strigulose minutely, the primary bracts caducous, 0.7-1 mm long, linear, uncinate, densely strigulose, the secondary bracts deciduous, 0.7-1 mm long, linear, glabrous or sparsely strigulose minutely, the bracteoles arising in the upper half of the pedicels, ca 0.7 mm long, persistent, linear; flowers glabrous, the pedicels 23-42 mm long; buds globose, 6-9 mm diameter; calyx segments 4 or 5, deciduous; petal orange-colored, glabrous, the claw 4-6 mm long, the blade 14-22 mm long, 15-17.5 mm wide, rounded to oblate, the base rounded or truncate; stamens glabrous, the 12-16 larger ones with filaments 17-28 mm long and oval anthers 0.9-1 mm long, 0.8-0.9 mm wide, the pollen elliptic, 34-36.5 µ long, 26 µ diameter, the smaller stamens with filaments ca 15 mm long, the oval anthers 0.9 mm long, 0.7-0.8 mm wide, the pollen globose, 26-28.5 µ diameter; gynoecium glabrous, the stigma obtuse, the style ca 4 mm long, the ovary about 4-ovulate, arcuate-fusiform, 6-8 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, the gynophore 15.5-19 mm long; fruit 4-7 cm long (plus the persistent style ca 4 mm long), ca 2 cm wide, elliptic in outline, the stipe 22-26 mm long.

description: Tree 10 m tall, the branchlets densely ferruginous-strigulose; stipules deciduous to persistent, 1-1.5 mm long, narrowly triangular, densely strigulose externally; petioles 15-20 mm long, minutely strigulose, stipellate apically; rachis 9.5-14.5 cm long, stipellate at each pair of leaflets, minutely strigulose; leaflets 6- or 7-jugate, the petiolules 1-1.5 mm long, minutely strigulose, the blades oblong-lanceolate, ca 5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, the basal ones smaller, all the leaflets rounded-obtuse basally, acuminate apically, glabrous on the upper surface, minutely strigulose and discolorous beneath, the venation obscure, the costa strongly impressed on the upper surface and salient beneath, the primary veins plane on both surfaces; infrutescence racemose, ramuligerous, 7.5-15 cm long, the axis minutely strigulose densely, the bracts persistent, narrowly ovate, 2 mm long, minutely strigulose externally, the bracteoles lacking; pedicels 5-6 mm long, densely strigulose; calyx segments 4, persistent; petal lacking (?); stamens and gynoecium not seen; fruit 20-25 mm long, 10-12 mm diameter, oval in outline, minutely strigulose, 1-seeded, the stipe 4-5 mm long; seeds 18-23 mm long, oval, black, nitid.

description: Plants epiphytic or epipetric; fronds erect to arcuate, determinate; rhizome short-creeping, dorsiventral, with ventral root insertion, scaly, the scales 1-1.5 x 0.2-0.4 mm, lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, the apex short-attenuate, clathrate, bright brown, ciliate, the cilia simple, present on scale margin and apex (apical cilia sometimes furcate); petiole 0.5-1 cm x 1-1.2 mm, castaneous, dark brown, marginate, densely pubescent, the hairs 0.3-0.5 mm long, spreading, simple, 3- to 5-celled, whitish; lamina to 40 cm long, linear-lanceolate, chartaceous, deeply pinnatisect, 35-50 pairs of segments, gradually reduced at the base, with 10-15 segments strongly reduced to auricles, about 4/5 shorter than the median ones, broadest near the middle, not showing periodic constrictions, the apex gradually reduced, pinnatifid, not forming a subconform apical segment; rachis straight, with dark sclerenchyma obscured by laminar tissue on both sides (not visible), sparsely pubescent on both sides, the hairs ca. 0.1-0.2 mm long, appressed, simple, 2-celled, yellowish to reddish; segments 0.8-1 x 0.2 cm, plane, set 85-90° to rachis, widened and slightly asymmetrical at the base, decurrent on both sides or slightly cuneate acroscopically, the base attached parallel on the rachis (i.e., both sides inserted along the same radius), not lobulate or overlapping the base of the next segment, the apex acute to obtuse, the margin entire, plane, glabrous, the lamina surface glabrescent on both sides, the hairs similar to those of the rachis; sinuses about the same width as the segments or wider; venation pinnate, with 4-6 pairs of veins per segment; costae with blackish sclerenchyma obscured by laminar tissue on both sides, glabrous or sparsely pubescent, the hairs similar to those of the rachis; veins with blackish sclerenchyma restricted to base and obscured by laminar tissue, ending in hydathodes that lack calcareous deposits; sori medial, rounded, not protruding beyond the costa and margin, up to 6 pairs per segment, superficial; sporangial capsules glabrous.

description: Plants epilithic, growing in moss layers and rock crevices. Rhizomes short-creeping, horizontal, frequently branched, 0.4-0.5 mm diam. Fronds 1.3-4.7 cm long, appressed to substrate, inserted onto the rhizome at an acute to right angle, closely to moderately spaced (1.5-3.0 mm). Rhizome scales 3-4 x 0.3-0.4 mm, 6-10 cells wide across bases, clathrate, dark brown, iridescent, narrowly cordate at bases, attenuate at tips; apical cells 1-4, linearly to furcately arranged. Petioles 3-10 x 0.2-0.3 mm, proximally terete, distally marginate, with few to many, dark brown, setiform hairs, 1.3-1.5 mm long, spreading, simple and branched, clavate hairs present on crosiers and persistent on older fronds, 0.2-0.4 mm long. Rachises castaneous to blackish, planar and slightly sunken adaxially, hemispherically protruding abaxially, with scattered setiform hairs on both the abaxial and adaxial sides, the setiform hairs 1.0-1.5 mm long, spreading, dark brown, the abaxial side of the rachises also provided with scattered, simple and branched, clavate hairs. Laminae 1.0-3.7 x 0.2-0.3 cm, linear to narrowly elliptic, the bases cuneate, the apices acute. Largest segments 1.0-1.4 x 0.8-1.0 mm (mostly as long as broad), segments oblong, fully adnate, the bases slightly decurrent, the apices rounded, midveins not visible; 1-2 proximal segment pairs usually markedly smaller than subsequent segments and with the base more strongly decurrent, the abaxial and adaxial surfaces of the laminae as well as the segment margins densely provided with dark brown setiform hairs, 1.0-1.5 mm long, spreading, the abaxial surface of the lamina also provided with scattered, simple and branched, clavate hairs; stomata not visible; hydathodes present, small and inconspicuous. Sori 1-3 per segment, confluent at maturity, with setiform hairs like those of the laminae, but not clustered in them.

description: Scandent shrubs, main branches up to 4 m long, lateral shoots, numerous, shorter, terete, olive gray-tomentose. Leaves not crowded along the branchlets; petioles 10-30 mm long; blades large, 8-13 x 4-7.5 cm, subcoriaceous, ovate to suborbicular, subacute at apex, slightly oblique to cordate at base, margin slightly revolute and entire, somewhat rugose, scabrous above, midvein tomentose, silvery gray-stellate-tomentose below, trichomes with long stalks, 6-8 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary, globose, corymbose clusters of 10-30 heads. Heads with six florets, single or in groups of 2-3, on silvery, tomentose peduncles; involucres ovoid to narrowly campanulate, 6-7 x 3-4 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 3-4 series, subpersistent, silvery tomentose with yellow-tomentose apices (outer surface) except lower half glabrous on inner phyllaries, outer ones ovate, subacute at apex, inner ones oblong to narrowly elliptic, abruptly acuminate at apex. Corollas cream-colored, glabrate with scattered trichomes and occasional glands at the juncture of the tube and lobes and on the outer surface of the lobes, tips pilose, tube ca. 4.5 mm long, lobes 1.5-2 mm long; anthers ca 3.5 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, 0.7-1 mm long. Pappus white, indistinctly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 6-6.5 mm long, outer bristles few, inconspicuous, less than 1 mm long. Achenes 4 mm long, 10-costate, gland-dotted.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Gerald L. & Coile, Nancy C. 2007. Piptocarpha (Compositae: Vernonieae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 99: 1--94.

description: Epiphytic or terrestrial shrubs, scandent or erect, 0.5–2 m tall. Young branchlets ridged or not ridged, ± smooth, villous, the hairs eglandular and brown, the indumentum of the mature branches similar but glabrate. Leaves 1–4 per cm, apparently distichous, diffuse or patent; petiole 1–2.8 mm long, puberulous, the hairs eglandular; lamina ovate or narrowly elliptic, 1.2–3.4 × (0.3–)0.7–1.7 cm, basally obtuse or cuneate, marginally entire, apically ciliolate with eglandular hairs (especially in young leaves), apically acute or acuminate, adaxially and abaxially glabrate with eglandular hairs, the venation adaxially hyphodromous with the midvein impressed, abaxially 3-nerved with the midvein raised. Axillary solitary flowers and rarely 2-flowered fascicles; bracts 8–11, chartaceous, elliptic, suborbicular or transverse-elliptic, 1.2–4.4 × 2–6 mm, marginally eciliate, apically obtuse, abaxially glabrous or glabrate with glandular hairs; pedicel 0.8 mm long, reduced and hidden by overlapping bracts, glabrous or glabrate with glandular hairs; differentiated apical bracteoles 2, distinct, chartaceous, extending beyond calyx 2.5–4 mm (covering 100% of calyx), obovate or broadly elliptic, (5.2–)6–9 × 5.2–6.3 mm, marginally eciliate, apically obtuse (and usually splitting), the surface smooth, abaxially glabrous or sometimes glabrate with glandular hairs, adaxially glabrous. Flowers 4- merous. Calyx aestivation valvate, campanulate or cylindric, 2.8–3.6(–4.5) mm long; tube weakly angled, 1.5–1.8 mm long, abaxially glabrate with glandular hairs; limb 1–1.7(–2.5) mm long, abaxially glabrate or apically puberulous, the hairs minute, eglandular, and deciduous, adaxially glabrous; lobes triangular, 1–1.7(–2) × 1.4–2 mm, marginally eciliate, apically acute; sinuses acute (V-shaped). Corolla pink and white or sometimes light green and white, thin-fleshy, bistratose, urceolate (inflated at the middle or more distally), (6.8–)7.5–10.7 mm long, 4.8–6.5 mm diam. (4 mm when dry), 3–3.5 mm wide at throat (2.4 mm when dry), abaxially glabrate with glandular hairs, adaxially glabrous; lobes 1.2–2.8 × 1.2–2.5 mm, apically acute, adaxially rugose. Stamens (7–)8, 6–8(–10) mm long, included; filaments distinct, straight, broader at base, 3.6–4(–7) mm long, abaxially pilulose, adaxially glabrate; anthers distinct, papillae only on thecae; thecae 1.6–2.1 mm long, without or sometimes with basal appendages; tubules 2, (2–)2.4–2.8 mm long, dehiscing introrsely by longitudinal slits, (0.8–)1–1.7 mm long. Ovary 4-locular; style 7.2–9 mm long, exserted (the style often remains enclosed by the enveloping differentiated apical bracteoles after the corolla is shed; when the fruit matures it falls off and the bracteoles spread out). Berry white, ± spherical, 7–9 mm diam., the persistent calyx lobes erect or spreading, becoming succulent (at least at base), same color as mature berry; embryo white.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches pendulous, lateral branchlets numerous, very short, cinereous-lepidote, resinous-dotted. Leaves somewhat crowded along the branchlets; petioles 6-11 mm long; blades small, 2.5-6 x 1.5-2.5 cm, coriaceous, obovate, acute to shortly acuminate at apex, cuneate at base, margin entire, lustrous, glabrate above, cinereous-lepidote, resinous-dotted below, 5-7 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary, clusters of 5-20 heads. Heads with three florets, subsessile on short, tomentose peduncles; involucres cylindric to narrowly turbinate, 6-7 x 2.5-3.5 mm; phyllaries irregularly imbricate in several series, yellowish brown with dark, subacute tips, margin ciliate to arachnoid, outer ones triangular-ovate to elliptic, inner ones elliptic or oblong. Corollas glabrous to sparsely pilose, tube ca. 4 mm long, the lobes ca. 3.5 mm long; anthers ca. 3 mm long, basal auricles elongated, papillate, blunt at apex, ca. 0.6 mm long. Pappus light straw-colored, distinctly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 6-7 mm long, outer ones linear, often fringed at apex, 0.52 mm long. Achenes ca. 4 mm long, 3-4-angled, indistinctly costate.

description: Robust, widely spreading, scandent to subscan-dent shrubs, lateral branchlets numerous, appressed cinereous-tomentulose-lepidote, leaf axils with dense, globose, showy glomerules. Leaves not crowded and evenly spaced along the branchlets; petioles stout, 10-20 mm long; blades typically large, 9-18 x 4-7 cm, coriaceous, acuminate at apex, oblique to rounded at base, glabrous above, cinereous to yellowish brown-tomentose below, 6-10 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary, dense, globose clusters of 20-50 heads. Heads with (4-)7-9 florets, subsessile; involucres narrowly turbinate, 8-9.5 x 2.5-3.5 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 7-8 series, uniformly brown (when dried), glabrate, margin arachnoid, slightly darkened, acute to acuminate at apex, outer ones elliptic, inner ones lanceolate to linear. Corollas cream-colored, occasionally gland-dotted, tube 4.5-5.5 mm long, lobes 2-3 mm long; anthers 3-4 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, ca. 1 mm long. Pappus white to straw-colored, indistinctly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 6-6.5 mm long, outer bristles few, unequal, mostly occurring at the lateral edges of the achenes, 0.5-1.5 mm long. Achenes ca. 3 mm long, often 3-4-angled, indistinctly to distinctly 10-costate, gland-dotted.

description: Highly branched scandent shrubs, branches slender, pendulous, slightly striate, cinereous-tomentulose-lepidote, lateral branchlets numerous, short with showy, axillary, umbellate glomerules. Leaves evenly spaced along branchlets; petioles 515 mm long; blades 5-11 x 1.5-4 cm, papery, elliptic, acuminate at apex, narrowly oblique or cuneate at base, margin entire, glabrous above, cinereous-stellate-tomentose below, 5-8 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary, umbellate to subumbellate clusters of 4-8(-10) heads. Heads with (12-) 15-18 florets, solitary or in groups of 2-3 on slender tomentose peduncles; involucres broadly campanulate, 7-10 x 4-6 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 8-9 series, uniformly brown, glabrate, slightly darkened at apex (when dried), outer ones triangular-ovate to elliptic, acute at apex, inner ones oblong to linear, subobtuse at apex. Corollas cream-colored, glabrate, tube ca. 4 mm long, lobes ca. 1.5 mm long; anthers 3-3.5 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, 0.7-1 mm long. Pappus white to light straw-colored, weakly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 4.5-5 mm. long, outer bristles few, filiform or linear, less than 1 mm long. Achenes slender 3-3.5(-4) mm long, 3-4-angled, distinctly costate, gland-dotted (Fig. 10).

description: Scandent shrubs, branches long, pendulous, lateral branchlets numerous, short, yellowish brown-tomentulose-lepidote. Leaves not crowded along the branches; petioles short, 5-10 mm long; blades typically small, 4-10 x 2-5 cm, coriaceous, elliptic to oval, shortly acuminate at apex, slightly oblique to cordate at base, margin slightly revolute, entire to remotely toothed, glabrous above, cinereous to yellowish brown-stellate-tomentose, gland-dotted below, 58 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary, pseudo-umbels of 5-20 heads. Heads with six florets, single or in pairs on slender peduncles of somewhat equal length; involucres narrowly campanulate, 7-8.5 x 3-3.5 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 3-4 series, greenish brown (when dried), tomentulose, acute at apex, margin arachnoid, outer ones triangular-ovate, inner ones narrowly elliptic. Corollas cream-colored, tube 4.5-5.5 mm long, lobes 1.5-3 mm long, tips pilose; anthers 3.5-4 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, 0.8-1.4 mm long. Pappus white, indistinctly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, ca. 7 mm long, outer bristles few, less than 1 mm long. Achenes 2.5-3 mm long, 10-costate, gland-dotted.

description: Large trees up to 30 m tall, secondary branches willowy, terete, cinereous-lepidote. Leaves numerous and evenly spaced along the branches; petioles short, slightly decurrent, 4-9 mm long; blades 5-10 x 3-10 cm, coriaceous, linear-lanceolate, acuminate at apex, narrowly cuneate or slightly obtuse at base, margin denticulate above middle, revolute, glabrous above, cinereous-stellate-tomentose below, 15-20 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary clusters of 2-3 heads, rarely one. Heads with 7-9 florets, single on short, thick, cinereous-tomentose peduncles; involucres turbinate, 5.5-6.5 x 4-5 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 56 series, straw-colored with upper portion brown, cinereous-tomentulose and acute at apex, margin arachnoid, outer phyllaries triangular-ovate, inner phyllaries elliptic to narrowly ovate. Corollas off-white, glabrate, tube 3-4 mm long, lobes 1.5-2.5 mm long; anthers purple, ca. 3 mm long, basal auricles elongated, papillate, blunt at tip, 0.7-0.9 mm long. Pappus white, distinctly biseriate, inner bristles 5.5-6 mm long, outer ones linear, notched at apex or paleaceous scales, 0.5-1 mm long. Achenes 3-3.5 mm long, occasionally 4-angled, indistinctly costate, gland-dotted.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches long, pendulous, terete, lateral branchlets short, numerous, cinereous-tomentulose-lepidote. Leaves not crowded along the branches; petioles 5-15 mm long; blades 5-10 x 2-5 cm, coriaceous, elliptic, acuminate at apex, cuneate at base, margin slightly revolute and remotely toothed, glabrous above, cinereous-stellate-tomentose below, 5-6 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary, subumbellate to corymbose clusters of 6-18 heads. Heads with 8-9 florets, sessile or shortly pedicellate on slender peduncles, usually of a uniform length; involucres narrowly campanulate 8.5-9.5 x 4-5 mm; phyllaries closely imbricate in 6-7 series, uniformly brown (when dried), glabrate, slightly darkened at tips, outer phyllaries triangular to elliptic, tomentulose and subacute at tip, margin ciliate, inner phyllaries narrowly elliptic to linear, acute at tip. Corollas cream-colored, glabrate, tube 4-4.5 mm long, the lobes 1.5-2 mm long; anthers 3-3.5 mm long, the basal auricles sharply caudate, ca. 1 mm long. Pappus white to straw-colored, indistinctly biseriate, the inner bristles filiform, 5-5.5 mm long, the outer bristles extremely reduced, filiform, less than 1 mm long, totally absent on some achenes. Achenes 2.5-3 mm long, occasionally 3-angled, indistinctly 10-costate, gland-dotted.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches long, pendulous, lateral branchlets shorter, numerous, cinereous-tomentulose-lepidote. Leaves not crowded along the branchlets; petioles 5-10 mm long; blades 6-10 cm x 4-6cm, coriaceous, elliptic to ovate, acute to shortly acuminate at apex, slightly oblique or rounded to subcordate at base, margin slightly revolute, entire, glabrous above, cinereous to yellowish brown-stellate-tomentose below, 4-8 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary and terminal panicles. Heads with six florets, clustered in groups of 5-15 on stout peduncles along and at the end of rachises, often subtended by bracteole leaves; involucres cylindrical to narrowly campanulate, 7-8 mm x 3-4 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 4-5 series, dark brown with blackened tips, glabrate, outer ones triangular-ovate, margin ciliate to arachnoid, tomentulose, subacute, at apex, inner ones narrowly elliptic to linear, acute at apex. Corollas glabrate, tube 4-5 mm long, lobes 1.5-3 mm long; anthers 4-4.5 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, 1-1.5 mm long. Pappus white, indistinctly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, ca. 7 mm long, outer ones few, less than 1 mm long. Achenes 3-3.5 mm long, angled, costate.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches widely spreading, ap-pressed cinereous-tomentulose-lepidote. Leaves not crowded along the branchlets; petioles 10-20 mm long; blades 4-10 x 3-5 cm, coriaceous, elliptic-oblong to lanceolate, subacute to apex, oblique to slightly cordate at base, margin slightly revolute and entire, glabrous above, cinereous-stellate-tomentose below, 58 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary, pseudoumbels of 5-15 heads. Heads with 6-7 florets, single or in pairs on somewhat thickened peduncles of equal length; involucres narrowly campanulate, 6.5-7.5 x 3-3.5 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 3-4 series, yellowish green, margin ciliate to arachnoid, tomentose and acute at apex, outer ones triangular-ovate, inner ones narrowly elliptic. Corollas cream-colored, tube ca. 4 mm long, lobes 1.5-2.5 mm long; anthers ca. 3 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, 0.7-1 mm long, Pappus silvery white, indistinctly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 6.5-7 mm long, outer bristles few, filiform to linear, 1 mm or less long. Achenes ca. 4 mm long, 10-costate, slightly angled, gland-dotted.

description: Arborescent shrubs, branches terete, yellowish brown-tomentose. Leaves not crowded along the branches; petioles 20-35 mm long; blades large 8-22 x 4-11 cm, subcoriaceous, suborbicular to elliptic-oblong, acute at apex, oblique to slightly cordate at base, margin sparsely and remotely denticulate, rugose, scabrous with tubercles and occasional trichomes above, silvery to yellowish gray stellate-tomentose below, 8-12 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary, rounded, umbellate, clusters of 8-14 heads. Heads with 9-12 florets, single or in groups of 2-3 on stout peduncles of a uniform length giving an umbellate appearance to inflorescences; involucres ovoid to turbinate with neck constricted, ca. 10 x 4-6 mm; phyllaries closely imbricate in 7-8 series, subpersistent, brown (when dried), glabrate, margin sparsely ciliate, slightly darkened, tomentulose at apex, outer ones triangular to obovate with lateral wings, acute to slightly acuminate at apex, inner ones narrowly elliptic to linear, subacute to apex. Corollas glabrate with scattered glands at the juncture of tube and lobes and on upper surface of lobes tips, tube 5-6 mm long, lobes 2.5-3.5 mm long; anthers ca. 5 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, 1-1.5 mm long. Pappus light straw-colored, distinctly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, ca. 9 mm long, outer bristles irregular, filiform, 0.5-1.5 mm long. Achenes ca. 3.5 mm long, angled, costate, gland-dotted.

description: Extensively branched and widely spreading scan-dent shrubs, lateral branchlets numerous, short, cinereous-tomentulose-lepidote. Leaves not crowded along the branchlets; petioles 5-15 mm long; blades 6-9 x 3-4 cm, coriaceous, elliptic to oblong, subobtuse to acute at apex, oblique, or rounded to subcordate at base, margin slightly revolute and often toothed, glabrous and occasionally black-glandular-punctate above, cinereous-stellate-tomentose below, 6-8 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary and terminal panicles. Heads with 3-4 florets, clustered in groups of 5-15 on stout, densely cinereous-tomentose peduncles along and at the end of rachises; involucres narrowly campanulate, 7-8.5 x 2.5-3 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 5-6 series, brown, tips slightly darkened, margin arachnoid, outer ones triangular-ovate to elliptic, silvery tomentose, obtuse at apex, inner ones narrowly ovate to linear, silvery tomentulose, subacute at apex. Corollas glabrate, tube 4 mm long, lobes 1.5-2 mm long, densely glandular at apex; anthers 3-3.5 mm long, basal auricles caudate, tapering to an abrupt point, 0.5-0.6 mm long. Pappus light brown, biseriate, inner series of filiform bristles, 5.5-6.5 mm long, outer series of paleaceous scales and linear bristles, 0.5-1 mm long. Achenes 4.5-5 mm long, often 4-5angled, 10-costate.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches robust, pendulous, cinereous-lepidote-tomentulose with oval, longitudinally cleft tubercles. Leaves not crowded along the branchlets; petioles 5-10 mm long; blades 11-14 x 4-6 cm, coriaceous, elliptic to ovate-lanceolate, acuminate at apex, slightly oblique to rounded at base, margin entire or remotely toothed, glabrate above, yellowish brown-stellate-tomentose below, 6-8 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary, corymbose to paniculate clusters of 10-15 heads. Heads with ca. six florets on short, stout pedicels at the end of stout peduncles; involucres cylindrical to narrowly campanulate, 7-8 mm x 2-3 mm; phyllaries imbricate in ca. four series, yellowish brown, tips dark, lepidote-tomentulose, subobtuse, outer ones ovate, margin ciliate, inner ones narrowly ovate to oblong, margin sparsely ciliate to entire. Corollas sparsely gland-dotted, tube ca. 4 mm long, lobes 1.5-2 mm long, gland-dotted at tips; anthers 3-3.5 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, ca. 1 mm long. Pappus brown, distinctly biseriate, the outer series of filiform bristles, 6 mm long, the inner series of paleaceous scales, oblong to lanceolate, unevenly fringed at apex, less than 1 mm long. Achenes robust, 4 mm long, somewhat 4-angled, distinctly 10-costate.

description: Scandent shrubs, branchlets closely olive-tomentose. Leaves not crowded along the branchlets; petioles 5-10 mm long; blades 11-15 x 4-5 cm wide, subcoriaceous, elliptic, subacute at apex, oblique at base, margin entire, sparsely stellate-pubescent above, punctate-glandular below, 8-10 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary, branching, corymbose clusters of ca. 30 heads. Heads with ca. six florets in groups of 2-3 on tomentose peduncles; involucres ovoid to cylindrical; outer phyllaries brown (when dried), ovate, margin ciliate to arachnoid, tomentulose, white-gland-dotted and subacute at apex, inner ones absent. Corollas glabrate, tube ca. 4 mm long, the lobes 1.5-2 mm long; anthers ca. 3 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, ca. 1 mm long. Pappus white, biseriate, inner bristles filiform, ca. 6 mm long, the outer bristles irregular, inconspicuous, less than 1 mm long. Achenes immature, ca. 3 mm long, costate, gland-dotted.

description: Scandent to subscandent shrubs, branches pendulous, widely spreading, lateral branchlets numerous, short, cinereous-lepidote. Leaves somewhat crowded toward the end of lateral branchlets; petioles 714mm long; blades (3.5-)4.5-9 x 1.5-3 cm, subcoriaceous, oblong, obtuse, rarely acute at apex, narrowly rounded to slightly oblique at base, margin often conspicuously dentate, glabrous above, cinereous scales with resinous dots in center below, 6-9 lateral veins on each side. Inflorescences axillary, dense corymbose clusters of (5-) 10-30 heads. Heads with three florets, solitary or in groups of two or three at end of branching peduncles; involucres ovoid to cylindrical, 7-8 x 2-3 mm; phyllaries irregularly imbricate in 5-7 series, yellowish brown but red or brownish purple at shallowly trifid apex, tomentulose-glandular below subobtuse tip, margin sparsely arachnoid to ciliate, outer phyllaries oval to elliptic, inner ones narrowly elliptic, curved or bow-shaped. Corollas sparsely pilose, white gland-dotted, the tube (5.5-)6-7(-7.5) mm long, the lobes 2.5-3(-3.5) mm long, outer surface densely glandular at tip; anthers (3.5-)4-4.5 mm long, basal auricles elongated, papillate at tip, 0.4-1 mm long. Pappus white, biseriate, inner bristles filiform, (8-)9-9.5 mm long, outer bristles linear or filiform, unequal 0.5-2.5 mm long. Achenes large, ca. 5 mm long, 10-costate, gland-dotted.

description: Highly branched scandent shrubs, branches pendulous, flexuous, terete, lateral branchlets numerous, short, cinereous-lepidote, resinous-dotted. Leaves numerous but not densely crowded along the branchlets; petioles 10-15 mm long; blades 4-8 x 2-4 cm, coriaceous, elliptic to oval, abruptly acuminate with tips often obtuse, cunéate at base, margin slightly revolute, glabrate above, scattered cinereous-lepidote, resinous-dotted below, 4-8 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary clusters of 6-20 heads. Heads with three florets, sessile; involucres narrowly turbinate, 7-8 x 2.53 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 6-7 series, yellowish brown, darkened, tomentulose or glabrate at apex, margin arachnoid, outer ones triangular-ovate to elliptic, obtuse at apex, margin arachnoid, outer ones triangular-ovate to elliptic, obtuse at apex, inner ones narrowly elliptic to linear, subacute at apex. Corollas glabrate, tube 2.5-3 mm long, the lobes 3.5-4.5 mm long, tips pilose; anthers 2.5-3 mm long, basal auricles elongated, papillate, blunt at tip, 0.7-0.9 mm long. Pappus white to light straw-colored, biseriate, inner bristles filiform, ca. 6.5 mm long, outer bristles unequal, filiform to linear, 0.5-2 mm long. Achenes large, ca. 5 mm long, 3-angled, indistinctly costate.

description: Frutices scandentes, 2 ramis pendulis. Folia alterna 9-13 x 3.5-5.5 cm, coriacea, lanceolata, supra glabra, infra arete cinereo-stellato-tomentosa. Inflorescentiae fasciculi, densi, globosi, subcorymbosi. Capitula 9-10-flosculosa, breviter pedunculata, solitaria vel aggregata bina vel tria; involucra anguste turbinata 9-10 x 3-3.5 mm; phyllaria imbricata 7-8-seriata, brunnea in sicco, intima lineares. Corollae cremeae, glabratae, tubo ca. 4 mm longo, lobis ca. 1.5 mm longis; antherae 3-3.5 longae, auriculae basi argute caudatae ca. 1 mm longae. Pappus albus imprimis unise-riatus; setae interiores filiformes 5-5.5 mm longae, setae exterires paucae filiformes minus quam 1 mm. Achaenia ca 3 mm longa, interdum 3-angulata, leviter 10-costata.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches long, pendulous, lateral branchlets numerous, shorter, terete, lightly striate, closely cinereous-substellate-tomentose. Leaves evenly spaced along the branches; petioles furrowed, cinereous-tomentose, 10-20 mm long; blades 9-13 x 3.5-5.5 cm, coriaceous, lanceolate, acuminate at the apex, oblique at the base, margin slightly revolute, glabrous above, cinereous brown-stellate-tomentose below, 6-10 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences dense, axillary, globose, subcorymbose clusters of (5-) 10-25 heads. Heads with 8-9 florets, shortly pedunculate, solitary or in groups of two or three; involucres narrowly turbinate, 9-10 x 3-3.5 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 7-8 series, glabrate, brown, slightly darkened at tips (when dried), margin ciliate, outer ones triangular-ovate to elliptic, subacute, tomentulose at apex, inner ones narrowly elliptic to linear, obtuse at apex. Corollas cream-colored, glabrate, tube ca. 4 mm long, the lobes ca. 1.5 mm long, gland-tipped; anthers 3-3.5 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, ca. 1 mm long. Pappus white, indistinctly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 5-5.5 mm long, outer bristles few, mostly occurring at the lateral edges of the achenes, less than 1 mm long. Achenes ca. 3 mm long, glabrate, finely 10-costate.

description: Robust scandent shrubs, branches long, pendulous, lateral branchlets shorter, terete, slightly striated, cinereous brown-lepidote, gland-dotted. Leaves not crowded along the branchlets; petioles 11-17 mm long; blades 12-17 cm long, 5.8-9.2 cm wide, subcoriaceous, broadly elliptic, abruptly short acuminate at apex, cuneate at base, margin slightly revolute, glabrate above, olive brown (when dried) glandular punctate below, 8-10 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary and terminal paniculate clusters of heads. Heads with ca. six florets, loosely clustered in groups of 5-9(-12) on slender peduncles along and at the end of rachises; involucres cylindrical to campanulate, 8-10 mm long, 4-5 mm wide; phyllaries imbricate in 5-7 series, brown, glabrous, dark tips, outer ones ovate to broadly elliptic, ciliate, subacute at apex, inner ones elliptic to oblong, subobtuse at apex. Corollas cream-colored, densely gland-dotted, tube ca. 4mm long, lobes ca. 3 mm long; anthers 3.54 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, 0.7-1 mm long. Pappus straw-colored, biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 6 mm long, outer ones filiform or linear, 13 mm long. Achenes cylindrical, gland-dotted, immature but appearing costate, 3.5-4 mm long.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches long, slender, lateral branchlets numerous, short, terete, lightly striate, cinereous-tomentulose-lepidote. Leaves somewhat crowded along the branchlets; petioles 3-5 mm long; blades small, 3-7 x 1-1.5 cm, subcoriaceous, oval to narrowly lanceolate, acute at apex, occasionally mucronate, slightly oblique at base, margin slightly revolute, entire, glabrate above, cinereous-stellate-tomentose below, 5-6 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary and terminal, shortly paniculate clusters of 5-15 heads; heads with 5-6 florets on short, tomentose peduncles along and at the end of rachises, often subtended by bracteole leaves; involucres ovoid, cylindrical to narrowly campanulate, 6-7 x 3-4 mm; phyllaries irregularly imbricate in 3-4 series, brown, glabrate, darkened, subobtuse at apex, outer ones ovate, margin arachnoid, inner ones narrowly ovate, or oblong to linear, margin minutely ciliate. Corollas cream-colored, glabrate, tube 3.5-4 mm long, the lobes 1.5-2 mm long; anthers 3.5-4 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, ca. 1.5 mm long. Pappus white to light straw-colored, biseriate, inner bristles filiform, ca. 5.5 mm long, outer bristles irregular, filiform to linear, 0.5-1.5 mm long. Achenes ca. 3.5 mm long, somewhat 4angled, distinctly 10-costate.

description: Small trees 3-5 m high, branchlets slender, terete, cinereous-stellate-tomentose, alternate but upper ones becoming subopposite to opposite with glomerules in leaf axils. Leaves alternate but upper ones becoming subopposite to opposite, decussate, somewhat crowded toward ends of branchlets; petioles slightly furrowed, cinereous-tomentose (7-)10-15(-18) mm long; blades 3.5-8 x 1.5-3.5 cm, coriaceous, elliptic to obovate, acute to subacute at apex, slightly oblique to cuneate at base, glabrous, lustrous above, cinereous-stellate-tomentose below, 6-8 pairs of lateral veins, margins remotely toothed. Inflorescences axillary clusters of 4-7 heads, the inflorescences of each opposite leaf pair often appearing as one dense cluster. Heads with 5-7 florets on short tomentose peduncles; involucres turbinate, 6.5-7.5 x 3.5-4.5 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 4-5 series, rusty brown, margin arachnoid, outer ones triangular-ovate, tomentulose and subacute at apex, inner ones ovate-lanceolate to oblong, tomentose and obtuse at apex. Corollas light purple to white, glabrate, tube ca. 4 mm long, lobes 1.5-3 mm long; anthers purple ca. 3.5 mm long; the basal auricles elongated, papillate at tip, ca. 0.5 mm long. Pappus white to light straw-colored, biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 56 mm long, outer ones linear or filiform, unequal 0.52 mm long. Achenes 3-3.5 mm long, somewhat 3-4angled, 10-costate, gland-dotted.

description: Small trees 3-8 m high, branchlets slender, brittle subopposite to opposite, terete, cinereous-lepidote, upper ones with axillary glomerules. Leaves opposite to subopposite, decussate, somewhat crowded towards the end of branchlets; petioles slightly furrowed, cinereous-lepidote (3-)5-11(-15) mm; blades (3.5-)5-8(-10) x (l-)1.5-3.5(-4) cm, coriaceous, elliptic, apex variably acute, subapiculate or obtuse, cuneate at base, margins coarsely toothed above middle, glabrate above, cinereous-lepidote below, 5-9 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary clusters of 1-2, rarely three heads, those of each opposite pair often appearing as a single cluster. Heads with 8-9 florets on short tomentose peduncles; involucres turbinate 8-11 x (4-) 4.5-5.5 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 4-5 series, below middle green-yellow, above rusty-brown-tomentose, margins arachnoid, outer ones triangular-ovate, tomentulose and subacute at apex, inner ones ovate-lanceolate to linear-oblong, tomentose and obtuse at apex. Corollas light purple to white, glabrate, tube 45 mm long, the lobes 2-3 mm long, glandular at apex; anthers purple ca. 3.5 mm long, the basal auricles elongated, papillate at tips, ca. 0.5 mm long. Pappus white to light straw-colored, biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 5.5-6.5 mm long, outer bristles filiform to linear, occasionally deciduous, (0.5-) l-2(-2.5) mm long. Achenes 3.5-4(-4.5) mm long, somewhat 4-angled, 10-costate, gland-dotted.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches pendulous, lateral branchlets numerous, short, cinereous brown-lepidote, gland-dotted. Leaves not crowded along the branchlets; petioles 8-12 mm long; blades 5.3-7.9 cm long, 1.8-2.4 cm wide, somewhat coriaceous, elliptic, shortly acuminate at apex, cuneate at base, margin entire, glabrate but occasional patches of cinereous scales and glandular dots above, densely glandular-dotted below, 5-6 pairs of lateral veins with veinlets finely reticulate and exsculpted. Inflorescences axillary, compact corymbose clusters of 915 heads. Heads with three florets on short, stout, lepidote peduncles; involucres cylindrical to narrowly campanulate, ca. 8 mm long, ca. 4 mm wide; phyllaries irregularly imbricate in several series, yellowish brown, glabrate, darkened, tomentulose and subacute at apex, margin ciliate, outer ones ovate, inner ones elliptic. Corollas cream-colored, sparsely gland-dotted, tube ca. 3 mm long, lobes ca. 2.5 mm; anthers 2.5-3 mm long, basal auricles elongated, papillate, blunt at apex, 0.5-0.7 mm long. Pappus light straw-colored, distinctly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 5-6 mm long, outer ones filiform, 1-2 mm long. Achenes ca. 3.5 mm long, 4-angled, indistinctly costate.

description: Vinelike shrub with long slender branches. Leaves mostly in fascicles of 2 or 3 (in part alternate, fide Little) from the slightly enlarged nodes, obovate to elliptic-obovate, obtusely acute to abruptly acuminate at apex, cuneate at base, 5-15 cm long, 2-8 cm wide, notably shiny, secondary and tertiary venation prominulous above and below, tertiary venation tending to parallel the secondary veins, drying olive-gray above, olive below, sparsely lepidote above and below, otherwise glabrous, petiole slender, 0.6-1.5 cm long. Inflorescence a single axillary flower, the pedicel 1-2 cm long. Flowers with the calyx bilabiately split to base, the lobes 2 cm long; corolla whitish, reticulate-veined, tubular-campanulate, 4 cm long, the lobes ca. 1 cm long. Fruit (only immature seen; larger measurements after Little) a pepo or calabash, oblong-ellipsoid, terete, acute at apex, distinctly angulate at base, 7-10 cm long, 3-3.5 cm in diam.; seeds thin, flat, ca. 5 by 5 mm.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches long, pendulous, lateral branchlets short, numerous, glabrate or cinereous-lepidote. Leaves not crowded along the branches; petioles 5-20 mm long; blades large, 9-16 x 4-8 cm, subcoriaceous, elliptic to ovate-lanceolate, acute to abruptly acuminate, oblique or cuneate at base, margin slightly revolute, entire or remotely toothed, glabrous above, silvery cinereous-lepidote below, 6-8 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary and terminal paniculate clusters of heads. Heads with six florets, clustered in groups of 6-12 on short, stout peduncles along and at the end of rachises, often subtended by bracteole leaves; involucres ovoid to cylindrical 5-7 x ca. 3 mm; phyllaries closely imbricate in 3-4 series, glabrous, straw-colored with purplish brown tips, margin minutely ciliate, outer ones ovate to elliptic, obtuse at apex, inner ones elliptic to oblong, acute at apex. Corollas cream-colored, glabrate, tube 3.5-4 mm long, the lobes 1.5-2 mm long; anthers ca. 3 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, 0.7-1 mm long. Pappus straw-colored, biseriate, the inner bristles filiform, 5-5.5 mm long, the outer ones irregular, filiform to linear, 0.5-1.5 mm long. Achenes ca. 3 mm long, distinctly 10-costate.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches widely spreading, pendulous, closely cinereous-lepidote-tomentulose. Leaves not crowded along the branches; petioles 10-20 mm long; blades large, 10-17 x 4-7 cm, coriaceous, elliptic to oblong, acute to shortly acuminate at apex, oblique at base, margin entire, glabrous above, cinereous-stellate-tomentose below, 5-8 pairs of lateral veins. Inflorescences axillary and terminal panicles. Heads with ca. four florets, clustered in groups of 5-10 on stout peduncles along and at the end of cinereous-tomentose rachises; involucres cylindrical to narrowly campanulate, 5-6 mm x ca. 3 mm; phyllaries imbricate in four series, yellowish brown, glabrate, margin ciliate, tips dark, subobtuse, outer ones ovate to elliptic, inner ones elliptic to linear. Corollas occasionally gland-dotted, tube ca. 3 mm long, lobes 1.5-2.5 mm long; anthers 3 mm long, basal auricles sharply caudate, 0.7-1 mm long. Pappus brown, distinctly biseriate, inner bristles filiform, 5-6 mm long, outer bristles linear to paleaceous 0.5-2 mm long. Achenes ca. 4 mm long, costate.

description: Scandent shrubs, branches long, pendulous, lateral branchlets shorter, numerous, densely cinereous brown-tomentose. Leaves not crowded along the branchlets; petioles 10-20 mm long; blades large, 12-22 x 5-10 cm, subcoriaceous, broadly elliptic, acute to acuminate at apex, oblique at the base, margin slightly revolute, glabrate above, cinereous brown-stellate-pubescent below, 8-10 pairs of lateral veins. Heads with six florets, on tomentose slender peduncles; involucres ovoid but heads immature on type collection; phyllaries yellowish brown (when dried), gray-brown tomentose at apex.

description: Herbs, 6-16 cm high. Rhizome-scales narrowly ovate, 1.7-2 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Stems white, mostly branched. Leaves ovate to broadly ovate, 0.8-2.1 mm long, 0.8-1.2 mm wide, apex acute. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, each cincinnus 0.5-9 cm long and 2-10-flowered, sometimes each cincinnus branched again. Bracts narrowly ovate to ovate, 0.6-1.5 mm long, 0.4-0.6 mm wide, apex acute. Pedicels 0.3-1.5(-2.8) mm long. Flowers pale yellow in bud, white at anthesis, 3.2-5 mm long. Floral tube 3.2-3.5 mm long. Outer tepals 3-lobed, 0.7-1.5 mm long; central lobe ovate-triangular; lateral lobes ovate-triangular to narrowly ovate-triangular. Inner tepals narrowly obovate (?), very small. Connective without appendages. Style, including branches and stigmas, 1.4-1.8 mm long, stigmas almost sessile, horseshoe-shaped, 0.2-0.3 mm diam., sinus ca. 0.1 mm deep, without appendages. Ovary obconical, 0.7-1.5 x 0.5-0.9 mm. Capsule broadly obovoid, to 2.8 x 2 mm, the persistent part of the floral tube including the capsule (1.7-)2.3-4.2 mm long, floral tube somewhat constricted above the capsule, style exceeding the floral tube by 0.3-0.7 mm. Seeds 0.2-0.3 x 0.1-0.2 mm.

description: Herbs, 15-35 cm high. Rhizome-scales narrowly ovate, 2.6-3.6 mm long, 0.70.9 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Stems white, mostly unbranched. Leaves ovate to broadly obovate, 1.8-3 mm long, 1.2-2.5 mm wide, margins involute, apex obtuse. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, each cincinnus at an angle of 90° or more with the other, 2-8 cm long and 6-9-flowered. Bracts ovate, (0.9-)1.3-2.2 mm long, 0.8-1.2 mm wide, the basal ones to 2.7 mm long and 1.4 mm wide, apex obtuse, often dark in herbarium material. Pedicels (1.2-)1.6-2.8 mm long. Internodes of infructescence 5-10 mm long. Flowers white to creamy, erect, 7.8-12 mm long. Floral tube 5.3-9 mm long, with six longitudinal, prominent ribs. Outer tepals 3-lobed, 2.1-3.8 mm long; central lobe depressed ovate-triangular, 1.2-1.8 mm long, 2-4 mm wide; lateral lobes narrowly ovate-triangular to ovate-triangular, 0.8-1.8 mm long, 0.4-0.5(-l) mm wide. Inner tepals ovate-triangular, often swollen, 0.5-1 mm long, 0.3-0.5 mm wide. Connective without appendages. Style, including branches and stigmas, 4.3-5 mm long, branches with stigmas 0.40.6 mm long, stigmas horseshoe-shaped, sinus 0.2-0.4 mm deep, appendages to 4.5 mm long. Ovary globose to transversely ellipsoid, 0.7-2.1 x 1.1-2.2 mm. Capsule broadly ellipsoid to globose, up to 2.5 x 3.5 mm, with six longitudinal ribs basally widened into wings; the persistent part of the floral tube horizontally abscising, somewhat constricted above the capsule, persistent part of the floral tube including the capsule 5-6.4 mm long, style exceeding the floral tube by ca. 0.6 mm, capsule walls withering with age. Seeds 0.5-0.7 x 0.4-0.6 mm.

description: Herbs, 5-8 cm high. Rhizome-scales narrowly ovate, 1-1.7 mm long, 0.4-0.5 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Stems white, branched or not. Leaves narrowly ovate to ovate, 1.2-2.1 mm long, 0.5-1.1 mm wide, apex acute to obtuse. Inflorescence capitate, 0.2-0.5 cm long, 2-5-flowered, consisting of two contracted cincinni, surrounded by short bracts. Bracts narrowly ovate to ovate, 1.8-3.5 mm long, 1.2-1.6 mm wide, apex acute. Pedicels absent or to 0.2(-0.6) mm long. Flowers white, 6.2-6.6 mm long. Floral tube 4.6-5 mm long. Outer tepals 3-lobed, 1.1-1.6 mm long, 1.5-1.6 mm wide; central lobe depressed ovate-triangular, ca. 0.3 mm long, 0.4-0.6 mm wide; lateral lobes broadly ovate-triangular, ca. 0.3 mm long and wide. Inner tepals narrowly ovate-triangular, swollen, ca. 0.2 mm long and 0.1 mm wide. Connective without appendages. Style, including branches and stigmas, 2.4-3 mm long, branches with stigmas ca. 0.6 mm long, stigmas horseshoe-shaped, sinus ca. 0.3 mm deep, without appendages. Ovary ellipsoid, 1.7-2.2 x 1.1-1.7 mm. Capsule broadly ovoid to globose, to 2.4 x 2 mm, including the persistent part of the floral tube 4.2-5 mm long, floral tube somewhat constricted above the capsule, the style exceeding the floral tube by 0.1-0.6 mm. Seeds 0.3 x 0.3 mm.

description: Herbs to 6(-15) cm high, somewhat greenish. Roots creeping horizontally, cylindric, 1-1.5 mm diam., to 10 cm long. Stems terete, 1-2 mm diam., covered by 5-7 leaves, uppermost ones congested directly below the flower (some even on the ovary itself). Leaves appressed to patent, navicular, ovate to narrowly ovate, 3-15 mm long, 2-3.5 mm wide, apex acute. Flower upright. Floral tube obovoid to slightly ureceolate, actinomorphic, 6-nerved, 8-20 mm long, largest diam. 8-12 mm; throat circular, 2-2.5 mm in diam. Shortest tepals inserted above the middle of the floral tube, reflexed, narrowly ovate, 9-13 mm long, 3-5 mm wide, dorsally keeled, apex acute to abruptly acuminate. Largest tepals inserted just below the annulus, ascending, spathulate; basal part 6-10 mm long; 1-3 mm wide with revolute margins; upper part suborbicular, imbricate, 6-7 mm long, 89 mm wide, irregularly dentate, ciliate, and connate with each other; midrib prolonged into a 70-110 mm long, pendent, linear-triangular appendage 0.5-1.5 mm diam., ending in a ca. 10 mm long, subclavate, glandular tip. Annulus a ring of 12 erect, very broadly ovate, hairy lobes, each ca. 1 x 1 mm. Filaments free, inserted just below the throat, ca. 1 mm long and wide. Connectives not dilated; anthers elliptic to circular, 1-1.5 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide, top slightly turned upwards, laterally connivent into a ring. Thecae close to each other, each one narrowly elliptic, ca. 1.5 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide. Interstaminal lobes absent. Style cylindric, ca. 1.5 mm long, stigma 3-winged deltoid, 2-4.5 mm long, 2-4 mm wide, wings ciliate with glandular spots at their base. Ovary obovoid to very broadly obovoid, 4-8 x 4-5 mm. Placentas parietal from the base to the top of the ovary; funicles short. Fruit unknown.

description: Herbs, almost colorless, to 2.5 cm high. Tuber ovoid to narrowly ovoid, 2-8 mm long, 1.5-3 mm diam., bearing 10-40 roots to 45 mm long, often ending in a secondary tuber. Stem(s) one (or seldom two), leafless, except for a rosette of bract-like leaves just below the flower. Bract-like leaves 2-4, appressed, navicular, narrowly ovate, 1.5-6 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide, apex acute to obtuse. Flower nodding to almost upright. Floral tube pale yellow, irregularly tubular to slightly urceolate, zygomorphic, 6-11 mm long, largest diam. 4-8 mm; throat circular, 2.5-3.5 mm diam. Shortest tepals inserted at the top of the floral tube, reflexed, ovate-triangular, 2-4.5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, apex obtuse. Longest tepals inserted at the same level as the shortest ones, reflexed, narrowly triangular, 4-5.5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, apex acute. Annulus ca. 0.5 mm wide (extending from the insertion of the tepals to the throat), forming a ring of three erect, transversely narrowly oblong lobes around the throat; each lobe placed opposite a longer tepal and 0.5-0.8 mm high and 2-3 mm wide; lobes decorated by two ca. 0.1 mm high ridges running parallel to the throat. Filaments inserted ca. 0.5 mm below the throat, ca. 1 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide. Connectives dilated, ca. 1 mm long including lobes, ca. 0.5 mm wide, apex 2-lobed with triangular, ca. 0.3 mm long, acute lobes, base sagittate with linear, ca. 0.5 mm long lobes. Thecae attached to the top of the filament, broadly ovate, 0.5-1 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm wide taken together. Interstaminal lobes present, inserted at the same level as the filaments, triangular, ca. 0.3 mm long, apex acute. Style cylindric, 0.5-1.5 mm long, stigmas erect to patent, narrowly ovoid, 0.5-2 mm long, covered up to the middle with ca. 0.1 mm long papillae, apically with 0.3-0.5 mm long hairs. Ovary depressed to very broadly obovoid, 0.5-2 x 1-2 mm. Placentas unknown. Fruit cup-shaped, 1.5-4 mm high with a 0.5-1 mm high rim, 2-7 mm diam. Seeds 0.4-0.5 x 0.2 mm.

description: Herbs, 3-10.5 cm high. Tuber ovoid, 2.5-10 mm long, 1-5 mm diam., bearing up to 40 roots to 100 mm long, sometimes ending in a secondary tuber. Stem(s) one (sometimes two or three), leafless except for a rosette of bract-like leaves just below the flower, 0.5-2 mm diam. Leaves two to four, hyaline, appressed, navicular, ovate, 2-3 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, apex acute, upper ones just below the flower, lowest one ca. 4 mm below the ovary. Flowers wine red (Glaziou) to yellow (Brade), nodding to almost upright. Floral tube campanulate, actinomorphic, 6-12 mm long, largest diam. 6-15 mm; throat circular, 1-1.5 mm diam.; base of flower at the outside with 12 swellings of ca. 1 mm diam., corresponding with 12 concave conical holes at the inside of the tube. Shortest tepals inserted at the broadest part of the flower, much thinner than the tube, at first erect and deltate, later very shallowly triangular when the floral tube stretches to campanulate, 0.5-2 mm long, 2-5 mm wide, apex acute. Longest tepals narrowly to linear triangular, inserted at the same level as the shortest ones, patent, 5-11 mm long, 0.1-0.2 mm wide, top linear-triangular, base triangular, spirally coiled in bud. Annulus 2-5 mm wide (extending from the insertion of the tepals to the throat), ornamented by three rings of erect, transversely narrowly oblong lobes; outermost ring a circular rim, ca. 0.2 mm high, middle one composed of six lobes, each ca. 0.2 mm high, 1-2 mm wide, innermost one composed of six V-shaped lobes, each one two times ca. 0.2 x 1.5 mm; inside of the V-shaped lobes papillate. Filaments inserted ca. 0.5 mm below the throat, ca. 1 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide. Connectives dilated, 1.5-2 mm long including lobes, 1-1.5 mm wide, 2-lobed at the apex with triangular, 1-1.5 mm long lobes, sagittate at the base with linear, ca. 1 mm long lobes; apical lobes converging to form a kind of trap (Poulsen). Thecae attached to the upper part of the connective, broadly to very broadly ovate, 0.4-0.6 x 0.5-0.6 mm taken together. Interstaminal lobes present, inserted at the same level as the filaments, linear, about as long as the filaments (Brade), but absent according to Poulsen. Style cylindric, 0.5-1.5 mm long, stigma capitate to very shortly 3-lobed, 0.5-1 mm long, upper side covered with pluricellular hairs, lower side papillate. Ovary broadly obovoid, 1-2 x 1-1.5 mm. Placentas inserted parietally at the base of the ovary. Fruit fleshy, cup-shaped, 1.5-4 mm high including a 0.5-2 mm high rim, 3-5 mm diam.

description: Herbs, 2-10 cm high. Tuber ovoid, 4.5-8 mm long, 2-4 mm diam., bearing up to 25 roots to 20 mm long, sometimes ending in a secondary tuber. Stem(s) one (to seldom four), leafless except for the rosette of bract-like leaves just below the flower, 1-2 mm diam. Leaves four (or less often three or two), appressed or patent, slightly navicular, ovate to narrowly ovate, 1.5-4 mm long and 1-1.5 mm wide, apex obtuse, sessile or sometimes petiolate with petiole to 0.5 mm long. Flower (almost) upright. Floral tube tubular to slightly urceolate, slightly zygomorphic to actinomorphic, 7-12 mm long, largest diam. 4-9 mm; throat circular, 1.5-3.5 mm diam.; base of flower with ca. 12 slightly visible swellings. Shortest tepals inserted at top of the floral tube, reflexed, triangular, imbricate, 2.5-5 mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm wide, apex obtuse. Longest tepals inserted at the same level as the shortest ones, almost erect, linear-triangular, 6-12 mm long, 0.3-1 mm wide, spirally included in bud. Annulus ca. 0.5 mm wide (extending from the insertion of the tepals to the throat), ornamented by three rows of erect, transversely narrowly oblong lobes: innermost row consisting of three lobes alternating with the shortest tepals, each lobe ca. 0.2 mm high and 1-2 mm wide; middle row consisting of three lobes placed as the innermost row, 0.2-1.2 mm high and 1-2.5 mm wide; outermost row consisting of six lobes, two of them placed before one lobe of the middle row, each ca. 0.2 mm high and ca. 0.5 mm wide. Filaments inserted ca. 0.5 mm below the throat, 0.5-1.5 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide. Connectives dilated, 1-2 mm long including lobes, ca. 1.5 mm wide, 2-lobed at the apex with triangular, 0.8-1 mm long, obtuse lobes, sagittate at the base with linear, 0.6-0.8 mm long lobes. Thecae attached to the upper part of the connective, broadly ovate, 0.70.9 mm long and 0.6-0.7 mm wide taken together. Interstaminal lobes present, inserted ca. 0.5 mm below the filaments, triangular, 0.7-1 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide, apex obtuse. Style cylindric, 1.5-3.5 mm long, stigmas erect, narrowly ovoid, 0.5-1.5 mm long, densely covered by ca. 0.1 mm long papillae, their apical part tufted by ca. 2 mm long hairs. Ovary broadly to depressed obovoid, 1-2 x 1.5-2 mm. Fruit cup-shaped, 2-3.5 mm high including a 0.5-1 mm high rim, 2.5-5 mm diam. Seeds to ca. 0.4 mm long.

description: Herbs, 5-12 cm high, hyaline. Tuber yellowish, inside darkened by mycorrhiza, broadly ovoid, 4-11 mm long, 3-6 mm diam., bearing 11-30 roots to 30 mm long, often ending in a secondary tuber. Stem(s) one (or seldom two to four), whitish (with some yellow, pink or brown), leafless except for a rosette of bractlike leaves just below the flower, 1-2 mm diam. Leaves four (seldom three), pale yellow, appressed, more or less navicular, ovate, imbricate, 3-5 mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm wide, apex obtuse to rounded. Flower upright. Floral tube ochre to pale yellow, turning to bright lilac (especially at the inside), urceolate, zygomorphic, 8-12 mm long, largest diam. 6.5—8.5 mm; base of floral tube bearing on its outside ca. 12 oblong swellings of ca. 2 x 0.5 mm; gibbous part of tube with 2-3 longitudinal slits; throat circular to slightly triangular, 3-3.5 mm diam.; inside of tube pilose, hairs ca. 0.5 mm long. Shortest tepals yellow, inserted at the top of the floral tube, patent, ovate to broadly ovate, imbricate, 2-3.5 mm long, 1.5-3.5 mm wide, apex obtuse to rounded. Largest tepals brown, inserted at the same level as the shortest ones, erect, linear-triangular, 5-7 mm long, 0.2-2 mm wide, ending in a swollen top of 0.7-1 x 0.5 mm; in bud curved into the throat, bending outwards one by one. Annulus yellow, 0.5 mm wide (extending from the insertion of the tepals to the throat), ornamented by three rows of three erect, transversely narrowly oblong lobes, alternating with the shortest tepals, each lobe 0.1-0.2 mm high, 2-3 mm wide. Filaments inserted 1 mm below the throat and attached by their lateral margins to the tube for half their length, 1-1.5 mm long and wide. Connectives dilated, 1.7-2 mm long including lobes, 1.5-1.7 mm wide, 2-lobed at the apex with triangular, rounded lobes of 0.3-0.8 mm long, sagittate at the base with linear, 0.8-1 mm long lobes. Thecae attached to the middle of the connective, broadly ovate, 0.8-1 mm long and wide taken together. Interstaminal lobes present, inserted 0.5 mm below the filaments, linear, ca. 1 mm long. Style cylindric, 1.5-2 mm long, stigmas erect, depressed ovoid, 0.5-1 mm long, densely covered by ca. 0.2 mm long papillae, their apical part tufted by ca. 0.6 mm long, pluricellular hairs. Ovary yellow, depressed to very broadly obovoid, 1-2.5 x 1.5-3.5 mm. Placentas inserted halfway up the ovary wall. Fruit cup-shaped, ca. 4 mm high including a ca. 1 mm high rim, 4-5 mm diam. Seeds ca. 0.4 x ca. 0.2 mm.

description: Herbs, 10-32 cm high. Stems mostly unbranched, upper part purple. Upper leaves purple, triangular-ovate, 1. 1-3(-3.4) mm long, 0.5-1.5(-1 .8) mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, cincinni 2-4-flowered and 5-7.5 mm long, flowers 1.8-4 mm apart, or the plant having a solitary terminal flower only. Bracts narrowly ovate-elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 1.3-3.8 mm long, 0.6-2.2 mm wide, apex mostly obtuse, rarely acute. Flowers sessile, tubular, purple, 6-9 mm long. Outer tepals depressed angular-ovate to depressed ovate, rarely very broadly angular-ovate, 0.3-0.8(-1) mm long, 0.7-1.2(-1.4) mm wide, margins involute, inner side papillate. Inner tepals depressed ovate, 0.1-0.4 mm long, 0.20.8 mm wide, papillate. Floral tube 2.3-5 mm long, 0.8-1.5(-l.8) mm diam. Wings undulate, running from the top of the floral tube down to the middle or base of the ovary, continuing over the outer tepals as a crest, broadly semiobcordate, 3.7-7.8 mm long, 1.8-3.5(-4.5) mm wide. Connective bearing apically two, and basally one appendage. Style 3.8-4.3(-6) mm long, branches 0.5-1 mm long. Ovary obconical to broadly obovoid, rarely globose, 1.8-2.6 x 1-2 mm. Capsule broadly obovoid to globose, (1.7-)2.1-4.3 x 1.1-2.4 mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.2-0.3(-0.4) x 0.1 mm.

description: Herbs, (5-)9-22 cm high, sometimes forming tufts. Stems mostly unbranched, woody at the base. Leaves green, narrowly ovate to narrowly triangular, 0.3-4.5 cm long, 0.1-0.5 cm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Inflorescence terminal, capitate, well exceeding the leaves, 0.8-2 cm long, 0.8-2.5 cm wide, consisting of two contracted, many-flowered cincinni. Bracts narrowly ovate to ovate, 1.5-4 (-4.6) mm long, 0.5-2 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Pedicels 0.4-4.5 mm long. Flowers tubular, yellowish to greenish-white, 4.5-6 mm long. Outer tepals ovate to broadly ovate, 0.8-1.3 mm long, 0.2-1.2 mm wide, margins involute. Inner tepals ovate, 0.3-0.6 mm long, 0.2-0.4 mm wide. Floral tube 2.2-3.5 mm long. Wings reduced to ribs, linear, 3.5-4.2 mm long, 0-0.3 mm wide. Connective bearing apically two appendages. Style 1.7-2.5 mm long, branches 0.2-0.4 mm long, funnel-shaped, upper lip of stigma 0.2-0.4 mm diam. Ovary obovoid to angular-ovoid, 1.5-2.1(-4) mm long. Capsule obovoid to angular-ovoid, 1.6-2.1 x 0.9-1.3 mm; dehiscing by transverse slits. Seeds 0.3-0.4 x 0.1-0.2 mm.

description: Herbs, 8.5-23 cm high. Roots ending in fusiform tubers. Stems mostly unbranched. Leaves often purplish, narrowly ovate to ovate, sometimes elliptic, 23.6 mm long, 0.8-1.4 mm wide, apex acute (to acuminate). Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, cincinni 2-4-flowered and 10—26 mm long, flowers 3-12 mm apart, or the plant having a solitary, terminal flower only. Bracts narrowly ovate-elliptic, 2.2-4.2 mm long, 0.7-1.4 mm wide, apex acute. Flowers sessile, salverform, purple to white, 11-23 mm long. Outer tepals radiate, ovate to elliptic, (3.5-)4-6.8 mm long, (1.6-)2.3-3.2 mm wide, inner side papillate, almost always 5-7-veined. Inner tepals narrowly ovate to narrowly elliptic, (0.6-)0.9-1.4 mm long, 0.1-0.5 mm wide, curved over the stamens. Floral tube (3.6-)4.5-6 mm long, 1.1-1.7(-2.1) mm diam., wingless. Connective bearing apically two, and basally one appendage. Style (2.6-)5-6.5 mm long, branches 0.9-1.0 mm long, upper lip of stigma divided into two parts. Ovary narrowly ellipsoid to narrowly obovoid, 4.1-9 x 1.1-2(-2.6) mm. Capsule narrowly ellipsoid to narrowly obovoid, 4.1-9 x 1.1-2.6 mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.3 x 0.1 mm.

description: Herbs, 4-25 cm high. Stems mostly unbranched. Leaves narrowly triangular-ovate, (1.7-)2.4-7.5 mm long, 0.7-2 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate, basal ones not obviously rosulate. Inflorescence more or less head-like, consisting of two contracted cincinni, cincinni 1-4-flowered, flowers to 1.3 mm apart. Bracts ovate-elliptic, 1.5-4.4 mm long, 0.8-2.8 mm wide, apex obtuse to bluntly acuminate, sometimes (the upper ones) acute. Flowers sessile, tubular, white to yellow sometimes with purple, 5-9 mm long. Outer tepals broadly angular-ovate, 1-1.5 mm long, (0.8-)1-1.3 mm wide, margins involute. Inner tepals triangular to elliptic, 0.6-1(-1.3) mm long, 0.3-0.5(-0.7) mm wide, margins sometimes involute. Floral tube 1.7-3.9 mm long, 0.8-1.6 mm in diam. Wings running from the top of the floral tube down to the middle or the base of the ovary, broadly semiobcordate (to semicircular), 2.5-6 mm long, 0.9-2.9 mm wide. Stamens yellow, connective bearing apically two, and basally one appendage. Style 2-3.6 mm long, branches 0.5-0.8 mm long, each branch with a yellow stigma, upper lip divided into two parts. Ovary obconical to ellipsoid, 1.9-4.4 x 0.9-2.5 mm. Capsule obconical to ellipsoid, (2-)2.5-4.5 x 1.4-2.6 mm, dehiscent by transverse slits. Seeds 0.3-0.4 x 0.1 mm.

description: Tree 15-20(-30) m high. Leaves opposite or subopposite, to 45 cm long. Petiole bearing a single elliptical gland on the upper side more than half way from base to first pair of pinnae. Pinnae (7-)10-15 pairs, opposite or subopposite. Leaflets 40-48 pairs per pinna, oblong, 9-11(-15) x 2.2-3.5 mm, apex rounded or acute, base auriculate, main nerve straight at apex. Compound inflorescence axis descending, projecting beyond foliage, unbranched or branched, to ca. 1 m or more long. Peduncles in 3-4 pairs, opposite or subopposite, pendent, (13.5-)20-35(-45) cm long. Capitula ca. 8-12 cm long, biglobose, the basal staminodial fringe ca. 7.5 or more cm diameter, the apical part ellipsoid, ca. 3.3-3.7 cm diam. Hermaphrodite flowers: calyx 9.5-10.5 mm long (including pseudopedicel of 1-1.5 mm); the lobes 1-2 mm long; corolla 10.5-11 mm long, the lobes 1.5-3 mm long; filaments exserted ca. 1 mm beyond calyx, free for more than half their length. Nectar-secreting flowers: calyx ca. 12-13.5 mm long. Staminodial flowers: calyx 14.5-15 mm long; corolla 17.5-19 mm long, the lobes 2.5-3.5 mm long; filaments exserted to ca. 30 mm beyond calyx. Pods strap-shaped, ca. 27-41 (including stipe of 4.5-13.5) x 3.7-5.3 cm, the sutures somewhat thickened, and the coriaceous, indehiscent, glabrous valves shallowly corrugated. Seeds to 22 per pod.

description: Tree to 18-35 m high. Leaves alternate, to 30 cm long. Petiole bearing a single elliptical gland on upper side between base and first pair of pinnae. Pinnae 6-15 pairs, opposite or subopposite. Leaflets 28-41 pairs, opposite, sigmoidally curved, 7-13 x 1.5-3 mm, apex acute or obtuse, base often strongly auriculate; main nerve sigmoid, curving towards distal margin at apex. Compound inflorescence axis horizontal to ascending, projecting beyond foliage, unbranched, ca. 0.5-1 m long. Peduncles to ca. ten per inflorescence, alternate, pendent, 5-26 cm long. Capitula 4.5-7 cm long, biglobose with basal staminodial fringe 4-6 cm diam. and apical part spherical or ellipsoid, 2.5-3.5 cm diam. Hermaphrodite flowers: calyx 7-9 mm long (including pseudopedicel of 0.5-1.5 mm), the lobes to ca. 1 mm long; corolla 8-11 mm long, the lobes 0.5-1 mm long; filaments exserted ca. 2-3 mm beyond calyx, free ± to base. Nectar-secreting flowers: calyx 6.5-9.5 mm long. Staminodial flowers: calyx to 8-11 mm long; corolla 9-14 mm long, the lobes 1-2 mm long; filaments exserted to 32 mm beyond calyx, irregularly united to neck of corolla. Pods strap-shaped, sometimes curved, 8.5—35 (including stipe of 0.5-7 cm) x 3.2-5.5 cm, the sutures somewhat thickened, and the coriaceous, indehiscent, sometimes velutinous valves shallowly corrugated; the cavity when fresh containing amber-colored sticky or crystalline gum. Seeds to 23 per pod, 13-18.5 x 6-12 x 5-8.5 mm, testa black. Field characters. Varying from a small to medium sized tree with a narrow bole and smallish crown to a large tree with a bole more than 1 m diameter, especially in the western part of its range. Bark sometimes reddish. Buds golden-brown. Capitula at anthesis have a bright red staminodial fringe, and the fertile and nectar-secreting flowers appear bright yellow from their anthers, the corolla itself being pale pink and the filaments cream. The pods are brown to reddish-brown, when immature often densely velutinous, when mature less so.
