description: Young branches minutely strigulose (trichomes ± basifixed) becoming glabrous, pale brown or greyish-white, smooth or rough. Bud scales absent. Leaves imparipinnate or pinnate with one leaflet of ultimate pair orientated to simulate a terminal leaflet, (5-)8-25(-40) cm long; petiole semiterete, rhachis terete or slightly canaliculate, minutely appressed puberulous to glabrous; petiolule 2-5 mm long. Leaflets usually alternate less frequently subopposite, (4-)5-9(-11), usually oblanceolate less frequently oblong or elliptic, apex usually acuminate, or attenuate or obtusely cuspidate, base attenuate or cuneate, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, 9-23(-26)[15.1] cm long, 3-7(-8.5)[5.3] cm wide, lowest pair usually much smaller, glabrous or rarely puberulous on upper or lower midrib, rarely glandular-punctate or -striate; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly prominent above or flat; secondaries 12-16(-22) on either side of midrib, usually steeply ascending, arcuate, slightly convergent to parallel; intersecondaries rather short; tertiaries obscure. Flowers unisexual, plants dioecious; inflorescence axillary, erect, 5-20(-40) cm long, minutely appressed strigulose, 8 inflorescence a slender to broadly pyramidal thyrse, finely-branched with many flowers, the 2 shorter and stouter, little-branched and few-flowered; pedicel 1-1.5 mm long. 8 flowers usually shorter and narrower than 2 . Calyx: 8 patelliform, 2 shallowly cyathiform, 0.5-1 mm long, with a truncate or obscurely lobed margin, sparsely puberulous or strigulose, sometimes ciliate. Petals 3-4(-5), fused their length, valvate, remaining erect, 3.5-5(-6.5) mm long, 0.75-1(-1.5) mm broad, lanceolate, apex acute, hooded, appressed or crisped puberulous or strigulose on outside, glabrous inside. Staminal tube cylindrical often slightly constricted at throat; filaments completely fused, 8 2.5-4.5 mm long, 0.75-1.25(-2) mm broad, 2 ca. 5 mm long, ca. 2 mm broad, margin with 5-7(-8) lanceolate or subulate lobes alternating with anthers, glabrous or sparsely crisped hirsute in throat; anthers 5-7(-8), 0.8-1 mm long, glabrous; antherodes 7-8, ca. 1 mm long, shrunken, not dehiscent, without pollen. Nectary absent. Ovary ovoid, 3-locular, loculi with 2 collateral ovules, densely appressed puberulous; style stout bearing a small capitate style-head equalling base of anthers; pistillode slender ovoid containing smaller non-functional ovules, with style-head below level of anthers. Capsule ovoid, ellipsoid or obovoid, apex rounded, base tapered, smooth, appressed puberulous mixed with granular papillae very rarely subglabrous, 2.3-3.5 cm long, 1-2 cm broad, 3-valved; pericarp 1.5-2 mm thick; endocarp thin, cartilaginous. Seeds 2, collateral in each fruit, to 2.5 cm long, 1.5 cm broad, rounded at apex, tapering from near apex to acute base, bearing a fleshy apical and adaxial arillode which is produced upwards to a point; arillode also developing on aborted ovules, free except for thin line of attachment from micropyle to top half of raphe; seed coat thin, membraneous. Embryo with plano-convex, collateral cotyledons; radicle apical, included. Endosperm absent.

description: Young branches appressed puberulous with most trichomes basifixed or sometimes intermixed with a few dibrachiate hairs, soon glabrous, greyish-white to dark brown, sometimes with a few lenticels. Bud scales absent. Leaves imparipinnate or pinnate with one leaflet of ultimate pair orientated to simulate a terminal leaflet, (4-)8-20 cm long; petiole and rhachis semiterete, glabrous; petiolule (1.5-)2-5 mm long. Leaflets usually alternate less frequently opposite, (3-)5-7, elliptic, oblong or oblanceolate, apex narrowly acuminate, base narrowly attenuate or cuneate, sometimes long decurrent into petiolule, base of lower leaflets not or only slightly asymmetric, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, 8-26[12.9] cm long, 2.7-7.7[4.1] cm broad, lower pairs smaller but similar in structure to other leaflets, glabrous, not glandular-punctate or -striate; venation eucamptodromous or brochidodromous, midrib sharply prominent; secondaries 9-20 on either side of midrib, ascending, usually ± arcuate, parallel or convergent; intersecondaries usually short; tertiary reticulum usually obscure, occasionally moderately prominent. Inflorescence axillary or several on a very short axillary shoot, 1.5-4(-11) cm long, a few-flowered panicle or thyrse, sparsely puberulous or subglabrous; pedicel 0.75-2 mm long. Calyx patelliform to shortly cyathiform, 0.5-1.5 mm long, with (3-)4-5 irregular, broadly ovate or triangular, acute or obtuse lobes, to 1/2 length of calyx, usually with a few minute appressed hairs on outer surface. Petals (3-)4-5(-6), free or fused to 1/3 their length, valvate, reflexing, (2-)2.5-3 mm long, 0.75-1.25 mm broad, lanceolate, apex acute sometimes hooded, outer surface with a few minute appressed hairs or glabrous, inside glabrous. Staminal tube cyathiform or urceolate; filaments completely fused, 1-2 mm long, 1-1.75 mm broad, margin with (4-)6-7(-9) acute appendages alternating with anthers and 1/3-2/3 their length, outside usually glabrous less frequently with a few crisped hairs at apex and crisped pubescent in throat; anthers (4-)6-7(-9), 0.6-1 mm long, glabrous. Nectary absent. Ovary ovoid, 3-locular, loculi with 2 collateral ovules, puberulous or strigulose; style short, stout, glabrous; style-head small discoid to capitate, sometimes minutely lobed, equalling anthers. Capsule narrowly oblong, apex and base rounded, smooth to strongly verruculose, densely papillose intermixed with dense puberulous hairs, 2-2.5 cm long, 0.6-1.5 cm broad, 3-valved; pericarp ca. 1 mm thick; endocarp thinly cartilaginous. Seed solitary, 1.6-2.2 cm long, tapering from near apex to base, completely surrounded by a 3-partite fleshy arillode; arillode free except for attachment at apex and along raphe; seed coat membraneous. Embryo with plano-convex, collateral cotyledons; radicle apical, included. Endosperm absent.

description: Young branches sparsely and minutely strigulose (trichomes basifixed) soon glabrous, greyish-white, with a few lenticels. Bud scales absent. Leaves imparipinnate or pinnate with one leaflet of the ultimate pair orientated to simulate a terminal leaflet, 13-22 cm long; petiole and rhachis semiterete, glabrous; petiolule 3-5 mm. Leaflets usually alternate rarely opposite, 5-6, with a pair of minute caducous vestigial scales 0.5-1 mm long about 1-1.5 cm above base of petiole, elliptic or oblanceolate, apex acuminate, base acute to narrowly cuneate, subcoriaceous, 11-17[14.5] cm long, 3.6-6[5.2] cm broad, glabrous, glandular-punctate and -striate; venation eucamptodromous to brochidodromous, midrib prominent; secondaries 13-14 on either side of midrib, arcuate ascending, slightly convergent; intersecondaries small; tertiaries obscure, widely spaced. Inflorescence axillary or several on a short axillary shoot, 12-20 cm long, a slender thyrse bearing small clusters of flowers on short lateral branches, glabrous; pedicel ca. 0.5 mm long. Calyx shallowly cyathiform, 1-1.5 mm long, with 4 rounded or obtuse lobes, ca. 1/3-1/2 length of calyx, glabrous. Petals (3-)4, free, imbricate, spreading, 3.5-4 mm long, 1.5-2 mm broad, oblong to lanceolate, apex rounded with a few minute appressed hairs on outer surface at tip. Staminal tube urceolate or short cylindrical; filaments united, 2-2.5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm broad, margin with 7-8 short acute lobes alternating with anthers and 1/4-1/2 their length, glabrous outside, sparse long hairs in upper 1/2 inside; anthers 7-8, ca. 0.8 mm long, glabrous. Nectary patelliform, fused to base of staminal tube, glabrous. Ovary small ovoid, 3-locular, loculi with 2 collateral ovules, puberulous or glabrous; style long, slender, glabrous; style-head narrowly conical. Capsule oblong to obovoid, apex rounded, smooth, appressed puberulous, 1.2-2 cm long, 0.6-1 cm broad, 3-valved; pericarp ca. 0.5 mm thick, endocarp thin-cartilaginous. Seed solitary, ca. 1.5 cm long, 0.7-0.8 cm broad, completely surrounded by a fleshy 3-partite arillode; arillode free except at apex and along raphe; seed coat rather thick. Embryo with plano-convex, collateral cotyledons; radicle apical, included. Endosperm absent.

description: Young branches strigulose-puberulous with a mixture of short erect basifixed and appressed dibrachiate hairs soon glabrous, greyish-white, usually without lenticels. Bud scales absent. Leaves imparipinnate or pinnate with one leaflet of the ultimate pair orientated to simulate a terminal leaflet, 6-8.5 cm long, petiole broadly semiterete, rhachis terete, minutely puberulous with erect hairs or glabrous; petiolule 1-2 mm long. Leaflets alternate or opposite, sometimes ± dimorphic, 5-10, oblong, elliptic or lanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate, base narrowly cuneate or attenuate, base of lower leaflets strongly asymmetric, chartaceous, 4.7-6.8[6.1] cm long, 1.2-2.2[1.7] cm broad, lower pairs usually much smaller, strongly asymmetric, often with a rounded apex, usually glabrous or with a few minute erect hairs on midrib, not glandular-punctate or -striate; venation eucamptodromous-brochidodromous, midrib flat; secondaries 14-15 on either side of midrib, ascending, usually straight and ± parallel; intersecondaries long; tertiary reticulum moderately prominent below. Inflorescence axillary or several clustered on a short axillary shoot, 1-4 cm long, a small slender subglabrous thyrse; pedicel 0.5-2.5 mm long. Calyx patelliform to cyathiform, 0.5-1 mm long, with 4-5 broadly triangular to ovate, acute or obtuse lobes ca. 1/2 length of calyx, subglabrous. Petals 4-5, free or fused to 1/3 their length, valvate, reflexing, 2-2.5 mm long, 0.75-1 mm broad, lanceolate, apex acute, subglabrous. Staminal tube urceolate to broadly cyathiform; filaments completely fused, 11.25 mm long, 0.75-1.5 mm broad, margin with 7-9 short acute lobes alternating with anthers and ca. 1/3 their length, outside glabrous, barbate to subglabrous in throat; anthers 7-9, ca. 0.8 mm long, glabrous. Nectary absent. Ovary broadly ovoid to conical, 3-locular, loculi with 2 collateral ovules, densely short puberulous; style short, stout, glabrous; style-head ± capitate, equalling anthers. Capsule oblong, apex and base rounded, smooth, appressed puberulous, ca. 1 cm long, ca. 0.5 cm broad, 3-valved; pericarp ca. 0.2 mm thick. Seed solitary, completely surrounded by a free fleshy arillode which also develops around aborted ovules; seed coat thin, soft. Embryo with flat (?immature) collateral cotyledons; radicle apical, included. Endosperm absent. FIELD CHARACTERS: Small treelet to 5 m high.

description: Young branches minutely puberulous (trichomes basifixed) soon glabrous, pale brown, lenticellate. Bud scales absent. Leaves imparipinnate or pinnate with one leaflet of ultimate pair orientated to simulate a terminal leaflet, 15-20 cm long, petiole narrowly winged at base, rhachis semiterete, minutely puberulous; petiolule 1-1.5 mm long. Leaflets opposite to alternate, ± dimorphic, 9-10, with 1 pair of greatly reduced caducous leaflets ("pseudostipules") near base of petiole, narrowly oblanceolate, elliptic or oblong, apex acute to shortly attenuate or acuminate, base acute to rounded or truncate, coriaceous, margin re volute, 13-15[14] cm long, 3.5-5[4.3] cm broad, glabrous or sometimes upper midrib puberulous, not glandular-punctate or -striate; basal reduced leaflets ovate, ca. 1.4 cm long, ± sessile; venation eucamptodromous, midrib sunken; secondaries 15-16 on either side of midrib, ascending, straight or slightly arcuate, parallel; intersecondaries and tertiaries obscure. Inflorescence axillary, to 26 cm long, a slender laxly-branched panicle with lateral branches to 6 cm long, branches rather densely-flowered, puberulous; pedicel 0.5-1 mm long. Calyx cyathiform, ca. 2 mm long, with 5 shallow, obtuse to rounded lobes ca. 1/4 length of calyx, puberulous. Petals 5, fused 1/2-2/3 their length, valvate, erect, 5-6 mm long, 1-1.5 mm broad, lanceolate, apex acute, usually hooded, densely appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Staminal tube cylindrical; filaments completely fused, ca. 4 mm long, ca. 1.5 mm broad, margin with 9-10 subulate appendages alternating with and ± equalling anthers, outside sparsely hairy especially in upper half, inside sparsely hairy to barbate in throat; anthers 9-10, 1.4-1.5 mm long, glabrous. Nectary absent. Ovary conical, 3-locular, loculi with 2 collateral ovules, densely strigose; style glabrous; style-head capitate, below anthers. Capsule narrowly ovoid, apex ± acute, smooth, appressed puberulous, ca. 2 cm long, 1 cm broad, 3-valved; pericarp ca. 1 mm thick; endocarp thin, cartilaginous. Seed solitary ca. 1 cm long, broadest above middle and tapering to base; arillode strongly developed at apex and along adaxial face of seed, free except for line of attachment from micropyle and along raphe; seed coat thin. Embryo with planoconvex, collateral cotyledons; radicle apical, included. Endosperm absent.

description: Rami novelli parce rigido-pubescentes, mox glabri, tandem laeves, nitide brunnei. Perulae nullae. Folia imparipinnata vel pinnata 10-13 cm longa, uno foliolo paris ultimi ad instar folioli terminalis ordinato; petiolus cum rhachide semiteres, glaber; petiolulus 5-6 mm. Foliola subopposita usque alterna, 5, late elliptica usque oblonga, apice abrupte in longum acumen abeuntia, basi asymmetrica, attenuata usque ± truncata, chartacea, 12-13 cm longa, ca. 5 cm lata (foliola terminali paullo majore), ad costam superiorem puberula, cetera glabra, nec glan-duloso-punctata nec -striata; venatio eucamptodroma usque brochidodroma, costa plana; nervi secundarii 8-9 utroque costae latere, arcuato-adscendentes, ± paralleli; nervi intersecundarii et tertiarii obscuri. Inflorescentia axillaris glabra 15-30 cm longa, in paniculam laxe ramosam, paucifloram disposita, ramis late ralibus ad 11 cm longis, recto angulo ab axi patentibus; pedicellus ca. 1.5 mm. Calyx patelliformis, 0.5-1 mm longus, vadosissime 5-lobatus, sparse ciliatus. Petala 5 (interdum 4 uno ad dimidium fisso), libera, paullum imbricata, valde reflexa, ca. 5.5 mm longa, 1.5 mm lata, lanceolata, apice acuta, glabra. Tubus stamineus longe urceolatus, ca. 4 mm longus, ca. 2.5 mm latus, filamentis per 1/2-3/4 longi-tudinem coalitis, apice truncatus, extus glaber, intus pubescens vel glaber; antherae 9-10, ca. 1 mm longae, glabrae. Nectarium lati gynophori instar, minute adpresso-puberulum. Ovarium parvum ovoideum, minute adpresso-puberulum 3-loculare, loculis 2 ovulis collateralibus; stylus a basi ad apicem usque attenuatus, minute puberulus; styli capitulum capitatum, antheris multo brevius. Fructus ignotus.

description: Rami novelli crispo-tomentosi usque villosi, indumento persistente. Perulae nullae. Folia imparipinnata, 15-35 cm longa; petiolus semiteres; rhachis vulgo paullum canaliculata, utraque dense crispo-tomentosa vel pubescens; petiolulus 1-3 mm longus. Foliola vulgo opposita vel subopposita, raro ± alterna, dimorpha, 7-11 cum 2 paribus foliolorum valde deminutorum ("pseudostipularum') ad basin petioli, haec ante folia normalia evoluta; foliola vulgo oblonga, vel oblongo-lan-ceolata, apice acuminata usque breviter attenuata, basi acuta, rotundata, truncata vel minute cordata, chartacea usque subcoriacea, 14-25[18.8] cm longa, 4-7.5[6.2] cm lata, costa paginae Superioris tomentosa inferioris pubescente, lamina brevibus pilis conspersa, glanduloso-punctata et -striata; venatio eucamptodroma, costa plana vel prominula; nervi secundarii (17-)20-29 utroque costae latere, adscendentes, vulgo arcuati, rarius recti, paralleli; nervi intersecundarii obscuri; foliola basalia deminuta persistentia, vulgo dimorpha, alterius (Superioris) paris ± ovata saepe basi obliqua 2-3.5 cm longa, alterius (inferioris) paris subulata, laminae expansae expertia, 0.6-1 cm longa. Inflorescentia axillaris, 30-60 cm longa, sat angusta, laxe ramosa, ramis 8 cm non superantibus, densiflore paniculata, pubescens; pedicellus 1-1.5 mm longus. Calyx cyathiformis, 1.5-2.5 mm longus, in 4-5 lobos triangulares vel vadosos, obtusos, circiter 1/4-1/3 calycem aequantes fissus, sparse puberulus usque grosse pubescens. Petala 4-5, coalita ad 1/3-2/3 longitudinem suam, valvata, ca. 6 mm longa, 1 mm lata, lanceolata, apice acuta, extus adpresse puberula, intus glabra. Tubus stamineus cylindricus, filamentis toto coalitis, 4-4.5 mm longus, ca. 1.5 mm latus, margine lobis 7-10 subulatis vel lanceolatis, alternantibus cum antheris et 1/2-2/3 longitudinem suam attingentibus lobatus, extus glaber, intus sparse pilosus pilis longis vel brevibus crispatis; antherae 7-10, 0.8-1 mm longae, glabrae. In loco nectarii tumor parvus circa basin ovarii, vel nectarium nullum. Ovarium 3-loculare, loculis 2 ovulis collateralibus; styli glabri capitulum capitatum vel truncatum longe infra antheras positum. Fructus ignotus.

description: Rami novelli pilis longiusculis, crispatis, ± erectis grosse pubescentes vel villosi dein subglabri, asperi, brunnei, pallide et prominenter lenticellosi. Perulae nullae. Folia 1-3-foliolata vel imparipinnata; petiolus cum rhachide foliorum pinnatorum usque ad 8.5 cm, 1- et 3-foliolatorum 1-2 cm; petiolus semiteres; rhachis teres, utraque pilis dispersis grosse et longe pubescens; petiolulus (foliolorum lateralium) 3-4 mm longus. Foliola alterna usque opposita, dimorpha, 1-5, ad basin petioli 1-2 paribus foliolorum vestigialium lineari-subulatorum ("pseudostipularum") 0.5-0.7 cm longorum munita; foliola lateralia elliptica usque obovato-elliptica, apice acuminatula usque obtuse cuspidata, basi cuneata vel obtusa, subcoriacea, 6.8-14.5[ 12.7] cm longa, 3.8-5.5[4.9] cm lata, secus costam superam dense pubescentia, inferamque nervosque secundarios pilis longis, grossis, crispatis conspersa, glanduloso-punctata et -striata; venatio eucamptodroma, costa prominente; nervi secundarii 7-15 utroque costae latere, arcuato-adscendentes, paralleli usque paullum convergentes, intersecundarii obscuri vel nulli; reticulum tertiarium pagina inferiore ramosissimum; foliola terminalia et folia unifoliolata elliptica usque oblanceolata, apice acuminatula, basi cuneata vel obtusa, 16-19 cm longa, 6-9 cm lata. Inflorescentia 10-20 cm longa, in paniculam graciliusculam irregulariter ramigeram disposita, grosse pubescens; pedicellus 0.5-1.5 mm longus. Calyx cyathiformis, 1-1.5 mm longus, 5-dentatus, dentibus triangularibus, acutis, 1/3-1/2 calycem aequantibus, subglaber. Petala 5, libera, valvata, 3-3.5 mm longa, 0.75-1 mm lata, anguste lanceolata, apice acuta, cucullata, extus strigulosa, intus glabra. Tubus stamineus cyathiformis, 1.5-2 mm longus, ca. 1.5 mm latus, extus glaber, intus pilis crispatis conspersus; filamenta toto coalita, alterna longiora et ad apicem 2 appendiculas graciles antheris circiter dimidio breviores gerentia; antherae 9-10, 0.6-0.7 mm longae, glabrae. description: Monoecious tree, 10-40 m tall, sometimes with buttresses, reaching a dbh of 120 cm; young branch-lets 4- to 6-angled or sulcate, densely covered with transparent or silvery peltate scales. Leaves in whorls of 4-6; petioles 2-5 cm long; lamina drying brown, coriaceous, obovate to oblanceolate, 22-40(-85) X 12-17(-25) cm, the base long-attenuate, the apex rounded or emarginate, above with a few minute scales, below with stellate hairs and scales, the latter especially along the veins, with 14-20 pairs of secondary veins, smooth above, distinctly raised below, the margin entire. Cymes 8-12 cm long and densely covered with silvery scales, the inflorescence axes sulcate like the young branchlets, with about 12 longitudinal ridges, with 30-40 flowers. Fresh flowers yellow; male flowers clavate to subglobose, 2.5-4.5 mm in diam., 2-6 mm high, the indumentum as on the cymes; tepals connate and forming a persistent dome; floral roof hardly developed; stamens 2, fleshy and triangular, dorsally with a few stellate-lepidote hairs (Fig. 11F); female flowers subglobose to ovoid, distinctly constricted at the apex (Fig. 29B) and tapering towards the floral pore, slightly larger than the male flowers, 4.2-7 mm in diam., 5.3-6.5 mm high, the tepals connate and forming a broadly conical dome around the floral roof, the floral roof sheathing the stylar column (compare Fig. 7I); carpels 6-10. Fruiting receptacle 2.5-3 cm in diam., up to 5 cm long, with about 12 longitudinal ribs, remaining green at maturity and not splitting open, with an astringent smell, drying black with a few silvery scales; drupelets 6-8, lacking a stylar aril.

description: Dioecious shrub or treelet, 3-8 m tall, sometimes a straggler with a liana-like habit; twigs quadrangular, deeply sulcate, and khaki-colored due to a dense indumentum of minute stellate hairs. Leaves opposite; petioles 4-5 cm long; lamina drying brownish to olive-green, chartaceous, broadly elliptic, 18-42 X 10-20 cm, the base obtuse or subacute, the apex shortly apiculate, the lower surface with minute (0.1-0.2 mm in diam.) appressed stellate hairs, the upper surface scantily stellate-pubescent to glabrescent and rather smooth, with (15-)22-24 pairs of secondary veins, the secondary and tertiary veins distinctly prominulous and yellow below, the margin inconspicuously denticulate. Cymes axillary and ample, 4-8 cm long, with minute stellate yellowish khaki hairs, usually with 40-60 flowers. Fresh flowers greenish; male floral cup urceolate to globose with minute stellate hairs, 1.9-2.1 mm in diam., 1.8-2.1 mm high, the floral roof moderately raised, glabrous and drying dark brown, the 4-5 tepals obtusely triangular and 0.4-0.6 mm long; stamens 6, fleshy and containing white globules (large oil cells), the 4 outer ones slightly exserted at anthesis; female floral cup of the same size and shape as the male cups but the floral roof raised to a cylindrical bulge separated by a distinct groove from a second innermost tube sheathing the styles; styles 5-7, often fused to a column. Fresh fruiting receptacles fleshy and red, sometimes with minute tubercles (1 mm long); mature fruiting receptacles unknown.

description: Dioecious treelet, 2-10 m tall and reaching a dbh of 6 cm; young branchlets terete, densely pubescent with small stellate hairs, the older branchlets glabres-cent. Leaves opposite; petioles 1.5-4.5 cm long; lamina drying olive-green or brown, chartaceous, oblan-ceolate to obovate, 16-27 X 10-17 cm, the base cordate, truncate, or rounded, the apex apiculate or acuminate, the tip 0.8-1 cm long, both surfaces rather rough and scantily to moderately stellate-pubescent, with 10-13(-16) pairs of secondary veins, the veins to the third order impressed above, raised below, the margin denticulate. Cymes 2-4 cm long, early gla-brescent, with 10-20 flowers. Fresh flowers whitish yellow, containing abundant whitish oil cells; male floral cup semiglobose to broadly obconical, 2.3-3.5 mm in diam., 1.7-2.8 mm high, with scant stellate hairs and conspicuous whitish oil cells, the tepals forming an 0.1-1 mm broad slightly lobed rim around the floral cup, the floral roof strongly raised, glabrous and drying dark brown or black; stamens 6, often 4 outer and 2 central ones, the outer stamens distinctly exserted at anthesis; female floral cup broadly obconical to subglobose, 2-3 mm in diam., 1.8-3.2 mm high, the tepals 1-1.4 mm long, usually forming a lobed rim, the roof acute-conical; styles 15-30, usually fused to a column. Fruiting receptacle globose, 1.3-2 cm in diam., when fresh and mature yellow to pinkish and smelling strongly of lemon, when dried the 15-25 drupelets distinctly protruding, each drupelet bearing a stylar aril.

description: Dioecious scrambling shrub or treelet, 2-7 m tall and reaching a dbh of 6 cm; branchlets quadrangular and slightly sulcate, densely covered with minute stellate hairs. Leaves opposite; petioles 2.5-4.5 cm long; lamina drying umber, chartaceous, oblanceolate, lanceolate or elliptic, 18.5-33 X 8.5-14 cm, the base acute, sometimes with small mite domatia, the apex long-cuspidate, the tip (1-)1.5-2(-3) cm long, both surfaces densely covered with minute stellate hairs, with 9-10(-13) pairs of secondary veins, the veins slightly raised above, distinctly raised below, the margin doubly serrulate. Cymes (1.5-)3-5(-9) cm long, densely covered with minute stellate hairs, with 3050 flowers. Fresh flowers greenish cream or white, sometimes with a red center; male floral cup obconical, 2-2.4 mm in diam., 2.5-3 mm high, with stellate appressed hairs, a few of these also on the upper side of the tepals and the floral roof, the roof distinctly raised and glabrous, the tepals (4-)5-6, oblong to spatulate, 2-3.5 mm long; stamens 5(-6), the outer ones somewhat exserted at anthesis; female floral cup of the same size and shape, the floral roof distinctly raised, consisting of a cylindrical bulge with a central tube sheathing the styles; styles 5-8. Fruiting receptacle subglobose, 1.3-2.5 cm in diam., crowned by the persistent tepals, mature red or purple with whitish spots and strongly lemon-scented; drupelets 5-8, gray with a red stylar aril.

description: Tree, to 15 m tall or shrub. Leafy twigs 1-4(-5) mm thick, sparsely to densely and minutely puberulous. Lamina oblong to lanceolate, 4.5-17(-42) × 1.5-6(-15) cm, broadest at or above the middle, almost equilateral, (sub)coriaceous; apex acuminate, the acumen acute to obtuse; base acute to obtuse to rounded; margin distinctly to obscurely dent(icul)ate (to subentire); upper surface often shining, glabrous; lower surface sparsely puberulous on the main veins, the globose-capitate, pluricellular hairs abundant to sparse; venation almost plane or the midrib slightly impressed above, ± prominent beneath; lateral veins 8-18 pairs; tertiary venation mostly partly scalariform; petiole 0.4-1.2 cm long, 1-2.5 mm thick, sparsely puberulous or glabrous; stipules 0.3-0.6 cm long, sparsely puberulous to glabrous, caducous. Staminate inflorescences patent, 1-6 cm long, including the 0.1-0.2 cm long puberulous peduncle; flowers crowded, narrowly to rather broadly sessile; perianth ca. 1.5 mm long, deeply 4-parted, sparsely puberulous or only ciliolate; stamens 4, sometimes anisomporphic, straight with the anthers ± transverse or bent outwards at anthesis; filaments 0.5-1.5 mm long; anthers 0.5-1 × 0.4-0.8 mm, the connective rather narrow, not or very shortly apiculate. Pistillate inflorescences sometimes on the older wood, patent, 0.5-2.5 cm long, to 7 cm long in fruit; peduncle 0.1-0.5 cm long, to 1 cm long in fruit, puberulous; rachis puberulous; flowers 10-ca. 40, sessile or subsessile, pedicellate in fruit; pedicel to 1(-1.2) cm long, minutely puberulous to muriculate; perianth 1.5-2 mm long, subentire, the upper part broadly ovoid to almost discoid, glabrous, the lower part with dense, globose-capitate, pluricellular hairs; stigmas narrowly tongueshaped, ca. 1-1.5 mm long, finely papillate. Fruiting perianth ellipsoid (to ovoid), 0.8-1.3 × 0.6-1 cm, chrome-yellow to orange to red or purple, (finally black?), the apex truncate with a collar-like rim, or obtuse, the surface smooth with dense, globose-capitate, pluricellar hairs.

description: Shrubs or trees up to 3 m tall. Leafy twigs 1.5-3 mm thick, yellow hirsute. description: Monoecious dwarf shrubs. Leafy twigs 1-2 mm thick, with very short, patent, yellowish hairs intermixed with distinctly longer, appressed to patent hairs. Leaves oblong to lanceolate, broadest near the upper end, not or hardly inequilateral, 3-17 cm long, 1-7 cm broad, chartaceous, acuminate (to caudate), (acute to) obtuse at the base, coarsely dentate, glabrescent above, strigose on the veins beneath; costa prominent, the other veins nearly plane above, prominent beneath, 8-12 pairs of secondary veins, parallel tertiary veins only in larger leaves; petioles 2-7 mm long; stipules 8-15 mm long, sparsely appressed-pubescent. Staminate inflorescences on short shoots up to 3 mm long, 1.1.5 mm in diameter, subsessile to pedunculate; peduncle up to 1 mm long; involucre with 4-5, ovate to elliptic, obtuse, sparsely puberulous bracts in 2-3 series; flower one; perianth 0.8-1.5 mm high, 4-fid, membranaceous, glabrous; filaments 0.8-1.5 mm long, broadened towards the base or not, anthers 0.4-0.6 mm long, 0.3-0.4 mm broad. Pistillate inflorescences on one of the lower nodes of the short shoot, ca 1.5 mm in diameter, subsessile to pedunculate; peduncle up to 1 mm long; involucre with 5-8 deltoid to subovate, obtuse, sparsely puberulous bracts in ca 3 series; flower one; perianth ca 2 mm high, protracted, 4-lobed, whitish substrigose; style 1.5-2 mm long, glabrous, stigmas triangular, 0.8-1.5 mm long, acute. Fruiting perianth obovoid, ca 13 mm high, sparsely hairy. Flowering in September to November.

description: Shrub or treelet, to 5 m tall. Leafy twigs 1-2.5 mm thick, puberulous to hirtellous. Lamina oblong to elliptic or to lanceolate, 3.5-21 × 1.5-8 cm, broadest at or above, or sometimes below the middle, almost equilateral, chartaceous to subcoriaceous; apex (caudate-)acuminate; base obtuse to subacute; margin serrate-dentate (to subentire); upper surface glabrous; lower surface often scabridulous, puberulous to hirtellous to strigillose on the veins; venation plane to slightly prominent above, slightly prominent beneath; lateral veins (4-)7-l 0 pairs; tertiary venation reticulate; petiole 0.2-0.6 cm long, 0.5-2 mm thick, puberulous to hirtellous; stipules 0.1-0.2 cm long, puberulous, caducous. Pistillate inflorescences solitary or in pairs in the leaf axils, uniflorous or subcapitate with 2-3 flowers; peduncle 0.1-0.4 cm long, to 5 cm long in fruit, puberulous; flowers sessile; perianth 4-fid to 4-parted, ca. 1 mm long, puberulous; ovary ca. 3 mm long, puberulous; stigmas 3-4 mm long, puberulous; bracts ovate, to 0.5 mm long, puberulous. description: Tree, to 20 m tall. Leafy twigs 1-3.5 mm thick, sparsely puberulous. Lamina (sub)obovate, 7-23 × 3.5-10.5 cm, slightly inequilateral, subcoriaceous to chartaceous; apex acuminate to subcaudate; base acute to subobtuse; margin (mostly) distinctly (serrate-)dentate; upper surface glabrous; lower surface sparsely and minutely appressed-puberulous on the main veins; venation plane, but the midrib and sometimes also the lateral veins slightly impressed above, the venation prominent beneath; lateral veins 7-13 pairs; tertiary venation mostly partly scalariform; petiole 0.2-1.5 cm long, 1-2 mm thick, rather densely to sparsely, minutely puberulous; stipules 0.2-0.5 cm long, appressed-puberulous, caducous. Staminate inflorescences pendulous, 2-8.5 cm long, including the 0.1-1 cm long puberulous peduncle; flowers distant to rather crowded, broadly sessile; perianth ca. 1-1.5 mm long, (deeply) 4-parted, subglabrous; stamens 4, bent inwards, filaments ca. 0.8-1.2 cm long; anthers ca. 0.6-0.7 × 0.6-0.8 mm, the connective broad, shortly apiculate. Pistillate inflorescences patent (or pendulous? in fruit), 1-5 cm long, to 9 cm long in fruit; peduncle 0.2-0.5 cm long, to 1.5 cm long in fruit, puberulous; flowers 5-15(-40) (in fruiting state often ± reflexed), pedicellate (or subsessile); pedicel to 0.3 cm long, 0.5-1.5 cm long in fruit; perianth ca. 2 mm long, faintly 4-lobed to subentire, the upper part ovoid to subglobose, glabrous, the lower part very sparsely and minutely puberulous; stigmas 0.5(-l) mm long, coarsely papillate. Fruiting perianth ovoid to globose, ca. 0.8-1 × 0.6-0.9 cm, soon black, the apex rounded or apiculate, the surface smooth, (sub)glabrous.

description: Shrub or tree, to 7 m tall. Leafy twigs 1-3 mm thick, hispidulous to puberulous; lenticels inconspicuous. Lamina oblong, (2-)5-12 × (1 -)2-5 cm, broadest at or above the middle, (almost) equilateral, chartaceous to (brittle) subcoriaceous; apex acute to subacuminate to obtuse; base acute to obtuse; margin entire, sometimes obscurely denticulate; upper surface scabrous to scabridulous; lower surface on the main veins scabrous, on the smaller veins tomentose to hirtellous; venation slightly impressed to plane above, prominent beneath; lateral veins (6-)9-12 pairs; tertiary venation partly scalariform to reticulate; petiole 0.2-0.8 cm long, 1-1.5 mm thick, scabrous; stipules 0.1-0.4 cm long, puberulous, caducous. Staminate inflorescences subcapitate, 0.4-0.6 cm diam.; peduncle 0.1-0.3 cm long, puberulous, bracteate; flowers sessile; tepals 4, free, ca. 1.5 mm long, membranaceous, minutely puberulous; stamens 4; filaments 0.1-0.3 mm long; anthers 0.6-0.7 × 0.5-0.7 mm, the connective broad, not apiculate. Pistillate inflorescences with 1-2(-3) flowers; peduncle 0.1-0.3 cm long, puberulous, bracteate; flowers sessile, but subsessile or with pedicels to 0.2 cm long in fruit; perianth ca. 2-2.5 mm long, 4-lobed to subentire, the upper part sparsely and minutely puberulous; stigmas subulate, 2-3 mm long, finely papillate. description: Tree, to 30 m tall, or shrub. Leafy twigs 1-3.5 mm thick, sparsely to densely puberulous. Lamina oblong to elliptic (or to lanceolate), (2.5-)5-15(-32) × (1.5-) 2.5-7(-13) cm, mostly broadest above the middle, almost equilateral, subcoriaceous; apex acuminate; base acute to obtuse to rounded; margin obscurely to distinctly dent(icul)ate to subentire; upper surface on the midrib sparsely to rather densely and minutely puberulous, glabrescent; lower surface on the main veins very sparsely to rather densely puberulous with mostly appressed hairs of different lengths; venation almost plane or the midrib slightly impressed above, sometimes also the lateral veins slightly impressed, prominent beneath; lateral veins 914 pairs; tertiary venation mostly partly scalariform; petiole 0.5-1.5(-3.5) cm long, 1.5-2 mm thick, sparsely and minutely puberulous to glabrous; stipules 0.3-0.8 cm long, puberulous to glabrous, caducous. Staminate inflorescences patent to pendulous, (0.5-)2-6(-l 0) cm long, including the 0.1-0.4 cm long, puberulous peduncle; flowers rather crowded to distant, (rather) broadly sessile; perianth ca. 2 mm long, 4-parted, ciliolate; stamens 4, isomorphic or anisomorphic, straight (with the anthers ± transverse) or bent outwards at anthesis; filaments 0.5-1.2 mm long; anthers 0.5-0.7 × 0.6-0.8 mm, the connective broad. Pistillate inflorescences patent to pendulous, 1-3 cm long, to 9 cm long in fruit; peduncle 0.1-0.5(-2) cm long, to 0.8 cm long in fruit, puberulous; rachis minutely puberulous to glabrous, carnose (?) and red (?) in fruit; flowers (5-)15-40, sessile to shortly pedicellate; pedicel 0.1-0.3(-0.5) cm long, or occasionally to 2 cm long in fruit, to 3 mm thick, sparsely puberulous; perianth 2-2.5 mm long, 4-lobed, the upper part broadly ovoid, glabrous, the lower part short, densely, minutely puberulous to glabrous; stigmas tongueshaped, 0.4-0.6 mm long, finely papillate. description: Shrub, to 5 m tall, probably dioecious. Leafy twigs 1.5-5 mm thick, with minute patent hairs, intermixed distinctly longer, mostly appressed, yellowish to grayish, stiff hairs. Lamina oblong, (8-) 15-30 × (4-)7-14.5 cm, slightly inequilateral, subcoriaceous to coriaceous; apex acuminate to subcaudate; base acute to obtuse; margin subentire to ± distinctly dentate; upper surface sparsely appressed-puberulous to strigillose on the midrib; lower surface sparsely appressed-puberulous to strigillose on the midrib and lateral veins; lateral veins 6-15 pairs; tertairy venation largely scalariform; petiole 0.4-1.2 cm long, appressed-puberulous to strigillose; stipules 0.5-1.5 cm long, yellowish-subsericeous, caducous. Staminate inflorescences numerous, successively formed on unbranched or branched, to 0.8 cm long short-shoots, with strigillose scales, the receptacle 0.1-0.25 cm diam.; peduncle 0.2-0.4 cm long, appressed-puberulous; involucre with 8-15 ovate, appressed-puberulous to subsericeous bracts in 4-5 rows; flowers 2-6; perianth ca. 1 mm long, 3-4-fid to -parted, the tepals ± cucullate, glabrous or puberulous; stamens 3-4, if 4, then often one of them ± reduced, free, about as long as the perianth; filaments broad or rather slender. Pistillate inflorescences solitary in the leaf axils; peduncle ca. 0.3 cm long, appressed-puberulous; involucre with ca. 10 ovate, appressed-puberulous bracts in 3 rows; flowers 2-6; perianth tubular, ca. 4 mm long, 4-lobed, puberulous; stigmas lingulate, ca. 0.1 cm long. Fruiting perianth ca. 1 cm long, red, densely puberulous; seed ca. 0.7 × 0.5 cm.

description: Tree, to ca. 25 m. Leafy twigs 1.5-3.5 mm thick, sparsely to densely appressed-puberulous; periderm (in older parts) flaking off. Lamina lanceolate, 6.5-24 × 1.3-6 cm, coriaceous; apex acuminate to subacute, the acumen often acute; base acute to obtuse; margin partly ± revolute, but always involute at the base; both surfaces glabrous; lateral veins 12-26 pairs; tertiary venation reticulate or partly scalariform; petiole 0.5-1.8 cm long, appressed-puberulous, the epidermis often ± flaking off; stipules 11.5 cm long, (brownish) appressed-puberulous. Staminate inflorescences on distinct short-shoots in the leaf axils, up to 6 together, ca 1 cm diam.; peduncle 0.2-0.3 cm long; involucral bracts in ca. 5 series, broadly ovate to semicircular to suborbicular, appressed-puberulous; perianth 1.52 mm long; tepals 4-5, free or basally connate; stamens 3-4; filaments 0.3-0.4 mm long; anthers oblong to elliptic, 0.6-0.8 × 0.3-0.4mm. Pistillate inflorescences (juvenile!) below the leaves. Infructescences (immature!) ca. 2-7 cm diam., sessile; involucral bracts in ca. 6 series, broadly to narrowly ovate, puberulous; flowers numerous; free parts of the tepals aculeate to subulate, to 1 cm long, minutely puberulous to subhispidulous; style 5-6 mm long; stigmas subulate, 2-3 mm long.

description: Shrub or tree, 3-6 m tall; trunk to 50 cm diam. Branchlets subangular, slender, the youngest parts shortly gray pubescent, older ones rugulose and covered with gray cork. Leaves lanceolate or ovate-lanceolate, apex shortly falcate-acuminate, tip bluntish, base cuneate, green-olivaceous and dull in dry specimens, chartaceous, finely and rather densely tuberculate on both surfaces, with a short puberulence on both surfaces mainly on the midrib, rarely also in the lower part of the lamina, glabrescent with age, 4-5.5(-6.5) x 1.5-2.5 cm, usually obscurely 4-5-nerved, no proper reticulation; petiole puberulent, 1-2 mm long. Inflorescence usually 2 or 3 from foliate or defoliate axils, patently yellowish-puberulous on peduncles (3-4, rarely -10 mm long) and 2-4 bracteoles, the latter more or less connate, ciliate, 1 mm long. Flowers 3-4(-6) per racemose inflorescence, subsessile. Flower-axis broadly cupular-turbinate, hardly 1 mm long. Corolla urceolate in the dolichostylous, more cylindrically so in the brachystylous form, greenish-yellowish in fresh, reddish-brown in dry specimens, 6-7 mm long including the lobes, lobed for ca. 1/3, lobes ovate-deltoid. Ovary rugulose, glabrous. Drupe (Hinton 5420) subglobose-ellipsoid, glabrous on free top, reddish, finally blackish, 7-9(-10) x 6-7(-8) mm.

description: Shrub, 1.5-3 m, or tree, to 5 m tall. Branch bark beige to mid brown when new, fading to pale gray, peeling to dark gray or dark red-gray, completely glabrous or only a few hairs when new. Lenticels numerous, minute, to 0.5 mm longest axis, generally inconspicuous, not prominent, orangish, sometimes contrasting against bark. Leaves simple, thick-coriaceous, drying pale green, ochre or ochraceous brown, matte or shiny, glabrous. Petiole commonly not well defined, (0.3-)0.5-1.2(-1.5) cm long × 1.5-1.7 mm broad at midlength, 1/2.7-1/5.7 the length of the lamina, semiterete near lamina (flat above), ± terete towards base, the lamina base descending ± to petiole base, often forming a groove, rugose towards base abaxially, tomentose adaxially, pale brown fading to gray, glabrescent. Lamina (2.3-) 3.5-6.5 × (1.5-)2-3.5(-4) cm, length:breadth 1.2-2 (-2.5): 1, narrowly to widely obovate, less commonly elliptic to widely elliptic; base cuneate (to acute), decurrent, symmetrical, pressing flat; apex (acute to) obtuse to rounded, the apical point frequently protruding as small mucro; margin coarsely serrate with 1-4	pairs of serrations in upper half of lamina, the rim thickened, cartilaginous, usually somewhat revolute towards the base; venation prominent on both sides, not particularly conspicuous, semicraspedodromous, the midvein reaching the apex; lateral veins 3-5 pairs. Inflorescences axillary, unbranched, (2-)4-10 × 1.5-1.8 cm, glabrous; peduncle 0.3-1.5 cm × 0.8-1 mm; sterile bracts absent at the base. Common bracts rarely persistent by the time of anthesis, 0.7 × 0.7 mm, glabrous, the margin fimbriate. Flower-pair axis absent. Pedicels 2.5-4 × 0.4-0.6 mm, glabrous. Buds 1.3-1.5 mm broad at the apex, 0.6-0.8 mm broad at midlength, glabrous. Flowers 3.5-6.8 mm long; filaments 0-0.6 mm long, attached 2-3.5 mm from base of tepals; anthers (1.2-) 1.7-2 mm long; nectary lobes 0.5-0.8mm long, the lobes very narrow, long, reaching to half the length of the ovary, well separated; ovary keeled, glabrous, drying black; ovules 0.5-0.6 mm long. Infructescence 4-7.5 cm long, glabrous; fruit pedicels 2-4 × 1 mm, glabrous. Fruit 2-2.6 × 0.8-1.1 cm, both sutured and unsutured sides curved to same degree, the base constricted for 1-2 mm, the apex not constricted, weakly curved to curved strongly so it is perpendicular to unsutured side, beaked, the style somewhat persistent, or not persistent, glabrous, rugulose, dark red-brown when young, maturing pale gray-brown. Seeds unknown.

description: Tree, 2-23 m tall. Young stems ferruginous to light ferruginous, sparsely tomentose. Branch bark beige superficially, dark red-brown beneath, glabrous except for new branch apices with a scurfy covering of short, appressed, yellowish hairs interspersed with long, red-brown hairs. Lenticels numerous or few, inconspicuous to very conspicuous, minute to 1 mm longest axis, granular, raised, pale brown to orange-or red-brown. Leaves simple, chartaceous, matte, drying pale green, greenish-brown or pinkish-brown, glabrous except when very young, when indumentum is the same as for young branches. Petiole 0-l cm long 1.5-2 mm broad at midlength, 1/11-1/15 the length of the lamina, subterete near base, the lamina sides descending upper-facing side of petiole, glabrous to short-tomentose. Lamina 7-20 × 2.5-7.5 cm, length:breadth 2-3:1, oblong; base cuneate, rarely acute, symmetrical, flat or slightly twisted; apex acuminate, rarely attenuate, flat or doubled over, the apical point of midrib not protruding, or as minute black protrusion; margin serrate, with (4-)7-14 small, unevenly spaced teeth, these frequently shallow, leaves occasionally with entire margins or few uneven serrations interspaced with serrate leaves, usually revolute towards base of leaf; venation plane except the midrib which is narrowly indented, inconspicuous to ± conspicuous above, raised and conspicuous beneath, semicraspedodromous, a double marginal vein sometimes seen, midvein reaching the apex; lateral veins 5-8 pairs. Inflorescence 6-9.5(-17) × 1.5-2.2 cm, axillary, unbranched, sparsely tomentose, with weak, pale yellow hairs interspersed with long, curly, ferruginous hairs; peduncle 0.5-1 cm × 0.7-1.3 mm, a few sterile bracts towards base. Common bracts 0.8-1 × 0.6-1 mm, with long ferruginous hairs on the outside, glabrous within. Flower-pair axis absent. Pedicels 2-4 × 0.3-0.5 mm, with sparse indumentum of short, appressed, weak hairs, or glabrous. Buds 0.8-1 mm broad apically, 0.4-0.5 mm broad at midlength, the indumentum as for pedicels. Flowers 6-7.5 mm long; filaments 0.6-0.8 mm long, adnate 3-5.7 mm from base of tepals; anthers 1.5-2.3 × 0.3-0.4 mm; nectary lobes 0.5-0.7 mm long, in contact with each other towards the base; ovary hairs extending 1.2-1.8 mm from base of ovary, short, erect, ferruginous- to rufous-hirsute, in dumentum lower on one side than on the other; ovules 0.5 × 0.2-0.3 mm. Infructescence 6.5-16 cm long, sparsely rufous-tomentose. Fruit pedicels 3-5 × 1-1.5 mm, sparsely puberulent to glabrous. Fruit 2-2.5 × 1.3-1.5 cm, hemispherical, the suture side strongly curved, the nonsutured side only slightly curved or flattened, the base constricted for 1-2 mm, the apex 5-8 mm long, sharply pointed, frequently drying folded, no vascular tissue evident on surface, sparsely appressed-puberulent to glabrous, pale brown. Seed not seen.

description: Small tree, to 4-5m tall. Young branch indumentum sparse, minutely scabrous, the hairs dark red-brown, quickly glabrescent. Older stems beige to pale gray, peeling to dark brown, glabrous. Lenticels few, inconspicuous, <0.5 mm diam., granular, plane, dark orange. Leaves simple, new leaves sometimes asymmetrically bifid, extremely thick-coriaceous, drying olive green-brown and somewhat shiny above (scorched red in parts above and over entire surface beneath), glabrous. Petiole 1-3 cm long, 2.5-3 mm wide at midlength, 1/5.8-1/10 the length of the lamina, grooved at lamina end, subterete towards the base, glabrous except for minute rufous puberulence towards base. Lamina 7.8-13.5 × 4.5-7.5 cm, length: breadth 1.7-1.8:1, ovate; base rounded, folded; apex obtuse and acuminate, less often acute or attenuate, the apical point of midrib not protrudent; margin entire, markedly revolute; venation plane except grooved midrib, inconspicuous above, slightly raised, inconspicuous beneath, brochidodromous as seen above, semicraspedodromous beneath, the midvein reaching the apex; lateral veins 4-6 pairs. Inflorescences 3.9-11 × 1.4-1.6 cm, axillary, unbranched, the indumentum rufous appressed-puberulent to strigose; peduncle 0.5-1.5 cm × 0.5-1 mm, sterile bracts few, scattered. Common bracts 0.7 × 0.6 mm, glabrous to sparsely puberulent, the margin fimbriate with long, strigose hairs. Flower-pair axis absent. Pedicels 1-2 mm × 0.5 mm, the indumentum as for inflorescence. Buds 0.8-1.1mm broad at the apex, ca. 0.5 mm broad at midlength, rufous-strigose, sparsely pubescent towards the apex. Flowers 6-7 mm long; filaments < 0.5 mm long, adnate ca. 4 mm from base of tepals; anthers 1.5-2 × 0.5 mm; nectary lobes < 0.5 mm long, well separated; ovary immature, the indumentum dark rufous, covering entire ovary, very short strigose. Infructescence unknown. Fruit 3-3.3 × 1.5-1.7 cm, constricted for 4-5 mm at base, and for 2-3 mm, strongly curved at the apex, the style not persistent, glabrous, smooth, brown or gray to black. Seeds not known.

description: Evergreen shrub, or tree, to 10m tall, often multistemmed, young twigs densely ferruginous pubescent to ferruginous crispate; lenticels red-brown or the same color as the bark (gray-brown to brown); bark of older twigs often buff, membranous, sometimes peeling. Buds swollen, ca. 2 × longer than wide; leaves shiny above, 3.5-20 cm long, imparipinnate, bipinnate, the juvenile leaves often tripinnate, and to 50 cm long; leaves originally imparipinnate, becoming bipinnate and tripinnate by division of the leaflets; dividing leaflets irregularly lobed, the entire leaflets sessile, oblong to narrowly oblong (occasionally lorate), to widely elliptic through to narrowly elliptic, to narrowly obovate to oblanceolate; apex acute to obtuse, mucronate; only the primary veins visible, sunken above, prominent below; young foliage ferruginous-pubescent, occasionally ferruginous-crispate, the older leaves pilose beneath, sparsely pilose or glabrous above, the hairs on rhachis concentrated in groove; old hairs becoming white. Inflorescences in the axils of older leaves, racemes 3.5-8 cm long, ferruginous-pubescent or occasionally pilose; peduncles 4-7 mm long; bracteoles 2-17 mm long, to 2 mm wide, sparsely pilose on both surfaces, the largest taking the form of very narrow elliptic lamina, decreasing in size up the inflorescence; flowers red and yellow, 1-1.6 cm long; perianth weakly ferruginous pubescent or pilose, the two segments adjacent to the nectary 2-3 mm shorter; gynoecium 0.9-1.5 cm long, always totally glabrous; stipe 2-5 mm long; ovary 3-5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide; ovules 10-20 in two rows; style apex umbonate, the stigmatic surface the pale raised area at its center; anthers 1.5-2 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, ± ovate to ± triangular (the bases diverging after dehiscence), bright yellow when mature; connective dark brown with an acute tip; hypogynous nectary glands three, shallowly to deeply 3-lobed, the lobes juxtaposed at the base, strongly separated towards the upper half, flat above and keeled below. Fruit (1.7-)2.3-3.9cm long, 0.5-1.0 cm wide, straight one side, ± curved on the other, ± flattened, dehiscing along the curved edge, the surface dark brown to black, glabrous, occasionally gray-brown with red-brown to dark brown in the longitudinal furrows, densely to sparsely minutely tuberculate; peduncle 0.7-0.9(-2.2) cm long; stipe 0.7-1.2 cm long; style and style apex persistent though breaking off from older fruits, 0.3-1.2 cm long; nectary glands persistent. Seed 4.5-7 mm long, 2.5-6 mm wide, shape irregular to ± ovate, tip acute to obtuse, generally mucronate, flattened, ± convex on one side with a ridge, ± convex on the other, smooth, brown with dark brown lepidote scales; wing 7-17 × 7 mm; dissepiment fitting the seed and wing exactly, dark brown; cotyledons red-brown.

description: Small tree, 6.5-10 m. Young branches glabrous; bark red-brown to dark brown; lenticels numerous, minute to 0.5 mm, elliptic or rounded, becoming raised, granular, red-brown or brown. Axillary buds dense, the hairs closely appressed, ferruginous-rufous. Leaves subcoriaceous to coriaceous, verticillate in whorls of four, subsessile, glabrous. Petioles to 5 mm long × 5 mm wide at base, semiterete, glabrous. Lamina 9.5-24 × 4-10.3 cm, wide elliptic through elliptic to narrowly elliptic, narrowly obovate or oblanceolate; base rounded to obtuse, less frequently acute-cuneate, symmetrical; apex rounded, rounded-emarginate, obtuse or acute; margin not revolute; venation obscure and slightly raised above, conspicuous and prominent beneath, eucamptodromous at base, brochidodromous towards apex; midrib raised above at base, sometimes developing slight channel farther up from base; lateral veins 6-8 pairs, leaving midrib at angle of 4050°, more rarely 50-60°, often more acute at apex and base of lamina, ascending steeply. Secondary peduncle 1-12 cm × 1-2.5 mm. Primary axis of inflorescence branched, 7-25.5 cm × 1-2.5 mm; 4-11 lateral inflorescences at 1-4 nodes, 4.5-21 cm × 0.5-1.5 mm, verticillately arranged, often further branched; indumentum short, closely appressed-pilose, red-brown, becoming glabrous and fading to gray. Common bracts minute to 0.50.7 mm long, the hairs red-brown. Pedicels 3.3-4.8(-5) × 0.3-0.5 mm, (close-)appressed, red-brown, short-tomentose. Flowers 3.0-3.8 mm long, not elongating after perianth parts lost, the perianth indumentum yellow-brown, short, closely appressed, densely- to sparse-pilose, usually paler and shorter than pedicel indumentum; filaments 2-2.7 mm long, free to base of perianth parts; anthers 0.7-1 × ca. 0.4-0.6 mm, oblong or elliptic-oblong; hypogynous nectary 0.7-1 mm long, shallowly four-lobed; ovary hairs orange-red, staggered in length extending to 1.2-1.4 mm from base, few hairs farther up style; style 0.2-0.3 mm wide at midlength. Fruit 3-3.5 cm long, 2.8-3.0 cm diam., subglobose, slightly drawn-out at attachment to pedicel, with a small apical mucro slightly or markedly offset from fruit axis, smooth, glabrous, dark brown; pericarp 1-2 mm thick; outer mesocarp thin; mid mesocarp 1-2 mm thick; inner mesocarp very thin. Seed coat heavily vascularized, fused to pericarp. Seed ca. 2 mm diam.; naked.

description: Tree. Young branches sparse red-brown to pale villous, the pubescence denser around nodes, glabrescent, bark dark brown; lenticels conspicuous, to 1.5 mm long, 0.3 mm wide, strongly elongate becoming circular, raised, granular, buff to orange-brown. Axillary buds clustered, rufous-villous. Leaves coriaceous, verticillate in whorls of four, the indumentum sparse, off-white, straight, closely appressed above, very sparse rufous-villous beneath, particularly along midrib when young, and rapidly glabrescent. Petioles 1-2 cm × 1-2 mm (to 4 mm at base), flat, sparsely rufous-villous when young becoming semiterete to terete and glabrous, smooth. Lamina 12.5-16.5 × 4-6.2 cm, elliptic (more rarely narrowly elliptic to narrowly obovate); apex acute to obtuse; base cuneate, sometimes slightly decurrent; margin thinly revolute at periphery; venation conspicuous, slightly raised above, prominently so beneath, eucamptodromous at base of leaf, brochidodromous farther up; midrib plane above, with a narrow sunken groove centrally; lateral veins 10-12 pairs, leaving midrib at 60-80°, straight, parallel at first then steeply ascending towards margin. Primary axis of inflorescence branched, 5-18 cm × 2-3 mm; 2-6 lateral inflorescences at 1-2 nodes, 6-14 cm x 0.5-1 mm, verticil-lately arranged; indumentum orange-brown villous. Common bracts ca. 1 mm long, orange- to red-brown villous. Pedicels 4-5.5 × 0.5-0.7 mm, orange-brown villous to tomentose. Buds 5 mm long. Flowers 4-4.5 mm long; perianth indumentum orange-brown, short, straight, closely appressed, becoming pilose; free part of filaments 1.5-2 mm long, adnate to perianth parts 1-2 mm from base; anthers 1 × 0.75 mm, widely ovate; hypogynous nectary 0.5 mm long, the lobes acute; ovary orange-red villous, the hairs fine, shaggy, extending 2-2.5 mm (rarely few hairs to 3 mm) from base; style 0.4-0.6 mm wide at midlength, remaining straight sided to apex, not generally becoming clavate. Not known in fruit. Field characters. Tree 4-5 m tall, with erect branches. Flowers greenish-yellow.

description: Tree. Young branches with indumentum appressed-tomentose when young, yellow-brown fading to gray, glabrescent; bark light orange-brown to dark reddish-brown or reddish-gray, with no outer membranous layer; lenticels few, conspicuous and distinctive (not present on all specimens), to 0.7-1.5 mm long, 0.40.8 mm wide, oblong-elliptic, not raised, smooth- and broad-rimmed, covered with a fragile membrane which breaks to form the pore; rarely also a few brown, granular lenticels. Axillary buds solitary or closely juxtaposed in stacks of two, ferruginous-villous. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous, arranged spirally or decussately to subopposite-decussate, the indumentum sparse, closely appressed, straight, buff-to dark gray-pilose, glabrescent, sometimes with persistent wavy hairs beneath, and along midrib above. Petioles 1-1.7 cm long × 1-2 mm wide, very broad at base to 3 mm, sulcate, dense to sparsely short-tomentose above, sparse villous to glabrous beneath. Lamina 6-23.5 × 4-11.5 cm, oblong, widely elliptic, elliptic, or narrowly obovate in shape; base frequently eccentric, asymmetry laterally inverted for leaves on opposite sides of branch, obtuse, at times slightly cordate; apex acute to rounded with slight mucro; margin not revolute to markedly revolute; venation usually ± conspicuous, slightly raised above, brochidodromous, eucamptodromous at base; midrib sunken above; lateral veins 8-11 pairs, leaving midrib at 50-60° and ascending steeply near base of lamina, then at 60-80° farther up the lamina and running straight and parallel before ascending steeply. Primary axis of inflorescence branched, 12-15.5 cm × 2-3 mm; 4-7 lateral inflorescences at 3-5 nodes, 1.8-12.5 cm × 1-2 mm, decussate at base, becoming spiral; the indumentum yellow-brown through orange-brown to gray, short-tomentose to villous. Common bracts to 3 mm long, pale yellow-brown- to ferruginous-pubescent. Pedicels 3-5 mm long, ca. 0.4-0.7 mm wide, indumentum yellow-brown to orange-brown, dense, short, straight, to short-tomentose, appressed or not. Flowers (3-)4-5.5 mm long, perianth indumentum yellow-brown to orange-brown, appressed short-sericeous to tomentose; filament 3.3-4 mm long, adnate 0-1 mm from base of perianth parts; anthers ca. 1 × 0.5-0.6 mm, elliptic to oblong in shape; hypogynous nectary 0.2-0.5 mm long; ovary villous or sericeous, the hairs extending 1.5-2 mm from base, often with few hairs farther up the style; style 0.2-0.4 mm wide at midlength, only slightly clavate. Not known in fruit. Field characters. Shrub or small tree 2-8 m tall × 15 cm dbh. Leaves alternate, coriaceous, stiff, and glabrous. Bark red-gray, smooth with many small, flat, transversely stretched warts (lenticels). Wood hard, white. Cortex 2 mm thick. Flowers small, white, perianth recurved. Said to have globose fruit the size of a walnut.

description: Árvore de 20 m de altura. Ramos jovens pilosos, glabrescentes. Folhas 2-pinadas alternas, longo-pecioladas, até 26 cm de comprimento, com 3-4 pinas; raque glabro, canaliculado na face superior; pecíolo primário 5.5-7 cm de comprimento, raque piloso ou glabrescente, brilhante, 4.5-6 cm de comprimento; pecíolo secundário de 2.5 cm de comprimento, glabrescente; pinas 1-2 jugas; folíolos com 3-5 jugos opostos ou altemos; pecíolo terciário de 4.5-6 mm de comprimento, estrigoso; folíolos secundários discolores, verde-escuros na face superior, na inferior verde-acinzentados, estreitamente elíticos, 7-9.5 cm de comprimento, 2-2.5 cm de largura, base obtusa ou atenuada, acuminados no ápice, brilhantes e glabros, antes crispado-pubescentes na face superior, na inferior os pelos curtos; nervura primária impressa na face superior, na inferior, proeminente; vênulas levemente promínulas. Inflorescência paniculado-racemosa; rácemos curtos, com 9-11 cm de comprimento. Flores densamente agrupadas numa raque espessa, pilosa; pedicelos também pilosos, de 2 mm de comprimento; cálice longo, 5-lobulado no ápice, 5 mm de comprimento, recoberto de pelos curtos; lóbulos de 1 mm de comprimento, largamente triangulares; corola com cinco pétalas; pétala estreitamente oblongo-lanceolada, 8.5 mm a 1 cm de comprimento por 3 mm de largura, obtusa, intemamente com pelos curtos, ciliada; estames cinco, glabros, com filetes 8.5 mm de comprimento; estaminódios com filetes longos, no ápice oblongos, carnosos, 10 mm de comprimento, intemamente vilosos, coalescentes e decíduos, semelhantes a uma cúpula no ápice. Ovário longo-estipitado, oblongo, piloso, estilete 2 mm de comprimento e estigma punctiforme. Fruto, legume espesso, aplanado, possivelmente recurvado e lenhoso, como em D. latifolia.

description: Plants epiphytic; fronds pendent, determinate; rhizome erect, radial, with ventral root insertion, scaly, the scales 2-2.5 x 0.3-0.5 mm, linear-lanceolate, the apex long-attenuate, clathrate, castaneous, ciliate, the cilia simple, present on scale margins and apex (apical cilia furcate); petiole 3-5 x 0.3-0.5 mm, dark brown, terete, sparsely pubescent, the hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long, spreading, simple or 1-furcate, 2- to 3-celled, whitish to reddish; lamina 10-30(-40) cm long, linear-lanceolate, chartaceous, deeply pinnatisect, 15-20(-25) pairs of segments, abruptly reduced at the base with 2-4 basal segments shorter than the median ones, the lowermost auriculiform, decurrent onto the petiole base, broadest in the middle, not showing periodic constrictions, the apex abruptly reduced, pinnatifid, not ending in a subconform segment; rachis straight, with dark sclerenchyma throughout its length, the sclerenchyma visible abaxially, obscured by laminar tissue adaxially, sparsely pubescent to glabrous abaxially, the hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long, spreading, simple or 1-furcate, 2- to 3-celled, whitish, glabrous adaxially; segments 1.8-2.5 x 0.2-0.3 cm, plane, set 70-80° to rachis, widened and symmetric at the base, decurrent basiscopically, surcurrent acroscopically, the base attached parallel on the rachis (i.e., both sides inserted along the same radius), not cuneate acroscopically, not lobulate, not overlapping the base of the next segment, the apex acute to obtuse, the margin entire, plane or slightly recurved, abaxial lamina surface sparsely pubescent, the hairs similar to those of the rachis abaxially, adaxial lamina surface glabrous; sinuses 3 or 4 times as broad as the segments; venation pinnate, with 7-12 pairs of veins per segment; costae with blackish sclerenchyma obscured by laminar tissue on both sides, glabrous or sparsely pubescent, the hairs similar to those of the rachis abaxially; veins simple, with blackish sclerenchyma restricted to base and obscured by laminar tissue, ending in hydathodes that lack calcareous deposits; sori medial, rounded, not protruding beyond the margin, 6-12 pairs per segment, superficial to slightly sunken; sporangial capsules setose, with 1-4 reddish setae.

description: Shrub usually to 3.0 m (rarely taller), evidently evergreen. Bark light when very young, dark and somewhat reddish when older. Stem with short (0.1-0.2 mm long) pubescence moderately dense terminally, moderately on leaf-bearing portions and glabrous on older portions; leaf-scars prominent. Bud-scales absent. Stipules ca 3.0 mm long, pubescent, dark, and persistent. Petioles (4.0-)5.8-8.0(-12.0) mm long with sparse to moderate amounts of shortish hairs. Leaf-blades firmly membranaceous, 1.7-5.6(-7.5) cm long, (0.9-) 1.2-2.8(-3.0) wide, mostly elliptic but also obovate or rarely oblong, breadth-length ratio mostly ca 0.5 (0.34 to 0.6); base cuneate (most frequent) to rounded; apex acute or with short acumen (5.0-8.0 mm in one case); margin usually revolute, rarely plane, mostly remote crenate, rarely serrate, teeth (2-)3-6(-8) per cm, mucronate or not; above glabrous to moderately hairy, dark or olive green with copper overtones, beneath glabrous and paler or sometimes yellowish; midrib above with sparse to moderate amounts of hairs, secondary veins with similar amounts, less, or none, midrib and secondary veins beneath beset with sparse to moderate amounts of hairs and conspicuous because of pale usually yellowish color; secondary veins (6-)7-8(-9) pairs. Flowers 1-3(-7) per axil; peduncles absent; pedicels (3.0-(4.0-7.0 mm long and often dull red in color; floral cup (1.0-)1.5-2.0 mm deep, (2.5-)3.0(-3.5) mm broad; sepals 5, 1.5-2.0 mm long, (1.3-)2.0 mm wide, sometimes broader than long; external floral parts with sparse to moderate amounts of short hairs; petals 1.5-2.0 mm long, 1.2-1.3 mm wide with margin tapering almost abruptly into a distinct claw ca 0.5 mm long and having a notch which is broad (up to 1.0 mm) at apex and acute at base and ca Vi the length of the broad portion of the petal; filaments ca 1.0 (rarely up to 1.5) mm long and broad-based, anthers 0.6-1.0 mm long, embraced by petals, lacking an apicule (rarely with a very short one); ovary glabrous, style extending to base of sepals or up to their length from the base. Fruits l-2(-3) per axil; pedicels in fruit 6.0-7.0(-8.0) mm long; floral cup angular (pentagonal, stellate) at upper margin and ca 3.0 mm in diam; floral parts (especially sepals) with a tendency to persist; fr 5-7 mm in diam, green at first, becoming red, glabrous, 3-stoned.

description: Shrub or small tree 1.5-5.0 m tall. Young branchlets sparsely or less often densely hairy near the tip, less hairy with age. Bud-scales absent. Stipules 1.02.5 mm long, dark, moderately pubescent, quickly deciduous; petioles 5-17(-20) mm long with moderate to dense pubescence; leaf-blades 5.6-16.5 (average, 8.6) cm long, 2.0-6.8 (average, 3.4) cm wide, mostly elliptic, sometimes lanceolate or oblong, rarely ovate, 1.5-2.7 (mostly 2.0) times longer than broad; base cuneate to rounded or obtuse; apex acuminate to long acuminate; margin plane or revolute, prominently crenate or serrate, teeth usually 6 per cm although sometimes fewer, mucro at tips dark or amber and often detached; both surfaces glabrous to moderately hairy, above green with midrib usually yellowish and sulcate and sparsely to moderately beset with hairs which may be longer than the depth of the channel, beneath lighter than above with midrib usually yellowish and raised, it and secondary veins with greater amount of hairs than above (conspicuously heavy along lateral margins in specimens from Veracruz; secondary veins (7-)8-l 1(-13) pairs. Inflorescence an axillary umbel with 2-4(-7) flowers; peduncles absent; pedicels (5.0-)9.0-13.0 mm long and hairy, floral cup 2.0 mm long or even longer and 2.0-3.0 mm broad at upper margin; sepals 5, almost 2.0 mm long or even longer and ca 1.2-1.5 mm broad; floral cup and sepals hairer externally than pedicel; petals 5, 1.5 mm long and enclosing filament only or up to 2A of the anther; filament 1.0 mm long, anther 1.0 mm long having a central dark portion with strong nerve and light colored margins; ovary pubescent usually densely so, style up to 2.5 mm long and reaching to the middle or apex of the sepals or even beyond, stigma 3-lobed. Fruits with peduncles lacking; pedicels 6.0-7.0 mm long; drupes ca 5.0-6.0 mm in diam, red, pubescent.

description: Shrub or usually tree (1.5-)3-18(-27) m tall; trunk 10-20(-40) cm in diam.; branchlets 3-7(-10) mm in diam., brown, reddish-brown when young, shining, lenticels spindle-shaped ca. 0.3-1 mm long, puberulous with spreading hairs ca. 0.05 mm, becoming glabrous in age. Leaves 1-3-foliolate with usually sessile or shortly stalked leaflets; sheath 4-10 mm long, inner margin ciliate with hairs to 0.4 mm long, abaxial side pubescent with hairs to 0.4 mm, becoming glabrous in age; petiole subterete, (shallowly) canaliculate, not or obsoletely winged, 4-40 mm long and 1-2 mm thick, pubescent with spreading hairs ca. 0.05 mm, becoming glabrous in age; wings to 0.2 mm broad and usually not eared; petiolules 0-2 mm long; leaflet blades elliptic or slightly obovate, rarely ovate, 7-25 × 2.5-9.5 cm or sometimes smaller towards apex of the branchlets, (shortly) attenuate or narrowly cuneate at base, at apex acuminate or occasionally slightly acuminate or obtuse, the very tip obtuse, the margin not revolute or only slightly so, the blade (sub)coriaceous, shining, glabrous or occasionally pubescent at base like the petioles, becoming glabrous in age, venation ± prominent, midvein plane or prominulous, sometimes slightly impressed towards base. Inflorescences terminal or axillary near tips of branches, widely paniculate, shorter or usually longer than the leaves, (7-)10-25(-30) × (5-)8-25 cm, numerous-flowered, pubescent with spreading hairs 0.05-0.1 mm, the lowermost side-branchlets usually subtended by the upper pair of leaves; bracts (depressedly) ovate or triangular, to 2(-5) × 1.2-1.5(-4.5) mm, rarely the lowest bracts leaf-like and up to 12 × 1 mm, minutely pubescent below with hairs 0.05-0.1 mm long, less dense above; pedicels 1.5-6 mm long and 0.2-0.5 mm thick; bractlets 2, (sub)opposite. Flowers 6.5-8.3 mm in diam., usually 7.5-8 mm, not fragrant (Capucho 475); calyx lobes subquincuncial or subcochlear to separate, depressedly ovate, (0.4-)0.7- 1	× (0.7-) 1-1.4 mm, slightly acuminate or obtuse, glabrous above, minutely pubescent below with spreading hairs 0.05 mm long; petals deciduous, valvate, very widely spreading, ovate, unguiculate, 3.5-4 × 1.5-2.5 mm, the claw 0.2-0.5 mm, acutish at tip, thickly coriaceous becoming thinly so, yellow-white when alive, brownish-yellow when dried, densely pubescent above with spreading hairs ca. 0.05 mm long, or papillose, pubescent or subglabrous below with spreading hairs 0.05-0.1 mm long; filaments persistent, 2.4-3 mm long and 0.3 mm thick, yellowish tending to become rose, glabrous; anthers broadly ovate to nearly heartshaped, 0.5-0.6 × 0.4-0.6 mm, becoming purplish, occasionally papillose; disc in the upper half 5-partite, not projecting beyond the ovary, (0.7-) 1 mm high in all, (1.8-)2(-2.5) mm in diam., becoming dark, upper part densely charged with thick tubercles ca. 0.1-0.4 mm long; carpels 0.5-0.6 mm on a raised receptacle, densely charged with clavate or finger-like, thick protuberances 0.2-0.8 mm, which are glabrous or pilose with spreading hairs 0.05-0.1 mm long; style inserted half-way on the carpels, (1-) 1.2-1.5 mm long and 0.3-0.5 mm thick, projecting 0.5-1 mm beyond protuberances of ovary, with some basal glands, glabrous; stigma capitate, 5-lobed, 0.2-0.3 × 0.4-0.5 mm. Fruits ± depressedly globose, stellately-lobed, (15-)20-28 x (15-)20-30 mm(-48 when dehisced), loculi near middle bearing a dorsal, blunt apophysis 5-10 mm long, transverse-parallel nerves hardly visible externally except near the commissures and sometimes at tip, strongly muricate with tubercles to 3-5 mm long, dehiscent septicidally from ca. 3	mm above base up to some mm below tip and loculicidally up to (half-way) the apophysis; seeds usually 2 per loculus, superposed, ovoid, 5-7 × 3.5-4.5 × 4-5.5 mm, flattened at or near base, rounded at apex, testa thinly coriaceous, dull medium brown, irregularly pustulate and reticulate-colliculate; chalazal area tearshaped, shining, dark brown, ca. 3.5 × 2.5 mm; hilum ca. 1 mm broad; embryo punctate, radicle projecting among the ears.

description: Shrub or treelet 2-5 m tall, glabrous or pubescent; branchlets 3-7 mm in diam., grayish- or reddish-brown, shining when young; perules of terminal buds triangular, 1.5-4 × 3 mm, strigillose with hairs 0.2-0.3 mm. Leaves alternate, (sub)opposite or ternate, crowded towards apex of branchlets, simple; petiole semiterete, slightly canaliculate towards tip or not, slightly winged to 0.3 mm, 1.5-20(-50) × 1.5-2 mm, often becoming transversely cracked in age; blade (narrowly) elliptic to obovate, rarely some ± ovate, 4.5-18.5(-25) × 1.5-6(-8) cm, narrowly or rarely broadly cuneate or (long-) attenuate at base, ± decurrent along petiole, rounded, obtuse, or subacuminate at apex, the very tip sometimes to 1 cm long and emarginate or entire, margin thick and strongly revolute, blade chartaceous to subcoriaceous, slightly paler beneath, ± shining above, venation brochidodromous to camptodromous, principal nerves prominent, costa above plane and wrinkled or not, prominent below. Racemes 1-several, subterminal, erect, 13-45 × 0.5-1.5 cm, with numerous flowers developing in basipetal fashion, glabrous, or rachis and pedicels pubescent with spreading hairs 0.05-0. l(-0.3) mm long; rachis 1-2 mm thick at base; bracts broadly to depressedly triangular or suborbicular, 0.3-0.5 × 0.3-0.5 mm, basal bracts up to more than twice as large as the upper ones; pedicels inserted at 90°; bractlets 2, alternate, obliquely or transversely inserted, one close to the calyx. Flowers 4.5-7 mm in diam.; calyx 4-5-lobed; lobes valvate to subquincuncial, very broadly to depressedly ovate-triangular, 0.2-0.6 × 0.5-0.8 mm, acute to rounded, coriaceous, glabrous or in bud with some hairs 0.05 mm long; petals subvalvate, ovate or very rarely elliptic, the tip 0.2-0.3 mm inflexed, (thinly) coriaceous and usually semitransparent, yellow-greenish when fresh, yellow-brownish when boiled, slightly carinate towards tip and with slight impressions above, shining below when young, glabrous, venation parallel, the median nerve thicker; filaments semiterete, 1.5-2(-2.8) × 0.20.3 mm, glabrous; anthers suborbicular, ca. 0.6-0.9 mm, pale yellow, with a dorsal, ovate gland; disc 0.3-0.6(-0.8) mm high and 1.4-1.8(-2.5) mm in diam., 5- to slightly 10-plicate, paler than the ovary, glabrous or strigillose with tawny hairs to 0.5 mm long; carpels ca. 0.5-0.7 mm high, with glands, glabrous or strigillose like the disc; ovule 1 per carpel; style obconical, ca. 0.2-0.3 mm long, not projecting beyond the ovary at anthesis but growing after flowering; stigma capitate, 0.2-0.4 × 0.2-0.5 mm. Mericarps subovoid, 6-9 × 4.5-6 mm, dorso-apically rounded, the very apex notched or not, with glands 0.3-0.4 mm, glabrous or minutely pubescent when young, dehiscent up to 1/2 or 2/3 below tip; seed 1 per mericarp, expelled immediately, (ob)ovoid to reniform, 5.5-6 × 4 × ca. 3.6 mm, slightly keeled on the back and curved at tip, testa chestnut-brown, irregularly finely reticulate with interspaces 0.05-0.1 mm; hilum to 2.5 mm long; cotyledons subequal with ears 1 mm; radicle thick, blunt, ca. 1.5 mm long; plumule to 1.5 mm, strigillose with tawny hairs to 0.2 mm long.

description: Description based on dry material and spirit material. Fleshy to almost woody, dark-brown root parasites. Tubers subterranean, very large, in clumps up to 60 cm diam., starchy; surface coarsely cracked into irregularly shaped warts up to 2 cm across. Stem appearing from upper, scaly part of tuber. Scales apparently arranged in 14-16 vertical ranks, triangular, 0.5 x 0.4 cm increasing to 3.2 x 1.7 cm at transition from tuber to inflorescence-bearing stem, where the scales become spirally arranged. Sterile part of stem very short or absent. Inflorescence unisexual, 5-15 cm long and 5-7 cm wide including the bracts. Branches each subtended by a persistent (?), scaly bract. Bracts subpeltate with petiole 1-1.8 cm long, 0.2-0.4 cm wide, and pelta angularly-ovate, 3.5-5 cm long, 1.6-2.7 cm wide. Male branches about 1 cm long. Each flower consists of 2 median perianth segments of equal size between which 2 stamens appear; filaments 1 mm long, anthers basifixed 3 mm long and 0.8 mm wide. Pollen grains spheroid-subprolate, tricolporate, P 31.9 µm, E 25. 7 µm, outer layer of wall granular, loosening irregularly (artefact caused by acetolysis ?). Female branches incl. of flowers 1.5 cm long and 1 cm wide, densely covered by flowers, apically rounded. Flowers with perianth adnate to ovary, obconical-prismatic, 3 mm long and 1.5 mm wide above, perianth lobes present as 2, median, conspicuous mamillae about 0.3 mm high and 0.8 mm wide; styles 2, 1 mm long and 0.1 mm wide with capitellate stigma 0.15 mm wide, appearing from 2 central cavities, diverging laterally. Fruit a small, 1-seeded achene.

description: Description based on dry material and color slide. Violet and yellowish, monoecious plants (inflorescences bisexual). Total length up to 16 cm. Tuber spheroidal, 1.8-3.5 cm diam., by a constriction passing into a volva, surface of both yellowish light-brown, irregularly verrucose by small warts 0.5-1 mm across. Volva 3-6 cm long, narrowly funnel shaped, violet inside, bursting irregularly upwards into 2 or 3 lobes. Inflorescence 4.5-13 cm long, lower female part 1.5-6 cm long, upper male part 3-7 cm long, up to 2.5 cm across inclusive of flowers. Inflorescence branches each subtended by a caducous peltate bract with petiole 3-5 mm long and 0.5-1 mm across, terete or slightly flattened, peltas red-brown to violet, flat, thin, more or less hexagonal, densely imbricate, each pelta with lower 1/3 free and upper 2/3 covered by the lower parts of the peltas of three neighboring bracts inserted at higher levels. Male branches composed of 4-8 decussately arranged flowers, 1.5-4 mm long, 1-3 mm wide, with a distinct, flattened, circular apical part 0.5-1.5 mm diam. Each male flower appearing on the branch as a reduced axis with two shallow pits laterally on either side of a more or less conspicuous mamilla, one stamen at each pit; perianth absent. Stamen with filament 0.25-0.5 mm long; anther 1-1.25 x 0.5-1 mm. Axis of inflorescence between male branches densely mamillate. Pollen grains spheroid, tricolporate, P 26.1 µm, E 24.2 µm, nuclei 2. Female branches 4-6 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide at fertile part, peltate apical part 2-4 mm diam. Female flowers densely arranged on narrow part of branch, without a perianth. Ovary slightly obconical, 1.2-1.5 mm by 1 mm; styles 2, 0.5 mm long, diverging from a shallow pit at the truncate apical part of the ovary; stigmas capitellate.

description: Description based on alcohol material, dried material and color slide. Whitish to light brown or flesh coloured, monoecious plants (inflorescence bisexual). Total length up to 20 cm. Tuber spheroidal, 3-4 cm diam., by a constriction passing into a volva, surface of both yellowish light-brown, irregularly verrucose by small warts 0.5-1 mm across. Volva up to 6 cm long, narrowly funnelshaped, violet inside, bursting irregularly upwards. Inflorescence with lower, sterile part up to 6 cm long, intermediar female part up to 4 cm long, and upper male part up to 11 cm long, 2.5-3 cm across inclusive of flowers. At least some of the branches of the inflorescence subtended by an inconspicuous bract. Bract 3-4 mm long with a filiform petiole about 3 mm long and 0.3 mm wide, blade obtriangular, 0.7-1 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, and 0.5 mm thick. Male branches 3-7 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, with a peltate, transversely elliptic to subcircular, slightly crenate apical part about 4 mm wide. Male flowers up to 20 in one branch, without a perianth. Stamens 2, alternately inserted in fissures on the branch; filament 1-1.2 mm long; anther 1-2 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide. Axis of inflorescence between male branches densely mamillate. Pollen grains spheroid, tricolporate, P 22.1 µm, E 22.2 µm, nuclei 2. Female branches about 4 mm long, with peltate apical part as in male branches, narrow lower part densely covered by 50-80 flowers. Female flowers whitish, without a perianth. Ovary about 1 mm long and 0.5-1 mm wide; styles 2, 0.5 mm long, diverging from a shallow pit at the truncate apical part of the ovary; stigmas capitellate.

description: Scandent shrub, the branches terete, lenticellate. Stipules caducous (nv); petioles 5.0-8.0(40.0) mm long, 1.0-2.0 mm thick, densely strigose;lamina elliptic to broadly elliptic, 8.0-16.0 cm long, 4.0-9.0 cm wide, chartaceous, smooth, the margins entire, the apex acute to acuminate, the base acute to obtuse; venation eucamptodromus, slightly strigose-pubescent, the midrib plane above, prominulous beneath, the secondary nerves 6-10 pairs; intercostal pubescence absent on both surfaces, rarely with arachnoid pubescence beneath. Inflorescences condensed terminal and axillary panicles, when axillary, present only associated with one of the leaves of a pair, 2.0-15.0 cm long. Flowers in groups of 1-3 (usually 2); peduncles and pedicels of equal length, 2.04.0 mm long, 0.7-0.9 mm thick, densely strigose, the bracts 1.5-3.0 mm long, ovate, strigose, the bracteoles 1.0-2.5 mm long, narrowly ovate, strigose; sepals ovate to deltoid, the inner ones usually narrower, 4.0-5.5 mm long, 2.5-5.0 mm wide, the exposed portions strigose, the protected portions white-lanate-pubescent; standard 5.0-6.0 mm long, 4.0-5.0 mm wide, the pouch extending 2/3 of the length, the upper portion erect, the apex irregular, barbate-pubescent on the inside of the throat, the wings spathulate, 4.0-5.0 mm long, 3.0-3.5 mm wide, barbate at the inside of the base, the keel petals 4.0-5.0 mm long, 3.0-4.0 mm wide, the pouch extending down, the apex irregular; stamens 8, all fertile, the filaments 1.5-2.0 mm long, free at apex, the anthers ovate-elliptic, 0.6-0.8 mm long, 0.4-0.5 mm wide, adhering 4 on each side of the style;glands 2, 3-lobate, ca 0.9 mm high, 2.0 mm long, glabrous; style clavate, 1.8-2.0 mm long, ca 0.5 mm thick at the apex, the stigma trilobate, white; ovary ovoid, 1.0-1.2 mm high, ca 1.5 mm wide at base, barbate-pubescent, 1-locular, the ovules numerous. Fruit 7.0-8.0 cm long, the valves ca 10.0 mm per side; exocarp thin, coriaceous, glabrous; endocarp cartilaginous. Seeds not seen.
