description: Plant flowering to 45 cm high. Leaves few in an elongate cylindrical rosette, to 3 dm long, narrowly scarious-margined, not at all cretaceous, very inconspicuously punctulate-lepidote; sheaths very indistinct, about as long as the blades but scarcely wider; blades ligulate, rounded-apiculate, flat, to 4 cm wide. Scape erect or somewhat curved, shorter or longer than the leaves, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts remote, erect and enfolding the scape, lance-ovate, obtuse and apiculate. Inflorescence laxly compound with simple or rarely divided branches, equaling or exceeding the leaves, 5-20 cm long, glabrous; primary bracts lanceolate, acute, much shorter than the usually naked sterile base of the axillary spikes; spikes divergent, 3-12 cm long, lax, to 15-flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, distinctly shorter than the sepals; flowers perfect. Sepals strongly asymmetric with the left side broadly elliptic and the right side cuneate at the base, and at the apex expanded into a large wing which overtops the midnerve, 5-6 mm long, prominently nerved when dry but not wrinkled, subcoriaceous; petals elliptic, obtuse, yellowish-white, barely exserted; stamens unequal; style lacking.

description: Plant flowering 14-40 cm high. Leaves about 10 in a subfasciculate rosette, erect or curving outward, to 24 cm long, obscurely punctulate-lepidote, cretaceous, especially toward the base; sheaths elliptic, about half as long as the blades; blades subtriangular, acuminate, 25 mm wide. Scape erect to decurved; scape-bracts erect, lanceolate or elliptic, acuminate, from much shorter to slightly longer than the internodes. Inflorescence mostly branched in the staminate plants, mostly simple in the pistillate or perfect; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than the sterile naked base of the spike; spikes laxly 3-15-flowered, to 2 dm long; rhachis nearly or quite straight, angled, glabrous. Floral bracts broadly ovate or elliptic, obtuse or broadly acute, the lower ones barely shorter than the sepals, the upper much shorter; flowers sessile, erect to spreading, perfect or functionally unisexual and dimorphic (only in Mexico and Central America so far as known). Sepals strongly asymmetric, broadly elliptic, obtuse, submembranaceous, prominently nerved, glabrous, the staminate to 12 mm long, the pistillate to 15 mm; petals ligulate with flaring blade, broadly acute or obtuse, 20 mm long, bright yellow; stamens unequal, the first series much longer than the second; anthers sagittate; ovary stoutly ovoid; style very short but distinct. Capsule ovoid, long-beaked, 15-20 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 1-45 cm high. Leaves few in a cyathiform or tubular rosette, 8-20 cm long, obscurely punctulate-lepidote throughout, not at all cretaceous; sheaths elliptic, inconspicuous, about as long as the blades but scarcely wider; blades ligulate, 10-25 mm wide, the outer ones often acute, the inner always rounded and apiculate. Scape suberect to decurved, 1-1.5 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts remote, erect, involute, elliptic, apiculate. Inflorescences mostly branched in the staminate plants, mostly simple in the pistillate or perfect; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, much shorter than to about equaling the naked sterile bases of the axillary branches; spikes divergent, 2-11 cm long, laxly flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, broadly acute or obtuse, much shorter than the sepals, thin, nerved; flowers suberect to spreading, perfect or functionally unisexual and dimorphic (only in Mexico and Central America so far as shown). Sepals asymmetric, broadly elliptic, thin, nerved, the staminate 4.5 mm long, the perfect or pistillate 7-8 mm long; petals lance-ovate, barely exserted, white; stamens unequal; ovary ovoid; style very short. Capsule ovoid, distinctly short-beaked, 12 mm long.

description: Plant flowering to 35 cm high. Leaves few, to 2 dm long; blades ligulate, 4 cm wide, broadly rounded, apiculate. Scape suberect or decurved; scape-bracts shorter than the internodes. Staminate inflorescence compound with 3-5 spikes, these to 8 cm long; pistillate inflorescence simple and dense or with 1 or 2 few-flowered spikes at the base; primary bracts all much shorter than the axillary branches. Floral bracts suberect to spreading, membranaceous, sparsely lepidote, prominently nerved, the staminate sublanceolate, acute, the pistillate ovate-triangular, obtuse, distinctly shorter than the sepals; flowers suberect, dioecious, the staminate slender, the pistillate stout. Sepals subsymmetric, membranaceous, sparsely lepidote prominently nerved, the staminate lanceolate, acute, mucronulate, 15 mm long, the pistillate broadly elliptic, subobtuse, 18 mm long; petals, stamens, and pistil unknown.

description: Stem ± densely covered with unicellular hairs, with sparse to dense covering of glandular-headed hairs and often with long-celled hairs. Leaves (3-) 3.5-14 × 0.5-3(-4) mm; adaxial surface lacking to densely covered with unicellular hairs throughout, with sparse to dense covering of glandular-headed hairs and sometimes a few long-celled hairs. Pedicels very sparsely to densely covered with unicellular hairs, variable in length, thus giving the inflorescence a compact to open appearance. Flowers with calyx lobes 3-6 mm long; abaxial surface moderately to densely (or occasionally only sparsely) covered with unicellular hairs throughout, with a sparse to dense covering of glandular-headed hairs, often also with long-celled hairs. Capsules with or without unicellular hairs.

description: Plants 1-2 m tall. Sheaths glabrous or sparsely minutely puberulous, 5-20 mm in diam. Ligule truncate, 1-9 mm long, sparsely to densely (minutely) puberulous. Petiole 1-10 mm long, sparsely to densely minutely puberulo-velutinous. Leaves narrowly elliptic, shortly acuminate at the apex, acumen to 10 mm long, cuneate to rounded at the base, 12-35 cm long, (4-) 6.5-11 cm wide, upper side glabrous except for the sparsely strigulose costa, lower side glabrous to densely minutely puberulous, costa densely minutely puberulous. Inflorescence ovoid, obtuse or acute, 4.5-12 cm long, 3-7 cm wide, terminating the leafy stem or on a separate, leafless ca 35 cm long shoot, sheaths obliquely truncate, 3-5 cm long, sparsely to densely minutely puberulous. Bracts purplish (according to Ule), coriaceous, broadly ovate-triangular, acute or obtuse, 3.5-6 cm long, 2-3.5 cm wide, densely velutinous, callus 5-11 mm long. Bracteole 2 7-31 (-40) mm long, densely velutinous. Calyx 17-22 mm long, densely velutinous, lobes deltate to triangular, 3-6 mm long. Corolla pink (according to Ule and Pires & Black), 65-100 mm long, tube ca 25 mm long, glabrous, lobes narrowly elliptic, 40-75 mm long, 15-20 mm wide, densely minutely puberulous at the base, densely velutinous towards the (shortly caudate) apex, (acumen 2-5 mm long). Labellum broadly obovate when spread out, 50-75 mm long, 40-50 mm wide. Stamen narrowly elliptic, 45-55 mm long, 15 mm wide, anther 10 mm long. Ovary 5-10 mm long, densely yellowish sericeous. Capsule ellipsoid, 15-17 mm long, densely velutinous, seeds black.

description: Plants 0.5-3 m tall. Sheaths green, tinged with reddish brown, rather densely minutely puberulous to glabrous, 7-12 mm in diam. Ligule truncate, 1-2 mm long, densely minutely puberulous to glabrous. Petiole 2-5 mm long, rather densely to densely puberulo-sericeous. Leaves narrowly elliptic, 12-25 × 3-6 cm, cuneate to rounded at the base, shortly acuminate at the apex, with a subulate point 2-7 mm long, upper side glabrous, lower side densely puberulous to sericeous, very soft to the touch. Inflorescence ovoid to broadly ovoid, 4-7 cm long, 3-5 cm wide. Bracts red to brownish red (5 R 4/12 to 2.5 R 4/10), coriaceous, narrowly ovate-triangular, acute, 25-35 mm long, 10-25 mm wide, rather densely puberulous to glabrous, apex ending in a 2-10 mm long, often pungent point, Bracteole purplish- to brownish-red, 18-20 mm long, sparsely minutely puberulous. Calyx reddish brown to green, 22-25 mm long, sparsely minutely puberulous, exceeding the bracts, bicarinate on the adaxial side, lobes triangular, 5-7(-12) mm long. Corolla white to pinkish white, ca 60 mm long, densely to rather densely minutely sericeous, tube ca 15 mm long, lobes elliptic to obovate, 45-50 mm long, ca 20 mm wide. Labellum white to pinkish white, broadly obovate when spread out, 60-70 mm long, 80-100 mm wide, margins crenate, middle lobe blotched with yellow in the centre. Stamen white to yellowish white, narrowly elliptic to narrowly ovate, 45-50 mm long, 7-15 mm wide, apex obtuse, anther 11 mm long. Ovary 5-10 mm long, sparsely to rather densely sericeous. Capsule not seen. Chromosome number 2n = 18, 27, or 36 (see Cytology).

description: Plants 1-2.5 m tall Sheaths glabrescent, 10-20 mm in diam. Ligule truncate, 2-10 mm long. Petiole 2-12 mm long, rather densely puberulous to glabrous. Leaves narrowly elliptic, rounded (to cordate) at the base, shortly acuminate, 7-33 cm long, 3-5-8.5(-10.5) cm wide, glabrescent on both sides, costa on upper side of leaves often strigulose. Inflorescence ovoid to cylindric, 5-27 cm long, 3-4.5(-6) cm wide. Bracts greenish or reddish in the exposed part, reddish in the covered part, coriaceous, broadly ovate, obtuse, glabrous, margins of the covered part dilacerating into fibers, callus yellow, 5-10 mm long. Bracteole 17-30 mm long, sparsely minutely puberulous to glabrous. Calyx 9-16 mm long, sparsely minutely puberulous to glabrous, lobes shallowly triangular, 2-3 mm long. Corolla yellow to pink, 40-50 mm long, glabrous, tube 10 mm long, lobes narrowly obovate, 30-40 mm long, 10-15 mm wide. Labellum yellow, broadly oblong-obovate when spread out, 25-50 cm long and wide, lateral lobes rolled inwards and forming a slender tube, margins crenulate. Stamen narrowly elliptic, 30-40 mm long, ca 10 mm wide, rounded or obtuse at the apex, anther 7-8 mm long. Pollen size 105-112 µ. Exine 2 µ thick. Porus diam 20 µ. Number of pores 7-8 (Ernst 1689 from Dominica). Ovary 4-9 mm long, sericeous or rarely glabrous. Capsule ellipsoid, 10-15 mm long, sericeous to glabrous, seeds black.

description: Plant caulescent, flowering to 1 m high; stem over 15 cm long, covered with the remnants of old leaves; living leaves erect, 60-75 cm long; sheaths broadly ovate, 4 cm long; blades linear, long-attenuate, not contracted at base, 15 mm wide, coriaceous, glabrous above, densely silvery-lepidote beneath, laxly and obscurely denticulate toward base, revolute with age. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, much exceeding the internodes, entire. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate; primary bracts linear, much shorter than the branches; branches spreading, 17 cm long, slender, laxly flowered, the naked sterile base to 6 cm long. Floral bracts triangular, about half as long as the slender 7 mm pedicels; flowers decurved, subsecund. Sepals broadly elliptic, 4.5 mm long. Capsule ovoid; seeds long-bicaudate.

description: Plant growing in large colonies, flowering 40-56 cm high. Leaves many, rosulate, 24 cm long, entire, coriaceous, very narrowly cartilaginous-margined; sheaths suborbicular, 4 cm long, glabrous, stramineous when dry except for the brown or reddish apex; blades linear-lanceolate, slightly contracted at base, subulate-attenuate at apex, 33 mm wide, appressed-white-lepidote above, glabrous beneath with age. Scape erect, 7 mm in diameter; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, the highest small, about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate; axis straight; primary bracts narrowly triangular, shorter than the branches; branches 4-7 cm long, secund, densely flowered toward apex, the sterile bases long and naked. Floral bracts elliptic, exceeding the stout 5 mm pedicels; flowers more or less secund. Sepals elliptic, 7 mm long; petals obovate, broadly rounded, 14 mm long. Capsule ovoid, castaneous; seeds bicaudate.

description: Plant flowering 1 m high. Leaves 7 dm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, 6 cm long, entire, impressed-punctate, stramineous when dry, glabrous; blades very narrowly triangular, 4 cm wide, coriaceous, glabrous above, densely white-flocculose beneath, laxly serrulate toward base. Scape straight, 15 mm in diameter, white-flocculose; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, erect, densely imbricate, entire. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, pale brown-flocculose; axis straight; primary bracts narrowly triangular, about half as long as the naked flattened 8 cm long sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading, slightly curved-ascending, 21 cm long, dense. Floral bracts triangular, about half as long as the slenderly obconic 5 mm long pedicels; flowers spreading, not at all secund. Sepals broadly elliptic, retuse, 5 mm long, verruculose, entire; petals obtuse, 12 mm long, exceeding the stamens, pale rose. Seeds long-caudate.

description: Plant short-caulescent, flowering to 1.3 m high. Leaves many, 4 dm long; sheaths broadly ovate, 4 cm long, glabrous, castaneous and lustrous toward apex; blades very narrowly triangular, 15 mm wide, pungent, laxly serrulate toward base, entire elsewhere, sparsely white-flocculose beneath, soon glabrous above. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, the highest much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, axis geniculate; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, short; branches suberect, 15 cm long, densely many-flowered. Floral bracts triangular, about half as long as the slenderly obconic 5 mm pedicels; flowers subspreading, not secund. Sepals convolute, broadly ovate, 5 mm long, entire. description: Plant short-caulescent, flowering to 13 cm high. Leaves many; sheaths broadly triangular, 15 mm long, brown with age, lustrous, sparsely white-flocculose above; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, to 10 cm long, 12 mm wide, laxly and obscurely denticulate, glabrous and lustrous above, densely appressed-white-flocculose beneath. Leaves (newest) erect, pale green, densely white-cretaceous, thin, entire; sheaths broadly ovate, 1 cm long; blades narrowly triangular, pungent, 6 cm long, 9 mm wide, flat. Scape none. Inflorescence terminal, hidden in the leaves, corymbose, few-flowered, glabrous. Floral bracts very narrowly triangular, exceeding the 9 mm long pedicels. description: Caudex of sterile plant 1-3 dm long; flowering shoot 1 m or higher. Leaves numerous, bulbous-rosulate, ca 45 cm long; sheaths suborbicular, 7 cm wide, toward base entire, stramineous, and glabrous, toward apex densely serrulate, brown, and densely lepidote above; blades narrowly triangular but the apex obtuse and thickened, 28 mm wide, densely lanate above with pale filamentous-parted scales, glabrous beneath, subdensely serrate at base with broad brown straight or curved spines 1 mm long. Scape erect, about twice as long as the leaves, 8 mm in diameter when dry, glabrous; scape-bracts subfoliaceous but entire, erect, all except the highest exceeding the internodes but not covering much of the scape. Inflorescence amply subtripinnate, pyramidal, 4 dm long, 2 dm in diameter, glabrous; axis nearly straight; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but gradually smaller, 2 or 3 times shorter than the naked sterile bases of the branches; branches simple or slightly divided, subdensely polystichous-flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, about equaling the stout 2-3 mm long pedicels; flowers spreading. Sepals broadly ovate, 3.5 mm long, entire, few-nerved; style slender; ovary slightly inferior, placentae extending the full height of the locule. Seeds caudate.

description: Plant probably stemless, flowering 1 m high. Leaves 6 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 4 cm long, white-cretaceous; blades very narrowly triangular, long-attenuate, 2 cm wide, glabrous, entire except for the laxly and minutely serrate extreme base. Scape erect, shorter than the leaves; scape-bracts subfoliaceous but entire throughout, erect, large, much exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence laxly and amply bipinnate, 6 dm long, subdensely vestite with microscopic glanduliform ferruginous scales; axis slightly flexuous; primary bracts very narrowly triangular, much shorter than the branches; branches spreading, to 25 cm long, slender, subdensely polystichous-flowered. Floral bracts linear, obtuse, about equaling or slightly exceeding the pedicels, thin, red; pedicels spreading, slender, 3.5 mm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 4 mm long, entire, thin, reddish; petals spatulate, obtuse, 12 mm long, white; stamens probably about equaling the petals, second series of filaments short-connate with the petals; ovary fusiform, style slender, placentae extending the length of the locule. Seeds caudate.

Floral bracts narrowly triangular, to 7 mm long, exceeding the pedicels, obscurely serrulate; pedicels rather stout, 3 mm long; flowers spreading, not secund. description: Plant stemless. Leaves very many; sheaths broadly ovate, ca 3 cm long, forming a globose bulb, castaneous toward apex; blades linear, long-attenuate, not contracted at base, 6 dm long, much exceeding the inflorescence, 10 mm wide at base, entire, subcoriaceous, glabrous and green above, covered beneath with appressed silvery scales. description: Plant stemless, flowering 3-4 dm high. Leaves very many, 15 cm long, the lowest marcescent and castaneous; sheaths broadly ovate, 15 mm long, the young ones stramineous when dry; blades very narrowly triangular, pungent, 7 mm wide, subdensely serrulate, glabrous above, white-flocculose beneath and on the margin, soon glabrous beneath. Inflorescence subsimple, 9-12 cm long, narrow, lax, vestite with minute linear white scales; primary bracts linear, small; branches very short, fasciculately few-flowered. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, shorter than or exceeding the stout 3 mm pedicels. Sepals very broadly elliptic, broadly convex, 5 mm long, entire, verruculose with age; petals yellow, 9-11 mm long, exceeding the stamens, the claw very short, the blade suborbicular. description: Plant flowering 5-10 dm high. Leaves to 32 cm long; sheaths imperfectly known, apparently suborbicular, ca 4 cm in diameter, stramineous, lustrous, sparsely and obscurely lepidote; blades very narrowly triangular, attenuate, pungent, 2 cm wide, very densely appressed-silvery-lepidote beneath, glabrous above, entire near apex, elsewhere laxly serrate with antrorse and retrorse spines 2 mm long. Scape erect, 6 mm in diameter, sulcate, densely vestite with minute linear whitish scales; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, much exceeding the internodes but hiding very little of the scape, the lowest obscurely serrulate. Inflorescence bipinnate, narrowly thyrsoid, dense, 35 cm long, 5 cm in diameter, except for the petals densely vestite with spreading minute linear white scales; primary bracts linear, exceeding the lowest branches; branches divergent, 25 mm long, flowering nearly to base, not at all secund. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, much shorter than the stoutish 3 mm long pedicels. Leaves many, aggregated at the ends of the branches, entire; sheaths suborbicular, 2 cm in diameter, densely nerved, yellow-brown when dry; blades very narrowly triangular, 2 dm long, 15 mm wide, conspicuously cartilaginous-margined. Scape erect, very slender, glabrous, exceeding the leaves; scape-bracts very narrowly triangular, erect, the highest distinctly shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, glabrous; axis straight; primary bracts triangular, exceeding the 15 mm long few-flowered (young) branches. description: Plant caulescent, flowering 55 cm high. Leaves to 45 cm long, sheaths elliptic, small, scarcely distinct, laxly serrate and minutely lepidote, blades linear, attenuate, 14 mm wide, flat, glabrous and entire except for the extreme base. Scape erect or ascending, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts strict, subfoliaceous, large and much exceeding the internodes but not hiding much of the scape, entire. Floral bracts elliptic, barely 2 mm long, membranaceous; pedicels divergent, very slender, 10-15 mm long. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 3 mm long, entire; petals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 7 mm long, white, slightly exceeding the stamens; ovary pyramidal; style short; seeds long-caudate.

description: Shrub or tree generally 2.0-5.0, rarely up to 12.0 m high; trunk up to 30.0 cm diam. Branchlets usually glabrous, rarely set with scattered appressed maybe hirsutulous hairs at tips, brownish, older parts sparsely lenticellate. Leaves generally persistent, though semideciduous in seasonal forest, oblong or elliptic to lanceolate or elliptic-oblong, sometimes lanceolate-elliptic, apex short- or long-, rarely subcaudate-acuminate, tip acute or often bluntish, base cuneate to almost rounded, firmly membranaceous or chartaceous, rarely subcoriaceous (or even coriaceous in savannahs or savannah/forest border), immature ones sometimes substrigose-hairy as are the stipules, mature ones generally glabrous, though sparse short appressed hairs may occur on midrib and lateral nerves, very rarely also on the intervenium beneath, subserrulate or undulate, usually subentire, (6.0-)7.0-12.0 (rarely -20.0) cm long, (2.5-)3.0-4.0 (-7.0, rarely -9.0) cm broad, lateral nerves (3-)4-6 pairs, generally flat above, prominent beneath, veins transverse and slightly raised on both faces or more distinctly so beneath, reticulation of veinlets lax and rather obscure in general; petiole 5.0-9.0(-12.0) mm long; stipules lanceolate-linear, 8.0—9.0 mm long, 1.5 mm broad at base, subpersistent. Spikes (3-)8-12 per axil, 0.6-1..8 (very rarely in part in the same axil or on the same specimen up to 3.0, occasionally even up to 5.0) cm long, 1.2-2.0 mm diam at full anthesis; rhachis hairy. Flowers white to cream, fragrant, their subtending bract ovate-deltoid, thickened below, apiculate, either covering or not covering the sepals. Sepals usually 4, occasionally 1, 3, or 6, narrowly ovate to lanceolate, sometimes subspathulate. Disk variable in shape and size, usually membranous, rarely rather fleshy, reddish, cup-shaped, entire or undulate, rarely 4-lobulate. Ovary glabrous; style practically 0; stigmas 3, sessile. Capsule bacciform, obovoid-ellipsoid, generally contracted at base or substipitate for 1.0-3.0 mm, red to brown, 6.0-8.0 (-10.0) mm long; seed 1, brown-black, ca 6.0 mm long, with white aril.

description: Shrub or tree, 2.0-7.5 m high. Branchlets slender, tips strigose. Leaves elliptic to obovate-oblong or -elliptic, apex for ca 1.5 cm cuspidate-acuminate, subacute, base cuneate to rounded, pubescent with ascending or spreading hairs beneath along midrib and lateral nerves, sparsely minutely strigose or glabrous between them, remotely and obscurely serrulate or subentire, 8.0-12.0 cm long, 2.5-5.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 6 pairs, ascending, prominent on both faces, veins transverse, dense, slightly raised on both faces, reticulation of veinlets rather obscure; petiole slender, strigillose, 3.0-8.0 mm long; stipules lance-triangular, 1.5-2.0 mm long, caducous. Racemes solitary, or 2-3 clustered in the upper leaf axils, slender, rather loosely flowered, hispidulous-strigillose, (2.0-)3.5-6.5(-11.0) cm long; pedicels articulate at base, glabrous, 1.0-2.0 mm long; bracts and bracteoles ca 0.8 mm long. description: Plant caulescent or rarely stemless, flowering to 2 dm high. description: Plant usually stemless, barely 10 cm high. Branchlets 5 cm below terminal bud 1.2-2(-3) mm in diam., initially slightly angular/flattened, or roundish from the beginning, with ± short, appressed hairs, usually moderately dense to dense immediately below the terminal bud (very rarely sparse from the beginning), staying moderately dense or becoming sparse; terminal buds conical to elongate, often minute, rarely up to ca. 6 mm long and 1 mm thick, frequently sprouting during anthesis, with a dense cover of moderately short (up to 0.3 mm), straight, appressed, light brownish hairs. Petioles 6-20 mm long, 0.9-2 mm thick, ± roundish below, ± flat to ± canaliculate above, indument below ± as on twigs, slightly denser above, glabrescent. Leaves alternate, ± narrowly lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, widest 1/4 from the base to ± at the middle, (6.5-) 10-21 cm long, (1.3-)1.8-4.5 cm wide, (3-)4-5.8(-7) times longer than wide, at the tip tapering towards a usually long and fine acumen, base (narrowly) acute to attenuate, margin flat or very narrowly bent down, midrib flat to slightly convex and/or slightly impressed above, prominent below, secondary veins level to very slightly raised above, raised to slightly prominent below, 5-9(-11) pairs, diverging at 30-45(-55)°, in mid-lamina running at an angle of 15-25(-35)° to the midrib, often scarcely visible above, tertiary venation mostly ± scalariform, usually very inconspicuous, ± level, or very slightly raised below. Indument consisting of ± short, appressed hairs, occasionally some up to 0.3 mm long, often rather inconspicuous, initally moderately dense to glabrous above except for the midrib, ± slowly glabrescent, dense to intermediate and scarcely visible below, usually sparser on veins, staying dense or subglabrescent, axils of secondary veins not rarely with slightly longer hairs (0.2-0.4 mm) surrounding a glabrous spot. Gland dots sometimes moderately distinct on upper surface of young leaves, in mature leaves usually not visible. Inflorescences in the axils of foliage leaves, 0.5-1.1 mm in diam. at the base, on a twig of 1-3 mm diam., 1.5-5 cm long, reaching less than 1/10 to ca. 1/2 the length of the subtending leaf; peduncle 0.3-2.7 cm long, i.e., ca. 1/5-1/2 the length of the inflorescence, lateral branches (0-)2-4 below terminal cyme (rarely a terminal cluster), branched (0-)l-4 times, indument consisting of short, ± appressed hairs, very sparse to moderately dense. Pedicels (0.7-)l.5-4.5 mm long, 0.3-0.5 mm thick. Flowers ca. 4.5-7 (-8.5) mm in diam., tepals ± elliptic, ca. 1.7-3 (-3.6) mm long, ca. 1.2-2 mm wide, covered with sometimes fine but always distinct papillae on the inside surface. Staminodes clavate, reaching ca. 1/2-2/3 the length of the stamens, for more than half of their length united with the filaments of the inner stamens, their apical part papillose on abaxial side and glandular on adaxial side. Pistil ca. 1.5-1.9 mm long, glabrous, ovary ± ellipsoid, style slightly to distinctly longer than the ovary. Receptacle urceolate (incl. the united part of the stamens and staminodes), glabrous inside. Berry very elongate, ca. 16-24 mm long, ca. 6-7.5 mm in diam., cupule campanulate, or deeply cup-shaped with a slightly widened rim, ca. 6-7 mm high and ca. 7-9 mm in diam., pedicel slightly thickened towards the cupule.

description: Trees to 30 m. Branchlets 5 cm below terminal bud ca. 2-3(-4) mm in diam., initially ± distinctly angular, with ± short, ± appressed, white hairs, initially dense to moderately sparse, quickly becoming sparser, older twigs rugose, greyish, glabrous; terminal buds elongate, 2.58 mm long, ca. 1-2 mm thick, densely white-sericeous. Petioles 10-27 mm long, 0.9-2.5 mm thick, shape variable, flattened to rolled, irregularly roundish below, ± flat to canaliculate above or somewhat ridged on both sides, with an indument ± as on twigs, denser above. Leaves alternate, (ob-)lanceolate to lanceolate-oblong or lanceolate-elliptic, widest ± at the middle (more frequently slightly above the middle), 8-18 (-27) cm long, 2.2-5.5(-10.5) cm wide (size in parentheses found in sterile material only!), (2.2)2.6-4(-4.6) times longer than wide, tip short acuminate, base attenuate to acute, margin flat to very narrowly recurved at the base, midrib with the center impressed and the sides slightly raised above, prominent below, secondary veins distinctly raised to prominent on both sides, 5-8 (-10) pairs, diverging at 35-55°, in mid-lamina running at an angle of 20-35(-50)° to the midrib, tertiary venation mixed, proportion of ± scalariform venation variable, finer reticulation almost equally distinct, distinctly raised on both sides. Indument consisting of ± short (up to ca. 0.3 mm), rather straight, white, appressed hairs, in young leaves moderately sparse to subglabrous on both sides, somewhat denser on midrib, glabrescent above, ± subglabrescent below, the axils of lower lateral veins usually with erect hairs. Gland dots scarcely visible to distinct above. Inflorescences axillary, sometimes not from axils of the most distal leaves, rarely from the axils of cataphylls at the base of the new growth, ca. 1-2 mm in diam. at the base, on a twig of 1.4-3.2 mm diam., 8-18 cm long, slightly shorter to slightly longer than their subtending leaf; peduncle 5-12 cm long, i.e., ca. 1/2-3/4 the length of the inflorescence, subglabrous or with some white hairs, lateral branches 0-4(-6) below terminal cluster of cymes, branched 1-2(-3) times, with a moderate to dense, white indument on terminal branches and flowers. Pedicels 3-8 (-10) mm long, 0.4-0.8 mm thick. Flowers 1117 mm in diam., tepals broadly elliptic, ca. 4.5-6.5 mm long and ca. 3-5.5 mm wide, densely papillose on the inside surface but also hairy at the base. Stamens (Fig. 6D) ca. 1.8-2.5 mm long including the hairy filament of 0.3-0.6 mm, anthers in dried material red, scarcely papillose, in all three whorls roundish-rectangular to trapeziform, ± truncate or often slightly emarginate at the tip. Staminodes very large, reaching ca. 3/4 the length of the stamens, with a hairy filament and a large sagittate glandular head. Pistil ca. 1.8-2 mm long, ovary subglobose to ovoid, glabrous, style reaching 1/2 to 2/3 the length of the ovary. Receptacle very shallow to hemispherical, glabrous or with a few hairs inside. Berry ellipsoid to slightly obovate, ca. 14-22 mm long and 12-16 mm in diam., cupule a thick, shallow bowl, distinctly longitudinally ridged, ca. 11-13 mm in diam. and ca. 5 mm high (much shallower inside).

description: Trees to 30 m (but mostly collected from much smaller individuals), rarely tall shrubs. Branchlets 5 cm below terminal bud 1.8-3.8 mm in diam., initially irregularly angular/furrowed but without sharp angles, with a dense, ± grey-brown cover of very short, ± appressed hairs (or hairs erect but so short as to be papillae-like), plus occasionally a few longer hairs, older twigs becoming roundish, the indument ± persistent as a grey cover, slowly wearing off; terminal buds narrowly lanceolate to rarely ovoid, (3-)4-7 mm long and 1-3 mm thick, densely covered with short, appressed, (grey-)brown hairs. Petioles (7-)9-17(-21) mm long, l.l-2.5(3.8) mm thick, roundish below, often longitudinally ridged, almost flat to distinctly canaliculate above, indument ± as on twigs, more persistent above than below. Leaves alternate, ± elliptic to lanceolate-elliptic, less often ovate-elliptic or lanceolate, widest at the middle or slightly below, (8-)12-23(-36) cm long, 3.3-10(-11.5) cm wide, (2-)2.3-3.5(-4.8) times longer than wide, tip acuminate, base broadly attenuate to obtuse, margin at the base usually narrowly bent down to narrowly recurved, rarely flat or almost rolled, midrib ± impressed above, distinctly prominent below, secondary veins level to slightly impressed above, sometimes convex, prominent below, (4-)5-7(-9) pairs, diverging at 35-50(-60)°, in midlamina running at an angle of 15-35° to the midrib, tertiary venation finely scalariform, sometimes inconspicuous, level to very slightly raised above, ± raised below. Indument consisting of short, ± appressed hairs, initially moderately sparse to (often) dense above, often ± curled when dense, more tightly appressed below, moderately sparse to moderately dense, less dense than above, hairs ± pointing towards the leaf tip, the axils of some of the secondary veins mostly with dense tufts of ± straight, ± thick, erect hairs (but see discussion), older leaves glabrescent above, indument becoming ± sparse below. Gland dots invisible to distinct above. Inflorescences in the axils of foliage leaves, 0.8-2 mm in diam. at the base, on a twig of 2-4 mm diam., (2.5-)4-11(-15) cm long, reaching ca. 1/3 to slightly more than the length of the subtending leaf; peduncle (1.5-)2-6 cm long, reaching ca. 2/5-2/3 the length of the inflorescence, lateral branches 0-2(-6) below the terminal cluster of cymes, branched 2-3(-5) times, indument ± as on twigs, slightly less appressed, ± dense. Pedicels l-2.5(-6.5) mm long, 0.3-0.6 mm thick. Flowers 5.5-8(-9) mm in diam., tepals ± elliptic, 2-3.5 mm long and 1.2-2.4 mm wide, heavily papillose on the inside surface. Stamens (Fig. 6P) ca. 0.7-1.2 mm long including a filament of 0.10.3 mm, anthers heavily papillose, in the first whorl broadly pentagonal to transverse elliptic with an obtuse to rounded tip, in the second whorl ± pentagonal with an acute to obtuse tip, in the third whorl obtrapeziform to axe-shaped with a ± truncate or slightly emarginate tip. Staminodes ca. half as long as the stamens, capitate, mostly with a glandular patch at the tip, for more than half of their length united with the inner stamens. Pistil ca. 1.7-2.1 mm long, ovary ± ellipsoid, glabrous, style ± as long as the ovary (1/3 shorter to 1/3 longer), usually ± papillose, rarely glabrous. Receptacle deeply urceolate, glabrous inside (but see discussion). Berry ellipsoid, ca. 13-17 mm long, ca. 8-9 mm in diam., cupule subglobose when young, ± hemispherical when mature, ca. 6.5-9 mm high and ca. 9-12 mm in diam., pedicel scarcely thickened.

description: Shrubs or mostly small trees, rarely exceeding 10 m height (largest trees ca. 18 m tall; already flowering when only ca. 1 m tall). Branchlets 5 cm below terminal bud ca. 1-2.5(-3) mm in diam., initially ± irregularly ridged, later becoming ± roundish, either glabrous from the beginning or mostly with ± short (up to 0.2 mm), ± appressed hairs, moderately dense or sparser immediately below terminal bud, very quickly (sub)glabrescent; terminal buds narrowly elongate, minute or up to 8 mm long and ca. 1.2 mm thick, mostly ± covered with ± short, appressed, white hairs, rarely glabrous. Petioles 4-l2(-l6) mm long, 0.8-2 mm thick, irregularly ridged to roundish below, ± flat to narrowly canaliculate above, glabrous or initially with some short, appressed hairs below. Leaves alternate, lanceolate to elliptic or ovate, widest 1/3-1/2 from the base, (4-)5.5-14.5(-17.5) cm long, (1.2-)1.7-6(-7) cm wide, (1.7-)1.9-4(-4.5) times longer than wide, tip ± acuminate (occasionally rather indistinct), base attenuate to obtuse, rarely rounded, margin flat to minutely recurved, midrib above almost flat to strongly convex, occasionally in a slight impression, at the base sometimes concave or with a central furrow, broadly convex to prominent below, secondary veins above ± raised to almost prominent, rarely almost level, slightly raised to slightly prominent below, (4-)5-8(-9) pairs (often inconspicuous), diverging at (30-) 45-65(-70)°, in mid-lamina running at an angle of (20-)25-60(-70)° to the midrib, tertiary venation mixed, ± reticulate, sometimes predominantly lineate, on both sides distinctly raised to level. Indument either absent or consisting of a few short appressed hairs on the lower surface, quickly (sub)glabrescent, axils of secondary veins mostly glabrous, rarely (in Puerto Rico often) with short or moderately long (up to ca. 0.6 mm), ± erect hairs. Gland dots in mature leaves not visible to distinct. Inflorescences in the axils of cataphylls, usually crowded below the terminal bud and on axillary brachyblasts, occasionally at the base of the new growth when the vegetative buds are sprouting during anthesis (if apparently in the axils of foliage leaves, then with several cataphylls at their base), ca. 0.4-1(-1.5) mm in diam. at the base, on a twig of 0.9-2.2 mm diam., 1.5-10(-12) cm long, reaching ca. 1/4 the length of the closest foliage leaf to slightly more than its length; peduncle extremely short or up to 5 cm long, i.e., up to 2/3 the length of the inflorescence, lateral branches (0-)2-6(-9) below the terminal cyme, branched 0-2(-3) times (very small inflorescences often botryoid), indument consisting of ± short, appressed to ± ascending hairs, moderately sparse to absent, on pedicels and receptacle occasionally up to moderately dense. Pedicels 1-5.5(-10) mm long, 0.2-0.5 mm thick. Flowers 4-8(-10) mm in diam., tepals ± elongate, ca. (1.5-)2-4(-5) mm long and ca. (0.7-)0.9-2 mm wide, ± densely covered with fine, long papillae on the inside surface, towards the base also hairy. Stamens ca. 0.5-0.8 mm long including a hairy filament of 0.1-0.3 mm, anthers sometimes papillose at the tip, often with hairs and/or papillae on back side, in the outer whorls ± transverse-elliptic to roundish-squarish, broadly rounded to slightly emarginate at the tip, in the third whorl roundish-rectangular to almost hexagonal or trapeziform, ± truncate to slightly emarginate at the tip. Staminodes reaching ca. 1/2-2/3 the length of the stamens, with a ± hairy filament and a mostly distinct glandular head. Pistil ca. 1-1.3 mm long, glabrous, ovary ± ellipsoid to pyriform, style very short, reaching not more than 1/3 of length of the ovary. Receptacle shallowly bowl-shaped, glabrous or with some hairs inside. Berry ± ellipsoid, ca. 9-18 mm long and 7-11 mm in diam., cupule variable, shallowly bowl-shaped, trumpet-shaped, obconical, or knob-like, occasionally slightly lobed, up to 4 mm high and ca. 4-7 mm in diam., pedicel scarcely thickened to swollen and gradually merging into the cupule.

description: Trees to 12 m (but mostly collected from much smaller individuals). Branchlets 5 cm below terminal bud 2-6 mm in diam., ± distinctly irregularly angular, the younger parts covered with a dense, ± reddish-brown indument of very short and (fewer) longer (ca. 0.2-0.7 mm), almost straight to curled, ± erect hairs, becoming felted and greyish on older twigs, very slowly wearing off; terminal buds ± ovate to elongate, 6-14 mm long, 2.5-5.5 mm thick, densely covered with reddish-brown hairs. Petioles (6-)8-18(-24) mm long, 1.7-4 mm thick, in young leaves often flattened with prominent midrib and decurrent margin below, later irregularly roundish or irregularly triangular below, ± ridged, flat to shallowly canaliculate with ridges along the central furrow above, indument as on twigs. Leaves alternate, lanceolate to oblong-elliptic, less often ovate or elliptic, widest ca. 1/3 from the base to ± at the middle, (6.5-)9-25 cm long, (2.5-)3.5-8(-11) cm wide, (1.8-)2.2-4 times longer than wide, tip acuminate, base attenuate to obtuse, margin at the base distinctly recurved to almost rolled, but recurved lobes less than 3 mm wide, midrib and secondary veins slightly to deeply impressed above, sometimes slightly convex, very prominent below, secondary veins (5-) 7-10(-12) pairs, diverging at 40-65°, in midlamina running at an angle of 20-45° to the midrib, tertiary venation scalariform, level to distinctly impressed above, distinctly raised to prominent below, finer veinlets usually also clearly raised below. Indument usually consisting of short, ± pale, irregularly ± appressed or strongly curled hairs, and longer (up to 0.8 mm), ± erect, curled, reddish hairs, in variable proportion and mostly intergrading, in young leaves the shorter hairs usually ± sparse to absent above, rarely up to moderately dense, the longer hairs moderately sparse to moderately dense, on veins denser and often less curled, the shorter hairs initially dense below, covering the epidermis completely, the longer hairs moderately dense to moderately sparse, denser on veins, older leaves glabrescent above, indument often subpersistent below, sometimes finally becoming sparse. Gland dots mostly not visible. Inflorescences in the axils of leaves on young growth, 1.3-2.3 mm in diam. at the base, on a twig of 2-4 mm diam., 4-12 (-15) cm long, reaching ca. 1/4 to slightly more than the length of the subtending leaf; peduncle 2-4.5(-6) cm long, i.e., 1/3 to 3/5 the length of the inflorescence (usually ca. 1/2), lateral branches (0-)2-6 below terminal cyme or cluster of cymes, branched 1-3 times, occasionally not entirely cymose, indument usually ± as on twigs, very dense. Pedicels extremely short or up to 3.5 mm long, 0.8-1.2 mm thick. Flowers (6-)8-12 mm in diam., tepals ± elliptic, (2.3-)3-5 mm long and (1.7-)2.5-4 mm wide, papillosity ± dense and (moderately) thick on the inside surface, sometimes fully developed only in basal triangle on outer tepals. Stamens ca. 1.3-2.4 mm long including the (very) short but usually distinct filament, anthers heavily papillose, in the first whorl pentagonal, ± ovate or trullate, with an acute to obtuse tip, in the second whorl ± trullate with an acute to parabolic tip, in the third whorl ± elongate-pentagonal to obtrapeziform with an acute to truncate tip. Staminodes thickish, reaching ca. 1/3 to 1/2 the length of the stamens, papillose and often hairy on abaxial side, mostly with a small glandular patch on adaxial side, united with the inner stamens at the base. Pistil ca. 1.8-2.9 mm long, ovary ellipsoid to spherical, glabrous, style ± as long as the ovary or often slightly longer, papillose or glabrous, rarely with a few hairs. Receptacle ± cup-shaped, largely closed by the bases of stamens and staminodes above, glabrous to ± hairy inside (only the receptacular tube, not the bases of stamens and staminodes). Berry ellipsoid, ca. 14-18 mm long, ca. 8-10 mm in diam., cupule deeply cup-shaped, 5-8 mm high, 10-13 mm in diam., pedicel slightly but increasingly thickened.

description: Trees to 20 m tall. Branchlets 5 cm below terminal bud ca. 2-5.5 mm in diam., initially ± distinctly angular, with ± short (rarely reaching up to 0.4 mm), ± appressed, mostly brownish hairs, moderately dense to dense below terminal bud, usually ± quickly becoming ± sparse, rarely persistent for some time, older twigs glabrous, roundish, mostly longitudinally ridged and ± lenticellate; terminal buds elongate, 3.5-11.5 mm long, ca. 1-2.5 mm thick, densely covered with ± short, appressed, hairs. Petioles 8-24 mm long, 1.2-3 mm thick, ± irregularly roundish below, slightly convex to (mostly) ± canaliculate above, indument! as on twigs, usually denser above, sparser below, glabrescent. Leaves alternate, elliptic to lanceolate-elliptic, widest ± at the middle, (8-)l 1-24 cm long, (3.5-)5-10 cm wide, 1.7-2.8(-3.2) times longer than wide, tip with a usually short acumen, base broadly attenuate to (mostly) obtuse, margin flat to minutely recurved, midrib above ± convex, mostly in a slight impression, at the base flat or sometimes even concave, broadly convex to prominent below, secondary veins above convex to prominent, often in a slight impression, ± prominent below, (4-)5-7 pairs, diverging at 30-50(-60)°, in mid-lamina running at an angle of (almost 0-)15-35(-45)° to the midrib, tertiary venation mixed, proportion of the percurrent (or sometimes scalariform) part variable, finer reticulation almost equally distinct, usually on both sides distinctly raised to almost prominent, rarely almost level above. Indument consisting of i short (rarely reaching ca. 0.4 mm), appressed hairs, in young leaves sparse to only on midrib above, moderately sparse to very sparse below, ± quickly glabrescent above, becoming sparse to subglabrous below, axils of secondary veins nearly always bearded with long (up to ca. 1.2 mm), ± erect hairs, rarely also along midrib or in higher-order axils. Gland dots in mature leaves scarcely if at all visible, in young leaves sometimes moderately distinct Inflorescences in the axils of foliage leaves as well as in the axils of cataphylls at the base of the new growth or below the terminal bud, ca. 0.9-2.2 mm in diam. at the base, on a twig of 1.3-4 mm diam., 3.520 cm long, reaching ca. 1/3 the length of the closest foliage leaf to ca. 1.5 times its length; peduncle 0.5-8 cm long, i.e., less than 1/10 to ca. half the length of the inflorescence, lateral branches 2-8(-14) below the terminal cyme, branched (l-)2-3(-4) times, indument consisting of short, appressed to ascending hairs, on peduncle moderately sparse to absent, on flowers sparse to moderately dense but still relatively inconspicuous. Pedicels 1-3.5(-5) mm long, 0.30.6 mm thick. Flowers 4.3-5.6(-7) mm in diam., tepals elliptic to elongate, ca. 1.6-2.1(-2.7) mm long and ca. 1-1.4(-1.7) mm wide, with a moderately dense to dense cover of short or long papillae on the inside surface, also with hairs, especially towards the base. Stamens ca. 1-1.4 mm long including a hairy filament of 0.30.5 mm, anthers often slightly papillose at the tip, occasionally with a few hairs on abaxial side, in all three whorls ± roundish-rectangular to roundish-trapeziform, in the two outer ones very broadly obtuse to truncate at the tip, in the third whorl truncate to slightly emarginate. Staminodes reaching ca. 2/5-3/5 the length of the stamens, with a relatively thick, hairy filament and a glandular head. Berry subglobose to (obovate-)ellipsoid, ca. 20-31 mm long and 17-27 mm in diam., cupule almost disk-like, often ± undulate (shallowly bowl-shaped to funnelshaped when young), ca. 7-12 mm in diam., pedicel slightly to clearly thickened but not swollen.

description: Shrubs or trees, up to 35 m tall (but already flowering when only 2.5 m tall; in the Antilles rarely reaching 20 m). Branchlets 5 cm below terminal bud l.l-3(-4.5) mm in diam., ± slightly angular, usually quickly becoming roundish, with ± short, appressed hairs if any (in Mexico p.p. very short, erect hairs), immediately below terminal bud (sub)glabrous to dense, quickly becoming sparser, usually soon glabrescent; terminal buds narrowly conical to elongate, 1.5-7 mm long and 0.5-2.5 mm thick (very often lacking in herbarium material), densely covered with ± short, appressed hairs (rarely only their apical part). Petioles 4-18(-23) mm long, 0.8-2.5 mm thick, ± irregularly roundish below, mostly ± canaliculate above, less often flat or even slightly convex, mostly flattened in young leaves, indument below ± as on twigs, often glabrous above, ± quickly glabrescent. Leaves alternate, most frequently elliptic to lanceolate, sometimes oblong or ovate, widest 1/3-3/5 from the base, mostly ± at the middle, (3.5-)6-22(-25) cm long, (1.9-)2.5-6.5(-8.5) cm wide, (1.5-)2-4.3(-5.8) times longer than wide, tip usually ± acuminate, acumen moderately long to rarely absent (then tip acute to obtuse), the very tip usually blunt, base attenuate to obtuse, margin flat to narrowly bent down, rarely very slightly recurved, midrib above slightly impressed, flat, or mostly ± convex, sometimes in a slight impression, distinctly raised to prominent below, secondary veins flat to ± convex above, sometimes in a slight impression, slightly raised to prominent below, (2-)4-7(-9) pairs, diverging at 2060°, in mid-lamina running at an angle of 15-40(-50)° to the midrib, tertiary venation usually mixed, rather variable, occasionally almost scalariform, often with relatively indistinct intersecondaries, ± level to raised on both sides (below usually more raised than above), especially in the Antilles often very inconspicuous. Indument consisting of ± short, appressed hairs, moderately sparse on both sides to (below almost) glabrous from the beginning, (subglabrescent, axils of secondary veins on lower leaf surface variable, either without special structures or with ± erect hairs or variously developed pit domatia (Fig. 4B; see discussion). Gland dots invisible to distinct, especially below often like a string of pearls on the veins (at 25x). Inflorescences in the axils of cataphylls at the base of the new growth or on an axillary brachyblast, less often below the terminal bud, often also (rarely exclusively) in the axils of foliage leaves, sometimes pseudoterminal and/or frond(ul)ose, not rarely branched from the base, 0.5-2(-2.4) mm in diam. at the base, on a twig of 0.9-4 mm diam., 2-15 (-21) cm long (frondose inflorescences sometimes larger), reaching ca. 1/4 of the length to ca. 50% more than the length of the closest foliage leaves; peduncle extremely short or up to 7 (-10) cm long, i.e., almost absent to reaching 4/5 the length of the inflorescence, lateral branches 0-6(-8) below terminal cyme or cluster of cymes, branched (0-)1-4 times, indument consisting of short, appressed to ± erect hairs, moderately sparse to glabrous, rarely up to moderately dense on receptacle. Pedicels 1-4.5(-8.5) mm long, 0.3-0.6 mm thick. Flowers (3.3-)4-7(-8.3) mm in diam., tepals ± elliptic to elongate, (1.2-)1.8-2.5(-3.3) mm long and 0.9-1.7(-2.3) mm wide, papillosity ± dense on the inside surface, on outer tepals sometimes absent from the margin. Staminodes reaching ca. 1/3-1/2 the length of the stamens, mostly slightly clavate, often with a glandular patch at the tip on adaxial side, free to completely united with the glands. Receptacle bowl-shaped to ellipsoid, often somewhat closed above by the bases of stamens and staminodes, glabrous inside. Berry ellipsoid, ca. 10-20 mm long, ca. 6-12 mm in diam., cupule bowl-shaped to deeply cup-shaped, mostly conspicuously lenticellate, ca. 3-7 mm high and ca. 7-12 mm in diam., pedicel ± slightly but increasingly thickened towards the cupule.

description: Small or medium-sized trees. Leafy twigs 4-12 mm thick, brownish, whitish to yellowish appressed-pubescent. Leaves lanceolate (to oblong), sometimes broadest near the upper end, 24-56 cm long, 7-11 cm broad, coriaceous, (abruptly) acuminate, acute to obtuse at the base, glabrous above, beneath also glabrous except for the pubescent costa; the costa and the proximal parts of the secondary veins prominent, otherwise the venation nearly plane to slightly impressed above, veins prominent beneath, 18-26 pairs of secondary veins; petioles 13-3o(-45) mm long, broadly canaliculate; stipules 15-30 mm long, whitish appressed-pubescent. Staminate inflorescences 10-15 mm diameter; peduncle 4-8 mm long, puberulous, bracteate; involucre with ca 25-35, deltoid to ovate acute to obtuse, (rather) densely whitish appressed-pubescent bracts in 7-8 series; perianth 2-3 mm high, with 4-6 free tepals; stamens 3-4, anthers 1.0-1.3 mm long, 0.4-0.6 mm broad. Pistillate inflorescences 1.5-3.5 cm in diameter, subsessile to pedunculate; peduncle up to 8 mm long; involucre with ca 25-40 deltoid to ovate to subovate, obtuse to acuminate to acute, (rather) densely whitish appressed-pubescent bracts in 5-10 series; flowers at least 30; tepals 4-6, free or basally connate, subulate or oblong to lanceolate and flattened, 3-8 mm long, puberulous; style 1-2.5 mm long, stigmas 20-25 mm long, vittiform; pseudobracts similar to the tepals, free or basally connate. Infructescences 3.5-4.5 cm (or more?) in diameter; tepals and pseudobracts more or less spine-like, 8-13 mm long, acute to obtuse, narrowed at the base, straight or slightly curved. Flowering from August to February.

description: Trees up to 20 m tall; latex very bitter. Leafy twigs (5-)7-12 mm thick, greyish to brownish, yellowish puberulous, periderm irregularly wrinkled, peeling off in very small flakes. Leaves lanceolate to oblong, often broadest near the upper end, 20-60 cm long, 7-18 cm broad, coriaceous to subcoriaceous, acuminate, acute to obtuse to emarginate to cordate at the base, glabrous or nearly so; the costa and (the proximal parts of) the secondary veins prominent, otherwise the venation nearly plane above, veins prominent beneath, secondary veins, (21-)26-35 pairs, mostly distinctly loop-connected, petioles 5-20 mm long; stipules (10-)20-35 mm long, coriaceous, puberulous at the base, curved, mostly subpersistent. Staminate inflorescences up to 8 together, 2-5 mm in diameter, including the indistinct, bracteate peduncle 5-12 mm high; receptacle more or less cup-shaped; involucre with 15-25 deltoid to suborbiculate to ovate to oblong to lanceolate, obtuse, sparsely puberulous bracts in 6-10 series; flowers 10 or more, basally connate; perianth 2-5 mm high, 4-6-lobed to 4-6-fid, glabrous; stamens 1-2, filaments 3-6 mm long, anthers 0.5-0.9 mm long, 0.2-0.3 mm broad, connectives narrow. Pistillate inflorescences solitary or occasionally accompanied by staminate ones, 7-12 mm in diameter, sessile or subsessile; involucre with ca 20-30 reniform to deltoid to ovate to lanceolate, acute, acuminate, or obtuse, sparsely puberulous bracts in (4-)6-8 series; flowers ca 20-30; tepals free, subulate to spine-like, 5-7 mm long, acute, puberulous; style 1-3.5 mm long, stigmas vittiform, 2-4.5 mm long; pseudobracts similar to the tepals, 2-7 mm long. Infructescences 5-7 cm in diameter; tepals and pseudobracts up to 2.5 cm long, up to 4 mm thick, spine-like, straight or curved; fruit ellipsoid, 9-12 × 7-9 mm. Flowering from June to February.

description: Herbs or subshrubs, 1.2-2.7 (-3.3) dm tall. Leaves glossy, ovate, broadly ovate, or ovate-elliptic to orbicular, (1-)2-4.7(-5.8) × 0.7-2.8(-3.5) cm, basally rounded to acute, apically acute, obtuse, rounded, or mucronulate, surface discolorous, light green above, pale green below; petioles channeled above, smooth, 0.4-2 cm long, reddish-brown. Inflorescences usually solitary, erect, (6-)8-15(-20)-flowered; scape terete, 1-2(-3) dm tall, smooth; scape bracts membranaceous, subulate to narrowly ovate or broadly lanceolate, (3-)4-9 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, base auriculate and clasping, apex acuminate (rarely apiculate), margin somewhat hyaline, slightly erose-denticulate, light reddish-brown; flower-bearing portion of scape 2.5-5 cm tall, expanding in fruit, finely papillate or smooth; pedicels terete, finely papillate or smooth, (1-)3-7(-9) mm long, light reddish-brown; bracts subtending the pedicels membranaceous, subulate to lanceolate-ovate or narrowly ovate, abruptly acute, ± equal in length to the pedicels, 4-9 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide, margin somewhat hyaline, slightly erose-denticulate, light reddish-brown, persistent. Flowers: calyx 1-2 mm long, lobes broadly triangular to ovate, bases overlapping, apically obtuse or rounded, slightly erose-denticulate, 0.5-1 mm long, 0.75-1.2 mm wide, margin erose-denticulate, greenish; corolla ca. 5-6 mm long, ca. 4 mm in diam., petals broadly ovate, 4.5-6 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, slightly erose-denticulate or irregularly toothed at the apex; stamens ca. 4-8 mm long; filaments ca. 3-6 mm long; anthers 1.2-1.8 mm long, anther sacs light-brown; ovary subglobose; style 3-5(-6) mm long; stigma ca. 1 mm in diam. Fruit 3-5 mm long, 4-6 mm in diam.

description: Plant flowering 8-10 dm high; growing in circles. Leaves 3-4 dm long; sheaths reniform, 7 cm wide, glabrous, castaneous beneath; blades 4 cm wide, attenuate to a slender caudate entire apex, covered above with white transparent scales, beneath with cinereous opaque ones, densely serrate with spines 3-4 mm long. Scape 5-6 mm in diameter, straight, glabrous; scape-bracts linear-triangular, serrate, the upper shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly paniculate, many-flowered; axes subferruginous-tomentellous or glabrous; primary bracts minute, about equaling the buds; branches spreading, slender, simple or compound, 10-20 cm long, very laxly flowered. Floral bracts very broadly ovate, apiculate, 4 mm long; flowers erect, sessile, 17-25 mm long. Sepals strongly asymmetric, ovate, obliquely truncate, 8-12 mm long, few-nerved; petals 25-28 mm long, yellow with a green spot at apex, equaling or exceeding the stamens; anthers 4-6 mm long, green.

description: Plants stout, 1-4 m tall. Sheaths glabrous to rather densely puberulous, to 2.5 cm in diam. Ligule truncate, 1-3 mm long, margins dilacerating into fibers, glabrescent with age. Petiole 2-6 mm long, glabrous. Leaves narrowly elliptic to narrowly obovate, cuneate to rounded at the base, shortly acuminate at the apex, 15-40 cm long, 5-7 cm wide, upper side glabrous, lower side silvery sericeous. Inflorescence ovoid to cylindric, 10-40 cm long, 5-6 cm wide, occasionally with leafy shoots at the base. Bracts yellowish, coriaceous, triangular-ovate to narrowly triangular-ovate, glabrous to sparsely sericeous, margins dilacerating into fibers, glabrescent with age; appendages foliaceous, green, reflexed when dry, broadly ovate-triangular to ovate-triangular, usually cordate at the base, shortly acuminate at the apex, 10-45 mm long, 10-25 mm wide, glabrous to sparsely sericeous above, densely silvery sericeous beneath. Bracteole 20-27 mm long, yellowish, glabrous to sparsely sericeous. Calyx yellowish green, 30-40 mm long, glabrous to sparsely sericeous, two adaxial lobes slightly concrescent, deltate, 4-5 mm long, callus 4-7 mm long; abaxial lobe ovate-triangular, rounded to obtuse at the apex, 7-9 mm long, 4-5 mm wide, callus absent or 1-5 mm long. Corolla creamy white or tinged with yellow, ca 70 mm long, tube 25 mm long, lobes narrowly obovate, obtuse to rounded, ca 45 mm long and 15 mm wide, yellowish sericeous to the apex. Labellum yellow (?), ca 75 mm long, three-lobed, fimbriate, lateral lobes almost rounded, deflexed, middle-lobe ovate (this description of the labellum according to Ruiz & Pavon). Stamen yellowish, 50-60 mm long, anther 14 mm long. Pollen grains 144-184 µ. Exine 4-5 µ thick. Pores absent. A spiral-shaped colpus and a slightly curved colpus present (Bang 2058 from Bolivia). Ovary cylindric 8-10 mm long, glabrous to sparsely sericeous. Capsule 20-25 mm long, 10 mm wide, ellipsoid, bisulcate, seeds 3 mm long, 2 mm wide, glossy black.

description: Tree, medium size, height to 15-25 m, often not more than 10 m, dbh to 20-60 cm. Trunk monopodial, erect, often forked higher up. Shoots reddish brown, often glaucous. Leaves in fascicles of (2-) 3(-4, rarely 5), (4-)6-12(-l4) cm X 0.9-1.3(-1.5) mm. Stomata in (4-)5-8(-9) lines on the convex abaxial face, in 3-4 lines on each adaxial face. Resin ducts in the leaves (3-)4-6(-7), medial, occasionally 1-2 internal.

description: Tree, medium to tall, height to 20-35(-45) m, dbh to 50-100 cm. Trunk monopodial, erect, slender, terete. Bark rough, scaly, on lower part of trunk breaking into irregularly square plates divided by shallow or deep fissures (in part influenced by fire damage, see Hunt, 1962), grey-brown, inner bark reddish brown. Branches of first order slender, spreading or ascending; of second and higher orders similar, or drooping. Crown broad conical, open or irregular; usually a clear bole for 2/3 or ¾ of tree height. Shoots multinodal, very rough, resinous; with large, short decurrent and persistent pulvini. Cataphylls large, 15-20 mm long, subulate, strongly recurved, scarious, with hyaline-ciliate margins, dark brown, apex caudate, persisting some time after the leaf fascicles have fallen. Vegetative buds ovoid-oblong to cylindrical, 20-25 mm long, the laterals smaller, ovoid-acute, (slightly) resinous; scales spreading or recurved, scarious, with ciliate margins, brown. Fascicle sheaths 15-20 mm long, retaining their length or reduced to ca. 10 mm at maturity; the scales papery, with erose-ciliate margins, yellowish brown, turning dark red-brown or grey-black. Leaves in fascicles of (2-)3(-4, very rarely 5) in dense, irregularly spaced tufts, persisting 3 years, spreading, straight, (slightly) twisted, rigid, (12-)15-26(-28) cm X (1.2-) 1.4-1.8 mm, margins serrulate, apex acute-pungent, light or dark green (occasionally glaucous-green), more or less lustrous. Stomata conspicuous on all faces of leaves, in 8-11(-14) lines on the convex abaxial face and 4-6 lines on each adaxial face. Leaf anatomy: Cross section transverse-triangular; hypodermis multi-layered (3-5 rows of cells); resin ducts 2-5(-8), internal, rarely 1-2 medial; stele elliptic in cross section; outer cell walls of endodermis not thickened; vascular bundles 2, distinctly separate. Pollen cones clustered near the proximal end of a new shoot, sometimes more spreading by multinodal habit, subtended by imbricate, scarious, reddish brown bracts, cylindrical, often curved when mature, 20-30 X 5-6 mm, pink or yellow, turning yellowish or reddish brown. Seed cones subterminal, often in several whorls (nodes) in one season, mostly in pairs or whorls of 3-5(-8), on 2-2.5 cm long, curved, deciduous peduncles (sometimes breaking off at the base); immature cones ovoid to narrowly ovoid, 15-20 X 10-15 mm with pyramidal or curved, acuminate umbos terminating in an erect or incurvate spine, ochraceous, lustrous, maturing time two seasons. Mature cones pedunculate, ovoid-conical or ovoid when opened, more or less symmetrical but the base obliquely flattened, (4-)5-12(-13) X (3-)4-6(-7) cm when open. Seed scales ca. 120-200, parting to release the seeds except at the base, thin or thick, oblong, straight or recurved, dark purplish or blackish brown on the abaxial side, dark brown with faintly visible marks of seed wings on the adaxial side. Apophysis slightly or strongly raised or nearly flat on basal scales, rhombic to pentagonal in outline, transversely keeled, to 15 mm wide, ochraceous, light or dark brown, lustrous. Umbo dorsal, flat or slightly raised or pyramidal and curved upward, 3-4 mm wide, up to 3 mm high, with a minute, persistent prickle, dull brown, weathering grey. Seeds obliquely (narrowly) obovoid, slightly flattened, obtuse or angular, 5-7 X 2.5-3.5 mm, light grey-brown with dark spots, or dark brown to blackish. Seed wings articulate or adnate, effective, held to the seed by two claws or more commonly enveloping the seed on one side (adnate), obliquely ovate or oblong, 10-20 X 5-8 mm, thin, semi-transparent, yellowish grey or light brown with dark stripes. Cotyledons (4-)5-8(-9), (12-)20-35 mm long. Seedlings with an elongated stem, primary leaves green or glaucous, more or less ascending or spreading, soon replaced by secondary leaves or these delayed.

description: Lianas ou arbustos, 1.5-3 m, escabrosos; ramos novos mais ou menos achatados, secos marrom-escuros, híspidos, esparso híspidos ou pubérulos, glabrescentes, velhos cilíndricos, fissurados, lenticelados, glabrescentes; gavinhas presentes; exsudando abundante seiva vermelha quando injuriados, córtex interno rosado. Folhas opostas a subopostas; estípulas estreito-triangulares, pubérulas; pecíolos (2–)5-6(-14) mm, secos marrom-escuros a enegrecidos; híspidos a pubérulos, ás vezes lenticelados; lâminas (1.7-)8-9.3 (-22) × (0.8-)3.6-4.4(-9) cm, elípticas, raro largo-elípticas, base arredondada ou cuneada, menos comumente reniforme, raro cordada, margem inteira, ápice acuminado ou agudo, raro obtuso, cartáceas, pubérulas e escabrosas em ambas as faces, raro glabras em ambas as faces, às vezes minutamente pontuadas em ambas as faces, secas marrom-claras ou esverdeadas em ambas as faces, nervuras secas de cor inconspícua, promínulas em ambas as faces. Inflorescências (1.1-) 5.5-6.8(-13.7) × (0.6-)2.4-4(-12.5) cm, com 10-120 flores, axilares; pedúnculos (0-)10-27(-79) mm, ramos pubérulos; brácteas denticuladas, às vezes afastadas das ramificações, pubérulas; pedicelos (2.5-)4.4-6.6 (-11.1) mm, pubérulos; bractéolas 2. Flores (6.5-)9-12 (-13) mm diâm na antese, rotáceas, inodoras ou aromáticas; sépalas (1.5-)2.7(-3.3) × (1.5-)2.3-2.8(-3.3) mm, triangulares, erosas, escariosas ou fimbriadas, pubérulas, carnosas, verde-amareladas; pétalas (3.5-) 3.9-4.6 × (4-)4.3-5.6(-7.1) mm, transverso-elípticas, ovais ou espatuladas, unguiculadas, margem erosa a fimbriada, pubérulas em ambas as faces, exceto internamente no ápice e base, papiráceas, amarelas, amarelo-esverdeadas, brancas, ou verdes, de bordos amarelados ou brancos, ou nervuras avermelhadas; disco 0.3 × 1.5-2.8 mm, papiloso na borda externa, hirsuto a pubérulo no restante, raro glabro, verde-de borda amarela, verde-amarelado ou marrom-claro, carnoso; estames (2-)2.7-3.4 mm, filetes 1.2-2.8 mm, achatados, às vezes retorcidos, glabros ou esparso pubérulos, verdes, anteras 0.6-0.8 × (0.7-)1-1.1 mm, deiscência na metade distal, brancas a amarelas; ovário ca 1.6 mm diâm, pubérulo, lilás, óvulos por lóculo 8, estigma amarelo. Mericarpos (4.3-)5.5-7.1(-8.2) × (1.8-)3.8-4.1(-6.4) cm, ovais ou obtriangulares, arredondados, truncados ou emarginados no ápice, escabrosos, glabrescentes, estriados. Sementes 4.6-6.2 × 1.7-3 cm, núcleo seminífero elipsóide.

description: Stems cespitose, often forming large clumps by rhizomes, 3-6(-9) m tall, 3-6(-8) cm diam., spiny on internodes. Leaves 4-7; leaf spines somewhat clustered, yellowish or yellowish brown, black at base and apex, strongly flattened, spinulose and tomentose, to 4 cm long, dense on lateral surfaces of sheath and petiole, fewer on abaxial surface of rachis; sheath 3060 cm long; ocrea to 15 cm long; petiole 10-70(-120) cm long; rachis 0.9-1.7 m long; pinnae (10-)23-34 per side, irregularly arranged in clusters of 2-5, spreading in different planes, linear-lanceolate, strongly plicate, with small spines on margins; middle pinnae 45-78 x 3.5-7cm. Inflorescences interfoliar; peduncle 20-60 cm long, recurved, spiny; prophyll 10-40 cm long; peduncular bract 25-62(-105) cm long, sparsely to moderately covered with flattened, yellowish spines to 2 cm long; rachis (3-)8-15 cm long; rachillae 15-33, 15-30 cm long, densely covered at anthesis with brown, moniliform trichomes; triads irregularly arranged among paired or solitary staminate flowers; staminate flowers 3.5-4.5 mm long, deciduous; sepal lobes 1-2 mm long; petals 3.54 mm long; stamens 6; pistillode small or absent; pistillate flowers to 3 mm long; calyx 2.5-3 mm long, tubular; corolla 2.5-3 mm long, tubular; staminodial ring adnate basally to corolla; fruits 1.3-1.7 cm diam., depressed-globose, purple-black, somewhat brown-tomentose; mesocarp juicy; endocarp depressed-oblong or depressed-globose, the sterile pores displaced longitudinally; endocarp fibers free, numerous, with juice sacs attached; fruiting perianth with irregularly lobed calyx half as long as the irregularly lobed corolla, staminodial ring present.

description: Stems cespitose, forming dense clumps of 4-20 or more stems, 1.7-5 m tall, 3-6 cm diam., spiny on internodes. Leaves 3-16; leaf spines distinctly clustered, black, tomentose at first, 3-4(-8) cm long, on sheath, petiole, and abaxial surface of rachis; sheath 10-35 cm long, fibrous on the margins, sheath, petiole, and rachis densely whitish tomentose, glabrescent; ocrea to 30 cm long, becoming fibrous and persistent; petiole 14-53 cm long; rachis 0.5-1.6 m long; pinnae 24-49 per side, irregularly arranged in distant clusters of 2-7, spreading in different planes, linear-lanceolate or oblanceolate, briefly bifid at the apex, with few spines on margins, densely whitish brown-lepidote abaxially; middle pinnae 16-34 × 2.3-4 cm. Inflorescences interfoliar; peduncle 8-32 cm long, straight to slightly recurved, not spiny; prophyll 9-20 cm long; peduncular bract 22-45 cm long, whitish brown-tomentose with few black spines to 2 cm long; rachis 4-12 cm long; rachillae 20-50, 10-12 cm long, at anthesis densely covered with moniliform trichomes; triads irregularly arranged among paired or solitary staminate flowers; staminate flowers 3-4 mm long; sepal lobes 1-1.5 mm long; petals 3-4 mm long; stamens 6; pistillode minute or absent; pistillate flowers 2.5-3 mm long; calyx cupular, to 1 mm long; corolla tubular, 2.5-3 mm long; staminodes absent; fruits to 2 cm diam., depressed-globose, rostrate, purple-black; mesocarp juicy; endocarp depressed-oblong, the sterile pores displaced longitudinally; endocarp fibers numerous, with juice sacs attached; fruiting perianth with cupular, 3-lobed calyx and cupular, scarcely 3-lobed corolla, without staminodial ring.

description: Prostrate and stoloniferous, to erect or ascending shrub, sometimes forming dense tufts or extensive mats, (0.1-)0.2-l(-3) m tall, bisexual; stems terete to subterete (sharply angled), glabrous or weakly to densely puberulous or laxly crisped pilose, and also usually moderately to densely strigose or hirsute-setose with basally swollen ferruginous, appressed or spreading eglandular and/or rarely gland-tipped hairs 0.5-3 mm long. Leaves subcoriaceous to coriaceous, narrowly to broadly elliptic, oblong, or ovate-oblong to linear-oblong, (2-)6-14(-40) × (2-)4-7(-12) mm, base rounded, obtuse, attenuate or cuneate, apex obtuse, acute or subacuminate, rarely short-mucronate or rounded, margin slightly to conspicuously thickened, usually slightly revolute, minutely crenate-serrulate with 6-12(-17) caducous teeth per side, these bristle-tipped or gland-tipped and 0.2-0.3 mm long, to hirsute-setose and eglandular to 2 mm long, blades themselves usually glabrous or rarely weakly short-pilose along the basal half of midrib above, rarely strigose beneath; midrib and secondary veins slightly impressed or raised above, raised and ± prominent beneath; petiole 1-4 mm long, often canaliculate above, glabrous to puberulous above. Flowers with pedicels (1-)4-10(-13) mm long, glabrous or puberulous (bearing short-strigose or hirsute-setose, straight or crisped, eglandular or gland-tipped hairs); bracts 5-10, ovate, ciliate, appressed, persistent, at the base and 1-6 scattered along pedicel, these (1.5-)2-4 mm long; calyx lobes membranaceous or rarely becoming fleshy after anthesis, ovate, 2-4 mm long, acuminate to acute, weakly to densely ciliate (also basally with short, gland-tipped hairs); corolla cylindric to campanulate-urceolate, (3.5-)5-6(-7) mm long, white to rose tinted when fresh, lobes 1-1.5 mm long, reflexed; stamens with filaments 1.5-3 mm long, glabrous (pilose); ovary glabrous to densely short-pubescent, style 2-4 mm long, glabrous (short-pilose in lower half). Berry subglobose, 6-16 mm diam., glabrous to densely short-pubescent, dark blue-black, rarely light purple to almost white. Chromosome number: n = 11 (Luteyn et al. 7966).

description: Bejuco, lenticelas presentes. Hojas trifolioladas, pulvínulo cilindrico, rugoso, glabro, hasta de 1 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, fuertemente estriado, glabro, 5-11 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, fuertemente estriado, glabro, 1-3.5 cm de largo. Folíolos (3.5-)7-17(-20) cm de largo, (2.5-)5-11.5 cm de ancho, el terminal generalmente mayor, ovado o suborbicular, los laterales menores, ovados, anchamente elípticos o suborbiculares, subcoriáceos, haz oscura (negra en ejemplares de herbario por lo general), brillante, glabra, envés más claro, a veces blanquecino, densamente papiloso, glabro o con pelos cortos generalmente inconspicuos, base redondeada, raramente subcordada o cuneada, por lo general irregular en los foliólos laterales, ápice acuminado, acumen de 0.4(-3) cm de largo, margen leve a marcadamente revoluto; peciólulo cilindrico, rugoso, hasta de 0.8 cm de largo; venación aerolada, nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 2 que nacen desde la base pero que por lo general se separan de la central a diversas distancias de la base, además 3-5 pares laterales no anastomosados pero con ramificaciones que terminan en el margen, todas la laterales formando ángulos de 45° con la central, promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias levemente promínulas en ambas caras. Inflorescencia paniculada, más o menos laxa; raquila delgada, hasta de 10 cm de largo, pubérula; brácteas más o menos conspicuas. Pedicelo delgado, pubérulo, 2-3 mm de largo; sépalos 1.5 mm de largo, 1 mm de ancho, suborbiculares, pubérulos exteriormente, glabros interiormente, ápice barbado, margen ciliado; pétalos 3.5-5.5 mm de largo, 1.5-3 mm de ancho, obovado-oblongos(espatulados), glabros; filamentos libres, 5 más largos 1.3-1.5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 0.8-1 mm de longitud, glabros; anteras cordadas, agudas, elongadas, 0.3-0.6 mm de longitud; ovario con 5 carpelos glabros, sésiles, estilo glabro, estigma capitado. Fruto sésil, 1 -2(-4) carpelos maduran, glabro.

description: Plant stemless or short-caulescent, propagating by scaly stolons; leaves 6-10 in a fasciculate rosette, petiolate, densely lepidote beneath, coarsely serrate with uncinate antrorse spines; sheaths broadly ovate, petioles broadly linear, 6-8 cm long, channeled; blades cordate or lance-ovate, acuminate, to 34 cm long, 7 cm wide. Scapes several, borne in a ring below the rosette, horizontal, short; scape-bracts imbricate, squamiform. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, ellipsoid, 8 cm long, 4-5 cm in diameter, few-flowered, white-lepidote. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, abruptly acute, imbricate but exceeded by the sepals, serrulate; flowers with a short but distinct pedicel, 35 mm long. Sepals 15 mm long, more than half-connate in a slender tube, the free lobes ovate, acute; petals naked, free, much exceeding the sepals, the blades spreading, elliptic, acute, yellow to red; stamens included; ovary short-cylindric, continued into an epigynous tube at least as large; placentae apical; ovules very few.

description: Plant caulescent; rhizome 15 mm in diameter. Leaves few, rosulate, 7 dm long, densely white-lepidote beneath, glabrous above; sheaths narrow, inconspicuous, entire; petioles 3 dm long, 1 cm wide, channeled, laxly serrate with flat spreading to antrorse 2 mm long teeth; blades linear-lanceolate, attenuate, 3 dm long, 55 mm wide, flat, laxly serrate. Scapes several, borne below the rosette, horizontal, short; scape-bracts imbricate, elliptic, sparsely serrulate. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, ellipsoid, 5	cm long. Floral bracts polystichous, elliptic, apiculate, 25 mm long, thin, densely serrulate, red, densely pale-lepidote; pedicels slender, 5 mm long. Sepals 22 mm long, connate for 15 mm, the free apices broadly spatulate, apiculate, serrulate. Fruit globose, 14 mm in diameter.

description: Liana, lenticelas presentes, inconspicuas, ramas jóvenes densamente pubérulas. Hojas trifolioladas; pulvínulo cilindrico, rugoso, pubérulo, hasta 0.5 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, levemente estriado, densamente pubérulo, 2.5-7(-13.5) cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, levemente estriado, pubérulo, hasta 3 cm de largo. Folíolos (2.5-)4.5-9.5(-12) cm de largo, (1.5-)2.2-5(-9) cm de ancho, ovados a levemente obovados, subcoriáceos, haz oscura, más o menos brillante, cuando jóvenes pubescentes, adultos glabros o glabrescentes, envés claro, opaco, pubérulo, densamente papiloso aún sobre las nervaduras, base redondeada, a veces irregular, ápice obtuso-acuminado, corto, 0.3-0.5(-1.5) cm de largo; peciólulo rugoso, 0.2-0.3 cm de largo; venación transversal, aerolada en la haz, nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 2 que nacen desde la base, además 1-3 pares ascendentes, formando ángulos de 45° con la nervadura central, y anastomosándose cerca al margen, prominentes en el envés, planas o levemente impresas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias promínulas en el envés, planas o levemente promínulas en la haz. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar; raquila hasta 8 cm de largo, ferrugíneo-tomentosa; brácteas inconspicuas. Pedicelo densamente tomentoso, 1-1.5 mm de largo; sépalos 1.5 mm de largo, 0.7 mm de ancho, oblongos, densamente tomentosos exteriormente, glabros interiormente, ápice barbado, obtuso, margen ciliado; pétalos 2.7 mm de largo, 1 mm de ancho, oblanceolados, glabros; filamentos 10, 5 más largos 1.7 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 1.2 mm de longitud, glabros; anteras subglobosas, 0.4 mm de diámetro; ovario con 5 carpelos, vellosos, estilo velloso. Fruto desconocido.

description: Arbolito(?) o arbusto escandente, 1-2 m de alto, ramas jóvenes débilmente estriadas, conspicuamente lenticeladas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos 29-33; pecíolo 1.5-2 cm de largo, densamente tomentoso; raquis hasta 9-11 cm de largo, densamente tomentoso y con pelos glandulosos esparcidos. Folíolos 1.3-2.5 cm de largo, 0.6-0.7(-l) cm de ancho, oblongos, los terminales oblongo-elípticos, membranosos a subcartáceos, haz oscura, glabra, envés claro, opaco, glauco, glabro, la nervadura central esparcidamente tomentosa, base obtusa, en el folíolo terminal cuneada, ápice obtuso o redondeado, raramente emarginado; peciólulo 0.05-0.1 cm de largo; venación reticulada, difusa; nervaduras laterales 5-6 pares, formando ángulos de 50-70° con la nervadura central. Inflorescencia una panícula reducida o pseudo-umbelada, axilar a pseudoterminal, raquila 5-9 cm de largo, velutina, pelos glandulosos presentes; brácteas hasta 0.1 cm de largo, caducas. Pedicelo articulado, velutino, 0.4-0.6 cm de largo; sépalos 5 mm de largo, 1.5 mm de ancho, linear-lanceolados, densamente tomentosos y con pelos glandulosos exteriormente, esparcidamente tomentosos o glabrescentes internamente; pétalos 12 mm de largo, 1-2 mm de ancho, oblongo-lanceolados, connados por encima de la base, glabros; filamentos unidos por 1 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos ca. 2 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos ca. 1 mm de longitud; anteras subcordadas; ovario piloso; estilo pubescente por más de la mitad de su longitud; estigma capitado. Fruto 1.2 cm de largo, densa y diminutamente pubérulo; cáliz en fruto diminutamente pubérulo, cortamente imbricado, 0.5-0.6 cm de largo, lóbulos del cáliz 0.4-0.5 cm de largo. Semilla 1 cm de largo; ariloide 0.2-0.3 cm de largo.

description: Arbusto escandente, arbusto o pequeño árbol, ramas jóvenes glabras o pubé-rulas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos (1-)3-5; pecíolo 1.5-3.5 cm de largo, glabro; raquis 1-10 cm de largo, glabro. Folíolos 6—31 cm de largo, 3-15 cm de ancho, elípticos u obovados, cartáceos, glabros, base atenuada u obtusa, ápice gradualmente acuminado; peciólulo 0.2-0.5 cm de largo; venación reticulada, difusa, plana en la haz, promínula (nervadura central prominente) en el envés; nervaduras laterales 6-7 pares, ascendentes, difusamente anastomosadas cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, pseudoterminal; raquila 4-13 cm de largo, pubérula; brácteas 0.1-0.15 cm de largo, triangulares, diminutamente pubérulas. Pedicelo articulado, desde muy corto hasta 0.4 cm de largo, pubérulo; sépalos 3-4 mm de largo, 1-2 mm de ancho, oblongo-lanceolados, oblongo-elípticos u ovado-oblon-gos, densa o esparcidamente pubérulos exteriormente, pubérulos interiormente; pétalos 5 mm de largo, 1-2 mm de ancho, glabros, libres; estambres 10; anteras globosas. Fruto 1-1.2 cm de largo, 0.5-0.6 cm de ancho, glabro, recurvado, ápice velloso; cáliz en fruto 0.5-0.6 cm de largo, densa o esparcidamente pubérulo, margen ciliado. Semilla 0.6-1 cm de largo, 0.3-0.4 cm de ancho; ariloide 0.20.3 cm de largo.

description: Subarbusto, ramas jóvenes densamente vellosas, lenticelas ausentes. Hojas im-paripinadas; folíolos 11-17; pecíolo 0.5-2 cm de largo, densamente velloso; raquis 7-9.5 cm de largo, densamente velloso. Foliolos 0.6-3.2 cm de largo, 0.5-1.6 cm de ancho, oblongo-ovados, el par proximal ocasionalmente suborbiculado, car-táceos, haz oscura y algo brillante en folíolos maduros, densamente vellosa, envés claro, opaco, densamente velloso, base cordada, ápice agudo o subobtuso, margen entero o más o menos revoluto; folíolos sésiles o peciólulo 0.1 cm de largo; venación reticulada, difusa en la haz, prominente en el envés; nervaduras laterales 5-6 pares, formando ángulos de 60° (cerca a la base) y 90° (cerca al ápice), anas-tomosadas claramente cerca al margen. Inflorescencias racemosas, axilares, las hojas que las subtienden en el extremo de las ramas a veces reducidas a estructuras semejantes a brácteas, vellosas, con pelos glandulosos, raquila muy corta, vellosa, con pelos glandulosos. Flores desconocidas. Pedúnculo articulado, 0.1 cm de largo o frutos sésiles. Fruto ca. 1.4 cm de largo, densamente velloso, con pelos glandulosos; cáliz en fruto hasta 0.9 cm de largo, densamente velloso, con pelos glandulosos. Semilla ca. 1 cm de largo; ariloide ca. 0.4 cm de largo.
