description: Plant 5 dm or higher. Leaves 5 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, ca. 15 mm wide, densely cinereous-lepidote beneath, serrate with spines 1.5-2 mm long. Scape ca 5 mm in diameter, ferruginous-tomentulose; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, ovate, long-attenuate, laxly laciniate-spinulose. Inflorescence paniculate or pseudoracemose with the lower bracts subtending buds, densely ferruginous-tomentulose. Floral bracts spreading, lance-ovate, acuminate, to 25 mm long, exceeding the flowers, spinulose-serrate; flowers short-pedicellate. Sepals obtuse, convex, 12 mm long, fimbriate; petals 16 mm long, orange, the blades large, suborbicular, obtuse, slightly undulate, ecarinate, apparently erect; stamens included, the filaments fused for 2-6 mm above the common tube with the petals, the anthers oblong, acute, recurved; style 1/3 the ovary; ovules with thick semiorbicular obtuse wings.

description: Plant flowering over 8 dm high. Leaves over 4 dm long; sheaths suborbicular, 4 cm long, brown; blades linear, attenuate to a finely subulate rigid apex, 14 mm wide, flat, covered beneath with brownish closely appressed scales, glabrous above, very laxly serrate with slender curved 2 mm long spines. Scape 5 mm in diameter, soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, densely lepidote beneath, the lowest subfoliaceous and imbricate, the others ovate, acuminate, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, lax, 23-28 cm long; rhachis soon glabrous. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, to 22 mm long, exceeding the lowest flowers, minutely serrulate, densely appressed-lepidote beneath; pedicels subcylindric, stout, 5 mm long; flowers spreading. Sepals broadly ovate or elliptic, acuminate, mucronate, 10 mm long, even except for the strong midnerve, slightly if at all carinate, minutely serrulate, white-lepidote becoming glabrous; petals 17 mm long, exceeding the stamens, orange-yellow, the blade suberect to spreading, subrhombic, carinate-complicate; filaments free above the common tube with the petals; stigmas subsessile.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Plant very variable in height, flowering to 2 m high, arising from the ends of prostrate branching stems up to 2 m long and 10-15 cm in diameter. Leaves 3-10 dm long; blades narrowly triangular, to 4 cm wide, glabrous above, densely and completely pale-lepidote beneath with broad shallow internerves, laxly serrate with coarse curved spines 3-5 mm long. Scape stout, ferruginous-puberulous; scape-bracts broadly ovate with narrowly triangular serrulate blades, longer than the internodes or sometimes the highest slightly shorter. Inflorescence many-flowered, simple to paniculate with many long lateral branches, ferruginous-tomentulose; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, much shorter than the sterile bases of the branches. Floral bracts ovate or lanceolate, acuminate, minutely serrulate, the lowest varying from shorter than the sepals to longer than the flowers; pedicels 1-2 mm long but rather slender; flowers spreading. Sepals broadly ovate, acute and mucronulate, fimbriate, 8 mm long; petals red or yellow, 12 mm long, exceeding the stamens, the blades elliptic to obovate, apiculate, undulate, carinate; filaments free to short-connate above the common tube with the petals, the anthers narrowly triangular, apiculate, recurved; style 1/3 as long as the ovary; ovules with asymmetric lateral wings.

description: Plant flowering ca 2 m high. Leaves to 9 dm long, densely cinereous-lepidote especially beneath; sheaths castaneous beneath, the outer reniform, the inner ovate; blades to 33 mm wide, laxly serrate with spines 6 mm long. Scape stout, glabrous; scape-bracts foliaceous, much exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence amply 2-3-pinnate, to 1 m long, glabrous; primary bracts narrowly lanceolate, attenuate, usually entire, much shorter than the branches, quickly deciduous; branches with perfect flowers lax and interrupted, those with pistillate flowers dense on the apical half. Floral bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, 2-3 mm long; flowers dimorphic, divergent to spreading, short-pedicellate. Sepals suborbicular or broadly ovate, apiculate, those of the perfect flowers nearly 5 mm long, those of the pistillate only 2 mm; petals obovate, acute or obtuse, yellow, the perfect 11-12 mm long, the pistillate 5-5.5 mm; stamens nearly equaling the petals, free above the short common tube with the petals; style slender, elongate; ovules narrowly alate.

description: Plant flowering 35-100 cm high. Leaves many, 15-50 cm long; sheaths persistent and forming a bulb, broadly ovate or suborbicular, large; blades more or less curved, narrowly triangular, abruptly acute and pungent, ca 1 cm wide, usually involute, glabrous above, covered beneath with pale appressed scales, laxly and evenly serrate with dark curved spines. Scape slender, lepidote or soon glabrous; scape-bracts erect, broadly ovate with narrowly triangular thick serrulate blades, the upper much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, lax, few-many-flowered, nearly or quite glabrous. Floral bracts spreading or reflexed, lance-triangular, acuminate, shorter than the flowers and usually shorter than the sepals, serrulate; pedicels 2-3 mm long; flowers spreading to reflexed at anthesis, erect in fruit. Sepals ovate, acute or obtuse, strongly convex, 5-7 mm long; petals reddish or orange, 9-14 mm long, exceeding the stamens, the claw broad, the blade suberect, broadly obovate, carinate-complicate; filaments free above the common tube with the petals, the anthers narrow, recurved; style 4-5 times shorter than the ovary; ovules with large falcate wings.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Lyman B. & Downs, Robert J. 1974. Pitcairnioideae (Bromeliaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 14 (1): 1-658.

description: Tree, to 20(-25) m tall. Leafy twigs and petioles densely covered with brownish, appressed to semierect, simple hairs, becoming glabrous. Petioles 5-20 mm long, 1-2(-3) mm in diam. Lamina narrowly elliptic (rarely elliptic, narrowly ovate, or narrowly obovate), chartaceous, mostly dark green above, pale green below, (6-) 10-25(-35) cm long, (2-)4-8.5(-13) cm wide, sparsely covered with crisped, simple (and furcate) hairs to 0.5 mm long above, rather densely covered with white (to brown along large veins), appressed, simple (and furcate) hairs up to 1 mm long below, base acute to rounded, apex (mostly) shortly acuminate, the tip itself acute to rounded; secondary veins straight to slightly curved, 13-25 on either side of primary vein, occasionally with few, mostly short intersecondaries, angles with primary vein 40-60°, loops indistinct to distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin up to 1 mm, tertiary veins 6-7 per intercosta, weakly percurrent above. Domatia found in high quantities but absent in some specimens. Inflorescences supra-axillary to leaf-opposed, 1-3(-7)-flowered, peduncles and pedicels rather densely covered with brownish to whitish, appressed to semierect, simple hairs, outer side of bracts and sepals sericeous, inner side glabrous, wings densely covered with pale brown to greyish to brown, erect to appressed hairs. Peduncles 1-4 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam., fruiting peduncles 2-5 mm long, 2-5(-10) mm in diam. Pedicels 10-55(-60) mm long, (0.5-) 1(-1.5) mm in diam., fruiting pedicels l-5(-8) mm in diam. Bracts triangular to broadly triangular, 1-4 mm long, acute, persistent, upper bract just above the base to inserted in the lower 1/3 (or halfway) of the pedicel. Flowers green to creamy, yellow when mature in vivo. Sepals free, appressed, rarely somewhat recurved, very broadly to shallowly ovate-triangular, (1.5-)2-5(-7) mm long, (1.5-) 3-5(-6) mm wide, mostly acuminate, not gibbous. Corolla tube (2-)3-4(-5) mm high, 5-8(-10) mm in diam., wings oblong-ovate to obovate, to sometimes circular, ascending to (when mature:) mostly horizontal, exceptionally erect, 7-15(-20) {-25} mm long, 4-10{-16} mm high, 1-2{-5} mm thick, index = ca. 1.5. Fruit mostly globose to depressed ovoid, 2-12[-20] cm long, 2.5-11[-15] cm in diam., green, maturing yellow to brown in vivo, black when dry, composed of (30-)50-150 carpels, rather densely to sparsely covered with appressed, brownish, simple hairs, becoming glabrous, areoles pyramidal to conical from a broad base, straight to recurved (rarely incurved), or (hexagonal-)pulvinate with (rarely without) recurved to incurved apicule in upper half, 10-25 × 5-12(-25) mm at the base, apex or apicule acute to obtuse, 1-10 mm high, smooth, wrinkled, or verrucose; wall 1-7 mm thick. Seeds 7-18 × 5-10(-13) mm. Chromosome numbers: 2n = 28, 42.
bibliographicCitation: Maas, Paulus J. M., et al. 1992. Rollinia. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 57: 1-188.

description: Shrubs ca. 2 m tall, the stems densely glandular-puberulent. Leaf blades ovate, 4-10 x 3-8 cm, basally truncate or subcordate, serrulate, acute or acuminate, palmately 5-7(-9)-nerved, discolorous, the upper surface densely and minutely stellate-tomentose with some glandular hairs intermixed, the lower surface densely whitish-tomentose, the epidermis obscured; petioles 1.5-6 cm long, with pubescence like stem; stipules 3 mm long, subulate, puberulent, deciduous. Flowers solitary in the upper leaf axils, the pedicels 2-3.5 cm long, with pubescence like stem; involucellar bracts ca. 14, linear, erect or somewhat arcuate, 20-28 x 1 mm or less, ciliate toward base (hairs 1-3 mm long), the abaxial surface densely hirsute; calyx 14-15 mm long, densely white-hirsute (hairs ca. 2 mm long), ca. half-divided, the lobes narrowly triangular; corolla 3.5 cm long, red with yellow venation, externally stellate-pubescent, the petals narrowly ligulate, ca. 8 mm wide; staminal column glabrous, reddish, 2.5 cm long, the filaments 5-6 mm long, the pollen reddish, the androecium subequal to the corolla; styles exserted from the staminal column (and slightly exserted from the corolla), reddish, glabrous. Fruits 6-7 mm diam., sparsely pubescent to subglabrous; mericarps 6.5 mm tall, reticulate-veined, twice height of column; seeds 4.5 mm long, minutely stellate-pubescent.

description: Shrubs ca. 1 m tall, the stems stellate-scabridulous and with longitudinal lines of dense curled hairs (sometimes also setose, the hairs 2-3 mm long). Leaf blades triangular to hastately or palmately 3-lobed, mostly 2-3 x 1-2 cm (the central lobe ca. 1 cm wide), basally truncate to cordate, serrate, acute, palmately 5-nerved, somewhat discolorous, coarsely pubescent above and beneath, the hairs ca. 1 mm long, stellate beneath, often also with simple and bifurcate hairs above; petioles 1-1.5 cm long; stipules subulate, 3-5 mm long. Flowers solitary in the leaf axils, the pedicels 2-5 cm long; involucellar bracts 20-23, narrowly linear, 15-21 x 0.5 mm, copiously setose, the hairs 2 mm long, ferruginous; calyx 8-10 mm long, ciliate; corolla 3-3.5 cm long, pink with a dark center; staminal column ca. 1 cm long. Fruits unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Fryxell, Paul A. 1999. Pavonia Cavanilles (Malvaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 76: 1-284.

description: Subshrubs 0.1-0.25 m tall, the stems coarsely and densely stellate-setose, the hairs 2-3 mm long, ferruginous, with understory of minute pubescence. Leaf blades subrotund to broadly elliptic, mostly 3-7 x 2-4 cm, basally rounded or truncate, serrate, subacute or obtuse, palmately 5-nerved, concolorous, with loose yellow stellate pubescence on both surfaces, the hairs 1-2 mm long; petioles 1-2 cm long; stipules subulate, 4-8 mm long. Flowers solitary in the leaf axils, the pedicels mostly 4-10 cm long, with pubescence like stem; involucellar bracts 13, filiform, 13-15 mm long, copiously setose, the hairs 2-3 mm long, yellowish; calyx 1.5-2 cm long, setose and with dense understory of fine stellate hairs; corolla white with purple center, 3 cm long; staminal column ca. 1 cm long, glabrous, the filaments 2-3 mm long. Fruits ca. 1 cm diam., glabrous, yellowish, reticulate-veined; mericarps ca. 6 mm high.

description: Shrubs 1-1.5 m tall, the stems more or less darkly pigmented, with minute glandular hairs and scattered simple hairs 1-3 mm long. Leaf blades ovate to subhastate, mostly 2-7 x 2-6 cm, deeply cordate, irregularly serrate, acute, discolorous, densely stellate-pubescent above and beneath; petioles ½-1 times length of blade; stipules 3-4 mm long, subulate. Flowers solitary in the leaf axils, the pedicels 2-5 cm long (exceeding subtending petiole at anthesis), viscid; involucellar bracts 16-21, narrowly linear, 1.5-2.5 cm long, copiously ciliate (hairs 2-2.5 mm long) and with minute glandular hairs; calyx 12-15 mm long, deeply divided, copiously ciliate; corolla yellow with dark red center, 4 cm long, glabrous externally and on margins of claw; androecium ca. half the length of the corolla, the column glabrous; styles and stigmas equaling corolla. Fruits unknown.

description: Lianas, glabras, exceto pelas estípulas; ramos novos cilíndricos, ou achatado, principalmente nos nós, lisos, secos verdes, velhos cilíndricos, fissurados, às vezes minutamente verrucosos, cinzentos a enegrecidos. Folhas opostas a subopostas; estípulas reduzidas a protuberâncias pilosas observáveis apenas nas folhas muito novas; pecíolos (8-)10-14(-27) mm, secos esverdeados ou marrons; lâminas (4.3-)9.9-16.6(-23.6) × (2.2-)4.6-8.7(-10.7) cm, elípticas, base cuneada, raro cuneada ou atenuada, margem inteira, ápice agudo a acuminado, cartáceas, secas esverdeadas em ambas as faces, às vezes pontuadas de negro na face adaxial, nervuras secas de cor inconspícua na face adaxial, amareladas na abaxial, na face adaxial secundárias promínulas, terciárias planas, na abaxial secundárias e terciárias promínulas. Inflorescências (9.8-)12-19.4 × (2.1-)4.9-11.3(-22.1) cm, ca 70 flores, ramifloras, nodosidades aparentemente produzindo sucessivas florações; pedúnculos 0(–120) mm, ramos subcilíndricos a achatados, alternos, secos mais ou menos glaucos, verde-claros; brácteas erosas, às vezes denticuladas, afastadas das ramificações, às vezes ausentes em algumas; estipetes florais (4.8-)7.3-7.6 mm, articulados na base ou na região mediana, seco glauco; bractéolas ausentes. Flores (4.7-)5.4-6.1(-7.5) mm diâm na antese, rotáceas, aromáticas ou fétidas; sépalas 1-1.2 × (1.1-)1.2-1.3(-1.6) mm, triangulares a transverso elípticas, erosas, escariosas, carnosas, verdes; pétalas (2.5-)3-3.2(-3.5) × (1.8-)2.9(-3.3) mm, obovais, deflexas, inteiras, papiráceas, amarelas, amareladas ou verde-amareladas; disco 0.2-0.4 mm alt.; estames 0.5-1 mm, verdes, filetes 0.35-0.85 mm, anteras 0.15-0.25 × 0.25-0.45 mm, oblongas, deiscência transversa a levemente oblíqua; ovário e disco 0.9-1.2 mm diâm, ovário 3-lobado, estilete 0.2-0.35 mm, seção levemente triangular, estigma pontual, óvulos por lóculo 6-8. Bagas 15.2-17.5(-21) × (2.7-)3.3-5.5 cm, cilíndricas, secas amareladas, pulverulentas, maduras bege acinzentado a marrom-claros, epicarpo maduro crustáceo. Sementes não vistas.
bibliographicCitation: Lombardi, Julio A. 2014. Celastraceae (Hippocrateoideae e Salacioideae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 114: 1--227.

description: Lianas ou árvores, 2-15 m, glabras exceto pelas flores; ramos novos achatado-tetrangulares ou subcilíndricos, lisos ou minutamente verrucosos, secos esverdeados a enegrecidos, velhos cilíndricos, minutamente lenticelados, enegrecidos. Folhas opostas a subopostas; estípulas triangulares, denticuladas, deixando cicatrizes interpeciolares; pecíolos (7-)9-10(-15) mm, secos esverdeados a marrons; lâminas (4.7-)8.2-16.6 × (2.4-)3.7-8.2 cm, elípticas, base arredondada ou cuneada, margem inteira, ápice agudo a acuminado, aparentemente carnosas, secas marrons ou marrom-esverdeadas em ambas as faces, às vezes minutamente verrucosas ou pontuadas de negro na face abaxial, nervuras secas de cor inconspícua na face adaxial, marrons na abaxial, em ambas as faces secundárias promínulas, terciárias levemente promínulas. Inflorescências (1.1-)1.3-2.4(-14.9) × (0.8-)1.7-3.7(-5.6) cm, ca 50-200 flores, axilares; pedúnculos 0-4(-7) mm, ramos achatados, angulados, opostos, secos seroso-pruinosos; brácteas escariosas, afastadas das ramificações; estipetes florais (0.5-)0.9-2.2(-2.8) mm, articulados na base; bractéolas ausentes. Flores 2.4-3.9 mm diâm na antese, campanuliformes; sépalas (0.4-)0.6-1 × 0.6-1.1 mm, triangulares, margem papilosa, carnosas, papilosas ou pubérulas externamente; pétalas 1.6-1.8(-2.7) × 0.8-1.1(-1.3) mm, elípticas ou espatuladas, mais ou menos oblíquas, margem papilosa, carnosas, densamente papilosas ou pubérulas em ambas as faces, principalmente na face adaxial, às vezes glabras na abaxial, amarelas, amarelo esverdeadas, esbranquiçadas, vermelhas; disco (0.3-)0.4(-0.5) mm alt.; estames 0.9-1.1 mm, opostos aos lobos do estigma, filetes 0.6-0.7 mm, anteras 0.2-0.4 × 0.4-0.6 mm, reniformes, deiscência transversa; ovário e disco ca 1 mm diâm, ovário 3-lobado, estilete 0.2-0.45 mm, seção triangular, estigma 3-lobado, 0.4-0.5 mm diâm, lobos inteiros, agudos, patentes, óvulos por lóculo 2. Bagas imaturas 2.5 × 1.5 cm diâm, elipsóides ou obovais, secas enegrecidas, miudamente e minutamente lenticeladas, base às vezes com 3 elevações marcadas, maduras amarelas, laranja ou esverdeados (n.v.), epicarpo maduro crustáceo. Sementes não vistas.

description: Plant stemless or with a short stout erect stem with its fusiform base buried in the ground, flowering over 1 m in diameter. Leaves very numerous, ca 5 dm long; sheaths elongate, more or less glabrescent toward base, elsewhere but especially above covered with coarse ferruginous spreading scales or the inner leaves appressed-lepidote, spinulose toward apex; blades linear, attenuate to a pungent apex, 15 mm wide, rigid, glabrate above, sparsely brown-lepidote beneath, spinose-serrate with the basal spines recurved, the intermediate spreading, and the upper antrorse and minute. Inflorescence corymbose or capitiform, 20-40 flowered; outer bracts forming an involucre, the base linear, the blade narrowly elliptic, acute, exceeding the flowers, laciniate-serrate, ivory-white, covered with snow-white scales or often tomentellous. Floral bracts broadly spatulate, obtuse, distinctly shorter than the sepals, fimbriate-crenulate; flowers 33-40 mm long, attenuate toward base. Sepals oblong, obtuse, cucullate and irregularly twisted at apex, to 12 mm long, glabrous inside, lepidote or tomentose-lepidote outside, often glabrate toward base, alate-carinate, the margin more or less hyaline; petals narrowly elliptic, 20 mm long, strict, slightly recurved-spreading at apex at anthesis, pale blue, the scales basal, minute, fleshy; filaments filiform, slightly shorter than the anthers; anthers linear, 8 mm long, acute, rounded at base; ovary clavate, usually lepidote toward apex, broadly bialate; epigynous tube infundibuliform, ovules with a short broadly conical appendage. Fruit 50 mm long.

description: Leaves (inner) at least 4 dm long; sheaths elongate, elliptic-ovate, covered especially beneath with pale allutaceous coherent scales, the margin laciniate-serrulate and fringed with long scales; blades linear-triangular, 22 mm wide, rigid, coriaceous, glabrate above, covered beneath with pale minute closely appressed scales, laxly serrate with flat green spines 3 mm long, the basal spines straight and spreading, the others antrorsely curved. Inflorescence subglobose, surrounded by red inner leaves, rather many-flowered; outer bracts broadly elliptic, acute, exceeding the flowers, very densely lepidote on both sides, coarsely laciniate-serrate. Floral bracts obovate, broadly rounded, shorter than the flowers, fimbriate-serrulate, densely lepidote; flowers (immature) nearly 40 mm long. Sepals oblong-lanceolate, obtuse and mucronulate, 18 mm long, glabrous and pellucid on the margin at base, elsewhere coarsely fimbriate-lepidote; petals narrowly elliptic, the 2 scales basal, conspicuous, membranaceous, laterally attached; filaments linear, 2.5 mm long; anthers stout, 12 mm long, obtuse at both ends; ovary slenderly clavate, subterete, lepidote; epigynous tube infundibuliform.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 3 dm high, less than 1 m in diameter. Leaves with sheaths distinct, elongate, narrowly ovate, covered with allutaceous-brown sericeous scales; blades linear, attenuate, 25 cm long, 10 mm wide, glabrate above, covered with closely appressed whitish scales beneath, serrate, the lower spines green or allutaceous, recurved or like the middle ones straight and spreading, 1.5 mm long, the upper minute and upwardly curved, pale green, paler beneath. Inflorescence corymbose, 10-15-flowered; outer bracts slightly exceeding the sepals, shorter than the flowers. Floral bracts with a long narrow claw, the blade rhombic, cuneate at base, very broadly acute or subrounded at apex, densely and minutely laciniate, covered beneath with ivory white scales especially toward apex; flowers 20 mm long, attenuate toward base. Sepals narrowly oblong, distinctly cucullate, 12 mm long, scarcely if at all hyaline-margined, strongly carinate, lepidote outside especially toward apex; petals narrowly elliptic, the 2 scales basal, minute, fleshy; filaments filiform; anthers linear, rounded at both ends, 9 mm long, mucronulate; ovary slenderly clavate, distinctly constricted at apex, sparsely lepidote, bilineate, the epigynous tube short, infundibuliform; ovules few, globose with a short conical apical appendage.

description: Plant flowering slightly over 5 dm high. Leaves often 1 m long, spreading; sheaths conspicuous, triangular-ovate, brownish beneath, white above, covered on both sides with a white membrane of fused scales, serrulate toward apex with straight brown spreading spines; blades linear, long-attenuate, to 18 mm wide, thick coriaceous, glaucous-green, glabrous at maturity or subglabrous above and sparsely white-lepidote beneath, serrate with flat greenish spines 1.5 mm long, the basal spines spreading, the others antrorsely curved. Inflorescence very densely capitate, many-flowered, surrounded by the bright red inner leaves. Floral bracts slightly exceeding the bases of the sepals, the claw linear, entire, glabrous, the blade obovate or broadly elliptic, obtuse, very densely fimbriate-serrulate, covered with a white membrane of fused scales especially beneath; flowers 4-6 cm long, attenuate toward base, bright violet or blue. Sepals broadly oblong-ovate, rounded and often slightly emarginate and incurved at apex, 1722 mm long, narrowly hyaline-margined, slightly carinate, glabrous inside, lepidote toward apex outside; petals 22-24 mm long, erect at anthesis with recurved-spreading apices, narrowly elliptic, bearing 2 small fleshy scales at base; filaments slender, slightly dilated toward base; anthers linear, 9 mm long; ovary strongly compressed, narrowly bialate; epigynous tube funnelform; ovules few, stoutly ellipsoid or globose, short-umbonate at apex.

description: Plant propagating by very short ascending rhizomes. Leaves many in a spreading rosette, 1-4 dm long, covered beneath with a pale membrane of fused scales; sheaths short, broadly subtriangular, serrulate, dark castaneous; blades very narrowly triangular, acuminate, pungent, 4-10 mm wide, channeled, laxly serrate with slender curved brown spines 1.5 mm long, smooth and glabrous above. Scape erect, slender, white-flocculose; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, elliptic, acuminate, subpapyraceous, nerved, red, white-lepidote, the lower with short foliaceous blades, the upper entire. Inflorescence simple, subdense, usually exceeding the leaves, many-flowered, to 14 cm long, sparsely white-flocculose except the petals; rhachis straight, slender, red. Floral bracts ovate, acute, entire, exceeding at least the ovary, red; pedicels suberect, very slender, the lowest 2 cm long; flowers to 2 cm long. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 7 mm long, thin, red; petals obovate, broadly rounded, 9 mm long, dark red; stamens ineluded; ovary terete, 7 mm long, much enlarged in fruit, the epigynous tube large; placentae nearly the whole height of the cell; ovules subobtuse. Fruit baccate, globose, 7 mm in diameter, trisulcate.

description: Herbs, to 30 cm high. Stems simple, sometimes branched, white to creamy, internodes 2.5-3 cm long. Leaves connate at their base, narrowly triangular to narrowly ovate, 3-5 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide, apex acute. Inflorescence dichasial at the base, monochasial towards the apex, to 30-flowered. Bracts similar to the upper leaves but somewhat smaller. Pedicels ca. 0.5 mm long. Flowers white to creamy, 5-merous. Calyx campanulate, 3-4 mm long, tube (1-)2-3 mm long, lobes triangular, remote, 0.5-2 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate, sinuses obtuse, calyx scales present. Corolla salverform, white to creamy, 8-10 mm long, tube cylindric, 7.5-9 mm long, swollen after anthesis, constricted at the throat, lobes deltate, 0.5-1 mm long and wide, apex acute to acuminate. Stamens inserted 1-2 mm below the throat, anthers subsessile, ca. 0.5 mm long, dorsifixed, thecae acute at the base, truncate at the apex, divergent. Ovary narrowly ellipsoid, 4-5 x 1 mm, eglandular, stipitate, the stipe to 3 mm long in fruit. Style 0.5-2 mm long, stigma 2-lobed, lobes homed. Capsule ellipsoid to globose, some what flattened, 4-6 mm diam., valves with involute margins. Seeds filiform to fusiform, 0.6-2.0 x 0.07-0.10 mm, paraphyses present.

description: Herbs, 3-15 cm high. Stems simple or branched, purplish to red, internodes 0.5-2 cm long. Leaves purplish to red, connate at the base only, patent, triangular to narrowly triangular, 3-8 mm long, 1-2 mm wide. Inflorescence a loose, few-flowered cyme, or flowers solitary. Flowers 4-6-merous, fragrant. Bracts rarely present, similar to the upper leaves. Pedicels 8-10 mm long. Calyx purplish to red, campanulate, 4-8(-12) mm long, tube 2-5 mm long, 15-veined, lobes narrowly triangular, 3-4(-7) mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, apex acuminate, often with 2-3 distinct veins, sinuses acute, calyx scales minute, inserted at the furcation of the main veins. Corolla salverform, 14-30 mm long, minutely hairy outside, tube whitish, glabrous to hairy inside, gradually widened towards the throat, 11-22 mm long, provided at the base with five nectar grooves, throat ca. 3 mm diam., lobes purple to blue or whitish, triangular to narrowly triangular, 3-10 mm long, 1-3 mm wide, apex acuminate to caudate, often involute when dry. Stamens inserted (3-)5-10 mm below the throat, filaments 3-10 mm long, hairy, anthers basifixed, coherent, ca. 1 mm long. Ovary oblong-fusiform, 2-4 mm long, subsessile, often swollen and furcate at the apex (in herbarium material), provided with two broadly elliptic glands at the base. Style 10-19 mm long, glabrous to papillate, stigma rotate, papillate, sometimes exceeding the corolla-tube. Capsule oblong-elliptic, ca. 5 x 2 mm, indehiscent (?). Seeds ovoid to subglobose, 0.20.3 x 0.2 mm.

description: Herbs to 15 cm high. Stems 0.5-2 mm diam. Roots to 30 mm long and 0.3 mm thick (Maas et al. 4246). Leaves ovate to depressed ovate, 1-4 mm long, 0.5-2 mm wide. Bracts and bracteoles narrowly triangular, (1-)3-8 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide. Pedicels 1-2 mm long. Flowers white. Calyx with almost free, narrowly triangular, sometimes recurved lobes, 3-10 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide. Corolla 3.5-12 mm long, to 2 mm diam., tube sometimes constricted near the throat, 3-10 mm long, lobes elliptic to ovate, 0.5-3 mm long, 1-2 mm wide. Stamens inserted 1-3.5(-6) mm below the throat, filaments 0.1-1(-5) mm long, connective sometimes prolonged beyond the thecae by 0.4-0.6 mm, thecae narrowly elliptic, 0.4-1.5 mm long. Style (0.5-)1-9 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 1-3 x 0.7-2 mm, sessile. Capsule 1-5 x 1-2.5 mm. Seeds globose, 0.2 mm diam.

description: Plant subacaulescent, flowering 8-10 dm high. Leaves many in a loosely spreading rosette, 7-10 dm long; sheaths narrow and inconspicuous; blades linear, soft-acuminate, narrowed toward base and serrulate with spines 1 mm long, elsewhere entire, 2-3 cm wide, cinereous-lepidote especially beneath. Scape erect, 7 mm in diameter, densely lepidote at first; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, much exceeding the internodes, entire. Inflorescence tripinnate, thyrsoid, many-flowered, to 4 dm long, pale-lepidote; primary bracts narrowly triangular, shorter than the branches; branches divergent, subdensely 10-20-flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, 4-5 mm long, slightly exceeded by the sepals; pedicels 1.5 mm long; flowers spreading, not secund. Sepals ovate, subobtuse, 4 mm long; petals obtuse, 5.5 mm long, white, recurved at anthesis; stamens shorter than the petals, the anthers 1.5 mm long. Capsule subpyramidal, 5 mm long; seeds many, fusiform, bicaudate.

description: Plant stemless, propagating by basal offsets, the flowering shoot 14-26 cm high. Leaves few, to 9 cm long, entire, thin, sparsely pale-lepidote when very young, completely glabrous by maturity; sheaths broadly ovate, about 1 cm long; blades lanceolate, flat, acuminate, 12 mm wide, strongly nerved. Scape straight, very slender, sparsely white-flocculose; scape-bracts lanceolate, acuminate, small and remote. Inflorescence simple or with a few very short branches at the base, 5-9 cm long, lax, sparsely white-flocculose. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, exceeding the pedicels; flowers divergent to spreading, not at all secund; pedicels slender, 1 mm long. Sepals ovate, obtuse, nearly 2 mm long; petals elliptic, obtuse, 5 mm long, exceeding the stamens, white, coiling-recurved at anthesis.

description: Plant flowering 30-45 cm high. Leaves rosulate, few, to 15 cm long, entire; sheaths broadly ovate, small, the outer ones white-tomentose-lepidote; blades linear-lanceolate, acuminate, narrowed toward base, 11 mm wide. Scape erect, slender, scape-bracts narrowly triangular, acuminate, much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate or subtripinnate, glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches curved-ascending, sublaxly many-flowered, very slender. Floral bracts ovate, acute, shorter than the pedicels; pedicels slender, 3 mm long; flowers nutant, secund. Sepals ovate, acute, 2 mm long; petals lanceolate, 5-6 mm long, equaling the stamens; anthers 3 mm long. Capsule 3 mm long.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high, very slender. Leaves to 6 dm long; sheaths broadly ovate, small; blades linear, filiform-acuminate, contracted at base but not really petiolate, to 12 mm wide, strongly channeled, subdensely serrate toward base with spines 1 mm long, glabrous above, covered beneath with a membrane of white scales. Scape erect, elongate, slightly flexuous, 5 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts very large but spreading and not concealing the scape, entire, the lowest subfoliaceous with small sheaths, the highest filiform-attenuate from a very narrowly triangular base. Inflorescence laxly and very amply tripinnate, over 6 dm long, glabrous; lowest primary bracts like the top scape-bracts, large but shorter than the branches, the highest greatly reduced; branches curved upward, laxly secund-flowered. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, less than half as long as the pedicels; pedicels slender, to 2 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 1.5 mm long; petals 3 mm long, equaling the stamens, white.

description: Flowering plant 3-7 dm high. Leaves entire, constricted above the sheath; blades lanceolate, acuminate, 30 cm long, 4 cm wide, thin, glabrous above, densely furfuraceous-lepidote below. Scape slender and erect; scape-bracts lanceolate or lance-ovate, thin. Inflorescence amply bipinnate, up to 26 cm long, arachnoid; branches curved-ascending, many times longer than their subtending bracts. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, slightly longer than the pedicels; flowers secund and nutant. Sepals triangular-ovate, obtuse, 3-4 mm long; petals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 7-9 mm long; style slender, elongate; stamens distinctly shorter than the petals.

description: Plant flowering to 5 dm high. Leaves about 12, fasciculate-rosulate, to 36 cm long, entire, constricted above the sheath; sheaths ovate, small; blades linear, caudate-attenuate, 8 mm wide, channeled, covered beneath with pale appressed scales, glabrous above. Scape erect; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate, subfoliaceous. Inflorescence laxly tripinnate, subthyrsoid, attenuate, to 4 dm long, subarachnoid-tomentellous; primary bracts linear-triangular, attenuate, shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches ascending, lax. Floral bracts triangular-ovate, exceeding the pedicels, the upper 3.5 mm long; flowers erect or suberect, not noticeably secund, 3.5 mm long. Sepals semiorbicular, broadly rounded, 2 mm long; petals slightly exceeding the sepals; stamens exserted, anthers 2 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 25-60 cm high, propagating by suckers. Leaves rosulate, linear-lanceolate with a soft narrow apex, to 35 cm long, 35 mm wide, entire, thin, glabrous above, sparingly scurfy beneath. Scape central, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts lanceolate, acuminate, entire, the upper remote. Inflorescence laxly paniculate, 2 dm long, glabrous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, 5-10 mm long, hyaline; branches simple or the lowest divided and 2 dm long, laxly and secundly many-flowered. Floral bracts ovate, acuminate, 1-1.5 mm long, thin, green; pedicels slender, 2, rarely 3 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, obtuse, 3.5 mm long, green with white margins; petals lance-oblong, 8-9 mm long, over 2 mm wide, white; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering to 1 m high, slender. Leaves many, fasciculate, entire, the outer squamiform, the inner functional; sheaths triangular, short; petioles 35 cm long; blades narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, long-cuneate, 4 dm long, 35 mm wide, submembranaceous, covered beneath with white or pale appressed scales. Scape erect, slender, araneose becoming glabrous; scape-bracts erect, much exceeding the internodes, narrowly lanceolate, membranaceous. Inflorescence tripinnate, slender, 25 cm long, 3 cm in diameter, interrupted, subglabrous; primary bracts suberect, lanceolate, large, membranaceous; branches weakly divided, laxly few-flowered, 35 mm long. Floral bracts broadly lanceolate, acute, slightly exceeding the pedicels, thin-membranaceous; pedicels scarcely over 1.5 mm long; flowers not at all secund, suberect to spreading, to 4 mm long, greenish white, glabrous. Sepals free, elliptic, narrowly rounded, 2.5 mm long, thin; petals broadly elliptic, slightly emarginate, 3.5 mm long; stamens free, slightly exceeding the petals; anthers rounded at both ends, 1.75 mm long; style rather stout, equaling the ovary; stigma obtuse.

description: Flowering plant 4-5 dm high. Leaves ca 3 dm long, entire; blades not constricted at base, sublinear, long-acuminate, 2 cm wide, glabrous above, covered beneath with a membrane of pale coalesced scales. Scape very slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, very narrowly triangular from an ovate base, subfiliform-acuminate, the highest equaling the internodes or slightly shorter. Inflorescence 2-3-pinnate, very lax, 22 cm long, glabrous; primary bracts small; branches ascending or toward apex arched-recurving, sublaxly secund-flowered, to 15 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, much shorter than the pedicels; pedicels very slender, to 5 mm long; flowers nutant. Sepals very broadly ovate, subacute, 1.9 mm long, 1.8 mm wide; petals linear, acute, 5.5 mm long, exceeding the stamens, white; ovary ellipsoid; ovules caudate.

description: Flowering 5 dm high. Leaves ca 2 dm long; sheaths small and inconspicuous; blades linear, acuminate to a soft filiform apex, slightly narrowed toward base, somewhat dimorphic with broad and narrow forms, to 25 mm wide, chartaceous-membranaceous, sparsely serrulate at base, pale green and glabrate above, covered beneath with a membrane of whitish scales. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts lanceolate, filiform-acuminate, longer or shorter than the internodes, entire. Inflorescence laxly 2-3-pinnate, ca 3 dm long; axes glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, much shorter than the branches; branches curved-ascending, elongate, very slender, laxly 8-15-flowered. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, minute, membranaceous; flowers nutant, secund, 3 mm long. Sepals ovate-elliptic, rounded, 1.5 mm long; petals greenish; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering 9 dm high. Leaves about 8-12, laxly rosulate, entire, constricted above the sheath but not definitely petiolate; blade broadly lanceolate, acuminate, 25 cm long, 4 m wide, membranaceous, glabrous, light green when dry. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts ovate, acuminate, shorter than the internodes, entire. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, 3 dm long, 75 mm in diameter, many-flowered, glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, many times shorter than the branches; branches curved-ascending, 8 cm long. Floral bracts ovate, acute, 1.5 mm long, shorter than the pedicels, erect; flowers nodding, rather obsucrely secund, 5 mm long, white. Sepals subtriangular, obtuse, half as long as the petals; petals subelliptic, acute, erect at anthesis; stamens included.

description: Plant propagating by basal offshoots, flowering over 6 dm high. Leaves few, rosulate, 2-3 dm long, entire, membranaceous; sheaths ovate, ca 5 cm long; blades linear-lanceolate, acuminate, narrowed toward base, 25-40 mm wide, sparsely flocculose beneath, glabrous above. Scape erect, flocculose; scape-bracts densely imbricate, linear-lanceolate, attenuate, 3-5 cm long, thin. Inflorescence laxly subtripinnate, subcylindric, 25 cm long, many-flowered, flocculose-villous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, 2-4 cm long; branches curved-ascending, subdense. Floral bracts lance-ovate, acuminate, nearly 7 mm long; pedicels very short; flowers nutant, secund. Sepals oblong-ovate, subacute, 4-5 mm long; petals broadly oblanceolate, subobtuse, 7 mm long; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering about 2 m high. Leaves 6-10 dm long; sheaths large, narrowly ovate, dark-punctulate-lepidote especially on the inside; blades acute, 7 cm wide, soon glabrous, reddish toward apex. Scape over 15 mm in diameter. Inflorescence very laxly and amply tripinnate, red throughout, glabrous; primary bracts lance-ovate, about half as long as the sterile bases of the branches; branches spreading, to 45 cm long, bearing 6-8 spikes, the sterile base about 1 dm long, usually bearing a single prophyllum slightly smaller than the primary bract; secondary bracts exacdy like the floral bracts, much shorter than the axillary spikes; spikes recurved, subsessile, densely ovoid or ellipsoid, 4-8 cm long. Floral bracts erect, densely imbricate, narrowly ovate, abruptly acute, 25-35 mm long, about equaling the sepals, slightly convex, keeled, prominently nerved, thick, coriaceous; flowers subsessile. Sepals narrowly triangular, acute, 24 mm long, 5 mm wide, thick, coriaceous, prominently nerved, some alate-carinate, others flat, free; petals ligulate, equaling the sepals, bearing 2 large lanceolate, closely attached scales at the base; ovary half superior. Capsule 30-35 mm long, the lower half ellipsoid, the upper half very slenderly conic; seeds slenderly cylindric with a long poorly divided coma on both ends.

description: Plant subacaulescent, leaves many in a dense rosette, 1.3 m long; sheaths conspicuous, subelliptic, covered toward base especially beneath with coarse rusty brown scales, elsewhere showing greenish white; blades ensiform, long-attenuate, pungent, narrowed toward base, to 40 mm wide, pale green above and glabrate, slightly paler beneath and white-lepidote at first, serrate toward base with stout straight brown spines 3 mm long, entire in the middle, and sparsely and finely spinulose-serrate on the apical half. Inflorescences axillary, 10-20-flowered, corymbose; outer bracts lanceolate, equaling the sepals, antrorsely spinose-serrate toward apex, pale green, densely and coarsely brown-lepidote; pedicels short; 3-angled; sepals lance-ovate, 21 mm long, nearly 7 mm wide, mucronate at apex, sharply carinate, sparsely lepidote; petals 33 mm long, tubular-connate for more than half their length, blades suberect to spreading at anthesis, minutely cucullate; stamens shorter than the petals, filaments highly adnate to the petals, anthers oblong, 5.5 mm long; ovary slenderly ellipsoid, the epigynous tube very short; fruit much enlarged from the ovary.

description: Plant stemless. Leaves to 2 m long, rosulate, the inner erect, the outer decurved; sheaths elliptic, distinct, very stiff, entire or with a few stout spines toward apex, sparsely lepidote above with coarse brown scales, more densely beneath; blades linear, attenuate to a stout spine, 30 mm wide, bright green above, paler beneath, serrate throughout with straight spreading or ascending stout brown spines 3-4 mm long becoming minute and paler upwards. Inflorescence many, lateral, subglobose, compound, many-flowered; outer bracts broadly lanceolate, brown or dark castaneous at base, attenuate into a green spine, exceeding the flowers, coarsely serrate with brown spines. Floral bracts narrower, equaling the sepals, serrulate; pedicels short but slender. Sepals lanceolate, subulate, 37-43 mm long, connate for 5-21 mm, white, brown-lepidote, carinate; petals 30-52 mm long, more than half-connate, fleshy, soon turning brown, sometimes appendaged, the blades erect; stamens equaling or slightly exceeding the petals, subexserted at anthesis, filaments highly adnate to the petals, anthers stout, 16-19 mm long; ovary 20-25 mm long, the epigynous tube lacking; ovules uniseriate. Fruit pulpy, white; seeds almost black, lacking a gelatinous coat.

description: Plant stemless, flowering to 76 cm high. Leaves few in a fasciculate rosette, 55 cm long; sheaths distinct, 6-10 cm long, very dark brown toward base, subdensely lepidote with minute appressed pale brown scales; blades linear, acuminate, 17 mm wide, deep green, glabrous at maturity, thin. Scape erect, slender; scape-bracts strict, narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, exceeding the internodes but not wholly covering the scape. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate or somewhat dense near apex; primary bracts spreading, lance-triangular, caudate-acuminate, the lower ones equaling to much exceeding the spikes; spikes spreading or subspreading, very short-stipitate, subglobose, 25 mm long, dense, about 9-flowered. Floral bracts very broadly ovate, rounded and often emarginate, 8 mm long, distinctly shorter than the sepals, nerved, punctulate-lepidote; flowers subsessile. Sepals obovate, broadly rounded, ca 8 mm long, connate for about 1/3, nerved; petals white, the blades elliptic, 7 mm long. Capsule subcylindric, acute, 22 mm long, dehiscent to base; seeds nearly 5 mm long, coma ferruginous.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 6 dm high. Leaves numerous, 45 cm long; sheaths indistinct, minutely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, acuminate, 3 cm wide. Scape erect, about equaling the leaves, glabrous; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate, lanceolate, acuminate, veined. Inflorescence bipinnate, lax, 2 dm long; primary bracts acuminate from an ovate base, exceeding the lowest branches; branches about 4-flowered, dense, the lowest stipitate. Floral bracts broadly ovate, distinctly exceeded by the sepals; flowers subsessile. Sepals slightly asymmetric, elliptic, obtuse, 30 mm long, ca 1/3 connate, nerved; petals 56 mm long, yellow, lobes spreading or reflexed, obtuse.

description: Tree or treelet 1.5-15 m tall. Branchlets sometimes purplish with whitish callose lenticels when dried, older branchlets becoming grayish, sparsely golden to whitish pilosulous when young, glabrescent when older. Leaves apparently opposite, sometimes also ternate; petioles (l-)2-8 mm long, golden hispidulous above, golden strigose beneath when young, glabrescent when older; stipules deciduous, deltoid, acuminate, 2.5-6 x 1-3.25 mm, herbaceous, sparsely golden to whitish strigose along the costa, ciliolate; lamina (narrowly) ovate, acuminate, (1.5-)3-21.5 x (0.5-)1-10 cm, herbaceous to papery, glabrous on both sides; costa above sparsely golden to whitish pilosulous, golden strigose to glabrescent beneath; domatia present, whitish to brownish pi-lose(ulous); lateral veins 7-14 (acumen excluded); tertiary venation reticulate to ± scalariform; base rounded to cuneate, asymmetric, oblique, subcordate to subauriculate at the petiole; margin (sub)crenate or (sub)serrate to subentire, mucronulate, ciliolate near the base; acumen (0-)0.5-3.5 cm long, apex subobtuse to subacute, often mucronulate. Inflorescences axillary, lateral and subterminal, solitary, racemose, (1-)2-6.5 x 0.60.8 cm; central axis golden pilosulous; 'pedicels’ 1.5-6 mm long, articulate at 1/3 from the base, sparsely golden pilosulous; bracts and bractlets more or less ovate, herbaceous, golden pilosulous, costate, strongly veined, ciliolate, apex subacute, mucronulate; bracts 1.5-2 x 1-1.75 mm, costate, 5-7 veined; bractlets subaltemate to subopposite, 1-1.5 x 0.5-1 mm. Flower buds ovoid, conical or tolpoid, subobtuse to subacute. Flowers deflexed, whitish or creamy. Sepals unequal, (ob)ovate to ellipsoid, 1.25-2 x 0.75-1.5 mm, herbaceous, scarious near the margin, golden strigose along the costa, obscurely 3-9 veined, margin ciliolate, apex (sub)entire, sometimes mucronulate. Petals narrowly elliptic to ovate, 3.25-4.25 x 1.5-2 mm, herbaceous, sparsely golden pilose when young, glabrescent when older, margin sparsely ciliolate, apex obtuse to subacute, sometimes sparsely pilosulous. Stamens 2.75-3.75 mm long; filaments free, 1.25-1.5 x 0.1-0.25 mm, glabrous; dorsal glands free, surrounding the basal part of the filaments, 0.250.75 x 0.1-0.25 mm, carnose, glabrous, apex obtuse, rounded, truncate or emarginate; anthers ovoid, 0.75-1.25 x 0.25-0.75 mm, glabrous, apex of thecae obtuse to subacute, unappendaged; connective outside, narrowly ovate, deltoid, elliptic or linear, obtuse, 0.5-1.25 x 0.1-0.25 mm, glabrous; connective scales lateral as well as apical, ovate, 1.5-2.25 x 0.5-1 mm, scarious, brownish, margin erose to lacerate, apex obtuse to rounded, (sub)erose. Ovary (sub)globose, 0.75-1.25 x 0.75-1 mm, golden villose; ovules two, occasionally three per placenta. Style filiform, erect to slightly curved, 2.25-2.75 mm long, exceeding the stamens by 0.2-0.6 mm, occasionally pilosulous at the base; stigma truncate. Capsule more or less symmetric, ellipsoid, shortly acuminate, coriaceous to subligneous, green when fresh, golden hirtellous, veined; valves three, (sub)equal, 1.5-2 x 0.5-0.75 cm. Seeds two per valve, subglobose, 2-5 mm in diam., golden hirtellous.

description: Stem from quite short to ca 2 dm long and branched. Leaves densely and evenly distributed along the stem, 8-15 cm long, green above, purplish beneath; sheaths distinct, elliptic, densely brown-punctulate-lepidote; blades suberect or slightly spreading, very narrowly triangular, attenuate, 10 mm wide, punctulate-lepidote. Scape slender, almost wholly concealed by the leaves. Inflorescence simple, few-flowered, stoutly fusiform, to 65 mm long and 40 mm in diameter, sterile toward apex. Floral bracts ample, ovate-elliptic, acute or subacuminate, erect, much exceeding the sepals, slightly shorter than the flowers at anthesis, membranaceous; flowers subsessile. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 15-20 mm long, membranaceous, glabrous, connate for 3 mm; petals bright yellow, 7 cm long, adherent in a slender tube for 6 cm, the free lobes subelliptic, obtuse; stamens 4 mm shorter than the petals; filaments adherent to the petals for almost their whole length. Capsule prismatic, acute, 28 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 1 m high or more. Leaves rosulate, 3-9 dm long, green, obscurely punctulate-lepidote; sheaths elliptic, 15-20 cm long but only a little wider than the blades, densely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly acute and apiculate, 4-7 cm wide, coriaceous. Scape 8 mm in diameter near apex, glabrous, red; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, elliptic, apiculate. Inflorescence bipinnate or at base tripinnate, thyrsoid, lax except near apex, 18-48 cm long, 8 cm wide; axis flexuous, glabrous, red; primary bracts ovate, acute, subchartaceous, red, minutely pale-lepidote especially toward their apices, the lowest about equaling the spikes, the others much shorter; spikes suberect to spreading or reflexed, densely to sublaxly ellipsoid, 35-70 mm long including the short sterile base, 20-25 mm in diameter. Floral bracts erect to suberect, broadly elliptic, obtuse, cucullate, ecarinate, 9-25 mm long, from much shorter than to exceeding the sepals, chartaceous, nerved, red, sparsely and minutely pale-lepidote; pedicels obconic, stout, 3-5 mm long. Sepals oblong-elliptic, obtuse, 15-20 mm long, connate for 4-5 mm, strongly nerved, sparsely and obscurely lepidote; petals agglutinated, naked, the blades elliptic, 10 mm long, yellow; stamens included.

description: Plant flowering over 3 dm high (?). Leaves (Foster 2637) 4 dm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, 15 cm long, dark castaneous; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 5 cm wide, covered on both sides with pale dark-centered appressed scales. Scape distinct, straight; scape-bracts densely imbricate and covering the scape, ovate, acuminate. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, cylindric, 15 cm long, 45 mm in diameter, fertile throughout; floral bracts strict, triangular-ovate, covering the sepals, membranaceous, bright red, densely and minutely dark-punctulate. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 24 mm long, connate for 6 mm, coriaceous, glabrous, lustrous and nearly even; petals 8 cm long, very high-connate, yellow when dry, the blades erect, elliptic, 15 mm long; stamens included. Capsules slenderly cylindric, 35 mm long; coma of the seeds dull white.

description: Plant flowering over 1.5 m high, spreading by stout stolons. Leaves rosulate, 5-6 dm long, punctulate-lepidote; sheaths large but only a little wider than the blades, often purplish toward base; blades ligulate, broadly acute, 4-6 cm wide. Scape erect, stout, dark red like its bracts and the inflorescence; scape-bracts strict, the lowest subfoliaceous and densely imbricate, the upper ovate, acute, and about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence lax, 35-65 cm long, narrow, tripinnate at base, bipinnate above; primary bracts broadly ovate, acute, barely exceeding the sterile base of the branch; branches decurved with downwardly secund flowers, 5-9 cm long. Floral bracts ovate, 8 mm long, thin, nerved; pedicels stout, 6 mm long. Sepals subelliptic, obtuse, 12-14 mm long, short-connate, nerved, glabrous; petals 24 mm long, white, the blades spreading, elliptic.

description: Stem 2-3 m long, simple or few-branched. Leaves 2-3 dm long; sheaths densely imbricate, elliptic, ca 4 cm long; blades linear, attenuate, flat, 5 mm wide. Inflorescence simple, corymbiform, 10-12-flowered. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, 25 mm long. Sepals 40-55 mm long, more than 1/2 connate in a slender tube, purplish, the free lobes spreading, oblong-elliptic, obtuse; petals slightly exceeding the sepals, bright green.

description: Plant flowering 4-10 dm high. Leaves rosulate, suberect, 3-6 dm long; sheaths narrowly ovate, 8 cm long, very densely and finely brown-lepidote, castaneous toward the base, green, some with many fine violet stripes toward the apex; blades ligulate, acute to acuminate, 15-30 mm wide, glabrous above, very obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, 5-8 mm in diameter; scape-bracts strict, imbricate, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper with castaneous and striped base and narrowly triangular apex. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, many-flowered, ovoid or cylindric, 5-8 cm long, 2-3 cm in diameter, glabrous. Floral bracts erect, densely imbricate and covering the sepals, suborbicular with a broadly triangular obtuse apex, ecarinate, coriaceous, lustrous, pale brown to castaneous; flowers subsessile. Sepals ovate, obtuse, 13-16 mm long, coriaceous, the posterior ones carinate; corolla white, 6-10 mm longer than the sepals, its lobes elliptic, obtuse; stamens and pistil included. Capsule slenderly cylindric, abruptly short-beaked.

description: Plant stemless but usually stoloniferous, flowering 4-9 dm high. Leaves suberect, 3-9 dm long; sheaths elliptic, distinct, dark castaneous at the base, the rest pale green with Fine brown longitudinal stripes, densely and finely lepidote; blades linear, attenuate, 7-12 mm wide, obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, 3-5 mm in diameter, much shorter than the leaves, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper elliptic, acute, bright red, glabrous. Inflorescence simple, very laxly 7-15-flowered, about equaling the leaves; axis nearly straight, slender, glabrous, sulcate. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, usually much shorter than the sepals and closely enfolding them; flowers mostly spreading; pedicels slender, 5-8 mm long. Sepals to 3 cm long, subchartaceous, glabrous, connate into a slender tube for more than half their length, the free segments oblong, obtuse; petals white. Capsule slenderly cylindric, equaling the sepals.

description: Leaves rosulate at the end of the stout caudex, 4-7 dm long, much exceeding the inflorescence; sheaths elliptic, 10 cm long, scarcely wider than the blades, covered with minute pale appressed scales, dark castaneous toward the base; blades ligulate, acute, minutely pale-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, from very short to 3 dm long; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, the lower elliptic, acute, the highest ovate, red, ample, forming a showy involucre about the inflorescence. Infloresence densely digitate from about 10 spikes; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts; spikes fusiform, 5-8 cm long, few-flowered. Floral bracts densely imbricate, elliptic, obtuse, 32 mm long, about equaling the sepals, pale green or yellow, thin, nerved; pedicels 5 mm long. Sepals elliptic, 26 mm long, high-connate, thin; petals 4 cm long, yellow or white, the lobes spreading, elliptic.

description: Plant flowering 7-9 dm high. Leaves rosulate, over 6 dm long; sheaths broadly ovate, 12 cm long, densely and finely brown-appressed-lepidote, castaneous; blades ligulate, acuminate to acute and apiculate, 5 cm wide, green, concolorous, lepidote below, soon glabrous above; scape erect, 10-14 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts erect or slightly spreading toward apex, densely imbricate, foliaceous, to 2 dm long. Inflorescence bipinnate, dense toward apex, thyrsiform, 5-8 dm long, 5-9 cm in diameter, sparsely and finely white-appressed-lepidote throughout, flavous or often purplish; primary bracts suberect to spreading, ovate-lanceolate or the upper broadly ovate, acuminate, the lower subfoliaceous and much exceeding the axillary branches, to 12 cm long, the upper only about half as long as the branches; racemes spiciform, suberect, 7-12-flowered, lax at least at base, ellipsoid, the lower short-stipitate; rhachis stout, angled, 25-30 mm long. Floral bracts oblong or elliptic, obtuse, 16 mm long, much shorter than the sepals, convex, ecarinate, submembranaceous when dry but wrinkled as if quite fleshy when alive; flowers suberect to spreading; pedicels stout, 3-4 mm long. Sepals symmetrical, lanceolate, acute or obtuse, 24-30 mm long, short-connate, subcoriaceous, prominently nerved; corolla slenderly cylindric, 45 mm long, yellow, the lobes elliptic, obtuse; stamens barely shorter than the petals.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 3 dm high. Leaves many in a dense rosette, 3 dm long, covered beneath with pale closely appressed scales; sheaths evident, narrowly elliptic; blades linear, acuminate, subpungent, 12-35 mm wide, chartaceous when dry, pale green. Scape erect, about half as long as the leaves, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, ovate, acuminate. Inflorescence simple, densely strobilate, 7 cm long, 23 mm in diameter, sterile toward apex. Floral bracts very broadly ovate, the lowest apiculate, the others rounded, equaling or exceeding the flowers, membranaceous, bright red, not at all farinose; flowers subsessile, 22 mm long. Sepals slightly asymmetric, subelliptic, rounded at apex, 12 mm long, connate for 3 mm, subcoriaceous, nerved; petal-lobes elliptic, rounded; stamens included, anthers sagittate, 4 mm long.

description: Plant flowering over 7 dm high. Leaves rosulate, 4-6 dm long; sheaths indistinct, covered with fine appressed dark brown scales; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 7-8 cm wide, subglabrous, green with a bright red apex. Scape stout, erect; scape-bracts foliaceous, very densely imbricate. Inflorescence densely cylindric; primary bracts subfoliaceous, greatly exceeding the many-flowered fascicles. Floral bracts elliptic, obtuse, equaling the sepals or slightly shorter, red, membranaceous; pedicels to 8 mm long. Sepals oblong, acute, 25-30 mm long, nearly free, thin, red; petals 5 cm long, yellow, blades erect, elliptic. Capsule cylindric, acute, 4 cm long.

description: Plant caulescent, branching, flowering 2-4 dm long. Leaves densely imbricate along the stem, 13-16 cm long; sheaths elliptic, 5-6 cm long, densely pale-lepidote, dark castaneous at base, Finely purple-striped above; blades narrowly triangular, 15 mm wide, densely cinereous-lepidote above, glabrous beneath. Scape erect or ascending, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts imbricate, ovate, acuminate, glabrous beneath, densely lepidote above, red. Inflorescence bipinnate, lax, 9-30 cm long, subthyrsoid, sparsely lepidote except the axes and petals; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, exceeding the lowest branches; spikes laxly 3-6-flowered, distinctly stipitate, 2-4 cm long, yellow. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, obtuse, distinctly shorter than the sepals; flowers subsessile. Sepals elliptic, broadly rounded and emarginate, 8 mm long, about half connate; petals to 16 mm long, blades elliptic, obtuse.

description: Plant scandent; stem elongate, 3-4 mm in diameter, finally losing its leaves at the base. Leaves 15-20 cm long, appressed-brown-lepidote beneath becoming glabrous; sheaths densely imbricate, elliptic, 2 cm long, dark castaneous; blades very narrowly triangular, 4 mm wide, soon glabrous. Scape distinct, elongate; scape-bracts elliptic, acuminate, membranaceous. Inflorescence simple, 2-4-flowered, its axis to 3 cm long. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, obtuse or apiculate, 3-4 cm long, membranaceous; flowers slenderly pedicellate. description: Plant stemless, large, Leaves numerous, 4 dm long; sheaths elliptic, distinct, minutely brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, abruptly acute, 3 cm wide, minutely lepidote. Scape stout, erect, glabrous; scape-bracts ovate, acuminate, the lower densely imbricate, the upper equaling the internodes, red. Inflorescence bipinnate, lax; axes becoming glabrous, red; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, reflexed, shorter than the branches; spikes laxly 4-6-flowered, their axes 4 cm long. Floral bracts narrowly ovate, obtuse, navicular, 15 mm long; pedicels stout, 5-8 mm long. description: Leaves 35-40 cm long, densely lepidote throughout; sheaths broadly ovate, dark brown; blades narrowly triangular, attenuate, 5 cm wide. Scape erect, rugose; scape-bracts erect, exceeding the internodes, lanceolate, acuminate, glabrous. Inflorescence subdensely bipinnate; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, the lowest about equaling the spikes, reflexed; spikes spreading, densely ellipsoid, rounded, 40 mm long, 25 mm in diameter, to 16-flowered, the lowest distinctly stipitate. Floral bracts ovate, subacute, to 15 mm long, distinctly shorter than the sepals, faintly sulcate, green; flowers sessile, 30 mm long, glabrous. Sepals subacute, 18 mm long, connate for 5-6 mm, coriaceous, green; petals white, the lobes linear, acute, 7 mm long; stamens included.

description: Plant stemless, flowering to about 3 dm high. Leaves 15-30 in a dense rosette, 30-45 cm long; sheaths ovate, conspicuous, densely brown-punctulate-lepidote, more or less castaneous at the base, sometimes marked dorsally with fine violet longitudinal stripes; blades ligulate, acute, to 4 cm wide, obscurely punctulate-lepidote. Scape erect, usually much shorter than the leaves, stout; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate and wholly concealing the scape, the lower ones foliaceous, the uppermost lanceolate, usually red-tinged, forming an involucre which overtops the flowers. Inflorescence simple, corymbiform, to 7 cm wide, 10-50-flowered. Floral bracts linear, cucullate, shorter than the flowers; flowers erect, 45 mm long; pedicels very short and stout. Sepals free, linear, obtuse, glabrous; petals linear, cucullate, white; stamens highly connate with the petals; ovary ellipsoid; capsule subellipsoid, 3 cm long, short-beaked; coma reddish-brown.

description: Plant caulescent; stem stout, covered with the remains of old leaves; flowering shoot 2-3 dm high. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, obtuse, 24 mm long, carinate; pedicels slender. Sepals elliptic, emarginate, 20 mm long, 1/3 connate, symmetric, punctulate within; petals 35 mm long.

description: Stem to 1 m long, 2 mm in diameter. Leaves to 22 cm long, sheaths densely imbricate, ovate, 25 mm long, appressed-brown-lepidote becoming glabrous, blades linear, filiform-acuminate, flat, 2-4 mm wide. Scape distinct; scape-bracts elliptic, red with green blades. Inflorescence simple, involucrate; outer and floral bracts broadly elliptic, much exceeded by the sepals, red. Sepals 35-55 mm long, high-connate in a slender tube, the free lobes broadly ovate, yellow; petals much exceeding the sepals, green.

description: Plant flowering 1-1.5 m high. Leaves 5-9 dm long, pale-appressed-lepidote beneath, soon glabrous above; sheaths elliptic, 18 cm long, dark castaneous at the base; blades ligulate, acute, 4-5 cm wide. Scape erect, glabrous; scape-bracts strict, the lower foliaceous and densely imbricate, the upper elliptic, acute, about equaling the internodes or slightly shorter. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate from 8-10 spikes; primary bracts ovate, acute, exceeding the sterile base of the spike; spikes spreading, ellipsoid or fusiform, 4-6 cm long, 2 cm in diameter. Floral bracts strict, densely imbricate, broadly elliptic, rounded, broadly convex, 20 mm long, equaling the sepals, coriaceous, even except toward the apex, sublustrous, obscurely punctulate-lepidote; pedicels obconic. Sepals narrowly elliptic, acute, 15 mm long, short-connate, carinate, nerved, lepidote; petals erect, 25 mm long, white. Capsule cylindric, acute, 25 mm long.

description: Plant often flowering over 1 m high. Leaves rosulate, about 4 dm long; sheaths inconspicuous, elongate, sparsely brown-punctulate-lepidote; blades ligulate, to 75 mm wide, subglabrous, broadly acute with a pungent apiculus, red toward the apex. Scape erect, equaling or exceeding the leaves, stout, glabrous; scape-bracts much exceeding the internodes, foliaceous, acute, pungent. Inflorescence bipinnate or tripinnate, to 4 dm long; primary bracts ovate, acute or the lower triangular-laminate, usually much shorter than the axillary branches; branches suberect to spreading, up to 12 cm long, laxly polystichous-flowered, bearing 12-15 more or less secund flowers. Floral bracts broadly ovate or elliptic, obtuse, strongly convex, cucullate, 15 mm long, shorter than the sepals, red, subglabrous, thin and striate when dry; flowers glabrous; pedicels stout, 3 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 18 mm long, free or equally short-connate; stamens highly adnate to the petals. Capsule slenderly ellipsoid, 13 mm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 7 dm high. Leaves numerous, circinate, spreading-decurved, 4-5 dm long; blades ligulate (?). Scape erect, stout. description: Plant stemless, flowering 6-10 dm high. Leaves many in a dense crateriform rosette, 4 dm long; sheaths broadly ovate, finely brown-lepidote, concolorous or longitudinally purple-striped; blades ligulate, rounded-apiculate, 25-40 mm wide, glabrous above, very obscurely punctulate-lepidote beneath. Scape erect, slender, exceeding the leaves, glabrous; scape-bracts ovate, obtuse or apiculate, shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence laxly few-branched, glabrous; primary bracts like the scape-bracts, enfolding the sterile bases of the spikes; spikes spreading, elongate with long sterile prophyllate bases, lax or subdense. Floral bracts ovate, narrowly obtuse, shorter than the sepals, even to faintly nerved, green; flowers suberect to spreading, sessile, 23 mm long. description: Plant stemless, 5-11 dm high. Leaves 4-7 dm long; sheaths elliptic, 8-15 cm long, castaneous toward the base, purple-striped above, appressed-lepidote; blades ligulate, acuminate or acute, 3-5 cm wide, subglabrous. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate, the lower foliaceous, the upper ovate or lanceolate, acute. Floral bracts ovate, acute, slightly but consistently shorter than the sepals, obtusely carinate, coriaceous, even or faintly nerved, glabrous, green or brown; pedicels stout, 2.5 mm long. description: Plant flowering 3.5-5 dm high. Scape erect, glabrous; scape-bracts imbricate, broadly elliptic, the lower ones acuminate and wholly lepidote, the upper apiculate and glabrous except at apex. Inflorescence simple, 10-25 cm long, B-25-flowered. Floral bracts orbicular, apiculate, enfolding the sepals, rose, the lower ones about equaling the sepals, the upper distinctly shorter; flowers spreading; pedicels 5 mm long. Sepals to 45 m long, connate to 25 mm, red, the free lobes slightly asymmetric, broadly rounded; petals 5-6 cm long, obtuse, yellow or green.

description: Plant caulescent. Leaves about 6 dm long, exceeding the inflorescence; sheaths narrowly elliptic, large, scarcely wider than the blades, covered with brown scales; blades linear, abruptly acute, 30 mm wide, chartaceous-coriaceous, subglabrous above. Scape rather stout, glabrous; scape-bracts foliaceous, densely imbricate, erect or the upper ones more or less decurved. Inflorescence bipinnate, 2 dm long, lax at base, dense toward apex; axis exposed below, terete, glabrous; primary bracts ovate, large, the lower laminate, the upper broadly triangular, spreading to decurved toward apex, convex, bright red, glabrous or subglabrous; branches aborted, 3-10-flowered. Floral bracts elliptic, subrounded, about 3/4 the length of the sepals; pedicels short, compressed; flowers glabrous. Sepals 21 mm long, connate for 18 mm, the lobes broadly elliptic, rounded and slightly emarginate, slightly asymmetric.

description: Plant flowering to 8 dm tall. Leaves numerous, densely rosulate, 4-6 dm long, densely pale-lepidote; sheaths distinct, ovate; blades ligulate, acuminate, subpungent, 3 cm wide. Scape erect or ascending, stout, about equaling the leaves; scape-bracts strict, densely imbricate, subfoliaceous. Inflorescence bipinnate, lax, 2 dm long; axes glabrous; primary bracts spreading to reflexed, ovate, triangular-acute, about equaling the lower spikes, much shorter than the upper; spikes spreading, globose, lax at base, 5 cm long including the flowers, the lowest stipitate. Floral bracts broadly elliptic, distinctly shorter than the sepals, membranaceous; pedicels 2 mm long. description: Plant stemless, flowering 4-6 dm high. Leaves about 9 in a tubular rosette, erect, 4-5 dm long; sheaths narrowly ovate, faintly red-striped, subdensely lepidote beneath with fine appressed brown-centered scales; blades linear, acuminate, 9-25 mm wide, glabrous above, deep green or reddish, the inner ones sometimes purplish toward base. description: Plant stemless, flowering 5 dm high. Leaöves to 4 dm long; sheaths broadly ovate, covered with minute brown scales above and allutaceous ones beneath; blades ligulate, acuminate, 55 mm wide, chartaceous when dry, glabrous at maturity. Scape erect, stout; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, imbricate. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate with about 4 spikes; axis very stout, angled, sparsely lepidote; primary bracts spreading to recurved-spreading, very broadly ovate, triangular-acute, about equaling or slightly shorter than the upper spikes; spikes strobilate, the terminal one stipitate with sterile bracts, 10 cm long, 5 cm in diameter, the lateral sessile, scarcely over 5 cm long. Sepals subobovate, obtuse, 21 mm long, 9 mm wide, equally connate for 4.5 mm, coriaceous, prominently nerved, punctulate-lepidote; petals 20 mm longer than the sepals, the blades lance-elliptic, acute, greenish yellow, spreading-revolute at anthesis; stamens shorter than the petals, anthers 7-7.5 mm long.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 50-75 cm high. Leaves numerous, to 7 dm long, densely appressed-lepidote beneath; sheaths elliptic, indistinct; blades ligulate, acuminate, 2-3 cm wide. Scape erect, glabrous; scape-bracts strict, imbricate, elliptic with narrowly triangular blades, pale green with red stripes. description: Plant stemless, to 55 cm high. Leaves over 10 in an infundibuliform rosette, straight, 40-60 cm long, usually bearing broad dark transverse bands beneath; sheaths broadly ovate; blades linear, acute, 15-25 mm wide. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts tightly imbricate, lanceolate, acuminate, subpungent. Inflorescence densely digitate and broadly ovoid from a few spikes or simple and globose, 3-4 cm long; primary bracts triangular-ovate, acute, mostly shorter than the spikes; spikes sessile, densely 10-15-flowered. Floral bracts ovate, 13 mm long, shorter than the sepals and enfolding them, coriaceous, even or nearly so; flowers subsessile. Sepals broadly elliptic, obtuse, 15 mm long, connate for 3 mm, coriaceous, even, sublustrous; petals about 2 cm long, white, blades spreading, obovate, obtuse and emarginate; stamens included. description: Plant stemless or slightly caulescent and branching, flowering about 5 dm high. Leaves 20-30 in a rosette, suberect to spreading, up to 6 dm long; sheaths narrowly ovate, scarcely distinct, obsucrely brown-lepidote, flavous with dark red longitudinal stripes; blades ligulate, acuminate, 27 mm wide, chartaceous to membranaceous, glabrous at maturity, purple-red throughout or green near the apex, marked dorsally or on both sides with red-brown longitudinal stripes. Scape slightly shorter than the leaves, erect, glabrous, red; scape-bracts erect and densely imbricate, narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, glabrous, bright scarlet. Inflorescence densely bipinnate or rarely simple, pyramidal or short-thyrsoid, to 25 cm long and 10 cm in diameter, glabrous, bright yellow in all its parts; primary bracts very broadly ovate with an acuminate lamina, the lower ones purple-tipped and exceeding the axillary spikes, spikes suberect to spreading, the lower distinctly stipitate, subcapitate, 5-12-flowered, less than 5 cm long including the flowers. Floral bracts broadly elliptic to suborbicular, broadly obtuse, strongly convex, carinate, 10 mm long, shorter than the sepals, nerved; flowers subsessile. Sepals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 18 mm long, connate for 2.5 mm, strongly carinate; petals elliptic, obtuse, about 3 cm long, connate for 7 mm; filaments adnate to the petals for most of their length; pistil exceeding the petals. description: Herbs, 4-22 cm high. Rhizome-scales narrowly ovate, 1.5-5 mm long, 0.5-0.6 mm wide, apex acuminate. Stems white, mostly unbranched. Leaves narrowly triangular-ovate, 2.5-8 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, auriculate, apex acute, margins fimbriate. Inflorescence capitate, ellipsoid to broadly ellipsoid, consisting of two contracted cincinni, 0.8-1.2 cm long, 0.5-1.5 cm wide, surrounded by large imbricate bracts. Bracts broadly ovate to obovate, up to 9 mm long, 4-10 mm wide, apex acute to slightly acuminate, outermost ones sterile. Pedicels to 1 mm long. Flowers white, 8-10 mm long. Floral tube 7-8 mm long. Outer tepals 3-lobed, 2-4 mm long and 3-3.5 mm wide; central lobe broadly ovate-triangular, 0.8-2 mm long and 1.6-2.4 mm wide; lateral lobes broadly ovate-triangular, 0.5-0.6 mm long and wide. Inner tepals ovate to obovate, 0.4-0.5 mm long and 0.3 mm wide. Connective without appendages. Style, including branches and stigmas, ca. 5 mm long, branches 0.1-0.3 mm long, stigmas horseshoe-shaped, 0.5-0.6 mm diam., sinus 0.3 mm deep, appendages up to 3.5 mm long. Ovary (ob)ovoid, ca. 2 mm long. Capsule unknown.

description: Herbs, 4-37 cm high. Rhizome-scales narrowly ovate, 2.6-3.8 mm long, 0.30.7 mm wide; apex acute to long-acuminate. Stems white to purplish, branched or not. Leaves ovate to broadly ovate, 0.6-2(-2.5) mm long, 0.6-1 mm wide, margins involute, apex acute or obtuse. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, each mature cincinnus at an angle of 90°-180° with the other, 0.5-10.5 cm long and 2-16-flowered, sometimes the plant having a solitary terminal flower only. Bracts ovate, 0.6-1.5(-2) mm long, 0.4-0.7(-1) mm wide, apex acute or obtuse, the two basal ones to 2.2 mm long, often dark colored (in herbarium material). Pedicels 0.7-4.5(-5.3) mm long. Flowers white to purplish white, (4-)5.7-10.7 mm long. Floral tube 4-7.7 mm long. Outer tepals 3-lobed, 1-1.6 mm long, 1.2-2.1 mm wide; central lobe depressed obovate-triangular, 0.3-0.7 mm long, 0.8-1.4 mm wide; lateral lobes ovate-triangular to broadly ovate-triangular, 0.3-0.6 mm long, 0.3-0.4 mm wide. Inner tepals broadly ovate to broadly obovate, 0.3-0.7 mm long, ca. 0.3 mm wide, often swollen. Connective in one case with two basal triangular appendages, 0.1 mm long. Style, including branches and stigmas, (2-)2.6-4.5(-6.3) mm long, branches to 0.2 mm long, stigmas yellow, horseshoeshaped, 0.3-0.6 mm diam., sinus ca. 0.2 mm deep, appendages to 2.5 mm long, seldom absent. Ovary obconical to broadly obovoid, 0.9-2 x 0.6-2.5 mm. Capsule broadly ellipsoid to transversely ellipsoid, to 2.8(-3.4) x 2 mm, the persistent part of the floral tube including the capsule 4.3-7.5(-8) mm long, floral tube mostly somewhat constricted above the capsule, style exceeding the floral tube by 0.5-0.7 mm. Capsule longitudinally dehiscent, the three valves separating from base to apex, each valve split into two narrowly obovate parts cohering at the top; the three remaining ribs of the capsule and the three placenta-bearing ribs forming a lantern-like structure. Seeds 0.3-0.4 x 0.2-0.3 mm.

description: Herbs, 4-28 cm high. Rhizome-scales imbricate, ovate to narrowly ovate, 0.6-2.5 mm long, 0.4-0.9 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Stems white, branched or not. Leaves ovate to broadly ovate, 0.7-2 mm long, 0.6-1 mm wide, apex acute or obtuse. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, each cincinnus 0.3-6 cm long and 1-9-flowered. Bracts ovate, 0.8-2 mm long, 0.4-1 mm wide, apex acute. Pedicels (0.5-)l-4.5(-5) mm long. Flowers white, erect, 5-7 mm long. Floral tube 2.5-4.7 mm long. Outer tepals 3-lobed or entire (Trinidad), 1.5-2 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide; central lobe broadly ovate-triangular, 1-1.1 mm long, 0.8-1 mm wide; lateral lobes narrowly ovate-triangular, ca. 0.5 (?) mm long and 0.2 (?) mm wide. Inner tepals broadly obovate, 0.1-0.3 mm long and wide, often swollen. Connective without appendages. Style, including branches and stigmas, 1.5-2.6 mm long, branches 0.1-0.2 mm long, stigmas horseshoe-shaped, 0.2-0.5 mm diam., sinus ca. 0.1 mm deep, appendages to 1.7 mm long. Ovary obconical, 1.3-2.1 x 0.6-1.3 mm. Capsule ellipsoid to broadly ellipsoid, 1-3.7 x 1-2.2 mm, the persistent part of the floral tube including the capsule 3-5.5 mm long, style exceeding the floral tube by 0.5 mm. Capsule dehiscing longitudinally, the three valves separating from apex to base, each bearing one parietal placenta. Seeds 0.2-0.3(-0.5) x 0.1-0.2(-0.3) mm.

description: Herbs, 4-16 cm high. Rhizome-scales narrowly ovate, 2.2-3 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide, apex acute to long-acuminate. Stems white to purplish, branched or not. Leaves ovate to broadly angular-ovate, 0.7-3 mm long, 0.6-1.5 mm wide, apex acute. Inflorescence a bifurcate cincinnus, each cincinnus 0.5-1.5(-3) cm long and l-4(-8)-flowered, or the plant having a solitary terminal flower only. Bracts ovate to angular-ovate, 0.9-3.5 mm long, 0.4-2.5 mm wide, the basal ones to 4 mm long, apex acute or obtuse. Pedicels 0-0.8(-1.2) mm long. Flowers white to purplish white, erect, 7.2-12(-14) mm long, sweet scented (Maas & Dressier 5077, Vogel 178). Floral tube (5-)6-9.5 mm long. Outer tepals 3-lobed, (1.7-2.43-)2.5-4 mm long; central lobe ovate-triangular to broadly ovate-triangular, (0.4-0.83-) 1-2 mm long, (0.5-0.93-)1.2-1.5 mm wide; lateral lobes narrowly ovate-triangular, (0.3-0.73-)l.5-2.5 mm long, (0.2-0.43-)0.5-l.l mm wide. description: Plant flowering over 2 m high. Leaves nearly 1 m long, entire; sheaths broadly ovate, 5 cm long, dark brown toward base; blades very narrowly triangular, long-attenuate, dull, glaucous green, soon glabrous above, white-lepidote between the nerves beneath. Scape central, slender; scape-bracts subfoliaceous, mostly spreading. Inflorescence diffuse, much branched; axes very slender; floral bracts triangular, about equaling the slender 2 mm long pedicels. Staminate flowers white. Sepals ovate, obtuse, 1 mm long. Petals narrowly ovate, obtuse, 3 mm long, exceeding the stamens. Pistillate sepals ovate, 1.5 mm long. Petals 6-7 mm long, 4-5 mm wide, blue. Capsule oblong-globose.

description: Leaves to 4 dm long, sparsely lepidote above, densely and coarsely lepidote below, armed with stout spines 7 mm long. Scape stout, glabrous; scape-bracts foliaceous, much exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence laxly bipinnate, pyramidal, 65 cm long, glabrous; primary bracts narrowly triangular, about equaling the long sterile bases of the branches; branches up to 15 cm long, laxly many-flowered. Floral bracts ovate-elliptic, apiculate, about equaling the pedicels; flowers 15 mm long, suberect to spreading, only the pistillate phase known; pedicels 7 mm long. Sepals triangular-ovate, acute, 5 mm long, roseate; petals narrowly elliptic with a carinate acuminate apex, rose, slightly coherent at base; ovary glabrous; style very short.

description: Plant flowering less than 1 m high, very graceful and delicate. Leaves rosulate, spreading, arched, 2-3 dm long; sheaths ample, subinflated; blades very narrowly triangular, 2 cm wide, densely pale-lepidote on both sides, becoming glabrous above with age, striate, densely and finely serrulate with teeth 0.2-0.5 mm long. Scape erect, about 4 mm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts with a broadly ovate base 5 mm long and a filiform lepidote remotely toothed blade exceeding the internodes. Inflorescence laxly and amply tripinnate, glabrous; primary bracts narrowly triangular, membranaceous, much shorter than the sterile base of the branches; branches up to 2 dm long, very laxly flowered. Floral bracts linear-lanceolate, membranaceous, less than half as long as the pedicels; flowers spreading, 5 mm long; pedicels very slender, about 3 mm long. Sepals broadly triangular-ovate, obtuse, 1.5 mm long, thin; petals elliptic, obtuse, 4 mm long, white; stamens present in the pistillate flowers but obviously not functional; ovary ovoid, glabrous; stigmas sessile.

description: Lianas, árvores, 4-6 m, ou arbustos, 2-5.5 m, glabras; ramos novos cilíndricos, achatados nos nós, lenticelados, secos cinzentos ou cinza-escuros, comumente com marcas longitudinais de coloração diferente, velhos cilíndricos, lenticelados ou lenticelados e fissurados, cinzentos.
