description: Treelet 0.5-5 m tall; branchlets often purplish when dried, golden-brownish to ferruginous hispidulous in combination with sparsely ferruginous hispid. Leaves apparently opposite, occasionally ternate; petioles 3-8 mm long, ferruginous hispidulous on both sides; stipules deciduous, narrowly deltoid, 3-4 x ca. 1 mm, herbaceous, densely golden to ferruginous hispidulous to strigulose, ciliolate; lamina elliptic to (ob)ovate, acuminate, 3-16 x 2-7.5 cm, papery to coriaceous; often whitish pilose(ulous) near the margin above, varying from densely ferruginous or golden hispidulous to glabrescent beneath; costa and lateral veins golden or ferruginous hispidulous on both sides; lateral veins (7-)8-10(-12) pairs (acumen excluded); tertiary venation reticulate, sometimes golden or ferruginous hispidulous on both sides; domatia sometimes present; base rounded to cuneate, symmetric, sometimes obtuse to rounded at the petiole; margin (sub)serrate, rarely subentire, usually irregularly whitish cili(ol)ate, mucronulate; acumen 0.3-0.5 cm long, apex subobtuse to subacute, mucronulate. Inflorescences axillary, lateral and subterminal, solitary, racemose, 4-12 cm long, densiflorous and conical shaped near the apex, laxiflorous near the base; central axis purplish when dried, densely golden to ferruginous hispidulous; ‘pedicels’ (2-)4-6 mm long, articulate near the middle, densely golden to ferruginous hispidulous; bracts and bractlets ovate to deltoid, herbaceous, golden pilosulous; margin cili(ol)ate, apex (sub)obtuse to (sub)acute; bracts 1.5-1.75 x ca. 1 mm; bractlets 0.75-1.25 x ca. 0.75 mm. Flower buds tolpoid to conical, subobtuse, slanting erected to the apex of the inflorescence, becoming strongly deflexed when flowering. Flowers greenish-white or yellowish. Sepals subequal to unequal, ovate, 1.5-2(-2.5) x 1-1.75 mm, herbaceous, greenish when fresh, 1-3 veined, golden to whitish strigillose along the costa and near the apex, margin ciliolate, apex obtuse to subacute. Petals (narrowly) ovate, 3.25-4.25 x 1.25-1.5 mm, herbaceous, sparsely pilose near the apex of the costa or glabrescent, apex (sub)obtuse, sometimes sparsely ciliolate. Stamens 2.75-3.25 mm long; anterior filaments embodied in fused dorsal glands, posterior filaments and dorsal glands free; free filaments 0.2-0.5 x 0.2-0.25 mm; free dorsal glands (0-)0.2-0.6 x (0-)0.2-0.3 mm; fused dorsal glands 0.6 mm high; glandular tissue carnose, usually glabrous, sometimes sparsely pilosulous; anthers narrowly ovoid, 1-1.75 x 0.4-0.8 mm, glabrous, apex obtuse, unappendaged; connective outside narrowly deltoid, acute, 0.75-1.25 x 0.3 mm, glabrous; connective scales lateral as well as apical, ovate, 2.252.75 x ca. 1 mm, scarious, orange-brown, suberose, apex (sub)obtuse. Ovary subglobose to conical, 1 x 0.75-1 mm, golden to ferruginous pilosulous; ovules two per placenta. Style filiform, erect to slightly curved, 2-2.25 x ca. 0.25 mm, slightly exceeding the stamens by 0-0.25 mm, slanting brownish pilosulous near the base; stigma truncate. Capsule more or less symmetric, ellipsoid to ovoid, acuminate, coriaceous to subligneous, greenish when fresh, golden to ferruginous hispid(ulous), distinctly veined, style sometimes subpersistent at the apex of one of the valves; valves three, subequal, 1.25-2.25 x ca. 0.5 cm. Seeds two per valve, globose, 4 mm in diam., glabrous.

description: Tree or treelet, 1.5-25 m tall. Branchlets yellowish to whitish pilosulous or puberulous. Leaves alternate; petioles 0.25-2.75 cm long, sparsely yellowish pilosulous when young, glabrescent when older; stipules deciduous, narrowly deltoid, subacute, (1-)9-11 x 1-1.75 mm, herbaceous, sparsely pilosulous along the costa to glabrescent, veined, sometimes sparsely ciliolate; lamina (narrowly) elliptic to (ob)ovate, acuminate, (4-)6.5-23 x (1.5-)2-10 cm, coriaceous, occasionally papery, glabrous on both sides; costa on both sides slightly pilosulous to glabrescent; lateral veins, (7-)8-10(-13) pairs (acumen excluded); tertiary venation ± scalariform; base rounded to cuneate; margin subentire to (sub)crenate or (sub)serrate, slightly thickened, mucronulate; acumen 0.5-3.5 mm long, apex obtuse to acute, mucronulate. Inflorescences axillary, lateral and subterminal, thyrsoid, solitary or often accompanied by one or two distinctly smaller lateral inflorescences, 5-20 x (1.5-)2.5-6 cm; central axis yellowish to whitish puberulous; cymules (1-)3-11(-15) flowered, often accompanied by 2-6 juvenile or undeveloped flowers; common peduncle 2-15(-35) mm long, yellowish puberulous; ‘pedicels’ 2.5-5 mm long, usually articulate below the middle, yellowish puberulous or strigillose; bracts and bractlets deltoid to ovate, herbaceous to carnose, sparsely strigillose along the costa, ciliolate, apex subacute, mucronulate; bracts (0.5-)0.75-1.75 mm long and wide; bractlets 0.5-1 mm long and wide. Flower buds ellipsoid to ovoid, obtuse. Flowers drooping, greenish- or yellowish-white, fragrant. Sepals subequal, ovate, 1.25-2.5 x 1-1.5 mm, herbaceous, carnose near the base, minutely yellowish-whitish strigillose, ciliolate, apex obtuse, occasionally mucronulate. Petals elliptic to ovate, (1.75-)2-3 x (1-)1.25-1.5 mm, herbaceous, sometimes sparsely yellowish pilosulous along the costa, sometimes ciliolate, apex rounded to obtuse. Stamens 1.5-2 mm long; filaments and dorsal glands fused to a tube; free parts of filaments 0-0.1 mm long; filamental tube sometimes strongly lobed, usually 0.2-0.3 mm high, glandular tissue of the tube on the dorsal side of the stamens up to 0.75(-1) mm high; anthers ellipsoid, 0.75 x 0.6 mm, apex rounded, appendaged by 1-2 cusps free or connate, ca. 0.2 mm x 0.1-0.2 mm; connective outside deltoid to ovate, subobtuse, 0.4-0.8 x 0.4-0.6 mm, glabrous. Connective scales lateral as well as apical, ovate to deltoid, 1.25-1.75 x ca. 0.75 mm, scarious, slightly orange-brown, margin erose, apex obtuse. Ovary ovoid-conical to trapezoid, 0.6-1 x 0.6-0.7 mm, pilose(ulous) along the ribs and near the apex; ovules one per placenta. Style filiform, sometimes subclavate near the apex, strongly sigmoid at the base to slightly curved, 1-1.25 mm long, ± equaling the thecae; stigma truncate to capitulate, often deflexed towards the anterior petal. Capsule asymmetric, slightly oblique, ellipsoid, acuminate, subtended by subpersistent floral parts, coriaceous to subligneous, smooth, olive-brown colored when fresh by a dense golden to brownish puberulous to strigillose indument; valves three, unequal; the larger one 9-11 x 4-6 mm; the two smaller ones 6-8 x 2-4 mm. Seeds one per valve, globose, ca. 3 mm in diam., olive-brown when fresh, glabrous, shining.

description: Treelet 2-3 m tall; branchlets erect pilose when young, glabrescent when older. Leaves alternate, subsessile, congested near the apex of the branchlets; petioles 1.5-2 mm long, pilose; stipules subpersistent, narrowly ovate to deltoid, subacute, mucronulate, 4-5 x 1-1.5 mm, herbaceous, pilose, costate, densely ciliolate; lamina narrowly elliptic to obovate, acuminate, sometimes emarginate, 5.5-14 x 1.5-4.5 cm, coriaceous, pilose on both sides; lateral veins (11-) 12-13(-l 5) pairs; tertiary venation reticulate; base symmetric, rounded to subcordate; margin slightly thickened, (sub)serrate to (sub)crenate, mucronulate, subentire near the base; acumen hardly differentiated, apex subacute, mucronulate. Injlores-censes axillary, lateral and subterminal, solitary, congested near the apex of the branchlets, racemose, laxiflorous, 6-8.5 x ca. 1.5 cm; central axis puberulous to pilose; ‘pedicels’ 4-7 mm long, articulate at 1/3-¼ from the base, puberulous; bracts and bractlets, ovate to deltoid, herbaceous, pilosulous, ciliolate, apex subacute; bracts ca. 1.5 x ca. 1 mm; bractlets subopposite, ca. 1 x ca. 0.75 mm. Flower buds ovoid to conical, subacute. Flowers dirty white. Sepals (sub)equal, (narrowly) ovate, ca. 2 x 0.75-1 mm, herbaceous, pilose, costate and 2-3 veined, ciliate, apex (sub)obtuse. Petals narrowly ovate, 5-5.5 x ca. 1.75 mm, herbaceous, sparsely pilose outside, margin ciliolate, apex obtuse, pilosulous. Stamens subsessile, 4-4.25 mm long; filaments (nearly) completely free, 0.3-0.4 mm long and wide, glabrous; dorsal glands free, erect, conical, ca. 0.25 mm long, carnose to callose, glabrous; anthers narrowly ovate, acuminate, 2.25 x 0.50.75 mm, glabrous, thecae sometimes mucronulate at the apex; connective outside ca. 0.75 x ca. 0.25 mm, ovate, subobtuse, glabrous; connective scales lateral as well as apical, narrowly ovate, 3.75 x 0.75 mm, scarious, golden-brown, dorsally densely whitish villose just above the connective, erose near the base, apex obtuse, subentire. Ovary subglobose to ovoid, up to 3 x 1.75 mm, whitish pilose to strigose; ovules one per placenta, each inserted near the middle of the placenta. Style filiform to slightly subclavate to the apex, slightly sigmoid to curved at the base, 3-3.5 mm long, exceeding the stamens by 2-2.5 mm, glabrous; stigma truncate. Fruits unknown.

description: Stem only with short internodes. Lamina ovate to cordiform, ca. 1.5 times longer than broad, to 12 cm long, to 8 cm broad; margin lobate to repand; upper surface almost glabrous; lateral veins 4-7, terminating at the margin; petiole to 17 cm long; stipules to 0.5 cm long. Receptacle 0.8-1.8 cm diam.

description: Lianas, arbustos; ou árvores, 4-12 m, ramos novos subcilíndricos a achatados, lisos, secos esverdeados ou amarelados, velhos cilíndricos, fissurados e lenticelados ou fissurados e escamantes (Aulestia & Grefa 263), marrons. Folhas opostas a subopostas; estípulas triangulares, denticuladas na base; pecíolos (4-) 9-11(-19) mm, secos esverdeados ou amarelados; lâminas (5.5-)6.4-10.9(-18.8) × (2-)5-6.2(-9.9) cm, elípticas, base cuneada ou arredondada, margem inteira, crenulada a obscuramente crenulada, ápice agudo ou acuminado, raro obtuso, herbáceas a cartáceas, secas verde-amareladas, ocre-amareladas ou verde-oliva, nervuras secas comumente amareladas, principalmente na face abaxial, secundárias e terciárias promínulas em ambas as faces, ou terciárias obscuras na adaxial. Inflorescências (1-)1.3-2.3(-15.3) × (0.9-)1.7-2.2(-4.7) cm, dicásios compostos, às vezes agregadas em inflorescências compostas tirsóides pela supressão de folhas nos nós, com ca 45-160 flores, axilares; pedúnculos (4-)5-11(-24) mm, ramos opostos ou subopostos, os de ordens mais altas abreviados, subtetrangulares, verdes; brácteas conspicuamente fimbriadas a denticuladas, escariosas, comumente denticuladas na base; pedicelos (0.4-)0.5-1.3 mm; bractéolas 2. Flores 1.5(-2.5) mm diâm na antese, tubuliformes ou raro campanuliformes, congestas, inodoras ou aromáticas; sépalas 0.55 -0.8(-0.9) × (0.7-)0.9-1.2(-1.3) mm, largo triangulares, erosas, conspicuamente fimbriadas, verdes; pétalas (1.1-)1.3-1.4(-1.5) × 0.7-1(-1.7) mm, elípticas ou obovais, eretas ou raro oblíquas, inteiras ou fimbriadas (Aulestia & Grefa 263), escariosas, carnosas, amarelas, amareladas, amarelo-esverdeadas ou verdes, espessadas na região mediana internamente; disco 0.2-0.25 mm alt., anelar, 5-angulado ou circular, carnoso; estames 3, 0.4-0.7 mm, filetes 0.2-0.4 mm, unidos até parte mediana ou raro livres e circulares (Aulestia & Grefa 263), anteras 0.15-0.3 × 0.2-0.3 mm, oblongas ou raro triangulares (Aulestia & Grefa 263); ovário (0.4-)0.65-0.9 mm diâm, estilete 0.1-0.2 mm, estigma pontual, óvulos por lóculo (5-)6. Mericarpos 5.5-10.8 × 2.7-4.1 cm, largamente elipsóides, sulcados, verrucosos. Sementes maduras não vistas, núcleo seminífero subfalcado, não marcadamente oblíquo em relação a ala, ala elíptica, papirácea, mais longa que o núcleo seminífero.

description: Lianas, arbustos; 2-6 m, ou árvores 2-6(-19) m, ramos novos cilíndricos a subtetrangulares, lisos, secos esverdeados a marrons, velhos cilíndricos, lenticelados. Folhas opostas a subopostas; estípulas triangulares, comumente denticuladas na base; pecíolos (3-)7-9(-17) mm, secos amarelados ou esverdeados; lâminas (1.7-)5.7-6.6(-16.6) × (0.6-)2.2-3.5(-7.7) cm, elípticas, largo elípticas ou obovais, raro espatuladas, ovais ou subcirculares, base cuneada ou arredondada, margem crenulada a obscuramente assim e quase inteira, ápice agudo ou acuminado, raro obtuso, herbáceas a cartáceas, secas esverdeadas, nervuras secas comumente amareladas, principalmente na face abaxial, secundárias promínulas em ambas as faces, terciárias obscuras ou levemente promínulas, principalmente na face abaxial. Inflorescências (0.7-)2.3-4.5(-15) × (0.4-)1.4-3.5(-9.4) cm, dicásios compostos, raro plecocásios compostos (Smith & Reitz 12515), às vezes agregadas em inflorescências compostas tirsóides pela supressão de folhas nos nós, com ca 15-100(-280) flores, axilares; pedúnculos (0-)11-15(-56) mm, ramos opostos ou subopostos, comumente subtetrangulares; brácteas ciliadas ou erosas, comumente denticuladas na base; estipetes florais 0.5-1.4 mm, articulados; bractéolas 0-2. Flores (2.3-)2.6-3.2(-3.7) mm diâm na antese, rotáceas a mais ou menos campanuliformes, inodoras ou aromáticas; sépalas (0.5-)0.7-1 × 0.6-0.9 (-1.2) mm, triangulares, margem ciliada ou esparso denticulada, carnosas; pétalas 1.2-1.6(-2.1) × (0.8-)1-1.1(-1.5) mm, elípticas, rômbicas, ou truladas, patentes a mais ou menos oblíquas, margem inteira, papilosas, carnosas, esverdeadas, amarelo-esverdeadas, amareladas, brancas ou verdes, às vezes com margens brancas, ou raro laranja, secas às vezes base marcada no centro internamente; disco 0.1-0.3 mm alt., anelar, circular ou mais ou menos 5-angulado, carnoso; estames 3, 0.4-0.7 (-0.8) mm, amarelos, filetes 0.2-0.3 mm, unidos na base ou tubo quase nulo, alargados ou não na base, anteras 0.2-0.3 × 0.2-0.5 mm, oblongas; ovário 0.7-0.9 mm diâm, estilete 0.15-0.4 mm, estigma pontual, óvulos por lóculo 4-6. Mericarpos 3.5-7.7 × (1-)2.4-3(-4) cm, elipsóides ou largamente elipsóides, ápice acuminado, estriados, lustrosos. Sementes 3.3-4.5(-5.2) × 1.1-1.8(-2.5) cm, núcleo seminífero elipsóide, mais ou menos oblíquo em relação a ala, ala elíptica, papirácea, mais longa que o núcleo seminífero.

description: Herbs, 3-11 cm high. Stems purple, unbranched. Leaves narrowly ovate to ovate, 1.2-4 mm long, 0.6-0.7 mm wide, apex acute to acuminate. Inflorescence a contracted, bifurcate cincinnus, each cincinnus 1.8-2 mm long and 2-9-flowered, or the plant having a solitary terminal flower only. Bracts ovate, ca. 2.5 x 1 mm. Pedicels 0.6-2 mm long. Flowers yellowish, 6-7 mm long. Floral tube 4.5-6 mm long. Outer tepals ovate-triangular, 1-1.5 mm long, 0.6-1 mm wide, sometimes margins involute. Inner tepals absent. Filaments 0.2-0.3 mm long and ca. 0.1 mm wide, crescent-shaped pouch 0.1-0.2 mm high, 0.5-0.6 mm wide; connective 0.1-0.2 mm long, 0.2-O.3 mm wide, stipes ca. 0.1 mm long. Style 3.1—3.5 mm long (branches and stigmas excluded), branches and stigmas 0.4 mm long, stigmas peltate. Ovary obovoid, 1.5-2 x 1-1.2 mm, 2-lobed glands 0.3-0.5 x 0.1-0.2 mm, stipes ca. 0.1 mm long. Capsule obovoid, 1.8-2 x 1.1-1.5 mm. Seeds 0.20.3 x 0.2 mm.

description: Herbs, 5-19 cm high. Rhizome up to 7.5 cm long; scales 0.5-3 mm long, 0.40.7 mm wide, base rounded, apex acute to long-acuminate. Stems white to purplish, unbranched. Leaves almost peltate, narrowly ovate to angular-ovate, 1.45 mm long, 0.6-1.5 mm wide, apex acuminate, base auriculate, margins sometimes fimbriate. Inflorescence (2-)4-10(-22)-flowered, umbelliform, at the base with 24 narrowly-ovate to angular-ovate bracts, 1.4-4(-4.6) mm long, 0.7-1.2 mm wide, apex acute to long-acuminate. Pedicels 2-4 mm long. Flowers deep lilac to white, 2.5-4.5 mm long. Floral tube 2.9-3.8 mm long. Outer tepals broadly ovate-triangular to broadly angular-ovate, (0.5-)0.6-0.8 mm long, 0.7-0.8 mm wide, margins slightly involute. Inner tepals ovate-triangular, 0.5-0.7 mm long, 0.30.4 mm wide. Connective 0.2-0.3(-0.4) mm long, 0.1-0.3 mm wide. Style, including branches and stigmas, 1.6-1.9 mm long, branches and stigmas 0.2-0.3 mm long, stigmas funnel-shaped, sometimes in older stages horseshoe-shaped, 0.2-0.3 mm diam. Ovary broadly ellipsoid to globose, 1-2 x 0.8-1.5 mm, two-lobed glands 0.2-0.3 mm long, 0.3-0.4 mm diam. Capsule broadly ellipsoid to globose, to 2 mm diam. Seeds 0.3-0.4 x 0.1-0.2 mm.

description: Hierba anual o perennizante 30-80 cm de alto, raíz pivotante 6-8 cm long. Tallo 1.5-3 mm diám., cilindrico, liso o longitudinalmente estriado en seco, simple a muy ramificado; ramas viejas con corteza rojiza agrietada longitudinalmente que dejan ver el súber blanquecino; ramas jóvenes con pelos porrecto-estrellados, ferrugíneos, radio central patente, 3-4 mm long., radios cortos 0.3-0.4 mm long. (Fig. 3D), pelos simples, erectos o recurvos, tenues, 0.1-0.2 mm long. (Figs. 2A y 3B, C) y pelos glandulares diminutos, 0.1-0.2 mm long, con pie cilindrico, pluricelular, y cabeza esférica (Fig. 3C). Yemas seriales generalmente ausentes; ramas seriales no observadas. Hojas herbáceas. Estípulas nulas. Pecíolo cilindrico, surcado en la haz en seco, indumento como el del tallo, 10-20(-40) mm long, en hojas inferiores, acortándose bruscamente en hojas apicales hasta desaparecer. Lámina ovada o elíptica, 26-135 x 10-72 mm, relación largo:ancho = 1.3-2.8:1, base redondeada, cuneada o cordada; ápice agudo, a veces obtuso; borde crenado-aserrado desde la base, ligeramente revoluto, con pelos porrecto-estrellados; haz con pelos porrecto-estrellados, radio central orientado oblicuamente hacia afuera; envés velutino, pelos estrellados; 6-9 pares de venas laterales rectas o ligeramente incurvas, prominentes en el envés, hirsutas, con pelos porrecto-estrellados, ángulo de divergencia 28-50°; venas terciarias a veces visibles en el envés; venación menor inconspicua. Racimo apical hasta 40 cm long., folioso o frecuentemente áfilo, y en ese caso hojas tectrices de tamaño bruscamente decreciente, las últimas sésiles, hasta atrofiarse. Flores heterostilas. Pedúnculo cilindrico, 5-47 mm long., indumento como el del tallo, pelos 1-2 mm long. Profilos ausentes. Pedicelo cilindrico, 2-5 mm long., diámetro ligeramente mayor e indumento más denso que el del pedúnculo, pelos simples abundantes. Cáliz 4-8 mm long.; tubo cali-cino 1.8-2.2 mm long., por fuera con pelos estrellados híspidos, por dentro con pelos simples; lóbulos angus-tiovados, 3-5 nervados, bordes membranáceos, mucrón apical 0.3 mm long., los internos con bandas de pelos más cortos y adpresos, frecuentemente simples, antes de los bordes. Corola amarillo-anaranjada, a veces blanquecina; pétalos con uña pilosa; lámina obovada 5-16 x 4-12 mm, borde superior eroso. Corona a veces coloreada, oscura, laciniada, lóbulos unidos a los pétalos 0.4-0.8 mm long., lóbulos unidos a los sépalos más cortos, lacinias papilosas. Filamentos estaminales glabros, 2-5.5 mm long., soldados 0.6-1 mm en la base al tubo calicino; anteras dorsifijas, angustiovadas, 1-2 x 0.5-1 mm, base emarginada, ápice agudo, recurvado en la dehiscencia. Ovario ovoide, 1.5-2.5 mm long, densamente cubierto de pelos simples, placentas 12-26 ovuladas; estilos cilindricos excurvos 0,5-3,5 mm long., glabros o con algunos pelos simples; estigma 0.5-1 mm long., multífido, ca. 24 ramas cilindricas. Frutos subesféricos, 4.5-11 mm long.; pedúnculo fructífero hasta 45 mm long.; valvas ovadas, por fuera lisas, papilosas, raramente apenas verrucosas, castañas, con pelos simples largos, por dentro ebúrneas, lustrosas, vena placentaria prominente. Semillas negruzcas, marcadamente curvadas, 1.7-2.2 x 0.6-1 mm (Fig. 12B); exóstoma cónico; rafe linear, ligeramente saliente; cálaza redondeada, un poco prominente, a veces coloreada; episperma muy característico, pilosiúsculo, con nudos del retículo elevados, cónicos, cada Aréola con una depresión punctiforme (Fig. 16B); arilo breve, angosto, unilateral.

description: Shrubs 0.5-2.5 m tall, the stems coarsely stellate-pubescent. Leaves usually distichous, the blades ovate-elliptic or oblong to oblanceolate, mostly 5-20 x 2-7 cm, asymmetrically truncate or rounded basally, serrate, acuminate, palmately 3(-5)-nerved, stellate-pubescent beneath, sparsely pubescent above (the hairs sometimes simple, mostly bifurcate, 0.5-0.7 mm long) to glabrate; petioles 0.5-1 (-2) cm long; stipules 4-5 mm long, subulate. Flowers solitary in the leaf axils, the pedicels 2-10 cm long, stellate-pubescent; involucellar bracts 8-9, linear, 7-9 x 1 mm, hirsute; calyx 6-9 mm long, hirsute; corolla 1-2 cm long, red, externally pubescent. Fruits 11-13 mm diam., reddish, glabrous, the mericarp body 7-10 mm high, smooth, 3-spined, the spines 5-8 mm long, retrorsely barbed, divergent, the lateral spines 4 mm apart at base.

description: Subshrubs or shrubs 2-3 m tall, the stems densely viscid-puberulent. Leaf blades mostly 5-11 cm long (smaller upward), 1.5-2 times as long as wide, ovate, cordate, shallowly crenate, acuminate, densely and softly pubescent, the hairs simple above, stellate-tomentose beneath, discolorous; petioles (of midstem leaves) usually ½ the length of blades; stipules 3-8 mm long, often recurved. Flowers principally in a terminal panicle with much-reduced leaves; pedicels 1- 5.5 cm long, slender, glandular-puberulent; involu-cellar bracts 5, linear, 8-10x1 mm, minutely pubescent; calyx 6-8 mm long, minutely pubescent; corolla 2-2.5 cm long, pink with a dark purple center, the margins of the claws ciliate; staminal column 1.5 cm long, dark purple, glabrous, with distinctive purplish appendages (staminodes) at base, each 1-1.5 mm wide, distally erose, the filaments 1-3 mm long. Fruits oblate, 6-7 mm diam., glabrous, the mericarps 3.5-4 mm high, unomamented; seeds 2.5-3 mm long. Chromosome number, 2n= 56 (Bates, 1976).

description: Shrubs or trees 3-5(-6) m tall, the stems stellate-pubescent or glabrate. Leaf blades mostly 6-17(-22) cm long, almost as wide or slightly wider, 3-5(-7)-lobed, deeply cordate, crenate-serrate, usually acute, minutely and sparsely stellate-pubescent, more densely and coarsely so beneath, occasionally glabrate above; petioles subequal to (or exceeding) the blades (up to 30 cm), progressively reduced upward to lA the length of the blades; stipules inconspicuous. Inflorescence a crowded terminal leafless raceme; pedicels 5-10(-25) mm long, stellate-pubescent; involucellar bracts 7-8, narrowly linear, 10-15 mm long, stellate-pubescent; calyx 7-8 mm long, stellate-pubescent (especially on nerves); corolla tubular, 10-15 mm long, pale yellow, externally glandular-puberulent; staminal column 18-22 mm long, exserted, pallid, glabrous, the filaments 2 mm long; styles exceeding the androecium, glandular-pubescent, the stigmas minutely villous. Fruits 8-9 mm diam., retrorsely pubescent, 10-costate; mericarps 5.5-6 mm high, indurate.

description: Dioecious shrubs or trees up to 20 m tall; latex white. Leafy twigs 0.5-3 mm thick white to yellowish strigose. Leaves lanceolate to oblong, sometimes broadest near the lower end, not or hardly inequilateral, 5-17 cm long, 1-7 cm broad, chartaceous, acuminate to caudate, acute at the base, entire to repand to dentate, sparsely strigose above, strigose on the veins beneath, without or with few pluricellular hairs; veins slightly prominent to plane above, prominent beneath, 9-14 pairs of secondary veins, sometimes a few parallel tertiary veins; petioles 2-10 mm long; stipules 4-10 mm long, white to yellowish subsericeous to strigose. Staminate inflorescences 3-5 mm in diameter; peduncle (1.5-)2.5-3 mm long; involucre with 15-30 deltoid to ovate, acute, puberulous bracts in 4-5 series; flowers 5-20; perianth 1-2 mm high, 4-lobed to 4-fid, free segments more or less cucullate, obtuse, not thickened at the upper end; filaments free, broadened towards the base, anthers 0.2-0.5 mm long, 0.15-0.2 mm broad. Pistillate inflorescences 1-5 mm in diameter; peduncle 1-3.5 mm long, bracteate at the upper end; involucre with 6-23 suborbiculate to reinform  ovate, obtuse, appressed-puberulous bracts in 3-5 series; flowers 1-12; perianth urceolate, 2-2.5 mm high, 4-lobed, appressed-puberulous; ovary nearly free or partly adnate to the perianth, style 0.5-0.7 mm long, nearly glabrous, stigmas vittiform, o.6-1.0 mm long, ca 0.15 mm broad, straight or twisted. Fruiting perianth sparsely appressed-puberulous. Flowering. Flowering throughout the year ?

description: Trees up to 4o(-60?) m tall; latex white, turning pinkish cream to brown. Leafy twigs 1-4 mm thick, covered with very short, patent, yellow hairs, intermixed with distinctly longer, yellow, appressed to patent hairs, sparsely or densely hairy; terminal buds often more or less swollen. Leaves lanceolate to oblong, often broadest near the lower end, little to strongly inequilateral, (4-) 7-17(-24) cm long, (1.5-)2.5-7(-8.5) cm broad, chartaceous to coriaceous, acuminate, obtuse, sometimes acute or emarginate at the base, except for the costa glabrescent above, sparsely to rather densely puberulous to hirtellous to hirsute beneath; costa prominent, the other veins slightly prominent to impressed above, all veins prominent beneath, 14-23(-27) pairs of secondary veins, mostly many close parallel tertiary veins; petioles 2-8 mm long; stipules (3-)6-10(-15) mm long, yellow subsericeous to hirsute. Staminate inflorescences 7-10 mm in diameter; involucre with 18-35 deltoid to ovate to spathulate, obtuse to acute, subsericeous bracts in 4-5 series; filaments o.5-1.0 mm long, anthers 1.2-2.0 mm long, 0.3-0.5 mm broad, often inequilateral, mostly apiculate and provided with apical hairs; intrastaminal bracts 2-4 mm long, narrowly spathulate, hairy outside. Pistillate inflorescences 2-2.5 mm diameter; involucre with 9-15 reniform to deltoid to ovate, obtuse to acute, subsericeous bracts in 2-4 series; perianth 1.5-2.5 mm high, subsericeous to hirtellous to hirsute; style 1-1.5 mm long, stigmas 7-11 mm long. Fruiting perianth ellipsoid to oblongoid, (8?-) 10-13 × 5-8 mm, yellow hirtellous to hirsute on the whole surface or mainly towards the tip; seed 7-9 × 4-5 mm. Probably flowering throughout the year; most flowering specimens collected between June and November; the main flowering time may differ regionally.

description: Trees up to 30 m tall; latex white. Leafy twigs 1.5-2.5 mm thick, sparsely puberulous to glabrous. Leaves oblong to lanceolate, slightly or not, inequilateral 3-17 cm long, 1-6 cm broad, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, acuminate (to acute), acute to obtuse at the base, almost glabrous; costa prominent above, the other veins slightly prominent to plane to slightly impressed at both sides, (10-17 (-20) pairs of secondary veins, without or with few parallel tertiary veins; petioles 3-8 mm long; stipules 2-12 mm long, hairy at the base and the vein or glabrous. Staminate inflorescences 4-6 mm in diameter; involucre with 15-25 reniform to ovate to lanceolate to spathulate, obtuse (to acute), sparsely puberulous bracts in 2-4 series; filaments 0.5-1.o mm long, anthers 1.2-2.0 mm long, 0.4-0.5 mm broad, usually uneuilateral, apiculate; interstaminal bracts 2-4 mm long, linear to oblanceolate toqpathulate often abruptly broadened towards the tip, acute, puberulous. Pistillate in sorescences 1.5-2.0 mm in diameter; involucre with 12-20 reniform to deltoid tosuflborbiculate to ovate, obtuse(to acute) puberulous bracts in 3-6 series; perianth 2-2.5 mm high, puberulous; style 1-1.5 mm long, stigmas (2-)4-6 mm long. Fruiting perianth globose to oblongoid, 9-14 × 5.5-9 mm, sparsely puberulous near the tip. Flowering from February to June (September?).

description: Trees up to 35 m tall; latex white to orange. Leafy twigs 1-3(-4.5) mm thick, covered with very short patent hairs intermixed with few to many whitish to yellowish, appressed to ascending hairs; terminal buds often curved. Leaves oblong to lanceolate, often broadest near the lower end, more or less inequilateral, 4-15.5 cm long, 1.5-6.5 cm broad, chartaceous to coriaceous, acute to acuminate, acute to obtuse at the base, sparsely puberulous to glabrous; costa prominent, the other veins plane above, prominent to plane beneath, 10-21 pairs of secondary veins, without or with few parallel tertiary veins; petioles 2-9 mm long; stipules 5-20 mm long, whitish to yellowish pubescent to nearly glabrous. Staminate inflorescences often solitary, 6-8 mm in diameter; involucre with 12-30 reniform to deltoid to suborbiculate to ovate to oblong to lanceolate, obtuse to acute, (sub)sericeous bracts in 4-8 series; filaments o.3-1.0 mm long, anthers 1.0-2.0 mm long, 0.25-0.5 mm broad, apiculate; interstaminal bracts 1.5-3.0 mm long, oblanceolate to spathulate to linear, obtuse to acute, hairy outside. Pistillate inflorescences 2-2.5 mm in diameter; involucre with 12-18 reniform to deltoid to ovate, acute to obtuse, (sub)sericeous bracts in 4-6 series; perianth 2-2.5 mm high, appressed-pubescent towards the tip; style 1.2-2.0 mm long, stigmas 3.5-5 mm long. Fruiting perianth ellipsoid to oblongoid, 13-15 × 6-7 or 7-10 × 4-5 mm, pubescent towards the tip. Flowering from January to September.

description: Tree, to 30 m tall, often with buttresses, (sometimes climbers?), on young parts aculeate with prickles with a hyaline apex. Leafy twigs 2-10 mm thick, sparsely to densely puberulous, with appressed, brown hairs, glabrescent, sometimes also hispidulous, or occasionally also with long, straight to uncinate rigid hairs, passing into prickles. Lamina (suborbicular) to elliptic to oblong (to lanceolate), 5-55 × 3-25 cm, broadest at or below the middle (in juvenile material sometimes above the middle), often ± inequilateral, subcoriaceous to chartaceous; apex acuminate to subacute; base acute to cordate; margin entire to repand, sometimes aculeate; upper surface (sub)glabrous; lower surface puberulous with sparse to dense, appressed, brown hairs, glabrescent, sometimes scabridulous, often aculeate on the midrib and the lateral veins; venation almost plane above, the midrib and lateral veins prominent beneath, the other veins almost plane; lateral veins 5-16 pairs; tertiary venation partly to largely scalariform; petiole 0.5-7 cm long, coriaceous, often aculeate, puberulous with dense, appressed, brown hairs; stipules (0.5-)1-8 cm long, coriaceous, with (dense) brown pluricellular hairs, usually aculeate, caducous. Staminate inflorescences globose, oblongoid- or obovoid-capitate, 0.5-3 × 0.5-2 cm; peduncle 0.5-2 cm long, puberulous; flowers free or basally connate; perianth 2-5 mm long, the upper part puberulous with brown hairs, often also hispidulous, the outer tepals ± cucullate; stamens often anisomorphic; filaments 3-6 mm long; anthers 0.7-1.6 × 0.7-1.2 mm, the connective narrow or broad, sometimes apiculate; bracts oblong to linear, to 1.5 mm long. Pistillate inflorescences subsessile or peduncle to 1 cm long; flowers (1-)3-15; perianth ca. 6 mm long, puberulous with appressed to patent, brown hairs, often also hispidulous, occasionally densely hirtellous or aculeate at the apex; ovary 2-3 mm long; style ca. 5 mm long, puberulous; stigmas (0.2-)3-7 mm long; bracts a few to numerous (40-50), ovate to subulate, often ± swollen, indumentum similar to that of the perianth. Infructescences 1-4 cm diam.; fruiting perianth 1.5-2 cm long, with yellowish warts; fruit ca. 1.3-1.8 × 1-1.5(-2) cm; bracts often cushion-shaped and apiculate or almost spine-like, to 1 cm long.

description: Shrubs 1-2 m tall, the stems densely glandular-puberulent (“very viscid, strong guava odor’’ fide collector), the hairs 0.2-0.3 mm long. Leaf blades ovate, mostly 3-4.5 x 2-2.5 cm, basally cordate, serrate, acute or acuminate, palmately 5-7-nerved, discolorous, densely glandular-puberulent above, densely whitish stellate-pubescent beneath; petioles 1-2 cm long; stipules subulate, 3 mm long, viscid. Flowers solitary in the leaf axils, the pedicels 3-5.5 cm long, viscid; involucellar bracts 7-8, linear, 10 x 1 mm, viscid-puberulent; calyx 6-7 mm long, hispid-ciliate (hairs ca. 1 mm), pallid with purplish veins (3 per lobe); corolla externally pubescent, 12 mm long, apparently white, pubescent on margins of claw. Fruits 7 mm diam., oblate, glabrous; mericarps un-omamented, smooth, 5 mm tall, with a minute subapical beak.

description: Plant short-caulescent, sometimes branched. Leaves to 12 cm long, the blades 6-10 mm wide, abruptly acute, very densely serrulate, glabrous. Inflorescence sunk in the center of the leaf-rosette, globose from a few spikes. Floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate 5 mm long. Sepals equal, 4-6 mm long, the posterior ones alate-carinate, short-connate; stamens exserted. Capsule broadly ellipsoid, woody-coriaceous, shorter than the sepals.

description: Plant stemless, 5 cm high. Leaves 38 cm long; blades linear, 16 mm wide, finely spinulose-serrate, sparsely tomentulose. Inflorescence capitate, sunk in the center of the leaf-rosette; outer bracts triangular, serrulate, glabrous, reddish brown. Floral bracts acuminate, pungent, entire. Sepals oblong, acute, 19 mm long, the posterior ones carinate. Capsule ellipsoid, acute, 13 mm long, indurate.

description: Arbusto 1 m de alto, corteza rojiza con grietas longitudinales que dejan ver el súber blanquecino; ramas nuevas longitudinalmente estriadas, con pelos simples crespos brevísimos, estrellados y porrecto-estrellados, radio central ca. 0.5 mm long., dorados o color herrumbre, con base más o menos esférica, tomentosas cerca del ápice. Yemas axilares 1-2, la basal florifera. Hojas coriáceas, discoloras, abolladas. Estípulas reducidas a prominencias glandulares rojizas muy pequeñas 0,2 mm long. Pecíolo semicilíndrico 1,5-6 mm long., canaliculado en la cara superior, indumento como el del tallo. Lámina foliar ovada o elíptica, 7-52 x 6-31 mm, relación largo:ancho = 1.5-2:1; haz oscura, lustrosa, rugosa, con pelos estrellados y porrecto-estrellados, radio central 0,5 mm long., radios cortos 0.2-0.3 mm long.; envés blanquecino, tomentoso-velutino, con pelos estrellados tenues multirradiados; base redondeada; ápice obtuso; borde crenado, revoluto; venas laterales 5-7 pares, alternas o subopuestas, rectas o curvado-ascen-dentes, divididas antes del margen, ángulo de divergencia 37-60°, hundidas en la haz, prominentes en el envés, con pelos porrecto-estrellados; venas terciarias recurvas con respecto a la vena media, hundidas en la haz, prominentes en el envés; venación menor conspicua en ambas caras. Inflorescencias cimosas, axilares, 3-6-floras, reunidas en el ápice de las ramas, hojas tectrices apicales reducidas. Pedúnculo cilindrico, 10-23 mm long., con pelos estrellados y algunos porrecto-estrellados. Ramas sucesivas 2.5-6 mm long. Profilos 0.5-1.5 mm long., subulados, indumento como el del pedúnculo. Pedicelos 4-6 mm long., más gruesos que el pedúnculo, indumento color herrumbre oscuro. Flores heterostilas. Cáliz verde-amarillento en vivo, 8-10 mm long., hirsuto, con pelos porrecto-estrellados ferrugíneos 0.5 mm long, y algunos glandulares; tubo calicino 2.5-3.6 mm long., glabro por dentro; lóbulos ovados o angus-tiovados, 5-nervados, los internos con bandas de pelos antrorsos, de color más claro, ordenadamente dispuestos antes de los bordes membranáceos; mucrón grueso, muy corto, prácticamente ausente. Corola color fuego, en seco anaranjado-rojiza, 14-18 mm long.; pétalos con uña glabra; lámina 12-15 x 6-8 mm. Corona glabra, lóbulos unidos a los pétalos 0.7-0.9 mm long., lóbulos unidos a los sépalos ligeramente más cortos, borde superior fimbriado. Filamentos estaminales anaranjados, 4-5 mm long, en flores longistilas, 6.5 mm long, en flores brevistilas, soldados 0.5 mm en la base al tubo calicino; anteras 1.2-1.3 x 0.5-1 mm, ovadas o sagitadas, base emarginada, filamento inserto a 0.5 mm de la base, ápice obtuso y no recurvado a la dehiscencia. Ovario latiovoide 2 mm long., placentas 5-ovuladas; estilos cilindricos anaranjados, indivisos, con algunos pelos laxos, 5-6 mm long, en flores longistilas, 2 mm long, en flores brevistilas; estigma 0.3-1 mm long., penicilado. Frutos 6-9 mm long., lisos, papilosos o apenas verrucosos, con pelos glandulares y simples rígidos, laxamente dispuestos, cara interna glabra, lustrosa, blanquecina, ondulada, vena placentaria no prominente. Semillas obovoides, rectas, 2.6-2.7 x 1.1-1.2 mm; exóstoma cónico prominente 0.5 mm long.; rafe linear; cálaza redondeada no prominente; episperma pilosiúsculo, reticulado, aréolas cuadrangulares o transrectangulares con una depresión punctiforme; arilo amplio, envolvente, lobulado, tan largo como la semilla o poco más corto.

description: Plant low, stemless, apparently annual, flowering 12-21 cm high. Leaves ca. 15, suberect, to 13 cm long, graminiform, entire throughout, sparsely and very minutely lepidote; sheaths ovate, 8 mm long, pale brown; blades linear, attenuate, flat, 5 mm wide. Scape erect, very slender, much shorter than the leaves; scape-bracts narrowly lanceolate, membranaceous except for the acute thickened apex, the highest shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple, laxly racemose, glabrous. Floral bracts like the scape-bracts, 2 or 3 times shorter than the pedicels; pedicels ascending, very slender, 6-7 mm long. Sepals free, narrowly oblong, obtuse, 2.5 mm long, subhyaline, cochlear-imbricate in bud; petals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, slightly exceeding the sepals, white; stamens included; ovary superior; style slender. Capsule slenderly fusiform, attenuate; seeds narrow, nearly or quite naked, black.

description: Plant propagating by underground rhizomes. Leaves few in a fasciculate rosette, to 15 dm long, exceeding the inflorescence; sheaths narrow and inconspicuous, entire, covered beneath with a whitish membrane of fused scales; blades linear, acuminate, pungent, 15-20 mm wide, minutely and obscurely punctulate-lepidote on both sides, green and smooth above, broadly white-banded beneath, margins revolute, laxly serrate with curved spines to 4 mm long. Scape erect, ca 5 mm in diameter, densely white-flocculose; scape-bracts large, much exceeding the internodes, subfoliaceous, narrow, entire or slightly serrulate. Inflorescence lax or sublax, to 25 cm long, 10-60-flowered. Lower floral bracts linear and about equaling the flowers, the upper triangular and shorter than the pedicels; pedicels ca 4 mm long; flowers spreading, glabrous. Sepals free, suborbicular, obtuse or sometimes minutely mucronate, 6-7 mm long, red; petals ligulate, obtuse, 13 mm long, purple, bearing 2 subentire scales at base; ovary obovoid, 5 mm long; epigynous tube short but evident; placentae subapical.

description: Plant propagating by slender rhizomes. Leaves 6-15 in a dense rosette, green, narrowly red-banded in life and variable in cultivation, 15-20 cm long; sheaths large, forming an ellipsoid tank constricted at apex, elliptic, entire, densely and minutely brown-lepidote, sometimes purplish; blades spreading, linear, rounded and apiculate, to 16 mm wide, laxly and obscurely serrulate with minute spines. Inflorescence few-flowered; outer bracts ovate-triangular, exceeded by the sepals, entire. Floral bracts oblong, acute, much exceeded by the sepals, entire, membranaceous; pedicels 3 mm long; flowers to 25 mm long. Sepals very short-connate, narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, ca 15 mm long, glabrous, green with whitish margins; petals 3/4 connate, ca 20 mm long, acute, blades blue at least on the margins; stamens included, highly adnate to the petals; ovary subellipsoid, 4 mm long, epigynous tube short; placentae subapical.

description: Leaves 15-20 in a cylindrical rosette that is not constricted at apex, 15-26 cm long, minutely appressed-lepidote; sheaths very large, 1-3 times the length of the blades, ca 6 cm wide; blades short-ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 2-3 cm wide, subdensely serrate with teeth 1 mm long. Inflorescence simple, 10-15-flowered, umbellate. Floral bracts oblong or linear, rounded and apiculate, exceeding the ovary, entire; pedicels slender, 1-2 cm long; sepals linear-obovate, acute, to 34 mm long, 6 mm wide, connate for 4 mm; petals narrowly ligulate, acute, 50-55 mm long, connate for 1 mm, blue toward apex; ovary ellipsoid, 8-10 mm long.

description: Leaves 10-15 in a rosette that is not constricted at apex, to 64 cm long, covered on both sides with minute appressed scales; sheaths broadly elliptic, 15-20 cm long, much wider than the blades, brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly rounded, apiculate, 6-9 cm wide, laxly serrate with coarse uncinate spines 7 mm long, green or sometimes reddish toward apex or with a few small dark spots at base, broadly glaucous-banded, the inner sometimes bluish. Inflorescence many-flowered, deeply sunk in the rosette; outer bracts broadly ovate, acute and apiculate, half equaling the inflorescence, densely brown-lepidote, membranaceous. Floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, acute, nearly equaling the middle of the sepals, membranaceous, lepidote; pedicels 1-3 cm long; flowers to 6 cm long. Sepals asymmetric, lanceolate or elliptic, acute with the apex often incurved, 29-37 mm long, connate for 5 mm, glabrous; petals white; ovary slenderly ellipsoid, slightly constricted at apex. Fruit white, slightly enlarged from the ovary.

description: Leaves about 20 in a broadly spreading rosette, 40-60 cm long; sheaths large, broadly elliptic, entire or slightly serrulate toward apex, sparsely and minutely dark brown-lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly acute or rounded and apiculate, 25-35 mm wide, subdensely serrate with spines 1 mm long, glabrous above, minutely and obscurely lepidote beneath, the outer wholly green, the inner with their bases brilliant red. description: Leaves 10-20 in a dense rosette that is not constricted at apex, erect, to 26 cm long; sheaths very broadly ovate, large, densely lepidote; blades ligulate, broadly rounded, minutely apiculate, to 32 mm wide, concolorous, entire or the inner obscurely serrulate, subglabrous, the outer green, the inner reddish. Inflorescence simple, many-flowered, deeply sunk in the rosette; outer bracts broadly ovate, triangular-acute, subpungent, sparsely lepidote toward apex, the upper ones exceeding the flowers. Floral bracts linear, acute, nearly equaling the sepals, straight and not incurved, glabrous or sparsely lepidote toward apex, entire, membranaceous, ecarinate; pedicels 5 mm or longer; flowers well over 40 mm long. description: Leaves few (ca 7) in a very dense rosette that is not constricted at apex, to 40 cm long; sheaths narrowly ovate, more or less violet-tinged; blades ligulate, to 6 cm wide, minutely serrulate, coriaceous, dark dull green with a few violet spots and cross-lines, sparsely appressed-lepidote beneath, the apex minutely apiculate, straight or recurved, not reddish, the innermost leaves dark violet. Sepals very narrow and long-acuminate, not uncinate, high-connate; petals long-acuminate, high-connate, violet with white margins; ovary subcylindric, scarcely if at all constricted at apex, three-angled, twice as long as the pedicels.

description: Leaves to 20 in a very dense rosette that is not contracted at apex, 3-9 dm long, usually broadly banded beneath; sheaths broadly ovate, large, densely lepidote, often tinged with purple toward apex; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, to 7-9 cm wide, green except for a large rose spot at apex, rigid, subdensely serrate with straight, stout, red, antrorse spines. description: Leaves about 20 in a dense slenderly funnelform rosette, to 22 cm long, coriaceous, concolorous; sheaths large, narrowly elliptic, dark blue; blades ligulate, acuminate, 10-20 mm wide, entire or laxly serrate with spines 0.5 mm long, dark green, sparsely white-lepidote beneath. Inflorescence deep in the rosette, few- or rather many-flowered; outer bracts broadly ovate, rounded and slenderly apiculate, entire, sparsely brown-lepidote. Floral bracts oblong or slightly enlarged toward apex, obtuse, nearly equaling the sepals, ca. 20 mm long, 4 mm wide, rather thick; pedicels to 4 mm long; flowers to 22 mm long. description: Plant stoloniferous. Inflorescence many-flowered, compound, 6-8 cm in diameter; outer bracts elliptic with a short purple mucro, 4-5 cm long, 24-32 mm wide, membranaceous, lepidote. description: Plant stemless. Leaves about 20 in a very dense rosette, to 6 dm long; sheaths very broadly elliptic-ovate, purple-brown throughout, densely lepidote; blades linear, broadly acute and apiculate, 4 cm wide, subglabrous above, densely farinaceous-lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with spines 1 mm long, concolorous, the outer green or in young plants reddish, the inner bright red. Inflorescence many-flowered, sunk in the center of the rosette; outer bracts very broadly ovate, cinereous-purple or greenish, acuminate and serrulate or the upper rounded-apiculate and entire, exceeding the inflorescence. Floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, incurved, mucronulate, 45 mm long, 8 mm wide, exceeded by the sepals, entire, membranaceous, greenish white, sparsely lepidote; pedicels to 16 mm long; flowers ca. 5 cm long. description: Leaves about 10 in a dense rosette that is not constricted at apex, to 2 dm long; sheaths elliptic, dark purple; blades rigid, suberect, rounded and apiculate, 35 mm wide, serrulate with spines 8 mm apart, sparsely lepidote, concolorous except for the red apex, the outer green, the inner bright red. description: Stemless, flowering 20 cm high. description: Plant propagating by basal rhizomes. description: Leaves 20-30 in a broadly funnelform rosette, 40-45 cm long, cinereous-lepidote and pale-banded beneath; sheaths ca. 15 cm long, very broadly elliptic or ovate; blades arching-spreading, ligulate, 4-5 cm wide, laxly serrulate with spines 1-3 mm long or nearly entire, the outer green with a large bright red apical spot, the inner completely red or whitish toward base. description: Plant flowering 10-14 cm high, stemless. Leaves 10-14 in a dense utriculate subovoid rosette, spreading above, 10-13 cm long, yellow-green with irregular brown cross-bands; sheaths elliptic, slightly shorter than the blades; blades ligulate, rounded and apiculate, 17 mm wide, laxly serrulate with minute antrorse brown spines, punctulate-lepidote especially beneath. description: Plant propagating by long slender horizontal rhizomes. Leaves few in a subcylindric rosette, sometimes short and broad, sometimes long and narrow, 20-50 cm long; sheaths broadly elliptic, entire or serrate toward apex, diffusely lepidote with brown subappressed scales; blades ligulate, more or less narrowed toward base, attenuate or acute and apiculate, 2-5 cm wide, glabrous or obscurely lepidote, green or beneath tinged with red, narrowly channeled, subdensely serrulate with spines 0.5-1 mm long. description: Leaves 30-50 in a dense rosette, more or less deflexed, 20-50 cm long; sheaths triangular or the inner ovate, serrate; blades very stiff, 8-25 mm wide, covered beneath with white or cinereous scales, serrate with spines 5 mm long, the lower spines retrorse, the others antrorse-curved. description: Plant short-caulescent. Mez); stamens conspicuously exerted; anthers 4.5 mm long, rounded at both ends; ovary compressed-angulate, glabrous or minutely lepidote; epigynous tube subcylindric, 5 mm long; style slightly shorter than the stamens.

description: Leaves many in a dense rosette, 4-5 cm long; sheaths wider than the blades, short; blades recurving, lance-linear, acuminate, to 5 mm wide, thick, coriaceous, glabrous, laxly serrate with recurved spines 1 mm long, red toward base, elsewhere bright green. description: Plant flowering over 1 m high (?). Leaves presumably much like the lower scape-bracts. description: Plant flowering to 13 cm high, widely stoloniferous. description: Tree, usually tall, height to 30-35 m. Leaves in fascicles of (3-)4-5, predominantly 5, rigid to slightly lax, usually curved, (5-)6-10(-12) cm X 11.3 mm. Stomata on all faces of leaves, in 4-7 lines on the convex abaxial face and in (3-)4 lines on each adaxial face (the abaxial number of lines correlated with width of leaf). Seed cones ovoid to broadly ovoid, often slightly curved, 5-10(-12) X 4-6 cm when open. Seeds obliquely ovoid, slightly flattened, 5-7 X 4-5 mm. Seed wings obliquely ovate, 15-20 X 6-8 mm.

description: Tree, tall, height to 40-45(-50?) m. Leaves in fascicles of 5, very rarely 6, straight or slightly curved or twisted, thin, lax, (8-) 10-15(-18) cm X 0.7-1 mm; epistomatic, stomatal bands whitish, abaxial face green or greyish green. Seed cones pendulous, broadly cylindrical, curved, often very large, 15-50 cm long, 10-15 cm wide when opened. Seed scales ca. 100-150, not flexible; apophysis thick, trullate, with an extremely elongated, abruptly narrowed, reflexed distal part and sometimes an upturned apex. Seeds 10-15 X 7-9 mm. Seed wing adnate, up to 2 X as long as the seed, oblique, broad truncate or tapering to a rounded apex.

description: Plant stemless or short-caulescent; rhizome prostrate, stout. Leaves 20-30 in a dense fasciculate rosette, all alike, persistent, 5-12 dm long, scarcely or not at all contracted between sheath and blade; sheaths conspicuous, triangular-ovate, dark-castaneous at least toward the base, spinose-serrate toward the apex, covered dorsally with a membrane of fine coalesced scales; blades linear to linear-lanceolate, subfiliform-attenuate, (10-) 13-24 mm wide, armed more or less throughout with spines up to 3 mm long, glabrous above, covered beneath with a fine membrane of white or brown coalesced scales. Scape erect, flocculose when young, often becoming glabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lower ones foliaceous, serrate, and exceeding the internodes, the upper narrowly triangular, filiform-attenuate, often shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple to much branched, white-flocculose when young, often becoming glabrous; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, many times shorter than the axillary branches; racemes suberect or ascending, elongate, laxly many-flowered. Floral bracts ovate to linear-lanceolate, acute or acuminate, from shorter than to exceeding the pedicels; flowers erect or ascending at anthesis, sometimes pendent-secund; pedicels slender, 3-13 mm long. Sepals oblong or narrowly triangular, acuminate to abruptly acute or obtuse, (13-) 15-23 (-24) mm long, ecarinate but often swollen at the base; petals linear, acute, up to 55 mm long, exceeding the stamens, red, bearing a large scale at the base; ovary about half superior; ovules with a truncate appendage.

description: Plant short-caulescent, flowering to 7 dm high. Leaves 12-20, fascicled; petiole distinct, dark-spinose toward base; blade lanceolate, 40 cm long, 7.5-10 cm wide, entire, glabrous. Scape stout, shorter than the leaves; scape-bracts imbricate, elliptic-ovate, acuminate. Inflorescence densely cylindric, arching, 25 cm long; rhachis long-lanate. Floral bracts erect, elliptic, acute, to 7 cm long, bright red; pedicels very stout, to 10 mm long. Sepals acuminate, to 5 cm long, carinate toward base, soon glabrous, bright red; petals 75 mm long, pale flavous, bearing very large scales; anthers 16 mm long; ovary almost wholly superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering to 2 m high; stem erect, elongate. Leaves about 3 dm long, blades dimorphic, some reduced to subulate spinose-serrate persistent spines, others deciduous, linear-lanceolate, pungent, 3 cm wide, entire, glabrous. Scape stout, elongate; scape-bracts long-attenuate, sparingly spinulose or subentire. Inflorescence densely racemose, about 3 dm long. Floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, to 35 mm long, exceeding the pedicels, glabrous or nearly so; pedicels to 13 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 33 mm long, alate-carinate; petals linear, 75 mm long, appendaged, yellowish white; ovary superior.

description: Plant flowering 7 dm high. Leaves possibly dimorphic but only large ones known, over 7 dm long, entire; sheaths narrowly triangular-ovate, covered beneath with appressed brownish scales; blades linear, attenuate, slightly contracted toward base, 20-30 mm wide, showing a median channel when dry, covered beneath with appressed scales. Scape stout, straight, white-lepidote; scape-bracts all exceeding the internodes, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper ovate, acuminate. Inflorescence simple, densely racemose, 18-27 cm long, pale-lepidote when young. Floral bracts ovate or lance-ovate, acuminate, 37-56 mm long, the lowest exceeding the sepals; flowers divergent after anthesis; pedicels slender, 4-13 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 20-25 mm long, ecarinate, glabrescent to glabrous; petals 37-52 mm long, exceeding the stamens, 8 mm wide, red or red-orange or yellow; ovary half superior.

description: Plant caulescent, flowering 1-1.5 m high. Leaves over 1 m long; sheaths ovate-triangular, small and inconspicuous, densely tomentose-lepidote, sparsely serrate toward apex; petioles 15-40 cm long, coarsely spinose-serrate; blades broadly oblanceolate, acute, 95 mm wide, entire, soon glabrous. Scape erect, densely brown-tomentose-lepidote at first; scape-bracts erect, exceeding the internodes, the lower subfoliaceous, the upper small, lanceolate, attenuate. Inflorescence 2-6 dm long, dense, more or less secund-flowered; axis brown-tomentose-lepidote. Floral bracts ovate, acute, much exceeded by the sepals, thin and soon disintegrating; flowers secund-spreading after anthesis; pedicels to 8 mm long, 1.5-2 mm in diameter. Sepals lanceolate, attenuate with an involute uncinate apex, more or less asymmetric, 30-35 mm long, ecarinate, thick, coriaceous, dark red, sparsely tomentose-lepidote toward apex; petals ligulate, broadly obtuse, 4 cm long, orange, bearing 2 narrow obliquely attached scales near the base; stamens and pistil included; ovary slightly more than half superior; ovules long-caudate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 6-8 dm high. Leaves many in a dense fasciculate rosette, all alike or some reduced, persistent, 8-14 dm long; sheaths ovate, deep-castaneous; blades linear, filiform-attenuate, 1 cm wide, slightly constricted, the larger ones entire except at the extreme base which is armed with antrorse spines up to 2 mm long, glabrous above, covered beneath with a fine membrane of white coalesced scales. Scape erect, slender, subglabrous; scape-bracts erect, the lower ones foliaceous and exceeding the internodes, the upper lanceolate, acuminate, much shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence simple and laxly racemose or few-branched, up to 22 cm long. Floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, mostly shorter than the pedicels; flowers suberect to divergent at anthesis, sometimes becoming secund; pedicels slender, 4-10 mm long. Sepals lance-oblong, abruptly acute or obtuse and apiculate, 14-16 mm long, ecarinate; petals linear, 4 cm long, exceeding the stamens, bearing at the base a scale 8 mm long, red; ovary half superior; ovules and seeds obliquely thick-caudate.

description: Plant stemless, flowering 5-8 dm high, glabrous; roots fibrous; rhizome horizontal, stout. Leaves many in a dense rosette, equaling the scape; sheaths broadly ovate; blades dimorphic, persistent, the outer filiform, reduced, 2-5 mm wide, pectinate-spinulose toward base, the inner linear-lanceolate, attenuate, slightly narrowed and coarsely serrate toward base. Scape erect at anthesis; lower scape-bracts subfoliaceous, the upper bracteiform. Inflorescence simple, laxly racemose, 15-25 cm long. Floral bracts lanceolate, acute, 5-7 mm long, about equaling the pedicels, subscarious; flowers polystichous, spreading at anthesis, reflexed in fruit. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, 15-22 mm long, the midnerve prominent; petals zygomorphic, linear-spathulate, broadly acute, 40-55 mm long, bearing a pair of small auricles near base; stamens included; ovary over ½ superior. Capsule dehiscent; seeds caudate.

description: Plant flowering 1 dm high or rarely to 2 dm. Leaves very numerous in a large bulb; sheaths suborbicular to ovate, deep castaneous; blades homomorphic or dimorphic, the outer reduced to spinose-serrate castaneous spines, the inner or all green, linear, filiform-attenuate, to 7 dm long and 13 mm wide, pale-flocculose beneath, soon glabrous, deciduous before anthesis along a straight transverse line slightly above the base, entire above that line, spinulose-serrate below it. Scape usually very short and concealed by the leaves; scape-bracts ovate, acuminate or the lower with a dark slenderly spinose apex, thin, white-flocculose. Inflorescence capitate or subspicate, 3- to 12-flowered. Floral bracts like the upper scape-bracts, entire, shorter than the sepals; flowers erect; pedicels 3 mm long, obconic. Sepals narrowly subtriangular, attenuate, 3 cm long, subalate-carinate, thin, flocculose; petals linear, to 55 mm long, bearing a sacciform retuse scale well above the base; ovary about half superior; ovules long-caudate. Capsule slenderly ovoid, acute, shorter than the sepals.

description: Plant stemless, flowering over 1 m high. Leaves 10-25 in a spreading rosette, distinctly petiolate, pale-green; sheaths large, triangular-ovate, entire, brown, at first covered below with a thick membrane of coalesced scales; petioles up to 3 dm long, channeled, densely armed with retrorse spinose teeth up to 2.5 mm long; blades narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 5 dm long, 45-50 mm wide, sparsely furfuraceous-lepidote or soon glabrous, entire or with a few teeth at the extreme base. Scape short, 7 mm in diameter; scape-bracts erect, densely imbricate, ovate, acuminate, green. Inflorescence simple, subspicate, slenderly cylindric, acute, many-flowered, up to 4 dm long, 25-3 5 mm in diameter, rhachis sparsely lanate. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, 4-ranked, erect, densely imbricate, 5-6 cm long, much exceeding the sepals, nearly or quite glabrous; flowers subsessile. Sepals narrowly oblong, rounded-apiculate, 22-33 mm long, whitish-green, glabrous except for a few tomentose scales at the base and apex; petals linear, unequal, 6-8 cm long, naked or appendaged, white, not recurved at anthesis; anthers 12 mm long; ovary almost wholly superior. Capsule 2 cm long, acute; seeds long-caudate at both ends.

description: Plant long-caulescent. Leaves few, fasciculate, trimorphic, the outer with short subtriangular sheaths and acicular spinose-serrate blades, others with small lanceolate entire blades, and the largest with stout serrate petioles 3 dm long; blades elliptic or obovate, apiculate, cuneate, 30-37 cm long, 10-14 cm wide, soon glabrous, entire. Scape erect or ascending, short; scape-bracts densely imbricate, elliptic, acute, pungent, spinose-serrate, red. Inflorescence 1-5 dm long; axis densely ferruginous-lanate. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, arched-spreading, 65 mm long, carinate toward apex, bright red, glabrous; flowers sessile. Sepals subtriangular, acuminate, 36 mm long, thin, nerved; petals acute, 10 cm long, very dark purple, appendaged; stamens included; ovary almost wholly superior. Seeds long-caudate.

description: Plant flowering 2 m or more high; stem erect, stout, ringed with leaf-scars. Leaves densely fasciculate, dimorphic or trimorphic, the outer ones reduced, scale-like or some with setiform spinose blades, the inner elongate, contracted above the sheath but not always petiolate, attenuate, to 1.5 m long, 35 mm broad, remotely spinulose-serrate or entire toward apex, glabrous above, sparsely furfuraceous beneath. Scape white-furfuraceous; scape-bracts narrowly triangular, filiform-caudate, the uppermost about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence laxly paniculate, pyramidal, 5 dm or longer; axis furfuraceous; primary bracts narrowly triangular, mostly shorter than the sterile bases of the branches; branches suberect to spreading, secundly many-flowered. Floral bracts lance-ovate, acute, much shorter than the pedicels; flowers slender; pedicels 13 mm long. Sepals narrowly trinagular, attenuate, 15-18 mm long, soon glabrous; petals 45 mm long, red, usually appendaged; stamens included; ovary almost wholly superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering 15 dm high; rhizome elongate, cylindric, covered with the remains of the leaf-sheaths. Leaves entire, dimorphic, some reduced to broadly triangular-ovate, acuminate, dark-brown sheaths, others with a deeply channeled petiole 2-5 dm long and blade, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, to 1 m long, 4 cm wide, glabrous above, white-furfuraceous below. Scape erect, stout, white-furfuraceous; scape-bracts narrowly ovate, lepidote, becoming glabrous, the lower ones filiform-caudate, the upper ones equaling or distinctly shorter than the internodes. Inflorescence racemose, many-flowered, lax, except toward the apex, 30-45 cm long. Floral bracts broadly ovate, acute, erect, distinctly shorter than the sepals, rose or green, even, coriaceous, soon glabrous; flowers suberect, over 1 dm long; pedicels stout, up to 2 cm long. Sepals oblong, rounded and apiculate, 20-25 mm long, 6 mm wide, strongly nerved; petals yellowish-white, bearing a coarsely incised scale at the base; ovary half superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering 5 dm high. Leaves (inner) persistent; sheaths narrow; blades not at all contracted at base, sublinear, attenuate, 3 dm long, 8 mm wide, entire, covered beneath with a membrane of ferruginous scales. Scape erect, glabrous; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, glabrous, the lower foliaceous, the upper triangular. Inflorescence a few-branched panicle, narrowly thyrsoid, lax, glabrous throughout; primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts, about equaling the branches; branches suberect, (axes) 2 cm long, 3-6-flowered. Floral bracts lanceolate, acute, 5 mm long, shorter than the pedicels, hyaline; pedicels slender. Sepals narrowly subtriangular, obtuse and mucronulate, 2 cm long; petals narrow, acute, 42 mm long, naked, white or yellowish when dry; stamens included; ovary more than 3/4 superior; ovules long-caudate.

description: Plant caulescent; stem scandent, over 1 m long. Leaves persistent, the outer reduced to narrowly triangular elongate sheaths, attenuate to an acicular apex, submembranaceous, brownish, densely serrate with slender spines 6 mm long, the inner forming a fasciculate rosette at the end of the stem; sheaths short, brown, covered with a livid membrane; petiole 10 cm long, densely acicular-serrate; blades narrowly lanceolate, attenuate at both ends, 35 cm long, 22 mm wide, entire, chartaceous, glabrous or subglabrous. Scape erect, stout, terete, much shorter than the leaves, densely and finely lanuginose; scape-bracts exceeding the internodes, triangular-ovate with an acicular apex, all but the highest serrulate with very slender spines 4 mm long, puberulent at base. Inflorescence densely racemose, to 16 cm long, apparently secundly many-flowered, slightly if at all exceeding the leaves, umbrinous-furfuraceous; axis stout, subangular. Floral bracts triangular, attenuate, the median ones to 20 mm long, subchartaceous, pale when dry, glabrous toward apex; flowers spreading or the lowest reflexed; pedicels 5 mm long, stellate-lepidote. Sepals triangular, attenuate, ca 25 mm long, ecarinate, red, subcoriaceous, becoming glabrous; petals 3/0 zygomorphic at anthesis, narrowly lingulate, subobtuse, 75 mm long, dark orange, porrect in age, bearing a single broadly emarginate scale; stamens included, anthers 11 mm long; ovary subpyramidal, over 3/4 superior; ovules caudate.

description: Plant flowering over 1 m high. Leaves dimorphic with those of the sterile offshoots reduced to dark serrate spines 15 cm long, the larger ones to 14 dm long; sheaths narrowly triangular-ovate, covered beneath with brown appressed scales except for the extreme base, serrate; blades linear, attenuate, slightly contracted toward base, 16-30 mm wide, showing a median channel when dry, covered beneath with white scales. Scape straight, ca 8 mm in diameter, white-lepidote, then glabrescent; scape-bracts from subfoliaceous and imbricate to triangular-ovate, acuminate, and about equaling the internodes. Inflorescence simple, densely racemose, 15-28 cm long, pale-lepidote when young. Floral bracts narrowly lance-triangular, the lowest equaling or exceeding the midpoint of the sepals, 5-6 mm wide; flowers divergent to spreading after anthesis; pedicels slender, 6-11 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, rounded and apiculate, 16-23 mm long, ecarinate; petals to 48 mm long, red, bearing an ovate scale at base; ovary ½ inferior.

description: Dioecious shrub or treelet, rarely a large tree, 2-11 (-20) m tall and reaching a dbh of 20 cm; trunk stout and branching about 3 m from the base, the bark dark rufous brown, scaly or with numerous short, coarse depressions. Young branchlets terete or subangular, more or less densely stellate-pilose. Leaves opposite; petioles 0.3-1 cm long; lamina drying grayish brown or greenish brown, rigid-chartaceous and often slightly shiny above, lanceolate, oblong, or elliptic, 10-18 X 3-6.5 cm, the base acute to obtuse, the apex acuminate to apiculate, the tip 0.3-1.5 cm long, on both sides with simple or stellate more or less appressed hairs, especially on the veins and the lower surface, with 9-11 pairs of secondary veins, these flat above, raised below, the margin entire. Cymes bifid, densely covered with minute stellate hairs, sometimes glabrescent, male cymes 3.5-5.5 cm long, with 30150 regularly spaced subsessile flowers; female cymes 2-3 cm long and with fewer flowers. Fresh flowers light yellow-green; male flowers obconical to cup-shaped and with minute wartlike outgrowths (barely visible), 1-1.8 mm in diam., 0.9-1.5 mm high, the indumentum as on the cymes; tepals forming a narrow rim, the floral roof hardly developed; stamens 12-25, membranous; female flowers ovoid, 1-1.5 mm in diam., 1.3-2 mm high, with minute wartlike outgrowths, 0.1 mm long, the tepals forming an upright rim, the floral roof conical, densely tomentose, glabrescent; styles 3(-5), free. Fruiting receptacle globose, 1-1.5 cm in diam., with short fleshy tubercles and often loosely villous, when fresh and mature reddish and with a strong astringent smell; drupelets usually three, lacking a stylar aril.

description: Dioecious shrub or tree, 2-10(-18) m tall, reaching a dbh of 25 cm; young branchlets quadrangular, covered with yellowish spreading hairs. Leaves opposite; petioles 3-5(-13) cm long; lamina typically coarsely bullate, drying yellowish brown to dark brown or olive-green, elliptic or broadly elliptic, (15-) 20-35(-70) X 11-20(-40) cm, the base truncate, cordate or rounded, the apex acute to acuminate, the upper surface typically covered with few-branched spreading hairs and often also a few simple hairs, gla-brescent when older, the lower surface more densely pubescent with tufted hairs, with (13-)16-20(-26) pairs of secondary veins, these impressed above, distinctly raised below, the margin dentate or irregularly doubly serrate. Cymes 4-7 cm long in the males, 24 cm long in the females, densely stellate-pubescent to tomentose, with 10-20 flowers. Fresh flowers yellow, turning orange-red; male floral cup narrowly ob-conical, sometimes subglobose, 4-5(-8) mm in diam., 5-7 mm high, more or less stellate-pubescent to tomentose, the floral roof moderately to distinctly raised, glabrous and drying black, the 4-6 tepals triangular, 2-3 mm long; stamens 5-6(-9), the outer stamens distinctly exserted at anthesis and their tips (pollen sacs) often bent backwards (cf. Fig. 12A); female floral cup of the same size and shape but the tepals up to 7 mm long, the floral roof with a central tube sheathing the styles; styles 10-30. Fruiting receptacle obovate to pear-shaped, 2-4 cm long (Fig. 13C), glabrescent, immature green with whitish spots, mature light red and with a strong sharp lemon smell when cut; drupelets 10-18, gray with a red-orange fleshy stylar aril.

description: Monoecious treelet or tree, (3-)8-22 m tall, rarely a shrub, reaching a dbh of 45(-60) cm; young branchlets terete but flattened at the nodes, densely or sparsely covered with appressed stellate-lepidote hairs or silvery scales. Trunk straight, round, slender, and unbranched up to half the entire height. Bark yellowish or light brown and fairly smooth. Leaves opposite; petioles (0.8-) 1.5-5 cm long; lamina drying dark brown or reddish brown, stiff-chartaceous to coriaceous, oblong or elliptic, 18-27(-38) X (7-)9-14 cm, the base obtuse, acute, or shortly attenuate, the apex acuminate, mature leaves glabrous above, the lower surface with minute stellate-lepidote scales along the veins, rarely with large scales on the veins, otherwise glabrous, with 7-13 pairs of secondary veins, more or less flat above, raised below, anastomosing near the leaf margin and forming inconspicuous loops, the tertiary veins straight, parallel to each other, and densely spaced (Fig. 25), the margin entire. Cymes in the axils of extant leaves, 2.5-7 cm long, usually with numerous (20-50) flowers, the pedicels 3-7 mm long, those of male flowers gradually elongating during anthesis and becoming up to 2 cm long, covered with few or many minute scales or silvery stellate-lepidote hairs. Fresh flowers white or yellow; male flowers cup-shaped, 1.8-4 mm in diam., 1.7-3 mm high, the indumentum as on the cymes; tepals thick and semiorbiculate or forming a narrow upright rim, the floral roof a narrow membranaceous rim; stamens 10-18, fleshy and with minute anther flaps, dorsally sometimes with a few stellate hairs; female flowers subglobose, 2-4 mm in diam., 3-4 mm high, the floral roof conical; styles 3-9, often fused to a column. Fruiting receptacle pyriform to oblong, (l-)2-3.5 cm in diam., fresh and immature light green with brownish spots, mature dark red, drying black with some persistent stellate-lepidote hairs, not splitting open at maturity; drupelets 3-5, lacking a stylar aril.

description: Monoecious treelet or tree, 3-20(-35) m tall, reaching a dbh of 40 cm, rarely a shrub; bark gray and smooth, the sapwood yellow or tan, young branchlets terete, with silvery peltate scales or stellate-lepidote hairs, glabrescent. Leaves opposite; petioles 0.5-1 cm long; lamina drying grayish-brown or brown, smooth, oblong, 11-21 X 4.5-6(-9) cm, the base obtuse or rounded, the apex cuspidate, the tip 1-2 cm long, older leaves glabrescent above, the lower surface lepidote along the nerves, with 6-8(-9) pairs of secondary veins, impressed above, slightly raised below, anastomosing several mm from the margin, the margin entire. Cymes 2-4 cm long, with 10-15 terminally clustered flowers on somewhat elongate pedicels, 3-7 mm long, transparent to silvery lepidote. Fresh flowers yellow-cream or reddish; male flowers cup-shaped, 1.5-1.7 mm in diam., 1.1-1.5 mm high, the indumentum as on the cymes; tepals forming a 0.2-0.3 mm high irregularly lobed rim or obsolete, the floral roof a narrow collar, glabrous; stamens 5-6(-10), short, fleshy, containing whitish oil cells; female flowers ovoid to subglobose, 1.8-2 mm in diam., 1.5-2 mm high, with or without minute tepals; carpels 5-9, styles forming a column. Fruiting receptacle globose, 1-1.5 cm in diam., with tubercles, 1-2 mm long, fresh and immature yellow, mature purple and smelling strongly of lemon; drupelets 5-9, lacking a stylar aril.

description: Monoecious tree, (3-) 10-20 m tall, reaching a dbh of 25(-30) cm, bark gray or brown, furrowed or flaky, inner bark yellowish; young branchlets terete or striate, densely covered with transparent or silvery peltate scales or stellate-lepidote hairs, glabrescent. Leaves opposite; petioles (1-)2-3 cm long; lamina drying brown or grayish brown, chartaceous, ovate, obovate-elliptic to oblanceolate, 12-18(-25) X 4.5-7(-12) cm, the base acute to obtuse, the apex acuminate, the tip 0.5-1 cm long, both surfaces loosely covered with silvery peltate scales (Fig. 7E), older leaves glabrous above, the lower surface usually with persistent stellate-lepidote hairs especially on the veins, with 6-10(-20) pairs of secondary veins, almost smooth above, slightly protruding below, the margin entire. Cymes 2-6 cm long, densely covered with silvery peltate scales (Fig. 4G), with 10-15 flowers. Fresh flowers cream or whitish green, turning yellow with age; male flowers clavate, about 2.2 mm in diam., 3-3.5 mm high, the indumentum as on the cymes; tepals and floral roof connate and forming a dome enclosing the stamens except for a minute apical pore, initially closed by a lid (Figs. 9E, 12D); stamens 5-6; female flowers flask-shaped, 2-3 mm in diam., 3-7 mm high, the tepals forming a calyptra dehiscing after anthesis circumscissily (Fig. 7E), leaving a truncate scar, the floral roof acute and tightly enclosing the stylar column, densely covered with silvery scales; carpels 5-8 (15), their styles fused and forming a column emerging from the floral roof (Fig. 71). Fruiting receptacle almond-shaped or often somewhat asymmetric (Fig. 13A), rarely ovoid, depending on the number of enclosed drupelets, with a distinct tip (where the calyptra fell off), 1.5-3 cm long and 0.7-1.5 cm in diam., fresh and immature green, mature purple, drying dark brown with few or many silvery scales, not splitting open at maturity; drupelets 2-5, lacking a stylar aril.

description: Leaves very numerous in a dense rosette, 8 dm long; sheaths subelliptic, large, serrate toward apex, covered with minute appressed dark brown scales; blades acute with a large stout brown terminal spine, nearly 10 cm wide at base, subdensely serrate with nearly straight spreading or antrorse nearly black spines 4 mm long, green, minutely and obscurely pale-lepidote. Scape stout, red-brown, subglabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, large, elliptic with short foliaceous usually serrulate blades. Inflorescence laxly 3-pinnate, subcylindric, many-flowered, to 5 dm long, red except for the petals; lowest primary bracts broadly lanceolate, usually entire, large, the others small; branches divergent or suberect, 10-12 cm long including the flowers, their main axes well developed. Floral bracts narrowly triangular, entire, 5 mm long; flowers suberect; pedicels slender, 10-40 mm long. Sepals with a large lateral wing, mucronate, half-connate, 15 mm long; petals 30 mm long, blue, bearing 2 fimbriate scales at base, claw linear, blade narrowly elliptic, acute; stamens included; ovary slender, ellipsoid or obconic, ca 10 mm long, the epigynous tube large; placentae extending most of the length of the cell.

description: Treelet 0.25-7 m tall. Branchlets orange-brown to black-purplish when dried, sometimes provided with small (in sicco whitish) lenticels, densely to sparsely brownish strigulose to hispidulous. Leaves apparently opposite; petioles 15 mm long, densely orange-brownish hispidulous) above, orange-brownish hispid beneath; stipules deciduous, narrowly ovate to deltoid, gradually acuminate, 4-7 x 1-1.75 mm, herbaceous and sparsely brownish strigose along the costa to glabrescent, scarious and glabrous near the margin, costate and ± 14 veined, irregularly ciliolate, apex subobtuse to subacute, mucronulate; lamina narrowly elliptic to obovate, acuminate, 2.5-23.5 x 1-8.5 cm, herbaceous, usually glabrous on both sides, sometimes brownish hispid(ulous) on both sides when young; costa brownish hispidulous above, brownish to whitish hispid(ulous) beneath; domatia wanting; lateral veins 11-20 pairs (acumen excluded), brownish hispid(ulous) on both sides; tertiary venation ± scalariform, sometimes sparsely brownish hispid(ulous) on both sides; base rounded to cuneate, asymmetric, oblique, (sub)cordate to (sub)auriculate at the petiole; margin serrate, mucronulate; acumen 1-2 cm long, apex subobtuse to subacute, mucronulate. Inflorescences axillary, lateral and subterminal, solitary, thyrsoid, laxiflorous, 4.5-9.5 x 2.5-4.5 cm; central axis brownish to whitish hispidulous; cymules 1-5 flowered; common peduncle 2.25-8.5 cm long, brownish to whitish hispidulous; pedicels 2-6.5 cm long, articulate at 2/5-1/6 from the base, brownish to whitish hispidulous; bracts and bractlets narrowly deltoid to ovate, acuminate, scarious, brownish to whitish hispidulous near the apex, margin ciliate, apex subacute, mucronulate; bracts 2.5-4.5 x ca. 1 mm, costate and 3-9 veined; bractlets 0.5-1.25 x 0.5-0.75 mm. Flower buds ovoid to conical, subacute. Flowers drooping, white. Sepals subequal, (narrowly) elliptic to ovate, 2.5-3.25 x 1.25-1.5 mm, herbaceous, sparsely whitish pilose near the apex of the costa, costate, obscurely 3-5 veined, margin whitish to brownish ciliate, apex subacute. Petals (narrowly) elliptic to ovate, 4-6 x 2-2.5 mm, herbaceous, glabrous or sometimes pilosulous and ciliolate at the apex, apex obtuse. Stamens 3.25-3.75 mm long; filaments free, 0.250.5 x 0.25-0.75 mm, glabrous; dorsal glands free, adnate to the filaments, sometimes fused and apparently wanting, 0-0.5 x 0-0.25(-0.4) mm, carnose, glabrous; anthers ovoid, 1.25-1.5 x ca. 0.75 mm, glabrous, apex of thecae obtuse to apiculate, each rarely appendaged by a cusp 0.1-0.2 x 0.1 mm; connective outside narrowly deltoid or elliptic, obtuse, 2 x 0.5 mm, glabrous; connective scales lateral as well as apical, narrowly ovate to elliptic, 3-3.35 x 1-1.5 mm, scarious, creamy colored, transparent, margin erose to fringed especially near the base, apex rounded to obtuse, suberose to subentire. Ovary subglobose, 0.5-1 mm long and wide, slanting golden to whitish pilose; ovules one per placenta. Style filiform, erect or curved, 3-3.5 mm long, exceeding the stamens by 0.25-1 mm, pilose at the base. Capsule more or less symmetric, ovate to orbicular, slightly acuminate, subtended by subpersistent floral parts, coriaceous, whitish pilose, obscurely veined, usually the style subpersistent at the apex of the valves; valves three, (sub)equal, 0.6-0.75 x ca. 0.35 cm. Seeds one per valve, subglobose to obovoid, 3.5 x 2.5 mm, glabrous.

description: Plant caulescent, propagating by long rhizomes, flowering 1.5 m high; stem leafy, straight, 30 cm high, 5 cm in diameter, leafless toward base. Leaves 30-40, arching-decurved, to 12 dm long; sheaths narrow and indistinct, entire; blades 6-7 cm wide, deeply channeled, coriaceous, reddish green and lustrous above, densely lepidote beneath, laxly serrate with curved antrorse and retrorse spines 10 mm long. Scape erect, 20-30 cm high, ca 25 mm in diameter, furfuraceous; scape-bracts foliaceous, reduced, reddish. Inflorescence simple, strobilate, ovoid, to 17 cm long, 9 cm in diameter, 150-200-flowered. Floral bracts densely imbricate, lanceolate, acuminate, erect, nearly equaling the petals, serrulate, red, cinereous-lepidote, persistent; flowers opening in succession. Sepals erect, asymmetric, ovate, narrowed at base, apiculate, 10-13 mm long, conduplicate or merely channeled, thick with membranous margins, red orange, sparsely lepidote; petals tubular-erect, 4-5 cm long, the claw oblong, white, the blade lanceolate, purplish; stamens included, adnate to the petals. Syncarp 20 cm long, 10 cm in diameter, succulent.
