description: Terrestrial shrub with one main erect or pendent stem to 3 m long; mature branches subterete, broadly angled, striate, glabrous, weakly glaucous, drying irregularly flattened due to high pith/wood ratio; twigs subterete, striate, glabrate. Leaves thick-coriaceous, elliptic, oblong-elliptic, or lance-elliptic, 26-45 X 7-20 cm, basally rounded or obtuse, apically long- or short-acuminate, margin conspicuously thickened, slightly revolute at middle becoming tightly revolute at base, moderately pilose on both surfaces when young otherwise glabrate; 3-5(-7)-plinerved from base, midrib and lateral nerves stout, weakly impressed or slightly raised above, conspicuously raised beneath, reticulate veinlets raised on both surfaces; petiole subterete, sometimes flattened adaxially, rugose, glabrate, 12-25 mm long and 3-7 mm diam. Inflorescence 20-30-flowered, encircled at base by 6-8 coriaceous, persistent, ovate bracts, 7-15 mm long; rachis sharply angled when dry, glabrous, 13-30 cm long and 5-8 mm in diam., green or green suffused with pink when fresh; floral bracts ovate, oblong-ovate, 28-40 x 17-23 mm, basally clasping and auriculate, glabrous although distal ¼ and especially apex ciliate, dark rose when fresh; pedicels terete, slightly swollen distally, glabrous, ca. 25 mm long and 3(-5 distally) mm diam., rose-red when fresh, becoming essentially a hollow cylinder (except for included stele) when dry; bracteoles oblong, obtuse, 7 x 3 mm, glabrous, each margin with 5-6 stout, tooth-like, callose glands. Flowers: calyx glabrous, ca. 13 mm long when fresh but drying 7-8 mm, rose-red when fresh; hypanthium a fleshy, apophysate rim 3 mm long; limb cylindric, smooth, 10 mm long (drying 4-5 mm); lobes triangular, acute, ca. 2 mm long, connivent after anthesis, each margin bearing along its edge an oblong, usually curved or crescent-shaped, slightly thickened gland 2.5 mm long which is black when fresh, the glands not contiguous at lobe apex; sinus obtuse; corolla cylindric, constricted at throat, glabrous, 33-34 mm long and 8 mm diam., light yellowish-green with white lobes (lobe margins purple) when fresh, lobes deltoid, spreading at anthesis, ca. 1 mm long; stamens 27 mm long; filaments weakly coherent at base, geniculate and there densely short-pilose on ventral surface, alternately ca. 4 mm and 8 mm long; anthers alternately ca. 26 mm and 21 mm long; thecae alternately ca. 11 mm and 8.5 mm long; style ca. 35 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Branchlets glabrous with prominent, white elongate lenticels, sometimes with a fuscous-brown pubescence. Leaves paripinnate, (20-)25-45(-55) cm long; petiole pubescent. Leaflets with thick petiolules, 3-8 mm long, 6-10(-13) pairs, opposite or subopposite, ovate-elliptic to ovate-oblong, sometimes oblong, apex short acuminate or obtuse, base cordate or broadly rounded more rarely obtuse, slightly asymmetrical, coriaceous, dark glossy yellowish-green above, paler beneath, midrib conspicuous with long reddish-brown hairs, lateral nerves closely and evenly spaced, puberulent with tufts of hairs in axils, (9-)9-15(-18) cm long, 3.5-5.5(-6.5) cm broad. Inflorescence terminal or subterminal, pubescent, thyrses congested and crowded, 12-25(-30) cm long, bracts deciduous or subpersistent. Flowers unisexual, with short pedicels, 1-2 mm long, densely tomentose. Calyx deeply and regularly 5-lobed to about or below middle, 1.5-3.0 mm long, lobes rounded to narrowly deltate, puberulous. Petals 5, free, imbricate, elliptic-oblong to oblong, thick and fleshy, (6-)8-10 mm long, 2-2.5(-3) mm broad, glabrous or minutely and densely puberulous on both surfaces, often with matted hairs along mid-line inside, adnate to gynophore by a carina along lower 1/2-1/3 their length. Stamens 5, free, 2-3.5 mm long; filaments with a few scattered hairs, adnate to base of broad, stout gynophore; anthers in [male] flowers large, yellow, markedly apiculate, in [female] flowers brown and shrivelled. Ovary in 9 flowers, glabrous, globose, 5-locular, each loculus with 12-14 ovules; style short, 1-2 mm long; style-head discoid, 1 mm thick, with 5 flat stigmatic lobes. Pistillode in [male] flowers slender, angular, with well-developed loculi, but ovules very small; style columnar, 3-4 mm long, glabrous; style-head thinner, lacking stigmatic lobes. Capsule obovoid to elongate-obovoid, pendulous, 5-valved, valves woody, 1.5-2.5 mm thick, greyish-brown, smooth, with large elongate whitish lenticels, 4-6(-7) cm long. Columella with 5 prominent broad wings extending to apex of capsule. Seed brown, 3.5-4.0 cm long including the wing.

description: Lianas, glabras; ramos novos tetrangulares a subtetrangulares, lisos, secos enegrecidos a acinzentados, depois castanhos a castanho avermelhados, velhos cilíndricos a subtetrangulares, fissurados. Folhas opostas a subopostas; estípulas triangulares, inteiras; pecíolos 8-12 mm, secos marrons a negros; lâminas (3.8-) 11.2-11.6 × (1.2-)4.9 cm, elípticas, base cuneada, margem crenulada, ápice acuminado, cartáceas, secas marrom-escuro em ambas as faces ou marrom-claro na face abaxial, dentes enegrecidos, às vezes esparso pontuada de negro na face abaxial, nervuras secas de cor inconspícua na face adaxial, marrom-escuras na abaxial, na face adaxial secundárias planas a levemente promínulas, terciárias obscuras, na abaxial secundárias promínulas, terciárias obscuras a levemente promínulas. Inflorescências 2.5-3 × 2.3-3.3 cm, dicásios compostos, com 32-320 flores, axilares; pedúnculos (6-)9-11 mm, ramos subcilíndricos, crassos e curtos; brácteas triangulares, escariosas, inteiras; pedicelos 0.3-0.5 mm; bractéolas 3. Flores ca 1.5 mm diâm na antese, urceoliformes; sépalas 0.4-0.6 × 0.6 -0.8 mm, triangulares, erosas, escariosas, carnosas; pétalas 0.8-1.1 × 0.7-0.9 mm, elípticas, mais ou menos eretas, espessadas no centro internamente, erosas, minutamente onduladas, carnosas, amarelas; disco 0.3-0.5 × 0.4-0.5 mm; estames 3, 0.4-0.5 mm, filetes 0.2-0.35 mm, anteras 0.1-0.25 × 0.2-0.25 mm, elipsóides; ovário 3-locular, estigma 3-lobado, lobos inteiros, agudos, levemente proeminentes, óvulos por lóculo 2. Bagas não vistas. Sementes não vistas.

description: Plant flowering to 56 cm high. Leaves many in a subbulbous rosette, to 34 cm long, densely and finely appressed-lepidote on both sides; sheaths subelliptic, ample, 7-9 cm long, dark castaneous, brown-lepidote; blades slightly curved, very narrowly triangular, subpungent, involute toward apex, 1 cm wide, wholly green, cinereous-lepidote. Scape erect, slender, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, elliptic, papyraceous, reddish, bearing sublinear erect lepidote blades or the highest merely acute. Inflorescence simple or laxly bipinnate and broadly pyramidal with 2-4 branches, to 2 dm long; primary bracts like the scape-bracts but bladeless, exceeding 2-3 basal internodes; branches spreading with the flowers more than distichous, 8-14 cm long, laxly 4-15-flowered, the sterile base short with a single bract nearly as large as the floral ones; rhachis slender, excavated next the flowers, glabrous. Floral bracts divergent or spreading at anthesis, broadly elliptic, acute or obtuse, 3 cm long, 16 mm wide, exceeding and enfolding the sepals, sometimes slightly carinate toward the apex, membranaceous, nerved, very obscurely lepidote, reddish; pedicels short, stout. Sepals narrowly elliptic, 15-20 mm long, ecarinate; petals ligulate, ca 25-45 mm long, yellow, bearing 2 elliptic obtuse scales; stamens exserted. Capsule slenderly cylindric, ca 3 cm long.

description: Plant flowering 8 dm high. Leaves rosulate, to 63 cm long, subdensely vestite throughout with minute appressed scales; sheaths subquadrate, scarcely wider than the blades but dark castaneous beneath; blades ligulate, broadly rounded and apiculate, 65 mm wide, green, concolorous. Scape erect, 1 cm in diameter, glabrous; scape-bracts imbricate and wholly covering the scape, green with fine purple spots, the upper elliptic. Inflorescence erect, few-branched, lax, 35 cm long, glabrous; primary bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, covering the short sterile naked bases of the branches; branches spreading with the flowers downwardly divergent-secund, the lateral 14 cm long, the terminal slightly larger. Floral bracts very densely distichous but not secund, broadly elliptic, apiculate, 4 cm long, sharply carinate, subcoriaceous, green, somewhat nerved in drying; pedicels cylindric, 1 cm long. Sepals narrowly oblong, rounded, 24 mm long, subcoriaceous, nerved; petals unknown. Capsule slenderly ovoid, beaked, 35 mm long.

description: Plant flowering 1-2 m high. Leaves about 10 in a dense rosette, suberect, 6-7 dm long, green, usually with large irregular spots of deep red especially near the base, obscurely punctulate-lepidote; sheaths ovate-elliptic, the same color as the blades but slightly broader; blades ligulate, acute or subrounded with a long apiculus, 8-10 cm wide. Scape erect, greatly exceeding the leaves, well over 1 cm in diameter at the summit, glabrous; scape-bracts erect, imbricate, very broadly ovate, acute or the lower ones triangular-laminate, glabrous, even, thick, coriaceous. Inflorescence simple or few-branched, to 4 dm long; primary bracts suberect, like the upper scape-bracts, covering only the sterile bases of the branches; branches suberect, secundly 11-15-flowered, the lateral ones 25 cm long with 1 or 2 sterile bracts at the base, the terminal one nearly 4 dm long with a sterile base as long as the fertile part and appearing like a continuation of the scape; rhachis to 10 mm in diameter, flexuous, strongly 4-angled, glabrous, dark, its internodes narrowly obconical. Floral bracts becoming secund with the flowers, broadly elliptic to suborbicular, abruptly acute, to 5 cm long, some and usually all more than twice as long as the internodes, glabrous, even, rigid, coriaceous, green, drying to light brown, incurved and carinate toward apex; flowers spreading and downwardly secund; pedicels very stout, to 12 mm long. Sepals very broadly elliptic or ovate, obtuse or broadly acute, 30-45 mm long, rigid, coriaceous, even and glabrous outside, striate and punctulate-lepidote within; petals white, slightly exceeding the stamens, bearing 2 scales at base.

description: Plant flowering barely 1 m high, slender. Leaves densely rosulate, to 55 cm long; blades ligulate, acuminate, 3-4 cm wide, green, concolorous, glabrous above, obscurely punctulate beneath. Scape erect, 4 mm in diameter, elongate; scape-bracts erect and tubular-involute, slightly exceeding the internodes, broadly elliptic, acute, stramineous. Inflorescence simple, densely distichous-flowered, 15-18 cm long. Floral bracts becoming secund with the flowers, very broadly ovate, obtuse, equaling the sepals, ecarinate, thin-coriaceous, minutely verrucose near the apex, green with brownish tips; flowers suberect; pedicels stout, 4-5 mm long. Sepals elliptic, obtuse, 15-20 mm long; petals oblong, subtruncate and emarginate, about 4 cm long, white, spreading above the sepals, each bearing 2 acute serrulate scales at the base; stamens slightly shorter than the petals. Capsule fusiform, 4 cm long; coma white.

description: Lianas, tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, nas inflorescências também com esparsos tricomas malpiguiáceos; ramos circulares, estriados, ramos reprodutivos comumente surgindo em ramos vegetativos já sem folhas, seríceos e glabrescentes. Gavinhas ramificadas dicotomicamente várias vezes, pubérulas na parte proximal, glabras nos ramos, discos adesivos presentes ñas extremidades; escamas ca. 1 mm compr., deltoides, pubérulas. Folhas (6,6-)8,4-13,9 cm compr. x (7-) 12-15 cm larg., pinadas oubi-pinadas, às vezes ausentes nos ramos reprodutivos; pecíolos (1,6—)2,1—3,8(—4,8) cm compr., canaliculados, pulvinados, pubérulos; estípulas (2-)4-10 mm compr. x 1-8 mm larg., elípticas, pubérulas, ciliadas, carnosas, persistentes, desde cedo túrgidas e reflexas, espessando-se nos ramos vegetativos em estruturas intumescidas cônicas, agudas, e carnosas que nos caules mais velhos formam estruturas alargadas compreendendo todo o nó; ráquis 1-6,8 cm compr., canaliculadas, pubérulas; peciólulos (0,5-)l-20(-37) mm compr., canaliculados, pulvinulados, pubérulos ou híspidos; folíolos (0,5-) 1,5—3(—7,4) cm compr. x (0,3-) 0,7-1,8(-6,2) cm larg., 5-7 pares por folha, simples ou temados; pecíolos de terceira ordem (0,5-) 1—2(—13,5) mm compr., canaliculados, pulvinulados, pubérulos ou híspidos; folíolos de segunda ordem (0,6-)2,2-2,7 (-5,6) cm compr. x (0,4-)0,8-l,6(-2,8) cm larg., lâminas dos folíolos de primeira e segunda ordens ovais ou elípticas, ápices agudos, acuminados, ou arredondados, margens denticuladas, bases arredondadas ou cuneadas, lâminas pubérulas em ambas as faces e glabrescentes na face adaxial, papiráceas. Inflorescências (1,7—)2—3,5 cm compr. x (1,7—)2,1—2,8 cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos (6,5-) 13-18 mm compr., vermelhos, pubérulos, seríceos no ápice e nos ramos; brácteas 1-2 mm compr., triangulares, pubérulas, ciliadas; pedicelos 2-3 mm compr., vermelhos, glabros; botões fusiformes; cálice 1 mm alt. x 1-2 mm diâm., vermelho, glabro, minutamente papiloso, carnoso, truncado, base arredondada; corola em botão 1-1,5 mm alt. x 1(-1,5) mm diâm.; pétalas vermelhas, glabras, minutamente papilosas; anteras latrorsas, conectivo vermelho, triangular, granuloso; disco amarelo tomando-se vermelho de borda externa amarela, não cobrindo o ápice do ovário, borda externa elevada; estilete cilíndrico, amarelo, estigma levemente capitado. Baga ca. 11 mm compr. x 8 mm larg., púrpura, piriforme, com lenticelas esparsas; semente 1, ca. 10 mm compr. x 5 mm larg., subturbinada, lateralmente achatada, laterais rugosas, hilo obtuso, rafe marcada com estrias transversais.

description: Lianas ou raro e ocasionalmente epífitas, glabras; ramos subcilíndricos, sub-4-angulados ou levemente alados, lustrosos, com lenticelas esparsas, carnosos, velhos serosos. Gavinhas não ramificadas oubirrami-fícadas, às vezes serosas, discos adesivos presentes abaixo das extremidades; escamas ca. 1 mm compr., triangulares, diáfanas, membranáceas. Folhas digitadas; pecíolos (2,2-)3,5-5,4(-7,4) cm compr., canaliculados; estípulas (2-)3-5 mm compr. x (1,5-) 2(—3,5) mm larg., deltóides ou espabiladas, às vezes ciliadas, carnosas, tardiamente caducas; peciólulos centrais 0(—12) mm compr., intermediários 0(-6) mm compr., laterais 0(-3,5) mm compr., canaliculados; láminas dos folíolos centrais (3,3-)4,4-6,5(-l 1) x (0,3-)l-2,3(-3,7) cm, intermediários (2,6-)3,3-4,3 (-6,7) x (0,3-)0,9-l,4(-2,4) cm, laterais (1,5-)2,1-4,3(-7) x (0,3-)0,8-l,8 cm, lineares, estreito-elípticas, elípticas, obovais, ou às vezes obtruladas, principalmente as dos folíolos centrais, ápice arredondado ou agudo, margem inteira, levemente sinuosa, ou denteada, levemente revoluta, base atenuada ou truncada, láminas carnosas, secas comumente enroladas. Inflo-rescéncias (0,6—)1,3—1,7(—3,2) cm compr. x (0,9-) l,4-2,2(-3,5) cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado; pedúnculos (4—)8—9(—15) mm compr., verdes; brácteas 0,5-2,5 mm compr., triangulares; pedicelos 2-4 mm compr., verdes; botões elipsoides; cálice 1 mm alt. x 1-2 mm diâm., verde-amarelado, carnoso, truncado, base arredondada; corola em botão 1-2 mm alt. x 1,5-2 mm diâm., de seção levemente 4-angular; pétalas verde-amareladas; anteras latrorsas, conectivo triangular, base levemente emarginada, granuloso, seco amarelo-claro; disco verde-amarelado, borda externa elevada; estilete cilindrico, estigma pontual. Baga 7-8 mm compr. x 6-9 mm larg., púrpura, subesférica, com lenticelas esparsas; semente 1, ca. 6 mm compr. x 5 mm larg., subturbinada, lateralmente mais ou menos arredondada, laterais rugosas, hilo agudo, rafe levemente marcada.

description: Lianas; tricomas não ramificados e não glandulares, ferrugíneos ou alvescentes; ramos circulares, engrossados nos nós, glaucos, glabros ou pubérulos. Gavinhas birramificadas, pubérulas principalmente na base, discos adesivos não observados; escamas ca. 1 mm compr., triangulares, pubérulas e glabrescentes, ciliadas, hialinas. Folhas digitadas, raro folíolos conatos e então folhas trifolioladas com folíolos laterais lobados ou até muito raramente folhas simples trilobadas, raro ramos reprodutivos áfilos, principalmente na parte distal; pecíolos (1,5—)2,2—5,1(—6,6) cm compr., canaliculados, tomentosos ou esparso pubérulos principalmente no ápice; estípulas 2 mm compr. x 1,5-2 mm larg., deltoides, tomentosas e glabrescentes, ciliadas, membranáceas, persistentes, hialinas, inseridas na base do pecíolo; peciólulos centrais (3,5—)5—13(-20) mm compr., intermediários (3,5—)4,5—8(—13) mm compr., laterais (0—)2—5(—12) mm compr., canaliculados, tomentosos ou esparso pubérulos; láminas dos folíolos centrais (3,4-)6,8-10(-12) x (l,3-)2,9-4,7(-5,7) cm, intermediários (2,7-)4,9-8(-10,3) x (1,1—)2—3,9(—5) cm, laterais (1,2-)2-5(-7) x (0,7-) 1,3-2,6(-3,7) cm, elípticas ou obovadas, ápice agudo, margem denticulada ou denteada, base cuneada, láminas glabras em ambas as faces, pubérulas na face adaxial, vilosas ou tomentosas na face abaxial principalmente ao longo das nervuras, às vezes com tufos de pelos nas axilas das nervuras secundárias na face abaxial, secas dicolores, membranáceas. Inflorescéncias (4,5-)5,4-7,2(-8,5) cm compr. x (1,7—)2,2-4,6(—5,6) cm larg., umbeliformes, de ápice aplanado, raro com ramos volúveis; pedúnculos (2,2-)2,9-3,9(-5,2) cm compr., verdes, tomentosos; brácteas 1-1,5 mm compr., triangulares, pubérulas, ciliadas, hialinas; pedicelos 12 mm compr., esverdeados, pubérulos; botões conoi-dais; cálice 0,5 mm alt. x 1-1,5 mm diám., verde-amarelado, glabro ou esparso pubérulo, membranáceo, truncado ou de lobos arredondados, base arredondada; corola em botão (1—)1,5—2 mm alt. x (l-)2 mm diâm., alargada na base, pétalas separadas entre si na base; pétalas verde-amareladas ou avermelhadas, glabras ou esparso pubérulas nas margens e nas nervuras centrais; filetes esverdeados de base rosada, anteras introrsas, conectivo inconspícuo; disco esverdeado a rosado, ápice aplanado; estilete cônico, estigma pontual. Baga ca. 7 mm compr. x 6 mm larg., amarela ou púrpura, esférica, lisa; sementes 2-4, ca. 5 mm compr. x 4 mm larg., subcordiformes, lateralmente mais ou menos arredondadas, faces levemente rugosas e lustrosas, hilo agudo, rafe inconspícua, chalaza conspícua e levemente marcada.

description: Shrub or tree, sometimes to 20 m tall. Leafy twigs 1-4 mm thick, puberulous, usually with uncinate hairs; periderm often flaking off. Lamina elliptic to (narrowly) lanceolate, (3-)8-33 × (1 -)2.5-12 cm, broadest at or sometimes below the middle, almost equilateral, (sub)coriaceous; apex (caudate-)acuminate, the acumen spinulose; base acute to obtuse; margin entire, spinulose-dentate, sometimes sinuate or lobate; upper surface glabrous; lower surface glabrous or sparsely puberulous with uncinate hairs; midrib distinctly prominent and other veins slightly prominent to plane above, ± prominent beneath; lateral veins (5-)8-20 pairs; tertiary venation reticulate; petiole 0.3-1.5 cm long, 1-2.5 mm thick, often puberulous with uncinate hairs; stipules subulate, 0.1-0.3 cm long, puberulous, caducous. Staminate inflorescences usually on short-shoots (spurs); peduncle to 0.5 cm long, (rather) densely puberulous with uncinate hairs; spike 0.2-2(-6.5) cm long; perianth ca. 0.5 mm long, (2-)3-4-lobed to -parted, minutely puberulous; stamens 1 (-3); filaments ca. 0.5-1.5 mm long; anthers ca. 0.2-0.3 × 0.2-0.3 mm; bracts variously shaped, often subpeltate, minutely puberulous, sometimes with uncinate hairs. Pistillate inflorescences usually on short-shoots (spurs); peduncle to 0.3 cm long, to 2 cm long in fruit, sparsely to densely puberulous with uncinate hairs; head ca. 0.5 cm diam.; flowers 6-20; perianth ca. 1.5-2 mm long, subentire, almost glabrous to rather densely puberulous, sometimes partly with uncinate hairs; ovary (almost) free; style 0.5-1 mm long; stigmas tongueshaped, 1-2 mm long; bracts basal (subtending the marginal flowers), sometimes among the flowers, broadly to narrowly ovate, to 1 mm long, minutely puberulous, often some of the bracts thickened and to 2 mm long in fruit. Fruiting perianth (subglobose to) ellipsoid to oblongoid, 1.2-2 × 0.8-1.3 cm, (yellow to) orange (to red); fruit adnate to the lower part or only to the basal part of the perianth.

description: Shrub to 3.5 m tall, young shoots glabrous. Leaf blade oblanceolate, 23-55 x 4.5-13 cm, coriaceous or subcoriaceous, 0.12-0.15 mm thick, glabrous, base attenuate, apex acute or short-acuminate, margins serrate or serrulate, rarely subentire, teeth 12-23 per side, lateral veins rather conspicuous, surfaces between veinlets striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma adjacent to epidermis on both sides, arranged in bundles 3-9 cells thick, hypoderm lacking; petiole 0.5-3.5 cm long, 1-2.5 mm thick, glabrous. Racemes in male and bisexual plants to 30 cm long with 20-40 flowers, in female plants to ca. 1 cm long with 6-12 flowers; rachis 0.7-1 mm thick, glabrous or puberulous; pedicels 1-2 mm long; bracts 0.5-1 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 5-merous; calyx lobes very broadly ovate, 1.2-1.5 x 1.5-2 mm, glabrous; corolla orange-red, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes in male and bisexual flowers 3-4 x 3-4.5 mm, in female flowers ca. 2.5 x 2.5 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, in male and bisexual flowers united into a tube 0.5-1 mm long, in female flowers united at base only, free parts ca. 0.7 mm long. Pistil in male and bisexual flowers narrowly ovoid, without or with 2 or 3 ovules, in female flowers ovoid with 10-12 ovules in 2 rows. Fruits yellow, 1.2-1.8 cm diam., pericarp ca. 0.3 mm thick, surface smooth, seeds 1-4, 7-8 mm long.

description: Shrub to 3 m tall, young shoots puberulous. Leaf blade oblanceolate or narrowly obovate, 29-61 x 9.5-21 cm, coriaceous, 0.15-0.22 mm thick, glandular-pilose or rarely subglabrous beneath, glabrous above, base attenuate, apex acute, obtuse or sometimes short-acuminate, margins serrulate or sometimes entire, lateral veins conspicuous beneath, less so above, surfaces between veinlets striate beneath, furrowed above; extraxylary sclerenchyma adjacent to epidermis on both sides, abaxially arranged in bundles 25-30 cells thick, adaxially in a more or less continuous layer, interrupted by mesenchymatous or rarely empty cells, hypoderm lacking; petiole 3-9 cm long, 1.8-3.8 mm thick, puberulous at base. Racemes in bisexual plants to 18 cm long with 25-42 flowers, plants with male flowers not seen, in female plants to ca. 2 cm long with 8-15 flowers; rachis 1-1.3 mm thick, puberulous, pedicels 1.5-2 mm long; bracts ca. 1 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 5-merous; calyx lobes very broadly ovate, 1.7-2.5 x 2-2.5 mm, glabrous; corolla orange, tube 2-3 mm long, lobes 3.5-4.5 x 3.7-4.5 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, in bisexual plants fused into a tube 1-1.5 mm long, in female flowers united at base only, free parts ca. 1 mm long. Pistil in bisexual flowers narrowly ovoid with 2-10 ovules in 1 or 2 rows, in female flowers ovoid with 25-30 ovules in 3 or 4 rows. Only immature fruits seen, pericarp smooth.

description: Small tree to at least 8 m tall, young shoots puberulous. Leaf blade oblanceolate, 35-60 x 8-11 cm, coriaceous, 0.22-0.31 mm thick, glabrous, base attenuate, apex acute, margins entire, lateral veins rather inconspicuous, surfaces between veinlets sparsely striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma sparse, arranged in bundles 2-10 cells thick, abaxially adjacent to epidermis, adaxially ajacent to or sometimes interrupting a 1-layered hypoderm; petiole 3-6 cm long, 2.2-3 mm thick, glabrous. Racemes in male and bisexual plants to 18 cm long with 20-40 flowers, plants with female flowers not seen; rachis 0.7-1.5 mm thick, glabrous or subglabrous; pedicels 1.5-3(-4) mm long; bracts 0.7-1 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 5-merous; calyx lobes very broadly ovate, 1.7-2 x 2-2.5 mm; corolla orange or orange-red, tube 1.7-2 mm long, lobes 3-4.5 x 3.5-4.5 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, fused into a tube 1-1.7 mm long. Pistil narrowly ovoid, in bisexual flowers with 3-10 ovules in 1 or 2 rows. Fruits orange, (1.2-) 1.5-2(-3.5) cm diam., pericarp ca. 0.4(-2.5) mm thick, surface smooth; seeds 2-15, 7.5-10 mm long.

description: Shrub or small tree to 7 m tall, stem to at least 6 cm thick, young shoots densely puberulous. Leaf blade oblanceolate, 21-74 x 7-18 cm, coriaceous, 0.24-0.27 mm thick, sparsely to densely glandular-pilose beneath, glabrous above, base attenuate, apex acute, short-acuminate, or rarely obtuse, margins entire or sometimes serrulate, lateral veins conspicuous beneath, less so above, surfaces between veinlets striate on both sides; extraxylary sclerenchyma adjacent to epidermis on both sides, arranged in bundles 4-10 cells thick, hypoderm lacking, but empty cells often present above major veins; petiole 5.5-16 cm long, 1.8-5.5 mm thick. Racemes in female, male, and bisexual plants to 12 cm long with 10-20 flowers; rachis 1.5-3 mm thick, puberulous; pedicels 1.5-2 mm long; bracts ca. 1 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 5-merous; calyx lobes broadly ovate, ca. 2.2 x 2.5 mm, glabrous; corolla orange, tube ca. 3 mm long, lobes 3 x 3.5 mm. Stamen filaments free, glabrous, 1 mm long. Pistil ovoid with 15-20 ovules in 2 rows; stigma subcapitate, entire. Fruits yellow or orange, somewhat irregular in shape, 1.5-2.5 cm diam., pericarp 0.7-0.9 mm thick, surface rugose; seeds 4-11, 8-9.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Ståhl, Bertil. 2010. Theophrastaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 105: 1-160.

description: Shrub to at least 1.5 m tall, young shoots puberulous. Leaf blade oblanceolate or narrowly obovate, 9-34 x 2.5-12 cm, cartilaginous, 0.25-0.35 mm thick, glabrous, base attenuate, apex acute, margins spinose-serrate with 17-70 teeth per side, lateral veins rather inconspicuous, surfaces between veinlets striate; extraxylary sclerenchyma adjacent to epidermis on both sides, arranged in bundles 5-15(-20) cells thick, empty hypodermal cells often present adaxially but without forming a continuous layer; petiole 0.5-1.5 cm long, 1.2-2 mm thick, glabrous or puberulous at base. Racemes in bisexual plants to 12 cm long with 10-15 flowers, in female plants to 4 cm long with 10-15 flowers, plants with male flowers not seen; rachis 0.6-1.2 mm thick, sparsely to densely puberulous; pedicels 2-5(-6) mm long; bracts 0.7-1 mm long, inserted at nodes. Flowers 5-merous; calyx lobes very broadly ovate, 1-1.7 x 2.2-3 mm, glabrous; corolla orange, tube 1-2 mm long, lobes in bisexual flowers 3-4 x 3.5-4.5 mm, in female flowers 2.2-2.7 x 2.2-3 mm. Stamen filaments glabrous, in bisexual flowers fused into a tube 0.7-1.2 mm long, in female flowers united at base only, free parts 0.5-0.7 mm long. Pistil in bisexual flowers narrowly ovoid with 1-9 ovules in 1 or 2 rows, in female flowers ovoid with 15-22 ovules in 2 or 3 rows; stigma truncate to subcapitate. Fruits orange, to ca. 2.5 cm diam., pericarp ca. 0.4 mm thick, surface smooth or very faintly papillose; seeds 4-11, ca. 7 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Ståhl, Bertil. 2010. Theophrastaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 105: 1-160.

description: Liana, ramas jóvenes tomentosas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos 5-7, pulvínulo cilindrico, rugoso, 0.5-0.7 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, (1-)2-5.5(-9) cm de largo; raquis (1-)2-7(-11) cm de largo. Foliolos (2.5-)4.5-11 (-13.5) cm de largo, (1.4-)2-6(-7.5) cm de ancho, generalmente ovado lanceolados, raramente elípticos, subcoriáceos, haz oscura, brillante, glabra, envés opaco, claro, a veces blanquecino, pubérulo, los pelos adpresos, paralelos entre sí y con las nervaduras secundarias, más densos sobre las nervaduras y ocasionalmente brillantes, base por lo general angostada, raramente completamente redondeada, ápice abrupto y cortamente acuminado, acumen hasta de 0.5 cm, margen revoluto, peciólulo 0.2-0.5 cm de largo; venación transversal, nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales (5-)7-9 pares, más o menos rectas y paralelas entre sí, formando ángulos de 45° con la nervadura central, obscuramente anastomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas a prominentes en el envés, impresas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias delgadas, planas en ambas caras. Inflorescencia paniculada, laxa, axilar o principalmente pseudoterminal; raquila hasta de 20 cm de largo, densamente ferrugíneo puberula; brácteas inconspicuas. Flores sésiles; sépalos 2-5 mm de largo, 1 mm de ancho, oblongos, densamente pubérulos exteriormente, glabrescentes interiormente, ápice acuminado a obtuso, barbado, margen ciliado; pétalos 2.5-3 mm de largo, 1 mm de ancho, oblongo-elípticos, glabros; 5 filamentos más largos 2.5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 2 mm de longitud, glabros; anteras cordadas, 0.3 mm de longitud; ovario con 5 carpelos vellosos, sésiles, estilo delgado, velloso en la base. Fruto sésil, marcadamente estriado longitudinalmente, 1-2(-4) carpelos maduran para formar frutos, 1.2-2 cm de largo, 0.4-0.7 cm de ancho, pubescencia marrón oscuro exteriormente, glabros interiormente, cáliz en el fruto presente, reflejo. Semilla hasta 1.3 cm de largo, 0.6 cm de ancho, ariloide 0.5 cm de alto, delgado.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Liana. Lenticelas pequeñas, conspicuas, ramas jóvenes diminutamente pubé-rulas o glabras. Hojas imparipinadas; foliolos (l-)3, pulvínulo cilindrico, rugoso, glabro, 0.5-1.5 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, estriado, glabro, 2-12 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, estriado, glabro, 1-3 cm de largo. Foliolos (5-)9-16(-34) cm de largo, (2.6-)3.8-7.6(-10) cm de ancho, elípticos o angosto-elípticos, coriáceos, haz brillante, oscura, glabra, envés opaco, claro, glabro, base redondeada, ápice suavemente acuminado (acumen hasta 1.5 cm de largo), margen revoluto; peciólulo cilindrico, grueso, rugoso o Asurado, 0.3-0.6(-0.8) cm de largo; venación transversal, visible en ambas caras, nervadura central prominente en el envés, plana o levemente impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 5-7 pares, formando ángulos de 45-60° con la nervadura central, irregularmente anastomosadas cerca al margen, levemente promínulas en el envés, planas o levemente promínulas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias levemente promínulas en ambas caras. Inflorescencia paniculada, laxa, delgada, con un aspecto general blanquecino debido a la pubescencia de los sépalos, axilar o pseudoterminal; raquila hasta 15 cm de largo, diminutamente pubérula, pubescencia marrón claro. Pedicelo pubérulo, ca. 0.3 cm de largo; sépalos 2.5-3 mm de largo, 1.4-1.7 mm de ancho, elípticos, con puntuaciones inconspicuas, densamente pubérulos en ambas caras, exteriormente blanquecinos; pétalos 3.5-4 mm de largo, 1.5-1.7 mm de ancho, débilmente unidos en la parte media, oblanceolados (espatulados), con numerosas puntuaciones pequeñas y más o menos conspicuas, glabros; filamentos unidos por ca. 05 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 2-2.5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 1.5-2 mm de longitud, pelos glandulosos presentes o a veces ausentes; anteras cordadas cuando jóvenes, luego globosas, 0.2-0.3 mm de diámetro; ovario tomentoso, estilo tomentoso, estigma lobulado. Fruto estipitado, estípite de 0.4-1.5 cm de largo, el fruto 2-3 cm de largo, 0.3-2 cm de ancho, glabro exteriormente, pubérulo interiormente, cáliz en el fruto inconspicuo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Bejuco alto, lenticelas presentes, levemente verrucosas, ramas jóvenes marrón-pubérulas. Hojas (2-)3-folioladas; pulvínulo cilindrico, rugoso, glabro, 0.5-0.8 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, glabro, 2.5-5 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, glabro, 1.5 cm de largo u ocasionalmente reducido y la hoja aparece bifoliolada. Foliolos 8-12.5 cm de largo, 5-6.5 cm de ancho, elípticos o levemente obovados, cartáceos, glabros por la haz, glabros en el envés excepto la nervadura central que es pubérula con los pelos adpresos, base redondeada o angostada, ápice abrupto y cortamente agudo, margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, hasta 0.5 cm de largo; venación re-ticulada u oscuramente transversal hacia la base de la lámina, nervadura central prominente en el envés, promínula en la haz; nervaduras laterales 5 pares, no claramente anastomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas en el envés y en la haz; nervaduras terciarias promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz. Flores desconocidas. Infrutescencias axilares, hasta 9 cm de largo, ferrugíneo-pubérulas o glabras. Fruto estipitado, estípite engrosado hasta de 0.7 cm de largo, fruto de 3 cm de largo, 1.7 cm de ancho, glabro exteriormente, ferrugíneo-tomentoso interiormente. Semilla 2 cm de largo, 1.2 cm de ancho, ariloide 1.3 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Hábito desconocido. Lenticelas presentes, pequeñas, ramas jóvenes ferrugíneo-tomentosas. Hojas imparipinadas; foliólos (l-)5, pulvínulo cilindrico, rugoso, tomentoso cuando joven, más tarde pubérulo, hasta 0.5 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, estriado, glabro, 2-7.5 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, estriado, pubérulo a glabrescente, 2-8 cm de largo. Foliolos 8-15(-17) cm de largo, 3.5-6.5 cm de ancho, elípticos u ovado-elípticos, cartáceos, haz opaca, glabra, envés opaco, oscuro, glabro, base redondeada o angostada, ápice acuminado (acumen hasta 1.5 cm de largo), margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, 0.4 cm de largo; venación claramente transversal en la mitad proximal del folíolo, el resto obsoleto, nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 6-7 pares, formando ángulos de 45° con la nervadura central, no anastomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias planas y densamente reticuladas en ambas caras. Inflorescencia subracemosa, axilar o pseudoterminal; raquila 3 cm de largo, pubérula. Flores desconocidas. Frutos sésiles, con estípite de 0.3 cm de largo, el fruto 2.2 cm de largo, 1.5 cm de ancho, tomentoso en la base, el resto glabrescente exteriormente, glabro interiormente.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbol de 7 m, lenticelas verrucosas, ramas jóvenes pubérulas. Hojas trifolio-ladas; raquis delgado, adpreso-pubérulo o glabrescente, 5-6.5 cm de largo. Foliolos 5.5-13.5 cm de largo, 3-5.5 cm de ancho, oblongos u oblongo-obovados, cartá-ceos, haz brillante, glabra, envés adpreso pubérulo, verrucoso, base cuneada o angostada, ápice abrupto y cortamente acuminado, acumen emarginado; venación transversal, tenue; nervaduras laterales 6-7 pares, ascendentes, anastomosadas cerca al margen. Inflorescencia paniculada, terminal o axilar; raquila diminutamente tomentosa; sépalos 3 mm de largo, 1.5 mm de ancho, con puntuaciones, esparcidamente vellosos exteriormente, glabros interiormente, ápice obtuso; pétalos 5 mm de largo, 2 mm de ancho, ápice obtuso, con puntuaciones, esparcidamente tomentosos exteriormente, con pelos glandulosos interiormente y en el margen; filamentos densamente cubiertos por pelos glandulosos. Fruto desconocido.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Escándeme, lenticelas presentes, inconspicuas, ramas jóvenes glabrescentes. Hojas trifolioladas, pulvínulo cilindrico, glabro, hasta 0.5 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, delgado, estriado, glabro, (2-)6-7 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, delgado, glabro, estriado, 0.5-1 cm de largo. Folíolos (3-)6.5-8(-11) cm de largo, (1.4-)3.1-5.3 cm de ancho, oblongos u oblongo-elípticos, haz oscura, brillante, glabra, envés claro, opaco, glabro, base redondeada, ápice acuminado (acumen 0.5 cm), margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, delgado, rugoso, hasta 0.7 cm de largo; venación transversal muy oscura, nervadura central promínula en el envés, plana en la haz; nervaduras laterales 6-9 pares, formando ángulos de 70° con la nervadura central, irregularmente anastomosadas cerca al margen, levemente promínulas o planas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias obsoletas en ambas caras. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar o pseudoterminal; raquila hasta de 12 cm de largo, pubérula, a veces blanquecina o grisácea. Pedicelo pubérulo, 0.5 mm de largo; sépalos 1.5-2.2 mm de largo, 0.6-1 mm de ancho, oblanceolados, con puntuaciones inconspicuas, densamente blanquecino-pubérulos exteriormente, pubérulos interiormente, ápice agudo, margen ciliado; pétalos 3-4 mm de largo, 1 mm de ancho, unidos en la parte media, espatulados, con punctuaciones conspicuas, glabros; filamentos unidos por ca. 0.5 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 1.5-2.5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 0.8-1.5 mm de longitud; anteras elongadas, 0.3 mm de diámetro; ovario tomentoso, estigma tomentoso. Fruto estipitado, estípite 0.1 cm de largo, el fruto 1.2 cm de largo, 0.8 cm de ancho, pubérulo o glabrescente exteriormente, pubérulo interiormente, cáliz inconspicuo en el fruto. Semilla inmadura 1.8 mm de largo, 1 mm ancho, ariloide 0.5 mm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Escandente(?), lenticelas conspicuas, alargadas, ramas jóvenes pubérulas. Hojas imparipinadas; folíolos (1-)3, pulvínulo cilindrico, rugoso, glabro, hasta 0.7 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico estriado, glabro, 3-9(-11) cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, liso, glabro, 1-3 cm de largo. Folíolos 7-14 cm de largo, 3.7-8 cm de ancho, elípticos, cartáceos a subcoriáceos, haz opaca, clara, glabra, envés algo brillante, oscuro, glabro, base redondeada, ápice acuminado (acumen hasta 0.7 cm de largo), margen revoluto; peciólulo cilindrico, 0.2-0.6 cm de largo; venación transversal, nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 6-8 pares, formando ángulos de 45° con la nervadura central, parcialmente anas-tomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias levemente promínulas en el envés, planas o muy levemente promínulas en la haz. Inflorescencia paniculada, axilar o pseudoterminal; raquila hasta 14 cm de largo, pubérula, las ramas más cortas ferrugíneo-tomentosas. Pedicelo pubé-rulo, 0.3 cm de largo; sépalos 2 mm de largo, 0.7 mm de ancho (hasta 1 mm ocasionalmente), con puntuaciones conspicuas, pubérulos exterior e interiormente, ápice agudo; pétalos 2.5-3 mm de largo, 0.5-0.7 mm de ancho, angosto-elípticos, con puntuaciones conspicuas, pubérulos y con pelos glandulosos exte-riormente, glabros interiormente; filamentos unidos por 0.3 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 1 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 0.7 mm de longitud, glabros; anteras globosas, 0.2 mm de diámetro; ovario tomentoso, estilo tomentoso con pelos glandulosos. Fruto estipitado, estípite 0.2-0.3 cm de largo, el fruto 2 cm de largo, 1.5 cm de ancho, pubérulo al menos en el estípite, el resto glabrescente o glabro exteriormente, pubérulo interiormente, cáliz en el fruto presente, reflejo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbusto, hasta 2 m, lenticelas presentes, pequeñas, conspicuas, levemente ve-rrucosas, ramas jóvenes glabras. Hojas imparipinadas, (1-)3(-5) folioladas, pul-vínulo cilindrico, rugoso o Asurado, glabro, hasta 0.5 cm de largo; pecíolo cilíndrico, estriado, glabro, 2.4-6.5 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, estriado, glabro, 14 cm de largo. Foliolos 5-16 cm de largo, 2-5.5 cm de ancho, angosto-elípticos, cartáceos, haz opaca, oscura, más o menos verrucosa, glabra, envés claro, opaco, marcadamente verrucoso, las verrugas por lo general visibles a simple vista, glabro, o con poquísimos pelos esparcidos sobre la nervadura central y hacia la base de la lámina, base angostado-cuneada, ápice suavemente acuminado (acumen hasta 0.5-0.7 cm de largo), margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, rugoso, hasta 0.5 cm de largo; venación reticulada, levemente transversal hacia la base del folíolo, nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 6-9 pares, formando ángulos de 45° con la nervadura central, irregularmente anastomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias levemente promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz. Inflorescencia paniculada, laxa, axilar o pseudoterminal; raquila 4-9 cm de largo, esparcidamente pubérula y con las ramas más cortas más densamente ferrugíneo-pubérulas. Pedicelo pubérulo, 0.5-0.7 cm de largo; sépalos variables en forma y tamaño en la misma flor, 2.5-2.8 mm de largo, 0.6-1.7 mm de ancho, ovados y angosto-ovados, con puntos numerosos, pubérulos exteriormente, glabros interiormente, ápice agudo; pétalos 4.5-5.5 mm de largo, 1.5-1.7 mm de ancho, débilmente unidos en la parte media, espatulados (oblongos), con puntos numerosos, más o menos conspicuos, pubérulos exteriormente, glabros interiormente; filamentos muy cortamente unidos en la base, 5 más largos 1.2-1,5(-1.7) mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 1-1.2 mm de longitud, con pocos pelos glandulosos hacia el ápice; anteras globosas, con pelos glandulosos en el ápice, 0.3-0.5 mm de diámetro; ovario tomentoso, estilo tomentoso y con pelos glandulosos. Fruto estipitado, estípite 0.3-0.5 cm de largo, el fruto 2.5 cm de largo, 1.4 cm de ancho, glabro y verrucoso exteriormente, con pelos glandulosos interiormente, cáliz en el fruto presente. Semilla 1.5 cm de largo, 0.9 cm de ancho, ariloide hasta 1 cm de largo.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Pecíolo 2-9 cm de largo, raquis 1-3 cm de largo. Folíolos 5.5-12(-l6) cm de largo, 2-4(-6.5) cm de ancho, angosto-elípticos a oblanceolados, subcoriáceos, base generalmente cuneada, ápice acuminado, acumen hasta 2 cm de largo; venación transversal, obsoleta en la haz. Pétalos 4-5 mm de largo, 1.8 mm de ancho, glabros; filamentos unidos por 1 mm de su longitud, pelos glandulosos presentes.
bibliographicCitation: Forero, Enrique. 1983. Connaraceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 36: 1-208.

description: Arbusto o bejuco hasta de 3 m, lenticelas presentes, verrucosas. Hojas trifolioladas, pulvínulo subcilíndrico, rugoso, glabro, 0.2-0.5 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, levemente estriado, glabro, 2-5.5 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, levemente estriado, glabro, 0.7-3 cm de largo. Foliolos 5-13 cm de largo, 1.5-3.5 cm de ancho, angosto-elípticos, cartáceos, haz brillante, glabra, envés opaco, glabro, base cuneada en el folíolo terminal, subcuneada u obtusa en los laterales, ápice suavemente acuminado, margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, rugoso. 0.2-0.5 cm de largo; venación reticulada, nervadura central promínula a prominente en el envés, plana en la haz; nervaduras laterales 5-7 pares, anastomosadas cerca al margen, levemente promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias ligeramente promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz. Inflorescencia en panícula racemosa, axilar; raquila 15-25 cm de largo, delgada, marrón-tomentosa; brácteas y bracteolas 0.5 cm de longitud. Pedicelo tomentoso, 0.2 cm de largo; sépalos (en botón) ovados, con puntuaciones conspicuas, tomentosos externa e internamente, ápice agudo; pétalos (en botón) con puntuaciones conspicuas, glabros; filamentos unidos, sin pelos glandulosos, glabros; anteras globosas; ovario velloso. Fruto estipitado, estípite 0.5-0.7 cm de largo, el fruto 2.5-3.5 cm de largo, 1.7-2 cm de ancho, pubérulo exteriormente, más o menos densamente tomentoso interiormente, cáliz en el fruto presente, pubérulo. Semilla 1.6 cm de largo, 0.7 cm de ancho, ariloide 0.4 cm de largo.

description: Hábito desconocido. Hojas imparipinadas; foliolos 5-7; pecíolo cilindrico, estriado, glabro, hasta de 6 cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, estriado, glabro, 5-7 cm de largo. Foliolos 4-10.5 cm de largo, 2-4 cm de ancho, oblongos, cartáceos, haz opaca, glabra, envés opaco, verrucoso, glabro, base redondeada, subpeltada, ápice obtuso, margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, rugoso, 0.5 cm de largo; venación oscuramente transversal en la mitad proximal del foliolo, el resto reticulado, nervadura central prominente en el envés, levemente impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales 5-7 pares, formando ángulos de 45° con la nervadura central, no anastomosadas cerca al margen, promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias planas en ambas caras. Inflorescencia paniculada, pseudoter-minal; raquila ca. 6 cm de largo, pubérula, grisosa. Pedicelo densamente tomentoso, 0.6 cm de largo; sépalos 3 mm de largo, 1.5 mm de ancho, ovados u oblongos, con puntuaciones pequeñas, inconspicuas, tomentosos exteriormente, pubérulos interiormente, ápice agudo u obtuso; pétalos 6 mm de longitud, 1.3 mm de ancho, unidos en su parte media, espatulados, con puntuaciones inconspicuas, pubérulos y con pelos glandulosos exteriormente, con pelos glandulosos interiormente; filamentos unidos por 0.6 mm de su longitud, 5 más largos 4.5 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos ca. 2 mm de longitud, con pelos glandulosos; anteras globosas, 0.5 mm de diámetro; ovario tomentoso, estilo cubierto por pelos glandulosos muy desarrollados. Fruto estipitado, estípite 0.4 cm de largo, el fruto 3.5 cm de largo, 2 cm de ancho, glabro exteriormente, pubérulo interiormente. Semilla 2.5 cm de largo, 1.5 cm de ancho.

description: Bejuco o arbusto escandente, lenticelas presentes, ramas jóvenes pubérulas. Hojas imparipinadas; foliólos (3-)5(-7), pulvínulo cilindrico, rugoso o Asurado, glabro, 0.5 cm de largo; pecíolo cilindrico, levemente estriado, glabro, 2-6.5(-11) cm de largo; raquis cilindrico, glabro, 1.5-8.5 cm de largo. Foliolos 4-15(-17) cm de largo, 2-7.5 cm de ancho, elípticos, cartáceos, por lo general el terminal es mayor que los demás, subconcoloros, glabros, base obtusa, ápice abruptamente acuminado (acumen 0.5-1 cm de largo), margen entero; peciólulo cilindrico, pubérulo, 0.2-0.5 cm de largo; venación reticulada, nervadura central prominente en el envés, impresa en la haz; nervaduras laterales ca. 7 pares, formando ángulos de 80° con la nervadura central, anastomosadas más o menos claramente cerca al margen, levemente promínulas en el envés, planas en la haz; nervaduras terciarias obsoletas en ambas caras. Inflorescencia en panícula racemosa, ramas delgadas; raquila 3-45 cm de largo, densamente marrón o ferrugíneo-pubérula. Pedicelo densamente pubérulo, 0.3-0.5 cm de largo; sépalos 3 mm de largo, 11.3 mm de ancho, oblongo-ovados, con puntuaciones inconspicuas, tomentosos exterior e interiormente, ápice obtuso; pétalos blancos, 4.5 mm de largo, 1.2 mm de ancho, oblongos (angosto-elípticos), con puntuaciones pequeñas, inconspicuas, glabros; filamentos unidos, 5 más largos 1.8-3 mm de longitud, 5 más cortos 1.52 mm de longitud, con pelos glandulosos; anteras lanceoladas, conectivo cubierto por pelos glandulosos, ca. 0.2 mm de diámetro; ovario densamente pubérulo, estilo pubérulo con pelos glandulosos cerca del ápice, estigma bilobulado. Fruto estipitado, estípite 0.5 cm de largo, el fruto 2.2 cm de largo, 1.3-1.5 cm de ancho, pubérulo exterior e interiormente, cáliz presente en el fruto. Semilla 1.2 cm de largo, 0.7 cm de ancho, ariloide 0.5-0.8 cm de largo.

description: Emergent or canopy palms. Stem solitary (rarely cespitose), stout, erect, cylindrical; stilt roots prominent, few. Leaves few, imparipinnate; sheath forming a compact crownshaft; petiole short; rachis long; pinnae numerous, entire or divided into few segments. Inflorescence protogynous, interfoliar in bud, infrafoliar and erect at pistillate anthesis, becoming pendulous at staminate anthesis; peduncular bracts few; triads spirally arranged; flowers trimerous; staminate flowers asymmetrical, with (17-)30-145 stamens; pollen sulcate or trichotomosulcate, with intectate, scabrate or reticulate exine, with or without spines; pistillate flowers symmetrical, lacking staminodes, gynoecium tricarpellate, triovulate, ovule orthotropous; fruit ovoid-elliptic, rostrate or erostrate, with apical stigmatic scar; seed with apical or slightly sub-apical embryo; eophyll bifid.

description: Stem to 20 m tall, 15-30 cm in diam. at base, 13-18 cm in diam. at apex, gray, smooth; stilt roots ca. 20, diagonal, terete, forming a cone 12 m long, 2 m x 6 cm, black, spiny. Leaves to seven, spreading; sheaths forming a crownshaft, 1.5-2.8 m long, gray-green, densely covered with deciduous tomentum; petiole terete, 30-55 x 2.2-3.2 cm, gray, densely covered with strongly appressed, gray trichomes; rachis ridged adaxially, rounded abaxially, 2-4 m long, densely brown-tomentose adaxially, abaxially with similar trichomes to those of petiole; pinnae 21-25 per side of rachis, alternate to sub-opposite, asymmetrically cuneate, to 90 cm long and 20 cm wide at mid-point, the margins entire except for praemorse apex, green and glabrous adaxially, densely brown-tomentose and brown abaxially especially on veins, with lines below up to 3 mm wide of dense white tomentum parallel to veins; pinnae split to the base into segments, the proximal ones of a pinna erect and stiff and pointing upwards, the distal one stiff and pointing down, others intermediate, appearing from a distance in four planes; proximal pinna to 35 cm long and 4 cm wide at mid-point; middle pinnae split into as many as six segments, the proximal one up to 90 cm long and 7 cm wide at mid-point, the distal one up to 70 cm long and 3 cm wide at midpoint, the middle ones intermediate; apical pinna entire, flabellate, deeply notched, up to 20 cm long and 8 cm wide at mid-point; veins yellow, prominent abaxially. Inflorescence to 90 cm long; peduncle dorsiventrally compressed, up to 41 cm long, 4-5 cm in diam., densely covered with caducous, long, loose, intertwined, white trichomes; prophyll erect, persistent, tubular, bicarinate, splitting apically, to 20 cm long; peduncular bracts three, inserted 2-3 cm apart, the first to 35 cm long and similar to the prophyll, the second and third oval in cross-section, to 75 cm long, with a ca. 5 cm acute, non-splitting apex, splitting abaxially longitudinally, with several incomplete or vestigial bracts above; prophyll and peduncular bracts coriaceous, densely tomentose at first on outside; rachis to 28 cm long, with similar trichomes to peduncle; rachillae 7-12, spirally arranged, pendulous, terete, up to 80 cm long, 7-8 mm in diam. at mid-point at anthesis (dry), 9-12 mm in diam. at mid-point in fruit (dry), subtended by a low bract, not densely wrinkled between scars when dry, with similar trichomes to those of peduncle; triads spirally arranged, surrounded by a low bract; flowers proximally in triads, for distal ca. 5 cm staminate in pairs or solitary, cream colored; sta-minate flowers to 2 cm long, very shortly pedicellate especially on distal parts of rachillae; sepals spreading, ovate, 4 mm long, 3 mm wide at base; petals valvate, triangular but irregularly shaped, fleshy, 12-17 mm long, 13-15 mm wide at base, stamens (77-)120(-145) (more numerous in proximal flowers, less in distal); filaments 1-2 mm long; anthers basifixed, latrorse, 6-7 mm long; pistillode minute or absent; pollen with scabrate, non-spiny exine; pistillate flowers 10 mm long; sepals imbricate, ciliate, blunt at apex, 8 x 1.0-1.3 mm; petals imbricate, similar to sepals; ovary 10 mm long, trilocular; stigmas sessile, recurved at anthesis, 1 mm long; fruit ellipsoid, rostrate, 4-5 x 2-2.5 cm, the stigmatic scar apical; epicarp yellowish-green, splitting irregularly from apex at maturity; mesocarp 1 mm diam.; endocarp very thin; seed obovate, often misshapen, basally attached, 3-5 x 2 cm; raphe anastomosing; hilum rounded; embryo apical.

description: Plants slender, in loose tufts, light green. Stems erect, to 4 cm high, densely reddish tomentose, equally foliate giving the plants a filiform appearance. Leaves appressed to the stem when dry, erect patent when wet, 5 mm long, lanceolate, concave, with canaliculate tips, serrate at tips. Costa filling 2/3 of the leaf width, excurrent, in transverse section with ventral hyalocysts and a ventral band of stereids, ridged at back. Alar cells hyaline or brownish, thin-walled. Basal laminal cells rectangular, incrassate, 6-16 × 2654 µm, narrower at margins. Upper laminal cells small, subquadrate, incrassate, 6-10 × 10-16 µm. Sporophyte not known.
bibliographicCitation: Frahm, Jan-Peter. 1991. Dicranaceae: Campylopodioideae, Paraleucobryoideae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 54: 1-238.

description: Terrestrial shrubs, prostrate and decumbent, often forming dense cushions, or erect, 0.1–1 m tall. Young branchlets ridged, ± smooth, pubescent or puberulous, the hairs eglandular, light brown, the indumentum of the mature branches similar but glabrate or puberulous. Leaves 9–12 per cm, spirally arranged, ascending; petiole 0.6–2 mm long, glabrate, the hairs eglandular; lamina elliptic or lanceolate, 0.4–1.4 × (0.1–)0.2–0.6 cm, basally attenuate or less often cuneate, marginally crenulate, apically ciliolate with eglandular hairs, apically acute or blunt-acute, adaxially glabrous or glabrate with eglandular hairs over midvein (especially in young leaves), abaxially glabrate with minute and deciduous glandular hairs, the venation obscure or hyphodromous on both sides, the midvein adaxially impressed and abaxially raised. Axillary solitary flowers and very rarely 2–3-flowered cymes; bracts 6–11, chartaceous, ovate or transverse-elliptic, 0.4–2.2 × 0.6–3.2 mm, marginally eciliate, apically obtuse, abaxially glabrous; pedicel 1.2–2.5 mm long, reduced and hidden by overlapping bracts or rarely with a portion not completely obscured, glabrous or glabrate with eglandular or glandular hairs; differentiated apical bracteoles 2, distinct, chartaceous, enveloping entire calyx tube or to part of calyx lobes, covering 36–80% of calyx, ovate, elliptic, or transverse-elliptic, 2–4.3 × 3–5.2 mm, rarely marginally ciliolate with eglandular hairs, apically obtuse, the surface softly longitudinally striate (rarely smooth in few herbarium specimens), abaxially and adaxially glabrous. Flowers 4-merous (one flower seen with a 5-merous corolla). Calyx aestivation valvate, campanulate, (4–)4.5–5.5 mm long; tube angled, (1–)1.5–2.5 mm long, abaxially glabrate with glandular hairs; limb (2.8–)3–3.5 mm long, abaxially glabrate, with eglandular or glandular hairs, adaxially glabrous; lobes triangular, (2–)2.3–3 × (1.5–) 1.9–2.7 mm, rarely marginally ciliolate with eglandular hairs, apically acute; sinuses acute (V-shaped). Corolla light green, often suffused with brick red distally or rarely completely brick red, thick-fleshy, bistratose, campanulate, (5.2–)6.7–10(–10.5) mm long, 6.5–9.5 mm diam., 6.5–9.5 mm wide at throat, abaxially glabrate with glandular hairs, adaxially glabrous; lobes (1.4–)2–3 × 2–4 mm, apically acute, adaxially rugose. Stamens 8 (10 in the 5-merous corolla), (4.7–) 5.3–7.5 mm long, included (the tips exerted in few herbarium specimens); filaments distinct, straight or rarely geniculate, broader at base, (2.8–)3.5–5 mm long, abaxially and adaxially glabrate or puberulous; anthers distinct, papillae on both thecae and tubules; thecae, (1.4–)1.6–2.1 mm long, without basal appendages; tubules 2, distinct, 1.3–2.1 mm long, dehiscing apically by oblique pores, 0.4–0.7 mm long. Ovary 4-locular; style (5.5–)6–7.7 mm long, included (exserted in few herbarium specimens). Berry white, ± spherical, 7.5–10 mm diam., the persistent calyx lobes erect or spreading, becoming succulent (at least at base), same color as mature berry; embryo white.

description: Tree, 5-9 m tall, 6-10 cm in diam. Young twigs and petioles totally covered with yellow to brown, stellate hairs 0.3-0.8 mm in diam. Petioles 1-2 mm long, 1-1.5 mm in diam. Lamina narrowly elliptic to narrowly ovate, 8-18 cm long, 2^L5 cm wide, leaf index 3.9-4.8, chartaceous, grey-green to blackish above, brown below, glabrous above, rather densely covered with yellow, stellate hairs 0.2-0.8 mm in diam. below, base obtuse, rounded, or subcordate, oblique, apex acute to acuminate (acumen to 30 mm long), primary vein impressed above, secondary veins curved, 10-14 on either side of primary vein, flat to slightly raised above, angles with primary vein 65-75°, loop-forming at obtuse angles, loops distinct, smallest distance between loops and margin 2-6 mm, tertiary veins raised above. Inflorescences among leaves, supra-axillary (or leaf-opposed), l(-2)-flowered, to 5 flowers in succession. Indument: peduncles, pedicels, outer side of bracts, and both sides of sepals and petals totally to densely covered with stellate hairs 0.1-0.8 mm in diam., inner base of inner petals glabrous. Peduncle 0-2 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam., fruiting peduncle to 3 mm long, and 2.5 mm in diam. Sympodial rachis to 2 mm long. Pedicels 2-3 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam., fruiting pedicels to 6 mm long, and to 3 mm in diam. Upper bract at 2/3 of base of pedicel, broadly ovate-triangular, 7-9 mm long. Flower buds very broadly ovoid, distinctly apiculate. Flowers white to yellow in vivo. Sepals free, broadly ovate-triangular, 7-10 mm long and wide, acute. Petals subequal, elliptic, 16-18 mm long, 10-11 mm wide, acute, inner base of inner petals not callose. Stamens 2-2.5 mm long, color unknown, apex of connective discoid, 0.3-0.4 x 0.6-0.7 mm, densely covered with simple and stellate hairs to 0.1 mm in diam. Carpels 2.5-3 mm long, ovary densely covered with stellate hairs, stigma subglabrous. Fruit very pale yellow when ripe in vivo, globose, 2.5 cm in diam., basal collar composed of 8 connate, almost completely reduced, sterile carpels, 7-8 mm in diam., slightly protruding below the fruit, fertile carpels ca. 60, broadly ovoid, 5-9 mm long, 4-9 mm in diam., free, areoles very shallowly pyramidal, 1-2 mm high, obtuse, rough, densely covered with whitish, stellate hairs 0.1-0.2 mm in diam. Seeds broadly obovoid, 8 mm long, 7 mm in diam., obtuse, pale brown.

description: Treelet or small tree. Branchlets spreading, slender, virgate, glabrous, olivaceous-yellowish, striate and more or less distinctly transversely wrinkled in the dry state as are petioles. Leaves ovate to ovate-elliptic, apex acuminate, tip acute or almost mucronulate, base attenuate to the petiole, obtuse or rounded, membranaceous to subcoriaceous and finely rugulose on both surfaces, glabrous except the sparsely hairy petiole, slightly shiny, becoming brownish-yellowish and brittle when dried, not wax-coated, thinly marginate, (2-)3.5-5.5(-8) x (1.2-)1.5-3 (-4.5) cm, midrib and ca. 4 pairs of lateral nerves slightly raised on both surfaces as is the very dense and fine reticulation in dry specimens; petiole (2-)3-6 mm long. Racemes simple or laxly composed, (2-)4-6(-10)-flowered, glabrous in all outer parts, 1-1.5(-2, -5) cm long; bracteoles ligular, short, caducous; pedicels 2-4(-6) mm long, gradually thickened distally to the cup-shaped undulately rimmed membranaceous short calyx. Petals linear-lanceolate, slightly connate in the lower 1/3, whitish to yellow, (5-)7(-10) x 1-1.5 mm. Stamens 5-6 mm long; filaments sparsely to densely hairy. Staminodia sparsely hairy below. Free part of ovary depressedly conical, abrupt with the style, shortly gray-pubescent; style glabrous, 5-6 mm long equaling or slightly exceeding the apex of the anthers in the doli-chostylous, ca. 3 mm long and hardly reaching the base of the anthers in the brachystylous form. Drupe ellipsoid or slightly obovoid, glabrous, the free umbonate apex short-hairy, (1.5-)2 x (1-) 1.3 cm; pericarp fleshy, color unknown; endocarp hard, ca. 0.5 mm thick; seed ellipsoid, ca. 1.5 x 1 cm.

description: Trees to 12 m. Branchlets slender to stout, midway along flush 3-6 mm diam., terete, densely pubescent, the surface barely visible to concealed by the indument cover, the hairs relatively long, to 0.6 mm, crooked, sprawling, greyish white; terminal buds plump, 5 × 3 mm, densely pubescent, the hairs straight, appressed to ascending, white. Leaves closely spiraled at tips of current flush; petioles robust, to 3 × 0.4 cm, semi-terete, the indument as on branchlets; laminae chartaceous, plane, broadly elliptic, 15-30 × 5-11 cm, the base obtuse to acute, the apex acute, acuminate for up to 2 cm, the margins minutely recurved throughout; upper surface light greyish green to olive-brown, minutely punctulate, the midrib prominent, the secondaries prominulous, the higher-order venation immersed, inconspicuous against the lamina; lower surface sparsely pubescent, the hairs 0.6 mm long, sprawling to weakly ascending, greyish white, denser on main veins, all vein orders raised, their prominence decreasing with rank; secondary veins 9-11 per side, ± evenly spaced, slightly more distant around midlamina, ascending at 50-60° (more obtusely around midlamina), arcuate to arching after midcourse, distal pairs loop-connected; tertiaries oblique to midrib, between secondaries straight to arched. Staminate inflorescences distally clustered in the axils of cataphylls, to 35 cm long with 10 lateral branches, branch orders 3-4, the highest order botryoid, or irregular, the flowers loosely crowded, the axes moderately grey-tomentose, the indument thinning distally, lost by third-order branches; bracts and bracteoles persistent at anthesis, lanceolate, the indument as on axes; pedicels terete, to 2 mm long, those supporting secondary flowers slightly shorter. Flowers campanulate, 2 mm diam., glabrous outside; receptacle cyathiform, 0.6 × 0.6 mm, glabrous inside. Tepals chartaceous, ligulate, 1.3 × 0.6 mm, spreading to recurved at anthesis, the inner surface glabrous, the margins minutely papillose near apex. Stamens of whorls I and II stipitate, 0.6 mm tall, the anthers transversely oblong, 0.3 × 0.4 mm, glabrous, the apex truncate or emarginate, the connectives level with or reduced between the 2 locelli, these suborbicular, introrse, the filaments laminar, much narrower than anthers, sparsely grey-villose; whorl III stamens stipitate, 0.6 mm tall, the anthers equal to outer whorls, erect, locelli 2, extrorse-latrorse, the filaments narrower than anthers, laminar, sparsely grey-villose, the basal glands sessile, globose; whorl IV wanting; pistillode filiform. Pistillate inflorescence with indument, color, and branching as in staminate plants, the flowers slightly deeper; stamens sterile, smaller; ovary glabrous, ovoid; style slender, distinct from ovary; stigma broadly tri-lobed, reniform, 0.6 mm diam. Fruits borne on terete pedicels of up to 6 × 4 mm; cupules hemispherical, to 0.5 × 1.3 cm, glabrous inside and outside, the margins entire; drupes ellipsoid, to 2 × 1 cm.

description: Trees to 5 m. Branchlets usually stout, midway along flush (3-)5-8 mm diam., terete, densely tomentose, the surface concealed by the indument cover, the hairs relatively short, to 0.2 mm, erect, rust brown to dark red; terminal buds plump, 1 × 0.6 mm, rusty tomentose, the hairs as on branchlets, erect, crisped to crooked. Leaves closely spiraled at tips of current flush; petioles robust, to 3 × 0.4 cm, semi-terete, the indument as on branchlets; laminae stiff chartaceous, plane to subbullate, obovate to elliptic, 10-27 × 3-10 cm, the base acute to obtuse, the apex acute, acuminate for up to 2 cm, the margins minutely recurved throughout; upper surface olive to reddish brown, waxy, the midrib and secondaries prominulous, the higher-order veins immersed; lower surface sparsely pubescent, the hairs on the upper surface of the midrib and secondaries crooked to crisped, dark red, soon falling, those on the sides of the main veins and lamina light brown to translucent, 0.2 mm long, straight, erect, persistent, denser on main veins, all vein orders raised, their prominence decreasing with rank; secondary veins 8-11 per side, ± evenly spaced, slightly more distant around midlamina, patent, diverging at 70-85° (more acutely towards apex), arching after midcourse, distal pairs loop-connected; tertiaries oblique to midrib, between secondaries once-forked to straight. Staminate inflorescences distally clustered in the axils of cataphylls, to 25 cm long with 12 lateral branches, branch orders 2-4, the highest order botryoid, lax, the flowers distant, the axes rusty tomentose, the indument moderately dense, thinning distally; bracts and bracteoles persistent at anthesis, lanceolate, the indument as on axes; pedicels slender, terete, to 1 mm long, reduced to lacking below secondary flowers. Flowers campanulate, to 1.5 mm diam., sparsely pubescent outside; receptacle cyathiform, 0.7 × 0.6 mm, slightly constricted below tepals, glabrous inside. Tepals membranaceous, ovate, 0.6 × 0.5 mm, spreading to recurved at anthesis, the inner surface glabrous except for sparsely papillose tips and distal margins. Stamens of whorls I and II stipitate, 0.5 mm tall, the anthers transversely oblong, 0.25 × 0.3 mm, glabrous, the apex truncate to emarginate, the connectives level with or reduced between the 2 locelli, these suborbicular, introrse, the filaments laminar, narrower than anthers, glabrous; whorl III stamens stipitate, 0.5 mm tall, the anthers depressed-oblong, 0.2 × 0.3 mm, bowed towards the outer whorls, locelli 2, extrorse-latrorse, the filaments narrower than anthers, laminar, silvery strigose on the adaxial side, the basal glands stipitate, globose, relatively large, filling the space between filaments of outer and inner whorls; whorl IV wanting; pistillode fusiform. Pistillate inflorescence with indument and color as in staminate plants, but shorter and with fewer lateral branches, the flowers similar in size and shape; stamens sterile, smaller; ovary ellipsoid, glabrous; style slender, distinct from ovary, 0.3 mm long; stigma tri-lobed, papillose, 0.25 mm diam. Fruits borne on short terete pedicels of up to 2 mm, rarely claviform and 1 cm long; cupules hemispherical, to 0.6 × 1 cm, glabrous inside and outside, the margins entire; drupes ovoid, to 1 × 0.8 cm.

description: Trees, 4-25 m. Branchlets slender, midway along flush 3-4 mm diam., angular, densely golden to reddish sericeous, the surface concealed by the indument cover, the hairs short, to 0.2 mm, straight, appressed; terminal buds plump, 3 × 3 mm, the indument as on branchlets. Leaves alternate, widely and evenly spaced along current flush; petioles slender, to 1.5 × 0.2 cm, semi-terete, striate above, the indument as on branchlets; laminae chartaceous to coriaceous, plane, ovate to lanceolate, 9-28 × 3-10 cm, the base obtuse to acute, briefly decurrent, the apex acute, acuminate for up to 2 cm, the margins minutely recurved throughout; upper surface dull greyish green to olive-brown, waxy, shining, the primary to fourth-order veins raised, their prominence decreasing with rank; lower surface densely sericeous, the hairs as on branchlets, uniformly distributed, all vein orders raised, their prominence decreasing with rank; secondary veins 4-5 per side, ± evenly spaced, slightly more distant around midlamina, ascending at 50-60° (more obtuse around midlamina), arcuate, distal pairs loop-connected; tertiaries roughly horizontal, between secondaries straight to once-forked. Staminate inflorescences evenly spaced along current flush in the axils of foliage leaves, to 10 cm long with 10 lateral branches, branch orders 3-4, the highest order dichasial, lax, the flowers distant, the axes densely rusty sericeous; bracts and bracteoles caducous by anthesis, lanceolate, rusty sericeous; pedicels terete, to 1 mm long, those supporting secondary flowers slightly shorter. Stamens of whorls I and II broadly stipitate, ca. 0.6 mm tall, the anthers ovate, 0.4 × 0.3 mm (slightly narrower in whorl II), glabrous, the apex apiculate, the connectives prolonged between the 2 locelli, these obliquely hemispherical, introrse-latrorse, the filaments fleshy, slightly narrower than anthers, densely grey-tomentellose; whorl III stamens sessile, 0.6 mm tall, the anthers narrowly ovate to lanceolate, 0.3 × 0.15 mm, erect, locelli 2, narrow, slitlike, extrorse-latrorse, the filaments apically as broad as anthers, widening towards base, fleshy, densely grey-tomentellose, the basal glands sessile, laminar, apiculate; whorl IV wanting; pistillode wanting. Pistillate inflorescence with indument and color as in staminate plants, but shorter and with fewer lateral branches, the flowers slightly deeper; stamens sterile, smaller; ovary glabrous, ellipsoid; style stout, weakly distinguished from ovary, 0.2 mm long; stigma tri-lobed, 0.5 mm diam. Fruits unknown.

description: Trees to 40 m. Branchlets stout, midway along flush 5-6 mm diam., angular, densely tomentellose, the surface concealed by the indument cover, the hairs short, to 0.15 mm, straight, ascending, reddish brown; terminal buds plump, 5 × 4 mm, densely pubescent, the hairs as on branchlets. Leaves alternate, widely and evenly spaced along current flush; petioles robust, to 5 × 0.4 cm, semi-terete, striate, the indument as on branchlets; laminae coriaceous, plane, ovate to obovate, 15-30 × 5-15 cm, the base obtuse to acute, briefly decurrent, the apex acute to obtuse, acuminate for up to 2 cm, the margins minutely recurved throughout; upper surface greyish green to olive-brown, waxy, the primary to fourth-order veins raised, their prominence decreasing with rank; lower surface densely pubescent, the hairs appressed, concealing surface, rusty red to golden yellow, reduced on main veins, all vein orders raised, their prominence decreasing with rank; secondary veins 5-7 per side, ± evenly spaced, slightly more distant around midlamina, ascending at 50-60° (more obtuse around midlamina), arcuate, the lowermost pair sometimes asymmetric (one or both merging with margin at base), distal pairs loop-connected; tertiaries roughly horizontal, between secondaries forked. Staminate inflorescences distally clustered in the axils of cataphylls, or evenly spaced along current flush in the axils of foliage leaves or cataphylls, to 25 cm long with 30 lateral branches, branch orders 3-4, the highest order dichasial, lax, the flowers distant, the axes rusty tomentellose; bracts and bracteoles persistent or caducous by anthesis, triangular, the indument as on axes; pedicels terete, to 4 mm long, those supporting secondary flowers slightly shorter. Flowers campanulate, to 3 mm diam., rusty to greyish tomentellose outside; receptacle cyathiform, 2 × 2 mm, rusty pilose inside. Tepals chartaceous, ovate, 1 × 0.7 mm (the inner whorl slightly narrower), erect to ascending at anthesis, the outer surface rusty to greyish tomentellose-sericeous, this reduced to a basal triangular patch in the inner whorl, the inner surface glabrous. Stamens of whorls I and II stipitate, 1 mm tall, the anthers ovate, 0.5 × 0.5 mm, glabrous, the apex broadly apiculate, the connectives bluntly prolonged between the 2 locelli, these suborbiculate, introrse-latrorse, the filaments laminar, narrower than anthers, glabrous or basally grey-tomentose; whorl III stamens sessile, ca. 1 mm tall, the anthers depressed-oblong, 0.3 × 0.5 mm, erect, locelli 2, extrorse-latrorse, the filaments as broad as anthers, ligulate, glabrous or sparsely grey-tomentose near base, the basal glands sessile, globose; whorl IV wanting; pistillode well-developed or wanting. Pistillate inflorescence with indument and color as in staminate plants, but shorter and with fewer lateral branches, the flowers slightly deeper; stamens sterile, smaller or equaling those of staminate flowers; ovary glabrous; style slender, distinct from ovary; stigma weakly tri-lobed, 0.2 mm diam. Fruits borne on stout terete pedicels of up to 1 × 0.4 cm; cupules hemispherical, to 1.5 × 2.5 cm, glabrous outside, rusty sericeous inside, the margins entire; drupes ellipsoid, to 4.5 × 2.5 cm.

description: Trees to 6 m. Branchlets slender, midway along flush 2-3 mm diam., distally weakly angular, soon terete, densely tomentose, the surface barely visible, the hairs short, to 0.3 mm, straight to crooked, erect to ascending, greenish yellow; terminal buds slender, 3 × 1 mm, densely pubescent, the hairs as on branchlets, ascending. Leaves alternate, widely and evenly spaced along current flush; petioles slender, to 1 × 0.1 cm, terete, the indument as on branchlets; laminae membranaceous or chartaceous, plane, narrow elliptic, 6-10 × 1.5-3 cm, the base acute, briefly decurrent, the apex acute, acuminate for up to 1 cm, the margins minutely recurved throughout; upper surface greyish green to olive-brown, waxy, the primary to fourth-order veins raised, their prominence decreasing with rank; lower surface moderately tomentose, the hairs 0.3 mm long, crookedly erect; denser and forming barbellate tufts in the axils of the midrib and secondaries, all vein orders raised, their prominence decreasing with rank; secondary veins 4-6 per side, ± evenly spaced, slightly more distant around midlamina, ascending at 50-60° (more obtusely around midlamina), arcuate, distal pairs loop-connected; tertiaries laxly reticulating between secondaries. Staminate inflorescences evenly spaced along current flush in the axils of foliage leaves, to 5 cm long with 3 lateral branches, branch orders 2-3, the highest order dichasial, lax, the flowers distant, the axes sparsely grey-strigillose; bracts and bracteoles caducous by anthesis, lanceolate, the indument as on axes; pedicels terete, to 3 mm long, those supporting secondary flowers slightly shorter. Flowers hypocrateriform, 3.5 mm diam., sparsely grey-strigillose outside; receptacle infundibuliform, 1 × 1 mm, densely pubescent inside, the hairs silvery, straight, rigidly erect. Tepals chartaceous, ovate, 1.2 × 1 mm, spreading to recurved at anthesis, the inner surface sparsely silvery strigillose, the margins and apex inside minutely papillose. Stamens of whorls I and II broadly stipitate, 0.6 mm tall, the anthers broadly ovate, 0.3 × 0.5 mm, glabrous, the apex apiculate, the connectives prolonged between the 2 locelli, these obliquely hemispherical, introrse-latrorse, the filaments laminar, narrower than anthers, glabrous; whorl III stamens sessile, 0.6 mm tall, the anthers ovate, 0.3 × 0.5 mm, erect, locelli 2, extrorse-latrorse, the filaments broader than anthers, ligulate, glabrous, the basal glands sessile, relatively large, filling the space between filaments; whorl IV wanting; pistillode fusiform. Pistillate plants unknown.

description: Trees to 18 m. Branchlets slender, midway along flush 3-4 mm diam., angular, densely reddish brown tomentose, the surface concealed by the indument cover, the hairs relatively short, to 0.3 mm, straight, erect; terminal buds plump, 3 × 2 mm, densely pubescent, the hairs as on branchlets, ascending. Leaves alternate, widely and evenly spaced along current flush; petioles slender, to 1.5 × 0.15 cm, semi-terete, the indument as on branchlets; laminae chartaceous, plane, ovate, 8-15 × 3-7 cm, the base obtuse, the apex acute, acuminate for up to 1 cm, the margins minutely recurved throughout; upper surface rusty to yellowish green, sparsely rusty strigose, waxy, the midrib and secondaries immersed, the higher-order venation prominulous; lower surface sparsely rusty tomentose, the hairs as on branchlets, scattered on lamina, denser on main veins, all vein orders raised, their prominence decreasing with rank; secondary veins 4-6 per side, ± evenly spaced, slightly more distant around midlamina, ascending at 50-60° (more obtuse around midlamina), arcuate, distal pairs loop-connected; tertiaries roughly horizontal, between secondaries straight to forked. Staminate inflorescences evenly spaced along current flush in the axils of foliage leaves, to 7 cm long with 8 lateral branches, branch orders 3-4, the highest order essentially dichasial, but the internodes reduced and flowers arranged in pseudo-umbellate fascicles, the axes sparsely rusty tomentose; bracts and bracteoles caducous by anthesis, ovate, the indument as on axes; pedicels terete, to 2 mm long, those supporting secondary flowers slightly shorter. Flowers infundibuliform, 2.5 mm diam., sparsely rusty strigose outside; receptacle broadly infundibuliform, 0.5 × 1 mm, densely rusty pilose inside. Tepals chartaceous, ovate, 1 × 0.6 mm (the inner whorl slightly narrower), ascending at anthesis, the inner surface sparsely grey-tomentose, the margins and tips papillose. Stamens of whorls I and II stipitate, 0.4 mm tall, the anthers depressed-oblong, 0.3 × 0.4 mm, glabrous, the apex truncate to emarginate, the connectives level with or reduced between the 2 locelli, these suborbicular, introrse, the filaments laminar, narrower than anthers, sparsely rusty pilose; whorl III stamens sessile, 0.6 m tall, the anthers depressed-oblong, 0.3 × 0.4 mm, erect, locelli 2, extrorse-latrorse, the filaments broader than anthers, ligulate, sparsely rusty pilose near base, the basal glands sessile, globose, apiculate; whorl IV wanting; pistillode minute, filiform. Pistillate inflorescence with indument and color as in staminate plants, but shorter and with fewer lateral branches. Mature pistillate flowers unknown. Fruits borne on claviform pedicels of up to 7 × 4 mm; cupules hemispherical, to 1 × 1.5 cm, glabrous outside, rusty sericeous inside, the margins entire; drupes ovoid, to 1.5 × 1 cm.
