description: Erect or ascending shrub 0.2-0.5 m tall or more; inflorescence and distal parts of stems tomentose or villous with whitish glandular hairs. Leaves short-petiolate; blades subcoriaceous, narrowly elliptic, 2-4.3 x 0.5-1 cm, acute, cuneate at base, the margins crenulate or serrulate, revolute; upper surface deep green, rugose, glandular-puber-ulous; lower surface whitish-green, pinnate-venose, villous or lanate with whitish hairs; petioles 1-3 mm, villous. Inflorescence composed of 24 pairs of 4-16-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.2-2.6 cm, the pedicels 0.8-1.4 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals ovate, yellow green, acute or subacute, glandular-puberulous on both surfaces, sometimes subglabrous inside, the margins entire, short-ciliate; dorsal sepal 5.5-8.2 x 3.5-4.3 mm at anthesis. Corolla type II, bright yellow, internally with red dots in the sides of the throat; upper lip 3-4 x 4-6 mm; lower lip saccate in 30-40% of length, the upcurved portion 12-20 x 6-12 mm; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1; anthers light brown, glabrous, 2.8-4.1 mm, dehiscing throughout but with a conspicuous transverse septum, the thecae equal or subequal; filaments 1.2-2 mm. Style 1.8-2.2 mm, almost straight. Capsule not seen at maturity.

description: Ascending herb, 0.2-0.5(-l) m tall; stems and inflorescence pilose or soft-hispid with white hairs. Leaves with blades ovate to triangular, 2.2-6.7 x 1.8-5.6 cm, acute to obtuse at apex, cuneate to slightly cordate at base, the margins ciliate, lobate or lobulate, the lobes irregularly biserrate; upper surface bright to dark green, pilose; lower surface whitish-green, rarely purplish, pilose; petioles 1.2-4.2 cm long, (0.8-) 1.7-4 cm wide at base, 0.4-2.5 cm at the distal end, the margins dentate or crenate, at least proximally. Inflorescence intercalary or distal, composed of 1-2(-3) pairs of (2-)4-24-flowered cymes on primary peduncles 4-14(-23) cm long (when the inflorescence is distal, usually a single pair of cymes are developed, and one of the cymes is often suppressed); cyme bracts 1.5-5.7 x 0.6-2.5 cm, subordinate bracts usually absent, but sometimes rudimentary or up to 2.6 x 1.5 cm; pedicels 1.2-3.6 cm. Sepals ovate, rarely lanceolate, pale green (sometimes turning purple in exposure), 7.7-13 x (3-)4-8.6 mm at anthesis, acuminate and slightly caudate, externally white-pilose with some of the hairs gland-tipped, internally glandular-puberulous, the margins entire or (rarely) sparsely denticulate, ciliate. Corolla type I, usually unspotted, yellowish-white to pale yellow above (sometimes sulphur-yellow in exposed sites), white below; upper lip 5-7 x 6-10 mm; lower lip 15-22 x 10-16 mm, saccate in 65-75% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 10; anthers yellowish-white to huffish, glabrous, 3.7-5.5 mm, the thecae unequal, ascending; filaments 1-1.4 mm. Style 3-5.4 mm, straight, decurved at apex. Capsule ovoid, 6-8 mm long, shortly glandular-hirsute. 2n = 36 (Harling et al. 15122).

description: Ascending or erect herb, 0.2-1 m tall, the stems and the inflorescence pilose to villous with white, gland-tipped hairs. Leaves with blades herbaceous, subcircular to almost deltoid, 1.7-9.1 x 1.7-9.4 cm, obtuse to acute at apex, cordate (rarely truncate) at base, the margins lobate with 2-5 lobes on each side of blade, the lobes serrate or dentate; upper surface bright to deep green, pilose to villous with white glandular hairs, almost smooth; lower surface pale green, palmate-venose, the major veins pilose or hispid with glandular hairs, interspaces glabrous to glandular-villous; petioles 1.3-5.2 cm, hispid or villous with most of the hairs gland-tipped. Inflorescence composed of l(-2) pairs of 4-20-flowered cymes (often only one cyme of the terminal pair developed); primary peduncles 3.5-16 cm; pedicels 0.8-4 cm. Sepals ovate to lanceolate, light green to bright green, ± suffused with purple, 4.2-10 x 3.2-8.3 mm, acute or slightly acuminate, externally hirsute or villous with glandular hairs, internally glandular-papillose or shortly glandular-hirsute, the margins entire. Corolla type III, light yellow to bright yellow, internally with red or purple dots in the sides of the throat; upper lip 3-7 x 4-7 mm; lower lip 13-24 x 8-18 mm, saccate in 30-60% of length, the neck 4-6 mm wide at base; elaiophore present. Stamens type 5; anthers sagittate, orange-yellow to yellow-brown, glabrous, 1.6-4 mm across, dehiscing throughout, the thecae equal, sharply deflexed, forming an angle of 80-150°, each one 1.4-2.6 mm long; filaments (0.9-) 1.5-2.6 mm. Style 2-3.8 mm, distally decurved. Capsule ovoid, 6-8 mm long, glandular-hirsute, ± purplish. 2n = 36 (Straw 2318, Straw in Löve, 1970: 268).

description: Erect, tufted shrub, 0.4-0.9 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems strongly glutinous, shortly glandular-hirsute to almost lepidote. Leaves 8-26 x 0.9-2 mm, obtuse and ± hamate at apex, dark green, glabrous or glandular-papillose, glutinous. Inflorescence composed of 1-4-flowered cymes; pedicels 0.4-1.3 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals ovate, green to yellow-green, 2.4-4.5 x 1.7-3 mm at anthesis, acute or subacute, finely glandular-puberulous on both sides. Corolla type VIII, lemon yellow to deep yellow, with transverse, undulate, red stripes in the throat; upper lip 2-3 x 3-4 mm; lower lip saccate in 30-40% of length, the upcurved portion 9-15 x 5-10 mm; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1; anthers 1.6-3 mm, huffish to light brown; filaments 0.8-1.5 mm. Style 1.4-2 mm, curved distally. Capsule ovoid, 4-8 mm long, yellow-brown to purplish, glandular or glandular-puberulous.

description: Ascending or scandent herb, at least 0.5-1 m tall, the stems and inflorescence pilose or villous with white, mostly gland-tipped hairs. Leaves with blades herbaceous, ± triangular (often almost perfectly deltoid), 2.8-7.5 x 2.4-7.6 cm, subacute to acuminate at apex, cordate at base, irregularly 9-15-lobate or lobulate, the lobes serrate; upper surface green, smooth, pilose or hispid with mostly gland-tipped hairs; lower surface pale or grayish-green, reticulate-venose to almost palmate-venose, the veins pilose or spreading hirsute, the interspaces glabrous or pilose; petioles 1.8-6.2 cm, villous. Inflorescence composed of 1-3 pairs of 4-20-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 3.8-11 cm, the pedicels 0.8-3 cm. Sepals ovate, green (turning red in exposure), 5.3-8.8 x 4.1-5.5 mm at anthesis, acute, glandular-pilose on both sides, the margins entire. Corolla type I, yellow, unspotted, the upper lip 3-5 x 5-6 mm, the lower lip 12-20 x 8-15, saccate in 40-70% of length; elaiophore absent or poorly developed. Stamens type 1; anthers huffish to almost white, glabrous, 2.5-3.1 mm, dehiscing throughout, the thecae equal, divaricate; filaments 1.5-2.6 mm. Style 3.5-4.2 mm, distally decurved. Capsule ovoid, 9-10 mm long, slightly acuminate, glandular-pilose.

description: Vine with the stems 2-4 m long, the branches divaricate; inflorescence and distal parts of stems puberulous. Leaves decussate; blades herbaceous, thin, ovate or triangular, 2.4-7.5 x 1.4-4.5 cm, acute, cordate at base, the margins sharply serrate or biserrate; upper surface bright green, pilose or puberulous, almost smooth; lower surface only slightly paler, reticulate-venose, pilose or puberulous, sparsely glandular; petioles 6-36 mm, puberulous, dilated at base. Inflorescence composed of (2-)3-7 pairs of 2-16-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.5-6.7 cm, the pedicels 1.4-4.6 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals bright green, thin, ovate or lanceolate, (3.4-)5.4- 9.2 x 2.5-5.3 mm at anthesis, acuminate or caudate, glabrous or glandular-puberulous on both sides, the margins ciliate. Corolla type VIII, unspotted, both lips yellowish-white at base and lemon yellow to bright yellow distally, the throat internally white; upper lip 2-4 mm long, 6-10 mm wide, and 8-14 mm high; lower lip saccate in 40-50% of length, the upcurved portion 13-24 x 10-18 mm; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1; anthers yellow-brown, glabrous, 1.9-2.7 mm, the thecae divaricate; filaments 0.6-1 mm. Style 1.3-2.1 mm, slightly curved. Capsule conic, 6-7 mm long, glandular-puberulous. 2n = 36 (Molau & Öhman 1633, new record).

description: Robust erect herb, 0.4-1.2 m tall; stems hirsute or villous with coarse whitish or pale brownish hairs, the lower internodes short. Leaves sessile; blades herbaceous, elliptic, 6-13 x 2.3-4.7 cm, acute, cuneate at base, the margins sharply serrate or biserrate, entire in the proximal third; upper surface bright green, flexuose, hirsute; lower surface light green, pinnate-venose, the veins hirsute, interspaces glabrous to villous. Inflorescence comprising 1 or 2 pairs of 12-36-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles (6.5-)9.5-35 cm long, the pedicels 0.8-3.2(-5.2) cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals ovate or lanceolate, acuminate or caudate, bright green, often suffused with purple, 3.2-6.5 x 1.9-3.6 mm at anthesis, puberulous or villous with gland-tipped hairs on both surfaces, the margins entire. Corolla type VI, white, the lower lip ± suffused with purple; upper lip 4-7 x 6-10 mm; lower lip 9-14 x 7-11 mm, saccate in 30-40% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 1 or 2, the anthers medium or light brown, 1.9-2.4 mm, glabrous, the thecae equal, divaricate, filaments 0.9-1.4 mm. Style straight, 1.8-2.7 mm, the stigma capitate. Capsule subglobose, purplish, 4-7 mm long, glandular-to-mentose. 2n = 36 (Lojtnant, Molau & Madison 11714, cf. Molau, 1980b: 364).

description: Erect or ascending subshrub, 0.2-0.8 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems red-brown, puberulous. Leaves decussate, sessile; blades ± coriaceous, lanceolate or narrowly triangular, 3 5.3 x 0.5-0.9 cm, obtuse, clasping at base, the margins revolute, entire; upper surface dark green, rugose, glabrous, glutinous; lower surface white-lanate. Inflorescence composed of a single pair (rarely two pairs) of 1-8-flowered cymes; primary peduncles 1.2-5.6 cm; pedicels 1.1-2.1 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals yellowish-green, 35 x 1.7-3.8 mm at anthesis, slightly acuminate, externally glabrous and glutinous, internally puberulous, the margins entire. Corolla type XI, unspotted, pale sulphur yellow above, white below; upper lip 4-5 x 5-6 mm; lower lip 13-25 x 12-17 mm, saccate in 65-75% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 8; anthers huffish, 2.2-2.6 mm, the thecae subglobose, equal, dehiscing to the connective; filaments 0.8-1.2 mm. Style curved, 1.3-2 mm. Capsule ovoid, 4-6 mm long, glabrous, glutinous.

description: Scandent subshrub at least 1 m tall, the branches ± divaricate; inflorescence and distal parts of stems hispid or coarsely tomentose with pale buffish hairs mixed with short-stalked brownish glands. Leaves with blades herbaceous, ovate or lanceolate, 3.6-7.7 x 2-3.6 cm, acute, cuneate to truncate at base, the margins serrate or biserrate; upper surface olive green, flexuose, hirsute and with sessile yellowish glands; lower surface paler, predominantly pinnate-venose, the veins hispid or coarsely villous with white hairs, interspaces glandular and pilose to villous; petioles 6-12 mm, hispid. Inflorescence distal, comprising 1-3 pairs of 2-12-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.4-3.5 cm; pedicels 0.5-1.4 cm; cyme bracts absent. Sepals subequal, pale green, ovate, 3.6-4 x 2.9-3.2 mm at anthesis, acute, externally white-hispid, internally glabrous except for the short-tomentose border along the margins. Corolla type II, bright yellow, unspotted, externally conspicuously glandular-puberulous, the upper lip 2-3 x 4-5 mm, the lower lip saccate in 40-50% of length, its upcurved portion 10-12 x 6-7 mm; elaiophore present. Stamens type 11; anthers buff, 2.7-3.2 mm, glabrous, the thecae equal; filaments 1.2-1.6 mm. Style decurved, 1.5-2.5 mm. Capsule ovoid, brown, 5-6 mm long, glandular-puberulous.

description: Vine, 0.6-2 m long, the branches divaricate; inflorescence and distal parts of stems whitish-tomentose, becoming pilose with age. Leaves with blades herbaceous, lanceolate to ovate, 3-4.7 x 1.5-2.6 cm, slightly acuminate, rounded or truncate at base, the margins serrate; upper surface bright green, almost smooth, pilose; lower surface pale green, reticulate-venose, the major veins pilose or villous, interspaces glabrous or pilose; petioles 5-15 mm, villous. Inflorescence usually intercalary, composed of 4-8 pairs of 1-4-flow-ered cymes on peduncles 2.6-6.2 cm long, the lateral branches of the cymes often purely vegetative; cyme bracts present; pedicels 1.8-3.8 cm. Sepals subequal, thin, ovate, yellow green, slightly acuminate, 5-6.3 x 3.5-4.7 mm at anthesis, externally pilose, internally glabrous except for the short-tomentose border along the short-ciliate margins. Corolla type V, pale yellow, usually with red dots in the throat, the upper lip 4-6 x 5-7 mm, the lower lip elliptic, 13-16 x 10-15 mm, saccate in 60-70% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens close to type 12 (the central part sterile); anthers yellowish to pale brown, 2.2-2.6 mm, not dehiscing throughout, glabrous, the thecae ± reniform, ± deflexed, equal or subequal; filaments 0.8-1 mm. Style arcuate, 2.1-3 mm. Capsule narrowly conic, ± acuminate, 47 mm long, glabrous.

description: Lax, erect or ascending subshrub (0.1-)0.4-2 m tall, often scrambling, the stems brittle, purplish to brown; inflorescence and distal parts of stem shortly brown- or purplish-tomentose. Leaves with blades coriaceous or subcoriaceous, lanceolate, 4.8-12 x 1.7-4.3 cm, acuminate or acute, truncate to attenuate at base, the margins irrregularly serrate or biserrate; upper surface dark green, sparsely to densely short-pilose, beset with sessile hyaline glands, almost smooth, dull; lower surface light or pale green, pinnate-venose, the veins brownish to purplish tomentose, interspaces glabrous, dotted with hyaline glands; petioles 5-15 mm, tomentose or villous. Inflorescence of one or two pairs of 2-10-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles (3.5-)5-12 cm, the pedicels 0.8-4 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals brownish-green or olivaceous, ovate, 4.5-9 x 3.5-7 mm at anthesis, yellowish-glandular on both sides, the margins entire, short-ciliate. Corolla type XIV, bright yellow, unspotted; upper lip 6-8 x 10-13 mm; lower lip 15-25 x 10-17 mm, saccate in 40-60% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 1; anthers dark brown, 3.54 mm, the thecae equal; filaments 1.3-1.7 mm. Style 4-5 mm, decurved at apex. Capsule globose, brownish or purplish, 5-8 mm long, glandular.

description: Vine, 1.5-8 m long, the branches divaricate or somewhat deflexed; inflorescence and distal parts of stems densely short-tomentose with purplish hairs; stems brittle. Leaves with blades herbaceous or subcoriaceous, ovate, 2.3-5.4 x 0.9-2.2 cm, acute, cuneate at base, the margins ± revolute, entire, denticulate, or shallowly crenate; upper surface dull, dull olivaceous green, somewhat flexuose to smooth, densely short-tomentose and with sessile, hyaline, yellow glands; lower surface pinnate-venose, pale green, the veins shortly glandular-tomentose with purple hairs, interspaces densely glandular (sessile, orange glands) and densely pustulate (pale flattened hairs), sometimes subglabrous and pruinose; petioles short-tomentose, 2-8 mm, canaliculate, dilated at base and slightly connate across nodes. Inflorescence distal, composed of 3 or 4 pairs of 1-6-flowered cymes; primary peduncles 1.0-2.8(-5.2) cm; pedicels 1.3-2.7(-3.8) cm; cyme bracts present but ± deciduous. Sepals unequal, bright greenish-yellow or light yellow-green, ovate, obtuse or subacute, externally shortly glandular-tomentose, internally glandular-puberulous and with a short-tomentose border along the margins; dorsal sepal 3.4-5.2 x 2.6-4.4 mm at anthesis. Corolla type VII, bright yellow, unspotted, the throat internally sulphur yellow, the upper lip 4-7 x 7-12 mm, the lower lip 13-20 x 10-15 mm, saccate in 50-60% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 2; anthers glabrous, dark brown, 2.3-2.8 mm, the thecae equal, somewhat reniform; filaments 0.7-1.2 mm. Style arcuate, 2.8-4.2 mm. Capsule widely ovoid, brown, 4-6 mm long, glandular-puberulous.

description: Vine, climbing 1-3 m high, the branches divaricate; inflorescence and distal parts of stems puberulous to tomentose with whitish hairs. Leaves with blades herbaceous or subcoriaceous, lanceolate or narrowly elliptic, 4.3-5.5 x 1.2-2.5 cm, acute or slightly acuminate, cuneate or attenuate at base; upper surface olive green, puberulous to pilose and beset with sessile orange glands, flexuose; lower surface pale green, pinnate-venose, the veins puberulous or hirsute, interspaces beset with sessile orange glands, otherwise glabrous; the margins denticulate; petioles 3-8 mm, puberulous to tomentose with white hairs. Inflorescence distal, composed of 2-4 pairs of 2-4-flowered cymes on primary peduncles 12 cm long; cyme bracts present; pedicels 1.2-2 cm. Sepals yellow green, acuminate, externally minutely puberulous to shortly tomentose, internally with a short-tomentose border along the margins, otherwise puberulous or glabrous; dorsal sepal ovate, 6.7-7.5 x 4.7-6 mm at anthesis. Corolla type II, bright yellow, (probably) unspotted, externally minutely glandular, proximally glandular-puberulous; upper lip 2-3 x 3-4 mm; upcurved part of lower lip 13-18 x 1012 mm, saccate in 35-45% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1, the anthers light brown to brownish-gray, 3.2-4.2 mm glabrous, the thecae divaricate or slightly deflexed, equal or subequal; filaments 0.9-1.5 mm. Style straight below, deflexed at apex, 2-2.5 mm. Capsule not seen.

description: Shrub, 0.2-1 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems pilose to hirsute with glandular hairs. Leaves with blades subcircular, slightly trilobate, 1-2 mm long and wide, obtuse, cordate at base, the upper surface dark green, smooth, somewhat concave, glandular-papillose, the lower surface white-villous, concealed by the strongly revolute margins; petioles 4-7 mm, ascending-hirsute with long, coarse, pale huffish hairs. Inflorescence composed of 1-2 pairs of 4-12-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.2-2 cm, the pedicels 0.5-1 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals green, subacute, 2.5-3 x 1.4-2 mm at anthesis. Corolla close to type VI, light yellow, probably unspotted; upper lip cucullate, ascending, 6-7 x 5-6 mm; lower lip flattened, pendent, 7-8 x 5-6 mm, saccate in 20-25% of its length, the orifice wide open; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 1 (or almost type 6); anthers buff, reniform, 1.8-1.9 mm, the thecae slightly deflexed; filaments glabrous, 2-2.5 mm. Style 2.53 mm. Capsule not seen.

description: Ascending or erect subshrub, 0.2-l(-1.5)m tall, the whole plant glabrous, branched mostly at base. Leaves subsessile; blades subcoriaceous, narrowly elliptic or (in exposed sites at high elevations) linear, (l-)2.5-7.1 x 0.2-1.1 cm, obtuse to subacute, cuneate at base; upper surface smooth, glutinous, bright to deep green; lower surface pale green or whitish-green, pinnate-venose; margins entire or denticulate, ± deflexed, rarely revolute (exposed sites at high elevations); petioles 0-3 mm. Inflorescence composed of 1-3 pairs of (1-) 4-12-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1-6.2 cm, the pedicels 0.5-2.5 cm, glutinous; cyme bracts present. Sepals triangular, green, glabrous, strongly glutinous, 3-5.6 x 1.4-2.5 mm at anthesis, acute. Corolla type IV, distally light yellow or light lemon yellow, proximally white; upper lip flattened, subcircular, 3-7 mm high and 5-10 mm wide; lower lip upeurved, saccate in 40-50% of length, the upeurved portion 13-23 x 10-16 mm; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1; anthers huffish to medium brown, 2-2.8 mm, glabrous, the thecae equal; filaments 0.8-1.2 mm. Style curved, 1.5-2.6 mm. Capsule ovoid, olive brown, 5-7 mm long, glabrous, glutinous. 2n = 36 (Harling et al 14843, Molau & Öhman 1137, new record, cf. below).

description: Lax, often scandent herb, 0.5-2.5 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems villous or tomentose with whitish hairs, at least some of which are gland-tipped. Leaves decussate; blades herbaceous,ovate,(2.2-)3.3-7.2 x (1.7-)2.4-4.9 cm, acute or subacute, cordate or truncate at base, the margins bluntly serrate to bicrenate; upper surface bright green, somewhat rugose, pilose or short-villous; lower surface pale green, reticulate-venose, the veins pilose or villous, the interspaces glabrous or pilose, ± glandular; petioles 3-12 mm, villous. Inflorescence composed of (1-)2-3 pairs of 4-20-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 2.4-11 cm, the pedicels 0.5-3.5 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals ovate, light green or yellow-green, often turning red in exposure, 4.2-7.6 x 3-5.8 mm at anthesis, acute or subacute, externally pilose, internally glabrous. Corolla type VI, bright yellow, unspotted, externally white-pilose and densely glandular; upper lip 47 x 7-10 mm; lower lip 10-15 x 10-13 mm, saccate in 40-50% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 2; anthers brown, glabrous, 2.4-3.2 mm, dehiscing centrally (through the connective but not to the distal ends of the anther); thecae equal or subequal, globose, divaricate; filaments 1.2-1.7 mm. Style arcuate, 4.6-5.7 mm long. Capsule broadly ovoid, 4-6 mm long, glandular-puberulous.

description: Ascending or scandent herb, at least 0.5 m high, the stems woody below; inflorescence and stems hirsute with coarse, pale buffish hairs. Leaves petiolate; blades herbaceous, ovate, 34 x 1.4-2.2 cm, acute or subacute, truncate at base, the margins serrate with the teeth somewhat rounded; upper surface bright green, flexuose, hirsute with coarse whitish hairs; lower surface paler, pinnate-venose, the veins hirsute, interspaces glabrous; petioles 5-13 mm, densely hirsute. Inflorescence composed of 2 or 3 pairs of 4-8-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.6-3 cm, the pedicels 0.7-1.7 cm; cyme bracts present, small. Sepals greenish, ovate, 5.2-6.5 x 3.6-5.3 mm at anthesis, subacute, the margins sparsely dentate, externally pilose, internally glabrous. Corolla type XIV, bright yellow, unspotted; upper lip 3-4 x 4-6 mm; lower lip ± pendent, 8-12 x 9-10 mm; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 6; anthers dark brown, 2.6-3 mm across, glabrous, the thecae deflexed, equal; filaments 1.3-1.5 mm. Style arcuate, 5-6 mm. Capsule glandular-tomentose, not seen at maturity.

description: Ascending herb, at least 0.5-1 m tall; stems and inflorescence hirsute with long buff to ferrugineous hairs. Leaves petiolate; blades herbaceous, ovate, 6.5-8.8 x 3.8-4.8 cm, acute, cuneate at base, the margins serrate; upper surface deep green, somewhat flexuose, pilose; lower surface predominantly pinnate-venose, pale green, pilose; petioles 15-25 mm, spreading-hirsute. Inflorescence composed of a single pair of 4-12-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 6.3-11 cm, the pedicels 1.6-4.7 cm; cyme bracts small or absent. Sepals green, ovate, 4-5.8 x 3-4.5 mm at anthesis, acuminate, the margins entire, externally pilose with long hairs, internally glandular-pilose, puberulous towards the margins. Corolla type II, deep yellow, unspotted; upper lip 4-5 x 6-7 mm; lower lip 15-18 x 12-14 mm, saccate in 40-50% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1; anthers huffish-white, 2.2-2.5 mm, glabrous, the thecae divaricate, equal; filaments 1.4-1.5 mm. Style straight, 3 3.7 mm, the stigma capitate. Capsule subglobose, brownish, 5-7 mm long, glandular-puberulous.

description: Low subshrub, the stems erect or ascending, 0.2-0.5 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems brownish, white-puberulous or papillose, glutinous. Leaves decussate, subsessile; blades coriaceous, elliptic to lanceolate, 11-25 x 4-8 mm, obtuse at apex, rounded at base, completely glabrous, the margins sparsely denticulate, revolute and seemingly entire; upper surface deep green, smooth, nitidous; lower surface pale green, pinnate-venose. Inflorescence composed of one or two pairs of 1-4-flowered cymes on peduncles 1.4-7 cm long; pedicels 0.7-2.3 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals green, 3-4.5 x 2-3.5 mm at anthesis, acuminate, externally glabrous, internally white-puberulous, the margins entire. Corolla type XI, unspotted, light yellow or sulphur yellow above, white below; upper lip 3-6 x 4-8 mm; lower lip 14-22(-26) x 9-16(-19) mm, saccate in 60-70% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 8; anthers yellowish-white to pale brown, 1.9-2.5 mm, the thecae equal, subglobose, dehiscing to the connective; filaments 0.9-1.2 mm. Style curved, 1.2-2.5 mm. Capsule conical, 5-6 mm long, glabrous, glutinous. 2n = 36 [Harling et al. (leg. Molau) 15073].

description: Frutex scandens, ramis divaricatis. Folia decussata, breviter petiolata; lamina subcoriacea, lanceolata, glabra, 3.8-5 x 0.8-1 cm, ad apicem acimunata, ad basin cuneata, margine dentato. Inflorescentia glabra. Sepala ovata, acuminata, sepalo dorsali maximo, 7.5-9.2 x 4.7-5.5 mm in anthesi. Corolla flava, labio superiore 7-8 x 6-7 mm, labio inferiore 8-10 x 7-8 mm; elaeo-phorus adest. Antherae fuscae, glabrae, 1.6-2.5 mm, totae dehiscentes; thecae divaricatae vel leviter deflexae, subglobosae. Stylus rectus, 3.2-3.5 mm. Capsulam maturam non vidi.

description: Scandent shrub, reaching several meters above the ground; stems and inflorescence glabrous, the branches divaricate. Leaves decussate, short-petiolate; blade subcoriaceous, lanceolate, 3.8-5 x 0.8-1 cm, attenuate at apex, cuneate at base, the margins dentate or denticulate, ± deflexed; upper surface deep green, slightly rugose; lower surface pale green, pinnate-venose; petioles 2-5 mm. Inflorescence diffuse, composed of one or two pairs of 4-8-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles often much suppressed, 0.1-1.5 cm long, the pedicels slender, 2-3.3 cm; cyme bracts present though often rudimentary. Sepals thin, green, ovate, acuminate, externally glabrescent, internally glabrous except for a short-tomentose border along the margins, the dorsal one largest, 7.5-9.2 x 4.7-5.5 mm at anthesis. Corolla type VI, uniformly bright yellow, unspotted, externally puberulous, the upper lip 7-8 x 6-7 mm, the lower lip 8-10 x 7-8 mm, saccate in 50-60% of its length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 2; anthers yellow-brown, glabrous, 1.6-2.5 mm, dehiscing throughout, the thecae subglobose, equal, divaricate or somewhat deflexed; filaments ca. 1 mm. Style straight, glabrous, 3.2-3.5 mm. Capsule not seen at maturity.

description: Lax, ascending herb, 0.5-2 m long; stems and peduncles hispid or villous with coarse, white, glandless hairs. Leaves with blades ovate or triangular-ovate, (2.2-)5-8.6 x (2.1-)3.8-6.7 cm, acute or subacute, cordate or truncate at base, the margins lobulate and serrate or crenate; upper surface bright to deep green, white-hispid; lower surface whitish-green, the major veins raised, glandular-hispid, interspaces villous to lanate with white glandless hairs; petioles (0.8-) 2.3-6.2 cm long, (1.6-)2.7-4.5 cm wide at base, 0.5-1.5 cm at the distal end, the margins dentate, crenate, or subentire. Inflorescence intercalary, composed of a single pair (rarely two pairs) of (2-)8-12-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 12-30 cm long, the pedicels of the terminal flower and its front flower 4.5-6 cm long, subordinate pedicels much shorter (1.4-2.8 cm); cyme bracts 1.8-5.2 x 1.1-3 cm, subordinate bracts absent. Sepals lanceolate, light green to yellow (often turning purplish with age), 13-16 x 4.8-8.5(-13) mm at anthesis, acuminate and slightly caudate, externally white-villous, internally glandular-puberulous, the margins denticulate or entire. Corolla almost type VII (but with the lower lip projecting, circular, and somewhat flattened), bright sulphur yellow, unspotted; upper lip 810 x 10-15 mm; lower lip 25-30 x 23-35 mm, saccate in ca. 80% of its length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 12; anthers light brown to deep yellow, glabrous, 2.5-3.2 mm, the thecae equal, deflexed; filaments 2-2.7 mm. Style 4-5.8 mm, decurved at apex, otherwise straight. Capsule ovoid, 6-8 mm long, villous. 2n = 36 (Løjtnant & Molau 14310).

description: Low shrubby plant or subshrub, the stems erect or ascending, 0.2-0.8 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems arachnoid-lanate with pale yellow or cream white hairs. Leaves short-petiolate; blades coriaceous, narrowly elliptic, 2-5.2 x 0.4-1.5 cm, obtuse, cuneate at base, the margins denticulate but always ± strongly revolute and seemingly entire; upper surface dark green, glabrous or pilose, finely rugose; lower surface densely arachnoid-lanate with yellow to cream-white hairs; petioles 1-5 mm, lanate. Inflorescence composed of one or two pairs of 2-10-flowered cymes; primary peduncles (0.8-)2-4.8	cm; pedicels 1-2.5 cm; cyme bracts absent. Sepals ovate or triangular, 4-6.7 x 2.3-4 mm at anthesis, acute or slightly acuminate, externally lanate, internally glabrous and light green. Corolla type V, lemon-yellow to sulphur-yellow, unspotted; upper lip 4-8 x 6-10 mm; lower lip 12-17 x 10-15 mm, often somewhat pendent (at least in late anthesis), saccate in 30-40% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 1 or 5 (thecae ± deflexed); anthers light brown, 2-3.1 mm, glabrous; filaments 1-1.9 mm. Style slightly curved, 2-4 mm. Capsule ovoid, 5-6 mm long, villous. 2n = 36 (Løjtnant & Molau 13740).

description: Erect or ascending subshrub or shrub, densely tufted, 0.3-1.2 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems short-tomentose or densely puberulous with white hairs. Leaves ternate (rarely decussate, less than 5% of the specimens examined), short-petiolate; blades lanceolate or (dept. Ancash) ovate, 2.3-6.2 x 0.8-2.5 cm, subcoriaceous, acute at apex, cuneate or rounded at base, the margins dentate or sharp-serrate with mucronulate teeth; upper surface olive green, sparsely glandular, puberulous or short-hirsute, slightly rugose; lower surface pale green, reticulate-venose, glandular, ± densely puberulous; petioles 1-4(-7) mm, white-tomentose. Inflorescence composed of 3-6 triplets (rarely pairs) of (4-)8-12-flowered cymes; primary peduncles 0.8-l.8(-3) cm; pedicels 0.6-1.2(-2.2) cm; cyme bracts present only in the lowermost cymes. Sepals green, 2.5-3.5 x 2.3-2.8 mm at anthesis, obtuse to acute, externally glandular and densely puberulous, internally sparsely puberulous. Corolla type VIII, bright yellow, the throat internally with a transverse zone of red spots, sometimes confluent to a crossband (very rarely unspotted); up-curved portion of lower lip 10-18 x 7-12 mm. Stamens with anthers light brown, 1.7-2.1 mm, the thecae divaricate or slightly deflexed; filaments 1-1.6 mm. Style 1.3-2.4 mm long. Capsule conical, 3-4 mm long, slightly acuminate, narrow, glandular.

description: Rosulate herb, 2-6 cm tall. Leaves indistinctly petiolate; blades spathulate or oblanceolate, 0.7-2.5 x 0.4-1.1 cm, obtuse, attenuate at base; petioles 3-18 mm, pilose. Inflorescence composed of 1-2(-6) pairs of 1-flowered peduncles 1.8-4.5 cm long, pilose to villous. Sepals green, subacute, 2.8-5.5 x 2-3.5 mm at anthesis. Corolla type X, deep yellow, unspotted; upper lip rounded-triangular, 2-3 x 3-5 mm; lower lip subcircular to obovate, dorsally flattened, 10-16 x 7-13 mm, saccate in 60-70% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1; anthers pale to light brown, 1.8-2.4 mm; filaments 1.4-1.8 mm. Style 1.2-1.5 mm. Capsule ovoid, 3-5 mm long.

description: Shrub, at least 0.5-1 m tall, much branched; inflorescence and distal parts of stems densely hispid with yellow-brown or ferrugineous hairs. Leaves with blades ovate or elliptic, 2.2-2.8 x 1.1-1.4 cm, acute, rounded at base, the margins crenulate, deflexed or slightly revolute; upper surface dark green, hispid, somewhat flexuose; lower surface light green, pinnate-venose, the midrib velutinous with golden yellow hairs, otherwise pilose; petioles velutinous, 5-7 mm. Inflorescence composed of a single pair of 4-8-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1-3.5 cm, the pedicels 0.8-2.2 cm; cyme bracts present, but small or rudimentary. Sepals ovate, brownish, 5-6.4 x 4-4.8 mm at anthesis, acute, externally shortly pilose or hispid, internally glabrous except for a short-tomentose border along the margins. Corolla type XV, bright yellow, the upper lip hooded, 7-9 mm high and 8-10 mm wide, the lower lip projecting, 8-10 x 9-11 mm, saccate in 40-50% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 5; anthers dark brown, glabrous, 2.3-2.8 mm across, the thecae equal, strongly deflexed, each one 2.5-3 mm long; filaments 1.52 mm. Style almost straight, 4.5-5.6 mm. Capsule ovoid, brownish, 4-6 mm long, slightly acuminate, sparsely glandular-hirsute.

description: Erect or ascending shrub, 0.4-1.5 m tall, the branches ± divaricate; inflorescence and distal parts of stems hirsute or tomentose with brown to purple hairs. Leaves with blades ovate, 1.5-4.2 x 0.8-2.8 cm, acute or slightly acuminate, cuneate or rounded at base, the margins sharply dentate, revolute or deflexed; upper surface dark green, flexuose or slightly rugose, pilose to hirsute with purple hairs; lower surface light green, pinnate-venose, the veins hirsute, interspaces glabrous or pilose; petioles densely purplish-hirsute, 3-12 mm. Inflorescence composed of 1-3 pairs of 4-10-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 0.5-5 cm, the pedicels 0.7-2 cm; cyme bracts usually rudimentary or absent. Sepals ovate, light yellow-green, 5.5-9 x 4-6 mm at anthesis, acute or slightly acuminate, externally hirsute or strigose with purplish hairs, internally with a short-tomentose border along the margins, otherwise glabrous or puberulous. Corolla type IV, bright yellow, the upper lip flattened, circular, 6-15 mm high and 10-17 mm wide, the lower lip saccate in 20-30% of length, the upcurved portion 1020 x 8-14 mm; elaiophore present. Stamens type 6; anthers dark brown, glabrous, 1.8-2.5 mm across, the thecae equal, slightly deflexed, beanshaped, each one 1.5-2 mm; filaments 1.2-2.2 mm. Style almost straight, 3.2-4.2 mm. Capsule ovoid, brownish, 5-6 mm long, hirsute, becoming glabrous with age. 2n = 36 (Molau & Öhman 1439, new record).

description: Erect subshrub, 0.3-1 m tall, much branched; inflorescence and distal parts of stems strigose or appressed-hirsute with ± ferrugineous hairs. Leaves subsessile; blades coriaceous, narrowly elliptic to almost linear, 2-5 x 0.2-1 cm, obtuse at apex, cuneate or slightly rounded at base, the margins strongly revolute and ± entire; upper surface dark green, somewhat rugose, glabrous or pilose, glutinous; lower surface lanate with olivaceous to ferrugineous, coarse hairs; petioles to 2 mm long, brownish-hirsute. Inflorescence composed of one or two pairs of 2-4-flowered cymes, the peduncles 1.5-5 cm, the pedicels 0.8- 2.7 cm; cyme bracts rudimentary or absent. Sepals green, ovate, acute, 3.2-5.3 x 2-3 mm at anthesis, externally appressed-hirsute. Corolla type V, bright yellow, unspotted; upper lip 57 x 8-10 mm; lower lip 10-21 x 7-17 mm, saccate in 40-50% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 5; anthers yellow-brown, glabrous, 2-2.8 mm across, the thecae ± deflexed, each one 1.4-1.8 mm long; filaments 1-1.8 mm. Style slightly curved, 2.5-4 mm. Capsule broadly ovoid, brownish, 4-7 mm long, glandular-puberulous. 2n = 36 (Molau & Ohman 1218, new record).

description: Scandent or ascending subshrub, 1-1.5 m tall, the branches ascending from almost divaricate bases; inflorescence and distal parts of stems short-tomentose with purple or red-brown hairs. Leaves with blades herbaceous, ovate, 1.8-3 x 1-1.3 cm, acute, rounded or cuneate at base, the margins crenate or shallowly serrate, somewhat deflexed; upper surface dull dark green, somewhat flexuose, densely short-hirsute with glandless hairs intermingled with stalked glands; lower surface pale green, pinnate-venose, the veins purplish- or brownish-tomentose, interspaces beset with stalked yellowish glands; petioles 2-12 mm, densely tomentose. Inflorescence distal, composed of 2-4 pairs of 4-6-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.5-2.8 cm, the pedicels 0.8-2.5 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals dark brownish-green, subequal, ovate to lanceolate, 4.1-5.8 x 2.2-3.2 mm at anthesis, somewhat acuminate, externally shortly glandular-hirsute, internally puberulous and with a short-tomentose border along the margins. Corolla type XV, bright yellow, unspotted, the upper lip 2-3 x 3-4 mm, the lower lip pendent, 10-17 x 7-10 mm, flattened, saccate in only 25-30% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 4; anthers dark brown, glandular at base, otherwise glabrous, 23 mm across, the thecae ascending, equal, each 1.3-2 mm; filaments 1-1.5 mm. Style straight or slightly arcuate, 4-6.2 mm. Capsule ovoid, brown, 5-6 mm long, glandular-hirsute.

description: Erect or ascending herb (or rarely subshrub), 0.1-1 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems glandular-pilose or glandular-villous with white hairs. Leaves decussate; blades herbaceous, ovate or elliptic, 3-8.5(-11) x 1.6-6.2 (-8.2) cm, acute or slightly acuminate, cuneate to rounded (rarely cordate) at base, the margins serrate or biserrate; upper surface bright or deep green, somewhat flexuose, glandular-pilose to hispid; lower surface pale green, reticulate-venose, the veins pilose or hirsute with gland-tipped hairs, interspaces glabrous or glandular-puber-ulous; petioles 7-35 mm, villous or tomentose with glandular hairs. Inflorescence composed of 1-2(-3) pairs of 6-28-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.4-15 cm, the pedicels 1-4 cm; cyme bracts usually absent. Sepals green or olive green, ovate, 2.5-5.5 x 1.7-3.8 mm at anthesis, acute or slightly acuminate, externally glandular-hirsute or hispid, internally glandular-puberulous or glandular-papillose. Corolla type V, bright yellow or lemon yellow (the upper lip always paler when dried), unspotted; upper lip 3-6 x 6-9 mm; lower lip 10-18 x 8-12 mm, saccate in 50-70% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1; anthers buff to light brown, glabrous, 2.2-3.5 mm, the thecae divaricate; filaments 0.8-1.5 mm. Style 1.5-2.8 mm, distally somewhat decurved. Capsule broadly ovoid, 47 mm long, shortly glandular-hirsute to glabrous.

description: Scandent subshrub or vine, the stems 1-3 m long, the branches divaricate; inflorescence and stems glabrous, dark reddish-brown. Leaves decussate; blades herbaceous, ovate, 3.5-7.3 x 2.8-4.8 cm, acuminate, cordate at base, the margins sharply biserrate; upper surface dark green, smooth, sparsely pilose; lower surface pale green, reticulate-venose, the major veins pilose or tomentose with white hairs, interspaces yellowish-glandular, glabrous or pilose; petioles 5-30 mm, puberulous or pilose, proximally dilated and connate across the node with a villous flap. Inflorescence composed of 2-3 pairs of 4-16-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.7-5.5 cm, the pedicels 0.5-2.2 cm; cyme bracts present (sometimes absent in the uppermost cyme pair). Sepals ovate, yellow-green, (3.8-)5.7-7.5 x (2.2-)4-5.5 mm at anthesis, acute, minutely glandular-puberulous on both sides, the margins short-ciliate. Corolla type II, white or very pale yellow, unspotted or with red dots in the sides of the throat; upper lip 2-4 x 3-4 mm; lower lip saccate in 30-40% of length, the upcurved portion 11-16 x 6-10 mm; elaiophore present. Stamens type 3; anthers pale grayish-brown, glabrous, 2.8-3.4 mm, the thecae somewhat sigmoid, divaricate or slightly ascending; filaments 1.2-1.5 mm. Style 2.1-3.1 mm, decurved at apex. Capsule conic, 5-7 mm long, ± acuminate, puberulous.

description: Vine, 2-4 m long, the branches divaricate; inflorescence and distal parts of stems minutely purplish-puberulous. Leaves with blades herbaceous, lanceolate, 4.8-6 x 1.3-1.8 cm, acute, attenuate at base, on both sides puberulous and beset with hyaline sessile glands, the margins serrate; upper surface dull green, smooth or shallowly rugose; lower surface pale green, reticulate-venose; petioles puberulous, 3-8 mm. Inflorescence diffuse and intercalary, composed of 1-3 pairs of 1-4-flowered cymes on peduncles 0.8-3.2 cm long; cyme bracts present; pedicels 1.1-2 cm. Sepals unequal, green, turning red, thin, minutely puberulous on both surfaces; the dorsal sepal largest, cordiform, slightly acuminate, 10-13 x 9.2-11 mm at anthesis, the other ones slightly shorter and much narrower. Corolla type IV, light yellow, unspotted, externally densely beset with minute short-stalked or sessile glands; upper lip flattened, 4-6 mm high and 12-18 mm wide; lower lip 16-18 mm high and wide, saccate in 40-50% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1 but with the thecae flattened and almost circular (whence name); anthers dark brown, glabrous, 2.5-3.3 mm; filaments 1.8-2 mm. Style almost straight, 3.1-3.3 mm. Capsule not seen at maturity.

description: Ascending herb, 0.2-1 m tall, sometimes scandent and up to 4 m long; stems and peduncles hispid or spreading villous (sometimes merely puberulous) with white hairs (often turning purple in exposure). Leaves with blades triangular to ovate, ± confluent with wide-winged petiole, 2.2-8 x 2.5-6.8 cm, acute or subacute at apex, usually cuneate at base (sometimes truncate, rarely somewhat cordate), the margins lobulate-serrate; upper surface bright to deep green, somewhat flexuose or rugose, pilose; lower surface pale green, sometimes purplish, puberulous or short-villous; petioles broadly winged, 1-3.5 cm long, 2-7.3 cm wide at base, (0.5-)1-5.4 cm at the distal end, the margins regularly serrate (never lobulate). Inflorescence intercalary, composed of 1-4 pairs of (2-)4-20-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 4.8-18 cm long; cyme bracts 1.3-5.1 x 0.7-3.4 cm, subordinate bracts absent; pedicels 1.5-5.5 cm, villous or hispid with whitish hairs unequal in length, the shorter ones glanduliferus. Sepals ovate to lanceolate, bright light green, acuminate, 7.5-13 x 3.6-7.3(-11) mm at anthesis, externally pilose or puberulous, internally puberulous or subglabrous, the margins ciliate, usually entire, sometimes denticulate. Corolla type I, light to bright yellow, unspotted, the upper lip 5-10 x 5-12 mm, the lower lip 15-33 x 13-23 mm, saccate in 65-80% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 10; anthers light to medium brown, glabrous, 3-4.6 mm, dehiscing to the connective, the thecae somewhat ascending, obovoid, unequal; filaments 0.5-1.3 (-2.0) mm. Style 4.2-6.7 mm, decurved at apex, otherwise straight. Capsule globose to ovoid, sometimes acuminate, 4-7 mm long, hirsute to puberulous with glandular hairs. 2n = 36 (Løjtnant & Molau 15186, 15194).

description: Erect or ascending herb, 5-50 cm tall, the stems and inflorescence pilose with at least some of the hairs gland-tipped. Leaves petiolate; blades ovate, 0.9-4.5(-5.8) x 0.6-2.8(-4.2) cm, acute to almost obtuse, rounded and often somewhat dimidiate at base, pilose on both sides, the margins crenate or serrate; petioles 1-13 mm. Inflorescence with pedicels 0.5-2 cm, ± straight. Sepals green, elliptic to ovate, 1.7-4 x 1.8-3.6 mm at anthesis, subacute, externally sparsely pilose, internally glabrous, the margins ciliate, entire. Corolla close to type X, light yellow, the throat with a reddish crossband or a series of two to several spots in the throat; upper lip arched, 2-4 x 35 mm, strongly acuminate and tapering to an abruptly truncate apex 1-2 mm wide; lower lip 4-9 x 4-8 mm, saccate in 40-60% of its length; elaiophore present. Stamens with anthers elliptic, yellow, 0.5-0.9 mm long; filaments filiform, 1.4-2.5 mm. Style 1.2-2 mm, straight, decurved near apex. Capsule conical, acuminate, 4-7 mm long, glandular-pilose, greenish-white, thin-walled, slightly translucent. 2n = 36 (Løjtnant & Molau 15185).

description: Erect or ascending shrub, 1-2 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems glandular-hirsute or -villous with huffish-white hairs. Leaves with blades ovate, 6.8-13 x 2-4.7 cm, acute, rounded at base, the margins irregularly sharp-serrate; upper surface dark green or deep olive green, almost smooth, hirsute; lower surface paler, somewhat brownish tinged, ± reticulate-venose, the midrib densely hirsute, other veins ± sparsely hirsute; petioles 8-22 mm, villous or hirsute. Inflorescence composed of a single pair of 4-16-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 3.4-7.4 cm, the pedicels 1.5-3.8 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals bright green, externally often purplish at base and margins, lanceolate, acuminate or caudate, 7.8-13 x 4-6.4 mm at anthesis, externally hirsute, internally glabrous except for a shortly glandular-tomentose border along the margins. Corolla type I, golden yellow to deep yellow, the upper lip 510 x 8-12 mm, the lower lip obovate, 23-31 x 15-22 mm, saccate in 60-70% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1; anthers buff or yellow-brown, 5.6-6.6 mm, dehiscing throughout (though ± constricted at the connective), glabrous, the thecae unequal; filaments 2-2.4 mm. Style 5.3-6.7 mm, ± arcuate, decurved near apex. Capsule brownish-purple, ovoid, slightly acuminate, 7-9 mm long, glandular-puberulous. 2n = 36 (Molau 909, new record).

description: Erect or ascending subshrub, 0.5-2 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems hirsute or pilose with short, glandular, ascending, buffish-olivaceous hairs. Leaves sessile; blades lanceolate or narrowly elliptic, subcoriaceous, 4.8-15 x 1-2.9 cm, acute or subacute at apex, rounded and clasping at base, the margins denticulate, ± strongly revolute, often seemingly entire; upper surface bright to olive green, pilose, glutinous, somewhat rugose; lower surface pinnate-venose, lanate with coarse, whitish hairs. Inflorescence composed of two or three pairs of 8-16-flowered cymes; primary peduncles 1.7-6.7 cm; pedicels 0.5-3 cm; cyme bracts absent or rudimentary. Sepals ovate to triangular, olivaceous to light green, 2.5-6.4 x 1.9-5.7 mm at anthesis, acute or slightly acuminate, mucronulate, externally glandular-papillose. Corolla type V, bright or deep yellow, unspotted, the upper lip 4-6 x 6-10 mm, the lower lip 11-16 x 9-14 mm, saccate in 4555% of length; elaiophore present, but less dense and possibly non-functional. Stamens type 2 (thecae subglobose); anthers light brown to chestnut, 2.4-3 mm, papillose; filaments curved inwards, 1.6-2.8 mm. Style slightly arcuate, 2-4.3 mm. Capsule ovoid, 4-5 mm long, shortly glandular-hirsute. In = 36 (Molau & Öhman 1180, 1219, 1232).

description: Erect or ascending herb, 0.5-1.2 m tall, often ± woody at base; inflorescence and distal parts of stems glandular-hirsute and densely glandular-puberulous. Leaves sessile; blades herbaceous, lanceolate to oblong, 5-14 x 1.5-5 cm, acute and somewhat attenuate at apex, cordate to truncate and clasping at base, the margins dentate or sharp-serrate, flat to deflexed; upper surface olive green, glandular-pilose and ± densely glandular-puberulous, slightly rugose; lower surface pale green, reticulate-venose, glandular-pilose to -villous. Inflorescence composed of two or three pairs of 12-20-flowered cymes on primary peduncles 1.8-9.8 cm long; pedicels 0.7-2.5 cm; cyme bracts absent. Sepals olivaceous, triangular, 2.8-4.6 x 2.1-3.1 mm at anthesis, acute, mucronate, externally glandular-hirsute and glandular-puber-ulous. Corolla type XIV, bright yellow, usually with red dots in the throat; upper lip 3-5 x 68 mm; lower lip obovate, somewhat flattened, ± pendent, 11-17 x 9-12 mm, saccate in 35-50% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 5; anthers yellow brown, 2.2-3.3 mm across, glabrous; thecae 1.3-1.9 mm long, somewhat deflexed; filaments 0.8-1.1 mm. Style arcuate, (2-)2.5-3.5 mm. Capsule ovoid, 4-6 mm long, glandular-puberulous.

description: Ascending or scandent subshrub or vine, 0.3-1.5 m tall, the branches divaricate or ascending; inflorescence and distal parts of stems reddish-brown, pilose to hispid with white glandless hairs. Leaves with blades herbaceous, lanceolate or narrowly elliptic, 3.7-11 x 0.8-3.3 cm, acute, cuneate or attenuate at base, the margins deflexed, serrulate or subentire; upper surface deep green, white-pilose and with sessile orange glands, the primary and secondary veins impressed; lower surface pale green, predominantly pinnate-venose (tertiary veins remote), the veins hirsute, interspaces glandular and ± sparsely pilose; petioles pilose, 2-10 mm. Inflorescence distal, composed of 2-4 pairs of (l-)4-8(-24)-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 2.3-19 cm, the pedicels 0.7-3.7 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals pale green to light yellow-green, subequal, ovate, acuminate or caudate, externally glandular and short-hispid with white hairs, internally glabrous except for a short-tomentose border along the margins, the margins ciliate; dorsal sepal 5.5-8.6 x 3.4-6.4 mm at anthesis. Corolla type XII, bright yellow, unspotted, the upper lip 2-3 x 35 mm, the lower lip 9-13 x 7-10 mm, saccate in 50-60% of length; elaiophore present (sometimes reduced in dept. Cuzco), deflexed rather than infolded. Stamens type 1; anthers buff, glabrous, 1.8-2.6 mm, the thecae equal; filaments 0.6-1.2 mm. Style 1.6-2.2 mm, straight, deflexed at apex. Capsule ovoid, brownish, 4-8 mm long, glandular-puberulous. 2n = 36 (Molau 809, new record).

description: Erect or ascending herb, 0.1-2 m tall, the stems often rather succulent. Leaves petiolate; blades ovate in inclusive outline, (2.2-)5.5-25 x (1.4)- 4-19 cm, pinnatifid (rarely lobate), usually dissected to the midrib or somewhat less with 2-4(-5) pairs of lateral pinnae, the pinnae often somewhat deflexed, the margins serrate or biserrate, in large blades laciniate-serrate; petioles 1.3-12 cm long, narrowly winged and 2-6 mm wide, proximally dilated and connate across the nodes with conspicuous wings 2-11 mm wide. Inflorescence of vigorous specimens with primary peduncles (3.2-)7.3-23 cm long; pedicels 0.8-6.2 cm. Sepals ovate, green, often suffused with purple, 3-6.7 x 1.6-4.6 mm at anthesis, acuminate, the margins ± dentate. Corolla type X, pale to bright yellow, unspotted, the upper lip 2-4 mm long and wide, the lower lip 6-17 x 4-15 mm, saccate in 80-90% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens with anthers 1.2-4.5 mm long, the posterior theca fertile, whitish, conspicuously (though shortly) stalked, 0.4-1.5 mm long, the anterior theca sterile and vestigial; connective yellow, without dorsal tooth, the lower connective arm 0.6-2.3(-3) mm long, flat, spathulate or lingulate, straight, sometimes decurved at apex; filaments 0.3-1.1 mm. Style arcuate, 0.7-2.3(-3.1) mm. Capsule pale green to purplish, conic, acute or slightly acuminate, 5-9 mm long, pilose to hirsute with glandular hairs. In = 64 (Lejtnant & Molau 11264, Molau 597), In = ca. 64 (Lojtnant & Molau 11348). (Earlier reports of In = 60 may be erroneous, cf. C. tenuis.)

description: Scandent herb, 0.2-0.7 m tall; inflorescence and stems hirsute or villous with gland-tipped hairs. Leaves decussate or (rarely) ternate, cymesubtending leaves often subsessile, other leaves distinctly petiolate; blades herbaceous, ovate, 1.8-9.6 x 1.7-7 cm, acute, broadly cuneate to rounded or truncate at base, the margins serrate or bicrenate; upper surface bright green, pilose, flexuose; lower surface pale green, pinnate-venose, pilose, glandless; petioles 5-17 mm, short-villous with white hairs. Inflorescence composed of one or two pairs of 6-24-flowered cymes (often only one of the cymes of the terminal pair developed); primary peduncles 3-17 cm; pedicels 0.4-1.5 cm; cyme bracts absent. Sepals ovate, green, 2-3.5 x 1.6-2.4 mm at anthesis, acute or subacute, externally hirsute or villous with gland-tipped hairs, internally glabrous, the margins short-ciliate. Corolla type XI, bright yellow, with red-brown spots in the throat and dorsally on the lower lip around the orifice; upper lip subglobose, 2-3 x 3-4 mm; lower lip obovate, flattened, projecting, distally crenate, 8-12 x 6-10 mm, saccate in 70-80% of length; elaiophore present (though with the glands ± unevenly dispersed). Stamens with anthers buff or pale brown, glabrous, 2.1-3 mm, the upper (posterior) theca fertile, the lower (anterior) theca sterile and reduced to a fusiform lever (sometimes slightly fertile); filaments 0.5-1.5 mm. Style 2.7-3.7 mm, decurved at apex. Capsule ovoid, 3-6 mm long, often slightly acuminate, shortly glandular-hirsute, purplish-green.

description: Robust herb, 0.5-1 m tall, erect or ascending; stems and inflorescence velutinous with brown or yellow-brown hairs. Leaves sessile; blades herbaceous, elliptic or narrowly elliptic, 4-17 x 1.5-7 cm, acute, cuneate at base, the margins serrate (though ± revolute and seemingly crenate), entire in the proximal third; upper surface yellow-green, velutinous, flexuose; lower surface light brownish-green to yellow-green, reticulate-venose, the major veins velutinous, interspaces pilose or villose with gland-tipped hairs. Inflorescence composed of 1 (or 2) pairs of 12-62-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 8.5-17 cm long, the pedicels 0.5-1.8 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals greenish-yellow, triangular or lanceolate, entire, 5.3-6.2 x 2.5-3.2 mm at anthesis, acute, slightly caudate, externally glandular-pilose, internally glandular-puberulous. Corolla type VI, deep yellow, unspotted; upper lip 5-7 x 8-10 mm; lower lip 10-14 x 8-11 mm, saccate in 30-40% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type I; anthers light brown, glabrous, 2.8-3 mm, the thecae equal, divaricate; filaments 0.7-1 mm. Style 2-2.5 mm, straight or slightly curved. Capsule subglobose, brownish, 5-7 mm long, glandular-tomentose. 2n = 36 (Løjtnant, Molau & Madison 12316, cf. Molau, 1980b: 363).

description: Scandent or scrambling herb, branched only at the base, the branches stout, (0.5-) 1-4 m long, spreading or pendent; stems and peduncles hispid with white hairs turning purple in exposure, sparsely glandular. Leaves with blades triangular or triangular-ovate, rather thick, (4-)5.2-12 (-16) x 3.2-10 cm, acute at apex, cordate at base (rarely almost truncate in Peruvian specimens), the margins deflexed, irregularly crenate or biserrate; upper surface deep green, rugose or bullate, pilose; lower surface pale grayish-green, pilose to lanate with coarse white hairs; petioles 2-9.4 cm long, 1.8-5.6 cm wide at base, 0.4-1.8(-3.5) cm at the distal end, the margins deflexed, serrulate, crenulate, or subentire. Inflorescence intercalary, composed of 1-3 pairs of 6-24-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 5.729 cm long; pedicels hispid or villous, 2-6 cm long (all pedicels of a cyme almost equal in length); cyme bracts 2.6-9.2 x 1.9-6.8 cm, subordinate bracts absent. Sepals ovate, yellow to bright greenish-yellow, acuminate and slightly caudate, 13-19 x 7.8-12 mm at anthesis, externally pilose, internally pilose or puberulous, the margins ciliate, entire or denticulate (often dentate in Peruvian specimens). Corolla type VII, bright yellow, unspotted, the upper lip 7-12 x 8-16 mm, the lower lip inflated, 17-30 x 13-22 mm, saccate in 60-70% of length; elaiophore present, well-developed. Stamens type 7; anthers medium or pale brown, 3.5-5 mm long, glabrous, the thecae divaricate, equal or subequal, slightly arcuate, flaring at maturity; filaments 1.9-3.2 mm. Style 4.8-7.5 mm long, somewhat decurved at apex, otherwise straight. Capsule ovoid, 5-8 mm long, white-villous. 2n = 36 (Harling et al. 15046).

description: Subshrub or low shrubby plant, the stems ascending or erect, 0.2-0.7(-l) m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems shortly glandular-hirsute with hyaline or whitish hairs. Leaves decussate or (in ca. 30% of the investigated specimens) ternate, short-petiolate; blades lanceolate to elliptic (sometimes ovate), coriaceous or subcoriaceous, 1-3 x 0.2-0.8(-l.3) cm, obtuse to subacute, truncate or slightly cordate at base, the margins revolute, crenate, crenulate, or denticulate, rarely entire; upper surface olive green to deep green, shortly glandular-hirsute to glabrescent, often ± pruinose, ± flexuose; lower surface light green, pinnate-venose with prominent midrib, glabrous or (usually) shortly glandular-hirsute; petioles 1-2 mm, glandular-hirsute. Inflorescence composed of 1-3 pairs or triplets of 1-8-flowered cymes; primary peduncles 0.5-4.8 cm; pedicels 0.5-1.7(-3) cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals olivaceous, yellow-green or lemon yellow, 2.3-5.3(-7.6) x 1.2-3.5(-4.5) mm at anthesis, acute, externally shortly glandular-hirsute, internally glabrous, the margins entire. Corolla type XI, light yellow or lemon yellow, the lower lip white or pale yellow below, internally with one or two purple or wine-red crossbands or bands of spots in the throat; upper lip 2-5 x 2-6 mm; lower lip obovate or elliptic, flattened, projecting, 9-22(-27) x 7-16(-20) mm, saccate in 70-80% of length, elaiophore present. Stamens type 9; anthers yellowish-white to light buff, 2.1-4.1 (5.2) mm, the thecae subequal or unequal, dehiscing to the connective, divaricate or slightly ascending; filaments 0.6-1.5 mm. Style decurved, somewhat fleshy, 1.4-3.3(-4) mm. Capsule narrowly conical, 4-7 mm long, brownish or purplish, glandular-hirsute.

description: Chasmophyte; caespitose herb forming dense cushions 1-3 cm high and 3-10 cm diam. Leaves with blades lanceolate to elliptic, 8-13 x 4-8 mm, acute or subacute, attenuate at base, the margins entire, revolute; upper surface densely silvery white sericeous, smooth; lower surface silvery white sericeous, becoming subglabrous with age, pinnate-venose; petioles indistinct, 35 mm long, sericeous. Inflorescence restricted to solitary erect peduncles 3.5-17 cm long (i.e., one cyme of each pair inhibited, see Andersson & Molau, 1980: 29), the cymes 4-12-flowered, asymmetric due to one-sided inhibition; cyme bracts present; pedicels 1.6-3.2 cm, glandular-villous. Sepals ovate to almost lanceolate, olive green, 4-4.7 x 1.5-3.6 mm at anthesis, acute or subacute, externally loosely sericeous, internally glabrous. Corolla type XI, golden yellow, externally with a red-dotted and densely short-sericeous area on the lower lip just below the orifice, the throat white with a dense pattern of deep red dots; upper lip slightly acuminate to a rounded and shallowly emarginate apex, 3-4 x 5-7 mm; lower lip projecting, obovate, flattened and somewhat concave dorsally, 10-13 x 7-15 mm, distally slightly 5-lobulate, saccate in 70-80% of length; elaiophore present, the infolded lobe densely sericeous. Stamens type 1; anthers purple, glabrous, 1.7-2.1 mm, the thecae divaricate; filaments 1.3-1.6 mm, curved outwards at apex. Style purple, ± straight, 2.1-2.6 mm. Capsule conic, slightly acuminate, pale brown, 4-6 mm long, minutely glandular-puberulous. Seeds colliculate to almost reticulate-foveate (the cells globose to almost collapsed). 2n = 36 (Molau & Öhman 1812, new record).

description: Low shrubby plant, at least 25 cm tall, the internodes short; inflorescence and distal parts on stems glandular-hirsute with coarse, purplish to brownish, septate hairs. Leaves with blades subcoriaceous, elliptic or lanceolate, 2.7-3.7 x 1-1.4 cm, obtuse or subacute at apex, cuneate or attenuate at base, the margins revolute, lobulate or deeply crenate; upper surface olive green, glabrous, bullate, glutinous; lower surface densely white-lanate; petioles 5-10 mm, coarsely grayish-villous. Inflorescence composed of at least one pair of 12-20-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 2.5-4.2 cm, the pedicels 0.7-1.7 cm; cyme bracts small (less than 5 mm long). Sepals ovate, olivaceous, 4-5.2 x 1.9-2.6 mm at anthesis, acute, externally glandular-pilose, internally glandular-puberulous, the margins entire. Corolla type III, yellow, probably with a purplish spot in the throat, the upper lip 2-3 x 3-4 mm, the lower lip saccate in 40-50% of length, its upcurved portion 6-8 x 4-6 mm; elaiophore present. Stamens type 1; anthers yellowish-white, glabrous, 2.2-2.4 mm, dehiscing throughout, the thecae divaricate, equal or subequal; filaments 0.5-0.8 mm. Style 1.7-1.9 mm, slightly arcuate. Capsule ovoid, 3-4 mm long, shortly glandular-pilose, ± suffused with purple.

description: Erect shrub, 0.6-2 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems minutely glandular-puber-ulous and strongly glutinous. Leaves with blades linear to narrowly elliptic, 2.5-6.4 x 0.3-0.8 cm, acute or subacute, attenuate at base; upper surface deep bright green, glandular or glandular-puberulous, the midrib sunken, otherwise smooth; lower surface pale green, subglabrous or shortly glandular-puberulous, hyphodromous; petioles 1-4 mm, glandular. Inflorescence composed of 2-4 pairs of 1- or 2-flowered cymes, the peduncles 1-2.3 cm, the pedicels 0.7-1.8(-2.3) cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals light yellow-green, ovate, deflexed, 4.5-7.4 x 4.5-5.8 mm, acute or subacute, externally glandular-puberulous and strongly glutinous, internally glandular-puberulous to almost glabrous. Corolla type II (but with the distal part of lower lip less up-curved), bright yellow with crossbands of red spots in sides of throat and on lower side of lower lip; upper lip 2-4 x 3-6 mm, subglobose; lower lip 12-21 x 7-13 mm, saccate in 40-50% of length, the sac projecting; elaiophore present, green. Stamens type 11; anthers buff or light brown, 3.0-3.9 mm, the thecae slightly ascending; filaments 0.6-1.1 mm. Style 1.7-2.3 mm, somewhat decurved at apex. Capsule ovoid, 46 mm long, brown or purplish-brown, glandular-puberulous. In = 36 (Molau & Solomon 646, new record).

description: Scandent shrub; stems 0.5-3 m long, much branched, the branches divaricate; inflorescence and distal parts of stems puberulous with purplish to pale huffish hairs. Leaves with blades herbaceous, elliptic, 2.2-5 x 1.2-1.6 cm, acute, attenuate at base, the margins serrate; upper surface deep green, slightly flexuose, minutely pilose; lower surface pale green, reticulate-venose, the midrib puberulous, otherwise glabrous; petioles puberulous, 3-7 mm. Inflorescence distal, diffuse, composed of 1 or 2 pairs of 1-4-flowered cymes on peduncles 0.7-3 cm long; cyme bracts present; pedicels 0.7-1.8 cm. Sepals unequal, light green, often suffused with purple, acute, glabrous or minutely puberulous on both surfaces; the dorsal sepal largest, cordiform, 5-7.7 x 5.9-7.7 mm at anthesis, the other ones narrower. Corolla type V, light yellow, unspotted, the upper lip sometimes almost white, 3-5 x 5-6 mm, the lower lip 8-15 x 6-8 mm, saccate in 30-40% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 1; anthers buff to medium brown, glabrous, 2.1-2.9 mm, the thecae equal; filaments 1-1.5 mm. Style 3.3-4.5 mm, slightly curved distally. Capsule ovoid, brownish, 5-6 mm long, puberulous.

description: Scandent or ascending perennial herb, vine, or subshrub, 0.2-1 m high when self-supporting, 14 m high when scandent; inflorescence and distal parts of stems ± purplish, hirsute or villous with white hairs. Leaves decussate, rarely ternate; blades herbaceous, ovate, 1.4-7.5(-10) x 0.9-5(-6.6) cm, acute or slightly acuminate, cordate at base, the margins biserrate, ± deflexed; upper surface bright to deep green, slightly flexuose, tomentose on the major veins, otherwise pilose; lower surface pale green or whitish-green, reticulate-venose, the major veins villous or lanate with white hairs, interspaces glandular and puberulous to lanate; petioles 7-35(-48) mm, villous, dilated at base. Inflorescence composed of 2-4 pairs of 8-32-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.5-8.2 cm, the pedicels 0.8-3.5 cm; cyme bracts present (sometimes absent in the uppermost cyme pair). Sepals ovate, very light green to light yellow, 5.6-11 x 3.8-7.7 mm at anthesis, externally short-villous, internally minutely glandular-puberulous. Corolla type II, bright yellow or sulphur yellow, usually with red dots in the sides of the throat, the throat deep yellow inside; upper lip 3-6 x 3-7 mm; lower lip saccate in 30-40% of length, the upcurved portion 12-19 x 7-14 mm; elaiophore present. Stamens type 3; anthers light yellow to light brown, 2.5-3.8 mm, glabrous, the thecae sigmoid, slightly ascending; filaments 1.4-2.4 mm. Style 2.5-4.2 mm, distally decurved. Capsule ovoid, 5-7 mm long, puberulous to hirsute with gland-tipped hairs. 2n = 36 (Molau 884, 917, new record).

description: Ascending or scandent subshrub, 0.6-2 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems puberulous to tomentose with white hairs. Leaves ternate (very rarely decussate); blades herbaceous, ovate, 4-9.6 x 2-6.3 cm, acute, rounded or slightly cordate at base, the margins biserrate; upper surface deep green, slightly bullate, ± densely puberulous; lower surface pale green or whitish-green, coarsely reticulate-venose to almost pinnate-venose, white-puberulous (exposed sites) to white arachnoid-lanate (sheltered sites), sessile-glandular; petioles 5-26 mm, white-tomentose. Inflorescence composed of 2-4 triplets of 8-16-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.6-4.8 cm, the pedicels 0.8-1.8 cm; cyme bracts present (though usually absent in the uppermost cymes). Sepals ovate, light yellow-green, 5.2-11 x 4-7.4 mm at anthesis, subacute, puberulous on both sides. Corolla type II, bicolorous, unspotted, the upper lip 3-7 x 5-10 mm, light yellow, the lower lip white in the proximal half, sulphur yellow in the distal half, saccate in 50-60% of length, the upcurved portion 14-21 x 10-17 mm; elaiophore present. Stamens type 3; anthers orange or deep yellow, glabrous, 2.6-4(-5.4) mm, the thecae ± sigmoid, divaricate or slightly ascending; filaments 1.3-2.6 mm. Style 2.3-4.7 mm, decurved at apex. Capsule ovoid, 5-7 mm long, slightly acuminate, glandular-papillose, ± purplish tinged. 2n = 36 (Srinath, 1939: 106).

description: Frutex vel suffrutex scandens, ad 1 m altus, caulibus arachnoideo-lanatis pilis albidis. Folia decussata, breviter petiolata; lamina herbacea, elliptica, 8.8-10 x 2.5-3 cm, obtusa, ad basin rotundata vel cuneata, supra puberula, infra arachnoideo-lanata pilis albis, marginibus inte-gris; petioli 6-8 mm, lanati. Inflorescentia dis-talis, arachnoideo-lanata, singula paria cymarum 24-28 florum complectens, pedunculis 3.4-3.7 cm longis; bracteae cymarum desunt. Sepala sub-acuta, 4.3-4.6 x 2.3-3 mm sub anthesi, extra arachnoideo-lanata, intra glanduloso-puberulo-sa, marginibus integris. Corolla flava, fauce rubromaculata, labio superiore acuminato, 5-6 x 8-10 mm, labio inferiore pendente, applanato, 18-22 x 11-13 mm, orificio exposito; elaeophorus adest, rudimentalis. Antherae fuscae, 1.82.1 mm, glabrae, totae dehiscentes; thecae sub-globosae, aequales, divaricatae; filamenta ca. 1.5 mm longa. Stylus rectus, 3.4-3.8 mm. Capsula ovoidea, ca. 5 mm longa, glanduloso-lanata.

description: Scandent shrub or subshrub, to 1 m tall; stems and inflorescence densely arachnoid-lanate with huffish-white hairs. Leaves decussate, short-petiolate; blade herbaceous, elliptic, 8.8-10 x 2.53 cm, obtuse at apex, rounded or cuneate at base, the margins entire, flattened or slightly deflexed; upper surface smooth, bright green, puberulous; lower surface pinnate-venose, arachnoid-lanate with white hairs; petiole arachnoid-lanate, 6-8 mm. Inflorescence distal, composed of a single pair of24-28-flowered cymes, the peduncles 3.4-3.7 cm; cyme bracts absent; pedicels 0.7-1.5 cm. triangular, subacute, entire, 4.3-4.6 x 2.33 mm at anthesis, externally white arachnoid-lanate, internally yellow-green, glandular-pu-berulous. Corolla type XV, yellow, the throat red-spotted inside; upper lip acuminate, 5-6 x 8-10 mm; lower lip pendent, 18-22 x 11-13 mm, saccate in 50-60% of its length; elaiophore present but small and ± rudimentary. Stamens type 2 (or almost type 4), light brown, 1.8-2.1 mm, glabrous, dehiscing throughout, the thecae equal, divaricate or slightly ascending, subglobose; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long. Style straight, 3.4-3.8 mm. Capsule ovoid, ca. 5 mm long, finely whitish-lanate with glandular hairs.

description: Subshrub, 0.3-1 m tall, forming dense stands, the stems erect or ascending; inflorescence and distal parts of stems hirsute or spreading-villous with white glandular hairs. Leaves decussate, short-petiolate on the main stems, sessile or subsessile on lateral shoots; blades herbaceous (subcoriaceous in high altitude specimens), triangular or narrowly triangular, sometimes lanceolate, 1.0-4.4	x 0.3-2.3 cm, obtuse, cordate at base, the margins grossly crenate, deflexed or revolute; upper surface bright green, somewhat flexuose, white-hirsute; lower surface pale green, reticulate-venose, the major veins white-hirsute, interspaces glabrous; petioles (when present) 1-5 mm, white-hirsute. Inflorescence composed of 13 pairs of (2-)4-12-flowered cymes; primary peduncles 1.2-6.0 cm; pedicels 0.8-3.1 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals light green to bright yellow-green, 5.1-7.2 x 3.6-5.9 mm at anthesis, obtuse, externally shortly glandular-pilose or glandular-puberulous, internally sparsely glandular-puberulous, the margins entire. Corolla type II, sulphur yellow or bright yellow, unspotted; upper lip subglobose, emarginate, 3-4 x 4-5 mm; lower lip inflated, distally ± upcurved, 15-25 x 10-16 mm, saccate in 55-65% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 9; anthers pale to medium brown, 4.1-5.7 mm, the thecae unequal, divaricate or somewhat ascending, dehiscing distally almost to the connective or less; filaments 0.8-1.5 mm. Style decurved at apex, otherwise straight, 3-4.8 mm. Capsule ovoid, 6-8 mm long, glandular-puberulous or sparsely glandular-hirsute. 2n = 36 (Molau & Solomon 650, new record).

description: Frutex, 0.4-1 m altus, caulibus villosis pilis fuscis. Folia alternata, fasciculata, subsessilia, 815 x 1.1-2 mm, tomentosa, marginibus integris, revolutis. Inflorescentia diffusa, subterminalis. Sepala ovata, flavovirentia, subacuta, 3.5-5.1 x 2.2-3.3 mm sub anthesi, extra tomentosa, intra villosa, marginibus integris. Corolla lutea vel vivide flava, fauce punctis rubris, fasciam trans-versam efficientibus, labio inferiore ascendente, 13-20 x 7-10 mm, elaeophoro nullo. Antherae fuscae, glabrae, 2.2-3 mm, totae dehiscentes; thecae deflexae, aequales, 1.4-2.3 mm. Stylus arcuatus vel paene rectus, 2.9-4 mm. Capsula ovoides, villosa, 4-6 mm longa.

description: Erect or ascending shrub, 0.4-1 m tall; stems villous with brownish hairs mixed with short glandular hairs; inflorescence yellowish hirsute. Leaves acute, 8-15 x 1.1-2 mm, olive-green, tomentose or short-villous with whitish hairs, the margins entire. Inflorescence composed of 12-flowered cymes; pedicels 0.5-1.1 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals ovate, light yellow-green, 3.5-5.1 x 2.2-3.3 mm at anthesis, subacute, externally short-tomentose, internally villous. Corolla type XIV, bright to deep yellow, with a cross-zone of red or maroon dots in the orifice just below the anthers; upper lip 3-5 x 4-7 mm; lower lip 13-20 x 7-10 mm, saccate in 20-30% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 5; anthers medium brown, 2.2-3 mm across, the thecae deflexed, each one 1.4-2.3 mm; filaments 1.6-2.2 mm. Style somewhat arcuate to almost straight, 2.9-4.0 mm. Capsule ovoid, 4-6 mm long, brown, villous.

description: Ascending or scandent herb, 0.5-1.5 m tall; inflorescence and distal parts of stems pilose, villous, or hirsute with white hairs. Leaves decussate; blades herbaceous, ovate, 2-6.8 x 1.5-3.6 cm, acute, cordate at base, the margins biserrate; upper surface bright to deep green, flexuose, pilose or villous; lower surface pale green, reticulate-venose, the major veins villous or tomentose, the interspaces glabrous, pilose, or villous, conspicuously glandular; petioles 12-30 mm, villous. Inflorescence composed of 1-3 pairs of 4-8-flowered cymes, the primary peduncles 1.5-4.3 cm, pedicels 1-2.4 cm. Sepals ovate or elliptic, light green, often suffused with purple, (3.5-)4.8-8 x (2.8-)3.4-5 mm at anthesis, acute, externally villous, internally glandular-papillose. Corolla type XV, white (rarely yellowish-white), mostly unspotted, sometimes with purple dots in the sides of the throat; upper lip 3-6 x 4-7 mm; lower lip 10-17 x 8-13 mm, saccate in 2535% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 6; anthers yellow brown or light brown, glabrous, 2.4-3.4 mm across, the thecae sharply deflexed, each one 1.6-2.5 mm long; filaments 1.2-2 mm. Style slightly arcuate, 4.5-6.8 mm long. Capsule ovoid, 5-6 mm long, glandular-hirsute.

description: Low shrubby plant, 10-50 cm tall, the stems erect or ascending; inflorescence and distal parts of stems purplish and puberulous or tomentose with white hairs. Leaves decussate, ± fasciculate; blades herbaceous or subcoriaceous, ovate, 7-14(-23) x 5-10(-16) mm, obtuse or subacute at apex, truncate or slightly cordate at base, the margins deflexed, crenate or bluntly serrate, with 6-7 teeth on each side of leaf; upper surface deep green, flexuose or slightly rugose, glutinous, pilose or puberulous with white hairs; lower surface pale green, pinnate-venose, the veins raised, puberulous or pilose, interspaces glabrous or puberulous, beset with stalked yellowish or orange glands; petioles 2-4(-7) mm, tomentose or villous with white hairs. Inflorescence composed of 2-4 pairs of 1-4-flowered cymes, the peduncles 0.4-2.4 cm, the pedicels 0.5-1.6 cm; cyme bracts mostly absent, sometimes present in lower cymes. Sepals light yellow-green, (2.5-)4-6 x (2.1-) 3.2-4.8 mm at anthesis, obtuse, externally shortly white-hirsute, internally puberulous or subglabrous, the margins densely short-ciliate. Corolla type IX, deep yellow or golden yellow, internally with a crossband of red spots in the throat; upper lip 2-3 mm long, 4-6 mm wide, and 6-11 mm high; lower lip saccate in 45-55% of length, the upcurved portion 10-17 x 8-14 mm. Stamens with anthers light brown, 2.3-3.2 mm, the thecae divaricate; filaments 0.9-1.3 mm. Style 1.5-2 mm long. Capsule ovoid or conical, 5-7 mm long, slightly acuminate, purplish, puberulous or hirsute with white, spreading hairs. 2n = 36 (Molau 602, new record).

description: Erect or ascending low shrubby plant, 0.1-0.5 m high; inflorescence and distal parts of stems silver-white sericeous. Leaves decussate, indistinctly short-petiolate; blades subcoriaceous, ovate or elliptic, 0.8-2(-3) x 0.3-1.2(-l.7) cm, acute, cuneate at base; upper surface sericeous; lower surface white-lanate, the pubescence becoming tufted with age; margins entire, revolute; petioles 1-3 mm, sericeous, ± covered by the pubescence of the stems. Inflorescence composed of a single pair (rarely two pairs) of 2-6-flowered cymes, the peduncles 1-6 cm, the pedicels 1-2.2 cm; cyme bracts present. Sepals 4.2-9 x 2.8-4.5 mm at anthesis, externally densely silver-white sericeous, internally glabrous, light green or light yellow-green, slightly acuminate, the margins entire. Corolla type XI, light yellow, usually with a crossband of wine red-spots in the throat, mostly with some additional spots below, sometimes with no reddish markings at all; upper lip 3-5 x 3-5 mm; lower lip 10-22 x 6-15 mm, saccate in 70-80% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens type 9; anthers yellowish-white, 2.5-3 mm, dehiscing to the connective, the thecae subequal; filaments 0.7-1.5 mm. Style slightly curved, 1.8-3.5 mm. Capsule ovoid, 6-8 mm long, slightly acuminate, puberulous. 2n = 36 (Molau 921, new record).

description: Erect shrub, 1-2 m high, much branched; inflorescence and distal parts of stems glutinous and sparsely pilose. Leaves with blades ovate, 3.2-7.9 x 1.6-3.6 cm, acute, cuneate at base, the margins shallowly serrate; upper surface dark green, smooth, glabrous, strongly glutinous; lower surface whitish-green, pinnate-venose, the midrib sparsely pilose, otherwise glabrous; petioles 6-13 mm, pilose. Inflorescence composed of a single pair of 1-4-flowered cymes, the peduncles 1-5 cm, the pedicels 1.8-4.3 cm; cyme bracts absent or rudimentary. Sepals greenish-yellow, ovate, 8.5-12 x 4.6-6.6 mm at anthesis, acute, externally glabrous or sparsely pilose, glutinous, internally glabrous. Corolla type XIV, bright yellow, the upper lip 4-6 x 6-9 mm, the lower lip 18-23 x 13-15 mm, saccate in ca. 50% of length; elaiophore absent. Stamens type 9; anthers yellow-brown or chestnut, 5.6-6.7 mm, minutely glandular-puberulous, dehiscing to, but not across, the connective, the thecae subequal, arcuate; filaments 2-3.5 mm. Style arcuate, 5-8 mm, decurved near apex. Capsule ovoid, brown, 5-7 mm long, densely glandular-hirsute.

description: Ascending herb, 10-70 cm tall, the stems succulent, light green to purplish. Leaves petiolate; blades ovate to lanceolate, 3-9.5 x 1.2-3.8 cm, acute, cuneate or attenuate at base and ± decurrent, the margins laciniate or lobulate, the lobelets serrate; petioles 0.7-2.8 cm, unwinged. Inflorescence with primary peduncles 3.4-6.7 cm; pedicels 1.5-3.8 cm. Sepals ovate, green, ± suffused with purple, 5.2-7.6 x 3.6-6.2 mm at anthesis, acute, externally short-pilose or sparsely puberulous, internally puberulous, the margins entire or denticulate. Corolla type III, light lemon yellow to bright yellow, unspotted, the throat white in the upper half, deep yellow in the lower half, the upper lip 3-5 mm long and wide, the lower lip 11-17 x 7-12 mm, saccate in 30-40% of its length; elaiophore present. Stamens with anthers orange-yellow, 3.2-4.8 mm, the thecae unequal, almost contiguous, both fertile, the posterior one 1.8-2.6 mm, the anterior one 1.2-2 mm long, the connective very short, without dorsal tooth or with a poorly developed knob; filaments 1.1-1.5 mm. Style curved, 2.6-3.8 mm. Capsule subglobose, 5-7 mm long, light green, ± suffused with purple, sparsely glandular-puberulous. 2n = 32 (Molau 686, 691, new record).

description: Erect or ascending herb, 10-60 cm tall. Leaves petiolate; blades ovate in inclusive outline, 1.3-8.5 x 1-8.2 cm, lobate to deeply (simply) pinnatifid into 1-3 pairs of lateral pinnae, the margins serrate to subentire; petioles 0.5-2 cm long, less than 2 mm wide, connate across the nodes by ridges 0.5-1 mm wide. Inflorescence with primary peduncles (when present) 4-13 cm long, pedicels 1.9-7.1 cm long. Sepals ovate, green, 3.4-6 x 2.5-4.5 mm at anthesis, acute or slightly acuminate, sparsely glandular-puberulous on both sides, the margins entire or denticulate, short-ciliate. Corolla type IX, pale greenish-yellow, unspotted, the upper lip 3-4 x 3-5 mm, the lower lip 14-22 x 11-17 mm, saccate in 8090% of length; elaiophore present. Stamens with anthers orange to yellow, 2.2-3.3 mm long, the thecae subequal (1.2-1.8 mm and 0.8-1.4 mm respectively), divaricate, both fertile, almost contiguous, the connective very short and without dorsal tooth; filaments 0.6-1.4 mm. Style curved, 1-2.2 mm. Capsule ovoid, acuminate, 7-10 mm long, pale green and ± tinged purplish, sparsely glandular-puberulous.
