description: Shrub or small tree; young branches tomentose with crisped brown hairs, becoming glabrous, grey, very rough, with persistent leaf and inflorescence scars, not lenticellate. Not spiny. Leaves spirally arranged, clustered at the branch tips, 4.2-6.2 × 1.8-2.5 cm, elliptic, apex acute or obtuse, base acute or narrowly cuneate, chartaceous, glabrous above, with sparse crisped residual indumentum below; venation eucamptodromous to brochidodromous, with a marginal vein; midrib flat or slightly sunken on the upper surface; secondary veins 8-9 pairs, ascending, parallel and slightly arcuate; intersecondaries short to moderately long; tertiaries reticulate. Petiole 5-9 mm long, not channelled, tomentose at first. Flowers bisexual, mostly below the leaves in the axils of leaf scars, in 2-5-flowered fascicles. Pedicel ca. 1.5 mm long, shortly tomentose. Sepals five, ca. 2.5 mm long, broadly orbicular-ovate, apex rounded, shortly tomentose outside, glabrous inside. Corolla glabrous, ca. 4 mm long, tube ca. 1.5 mm long, lobes five; median segment suborbicular, lateral segments lanceolate or irregular, 1.5-1.75 mm long. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube, glabrous; filaments ca. 1.75 mm long, anthers 0.75-1 mm long, lanceolate, ventrifixed and extrorse in bud. Staminodes five, ca. 1.5 mm long, triangular-ovate with a short stalk, slightly erose, not infolded, glabrous. Ovary slender, gradually tapered above, five-locular, glabrous; style ca. 1.5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit ca. 1.2 cm long, ca. 0.6 cm broad, ellipsoid, apex acute, base tapered, smooth, glabrous; pericarp 0.5-1 mm thick, fleshy. Seed solitary, ca. 7.5 mm long, ellipsoid, slightly laterally compressed; testa hard, shining, smooth, hollowed at the base, 0.3-1.5 mm thick; scar basal, circular, ca. 0.75 mm diam.; embryo vertical, with thin foliaceous cotyledons and radicle exserted ca. 1 mm, surrounded by copious endosperm. Field characters. Shrub or small tree to 4 m high, with yellow flowers. The three known specimens were flowering in Mar, May and Oct, and the May flowering specimen also bears fruit.

description: Tree; young branches minutely appressed puberulous with ferruginous hairs, becoming glabrous, pale greyish-white, flaking and cracking, without lenticels. Usually unarmed, but occasionally with spines on young branches. Leaves opposite or spirally arranged, spaced, 3.5-4.5 × 1.8-2.5 cm, usually broadly elliptic or oblanceolate, occasionally orbicular on young growth, apex rounded to retuse, base acute or narrowly cuneate, thinly coriaceous with a flat or slightly revolute margin, glabrous; venation brochidodromous, with a marginal vein; midrib sunken on the upper surface; secondary veins 6-7 pairs, ascending, straight, parallel; intersecondaries prominent; tertiaries descending from the margin and tending to be parallel to the secondaries. Petiole 2-6 mm long, strongly channelled, with scattered appressed hairs. Flowers bisexual, axillary or in the axils of fallen leaves, fascicles 1-2-flowered. Pedicel ca. 8 mm long, sparsely appressed puberulous. Sepals five(six), 2.5-3 mm long, ovate, obtuse, sparsely appressed puberulous outside, becoming cartilaginous when old. Corolla glabrous, 3.5-4.5 mm long, lobes ovate, obtuse, undivided; stamens and staminodes not seen; ovary ovoid, five-locular, appressed puberulous; style ca. 3.5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. A tree with spiny or unarmed branches. The two flowering specimens seen were collected in Apr and Aug.

description: Young shoots and leaves tomentose, indumentum persisting on both surfaces of the leaf or at least on the lower surface. Field characters. A tree to 18 m tall and 75 cm diam, with grey exfoliating bark containing white latex. The flowers are yellow or greenish-white and the fruit ripens yellow. Flowering is from Apr to Jul, and mature fruits have been collected from Apr to Jun, in Aug and in Dec.

description: Shrub or small tree; young branches closely appressed ferruginous, becoming glabrous, rough, grey, grid-cracked, without lenticels. Unarmed. Leaves spirally arranged and spaced on young shoots, becoming clustered in fascicles of 4-5, 0.7-1.8 × 0.2-0.4 cm, narrowly spatulate to linear-oblong, apex rounded to truncate, base acute to narrowly cuneate, margin strongly revolute, strongly coriaceous, glabrous above, lower surface closely appressed ferruginous puberulous; venation obscure, midrib visible only on the lower surface. Petiole 1.5-2.5 mm long, not channelled, appressed ferruginous puberulous. Flowers bisexual, axillary, in 1-3 flowered fascicles. Pedicel 3-4 mm long, appressed puberulous. Sepals five, ca. 3 mm long, ovate or triangular, acute, outside appressed ferruginous puberulous, inside glabrous. Corolla glabrous, ca. 3.5 mm long, tube 1.75-2 mm long, lobes five, oblong-ovate, acute, entire or with only vestigial lateral segments. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube, glabrous; filaments ca. 0.75 mm long, anthers ca. 0.5 mm long, lanceolate. Staminodes five, ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, five-locular, appressed ferruginous puberulous, enlarging after anthesis, gradually tapering to the appressed puberulous exserted style; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. A shrub or small tree to 4 m. Flowering is recorded in Sep and Dec.

description: Tree; young shoots densely short brown-pubescent, becoming glabrous, grey-brown to whitish-grey, smooth, with small lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous, 20-23 × 7-8 cm, broadly oblong-lanceolate, apex narrowly acuminate or caudate, base shortly broadly attenuate or obtuse, chartaceus, glabrous above, uniformly and closely appressed puberulous (brown hairs) below; venation eucamptodromous or brochidodromous in the upper half, marginal vein present, midrib slightly prominent on the upper surface, secondary veins 14-15 pairs, convergent, arcuate, slightly impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries moderate to long; tertiary reticulum conspicuous and raised on the lower surface. Petiole 1-1.3 cm long, slightly channelled, shortly pubescent to glabrous. Fascicles 3-6-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 1.2-1.6 cm long, appressed puberulous with golden brown hairs. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals five, 2.5-3 mm long, ovate, apex acute to obtuse, golden sericeous outside, appressed puberulous near margin inside. Corolla ca. 3 mm long, tube about equalling the lobes, lobes five, ovate, apex acute, sericeous outside, tube puberulous inside. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.2 mm long, puberulous; anthers not seen, absent in female. Staminodes five, ca. 0.5 mm long, triangular, puberulous on the outer face. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, 2-4-locular, densely appressed puberulous; style ca. 0.75 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 15 m high with copious milky white or slightly pinkish latex. Flowers pink, in Oct.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli initio minute adpresse puberuli, demum glabri, atro-brunnei, asperi vel squamati, lenticellis paucis grandibus. Folia dis-sita, altemantia et disticha vel leviter spiraliter disposita, 12-16.6 × 3.7-5.5 cm, elliptica usque anguste oblongo-elliptica, apice anguste attenuata vel acuminata, basi acuta usque anguste attenuata, chartacea, glabra; venatio eucamptodroma; nervus marginalis praesens; costa supra prominula (rotundata); nervi secundarii 10-13-jugi, leviter convergentes, arcuati; nervi inter-secundarii longi, saepe prope marginem extensi; nervi tertiarii reticulum laxum facientes. Petiolus 0.8-1.5 cm longus, leviter canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 5-usque multi-flori, axillares vel infra folia dispositi. Pedicellus (masculinus) 3-4 mm longus, (foemineus) 1.5-2 mm longus, subglaber. Flores unisexuales (planta dioica). Sepale 2.5-3 mm longa, ovata, apice acuta vel obtusa, sepala interiora extus adpresse puberula, intus glabra. Corolla (masculina) ca. 5 mm longa, (foeminea) ca. 3.5 mm longa; tubus fere lobos aequans; lobi quinque, late expansi, triangulares vel ovati, apice rotundati vel obtusi, glabri. Stamina quinque ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 0.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1 mm longae, late lanceolatae, glabrae, in flore foemine nullae. Staminodia quinque 0.5-1 mm longa, ovata vel triangularia, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideum usque globosum, 4-5-loculare, minute adpresse puberulum; stylus post anthesin 1-1.5 mm longus, adpresse puberulus; styli capitulum 4-5-lobatum. Fructus 2.2-2.5 × 3-3.2 cm, oblatus, apice et basi subtruncatus, laevis, glaber. Semina 2-4, 1.7-1.8 cm longa, lateraliter compressa, apica acuta, basi rotundata, testa leviter rugosa, nitida, ca. 0.3 mm crassa; cicatrix adaxialis, per longtudinem extensa, prope apicem ca. 3 mm lata, ad basim decrescens; embryo cotyledonibus plano-convexis, liberis, radicula ad superficiem extensa; albumen nullum.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, dark brown, rough or scaling, with few large lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous or weakly spirally arranged, 12-16.6 × 3.7-5.5 cm, elliptic to narrowly oblong-elliptic, apex narrowly attenuate or acuminate, base acute to narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib slightly prominent (rounded) on upper surface, secondary veins 10-13 pairs, slightly convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries long, often extending to near the margin; tertiaries forming a lax reticulum. Petiole 0.8-1.5 cm long, slightly channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 5-many-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel (male) 3-4 mm long, (female) 1.5-2 mm long, subglabrous. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals 2.5-3 mm long, ovate, apex acute or obtuse, inner sepals appressed puberulous on outer face, otherwise glabrous. Corolla (male) ca. 5 mm long, (female) ca. 3.5 mm long, tube about equalling the lobes, lobes five, widely spreading, triangular or ovate, apex rounded or obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, broadly lanceolate, glabrous, absent in female flowers. Staminodes five, 0.5-1 mm long, ovate or triangular, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid to globose, 4-5-locular, minutely appressed puberulous; style 1-1.5 mm long after anthesis, appressed puberulous; style-head 4-5-lobed. Fruit 2.2-2.5 × 3-3.2 cm, oblate, apex and base subtruncate, smooth, glabrous. Seeds 2-4, 1.7-1.8 cm long, laterally compressed, apex acute, base rounded, testa slightly wrinkled, shining, ca. 0.3 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, ca. 3 mm wide near apex, tapering to base; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 25 m high and 50 cm diam., buttressed to 1 m; bole fluted, with buff-grey bark scaling in large, rather irregular pieces; slash pink with some white latex. Flowers with pale cream-white corolla, without scent. Fruit yellow, with copious white latex in the whitish flesh. Flowering Oct-Nov, fruit Nov.

description: Tree; young shoots brown-tomentose, becoming glabrous, grey-brown, rough, with prominent lenticels. Leaves loosely to densely clustered, in whorls of 5-7, 11.5-26 × 4.5-9.6 cm, broadly oblanceolate, apex shortly obtusely attenuate to rounded, base acute to narrowly cuneate, coriaceous, upper surface glabrous except for residual tomentum along midrib, lower surface shortly dark brown-pubescent, denser on midrib and veins; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 23-26 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate; impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries numerous, oblique; quaternary reticulum sometimes visible. Petiole 1.5-4 cm long, channelled in upper part, brown-tomentose, stipels absent. Fascicles 5-10-flowered, on branches and twigs. Pedicel ca. 1 mm long, appressed puberulous. Sepals five, ca. 2 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Corolla ca. 4 mm long, tube ca. 1.5 mm long, lobes five(six), ca. 2.5 mm long, elliptic or lanceolate, apex rounded, densely sericeous outside, margin glabrous, glabrous inside. Stamens five(six), fixed at base of corolla lobes; filaments ca. 2.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Ovary conical, tapering gradually into style, five-locular, densely strigose; style ca. 1.5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 3.5-5 cm long, narrowly obovoid, asymmetric, one side straight or concave, the other convex, apex rounded, base tapered, smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary, 2.5-3 cm long, laterally compressed, apex rounded, base acute, asymmetric, testa smooth, shining, thin; scar adaxial, full-length, ca. 4 mm wide; embryo with thinly plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle exserted ca. 4 mm; endosperm a thin sheath. Field characters. Tree to 33 m high and 35 cm diam. with short simple stout buttresses to 0.5 m high; bark pale buff-brown exfoliating in large irregular thin sheets, and becoming dippled, slash orange-brown, exuding some sticky white latex; crown broad, with massive twigs and dense terminal clusters of leaves. Rowers dark violet-blackish. Flowering and fruiting in Oct (Brazil).

description: Tree; young shoots densely reddish-ferruginous-hirsute, soon glabrous, pale greyish, rough, with numerous lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, in whorls of five, 12-22 × 5-9 cm, oblong-elliptic to obovate, apex shortly narrowly attenuate or acute, base obtuse or acute, coriaceous, glabrous above, finely appressed puberulous with pale hairs on midrib and veins below; venation eucamptodromous, midrib sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 30-40 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate; slightly sunken on upper surface; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries numerous, oblique. Petiole 1-2 cm long, channelled in upper part, hirsute to subglabrous, stipels absent. Fascicles 2-10-flowered, below the leaves. Pedicel ca. 1 mm long, densely pubescent. Sepals five, 2-3 mm long, broadly ovate to orbicular, apex rounded, densely puberulous outside, broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Corolla ca. 5 mm long, tube ca. 1.5 mm long, lobes five, ca. 3.5 mm long, oblong, apex rounded or obtuse, densely sericeous outside, with broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Stamens five, fixed at the base of the corolla lobes; filaments ca. 3 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, five-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 2 mm long, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 3.5-4.5 cm long, ovoid to ellipsoid, slightly oblique, apiculate, densely covered with small ribs and tubercles, densely shortly pubescent, becoming subglabrous with age. Seed solitary, ca. 2.3 cm long, obovoid, slightly laterally compressed, testa smooth, shining; scar adaxial, full-length, ca. 6 mm broad, rugose; embryo not seen. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high with cylindrical trunk; bark grey-brown, with astringent taste. Flowers with dark red corolla, fruit maturing yellow. Flowering Apr, fruit May.

description: Tree; young shoots long- and stiffly-pubescent, soon glabrous, pale greyish-white, rough and cracked, lenticellate. Leaves clustered, subverticillate, 9-15 × 4-6.1 cm, broadly oblanceolate, apex rounded to shortly narrowly attenuate, base acute or narrowly cuneate, thinly coriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 15-18 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate, slightly impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries very fine, oblique. Petiole 1.5-3 cm long, not or only slightly channelled at the apex, glabrous, stipels absent. Fascicles many-flowered, densely clustered in the leaf axils and below the leaves. Pedicel 4-6 mm long, shortly pubescent. Sepals five, 2.5-3 mm long, broadly ovate, apex rounded, appressed pubescent outside, glabrous inside, long ciliate. Corolla ca. 6 mm long, tube ca. 2 mm long, lobes five(six), ca. 4 mm long, oblong or elliptic, apex rounded, sparsely sericeous outside, margin glabrous, glabrous inside. Stamens five(six), fixed at the base of the corolla lobes, exserted; filaments ca. 3 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Ovary narrowly ovoid, five-locular, densely strigose; style ca. 0.5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit (desc. ex Ducke) 2.5-4 cm long, subfalcate-oblong, apex acuminate or apiculate, one side straight, the other strongly arcuate-convex, smooth, subglabrous. Seed with an oblong scar, not reaching the base. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high with cylindrical bole and yellowish-grey, smooth sweet-tasting bark. Flowers greenish. Flowering Jun, Sep, fruit Mar, May.

description: Young shoots sparsely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, smooth, lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 4.2-12.5 × 2.3-4.9 cm, oblanceolate to broadly elliptic, apex obtusely cuspidate to shortly narrowly attenuate, base shortly narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glaborus; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 12-15 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate, not impressed; intersecondaries long; tertiaries finely reticulate-areolate. Peticle 1.2-2 cm long, channelled, glabrous, stipels absent. Fascicles 2-10-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 0.5-1 mm long, glabrous. Sepals five, ca. 1 mm long, suborbicular, apex rounded, glabrous. Corolla 2.5-3 mm long, tube ca. 1 mm long, lobes five, 1.5-2 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, apex obtuse or rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the base of the corolla lobes; filaments ca. 2 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.6 mm long, broadly lanceolate, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, five-locular, appressed puberulous; style ca. 0.3 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit unknown.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli dense et breviter pubescentes, demum glabri cinerascenti-brunnei, asperi, lenticellis prominentibus meniti. Folia congesta, verticillata vel spiraliter disposita, 4.5-9.5 × 2.7-5.9 cm, obovata vel late elliptica, apic obtusa vel emarginata, basi late vel anguste attenuata, tenuiter coriacea, costa et nervi secundarii supra pubescentes, infra breviter et molliter pubescentia (pilis petiolatis, biramosis, pallide brunneis vestita), interdum in senectute rarescens et solum in costa nervisque repertum; venatio eucamptodroma; nervus marginalis praesens; costa supra impressa; nervi secundarii 8-10-jugi, paralleli, leviter arcuati, supra leviter impressi; nervi intersecundarii breves vel nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui usque horizontales; subtilius reticulum quatemarium interdum visibile. Petiolus 5-7 mm longus, leviter canaliculatus, breviter pubescens, stipellae nullae. Fasciculi 5-10-flori, sub foliis saepe dense congesti. Pedicellus 2-3 mm longus, puberulus. Sepala quinque, ca. 2 mm longa, late ovata, apice obtusa, extus adpresse puberula, intus glabra, ciliata. Corolla ca. 3 mm longa; tubus ca. 1 mm longus; lobi quinque; ca. 2 mm longi, elliptici, apice obtusi, glabri. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 2 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1.25 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Ovarium ovoideum, ad basim expansum, quinquelocular, dense et longe strigosum; stylus post anthesin ca. 1 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ca. 2 cm longus, late ellipsoide-us, apice rotundatus, basi acutus, laevis vel prope apicem leviter verruculosus, dense et breviter pubescens. Semen (immaturum) solitarium, ca. 1.5	cm longum, lateraliter compressum, apice et basi rotundatum, testa laevis, nitida; cicatrix adaxialis, per totam longitudinem extensa, 1-2 mm lata; embryo cotyledonibus plano-convexis, liberis, radicula usque ad superficiem extenta, albumen nullum.

description: Tree; young shoots densely short pubescent, becoming glabrous, greyish-brown, rough, with prominent lenticels. Leaves clustered, verticillate or spirally arranged, 4.5-9.5 × 2.7-5.9 cm, obovate or broadly elliptic, apex obtuse to emarginate, base broadly or narrowly attenuate, thinly coriaceous, upper surface pubescent on midrib and secondary veins, lower surface shortly softly pubescent (indumentum of stalked two-branched pale brown hairs), sometimes becoming sparser with age and confined to midrib and veins; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 8-10 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate, slightly impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries oblique to horizontal; fine quaternary reticulum sometimes visible. Petiole 5-7 mm long, slightly channelled, shortly pubescent, stipels absent. Fascicles 5-10-flowered, below the leaves, often densely clustered. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, puberulous. Sepals five, ca. 2 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside, ciliate. Corolla ca. 3 mm long, tube ca. 1 mm long, lobes five, ca. 2 mm long, elliptic, apex obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.25 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, expanded at base, five-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 1 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit ca. 2 cm long, broadly ellipsoid, apex rounded, base acute, smooth or slightly verruculose near the apex, densely short pubescent. Seed (immature) solitary, ca. 1.5 cm long, laterally compressed with rounded apex and base, testa smooth, shining; scar adaxial, full-length, 1-2 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 12 m high and 25 cm diam. with pale grey bark, scaling in small rectangular pieces, slash pinkish with some cream or white latex. Flowers with dark red corolla. Flowering Nov-Mar, immature fruit Mar.

description: Tree; young shoots golden appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, pale greyish, rough, lenticellate. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 4-7 × 2-4 cm, elliptic or broadly oblanceolate, apex and base narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation brochidodromous, marginal vein present, secondaries uniting to form a submarginal vein, midrib flat on the upper surface, secondaries 12-13 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate or straight, not sunken on the upper surface; intersecondaries moderately long; tertiaries fine, horizonatal. Petiole 0.7-2 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles axillary, 1-3-flowered. Pedicel 0.5-1 mm long, appressed puberulous. Sepals five, ca. 1.5 mm long, ovate or elliptic, apex obtuse, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Corolla ca. 3 mm long, tube ca. 1 mm long, lobes five, ca. 2 mm long, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Ovary narrowly ovoid, five-locular, appressed pubescent; style ca. 2 mm long after anthesis, pubescent below; style-head simple. Fruit 3-3.5 cm long, oblong to ellipsoid, slightly asymmetric, apex rounded, base attenuate, smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary, 2-2.5 cm long, asymmetric, adaxial side convex, abaxial side straight, laterally compressed, obtuse or acute at apex and base, testa smooth, shining, 0.4-0.5 mm thick; scar adaxial, full length, 3.5-5 mm wide; embryo with planoconvex, free cotyledons, radicle exserted ca. 2 mm; endosperm absent. Field characters. A tree to 20 m high with sweet tasting bark and greenish flowers. Flowering records Dec, May, fruit May.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli adpresse puberuli, mox glabri, cinerascentibrunnei, laeves, lenticellis prominentibus muniti. Folia dissita, subverticillata, 9-17.5 × 4-8 cm, late oblanceolate usque obovata, apice obtusa vel rotundata, basi acuta, coriacea, supra glabra, infra pilis sparsis brevibus adpressis vestita vel subglabra; venatio eucamptodroma; nervus marginalis praesens; costa supra impressa; nervi secundarii 16-20-jugi, paralleli, recti vel leviter arcuati, supra leviter impressi; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii numerosi, tenues, obliqui; nervi quatemarii subtiliter areolati. Petiolus 0.7-1.5 cm longus, ad apicem canaliculata, glaber, stipellae nullae. Fasciculi 10-15-flori, axillares et sub foliis dispositi. Pedicellus 2-3 mm longus, adpresse puberulus. Sepala quinque, ca. 2 mm longa, late ovata usque suborbicularia, apice obtusa vel rotundata, extus adpresso-puberula, lato margine glabro, intus glabra. Corolla ca. 5 mm longa; tubus ca. 1.5 mm longus, lobi quinque, ca. 3.5 mm longi, anguste elliptici vel oblongi, apice rotundata extus rigide sericei, intus glabri. Stamina quinque, ad basim lobos corollae affixa; filamenta 3-4 mm longa, glabra; antherae 1.2-1.8 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Ovarium ovoideum, five-loculare, longe strigosum; stylus post anthesin ca. 2 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus 3-3.5 cm longus, late oblongo-ellipticus, interdum asymmetricus, apice obtusus vel apiculatus, basi obtusus, vadose et irregulariter costatus et verruculosus, granu-lari-papillosus. Semen solitarium, 2-2.5 cm longum, oblongo-ellipsoideum, leviter asymmetrcum, lateraliter non compressum, testa laevis, nitida, 0.3-0.7 mm crassa; cicatrix adaxialis, per longitudinem, 2-3 mm lata; embryo cotyledon-ibus plano-convexis, liberis, radicula ca. 1 mm exserta; albumen nullum.

description: Tree, young shoots appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, grey-brown, smooth, with prominent brown lenticels. Leaves spaced, subverticillate, 9-17.5 × 4-8 cm, broadly oblanceolate to obovate, apex obtuse or rounded, base acute, coriaceous, upper surface glabrous, lower surface with sparse fine short appressed indumentum to subglabrous; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 16-20 pairs, parallel, straight or slightly arcuate, slightly impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries numerous, fine, oblique; quaternaries finely areolate. Petiole 0.7-1.5 cm long, channelled at the apex, glabrous, stipels absent. Fascicles 10-15-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, appressed puberulous. Sepals five, ca. 2 mm long, broadly ovate to suborbicular, apex obtuse or rounded, appressed puberulous outside, with a broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Corolla ca. 5 mm long, tube ca. 1.5 mm long, lobes five, ca. 3.5 mm long, narrowly elliptic or oblong, apex rounded, stiffly sericeous outside, glabrous inside. Stamens five, fixed at the base of the corolla lobes; filaments 3-4 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.2-1.8 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, five-locular, long-strigose; style ca. 2 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 3-3.5 cm long, broadly oblong-elliptic, sometimes asymmetric, apex obtuse or apiculate, base obtuse, shallowly and irregularly ribbed and verruculose, granular-papillose. Seed solitary, 2-2.5 cm long, oblong-ellipsoid, slightly asymmetric, not laterally compressed, testa smooth, shining, 0.3-0.7 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, 2-3 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle exserted ca. 1 mm; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 10 m high with white latex; flower reddish-green, fruit maturing yellow. Flowering May-Jun, fruit Dec.

description: Tree, young shoots finely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, smooth, brown, with small lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 9.8-15 × 5.4-8.3 cm, broadly elliptic or obovate, apex obtuse or rounded, base acute or obtuse, coriaceious, upper surface glabrous, lower surface with sparse minute appressed brown indumentum (lens); venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 11-13 pairs, parallel, arcuate, slightly impressed on upper surface; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries obscure, oblique. Petiole 1.5-2.5 cm long, channelled in the upper half, glabrous, stipels absent. Fascicles 10-15-flowered, densely clustered below the leaves. Pedicel 5-7 mm long, glabrous. Sepals five, 2.5-3 mm long, suborbicular, apex rounded, glabrous. Corolla ca. 5 mm long, tube ca. 2 mm long, lobes five(six), ca. 3 mm long, broadly elliptic, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens five(six), fixed at the base of the corolla lobes; filaments (not fully developed) ca. 2.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.5-1.6 mm long, broadly lanceolate, glabrous. Ovary narrowly ovoid, five-locular, appressed puberulous; style ca. 1.25 mm long, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit (desc. ex Ducke) ca. 3.4 cm long, 1.5 cm broad (dry), obliquely oblong-ovoid, apex obtuse, base attenuate, one side straight, the other curved; mature seed not examined. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high, buttressed, with smooth pale yellowish bark bearing discolorous scars; the bark is astringent. Rowers white, in Dec.

description: Tree; young shoots subglabrous, pale greyish-brown, becoming cracked, few lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged or verticillate, 9-19 × 4.2-8 cm, broadly oblanceolate, apex shortly narrowly attenuate to obtuse or rounded, base acute, chartaceous to thinly coriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 15-16 pairs, slightly convergent or parallel, arcuate, slightly impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries very fine, horizontal; quaternaries finely areolate. Petiole 1.2-2 cm long, channelled in the upper half, glabrous, stipels present, paired, ca. 1 mm long, linear, fixed 0.5-1 cm above base of petiole. Fascicles many-flowered, on twigs and larger branches. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, finely appressed puberulous. Sepals (four)five, 2.5-3 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse, finely appressed puberulous ouside, glabrous inside. Corolla 4-5 mm long, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes 5-6, 2.5-3 mm long, ovate-lanceolate, apex obtuse, sparsely sericeous outside, glabrous inside. Stamens 5-6, fixed at the base of the corolla lobes; filaments ca. 2.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.3 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Ovary conical, tapering gradually into style, five-locular, appressed puberulous; style ca. 1.5 mm long after anthesis, appressed puberulous in lower half; style-head simple. Fruit 4-5 cm long, broadly oblong-ellipsoid, asymmetric, apex and base acute; smooth, sparsely and finely appressed puberulous. Seed solitary. Field characters. Tree to 40 m high and 1 m diam. with cylindrical bole and white latex; the bark is bitter and astringent. Flowers dark violet. Flowering Nov-Feb, fruit Mar-Jun.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous, becoming glabrous, pale greyish, cracked and fissured, lenticels present or absent. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 8.7-20 × 4.5-7.5 cm, oblong to oblanceolate, apex rounded or obtusely cuspidate, base acute to narrowly attenuate, margin slightly revolute, coriaceous, glabrous; venation mostly brochidodromous, midrib flat or only slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 7-12 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, straight or slightly arcuate; intersecondaries moderate to long; tertiaries lax, reticulate. Petiole 1.3-3.3 cm long, flat or slightly channelled in the upper half, appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles 3-10-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 3-7 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals five, (male) ca. 4 mm long, (female) ca. 2.5 mm long, ovate to elliptic, apex obtuse to rounded, appressed puberulous outside, puberulous inside. Corolla (male) ca. 5 mm long, tube ca. 2 mm long, lobes ca. 3 mm long, (female) ca. 3 mm long, tube equalling the lobes, lobes five, obovate, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed near the top of the corolla tube (but traces visible to near base); filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.5-1.75 mm long, lanceolate, apiculate, glabrous; stamens absent in female flower. Staminodes five, (male) 2.5-2.75 mm long, (female) ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, or sometimes irregular in female, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary conical, bilocular, densely stiff-pubescent; style ca. 1.5 mm long after anthesis, stiff-pubescent; style-head simple. Fruit ca. 4 × 3 cm, broadly ellipsoid, apex obtuse, base truncate, smooth, velutinous. Seeds two, ca. 2.4 cm long, ellipsoid, slightly planoconvex, acute at base and apex, testa smooth, shining, adherent to pericarp, 0.5-1.5 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, elliptic, ca. 8 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle exserted, ca. 1.5 mm; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 45 cm diam., buttressed to 2 m. Bark reddish-brown, scaling, with thick milky white latex. Flowers yellowish-white to pale brown, fruit ripening orange. Flowering Oct to Nov, fruit Nov to Dec, and Jun.

description: Arbor:; ramuli novelli glabri, brunnei, costulati, demum cinerascentes, leviter squamati, elenticellati. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 6.8-13 × 3.2-6.8 cm, lanceolata vel oblongo-lanceolata, apice anguste attenuata, basi rotundata, coriacea, supra laevia et nitida, glabra; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra prominula (rotundata); nervus marginalis praesens; nervi secundarii 9-12-jugi, paralleli vel leviter convergentes, arcuati; nervi intersecundarii breves usque modice longi; nervi tertiarii pauci, reticulati vel nulli; reticulum subtile Superioris ordinis sub lente visibile. Petiolus 1-2 cm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 5-10-flori, sub foliis enati. Pedicellus 0.2-1.1 cm longus, glaber. Flores bisexulaes (?). Sepala quinque, 1.5-2 mm longa, ovata, apice acuta usque obtusa, glabra, interdum ciliata. Corolla 3-4 mm longa; tubus ca. 1 mm longus, lobi quinque, 2-3 mm longi, late oblanceolata apice rotundati, glabri. Stamina quinque, in dimidio inferiore tubo corollae affixa; filamenta 0-0.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae 1-1.5 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, ca. 1.5 mm longa, lanceolato-subulata, carnosa, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium conicum, in stylum decrescens, uniloculare, glabrum; stylus 0.2-0.5 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ignotus.

description: Tree; young shoots glabrous, brown, shallowly ridged, becoming greyish, thinly scaling, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 6.8-13 × 3.2-6.8 cm, lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate, base rounded, coriaceous, upper surface smooth and glossy, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised (rounded) on the upper surface, marginal vein present, secondary veins 9-12 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries short to moderately long; tertiaries few or absent, reticulate; fine higher order areolate network visible with lens. Petiole 1-2 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles borne below the leaves, 5-10-flowered. Pedicel 0.2-1.1 cm long, glabrous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 1.5-2 mm long, ovate, apex acute to obtuse, glabrous, sometimes ciliate. Corolla 3^1 mm long, tube ca. 1 mm long, lobes five, 2-3 mm long, broadly oblanceolate, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed in the lower half of the corolla tube; filaments 0-0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1-1.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, carnose, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary conical, tapering gradually to style, unilocular, glabrous; style 0.2-0.5 mm long, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 35 m high and 50 cm diam. with white latex. Flowers white, in Oct, Nov and Feb.

description: Plants to 10 cm high, in loose tufts, yellowish to brownish, conspicuously glossy golden green. Stems laxly foliate with distant, spreading, flexuose or slightly homomallous leaves, often comose at tips, not tomentose. Leaves 6-7 mm long, from ovate base gradually lanceolate, ending in a long, slender, smooth tip. Costa filling one half of the leaf width, excurrent, in transverse section with large ventral hyalocysts, median and dorsal chlorocysts, without dorsal stereids. Alar cells large, inflated, protruding conspicuously into the costa. Basal laminal cells rectangular, slightly incrassate, elongate oval upper laminal cells, 36 × 26-42 µm. Sporophytes pseudolateral. Seta to 1 cm long, twisted, light brown to blackish in age. Capsule erect, symmetric, olive-green in young capsules to brownish in mature capsules and blackish in old capsules, furrowed. Annulus blackish. Lid obliquely rostrate, 1 mm long, reddish to reddish brown or blackish, darker colored than the capsule. Calyptra not known. Vegetative propagation by means of small propaguliferous leaves produced in the axils of comose leafs at stemtips.

description: Plants bright green, 1.5-5 cm high. Stems equally and densely foliate. Leaves appressed and slightly curled when dry, erect patent when wet, 6 mm long, broadly lanceolate, serrate at tips, widest at midleaf and contracted towards leaf base. Costa filling 1/2 of the leaf width, in transverse section with ventral hyalocysts and dorsal groups of stereids, excurrent. Alar cells weakly differentiated or not, often reddish with hyaline margins. Basal laminal cells thin-walled, hyaline, 6-9 × 40-50 µm. Upper laminal cells small, subquadrate to short rectangular, 5-6 × 9-12 µm. Sporophyte not known.

description: Shrub or tree; indumentum of young parts and inflorescence closely appressed puberulous. Inner surface of sepals uniformly appressed puberulous; anthers 1.75-2 mm long. Fruit 4-8 cm long. Seed scar often covering up to two-thirds of seed surface. Field characters. Shrub or tree to 40 m high and 90 cm diam., larger specimens with low buttresses and fluted towards the base. Bark dark brown or black, scaling in small flakes, slash pink, soft, thick and laminated, with copious white latex. Flowers pale green, fruit maturing orange or yellow, usually with rufous-brown tomentum; the flesh is pale orange or yellow, rather mealy or greasy. Most flowering occurs between Jul and Nov (throughout range) with fruit maturing Dec to May.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous with ferruginous hairs, soon glabrous, dark brown, finally pale greyish, cracked and scaling, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 10-20 × 5.6-9.2 cm, broadly elliptic, oblong or oblong-lanceolate, apex obtusely cuspidate to narrowly attenuate, base obtuse to broadly or narrowly attenuate, usually asymmetric, coriaceous, glabrous above or with some minute appressed hairs in the midrib, lower surface thinly appressed puberulous with brown hairs; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, marginal vein present; secondary veins 9-14 pairs, parallel, straight or slightly arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries obscure, few, horizontal or reticulate. Petiole 2.5-5 cm long, not channelled, appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles many-flowered, axillary and densely clustered below the leaves. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, appressed ferruginous-puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant monoecious ?). Sepals five, 1.5-2 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse, appressed puberulous outside, subglabrous inside. Corolla cyathiform, ca. 2.5 mm long, tube equalling the lobes, lobes five, ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, strigose on the outside of the tube. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments 0.2-0.5 mm long with traces to near the base of corolla tube, glabrous; anthers 0.5-0.6 mm long, broadly ovoid, glabrous, absent in female flowers. Staminodes 0-5, vestigial to ca. 0.5 mm long, subulate, glabrous. Disk represented by the expanded base of the ovary, pubescent. Ovary ovoid (female), reduced and sunken in the expanded disk (male), bilocular, pubescent; style 0.5-0.75 mm long (male), shorter in female, glabrous; stylehead simple. Fruit 10-11 × 7.5-8 cm, obovoid, apex rounded, base tapered, smooth, glabrous. Seeds 1-2, 7-8 cm long, somewhat laterally compressed, apex and base acute to obtuse, testa smooth, shining, ca. 1 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, 1.5-1.8 cm wide near the base, tapering towards the apex; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 35 m high and 100 cm diam., buttressed to 2 m high, with a cylindrical bole. Bark dark brown, thick, soft, shaggy, with a reddish slash which exudes copious watery white latex. Flowers yellowish-green, with a strong aromatic and pungent scent (Pires & Schultes, 1950: 93). The fruits are hard-skinned, yellowish, with soft, whitish flesh like that of an avocado. The paper by Pires & Schultes contains much interesting additional field information on the flowering behaviour of this plant. Although the flower buds take months to develop, the open flowers are extremely ephemeral. They are visited by large bees and smaller insects. Flowering recorded Nov to Jan, ripe fruit seen between Oct and Mar.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, becoming greyish-brown, cracked and scaling, lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 12.5-32 × 5-10.6 cm, elliptic, oblong-elliptic or lanceolate, apex broadly or narrowly attenuate to subtruncate, base attenuate to obtuse or truncate, coriaceous, glabrous, venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat or occasionally slightly raised on the upper surface, weak marginal vein present, secondary veins 7-14 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries small or absent; tertiaries horizontal or oblique, usually with a slightly less prominent reticulum, secondary and higher order venation raised on lower surface. Petiole 1-2 cm long, not or only slightly channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 5-15-flowered, axillary and in the axils of fallen leaves. Pedicel 0.4-1.6 cm long, often accrescent in fruit and up to 1 cm broad, sparsely appressed puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant monoecious ?). Sepals five, 3-5 mm long, outer lanceolate with acute apex, inner oblong with rounded apex, appressed puberulous outside, sparsely appressed puberulous inside, sometimes ciliate. Corolla shortly tubular, (male) 5.5-6.5 mm long, tube 3.5-4.5 mm long, lobes ca. 2 mm long, (female) 3.5-5 mm long, tube 1.75-3 mm long, lobes 1.5-2 mm long, lobes (both sexes) five, ovate, lanceolate or triangular, apex acute, sericeous or glabrous outside, glabrous inside. Stamens five, fixed at the apex of the corolla tube, filaments 0.2-0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1-1.25 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous, absent in female flowers. Staminodes five, (male) 1-1.25 mm long, (female) 0.5-1 mm long, broadly triangular or lanceolate, usually glabrous, occasionally densely puberulous on the outer surface. Disk absent (or perhaps represented by the expanded flattened ovary). Ovary usually flattened and expanded, less frequently conical, 3-5-locular, puberulous; style 1-3 mm long after anthesis, puberulous below; style-head simple. Fruit 4-5.5 cm long, ovoid to globose, apex rounded, base truncate, strongly tuberculate to almost smooth, glabrous. Seeds 1-3, 2.5-3.5 cm long, ellipsoid, plano-convex or shaped like the segment of an orange (depending on how many seeds in the fruit), testa smooth, shining, 0.75-1 mm thick; scar adaxial, full length, sometimes extending over the base and apex of seed, 0.8-1.8 cm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 35 m high and 75 cm diam.; buttressed to 1.5 m high; bark greyish-brown, fissured or scaly and peeling off in rounded flakes; slash light brown with abundant white, fast flowing latex. The flowers are cream-white and the ripe fruit yellow or orange. Flowering and fruiting throughout the year.

description: Tree; young shoots densely puberulous with spreading and appressed, reddish-ferruginous hairs, becoming glabrous, pale greyish, cracked and fissured, without lenticels. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, 11-19 × 6.5-10 cm, broadly elliptic or obovate, apex rounded or obtuse, base rounded or obtuse, thinly coriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib sharply raised but recessed on the upper surface, secondary veins 6-8 pairs, parallel, arcuate; intersecondaries small or absent; tertiaries oblique; fine higher order reticulum visible on lower surface (lens). Petiole 2-4.6 cm long, strongly channelled, puberulous. Fascicles 1-3-flowered, mostly below the leaves. Pedicel 1.4-2.6 cm long, appressed puberulous with reddish-ferruginous hairs. Flowers bisexual. Sepals four, 1-1.5 cm long, inner pair exceeding the outer, outer ovate, apex obtuse, inner oblong or oblong-spathulate, apex rounded, appressed puberulous on both surfaces, the inner pair sometimes with broad glabrous margin. Corolla broadly cylindrical, 1.4-1.6 cm long, tube 0.9-1 cm long, lobes six (see note below), 4.5-6 mm long, oblong to lanceolate, apex obtuse, papillose. Stamens six, fixed near the top of the corolla tube; filaments 1.5-2 mm long, geniculate, glabrous; anthers 1.75-2 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes six, or occasionally absent, 2.5-3.5 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, keeled, papillose. Disk absent. Ovary broadly columnar with a truncate apex, 7-8-locular, pubescent; style 1-1.4 cm long after anthesis, exserted, pubescent in the lower half; style-head simple. Fruit 6-7 cm long, subglobose to broadly ovoid or oblate, apex obtuse, base truncate, smooth, glabrous. Seeds 5-8, shaped like the segment of an orange, testa smooth, shining; scar covering the two radial sides and base of the seed; embryo with plano-convex cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 40 m high and 65 cm diam. with thick white latex. Corolla greenish-cream, ripe fruit green, with soft, dry, pale yellow pulp with apple odour (LBB 12124). Flowering Jun-Oct, fruit Oct.

description: Tree. Leaves usually 20-45 cm long, with narrowly attenuate to obtusely cuspidate apex, secondary veins 17-39 pairs, higher order venation clearly differentiated into oblique tertiaries and finely reticulate quaternaries, lower surface glabrous. Fruit smooth, 3-5 cm long, pubescent to glabrous. Field characters. Tree to 32 m high and 50 cm diam., larger specimens buttressed to 4 m high, trunk fluted; bark brown to greyish white, scaling or shallowly fissured; slash pinkish to pale brown with scant white latex. Flowers pale to yellowish-green, sometimes scented, fruit maturing yellow-orange, with caducous irritant hairs. Flowering mostly Jul-Nov, but with some records from Jan-Mar in Peru, fruit found throughout the year.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli subglabri, cinerascentibrunnei, subtiliter rimosi et squamati, elenticellati. Folia dissita vel laxe congesta, spiraliter disposita, 13-25 × 4.3-8 cm, elliptica, apice et basi anguste attenuate, chartacea vel tenuiter coriacea, glabra; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra leviter prominula; nervus marginalis tenuis praesens; nervi secundarii 10-12-jugi, leviter convergentes et arcuati; nervi intersecundarii breves vel nulli; nervi tertiarii indistincti, obliqui usque horizontales, plerumque inter nervos secunda-rios anastomosantes; nervi quatemarii reticulati. Petiolus 2-4 cm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 5-10-flori, axillares et sub foliis dispositi. Pedicellus 2.5-4 mm longus, adpresse puberulus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quatuor, 3.3-5 mm longa, late ovata, apice obtusa velrotundata, extus, subtiliter et adpresse puberula, duo interiora margine lato, tenui, glabro, omnia intus glabra. Corolla late tubularis, ca. 5 mm longus, tubus ca. 3 mm longus, lobi quatuor, ca. 2 mm longi, late oblongi, apice rotundati, glabri. Stamina quatuor, medio tubo corollae vel paul-lum superius affixa; filamenta ca. 1.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1 mm longae, ovatae, dorsoventraliter complanatae, apiculatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, ca. 1.5 mm longa, anguste lanceolata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium trun-catum, quadriloculare, dense et longe strigosum; stylus ca. 1.5 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus immaturus ca. 1.5 cm diam., globosus, laevis, pubescens. Semen non visum.

description: Tree; young shoots subglabrous, grey-brown, finely cracked and scaling, without lenticels. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 13-25 × 4.3-8 cm, elliptic, apex and base narrowly attenuate, chartaceous or thinly coriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, thin marginal vein present, secondary veins 10-12 pairs, slightly convergent and arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries indistinct, oblique to horizontal, but tending to anastomose midway between the secondaries; quaternaries reticulate. Petiole 2-4 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles axillary and below the leaves, 5-10-flowered. Pedicel 2.5-4 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, 3-3.5 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, finely appressed puberulous outside, inner pair with broad, thin, glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular, ca. 5 mm long, tube ca. 3 mm long, lobes four, ca. 2 mm long, broadly oblong, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens four, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube or slightly above; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, ovate, dorso-ventrally flattened, apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 1.5 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary flat-topped, four-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; style-head simple. Young fruit ca. 1.5 cm diam, globose, smooth, pubescent. Seed not seen. Field characters. Tree to 15 m high and 30 cm diam. with white latex, and pale bark. Flowers yellowish green, present Jun-Aug, immature fruit in Sep.

description: Tree, young shoots glabrous, becoming greyish-brown, thinly scaling, sometimes with a few lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 15-22.5 × 5.5-8 cm, elliptic to oblanceolate, apex obtuse to acute, base narrowly attenuate, coriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, strong marginal vein, secondary veins 7-9 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries obscure. Petiole 1.5-3 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 5-10-flowered, axillary and below leaves. Pedicel 5-7 mm long (accrescent to 1.5 cm in fruit), glabrous. Flowers unisexual (?). Sepals 4-4.5 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, glabrous. Corolla cyathiform, ca. 5.5 mm long, tube about equalling the lobes, lobes five, ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed in the upper half of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 3 mm long, geniculate at apex, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 1-2.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Disk patelliform, surrounding the reduced ovary, pubescent. Ovary (male flower ?) globose, immersed in the disk, densely pubescent; style ca. 2.5 mm long after anthesis, included, glabrous; style-head minutely lobed. Fruit 2.5-2.9 cm long, narrowly obovoid, apex rounded, apiculate, base slightly tapered, smooth, glabrous or with tuft of hair at base. Seed solitary, ca. 1.8 cm long, laterally compressed, apex rounded, base acute, testa smooth, shining, adherent to pericarp, 0.5-0.6 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, ca. 1.5 mm wide; embryo with thin, foliaceous cotyledons, radicle exserted; endosperm present. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 35 cm diam. with sticky white latex. Flowers white or yellowish, scented, fruit maturing yellow. Flowering Jun-Jul, fruit recorded Feb and Apr.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, pale greyish-buff, cracked and scaling in thin flakes, without lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged 15-30 × 6.2-12	cm, oblanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate, acute or obtusely cuspidate, base narrowly attenuate, coriaceous, glabrous above, closely sericeous below with yellowish to golden-brown hairs; venation eucamptodromous, midrib raised on the upper surface, thin marginal vein sometimes visible, secondary veins 14-24 pairs, usually parallel and straight, or slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries obscure, oblique; finer reticulum sometimes visible. Petiole 2-3.5 cm long, not channelled, appressed puberulous. Fascicles 2-4-flowered, axillary. Pedicel 0.6-1 cm long, puberulous, hairs appressed and spreading. Flowers bisexual. Sepals five(-six), 0.7-1 cm long, broadly ovate to elliptic, apex obtuse to rounded, puberulous outside with appressed and spreading hairs, subglabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular, 0.8-1.1 cm long, tube 4-7 mm long, lobes five, 4-4.5 mm long, oblong to lanceolate, apex acute to rounded, coarsely sericeous on outside of lobes and upper part of tube, papillose, glabrous inside. Stamens five, fixed near the top of the corolla tube; filaments 0.5-2 mm long, geniculate at apex, glabrous; anthers 1.5-2 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, 2.5-3.5 mm long, subulate, papillose. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid-conical, 5-9-locular, densely stiff-pubescent; style 7-8 mm long after anthesis, slightly exserted or equalling the corolla, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 5-5.5 cm long, globose, broadly ellipsoid or pyriform, apex obtuse, base rounded or tapered, smooth, puberulous (golden-brown). Seed solitary, 3.5-4 cm long, subglobose, apex and base rounded, testa smooth, shining, ca. 0.5 mm thick; scar area covering most of the seed surface; embryo with plano-convex free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 35 cm diam, with white latex. Leaves conspicuously golden brown on the lower surface. Corolla pale green to greenish-white, mature fruit golden-brown. Flowering Jun to Oct, fruiting Jan to Jun.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Treelet; young shoots densely ferruginous-puberulous, indumentum persistent, eventually glabrous, greyish-brown, becoming cracked, lenticels absent. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 4.5-8 × 2.7-4.3 cm, elliptic, elliptic-oblong, or elliptic-ovate, apex acute, obtuse or rounded, base truncate or shortly cordate, margin slightly revolute, coriaceous, upper surface with sparse minute crisped hairs or glabrous, lower surface puberulous with crisped ferruginous hairs, turning greyish with age, venation eucamptodromous-brochididromous, midrib flat or slightly sunken on the upper surface, marginal vein present, secondary veins 11-14 pairs, parallel, straight, sometimes impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries short or long; tertiaries obscure, lax, reticulate to oblique, sometimes impressed and finer on the upper surface. Petiole 2-3 mm long, not channelled, puberulous. Fascicles 3-15-flowered, axillary and on short leafless axillary shoots to 1.5 cm long. Pedicel 3-8 mm long, ferruginous-puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals five(-six), 2.5-3 mm long, ovate, apex acute to obtuse, ferruginous-puberulous outside, glabrous inside, ciliate. Corolla shortly tubular or cyathiform, 2.5-3.5 mm long, tube equalling or slightly shorter than lobes in male, much shorter than lobes in female, lobes five(-seven), broadly ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, often auriculate, glabrous. Stamens five(-seven), fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments (male) ca. 0.5 mm long, (female) ca. 1 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous, converted to a flat lanceolate sterile staminode in female. Staminodes five(-seven), vestigial to ca. 1 mm long, narrowly subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary short, expanded at the base, bilocular, pubescent; style ca. 1.5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 2-2.2 cm long, ovoid to subglobose, apex and base rounded, smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary, subglobose, 1.8-2.1 × 1.61.8 cm, testa smooth, shining, thin; scar adaxial, 3-4 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle included; endosperm absent. Field characters. Small, little-branched treelet to 3 m high, often flowering when less than 1 m high. Scant white latex present in stem. The leaves are slightly discolorous. Flowers cream or white, fruit ripening red to purple. Flowering Sep to Nov, fruiting Nov to Feb.

description: Tree, young shoots finely appressed puberulous with pale buff indumentum, becoming glabrous, greyish-brown, rough, lenticellate. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 6.5-19 × 3.1-10.2 cm, broadly oblanceolate to obovate, apex rounded, obtuse, obtusely cuspidate to shortly attenuate, base obtuse to narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous or occasionally with scattered minute pale appressed indumentum on lower surface; venation eucamptodromous, usually with thin marginal vein, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 8-11 pairs, parallel or convergent, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries numerous, close, oblique to horizontal; fine quaternary reticulum present (obscure). Petiole 1.2-2.8 cm long, not channelled, finely appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles 3-8-flowered, axillary and below the leaves, often borne on scaly leafless shoots 2-4 mm long. Pedicel 1-1.5 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals five, 2-2.5 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, appressed puberulous outside, appressed puberulous or glabrous inside. Corolla broadly cyathiform to subrotate, 3.25-3.5 mm long, tube 1-1.5 mm long, lobes five, 2-2.25 mm long, broadly lanceolate, apex obtuse or rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube, exserted; filaments 1.25-1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.6-0.7 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, 1.75-2 mm long, narrowly lanceolate to subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid-conical, five-locular, appressed puberulous; style 1.5-2 mm long after anthesis, exserted, glabrous; style-head minutely five-lobed. Fruit 2.2-3 cm long, ellipsoid, apex acute or obtuse, sometimes apiculate, base acute to rounded, smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary, 1.9-2.5 cm long, ellipsoid, rounded or obtuse at base and apex, testa smooth, shining, 0.3-0.5 mm thick; scar adaxial, almost full-length, elliptic, ca. 1 cm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons; radicle exserted ca. 1 mm; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 35 cm diam. with small buttresses and a strongly fluted bole; bark pale buff-grey to medium brown, scaling in thin irregular pieces, slash pinkish-brown to pale buff, with watery white latex. Rowers whitish or pale green, fruit maturing yellowish-green. Flowering Feb to Apr in Central America, Oct (Venezuela), Sep (Peru); mature fruit May to Aug.

description: Geoxylic subshrub; young shoots densely crisped-pubescent with ferruginous or greyish hairs, becoming glabrous, pale, cracked and fissured, angular due to decurrent petiole bases, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 9.5-17.5 × 3-6.2 cm, oblanceolate, apex obtuse to rounded, base narrowly attenuate, coriaceous, densely crisped-pubescent with ferruginous hairs on both surfaces at first, soon glabrous above, indumentum persisting below and becoming greyish, often eventually glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib flat or slightly raised on upper surface, secondary veins 8-10 pairs, steeply ascending, slightly convergent and arcuate; intersecondaries small or absent; tertiaries mostly oblique. Petiole 0.4-1.2 cm long, not channelled, crisped-pubescent. Fascicles 5-15-flowered, mostly axillary. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, pubescent. Sepals four, 4.5-5.5 mm long, outer two broadly lanceolate, apex obtuse, inner two broadly elliptic, apex rounded, pubescent outside, inner pair with broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular, 5.5-6 mm long, tube slightly longer than lobes, lobes four, broadly oblong, apex truncate, fringed-ciliate. Stamens four, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube; filaments 2-2.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.25-1.5 mm long, lanceolate, apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 2 mm long, narrowly lanceolate or linear, fringed-ciliate. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 5 mm long after anthesis, slightly exserted, strigose in lower half; style-head simple. Fruit ca. 3.5 cm diam., broadly obovoid, apex rounded, base obtuse, smooth, puberulous. Seed one-several, 2-2.5cm long, ellipsoid, sometimes plano-convex, rounded at base and apex, testa smooth, adherent to pericarp, 0.4-0.7 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length and extending across the base, 7-9 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle included; endosperm absent. Field characters. A geoxylic subshrub, the above-ground part of the plant only a few cm high, rarely as much as 1 m high; white latex in the stems; flowers greenish-cream and fruit maturing yellow. Flowering Aug to Oct, mature fruit (one collection only, from São Paulo) in Jun.

description: Tree; young shoots shortly pale-pubescent at first, soon glabrous, greyish, scaling or grid-cracked, without lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 7.6-17.5 × 2.9-5 cm, oblanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate to obtusely cuspidate, base narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous, usually glandular-striate; venation eucamptodromous, sometimes with a thin marginal vein, midrib raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 7-12 pairs, convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries short to moderately long, or absent; tertiaries mostly reticulate, with a few oblique or horizontal. Petiole 0.5-1.8 cm long, not channelled, pubescent to glabrous. Fascicles 5-10-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 1.5-3 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals four, 2.5-3 mm long, outer pairs ovate, apex acute or obtuse, inner pair elliptic to suborbicular, apex rounded, subglabrous, with a few scattered appressed hairs near the base outside. Corolla broadly tubular, 2.5-3.5 mm long, tube 1.25-2.5 mm long, equalling or exceeding the lobes, lobes four, 1-1.25 mm long, broadly oblong, apex rounded or truncate, ciliate. Stamens four, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube; filaments 0.51.25 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.75-1 mm long, lanceolate, apiculate, glabrous, reduced to a small tuft of hairs in female. Staminodes four, 0.5-0.75 mm long, lanceolate to oblong, apex ciliate. Ovary globose, (3-)4-locular, densely strigose; style 1.5-1.75 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 3-4 cm long, obovoid or ellipsoid, apex rounded, base tapered to a short stipe, smooth or slightly verrucose, with residual tomentum in the lower half. Seeds 1-4, 2-2.5 cm long, broadly ellipsoid or plano-convex (when 2 in a fruit), testa smooth, shining, 0.7-1 mm thick; scar adaxial, elliptic, tuberculate, 7-9 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 15 m high and 30 cm diam. with shallow fissured and flaking brown or brownish-red bark, slash white to pale brown, with white milky sap, which sometimes has an unpleasant odour (Croat, 1978: 692). Flowers fragrant, greenish-white, fruit maturing yellow, with an unpleasant odour. Flowering Apr to Jun throughout the range, fruit maturing Aug to Oct.

description: Young shoots glabrous, pale brown, smooth, lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 9.420 × 0.8-1.3 cm, linear or very narrowly oblanceolate, apex acute, base long narrow attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation craspedodromous or brochidodromous, with a submarginal vein very close to, and often fusing with the strong marginal vein, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 22-24 pairs, parallel, straight; intersecondaries well developed; tertiaries obscure. Petiole 1-2 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 1-2-flowered, axillary. Pedicel 5-8 mm long, finely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals four, 0.9-1 cm long, outer lanceolate, inner oblong, apex acute to rounded, finely and sparsely appressed puberulous outside, inner ones with glabrous margin, outer ones puberulous in upper half inside, inner ones glabrous inside. Corolla cylindrical, 1.2-1.4 cm long, tube 8-9 mm long, lobes 6-7, 4-5 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, apex acute, papillose. Stamens 6-7, fixed just below the apex of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, geniculate at apex, glabrous; anthers ca. 2 mm long, oblong, glabrous. Staminodes 6-7, ca. 3 mm long, subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary globose, borne on a short stout stipe, seven-locular, densely pubescent, style ca. 1.1 cm long after anthesis, equalling the corolla, glabrous; style-head capitate. Fruit unknown.

description: Tree; young shoots sparsely and minutely appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, smooth, eventually thinly-scaling, without lenticels. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, 15-31 × 4.5-11 cm, elliptic to broadly oblanceolate, apex narrowly to obtusely attenuate, base narrowly attenuate, decurrent, chartaceous, glabrous or sometimes with a finely and closely appressed pale indumentum on lower surface of young leaves (lens); venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat or slightly raised on upper surface, secondary veins 12-15 pairs, steeply ascending, slightly arcuate and convergent; intersecondaries numerous, oblique to horizontal. Petiole 2-3 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 2-5-flowered, axillary. Pedicel 2-5 mm long, finely appressed puberulous. Sepals four, 4.5-5 mm long, oblong-lanceolate or elliptic, hooded, apex acute, finely appressed puberulous outside, subglabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular, ca. 4.5 mm long, tube slightly longer than lobes, lobes four, broadly oblong, apex rounded, fringed-ciliate. Stamens four, fixed in the lower half of the corolla tube; filaments 1.5-2 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, broadly lanceolate, apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 1.5 mm long, oblong, apex rounded, fringed-ciliate. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 3 mm long after anthesis, about equalling the corolla, glabrous; style-head minutely lobed. Fruit 3-7.5 cm long, globose, rounded at base and apex, covered by numerous anastomosing, convoluted ridges, 1-1.5 cm high and 0.3-1 mm thick, finely appressed puberulous. Seeds 2-4, 2.7-3.2 cm long, planoconvex or shaped like the segment of an orange, rounded at base and apex, testa smooth, hard, ca. 1 mm thick; scar covering almost all the seed surface, except for a slender abaxial strip 1-2 mm wide. Embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle slightly exserted; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 12 m high and 25 cm diam. with dark brown, fissured and scaling bark; slash cream, with white latex; corolla white or greenish; fruit green. Flowers and mature fruit Apr and Jul.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli dense ferrugineo-puberuli, pilis crispatis, tandem glabri, atro-cinerascenti-brunnei, interdum lenticellati. Folia congesta, spiraliter disposita, 15.7-25 × 7.5-11.7 cm, late lanceolata usque obovata, apice rotundata, basi anguste attenuata, margine revoluta, valde coriacea, supra glabra vel costa indumento residuale vestita, infra dense breviter tomentosa, pilis crispatis rufo-brunneis usque ferrugineis; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra plana vel prominula; nervi secundarii 10-12-jugi, parallel^ arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui, obscuri. Petiolus 2.5-4 cm longus, non canaliculata, puberulus vel glaber. Fasciculi 3-7-flori, sub folia congesti. Pedicellus 5-7 mm longus, tomentosus, pilis brevis ferrugineis. Flores bisexuales. Sepala quinque, 6-7 mm longa, sepala exteriora ovata, apice obtusa, sepala interiora elliptica, apice rotundata, extus brevitertomentosa, sepala interiora interdum margine glabra, intus glabra. Corolla late tubularis, ca. 7.5mm longa; tubus ca. 4.5 mm longus; lobi quinque, ca. 3 mm longi, ovati, apice obtusi, glabri. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamentaca. 2 mm longa, glabra; antherae 1.5-2 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, ca. 2 mm longa, lanceolata, carnosa, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium conicum supra medium in ala expansum, 5-loculare, dense tomentosum; stylus post anthesin ca. 2 mm longus, in dimidio inferiore tomentosus; styli ca-pitulum simplex. Fructus immaturus ca. 2.8 × 1.8 cm, ellipsoideus vel obovoideus, apice obtusus, apiculatus, basi decrescens; laevis, glaber. Semen solitarium.

description: Tree; young shoots densely ferruginous-puberulous, hairs crisped, becoming glabrous, dark greyish-brown, lenticellate or not. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 15.7-25 × 7.5-11.7 cm, broadly oblanceolate to obovate, apex rounded, base narrowly attenuate, margin revolute, thickly coriaceous, glabrous above or with residual indumentum along the midrib, densely short-tomentose below with crisped reddish-brown to ferruginous hairs, venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat or slightly prominent, secondary veins 10-12 pairs, parallel, arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique, obscure. Petiole 2.5-4 cm long, not channelled, puberulous or glabrous. Fascicles 3-7-flowered, clustered below the leaves. Pedicel 5-7 mm long, tomentose with short crisped ferruginous hairs. Flowers bisexual. Sepals five, 6-7 mm long, outer ovate with obtuse apex, inner elliptic with rounded apex, shortly tomentose outside, inner ones sometimes with glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular, ca. 7.5 mm long, tube ca. 4.5 mm long, lobes five, ca. 3 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.5-2 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 2 mm long, lanceolate, carnose, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary conical, with a small expanded wing above the middle, five-locular, densely tomentose; style ca. 2 mm long after anthesis, tomentose in lower half; style-head simple. Immature fruit ca. 2.8 × 1.8 cm, ellipsoid or obovoid, apex obtuse, apiculate, base tapered, smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary. Field characters. Tree to 15 m high with scant white latex. Flowers cream. Flowers and young fruit collected in Jan.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli glabri, saepe resina inducti, brunnei, demum tenuiter squamati, interdum lenticellati. Folia congesta, spiraliter disposita, 7-17 × 3.5-7 cm, oblanceolata, apice obtusa, rotundata vel breviter et late attenuata, basi anguste attenuata, leviter decurrentia, tenuiter coriacea, glabra; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra elevata; nervi secundarii 6-8-jugi, leviter convergentes, arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui. Petiolus 1-1.5 cm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 1-3-flori, axillares. Pedicellus 4-5 mm longus, furfuraceo-squamatus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quatuor, ca. 5 mm longa, late lanceolata, apice acuta vel obtusa, sepala externa extus squamata, sepala interna extus glabra, omnia intus glabra. Corolla tubularis, ca. 6 mm longa; tubus ca. 4 mm longus; lobi quatuor, ca. 2 mm longi, late oblongi, apice rotundati, ciliati. Stamina quatuor, in dimidio inferiore tubo corollae affixa; filamenta 2.5-3 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1 mm longae, lanceolatae, complanatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, 0.75-1 mm longa, lanceolato-subulata, ciliata. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideum, quadriloculare, pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 5.5 mm longus, exsertus, in dimidio inferiore pubescens; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus 3.5-4 × 2-2.5 cm, ellipsoideus vel anguste obovoideus, apice obtusus, basi decrescens, laevis, superficie furfuraceo-granulosus. Semen solitarium, 2.1-2.5 × 0.8-0.9 × 0.6-0.7 cm, leviter lateraliter compressum, apice acutum, testa subtiliter transverse rugosa vel laevis, nitida, 0.30.5 mm crassa; cicatrix paene per totam longi-tudinem extensa, adaxialis, 2.5-3.5 mm lata; embryo cotyledonibus plano-convexis, liberis, radicula leviter exserta; albumen nullum.

description: Tree; young shoots glabrous, often resin-coated, medium brown, thinly scaling with age, sometimes lenticellate. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 7-17 × 3.5-7 cm, oblanceolate, apex obtuse, rounded or shortly and broadly attenuate, base narrowly attenuate, slightly decurrent, thinly coriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 6-8 pairs, slightly convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique. Petiole 1-1.5 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 1-3-flowered, axillary. Pedicel 4-5 mm long, scurfy scaly. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, ca. 5 mm long, broadly lanceolate, apex acute or obtuse, outer two scaly outside, inner two glabrous outside, all glabrous inside. Corolla tubular, ca. 6 mm long, tube ca. 4 mm long, lobes four, ca. 2 mm long, broadly oblong, apex rounded, ciliate. Stamens four, fixed in the lower half of the corolla tube; filaments 2.5-3 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate, flattened, apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes four, 0.75-1 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, ciliate. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, four-locular, pubescent; style ca. 5.5. mm long after anthesis, exserted, pubescent in lower half; style-head simple. Fruit 3.5-4 × 2-2.5 cm, ellipsoid or narrowly obovoid, apex obtuse, base tapered, smooth, surface mealy-granular. Seed solitary, 2.1-2.5 × 0.8-0.9 × 0.6-0.7 cm, laterally compressed, apex rounded or acute, base acute, testa smooth or finely transversely wrinkled, shiny, ca. 0.3 mm thick; scar adaxial, almost full-length, 2.5-3.5	mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle slightly exserted; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 40 cm diam. with whitish sap. Flowers greenish-white, fruit ripening yellow. Flowering Aug to Oct, fruit Sep to Feb.

description: Tree; young shoots coarsely spreading-pubescent, becoming glabrous, dark grey-brown, rough and lenticellate. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 11.2-22 × 3.2-9 cm, broadly elliptic to oblanceolate, apex obtusely cuspidate to narrowly attenuate, base narrowly cuneate, obtuse or rounded, chartaceous, glaucous below, glabrous above, lower surface usually sparsely pubescent with spreading dendroid hairs, rarely glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, usually with a thin marginal vein, midrib usually slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 10-12 pairs, slightly convergent, arcuate, strongly raised on the lower surface; intersecondaries small or absent; tertiaries oblique, higher order reticulum rather conspicuous. Petiole 1-1.8 cm long, channelled, pubescent, often decurrent on the stem as two raised lines. Fascicles axillary and in the axils of fallen leaves, 1-5-flowered. Pedicel 0.7-2 cm long (to 3 cm long in fruit), pubescent. Flowers bisexual. Sepals five, 4-5 mm long, ovate to elliptic, obtuse or rounded, spreading-pubescent outside, inner sepals often with a glabrous margin, subglabrous inside. Corolla cyathiform, 4.5-7 mm long, tube equalling the lobes; lobes five, ovate to suborbicular, apex obtuse or rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments 0.5-1.5	mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.75-3 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, 2-3.5 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, keeled, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid or with a slightly protruding collar near the apex, bilocular, densely pubescent; style 1.5-3.5 mm long after anthesis, pubescent in the lower half, style-head simple. Fruit 3.5-4 cm long, ellipsoid, acute at apex and base, hard-skinned, smooth, densely stiff-pubescent at first, eventually becoming subglabrous. Seed solitary, 2.5-2.7 cm long, ellipsoid, laterally compressed, rounded at both ends, testa smooth and shining or slightly roughened, 0.3-0.75 mm thick; scar full length, adaxial, 0.2-1 cm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 25 m high with milky white sap. Flowers white, fruit dull orange with yellowish-brown indumentum. Flowering records Nov and Mar to Apr, mature fruit Feb to Jun. The field data on Foster 5523 (Peru: Madre de Dios) record that the fruit is eaten by the monkey Cebus apella.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli minute adpresse puberuli, pilis aureo-brunneis, indumento persistente, demum glabri, pallide cinerascenti-bubalini, tenuiter squamati, elenticellati. Folia congesta, spiraliter disposita, 13.5-30 × 5.8-11.5 cm, elliptica usque late oblanceolata, apice obtusa usque tenuiter et anguste attenuata, basi acuta usque rotundata, coriacea, supra glabra, infra persistente et subtiliter sericea, pilis aureo-brunneis; venatio eucamptodroma; nervis marginalis praesens; costa supra leviter elevata; nervi secundarii 22-27-jugi, paralleli, leviter arcuati, supra valde impressi; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii numerosi, tunues, obliqui. Petiolus 1.5-2.2 mm longus, non canaliculata, adpresse puberulus. Fasciculi 5-10-flori, axillares et sub foliis dense congesti. Pedicellus 0.5-2 mm longus, sericeus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quatuor, 4.5-5 mm longa, elliptica (duo interiora angustiora), cucullata, apice obtusa, duo exteriora extra adpresse puberula, duo interiora glabra, omnia intus glabra. Corolla late tubularis, ca. 4.5 mm longa; tubus ca. 3 mm longus; lobi quatuor, ca. 1.5 mm longi, late oblongi, apice truncati, glabri, interdum leviter ciliati. Stamina quatuor, medio tubo corollae aflixa; filamenta ca. 2 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, ca. 1 mm longa, oblonga, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium glabrum, quadri-loculare, dense strigosum; stylus post anthesin ca. 2.5 mm longus, glaber; stylicapitulum simplex. Fructus (non visus) 8-10 cm diam.
