description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous with golden-brown hairs, indumentum persistent, eventually glabrous, pale greyish-buff, thinly scaling, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 13.5-30 × 5.8-11.5 cm, elliptic to broadly oblanceolate, apex obtuse to shortly narrowly attenuate, base acute to rounded, coriaceous, glabrous above, persistently finely sericeous below with golden-brown indumentum; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib slightly prominent on the upper surface, secondary veins 22-27 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate, strongly impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries numerous, fine, oblique. Petiole 1.5-2.2 cm long, not channelled, appressed puberulous. Fascicles 5-10-flowered, axillary and densely clustered below the leaves. Pedicel 0.5-2 mm long, sericeous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, 4.5-5 mm long, elliptic (inner two narrower), hooded, apex obtuse, outer two appressed puberulous outside, inner two glabrous outside, all glabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular, ca. 4.5 mm long, tube ca. 3 mm long, lobes four, ca. 1.5 mm long, broadly oblong, apex truncate, glabrous, sometimes slightly ciliate. Stamens four, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 1 mm long, oblong, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, densely strigose; style ca. 2.5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit (not seen) 8-10 cm diam. Field characters. Tree to 25 m high and 60 cm diam. with creamish-white flowers. Flowering Mar-May.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli adpresse puberuli, mox glabri, cinerascenti-brunnei, squamati, elenticellati. Folia congesta, spiraliter disposita, 10-15 × 5.9-9 cm, late elliptica vel obovata, apice obtusa, interdum breviter cuspidata, basi obtusa, coriacea, glabra, venatio plerumque eucamptodroma; interdum prope apicem brochidodroma; costa supra leviter prominula; nervus marginalis praesens; nervi secundarii 10-11-jugi, ascendentes; paralleli, leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii laxe reticulati et obliqui. Petiolus 1.1-1.8 cm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 1-pauci-flori, axillares. Pedicellus 0.5-1 cm longus, breviter pubescens. Sepala quinque, 3-3.5 cm longa, ovata vel oblonga, apice obtusa usque rotundata, extus pubescentia, intus glabrescentia, fimbriato ciliata. Corolla cyathiformis, 7.5-8 mm longa, tubus ca. 2.5 mm longus, lobi quinque, 4.5-5 mm longi, late elliptici, apice rotundati, basi leviter auriculata glabri. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; antherae 4-4.5 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae, sessiles sed prominentibes filis vascularibus usque ad basin tubi corollae visibilibus. Staminodia quinque, 4-4.5 mm longa, anguste lanceolata, plica longitudinali carinam adaxialem prominentem faciente, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium in stylum decrescens, bilocu-lare, dense et longe strigosum; stylus post anthesin ca. 4 mm longus, inclusus, dense strigosus; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ignotus.

description: Tree, young shoots appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, scaling, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 10-15 × 5.9-9 cm, broadly elliptic or obovate, apex obtuse, sometimes shortly cuspidate, base obtuse, coriaceous, glabrous; venation mostly eucamptodromous, sometimes brochidodromous near apex, midrib slightly raised on upper surface, marginal vein present, secondary veins 10-11 pairs, ascending, parallel, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries open-reticulate and some oblique. Petiole 1.1-1.8 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles axillary, 1-few-flowered. Pedicel 0.5-1 cm long, shortly pubescent. Sepals five, 3-3.5 mm long, ovate or oblong, apex obtuse to rounded, pubescent outside, glabrous inside, fringed-ciliate. Corolla cyathiform, 7.5-8 mm long, tube ca. 2.5 mm long, lobes five, 4.5-5 mm long, broadly elliptic, apex rounded, slightly auriculate at base, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; anthers 4-4.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous, sessile, but prominent filament traces visible to base of corolla tube. Staminodes five, 4-4.5 mm long, narrowly lanceolate with a longitudinal fold forming a prominent adaxial keel, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary tapering gradually to style, bilocular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 4 mm long after anthesis, included, densely strigose; style-head simple. Fruit unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots golden-sericeous at first, soon glabrous, greyish-white, slightly scaling, usually lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged to rarely subopposite, 4.4-10 × 2.1-3.7 cm, elliptic to broadly oblanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate to rounded, base narrowly attenuate or cuneate, margins usually revolute, thinly coriaceous, upper surface minutely pustular or pitted, glabrous, glaucous below, with residual appressed sericeous indumentum; venation brochidodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface (at least in the upper half of the leaf), secondary veins 6-13 pairs, parallel, straight, slightly impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries long (sometimes obscure); tertiaries obscure. Petiole 0.5-1.3 cm long, not channelled, sericeous at first. Fascicles 2-8-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 0.4-0.7(-l) cm long, golden sericeous. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals 5-6, 1.75-2 mm long, ovate, apex acute to rounded, golden sericeous on both surfaces. Corolla cyathiform, 1.75-2.5 mm long, tube 0.75-1 mm long, lobes five(-six), 1-1.5 mm long (equalling or exceeding the tube), ovate, apex obtuse to rounded, glabrous or with sparse appressed indumentum near base of tube. Stamens five(six), fixed at or near the top of the corolla tube; filaments 0.25-0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.75 mm long, ovate, glabrous; stamens absent in female. Staminodes 0-2, usually vestigial. Disk absent. Ovary broadly conical, bilocular, pubescent; style ca. 0.5 mm long after anthesis (male); absent or very short in female; style-head simple or slightly expanded. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high, the leaf undersurface silvery or bluish; flowers white. Flowering Dec-Jan, May-Jul.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli aureo-brunnei, adpresse puberuli, mox glabri, pallide cinerascenti, subtiliter rimosi, elenticellati. Folia laxe congesta, spiraliter disposita, 5.3-16.5 × 2.5-4.5 cm, anguste elliptica usque oblonga vel oblanceolata, apice breviter anguste attenuata usque acuta vel rotundata, basi anguste attenuata, tenuiter coriacea, supra glabra, infra indumento sparso minute adpresse aureo-brunneo vestita (solum sub lente visibili); venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra valde impressa; nervus marginalis tenuis praesens; nervis secundarii 15-33-jugi, paralleli, recti; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii subtiliter areolati (in superficie superiore solum visibili). Petiolus 0.9-2.1 cm longus, leviter canaliculata, adpresse puberulus. Fasciculi 3-10-flori, plerumque axillares. Pedicellus 3-4 mm longus, adpresse puberulus. Flores bisexuales. Sepala quinque, 2.5-3 mm longa, ovata usque suborbiculares, apice acuta vel rotundata, extus adpresse puberula, intus glabra, ciliata. Corolla breviter tubularis, 3-4 mm longa; tubus 1.75-2 mm longus; lobi quinque, 1.25-1.5 mm longi, oblongi, apice obtusi, in superficie exteriore loborum sericei. Stamina quinque, prope apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta 0.5-1 mm long, ad apicem geniculata, glabra; antherae 0.75-1 mm longae, lanceolato-sagittatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, ca. 1 mm longa, subulata, papillosa. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideum, quinque-loculare, pubescens; stylus post anthesin 2.5-3 mm longus, in alabastro et flore aperta exsertus, in dimidio inferiore pubescens; styli capitulum simplex vel capitatum. Fructus 4-5 cm longus, ovoideus usque globosus, apice et basi rotundatus, laevis, glaber. Semen solitarium, 2-3 cm diam, globosum, testa ossea ca. 1 mm crassa; cicatrix valde aspera, pleroque semine operto, parva area laevis in superficie abaxiale relicta; embryo non visus.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots golden-brown, appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, pale grey, finely cracked, without lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 5.3-16.5 × 2.5-4.5 cm, narrowly elliptic to oblong or oblanceolate, apex shortly narrowly attenuate, to acute or rounded, base narrowly attenuate, thinly coriaceous, glabrous above, lower surface golden-brown with sparse minute appressed indumentum (lens); venation eucamptodromous, midrib deeply sunken, thin marginal vein present, secondary veins 15-33 pairs, parallel, straight; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries finely areolate (visible only on upper surface). Petiole 0.9-2.1 cm long, slightly channelled, appressed puberulous. Fascicles 3- 10-flowered, mostly axillary. Pedicel 3-4 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals five, 2.5-3 mm long, ovate to suborbicular, apex acute to rounded, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside, ciliate. Corolla shortly tubular, 3-4 mm long, tube 1.75-2 mm long, lobes five, 1.25-1.5 mm long, oblong, apex obtuse, sericeous on the outer surface of lobes. Stamens five, fixed near the top of the corolla tube; filaments 0.5-1 mm long, geniculate at apex, glabrous; anthers 0.75-1 mm long, lanceolate-sagittate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 1 mm long, subulate, papillose. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, five-locular, pubescent; style 2.5-3 mm long after anthesis, exserted in bud and open flower, pubescent in lower half; style-head simple or capitate. Fruit 4-5 cm long, ovoid to globose, apex and base rounded, smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary, 2-3 cm diam., globose, testa bony, ca. 1 mm thick; scar very rough, covering most of the seed, leaving a small smooth strip on the abaxial surface; embryo not seen. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 50 cm diam. with steep simple plank buttresses to 1 m high; bark reddish-brown to brown, scaling in small rectangular pieces; slash pinkish, with sticky white latex. Bole sometimes fluted. Flowers greenish-white from Jul to Oct.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli subtiliter adpresse puberuli (pilis brunneis), demum glabri, porcati, ci-nerascenti, squamati et rimosi. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 12-21 × 6.2-9.3 cm, elliptica usque late oblanceolata, apice et basi anguste attenuata, chartacea, glabra; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra leviter elevata; nervus marginalis tenuis praesens; nervi secundarii 11-14-jugi, paralleli, recti vel leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii laxe dispositi; nervi quatemarii subtiliter areolati in superficiebus ambabus conspicui. Petiolus 1.5-2.5 cm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 3-10-flori, axillares et in axillis foliorum delapsorum dispositi. Pedicellus 2-4 mm longus, adpresse puberulus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quinque, ca. 2 mm longa, ovata vel lanceolata, apice acuta, extus adpresse puberula, intus glabra. Corolla ca. 3.5 mm longa; lobi quinque, ca. 2.5 mm longi, patentes, oblongi, apice rotundati, glabri. Stamina quinque, in dimidio superiore tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 0.4 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 0.8 mm longae, late lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, ca. 1.5 mm longa, lanceolata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium coni-cum, 1-2-loculare, glaber praeter annulum pi-lorum circum basim dispositarum, in stylum descrescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 0.75 mm longus; styli-capitulum capitatum. Fructus Ignotus.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous (brown hairs), becoming glabrous, ridged, greyish, scaling and cracked. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 13-21 × 6.2-9.3 cm, elliptic to broadly oblanceolate, apex and base narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, thin marginal vein present, secondary veins 11-14 pairs, parallel, straight or slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique, rather widely spaced; fine quaternary areolate reticulum conspicuous on both surfaces. Petiole 1.5-2.5 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles axillary and in the axils of fallen leaves, 3-10-flowered. Pedicel 2-4 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, ca. 2 mm long, ovate or lanceolate, apex acute, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Corolla ca. 3.5 mm long, lobes five, ca. 2.5 mm long, spreading, oblong, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed in the upper half of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.4 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.8 mm long, broadly lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary conical, 1-2-locular, glabrous except for a ring of hairs around the base, tapering gradually into the style; style ca. 0.75 mm long after anthesis; style-head capitate. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 60 cm diam. Bark scaling; slash laminated with alternating bands of orange and white. Flowers greenish-white, in Nov.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Arbor:; ramuli novelli subglabri, rufo-brunnei, longitudinaliter rimosi et tenuiter squamati, len-ticellis grandis. Folia dissita vel laxe congesta, spiraliter disposita, 4.5-12 × 2-6.7 cm, oblanceolata, obovata vel elliptica, apice obtuse cuspidata vel rotundata, basi anguste attenuata vel cuneata, coriacea, glabra, infra subglauca; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra prominula; nervus marginalis tenuis plerumque praesens; nervi secundarii 7-10-jugi, supra leviter impressi, leviter convergentes et arcuati, prope marginum saepe irregulares; nervi intersecundarii variables vel nulli; nervi tertiarii pauci, reticulati usque obliqui; nervi quatemarii nulli. Petiolus 0.6-1.7 cm longus, leviter canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 1-2-flori, efoliorum delapsorum axillis orti. Flores sessiles, bisexuales (?). Sepala quinque, 5-5.5 mm longa, lanceolata, apice acuta, extus pilis sparsis brevibus adpressis vestita vel glabra, intus glabra. Corolla tubularis, ad apicem leviter expansa, 7-7.5 mm longa; tubus 4-4.5 mm longus; lobi quinque, 2.5-3 mm longi, late ovati, apice obtusi, glabri. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta 1-1.25 mm longa, recta, glabra; antherae ca. 0.8 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, 1-1.5 mm longa, elliptica vel lanceolata, satis carnosa, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium breviter trun-catum, biloculare, dense et longe pubescens, stylus post anthesin ca. 4 mm longus, inclusus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus 3.5-5.5 × 3-4 cm, globosus vel obovoideus, apice rotundatus, basi rotundatus vel leviter decrescens, laevis (sub lente minute squamatus), in sicco pallide brunneus, putamine duro 3-5 mm crasso. Semen solitarium, 2.4-3.4 cm longum, ellipsoideum, leviter lateraliter compressum, basi et apice obtusum vel rotundatum; testa laevis; nitida, 1-1.5 mm; crassa; cicatrix adaxialis per longitudinem extensa, 0.8-1.9 cm lata, embryo cotyledonibus plano-convexis, liberis, radicula ad superficiem extensa; albumen nullum.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots subglabrous, reddish-brown, longitudinally cracked and thinly scaling, with large lenticels. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 4.5-12 × 2-6.7 cm, oblanceolate, obovate or elliptic, apex obtusely cuspidate or rounded, base narrowly attenuate or cuneate, coriaceous, glabrous, subglaucous below; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, thin marginal vein usually present, secondary veins 7-10 pairs, slightly sunken on upper surface, slightly convergent and arcuate, often rather irregular near the margin; intersecondaries variable, or absent; tertiaries few, reticulate to oblique; quaternaries absent. Petiole 0.6-1.7 cm long, slightly channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 1-2-flowered, in the axils of fallen leaves. Flowers sessile, bisexual (?). Sepals five, 5-5.5 mm long, lanceolate, apex acute, outside with scattered short appressed hairs or glabrous, inside glabrous. Corolla tubular, slightly expanded at the apex, 7-7.5 mm long, tube 4-4.5 mm long, lobes five, 2.5-3 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the staminal tube; filaments 1-1.25 mm long, straight, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.8 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, 1-1.5 mm long, elliptic or lanceolate, rather fleshy, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary shortly truncate, bilocular, densely long-pubescent; style ca. 4 mm long after anthesis, included, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 3.5-5.5 × 3-4 cm, globose or obovoid, apex rounded, base rounded or slightly tapered, smooth (minutely scaly with lens), drying pale brown, with a hard shell 3-5 mm thick. Seed solitary, 2.4-3.4 cm long, ellipsoid, slightly laterally compressed, obtuse or rounded at base and apex; testa smooth, shiny, 1-1.5 mm thick; scar adaxial, full length, 0.8-1.9 cm wide, only slightly narrower than the total width of the seed; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 75 cm diam. with white flowers and pale brown fruit. Flowering Oct, fruit maturing Apr-Nov.

description: Young shoots finely appressed puberulous with brown indumentum, becoming glabrous, greyish, cracked and fissured, rough with persistent inflorescence bases. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 7.8-15 × 2-4.5 cm, elliptic or oblanceolate, apex and base narrowly attenuate, thinly coriaceous, finely appressed rufous-brown puberulous on both surfaces at first, becoming glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib not raised on upper surface, secondary veins 22-25 pairs, ascending, straight, parallel; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique. Petiole 0.7-1.3 cm long, not channelled, finely appressed puberulous. Fascicles 10-20-flowered, mostly below the leaves. Pedicel 2-4 mm long, finely appressed puberulous. Sepals five, ca. 1.5 mm long, ovate, apex rounded, finely rufous-brown appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside, ciliate. Corolla (not seen, description from Pulle) 2 mm long, lobes five, exceeding the tube, oblong-elliptic. Stamens five, fixed at the middle of the corolla tube; filaments short, thickened; anthers glabrous. Staminodes few or one, dentiform or deltoid, unequal. Ovary truncate, five-locular, style-head five-lobed. Fruit unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli glabri, cinerascentibrunnei, tandem subtiliter rimosi, lenticellati. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 9.5-14 × 3.8-5.7 cm, elliptica vel elliptico-lanceolata, saepe modice asymmetrica, apice anguste attenuata, basi anguste cuneata vel breviter et anguste attenuata, margine leviter revoluta, chartacea, glabra; venatio brochidodroma, nervus marginalis nullus, costa supra non elevata, nervi secundarii 11-14-jugi, paralleli, recti; nervi intersecundarii modici usque longi; nervi tertiarii aperte reticulati. Petiolus 1.2-1.6 cm longus, canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 2-6-flori, axillares et in ramulos aphyllos laterales breves 1-3 cm longos congesti. Pedicellus 4-6 mm longus, glaber. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quinque, ca. 1 mm longa, late ovata, apice obtusa, saepe late extensa, extus glabra, intus adpresse puberula, interdum leviter ciliata. Corolla ca. 2 mm longa, tubus ca. 0.75 mm longus, lobi quinque, ca. 1.25 mm longi, late ovati, rotundati vel obtusi, glabri. Stamina quinque, tubo corollae in dimidio inferiore affixa; filamenta ca. 0.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 0.75 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, ca. 1 mm longa, lanceolato-subulata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideum, biloculare, adpresse puberulum; stylus post anthesin ca. 0.75 mm longus, ad basim adpresse puberulus; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ignotus.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots glabrous, greyish-brown, becoming finely cracked with age, lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 9.5-14 × 3.8-5.7 cm, elliptic or elliptic-lanceolate, often somewhat asymmetric, apex narrowly attenuate, base narrowly cuneate to shortly narrowly attenuate, margin slightly revolute, chartaceous, glabrous; venation brochidodromous, marginal vein absent, midrib not raised above, secondary veins 11-14 pairs, parallel, straight; intersecondaries moderate to long; tertiaries open-reticulate. Petiole 1.2-1.6 cm long, channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 2-6-flowered, axillary and clustered on short lateral leafless shoots 1-3 cm long. Pedicel 4-6 mm long, glabrous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, ca. 1 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse, often widely spreading, glabrous outside, appressed puberulous inside, sometimes slightly ciliate. Corolla ca. 2 mm long, tube ca. 0.75 mm long, lobes five, ca. 1.25 mm long, broadly ovate, rounded or obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed in the lower half of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.75 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, bilocular, appressed puberulous; style ca. 0.75 mm long after anthesis, appressed puberulous at base; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Hard-wooded tree to 20 m high, with white latex. Flowering in Sep.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, rough, greyish, without lenticels. Leaves densely clustered, spirally arranged, 10.7-20 × 5-8 cm, broadly oblanceolate, apex obtuse or shortly cuspidate, base rounded, or obtuse, chartaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 15-18 pairs, parallel, straight; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique; quaternaries obscure, finely areolate. Petiole 1.9-2.3 cm long, not or only slightly channelled, appressed puberulous. Fascicles 2-4-flowered, clustered below the leaves. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals 11, in a closely overlapping spiral, increasing in size towards the centre, outer 0.2 mm long, inner 7-9 mm long, broader than long, apex rounded to emarginate, sericeous outside, with broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Corolla cylindrical, 1.8-1.9 cm long, tube 1.4-1.5 cm long, lobes five, ca. 4 mm long, oblong, apex truncate, sericeous-strigose outside of the centre of the lobe and upper part of the tube, glabrous inside. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments 3-3.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.5-1.75 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 3 mm long, subulate, minutely ciliate. Disk absent. Ovary broadly cylindrical, truncate, five-locular, coarsely pubescent; style 1.2-1.5 cm long after anthesis, slightly exserted in bud, filiform, glabrous above; style-head minutely lobed or capitate. Fruit (not seen, description from Ducke) immature 3.5 cm diam., globose. Seed 2-2.5 × 1.4-1.7 cm, testa shining, scar broad.  Known only from the type collection in W Amazonas, Brazil, when it occurs in non-flooded forest. Field characters. A large tree, the cut bark smelling of almonds (hydrocyanic acid). Flowers sweetly scented, white, in Oct.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli minute et adpresse puberuli, mox glabri, pallide bubalini usque cinerascenti-brunnei, demum rimosi et fissurati, elenticellati. Folia dissita vel laxe congesta, spiraliter disposita, 8.6-20 × 2.8-6.5 cm, elliptica, oblongo-elliptica vel oblonga, apice anguste attenuata, acuta, obtusa vel raro rotundata, basi acuta, anguste cuneata vel attenuata, chartacea, glabra; venatio plerumque eucamptodroma, raro brochidodroma; interdum nervus marginalis tenuis praesens; costa supra plana vel elevata; nervi secundarii (10-)13-23-jugi, paralleli vel leviter convergentes, arcuati vel fere recti; nervi intersecundarii breves usque modici; nervi tertiarii reticulati et obliqui. Petiolus 0.8-2.1 cm longus, margines valde plicati, minute et adpresse puberulus usque glaber. Fasciculi 5-10-flori, axillares et sub foliis congesti, Pedicellus 0.5-1.5 mm longus, minute et parce adpresse puberulus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quatuor, ca. 2 mm longa, late ovata, sepala externa apice obtusa, sepala interna apice rotundata, sepala externa minute et adpresse puberula, sepala interna glabra, sepala tota intus glabra. Corolla late tubularis, ca. 3 mm longa; tubus ca. 2 mm longus; lobi quatuor, ca. 1 mm longi, late oblongi, apice rotundata ciliati. Stamina quatuor, in dimidio inferiore tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 1.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1 mm longae, ovato-lanceolatae, complanatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, ca. 0.75 mm longa, lanceolata, apice rotundata, ciliata. Discus nullus. Ovarium late ovoideum, quadriloculare, dense pubescens; stylus ca. 1.7 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus 2-4 cm longus, irregulariterglo-bosus, apice et basi rotundatus, cortice molli et camoso, in sicco deformatus, glaber. Semina plura, 1.8-2 mm longa, late ellipsoidea, interdum in apicem decrescens, testa laevis, ad pericarpium adherens, 1-1.5 mm crassa; cicatrix adaxialis et interdum circa basim extensa, 0.41 cm late; embryo cotyledonibus piano-convexis, liberis, radicula ad superficiem extensa; albumen nullum.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, pale buff to greyish-brown, becoming cracked and fissured, without lenticels. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 8.6-20 × 2.8-6.5 cm, elliptic, oblong-elliptic or oblong apex narrowly attenuate, acute, obtuse or rarely rounded, base acute, narrowly cuneate or attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation usually eucamptodromous, rarely brochidodromous, sometimes with a thin marginal vein, midrib flat or raised on the upper surface, secondary veins (10-) 13-23 pairs, parallel, or slightly convergent, arcuate or almost straight; intersecondaries short to moderate; tertiaries a mixture of reticulate with some oblique. Petiole 0.8-2.1 cm long, margins strongly infolded, minutely appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles 5-10-flowered, axillary and clustered below the leaves. Pedicel 0.5-1.5 mm long, minutely and sparsely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, ca. 2 mm long, broadly ovate, apex of outer ones obtuse, inner ones rounded, outer ones minutely appressed puberulous, inner glabrous, all glabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular, ca. 3 mm long, tube ca. 2 mm long, lobes four, ca. 1 mm long, broadly oblong, apex rounded, ciliate. Stamens four, fixed about one third up the corolla tube; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, ovate-lanceolate, flattened, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 0.75 mm long, lanceolate, apex rounded, ciliate. Disk absent. Ovary broadly ovoid, four-locular, densely pubescent; style ca. 1.7 mm long, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 2-4 cm long, irregularly globose, apex and base rounded, soft-skinned and fleshy, deforming on drying, glabrous. Seeds several, 1.8-2 cm long, broadly ellipsoid, sometimes tapering to the apex, testa smooth, adherent to the pericarp, 1-1.5 mm thick; scar adaxial and sometimes extending around the base, 0.4-1 cm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 40 cm diam. with reddish-brown scaling bark; slash with white or rarely yellow latex. Flowers greenish-yellow, fruit maturing yellowish, reputedly eaten by fish (Paula 786, Brazil: Maranhão). Flowering and fruiting throughout the year.

description: Tree; young shoots glabrous, becoming pale buff-brown, cracked and scaling, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 8-12 × 3-4 cm, oblanceolate, apex obtuse to shortly narrowly attenuate, base narrowly attenuate or cuneate, decurrent, chartaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 8-9 pairs, convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries horizontal to oblique, higher order reticulum only slightly less prominent than the tertiaries. Petiole 0.6-1.2 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 2-5-flowered, mostly clustered below the leaves. Pedicel 0.8-1.2 cm long, slender, glabrous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, 3-4 mm long, ovate (outer) to suborbicular (inner), apex obtuse to rounded, glabrous. Corolla tubular, 5-6 mm long, tube 3-4 mm long, lobes four, ca. 2 mm long, oblong, apex truncate, with sparse long appressed hairs on the outside of the lobes. Stamens four, fixed about one-third up the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, broadly lanceolate, apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 1.5 mm long, narrowly oblong, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, pubescent; style 4.5-6 mm long after anthesis, exserted, glabrous; style-head capitate. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree 30 cm diam. with whitish-green flowers. Flowering Aug.

description: Shrub or bushy tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous with ferruginous hairs, soon glabrous, greyish or greyish-white, finely cracked, usually without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 4-11.5 × 2-3.9 cm, oblanceolate, elliptic or oblong, apex rounded or truncate, less frequently obtuse, base acute, narrowly cuneate or rounded, margin strongly revolute, coriaceous, glabrous above, lower surface persistently puberulous with sparse minute appressed ferruginous hairs; venation obscure, brochidodromous, marginal vein sometimes visible, midrib slightly sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins obscure, ca. 15-20 pairs, parallel, straight; intersecondaries and tertiaries obscure. Petiole 0.7-1.3 cm long, not channelled, subglabrous. Fascicles 5-15-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 0.5-1.2 cm long, minutely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 2-3 mm long, broadly ovate to suborbicular, apex acute or obtuse, fused near base, finely appressed puberulous outside, subglabrous inside, often ciliate. Corolla cyathiform, 3-3.5 mm long, tube equalling or slightly shorter than lobes, lobes five(-seven), ovate or elliptic, apex acute or obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five(-seven), fixed in the upper half of the corolla tube; filaments 0.25-0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.75-1 mm long, ovate or lanceolate, sometimes apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes 0-5, 0.5-2 mm long, subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid or conical, bilocular, pubescent; style 0.5-1 mm long after anthesis, pubescent below; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Shrub or bushy tree to 8 m high with thick sticky white latex, leaves bluish-green or brownish-green on the lower surface; flowers fragrant, white; fruit ferruginous-brown. Flowering Oct-Nov and Apr, fruit maturing Mar-Apr and Oct.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli subglabri, pallide cinerascenti-bubalini, frustis tenuibus desquamati, elenticellati. Folia congesta, spiraliter disposita, 16.7-30 × 5.5-11 cm, elliptica usque oblanceolata, apice obtusa usque anguste attenuata, basi anguste attenuata, decurrentia, chartacea, supra glabra, infra subglabra vel pilis arcte adpressis albidis vestita; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra elevata; nervi secundarii 12-14-jugi, convergentes, valde arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui usque horizontales, numerosi. Petiolus 2.5-5.5 cm longus, non canaliculata, lateraliter complanatus vel anguste alatus, glaber. Fasciculi 1-4-flori, axillares et sub foliis dispositi. Pedicellus 1-2.5 mm longus, adpresse puberulus, pilis brunneis. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quatuor, ca. 6 mm longa, lanceolato-oblonga, apice obtusa, sepala externa extus adpresse puberula, sepala interna extus glabra, sepala tota intus glabra, margine ciliata. Corolla cylindrica, ca. 8 mm longa; tubus ca. 5.5 mm longus; lobi quatuor, ca. 2.5 mm longi, oblongi, apice rotundati, margine dense fimbriato-hirsuti. Stamina quatuor, medio tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 2.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 2.2 mm longae, oblongae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, ca. 1.5 mm longa, oblongo-lanceolata, dense fimbriato-hirsuta. Discus nullus. Ovarium glabrum, quadriloculare, dense et longe strigosum; stylus post anthesin ca. 5 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ignotus.

description: Tree; young shoots subglabrous, pale greyish-buff, scaling in thin sheets, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 16.7-30 × 5.5-11 cm, elliptic to oblanceolate, apex obtuse to narrowly attenuate, base narrowly attenuate, decurrent, chartaceous, glabrous above, subglabrous below or with a closely appressed covering of whitish hairs; venation eucamptodromous, midrib raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 12-14 pairs, convergent, strongly arcuate, intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique to horizontal, numerous. Petiole 2.5-5.5 cm long, not channelled, flattened laterally or narrowly winged, glabrous. Fascicles 1-4-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 1-2.5 mm long, appressed puberulous with brown hairs. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, ca. 6 mm long, lanceolate-oblong, apex obtuse, outer two appressed puberulous outside, inner two glabrous outside, all glabrous inside, margin ciliate. Corolla cylindrical, ca. 8 mm long, tube ca. 5.5. mm long, lobes four, ca. 2.5 mm long, oblong, apex rounded, margin densely fringed-hairy. Stamens four, fixed about half way up the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 2.2 mm long, oblong, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 1.5 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, densely fringed-hairy. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 15m high and 12 cm diam. with white latex, flowers scented, greenish cream, Aug to Oct.

description: Tree; young shoots finely puberulous, soon glabrous, pale greyish-buff, thinly cracked and scaling, lenticellate. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 7.5-13.6 × 2.5-4.5 cm, oblanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate to obtuse, base narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, thin marginal vein present, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 5-6 pairs, convergent and strongly arcuate; intersecondaries absent, tertiaries numerous, fine, horizontal. Petiole 1.4-2 cm long, channelled, subglabrous. Fascicles 5-10-flowered, mostly axillary, often densely clustered. Pedicel 1.5-2.5 mm long, sparsely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, ca. 3 mm long, outer two lanceolate, apex obtuse, inner two broadly elliptic, apex rounded, sparsely appressed puberulous outside, inner two with broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Corolla shortly tubular, ca. 4.5 mm long, tube ca. 3 mm long, lobes four, ca. 1.5 mm long, oblong, apex rounded, fringed-ciliate. Stamens four, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1-1.25 mm long, broadly lanceolate, flattened, long-apiculate, with a few minute hairs at the apex. Staminodes four, ca. 1.25 mm long, subulate, fringed-ciliate. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 3 mm long, after anthesis, strigose in lower half; style-head simple. Fruit unknown.  Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 50 cm diam. without buttresses, bole fluted; flowers cream, with a greenish tinge, in Apr.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli adpresse puberuli, mox glabri, atrobrunnei, lenticellis prominentibus pallidis, demum pallide brunnei. Folia laxe congesta, spiraliter disposita, 14.5-22 × 5-9.2 cm, elliptica usque oblongo-oblanceolata, apice anguste attenuata vel acuminata, basi acuta, tenu-iter coriacea, supra glabra, infra parce et minute hirsuta, pilis arete adpressis, albidis (sub lente solum visibilibus); venatio plerumque brochidodroma; nervus marginalis tenuis praesens; costa et nervi secundarii supra elevata; nervi secundarii 11-15-jugi, paralleli vel leviter convergentes, leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui et reticulati. Petiolus 2.2-3.5 cm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 3-10-flori, axillares et sub foliis dispositi. Pedicellus 3-5 mm longus, adpresse puberulus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quinque, 4-4.5	mm longa, lanceolata usque elliptica, apice acuta usque rotundata, extus adpresse puberula, intus glabra, ciliata. Corolla 5-5.5 mm longa; tubus ca. 2 mm longus; lobi quinque, ca. 3 mm longi, late oblongi, apice truncati, margine ciliata. Stamina 5, prope apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 1.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1.5 mm longae, lanceolatae, apiculatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, 1.5-2.5 mm longa, lanceolato-subulata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideo-conicum, biloculare, adpresse pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 2 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum discoideum. Fructus ignotus.

description: Tree; young shoots appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, dark brown with prominent pale lenticels, finally becoming pale brown. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 14.5-22 × 5-9.2 cm, elliptic to oblong-oblanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate or acuminate, base acute, thinly coriaceous, glabrous above, sparsely and minutely hairy below, indumentum of stiff, closely appressed, whitish hairs (visible only with a lens); venation mostly brochidodromous, marginal vein thin, midrib and secondary veins raised on the upper surface; secondaries 1-15 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique and reticulate. Petiole 2.2-3.5 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 3-10-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 3-5 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 4-4.5 mm long, lanceolate to elliptic, apex acute to rounded, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside, ciliate. Corolla 5-5.5 mm long, tube ca. 2 mm long, lobes five, ca. 3 mm long, broadly oblong, apex truncate, margin ciliate. Stamens five, fixed near the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate, apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes five, 1.5-2.5 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid-conical, bilocular, appressed pubescent; style ca. 2 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head discoid. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 10 m high and 20 cm diam. with whitish flowers; collected in Sep.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli dense ferrugineo-brun-neo-pubescentes, indumento persistente demum fissurati. Folia congesta, spiraliter disposita, 1925 x 5.5-8.5 cm, oblanceolata, apice acuta usque rotundata, basi anguste attenuata, margine revoluta, tenuiter coriacea, supra costa adpresse puberula, lamina glabra, infra costa breviter adpresse pubescens, pilis ferrugineo-brunnei, lamina subglabra; venatio eucamptodroma; supra costa plana vel prominula; nervi secundarii 13-15-jugi, paralleli vel leviter convergentes, arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui. Petiolus 2.5-3 cm longus, non canaliculatus, dense ferrugineo-brunneo-pubescens. Fasciculi 2-5-flori, axillares. Pedicellus crassus, 0.9-1 cm longus, dense et breviter pubescens. Flores bisexuales. Sepala quatuor, 1-1.3 cm longa, late elliptica usque orbiculares, apice rotundata, sepala exteriora valde incrassata, extus dense et breviter pubescentia, sepala interiora margine lata glabra, intus dense adpresse puberula, sepala interiora interdum subglabra. Corolla late cylindrica, ca. 1.5 cm longa; tubus 0.9-1 cm longus; lobi octo, 5-6 mm longi, lanceolati vel oblongi, apice acuti vel obtusi, papillosi. Stamina octo, ad apicem tubo corolla affixa; filamenta ca. 2 mm longa, ad apicem geniculata, glabra; antherae ca. 1.5 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia octo, 2-2.5 mm longa, anguste lanceolata, papillosa. Discus nullus. Ovarium late cylindricum ad apicem truncatum, 10-loculare, dense pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 1.3 cm longus, corollam fere aequans, inferioribus duabus partibus pubescens, styli capitulum capitatum. Fructus ignotus.

description: Tree; young shoots densely ferruginous-brown pubescent, indumentum persistent, becoming fissured with age. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 19-25 × 5.5-8.5 cm, oblanceolate, apex acute to rounded, base narrowly attenuate, margin revolute, thinly coriaceous, upper surface with appressed puberulous midrib and glabrous 1amina, lower surface with shortly appressed pubescent midrib (ferruginous-brown hairs), lamina subglabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 13-15 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique. Petiole 2.5-3 cm long, not channelled, densely ferruginous-brown pubescent. Fascicles axillary, 2-5-flowered. Pedicel stout, 0.9-1 cm long, densely short-pubescent. Flowers bisexual. Sepals four, 1-1.3 cm long, broadly elliptic to orbicular, apex rounded, outer ones strongly thickened, densely short pubescent outside, inner ones with broad glabrous margin, densely appressed puberulous inside, inner ones sometimes largely glabrous. Corolla broadly cylindrical, ca. 1.5 cm long, tube 0.9-1 cm long, lobes eight, 5-6 mm long, lanceolate or oblong, apex acute to obtuse, papillose. Stamens eight, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2 mm long, geniculate at apex, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes eight, 2-2.5 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, papillose. Disk absent. Ovary broadly cylindrical with truncate apex, ten-locular, densely pubescent; style ca. 1.3 cm long after anthesis, almost equalling the corolla, pubescent in the lower two-thirds; style-head capitate. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high with fissured and scaling bark. Corolla green. Flowering in Jan.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli initio adpresse puberuli, mox glabri, cinereo-brunnei, asperi et fissurati, elenticellati. Folia congesta, spiraliter disposita, 26-46.5 × 10-13.2 cm, late oblanceolata apice acuta vel leviter attenuata, basi acuta, tenuiter coriacea, supra glabra, infra subtiliter sericea, pilis arete adpressis pallidis aureis usque albescen-tibus; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra plana vel leviter elevata; nervi secundarii 25-26-jugi, paralleli, recti vel arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui, numerosi. Petiolus ca. 4 cm longus, non canaliculata, subtiliter adpresse puberulus. Fasciculi 5-12-flori, axillares et sub foliis. Pedicellus 1-1.5 cm longus, adpresse puberulus. Flores bisexuales. Sepala quatuor, 0.8-1.4 cm longa, sepala exteriora breviora quam sepala interiora, ovata usque oblongo-elliptica, apice acuta vel obtusa, extus subtiliter adpresse puberula, sepala interiora saepe margine lato glabro, intus glabra. Corolla late cylindrica, 1.7-1.8 cm longa; tubus 1.2-1.3 cm longus; lobi sex, ca. 5 mm longi, lanceolati, anguste acuti, papillosi. Stamina sex, prope apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta 1.5-2 mm longa, non geniculata, glabra; antherae ca. 2 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia sex, 2-3 mm longa, anguste lanceolata vel subulata, papillosa. Discus nullus. Ovarium globosum vel latum apice truncato, 7-loculare, dense pubescens; stylus post anthesin 1.4-1.5 cm longus, leviter exsertus, praeter basim glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus Ignotus.

description: Tree; young shoots appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, rough and fissured, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 26-46.5 × 10-13.2 cm, broadly oblanceolate, apex acute or slightly attenuate, base acute, thinly coriaceous, glabrous above, finely sericeous below with closely appressed pale golden to whitish hairs; venation eucamptodromous, midrib not or only slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 25-26 pairs, parallel, straight or arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique, numerous. Petiole ca. 4 cm long, not channelled, finely appressed puberulous. Fascicles 5-12-flowered, axillary and below leaves. Pedicel 1-1.5 cm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals four, 0.8-1.4 cm long, outer shorter than inner, ovate to oblong-elliptic, apex acute or obtuse, finely appressed puberulous outside, inner sepals often with broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Corolla broadly cylindrical, 1.7-1.8 cm long, tube 1.2-1.3 cm long, lobes six, ca. 5 mm long, lanceolate, narrowly acute, papillose. Stamens six, fixed near the top of the corolla tube; filaments 1.5-2 mm long, not geniculate, glabrous; anthers ca. 2 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes six, 2-3 mm long, narrowly lanceolate or subulate, papillose. Disk absent. Ovary globose or broad with a truncate apex, seven-locular, densely pubescent; style 1.4-1.5 cm long after anthesis, slightly exserted, glabrous except at base; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree 7-10 m high with latex and greenish-cream flowers. Flowering Aug-Sep.

description: Tree; young shoots with minute appressed indumentum or subglabrous, becoming greyish, scaling in thin; small pieces, with a few lenticels. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 7.7-18 × 3.4-7.5 cm, oblanceolate, apex usually rounded, or obtuse, base narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib raised on the upper surface, marginal vein present, seconary veins 7-10 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, slightly arcuate or straight; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique. Petiole 1-2 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 3-15-flowered, in the axils of fallen leaves. Pedicel 3-5 mm long, with sparse minute appressed hairs. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals five, 3-3.5 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, subglabrous outside, closely sericeous inside. Corolla cyathiform or shortly tubular, 3.5-5 mm long, tube equalling or shorter than the lobes (male), longer than the lobes in female, lobes five, ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, auriculate, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube (female with vestigial filaments fixed in the upper half of the tube); filaments 1-1.5 mm long (conspicuous traces visible to base of tube), geniculate at apex, glabrous; anthers 1.25-1.5 mm long, lanceolate, apiculate, glabrous, absent in female. Staminodes five, 1.75-2.5 mm long (male), ca. 0.5 mm long (female), narrowly lanceolate to triangular, glabrous. Disk an annulus surrounding the reduced ovary (male), a small swelling around the ovary base (female). Ovary ovoid (reduced in male), five-locular, densely pubescent; style 2-2.5 mm long (male), ca. 1.25 mm long (female), glabrous; style-head five-lobed (female), or simple (male). Fruit 2.5-5 cm long, narrowly obovoid or ellipsoid, apex rounded, apiculate, base tapered, smooth, glabrous except for a tuft of residual hair at base. Seed solitary, 1.8-2.1 cm long, strongly laterally compressed, apex rounded, base acute, testa smooth, shining, adherent to the pericarp, ca. 0.5 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, 2-3 mm wide; embryo with thin foliaceous cotyledons, radicle exserted ca. 2 mm; endosperm present. Field characters. Tree to 32 m high and 60 cm diam. with small, simple or branched plank buttresses; trunk fluted in the lower part, cylindrical above. Bark blackish- or reddish-brown, shallowly and narrowly fissured; inner bark surface orange, slash pale pink; sticky white latex present. Flowers greenish-yellow or whitish, without scent, fruit maturing yellow. Flowering Jul to Nov, fruit Jan to May.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli dense et longe aureohispidi, demum glabri, atrobrunnei, laeves, lenticellati. Folia dissita vel laxe spiraliter disposita, 12.5-25.7 × 3.8-7.8 cm, oblanceolata, apice anguste attenuata usque longe acuminata, basi de supra medium descrescentia, denique acuta vel anguste cuneata, chartacea, glabra vel costa paginae inferioris indumento residuale hispido; venatio eucamptodroma-brochidodroma; nervus marginalis interdum praesens; costa supra elevata; nervi secundarii 12-20-jugi, leviter convergentes et arcuati, supra leviter impressi, infravalde elevati; nervi intersecundarii parvi vel nulli; nervi tertiarii pauci, late dispersi, obliqui; nervi reticulum quatemarium praesens. Petiolus 0.5-1 cm longus, leviter canaliculata, dense et longe hispidus, mox glaber. Fasciculi 2-3-flori, plerumque infra folia dispositi in axillis foliorum delapsorum. Pedicellus 2-3 mm longus, dense hispidus, leviter reflexus. Flores unisexuales (planta dioica (?)). Flores masculinae vel bisex-uales non visae. Sepala quinque, 1.5-2 mm longa, late lanceolata, apice obtusa, extus dense et longe-hispida, intus glabra. Corolla anguste cyathiformis, ca. 1.5 mm longa; tubus ca. 0.4 mm longus; lobi quinque ca. 1.1 mm longi, ovati, apice obtusi, glabri. Stamina et staminodia nulla. Discus nullus. Ovarium conicum, sensim cum stylo decrescens et corollam implens, biloculare, dense strigosum; stylus ca. 0.7 mm longus, dense strigosus; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus 2.5-3 cm longus, ellipsoideus vel obovoideus, apice rotundatus, basi acutus usque rotundatus, laevis, dense hispidus, stylus persistens. Semen solitarium (immaturum), lateraliter compressum, testa laevis e pericarpio libera, cicatrix anguste adaxialis, ca. 1.5 mm lata; embryo cotyledonibus liberis planoconvexis, radicula ad superficiem extensa, albumen nullum.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots densely golden long-hispid, becoming glabrous, dark brown, smooth, lenticellate. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 12.5-25.7 × 3.8-7.8 cm, oblanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate to long acuminate, base long tapering from above halfway, finally acute or narrowly cuneate, chartaceous, glabrous, or with residual hispid indumentum along the lower midrib; venation eucamptodromous-brochidodromous, sometimes with thin marginal vein, midrib raised on the upper surface, secondary veins, 12-20 pairs, slightly convergent and arcuate, slightly impressed on the upper surface, strongly raised below; intersecondaries small or absent; tertiaries few, widely spaced, oblique, quaternary reticulum present. Petiole 0.5-1 cm long, slightly channelled, densely long-hispid, soon glabrous. Fascicles 2-3-flowered, mostly below the leaves at defoliated nodes. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, densely hispid, slightly reflexed. Flowers unisexual (plants dioecious (?)). Male or bisexual flowers not seen. Sepals five, 1.5-2 mm long, broadly lanceolate, apex obtuse, densely long-hispid outside, glabrous within. Corolla narrowly cyathiform, ca. 1.5 mm long, tube ca. 0.4 mm long, lobes five, ca. 1.1 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse, glabrous. Stamens and staminodes absent. Disk absent. Ovary conical, tapering imperceptibly with the style and filling the corolla, bilocular, densely strigose; style ca. 0.7 mm long, densely strigose; style-head simple. Fruit 2.5-3 cm long, ellipsoid or obovoid, apex rounded, base acute to rounded, smooth, densely hispid, style persistent. Seed solitary, (immature) laterally compressed, testa smooth, free from pericarp; scar narrowly adaxial, ca. 1.5 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 10 m high with white latex. Flowering Jun and Jul, fruit Jun.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots shortly golden sericeous, soon glabrous, grey-brown, rough, densely lenticellate. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 8.6-11 x 4-5 cm, broadly elliptic, apex shortly narrowly attenuate, base shortly broadly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib sunken on upper surface, secondary veins 12-14 pairs, ascending, parallel, arcuate; intersecondaries well developed, often extending to near the margin; tertiaries reticulate. Petiole 1.4-2 cm long, strongly channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 2-12-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 1-1.5 mm long, appressed puberulous. Sepals five, 1-1.5 mm long, broadly ovate to suborbicular, apex obtuse or rounded, sparsely appressed puberulous in the lower half on both surfaces. Corolla ca. 3 mm long, broadly cyathiform to rotate, tube ca. 1 mm long, lobes 56, ca. 2 mm long, broadly elliptic, apex rounded, glabrous, weakly punctate with raised dots on outer surface. Stamens 5-6, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube, exserted; filaments ca. 2 mm long, strongly geniculate, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, broadly ovate, the two cells separate for about 2/3 of their length, glabrous. Staminodes 5-6, free portion 0.5-0.75 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, glabrous, strong broad traces visible to about halfway down the corolla tube. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, 5-6-locular, pubescent, style ca. 0.5 mm long, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high. Flowers greenish-white, with lilac stamens. The fruit is said to be the size of a cherry.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Small tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous with golden-ferruginous hairs, soon glabrous, pale greyish, cracked and fissured, without lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 8.8-13 × 3.1-5.2 cm, elliptic to oblanceolate, apex obtuse or rounded, base narrowly attenuate, margin revolute, coriaceous, young leaves with fine appressed brown indumentum on lower surface, soon glabrous; venation brochidodromous, midrib slightly sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 9-10 pairs, straight, mostly parallel; intersecondaries usually long; tertiaries forming a lax reticulum. Petiole 2-3.2 cm long, not channelled, appressed puberulous. Fascicles 2-4-flowered, below the leaves. Pedicel 1.5-1.9 cm long, finely appressed puberulous. Sepals four, 1-1.2 cm long, broadly elliptic, outer with obtuse apex, inner with rounded apex, finely appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular, 1.2-1.3 cm long, tube 8-9 mm long, lobes six, 3-4 mm long, broadly oblong, apex rounded, papillose. Stamens six, fixed near the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 1.25 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 2 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes six, 2-2.5 mm long, linear-lanceolate, papillose. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, four-locular, pubescent; style ca. 7 mm long after anthesis, equalling the corolla, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Small tree to 8 m high, flowering Jun.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli glabri, demum atrobrunnei, scabri, minute squamati et rimosi, elenti-cellati. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 7.6-12.3 × 4.7-7.9 cm, obovata, apice rotundata vel truncata, basi acuta usque breviter et late attenuata, leviter revoluta, coriacea, glabra, infra leviter glauca; venatio eucamptodroma, vel interdum prope apicem leviter brochidodroma; nervus marginalis praesaens; costa supra leviter elevata; nervi secundarii 8-9-jugi, paralleli, leviter ar-cuati; nervi inter-secundarii breves vel nulli; nervi tertiarii plerumque aperte reticulati. Petiolus 1.3-1.8 cm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 10-60-flori, axillares et infra folia enati. Pedicellus 2-3 mm longus, minute adpresse puberulus. Flores unisexuales (planta monoica). Se-pala quinque, 1-1.25 mm longa, ovata, apice obtusa, extus parce adpresse puberula, intus glabra. Corolla late cyathiformis, ca. 1.5 mm longa, tubo lobos fere aequante; lobi quinque, ovati, apice obtusi, extus minute adpresse puberuli. Stamina quinque, in dimidio superiore tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 0.2 mm longa (filis vascularibus visibilibus usque ad basim tubi), glabra; antherae ca. 0.4 mm longae, ovatae, glabrae; stamina in flore foemineo nulla. Staminodia 4-5, 0.3-0.4 mm longa, late oblonga, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium late conicum, biloculare, puberulum; stylus brevissimus; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus (immaturus) ca. 2.4 cm longus, ellipsoidea, apice rotundatus, basi obtusus, laevis, glaber. Semen non visum.

description: Tree; young shoots glabrous, becoming dark brown, rough, minutely scaling and cracked, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 7.6-12.3 × 4.7-7.9 cm, obovate, apex rounded or truncate, base acute to shortly broad-attenuate, slightly revolute, coriaceous, glabrous, slightly glaucous below; venation eucamptodromous, or sometimes slightly brochidodromous near the apex, marginal vein present, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 8-9 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries mostly open-reticulate. Petiole 1.3-1.8 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 10-60-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, minutely appressed puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant monoecious). Sepals five, 1-1.25 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse, sparsely appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Corolla broadly cyathiform, ca. 1.5 mm long, tube about equalling the lobes, lobes five, ovate, apex obtuse, minutely appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Stamens five, fixed in the upper half of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.2 mm long (traces visible to base of tube), glabrous; anthers ca. 0.4 mm long, ovate, glabrous; stamens absent in female. Staminodes 4-5, 0.3-0.4 mm long, broadly oblong, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broadly conical, bilocular, puberulous; style very short; style-head simple. Fruit (immature) ca. 2.4 cm long, ellipsoid, apex rounded, base obtuse, smooth, glabrous. Seed not seen. Field characters. An enormous tree (Schultes & Pires).

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli subtiliter adpresse puberuli, pilis brunneis, mox glabri, saepe striati, pallide brunnei usque atrobrunnei, demum squa-mati et centuriato modo rimas ducens, saepe lenticellati. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 7.5-16.5 × 2.3-5 cm (in ramulis sterilibus usque 24 × 6.5 cm), elliptica, oblonga vel lanceolata, apice breviter et anguste attenuata vel cuspidata, basi acuta usque anguste attenuata, margine leviter reflexa, tenuiter coriacea, supra glabra, arete vestita minutis pallidis pilis rigidis adpressis indumentum uniforme facientibus, interdum tandem glabra; venatio eucamptodroma, nervus marginalis praesens, costa supra elevata, nervi secundarii 12-14-jugi, leviter convergentes et arcuati; nervi intersecundarii parvi usque modice longi, vel nulli; venatio Superioris ordinis horizontal-ibus usque obliquis venis consistens cum tenui imbecilliore rete reticulato-areolato. Petiolus 1.1-2 cm longus, non canaliculata, subglaber. Fasciculi 3-20-flori, axillares et in axillis foliorum delapsorum enati. Pedicellus 2-4 mm longus, indumento brunneo adpresse puberulo. Flores bisexuales. Sepala quatuor, ca. 2 mm longa, late ovata, apice obtusa vel rotundata, extus et intus prope marginem dense adpresse puberula, interdum ciliata. Corolla ca. 2.5 mm longa, tubus ca. 1.5	mm longus, lobi quatuor, ca. 1 mm longi, ovati, apice obtusi vel rotundati, glabri. Stamina quatuor, prope vel ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta 0.2-0.5 mm longa (filis vascularibus saepe visibilibus ad prope basim tubi), glabra; antherae 0.5-0.7 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, 0.5-0.7 mm longa, lanceolata usque anguste triangularia, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium annulariforme, bilocular, dense pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 1 mm longus, inclusus, ad basim pubescens, styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ca. 2 × 1.6 cm, ellipsoidea vel obovoideus, apice rotundatus, basi obtusus vel decrescens, laevis, glaber. Semen solitarium, ca. 1.5 cm longum, ellipsoideum, non lateraliter compressum, apice et basi rotundatum; testa laevis vel leviter rugosa, nitida, 0.3-0.5 mm crassa; cicatrix adaxialis, secundum plerumque latus adaxiale et circa basim extensa, 3-7 mm lata; embryo cotyledonibus plano-convexis, liberis; radicula ad superficiem extensa; albumen nullum.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous with brown hairs, soon glabrous, often striate, pale to dark brown, later scaling and grid-cracked, often lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 7.5-16.5 × 2.3-5 cm, (to 24 × 6.5 cm on sterile shoots), elliptic, oblong or lanceolate, apex shortly narrowly attenuate or cuspidate, base acute to narrowly attenuate, margin slightly recurved, thinly coriaceous, glabrous above, lower surface uniformly covered with a close indumentum of minute pale-coloured, stiff appressed hairs, sometimes becoming subglabrous with age; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 12-14 pairs, slightly convergent and arcuate; intersecondaries small to moderately long, or absent; higher order venation of horizontal to oblique veins with a slightly weaker reticulate-areolate network. Petiole 1.1-2 cm long, not channelled, subglabrous. Fascicles 5-20-flowered, axillary and in the axils of fallen leaves. Pedicel 2-4 mm long, with brown appressed puberulous indumentum. Flowers bisexual. Sepals four, ca. 2 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, densely appressed puberulous outside, and inside near the margin, sometimes ciliate. Corolla ca. 2.5 mm long, tube ca. 1.5 mm long, lobes four, ca. 1 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, glabrous. Stamens four, fixed near or at the top of the corolla tube; filaments 0.2-0.5 mm long (traces often visible to near base of tube), glabrous; anthers 0.5-0.7 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes four, 0.50.7 mm long, lanceolate to narrowly triangular, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary flattened and cushion-like, bilocular, densely pubescent; style ca. 1 mm long after anthesis, included, pubescent near the base; style-head simple. Fruit ca. 2 × 1.6 cm, ellipsoid or obovoid, apex rounded, base obtuse or tapered, smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary, ca. 1.5 cm long, ellipsoid, not laterally compressed, rounded at both ends, testa smooth or slightly wrinkled, shining, 0.3-0.5 mm thick; scar adaxial, extending almost full length of seed and along the base, 3-7 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 30(-60) m high and 1 m diam. with cylindrical bole and dark brown, fissured and scaly bark, exuding abundant white latex. Flowers pale green, Sep to Nov, fruit collected during the same period.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots shortly brown-pubescent (mostly appressed) to subglabrous, becoming pale buff, smooth or thinly scaling, sometimes with large lenticels. Leaves loosely spiralled, 13-25 × 5-10 cm, elliptic to broadly oblanceolate, apex shortly narrowly attenuate to obtusely cuspidate, base shortly narrowly attenuate, coriaceous to chartaceous, glabrous or with some residual indumentum near base of midrib; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 11-13 pairs, ascending, parallel or slightly convergent, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries oblique and reticulate. Petiole 2.5-3.8 cm long, not channelled, subglabrous. Fascicles 2-5-flowered, below the leaves. Pedicel 4-5 mm long, puberulous (brown). Sepals five, ca. 3 mm long, ovate to broadly elliptic, apex acute to rounded, puberulous on both surfaces. Corolla broadly tubular, 3-3.5 mm long, tube equalling the lobes, lobes five, ovate, apex obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed near the apex of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.75 mm long, geniculate, glabrous; anthers 1.25-1.5 mm long, broadly lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 0.75 mm long, ovate to lanceolate, often with an adaxial keel, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary short, broad, truncate, five-locular, densely pubescent; style ca. 1.5 mm long, pubescent; style-head simple. Young fruit ca. 2 cm long, obovoid, densely short-pubescent. Seed not seen. Field characters. Tree to 36 m high and 70 cm diam. with simple or branched, steep and slightly concave buttresses to 2.5 m high, bole usually cylindrical, bark reddish-brown, scaling profusely in small thin rectangular pieces which exfoliate from the base, slash cream with pink striations, exuding sparse to copious sticky white latex. Flowering and young fruit Dec.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, smooth, blackish-brown, becoming paler, greyish, slightly scaling, lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 9.526 × 3.5-9.5 cm, broadly oblanceolate, apex acute to rounded, base acute or narrowly attenuate, margin revolute, coriaceous, glabrous; venation brochidodromous, midrib usually sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 12-15 pairs, straight, parallel; intersecondaries extending to the margin; tertiaries few, reticulate, obscure. Petiole 1-3 cm long, not channelled, puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles l-2(-3)-flowered, arranged along short axillary or lateral shoots 1-3 cm long. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, sparsely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, ca. 1.5 mm long, fused at base, lanceolate, apex acute or narrowly attenuate, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside, except at the apex. Corolla ca. 1.5 mm long, tube equalling the lobes, lobes five, suborbicular, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.2 mm long, straight, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.4 mm long, suborbicular, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 0.5 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broad-ovoid, bilocular, puberulous; style ca. 0.5 mm long after anthesis, puberulous below; style-head simple. Fruit (immature) ca. 1.8-1.2 cm, pyriform, ferruginous, densely scurfy-lenticellate. Seed not seen. Field characters. Tree to 15 m high and 15 cm diam., with white latex. Flowers collected Feb and Jul, young fruit May and Aug.

description: Tree; young shoots finely and minutely appressed puberulous or glabrous, pale greyish-brown, smooth, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 13-33.5 × 6.3-16 cm, broadly oblanceolate to broadly oblong-elliptic, apex obtuse to broadly short-attenuate, bases acute or obtuse, sometimes finally slightly attenuate, thinly coriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib convex on the upper surface, secondary veins 8-13 pairs, convergent or parallel, arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique; quaternary reticulum present. Petiole 1.5-4.5 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 10-20-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 0.7-1 cm long, glabrous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals four, 2-2.5 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, glabrous. Corolla broadly tubular, 4.5-5 mm long, tube 3.5-4 mm long, lobes four, 1-1.5 mm long, broadly oblong, apex truncate, sparsely appressed hairy along the center of the lobes, glabrous inside. Stamens four, fixed about one-third up the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.8 mm long, ovate, dorso-ventrally flattened, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 1 mm long, narrowly oblong, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary depressed-globose, four-locular, shortly pubescent; style ca. 4 mm long after anthesis, exserted, glabrous; style-head minutely four-lobed. Fruit (not seen), ca. 8 cm diam. globose (data from Hartshorn 1488). Field characters. Tree to 25 m high and 60 cm diam. with white latex. Fruit maturing yellow. Flowering Mar-May, fruit May.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli glabri, atro-brunnei, laeves, ramuli veteres lenticellis numerosis. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 6.5-13.5 × 3-5 cm, late elliptica usque oblanceolata, apice obtusa, basi acuta usque anguste attenuata; margine leviter revoluta, subcoriacea, glabra; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra leviter elevata (in sectione rotundata); nervi secundarii 6-7-jugi, con-vergentes, arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii prominentes, numerosi, horizon-tales usque obliqui, venatio ordinis Superioris reticulata praesens. Petiolus 0.7-1 cm longus, leviter canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 10-multi-flori, axillares et in axillis foliorum delapsorum dispositi. Pedicellus 3-4 mm longus, parce et adpresse puberulus. Flores bisexuales. Sepala quinque, ca. 1.5 mm longa, ovata usque sub-orbiculares, apice obtusa vel rotundata, extus parce et adpresse puberula, intus glabra, ciliata. Corolla cyathiformis; lobis leviter extensis, ca. 2.5 mm longa; tubus lobos aequans vel paullum brevior; lobi quinque (sex), ovati, apice rotundati, auriculata glabri. Stamina quinque (sex), ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 0.4 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 0.4 × 0.8 mm, depresse globosae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque (sex), 0.5-0.75 mm longa, carnosa, ovata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium late ovoideum, 5-loculare, adpresse puberulum; stylus post anthesin ca. 0.2 mm longus, in alabastro leviter exsertus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus non visus.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots glabrous, blackish-brown, smooth, older twigs with numerous lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 6.5-13.5 × 3-5 cm, broadly elliptic to oblanceolate, apex obtuse, base acute to narrowly attenuate, margin slightly revolute, subcoriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface (rounded in section), secondary veins 6-7 pairs, convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries prominent, numerous, horizontal to oblique; higher order reticulum present. Petiole 0.7-1 cm long, slightly channelled, glabrous. Fascicles ten-many flowered, axillary and in the axils of fallen leaves. Pedicel 3-4 mm long, sparsely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals five, ca. 1.5 mm long, ovate to suborbicular, apex obtuse or rounded, sparsely appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside, ciliate. Corolla cyathiform, with slightly spreading lobes, ca. 2.5 mm long, tube equalling or slightly shorter than lobes, lobes five(six), ovate, apex rounded, auriculate, glabrous. Stamens five(six), fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.4 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.4 x 0.8 mm, cells separated by broad connective, depressed globose, glabrous. Staminodes five(six), 0.5-0.75 mm long, carnose, ovate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broadly ovoid, five-locular, appressed puberulous; style ca. 0.2 mm long after anthesis, slightly exserted in flower bud, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit not seen. Field characters. Tree to 15 m high and 40 cm diam. with buttresses to 1.5 m high. Flowers white or cream-coloured, Aug-Sep.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Arbor parva; ramuli novelli minute adpresse ferrugineo-puberuli, mox glabri, cinerascentibrunnei, longitudinaliter costati, elenticellati. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 8-13 × 3.9-6.2 cm, ovata vel late lanceolata, apice anguste attenuata, basi rotundata vel obtusa, coriacea, supra glabra, infra glabra vel costa pilis paucis adpressis vestita, leviter glauca; venatio plerumque eucamptodroma; nervus marginalis validus; costa supra valde elevata; nervi secundarii 11-13-jugi, paralleli, recti vel leviter arcuati, in superficiebus ambabus impressi; nervi intersecundarii breves vel nulli; nervi tertiarii laxe reticulati vel horizontales pauci. Petiolus (1.5-)2-2.8 cm longus, interdum leviter canaliculata, subglaber. Fasciculi 15-25-flori, axillares. Pedicellus ca. 2 mm longus, adpresse puberulus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quinque, 2-2.5 mm longa, ovata, apice obtusa, basi coalita. Corolla cyathiformis, ca. 2.5 mm longa; lobi tubum aequantes; lobi quinque, ovati vel elliptici, apice obtusi, glabri. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 0.75 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 0.4 mm longae, ovatae, rotundatae, glabrae. Staminodia nulla. Discus nullus. Ovarium late ovoideum, biloculare, adpresse pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 0.5 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus immaturus ellipsoidea, apice rotundatus, adpresse aureobrunneo puberulus.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Small tree; young shoots minutely appressed ferruginous-puberulous, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, longitudinally ribbed, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 8-13 × 3.9-6.2 cm, ovate or broadly lanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate, base rounded or obtuse, coriaceous, glabrous above, glabrous below or with a few appressed hairs on midrib, slightly glaucous; venation moistly eucamptodromous, with a strong marginal vein, midrib sharply raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 11-13 pairs, parallel, straight or slightly arcuate, impressed on both surfaces; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries open reticulate, with a few horizontal. Petiole (1.5-)2-2.8 cm long, not or only slightly channelled, subglabrous. Fascicles 15-25-flowered, axillary. Pedicel ca. 2 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 2-2.5 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse, fused at base. Corolla cyathiform, ca. 2.5 mm long, tube equalling the lobes, lobes five, ovate or elliptic, apex obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.75 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.4 mm long, ovate, rounded, glabrous. Staminodes absent. Disk absent. Ovary broadly ovoid, bilocular, appressed pubescent; style ca. 0.5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Young fruit ellipsoid, apex rounded, appressed golden-brown puberulous. Field characters. Tree to 4 m high with white latex, leaves glaucous below; flowers yellow. Flowering Feb, fruit probably maturing Jun-Aug.

description: Tree; young shoots sparsely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, pale grey-brown, thinly scaling, without lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 6-12 × 3.5-5.5 cm, elliptic or broadly oblanceolate, apex shortly and narrowly attenuate, base shortly attenuate, chartaceous, sparsely and closely appressed puberulous below or glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib raised above (sometimes recessed), secondary veins 6-8 pairs, arcuate and slightly convergent, impressed on upper surface; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique to horizontal. Petiole 49 mm long, not channelled, subglabrous. Fascicles 1-3-flowered, axillary. Pedicel ca. 3 mm long; finely appressed puberulous. Sepals four, 2-3.5 mm long, ovate, apex rounded, sparsely and minutely appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Corolla tubular, 4-6 mm long, tube ca. 2.5-4 mm long, lobes four, ca. 1.5-2 mm long, broadly oblong, apex rounded, subglabrous. Stamens four, fixed in the lower half of the corolla tube; filaments glabrous; anthers ovate, glabrous. Staminodes four, linear, 1-1.5 mm long, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary conical, tapering gradually into style; four-locular, sparsely appressed puberulous; style about equalling the corolla, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 10 m high; flowers yellowish, in Jun (Brazil) and Nov (Colombia).

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli initio parce adpresse puberuli, mox glabri, atro-brunnei, demum cinerascentes, squamati, lenticellis paucis vel nullis. Folia dissita vel laxe congesta, spiraliter disposita, 6.5-18 × 3.6-7.6 cm, late elliptica, oblongo-elliptica vel raro oblanceolata, apice obtuse cuspidata vel raro breviter attenuata, basi anguste cuneata, attenuata vel obtusa, coriacea, glabra; venatio brochidodroma; nervus marginalis praesens; costa et nervi secundarii supra prominula; nervi secundarii 7-14-jugi, plerumque paralleli, arcuati; nervi intersecundarii breves vel nulli; nervi tertiarii pauci, obliqui usque reticulati. Petiolus 1-2(-2.8) cm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 2-5-flori, axillares et sub foliis dispositi. Pedicellus 1.5-2 mm longus, adpresse puberulus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quinque, 2-2.5 mm longa, lanceolata vel ovata, apice obtusa extra adpresse puberula, intus glabra, ciliata. Corolla 3-4 mm longa; tubus lobos aequans; lobi quinque, elliptici, apice rotundati, glabri, ciliati. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta 0.5-1 mm longa, glabra; antherae 1-1.25 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, 1-1.5 mm longa, lanceolata, saepe in dimidio inferiore irregulariter dentata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoid-eo-conicum, biloculare, pubescens; stylus post anthesin 1.25-1.5 mm longus; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus 2.5-3 cm longus, ellipsoideus usque obovoideus, apice rotundatus vel obtusus, basi obtusis, laevis (in sicco rugosus), velutinus. Semen solitarium vel geminatum, ca 1.5 cm longum, ellipsoideum usque obovoideum vel planoconvexum (ubi semina geminata), apice rotundatum, basi acutum, testa laevis, pericarpio adherens, ca. 0.3 mm crassa; cicatrix adaxialis, per totem longitudinem extensa, elliptica, 4.5-7 mm lata, embryo cotyledonibus plano-convexis, liberis, radicula leviter exserta; albumen nullum.
