description: Tree; young shoots sparsely appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, dark brown, becoming grey, scaling, lenticels few or absent. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 6.518 × 3.6-7.6 cm, broadly elliptic, oblong-elliptic or rarely oblanceolate, apex obtusely cuspidate or rarely shortly attenuate, base narrowly cuneate, attenuate or obtuse, coriaceous, glabrous; venation brochidodromous, thin marginal vein present, midrib and secondary veins slightly raised on the upper surface; secondaries 7-14 pairs, mostly parallel, arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries few, oblique to reticulate. Petiole 1-2(-2.8) cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 2-5-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 1.5-2 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 2-2.5 mm long, lanceolate to ovate, apex obtuse, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside, ciliate. Corolla 3-4 mm long, tube equalling the lobes, lobes five, elliptic, apex rounded, glabrous, ciliate. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments 0.5-1 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1-1.25 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, 1-1.5 mm long, lanceolate, often irregularly toothed in lower half, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid-conical, bilocular, pubescent; style 1.25-1.5 mm long after anthesis; style-head simple. Fruit 2.5-3 cm long, ellipsoid to obovoid, apex rounded or obtuse, base obtuse, smooth (wrinkled on drying), velutinous. Seed solitary or paired, ca. 1.5 cm long, ellipsoid to obovoid (plano-convex when seeds paired), apex rounded, base acute, testa smooth, adherent to the pericarp, ca. 0.3 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, elliptic, 4.5-7 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle slightly exserted; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 26 m high and 40 cm diam. with steep, simple buttresses to 1.5 m high; bole fluted; bark greyish to brown, scaling in thin slender pieces, slash pink, white sticky latex. Flowers greenish-yellow or cream-coloured, fruit maturing yellow or orange. Flowering recorded Nov to Jan, mature fruit Dec to Apr.

description: Tree; young shoots golden-brown hispid or villose, becoming glabrous, greyish to dark brown, rough and scaling, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 5.5-25 × 2.7-9 cm, narrowly to broadly oblanceolate, apex rounded, obtusely cuspidate or narrowly attenuate, base narrowly attenuate to rounded, thinly coriaceous, upper surface glabrous or with hispid or pubescent midrib, lower surface sparsely villose or variously pubescent with a mixture of simple and two-branched hairs, often becoming glabrous with age; venation eucamptodromous or brochidodromous, marginal vein usually present, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, but often recessed, secondary veins 8-18 pairs, usually parallel and arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries oblique and conspicuous or obscure and not distinguishable from the higher order fine reticulum. Petiole 0.5-3.5 cm long, channelled, hispid to villose. Fascicles 2-6-flowered, usually densely clustered below the leaves. Pedicel 0-1.5 mm long, hispid to sericeous. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals four, 2-4 mm long, broadly ovate to suborbicular, apex obtuse to rounded, sericeous or sericeous-hispid outside, often with a glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular, 2-5.5 mm long, tube 1-3.5 mm long, lobes four, 1-1.5 mm long, broadly oblong to suborbicular, apex rounded or truncate, often ciliate. Stamens four, fixed one-third to two-thirds up the corolla tube; filaments 1-2 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.6-1 mm long, ovate or lanceolate, flattened, glabrous, absent in female. Staminodes four, 0.5-2 mm long, subulate, glabrous, reduced to a vestige in female. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid to globose, four-locular, densely long-strigose; stype 26 mm long after anthesis, exserted or not, glabrous; style-head simple or minutely four-lobed. Fruit 3.5-8 cm long, broadly ovoid to globose, apex obtuse to rounded, base rounded or truncate, smooth, densely velutinous. Seeds several, 2.5-3.5 cm long, ellipsoid, sometimes shaped like the segments of an orange, apex and base obtuse, testa smooth, shining, ca. 0.5 mm thick; scar adaxial and sometimes extending around the base, 2-3.5 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 36 m high and 1 m diam. with steep rounded, branched buttresses to 5 m high and usually fluted bole bark dark or reddish-brown, scaling in thin, narrowly rectangular or irregular pieces; slash cream to pale orange or pinkish, exuding abundant sticky white latex. Flowers greenish-white, fruit ripening yellow or orange with thick, hard flesh; there is a thin layer 2-3 mm thick of sweet yellow juicy jelly surrounding the seed. Flowering mostly Jul-Nov, fruit recorded throughout the year.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous, becoming glabrous, greyish-brown, fissured or scaling, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, (8-) 13-25(-50) × (2.7-)5-10 cm, oblanceolate to oblong-elliptic, apex narrowly attenuate to rounded, bases usually acute, rarely narrowly cuneate or attenuate, coriaceous, glabrous above or with sparse appressed indumentum along the midrib, minutely sericeous below with brownish hairs or glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, or rarely brochidodromous, marginal vein present, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, but usually recessed, secondary veins 13-22 pairs, convergent or parallel, arcuate or straight; intersecondaries usually poorly developed or absent; tertiaries oblique, sometimes obscure; quaternaries reticulate. Petiole (1.5-)2-5 cm long, margin strongly infolded, appressed puberulous. Fascicles 2-5(-10)-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 1-6 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals four, 0.3-1 cm long, broadly ovate or oblong, apex obtuse to rounded, appressed puberulous to sericeous outside, often with a broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside, often ciliate. Corolla broadly tubular, 0.5-1.4 cm long, tube 0.4-1 cm long, lobes four, 1.5-4 mm long, broadly oblong to suborbicular, apex truncate or rounded, sometimes ciliate. Stamens four, fixed between one-quarter and three-quarters up the corolla; filaments 2-4 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1-2.25 mm long, broadly lanceolate or ovate, glabrous. Staminodes four, 0.75-2 mm long, subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broadly ovoid to globose, four-locular, densely long-strigose; style 0.4-1.1 cm long after anthesis, often slightly exserted, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 3-7 cm long, globose, rounded or truncate at base and apex, smooth or rarely verrucose, tomentose to appressed puberulous at first, usually maturing glabrous. Seeds 2-4, 1.7-3.3 cm long, ellipsoid or plano-convex, rounded at base and apex, testa hard, smooth, shining, 0.4-1 mm thick; scar broad, adaxial and often extending around the base, 0.6-1.1 cm broad; embryo with plano-convex free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 40 m high and 90 cm diam. with steep, slender thick buttresses or trunk merely strongly fluted from base; bole usually fluted above. Bark reddish brown, finely vertically fissured or cracked, and scaling in long thin narrow friable strips; slash pale brown or cream, exuding sticky white latex; wood red. Flowers pale green, fruit ripening orange-yellow. Flowering throughout the range mostly Aug-Jan, fruit maturing Dec-Apr.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous with reddish-ferruginous hairs, becoming glabrous, greyish-brown, fissured and scaling, without lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 17.5-30 × 3.5-13.3 cm, broadly oblong to oblanceolate or obovate, apex obtuse or obtusely cuspidate, base shortly and broadly attenuate to narrowly attenuate, margin slightly revolute, coriaceous, glabrous above, minutely appressed puberulous below with reddish-ferruginous hairs; venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat or sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 11-15 pairs, parallel, straight or slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries fine, oblique; lower order venation obscured. Petiole 3-6 cm long, strongly channelled, appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles 2-3-flowered, axillary. Pedicel 1.4-1.5 cm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals four, 1.3-1.7 cm long, inner pair longer than the outer, outer broadly ovate to oblong, inner broadly spathulate, apex rounded, densely appressed puberulous on both surfaces. Corolla cylindrical, 1.7-1.8 cm long, tube 1.2-1.3 cm long, lobes six, ca. 6 mm long, oblong, apex obtuse, papillose. Stamens six, fixed near the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2 mm long, geniculate at apex, papillose; anthers ca. 2 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes six, ca. 2.5 mm long, subulate, papillose. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, 5-6-locular, densely pubescent; style 0.95-1.1 cm long after anthesis, included, glabrous or hairy in lower part; style-head simple. Fruit (immature) ca. 5 cm long, ellipsoid to globose, apex obtuse, base truncate, smooth, minutely ferruginous-puberulous, becoming glabrous. Seed not seen. Field characters. Buttressed tree to 35 m high and 40 cm diam. with dark, mottled bark and reddish wood; slash with white latex. Flowers pale green. Flowering Jun-Aug, fruit (immature) Sep.

description: Arbor:; ramuli novelli subtiliter adpresse pu-bescentes, mox glabri, cinerascenti-brunnei, ri-mosi et squamati, lenticellati. Folia laxa congesta, spiraliter disposita, 5.3-10.4 × 2.7-3.1 cm, oblanceolata et elliptica, apice et basi anguste attenuata, tenuiter coriacea, glabra, vel costa inferiore pilis sparsis residuis adpressis; venatio eucamptodroma; costa plana (supra non eleva-ta); nervus marginalis tenuis praesens; nervi secundarii 7-8-jugi, convergentes, arcuati; nervi tertiarii obliqui, pauci. Petiolus 5-8 mm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Flores solitarii, plerumque infra folia enati. Pedicellus 6-7.5 cm longus, tenuis, subglaber. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quinque, ca. 2.5 mm longa, ovata usque late elliptica, apice obtusa vel rotundata, extra ad basim pilis sparsis minutis adpressis, intus glabra. Corolla cyathiformis, ca. 3.5 mm longa; tubus ca. 1.5 mm longa; lobi quinque, ca. 2 mm longi, ovati, apice rotundati in tubo exteriore, sparsim strigosi, aliter glabra. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 1 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, ca. 1.5 mm longa, lanceolato-subulata, carnosa, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideum, biloculare, adpresse puberulum; stylus post anthesin ca. 0.5 mm longus, adpresse puberulus, styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ca. 9 × 7 cm (ut observatum est a collectore Schunke 5736); fructus imma-turus obovoideus, apice truncatus, basi rotun-datus, pariete crasso, asper et lenticellatus. Semen non visum.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed pubescent, soon glabrous, greyish brown, cracked and scaling, without lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 5.3-10.4 × 2.7-3.1 cm, oblanceolate or elliptic, apex and base narrowly attenuate, thinly coriaceous, glabrous or with sparse residual appressed hairs along the lower midrib; venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat, (not raised on upper surface), thin marginal vein present, secondary veins 7-8 pairs, convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique, few. Petiole 5-8 mm long, not channelled, glabrous. Flowers solitary, mostly below the leaves. Pedicel 6-7.5 cm long, slender, subglabrous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, ca. 2.5 mm long, ovate to broadly elliptic, apex obtuse or rounded, with sparse minute appressed hairs outside near the base, glabrous inside. Corolla cyathiform, ca. 3.5 mm long, tube ca. 1.5 mm long, lobes five, ca. 2 mm long, ovate, apex rounded, sparsely strigose on the tube outside, otherwise glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 1 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, carnose, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, bilocular, appressed, puberulous; style ca. 0.5 mm long after anthesis, appressed puberulous; style-head simple. Fruit ca. 9 × 7 cm (field data from Schunke 5736), immature fruit obovoid, apex truncate, base rounded; thick-walled, rough and lenticellate. Seed not seen. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 16 cm diam. with white latex. The mature fruit is orange. Flowering in Dec.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous, becoming glabrous, greyish, smooth, often lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 14-22.5 × 5.5-7.5 cm, usually oblanceolate, less frequently elliptic, apex narrowly acuminate, base narrowly attenuate, thinly coriaceous, glabrous above, sparsely appressed puberulous below with minute closely appressed hairs; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 8-13 pairs, convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries short to moderately long; tertiaries few, widely spaced, reticulate; fine areolate quaternary reticulum visible on the lower or both surfaces. Petiole 0.7-1.2 cm long, not channelled, sparsely appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles axillary and in the axils of fallen leaves, 5-20-flowered. Pedicel 2-7 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers unisexual and bisexual (? functionally male) (plant probably dioecious). Sepals five, 1.5-2 mm long, ovate, apex acute or obtuse, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous or rarely appressed puberulous inside, sometimes slightly ciliate. Corolla 2.5-3 mm long (2-2.25 mm long in female), tube equalling the lobes; lobes five, ovate-lanceolate to oblong, apex acute to rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the apex of the corolla tube; filaments 0.4-0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.50.6 mm long, lanceolate to ovate, sometimes shortly apiculate, sparsely hairy or glabrous; stamens converted to lanceolate staminodes in female flower. Staminodes five, 0.75-1 mm long, narrowly triangular, glabrous or with a few hairs at the apex. Disk absent. Ovary broadly conical to ovoid or truncate, unilocular, appressed puberulous; style 0.5-1 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 3-3.3 cm long, ellipsoid, apex rounded, base tapering to a short stipe, smooth, subglabrous. Seed solitary, 2-2.2 cm long, oblong, rounded or obtuse at both ends, not laterally compressed, testa smooth, adherent to the pericarp, ca. 1 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, ca. 4 mm wide, very rough and warty; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 28 m high and 40 cm diam. with small buttresses. Bole cylindrical, with reddish-brown bark exfoliating in thin scales; slash orange or red, with copious sticky white latex. Flowers pale green to yellowish-green, strongly scented, fruit ripening orange. Flowering Sep to Jan, fruit Jan to Jun.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli initio grosse pubescentes, demum glabri, cinerascentibrunnei, laevi, vel leviter striati, lenticellati. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 10.5-18.5 × 2.6-5.3 cm, oblanceolata, apice anguste attenuata usque longe anguste acuminata, basi acuta usque anguste attenuata, chartacea, infra glauca, glabra vel costa paginae inferioris pilis dispersis; venatio eucamptodroma; interdum nervo marginali; costa supra elevata; nervi secundarii 8-15-jugi, con-vergentes, arcuati, infra elevati; nervi interse-cundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii pauci, obliqui, ob-scuri. Petiolus 0.4-1.2 cm longus, in parte inferiore canaliculata, parce pubescens. Fasciculi 1-3-flori, axillares et in axillis foliorum de-lapsorum enati. Pedicellus 4-5 mm longus, grosse pubescens. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quatuor, 4-4.5 mm longa, late ovata, rotundata, extus dense rigide implexo-pubescentia, margine saepe glabro, intus glabra. Corolla cyathiformis, ca. 5 mm longa; tubus lobos aequans; lobi quatuor, late ovati, apice rotundati, extus parce et adpresse hirsuti. Stamina quatuor, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 0.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1.75 mm longae, oblongo-lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, 2-2.5 mm longa, lanceolata, carinata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideo-conicum, biloculare, dense et rigide pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 2 mm longus, inclusus, pubescens, styli capitulum minute lobatum. Fructus ca. 3.7-4 × 2 cm, ellipsoidea, apice obtusus, basi acutus, laevis, parce et grosse pubescens. Semen solitarium, ca. 2.7 cm longum, ellipsoideum, lateraliter compressum, apice obtusum, basi leviter decrescens, testa aspera, minute tuberculata, pericarpio adherens ca. 0.5 mm crassa; cicatrix adaxialis per longitudinem extensa, ca. 3 mm lata; embryo cotyledonibus plano-convexis, liberis, radicula ad superficiem extensa; albumen nullum.

description: Tree; young shoots coarsely pubescent at first, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, smooth or slightly striate, lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 10.5-18.5 × 2.6-5.3 cm, oblanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate to long narrowly acuminate, base acute to narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glaucous below, glabrous or with scattered hairs on the undersurface midrib; venation eucamptodromous, sometimes with a marginal vein, midrib raised on the upper surface; secondary veins 8-15 pairs, convergent, arcuate, raised on the lower surface; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries few, oblique, obscure. Petiole 0.4-1.2 cm long, channelled in the lower part, sparsely pubescent. Fascicles axillary and in axils of fallen leaves, 1-3-flowered. Pedicel 4-5 mm long, coarsely pubescent. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, 4-4.5 mm long, broadly ovate, rounded, densely stiff matted-pubescent outside, margin often glabrous, glabrous inside. Corolla cyathiform, ca. 5 mm long, tube equalling the lobes; four, broadly ovate, apex rounded, sparsely appressed hairy outside. Stamens four, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.75 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes four, 2-2.5 mm long, lanceolate, keeled, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid-conical, bilocular, densely stiff-pubescent; style ca. 2 mm long after anthesis, included, pubescent; style-head minutely lobed. Fruit ca. 3.7-4 × 2 cm, ellipsoid, apex obtuse, base acute, smooth, sparsely coarsely-pubescent. Seed solitary, ca. 2.7 cm long, ellipsoid, laterally compressed, apex obtuse, base slightly tapered, testa rough, minutely tuberculate, adhering to the pericarp, ca. 0.5 mm thick; scar full-length, adaxial, ca. 3 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 8 m high with white milky latex. Flowers white, fruit ripening orange-yellow. Flowers collected Jui, fruit Dec and Apr.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli dense et crispato-puberuli (pilis brunneis), indumento persistenti, tandem glabri, brunnei, leviter rimosi, elenticellati. Folia laxe congesta, spiraliter disposita, 10.5-25.5 × 5-10.5 cm, oblanceolata usque obovata, apice anguste attenuata usque obtuse cuspidata, basi anguste attenuata vel acuta, chartacea, supra glabra praeter costam puberulam, infra uniformiter et breviter pubescentia, pilis erectis, brunneis pedunculatis; biramosis; venatio eucamptodroma; nervus marginalis tenuis praesens; costa supra leviter elevata; nervi secundarii 10-15-jugi, paralleli, leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui; nervi quatemarii plerumque perpendiculariter ad tertiarios abeuntes. Petiolus 0.7-3 cm longus, non canaliculata, dense puberulus. Fasciculi 5-7-flori, plerumque sub foliis congesti, Pedicellus 2.5-3 mm longus, puberulus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quatuor, 2.5-3.5 mm longa, sepala externa late ovata, apice obtusa, sepala interna suborbicularia, apice rotundata, extus adpresse et sericeo-puberula, sepala interna margine lata glabra, omnia intus glabra. Corolla late tubularis vel campanulata, 3.5-4 mm longa; tubus 2.5-3 mm longus; lobi quatuor, ca. 1 mm longi, late oblongi, apice rotundati vel truncati ciliati. Stamina quatuor, paullum infra medium tubum corollae affixa, fllis vascularibus usque ad basim prominentibus; filamenta 1-1.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae 1-1.25 mm longae, lanceolatae, complanatae, interdum apiculatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, ca. 0.75 mm longa, lanceolata, apice rotundata, ciliata. Discus nullus. Ovarium globosum, quadriloculare, dense strigosum; stylus post anthesin 1.5-2 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ca. 3 cm longus, late obovoideus, apice truncatus leviter apiculatus, basi obtusus, velutinus. Semina plura, 2-2.2 cm longa, segmenti aurantii instar, apice et basi acuta, testa laevis, obsoleta, ad pericar-pium adherens, ca. 0.5 mm crassa; cicatrix adaxialis, per totam longitudinem extensa, 2-3 mm lata; embryo non visus.

description: Tree; young shoots densely crisped puberulous (brown hairs), indumentum persisting, eventually glabrous, brown, slightly cracked, without lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 10.5-25.5 × 5-10.5 cm, oblanceolate to obovate, apex narrowly attenuate to obtusely cuspidate, base narrowly attenuate or acute, chartaceous, glabrous above except for puberulous midrib, uniformly shortly-pubescent below with brown, erect, stalked, two-branched hairs; venation eucamptodromous, thin marginal vein present, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 10-15 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique; quaternaries mostly at right angles to the tertiaries. Petiole 0.7-3 cm long, not channelled, densely puberulous. Fascicles 5-7-flowered, mostly clustered below the leaves. Pedicel 2.5-3 mm long, puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, 2.5-3.5 mm long, outer broadly ovate, apex obtuse, inner suborbicular, apex rounded, appressed sericeo-puberulous outside, inner pair with broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular or campanulate, 3.5-4 mm long, tube 2.5-3 mm long, lobes four, ca. 1 mm long, broadly oblong, apex rounded or truncate, ciliate. Stamens four, fixed just below halfway up the corolla tube, with prominent traces to the base of the tube; filaments 1-1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1-1.25 mm long, lanceolate, flattened, sometimes apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 0.75 mm long, lanceolate, apex rounded, ciliate. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, densely strigose; style 1.5-2 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit ca. 3 cm long, broadly obovoid, apex truncate with small apiculum, base obtuse, veluinous. Seeds several, 2-2.2 cm long, shaped like the segment of an orange, apex and base acute, testa smooth, matt, adherent to pericarp, ca. 0.5 mm thick, scar adaxial full length, 2-3 mm wide; embryo not seen. Field characters. Tree to 25 m high and 25 cm diam. with white latex. Flowers yellowish-green, in Jan-Mar and Oct, fruit collected Mar-Apr.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli minute adpresse ferrugineo-brunneo puberuli, demum glabri, cinerascens, laeves vel subtiliter rimosi, elenticellati. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 10.5-18.3 × 5.4-9.6 cm, obovata, apice rotundata usque leviter emarginata, basi anguste attenuata, leviter decurrentia, coriacea, pagina superiore glabra (costa indumento residuale adpresso), pagina inferiore dense et persistenter adpresse puberula, pilis aureo-ferrugineis; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra prominula; nervus marginalis praesens; nervi secundarii 8-11-jugi, leviter convergentes, leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii modici; nervi tertiarii pauci, reticulati; subtile Superioris ordinis areolatum reticulum utrinque sub lente visible. Petiolus 1-1.5 cm longus, non canaliculata, adpresse puberulus. Fasciculi 5-10-flori, sub folia erati. Pedicellus 1.3-1.5 cm longus, adpresse puberulus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quinque, late extensa, ca. 2 mm longa, ca. 3 mm lata, late ovata usque suborbicularia, apice obtusa vel rotundata, adpresse puberula in superficiebus am-babus, ciliata. Corolla (immatura) ca. 3 mm longa; tubus lobis brevior; lobi quinque, late elliptica, apice rotundata, glabra. Stamina in dimidio superiore (?) tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 0.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1.5 mm longae, ovatae, hirsutae. Staminodia quinque, ca. 1.5 mm longa, subulata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium truncatum, longitudinaliter costatum, uniloculare, puberulum; stylus post anthesin ca. 0.5 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ignotus.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli ferrugineo-brunneo pubescentes, indumento persistente, leviter squamati, elenticellati. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 18-25 × 7.5-8.5 cm, late oblanceolata, apice obtusa vel breviter attenuata, basi longe decrescentia, denique abrupte obtusa, chartacea, supra glabra, infra persistente subtiliter sericea, pilis pallide brunneis; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra non elevata; nervi secundarii 18-20-jugi, paralleli vel leviter convergentes, leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui usque horizontales; nervi quatemarii perpendiculariter ad tertiarios abeuntes vel re-ticulati. Petiolus 0.8-1.2 cm longus, latus, non canaliculata, pubescens. Fasciculi 5-10-flori, axillares. Pedicellus 1-1.3 cm longus, pubescens. Flores ? bisexuales. Sepala quinque, ca. 5 mm longa, ovata vel elliptica, apice acuta vel obtusa, in superficiebus ambabus adpresse puberula. Corolla (immatura), late tubularis, ca. 6 mm longa; tubus ca. 3.5 mm longus; lobi quinque, ca. 2.5 mm longi, ovati, apice obtusi, glabri. Stamina quinque, medio tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 2.5 mm longa, prope apicem geniculata, glabra; antherae ca. 1.5 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia nulla. Discus nullus. Ovarium latum apice truncatum, 5-loculare, dense pubescens; stylus in alabastro ca. 4.5 mm longus, exsertus, glaber; styli capitulum minute 5-lobatum. Fructus ignotus.

description: Tree; young shoots ferruginous-brown pubescent, indumentum persistent, slightly scaly, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 18-25 × 7.5-8.5 cm, broadly oblanceolate, apex obtuse to shortly attenuate, base long-tapering, finally abruptly obtuse, chartaceous, glabrous above, persistently finely sericeous below with pale brown hairs; venation eucamptodromous, midrib not raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 18-20 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique to horizontal; quaternaries at right angles to the tertiaries or reticulate. Petiole 0.8-1.2 cm long, broad, not channelled, pubescent. Fascicles 5-10-flowered, axillary. Pedicel 1-1.3 cm long, pubescent. Flowers ? bisexual. Sepals five, ca. 5 mm long, ovate or elliptic, apex acute or obtuse, appressed puberulous on both surfaces. Corolla (immature) broadly tubular, ca. 6 mm long, tube ca. 3.5 mm long, lobes five, ca. 2.5 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2.5 mm long, geniculate near apex, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes absent. Disk absent. Ovary broad with truncate apex, five-locular, densely pubescent; style ca. 4.5 mm long (bud), exserted, glabrous; style-head minutely five-lobed. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 35 cm diam. with white latex and pale greenish flowers. Flowering Oct.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely golden appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, smooth, usually lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 3.6-9 × 1.4-3.1 cm, elliptic, apex narrowly attenuate or acuminate, base narrowly attenuate, coriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, with a strong marginal vein, midrib not raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 6-8 pairs, convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries short to moderately long; tertiaries finely reticulate, intergrading with the lower order reticulum. Petiole 0.5-1.6 cm long, channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 1-2-flowered, arranged along leafless axillary shoots 0.5-3 cm long. Pedicel 0.3-1 mm long, sometimes bearing 1-2 minute bracts, appressed puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals six, outer ca. 1 mm long, inner ca. 3.5 mm long, sparsely appressed puberulous on both surfaces. Corolla shortly tubular, slightly expanded at the throat, ca. 4 mm long, tube ca. 2.5 mm long, lobes 4-5, ca. 1.5 mm long, suborbicular, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens 4-5, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments (female) ca. 0.25 mm long, glabrous; anthers absent in female. Staminodes 4-5, ca. 0.3 mm long, subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary narrowly ovoid, five-locular, appressed pubescent; style ca. 2 mm long, about equalling the corolla, glabrous; style-head minutely lobed. Fruit 3.3-3.5 cm long, broadly ellipsoid, apex and base rounded, smooth (wrinkled on drying), glabrous. Seed solitary, 2.2-2.5 cm long, broadly ellipsoid to subglobose, rounded at apex and base, testa smooth, shining, ca. 0.75 mm thick; scar adaxial, covering two thirds or more of the seed surface, rough and slightly verruculose; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 35 m high and 1.1m diam., larger specimens buttressed to 2.5 m high, trunk sometimes fluted; bark greyish-brown, scaling in large irregular pieces, slash pinkish to cream, with sticky white latex. Flowers whitish, fruit green (? mature). Flowers collected May and Oct, single fruit collection Nov.

description: Tree; young shoots closely appressed puberulous with golden-brown indumentum, soon glabrous, greyish to black, rough, lenticellate. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 4.218 × 2.2-9 cm, broadly elliptic or obovate, apex acute to rounded, base narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, thin marginal vein sometimes present, secondary veins 6-9 pairs, slightly convergent or parallel, slightly arcuate or straight; intersecondaries variable in length, or absent; tertiaries mostly horizontal. Petiole 0.4-2 cm long, not channelled, appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles 10-20-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 4-8 mm long, sparsely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals five, 2-2.5 mm long, ovate or oblong, apex rounded to acute, sparsely appressed puberulous outside, sericeous inside, ciliate. Corolla shortly tubular, 3.5-4.25 mm long, tube equalling or exceeding the lobes, lobes five, broadly oblong, apex rounded or truncate, subglabrous. Stamens five, fixed in the lower half (about one third up from the base) of corolla tube; filaments 1.5-2 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.6-0.8 mm long, broadly lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes 0-5, 0.1-0.3 mm long, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary conical, tapering gradually to style, five-locular, densely pubescent; style 2-2.5 mm long (elongating further after corolla falls), exserted in bud and in open flower, longitudinally ribbed, glabrous; style-head simple or minutely five-lobed. Fruit 2-2.5 cm long, ellipsoid, apex and base rounded, fleshy (shrinking on drying), smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary, 1.8-2 cm long, ellipsoid, slightly laterally compressed, rounded at base and apex, testa slightly wrinkled, shining, ca. 0.3 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, ca. 2 mm wide; embryo with thinly plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 38 m high and 1 m diam. with simple plank buttresses to 2 m high and cylindrical bole; bark reddish-brown to greyish-brown, rough and flaking, slash orange to pinkish, with sticky white latex. Flowers yellowish-green, fruit maturing orange-yellow, the seeds surrounded by soft sweet pulp. Flowering mostly Aug-Nov, fruit Feb-Mar.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely and sparsely appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, rough, greyish, lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged to subopposite, 5-9(-l1) x 2.5-3.3(-4.8) cm, oblanceolate, elliptic or oblong-elliptic, apex shortly narrowly attenuate to obtusely cuspidate or rounded, base narrowly attenuate or cuneate, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, upper surface glabrous, lower surface glaucous, with scattered minute appressed hairs, or glabrous; venation brochidodromous, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 14-21 pairs, parallel and usually straight; intersecondaries long; tertiaries mostly parallel to secondaries and descending from margin. Petiole 3-9 mm long, slightly channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 5-15-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 1-8 mm long, with scattered minute appressed indumentum. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals four, 0.5-1 mm long, fused to about halfway, broadly ovate or triangular, apex acute to rounded, with sparse minute appressed indumentum outside, glabrous inside, sometimes ciliate. Corolla cyathiform, ca. 2 mm long, tube 0.75-1 mm long, lobes four, 1-1.25 mm long (equalling or exceeding tube), lanceolate to ovate, apex acute, aestivation slightly imbricate to subvalvate, minutely appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Stamens four, free or fixed in the lower half of the corolla tube; filaments 0.75-1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.3-0.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous; stamens absent in female. Staminodes four, 0.6-1 mm long in male, ca. 0.2 mm long in female, subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broadly ovoid, bilocular, appressed puberulous; style 0.4-0.6 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 1.8-2.7 cm long, broadly ellipsoid to globose, apex rounded or obtuse, base rounded to slightly tapered, smooth to minutely verruculate, glabrous. Seed 1 (-2), 1.4-1.8 cm long, broadly ellipsoid to obovoid, rounded at base and apex, slightly laterally compressed, testa smooth, shining, sometimes adherent to pericarp, 0.3-1 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, 3.5-8 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 40 m high and 90 cm diam., larger specimens with simple or branched running buttresses to 2.5 m high (spreading up to 3 m), bole slightly fluted at base, cylindric above, bark pale buff-brown or grey-brown, vertically cracked and scaling in thin narrow strips, slash orange-streaked, with plentiful sticky white latex, leaves greyish-green to glaucous below; flowers pale greenish-white, fruit maturing yellowish to dull orange. Flowering Sep-Nov, fruit maturing May-Sep (Colombia, Venezuela, the Guianas), Nov (Brazil).

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli breviter et adpresse pubescentes usque strigosi (pilis pallidis), mox glabri, demum pallide cinerascenti, grandibus frustis desquamati, elenticellati. Folia congesta, spiraliter disposita, 13-23 × 3.6-8 cm, oblanceolata, apice congeste acuminata usque caudata, basi anguste attenuata, saepe decurrentia, chartacea vel tenuiter coriacea, supra glabra, costa et nervi secundarii infra pilis brevibus rigidis pallidis adpressis vestita, lamina inferioris pilis albidis adpressis vestita; venatio eucamptodroma; nervus marginalis praesens; costa supra acute elevata; nervi secundarii 13-20-jugi, paralleli vel leviter convergentes, recti vel leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii breves vel nulli; nervi tertiarii indistincti, obliqui; reticulum quaternarium praesens. Petiolus 2-3.5 cm longus, canaliculata, subglaber. Fasciculi 1-3-flori, sub foliis congesta Flores sessiles, bisexuales. Sepala quatuor, 6-7 mm longa, late ovata, apice acuta vel obtusa, extus breviter rigide et adpresse puberula, sepala interna saepe margine lata glabra, omnia intus glabra, interdum ciliata. Corolla late tubularis, 0.95-1 cm longa; tubus ca. 6 mm longus; lobi quatuor, 3-4 mm longi, late oblongi usque ovati, apice rotundati, glabri. Stamina quatuor, in dimidio superiore tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 1.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae 1.8-2 mm longae, suborbiculares, complanatae, apiculatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, ca. 2 mm longa, anguste lanceolata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideum usque globosum, quadriloculare, dense et longe strigosum; stylus post anthesin 69 mm longus, interdum exsertus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus 3-3.5 cm longus, anguste ovoideus vel ellipsoideus, apice acutus, basi rotundatus, laevis, adpresse puberulus. Semina plura, 1.8-2 cm longa, oblonga vel ellipsoidea, saepe plano-convexa, apice et basi rotundata vel obtusa, testa laevis, nitidus, ca. 0.3 mm crassus; cicatrix adaxialis et circa basim extensa, ca. 2 mm lata; embryo cotyledonibus convexis, liberis, radicula and superficiem extensa; albumen nullum.

description: Tree; young shoots shortly appressed pubescent to strigose (hairs pale), soon glabrous, becoming pale greyish, scaling in large thin pieces, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 13-23 × 3.6-8 cm, oblanceolate, apex narrowly acuminate to caudate, base narrowly attenuate, often decurrent, chartaceous or thinly coriaceous, glabrous above, lower surface with short stiff pale appressed hairs on midrib and secondary veins, and scattered fine white closely appressed hairs on the lamina; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib sharply raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 13-20 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, straight or slightly arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries indistinct, oblique; quaternary reticulum present. Petiole 2-3.5 cm long, channelled, subglabrous. Fascicles 1-3-flowered, clustered below the leaves. Flowers sessile, bisexual. Sepals four, 6-7 mm long, broadly ovate, apex acute or obtuse, shortly stiff-appressed puberulous outside, inner pair often with broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside, sometimes ciliate. Corolla broadly tubular, 0.95-1 cm long, tube ca. 6 mm long, lobes four, 3-4 mm long, broadly oblong to ovate, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens four, fixed about two-thirds up the corolla tube; filament ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.8-2 mm long, suborbicular, flattened, apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 2 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid to globose, four-locular, densely long-strigose; style 6-9 mm long after anthesis, sometimes exserted, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 3-3.5 cm long, narrowly ovoid or ellipsoid, apex acute, base rounded, smooth, appressed puberulous. Seeds several, 1.8-2 cm long, oblong or ellipsoid, often plano-convex, apex and base rounded or obtuse, testa smooth, shining, ca. 0.3 mm thick; scar adaxial and extending around the base, ca. 2 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 25 m high and 35 cm diam., unbuttressed, or with small, simple or branched buttresses to 50 cm high; trunk fluted or irregular in section; bark brown or reddish-brown, exfoliating profusely in large papery scales, slash very thin (ca. 2 mm), orange, pink or cream, exuding sticky white latex. Rowers greenish-white, fruit matruing yellow or pale orange, flesh tough, containing white pulp. Flowering May-Jun, fruit maturing Nov-May.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, becoming pale greyish-white, scaling, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 10-21 × 3.4-8 cm, elliptic or oblong-elliptic, apex acute, base shortly and narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation mostly brochidodromous, midrib not raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 13-18 pairs, spreading widely, almost at right angles to the midrib, parallel, straight; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries at right angles to the secondaries; quaternaries at right angles to the tertiaries. Petiole 1.5-2.5 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 1-3-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers (not seen, description from Urban). Sepals four, ca. 4 mm long, outer ovate, inner obovate, outer appressed puberulous outside, inner glabrous. Corolla broadly tubular, 4-5 mm long, tube about twice as long as the lobes, lobes four, suborbicular, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens four, fixed at about the middle of the corolla tube; anthers ovate. Staminodes four, oblong, slightly shorter than corolla lobes, fixed between the lobes. Ovary globose, four-locular, pubescent; style ca. 3 mm long. Fruit globose, 2.8 cm diam. Field characters. Tree with white flowers, and brown fruit. Flowering May-Sep.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli dense velutino-tomentosi, pilis brunneis, indumento persistente, demum glabri, cinerascenti-brunnei, squamati, elenticellati. Folia laxe congesta, spiraliter disposita, 23.5-70 × 10.5-23 cm, late oblanceolata vel elliptitica, apice obtuse cuspidata usque breviter attenuata, basi acuta vel obtusa, tenuiter coriacea, supra glabra, infra costa et nervi infra pubescentia pilis brevius biramosis, indumentum in lamina sparsius; venatio eucamptodroma-brochidodroma; costa supra prominens vel recessa; nervi secundarii 16-25-jugi, paralleli, leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui; nervi quatemarii reticulati; nervi secundarii et tertiarii supra valde impressi, ventaio tota infra valde elevata. Petiolus 4-8.5(-13) cm longus apice leviter canaliculata, breviter tomentosus usque subglaber. Fasciculi 3-10-flori, axillares et sub foliis enati. Pedicellus 2-5 mm longus, tomentosus. Flores bisexuales. Sepala quinque(-sex), 5-5.5 mm longa, ovato-elliptica, apice obtusa usque rotundata, crassa, extus dense adpresse puberula, intus in dimidio superiore adpresse puberula. Corolla breviter tubularis, ca. 7 mm longa; tubus ca. 4 mm longus; lobi quinque, ca. 3 mm longi, anguste ovati, apice rotundati, glabri. Stamina quinque, prope apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 1.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 2 mm longae, lanceolatae, apiculatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, ca. 2.5 mm longa, lanceolata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium columnare, quinquelocular, dense strigosum; stylus post anthesin ca. 2 mm longus, supra glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus (in prima juventute) dense tomentosus.

description: Tree; young shoots densely velutinous-tomentose with short brown hairs, indumentum persistent, finally glabrous, grey-brown, scaling, without lenticels. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 23.5-70 × 10.5-23 cm, broadly oblanceolate or elliptic, apex obtusely cuspidate to shortly attenuate, base acute to obtuse, thinly coriaceous; upper surface glabrous, lower surface with indumentum of short two-branched hairs, pubescent on midrib and veins, sparser on the lamina; venation eucamptodromous-brochidodromous, midrib sharply prominent but recessed on the upper surface, secondary veins 16-25 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique; quaternaries reticulate; secondary and tertiary venation strongly impressed on the upper surface, all venation strongly raised on the lower surface. Petiole 4-8.5(-l3) cm long, slightly channelled at the apex, shortly tomentose to subglabrous. Fascicles 3-10-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 2-5 mm long, tomentose. Flowers bisexual. Sepals five(-six), 5-5.5 mm long, ovate-elliptic, apex obtuse to rounded, thickened, densely appressed puberulous outside, sparsely appressed puberulous in upper half inside. Corolla shortly tubular, ca. 7 mm long, tube ca. 4 mm long, lobes five, ca. 3 mm long, narrowly ovate, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed near the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 2 mm long, lanceolate, apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 2.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary columnar, five-locular, densely strigose; style ca. 2 mm long after anthesis, glabrous above; style-head simple. Fruit (very young) densely tomentose. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 35 m diam. with thinly flaking bark. Rowers yellowish-green, fruit maturing orange (not seen, field data from Mori & Cardoso 17721). Flowering Sep-Oct.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed at first, soon glabrous, brown, rough with scars of fallen leaves, without lenticels. Stipules 3-6 mm long, narrowly lanceolate-subulate, minutely appressed puberulous, caducous, leaving a small scar. Leaves densely clustered, spirally arranged, 12-20 × 4.6-11.2 cm, oblanceolate or cuneiform, apex obtuse to rounded, base long-tapered, finally narrowly cuneate to abruptly rounded, thinly coriaceous, some fine appressed indumentum on midrib and veins at first, soon glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib not raised on the upper surface, secondary veins (12-) 15-22 pairs, parallel, straight or slightly arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries oblique; quaternaries reticulate, prominent. Petiole 2-6 cm long, strongly channelled, soon glabrous. Fascicles 5-20-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 0.6-1.3 cm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals five, 3-3.5 mm long, outer ovate, apex acute, inner elliptic, apex rounded, appressed puberulous outside, inner with broad glabrous margin, glabrous inside, ciliate. Corolla broadly tubular, 5-6 mm long, tube 3-3.5 mm long, lobes five, 2-2.5 mm long, broadly oblong, apex truncate, appressed puberulous or glabrous outside, glabrous inside, ciliate. Stamens five, fixed near the base of the corolla tube; filaments 2.5-3.5 mm long, not geniculate, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, ovate, laterally flattened, apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 1 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broad, subtruncate, five-locular, densely pubescent; style ca. 4.5 mm long after anthesis, exserted in bud, included in open flower, pubescent in lower half; style-head minutely five-lobed. Fruit 5.5-6.5 × 6.5-7.5 cm, oblate, apex rounded, base truncate, thick-walled, smooth, glabrous. Seeds two, 3.5-4 cm long, broadly ellipsoid, plano-convex, rounded at base and apex, testa smooth, shiny, 1.5-1.75 mm thick; scar covering most of the seed surface, except for a narrow abaxial segment; embryo with planoconvex, free cotyledons, radicle included; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 50 m high and 1.5 m diam., larger specimens with small buttresses; bark greyish-brown, scaling thinly in small papery pieces; sap copious, pale yellow; flowers pale green, sometimes delicately scented; fruit brown. Flowering recorded May (Panama), Sep, Feb (Costa Rica), fruit Dec to Feb.

description: Tree; young shoots densely appressed puberulous, becoming glabrous, greyish. Leaves clustered, 9-15 × 4-6 cm, oblong or broadly oblanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate or acuminate, base narrowly attenuate, coriaceous, glabrous above or with residual greyish pubescence along midrib, densely reddish-brown sericeous below; venation eucamptodromous, secondary veins 10-15 pairs, ascending, slightly convergent, slightly impressed on upper surface; higher order venation finely reticulate. Petiole 2-3 cm long, appressed puberulous. Fascicles 4-10-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 4-7 mm long, reddish-brown sericeous. Sepals five, ca. 2 mm long, broadly ovate or suborbicular, apex rounded, sericeous outside, ciliate. Corolla cyathiform, 3-3.5 mm long, tube shorter than lobes, lobes five, 2.5-3.5 mm long, rounded, margin fimbriate-ciliate. Stamens five, fixed near top of corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, ovate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broadly conical, 4-5-ribbed, unilocular, densely sericeo-villous; style ca. 1 mm long, glabrous; style-head capitate. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree with greenish flowers. Flowering Jul.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, thin-scaly, usually lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 6.8-15 × 2.5-7.5 cm, oblanceolate, elliptic or broadly oblong, apex usually obtusely cuspidate or rounded, less frequently narrowly attenuate, base usually narrowly attenuate, rarely rounded, margin often revolute, thinly coriaceous, glabrous, usually minutely punctate on lower surface; venation brochidodromous, marginal vein often present, midrib raised on the upper surface (rounded in section), secondary veins 9-15 pairs, straight, parallel, often slightly impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries usually well-developed; tertiaries obscure, reticulate or tending to parallel the secondaries. Petiole 0.4-1.7 cm long, not channeled, glabrous. Fascicles 3-20-flowered, axillary or clustered on usually leafless axillary shoots up to 8 cm long. Pedicel (2-)3-5 mm long, minutely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual or unisexual (?) (dioecious) sepals 4-5, 1.5-2.25 mm long, free, or fused at base, ovate, apex usually obtuse or rounded, minutely appressed puberulous on both surfaces. Corolla 1-2 mm long, tube exceeding the lobes (up to 3 times as long), lobes 4-5, ovate, apex obtuse or rounded, glabrous or appressed puberulous on outside of tube. Stamens 4-5, fixed in the upper half or at the top of the corolla tube; filaments (0.2-0.3 mm long, strongly curved, glabrous; anthers 0.3-0.8 mm long, ovoid, glabrous, absent in female flowers. Staminodes 4-5, 0.20.4 mm long, subulate, glabrous. Disk absent (see note below). Ovary patelliform (in functionally male flowers) or ovoid (in female flowers), 2(-3)-locular, puberulous; style ca. 0.5 mm long after anthesis (in male), ca. 0.2 mm long (female), puberulous; style-head simple. Fruit 1.8-3 cm long, ellipsoid to globose, rounded at apex and base, fleshy, smooth, glabrous when mature. Seed solitary, 1.4-2.2 cm long, ellipsoid, slightly laterally compressed, rounded at base and apex, testa smooth, shining, 0.3-0.5 mm thick; scar adaxial full-length, 3-4 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 80 cm diam., larger specimens buttressed to 2 m high and with deeply fluted bole. Sticky white latex present. Flowers greenish-yellow, fruit ripening yellow, with clear pulp. Flowering throughout its range Jun to Nov, fruiting season uncertain.

description: (Description largely from Diels’s protologue.) Leaves clustered, 10-15 × 4-4.5 cm, oblanceolate or obovate-elliptic, apex obtuse and slightly apiculate, base narrowly attenuate, coriaceous, glabrous above except for pubescence along midrib, densely sericeous-tomentose below with greyish-brown hairs (both appressed and spreading); venation eucamptodromous, midrib not raised on the upper surface, marginal vein present, secondary veins 13-18 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate, impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries obscure, oblique. Petiole 1.2-1.8 cm long, not channelled, sericeous-tomentose. Fascicles 3-10-flowered, axillary. Pedicel 0.8-1 cm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers unisexual. Sepals 5.5-8 mm long, broadly lanceolate to oblong, apex acute, hooded, outer two appressed puberulous outside, inner two glabrous outside, all glabrous inside. Corolla cylindrical, 6-7 mm long, tube ca. 4 mm long, lobes four, ca. 2 mm long, broadly oblong, apex rounded, glabrous, or sparsely ciliate. Stamens (female flower only) four, fixed about half way up the corolla tube; filaments glabrous, anthers absent. Staminodes four, ca. 1 mm long, oblong, glabrous. Ovary globose, four-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 3 mm long after anthesis, densely strigose in the lower half; style-head glabrous. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Flowering in Jul.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli dense et breviter brunneo-tomentosa-pubescentes, indumento persistente, demum glabri, pallide brunnei, grandibus squamis desquamati, elenticillati. Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 13.7-27 × 7.3-10.5 cm, late oblongo-oblanceolata, apice rotundata et obtuse cuspidata, basi acuta vel anguste cuneata, chartacea, supra glabra, infra dense et breviter pubescentia, mixtis brevibus pilis adpressis et longioribus patentibus pilis argenteo-brunneis vestita; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra recessa; nervi secundarii 15-20-jugi, paralleli, leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii numerosi, obliqui. Petiolus 1.7-3.5 cm, non canaliculata, dense et breviter pubescens. Fasciculi 1-2-flori, axillares et sub foliis dispositi. Pedicellus 0-0.5 mm longus, breviter pubescens. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quatuor, 5-6 mm longa, lanceolata, apice acuta, sepala externa extus dense et breviter pubescentia, sepala interna extus glabra, omnia intus glabra, Corolla tubularis, ca. 3.5 mm longa; tubus ca. 2.5 mm longus; lobi quatuor, ca. 1 mm longi, oblongi, apice truncati, glabri. Stamina quatuor, in dimidio inferiore tubo corollae affixa; filamenta 1-1.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1 mm longae, lanceolatae, complanatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, ca. 0.5 mm longa, oblonga, apice rotundata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium globosum, quadrilocu-lare, dense et longe strigosum; stylus post anthesin ca. 3.5 mm longus, leviter ex corolla exsertus, in dimidio superiore glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus 3-3.5 cm longus, globosus, breviter rostratus, basi truncatus, in sicco leviter torulosus et verruculosus, dense et breviter tomentosus vel pubescens. Semina dua, ca. 2.2 cm longa, oblongo-ellipsoidea, plano-convexa, apice et basi rotundata, area laevis testae reducta ad segmentum lanceolatum abaxiale quod pericarpio adhaerens, testa ca. 1 mm crassa, lignea; cicatrix plerumque seminis operiens, aspera et verruculosa; embryo cotyledonibus plano-convexis, libris, radicula ad superficiem extensa; albumen nullum.

description: Tree; young shoots densely short brown tomentose-pubescent, indumentum persisting, eventually glabrous, pale brown, scaling in large flakes, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 13.7-27 × 7.3-10.5 cm, broadly oblong-oblanceolate, apex rounded and obtusely cuspidate, base acute or narrowly cuneate, chartaceous, glabrous above, densely short-pubescent below with a mixture of short appressed and longer spreading silvery-brown hairs; venation eucamptodromous, midrib sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 15-20 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries numerous, oblique. Petiole 1.7-3.5 cm long, not channelled, densely short-pubescent. Fascicles 1-2-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 0-0.5 mm long, short-pubescent. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, 5-6 mm long, lanceolate, apex acute, outer pair densely short-pubescent outside, inner pair glabrous outside, all glabrous inside. Corolla tubular, ca. 3.5 mm long, tube ca. 2.5 mm long, lobes four, ca. 1 mm long, oblong, apex truncate, glabrous. Stamens four, fixed about one-third up the corolla tube; filaments 1-1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate, flattened, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 0.5 mm long, oblong, apex rounded, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca 3.5 mm long after anthesis, slightly exserted from the corolla, glabrous in upper half; style-head simple. Fruit 3-3.5 cm long, globose, shortly rostrate, base truncate, slightly knobbly and verruculose when dry, densely short-tomentose or short-pubescent. Seeds two, ca. 2.2 cm long, oblong-ellipsoid, plano-convex, apex and base rounded, smooth area of testa reduced to a lanceolate, abaxial segment which adheres to the pericarp, testa ca. 1 mm thick, woody; scar area covering most of the seed, rough and verruculose; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent.  Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 20 cm diam. with white latex. Flowering Jul, fruit maturing Oct.

description: Tree; young shoots massive, finely appressed puberulous, becoming glabrous, pale brown, rough, minutely scaling and with prominent leaf scars, lenticellate. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 30-75 × 15-30 cm, broadly oblanceolate, apex acute to rounded, base long tapering, narrowly cuneate, chartaceous, upper surface glabrous, lower surface minutely and closely appressed puberulous (lens) on the midrib and veins, sometimes extending to the lamina; venation eucamptodoromus, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface (rounded in section), secondary veins 30-38 pairs, parallel, straight; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique, fine higher order reticulum mostly at right angles to the tertiaries. Petiole 1-3 cm long, not channelled, appressed puberulous. Fascicles 1-2-flowered, axillary and below the leaves, and on larger branches. Pedicel 2.5-5 cm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals four, 1.2-1.6 cm long, broadly ovate or elliptic, apex obtuse or rounded, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Corolla ellipsoid-tubular, contracted at throat, 1.8-2.2	cm long, tube 1.3-1.7 cm long, lobes six, 4.5-5 mm long, broadly elliptic, apex obtuse, appressed pubescent on the outside of lobes, papillose. Stamens six, fixed near the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 3 mm long, geniculate at apex, glabrous; anthers 2-2.5 mm long, broadly lanceolate, sparsely hairy. Staminodes six, 3-4 mm long, subulate, papillose. Disk absent. Ovary globose, 6-10-locular, densely pubescent; style 1.2-1.5 cm long after anthesis, equalling the corolla, pubescent in lower half; style-head minutely lobed. Fruit globose or broadly ovoid, 9-13 cm long, apex rounded or apiculate, base truncate, rough-skinned with numerous large prominent lenticels. Seeds several, 5-6.5 cm long, plano-convex or angular, testa smooth, shining, ca. 1 mm thick; scar adaxial, but covering most of the seed, leaving a small elliptic area of shiny smooth testa on the abaxial face; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 50 cm diam., trunk of larger specimens strongly fluted towards the base. Bark pale, greyish-brown, shallowly and finely fissured, slash cream to orange-brown with small amount of white latex. Branches often whorled in younger specimens, branching sympodial, forming a dense, dark crown. The massive twigs bear conspicuous scars of fallen leaves. Flowers sweetly scented, with a greenish-cream corolla. Fruit pale brown, roughskinned with whitish lenticels; flesh bright orange-yellow, eaten by rodents. Flowering Oct-Nov, Feb-Mar, mature fruit collected Oct-Nov.

description: Frutex vel arbor parva; ramuli novelli adpresse puberuli, pilis ferrugineis vel albidis, mox glabri cinerascenti-brunnei, squamati, interdum centuriato modo rimas ducens, elenticellati. Folia dissita, opposita, verticillata vel spiraliter disposita, 3-6 × 1.5-3.4 cm, late oblanceolata usque obovata, apice obtusa, rotundata vel emarginata, basi anguste cuneata vel attenuata, margine leviter revoluta, coriacea, glabra; venatio eucamptodroma-rochidodroma; costa supra leviter elevata; nervi secundarii 9-10-jugi, par-alleli vel leviter convergentes, recti vel leviter arcuati, supra interdum leviter impressi; nervi intersecundarii interdum modice longi; nervi tertiarii obscuri. Petiolus 3-5 mm longus, non canaliculata, adpresse puberulus. Fasciculi 3-15-flori, axillares et sub foliis dispositi, saepe in ramulos veteres a brachyblastis 5 mm longi pro-ducti. Pedicellus 1-6 mm longus, adpresse fer-rugineo-puberulus. Flores bisexuales. Sepala 4-5, ca. 1.25 mm longa, lanceolata-ovata, apice acuta, extus breviter ferrugineo-pubescentia, intus prope apicem pubescentia. Corolla rotata, 2-2.25 mm longa; tubus 0.5-1 mm longus; lobi 4-6, 1.25-1.5 mm longi, lanceolati, apice acuti usque rotundati, extus adpresse ferrugineo-strigosi, intus glabri. Stamina 4-6, ad basim loborum corollae affixa, exserta; filamenta ca. 0.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae 0.3-0.5 mm longae, ovatae usque oblongae, rotundatae, glabrae. Staminodia 4-6, 1-1.25 mm longa, anguste triangularia vel lanceolata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium globosum usque truncatum, 2-3-loculare, pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 1 mm longus, solum ad basim pubescens; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus (immaturus) 1-2 cm longus, globosus, laevis, dense ferrugineo-puberulus, stylus persistens. Semen solitarium, ca. 1 cm longum, late ellipsoideum, testa laevis, cicatrix adaxialis, ca. 2 mm lata; embryo cotyledonibus plano-convexis, liberis, radicula ad superficiem extensa; albumen nullum.

description: Shrub or small tree; young shoots appressed puberulous with ferruginous or whitish hairs, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, scaling and sometimes grid-cracked, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, opposite, verticillate or spirally arranged, 3-6 × 1.5-3.4 cm, broadly oblanceolate to obovate, apex obtuse, rounded or emarginate, base narrowly cuneate or attenuate, margin slightly revolute, coriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous-brochidodromous, midrib not or only slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 9-10 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, straight or slightly arcuate, sometimes slightly impressed on the upper surface; intersecondaries sometimes moderately long; tertiaries obscure. Petiole 3-5 mm long, not channelled, appressed puberulous. Fascicles 3-15-flowered, axillary and below the leaves, often developing short brachyblasts to 5 mm long on older shoots. Pedicel 1-6 mm long, appressed ferrugineous puberulous. Flowers bisexual. Sepals 4-5, ca. 1.25 mm long, lanceolate-ovate, apex acute, shortly ferruginous pubescent outside, and near the apex inside. Corolla rotate, 2-2.25 mm long, tube 0.5-1 mm long, lobes 4-6, 1.25-1.5 mm long, lanceolate, apex acute to rounded, appressed ferruginous-strigose outside, glabrous inside. Stamens 4-6, fixed at the base of the corolla lobes, exserted; filaments ca. 0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.3-0.5 mm long, ovate to oblong, rounded, glabrous. Staminodes 4-6, 1-1.25 mm long, narrowly triangular or lanceolate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary globose to truncate, 2-3-locular, pubescent; style ca. 1 mm long after anthesis, pubescent at base only; style-head simple. Fruit (immature) 1-2 cm long, globose, style persistent, smooth, densely ferruginous-puberulous. Seed solitary, ca. 1 cm long, broadly ellipsoid, testa smooth; scar adaxial, ca. 2 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Shrub or small tree to 10 m high, the leaves glaucous or silvery below; slash with white latex. Flowers yellowish-green, fruit ferruginous brown. Flowering recorded Aug-Oct and Mar.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous, becoming glabrous, brown or greyish-brown, slightly fissured, without lenticels. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 19-40 × 7-19 cm, oblanceolate or elliptic, apex narrowly attenuate to rounded but then finally cuspidate, base narrowly attenuate, margin sometimes revolute, coriaceous, upper surface glabrous, lower surface minutely appressed puberulous to glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat (not raised on the upper surface), marginal vein present, secondary veins 14-23 pairs, parallel, straight or slightly arcuate; intersecondaries small or absent, tertiaries oblique; fine areolate reticulum conspicuous on lower surface. Petiole 2-4 cm long, not channelled, subglabrous. Fascicles axillary and produced from cushion-like projections on old wood, 5-many-flowered. Pedicel 0.5-1.5 cm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 2.5-3 mm long, ovate, rounded, puberulous on both surfaces, sometimes ciliate. Corolla 4-6 mm long, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes five, 2.5-4 mm long, broadly elliptic to suborbicular, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed in the upper half of the corolla tube; filaments 0.1-0.2 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.5-2 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 2 mm long, lanceolate with a narrowly attenuate apex, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broadly conical, strongly and irregularly longitudinally ribbed, unilocular, puberulous; style 0-1 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head discoid to capitate. Fruit 1.5-1.7 cm long, ellipsoid, apex acute, base rounded, smooth or finely lenticellate, glabrous. Seed solitary, ca. 1.3 cm long, ellipsoid, obtuse at base and apex, not laterally compressed, testa smooth, shining; scar adaxial, full length, ca. 1.5 mm wide; embryo not seen. Field characters. Tree to 27 m high and 30 cm diam., unbuttressed, with reddish bark, slash exudes abundant sticky white sap. Flowers white to cream-coloured. Flowering recorded May, Jul, Sep to Dec, young fruit Dec.

description: Tree; young shoots densely tomentose (golden-brown hairs), rather persistent, eventually glabrous, pale buff or brown, scaling, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 15-24 × 5.3-6.5 cm, oblanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate, base long-tapering, narrowly cuneate or acute, chartaceous, mature leaves, glabrous above, lower surface with residual tomentum along the midrib and secondary veins; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 16-20 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique, close; higher order reticulum visible with lens. Petiole 1-1.5 cm long, not channelled, densely tomentose. Fascicles 2-3-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 0-0.5 mm long, densely tomentose. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, ca. 4.5 mm long, outer pair ovate, apex acute, inner pair oblong, apex rounded, outer pair tomentose outside, inner pair glabrous outside, all glabrous inside. Corolla broadly tubular, ca. 5 mm long, tube ca. 4 mm long, lobes four, ca. 1 mm long, broadly oblong, apex truncate, glabrous. Stamens four, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate, flattened, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 0.75 mm long, broadly lanceolate, apex rounded, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary depressed-globose, four-locular, densely long strigose; style ca. 3 mm long after anthesis, pubescent in lower half; style-head minutely lobed. Fruit ca. 2 × 2.5 cm, oblate-spheroidal, apex bluntly conical, base truncate, densely tomentose. Seed (not seen, descr. Lundell), 1 cm long, ellipsoid, scar 6 mm long, lateral. Field characters. Tree to 16 m high and 25 cm diam with whitish flowers in Apr, fruit Sep.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli initio minute et adpresse puberuli, mox glabri, rufo-brunnei vel cinerascenti-brunnei, squamati, elenti-cellati. Folia dense congesta, spiraliter disposita, 8.5-13 × 4-5.8 cm, cuneiformia usque oblanceolata, apice obtuse usque rotundata, basi abrupte rotundata vel truncata, chartacea, glabra vel ad basim pilis sparsis minutis residualibus, venatio eucamptodroma; nervus marginalis tenuis praesens; costa supra plana vel leviter elevata; nervi secundarii 9-11-jugi, paralleli, recti vel leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui, numerosi; venatio ordinis Superioris subtiliter reticulata. Petiolus 2-3 mm longus, non canaliculata, lateraliter latus, minute et adpresse puberulus. Fasciculi 2-5-flori, axillares et sub foliis disposita. Pedicellus 1.3-1.5 mm longus, gracilis, pilis sparsis minutis munitus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quatuor, 4-5 mm longa, lanceolata, apice acuta vel obtusa, sepala externa extus pilis sparsis adpressis minutis munita, sepala interna extus glara, sepala tota intus glabra. Corolla cylindrica, 8-8.5 mm longa; tubus 5-5.5 mm longus, lobi quatuor, ca. 3 mm longi, late oblongi, apice rotundati, glabri vel extus pilis paucis longis adpressis muniti. Stamina quatuor, in dimidio inferiore tubo corollae affixa; filamenta 4-4.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1.5 mm longae, late lanceolato-sagittatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, 2.5-3 mm longa, subulata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium globosum, quadriloculare, parce puberulum; stylus post anthesin ca. 5.5 mm longus, inclusus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ignotus.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous, reddish-brown or greyish-brown, scaling, without lenticels. Leaves densely clustered, spirally arranged, 8.5-13 × 4-5.8 cm, cuneiform to oblanceolate, apex obtuse to rounded, base abruptly rounded or truncate, chartaceous, glabrous or with some sparse residual minute indumentum near the base; venation eucamptodromous, thin marginal vein present, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 9-11 pairs, parallel, straight or slightly arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique, numerous; finer higher order reticulum (lens). Petiole 2-3 mm long, not channelled, broadened laterally, minutely appressed puberulous. Fascicles axillary and below the leaves, 2-5-flowered. Pedicel 1.3-1.5 cm long, slender, with sparse minute appressed hairs. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, 4-5 mm long, lanceolate, apex acute or obtuse, outer pair with sparse minute appressed indumentum outside, inner pair glabrous outside, all glabrous inside. Corolla cylindrical, 8-8.5 mm long, tube 5-5.5 mm long, lobes four, ca. 3 mm long, broadly oblong, apex rounded, glabrous or with a few scattered long appressed hairs outside. Stamens four, fixed about one-third up the corolla tube; filaments 4-4.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, broadly lanceolate-sagittate, glabrous. Staminodes four, 2.5-3 mm long, subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, sparsely puberulous; style ca. 5.5 mm long after anthesis, included glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 10 m high and 20 cm diam. with fluted bole; bark shallowly fissured, pale brown, slash pinkish brown with some white latex. Flowers pale green, slightly scented. Flowering in Nov.

description: Tree; young shoots subglabrous. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 7-10 × 3.5-4.5 cm, broadly oblanceolate, apex rounded, margin slightly revolute, base narrowly attenuate or cuneate, chartaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib slightly raised on upper surface, marginal vein prominent, secondary veins 6-8 pairs, ascending, convergent, arcuate; lower order venation obscure, reticulate. Petiole 0.7-1.7 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles mostly axillary, 2-8-flowered. Pedicel 0.9-1.3 cm long, glabrous. Sepals four, ca. 4 mm long, ovate. Corolla broadly tubular, ca. 6.5 mm long, tube 4-4.5 mm long; lobes four, ca. 2 mm long, apex rounded, ciliate. Stamens four, fixed at base of corolla tube; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, ovate, glabrous. Staminodes four, 2-2.5 mm long, apex obtuse. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, densely pubescent; style ca. 5 mm long, glabrous in upper half. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Large tree with white flowers. Flowering Jul.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli molliter et dense tomentoso-villosi, indumento persistente, demum glabri, pallide cinerascentes, laeves, crassi, lenticellis parvis; ramuli novelli subtenti fasciculo frondium squamarum late triangularium, 0.5-1 cm longarum. Folia laxe congesta, spiraliter dis-posita, 13-21.6 × 8.5-11.3 cm, late elliptica usque late oblongo-ovata, apice obtusa vel acuta, basi truncata, chartacea (immatura), costa et nervi supra tomentosi pilis residuis crispatis aureis, pagina inferiore dense crispato-aureo-tomento-sa, venatio eucamptodroma; nervus marginalis tenuis; costa supra non elevata; nervi secundarii 15-18-jugi, paralleli, leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii breves vel nulli; nervi tertiarii obliqui, numerosi, supra impressi; reticulum quatemarium supra impressum. Petiolus 1.2-1.7 cm longus, canaliculata, tomentosus. Fasciculi 6-10-flori, axillares, vel in axillis bractearum oblongarum, obtusarum, tomentosarum, 1.8-2.2 cm longarum enati. Pedicellus 1.3-1.5 cm longus, aureotomentosus. Flores unisexuales (planta verosimiliter dioica) solum in tenero alabastro visi. Sepala quinque, 3 mm longa (in fructu usque 5	mm longa), extus tomentosa, intus glabra. Tubus corollae lobos aequens, glaber. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa, antherae in flores foemina nullae. Staminodia 5, lanceolata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium biloculare, pubescens; stylus inclusus. Fructus 4.3-5 × 2.7-3.2 cm, ellipsoideus, apice breviter et obtuse cuspidatus, basi obtusus, cortice duro, laevis, lenticellatus, glaber. Semen non visum.

description: Tree; young shoots densely soft golden tomentose-villous, indumentum persisting, eventually glabrous, pale grey, smooth, stout, with small lenticels; young growth subtended by a cluster of broadly triangular scale-leaves, 0.5-1 cm long. Leaves loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 13-21.6 × 8.5-11.3 cm, broadly elliptic to broadly oblong-ovate, apex obtuse or acute, base truncate, chartaceous (young), upper surface with residual crisped golden tomentum on the midrib & veins, lower surface densely crisped golden-tomentose, venation eucamptodromous, with a thin marginal vein, midrib not raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 15-18 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries oblique, numerous, impressed on the upper surface; quaternary reticulum impressed on the upper surface. Petiole 1.2-1.7 cm long, channelled, tomentose. Fascicles 6-10-flowered, axillary, or in the axils of oblong, obtuse, tomentose bracts 1.8-2.2 cm long. Pedicel 1.3-1.5 cm long, golden-tomentose. Flowers unisexual (plant probably dioecious), seen only in young bud. Sepals five, 3 mm long (to 5 mm in fruit), tomentose outside, glabrous within. Corolla tube equalling the lobes, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube, anthers absent in female flowers. Staminodes five, lanceolate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary bilocular, pubescent; style included. Fruit 4.3-5 × 2.7-3.2 cm, ellipsoid, apex shortly obtusely cuspidate, base obtuse, hard-skinned, smooth, lenticellate, glabrous. Seed not seen. Field characters. A large tree with white latex, flowering and fruiting in Aug.

description: Tree; young shoots scurfy-puberulous, becoming glabrous, medium to dark brown, cracked and fissured, without lenticels. Leaves densely clustered, spirally arranged, 15.5-30 x 6.3-14.6 cm, oblong-elliptic to broadly oblanceolate, apex obtusely cuspidate to rounded, base acute, obtuse or truncate, chartaceous, upper surface glabrous, lower surface with some minute residual scurfy appressed indumentum, especially along the midrib, venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 16-18 pairs, parallel, arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries oblique and reticulate. Petiole 2.2-4.3 cm long, channelled, scurfy-puberulous. Fascicles 5-10-flowered, ramiflorous. Pedicel 2-3 mm long, appressed scurfy-puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 3-4 mm long, elliptic to broadly ovate, apex obtuse to rounded, appressed scurfy-puberulous outside, glabrous inside or with some indumentum near the margin. Corolla cyathiform, ca. 5 mm long, tube equalling the lobes, lobes five, broadly ovate or triangular, apex obtuse, auriculate, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the apex of the corolla tube; filaments 1.25-1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes 3-5, vestigial to ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, tapering gradually into the style, five-locular, densely short-pubescent; style stout, ca. 2 mm long, pubescent below; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 15 m high with copious milky white latex, and cream flowers. Flowering Oct-Nov.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli dense et breviter pubescentes, pilis luteobrunneis, tandem glabri, cinerascenti-brunnei, asperi et squamati, elenticellati. Folia congesta, spiraliter disposita, 8.8-23.8 × 3.7-10 cm, late oblanceolata usque elliptica, apice acuta usque breviter et anguste attenuata, basi acuta vel anguste cuneata, chartacea usque tenuiter coriacea, supra glabra, infra subtiliter breviter pubescentia, pilis brunneis bi-ramosis, demum glabra; venatio eucamptodroma-brochidodroma; costa supra prominula; nervi secundarii 10-20-jugi, paralleli, leviter arcuati; nervi intersecundarii plerumque breves vel nulli; nervi tertiarii pauci, laxe dispositi, obliqui, reticulum ordonis Superioris infra modice conspicuum. Petiolus 1.2-2.3 cm longus, non canaliculata, pubescens. Fasciculi 2-5-flori, axillares et sub foliis dense congesti. Pedicellus 1-3 mm longus, dense pubescens. Flores unisexuales (planta dioica). Sepala quinque, 3.5-4 mm longa, late ovata, apice acuta vel obtusa, extus dense brunneo-pubescentia, intus prope marginem crispato puberula. Corolla (masculina) ca. 6 mm longa, (foeminea) ca. 3.5 mm longa; tubus lobos aequans; lobi quinque, late elliptici usque suborbiculares, apice rotundati, glabri. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 1.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1.5 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae; stamina in flore foemineo nulla. Staminodia quinque, (masculina) ca. 2.5 mm longa, lanceolato-subulata, glabra, (foeminea) ad vestigium parvum ca. 0.5 m longum reducta. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideo-conicum, 4-5-loculare, dense longe-strigosum; stylus post anthesin 3.5-4 mm longus, in dimidio inferiore strigosus; styli capitulum simplex (masculina) vel lobatum (foeminea). Fructus ca. 4 × 3 cm, ellipsoideus, apice rotundatus, basi depressus, crassus, in sicco rugosus, velutinus. Semen solitarium, ca. 2.3 cm longum, ellipsoideum, apice rotundatum, basi acutum, in superficie adaxiale planum, testa laevis, pericarpio adherens, 1.25-1.5 mm crassa; cicatrix adaxialis, elliptica, ca. 1 cm lata, ca. 0.5 cm semine brevior; embryo cotyledonibus planoconvexis, liberis, radicula leviter exserta; albumen nullum.
