description: Tree; young shoots densely short-pubescent with yellowish-brown hairs, becoming glabrous, greyish-brown, rough and scaly, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 8.8-23.8 × 3.7-10 cm, broadly oblanceolate to elliptic, apex acute to shortly narrowly attenuate, base acute or narrowly cuneate, chartaceous to thinly coriaceous, glabrous above, finely short-pubescent below with brown two-branched hairs, eventually glabrous; venation eucamptodromous-brochidodromous, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 10-20 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries usually short or absent; tertiaries few, widely spaced, oblique; higher order reticulum rather conspicuous on the lower surface. Petiole 1.2-2.3 cm long, not channelled, pubescent. Fascicles 2-5-flowered, axillary and densely clustered below the leaves. Pedicel 1-3 mm long, densely pubescent. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals five, 3.5-4 mm long, broadly ovate, apex acute or obtuse, densely brown-pubescent outside, crisped puberulous near the margin inside. Corolla (male) ca. 6 mm long, (female) ca. 3.5 mm long, tube equalling the lobes, lobes five, broadly elliptic to suborbicular, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous; stamens absent in female. Staminodes five, (male) ca. 2.5 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, glabrous, (female) reduced to small vestiges ca. 0.5 mm long. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid-conical, 4-5-locular, densely long-strigose; style 3.5-4 mm long after anthesis, strigose in lower half; style-head simple (male) or lobed (female). Fruit ca. 4 × 3 cm, ellipsoid, apex rounded, base depressed, thick-walled, wrinkled on drying, velutinous. Seed solitary, ca. 2.5 cm long, ellipsoid, apex rounded, base acute, flattened on adaxial face, testa smooth, adherent to pericarp, 1.25-1.5 mm thick; scar adaxial, elliptic, ca. 1 cm wide, ca. 0.5 cm shorter than the seed; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle slightly exserted; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 10 m high and 15 cm diam. with white latex. Flowers and fruit green. Flowering Sep, young fruit collected Oct.

description: Tree; young shoots appressed ferruginous puberulous, soon glabrous, grey-brown, longitudinally ridged, rough, often scaling, usually without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 9-43 × 4-17.5 cm, oblanceolate to broadly oblong, apex obtusely cuspidate, obtuse or rounded, base acute or narrowly attenuate or cuneate, thinly coriaceous, mature leaves glabrous, very young leaves with evanescent ferruginous scurfy indumentum on lower surface; venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 12-18(-22) pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries small or absent; tertiaries numerous, oblique; quaternaries mostly at right angles to the tertiaries. Petiole 1.5-3.5(-5.2) cm long, not or only slightly channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 1-8-flowered, axillary and ramiflorous. Flowers sessile, bisexual. Sepals 8-12 in a closely overlapping spiral, increasing in size towards the centre, outer 2-5 mm long, innermost 1-1.1 cm long, outer ones broader than long, inner broadly elliptic, apex rounded to emarginate or deeply cleft, densely sericeous outside, appressed puberulous in the upper half inside, often densely fringed. Corolla cylindrical, 1.25-1.7 cm long, tube 0.8-1.4 cm long, lobes five(-six), 3-5 mm long, broadly oblong, apex truncate or rounded, glabrous. Stamens five(-six), fixed near the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.5-2 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five(-six), 2-3 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broadly ovoid, sometimes truncate, (four-)five-locular, densely long pubescent; style 1-1.2 cm long after anthesis, included or equalling the corolla, glabrous; style-head simple or capitate. Fruit 4-4.5 cm long, globose or broadly ellipsoid, apex rounded to acute or slightly rostrate (when dry), base rounded, rough-skinned and scaly, glabrous. Seed solitary, ca. 3 cm long, globose, testa smooth, shining, ca. 0.75 cm thick; scar covering about three-quarters of the surface; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle included; endosperm absent. Field characters. Unbuttressed tree to 25 m high and 45 cm diam, with smooth greyish-brown bark; slash streaked yellowish and brown, exuding thick white latex. Flowers pale yellow to white, fruit maturing pale brown. Flowering mostly Feb-Jun, fruit Mar-Nov.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, becoming cracked and fissured, usually without lenticels. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 9.6-22 × 4-8.6 cm, elliptic, oblanceolate or oblong-elliptic, apex narrowly attenuate to rounded and obtusely cuspidate, base acute or narrowly attenuate, coriaceous, glabrous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib usually flat (not raised on upper surface), marginal vein sometimes present, secondary veins 10-15 pairs, parallel, slightly arcuate; intersecondaries usually absent; tertiaries numerous, oblique, fine areolate quaternary reticulum present (more prominent on lower surface). Petiole 0.8-1.5(-2.5) cm long, not channelled, appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles borne below the leaves, 10-20-flowered. Pedicel 0.2-1 cm long, sparsely appressed puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals five, 1-1.5 mm long, ovate, apex acute to rounded, sparsely appressed puberulous outside, glabrous or occasionally sparsely appressed puberulous inside, ciliate. Corolla (male) 3.25-4.5 mm long, (female) ca. 1.5 mm long, tube equalling or shorter than the lobes, lobes five, broadly ovate, apex rounded, glabrous, often ciliate. Stamens five, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube; filaments 0-0.4 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.5-1.75 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous; stamens in female reduced to sterile lanceolate-subulate staminodes, 0.5-0.75 mm long. Staminodes five, 1.5-2 mm long (male), ca. 0.75 mm long (female), subulate, carnose, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary slender, ovoid-conical, gradually tapering to the style; unilocular, glabrous; style 0.4-0.5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 2.5-3.5 cm long, ellipsoid, slightly asymmetrical, apex acute to obtuse, base acute or tapering to a short stipe ca. 5 mm long, smooth, soft-skinned, glabrous. Seed solitary, 2-2.7 cm long, ellipsoid, not laterally compressed, testa smooth, adhering to the pericarp, ca. 0.5 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, 4-7 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle included; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 40 cm diam., without buttresses, with reddish scaly bark; latex copious, milky. Flowers white, fruit green. Flowering recorded Apr, Oct to Dec, fruit Oct and Jun.

description: Tree, young shoots shortly brown-tomentose with strongly crisped hairs, soon glabrous, buff-grey, rough, lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 8.3-12.5 × 2.3-3.9 cm, narrowly elliptic to oblong, apex acute to narrowly attenuate, base acute or narrowly cuneate to rounded, coriaceous, glabrous above, young leaves with a loose layer of minute, matted, strongly crisped brown hairs on the lower surface, soon glabrous; venation eucamptodromous-brochidodromous, with a marginal vein, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 12-18 pairs, slightly convergent or parallel, straight or arcuate; inter-secondaries few, usually short to moderately long; tertiaries few, oblique or reticulate; quaternaries finely areolate. Petiole 1.8-2.5 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 2-3-flowered, axillary. Flowers sessile. Sepals seven, outer ca. 1 mm long, inner ca. 2.5 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse to rounded, sparsely appressed puberulous outside, sericeous inside. Corolla not seen. Ovary globose, five-locular, densely long pubescent; style ca. 1.25 mm long, glabrous; style-head simple. Young fruit ca. 1.8 cm long, ellipsoid, apex obtuse, base tapered, densely short-tomentose, with brown hairs. Seed solitary; embryo not seen. Field characters. Tree to 40 m high and 1 m diam. with reddish-tomentose fruit. Immature fruit collected Mar-Apr and Aug.

description: Tree; young shoots appressed pubescent with reddish-brown hairs, becoming greyish with age, finally glabrous, grey, cracked and scaling, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, opposite, 7.8-9.7 × 3.5-5 cm, elliptic, apex acute or obtuse, base acute or finally attenuate, subcoriaceous, glabrous above, sericeous below with reddish-brown hairs; venation eucamptodromous, midrib not raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 67 pairs, convergent, arcuate and steeply ascending; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries obscure, numerous, fine, horizontal, hidden by the indumentum on the lower surface. Petiole 0.4-1 cm long, not channelled, appressed pubescent to glabrous. Fascicles axillary and below the leaves. Flowers unknown. Fruit 1.8-2 cm long, ellipsoid, apex rounded, apiculate, base rounded, smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary, 1.2-1.4 cm long, ellipsoid, laterally compressed, testa finely transversely wrinkled, shining, ca. 0.4 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, ca. 1 mm wide; embryo with thin, foliaceous cotyledons, radicle exserted; endosperm copious. Field characters. Tree 10-15 m high with greyish scaling bark, latex present in cut bark. Ripe fruit yellowish, in Apr.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli initio pubescentes, pilis pallidis implexis furfuraceis evanescentibus, mox glabri, cinerascentes, asperi et rimosi, lenticellati. Folia dissita vel laxe congesta, spiraliter disposita, 11.8-23 × 3.6-7 cm, oblanceolata vel oblongo-oblanceolata, apice anguste acuminata vel attenuata, basi acuta usque rotundata, chartacea, glabra vel costa infra indumento residuali implexo vestita; venatio eucamptodroma; nervus marginalis praesens; costa plana vel supra pro-minula; nervi secundarii 12-15-jugi, leviter convergentes, arcuati; nervi intersecundarii breves vel nulli; nervi tertiarii oblique usque reticulati, pagina inferiore conspicui. Petiolus 0.8-2.5 cm longus, non canaliculata, pubescens vel glaber. Fasciculi 1-3-flori, axillares et sub foliis dispositi. Pedicellus 0-1 mm longus, pubescens. Flores unisexuales (planta dioica). Sepala quinque, (masculina) 4-5 mm longa; (foeminea) ca. 3 mm longa; lanceolata vel elliptica, apice acuta usque rotundata, extus dense implexo-pubescentes, intus glabra praeter aliquantam-pubescantiam prope marginem. Corolla (masculina) ca. 5 mm longa; tubus lobos aequans; (foeminea) ca. 4 mm longa; tubus ca. 1.5 mm longus; lobi ca. 2.5 mm longi, lobi quinque, ovati, apice obtusi, glabri. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 1.5 mm longa, glabra; antherae 1.5- 1.75	mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae; stamina nulla in flore foemineo. Staminodia quinque, (masculina) 1.5-1.75 mm longa, (foeminea) ca. 0.5 mm longa, lanceolata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideum vel conicum, quinque-lo-culare, dense pubescens; stylus post anthesin 1.5- 2.5	mm longus, supra glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus 4.5-6 cm longus, globosus, apice et basi rotundatus, in sicco valde rugosus, indumento residuali crispato puberulo. Semina quinque, ca. 3 cm longa, segmenti aurantii instar, testa laevis, pericarpio adherens, 0.3-0.5 mm crassa; cicatrix adaxialis per totam longitudinem extensa, ca. 3.5 mm lata; embryo cotyledonibus plano-convexis, coalitis, radicula ad superficiem extensa; albumen nullum.

description: Tree; young shoots pubescent at first with pale, matted, scurfy easily removed hair, soon glabrous, greyish, rough and cracked, lenticellate. Leaves spaced or loosely clustered, spirally arranged, 11.8-23 × 3.6-7 cm, oblanceolate or oblong-oblanceolate, apex narrowly acuminate or attenuate, base acute to rounded, chartaceous, glabrous or with some residual matted indumentum on the undersurface midrib; venation eucamptodromous, marginal vein present, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 12-15 pairs, slightly convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries short or absent; tertiaries oblique to reticulate, conspicuous on the lower surface. Petiole 0.8-2.5 cm long, not channelled, pubescent to glabrous. Fascicles 1-3-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel 0-1 mm long, pubescent. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals five, (male) 4-5 mm long, (female) ca. 3 mm long, lanceolate to elliptic, apex acute to rounded, densely matted pubescent outside, glabrous inside except for some pubescence near the margin. Corolla (male) ca. 5 mm long, tube equalling the lobes, (female) ca. 4 mm long, tube ca. 1.5 mm long, lobes ca. 2.5 mm long; lobes 5, ovate, apex obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.5-1.75 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous; stamens absent in female. Staminodes five, (male) 1.5-1.75 mm long, (female) ca. 0.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid or conical, five-locular, densely pubescent; style 1.5-2.5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous above; style-head simple. Fruit 4.5-6 cm long, globose, apex and base rounded, strongly wrinkled on drying, with residual crisped puberulous indumentum. Seeds five, ca. 3 cm long, shaped like the segments of an orange, testa smooth, adhering to the pericarp, 0.3-0.5 mm thick; scar adaxial, full-length, ca. 3.5 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, fused cotyledons, radicle extending to the surface; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 25 cm diam. with plank buttresses to 0.5 m high. Bark slightly fissured or flaking, dark brown; slash cream with reddish striations, laminated. Slash with or without sticky white exudate. Flowers white, ripe fruit yellow-orange. Flowering Apr to Jun, fruiting records May to Jun.

description: Arbor:; ramuli novelli parce adpresse puberuli, mox glabri, atrocinerascentes usque atrobrunnei, laeves, saepe lenticellate Folia dissita, spiraliter disposita, 5.7-8.8 × 2.3-4.3 cm, elliptica, apice acuta usque obtusa, basi acuta usque breviter et anguste attenuata, margine leviter revoluta, tenuiter coriacea, glabra, pagina inferiore glauca; venatio eucamptodroma; costa plana vel supra prominula; nervi secundarii 7-10-jugi, paralleli vel leviter convergentes, leviter arcuati, supra haud vel paullum impressi; nervi intersecundarii modice evoluti; nervi tertiarii pauci, reticulati; venatio Superioris ordinis subtilior supra conspicua, subtus obscura. Petiolus 3-6 mm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 3-12-flori, axillares. Pedicellus 5-6 mm longus, parce pub-erulus. Flores unisexuales (planta dioica). Sepala quinque, ca. 2 mm longa, infra coalita, lanceolata usque oblonga, apice acuta vel obtusa, extus adpresse pubescentia, intus parce pubescentia, ciliata. Corolla cyathiformis, ca. 2.5 mm longa; tubus 1-1.5 mm longus; lobi quinque, 1.25-1.5 mm longi, tubum aequentes vel excedentes, elliptica, apice rotundati, ad basim auriculati, glabri. Stamina quinque, ad apicem tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 0.3 mm longa, glabra; an-therae ca. 0.8 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae; stamina nulla in flore foeminea. Staminodia (4-)5, 0.3-0.5 mm longa, lanceolata, glabra, in flore foeminea vestigialia. Discus nullus. Ovarium an-guste ovoideum, biloculare, pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 1 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum truncatum. Fructus ignotus.

description: Tree; young shoots sparsely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, dark greyish to blackish-brown, smooth, usually lenticellate. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged 5.7-8.8 × 2.3-4.3 cm, elliptic, apex acute to obtuse, base acute to shortly narrowly attenuate, margin slightly revolute, thinly coriaceous, glabrous, lower surface glaucous; venation eucamptodromous, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 7-10 pairs, parallel or slightly convergent, slightly arcuate, not or only slightly impressed on upper surface; intersecondaries moderate to long; tertiaries few, reticulate; finer higher order reticulum conspicuous on upper surface, obscure below. Petiole 3-6 mm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 3-12-flowered, axillary. Pedicel 5-6 mm long, sparsely puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals five, ca. 2 mm long, fused below, lanceolate to oblong, apex acute or obtuse, appressed pubescent outside, sparser inside, ciliate. Corolla cyathiform, ca. 2.5 mm long, tube 1-1.5 mm long, lobes five, 1.25-1.5 mm long, equalling or exceeding the tube, elliptic, apex rounded, auriculate at base, glabrous. Stamens five, fixed at the top of the corolla tube; filaments ca. 0.3 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.8 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous; stamens absent in female. Staminodes (4)-5, 0.3-0.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous, vestigial in female. Disk absent. Ovary narrowly ovoid, bilocular, pubescent; style ca. 1 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head truncate. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree to 12 m high, flowering in Oct.

description: Arbuscula; ramuli novelli minute et adpresse puberuli, mox glabri, pallide brunnei, tenuiter squamati, elenticellati. Folia congesta, spiraliter disposita, 10.5-14.5 × 2.8-3.7 cm, anguste oblanceolata, apice anguste attenuata, basi longe decrescentia, anguste attenuata, chartacea usque tenuiter coriacea, supra glabra, infra pellicula tenui argentea vestita; venatio eucamptodroma; costa supra elevata; nervi secundarii 8-13-jugi, valde ascendentes, convergentes, arcuati; nervi intersecondarii nulli; nervi tertiarii horizontales. Petiolus 2-5 mm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 1-2-flori, axillares vel sub foliis dispositi. Pedicellus ca. 1 mm longus, pilis sparsis minutis adpressis vestitus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quatuor, ca. 4 mm longa, anguste lanceolata, apice acuta, leviter cucullata, extus parce et minute hirsuta, intus glabra. Corolla anguste cylindrica, ca. 5.5 mm longa, tubus ca. 3.5 mm longus, lobi quatuor, ca. 2 mm longi, oblanceolata apice rotundati, leviter ciliati. Stamina quatuor, medio tubo corollae affixa; filamenta ca. 2 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1.25 mm longae, lanceolatae, apiculatae, glabrae. Staminodia quatuor, ca. 1.5 mm longa, anguste oblonga, apice rotundata, ciliata. Discus nullus. Ovarium globosum, quadriloculare, dense et longe strigosum; stylus post anthesin ca. 3.5 mm longus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ignotus.

description: Treelet; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, pale brown, thinly scaling, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 10.5-17.5 × 2.8-3.7 cm, narrowly oblanceolate, apex narrowly attenuate, base long tapering, narrowly attenuate, chartaceous to thinly coriaceous, glabrous above, with a silvery pellicle below, venation eucamptodromous, midrib raised on the upper surface, secondary veins 8-13 pairs, steeply ascending, convergent, arcuate; intersecondaries absent; tertiaries horizontal. Petiole 2-5 mm long, not channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 1-2-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel ca. 1 mm long, with sparse minute appressed hairs. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals four, ca. 4 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, apex acute, slightly hooded, sparsely minutely hairy outside, glabrous inside. Corolla narrowly cylindrical, ca. 5.5. mm long, tube ca. 3.5 mm long, lobes four, ca. 2 mm long, oblanceolate, apex rounded, slightly ciliate. Stamens four, fixed about halfway up the corolla tube; filaments ca. 2 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.25 mm long, lanceolate, apiculate, glabrous. Staminodes four, ca. 1.5 mm long, narrowly oblong, apex rounded, ciliate. Disk absent. Ovary globose, four-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 3.5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Treelet 2 m high with greenish white flowers, flowering in Oct.

description: Imperfectly Known Species of Podoluma: Tree; young shoots glabrous, becoming pale whitish-grey, smooth, without lenticels. Leaves clustered, spirally arranged, 1.2-3.5 × 0.9-2 cm, broadly elliptic to obovate, apex obtuse, rounded or slightly emarginate, base obtuse to rounded, margin slightly revolute, coriaceous, glabrous; venation obscure, brochidodromous, midrib slightly raised on upper surface (at least in lower half of leaf), marginal vein strongly thickened, submarginal vein present, secondary veins 4-6 pairs, ascending, straight, mostly parallel; higher order venation obscure. Petiole 1-2 mm long, not channelled, laterally flattened, glabrous. Fascicles 1-2-flowered, axillary and below the leaves. Pedicel (in young fruit) 1-2 mm long, glabrous. Sepals five, 1.5-2 mm long, ovate or broadly elliptic, apex obtuse to rounded, slightly ciliate. Corolla, stamens, ovary not seen. Fruit 0.8-1.1 cm long, broadly ellipsoid or globose, apex rounded, apiculate, base rounded or obtuse, smooth, glabrous. Seeds 1-2, 6-8 mm long, ellipsoid, apex rounded, base obtuse, testa smooth, shining, with two prominent lateral lines (of dehiscence), sometimes with a small beak above apex of scar; scar adaxial, extending from the base to about 3/4 up the seed, ca. 1.5 mm wide; embryo with plano-convex, free cotyledons, radicle slightly exserted; endosperm absent. Field characters. Tree 4-5 m high with milky latex; fruit maturing red, collected in Feb.

description: Tree; young shoots densely velutinous-hirsute, with erect brown hairs, indumentum persistent, eventually glabrous, greyish, finely fissured, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous, 18-24.3 × 6.1-10 cm, broadly oblong, apex obtusely short-cuspidate, base acute to obtuse, coriaceous, glabrous above, pubescent below with a mixture of short appressed hairs and longer erect hairs, venation brochidodromous, with a marginal vein, submarginal vein present, midrib sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 30-45 pairs, widely spreading, parallel, straight, prominent on the lower surface; intersecondaries extending to the margin; tertiaries reticulate. Petiole 0.7-1.2 cm long, not channelled, densely velutinous-hirsute. Fascicles axillary, 5-10-flowered at first, developing into dense, many-flowered clusters on short scaly brachyblasts 0.5-1 cm long. Pedicel ca. 1 mm long, very stout and tapering from the calyx base. Flowers unisexual (?). Sepals five, 3-3.5 mm long, elliptic, apex obtuse, densely velutinous-pubescent outside, appressed puberulous in the upper half inside. Corolla ca. 4.5 mm long, tube ca. 3 mm long, shortly tubular, lobes 4-5, ca. 1.5 mm long, oblong-ovate, margin truncate, glabrous. Stamens 4-5, included; filaments ca. 0.4 mm long, strongly curved outwards, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.6 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes 4-5, ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate-subulate to ovate, glabrous. Disk absent or represented by a small wing-liked annulus around the base of the ovary. Ovary ovoid, 4-5-locular, pubescent; style ca. 2 mm long after anthesis, included, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit (immature), ca. 2 cm long, oblong-ellipsoid, apex rounded, base tapered, densely velutinous-hispid, smooth. Seed solitary, ca. 1.1 cm long, laterally compressed, smooth, shiny; scar narrow, adaxial, extending the full length of the seed. Field characters. Tree to 15 m high and 20 cm diam. with horizontally spreading branches. Cut bark exudes white sap. Flowers sweet-scented, greenish, fruit with dense brown indumentum. Flowering Jul to Nov, young fruit collected Oct and Nov.

description: Tree; young shoots brown-tomentose, indumentum soon falling, becoming greyish or brown, scaly, usually without lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous, 8-21.5 × 3.5-5.9 cm, oblong, oblong-elliptic or elliptic, apex narrowly attenuate or obtusely cuspidate, base narrowly attenuate or acute, thinly coriaceous, glabrous or with residual tomentum along the undersurface midrib, venation brochidodromous or craspedodromous, with a strong marginal vein, submarginal vein present or absent, very close to the margin, midrib sunken on the upper surface, leaves finely and minutely striate, the secondaries indistinguishable from intersecondaries and tertiaries, venation spreading at a wide angle (almost at right angles to the midrib). Petiole 0.4-1.2 cm long, channelled, tomentose at first. Fascicles 1-5-flowered, axillary, and in the axils of fallen leaves, and densely clustered on large knarled protuberances several cm diam. on trunk. Pedicel 2-5 mm long, shortly tomentose. Rowers unisexual (plant monoecious). Sepals (four-)five, 1.5-2.5 mm long, ovate, apex acute or obtuse, pubescent outside, glabrous inside. Corolla tubular, 2.5-3 mm long (female), 4-4.5 mm long (male), tube 1.7-2 mm long (female), 3-3.5 mm long (male), lobes (four-)five, 0.8-1.25 mm long, triangular or ovate-oblong, apex acute to rounded, glabrous. Stamens (four-)five, included, fixed near the top of the corolla tube but filament traces often visible to near the base; filaments 0.3-0.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.50.6 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous; stamens absent in the female flowers. Staminodes (four-)five, 0.5-0.75 mm long, narrowly lanceolate to subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, five-locular, densely pubescent, style 1-2 mm long after anthesis; included or slightly exserted, glabrous or pubescent below; style-head simple or minutely lobed. Fruit 1.3-2 cm long, ellipsoid to globose, apex acute to rounded, apiculate, base acute to rounded, longitudinally five-sulcate, glabrous. Seed solitary, 1.3-1.5 cm long, laterally compressed, testa finely transversely wrinkled, shining, ca. 0.3 mm thick; scar adaxial, ca. 2 mm wide. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 12 cm diam, with cylindrical bole. Cut bark exudes a small amount of white latex. According to Ducke (1950b: 20), the inflorescences are so dense that they cover two-thirds of the surface of the trunk. Rowers green, fruit maturing dark blue or purple. Flowering Nov to Jan, fruiting Dec to Jul. Local names. Abiurana (Brazil: Amazonas). Relationships. This species was confused with Af. egensis (as Af. ulei) by Baehni & Bernardi in the Hora of Peru (1970: 167). The two species share a similar venation, though that of Af. trunciflora spreads at a wider angle to the midrib. Other differences are the evanescent tomentum of the young parts (appressed puberulous in Af. egensis); the distinctly sunken midrib (flat or raised in Af. egensis), the cauliflorous habit, the generally smaller, glabrous corolla (frequently appressed hairy outside in Af. egensis), the sulcate fruit (smooth in Af. egensis), and seed with shining testa (dull, matt testa in Af. egensis).

description: Shrub or small tree; young shoots persistently appressed ferruginous puberulous, eventually becoming glabrous, blackish-brown, fissured, with a few large lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 2-8 × 1.9-6.3 cm, suborbicular, broadly ovate or elliptic, apex obtuse, rounded or emarginate, base obtuse, rounded or rarely acute, strongly coriaceous, sericeous at first on both surfaces, soon glabrous above, persistently ferruginous-sericeous below, indumentum becoming paler and thinner with age, venation brochidodromous, sometimes with a marginal vein, submarginal vein present, very close to the margin, midrib flat or slightly sunken on the upper surface, secondary veins 10-20 pairs, parallel, straight; intersecondaries long, often extending to the margin; higher order venation finely reticulate-areolate, usually obscured by the indumentum on the lower surface. Petiole 0.2-1.3 cm long, slightly channelled, appressed ferruginous-puberulous. Fascicles 1-3-flowered axillary, rarely persisting and developing into short scaly shoots 2-3 mm long. Pedicel 1-3 mm long, appressed, puberulous. Flowers unisexual (?). Sepals five, ca. 2.5 mm long, ovate, apex acute or obtuse, appressed puberulous on both surfaces. Corolla 2-2.5 mm long, shortly tubular; tube slightly exceeding the lobes; lobes 4-5, broadly oblong, margin truncate, glabrous. Stamens 4-5, included; filaments ca. 0.25 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.4 mm long, ovoid, glabrous. Staminodes 4-5, 0.4-0.5 mm long, subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary globose, five-locular, pubescent; style ca. 0.75 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head single or minutely lobed. Immature fruit ca. 9 mm long, obovoid, apiculate, sparsely pubescent. Field characters. Shrub or small tree to 15 m high, with latex. The leaves are characteristically reddish or ferruginous below. Flowers cream, from Jan to May.

description: Tree, young shoots minutely appressed puberulous with rufous brown hairs, becoming glabrous, greyish-brown, minutely cracked, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 13.6-23.2 × 7.3-9 cm, broadly elliptic-oblong or oblanceolate, apex obtusely cuspidate or obtuse, base obtuse to acute, margin slightly revolute, thickly coriaceous, glabrous above, minutely and densely rufous-brown appressed puberulous below, venation craspedodromous, midrib slightly prominent on the upper surface, but sometimes slightly recessed, marginal vein present, secondary and higher order venation finely striate, ascending, slightly arcuate. Petiole 1.7-3 cm long, channelled, appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles 5-10-flowered, ramiflorous. Pedicel 1-1.7 cm long, minutely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals six, 7-8 mm long, broadly oblong, apex rounded, minutely appressed puberulous on both surfaces, margin ciliate. Corolla ca. 1.7 cm long, cylindrical, tube ca. 1.3 cm long, lobes five, ca. 0.4 cm long, lanceolate, acute, reflexed, glabrous. Stamens five, exserted; filaments ca. 5 mm long, geniculate at apex, glabrous; anthers 1.6-1.8 mm long, lanceolate-sagittate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 2.5 mm long, narrowly lanceolate-subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary shortly, broadly ovoid, five-locular, pubescent; style ca. 5 mm long after anthesis, appressed puberulous; style-head lobed. Fruit 3-3.7 cm long, ellipsoid, apex narrowly rostrate, base acute, smooth, subglabrous. Seed solitary, ca. 2.2 cm long, laterally compressed, testa smooth, shining, 0.2-0.3 mm thick; scar adaxial, ca. 8 mm wide, extending the whole length of the seed. Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 50 cm diam., larger specimens buttressed. Latex white or yellowish. Leaf undersurface persistently and conspicuously shining-rufous-brown. Flowers white, fruit glaucous-green, with fugacious rufous hairs when young. Flower Dec to Jan and Jul, fruit maturing Mar.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli adpresse puberuli, pilis rufo-brunneis, mox glabri, cinereo-brunnei, parvis frustis desquamati, elenticellati. Folia dissita, altemantia et disticha, 6.7-13 × 3.5-5.3 cm, elliptica vel oblanceolata, apice anguste acuminata, basi acuta vel anguste cuneata, coriacea, glabra vel costa paginae inferioris indumento adpresso residuo; venatio brochidodroma; nervus marginalis validus; costa pagina superiore plana; nervus submarginalis infirmus; venatio secundaria et Superioris ordinis obscura, subtiliter striata, adscendens, leviter arcuata. Petiolus 0.7-1.1 cm longus, canaliculata, adpresse puberulus usque glaber. Fasciculi 5-15-flori, axillis foliorum delapsorum enati. Pedicellus 5-7 mm longus, glaber. Florasbisexuales (?). Sepala quinque, 2.5-3 mm longa, late ovata usque suborbicularia, extra adpresse puberula usque subglabra, intra adpresse puberula. Corolla ca. 4 mm longa, breviter tubularis; lobos aequans tubus, lobi quinque, oblongi, apice rotundati, reflexi, glabri. Stamina quinque, exserta; filamenta 1.5-3 mm longa, apice geniculata, glabra, antherae ca. 1 mm longae, lanceolato-oblangae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, ca. 1.5 mm longa, subulata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium globosum, 5-loculare, pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 1.5 mm longus, longitudine costatus, glaber; styli capitulum minute lobatum. Fructus 2-3 cm longus, late ellipsoidea, apice rotundatus, apiculatus, basi ob-tusus, laevis glaber. Semen solitarium, ca. 1.8 cm longum, lateraliter compressum, carina abaxiali apice et basi obtusum vel rotundatum, testa laevis, nitida, 0.3-0.5 mm crassa; cicatrix adaxialis, per totam longitudinem extensa, 4-5 mm lata.

description: Tree; young shoots appressed puberulous with reddish-brown hairs, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, scaling in small, thin pieces, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous, 6.7-13 × 3.5-5.3 cm, elliptic or oblanceolate, apex narrowly acuminate, base acute or narrowly cuneate, coriaceous, glabrous or with some residual appressed indumentum along the lower midrib, venation brochidodromous, marginal vein strong, midrib flat on the upper surface, submarginal vein weak, secondary and higher order venation obscure, finely striate, ascending, slightly arcuate. Petiole 0.7-1.1 cm long, channelled, appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles in the axils of fallen leaves, 5-15-flowered. Pedicel 5-7 mm long, glabrous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 2.5-3 mm long, broadly ovate to suborbicular, appressed puberulous to subglabrous outside, appressed puberulous inside. Corolla ca. 4 mm long, shortly tubular, tube equalling the lobes, lobes five, oblong, apex rounded, reflexed, glabrous. Stamens five, exserted; filaments 1.5-3 mm long, geniculate at apex, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, lanceolate-oblong, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 1.5 mm long, subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary globose, five-locular, pubescent; style ca. 1.5 mm long after anthesis, longitudinally ribbed, glabrous; style-head minutely lobed. Fruit 2-3 cm long, broadly ellipsoid, apex rounded, apiculate, base obtuse, smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary, ca. 1.8 cm long, laterally compressed, with abaxial keel, obtuse or rounded at apex and base, testa smooth, shining, 0.3-0.5 mm thick, scar adaxial, full-length, 4.5 mm wide. Field characters. Tree to 35 m high and 85 cm diam. with large thin convex buttresses to 1.5 m high, bole cylindrical or slightly fluted near base. Bark dark or reddish-brown, shaggy, coarsely scaling in large irregular plates. Slash brown or yellow with brown streaks, with slow exudation of white or cream latex. Branches steeply ascending, forming a compact crown. Flowers greenish-white or pale yellow, scented, fruit yellowish. Flowering Aug to Nov, fruit Mar to Apr.

description: Plants small, usually only to 1.5 cm high, rarely 2 cm, in soft, light green or brownish green tufts. Stems radiculose below, erect, the lower stem leaves smaller, the upper stem leaves longer pointed, pencil-like. Leaves 4-5 mm long, narrow lanceolate, from ovate base contracted into a long, fine point. Costa long-excurrent, finely serrate at tips, filling 1/2 of the leaf base, in transverse section with ventral hyalocysts, slightly ridged at back. Alar cells lacking. Basal laminal cells short rectangular, hyaline, ca. 3-4:1, 6-16 × 13-38 µm. Upper laminal cells rectangular, ca. 3-4:1, 3-10 × 10-16 µm. Lamina vanishing below midleaf. Sporophyte found only once (Laegaard 52906). Seta to 1 cm long, yellowish. Capsule 1.5 mm long, erect, symmetric, olive-brown, furrowed. Operculum obliquely rostrate, 0.5 mm long, reddish. Calyptra fimbriate at base.

description: Plants yellowish green, erect, in tufts. Stems 8-15 mm high, radiculose below, equally foliate, erecto-patent when wet, appressed foliate when dry, sometimes with flagelliferous branches in the axils of the upper leaves. Leaves 3.5-5 mm long, lanceolate, from ovate base gradually narrowed into a long acumen, entire at margins except for few teeth at the leaf tip. Perichaetial leaves suddenly contracted from a broadly ovate base. Costa filling 1/3-2/5 of the leaf base, 175-200 µm wide, excurrent, in transverse section with ventral and dorsal hyalocysts, a median band of stereids and 2-3 ventral stereids. Alar cells weakly differentiated. Basal laminal cells in 15-18 rows, hyaline, thin-walled, rectangular, 45-95 × 4-20 µm, narrower at margins. Upper laminal cells elongate, 74-140 × 4-7.5 µm. Seta erect, 8-19 mm high, sinistrorsely twisted in the upper part. Capsule (without operculum) long-cylindric, 0.4 × 2.5-3 mm, yellowish green or brownish in age. Exothecial cells incrassate, rectangular. Stomata lacking. Operculum longly rostrate, reddish brown, 1-1.2 mm long. Annulus present. Peristome teeth divided nearly to the base, yellowish brown, lighter at tips, striate at base and papillose at tips, about 290 µm long. Spores yellowish green, 11-13 µm. Calyptra cucullate.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, pale greyish-brown, cracked and scaly, lenticels present or absent. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous, 7-17 × 2-5.2 cm, oblong or elliptic, apex obtuse, acute or shortly narrowly attenuate, base acute or narrowly cuneate, thinly coriaceous, glabrous, venation craspedodromous or brochidodromous, marginal vein present, submarginal vein present, very close to or fusing with the marginal vein, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary, intersecondary and tertiary veins indistinguishable from one another, finely ascending-striate. Petiole 0.8-1.5 cm long, channelled, appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles 5-15-flowered, axillary or in the axils of fallen leaves. Pedicel 2-6 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant monoecious (?)). Sepals five, 2-3 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse, appressed puberulous outside, scattered appressed hairs or glabrous inside, often ciliate. Corolla 2.5-3.5 mm long, tube 1.5-2 mm long, lobes (four-)five, 1-1.5 mm long, ovate to broadly oblong, apex truncate, glabrous. Stamens (4-)5, included; filaments 0.75-1 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.4-0.7 mm long, lanceolate to ovate, glabrous; stamens reduced to small vestiges on female flowers. Staminodes (four-)five, 0.75-1.25 mm long, narrowly oblong, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, five-locular, pubescent; style 2-3 mm long after anthesis, exserted, glabrous; style-head simple or minutely lobed. Fruit 4-7 cm long, broadly ellipsoid, apex and base, acute or obtuse, smooth, glabrous. Seed 1-several, 2.5-2.6 cm long, laterally compressed, testa smooth, shining, ca. 0.5 mm thick; scar adaxial, 4-6 mm wide. Field characters. Tree to 40 m high and 1.5 m diam., with thick buttresses to 2 m high, and columnar trunk. Bark smooth to finely fissured, greyish-brown, slash thick, cream-brown, to reddish, exuding sticky white or cream latex. Flowers scented, greenish-white or cream, fruit yellow, orange, reddish or purple, sometimes slightly sulcate. Flowering and fruiting throughout the year. The fruit is reported to be eaten by macaws (Peru: Foster & Terborgh 5110).

description: Slender tree; young shoots ferruginous-tomentose, indumentum soon falling, becoming smooth, greyish-white, without lenticels. Leaves spaced and distichous, 10.5-16 × 3.5-6.2 cm, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, apex narrowly acuminate, base acute to rounded, coriaceous, glabrous above, with arachnoid ferruginous tomentum briefly present on the lower surface, soon glabrous, venation brochidodromous, with a marginal vein, midrib prominent on the upper surface, submarginal vein present, secondary and higher order venation obscurely and finely striate, ascending. Petiole 1-1.7 cm long, channelled, tomentose to glabrous. Ramiflorous fascicles 5-12-flowered. Pedicel 5-10 mm long, shortly ferruginous-tomentose. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 0.9-1 cm long, broadly elliptic, apex obtuse or rounded, shortly ferruginous tomentose on both surfaces. Corolla ca. 2.3 cm long, cylindrical, tube ca. 1.8 cm long, lobes five, ca. 5 mm long, narrowly triangular, apex obtuse, reflexed, glabrous. Stamens five, exserted; filaments 0.81 cm long, geniculate at apex, glabrous; anthers 2-2.2 mm long, ovate-lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 5 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, glabrous. Disk annular, pubescent. Ovary slender, tapering gradually to the thick style, five-locular, densely pubescent; style 6-7 mm long after anthesis, pubescent; style-head simple. Fruit (immature) ca. 2 cm long, ovoid, apex rostrate, base rounded, smooth, rufous-brown pubescent. Seed not seen. Field characters. Slender tree to 25 m high and 30 cm diam. with narrow buttresses to 1 m high. The bark contains white milky latex. The ferruginous tomentum on the lower surface of young leaves is sometimes conspicuous in the field. The flowers are white and fragrant. Flowering Nov to Mar, young fruit collected in Apr.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, grey-brown, smooth or slightly scaly, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous, 5.5-13 × 2-5.5 cm, broadly elliptic, apex narrowly acuminate to caudate, base narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous, venation brochidodromous, marginal vein present, submarginal vein very close to the marginal and tending to merge with it, midrib slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary and higher order veins appearing finely striate, but with a lens the parallel intersecondaries and tertiaries can usually be distinguished from the slightly stronger secondaries. Petiole 2-4 mm long, slightly channelled, subglabrous. Fascicles 1-5-flowered, axillary. Pedicel 0.5-2.5 cm long, sparsely short-pubescent. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious (?)). Sepals five, 2.5-4 mm long, broadly ovate to suborbicular, apex obtuse to rounded, sparsely appressed hairy outside, glabrous inside, ciliate. Corolla ca. 5 mm long, tube ca. 3 mm long, lobes five, ca. 2 mm long, oblong-ovate, apex rounded, appressed puberulous outside, especially on the tube. Stamens five, included; filaments ca. 1.25 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1 mm long, broad, rounded-sagittate, glabrous; stamens in female flowers reduced to small vestiges. Staminodes five, ca. 1.75 mm long, petaloid, broadly elliptic, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary narrowly ovoid or columnar, 3-5-locular, strigose in the lower half; style ca. 3 mm long after anthesis, exserted in bud and open flower, glabrous; style-head minutely lobed. Fruit 2.1-3.5 cm long, borne on a pedicel up to 4 cm long, ellipsoid, apex acute, base rounded or acute, smooth, glabrous. Seeds one-several, ca. 2.2 cm long, laterally compressed, tapering to base and apex, testa smooth, shining; scar adaxial, ca. 2 mm wide. Field characters. Tree to 15 m high and 20 cm diam, without buttresses. Bark reddish-grey to dark brown, thinly scaling, slash orange-yellow, exuding a small amount of white latex. Flowers pale green, fruit maturing yellow. Flowering Jun to Aug, fruiting Oct to Mar.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous with brown hairs, soon glabrous, greyish-brown, scaling, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous, 20-24 × 9.8-11.4 cm, broadly oblong-elliptic, apex truncate or obtusely short cuspidate, base truncate, sometimes slightly decurrent on the petiole, thickly coriaceous, glabrous, venation brochidodromous, midrib flat on the upper surface, submarginal vein present, secondaries numerous (ca. 60 pairs), widely spreading, parallel, straight, not striate and clearly distinguished from the parallel higher order venation. Petiole 1.6-2.5 cm long, flat or only weakly channelled, glabrous. Fascicles 10-15-flowered, axillary and ramiflorous. Pedicel 1.2-1.3 cm long, minutely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, ca. 1 cm long, broadly elliptic, apex obtuse or rounded, subglabrous or finely appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Corolla 1.4-1.5 cm long, tubular, broadened at the apex, tube ca. 1 cm long, carnose above, lobes five, 0.4-0.5 cm long, ovate-lanceolate, apex obtuse, erect, glabrous. Stamens five, exserted; filaments ca. 5 mm long, carnose, not geniculate, glabrous; anthers 2.5-3 mm long, lanceolate-sagittate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 4 mm long, narrowly triangular, carnose, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary slender, five-locular, sparsely puberulous near the base; style 7-8 mm long after anthesis, strongly longitudinally ribbed, glabrous; style-head minutely lobed. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree 30 m high and 50 cm diam, with white latex. Flowers green, in Jan.

description: Tree; young shoots appressed puberulous with ferruginous hairs, becoming glabrous, greyish-brown, cracked, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged or alternate and distichous, 2.2-7.6 × 2-4.2 cm, orbicular, broadly ovate or elliptic, apex rounded or obtuse, base obtuse to truncate, thickly coriaceous, glabrous, venation brochidodromous, marginal and submarginal vein present, midrib flat or slightly raised on the upper surface, secondary veins shallowly ascending, striate; with a lens the parallel or slightly reticulate higher order venation can be distinguished. Petiole 0.4-1 cm long, slightly channelled, appressed puberulous to glabrous. Fascicles 1-2-flowered, axillary. Pedicel 2-5 mm long, appressed puberulous. Flowers unisexual (?). Sepals 5-6, ca. 3 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse, appressed puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Corolla ca. 3 mm long, subglobose, tube equalling or slightly exceeding the lobes, lobes five, broadly ovate, apex obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, included; filaments ca. 0.7 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.4 mm long, ovoid, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 1 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broad, flattened-ovoid, five-locular, densely long-strigose; style ca. 1 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit 4-4.5 cm long, ellipsoid, apex rostrate, base acute, smooth, glabrous. Seeds two-several, 1.5-2 cm long, laterally compressed, testa smooth, shining, 0.5-0.6 mm thick; scar adaxial, 2-3 mm wide. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 65 cm diam. Bark smooth, pale grey, slash reddish, streaked with cream-brown, exuding white latex. Flowers white or cream, flowering Jui, immature fruit Mar to Apr.

description: Frutex vel arbuscula; ramuli novelli minute et persistenter sericei, pilis rufo-ferrugineis, de-mum glabri, cinerascentes, subtiliter fissurati vel rimosi, elenticellati. Folia dissita, spiraliter dis-posita, 3-7 × 1.4-4.2 cm, obovata vel late oblanceolata, apice plerumque emarginata, raro rotundata, basi acuta, anguste cuneata vel attenuata, margine revoluta, crasse coriacea, supra glabra, infra dense et persistenter sericea pilis rufo-ferrugineis demum albescentibus; venatio craspedodroma; nervus marginalis praesens; costa supra impressa; venatio secundaria supra visibilis in forma indistinctarum spissarum subtilium striationum angulo acutiusculo ascendentium, subtus indumento obscurata. Petiolus 4-8 mm longus, canaliculata, sericeus usque glaber. Fasciculi 2-8-flori, axillares, interdum brachyblastis brevibus squamatis 1-2 mm longi tandem instructi. Pedicellus 2-4 mm longus, ferrugineopuberulus. Flores unisexuales (planta dioica). Sepala quinque, ca. 2 mm longa, lanceolata usque ovata, apice acuta usque rotundata, extus adpresse ferrugineo-puberula, intus parce adpresse puberula. Corolla ca. 2 mm longa, breviter tubu-laris; tubus ca. 1.5 mm longus; lobi quinque, ca. 0.5 mm longi, breviter oblongi, apice rotundati, glabri. Stamina non visa (in flore foemina ad quinque vestigia minuta reducta). Staminodia quinque, ca. 0.6 mm longa, late oblonga, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium ovoideum, 5-loculare, pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 1 mm longus, inclusus, glaber; styli capitulum simplex. Fructus ca. 1.3 cm longus, late ellipsoideus, apice et basi rotundatus, laevis, glaber. Semen solitarium, ca. 8.5 mm longum, lateraliter compressum, testa nitida, laeviter transversaliter rugosa, ca. 0.3 mm crassa, cicatrix adaxialis, secundum plerunque latus adaxiale extensa, 0.5-1 mm lata.

description: Shrub or small tree; young growth minutely and persistently sericeous with reddish-ferruginous hairs, eventually glabrous, greyish, finely fissured or cracked, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, spirally arranged, 3-7 × 1.4-4.2 cm, obovate or broadly oblanceolate, apex usually emarginate, rarely rounded, base acute, narrowly cuneate or attenuate, margin revolute, thickly coriaceous, glabrous above, densely and persistently sericeous below with reddish-ferruginous indumentum, the hairs becoming whitish with age, venation craspedodromous, marginal vein present, midrib sunken on the upper surface, secondary venation visible on the upper surface as faint rather steeply ascending close, fine striations, obscured by the indumentum on the lower surface. Petiole 4-8 mm long, channelled, sericeous to glabrous. Fascicles 2-8-flowered, axillary, occasionally developing short scaly brachyblasts 1-2 mm long. Pedicel 2-4 mm long, ferruginous puberulous. Flowers unisexual (plant dioecious). Sepals five, ca. 2 mm long, lanceolate to ovate, apex acute to rounded, appressed ferruginous-puberulous outside, scattered appressed-puberulous inside. Corolla ca. 2 mm long, shortly tubular; tube ca. 1.5 mm long; lobes five, ca. 0.5 mm long, shortly oblong, apex rounded, glabrous. Stamens not seen (reduced to five minute vestiges in female flower). Staminodes five, ca. 0.6 mm long, broadly oblong, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid, five-locular, pubescent; style ca. 1 mm long after anthesis, included, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit ca. 1.3 cm long, broadly ellipsoid, apex and base rounded, smooth, glabrous. Seed solitary, ca. 8.5 mm long, laterally compressed, testa shining, slightly transversely wrinkled, ca. 0.3 mm thick; scar adaxial, extending most of the length of the seed, 0.5-1 mm wide. Field characters. Shrub or small tree to 4 m high, with discolorous leaves with persistent brown indumentum on the lower surface. Flowers green. Flowering recorded throughout the year, a single collection of mature fruit in May.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots shortly pubescent with ferruginous hairs, becoming glabrous, greyish-white, scaly, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous, 9-15.5 × 3.5-5.2 cm, oblong, apex acute or narrowly attenuate, base acute, narrowly cuneate or obtuse, chartaceous or subcoriaceous, glabrous or with residual pubescence on the undersurface midrib, venation craspedodromous, marginal vein strong, submarginal vein fusing with the marginal vein, midrib sunken on the upper surface, venation finely striate with the intersecondaries and tertiaries indistinguishable from the secondaries. Petiole 0.9-1.5 cm long, channelled, shortly pubescent to glabrous. Fascicles 3-8-flowered, axillary or in the axils of fallen leaves. Pedicel 3-4 mm long, shortly golden-pubescent. Flowers bisexual ?. Sepals five, 3-4.5 mm long, suborbicular to ovate, apex acute to rounded, shortly pubescent outside, scattered appressed hairy inside. Corolla ca. 5.5 mm long, tube ca. 4 mm long, lobes five, ca. 1.5 mm long, ovate, rounded, glabrous or with scattered appressed hairs on the lobes outside. Stamens five, included; filaments 0.5-0.8 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.75-1 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, 1-1.25 mm long, narrowly lanceolate or subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary ovoid or triangular, five-locular, densely pubescent; style 1-2 mm long after anthesis, included, glabrous; style-head simple or slightly lobed. Fruit (immature) 0.8-0.5 cm, ellipsoid. Field characters. Tree to 20 m high and 50 cm diam. with white latex. Flowers greenish, in Oct, immature fruit in Apr.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli subtiliter adpresse puberuli (pilis aureo-brunneis), demum glabri, cinerascentes, scabri, rimosi, fissurati, elenticellati. Folia dissita, altemantia et disticha, 14-24 × 5.8-10 cm, elliptica vel oblanceolata, apice breviter et anguste attenuata usque obtuse cuspidata, basi anguste attenuata usque obtusa, margine subtiliter revoluta, crasse coriacea, supra glabra, infra indumento aureo parce et arcte subtiliter adpresso (indumento solum sub lente visibili) vel glabra; venatio brochidodroma; costa in dimidio inferiore leviter impressa, in dimidio superiore prominula; nervus submarginalis praesens; nervi secundarii numerosi, ascendentes, paralleli, leviter arcuati, folia quasi grosse striata oculo inermi; nervi intersecundarii ad nervum submarginalem producti; nervi tertiarii ad nervos secundarios paralleli. Petiolus 1-2 cm longus, anguste alatus (alae in sicco involutae), initio subtiliter adpresso-puberulus, mox glaber. Fasciculi multiflori, ramiflori. Pedicellus 1-1.3 cm longus, subtiliter adpresse puberulus. Sepala quinque, 4-5 mm longa, late ovata, apice obtusa usque ro-tunduta, in superficiebus ambobus adpresse puberula, interdum parce ciliato. Corolla cylindrica, 1-1.3 cm longa; tubus 0.7-1 cm longus; lobi quinque, 2-3 mm longi, lanceolati, apice rotundata reflexi, glabri. Stamina quinque, exserta; filamenta 4-6 mm longa, glabra; antherae ca. 1.25 mm longae, lanceolato-sagittatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, 1.5-2 mm longa, anguste lanceolata vel subulata, glabra. Discus nullus. Ovarium gracile, in stylum sensim decrescens, 5-loculare, breviter pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 3 mm longus, adpresse hirsitus; styli capit-ulum simplex. Fructus (maturus non visus, des-criptio ex Billet & Jadin 1231) 5 × 3 cm, ellipsoidea, apice acutus, laevis glaber. Semen (immaturum) ca. 1.8 cm longum, lateraliter valde compressum, apice rotundatum, basi acutum, testa laevis, nitida; cicatrix adaxialis, per totam longitudinem extensa, 2-2.5 mm lata; embryo non visus. Field characters. Tree to 31 m high and 50 cm diam., with steep simple buttresses to 1.5 m high, and usually with a cylindrical bole; bark rich brown, scaling in thin longitudinal-rectangular pieces, slash cream streaked with brown, with a small amount of sticky white or yellowish latex; crown dense, spreading; flowers with white corolla. Flowering Jun-Jul, fruit (mature?) Oct.

description: Tree; young shoots finely appressed puberulous (golden-brown hairs), becoming glabrous, greyish, rough, cracked, fissured, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous, 14-24 × 5.8-10 cm, elliptic or oblanceolate, apex shortly narrowly attenuate to obtusely cuspidate, base narrowly attenuate to obtuse, margin slightly revolute, thickly coriaceous, glabrous above, lower surface with sparse very fine (visible with a lens), closely appressed indumentum of golden hairs or glabrous; venation brochidodromous, midrib slightly sunken in lower half of leaf, slightly raised in upper half, submarginal vein present, secondary veins numerous, ascending, parallel, slightly arcuate, leaf appearing coarsely striate to the naked eye; intersecondaries extending to the submarginal vein; tertiaries parallel to the secondaries. Petiole 1-2 cm long, narrowly winged (wings infolded when dry), finely appressed puberulous at first, soon glabrous. Ramiflorous, fascicles many-flowered. Pedicel 1-1.3 cm long, finely appressed puberulous. Sepals five, 4-5 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse to rounded, appressed puberulous on both surfaces, sometime sparsely ciliate. Corolla cylindrical, 1-1.3 cm long, tube 0.7-1 cm long, lobes five, 2-3 mm long, lanceolate, apex rounded, reflexed, glabrous. Stamens five, exserted; filaments 4-6 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.25 mm long, lanceolate-sagittate, glabrous. Staminodes five, 1.5-2 mm long, narrowly lanceolate or subulate, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary slender, tapering gradually to style, five-locular, shortly pubescent; style ca. 3 mm long after anthesis, appressed hairy; style-head simple. Fruit (mature fruit not seen, description from Billiet & Jadin 1231) 5 × 3 cm, ellipsoid, apex acute, smooth, glabrous. Seed (immature) ca. 1.8 cm long, strongly laterally compressed, apex rounded, base acute, testa smooth, shining; scar adaxial, full-length, 2-2.5 mm broad; embryo not seen.

description: Arbor,; ramuli novelli adpresse puberuli, de-mum glabri, pallide cinereo-albi, leviter squa-mati, elenticellati. Folia dispersa, alterna vel laxe spiraliter disposita, 6.2-7.8 × 3.6-3.7 cm, elliptica, apice breviter caudata, basi anguste cuneata, coriacea, supra glabra, costa paginae inferioris pilis subtilibus adpressis sparsim vestita; venatio craspedodroma; nervus marginalis prominens, costa supeme elevata; nervi secundarii et venatio Superioris ordinis subtiliter striati, late adscen-dentes, arcuati. Petiolus 7-9 mm longus, canaliculata, adpresse puberulus. Ramiflori fasciculi 5-12-flori. Pedicellus 1.5-1.6 cm longus, sub calyx expansus, subtiliter puberulus. Flores bisexuales (?). Sepala quinque, 7-8 mm longa, ovata, apice rotundata vel obtusa, intus subtiliter puberula. Corolla ca. 1.8 cm longa, cylindrica; tubus ca. 1.4 cm longus, lobi quinque, ca. 0.4 cm longi, oblongo-lanceolati, apice acuti, reflexi, glabri. Stamina quinque, exserta, filamenta ca. 8 mm longa, in alabastro ? geniculata, glabra, antherae ca. 2 mm longae, oblongo-lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia 5, ca. 3 mm longa, lanceolato-subulata, glabra. Discus sub ovario annularis, planus, dense pubescens. Ovarium conicum, supra sensim decrescens, quinqueloculare, dense pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 5 mm longus, in dimidio inferiore pubescens; styli capitulum minute lobatum. Fructus ignotus.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young shoots appressed puberulous, becoming glabrous, pale greyish-white, slightly scaly, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate or in lax spirals, 6.2-7.8 × 3.6-3.7 cm, elliptic, apex shortly caudate, base narrowly cuneate, coriaceous, glabrous above, sparse fine appressed hairs on the midrib below, venation craspedodromous, with a prominent marginal vein, midrib raised on the upper surface, secondary and higher order venation finely striate, shallowly ascending, arcuate. Petiole 7-9 mm long, channelled, appressed puberulous. Ramiflorous, fascicles 5-12-flowered. Pedicel 1.5-1.6 cm long, expanded below the calyx, finely puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 7-8 mm long, ovate, apex rounded or obtuse, finely puberulous inside. Corolla ca. 1.8 cm long, cylindrical; tube ca. 1.4 cm long, lobes five, ca. 0.4 cm long, oblong-lanceolate, apex acute, reflexed, glabrous. Stamens five, exserted; filaments ca. 8 mm long, ? geniculate in bud, glabrous; anthers ca. 2 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, ca. 3 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, glabrous. Disk a densely pubescent flat annulus below the ovary. Ovary conical, tapering gradually above, five-locular, densely pubescent; style ca. 5 mm long after anthesis, pubescent in lower half; style-head minutely lobed. Fruit unknown. Field characters. Tree 25 m high and 25 cm diam. with white latex. Flowers collected Oct.

description: Tree; young shoots minutely appressed puberulous, soon glabrous, grey-brown, rough, fissured and scaling, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, alternate and distichous, 7-12.2 × 3.2-5.6 cm, elliptic, apex obtusely acuminate, base rounded or obtuse, thinly coriaceous, glabrous, venation brochidodromous, marginal vein weak or absent, submarginal vein present, very close to the leaf margin, midrib flat, secondary veins numerous, slightly ascending, the parallel intersecondaries and tertiaries visible with a lens, the leaf appearing striate. Petiole 0.5-1.2 cm long, flat or only slightly channelled, glabrous. Fascicles in the axils of fallen leaves, ca. 10-flowered. Pedicel 0.8-1.4 cm long, finely appressed puberulous. Flowers bisexual (?). Sepals five, 2-2.5 mm long, broadly ovate, apex obtuse, slightly swollen at base and calyx abruptly contracted into pedicel, sparsely appressed puberulous on both surfaces. Corolla ca. 3 mm long; tube ca. 2 mm long; lobes five, ca. 1 mm long, ovate, apex obtuse, glabrous. Stamens five, included; filaments ca. 1 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 0.75 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, 0.75-1 mm long, narrowly lanceolate or triangular, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary flattened or slightly winged at base, five-locular, puberulous; style ca. 1 mm long after anthesis; tapering gradually from the ovary, included, glabrous; style-head simple. Fruit smooth, ca. 1.5 × 1 cm (not seen). Field characters. Tree to 30 m high and 90 cm diam., buttressed, the bark almost smooth, but flaking off in small vertical scales. The exudate is described as milky-tan (B. & S. Nelson 427). Flowers cream or greenish-white, fruit maturing yellow to reddish-black. Flowering Oct to Dec, fruiting Mar to Jun.

description: Arbor; ramuli novelli primum parce adpresso-puberuli (pilis aureobrunneis), mox glabri, tenues, brunnei, scabri, elenticellati. Folia dissita, plerumque altemantia et disticha, 4.8-8 × 1.9-3.8 cm (in ramulis sterilibus juvenilibus usque 10 cm longa), late elliptica, apice obtusa et denique longe-caudata, basi late usque anguste attenuata, chartacea, glabra vel interdum pagina inferiore in juventute pilis valde arete adpressis pallidis; venatio brochidodroma; costa pagina superiore recessa; nervus submarginalis praesens; nervi secundarii 12-16-jugi, paralleli, arcuati; nervi intersecundarii praesentes, plerumque longi et paullum minus prominentes quam nervi secundarii, nervi tertiarii prominentes, reticulati. Petiolus 0.5-1 cm longus, canaliculata, subtiliter adpresso-puberulus. Fasciculi 1-5-flori, plerumque axillares. Pedicellus 8-9 mm longus (in fructu usque 2 cm longus), subtiliter sericeus. Sepala quinque, ca. 2.5 mm longa, elliptica vel ovata, apice acuta vel obtusa, superficiebus ambobus subtiliter adpresse puberula. Corolla late tubularis, ca. 3 mm longa; tubus ca. 2 mm longus; lobi quinque, ca. 1 mm longi, late oblongi vel leviter decrescentes, apice truncati; corolla glabra. Stamina quinque, inclusa; filamenta ca. 0.75 mm longa, glabra; antherae 0.4-0.5 mm longae, lanceolatae, glabrae. Staminodia quinque, lobos corollae aequantes vel leviter super-antes, anguste oblonga, glabra. Discus deest. Ovarium latum, truncatum, quinqueloculare, pubescens; stylus post anthesin ca. 2 mm longus, glaber. Fructus 2-2.2 cm longus, ellipsoideus, apice et basi obtusus, parce et minute sericeus. Semen solitarium, ca. 1.4 cm longum, lateraliter compressum, apice rotundatum, basi acutum; testa laevis, nitida; cicatrix adaxialis, per totam longitudinem extensa, ca. 1.5 mm lata.

description: Tree; young shoots sparsely appressed puberulous at first (hairs golden-brown), soon glabrous, slender, brown, rough, without lenticels. Leaves spaced, mostly alternate and distichous, 4.8-8 × 1.9-3.8 cm (to 10 cm long on sterile juvenile shoots), broadly elliptic, apex obtuse and finally long-caudate, base broadly to narrowly attenuate, chartaceous, glabrous or sometimes with sparse very closely appressed pale hairs on the lower surface when young; venation brochidodromous, midrib sunken on upper surface, submarginal vein present, secondaries 12-16 pairs, parallel, arcuate; intersecondaries present, mostly long and only slightly less prominent than the secondaries; tertiaries prominent, reticulate. Petiole 0.5-1 cm long, channelled, finely appressed puberulous. Fascicles 1-5-flowered, mostly axillary. Pedicel 8-9 mm long (to 2 cm long in fruit), finely sericeous. Sepals five, ca. 2.5 mm long, elliptic or ovate, apex acute to obtuse, finely appressed puberulous on both surfaces. Corolla broadly tubular, ca. 3 mm long, tube ca. 2 mm long, lobes five, ca. 1 mm long, broadly oblong or slightly tapered, apex truncate, glabrous. Stamens five, included; filaments ca. 0.75 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.4-0.5 mm long, lanceolate, glabrous. Staminodes five, equalling or slightly exceeding the corolla lobes, narrowly oblong, glabrous. Disk absent. Ovary broad, truncate, five-locular, pubescent; style ca. 2 mm long after anthesis, glabrous; style-head glabrous. Fruit 2-2.2 cm long, ellipsoid, apex and base obtuse, sparsely and minutely sericeous. Seed solitary, ca. 1.4 cm long, laterally compressed, apex rounded, base obtuse; testa smooth, shining; scar adaxial, full-length, ca. 1.5 mm wide. Field characters. Tree to 10 m high with white latex; crown of very slender branches, mature (?) fruit green. Flowering Sep, fruit Mar.

description: Tree, young shoots glabrous or puberulous with brown hairs, becoming greyish-brown, rough and lenticellate. Stipules present, 1-2 mm long, narrowly lanceolate to filiform, puberulous or glabrous, caducous. Leaves 4.6-12(-l7) × 2-4.5 (-6) cm, oblong-elliptic or elliptic, apex and base acute to narrowly attenuate, glabrous; chartaceous to subcoriaceous; midrib slightly prominent on the upper surface or flat or slightly sunken; secondaries 14-21 pairs, higher order venation finely areolate. Petiole 1-3.4 cm long, slightly channelled in the upper part, puberulous or glabrous. Flowers solitary or paired. Pedicel 1-1.4 cm long, puberulous. Sepals 8-9 mm long, broadly lanceolate or ovate, outer acute, inner obtuse, puberulous to shortly tomentose outside, appressed puberulous to glabrous inside. Corolla 0.7-1.1 cm long, tube 3-3.5 mm long; lobes 6 (-8), divided to near the base into three segments; median segment narrowly boat-shaped, clawed, apex rounded; lateral segments broadly lanceolate to obliquely ovate, overlapping; corolla usually glabrous, or with some pubescence on the outside of the tube below the insertion of the staminodes. Stamens 6(-8); filaments 1-1.5 mm long, strongly curved, glabrous; anthers 2-3 mm long, lanceolate, usually hairy. Staminodes 6 (-8), 1-2 mm long, strongly curved inwards and downwards, broad with divided or lobed apex, densely pubescent. Ovary ovoid or conical, sunken in a fleshy annulus, 9-11-locular, pubescent; style 6-9 mm long after anthesis, glabrous. Fruit 3.5-5 cm long, globose, apex and base rounded, rough skinned and scaly. Seeds several, 2-2.5 cm long, strongly laterally compressed, with a smooth shiny testa; scar adaxial or basi-ventral, 0.9-1.4 cm long, 1.5-2 mm broad. Field characters. Unbuttressed tree to 30 m high and 75 cm diam., with fissured and grid-cracked bark, exuding sticky white latex when cut. The flowers are white or cream-coloured and the mature fruit rough-skinned and brown. Flowering has been recorded in the periods Mar to May and Jul to Sep, and the two known collections of mature fruit are from Jan (Belize) and Mar (Guatemala: Peten). According to the field data on Conservator of Forests 12795 from Belize, the fruits are dispersed by birds.

description: A tall tree; young branches appressed puberulous at first, soon becoming glabrous, greyish-brown, rough, lenticellate. Stipules absent. Leaves 8.5-14.5 × 5-6.5 cm, broadly oblong, apex obtuse, base broadly attenuate; glabrous; chartaceous; midrib sunken on the upper surface; secondaries 19-23 pairs, tertiaries finely reticulate. Petiole 2-3.5 cm long, subglabrous. Flowers 3-5 in a fascicle. Pedicel 2-2.7 cm long, sparsely puberulous. Sepals ca. 4 mm long, lanceolate, apex acute, puberulous outside, glabrous inside. Corolla glabrous, ca. 3.5 mm long, tube ca. 1 mm long; lobes six, divided to base into three segments, median segment narrowly boat-shaped, clawed, apex rounded, lateral segments equalling the median segment, narrowly lanceolate. Stamens six, glabrous; filaments ca. 2 mm long, shortly connate with the staminodes; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, oblong. Staminodes six, glabrous, ca. 2.25 mm long, strap-shaped with a bilobed apex. Ovary globose, 6-locular, appressed puberulous; style ca. 4 mm long after anthesis, glabrous. Fruit unknown. Field characters. A tall tree with white latex and white flowers. Flowering Oct.

description: Arbor, ramuli novelli atro-brunnei, glabri, apice resina vernicosa inducti, manifeste lenticellate demum pallide cinerascentes, rimosi et subtiliter fissurati. Stipulae 1.5-2 mm longae, late lanceolatae, glabrae, caducae. Folia 9.1-14 × 5.5-6.7 cm, late oblongo-elliptica usque oblanceolata, apice truncata, interdum subtiliter emarginata, basi obtusa usque acuta, supra glabra, infra minute adpresso-puberula, pelliculam tenuem induentes, coriacea; costa prominula sed pagina superiore recessa; nervi secundarii 20-22-jugi, nervum submarginalem indistinctum facientes; nervi quatemarii subtiliter areolati; venatio pagina superiore leviter impressa. Petiolus 2-3 cm longus, ad apicem leviter canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 5-6-flori. Pedicellus 0.9-1 cm longus, minute adpresso-puberulus. Sepala 4-5 mm longa, late elliptico-lanceolata, acuta vel obtusa, extra minute puberula, intra solum ad marginem minute puberula. Corolla glabra, ca. 4.5 mm longa; tubus ca. 1 mm longus; lobi 8-9, ad basim in segmenta tria divisi, segmentum medium anguste naviculare, apice acutum, segmenta lateralia segmentum medium aequantia, late oblongo-lanceolata, fere ad dimidium in lobos duos graciles divisi. Stamina 8-9, glabra; filamenta 23 mm longa, cum staminodiis breviter coalita; antherae ca. 1.5 mm longae, oblongo-lanceolatae. Staminodia 8-9, glabra, ca. 1 mm longa, oblonga, apice truncata vel emarginata. Ovarium conicum, 11-loculare, glabrum; stylus post anthesin 3-4 mm longus, glaber. Fructus ignotus.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Tree; young branches dark brown, glabrous, apex covered with a varnish-like layer of resin, prominently lenticellate, becoming paler greyish, cracked and slightly fissured. Stipules 1.5-2 mm long, broadly lanceolate, glabrous, caducous. Leaves 9.1-14 × 5.5-6.7 cm, broadly oblong-elliptic to oblanceolate, apex truncate, sometimes slightly emarginate, base obtuse to acute; glabrous above, minutely appressed puberulous below, forming a thin pellicle, coriaceous; midrib slightly prominent but recessed on the upper surface, secondaries 20-22 pairs, forming an indistinct submarginal vein, quaternaries finely areolate; venation slightly impressed on the upper surface. Petiole 2-3 cm long, slightly channelled near the apex, glabrous. Flowers 5-6 in a fascicle. Pedicel 0.9-1 cm long, minutely appressed puberulous. Sepals 4-5 mm long, broadly elliptic-lanceolate, acute or obtuse, minutely puberulous outside, minutely puberulous inside near the margins only. Corolla glabrous, ca. 4.5 mm long, tube ca. 1 mm long; lobes 8-9, divided to base into three segments, median segment narrowly boat-shaped, apex acute, lateral segments equalling the median segment, broadly oblong-lanceolate, divided to about halfway into two slender lobes. Stamens 8-9, glabrous; filaments 2-3 mm long, shortly connate with the staminodes; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long, oblong-lanceolate. Staminodes 8-9, glabrous, ca. 1 mm long, oblong, apex truncate or emarginate. Ovary conical, 11-locular, glabrous; style 3-4 mm long after anthesis, glabrous. Fruit unknown. Field characters. A tree ca. 14 m high, containing white latex. The flowers are described as having a reddish calyx and white corolla. Flowering in Sep.

description: Arbor:; ramuli novelli crassi, apice resina vernicosa inducti, glabri, atri, demum pallide cinerascentes, scabri, valde squamati. Stipulae nullae. Folia 11.5-25 × 5.4-10 cm, late cunei-formia, apice rotundata vel emarginata, basi an-guste attenuata, supra glabra, pagina inferiore minute et adpresse ferrugineo-puberula, valde coriacea; costa prominens sed recessa, nervi se-cundarii 27-32-jugi, in nervum submarginalem conjuncti, venatio Superioris ordines obscura. Petiolus 3.3-6 cm longus, haudquaquam vel paullum canaliculata, glaber. Flores solitarii. Pedicellus 5-6 cm longus, manifeste lenticellate, subglaber. Sepala 1.5-1.6 cm longa, ovata, acuta, basi distincte inflata et abrupte in petio-lum contracta, extra minute et adpresse ferrugineo-puberula, intra puberula, indumentum interioris verticilli pallidius. Corolla glabra, 1.61.7 cm longa, tubus ca. 3 mm longus; lobi sex, ad basim in segmenta tria divisi, segmentum medium valde anguste naviculare, apice acutum, segmenta lateralia segmento medio ca. 2 mm longiora, late lanceolata, apice acuta vel obtusa. Stamina sex, glabra; filamenta ca. 2 mm longa, libera; antherae ca. 3 mm longae, lanceolatae. Staminodia sex, glabra, 7-8 mm longa, ligulata, parte superiore profunde laciniato-fimbriata. Ovarium ovoideum, glabrum (loculi et stylus non visi). Fructus maturus non visus, fructus im-maturus late ellipsoideus, ca. 2.5 × 2.2 cm, apice et basi rotundatus, laevis, glaber, stylo crasso ca. 0.6 cm longo terminatus.

description: Tree; young branches stout, glabrous, black, apex covered by a varnish-like coat of resin, lenticellate, becoming pale grey, rough and strongly scaling. Stipules absent. Leaves 11.5-25 × 5.410 cm, broadly cuneiform, apex rounded or emarginate, base narrowly cuneate, glabrous above, minutely appressed ferruginous puberulous below, strongly coriaceous; midrib prominent, but recessed, secondary veins 27-32 pairs, forming a submarginal vein, higher order venation obscure. Petiole 3.3-6 cm long, not or only slightly channelled, glabrous. Flowers solitary. Pedicel 5-6.5 cm long, prominently lenticellate, subglabrous. Sepals 1.5-1.6 cm long, ovate, acute, distinctly swollen at the base and abruptly contracted into the pedicel, minutely appressed ferruginous puberulous outside, puberulous inside, indumentum of inner whorl paler. Corolla glabrous, 1.6-1.7 cm long, tube ca. 3 mm long; lobes six, divided to base into three segments, median segment very slender, boatshaped, apex acute; lateral segments ca. 2 mm longer than the median segment, broadly lanceolate, apex acute or obtuse. Stamens six, glabrous; filaments ca. 2 mm long, free; anthers ca. 3 mm long, lanceolate. Staminodes six, glabrous, 7-8 mm long, strap-shaped, deeply laciniate-fimbriate in the upper part. Ovary ovoid, glabrous (locules and style not seen). Mature fruit not seen, young fruit broadly ellipsoid, ca. 2.5 × 2.2 cm, apex and base rounded, smooth, glabrous, bearing a stout persistent style ca. 0.6 cm long. Field characters. Unbuttressed tree to 30 m high and 60 cm diam. The inner bark is reddish, with abundant white latex. Flowers white. Flowering from Jul to Sep, young fruit Sep and Dec.

description: Leaves usually 2.5-4 times as long as broad, 4-11.5 cm long, base acute or attenuate, petiole less than 1 cm long, corolla 4-5 mm long, tube 1/2 to 1/3 as long as lobes, style puberulous below. Field characters. A shrub or small tree to 12 m high, with hard reddish wood. Flowering May-Jun.

description: Arbuscula; ramuli novelli atrobrunnei, glabri, apice resina vernicosa inducti, demum pallide cinerascentes, subtiliter rimosi, lenticellis paucis. Stipulae nullae. Folia 5-8.3 × 3.7-5 cm, late elliptica vel late oblanceolata, apice rotundata et emarginata, basi obtusa vel rotundata, glabra sed pagina inferiore pellicula ceracea inducta, coriacea; costa pagina superiore leviter impressa; nervi secundarii 13-15-jugi, nervum submarginalem indistinctum facientes; nervi quatemarii subtiliter areolati; venatio non impressa. Petiolus 1.2-1.8 cm longus, non canaliculata, glaber. Fasciculi 3-7-flori. Pedicellus 1.4-1.7 cm longus, sensim in calycem expansus, glaber. Sepala ca. 4 mm longa, lanceolata, apice acuta, verticillus extemus glaber, nitidus, resina vernicosa induc-tus, verticillus interior extra puberulus, verticilli ambo intra glabri, calyx sensim in pedicellum decrescens. Corolla glabra, ca. 4 mm longa; tubus ca. 1 mm longus, carnosus; lobi sex, ad basim in segmenta tria divisi, segmentum medium an-guste naviculare, unguiculatum, apice rotundatum; segmenta lateralia segmentum medium ae-quantia, lanceolata, apice acuta. Stamina sex, glabra; filamenta ca. 1.5 mm longa, carnosa, cum staminodiis bre viter coalita; antherae 1.5-1.7 mm longae, lanceolatae, sagittatae. Staminodia sex, glabra, ca. 1.75 mm longa, latiuscula, irregulariter dentata et lobata, infra carnosa. Ovarium in receptaculo immersum, 10-12-loculare, glabrum; stylus post anthesin 4-5 mm longus, glaber. Fructus ignotus.

description: Treelet, young branches dark brown, glabrous, apex covered with a varnish-like layer of resin, becoming paler greyish, finely cracked, with a few lenticels. Stipules absent. Leaves 5-8.3 × 3.7-5 cm, broadly elliptic or broadly oblanceolate, apex rounded and emarginate, base obtuse to rounded; glabrous but lower surface overlaid by a waxy coat, coriaceous; midrib slightly sunken on the upper surface, secondaries 13-15 pairs, forming an indistinct submarginal vein; quaternaries finely areolate; venation not impressed. Petiole 1.2-1.8 cm long, not channelled, glabrous. Flowers 3-7 in a fascicle. Pedicel 1.4-1.7 cm long, expanded gradually into the calyx, glabrous. Sepals ca. 4 mm long, lanceolate, apex acute, outer whorl glabrous, shining, with a varnish-like coat, inner whorl puberulous on the outer face, both whorls glabrous inside. Corolla glabrous, ca. 4 mm long, tube ca. 1 mm long, carnose; lobes six, divided to base into three segments, median segment narrowly boat-shaped, clawed, apex rounded; lateral segments equalling the median segment, lanceolate, apex acute. Stamens 6, glabrous; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, carnose, shortly fused to the staminodes; anthers 1.5-1.7 mm long, lanceolate, sagittate. Staminodes six, glabrous, ca. 1.75 mm long, rather broad, irregularly toothed and lobed, carnose below. Ovary sunken in the receptacle, 10-12-locular, glabrous; style 4-5 mm long after anthesis, glabrous. Fruit unknown. Field characters. A treelet 5-6 m high with white latex, discolorous leaves and yellow flowers. Flowering in Jan.
bibliographicCitation: Pennington, Terence D. 1990. Sapotaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 52: 1-750.

description: Small tree, young shoots shortly golden-tomentose, becoming glabrous, greyish, rough, fissured, lenticellate. Stipules absent. Leaves 5-8.5 × 2.3-3.6 cm, elliptic to oblanceolate, apex acute to rounded, often slightly emarginate, base acute, upper surface glabrous except sometimes for some residual tomentum along the midrib, densely golden-brown crisped tomentose below, the indumentum loose and soon falling to leave a glabrous lamina; coriaceous; midrib sunken on the upper surface; secondaries 12-16 pairs, quaternary venation reticulate-areolate; venation slightly impressed on the upper surface. Petiole 3-8 mm long, shallowly and broadly channelled, tomentose at first, becoming glabrous. Flowers solitary. Pedicel 1-1.7 cm long, shortly tomentose. Sepals 5-6.5 mm long, outer lanceolate with acute apex, inner whorl elliptic with obtuse apex, outer shortly tomentose, inner whorl puberulous, both whorls glabrous inside except for some appressed puberulous hairs near the margin. Corolla glabrous, 5-5.5 mm long, tube 1-1.5 mm long; lobes six, divided to base into three segments, median segment narrowly boat-shaped, apex acute or obtuse; lateral segments slightly exceeding the median segment, narrowly lanceolate. Stamens six, glabrous; filaments 1.75-2.5 mm long, shortly fused to the staminodes; anthers 1-1.5 mm long, lanceolate. Staminodes six, glabrous, 1.5-2 mm long, oblong, apex bifid to fimbriate-laciniate. Ovary ovoid, 7-locular, glabrous; style glabrous. Fruit (not seen, description from Ducke, 1957:656) oblong to fusiform. Seed longer and narrower than that of M. rufula. Field characters. Small tree to ca. 6 m high with cream-coloured flowers. Mature fruit orange to red (Ducke, 1957: 645). Flowering in Jul and Oct.
