description: Shrub or generally a tree up to 30.0 m high; trunk sometimes buttressed. Branchlets puberulous at tips, glabrescent below. Leaves (narrowly) oblong, obovate- or elliptic-oblong, apex caudate-acuminate for 2.0-3.0 cm, base slightly unequal, rounded to subcordate, thinly subcoriaceous, lustrous and glabrous above, glabrous or minutely pubescent especially along the midrib beneath, remotely repand-serrate to subentire, 8.0-25.0 cm long, 6.0-9.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 7-8 pairs a little prominent above, more distinctly so beneath, veins more or less transverse, finely raised on both faces as is the dense reticulation of the veinlets; petiole 5.0-7.0 mm long; stipules foliaceous, narrowly ovate-oblong, somewhat falcate, puberulous, up to 17.0 mm long and 3.0 mm broad, subpersistent. Inflorescence all over puberulous, 3.0-6.0(-8.0) cm long, the spikes up to 2.5 cm long in anthesis, much enlarged in fruit. Flowers densely crowded along the secondary rhachises; bracts and bracteoles minute, caducous. Flowers white. Calyx 4 (or 5)-angled by mutual pressing of the flowers along rhachis, not gibbous as in T. macrophyllum, glabrous outside, pubescent inside, up to 2.0 mm long, the lobes only ca 0.5 mm long. Stamens 4, ca 0.5 mm long. Ovary apparently glabrous. Fruit globose to obovoid, glabrous, up to 2.5 cm long and 1.8 cm broad; seeds numerous, ovoid, ca 2.0 mm long.

description: Tree 3.0-8.0(-15.0) m tall, with spreading crown; trunk 10.0-30.0 cm diam; bark pinkish or grayish-brown, rather smooth; young stems inhabited by ants. Branchlets pubescent at tips, glabrescent. Leaves narrowly to broadly oblong, apex long to shortly caudate-acuminate or often rounded with a short abrupt acute acumen, base somewhat unequal, rounded or rather deeply cordate or truncate, chartaceous to coriaceous, glabrous and shining above, glabrous or short-pubescent, rarely tomentulose, and dull beneath, (14.0-)20.0-40.0 cm long, (5.0-)8.0-14.0(-18.0) cm broad, entire to remotely and rather obscurely serrate, midrib and lateral nerves slightly sunken above, very prominent beneath, lateral nerves (8-)10-12 pairs curved-ascendent, veins more oblique to transverse forming with the veins a dense reticulation which is hardly raised above, though distinctly so beneath; petiole subpeltately inserted, robust, 0.5-1.5(-2.0) cm long; stipules including foliar buds lanceolate, pubescent, ca 1.0 cm long, caducous before the leaves start to grow. Panicles axillary and sometimes from older branches and the trunk, 8.0-10.0(-20.0) cm long at anthesis, up to 35.0 cm in fruit, sessile or on peduncle up to 5.0 cm long, pendent, ample, corymbiform or broom-like, composed of numerous spikes, the flowers spaced along the angular, short-pubescent or subglabrous rhachis; bracts and bracteoles broadly triangular, ciliate, persistent, ca 1.0 mm long. Flowers subglobose, reddish-purplish or maroon, puberulous or glabrous. Calyx 4-gibbous, 1.5-2.5(-3.5) mm long, glabrous outside, pubescent inside, lobes ca 1.5 mm long. Stamens ca 2.2 mm long; anthers sagittate, ca 1.5 mm long; filaments glabrous. Ovary puberulous to yellowish-tomentellous. Fruit subglobose, red-purple, puberulous, up to 1.5 cm diam; seeds ovoid, ca 1.5 mm long.

description: Intricately branched shrub or small tree up to 4.0 m tall; trunk and old branches densely armed with branched spines up to 5.0 cm long. Branchlets glabrous, older parts covered with grayish cork and numerous lenticels, set with slender spines up to 1.5 cm long. Leaves variable in shape and size on the same specimen, generally ovate or oblong, rarely oblanceolate or obovate-oblong, apex subacuminate or obtuse, base narrowly to broadly attenuate or cuneate, rarely obtuse, subcoriaceous, glabrous, a little shining above, entire or with 1-4 blunt teeth on either side, 0.6-1.3 cm long, 0.3-0.6(-1.2) cm broad, lateral nerves and veins rather obscure on both faces; petiole 1.0-2.0 mm long. Flowers unknown. Fruit oblong-obovoid, obtuse, 6.0 mm long, 3.0 mm diam.

description: Shrub or tree, 2.0-6.0, rarely -15.0 m tall; trunk usually with abundant stout branched dark-coloured spines up to 10.0 cm long; bark gray to brownish. Branchlets puberulous or glabrous at tips, older parts densely lenticellate, early covered with grayish cork, rarely with slender axillary spines. Leaves elliptic or elliptic-oblong, rarely ovate or lanceolate-oblong, apex rather abruptly and shortly, acutely or obtusely attenuate or acuminate, base broadly attenuate, the basal gland(s) obvious, rather inconspicuous, or absent, thinly to firmly chartaceous or subcoriaceous, glabrous or practically so, rarely puberulent or pubescent on midrib beneath, rather densely and coarsely glandular-subserrate or -crenate (ca 1.0 mm), (4.0-)5.0-12.0 cm long, (2.0-)3.0-5.0 (-6.0) cm broad, lateral nerves 5-6 pairs prominent beneath, reticulation of the transverse veins and the veinlets a little raised on both faces, that of the veinlets less conspicuous; petiole (2.0-)3.0-6.0 mm long. Flowers whitish or greenish, per 4-8 arranged in fascicles or very short racemes, from foliate or already defoliate axils; pedicels slender, articulate at or somewhat above base, puberulent, 3.0-4.0 mm long in [male] shorter and more robust in [female]: Sepals ovate, ciliate, glabrous, 1.0-1.5 mm long. Disk 8-12-lobed, the lobes close together. [male]: stamens 15-20(-30); filaments glabrous, 2.0-3.0 mm long. [female]: ovary ovoid, glabrous; style very short; stigmas 2, thick-subulate below, dilated distally, divergent. Fruit subglobular, cherry-red to blackish, 4.0-5.0(-6.0) mm diam; seeds 2-4, ovoid-subtrigonous, 2.0-3.0(-4.0) mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Sleumer, Hermann O. 1980. Flacourtiaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 22: 1-499.

description: Tree, to 20(-30) m tall. Leafy twigs 4-8 cm thick, green to bluish gray, densely villous and with filiform brown pluricellular hairs (or only with these pluricellular hairs). Lamina (sub)coriaceous, ca. 50 × 50 cm to 100 × 100 cm, the segments 10-12 or 13-18 (but on new shoots down to 8), the free parts of the segments oblanceolate to oblong, the incisions down to ca. 6/10-9/10; apices subacuminate to acute; upper surface scabrous to scabridulous, sparsely to rather densely hispidulous to subhispid or to hirtellous or largely hirsute to subvillous and with sparse to dense filiform brown pluricellular hairs, "umbilicus" prominent and villous; lower surface rather sparsely subvillous and with filiform brown pluricellular hairs or also sparse white arachnoid indument on the main veins, varying to pilose (to subtomentose) on the lesser veins, with arachnoid indumentum in the areoles and on the reticulum; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment 15-25 or 25-35 pairs, most of them unbranched or the lower ones branched, sub-marginally (± faintly) loop-connected; petiole 40-80 cm long, ± densely (sub)villous and with filiform brown pluricellular hairs and sparse arachnoid indument or sparsely villous in the upper part, glabrescent or (sub)glabrous; trichilia absent; stipules 15-35 cm long, green (or red to grayish), caducous, densely villous outside, sparsely to densely hairy inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs, erect to spreading with the spikes curved upward, often subtended by caducous bracts, to 13 cm long; peduncle 5-12 cm long, ± densely white-villous (at least in the upper part) and also or only with filiform brown pluricellular hairs, often also with sparse white arachnoid indumentum or (sub)glabrous; spathe 14-20 cm long, green (or purple), with dense filiform brown pluricellular hairs and sparsely villous (glabrescent) outside, hairy inside; spikes ca. 10-25, 12-20 × 0.3-0.5 cm, sessile or with stipes to 1 cm long and with brown pluricellular hairs or also sparsely hirtellous; rachis hairy with stiff hairs and arachnoid indumentum. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, ca. 1.2-1.8 mm long, with short arachnoid indumentum below the apex, the apex plane to slightly convex, sparsely to densely muriculate; filaments swollen; anthers ca. 0.6-0.8 mm long, not appendiculate, remaining attached at anthesis. Pistillate inflorescences in pairs, erect to spreading and with the spikes curved upward, often subtended by caducous bracts, to 13 cm long; peduncle 5-12 cm long, with indumentum similar to that of the staminate inflorescence; spathe 9-14 cm long, the color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes 3-7, 6-13 × ca. 0.5 cm, to 22 × 1.5 cm in fruit, (sub)sessile; rachis hairy with stiff hairs and arachnoid indumentum. Pistillate flowers: perianth, ca. 1.5-2 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, also in the lower part of the style channel inside, the apex plane to slightly convex, muriculate; style long, slightly curved, muriculate; stigma comose. Fruit oblongoid, ca. 1.5 mm long, finely tuberculate.

description: Tree, to 20(-30) m tall. Leafy twigs 1.5-5 cm thick, green, hirsute, sometimes only at the stipular scars; internodes partly to entirely (?) filled with orange-brown pith. Lamina coriaceous, ca. 20 × 20 cm to 90 × 90 cm, the segments 8-10, the free parts of the upper segments obovate or elliptic, the incisions down to 7/10-8/10; apices acute to obtuse; upper surface smooth, often ± rugose, very sparsely strigose and with dense to ± sparse arachnoid indumentum (or subglabrous), lower surface sparsely to densely hirsute to hirtellous on the main veins, hirtellous to puberulous on the smaller veins, with arachnoid indumentum in the areoles or extending to the smaller veins or also to the main veins (not distinctly in two layers as in C. telenitida); lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment ca. 15-25(-30?) pairs, submarginally loop-connected, unbranched or sometimes branched; petiole 15-65 cm long, sparsely subvillous in the upper and lower part or also with arachnoid indumentum; trichilia fused (or separated), the brown indumentum intermixed with short (or also long) white hairs; stipules (6-) 13-32 cm long, reddish to purplish or pale green to yellowish, hirsute to subvillous (to rather sparsely strigose to hirtellous to subsericeous outside, sparsely hairy inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs or solitary, erect; peduncle 5-7 cm long, subvillous, often only in the upper and lower part; spathe 9-17 cm long, pink to reddish to purplish or pale green to yellowish, subvillous outside, glabrous inside; spikes 8-12, 5-12 × 0.5-0.9 cm, with stipes 0.5-1.2 cm long and sparsely hairy or glabrous; rachis hairy. Staminate flowers with pedicels to 1.5 cm long and minutely puberulous; perianth tubular, ca. 1.2-2 mm long, minutely puberulous below the apex, the apex plane to slightly convex; filaments flat; anthers 0.6-0.8 mm long, appendiculate, detached at anthesis (?), reattached to the margins of the aperture by the appendages (?). Pistillate inflorescences in pairs or solitary, erect, later on deflexed, subtended by caducous bracts, to 4 cm long; peduncle 3-11 cm long, subvillous, often only in the upper and lower part or subglabrous; spathe 8-13 cm long, the color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes l-3(-4), (1.4-)5-9 × 0.4-0.6 cm, to 32 × 2.5 cm in fruit, sessile or with stipes to 1 cm long and subvillous; rachis hairy. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 2-3 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, also in the lower part of the style channel inside, the apex convex, muriculate to minutely puberulous (only in the lower part); style long, straight, minutely puberulous; stigma penicillate. Fruit oblongoid, 3.5-4 mm long, finely tuberculate.

description: Tree, to 15(-30) m tall. Leafy twigs 2-8 cm thick, green to bluish by a waxy layer, glabrous or (initially) with dense brown pluricellular trichomes, hirtellous, villous to hirsute, or puberulous with straight white (unicellular) hairs; internodes with scarce pith. Lamina (sub)coriaceous, ca. 30 × 30 cm to 90 × 90 cm (to 100 × 100 cm), the segments 7-10(-11), the free parts of the upper segments ovate to elliptic to oblong to (sub)obovate, the incisions down to 4/10-9/10; apices rounded to short-acuminate; upper surface smooth or scabridulous (to scabrous), very sparsely to densely puberulous (to hirtellous or subvelutinous) or hispidulous and with sparse to dense arachnoid indumentum, often slightly bullate, lower surface hirtellous to subtomentose (or puberulous), especially on the main veins hirsute to villous, or main veins subglabrous, with very short arachnoid indumentum in the areoles or also on the reticulum and usually very sparse to rather dense longer arachnoid indumentum on the main veins and supported by the other indumentum on the smaller veins (the arachnoid indumentum thus in two distinct layers); lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment 7-16 pairs, submarginally loop-connected, unbranched or branched, the smaller veins often prominent; petiole ca. 25-90 cm long, glabrous, villous in the upper or also the lower part, also with arachnoid indumentum and/or dense brown pluricellular trichomes (sometimes at the base dense, and suggesting the occurrence of trichilia, but Mullerian bodies lacking), or puberulous; trichilia absent or present, weakly developed without Mullerian bodies or with Mullerian bodies and separate or fused (and then sometimes lobate), the brown indumentum intermixed with short or also long white hairs; stipules (12-)20-55 cm long, green to orange to pink to reddish to dark maroon, with sparse to dense dark brown pluricellular hairs and sparsely minutely puberulous to tomentellous or often also sparsely to densely hirsute to villous to sericeous, subglabrous, subhirsute or hirtellous outside, densely to sparsely subvillous to subsericeous or subglabrous inside. Staminate inflorescences solitary or in pairs, (usually/always?) subtended by caducous bracts, to 8 cm long, the peduncle erect and the spikes spreading to subpendulous; peduncle 2-11 cm long, glabrous or in the upper part sparsely to densely (sub)villous or puberulous to hirtellous to subhirsute; spathe 9-24 cm long, red-brown to orange to pinkish or yellowish brown or yellowish, rather sparsely to densely (sub)villous to hirsute or also with sparse arachnoid indumentum outside, sparsely hairy or glabrous inside; spikes 5-12(-16), 6-25 × ca. 0.5-1 cm, sessile or with stipes to 1 cm long and hairy; rachis hairy. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 1-2(-2.5) mm long, (sparsely) puberulous or glabrous below the apex, the apex slightly convex, glabrous; filaments swollen; anthers 0.6-0.8 mm long, detached at anthesis (?). Pistillate inflorescences solitary or in pairs, erect to deflexed, (usually/always?) subtended by caducous bracts, to 8 cm long; peduncle 4-12(-15) cm long, glabrous or sparsely villous or ± densely hirtellous to puberulous; spathe 6-13 cm long, the color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes (l-)4-5(-6), purplish or reddish, 3-12 × 0.7-1.6 cm, to 25 × 2.5 cm in fruit, subsessile (or with to 2 cm long stipes); rachis subglabrous. Pistillate flowers: perianth 2-2.5 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, also below the style channel inside (or the style channel minutely puberulous), the apex conical to convex, hispidulous near the slitshaped aperture; style rather long, puberulous; stigma comose to subpeltate. Fruit oblongoid to subobovoid, 2-2.5 mm long, tuberculate or smooth.

description: Tree, to 4(-8) m tall, usually unbranched, the leafy part of the stem 3-5 cm thick, green, hispid to setose, sometimes also with sparse arachnoid indumentum. Lamina chartaceous to subcoriaceous, ca. (20 × 20 cm to) 30 × 30 cm to 80 × 80 cm, the segments 12-15, oblanceolate, the incisions down to 1.5-5 cm from the petiole; apices acute to acuminate (to obtuse); upper surface ± scabrous, hispidulous to hirtellous, initially also with sparse arachnoid indumentum; lower surface hirtellous on the veins, with arachnoid indumentum in the areoles, sometimes intially also on the main veins; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment ca. 20-25 pairs, submarginally loop-connected, unbranched or some branched; petiole 40-75 cm long, hispidulous to subsetose, sometimes also with sparse arachnoid indumentum; trichilia fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with rather long white hairs; stipules 8-13 cm long, red-brown to grayish, hirtellous and with arachnoid indumentum outside, subsericeous inside. Staminate inflorescences mostly in pairs, the peduncle erect and the spikes pendulous; peduncle 4-10 cm long, hispidulous to subsetose; spathe 8-12 cm long, red-brown to grayish, hirtellous to subhispid outside, glabrous inside; spikes 2-5, often 4, 6-13 × 0.6 cm, with stipes ca. 0.5 cm long and only with brown pluricellular trichomes; rachis hairy. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 2-2.5 mm long, glabrous, the apex almost plane, the aperture surrounded by a rim; filaments ± swollen; anthers 0.5-0.7 mm long, appendiculate, detached at anthesis(?), reattached to the margins of the aperture by the appendages (?). Pistillate inflorescences solitary or in pairs, erect; peduncle 7-10 cm long, hispidulous to subsetose; spathe 79 cm long, the color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes 1-3, often 2, 6-8 × ca. 0.7 cm, to 15 × 1.1 cm in fruit, sessile or with stipes to 0.3 cm long; rachis hairy. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 2.5 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, also below the style channel inside, the apex convex, hispidulous; style rather long, slightly curved; stigma truncate and comose to sublingulate. Fruit oblongoid to ellipsoid, 3-3.5 mm long, ± tuberculate.

description: Tree, to 15(-25) m tall. Leafy twigs 1.5-3.5(-5) cm thick, green (or partly bluish), puberulous to sub-hispidulous with curved to uncinate hairs. Lamina chartaceous to subcoriaceous, ca. (10 × 10 cm to) 25 × 25 cm to 60 × 60 cm, the segments 7-9(-11), the free part of upper segments oblong to subobovate or to obovate, the incisions down to 5/10-6(-7/1 )0; apices obtuse to short-acuminate; upper surface scabrous to scabridulous (to almost smooth), puberulous to hispidulous (to hirtellous); lower surface minutely puberulous, mostly also with longer uncinate to straight hairs on the veins, with arachnoid indumentum in the areoles or (almost) confined to the margin; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment 9-16 pairs, submarginally loop-connected, some or most of them branched; petiole 15-50 cm long, green or red-brown, minutely puberulous; trichilia fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with sparse, (rather) short, white hairs; stipules 4-12 cm long, red-brown to brown, dark red to purplish, or greenish, minutely puberulous or on the ribs sparsely hirtellous outside, sparsely to densely sericeous with white (or brownish) hairs inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs, pendulous; peduncle (6-) 10-21 cm long, puberulous and with very sparse arachnoid hairs; spathe 7-26 (-32) cm long, yellowish brown to greenish, dark red to orange, or grayish, puberulous to sparsely strigillose to subhirtellous or also with sparse to dense arachnoid indumentum outside, (almost) glabrous inside; spikes 4-7(-15), (4-) 10-22(-31) × 0.2-0.5 (-0.8) cm, sessile (or with stipes 0.8-1.8 cm long and hairy); rachis glabrous or sparsely hairy. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 0.8-1.5 mm long, with short hairs just below or also on the margin of the apex, the apex slightly convex to plane; filaments flat; anthers 0.4-0.7 mm long, not appendiculate, detached and remaining attached by 2 filiform connections between the connective and the upper margin of the filament. Pistillate inflorescences in pairs, pendulous; peduncle 15-50 cm long, puberulous to subhispidulous; spathe 9-20 cm long, the color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes 4-5(-6), 10-20 × 0.8-1 cm, to 35 × 1.2 cm in fruit, (sub)sessile; rachis hairy to subglabrous. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 2 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, also below the style channel inside, the apex sparsely to densely muriculate; style rather short; stigma penicillate. Fruit ellipsoid, 2-2.5 mm long, smooth, the upper and lower part dark brown, the middle part pale brown.

description: Tree, to 25 m tall. Leafy twigs 5-13 cm thick, dark brown to black, white-hirtellous and with dark brown to black pluricellular hairs. Lamina subcoriaceous, ca. 50 × 50 cm to 130 × 130 cm, the segments 14-20 (-24), lanceolate to linear, the incisions down to the petiole; apices acute; upper surface smooth or scabridulous, minutely puberulous and initially with sparse brown pluricellular hairs; lower surface with very dense arachnoid indumentum, on the main veins (initially) also with brown pluricellular hairs; lateral veins in the midsegment 50-80 pairs, submarginally loop-connected, mostly unbranched; petiole 30-100 cm long, with dense arachnoid indumentum and with brown pluricellular hairs, the upper part (pale brown) hirsute to subvillous; trichilia fused, the dark brown indumentum intermixed with short grayish hairs; stipules 25-60 cm long, white to brownish, with dense arachnoid indumentum, intermixed with brown pluricellular hairs outside, dark red, with very short hairs on the ribs or glabrous inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs, the peduncle erect and the spikes pendulous (?); peduncle 7-14 cm long, brown-puberulous to- subhispidulous, toward the apex hirtellous to setulose, also with arachnoid indumentum and dense brown pluricellular hairs; spathe not seen; spikes ca. 8-10, 12-20 × ca. 0.3 cm, with stipes 0.7-1 cm long and sparsely hirtellous and with dense arachnoid indumentum; rachis glabrous. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 1-1.5 mm long, with dense arachnoid indumentum below the apex, the apex muriculate; filaments flat; anthers ca. 0.6 mm long, at anthesis detached, reattached to the margins of the aperture by the appendages (?). Pistillate inflorescences solitary, erect to deflexed; peduncle 7-14 cm long, dark green, with sparse arachnoid indumentum and toward the base and apex brownish-subhispidulous; spathes not seen; spikes 4-5, ca. 25-45 × 1-1.5 cm in fruit, ± curved; rachis subglabrous. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 1.5-2 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, also the lower part of the style channel inside, the apex almost plane, muriculate; style rather long, straight to slightly curved, muriculate; stigma comose. Fruit ellipsoid to subovoid, ca. 2 mm long, slightly tuberculate, dark brown.

description: Tree, to 15 m tall. Leafy twigs 2-4 cm thick, green to purplish brown with conspicuous lenticels, sparsely puberulous to hispidulous. Lamina subcoriaceous, ca. 30 × 30 cm to 80 × 80 cm, the segments (6-)7-8, the free parts of upper segments ovate, the incisions down to 3/10-6/10; apices subacuminate to rounded; upper surface almost smooth to scabridulous, sparsely hispidulous, on the main veins and the "umbilicus" sparsely hirtellous to subhirsute; lower surface sparsely puberulous with brown pluricellular hairs on the veins, with arachnoid indumentum in the areoles and extending to the main veins; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment ca. 10-15 pairs, submarginally loop-connected, the lower ones usually branched; petiole 15-40 cm long, sparsely puberulous to subhispidulous and with rather dense arachnoid indumentum; trichilia separate, sunken into 2 pockets with slit-shaped apertures; stipules (7-) 10-26 cm long, reddish to brownish or to purplish, ± curved, sparsely hirtellous and with dense arachnoid indumentum and with brown pluricellular trichomes outside, densely pale yellow-sericeous inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs, erect or ± deflexed; peduncle 7-11 cm long, hispidulous or also with sparse arachnoid hairs; spathe 7-12 cm long, reddish to brownish or to purplish, sparsely hirtellous to strigose and with dense arachnoid indumentum and brown pluricellular trichomes outside, densely yellowish-sericeous inside; spikes 2-4, 4-13 × 0.3-0.7 cm, sessile; rachis hairy. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 1-1.5 mm long, with stiff hairs on the ribs below the apex, the apex plane to slightly convex, glabrous or muriculate; anthers ca. 0.4-0.5 mm long, appendiculate, detached at anthesis (?). Pistillate inflorescences in pairs, pendulous (?), subtended by caducous bracts, 0.5-5 cm long; peduncle 5.5-15 cm long, hispidulous or also with sparse arachnoid hairs; spathe 6-8 cm long, the color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes 2-4, 3.5-6 × 0.4-0.5 cm, to 11 × 1.5 cm in fruit, sessile; rachis hairy with straight hairs or also arachnoid indumentum. Pistillate flowers: perianth 2-2.5 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, absent inside, the apex slightly convex, muriculate, the aperture wide and round, surrounded by a rim; style rather short the apex slightly convex, muriculate, with a wide round aperture surrounded by a rim; stigma comose. Fruit ellipsoid to ovoid, ca. 2 mm long, tuberculate.

description: Shrub or tree, mostly hemi-epiphytic, up to 30 m tall. Leafy twigs 3-8 mm thick, glabrous or sparsely, minutely puberulous, lenticels numerous and conspicuous. Lamina coriaceous obovate or subobovate (to oblanceolate or elliptic to oblong), 2-11 × 1-6 cm, apex obtuse to rounded or emarginate, base acute to cuneate (or to subobtuse), margin entire; upper surface glabrous, lower surface glabrous or sparsely appressed-puberulous; lateral veins 2-4 pairs, straight or curved, basal pair unbranched, reaching the margin far above the middle of the lamina; intercostal venation mostly plane; petiole 15 cm long, glabrous or sparsely appressed-puberulous; stipules 0.5-1 cm long, glabrous or sparsely appressed-puberulous. Staminate inflorescences poorly branched, heads 3-5, sometimes partly fused, globose, 5-8 mm diam.; common peduncle 0.5-1.5 cm long, minutely  puberulous; perianth 1 mm high, glabrous; stamen one, as long as the perianth. Pistillate inflorescences unbranched or rarely branched; heads 1(-2), globose, ca. 5 mm, in fruit up to 20 mm diam.; (common) peduncle 0.3-3 cm long, minutely puberulous; perianth l(-2) mm high, glabrous; fruiting perianth yellow to orange. Inter-floral bracts spathulate to subpeltate, apex ciliolate.

description: Small tree. Branchlets glabrous. Leaves ovate to oblong, apex shortly or elongately, acutely or generally obtusely acuminate, base rounded or subtruncate, firmly chartaceous, glabrous, rather obscurely glandular-subserrate-denticulate, 3.5-8.5 cm long, 2.0-3.5 cm broad, 3-nerved from base (the pair of basal nerves ascending to 1/5-1/3 of the lamina), upper lateral nerves 3-7 pairs raised on both faces as is the rather dense reticulation of veins and veinlets; petiole 4.0-7.0 mm long; stipules triangular-lanceolate, hardly 1.0 mm long, caducous. Inflorescence known only in not yet fully developed state; racemes terminal, 6-8-flowered, pedunculate (5.0 mm), with a solitary flower added from the uppermost leaf-axil; pedicels at least 4.0 mm long, glabrous; bracts lanceolate-linear, 1.5 mm long, caducous. Flower buds glabrous. Sepals 3, ovate, subacute, ciliate. Petals 3, suborbicular. Otherwise unknown.

description: Slender tree or treelet, 4.0-6.0 (rarely -20.0) m tall. Branchlets pubescent at tips, early glabrescent below, minutely rather densely lenticellate. Leaves elliptic to subovate-oblong, apex shortly obtusely acuminate, base unequal, one side cuneate, the other one more or less rounded-obtuse, firmly membranaceous to chartaceous, becoming blackish when dry, (sub)glabrous above (puberulent midrib and nerves excepted) and often shining there, dull and with sparse very short hairs all over the undersurface, more densely and appressedly pubescent there on midrib and nerves, coarsely glandular-crenate-serrate (ca 1.5 mm), 6.0-11.0 cm long, 3.0-5.0 cm broad, 3 (-faintly 5)-nerved from base, with 5-6 pairs of lateral nerves from the lower 3/4 part of the lamina, all nerves curved-ascending and excurrent close to the edge, prominent beneath, veins transverse, rather laxly reticulate with the veinlets and slightly raised beneath; petiole pubescent, 3.0-5.0 mm long; stipules very small. Panicles terminal, pyramidate, many-flowered, short-pedunculate, its partial inflorescences racemose and more or less horizontally spreading, 7.0-12.0 cm long, lower branches 4.0-6.0 cm long, all over laxly appressedly and shortly yellowish- or grayish-pubescent; pedicels rather robust, pubescent below, glabrescent distally, 4.0-5.0 mm long. Flowers canary-yellow. Sepals 3 (rarely 4) ovate, obtuse, laxly pubescent outside, tomentellous inside, 3.0-4.0 mm long, 2.0 mm broad. Petals broadly elliptic, slightly larger than but otherwise similar to the sepals. Receptacle white-villous. Ovary subglobose, glabrous, attenuate to the short style. Fruit baccate, globose, short-apiculate, greenish, 1.0-1.2 cm diam, many-seeded.

description: Shrub or small tree up to 5.0 m high. Branchlets grayish, glabrous, set with numerous small lenticels. Leaves ovate or ovate-elliptic, rarely elliptic or lanceolate, apex longer or shorter acutely or obtusely subacuminate, base obtuse to rounded, chartaceous to (sub)coriaceous, glabrous, shining on both faces, glandular serrate-crenate or -crenulate, (4.0-)6.0-10.0 cm long, 1.0-2.3 (-4.0) cm broad, the pair of basal nerves rather short, similar to the upper 7-10 (-12) pairs, prominent on both faces as is the (sometimes less obvious) reticulation of veins and veinlets; petiole 1.5-2.0(-3.0) mm long; stipules triangular to lanceolate, ca 1.0 mm long, caducous. Inflorescence (Holdridge 1301) short-racemose or corymbose, 2.0-3.0 cm long, few-flowered; rhachis subglabrous; pedicels rather slender, articulate 2.0-3.0 mm above base, 8.0-10.0 mm long. Sepals 3, ovate, subacuminate, minutely pubescent or often glabrous on both faces, 3.0-3.5 mm long, 2.0-2.5 mm broad. Petals 3, similar to the sepals, yellow. Receptacle glabrous. Ovary ovoid-subglobose, glabrous; style 2.5 mm long. Fruit not known.

description: Shrub or tree 2.0-4.0, sometimes up to 20.0 m tall; trunk rarely up to 50.0 cm diam; bark grayish-brown, rather smooth. Branchlets slender, flexible, tips more or less densely covered with a soft tomentum of pale yellowish to deeply ferrugineous both simple and stellate hairs, extending equally to leaves and inflorescences; older parts of branchlets glabrescent and corticate, lenticels pale, dense, small, oblong. Leaves variable in form, size and density of tomentum, ovate-oblong to lanceolate-elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, apex rather long-acuminate and generally acutish, base cuneate to almost rounded, usually a little unequal, membranaceous when young, chartaceous or rarely subcoriaceous with age, laxly and softly pubescent, often early glabrescent and somewhat shining above, more densely pubescent to tomentose beneath though there too not rarely glabrescent (midrib and nerves excepted), glandular-crenate-serrate (rarely up to 2.0 mm) especially towards the apex of the lamina, (7.0-)9.0-l 1.0(-15.0) cm long, 3.5-5.0(-8.0)-cm broad, 3-nerved from base, with 4 or 5 pairs of upper lateral nerves, all nerves prominent mainly beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets rather dense though little raised beneath, often hardly visible when covered by the tomentum; petiole more or less densely pubescent, (3.0-)5.0-8.0 mm long; stipules subulate, tomentose, 2.0-3.0 mm long, caducous. Panicles terminal, pyramidate, the branches 2- or 3-fold branched, slender, many-flowered, 6.0-9.0(-11.0) cm long, 3.0-5.0 cm wide below, shortly or hardly pedunculate, all over more or less densely yellowish- to rusty-tomentose; pedicels 1.0-2.0(-4.0) mm long; bracts lanceolate-setaceous. Flowers rather small, yellowish-whitish. Sepals 3, ovate, short-acuminate, pubescent on both faces, 1.5-2.0(-3.0) mm long, 1.5-2.0 mm broad. Petals similar to the sepals, bluntish. Receptacle short-pubescent. Ovary ovoid-subglobose; style 1.5 mm long. Fruit subglobular, orange to reddish, 4.0-5.0 mm diam; pericarp thin, a little juicy; seeds 6-8, ovoid, flattened, blackish, longitudinally striate, 2.0 mm long, 1.0 mm broad.

description: Shrub or treelet up to 6.0 m tall. Branchlets slender, tips puberulent, older parts fuscous, glabrous, lenticellate. Leaves lanceolate-oblong or oblong, apex obtusely or subacutely subcaudate-acuminate, base slightly unequal, cuneate to obtuse, firmly membranaceous, glabrous, somewhat shining above, rather coarsely and obtusely glandular-subserrate, 6.5-9.0(-10.0) cm long, 2.0-3.5 cm broad, high-ascending 3-nerved from a little above the base, with 3-4(-5) pairs of upper shorter lateral nerves but slightly raised on both faces, veins numerous, more or less transverse, laxly reticulate and a little prominent as are the veinlets; petiole puberulous or glabrous, 2.0-3.0 mm long; stipules linear, minute, caducous. Panicles terminal, on lateral branchlets, slender, erect, 20-25-flowered (the flowers set in fascicles along rhachis), all over minutely hirtellous to almost glabrous, 5.0-7.0 cm long incl peduncle (1.0-2.0 cm); pedicels 3.0-5.0 mm long; bracts ovate-subulate, hardly 1.0 mm long. Flowers yellowish. Sepals 3 (rarely 4), ovate-oblong, obtusely acuminate, ciliate otherwise glabrous, 2.0 mm long. Petals similar to the sepals, a little larger. Receptacle glabrous. Ovary ovoid, glabrous; style 1.5-2.0 mm long. Fruit ovoid, attenuate to the style, blackish, 7.0-8.0 mm diam; seeds several.

description: Shrub or small tree up to 4.0 m high, horizontally branching. Branchlets slender, tips puberulous, older parts covered with grayish-reddish cork and small roundish lenticels. Leaves ovate to ovate-oblong, apex attenuate or acuminate, subacute to obtuse, base a little unequal and more or less rounded, membranaceous, finely puberulous mainly on midrib and nerves initially, early glabrescent and somewhat glossy on both faces, glandular-crenate-serrate (1.0 mm), 4.5-8.0(-11.0) cm long, 2.0-3.0(-4.0) cm broad, 3- or faintly 5-nerved from base, with 3 or 4 pairs of upper lateral nerves, all prominent beneath, veins more or less transverse, a little raised on both faces, reticulation of veinlets dense though rather inconspicuous; petiole very slender, puberulous, 2.0-3.0 mm long; stipules lanceolate, ca 1.5 mm long, finally caducous. Panicles terminal, not much branched, in general short and rather few-flowered, 2.0-3.0(-5.0) cm long incl peduncle (1.0-1.5 cm), lower branches 0.5-2.0 cm long, all over finely grayish-pubescent; pedicels 3.0-5.0 mm long; bracts very small. Flowers white. Sepals 3, subovate, subacuminate, tomentellous on both faces, ca 3.0 mm long, 2.0 mm broad. Petals 3, similar to the sepals though slightly larger. Receptacle densely short-hairy. Ovary ovoid, glabrous; style ca 1.0 mm long. Fruit globular, blackish-red, 8.0-10.0 mm diam, with several oblongoid-ovoid slightly compressed seeds ca 1.5 mm long.

description: Shrub 3 or more m tall. Branchlets densely hairy to villous with yellowish-whitish spreading hairs. Leaves elliptic-oblong or lanceolate, or broadly elliptic, apex subacutely acuminate, base obtuse to rounded, chartaceous, becoming blackish in the dry state, softly pubescent on both faces initially, glabrescent and ultimately scabrous above, glandular-sinuate-dentate to -crenate, 4.0-12.0 cm long, (1.2-)2.0-5.0 cm broad, with a basal nerve on either side high-ascending and close to the edge, upper lateral nerves 3-5 pairs prominent beneath, veins more or less transverse from the midrib, forming a lax network with the veinlets which is slightly though distinctly raised beneath; petiole rather densely hairy, 4.0-7.0 mm long; stipules filiform, pubescent, persistent for some time, 3.0-4.5 mm long. Flowers solitary or rarely in twos, terminal to lateral branchlets which bear 1 or 2 leaves, or sometimes also in the axil of these leaves, yellow; pedicels articulate at base, robust, densely short-pubescent, 1.5-2.0 cm long. Sepals 3, triangular-ovate or subrhombic-lanceolate, obtusely acuminate, spreading at anthesis, covered with a sordid-whitish tomentum on both faces, 5.0-7.0 mm long, 3.0-4.0 mm broad. Petals 3, ovate, bluntish, the edge set with a few glandular teeth, tomentulose on both faces, 6.0-8.0 mm long, 3.5-5.0 mm broad. Receptacle hairy. Ovary ovoid-subglobose, glabrous; style 6.0-7.0 mm long, minutely 4-lobed. Fruit unknown.

description: Shrub or tree. Branchlets grayish-yellowish-velutinous. Leaves oblong or lanceolate-, rarely elliptic-oblong, apex obtusely attenuate or rounded, base strongly unequal, one side rounded, the other one cuneate, with 1 or 2 thick basal glands, chartaceous, softly tomentulose on both faces, obscurely glandular-serrulate, 4.0-8.0 cm long, 1.5-3.0 cm broad, margin a little revolute, 1 pair of basal nerves ascending to ca 1/3 of the length of the lamina, 6-8 other higher pairs of nerves curved-ascending, all nerves slightly impressed above, strongly raised beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets dense and markedly raised beneath, rather obscure above; petiole slender, densely pubescent, 3.0-5.0 mm long. Panicles from the upper axils, shortly branched below; rhachis stoutish, densely pubescent or tomentellous, up to 8.0 cm long; pedicels articulate at base, almost glabrous, 2.0-3.0 mm long. Sepals 3, ovate-lanceolate, subacuminate, laxly hairy on both faces, ciliate, 2.0 mm long, 1.0 mm broad. Petals 3, similar to the sepals. Receptacle white-hairy. description: Shrub, sometimes scrambling or subcandent with elongate branches, though generally erect, or tree 2.0-5.0, rarely -12.0 m tall, often with strong simple or branched spines on trunk and branches; trunk up to 15.0 cm diam. description: Shrub or tree up to 8.0, occasionally up to 16.0 m high; trunk up to 20.0 cm diam; bark whitish, mottled. description: Shrub or tree, 1.5-12.0 (rarely -25.0) m tall; trunk 10.0-20.0(-40.0) cm diam; bark grayish to light brown. description: Shrub or small tree, occasionally up to 12.0 m high. Branchlets slender, tips puberulent, older parts subangular and early covered with thin gray cork, striate, bearing hardly any lenticels. description: Shrub or small tree, rarely up to 20.0 m high with trunk up to 30.0 cm diam; bark whitish, grayish or dull brown, smooth, coming off in small rectangular pieces. description: Shrub or small tree, sometimes up to 18.0 m tall; trunk up to 40.0 cm diam; bark gray or brownish. description: Shrub or small tree up to 4.0 m high. Branchlets slender, young parts finely pubescent or glabrous, older ones reddish-brownish with scattered small lenticels. description: Shrub or small tree, 1.0-3.0 m high. Branchlets sometimes abbreviate-divaricate and spinescent, puberulous at the young parts, glabrescent and gray-corticate below, lenticels small. description: Shrub or tree, rarely up to 16.0 m high. Branchlets gray puberulous or glabrous, early covered with gray cork and laxly lenticellate. Leaves persistent, oblong, elliptic-oblong or oblanceolate-elliptic, apex rather abruptly subcaudate-acuminate for 1.0-2.0 cm, tip acute, base equilateral, cuneate to the petiole, thin-chartaceous to subcoriaceous, olivaceous and dull in dry specimens, glabrous, though occasionally with laxly hairy domatia in the axils of the lateral nerves with midrib beneath, laxly to densely coarsely pellucid-punctate and -lineate (each dot within an areola formed by the ultimate veinlets), sometimes almost impunctate, obscurely serrate-crenulate or subentire, variable in size, (6.0-)8.0-16.0 (sometimes -22.0) cm long, (2.5-)3.0-6.0 (-7.0, -9.0) cm broad, midrib depressed in its lower part above, lateral nerves (4-)5-6 (rarely -7) pairs arculately high-ascending, excurrent before the margin, veins more or less transverse, slightly raised beneath, reticulation of veinlets a little prominent to almost obscure beneath; petiole slender, glabrous, (6.0-)8.0-10.0 (-12.0, -15.0) mm long; stipules normally subulate, ca 4.0 mm long, caducous, sometimes foliar and persistent, up to 1.0 by 0.5 cm. description: Tree with small crown, 6.0-8.0, sometimes up to 40.0 m tall; trunk up to 1.8 m diam; bark smooth. description: Subshrub, shrub or usually small tree, occasionally up to 15.0 m high; stem up to 12.0 cm diam. Branchlets tawny-tomentellous, finely striate, lenticels sparse or absent. Leaves oblong, sometimes ovate- or lanceolate-oblong, maybe elliptic (such of specimens growing in dry places), apex shortly to longish obtusely or acutely acuminate, rarely obtuse, base generally subinequilateral, attenuate to obtuse on both sides, or rounded on one side only, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, obscurely pellucid-punctate, markedly discolorous in dry specimens, the upper surface glabrous (midrib excepted) and shining, dark green when fresh, brown when dry, the undersurface dull, persistently tawny-tomentellous, crenulate-serrulate, rarely sharply serrate, (4.0-)6.0-10.0(-14.0) cm long, (1.5-)2.0-3.0(-4.5) cm broad, lateral nerves 6-10(-12) pairs, curved-ascending, rather obscure above, prominent beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets dense, raised beneath though generally obscured by the tawny tomentum initially, becoming more visible with age; petiole tomentellous, (2.0-)3.0-5.0 mm long; stipules linear-lanceolate, 6.0-10.0 mm long, fugacious. description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5-6.0(-20.0) m tall, unarmed; trunk up to 30.0 cm diam; bark smooth, greenish-yellowish, inner part exuding a sticky yellow slime. Branches few, elongate. description: Unarmed shrub or tree 2.5-4.0, rarely up to 8.0 m tall; trunk slender. Branchlets rusty-tomentose at tips, glabrescent below and early grayish-brownish-corticate; lenticels elongate. Calyx-lobes broadly oblong, obtuse, laxly to densely hairy dorsally, 4.0-5.0 mm long, 2.5 mm broad. Stamens 8, subequilong; filaments subglabrous, 2.5 mm long. description: Spreading bush or tree up to 6.0 m tall; stem up to 10.0 cm diam. Branchlets densely hairy at young parts, grayish-corticate and rather laxly lenticellate below. Leaves subpersistent, oblong to obovate-oblong in outline, apex trun-cate-emarginate tipped by 2 spines or almost rounded, base truncate or truncate-cordate, coriaceous, tomentellous on both faces initially, glabrous and shining above with age, persistently gray-tomentulose and soft to the touch beneath, subdensely pellucid-punctate and -lineate initially, practically impunc-tate with age, margin strongly sinuate, spinose, the 10-13 lateral spines and ultimate leaf-margins cartilagineous, (4.0-)5.5-7.0(-10.0) cm long, 2.5-4.0(-6.0) cm broad, lateral nerves 6-9 pairs arcuate, anastomosing before the margin with strong branch-veins running into the spines, reticulation of veins and veinlets dense, slightly though distinctly raised on both faces, more or less obscured beneath by the indumentum; petiole densely hairy, 2.0-4.0 mm long; stipules acicular, pubescent, caducous. Flowers 6-8 per axillary sessile fascicle from defoliate nodes; bracts ovate-acuminate, hairy; pedicels articulate a little above base, pubescent, 3.0-6.0 mm long. Stamens 8, subequilong; filaments united below with the disk-lobes for ca 1.5 mm, free part sparsely hairy, ca 2.0 mm long; anthers eglandular, 1.0 mm long. Disk-lobes linear as long as filaments, subglabrous or sparsely pubescent. Ovary globose, glabrous below, laxly short-hairy above middle; style sparsely hairy, 2.5-3.0 mm long; stigma capitate. Fruit baccate, depressed-globose, somewhat obtusely 3-angular in dry state, yellow-orange, ca 1.0 cm diam, splitting along 3 lines; pericarp coriaceous, thin; seeds 4-8, yellow, in a red pulp, ca 2.5 mm long.

description: Shrub or tree, 1.0-10.0 (rarely -15.0) m tall; trunk up to 12.0 cm diam; bark grayish-whitish to brownish. Flowers similar to those of C. commersoniana, white to greenish, mostly numerous (up to 60) per axillary sessile fascicle, these with many scarious small bracts; pedicels slender, appressedly gray-pubescent, (3.0-)4.0-7.0(-10.0) mm long at anthesis, not or hardly accrescent. Sepals 4 or 5, oblong, subacuminate or obtuse, gray-tomentellous on both faces, 3.0-4.0(-5.0) mm long, 2.0(-3.0) mm broad, not or hardly accrescent, generally reflexed at early anthesis though sometimes remaining erect for some time. Capsule ovoid-subglobose, shortly brownish-purplish-tomentulose besides some appressed long pale hairs outside, spongiously so inside, 0.8-1.4 cm diam, splitting to 3 naviculate subacute coriaceous valves; seeds 1 or 2 (rarely 3), subglobular, laxly to densely hairy, 3.0-4.0(-5.0) mm long; aril white, thin; testa finely foveolate.

description: Shrub or tree 3.0-8.0(-12.0) m tall; trunk up to 25.0 cm diam. description: Tree. Branchlets slender, tips puberulent, older parts early gray- to whitish-corticate and densely lenticellate. Leaves oblong to elliptic or subobovate-oblong, apex gradually attenuate or subacuminate, tip obtuse, base broadly attenuate, glabrous, brown and dull when dry, firmly chartaceous to subcoriaceous, with rather few pellucid points (hardly lines) visible against strong light, i e practically impunctate, laxly remotely serrulate-denticulate or subentire, 3.0-5.0(-6.0) cm long, 2.5-3.5 cm broad, lateral nerves (4-)5-6(-7) rather irregular pairs more or less distinctly looping before the margin, slightly prominent on both faces, reticulation of veins and veinlets dense, finely raised on both faces though mainly beneath; petiole slender, puberulous initially, 2.0-3.0 mm long; stipules linear-subulate, rather stiff, puberulous, 2.0-3.0(-4.0) mm long, caducous. Flowers 15-20 umbellately from a sessile or very shortly pedunculate axillary cup formed by the fusion of outer scarious rather hard bracts; inner bracts much thinner, squamiform, more or less free, minute, glabrous; pedicels filiform, thickened distally, articulate just above base, glabrous, (4.0-)6.0-8.0(-10.0) mm long. Sepals 5, oblong, obtuse, membranous, glabrous, 2.0(-2.5) mm long. Stamens 8 or 10, alternately a little inequilong, filiform, glabrous, 2.0-3.0 mm long; anthers subglobose, eglandular, ca 0.3 mm diam. Capsule pyriform, ca 3.5 mm long, 3-valved, subcoriaceous, reticulate-venose, subtended by the slightly accrescent sepals; seeds 3, ovoid, apiculate, 1.8 mm long; testa fuscous, scrobiculate, covered with longish fuscous cottony wool.

description: Shrub or tree 3.0-10.0 (rarely -30.0) m tall; trunk occasionally up to 60.0 cm diam; bark grayish-brownish, smooth. description: Tree up to 20.0 m tall; trunk up to 30.0 cm diam; bark smooth, gray. Branchlets glabrous, subterete, early gray-corticate. description: Arborescent shrub or tree up to 10.0 m high; trunk up to 20.0 cm diam. Branchlets glabrous, older parts red-brown, striate lengthwise and densely set with minute oblong lenticels. Leaves deciduous or subpersistent, elliptic to ovate-elliptic, apex short-acuminate, tip obtuse, base slightly unequal, broadly attenuate to the petiole, or one side obtuse, pergamaceous initially, becoming coriaceous at full age, glabrous, shining on both faces, yellowish-greenish when dry, edge a little recurved, subentire, densely pellucid-punctate and -lineate, 14.0-17.0 cm long, 6.0-8.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 5-7 pairs moderately curved-ascending, prominent on both faces as is the rather dense reticulation of the more or less transverse veins with the veinlets; petiole ca 1.0 cm long; stipules oblong-lanceolate, ca 5.0 mm long, caducous. description: Tree ca 7.0 m high, with umbrella-shaped crown. Branchlets glabrous, ultimate buds glutinous, older parts striate-corticate and sparsely lenticellate. description: Shrub 0.5-2.0 m tall, stem or branches slender, covered with gray cork cracked quadrangularly. Branchlets zig-zag, glabrous, smooth, early corticate. description: Shrub or tree, 2.0-5.0(-10.0, very rarely -30.0) m tall; trunk often branching from base; bark grayish or light brown, smooth. description: Arbor 15.0 m alta, trunco 20.0 cm diam. description: Unarmed shrub or tree, (2.5-)4.0-8.0, rarely up to 18.0 m high; trunk up to 10.0 cm diam. Branchlets subangular, laxly to subdensely hairy at tips, older parts early brownish-corticate, laxly lenticellate. Leaves oblong to subovate-oblong, apex subcuspidate-acuminate for 1.0-2.0 cm, base slightly unequal, attenuate, initially membranaceous, (sub)coriaceous with age, shining above, with sparse appressed hairs on midrib and lateral nerves, rarely also on the intervenium beneath, glabrescent, finally quite glabrous, remotely rather obscurely spinulose-serrate or subentire, rather densely pellucid-punctate and -lineate, (8.0-)10.0-20.0(-30.0) cm long, (3.5-)5.0-6.0(-9.0, -12.0) cm broad, lateral nerves 7-9(-10) pairs curved-ascending, the upper pairs only inarching before the margin, slightly prominent above, strongly so beneath, veins transverse, subparallel to each other, slightly to markedly raised on both faces, as is the reticulation of veins and veinlets; petiole laxly to subdensely hairy initially, glabrescent, (3.0-)4.0-8.0(-10.0) mm long; stipules subulate, sericeous to hirsutulous, 2.0-4.0 mm long, caducous. Fascicles of 4-6 flowers axillary, sessile; bracts ovate to narrowly so, dorsally hairy, ciliate, ca 1.0 mm long; pedicels articulate a little above base, laxly pubescent, (2.0-)3.0-5.0(-7.0) mm long. Sepals 4 or 5, ovate-oblong or oblong, obtuse, greenish-white, laxly hairy outside, more densely appressedly hairy inside, (4.0-)5.0-6.0(-7.0) mm long, 2.0-2.5 mm broad. Stamens 8; filaments filiform, connate with the disk-lobes at base and pubescent there, otherwise glabrous, alternately 3.0 and 3.5 mm long; anthers oblong, not apiculate, hardly 1.0 mm long. Disk-lobes thick-clavate, penicillate mainly distally, 1.0-1.5 mm long. Ovary narrowly ovoid, more or less densely appressedly long-hairy except the very base, attenuate to a short subglabrous style; stigma capitate. Fruit subovoid-oblongoid to ellipsoid, slightly obtusely 3-gonous, apiculate, laxly pubescent mainly at apex, dark red to blackish at maturity, shining, 2.0-2.5 cm long, 1.3-1.8 cm diam; pericarp subcoriaceous; seeds 6-10, obovoid-angular, red-brown, ca 6.0 mm long; testa impressed-punctulate.
bibliographicCitation: Sleumer, Hermann O. 1980. Flacourtiaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 22: 1-499.

description: Tree, 3.0-5.0 m high. Branchlets fuscous-tomentellous at the young parts. Leaves broadly lanceolate to elliptic-oblong, generally widest in the middle, apex acuminate for 1.5-2.0 cm, base slightly inequilateral, attenuate to the petiole, membranaceous to thin-chartaceous, becoming brownish-blackish when dry, subglabrous above except the pubescent midrib and lateral nerves, softly fuscous-ferrugineous-tomentose beneath, indistinctly or not pellucid-punctate and -lineate, subserrate (0.5 mm), 15.0-20.0 cm long, 6.0-8.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 10(-12) pairs curved-ascending, slightly or hardly impressed above, raised beneath, veins transverse, slightly prominent beneath, reticulation of veinlets rather inconspicuous beneath; petiole fuscous-ferrugineous-tomentose, 3.0-4.0 mm long, ca 2.5 mm thick; stipules not observed. Fascicles axillary, 10-15-flowered, glomerulate; bracts ovate, obtuse, membranaceous, pubescent, 1.0-1.5 mm long; pedicels articulate about middle, pubescent, 1.5-2.0 mm long at anthesis, ca 3.0 mm long in fruit. Sepals 5, ovate-oblong, obtuse, connate at base, greenish-yellowish though nigrescent in dry specimens, fuscous-tomentulose outside, tomentellous inside, ca 4.0 mm long, 1.6-1.8 mm broad. Stamens 10, alternately inequilong; filaments pubescent, 1.5-2.0 mm long; anthers subglobose, eglandular, glabrous or rarely with one or two erect apical hairs, 0.5 mm diam. Disk-lobes narrowly clavate, densely hairy, ca 1.5 mm long. Ovary ovoid, white-tomentose, attenuate to the 2.0 mm long glabrescent style; stigma capitate. Immature fruit globular, shortly yellowish-tomentose, smooth.

description: Shrub ca 5.0 m high. Branchlets sparsely fuscous-pubescent. Leaves oblong-ovate or broadly oblong, apex short-attenuate, tip bluntish, base rounded, membranaceous to thin-chartaceous, becoming brownish-blackish when dry, glabrous except the base of the depressed midrib above, fuscous-tomentulose all over the undersurface, more densely so at midrib and lateral nerves, denticulate or subentire, sparsely pellucid-punctate and -lineate against strong light, 8.5-16.0 cm long, 4.0-7.5 cm broad, lateral nerves 4-6(-7) pairs arcuate-ascending, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets rather lax, slightly raised beneath, obscured there by the tomentum; petiole tomentulose, ca 2.0 mm long; stipules not observed. Fascicles axillary, 15-20-flowered; basal bracts few, very small; pedicels articulate just above base, slender, almost filiform, puberulous, 6.0-7.0 mm long. Sepals 5, ovate-oblong, obtuse, slightly connate at base, reddish- or yellowish-tomentellous on both faces, erect, (3.0-)4.0 mm long, 1.2-1.5 mm broad. Stamens 10, subequilong; filaments glabrous, ca 2.0 mm long; anthers globose, eglandular, 0.5 mm long. Disk-lobes linear-spathulate, villous, ca 1.0 mm long. Ovary ovoid, attenuate to the style (1.0 mm), all over pubescent; stigma capitate. Fruit not known.

description: Much branched shrub or small tree, 2.0-6.0 m high. Branchlets slender, tips glabrous, brownish-reddish, early covered with gray cork and numerous elongate lenticels below. Leaves semi-deciduous, flush reddish, ovate to ovate-elliptic, rarely oblong-elliptic, apex shortly and bluntly subacuminate, rarely attenuate or obtuse, base generally more or less deeply cordate, or rarely rounded, subcoriaceous to coriaceous, glabrous and shining on both faces, the pellucid dots (no lines !) somewhat raised in young blades, edge subserrate-crenate to subentire, (1.5-)3.0-7.0(-10.0) cm long, (1.0-)2.0-4.5 cm broad, lateral nerves 5-8 pairs, slightly raised on both faces as is the dense fine reticulation of veins and veinlets; petiole 6.0-8.0(-13.0) mm long; stipule ovate to almost rounded, membranaceous, ca 1.0 mm long, caducous. Cymes axillary, (2-)6-12-flowered, glabrous in all outer parts, on peduncle 3.0-10.0 mm long; pedicels slender, 3.0-5.0(-10.0) mm long; bracts minute. Flowers fragrant, yellowish or greenish-white. Sepals oblong-obovate, obtuse, erect, though somewhat reflexed in late anthesis, puberulous within, 4.0-5.0 mm long, 2.0 mm broad. Stamens 8, slightly shorter than the sepals; filaments laxly hairy below; anthers elliptic, dark red, 0.5 mm long. Disk-lobes clavate, laxly hairy distally, light red, of half the length of the filaments. Ovary narrowly ovoid, tapering to the thick style, subglabrous; stigma capitate. Fruit ellipsoid or subglobose, first fleshy and drupaceous, later dehiscent to 3 or 4 valves, 3-4-gonous, pale purplish or yellow when ripe, 1.5-2.0 cm diam; seeds 1-5, ovoid-angular, almost enclosed by the orange irregularly incised aril.

description: Shrub or treelet, rarely tree up to 20.0 m tall; trunk up to 50.0 cm diam. Branchlets slender, flexuous, tips puberulent or glabrous, older parts grayish-or brownish-corticate, sparsely lenticellate. Leaves variable in shape and size, lanceolate to ovate-oblong, apex oblique or falcately subacutely acuminate, base very inequilateral, attenuate or almost rounded, or one side broadly attenuate and the other more or less rounded, firmly membranaceous or thin-chartaceous, occasionally subcoriaceous, generally glabrous though rarely somewhat short-pubescent mainly on midrib and nerves beneath, shining above, densely pellucid-punctate and -lineate, rarely more laxly so at least in the marginal part of the lamina, glandular-serrate-dentate, (3.0-)5.0-8.0(-10.0) cm long, 1.5-3.5(-4.0) cm broad, subtriplinerved from base, with 2-4(-6) pairs of upwardly curved and high-ascending lateral nerves prominent on both faces though mainly beneath as is the rather dense reticulation of veins and veinlets to a minor degree; petiole slender, (4.0-)6.0-8.0 mm long; stipules lanceolate, minute, caducous. Flowers 20-40 per axillary sessile or shortly pedunculate umbel-like fascicle; bracts scarious, squamiform, puberulent, 0.5-1.0 mm long, very numerous, forming a subglobular cushion 1.0-2.0 mm diam; pedicels articulate 1.0-2.5 mm above base, slender, sparsely pubescent, (3.0-)4.0-7.0 mm long. Sepals 5, ovate-suborbicular, erect-patent, whitish, yellowish or reddish, glabrous or puberulous, 1.0-1.5(-2.0) mm long. Stamens 10, alternately longer by the length of an anther; filaments setaceous, glabrous, 1.5(-2.0) mm long; anthers subglobose, minute, eglandular. Disk-lobes spathulate-oblong, (very) much shorter than filaments, white-tomentulose or -barbate. Ovary oblongoid, subtrigonous, glabrous or laxly hairy distally, attenuate to the cylindric 3-fid style; stigmas subcapitate, reflexed. Capsule ellipsoid, 6-angular, subtended by the appressed sepals, 3.0-5.0 mm long, splitting into 3 thin-coriaceous valves; seeds 1 to few, oblongoid-ovoid, apiculate, 1.0-1.5 mm long; testa reticulate-foveolate, hairy; aril divided into long-filiform feather-like laciniae.
bibliographicCitation: Sleumer, Hermann O. 1980. Flacourtiaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 22: 1-499.

description: Shrub or treelet up to 8.0 m high; trunk and branches armed as in C. aculeata. Branchlets generally without spines, slender, tips (sub)glabrous, brownish, older parts grayish-corticate, with minute pale lenticels. Leaves oblong to elliptic-oblong, apex more or less caudate-acuminate, tip acute or bluntish, base cuneate to the petiole, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, glabrous, brownish-yellowish when dry, shining on both faces, pellucid-punctate and -lineate, repand-serrate to subentire, margin a little revolute, 8.0-14.0(-18.0) cm long, (2.5-)3.0-5.0(-7.0) cm broad, lateral nerves 6-9 (rarely -12) pairs, curved-ascending, slightly prominent above, more distinctly so beneath, reticulation of transverse veins and veinlets dense, markedly raised on both faces; petiole 6.0-10.0 mm long; stipules lanceolate-subulate, glabrous, 2.0(-3.0) mm long, caducous. Inflorescence as in aculeata though few-flowered in general, and basal bracts, pedicels and sepals less densely hairy; pedicels 5.0-10.0 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid, 3-gonous, laxly hairy, 1.0-1.3 cm long; seeds 36; testa foveolate.

description: Shrub or tree up to 10.0 m tall; trunk up to 12.0 cm diam. Branchlets very slender, young parts softly patently brownish-yellowish-hirsutulous, older ones verruculose with roundish lenticels. Leaves elliptic- to oblong-obovate, sometimes oblong, apex shortly to subcaudately or subcuspidately acuminate, tip acutish or bluntish, base attenuate to obtuse, membranaceous to thin-chartaceous, rather densely pellucid-punctate and -lineate, olivaceous to brownish in dry specimens, laxly hairy at midrib and nerves above, densely and softly patently tomentulose all over the undersurface, or at least remaining so on midrib and lateral nerves in age beneath, minutely serrate to subentire, (6.0-)8.0-14.0(-15.0) cm long, 3.0-6.0(-7.5) cm broad, lateral nerves 5-6(-7) pairs, arcuate, subimpressed or flat above, prominent beneath, veins more or less transverse, (very) slightly raised as is the reticulation of veinlets; petiole slender, hirsutulous, 2.0-3.0 mm long; stipules subulate, tomentulose, 2.0-3.0 mm long, caducous. Fascicles from defoliate nodes, many-flowered; bracts ovate, acuminate, scarious, subglabrous, 1.0(-1.5) mm long; pedicels very slender, articulate at middle, pubescent, 2.0(-3.0) mm long. Sepals 5, oblong-lanceolate, remaining erect at anthesis, connate and attenuate below into a kind of tube for 1.0 mm, gray-tomentellous, 3.0(-4.0) mm long, 1.0 mm broad. Stamens 10, alternately inequilong; filaments glabrous, ca 1.5 mm long; anthers elliptic-cordate, glabrous, eglandular, 0.5 mm long. Disk-lobes spathulate-oblong, barbate, ca 1.0 mm long. Ovary ovoid, included in the tube formed by the sepals, glabrous though hairy at the short style; stigma capitate. Capsule (Berlin 322, Kayap 1122) globose, glabrous, yellow-orange, minutely tuberculate, 3.0-5.0 cm diam; pericarp coriaceous, fibrose-lignescent, 2.0-3.0 mm thick; seeds ca 10, obliquely ovoid-angular, 1.0-1.4 cm long, with yellow translucent sweet aril.
bibliographicCitation: Sleumer, Hermann O. 1980. Flacourtiaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 22: 1-499.

description: Shrub or small tree, up to 6.0 m tall, apparently unarmed. Branchlets slender, rusty-velutinous (with erect hairs) in the young parts. Leaves obovate or elliptic-, sometimes oblong-obovate, apex shortly obtusely attenuate, rarely subacuminate, often obtuse to rounded, base slightly unequal, broadly attenuate to rounded, chartaceous, initially pale ferrugineous-tomentulose or -velutinous and soft to the touch on both faces, glabrescent except midrib and lateral nerves above with age, remaining tomentulose or velutinous beneath, laxly pellucid-punctate and -lineolate, rather irregularly and more or less obtusely subserrate-crenate, 5.0-8.0(-10.0) cm long, 2.5-5.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 4-5 pairs (the lower 2 or 3 ones rather steeply ascending) prominent beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets dense and slightly raised above, rather obscured beneath by the tomentum; petiole velutinous, 6.0-8.0(-10.0) mm long; stipules deltoid-ovoid, acute, ca 2.0 mm long, caducous. Fascicles axillary, 5-10-flowered; basal bracts ovate, thin, brownish-reddish, sericeous dorsally, ca 1.5	mm long; pedicels articulate more or less halfway, densely hairy, or maybe glabrescent above the articulation, 3.0-5.0 mm long at anthesis, up to 8.0 mm long in fruit. Sepals 5, oblong, obtuse, greenish, densely appressed-ferru-gineous-pubescent outside, whitish so inside, 3.0-4.0(-5.0) mm long, 2.0-2.5 mm broad. Stamens 8, subequilong; filaments glabrous, ca 1.8 mm long; anthers oblong, apex glandless. Disk-lobes linear-spathulate, villous, 1.0 mm long. Ovary narrowly ovoid, laxly hairy except the attenuate distal part or style; stigma capitate. Fruit subglobose, subtrigonous, red, laxly hairy, 6.0-8.0 mm diam; seeds few, angular-ovoid, 2.5 mm long; testa striate-foveolate.

description: Shrub 0.3-1.5 (rarely -4.0) m tall, of irregular growth; stem slender, bark gray or blackish, verruculose, thick, quadrangulare fissured. Branchlets patently puberulent at tips, older parts dark brown to blackish, with scattered elongate-oblong lenticels. Leaves persistent, subimbricately arranged, oblong to elliptic in outline, Ilex-like, apex truncate with a short mucro, base obtuse, (sub)coriaceous, crisp when dry, glabrous, grayish- to brownish-green when dry, shining above, subdensely pellucid-punctate when young, practically impunctate with age, sinuate-dentate with 3-5 (rarely -7) spiny teeth (1.0-3.0 mm) on either side of the lamina, 1.0-1.5 (-2.0, -3.0) cm long, 0.6-1.0(-2.0) cm broad, lateral nerves ca 5 pairs slightly raised mainly above, reticulation of veins and veinlets very dense, finely prominent on both faces, generally more obvious above; petiole 1.0-1.5 mm long; stipules narrow-triangular, 1.5 mm long, caducous. Flowers 1-3 per fascicle from foliate axils, the fascicles sessile or on a very short peduncle; bracts ovate, chartaceous, pubescent dorsally, ca 0.5 mm long, covering the peduncle if any; pedicels slender, articulate 1.0 mm above base, 5.0-10.0 mm long. Sepals 5, oblong-obovate, pinkish-reddish, puberulent on both faces, 3.0-4.0 mm long, 1.7 mm broad, slightly connate at base. Stamens 7-9, equilong; filaments fused with the disk-lobes below for ca 1.0 mm, free for 1.5 mm, puberulous; anthers oblong, not gland-apiculate, 0.6 mm long. Disk-lobes linear-attenuate, practically glabrous, ca 1.5 mm long. Ovary ovoid, glabrous, tapering to the style (1.0 mm); stigma capitate. Fruit capsular, globose, dull purple outside, yellow inside, 5.0-7.0 mm diam; seeds few, ca 2.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Sleumer, Hermann O. 1980. Flacourtiaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 22: 1-499.

description: Arbor 10.0-15.0 m alta, trunco usque ad 70.0 cm diam. Ramuli in partibus juvenilibus laxe patenter pilosi, deorsum citissime glabrati et corti-cati, cortice longitudinaliter fisso rubescente lenticellis anguste ellipticis dense obtecto tactuque rugosulo. Folia persistentia, elliptico-oblonga, apice breviter acuminata, ipso apice obtusiuscula, basi in petiolum angustata, chartacea, glabra, in sicco olivaceo-virentia, subtus pallidiora, in parte marginali laminae sparse pellucido-punctata, ceterum impunctata, superne distanter glanduloso-serrato-dentata (0.5-1.0 mm), inferne subintegra, subtus ad axillas costae cum nervis lateralibus subvilloso-domatiigera, (3.5-)4.0-7.5 cm longa, 2.0-2.5(-3.0) cm lata, nervis lateralibus (4-)5-paribus inferioribus alte ascendentibus, su-perioribus breviter arcuatis, omnibus supra paullo, subtus distinctius elevatis, reticulatione venarum venularumque subdensa subtus tantum prominula; Petioli laxe breviter pubescentes vel glabri, 4.0-5.0(-6.0) mm longi, fere 1.0 mm crassi; stipulae haud observatae. Fasciculi in axillis foliorum 5-8(-10)-flori; bracteae subrotundae, tenues, scariosae, dorso tomentellae, ca. 1.5 mm diam.; pedicelli paullo supra basin articulati, sat graciles, albido-tomentelli, sub anthesi 4.0-5.0(-6.0) mm longi. Sepala 5 basi paullo connata, anguste oblonga, obtusa, erecta, in vivo cremeo-virescentia, utrinque tomentella, 5.0-6.0 mm longa, 1.5(-2.0) mm lata. Stamina 10 inaequilonga; filamenta glabra, alternatim 2.5-3.0 et 3.5-4.0 mm longa; antherae subglobosae, eglandulosae, glabrae, ca 1.0 mm longae. Disci lobi clavati, breviter tomentosae, 2.0 mm longae. Ovarium elongato-ovoideum, inferne per 1.5 mm glabrum, superne in stylum 1.5 mm longum attenuatum denseque albopilosum; stigma capitatum. Fructus adhuc incognitus, probabiliter glaber.
bibliographicCitation: Sleumer, Hermann O. 1980. Flacourtiaceae. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 22: 1-499.

description: Shrub or small tree up to 6.0 m tall. Branchlets slender, flexuous, tips laxly pubescent, older parts gray-corticate, lenticels rather sparse. Leaves persistent, oblong or lanceolate-oblong or -elliptic, apex acuminate for 1.5-2.0 cm, tip acute, base more or less broadly attenuate to the petiole, thin-chartaceous to subcoriaceous, dark brown and dull when dry, paler beneath, pubescent or puberulent beneath initially, early glabrescent and finally practically glabrous, slightly revolute at margin, remotely repand-denticulate or subentire, rather laxly pellucid-punctate and -lineate or sometimes almost impunctate, 6.0-12.0 cm long, 2.0-4.5(-5.5) cm broad, lateral nerves 3-5 pairs arcuately ascending, the lowest pair more steeply so, slightly raised beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets inconspicuous; petiole puberulent initially, 3.0-5.0 (rarely -10.0) mm long; stipules lanceolate-subulate, puberulent, 2.0-3.0 mm long, caducous or rarely persistent for some time. Fascicles axillary, 2-5-flowered; bracts broadly ovate, subacuminate, scarious, tomentellous, 1.0-2.0 mm long, forming a small cushion; pedicels articulate a little above base, tomentellous, 2.0-5.0 mm long. Sepals 5, ovate-oblong, obtuse, patently erect at anthesis, slightly connate at base, tomentellous on both faces, dark when dry except the much paler edge, white to greenish, 4.0-5.0(-6.0) mm long, 1.5-2.0 mm broad. Stamens 10, alternately slightly inequilong; filaments glabrous, 2.0-2.5 mm long; anthers broadly elliptic, eglandular, 0.5 mm long. Disk-lobes linear-oblong, white-tomentose, 1.3 mm long. Ovary ovoid-subglobose, hispidulous-villous; style short (0.5 mm); stigma capitate. Capsule subglobose, apiculate, with 3 ribs, sparsely hairy, (2.0-)2.5-3.0 cm diam, valves coriaceous, provided with a yellowish membrane inside; seeds 6-12, ovoid-trigonous, smooth, ca 1.0 cm long.

description: Shrub or tree up to 6.0 (rarely -25.0) m tall; trunk up to 60.0 cm diam; bark whitish to grayish, greenish, or pale brown, smooth. Branchlets slender, tips striate, glabrous or sparsely pubescent, older parts early gray-corticate and set with numerous small pustular lenticels. Leaves subpersistent, elliptic-oblong, sometimes obovately so, apex rather suddenly and acutely acuminate for 1.5-2.0 cm, base a little or hardly asymmetrical, cuneate, the very base contracted to the petiole, firmly membranaceous to chartaceous, finally sometimes subcoriaceous, shining, dark brown to blackish when dry, glabrous or occasionally with spreading hairs on midrib and lateral nerves beneath, rather laxly pellucid-punctate and -lineate, depressedly serrate, crenate or subentire, 10.0-17.0(-22.0) cm long, (2.5-)3.0-6.0(-8.0, -12.0) cm broad, often partly much smaller in a given specimen, lateral nerves (4-)5-6(-8) pairs curved-ascending, slightly raised above, much more distinctly so beneath, reticulation of the more or less transverse veins and the veinlets rather lax, finely prominent on both faces; petiole glabrous, 3.0-5.0(-7.0) mm long; stipules linear-subulate, ca 2.0 mm long, caducous. Inflorescence at foliate or not rarely already defoliate axils, fascicled, 10-20-flowered, all over gray-puberulous; bracts suborbicular, thin, fuscus, minute, hardly forming a proper cushion; pedicels articulate at middle, (2.0-)3.0-5.0(-6.0) mm long. Flowers whitish-greenish. Sepals oblong, subacuminate, more densely puberulous along margin, remaining erect at anthesis, 4.0-5.0(-6.0) mm long, 1.0-2.0 mm broad. Stamens 10 (rarely 12), slightly inequilong; filaments hairy, 1.5-2.0 mm long; anthers subglobular, provided with a thick apical gland and barbate by a tuft of rather numerous (sub)erect longish white hairs or setae. Disk-lobes linear-clavate, villous distally, ca 1.0 mm long. Ovary generally glabrous at base, white-hairy towards the base of the style, rarely completely hairy; stigma capitate. Fruit globular, apiculate, smooth or all over finely (rarely coarsely) tubercled, dark green to green-yellow or orange at full maturity, glabrous except the densely hairy apiculus, 2.0(-3.0) cm diam, tardily splitting along 3 marked vertical impressed lines; pericarp coriaceous to lignescent, 1.0-2.0(-3.0 mm thick; seeds few to ca 20, irregularly flattened or subtetrahedric, smooth, 1.0-2.0 cm long, conglutinating; aril white, transparent.

description: Shrub or generally small to medium-sized tree, rarely up to 20.0 m high; trunk up to 40.0 cm diam; bark flaky, gray, ca 5.0 mm thick. Branchlets slender, tips puberulent or glabrous, early whitish-grayish-corticate, lenticels small, numerous. Leaves ovate to ovate-oblong, often inequilateral, apex subacuminate, tip acute or blunt, base broadly cuneate to rounded, (thin-chartaceous, glabrous except for some fugacious hairs on midrib beneath, minutely pellucid-punctate when young, practically impunctate with age, brown when dry, a little shining above, glandular-serrate-crenulate, 4.0-7.0 cm long, 2.0-3.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 6-7 pairs rather irregular, slightly prominent on both faces though mainly beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets dense, finely raised on both faces; petiole (3.0-)5.0-6.0 mm long; stipules lanceolate-linear, membranous, 1.5-2.5 mm long, caducous. description: Shrub or tree, occasionally up to 30.0 m high; trunk 8.0-20.0, rarely up to 100.0 cm diam; bark gray. description: Treelet or tree 3.0-10.0, rarely up to 20.0 m high; trunk up to 35.0 cm diam, sometimes provided with small buttresses; bark pale gray to purplish-brown. description: Shrub or tree 2.0-8.0 m high, glabrous in all parts. Branchlets slender, striately corticate, laxly set with small pale lenticels. description: Shrub or tree. Branchlets 3.0-5.0 mm diam, terete, young parts covered with a brownish-ferrugineous soft tomentum. description: Shrub or tree, (0.6-)2.0-6.0(-10.0) m tall. Branchlets divaricate, glabrous even at tips, older parts gray-corticate and verruculose with small oblong lenticels. description: Shrub or small tree up to 10 m tall, quite glabrous, of a pyramidal habit; trunk up to 8 cm diam; bark gray to blackish, fissured lengthwise. description: Shrub or tree 3.0-10.0, sometimes up to 25.0 m tall; trunk up to 65.0 cm diam; bark gray, rather smooth. description: Tree up to 20.0 m tall; trunk up to 30.0 cm diam. Branchlets grayish-corticate on the older, sparsely pubescent on the youngest parts. description: Erect shrub or tree (2.0-)6.0-10.0 m high; trunk up to 20.0 cm diam. description: Shrub or small tree up to 20.0 m tall, trunk up to 1.2 m diam, sometimes provided with buttresses; bark sordid gray. Inflorescences axillary and subterminal, spikelike and simple in general, though sometimes shortly (up to 4 cm) branched or paniculate in their lower part, flexuous-pendent, loosely flowered, all over gray-puberulous, the slender rhachis 6-17 cm long. description: Slender tree up to 20 m high; trunk up to 60 cm in diam; bark thin, light gray or brownish. Branchlets puberulous at tips, older parts glabrous, dotted with whitish lenticels. Leaves elliptic, sometimes subovate-, oblong- or obovate-elliptic, apex short-acuminate or often obtuse, rarely a little retuse, base broadly cuneate to rounded, thin-chartaceous, sometimes tomentellous or velutinous on both faces initially, in general sparsely hairy at midrib above, or puberulous on the lateral nerves beneath, or glabrous on both faces, except for the barbellate axils of the lateral nerves with the midrib on the undersurface, coarsely subserrate-crenate tarepand-crenate, 5-12 cm long, 3.0-4.5 cm broad, lateral nerves 6-8(-9) pairs, prominent beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets dense, finely raised on both faces; petiole slender, laxly hairy, 4-8 mm long. Sepals ovate to ovate-lanceolate, subacute, gray-tomentellous and ciliolate, 3.5-4.0 mm long, ca 1.5 mm broad. Petals ovate, obtuse, gray-tomentellous and ciliolate, 4.0-5.0(-5.5) mm long, 2.0-2.5 mm broad. Glands tomentulose. Stamens (4-)5-7(-8) per fascicle; filaments usually hairy up to the middle. Free part of ovary tomentose to villous; styles 3, distinct or forming a very short hairy column below. Capsule as in H. racemosum.

description: Shrub or tree up to 10.0 m tall; trunk up to 20.0 cm diam; bark brittle, yellowish-gray, finely fissured. Leaves subpersistent or deciduous, oblong to elliptic, rarely ovate-oblong or -elliptic, not rarely variable in form and size on the same specimens, apex broadly attenuate, obtuse, not rarely rounded, rarely shortly subacuminate, occasionally retuse, base obtuse-truncate, sometimes subcordate, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, glabrous or fugaciously, rarely more persistently soft-pubescent mainly beneath, laxly to densely pellucid-punctate and -lineate, minutely to more distinctly glandular-serrulate, 3.0-7.0(-10) cm long, 1.5-3.0(-4) cm broad, lateral nerves (8-)10-12(-14) pairs prominent beneath, veins more or less transverse, laxly reticulate with the veinlets, raised on both faces though mainly above in fully mature leaves; petiole slender, puberulous, (2.0-)3.0-6.0 mm long; stipules lanceolate, hardly 2.0 mm long, fugacious. description: Shrub or small tree 1.0-4.0 m tall. Branchlets slender, tips finely striate, subglabrous, older parts grayish-blackish-corticate and fissured lengthwise. Leaves ovate- to lanceolate-oblong, rarely ovate-elliptic, apex rather gradually attenuate or sometimes shortly acuminate, tip bluntish, base broadly attenuate to rounded, very base often suddenly contracted into the petiole, coriaceous, shining mainly above, impunctate, glabrous, obscurely sinuate-crenulate or practically entire, (5.0-)7.0-12.0(-16.0) cm long, (2.5-)3.0-5.5 cm broad, lateral nerves 4-5(-6) pairs curved-excurrent along the margin, prominent on both faces though more distinctly so beneath, veins more or less transverse, finely raised on both faces, their rather lax reticulation with the veinlets raised beneath only; petiole (6.0-)8.0-10.0 mm long; stipules lanceolate, ca 1.5 mm long, caducous. description: Tree, 3.0-8.0(-10.0) m tall. Branchlets glabrous at tips, subangular, lenticels sparse. description: Tree 4.0-15.0(-20.0) m tall; trunk up to 30.0 cm diam. Leaves elliptic or oblong, shortly and abruptly (1.0-2.0 cm) acuminate, tip bluntish, base broadly cuneate to rounded, subcoriaceous to coriaceous, glabrous except some hairs on the lower part of the midrib beneath, shining above, practically entire though with distant minute glands along the margin, impunctate in fully mature state, 9.0-18.0(-25.0) cm long, (4.5-)5.5-7.0(-8.0) cm broad, lateral nerves 3-5 pairs arcuate-ascending, slightly raised above, distinctly so beneath, veins transverse forming with the veinlets a rather dense reticulation which is finely prominent on both faces; petiole pubescent, (0.5-)0.8-1.2 cm long; stipules not observed, apparently early caducous. description: Tree up to 20.0 m tall; trunk up to 25.0 cm diam. Branchlets puberulous, pendent. Leaves narrowly ovate-oblong or lanceolate, or narrowly oblong, apex caudate-acuminate, tip bluntish, base more or less unequal, cuneate, but not rarely one side acute to obtuse, the other one obtuse to rounded, membranaceous to thin-chartaceous, shining above, laxly short-pubescent on both faces, more densely so along midrib and lateral nerves, densely pellucid-punctate and -lineate, serrulate, 6.0-13.0 cm long, 1.5-4.5 cm broad, lateral nerves 8-10 pairs a little raised mainly beneath, as is the rather lax reticulation of veins and veinlets on both faces; petiole short-pubescent, 5.0-6.0 mm long; stipules narrow-triangular, ca 4.0 mm long, 1.0 mm broad, fugacious. description: Tree up to 15.0 m high. Branchlets subangular, glabrous. Leaves oblong-or rounded-elliptic, apex abruptly and shortly acuminate, tip blunt, base rounded, coriaceous, glabrous, shining above, impunctate, very shallowly and distantly crenate or undulate, practically entire, 10.0-15.0(-20.0) cm long, 6.5-8.0(-10.0) cm broad, lateral nerves ca 5 pairs, curved-ascending towards the margin, prominent on both faces though more distinctly so beneath, veins transverse and subparallel, raised a little above, hardly so beneath, reticulation of veinlets rather dense, more conspicuous beneath only; petiole 1.3-2.0 cm long, 2.0-3.0 mm diam; stipules not observed, apparently early caducous. description: Slender tree, usually 8.0-30.0, sometimes -40.0 m tall; trunk cylindrical, straight, up to 80.0 cm diam; dark gray to yellowish; branches elongate, spreading. Branchlets subangular glabrous, sometimes pruinose. Leaves oblong to elliptic-oblong, apex more or less abruptly and shortly acuminate, or even cuspidate, base rather unequal, rounded to subcordate, firm-chartaceous to subcoriaceous, rarely coriaceous, glabrous, often brownish when dry, pellucid-punctate and -lineate, appressedly glandular-serrulate or -subcrenulate, (8.0-)10.0-16.0(-21.0) cm long, 3.5-6.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 9-10(-14) pairs curved-ascending, prominent beneath, veins more or less transverse, forming with the veinlets a rather dense reticulation which is distinctly raised on both faces especially in fully mature leaves; petiole glabrous or pruinose, 5.0-10.0(-15.0) mm long; stipules deltoid, ca 0.6 mm long, caducous. description: Shrub or tree up to 15, occasionally to 40 m tall; bark gray or brown, rough, resinous. description: Shrub or tree 1.5-7.0(-12.0) m tall; trunk up to 40.0 cm diam; bark yellowish. description: Tree up to 10.0 m high. Branchlets glabrous.
