description: Shrub. Branchlets slender, glabrous. Leaves ovate to lanceolate-ovate, apex short-acuminate, tip bluntish, base broadly attenuate to rounded, sometimes subcordate, rather coriaceous, glabrous, impunctate, entire, 5.0-9.0 cm long, 4.0-5.0 cm broad, 3-nerved from the base, with an additional outer faint pair of nerves, all these nerves high-ascending to the upper third of the lamina, the inner pair only prominent beneath, veins transverse, rather distant from each other, their reticulation with the veinlets inconspicuous; petiole 1.2-1.5 cm long. Racemes terminal, spiciform, 3-5-branched, slender, all over tomentellous, 5.0-7.0 cm long. Flowers subsessile, greenish-yellowish. description: Tree 10.0-15.0 m high. Branchlets short-pubescent at tips. Leaves oblong-lanceolate, apex rather abruptly subacutely subfalcate-acuminate for 1.5-2.0 cm, the acumen 2.0-3.0 mm broad at base, base inequilateral, broadly attenuate to almost rounded, thin-chartaceous, glabrous, not pellucid-punctate, undulate to entire, 8.0-16.0(-20.0) cm long, 4.0-6.0 cm broad, with a distinct basal pair of nerves ascending to the top of the lamina, much raised beneath, and an outer pair, hardly raised beneath, veins conspicuous, transverse, partly looping with the outer pair of lateral nerves, somewhat raised beneath as is the lax reticulation of the veinlets; petiole slender, 1.0-1.5(-2.0) cm long. Stamens 12. Ovary ovoid-conical, densely short-hairy; style very short; stigmas 3, foliaceous, crenate, divergent. Disk short, truncate. description: Slender shrub or small tree up to 6.0 m high. Branchlets glabrous at tips, older parts early grayish-corticate. Leaves ovate to suborbicular-ovate, sometimes narrowly ovate, apex shortly obtusely acuminate, base rounded to subcordate, chartaceous, sometimes firmly so, (4.0-)6.0-10.0(-12.0) cm long, 3.0-5.0(-8.0) cm broad, glabrous, entire or obsoletely denticulate, 3-5-nerved from base, the inner pair of nerves more distinct, ascending to the top of the lamina and prominent beneath, the outer pair rather faint, looping with numerous more or less transverse veins, but slightly raised beneath, as is the lax reticulation of veins and veinlets, upper lateral nerves 1 or 2 on either side, short and vein-like, or obsolete; petiole (6.0-)8.0-15.0 mm long. description: Shrub or treelet. Branchlets flexuous, minutely pubescent at tips, older parts early gray-corticate. Leaves rather shortly and obtusely acuminate, base broadly attenuate to rounded, slightly unequal, coriaceous, shining on both faces, shortly patently pubescent for some time on midrib and lateral nerves beneath, glabrescent, becoming quite glabrous with age, entire or faintly denticulate, the edge somewhat revolute, (6.0-)7.0-12.0 cm long, 3.0-4.0 cm broad, 3-nerved from the base, the lateral pair of nerves ascending close to the edge at least hah the length of the lamina, a little impressed above, distinctly raised beneath as is the midrib, 4 or 5 pairs of upper vein-like nerves arising more or less rectangularly from the midrib markedly looping with the marginal nerves respectively the upper ones with each other, distinctly impressed above, raised beneath, numerous veins transverse and rather distant from each other, forming with the veinlets a lax reticulation which is slightly prominent beneath; petiole short-pubescent initially, 0.6-1.2 cm long. Racemes spiciform, subterminal, solitary, pendent, usually not branched, though occasionally dichotomous, 16.0-27.0 cm long incl peduncle (6.0-12.0, rarely -18.0 cm); rhachis angular, minutely patently pubescent, ca 1.0 mm thick; pedicels 1.5L-2.0 mm long; bracts lanceolate-subulate, 0.5-1.0 mm long. description: A large slender shrub or tree to 11.0, occasionally to 20.0 m high; bark smooth, pale. Branchlets slender, flexuous, tips densely pubescent to hirtellous, older parts glabrescent. Leaves ovate to oblong-ovate, sometimes narrowly so, apex caudate-acuminate for 1.5-2.5 cm, tip blunt, base somewhat unequal, broadly cuneate to rounded, (thin-)chartaceous, glabrous above, shortly pubescent to hirtellous along midrib and nerves, mainly so in the lower part, especially towards the base beneath, glabrescent, sometimes glabrous beneath from the beginning, though generally barbulate in the axil of midrib with lateral nerves, sparsely pellucid-punctate or practically impunctate, entire to undulate, 7.0-13.5(-20.0) cm long, 3.0-5.5(-8.0) cm broad, 3- or sub-5-nerved from the base to half the length of the blade, midrib slightly impressed above, the pair of (inner) lateral basal nerves less deeply so, other lateral nerves from the upper half of the midrib (2-)3-4 pairs, prominent beneath, veins more or less transverse, very slightly raised as is the reticulation of veinlets on both faces; petiole very slender, puberulous, 1.0-1.8 cm long. Calyx splitting into 2 (rarely 3) cucullate glabrous lobes, whitish-greenish or yellow, 1.5-2.0 mm long. Stamens 10 (rarely 9 or less); filaments 1.5-2.0 mm long; anthers subglobose, 0.5 mm diam. Fruit subglobose, pale red, turning blackish, ca 5.0 mm diam; pericarp coriaceous, smooth; seeds few to rather numerous, ovoid, foveolate, 1.0 mm long.

description: Shrub or usually tree, occasionally up to 20.0 m high; crown more or less spreading; trunk straight, slender; bark thin, pale grayish-brown. Branchlets minutely puberulous, or generally glabrous. Leaves subovate to elliptic, or elliptic-oblong, sometimes rather narrowly so, apex caudate-acuminate for 2.0-3.0 cm, tip bluntish, base oblique, acute to rounded, (thin-)chartaceous, glabrous above, initially somewhat puberulent or hirtellous along midrib and nerves beneath, glabrescent, or glabrous from the beginning, a little shining above, dull beneath, finely pellucid-punctate, sometimes with (glabrous!) domatia at the angle of midrib with the lateral nerves, 10.0-20.0 cm long, 4.0-8.0 cm broad, 3-5-nerved from the base, these nerves ascending almost to the top of the lamina, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath, the outer pair rather obscurely looping with the transverse veins, veinlets laxly reticulate, very slightly raised on both faces; petiole 1.0-1.5(-2.2) cm long. description: Tree, 4.0-10.0 m high. Branchlets zigzag, minutely pubescent at tips, older parts gray-corticate. Racemes spiciform, terminal, 5-10 together subumbellately arranged, more or less erecto-patent, 5.0-7.5(-10.0) cm long incl peduncle (0.5-1.0 cm), all over minutely pubescent; pedicels 0.5-1.0	mm long; bracts setaceous, ca 0.7 mm long. description: Tree, 8.0-16.0 m high. Branchlets slender, tips subglabrous, older parts early covered with grayish cork. Leaves ovate, apex short-acuminate, tip acute, base often oblique, rounded to subcordate, membranaceous to chartaceous, entire, glabrous, 6.0-10.0(-15.0) cm long, (4.0-)5.0-7.5 cm broad, 5-nerved from the base, the outer pair of nerves less obvious and shorter, the inner ones marked and ascending to almost the top of the lamina, prominent beneath, other 1 or 2 pairs of lateral nerves from the upper third of the midrib, the transverse veins partly looping with them and the outer pair of the basal nerves, slightly raised beneath, veinlets rather obscure; petiole 1.0-1.5 cm long. Racemes terminal, solitary, usually forked from below, pendulous, about 30.0 (or more) cm long incl peduncle (5.0-7.0 cm); rhachis robust (1.0-2.0 mm diam), finely puberulous or subglabrous. description: Shrub or small tree. Branchlets elongate, tips short-pubescent, older parts gray-corticate. Leaves subovate-oblong or -lanceolate, apex subacutely acuminate or subcaudate, base rounded or more rarely subcordate, slightly unequal, (thin-)chartaceous, dull and brownish when dry, paler beneath, glabrous except a slight puberulence of the midrib beneath which disappears with age, entire, the margin a little revolute, (5.0-)6.0-l 1.0(-15.0) cm long, 2.5-3.5(-4.5) cm broad, 3- or sub-5-nerved from the base, the outer lateral pair faint, looping with the transverse veins, the inner one distinct, ascending to more or less half the length of the blade and looping with 2 or 3(-4) pairs of upper shorter lateral nerves, all these nerves prominent beneath, veins slightly raised beneath, reticulation of the veinlets rather obsolete; petiole puberulent initially, 8.0-13.0(-20.0) mm long. description: Glabrous shrub or tree 6.0-8.0 m high. Branchlets few, elongate, glabrous. description: Shrub or treelet up to 8.0 m high. Branchlets (sub)glabrous, early grayish-corticate. description: Treelet or tree. Branchlets puberulous at tips, lower parts glabrescent, brownish, minutely lenticellate. Leaves ovate or ovate-oblong, apex attenuate, tip acute or cuspidate, base obtuse, no basal glands, subchartaceous, glabrous above, sparsely short-pubescent at midrib and lateral nerves but otherwise glabrous beneath, repand-glandular-dentate, 6.0-13.0 cm long, 3.0-6.5 cm broad, 3-nerved from base (these main-nerves impressed above, prominent beneath), upper nerves or veins transverse, closely parallel to each other, slightly raised beneath as is the rather inconspicuous reticulation of veinlets; petiole sparsely strigose, 1.0-2.0 cm long. description: Small tree, 6.0-10.0 m high; trunk up to 20.0 cm diam. Branchlets gray-corticate, tips minutely appressed-pubescent. Leaves elliptic, apex attenuate, base almost rounded, no basal glands present, membranaceous to chartaceous, glabrous except midrib and nerves beneath which bear a short appressed pubescence, coarsely remotely and obtusely glandular-serrate (1.01.5, rarely -2.0 mm), 10.0-20.0 cm long, 6.0-10.0 cm broad, 3 (or faintly 5)-nerved from base, with 3 or 4 pairs of short lateral nerves from the upper 1/3 of the midrib, veins numerous, transverse, all nerves and veins more or less prominent beneath, veinlets rather densely reticulate, slightly raised beneath; petiole appressed-pubescent, 1.2-1.6(-2.0) cm long. description: Shrub or medium-sized tree. Branchlets minutely pubescent at tips, older parts glabrous, brownish-corticate, and sparsely lenticellate. Leaves oblong-elliptic, apex rounded, tip abruptly short-acuminate, base obtuse or rounded, no basal glands, chartaceous, glabrous above, sparsely softly hirtous-tomentellous beneath, repand-glandular-serrate (2.0 mm), up to 35.0 cm long and 16.0 cm broad, 3-nerved from base (these main-nerves markedly prominent beneath), other nerves or veins transverse, slightly raised beneath as is the reticulation of veinlets; petiole tomentose, 2.0-3.0 cm long. description: Shrub or treelet, though usually a tree 10.0-15.0(-30.0) m high, glabrous, with irregular branches and an open or dense high crown; trunk up to 35.0 cm diam; bark gray, flaky. Branchlets slender, grayish-corticate. Leaves oblong to elliptic-oblong, rarely elliptic or ovate, apex short- to long-acuminate and spiny, base broadly cuneate to rounded, with a pair of basal foveolate glands on the upper surface, rather rigidly coriaceous, shiny green, (5.0-)8.0-15.0 (-18.0) cm long, (2.5-)3.5-6.0 cm broad, edge cartilaginous-thickened and exceedingly variable, from coarsely sinuate with spine-tipped teeth to (sub)entire (the latter form mainly on fertile branches) as found in Ilex, lateral nerves (6-)8-10 pairs rather straight from the midrib and looping before the edge, prominent beneath, veins coarsely reticulate and slightly raised beneath, veinlets rather obscure; petiole rugose, 6.0-10.0 mm long, ca 2.0 mm thick; stipules minute, triangular, fugacious. description: Shrub, often multi-stemmed, 1.0-3.0(-4.0) m high. Branches virgate, flexuous, tips grayish-tomentellous, older parts glabrescent and gray- to fuscous-corticate. Leaves lanceolate-oblong, rarely subobovate or even sub-spathulate-oblong, apex rounded-obtuse, often minutely mucronulate, base cuneate to obtuse, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, gray-stellate-tomentellous on both faces, glabrescent mainly beneath with age, denticulate to (sub)entire, (1.5-)2.0-4.0 cm long, 0.8-1.5 cm broad, lateral nerves 4-6 pairs rather inconspicuous as is the reticulation; petiole puberulous, 3.0-5.0 mm long; stipules setaceous, appressed, ca 1.5 mm long, caducous. Flowers few in short corymbiform racemes in the upper axils of the branchlets, sometimes solitary, yellowish fading reddish, all over gray-stellate-tomentellous; pedicels articulate just above base, slender, 0.6-1.5(-l.7) cm long; bracts 3, elongate-ovate, subacute, ca 2.0 mm long. Sepals 5 (rarely 4), oblong-lanceolate, subacute, more or less spreading, 3.0-4.0 mm long, 1.5-2.0(-2.5) mm broad. Petals similar to though slightly larger than the sepals, and persistent as these. Capsule subtrigonous, thin-walled, split from apex, with a few angular seeds.

description: Shrub or generally tree 3.0-5.0, rarely -10.0, occasionally -30.0 m tall; trunk up to 65.0 cm, sometimes with low buttresses; crown usually spreading; bark thin, reddish-brown, flaky. Branchlets slender, tips puberulent, lower parts early glabrescent. Leaves oblong-lanceolate to -elliptic, rarely elliptic, apex more or less abruptly and shortly subacutely or more obtusely acuminate, base cuneate to almost rounded, sometimes a little unequal, with a pair of large basal glands, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, somewhat shining on both faces, glabrous above, puberulent though finally glabrescent beneath, or often glabrous from the beginning on both faces, (7.0-)9.0-15.0(-24.0) cm long, 2.5-7.0(-12.0) cm broad, remotely glandular-subsinuate-subserrate or -subcrenulate mainly in the upper half of the lamina or practically entire, 3(-5)-nerved from base (the outer often rather indistinct), with 2-4 upper shorter pairs beyond middle of midrib, all nerves rather conspicuously inarching within the margin and prominent beneath, transverse veins numerous and subparallel to each other, veinlets densely reticulate and slightly elevate; petiole slender, (1.0-)2.0-3.5(-6.5) cm long; stipules minute, subulate, caducous. Flowers white or cream, a little fragrant. Sepals 4-6, subovate-oblong, bluntish, white- or gray-puberulous to -tomentellous on both faces, 4.0-6.0 mm long, 1.5-2.0(-2.5) mm broad. Capsule subglobose, often a little depressed distally and with a slight vertical depression on one side, tomentellous or finally glabrous, somewhat rugose on the surface, (4.0-)5.0-7.0(-10.0) mm long, 4.0-6.0(-8.0) mm wide, green turning red to blackish; seed 1.

description: Shrub or treelet up to 6 m high, with spreading branches. Branchlets with axillary simple slender spines (3.0-)5.0-10.0 mm long, or sometimes unarmed, tips patently puberulent, older parts grayish-brownish-corticate and set with small roundish lenticels. Leaves ovate or obovate, sometimes suborbicular, apex obtuse to rounded, rarely subacuminate-attenuate, base broadly cuneate, very base obtuse or truncate, young blades thin, becoming blackish when dry, mature ones (sub)coriaceous, glaucous-green and shining above, dull beneath, glabrous, with 1-4 crenulations on either side or rarely entire, (4.0-)10.0-15.0 mm long, (3.0-)6.0-13.0 mm broad, midrib somewhat impressed above, lateral nerves rather obscure; petiole 0.5-1.5 mm long. Stamens 4; filaments 1.5 mm long; anthers 0.6 mm diam. Flowers [female] (Holdridge 1950): pedicels slender, glabrous, 4.0-5.0 mm long in young fruit. Berry globose, red, 2-seeded, ca 4.0 mm diam, crowned by a short bifurcate style.

description: Shrub or small tree, 2.0-10.0 (very rarely -20.0) m tall; trunk rarely up to 20.0 cm diam; bark brown, rough. Branchlets gray-puberulous to -tomentose, glabrescent, sometimes quite glabrous from the beginning, lenticellate. Leaves and stipules variable as to form, size, density of tomentum and coarseness of serration, broadly to narrowly ovate or lanceolate-oblong, rarely elliptic, apex acuminate, tip bluntish by an apical gland, base rounded to deeply cordate, generally with 2 basal glands above, membranaceous to thin-chartaceous, more or less nigrescent when dry, glabrous or laxly short-pubescent in general, rarely more densely pubescent above, beneath either softly tomentose or hirtellous, though not rarely mainly so along midrib and lateral nerves, rarely glabrous beneath, glandular-serrate to -crenate, 3.5-10.0(-15.0) cm long, 2.0-5.0(-10.0) cm broad, (3-)5- or 7-nerved from base, upper pinnate nerves 2-4 pairs, all nerves often a little impressed above, slightly prominent beneath, reticulation rather obscure; petiole 0.5-2.0(-3.0) cm long; stipules (sub)sessile, falcate-semiovate or -lanceolate, extremely inequilateral, apex acute, base oblique, glandular-serrate, glabrous to hirtellous, 5.0-8.0 (rarely -17.0) mm long, more or less persistent mainly in the upper axils though sometimes early caducous. Inflorescence racemose or corymbiform at the end of lateral branchlets, slender, sometimes up to 12-flowered, though generally few- or even 1-flowered. Flowers fragrant, variable in size and in density of pubescence, 8.0-14.0 mm diam; pedicels slender, 6.0-17.0 mm long, sometimes bracteolate. Sepals 3 (rarely 4), ovate or subcordate-ovate, apex acute or obtuse, entire or practically so i e rarely with 1 or 2 short glands on either side, greenish, glabrous to rather densely gray-tomentellous outside, white-tomentellous in general inside, 4.0-7.0 mm long, 3.0-5.0(-6.0) mm broad. description: Shrub or slender tree 3.0-8.0 m high. Branchlets patently soft-hairy at tips, glabrescent and set with sparse lenticels below. Leaves ovate, apex rather shortly subacutely acuminate, often a little curved, ending with a small gland, base more or less deeply cordate, thin-chartaceous, softly and rather appressedly laxly hairy above, more densely so i e grayish-whitish-tomentose beneath, regularly serrate-crenate (1.0-1.5 mm), 5.0-8.0(-10.0) cm long, 3.0-6.0 (-7.0) cm broad, 5-nerved from base, other upper lateral nerves 2 or 3 pairs impressed above, a little raised beneath, reticulation obscure; petiole slender, densely patently hairy, 1.0-1.5 (rarely -2.5) cm long; stipules 2 semicordate, acute, persistent, up to 1.0 cm long and 0.5 cm broad. Racemes laxly (2-)3-6-flowered, rarely reduced to a solitary flower, generally 3.0-6.0 cm long incl peduncle (1.0-3.0 cm), all over softly patently tomentulose or villous; pedicels at anthesis ca 1.0 cm long, accrescent to 2.5 cm in fruit. description: Shrub or tree up to 8.0 m tall; stem up to 10.0 cm diam. Branchlets slender, very sparsely stellate-pubescent or glabrous. Leaves narrowly lanceolate to broadly elliptic, rarely ovate-lanceolate, apex caudate-acuminate, base usually much narrowed, thin-coriaceous, (sub)entire, glabrous and shining above, sparsely appressedly pubescent on midrib and nerves beneath, 10.0-18.0 cm long, (2.0-)3.0-8.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 7-8 pairs, raised on both faces though mainly beneath, reticulation fine, close and somewhat prominent on both faces; petiole sparsely pubescent or glabrous, 5.0-6.0 mm long; stipules subulate, hispidulous, 2.0-7.0 mm long. description: Shrub or treelet up to 8.0 m high. Branchlets grayish-tomentose. Leaves oblong or elliptic, sometimes obovately so, apex short-acuminate, base acutely or obtusely attenuate, more or less coriaceous, dull and sparsely minutely hispidulous mainly on midrib initially, glabrescent with age, though remaining a little scabrous above, grayish-tomentose with abundant stellate hairs (rays up to 0.5 mm) intermixed beneath, margin obscurely subglandular-serrate, or -sinuate-dentate or subentire, 15.0-19.0(-22.0) cm long, 5.0-8.0 cm broad, lateral nerves about 10 pairs, slightly prominent beneath, forming rather open areolae; petiole gray-tomentose, 5.0-10.0 mm long; stipules subulate, 5.0 mm long, caducous. description: Subshrub or shrub, few-branched, 0.3-1.5 m tall. Branchlets flexuous, grayish-tomentose, some of the hairs ascending or erect. Leaves elliptic or subovate-elliptic or -oblong, apex shortly subacuminate to rounded (though mucronate), base rounded to subcordate, rarely attenuate, coriaceous at maturity, dull and hirtellous on midrib or glabrous above, grayish-tomentose (hairs frequently 0.16 mm or longer) all over the undersurface, 6.0-9.0(-10.0) cm long, 2.5-4.0 cm broad, entire or obscurely serrate, lateral nerves 7 or 8 pairs, deliquescent into a reticulum before reaching the edge of the lamina, prominent above, reticulation raised and coarse beneath, forming rather open areolae; petiole tomentose, ca 5.0 mm long; stipules subulate, 5.0-8.0 mm long. description: Shrub or treelet up to 8.0 m tall; trunk up to 10.0 cm diam. Branchlets roughly ferrugineous-stellate-pubescent to -tomentose and a little scabrous. Leaves elliptic to oblong, apex more or less long-acuminate, base rather inequilateral, obtuse to rounded, sometimes attenuate to one side, thin-coriaceous, dull or somewhat shining and hirtellous on midrib, otherwise glabrous above, roughly ferrugineous-pubescent to -tomentose mainly on midrib, nerves and veins, finally glabrescent beneath, 8.2-25.0 cm long, 3.0-9.0 cm broad, obsoletely sinuate-dentate or subentire, lateral nerves 10-12 pairs, slightly though distinctly impressed above, prominent beneath, veins connecting lateral nerves sharply raised beneath, ultimate veinlets prominulous; petiole scabridly ferrugineous-pubescent to -tomentose, 3.0-5.0 mm long; stipules linear-subulate or lanceolate, 5.0-6.0 mm long, caducous. description: Shrub up to 3.0 m tall. Branchlets grayish-rusty-tomentose, somewhat roughened. Leaves elliptic to lanceolate-oblong, apex acuminate, base more or less inequilateral, obtuse to rounded, (sub)coriaceous, midrib hirtellous otherwise glabrous and dull abofe, appressedly pubescent mainly on midrib and nerves beneath, (sub)entire, 6.0-11.0 cm long, 2.5-4.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 5-7 pairs prominent beneath only, the connecting veins slightly raised beneath as is the fine reticulation; petiole pulverulent-tomentulose, ca 3.0 mm long; stipules linear-lanceolate, ca 7.0 mm long, 1.0 mm broad, caducous. description: Shrub or small tree 3.0-7.0 m tall, with simple branches crowded towards the top of the stem. Branchlets smoothly stellate-tomentose, hairs short, appressed to ascending. Leaves broadly elliptic-oblong, apex subcuspidate-acuminate, base inequilateral, broadly attenuate to obtuse, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, glabrous except the midrib above, appressedly short-stellate -pubescent on midrib and nerves, very laxly so at veins beneath, entire, 13.0-23.0 cm long, 4.0-7.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 7-10 pairs, depressed above, prominent beneath, intercostal veins faint beneath, reticulation not prominent; petiole 3.0-6.0 mm long; stipules lanceolate, 5.0-6.0 mm long, caducous. description: Shrub to 4.0 m tall. Branchlets shortly subferrugineous-tomentosulous at tips, lower parts tardily glabrescent, finally covered with reddish brown or grayish cork. Leaves distichous, remote, oblong to elliptic or sometimes subobovate, apex rounded, generally slightly emarginate, base maybe slightly oblique, subcuneate to rounded, chartaceous to coriaceous, usually tuberculate on both faces, rather laxly appressedly short-pubescent on both faces initially, early glabrescent above, more or less tardily so beneath except on midrib and nerves, pellucid-punctate and -lineate, margin narrowly revolute, remotely serrulate-crenulate, (2.0-)3.0-7.0 cm long, (1.0-)1.3-3.0 cm broad, lateral nerves (5-)7-9(-13) pairs arcuate-ascending, rather distinctly raised as are the veins beneath, veinlets more or less obscure beneath; petiole pubescent, 2.0-4.0 (-6.0) mm long; stipules (linear-)lanceolate, pubescent, up to 1.0 mm long. description: Erect shrub or slender tree to 5.0 (rarely 10.0) m tall. Branchlets zigzag, densely subferrugineous-velutinous to -villous in the young, glabrescent and brownish- or whitish-corticate in the older parts. Leaves distichous, sometimes rather clustered at the branch tips due to condensation of internodes, variable in shape and size, broadly to narrowly lanceolate-ovate, oblong, oblong-elliptic, or obovate-oblong, or elliptic, apex subacuminate and acute, or obtuse or rounded, maybe a little retuse, base more or less broadly cuneate to subcordate, often oblique, chartaceous to subcoriaceous or even coriaceous, rather densely pellucid-punctate and -lineate, densely and appressedly covered with stoutish hairs, glabrescent and somewhat scabrous with age above, generally yellowish- to ferrugineous- or rarely whitish-velutinous-villous beneath especially on midrib, nerves and veins, edge a little revolute, remotely to closely glandular-denticulate or -serrate, occasionally subentire, 5.0-11.5 cm long, 3.0-7.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 6-11 (-13) pairs, ascending, more or less distinctly looping within the margin, often depressed above, distinctly raised beneath, veins scalariform, forming with the veinlets a rather dense reticulation which may be depressed above, and is always prominent beneath; petiole densely appressedly short-pubescent, 2.0-4.0(-5.0) mm long; stipules linear-lanceolate to subacicular, 1.0-3.0 mm long, caducous. Ovary ovoid, velutinous-villous; style glabrate; stigma depressed-globose. Fruit ovoid, ellipsoid or subglobose, rarely subobovoid, obtusely angled at the sutures, red, sparsely villous to glabrate, 6.0-23.0 mm long, valves 3-5, orange to red inside; seeds several, 2.5-3.5 mm long.

description: Shrub or slender tree, 1.0-6.0(-8.0) m tall. Branchlets reddish brown, becoming gray with age, tips rather densely appressed-pubescent, older parts glabrescent. Leaves more or less narrowly oblong- to obovate or oblanceolate-elliptic, sometimes subspatulate, apex obtuse to rounded, occasionally obtusely acuminate or emarginate, base attenuate to obtuse or rounded, chartaceous to subcoriaceous with age, dark green above, brownish beneath, tuberculate mainly above, densely pellucid-punctate and -lineate, sparsely to subdensely appressed-pubescent when young, early glabrescent above, remaining pubescent on midrib below, edge a little revolute, glandular-crenulate-serrulate, (3.0-)4.0-7.0(-9.0) cm long, (1.0-)1.5-3.0(-4.5) cm broad, lateral nerves (7-)8-9(-10) pairs arcuate-ascending, (very) slightly raised on both faces, veins and veinlets rather obscure; petiole short-pubescent, 2.0-5.0 mm long; stipules acuminate-deltoid, persistent, up to 1.0 mm long. Calyx 5-merous, (2.0-)3.0-4.0 cm long, greenish or usually whitish and densely pubescent outside, tube 1/3-1/2 of the total calyx length, cylindrical to subcampanulate, lobes (obovate-) oblong, obtuse, 7.0-20.0 mm long. description: Erect shrub to 3 m tall. Branchlets villous-velutinous at tips, older parts glabrate, covered with grayish to reddish-brown cork. Leaves resembling much those of certain forms of Casearia aculeata, distichous, elliptic, oblong-elliptic or elliptic-obovate, apex rounded to short-acuminate, rarely emarginate, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, appressedly villous to velutinous when young, generally more densely so beneath, glabrate or not with age, densely pellucid-punctate and -lineate, distantly glandular-serrulate-crenulate or sometimes subentire, 3.0-7.0(-11.0) cm long, 3.0-5.5 cm broad, lateral nerves 6-8(-9) pairs, more or less arcuately ascending, prominulous above, more distinctly so beneath, veins and veinlets a little raised on both faces; petiole pubescent, not rarely glabrate, 2.0-7.0 mm long; stipules broadly lanceolate, subulate distally, persistent, up to 2.0 mm long. Flowers l-2(-3) per axil, sometimes aggregate due to condensation of internodes, together forming a leafy terminal inflorescence, fragrant; bracts connate initially, subsequently separating to the base, broadly ovate, acuminate, convex, keeled and short-velutinous outside, 2.5-4.5 mm long, tardily caducous; pedicels villous-velutinous, 2.0-6.0 mm long. Calyx (4-)5-merous, 6.0-14.0 mm long, cylindric- to broad-campanulate, abruptly tapering towards the base, whitish to greenish and villous-velutinous outside, tube 2.0-7.0 mm long, glabrous inside, limb 4.0-7.0 mm long, lobes oblong to orbicular-elliptic. Androecium almost completely fused, tube 2.0-3.0 mm long, sparsely hairy outside. Stamens 10-12; anthers ovate-triangular, subsessile, ca 1.0 mm long; staminodes distinct, the free tips short to fully as long as the anthers, more or less densely villous. Ovary narrowly ovoid, rather densely appressed-velutinous; style sparsely hairy; stigma depressed-globose. Fruit obovoid-ellipsoid to depressed-globose, obtusely 3-gonous, sparsely villous to glabrate, 0.6-2.0 cm long; valves 3, becoming woody after dehiscence; seeds brown, 3.0-4.0 mm long.

description: Shrub or small tree. Branchlets when short usually becoming spinose, tips minutely ferrugineous-pubescent, older parts glabrescent, reddish-brownish-corticate. Leaves maybe aggregated on contracted short-shoot-like branch segments, broadly to narrowly elliptic, obovate-elliptic or -oblong, apex rounded, rarely emarginate, base acute to rounded, thick-chartaceous to coriaceous, glabrous above, sparsely to moderately appressed-pubescent when young and early glabrescent except the midrib beneath, pellucid-punctate when young, edge entire and narrowly revolute, 4.0-10.0(-16.0, -28.0 ?) mm long, 2.0-9.0 mm broad, lateral nerves 4-7 pairs, ascending, more or less prominulous above and/or beneath, veins and veinlets obscurely reticulate; petiole glabrous, very short (up to 1.5 mm); stipules lanceolate, persistent, 0.5-1.5 mm long. Flowers apparently strictly 1 per axil, aggregated when produced from condensed branch-segments and pulvini, floral bracts completely fused, grayish becoming brown, scarious, splitting at bud emergence and promptly caducous, densely shortly appressedly pubescent outside; pedicel not seen. Calyx 5-merous, 6.0-8.0 mm long, the tube cylindric to campanulate-obconical, the limb more or less as long as the tube, the lobes oblong, obtuse to rounded distally. Androecium fused almost completely, the tube essentially glabrous; stamens 10; staminodes obsolete. Ovary narrowly ovoid, white appressed-velutinous; stigma depressed-globose. Mature fruit not known.

description: Erect shrub or small tree to 8.0 m tall. Branchlets appressedly rusty-villous-velutinous when young, rather early glabrescent, older parts brownish-corticate. Leaves lanceolate- to oblong-elliptic or elliptic, more rarely obovate-elliptic to obovate, apex more or less abruptly acuminate and acute, usually mucronate, rarely obtuse, rounded or even emarginate, base often slightly unequal, broadly cuneate to obtuse, generally subcoriaceous, sparsely short-pubescent, glabrescent except the midrib above, similarly so the undersurface, often tubercled on both faces, densely pellucid-punctate and -lineate, remotely glandular-serrulate, 3.0-15.0 cm long, 1.8-7.5 cm broad, lateral nerves 7-12 pairs arcuate-ascending, at least the upper ones markedly looping, prominent beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets rather lax, slightly raised on both faces though mainly beneath; petiole subulate, shortly rusty-pubescent, glabrescent, 2.0-6.0 mm long; stipules lanceolate-subulate to linear, appressed-pubescent, 1.5-2.0(-3.0) mm long. Axillary inflorescence-units of up to 8 serially developing fragrant flowers; bracts connate initially, only ca 1.0 mm long, splitting or not at anthesis, persistent, densely pubescent; pedicels rusty-velutinous, 2.0-3.0 mm long. Calyx (4-)5(-6)-merous, 12.0-16.0(-18.0) mm long, greenish and villous-velutinous outside, white to yellowish inside the limb, tube cylindrical to cylindrical-campanulate, more or less half the calyx length, lobes oblong to elliptic, obtuse. Androecium of (9-)10-11(-13) stamens; filaments 3.0-5.5 mm long, connate except the distal, 0.5-1.5 mm long part though often only delicately fused and separating easily below, rather sparsely hairy outside, anthers oblong, 1.0-1.5 mm long; staminodes more or less obsolete. description: Arbor parva, trunco spinis ramificatis armato. Ramuli etiam apicibus glabri, partibus vetustioribus rubro-brunneis laxeque lenticellate pallidis parvis obtectis. Folia, ut videtur, periodice decidua, novella una cum floribus producta, ovato-elliptica, apice breviter acuminata, apice ipso obtusa, basi in petiolum cuneata haud glandulifera, chartacea, glabra, in sicco brunnea et sat opaca, 5.0-7.5 cm longa, 3.0-4.0 cm lata, sat irregulariter glanduloso-serrato-crenata (1.0-2.0 mm), nervis lateralibus 6-7-paribus angulo acuto a costa ascendentibus, pro parte profunde bifurcatis, subtus leviter elevatis, reticula-tione venarum venularumque subtus parum prominulis; petioli graciles, glabri, 1.0-1.2(-1.5) cm longi. Flores [male] tantum cogniti, 4-6 per fasciculum ex axillis defoliatis orti; bracteae numerosae, scariosae, ciliolatae; pedicelli basi articulati, glabri, 3.0-5.0 mm longi. Sepala 4 vel 5 (raro 6), ovato-acuminata, dorso glabra, intus laxe longepilosa, longe ciliata, ca 3.0 mm longa. Discus e glandulis 12-15 parvis subquadratis formatus. description: Shrub or small slender tree (0.5-)2.0-8.0 (rarely -10.0) m tall; trunk usually armed with slender, often branched spines up to 4.0 cm long; bark grayish, verrucose. Branchlets puberulent at tips, older parts glabrescent and laxly lenticellate, the leaf-axils here and there with a slender spine. Leaves variable in shape and size, obovate to oblanceolate, oblong, elliptic, rarely rhombic, those of sterile shoots sometimes ovate, apex acute and usually mucronate, rarely obtuse, rounded or even emarginate, base cuneate, obtuse or sometimes rounded, coriaceous, rigid, shining above, glabrous, entire or frequently with l-3(-5) coarse mucronate teeth in the upper half of either side of the lamina, (1.5-)3.0-5.5(-7.0) cm long, (0.7-)1.0-2.5(-4.0) cm broad, sometimes microphyllous, lateral nerves numerous, steeply ascending, rather obscure or minutely impressed beneath as are the veins; petiole 1.5-2.5(-4.0) mm long. Sepals 4 or 5, lanceolate to ovate, sometimes elliptic, whitish-greenish, glabrous on both faces, ciliolate, (1.0-)1.5-2.0 mm long. Disk-lobes ca 8, free in the [male], more or less fused in the [female] specimens, [male]: stamens (8-)12-20 (rarely -30); filaments 2.0-3.0 mm long. 9 [female]: ovary ovoid-subglobose, glabrous; styles 2, short, connate at base only, each with 2 semilunate stigmas. description: Spiny arborescent shrub up to 1.5 m high; stem up to 2.5 cm diam. Branchlets slender, young parts with dense brownish spreading tomentum of soft hairs, older ones brown and thin-corticate; lenticels sparse, small, rotund; axillary spines slender, 0.5-1.0(-l .5) cm long. Leaves ovate- to elliptic-oblong, apex short-acuminate, tip subacute, base broadly attenuate to rounded, membranaceous to thin-chartaceous, grayish-green and rather dull when dry, glabrous above, the pubescent midrib excepted, more or less densely patently hairy (0.5-1.0 mm) along midrib and lateral nerves, less conspicuously so on veins and veinlets beneath with age (subtomentose sometimes in young sterile shoots), minutely to coarsely and sharply serrate, 4.0-7.0 cm long, (2.0-)2.5-3.5(-4.0) cm broad, lateral nerves 3-4 pairs, the lowest 1 or 2 pair(s) rather steeply ascending, reticulation of veins and veinlets very dense, finely raised on both faces; petiole slender, hairy, 1.5-3.0(-4.0) mm long. Inflorescences of axillary 3-5-flowered fascicles; bracts ovate-acuminate, ciliate, ca 1.0 mm long; pedicels articulate at base, sparsely patently hairy, ca 2.0 mm long at anthesis, ca 3.0 mm long in fruit. Sepals 4, subovate-oblong, subacute, white to greenish, laxly hispidulous on both faces, ciliate, 1.5-2.0 mm long, [male]: stamens ca 15; filaments glabrous, 2.5 mm long. Disk-lobes 1 or 2 before each sepal, forming a rather coherent crenate annulus. [female]: ovary globose, laxly hispidulous-hairy; style very short; stigmatic branches 2, recurved. Fruit globular, red, hispid-hairy or early glabrescent, 5.0-6.0 mm diam; pericarp thin; seeds 1-3; testa very finely foveolate.

description: Shrub or small tree up to 6.0, occasionally to 25.0 m tall; trunk usually armed with compound spines up to 6.0 cm long. Branchlets glabrous, early covered with brownish cork and numerous small roundish-elliptic lenticels; axillary spines simple, ca 1.0 cm long. Leaves lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, apex subcaudate-acuminate, slightly falcate, tip acute or bluntish, base sometimes a little unequal, cuneate, firmly chartaceous to subcoriaceous, glabrous, shining on both faces especially above, rather coarsely glandular-crenate (1.5-2.0	mm), (10.0-)12.0-16.0(-20.0) cm long, 4.0-6.0 cm broad, lateral nerves 5-7 pairs slightly raised above, more distinctly so beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets dense, finely prominent on both faces; petiole 5.0-8.0 mm long. description: Shrub or small tree to 8.0 (rarely -12.0) m tall; trunk up to 20.0 cm diam, set with strong branched rusty-pubescent finally glabrescent thorns up to 10.0 cm long as are the branches. Branchlets ferrugineous-velvety at tips, with simple axillary pubescent spines up to 5.0 cm long, older parts tardily glabrescent. description: Shrub or treelet up to 3.0 m tall. Branchlets armed with spines or unarmed, tips puberulent. Leaves rather close together, subsessile, ovate to elliptic, apex subacute or obtuse, base (sub)cordate, rather coriaceous, glabrous, shining above, young ones reddish, serrulate-crenate with minute inflexed callose teeth (ca 0.5 mm), 2.5-5.0 cm long, 1.5-3.5 cm broad, lateral nerves ca 6 pairs, prominent beneath, reticulation of veins and veinlets dense, raised on both faces, areolae subangular; petiole puberulous, 1.0-2.0(-3.0) mm long. description: Shrub or tree up to 7.0 m tall; trunk provided with bunches of branched spines. Branchlets glabrous, young parts with simple spines (1.0-2.0 cm) and narrower leaves, old ones brownish-grayish-corticate, densely lenticellate, often unarmed. Leaves ovate to ovate-oblong, apex obtuse or rounded, rarely acute, base subtruncate and obtuse, rarely acute, coriaceous, rather stiff, glabrous, lustrous on both faces, 6.0-9.0 cm long, 2.5-4.5 cm broad, glandular-subserrate-crenate (0.5-1.0 mm) along the whole margin, lateral nerves 8-10 pairs slightly raised on both faces as is the dense reticulation of veins and veinlets; petiole 5.0-8.0(-10.0) mm long. description: Shrub with slender stem and spiny branches, up to 5.0 m high; bark gray, smooth. Branchlets with axillary slender simple spines up to 5.0 cm long, tips puberulent. Leaves subovate- or sometimes obovate-elliptic, shortly subacutely acuminate, base attenuate to the petiole and with a pair of marginal glands, subcoriaceous, glabrous, shining on both faces, glandular-subserrate-dentate (9.5-1.0 mm), 3.5-7.0 cm long, 2.0-3.5(-4.0) cm broad, lateral nerves 6-8 pairs markedly prominent on both faces as is the dense reticulation of veins and veinlets; petiole puberulous initially, 2.0-4.0 mm long. description: Shrub or tree 2.0-5.0, rarely up to 13.0 m tall, apparently unarmed. Branchlets puberulous at tips, early covered with brownish to whitish-grayish cork and rough by numerous roundish lenticels. Leaves elliptic to ovate or obovate, apex obtuse or sometimes rounded, rarely acute, base (sub)cuneate, (sub)coriaceous, glabrous, a little shining on both faces, with subserrate crenations mainly in the upper part of the lamina, (3.0-)4.5-6.0(-7.0) cm long, 2.5-3.5 cm broad, lateral nerves 7-9 pairs raised with the network of veins on both faces though more conspicuously so beneath; petiole 3.0-4.0 mm long, [male]: flowers 3-9 per axillary fascicle; pedicels slender, articulate at or slightly above base, glabrous, 5.0-8.0 mm long. Sepals (4-)5, orbicular-ovate, short-acuminate, glabrous, greenish-yellowish, ciliolate, 1.5-2.0 mm long. Stamens 10-17; filaments 3.0-5.0 mm long. description: Shrub or tree, 2.0-6.0, rarely -12.0 m high; trunk rarely up to 40.0 cm diam, usually armed with strong compound spines; branches with simple spines up to 4.5 cm long. Branchlets slender, flexuous, tips puberulous or glabrous, older parts whitish-grayish-corticate, laxly lenticellate; axillary spines up to 1.5 cm long. description: Much branched shrub or treelet 2.0-5.0 m tall; trunk spiny; bark grayish-brownish. Branchlets puberulent at tips, otherwise glabrous, often with robust axillary spines up to 5.0 cm long though generally unarmed in the youngest parts. Leaves (sub)persistent, variable in shape and size, ovate-elliptic to -oblong, sometimes almost rhombic-elliptic, apex broadly attenuate or subacuminate, tip obtuse to roundish, base cuneate to the petiole, (subcoriaceous, shining mainly above, remaining green-olivaceous in the dry state, bluntly glandular-crenate (1.0-1.5 mm), (4.0-)5.0-7.5(-9.0) cm long, 2.0-4.0 (-5.5) cm broad, lateral nerves 6-8 pairs, discolorous, subparallel to each other and rather steeply curved-ascending, forked before the margin, markedly raised on both faces as is the dense reticulation of veins and veinlets; petiole at least in some leaves of any specimen with 1 or generally 2 distinct gland(s) at the very base of the lamina or at apex of petiole, 3.0-5.0(-10.0) mm long. Flowers 4-10 per fascicle in the axils of foliate or already defoliate annotinous branchlets; bracts scarious, ovate, pubescent, 1.0-1.5 mm long; pedicels articulate more or less at middle, patently puberulous at least below, 2.0-3.0 mm long. Sepals 4 or 5, ovate-acuminate, bluntish, greenish-yellowish or whitish, pubescent to (sub)glabrous on both faces, ciliate, 2.0 mm long. Disk almost annular, formed by several reddish glands, [male]: stamens 15-20; filaments glabrous, 2.0-3.0 mm long. [female]: ovary ovoid, glabrous; style short, more pronounced in fruit (up to 1.0 mm); stigma 2 or 3 shortly bifid. Berry ovoid-subglobose, red, becoming blackish when dry, 4.0-5.0 mm diam; seeds 4 or 5, angular, 2.0-2.5 mm long.

description: Lianas, glabras; ramos novos subcilíndricos a subtetrangulares, estriado, esparso lenticelados ou verrucosos, secos castanhos, velhos cilíndricos, fissurados, lenticelados. Folhas opostas a subopostas; estípulas triangulares, denticuladas ou inteiras; pecíolos (4-)8-10(-16) mm; lâminas (3-)4.4-11.4(-13.4) × (1.6-)2.7-4.2(-8.4) cm, elípticas, base cuneada ou arredondada, margem crenulada ou obscuramente crenulada, levemente revoluta, ápice agudo ou acuminado, cartáceas, secas verdes, às vezes minutamente pontuadas na face abaxial, nervuras secas amareladas na face abaxial, promínulas em ambas as faces ou terciárias obscuras na face adaxial. Inflorescências (2.7-)3.2-4.7(-7.1) × (1.3-)1.5-4.5 cm, com 2-4(-35) flores, axilares; pedúnculos (7-)19-26(-35) mm, ramos opostos, subcilíndricos; brácteas denticuladas na base; pedicelos 4(-9) mm; bractéolas ausentes. Flores 8.5-10.3 mm diâm na antese, rotáceas; sépalas (1.7-)2(-2.9) × (1.5-)2.5-3(-3.4) mm, triangulares a transverso oblongas, erosas a inteiras, papiráceas; pétalas (3-)4.6(-5) × 3(-3.8) mm, rômbicas a transverso rômbicas, patentes, erosas, carnosas, amarelas, brancas, amarelo esverdeadas, secas ás vezes rajadas de marrom; disco 0.7-1.2 × 0.5-0.9 mm, anelar-pulviniforme, carnoso, verde; estames 3, ca 1.6 mm, filetes ca 1.3 mm, alargados na base, às vezes retorcidos, anteras ca 0.3 × 0.6 mm; ovário ca 1.2 mm diâm, estilete ca 1.4 mm, estigma pontual, óvulos por lóculo 6-8. Cápsulas 9.6-13.2 × 12.4 -13.2 cm, obinfundibuliformes, rugosas, mais ou menos pruinosas. Sementes 3.4-3.8 × 1.7-2.1 cm, elípticas ou subrômbicas, núcleo seminífero elipsóide, ala papirácea.

description: Árvores (6-)10-12(-24) m, arbustos, 1-6 m, ou lianas; ramos novos subcilíndricos, pubérulos a pubescentes, estriados, secos acinzentados, velhos glabrescentes, conspicuamente suberificados, extensamente fissurados, com lenticelas longas e conspícuas. Folhas opostas a subopostas; estípulas triangulares, pubérulas a esparso pubérulas, gibosas, denticuladas; pecíolos (1-)5-7(-12) mm, secos acinzentados; lâminas (1.8-) 7-8.7(-14.7) × (0.7-)2-4(-9) cm, elípticas a obovais, base arredondada ou cuneada, raro truncada ou reniforme, margem crenulada a obscuramente crenulada, ápice agudo, obtuso ou acuminado, cartáceas, glabras em ambas as faces, ou glabras na face ventral e esparso pubescentes ao longo das nervuras na face dorsal, secas castanhas ou verde-acinzentadas, nervuras secas acinzentadas, promínulas em ambas as faces. Inflorescências (1.3-)2-3.4(-8.1) × (0.5-)1-2(-5.5) cm, com 3-30 flores, axilares, às vezes compostas pela supressão de folhas nos nós; pedúnculos (6-)10-21(-39) mm, pubérulos a esparso pubérulos, ramos alternos, pubérulos a esparso pubérulos, subcilíndricos; brácteas triangulares, esparso pubérulas, denticuladas; pedicelos 1.4-5.5 mm, pubérulos; bractéolas 0-2. Flores 7.5-9 mm diâm na antese, rotáceas; sépalas 1-1.4 × 1.2-1.9 mm, triangulares, pubérulas, erosas, escariosas, carnosas, verdes com margem amarela; pétalas 4-4.7 × 2.4-3 mm, elípticas, patentes, inteiras, papilosas, glabras, carnosas, amarelas, amareladas, verde-amareladas, verdes e amarelas ou brancas no ápice; disco 0.8-1 × (0.3-)0.7-0.9 mm, pulviniforme a anelar-pulviniforme, glabro, carnoso; estames 3, 1.2-1.5 mm, amarelos, filetes 0.5-1 mm, alargados na base, anteras 0.5-0.6 × 0.75-0.8 mm, alaranjadas ou amarelas; ovário ca 1.1 mm diâm, estilete 0.7-1 mm, estigma pontual, óvulos por lóculo 6-7. Mericarpos (2.2-)4-6.2(-10.5) × (2.1-)4.8-5.4(-7.8) cm, elipsóides, estriados, pubérulos, esparso pubérulos ou glabros, lustrosos. Sementes (2-)2.9-4(-4.2) × (1-)1.3-1.6(-1.7) cm, elípticas, núcleo seminífero elipsóide, ala papirácea.

description: Lianas, arbustos ou árvores, glabros ou pilosos. Folhas opostas ou subopostas, venação broquidódroma; estípulas caducas; pecíolos canaliculados. Inflorescências dicásios compostos, multifloros, axilares ou falsamente terminais; pedúnculos e ramos subcilíndricos a tetrangulares; ramos opostos ou alternos, sujeitos por brácteas; estipetes florais cilíndricos, articulados; bractéolas basais. Flores 5-meras no perianto, rotáceas; sépalas livres, desiguais, pétalas patentes, levemente desiguais; disco pulviniforme ou anelar-pulviniforme, livre da parede do ovário; estames 3, inicialmente apressos ao estilete, depois reflexos, filetes achatados, alargados na base, adnatos à borda interna do disco, anteras oblongas, deiscência transversal; ovário 3-lobado, 3-locular, estilete conspícuo, seção triangular a subcilíndrica, estigma pontual, óvulos axilares. Cápsulas largo obinfundibuliformes, margem 3-lobada, loculicida por 3 fissuras medianas nos lobos, valvas caducas. Sementes aladas, elípticas ou subrômbicas, alas membranáceas, elípticas, espessadas na margem externa, mais longas que o núcleo seminífero.

description: Tree, dioecious, terrestrial, usually with stilt-roots; internodes (mostly) hollow; sap watery, turning black at exposure to the air. Leaves in spirals; lamina simple, peltate, radially veined and incised; petiole usually with one or two patches of dense indumentum of various trichomes (trichilia) at the base; stipules large, connate, fully amplexicaul, leaving circular scars. Inflorescences axillary, pedunculate digitate clusters of spikes, sometimes 1 spike, (usually) enclosed by a spathe until anthesis. Flowers unisexual, sessile (or short-pedicellate); tepals 2, rarely 3, mostly entirely connate, forming a tubular perianth with a narrow aperture; stamens 2, rarely 3, free; ovary free, stigma penicillate to peltate. Fruit a small achene, often tuberculate, fully enclosed by a fleshy perianth; seed with endosperm; embryo small, with flat cotyledons.

description: Hemi-epiphytic (or epiphytic) or terrestrial trees or shrubs with aerial roots or stilt-roots. Leaves in spirals, entire, venation pinnate to tri-nervate, margin entire to subcrenate, stipules fused, fully amplexicaul, usually leaving oblique scars. Inflorescences mostly in pairs in the leaf axils, branched or in pistillate ones often unbranched, bracteate (mostly only with interfloral bracts) or ebracteate. Flowers in globose (to ellipsoid or clavate) terminal heads, free or pistillate ones sometimes connate, perianth tubular, in staminate flowers (2-)3(-4)-lobed, in pistillate ones entire; stamens two or three and connate, or one; ovary free, stigma penicillate to subpeltate. Fruit a drupelet or almost an achene, enclosed in the enlarged ± fleshy perianth; seed with endosperm, embryo straight with flat and equal cotyledons and relatively short radicle.

description: Trees, terrestrial, often with stilt-roots. Leaves in spirals, entire or palmately incised, margin entire to subcrenate; stipules fused, fully amplexicaul. Inflorescences in the leaf axils, mostly in pairs, branched (or to subumbellate in pistillate inflorescences), mostly ebracteate, sometimes bracteate; staminate flowers sessile or pedicellate, tepals (3-)4, free or connate; stamens (3-)4, mostly free, sometimes connate; pistillate flowers pedicellate, perianth tubular; ovary free, stigma (sub)peltate or sometimes-knob-like. Fruit an achene, large, surrounded by the enlarged, more or less fleshy perianth with a purplish to blackish or red-brown outer layer at full maturity; seed without endosperm, embryo straight, cotyledons thick, radicle short.

description: Tree, to 20 m tall; branches (very) short and departing at angles of ca. 90° at the apex of the tree or longer and then departing in acute angles at the lower part of the tree. Leafy twigs 3-10 cm thick, blackish or reddish to green and then with a bluish waxy layer, densely (sub)hirsute or (sub)glabrous. Lamina coriaceous, ca. 25 × 25 cm to 95 × 95 cm; the segments 11-13, the upper ones in deeply incised laminas oblong (to subovate), the incisions down to 4/10 or to 8/10; apices acute to subacuminate; upper surface smooth, subglabrous or with ± dense arachnoid indumentum; lower surface rather sparsely to densely tomentose on the veins, arachnoid indumentum in the areoles and on the smaller veins or also on the main veins; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment 10-16 pairs, submarginally loop-connected, in the lower part often not distinctly so, often ± branched; petiole ca. 30-75 cm long, puberulous and with sparse to rather dense arachnoid indumentum or subglabrous; trichilia absent or present and fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with short to rather long white to pale brown (unicellular) hairs; stipules ca. (10-)25-45 cm long, red to pinkish, sometimes with a bluish waxy layer, with only moniliform brown pluricellular hairs outside, glabrous inside; terminal buds inflated. Staminate inflorescences in pairs, erect, usually subtended by pinkish or greenish, caducous bracts to 4 cm long, attached at or ca. 1 cm above the base of the peduncle; peduncle 3-7 cm long, (sub)glabrous; spathe ca. 4-10 cm long, yellowish to pinkish, with only moniliform brown pluricellular hairs outside, glabrous inside; spikes (7-) 15-24, 3.59 × 0.3-0.7 cm, sessile or with stipes 0.2-0.3 cm long and sparsely hairy; rachis hairy. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 1-1.5 mm long, sparsely and minutely puberulous on the lower part of the apex, the apex plane, ± clearly 2-lobed; filaments flat; anthers ca. 0.8 mm long, appendiculate, detached at anthesis, remaining attached to the filament by 2 filiform connections between the connective and the upper margin of the filament. Pistillate inflorescences in pairs, erect, usually subtended by pinkish, caducous bracts to 4 cm long, attached at or ca. 1 cm above the base of the peduncle; peduncle 1.5-2.5 (or to 14) cm long, subglabrous; spathe 5-11 cm long, the color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes 4-7(-9), 4-10 × 1-1.2 cm, to 15 × 2 cm in fruit, sessile; rachis glabrous. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 2 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, also in the lower part of the style channel inside, the apex ± convex, punctate to submuriculate; style rather long, straight, unilaterally hairy; stigma comose. Fruit oblongoid, ca. 2.5 mm long, ± tuberculate.

description: Tree, to 20 m tall. Leafy twigs 2-4 cm thick, bluish due to a waxy layer, glabrous; pith brown and copious. Lamina subcoriaceous to chartaceous, ca. 40 × 40 cm to 80 × 80 cm (to 130 × 130 cm), the segments 7-9, the free parts of upper segments elliptic to subobovate, the incisions down to 4/10-7/10 or in the lower part of the lamina <4/10; apices acuminate to obtuse; upper surface ± scabrous, sometimes ± bullate, hirtellous to puberulous to hispidulous subhirsute; lower surface hirtellous to subtomentose on the veins or the primary veins subglabrous, the arachnoid indumentum in the areoles, often very short and sparse or only near the margin, sometimes absent; lateral veins ca. 10-15 pairs, submarginally loop-connected, most of them branched; petiole 30-85 cm long, (sub)glabrous, often ± bluish due to a waxy layer; trichilia absent, or if present, then separate and usually poorly developed, the brown indumentum intermixed with dense short and rather long white hairs; stipules ca. 15-30 cm long, red to greenish, glabrous outside, hairy inside. Staminate inflorescences solitary or in pairs, the peduncle erect, the spikes pendulous; peduncle 6-10 cm long, glabrous or with sparse long white hairs, often bluish due to a waxy layer; spathe 18-30 cm long, green to yellowish or to pink, almost glabrous outside, densely (sub)sericeous inside; spikes 6-16, 9-27 × 0.3-0.6 cm, the stipes 0.6-1 cm long, glabrous; rachis with short hairs. Staminate flowers sessile or short-pedicellate; perianth tubular, 1.2-1.6 mm long, glabrous, the apex slightly convex to almost plane, slightly 2-lobed, smooth; filaments flat; anthers 0.6-0.8 mm long, appendiculate, detached at anthesis, reattached to the margins of the aperture by the appendages. Pistillate inflorescences solitary or in pairs, pendulous or the peduncle initially erect; peduncle 6-14 cm long, glabrous, often bluish due to a waxy layer; spathe ca. 15-22 cm long, the color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescences or glabrous inside; spikes (3 or) 4, 12-20 × 0.8-1 cm, to 35 × 1.2 cm in fruit, subsessile or with stipes to 1.5 cm long and glabrous; rachis hairy or glabrous. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 2 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, also in the style channel inside, the apex convex to dome-shaped, smooth; style short, hairy. Fruit ellipsoid to ovoid, ca. 1.2-1.5 mm long, smooth.

description: Tree, to 20 m tall. Leafy twigs 3-6 cm thick, green, puberulous to hispidulous, some of the hairs uncinate. Lamina (sub)coriaceous, ca. 55 × 55 cm to 100 × 100 cm (to 120 × 120 cm), the segments (8-)9-11, the free parts of upper segments obovate, the incisions down to ca. 7/10-9/10; apices obtuse to rounded; upper surface usually smooth, sometimes scabridulous, usually subglabrous or sometimes scabrous, initially often also with sparse arachnoid indumentum; lower surface puberulous on the veins, and with sparse longer uncinate hairs, with arachnoid indumentum in the areoles and on the smaller veins, or sometimes extending to the main veins; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment 15-20 pairs, submarginally loop-connected, unbranched or the lower ones branched; petiole 50-110 cm long, sparsely puberulous to hirtellous or toward the apex often densely hirtellous, or also with ± dense (± persisting) arachnoid indumentum; trichilia fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with short white hairs; stipules 12-20 cm long, color unknown, outside ± densely puberulous to hirtellous or sometimes also with arachnoid indumentum, inside (rather) sparsely hairy. Staminate inflorescences in pairs, the peduncle curved downward and the spikes pendulous at anthesis; peduncle (6-) 10-15 cm long, puberulous to hispidulous or also with arachnoid indumentum; spathe 12-16 cm long, color unknown, outside sparsely to rather densely puberulous to hirtellous or also with arachnoid indumentum, inside glabrous; spikes ca. 8-20, 4-14 × 0.3-0.6 cm long, ± angular; stipes 0.8-2 cm long, glabrous; rachis glabrous. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 1-2 mm long, sparsely minutely puberulous below the apex, the apex almost plane; anthers 0.6-0.8 mm long, appendiculate, detached at anthesis, reattached to the margins of the aperture by the appendages (?). Pistillate inflorescences in pairs or solitary, initially erect, in fruit pendulous; peduncle 3-14(-18) cm long, puberulous to hispidulous; spathe 6-13 cm long, the color unknown, puberulous to hirtellous, or also with ± dense arachnoid indumentum outside, glabrous inside; spikes (2-)4(-6), (3-)7-9 × 0.4-0.6 cm, to 16 × 1.2 cm in fruit, subsessile or with stipes to 0.6 cm long and subglabrous; rachis hairy. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 1.5 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex, also below the style channel inside, the apex convex, glabrous and smooth or muriculate; style short; stigma comose. Fruit oblongoid, ca. 2.5 mm long, tuberculate.
bibliographicCitation: Berg, Cornelius C. & Franco Rosselli, Pilar. 2005. Cecropia. Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 94: 1--230.

description: Tree, to 20(-25) m tall. Leafy twigs (1-)2-5 cm thick, green to brownish to often (turning) blackish, hispidulous to hirtellous to strigose to subvelutinous or to villous, usually also with dense brown to blackish pluricellular hairs, sometimes also with arachnoid indumentum; internodes with sparse (whitish) pith or sometimes partly to entirely filled with brown pith. Lamina chartaceous to coriaceous, ca. (20 × 20 cm to) 45 × 45 cm to 75 × 75 cm (to 90 × 90 cm), the segments (8-) 10-14, in young leaves often reflexed, the free parts of upper segments (ob)lanceolate to oblong to subobovate, the incisions down to (5/10-) 6/10-9/10 (or to near the petiole); apices obtuse to rounded or subacute to short-acuminate; upper surface scabrous or smooth, densely to sparsely hispidulous or puberulous or partly to hirtellous or to (sub)strigillose, also with ± dense brown pluricellular hairs and sometimes sparse arachnoid indumentum, the "umbilicus" sometimes villous; lower surface sparsely to densely (minutely) puberulous (with straight to uncinate hairs) to hirtellous to subtomentose or to subhirsute on the (main) veins, with arachnoid indumentum confined to the areoles, extending to the smaller veins, or (almost) absent; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment (12-)15-35(-43) pairs, submarginally or marginally loop-connected, branched or unbranched; petiole 20-70 cm long, sparsely to densely puberulous to hirtellous to sub-hirsute or to villous, or sometimes also with sparse to dense arachnoid indumentum; trichilia fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with short (or sometimes rather long) white to brownish (unicellular) hairs; stipules 6-25(-30) cm long, caducous or subpersistent, green to yellowish, reddish to purplish, brownish or black, sparsely to densely white to brownish puberulous to hirtellous or partly to largely subhirsute to sericeous to subvelutinous or to villous, also with ± dense brown pluricellular hairs outside, sparsely to densely white- to pale brown-sericeous (or glabrous) inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs, erect, often subtended by subpersistent bracts, to 5 cm long; peduncle 1-8(-12) cm long, puberulous to sub-hispid to hirtellous to subhirsute or to subvelutinous and often (initially) with dense brown pluricellular hairs and often also sparse arachnoid indumentum, sometimes subglabrous; spathe 4-14 cm long, greenish to yellowish to brownish or reddish to purplish, densely white- to brownish-puberulous to -hirtellous or partly to -subhirsute to -strigose or to villous and with dense brown pluricellular hairs or also with sparse to rather dense arachnoid indumentum outside, sparsely to densely (sub)sericeous or glabrous inside; spikes 10-25(-50), (1.5-)3-l 1(-13) × 0.3-0.8 cm, sessile or with stipes to 0.7(-1.2) cm long, (sub)glabrous to puberulous to hirtellous; rachis hairy (or glabrous). Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 12 mm long, with short and stiff hairs on the ribs, arachnoid indumentum below the apex, or glabrous, the apex plane to convex, smooth or muriculate, the aperture circular or slit-shaped; filaments flat or ± swollen; anthers 0.5-0.9 mm long, appendiculate or not, detached and reattached to the margins of the aperture by the appendages or remaining attached to the filament at anthesis. Pistillate inflorescences in pairs, erect, often subtended by subpersistent bracts, to 3 cm long; peduncle 1-8(-12) cm long, the indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spathe 3-6(-8) cm long, color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes 3-8(-12), 1-7 × 0.4-0.8 cm, to 17 X 0.8-2 cm in fruit, often broadened toward the base, sessile; rachis hairy (or glabrous). Pistillate flowers: perianth 1.5-2.5 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, also in the lower part of and/or below the style channel inside, the apex convex to almost plane, muriculate to minutely hispidulous or glabrous, the aperture circular or slitshaped; style rather short; stigma comose. Fruit ellipsoid to oblongoid to ovoid 1.5-2.5 mm long, tuberculate or smooth.

description: Tree, to 25 m tall; trunk with prominent (annular) scars of the stipules. Leafy twigs 2-4.5 cm thick, (dark) green, hispidulous with curved to uncinate hairs. Lamina subcoriaceous to coriaceous, ca. 30 × 30 cm to 75 × 75 cm, the segments 8-10, the free parts of the upper segments obovate to elliptic, the upper ones sometimes slightly lobate, the incisions down to 6/10-8/10(-9/10); apices obtuse; upper surface smooth to scabridulous, sparsely to rather densely minutely puberulous to strigillose on the (main) veins, initially also with sparse arachnoid indumentum; lower surface sparsely puberulous to strigillose with straight, curved, or uncinate hairs on the (main) veins, with arachnoid indumentum (almost) confined to the areoles or almost absent; lateral veins 11-16(-20) pairs, marginally loop-connected, the lower ones branched; petiole ca. 25-70 cm long sparsely (minutely) puberulous and also with sparse arachnoid indumentum; trichilia fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with (rather) short white hairs; stipules 12-20(-28) cm long, orange-red to pinkish or partly whitish, caducous, (appressed-)puberulous to hirtellous, or on the ribs to subhirsute, also with dense arachnoid indumentum and rather dense brown pluricellular hairs outside, ± densely hairy inside. Staminate inflorescences solitary or in pairs, the peduncle erect, the spikes ± spreading to pendulous; peduncle 9-13 cm long, with sparse arachnoid indumentum and brown pluricellular hairs; spathe 12-15 cm long, white, with dense arachnoid indumentum and sparse brown pluricellular hairs outside, glabrous or sparsely hairy inside; spikes ca. 10-25, 6-17 × ca. 0.3 cm (yellow to pale orange), with stipes 0.8-1.3 cm long and sparsely puberulous in the upper part; rachis hairy. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 1-1.5 mm long, glabrous, the apex slightly convex, smooth; filaments flat; anthers ca. 0.8 mm long, appendiculate, detached at anthesis (?). Pistillate inflorescences solitary or in pairs, pendulous; peduncle 9.5-19 cm long, sparsely puberulous to hirtellous (to subhispid); spathe not seen; spikes 4-5(-6), 9-17 × (0.5-)0.7-0.8 cm, sessile or with stipes to 0.5 cm long and minutely puberulous; rachis hairy. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 1.5-2 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex or also on the margin of the apex outside, also below the style channel inside, the apex ± convex, punctate to muriculate; style rather short; stigma tongue-shaped to subpeltate. Fruit ellipsoid, ca. 1.8 mm long, smooth.

description: Tree, to 20 m tall. Leafy twigs 2-4 cm thick, densely white to brownish villous to subsericeous or to subhirsute; internodes entirely or partly filled with brown pith. Lamina subcoriaceous (when dry often brittle), ca. 30 × 30 cm to 70 × 70 cm, the segments 7-9, the free parts of the upper segments elliptic to obovate, the incisions in the upper part of the lamina down to 5/10-6/10, the lower part of the lamina lobed; apices (of the upper segments) acuminate; upper surface smooth, bullate, (sub)glabrous; lower surface with concave areoles, ± densely (sub)hirsute to hirtellous to subtomentose or sparsely hirtellous to puberulous (to subglabrous) on the veins, on the main veins often also with elongate brown pluricellular hairs, with (sparse) arachnoid indumentum in the areoles, mostly extending to the reticulum or also dense arachnoid indumentum largely covering the area between the secondary veins, often extending to the main veins; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment 10-20 pairs, submarginally loop-connected, unbranched (or the lower ones branched); petiole ca. 40-55 cm long, puberulous to hirtellous or also whitish to brownish hirsute to (sub)villous, often also with rather dense arachnoid indumentum (or subglabrous); trichilia fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with sparse short whitish to brownish (unicellular) hairs; stipules (8-)20-36 cm long, pink to dull red, densely whitish to brownish villous to subhirsute to subsericeous or also with short arachnoid indumentum outside, sparsely hairy to glabrous inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs or solitary, the peduncle erect, the spikes erect to ± spreading; peduncle ca. 6.5 cm long, white-hirsute; spathe pink to dull red, ± densely villous to subhirsute to hirtellous outside, glabrous inside; spikes 4-10, 6-15 × 0.7-0.8 cm, with stipes 0.3-1.5 cm long and subsericeous or with arachnoid indumentum; rachis hairy. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, ca. 2 mm long, glabrous or puberulous below the apex, the apex plane to slightly convex, hispidulous to muriculate; filaments swollen; anthers 0.5-0.7 mm long, appendiculate, remaining attached to the filament at anthesis (?) Pistillate inflorescences (usually) solitary, erect at anthesis to pendulous in fruit; peduncle ca. 5-12 cm long, at least in the upper part or the lower part hirsute to sub villous, also with short hairs and/or sparse arachnoid indumentum; spathe 10-14 cm long, the color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes 2 or 1, 8-12 × ca. 1 cm, to 21 × ca. 2-3.5 cm in fruit, subsessile or with stipes ca. 0.5 cm long and hirtellous to hirsute; rachis hairy. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 4-5 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex, sometimes also sparsely in the style channel inside, sometimes also short stiff hairs just below the apex outside, the apex slightly convex, muriculate to smooth or hispidulous around the aperture; style rather long, straight, hairy; stigma penicillate. Fruit oblongoid, ca. 3 mm long, smooth.

description: Tree, to 22 m tall. Leafy twigs 2-3.5 cm thick, whitish (due to the indumentum), green, white- to brownish-subvillous to -subhirsute to -hirtellous, sometimes only near the scars of the stipules, also with dense arachnoid indumentum and brown pluricellular hairs. Lamina (sub)coriaceous, ca. 50 × 50 cm to 60 × 60 cm, the segments 7-10, the free parts of upper segments elliptic to oblong, the incisions in the upper part of the lamina down to ca. 6/10, apices acuminate; upper surface (almost) smooth, rather sparsely puberulous to hirtellous, also sparse arachnoid indumentum; lower surface rather sparsely sub-villous to subhirsute to hirtellous on the veins, with arachnoid indumentum in the areoles, extending to the main veins, on the main veins also brown pluricellular hairs, most densely near the petiole; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment ca. 15-20 pairs, submarginally loop-connected, mostly unbranched; petiole ca. 25-55 cm long, white subvillous to subhirsute and with dense arachnoid indumentum; trichilia fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with short and (partly with) long white hairs, the Mullerian bodies pinkish; stipules 15-32 cm long, subpersistent, pinkish, densely (sub)villous, also with dense arachnoid indumentum and brown pluricellular hairs outside, sparsely to (partly) densely hairy inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs, erect, or the spikes ± spreading; peduncle ca. 3-6 cm, white, subhirsute to hirtellous and with dense arachnoid indumentum; spathe ca. 12-15 cm long, white, (sub)villous, with dense arachnoid indumentum and with brown pluricellular hairs outside, inside hairy; spikes 7-8, 15-17 × 0.6-0.8 cm, before anthesis yellow, at anthesis green, with stipes 0.5-1 cm long and hirtellous; rachis hairy with stiff and crinkled (arachnoid) hairs. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 1.8-2 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex, the apex plane, sparsely muriculate; anthers ca. 0.8 mm long, with short appendages, detached at anthesis, remaining attached to the filament by 2 filiform connections between the connective and the upper margin of the filament. Pistillate inflorescences in pairs or solitary, erect to ± spreading with the spikes straight to curved upward, subtended by whitish, caducous bracts, to 3 cm long; peduncle ca. 7-10 cm long, the indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spathe 10-12 cm long, pinkish, the indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes 4, 4-12 × ca. 0.4-0.5, to 15 × 1 cm in fruit, subsessile or with stipes to 0.4 cm long with dense arachnoid indumentum; rachis hairy with stiff and crinkled hairs. Pistillate flowers: flowers often basally connate; perianth ca. 2.5 mm long, with arachnoid hairs below the apex outside, and below the style channel inside, the apex plane to slightly convex and muriculate; style short; stigma comose. Fruit ellipsoid to oblongoid, ca. 1.5-2 cm long, (almost) smooth.

description: Tree, to 15 m tall; stem with prominent stipular scars. Leafy twigs 1.5-4 cm thick, green with yellow spots to purplish-brown, hispidulous, with curved or uncinate hairs, or also with sparse to rather dense arachnoid indumentum. Lamina subcoriaceous to chartaceous, ca. 30 × 30 cm to 65 × 65 cm, the segments (7-)8-10(-11), the free parts of the upper segments oblong to subobovate to oblanceolate, entire or ± sinuate (or if juvenile, then to lobate), the incisions down to 1.5(-2.5) cm from the petiole; apices short-acuminate to (sub)acute to obtuse; upper surface smooth to scabridulous, sparsely puberulous to sub-hispidulous, also with sparse to rather dense arachnoid indumentum, along the main veins often with brown pluricellular hairs; lower surface minutely puberulous on the main veins, with arachnoid indumentum in the areoles, on the smaller veins, or, at least initially, also on the main veins; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment 16-24 (or if juvenile to 30) pairs, marginally loop-connected, mostly branched; petiole 25-50 cm long, sparsely puberulous and/or with sparse to (rather) dense arachnoid indumentum; trichilia fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with (sparse) short white hairs; stipules 7-15 cm long, white to pale yellow or pinkish, caducous or subpersistent, puberulous or sparsely sericeous, often with ± dense arachnoid indumentum, sometimes (also) with ± dense brown pluricellular hairs outside, ± densely sericeous inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs or solitary, pendulous; peduncle (3.5-) 10-19 cm long, sparsely puberulous to hirtellous and with sparse to rather dense arachnoid indumentum; spathe 10-20 cm long, white to yellowish or pinkish, puberulous to hirtellous and often with dense arachnoid indumentum outside, glabrous or (densely) sericeous inside; spikes (8-) 15-20, (1-)6-15 × 0.2-0.4 cm, with stipes 0.2-2 cm long and hairy or subglabrous; rachis hairy. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 0.8-1.5 mm long, glabrous, the apex almost plane; filaments slightly swollen; anthers 0.5-0.6 mm long, appendiculate, detached at anthesis, reattached at the margins of the aperture by the appendages (?). Pistillate inflorescences in pairs or solitary, pendulous; peduncle (3.5-) 10-22 cm long, puberulous to hirtellous and with sparse to rather dense arachnoid indumentum; spathe 10-17 cm long, the color and indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence; spikes 4, (2-) 5-18 × 0.4-1 cm, to 29 × 1-1.5 cm in fruit, sessile or with stipes to 1(-1.5) cm long and hairy: rachis hairy. Pistillate flowers: perianth 1.5-2.5 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum on and below the apex, absent inside, the apex plane; style short; stigma (sub)peltate. Fruit ellipsoid to ovoid to oblongoid, 1.5-2.5 mm long, ± tuberculate.

description: Tree, to 30 m tall. Leafy twigs 1.5-6 cm thick, dark green to red-brown to blackish, hispidulous to puberulous to subhirtellous, partly with uncinate hairs. Lamina (sub)coriaceous, ca. 20 × 20 cm to 85 × 85 cm, the segments (5-)7-10(-12), the free parts of upper segments obovate to subobovate, the incisions down to 6/10-9/10; apices acute to acuminate or to rounded; upper surface smooth (to scabridulous), puberulous (to hispidulous), initially often also sparse with arachnoid indumentum; lower surface (minutely) puberulous (with uncinate hairs) on the (main) veins, sometimes also with sparse longer uncinate hairs, with arachnoid indumentum in the areoles, sometimes sparse (to nearly absent), sometimes (initially) also on the main veins; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment 12-18(-25) pairs, usually marginally or sometimes submarginally loop-connected, most (or some) of them branched; petiole 15-60 cm long, sparsely puberulous, sometimes (initially) also with arachnoid indumentum, or subglabrous; trichilia fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with short white (to brownish unicellular) hairs; stipules (6-) 1025 cm long, dark red-brown to brown or to bright red, densely to sparsely puberulous or also with arachnoid indumentum outside, sparsely hairy to subglabrous inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs, the peduncle erect (or slightly deflexed), the spikes erect to ± spreading (or to pendulous); peduncle 2-12(-15) cm long, often at the apex ± strongly broadened, sparsely hispidulous to hirtellous; spathe (7-)10-18 cm long, dark red-brown to red, densely to sparsely puberulous to hirtellous or also with sparse to rather dense arachnoid indumentum outside, glabrous inside; spikes (8-) 15-25(-50), (0.5-)6-14 × 0.3-0.4 or 0.5-1 cm, ± angular, (sometimes green just before anthesis), the stipes 0.3-1.5 cm long, puberulous, sometimes only with brown pluricellular hairs, or glabrous; rachis hairy or glabrous. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, ca. 1-1.5 mm long, with sparse straight hairs and/or sparse to rather dense arachnoid indumentum below the apex, the apex slightly convex to plane, muriculate or (also) with sparse brown pluricellular hairs; filaments swollen; anthers 0.6-0.7 mm long, detached at anthesis (?). Pistillate inflorescences in pairs or solitary, erect or deflexed to pendulous in fruit; peduncle (2-)5-13 cm long, hispidulous to hirtellous; spathe dark red-brown to red, 6-15 cm long, densely to sparsely puberulous to hirtellous or also with arachnoid indumentum outside, glabrous inside; spikes 2-4, (3-)8-15 × 0.6-0.8 or ca. 2.5 cm, to 22 × 1.5(-2) cm or to 38 × 4 cm in fruit, sessile or with stipes to 0.5 cm long and subglabrous; rachis glabrous or sparsely hairy. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 1.5-3.5 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex, also in the lower part of style channel inside, the apex plane with (a rim around) a circular aperture or strongly convex with a slit-shaped aperture, muriculate to smooth; style long; stigma comose. Fruit ellipsoid to oblongoid, 2.5-4.5 mm long, tuberculate or smooth.

description: Tree, to 15 m tall. Leafy twigs 2-9(-15) cm thick, purplish brown, puberulous to hispidulous, with straight hairs and also dense brown pluricellular trichomes. Lamina chartaceous to subcoriaceous, ca. 30 × 30 cm to 90 × 90 cm (to 105 × 105 cm), the segments (8-) 10-16, oblanceolate, the incisions down to 7/10-9/10; apices subacute to acuminate; upper surface ± scabrous, hispidulous; lower surface puberulous to subtomentellous to subtomentose on the smaller veins to almost glabrous on the main veins, with arachnoid indumentum in the areoles and on the smaller veins; lateral veins in the free part of the midsegment (18-)20-25(-40) pairs, submarginally (in the lower part of the segment faintly) loop-connected, unbranched; petiole 20-80(-105) cm long, sparsely puberulous to hispidulous to subglabrous; trichilia fused, the brown indumentum intermixed with short white hairs; stipules ca. (10-)20-40 cm long, red-brown to greenish, sparsely strigillose and with dense brown pluricellular trichomes or also with arachnoid indumentum outside, (sparsely) sericeous inside. Staminate inflorescences in pairs, the peduncle erect, the spikes ± spreading to pendulous; peduncle ca. 7-25 cm long, hirtellous to subhirsute; spathe at least 15 cm long, color unknown, densely brownish to whitish subhirtellous to subsericeous outside, ± sparsely hairy inside; spikes 13-25, 18-27 × ca. 0.40.6 cm, the stipes 0.4-1 cm and glabrous or sparsely hairy; rachis sparsely hairy. Staminate flowers: perianth tubular, 1.5-2 mm long, with sparse to dense short arachnoid indumentum below the apex, the apex slightly convex to plane, punctate to smooth, or initially also with brown pluricellular trichomes; filaments flat; anthers ca. 0.6-0.8 mm long, without appendages, remaining attached to the filaments at anthesis. Pistillate inflorescences in pairs or solitary, erect to spreading to subpendulous in fruit; peduncle (10-)20-25 cm long, sparsely to rather densely hirtellous to subhirsute; spathe at least 20 cm long, the color unknown, the indumentum as in the staminate inflorescence or more densely hairy inside; spikes 4-9, ca. 25-40 × 1 cm, to 47 × 1.5 cm in fruit, the stipes 0.3-1.5 cm long and glabrous; rachis glabrous. Pistillate flowers: perianth ca. 1.5-2 mm long, with arachnoid indumentum below the apex outside, absent inside, the apex convex, punctate to muriculate, the aperture slit-shaped; style long, straight; stigma comose. Fruit ellipsoid to oblongoid, 2-2.5 mm long, tuberculate, brown.
